व्यापिनी सर्वभूतानां सूक्ष्मात्सूक्ष्मतरा स्मृता .
अक्षया ह्यमृता ह्येषा स्वर्गसोपानमुत्तमा .. 9.48 ..
6.3.m: She pervades all beings, considered subtler than the subtle, / imperishable and immortal, an excellent stairway to heaven,

6.3.s: sṛṣṭā rudreṇa lokānāṃ saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī .. 9.49 ..
6.3.d: सृष्टा रुद्रेण लोकानां संसारार्णवतारिणी .. 9.49 ..
6.3.m: created by Rudra to carry the worlds across the ocean of worldly existence.

6.3.s:
sarijjalaṃ ye'pi pibanti loke mucyanti te pāpaviśeṣasaṅghaiḥ .
vrajanti saṃsāramanādibhāvaṃ tyaktvā ciraṃ mokṣapadaṃ viśuddham .. 9.50 ..
6.3.d:
सरिज्जलं येऽपि पिबन्ति लोके मुच्यन्ति ते पापविशेषसङ्घैः .
व्रजन्ति संसारमनादिभावं त्यक्त्वा चिरं मोक्षपदं विशुद्धम् .. 9.50 ..
6.3.m: Those who drink the water of the river in the world are freed from multitudes of distinct sins; / abandoning the beginningless state of worldly existence, they go for a long time to the pure station of liberation.

6.3.s:
yathā gaṅgā tathā revā tathā caiva sarasvatī .
samaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ proktaṃ snānadarśanacintanaiḥ .. 9.51 ..
6.3.d:
यथा गङ्गा तथा रेवा तथा चैव सरस्वती .
समं पुण्यफलं प्रोक्तं स्नानदर्शनचिन्तनैः .. 9.51 ..
6.3.m: As is the Gaṅgā, so is the Revā, and even so is the Sarasvatī; / equal holy fruit is declared through ritual ablution, darśana, and contemplation.

6.3.s:
varadānānmahābhāgā hyadhikā cocyate budhaiḥ .
kāruṇyāntarabhāvena na mṛtā samupāgatā .. 9.52 ..
6.3.d:
वरदानान्महाभागा ह्यधिका चोच्यते बुधैः .
कारुण्यान्तरभावेन न मृता समुपागता .. 9.52 ..
6.3.m: Because of a boon granted, she is highly fortunate and said by the wise to be superior; / having not died due to compassion within, she arrived.

6.3.s:
mucyante darśanāttena pātakaiḥ snānamaṅgalaiḥ .
narmadāyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ye namanti trilocanam .. 9.53 ..
6.3.d:
मुच्यन्ते दर्शनात्तेन पातकैः स्नानमङ्गलैः .
नर्मदायां नृपश्रेष्ठ ये नमन्ति त्रिलोचनम् .. 9.53 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, by darśana and by the blessings of ritual ablution, they are freed from sins, / O best of kings, who bow to the Three-Eyed One at the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
umārudrāṅgasambhūtā yena caiṣā mahānadī .
lokānprāpayate svargaṃ tena puṇyatvamāgatā .. 9.54 ..
6.3.d:
उमारुद्राङ्गसम्भूता येन चैषा महानदी .
लोकान्प्रापयते स्वर्गं तेन पुण्यत्वमागता .. 9.54 ..
6.3.m: Because this great river was born from the body of Umā and Rudra / and leads the worlds to heaven, she has attained holiness.

6.3.s:
ya evamīśānavarasya dehaṃ vibhajya devīmiha saṃśṛṇoti .
sa yāti rudraṃ mahatāraveṇa gandharvayakṣairiva gīyamānaḥ .. 9.55 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadotpattitatsnānaphalādikathanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 10
6.3.d:
य एवमीशानवरस्य देहं विभज्य देवीमिह संशृणोति .
स याति रुद्रं महतारवेण गन्धर्वयक्षैरिव गीयमानः .. 9.55 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये नर्मदोत्पत्तितत्स्नानफलादिकथनं नाम नवमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 10
6.3.m:
Whoever, thus dividing the body of the supreme Lord, hears of the goddess here, / goes to Rudra with a great sound, sung of, as it were, by Gandharvas and Yakṣas.
Thus ends the ninth chapter, titled “Account of the Origin of Narmadā, the Fruit of Bathing Therein, and Other Matters,” in the Narmadāmāhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa in the fifth Āvantyakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 10

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kasminkalpe mahābhāgā narmadeyaṃ dvijottama .
vibhaktā ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaistapoyuktairmahātmabhiḥ .. 10.1 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कस्मिन्कल्पे महाभागा नर्मदेयं द्विजोत्तम .
विभक्ता ऋषिभिः सर्वैस्तपोयुक्तैर्महात्मभिः .. 10.1 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / In which kalpa, O best of the twice-born, was this illustrious Narmadā / divided by all the magnanimous ṛṣis endowed with austerity?

6.3.s:
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara .
kalpānte yadbhavetkaṣṭaṃ lokānāṃ tattvameva ca .. 10.2 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं ब्रूहि मे वदतां वर .
कल्पान्ते यद्भवेत्कष्टं लोकानां तत्त्वमेव च .. 10.2 ..
6.3.m: Tell me all this in detail, O best of speakers, / as well as the distress that befalls the worlds at the end of a kalpa, and the truth of it.

6.3.s:
atīte tu purā kalpe yatheyaṃ vartate'nagha .
asyāntyasya ca kalpasya vyavasthāṃ kathaya prabho .
evamuktaḥ sabhāmadhye mārkaṇḍo vākyamabravīt .. 10.3 ..
6.3.d:
अतीते तु पुरा कल्पे यथेयं वर्ततेऽनघ .
अस्यान्त्यस्य च कल्पस्य व्यवस्थां कथय प्रभो .
एवमुक्तः सभामध्ये मार्कण्डो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 10.3 ..
6.3.m: In a kalpa passed long ago, as she existed, O sinless one, / tell me, O Lord, of the state of this final kalpa. / Addressed thus in the midst of the assembly, Mārkaṇḍeya spoke:

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
vakṣye'haṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvaiḥ katheyaṃ pūrvataḥ śrutā .. 10.4 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
वक्ष्येऽहं श्रूयतां सर्वैः कथेयं पूर्वतः श्रुता .. 10.4 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I shall speak; let everyone hear this story heard previously.

6.3.s:
mahatkatheyaṃ vaiśiṣṭī kalpādasmātparaṃ tu yā .
lokakṣayakaro ghora āsītkālaḥ sudāruṇaḥ .. 10.5 ..
6.3.d:
महत्कथेयं वैशिष्टी कल्पादस्मात्परं तु या .
लोकक्षयकरो घोर आसीत्कालः सुदारुणः .. 10.5 ..
6.3.m: This is a great, distinguished tale, concerning what came after this kalpa: / there was a dreadful, most terrible time bringing destruction to the worlds.

6.3.s:
tasminnapi mahāghore yatheyaṃ vā mṛtā satī .
parituṣṭairvibhaktā ca śṛṇudhvaṃ tāṃ kathāmimām .. 10.6 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिन्नपि महाघोरे यथेयं वा मृता सती .
परितुष्टैर्विभक्ता च शृणुध्वं तां कथामिमाम् .. 10.6 ..
6.3.m: Hear this story of how, even in that terrifying time, she did not die, being virtuous, / and was divided by those who were satisfied.

6.3.s:
yugānte samanuprāpte pitāmahadinatraye .
mānasā brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sākṣādbrahmeva sattamāḥ .. 10.7 ..
6.3.d:
युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते पितामहदिनत्रये .
मानसा ब्रह्मणः पुत्राः साक्षाद्ब्रह्मेव सत्तमाः .. 10.7 ..
6.3.m: When the end of a yuga had arrived during the three days of the Grandfather, / the mind-born sons of Brahmā, being best of beings, like Brahmā in visible form,

6.3.s:
sanakādyā mahātmāno ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ .
yamendravaruṇādyāśca lokapālā dinatraye .. 10.8 ..
6.3.d:
सनकाद्या महात्मानो ये च वैमानिका गणाः .
यमेन्द्रवरुणाद्याश्च लोकपाला दिनत्रये .. 10.8 ..
6.3.m: Sanaka and the other magnanimous ones, and those hosts who travel in aerial chariots, / and the world protectors Yama, Indra, Varuṇa, and others, during the three days,

6.3.s:
kālāpekṣāstu tiṣṭhanti lokavṛttāntatatparāḥ .
tataḥ kalpakṣaye prāpte teṣāṃ jñānamanuttamam .. 10.9 ..
6.3.d:
कालापेक्षास्तु तिष्ठन्ति लोकवृत्तान्ततत्पराः .
ततः कल्पक्षये प्राप्ते तेषां ज्ञानमनुत्तमम् .. 10.9 ..
6.3.m: awaiting the time, intent upon the events of the worlds; / then, when the destruction of the kalpa arrived, their unequalled knowledge [remained].

6.3.s:
sarveṣāṃ naśyate cāyuryugarūpānusārataḥ .
bhūrlokaṃ te parityajya agamaṃśca bhuvaṃ tadā .. 10.10 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषां नश्यते चायुर्युगरूपानुसारतः .
भूर्लोकं ते परित्यज्य अगमंश्च भुवं तदा .. 10.10 ..
6.3.m: The lifespan of all perished according to the nature of the yuga; / leaving the Bhūrloka, they then went to Bhuvarloka,

6.3.s:
svarlokaṃ ca mahaścaiva janaścaiva tapastadā .
āśrayaṃ satyalokaṃ ca sarvalokamanuttamam .. 10.11 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्लोकं च महश्चैव जनश्चैव तपस्तदा .
आश्रयं सत्यलोकं च सर्वलोकमनुत्तमम् .. 10.11 ..
6.3.m: and Svarloka, and Maharloka, Janaloka, and Tapoloka; / then they sought refuge in Satyaloka, the highest of all worlds.

6.3.s:
kālaṃ yugasahasrāntaṃ putrapautrasamanvitāḥ .
satyaloke ca tiṣṭhanti yāvatsaṃjāyate jagat .. 10.12 ..
6.3.d:
कालं युगसहस्रान्तं पुत्रपौत्रसमन्विताः .
सत्यलोके च तिष्ठन्ति यावत्संजायते जगत् .. 10.12 ..
6.3.m: For a time up to the end of a thousand yugas, accompanied by sons and grandsons, / they remain in Satyaloka until the universe is generated.

6.3.s:
brahmaputrāśca ye kecitkalpādau na bhavanti ha .
trailokyaṃ te parityajya anādhāraṃ bhavanti ca .. 10.13 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मपुत्राश्च ये केचित्कल्पादौ न भवन्ति ह .
त्रैलोक्यं ते परित्यज्य अनाधारं भवन्ति च .. 10.13 ..
6.3.m: And whichever sons of Brahmā do not appear at the beginning of the kalpa, / they abandon the three worlds and become without support.

6.3.s:
taiḥ sārdhaṃ ye tu te viprā anye cāpi tapodhanāḥ .
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca anye vaimānikā gaṇāḥ .. 10.14 ..
6.3.d:
तैः सार्धं ये तु ते विप्रा अन्ये चापि तपोधनाः .
यक्षरक्षःपिशाचाश्च अन्ये वैमानिका गणाः .. 10.14 ..
6.3.m: Together with them, those brahmins and other ascetics, / yakṣas, rakṣasas, piśācas, and other hosts traveling in aerial chariots,

6.3.s:
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā varṇāścānye pṛthagvidhāḥ .
sīdanti bhūmyāṃ sahitā ye cānye talavāsinaḥ .. 10.15 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषयश्च महाभागा वर्णाश्चान्ये पृथग्विधाः .
सीदन्ति भूम्यां सहिता ये चान्ये तलवासिनः .. 10.15 ..
6.3.m: and the illustrious ṛṣis, and others of various classes, / and those others dwelling in the lower regions, all perish together on the earth.

6.3.s:
anāvṛṣṭirabhūttatra mahatī śatavārṣikī .
lokakṣayakarī raudrā vṛkṣavīrudvināśinī .. 10.16 ..
6.3.d:
अनावृष्टिरभूत्तत्र महती शतवार्षिकी .
लोकक्षयकरी रौद्रा वृक्षवीरुद्विनाशिनी .. 10.16 ..
6.3.m: There was a great drought of a hundred years, / bringing destruction to the worlds, fierce, destroying trees and shrubs,

6.3.s:
trailokyasaṃkṣobhakarī saptārṇavaviśoṣaṇī .
tato lokāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭā bhramantīva diśo daśa .. 10.17 ..
6.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यसंक्षोभकरी सप्तार्णवविशोषणी .
ततो लोकाः क्षुधाविष्टा भ्रमन्तीव दिशो दश .. 10.17 ..
6.3.m: agitating the three worlds, drying up the seven oceans; / then the people, seized by hunger, wander as it were in the ten directions.

6.3.s:
kaṃdairmūlaiḥ phalairvāpi vartayante suduḥkhitāḥ .
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ kūpāḥ sevante pāvanāni ca .. 10.18 ..
6.3.d:
कंदैर्मूलैः फलैर्वापि वर्तयन्ते सुदुःखिताः .
सरितः सागराः कूपाः सेवन्ते पावनानि च .. 10.18 ..
6.3.m: Deeply distressed, they subsisted on bulbs, roots, or fruits; / they frequented rivers, oceans, wells, and purifying waters.

6.3.s:
tatrāpi sarve śuṣyanti saridbhiḥ saha sāgarāḥ .
tato yānyalpasārāṇi sattvāni pṛthivītale .. 10.19 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रापि सर्वे शुष्यन्ति सरिद्भिः सह सागराः .
ततो यान्यल्पसाराणि सत्त्वानि पृथिवीतले .. 10.19 ..
6.3.m: Even there, all of them dried up, the oceans along with the rivers. / Then, whatever beings on the surface of the earth had little strength,

6.3.s:
tānyevāgre pralīyante bhinnānyurujalena vai .
atha saṃkṣīyamāṇāsu saritsu saha sāgaraiḥ .. 10.20 ..
6.3.d:
तान्येवाग्रे प्रलीयन्ते भिन्नान्युरुजलेन वै .
अथ संक्षीयमाणासु सरित्सु सह सागरैः .. 10.20 ..
6.3.m: perished first of all, bereft of abundant water. / Then, as the rivers along with the oceans were drying up,

6.3.s:
ṛṣīṇāṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ kurukṣetranivāsinām .
ye ca vaikhānasā viprā dantolūkhalinastathā .. 10.21 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषीणां षष्टिसाहस्रं कुरुक्षेत्रनिवासिनाम् .
ये च वैखानसा विप्रा दन्तोलूखलिनस्तथा .. 10.21 ..
6.3.m: the sixty thousand seers residing in Kurukṣetra, / and those brahmins who were Vaikhānasa ascetics and used their teeth as mortars,

6.3.s:
himācalaguhāguhye ye vasanti tapodhanāḥ .
sarve te māmupāgamya kṣuttṛṣārtāstapodhanāḥ .. 10.22 ..
6.3.d:
हिमाचलगुहागुह्ये ये वसन्ति तपोधनाः .
सर्वे ते मामुपागम्य क्षुत्तृषार्तास्तपोधनाः .. 10.22 ..
6.3.m: and the ascetics who lived in the secret caves of the Himālaya— / all those ascetics, afflicted with hunger and thirst, approached me

6.3.s:
ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve sīdayāmo mahāmune .
saritsāgaraśailāntaṃ jagatsaṃśuṣyate dvija .. 10.23 ..
6.3.d:
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे सीदयामो महामुने .
सरित्सागरशैलान्तं जगत्संशुष्यते द्विज .. 10.23 ..
6.3.m: and, with folded hands, all said: “O great sage, we are perishing! / O twice-born, the world, up to its rivers, oceans, and mountains, is drying up!

6.3.s:
kutra yāsyāma sahitā yāvatkālasya paryayaḥ .
dīrghāyurasi viprendra na mṛtastvaṃ yugakṣaye .. 10.24 ..
6.3.d:
कुत्र यास्याम सहिता यावत्कालस्य पर्ययः .
दीर्घायुरसि विप्रेन्द्र न मृतस्त्वं युगक्षये .. 10.24 ..
6.3.m: Where shall we go together until the turn of time? / You are long-lived, O best of brahmins; you did not die at the end of the yuga.

6.3.s:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca sarvaṃ tava hṛdi sthitam .
tasmāttvaṃ vetsi sarvaṃ ca kathayasva mahāvrata .. 10.25 ..
6.3.d:
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च सर्वं तव हृदि स्थितम् .
तस्मात्त्वं वेत्सि सर्वं च कथयस्व महाव्रत .. 10.25 ..
6.3.m: Past, present, and future—all rests in your heart. / Therefore you know everything; tell us, O observer of great vows!

6.3.s:
kīdṛkkālaṃ mahābhāga kṣapiṣyāmo'tha suvrata .
anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ sīdate sacarācaram .. 10.26 ..
6.3.d:
कीदृक्कालं महाभाग क्षपिष्यामोऽथ सुव्रत .
अनावृष्टिहतं सर्वं सीदते सचराचरम् .. 10.26 ..
6.3.m: For what length of time, O fortunate one of good vows, shall we endure? / Everything, moving and unmoving, is ruined by the drought and perishing.

6.3.s:
paritrāhi mahābhāga na yathā yāma saṃkṣayam .
tataḥ saṃcintya manasā tvaranviprānathābravam .. 10.27 ..
6.3.d:
परित्राहि महाभाग न यथा याम संक्षयम् .
ततः संचिन्त्य मनसा त्वरन्विप्रानथाब्रवम् .. 10.27 ..
6.3.m: Protect us, O fortunate one, so that we do not meet destruction!” / Then, having reflected in my mind, I quickly spoke to the brahmins:

6.3.s:
kurukṣetraṃ tyajadhvaṃ ca putradārasamanvitāḥ .
tyaktvodīcīṃ diśaṃ sarve yāmo yāmyāmanuttamām .. 10.28 ..
6.3.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं त्यजध्वं च पुत्रदारसमन्विताः .
त्यक्त्वोदीचीं दिशं सर्वे यामो याम्यामनुत्तमाम् .. 10.28 ..
6.3.m: “Leave Kurukṣetra together with your sons and wives! / Leaving the northern quarter, let us all go to the unsurpassable southern region,

6.3.s:
nagaragrāmaghoṣāḍhyāṃ purapattanaśobhitām .
gacchāmo narmadātīraṃ bahusiddhaniṣevitam .. 10.29 ..
6.3.d:
नगरग्रामघोषाढ्यां पुरपत्तनशोभिताम् .
गच्छामो नर्मदातीरं बहुसिद्धनिषेवितम् .. 10.29 ..
6.3.m: abounding in cities, villages, and cowherds' settlements, adorned with towns and capitals. / Let us go to the bank of the Narmadā, frequented by many perfected beings,

6.3.s:
rudrāṅgīṃ tāṃ mahāpuṇyāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm .
paśyāmastāṃ mahābhāgāṃ nyagrodhāvārasaṃkulām .. 10.30 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्राङ्गीं तां महापुण्यां सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् .
पश्यामस्तां महाभागां न्यग्रोधावारसंकुलाम् .. 10.30 ..
6.3.m: born from the limbs of Rudra, most holy, destroying all sins! / Let us behold that fortunate [river], crowded with the shelters of banyan trees,

6.3.s:
māheśvarairbhāgavataiḥ sāṃkhyaiḥ siddhaiḥ susevitām .
anāvṛṣṭibhayādbhītāḥ kūlayorubhayorapi .. 10.31 ..
6.3.d:
माहेश्वरैर्भागवतैः सांख्यैः सिद्धैः सुसेविताम् .
अनावृष्टिभयाद्भीताः कूलयोरुभयोरपि .. 10.31 ..
6.3.m: well-attended by Śaivas, Bhāgavatas, followers of Sāṃkhya, and perfected beings! / Frightened by the dread of the drought, on both of its banks,

6.3.s:
āśrame hyāśramāndivyānkārayāmo jitavratāḥ .
evamuktāstu te sarve sametānucaraiḥ saha .. 10.32 ..
6.3.d:
आश्रमे ह्याश्रमान्दिव्यान्कारयामो जितव्रताः .
एवमुक्तास्तु ते सर्वे समेतानुचरैः सह .. 10.32 ..
6.3.m: we, having subdued our vows, shall establish divine hermitages in each settlement.” / Thus addressed, all of them, along with their assembled followers,

6.3.s:
narmadātīramāsādya sthitāḥ sarve'kutobhayāḥ .
kiṃcitpūrvamanusmṛtya purā kalpādibhirbhayam .. 10.33 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातीरमासाद्य स्थिताः सर्वेऽकुतोभयाः .
किंचित्पूर्वमनुस्मृत्य पुरा कल्पादिभिर्भयम् .. 10.33 ..
6.3.m: reached the bank of the Narmadā and stayed there, free from all fear, / remembering a little from before the danger at the beginnings of kalpas in ancient times.

6.3.s:
prāptāstu narmadātīramādāveva kalau yuge .
tato varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ divyaṃ revātaṭe'vasan .. 10.34 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्तास्तु नर्मदातीरमादावेव कलौ युगे .
ततो वर्षशतं पूर्णं दिव्यं रेवातटेऽवसन् .. 10.34 ..
6.3.m: Having reached the bank of the Narmadā at the very beginning of the Kali yuga, / they then lived on the bank of the Revā for a full hundred divine years,

6.3.s:
ṣaḍviṃśacca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi ca .
tatrāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭamṛṣīṇāṃ vasatāṃ nṛpa .. 10.35 ..
6.3.d:
षड्विंशच्च सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि च .
तत्राश्चर्यं मया दृष्टमृषीणां वसतां नृप .. 10.35 ..
6.3.m: and twenty-six thousand human years. / There, O king, a wonder was seen by me as the seers lived there:

6.3.s:
anāvṛṣṭihate loke saṃśuṣke sthāvare care .
bhinne yugādikalane hāhābhūte vicetane .. 10.36 ..
6.3.d:
अनावृष्टिहते लोके संशुष्के स्थावरे चरे .
भिन्ने युगादिकलने हाहाभूते विचेतने .. 10.36 ..
6.3.m: While the world was struck by drought, the moving and unmoving dried up, / the reckoning of yugas and the like shattered, and [everything] cried in distress and lost consciousness,

6.3.s:
cāturvarṇe pralīne tu naṣṭe homabalikrame .
niḥsvāhe nirvaṣaṭkāre śaucācāravivarjite .. 10.37 ..
6.3.d:
चातुर्वर्णे प्रलीने तु नष्टे होमबलिक्रमे .
निःस्वाहे निर्वषट्कारे शौचाचारविवर्जिते .. 10.37 ..
6.3.m: with the four classes dissolved, the order of oblations and sacrifices destroyed, / devoid of svāhā and vaṣaṭ, and bereft of purity and proper conduct,

6.3.s:
iyamekā saricchreṣṭhā ṛṣikoṭiniṣevitā .
nānyā kācittriloke'pi ramaṇīyā nareśvara .. 10.38 ..
6.3.d:
इयमेका सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा ऋषिकोटिनिषेविता .
नान्या काचित्त्रिलोकेऽपि रमणीया नरेश्वर .. 10.38 ..
6.3.m: this single best of rivers was frequented by tens of millions of seers; / there was none other so delightful even in the three worlds, O lord of men!

6.3.s:
yatheyaṃ puṇyasalilā indrasyevāmarāvatī .
devatāyatanaiḥ śubhrairāśramaiśca sukalpitaiḥ .. 10.39 ..
6.3.d:
यथेयं पुण्यसलिला इन्द्रस्येवामरावती .
देवतायतनैः शुभ्रैराश्रमैश्च सुकल्पितैः .. 10.39 ..
6.3.m: Just as this [river] has holy waters, like Indra’s Amarāvatī, / with shining temples of gods and well-constructed hermitages,

6.3.s:
śobhate narmadā devī svarge mandākinī yathā .
yāvadvṛkṣā mahāśailā yāvatsāgarasaṃbhavā .. 10.40 ..
6.3.d:
शोभते नर्मदा देवी स्वर्गे मन्दाकिनी यथा .
यावद्वृक्षा महाशैला यावत्सागरसंभवा .. 10.40 ..
6.3.m: goddess Narmadā shines like the Mandākinī in heaven. / As far as the trees and great mountains extend, as far as it reaches the ocean,

6.3.s:
ubhayoḥ kūlayostāvanmaṇḍitāyatanaiḥ śubhaiḥ .
hūyadbhiragnihotraiśca havirdhūmasamākulā .. 10.41 ..
6.3.d:
उभयोः कूलयोस्तावन्मण्डितायतनैः शुभैः .
हूयद्भिरग्निहोत्रैश्च हविर्धूमसमाकुला .. 10.41 ..
6.3.m: so far on both banks it was adorned with auspicious temples, / and crowded with the smoke of offerings from the agnihotras being offered.

6.3.s:
babhūva narmadā devī prāvṛṭkāla iva śarvarī .
devatāyatanairnaikaiḥ pūjāsaṃskāraśobhitā .. 10.42 ..
6.3.d:
बभूव नर्मदा देवी प्रावृट्काल इव शर्वरी .
देवतायतनैर्नैकैः पूजासंस्कारशोभिता .. 10.42 ..
6.3.m: Goddess Narmadā became like a night in the rainy season, / adorned with the rites of worship at manifold temples of the gods.

6.3.s:
saridbhirbhrājate śreṣṭhā purī śākrī ca bhāskarī .
kecitpañcāgnitapasaḥ kecidapyagnihotriṇaḥ .. 10.43 ..
6.3.d:
सरिद्भिर्भ्राजते श्रेष्ठा पुरी शाक्री च भास्करी .
केचित्पञ्चाग्नितपसः केचिदप्यग्निहोत्रिणः .. 10.43 ..
6.3.m: The best among rivers, it shone like the city of Śakra and that of Bhāskara. / Some practiced the austerity of the five fires, while others maintained the sacred fires;

6.3.s:
keciddhūmakamaśnanti tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ .
ātmayajñaratāḥ kecidapare bhaktibhāginaḥ .. 10.44 ..
6.3.d:
केचिद्धूमकमश्नन्ति तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थिताः .
आत्मयज्ञरताः केचिदपरे भक्तिभागिनः .. 10.44 ..
6.3.m: some inhaled smoke, established in fierce austerity; / some were devoted to the sacrifice of the self, while others were endowed with devotion.

6.3.s:
vaiṣṇavajñānamāsādya kecicchaivaṃ vrataṃ tathā .
ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ ca kecitṣaṣṭhāhabhojanāḥ .. 10.45 ..
6.3.d:
वैष्णवज्ञानमासाद्य केचिच्छैवं व्रतं तथा .
एकरात्रं द्विरात्रं च केचित्षष्ठाहभोजनाः .. 10.45 ..
6.3.m: Having attained Vaiṣṇava knowledge, some undertook the Śaiva observance; / some fasted for one night, some for two nights, and some ate on every sixth day;

6.3.s:
cāndrāyaṇavidhānaiśca kṛcchriṇaścātikṛcchriṇaḥ .
evaṃvidhaistapobhiśca narmadātīraśobhitaiḥ .. 10.46 ..
6.3.d:
चान्द्रायणविधानैश्च कृच्छ्रिणश्चातिकृच्छ्रिणः .
एवंविधैस्तपोभिश्च नर्मदातीरशोभितैः .. 10.46 ..
6.3.m: some observed the rules of the Cāndrāyaṇa vow, and some practiced the kṛcchra and atikṛcchra penances. / Through such austerities adorning the bank of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
yajadbhiḥ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ keśavaṃ bhāti nityadā .
ekatve ca pṛthaktve ca yajatāṃ ca maheśvaram .. 10.47 ..
6.3.d:
यजद्भिः शंकरं देवं केशवं भाति नित्यदा .
एकत्वे च पृथक्त्वे च यजतां च महेश्वरम् .. 10.47 ..
6.3.m: and by those worshipping the god Śaṃkara and Keśava, it shone continually. / For those worshipping Maheśvara in unity and in differentiation,

6.3.s:
kalau yuge mahāghore prāptāḥ siddhimanuttamām .
yasya yasya hi yā bhaktirvijñānaṃ yasya yādṛśam .. 10.48 ..
6.3.d:
कलौ युगे महाघोरे प्राप्ताः सिद्धिमनुत्तमाम् .
यस्य यस्य हि या भक्तिर्विज्ञानं यस्य यादृशम् .. 10.48 ..
6.3.m: in the terrible Kali yuga, unsurpassable perfection was attained. / Whatever devotion anyone had, and of whatever kind his knowledge,

6.3.s:
yasminyasmiṃśca deve tu tāṃtāmīśo'dadātprabhuḥ .
svabhāvaikatayā bhaktyā tāmetyāntaḥ pralīyate .. 10.49 ..
6.3.d:
यस्मिन्यस्मिंश्च देवे तु तांतामीशोऽददात्प्रभुः .
स्वभावैकतया भक्त्या तामेत्यान्तः प्रलीयते .. 10.49 ..
6.3.m: and toward whatever god, the lord Īśa granted that very [reward]. / Through singular devotion according to one's nature, reaching him, one dissolves within.

6.3.s:
saṃsāre parivartante ye pṛthagbhājino narāḥ .
ye mahāvṛkṣamīśānaṃ tyaktvā śākhāvalambinaḥ .. 10.50 ..
6.3.d:
संसारे परिवर्तन्ते ये पृथग्भाजिनो नराः .
ये महावृक्षमीशानं त्यक्त्वा शाखावलम्बिनः .. 10.50 ..
6.3.m: Those men who worship with differentiation revolve in saṃsāra; / those who, having abandoned Īśāna, the great tree, cling only to its branches,

6.3.s:
punarāvartamānāste jāyante hi caturyuge .
devānte sthāvarānte ca saṃsāre cābhramankramāt .. 10.51 ..
6.3.d:
पुनरावर्तमानास्ते जायन्ते हि चतुर्युगे .
देवान्ते स्थावरान्ते च संसारे चाभ्रमन्क्रमात् .. 10.51 ..
6.3.m: return again and are born in the four yugas; / wanderers in succession through saṃsāra, ending as gods and ending as immovable beings,

6.3.s:
punarjanma punaḥ svarge punarghore ca raurave .
ye punardevamīśānaṃ bhavaṃ bhaktisusaṃsthitāḥ .. 10.52 ..
6.3.d:
पुनर्जन्म पुनः स्वर्गे पुनर्घोरे च रौरवे .
ये पुनर्देवमीशानं भवं भक्तिसुसंस्थिताः .. 10.52 ..
6.3.m: they experience birth again, heaven again, and the dreadful Raurava hell again. / But those who, firmly established in devotion, worship the god Īśāna, Bhava,

6.3.s:
yajanti narmadātīre na punaste bhavanti ca .
ā dehapatanātkecidupāsantaḥ paraṃ gatāḥ .. 10.53 ..
6.3.d:
यजन्ति नर्मदातीरे न पुनस्ते भवन्ति च .
आ देहपतनात्केचिदुपासन्तः परं गताः .. 10.53 ..
6.3.m: on the bank of the Narmadā, are never born again. / Some, worshipping until the fall of the body, attained the Supreme.

6.3.s:
keciddvādaśabhirvarṣaiḥ ṣaḍbharanye tapodhanāḥ .
tribhiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ kecitkecitsaṃvatsareṇa tu .. 10.54 ..
6.3.d:
केचिद्द्वादशभिर्वर्षैः षड्भरन्ये तपोधनाः .
त्रिभिः संवत्सरैः केचित्केचित्संवत्सरेण तु .. 10.54 ..
6.3.m: Some ascetics [attained perfection] in twelve years, others in six, / some in three years, and some in a single year;

6.3.s:
ṣaḍbhirmāsaistu saṃsiddhāstribhirmāsaistathāpare .
munayo devamāśritya narmadāṃ ca yaśasvinīm .. 10.55 ..
6.3.d:
षड्भिर्मासैस्तु संसिद्धास्त्रिभिर्मासैस्तथापरे .
मुनयो देवमाश्रित्य नर्मदां च यशस्विनीम् .. 10.55 ..
6.3.m: some were perfected in six months, and others in three months. / Taking refuge in the god and in the renowned Narmadā, the sages,

6.3.s:
chittvā saṃsāradoṣāṃśca agamanbrahma śāśvatam .
evaṃ kaliyuge ghore śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 10.56 ..
6.3.d:
छित्त्वा संसारदोषांश्च अगमन्ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् .
एवं कलियुगे घोरे शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 10.56 ..
6.3.m: having severed the defects of saṃsāra, went to the eternal Brahman. / Thus, in the terrible Kali yuga, by hundreds and thousands,

6.3.s: narmadātīramāśritya munayo rudramāviśan .. 10.57 ..
6.3.d: नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य मुनयो रुद्रमाविशन् .. 10.57 ..
6.3.m: the sages, taking refuge on the bank of the Narmadā, entered Rudra.

6.3.s:
ye narmadātīramupetya viprāḥ śaive vrate yatnamupaprapannāḥ .
trikālamambhaḥ pravigāhya bhaktyā devaṃ samabhyarcya śivaṃ vrajanti .. 10.58 ..
6.3.d:
ये नर्मदातीरमुपेत्य विप्राः शैवे व्रते यत्नमुपप्रपन्नाः .
त्रिकालमम्भः प्रविगाह्य भक्त्या देवं समभ्यर्च्य शिवं व्रजन्ति .. 10.58 ..
6.3.m: Those brahmins who, having reached the bank of the Narmadā, engage in the Śaiva vow, / plunging into the water at the three junctions of the day, worshipping the god with devotion, attain Śiva.

6.3.s:
dhyānārcanairjāpyamahāvrataiśca nārāyaṇaṃ vā satataṃ smaranti .
te dhautapāṇḍurapaṭā iva rājahaṃsāḥ saṃsārasāgarajalasya taranti pāram .. 10.59 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यानार्चनैर्जाप्यमहाव्रतैश्च नारायणं वा सततं स्मरन्ति .
ते धौतपाण्डुरपटा इव राजहंसाः संसारसागरजलस्य तरन्ति पारम् .. 10.59 ..
6.3.m: Or those who constantly remember Nārāyaṇa through meditation, worship, silent recitation, and great vows, / like royal swans with washed white feathers, cross to the other shore of the ocean of saṃsāra.

6.3.s:
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujamucyate .
idamekaṃ suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā .. 10.60 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यमुत्क्षिप्य भुजमुच्यते .
इदमेकं सुनिष्पन्नं ध्येयो नारायणः सदा .. 10.60 ..
6.3.m: True, true, again it is true—with upraised arm it is proclaimed: / this single truth is well-established, that Nārāyaṇa should always be meditated upon!

6.3.s:
yo vā haraṃ pūjayate jitātmā māsaṃ ca pakṣaṃ ca vasennarendra .
revāṃ samāśritya mahānubhāvaḥ sa devadevo'tha bhavetpinākī .. 10.61 ..
6.3.d:
यो वा हरं पूजयते जितात्मा मासं च पक्षं च वसेन्नरेन्द्र .
रेवां समाश्रित्य महानुभावः स देवदेवोऽथ भवेत्पिनाकी .. 10.61 ..
6.3.m:
Or whatever self-controlled, noble person worships Hara
and resides for a month or a fortnight having resorted to the Revā, O lord of men, becomes that god of gods, the bow-wielding Pinākin. (10.61)

6.3.s:
kīṭāḥ pataṃgāśca pipīlikāśca ye vai mriyante'mbhasi narmadāyāḥ .
te divyarūpāstu kulaprasūtāḥ śataṃ samā dharmaparā bhavanti .. 10.62 ..
6.3.d:
कीटाः पतंगाश्च पिपीलिकाश्च ये वै म्रियन्तेऽम्भसि नर्मदायाः .
ते दिव्यरूपास्तु कुलप्रसूताः शतं समा धर्मपरा भवन्ति .. 10.62 ..
6.3.m:
Insects, flying moths, and ants that die in the waters of the Narmadā,
having taken divine forms and being born into noble families, remain devoted to dharma for a hundred years. (10.62)

6.3.s:
kālena vṛkṣāḥ prapatanti ye'pi mahātaraṃgaughanikṛttamūlāḥ .
te narmadāṃbhobhirapāstapāpā dedīpyamānāstridivaṃ prayānti .. 10.63 ..
6.3.d:
कालेन वृक्षाः प्रपतन्ति येऽपि महातरंगौघनिकृत्तमूलाः .
ते नर्मदांभोभिरपास्तपापा देदीप्यमानास्त्रिदिवं प्रयान्ति .. 10.63 ..
6.3.m:
Even the trees whose roots in course of time are severed by the force of great waves and collapse,
their sins cast off by the waters of the Narmadā, go radiant to heaven. (10.63)

6.3.s:
akāmakāmāśca tathā sakāmā revāntamāśritya mriyanti tīre .
jaḍāndhamūkāstridivaṃ prayānti kimatra viprā bhavabhāvayuktāḥ .. 10.64 ..
6.3.d:
अकामकामाश्च तथा सकामा रेवान्तमाश्रित्य म्रियन्ति तीरे .
जडान्धमूकास्त्रिदिवं प्रयान्ति किमत्र विप्रा भवभावयुक्ताः .. 10.64 ..
6.3.m:
Those free from desire or filled with desire who take refuge at the bank of the Revā and die there—
even the dull, the blind, and the mute go to heaven, how much more so brahmins endowed with devotion to Śiva? (10.64)

6.3.s:
māsopavāsairapi śoṣitāṅgā na tāṃ gatiṃ yānti vimuktadehāḥ .
mriyanti revājalapūtakāyāḥ śivārcane keśavabhāvayuktāḥ .. 10.65 ..
6.3.d:
मासोपवासैरपि शोषिताङ्गा न तां गतिं यान्ति विमुक्तदेहाः .
म्रियन्ति रेवाजलपूतकायाः शिवार्चने केशवभावयुक्ताः .. 10.65 ..
6.3.m:
Even those who emaciate their limbs with fasts lasting a month do not attain that destination when they abandon their bodies,
which is reached by those who die with their bodies purified by the waters of the Revā, endowed with love for Keśava while worshiping Śiva. (10.65)

6.3.s:
nīvāraśyāmākayaveṅgudādyairanyairmunīndrā iha vartayanti .
āpritya kūlaṃ tridaśānugītaṃ te narmadāyā na viśanti mṛtyum .. 10.66 ..
6.3.d:
नीवारश्यामाकयवेङ्गुदाद्यैरन्यैर्मुनीन्द्रा इह वर्तयन्ति .
आप्रित्य कूलं त्रिदशानुगीतं ते नर्मदाया न विशन्ति मृत्युम् .. 10.66 ..
6.3.m:
The best of sages who subsist here on wild rice, millet, barley, inguda-nuts, and other foods,
resorting to the bank praised by the gods, do not enter death. (10.66)

6.3.s:
bhramanti ye tīramupetya devyāstrikāladevārcanasatyapūtāḥ .
viṇmūtracarmāsthitiropadhānāḥ kukṣau yuvatyā na vasanti bhūyaḥ .. 10.67 ..
6.3.d:
भ्रमन्ति ये तीरमुपेत्य देव्यास्त्रिकालदेवार्चनसत्यपूताः .
विण्मूत्रचर्मास्थितिरोपधानाः कुक्षौ युवत्या न वसन्ति भूयः .. 10.67 ..
6.3.m:
Those who, purified by the truth and the worship of the deity at the three junctures of the day, wander along the river-bank of the goddess,
never again dwell inside a young woman’s womb enclosed with feces, urine, skin, and bones. (10.67)

6.3.s:
kiṃ yajñadānairbahubhiśca teṣāṃ niṣevitaistīrthavaraiḥ samastaiḥ .
revātaṭaṃ dakṣiṇamuttaraṃ vā sevanti te rudracarānupūrvam .. 10.68 ..
6.3.d:
किं यज्ञदानैर्बहुभिश्च तेषां निषेवितैस्तीर्थवरैः समस्तैः .
रेवातटं दक्षिणमुत्तरं वा सेवन्ति ते रुद्रचरानुपूर्वम् .. 10.68 ..
6.3.m:
What need have they of many sacrifices, gifts, or resorting to all the foremost sacred fords,
when they attend upon the southern or the northern bank of the Revā following the attendants of Rudra? (10.68)

6.3.s:
te vañcitāḥ paṅgujaḍāndhabhūtā lokeṣu martyāḥ paśubhiśca tulyāḥ .
ye nāśritā rudraśarīrabhūtāṃ sopānapaṅktiṃ tridivasya revām .. 10.69 ..
6.3.d:
ते वञ्चिताः पङ्गुजडान्धभूता लोकेषु मर्त्याः पशुभिश्च तुल्याः .
ये नाश्रिता रुद्रशरीरभूतां सोपानपङ्क्तिं त्रिदिवस्य रेवाम् .. 10.69 ..
6.3.m:
Those mortals are cheated, like the lame, dull, and blind among the worlds, and are equal to beasts,
who have not resorted to the Revā, which is the body of Rudra and a flight of steps to heaven. (10.69)

6.3.s:
yugaṃ kaliṃ ghoramimaṃ ya iccheddraṣṭuṃ kadācinna punardvijendraḥ .
sa narmadātīramupetya sarvaṃ sampūjayetsarvavimuktasaṃgaḥ .. 10.70 ..
6.3.d:
युगं कलिं घोरमिमं य इच्छेद्द्रष्टुं कदाचिन्न पुनर्द्विजेन्द्रः .
स नर्मदातीरमुपेत्य सर्वं सम्पूजयेत्सर्वविमुक्तसंगः .. 10.70 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever leader of brahmins desires never again to behold this terrible Kali age
should approach the bank of the Narmadā and, freed from all attachments, worship all. (10.70)

6.3.s:
vighnairanekairatiyojyamānā ye tīramujhanti na narmadāyāḥ .
te caiva sarvasya hitārthabhūtā vandyāśca te sarvajanasya mānyāḥ .. 10.71 ..
6.3.d:
विघ्नैरनेकैरतियोज्यमाना ये तीरमुझन्ति न नर्मदायाः .
ते चैव सर्वस्य हितार्थभूता वन्द्याश्च ते सर्वजनस्य मान्याः .. 10.71 ..
6.3.m:
Those who do not abandon the bank of the Narmadā though afflicted with countless obstacles
become benefactors of all, worthy of worship, and honored by everyone. (10.71)

6.3.s:
bhṛgvatrigārgeyavaśiṣṭhakaṅkāḥ śataiḥ sametairniyatāstvasaṃkhyaiḥ .
siddhiṃ parāṃ te hi jalaplutāṅgāḥ prāptāstu lokānmarutāṃ na cānye .. 10.72 ..
6.3.d:
भृग्वत्रिगार्गेयवशिष्ठकङ्काः शतैः समेतैर्नियतास्त्वसंख्यैः .
सिद्धिं परां ते हि जलप्लुताङ्गाः प्राप्तास्तु लोकान्मरुतां न चान्ये .. 10.72 ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu, Atri, Gārgya, Vasiṣṭha, Kaṅka, and countless disciplined sages together in their hundreds,
their limbs bathed in the waters, attained supreme perfection and the worlds of the Maruts, and not others. (10.72)

6.3.s:
jñānaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ pavitraṃ paṭhantyado nityaviśuddhasattvāḥ .
gatiṃ parāṃ yānti mahānubhāvā rudrasya vākyaṃ hi yathā pramāṇam .. 10.73 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye narmadāsnānaphalaśrutikathanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 11
6.3.d:
ज्ञानं महत्पुण्यतमं पवित्रं पठन्त्यदो नित्यविशुद्धसत्त्वाः .
गतिं परां यान्ति महानुभावा रुद्रस्य वाक्यं हि यथा प्रमाणम् .. 10.73 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये नर्मदास्नानफलश्रुतिकथनं नाम दशमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 11
6.3.m:
Those of eternally purified being who recite this great, most auspicious, and sacred knowledge,
those noble beings attain the supreme state, for the word of Rudra is authoritative. (10.73)
Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled “Proclamation of the Fruits of Bathing in the Narmadā,” in the glorification of the Narmadā, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 11

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
aho mahatpuṇyatamā viśiṣṭā kṣayaṃ na yātā iha yā yugānte .
tasmātsadā sevyatamā munīndrairdhyānārcanasnānaparāyaṇaiśca .. 11.1 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
अहो महत्पुण्यतमा विशिष्टा क्षयं न याता इह या युगान्ते .
तस्मात्सदा सेव्यतमा मुनीन्द्रैर्ध्यानार्चनस्नानपरायणैश्च .. 11.1 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Oh, how supremely auspicious and distinguished is she who does not perish here at the end of an age!
Therefore, she is always most worthy of being resorted to by the lords of sages intent upon meditation, worship, and ritual ablution. (11.1)

6.3.s:
yāmāśritya gatā mokṣamṛṣayo dharmavatsalāḥ .
ye tvayoktāstu niyamā ṛṣīṇāṃ vedanirmitāḥ .. 11.2 ..
6.3.d:
यामाश्रित्य गता मोक्षमृषयो धर्मवत्सलाः .
ये त्वयोक्तास्तु नियमा ऋषीणां वेदनिर्मिताः .. 11.2 ..
6.3.m:
Having resorted to whom, the seers devoted to dharma have gone to liberation—
those rules of the seers established by the Veda that were spoken of by you, (11.2)

6.3.s:
mokṣāvāptirbhavedyeṣāṃ niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ .
daśadvādaśabhirvāpi ṣaḍbhiraṣṭābhireva vā .. 11.3 ..
6.3.d:
मोक्षावाप्तिर्भवेद्येषां नियमैश्च पृथग्विधैः .
दशद्वादशभिर्वापि षड्भिरष्टाभिरेव वा .. 11.3 ..
6.3.m:
by which diverse observances their attainment of liberation comes to be,
either in ten or twelve, or in six or eight, (11.3)

6.3.s:
tribhistathā caturbhirvā varṣairmāsaistathaiva ca .
mucyante kalidoṣaiste deveśānasamarcanāt .. 11.4 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिभिस्तथा चतुर्भिर्वा वर्षैर्मासैस्तथैव च .
मुच्यन्ते कलिदोषैस्ते देवेशानसमर्चनात् .. 11.4 ..
6.3.m:
or in three or four years or months,
they are freed from the blemishes of the Kali age by worshiping the Lord of the gods. (11.4)

6.3.s:
brahmāṇaṃ vā suraśreṣṭha keśavaṃ vā jagadgurum .
arcayanpāpamakhilaṃ jahātyeva na saṃśayaḥ .. 11.5 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्माणं वा सुरश्रेष्ठ केशवं वा जगद्गुरुम् .
अर्चयन्पापमखिलं जहात्येव न संशयः .. 11.5 ..
6.3.m:
Whether worshiping Brahmā, O best of gods, or Keśava, the teacher of the world,
one surely abandons all sin, there is no doubt. (11.5)

6.3.s:
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha .
yasminsaṃsāragahane nimagnāḥ sarvajantavaḥ .
te kathaṃ tridivaṃ prāptā iti me saṃśayo vada .. 11.6 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं कथयस्व ममानघ .
यस्मिन्संसारगहने निमग्नाः सर्वजन्तवः .
ते कथं त्रिदिवं प्राप्ता इति मे संशयो वद .. 11.6 ..
6.3.m:
Relate all this to me in detail, O sinless one:
how all creatures drowned in this dense jungle of saṃsāra
have attained heaven—resolve this doubt of mine, speak! (11.6)

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
janmāntarairanekaistu mānuṣyamupalabhyate .
bhaktirutpadyate cātra kathaṃcidapi śaṅkare .. 11.7 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
जन्मान्तरैरनेकैस्तु मानुष्यमुपलभ्यते .
भक्तिरुत्पद्यते चात्र कथंचिदपि शङ्करे .. 11.7 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Human birth is obtained only after many previous lives,
and devotion to Śaṅkara arises in it only with great difficulty. (11.7)

6.3.s:
tīrthadānopavāsānāṃ yajñairdevadvijārcanaiḥ .
avāptirjāyate puṃsāṃ śraddhayā parayā nṛpa .. 11.8 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थदानोपवासानां यज्ञैर्देवद्विजार्चनैः .
अवाप्तिर्जायते पुंसां श्रद्धया परया नृप .. 11.8 ..
6.3.m:
The fruit of sacred fords, gifts, fasts, sacrifices, and worship of gods and brahmins
arises for men only through supreme faith, O king. (11.8)

6.3.s:
tasmācchraddhā prakartavyā mānavairdharmavatsalaiḥ .
īśo'pi śraddhayā sādhyastena śraddhā viśiṣyate .. 11.9 ..
6.3.d:
तस्माच्छ्रद्धा प्रकर्तव्या मानवैर्धर्मवत्सलैः .
ईशोऽपि श्रद्धया साध्यस्तेन श्रद्धा विशिष्यते .. 11.9 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore, faith should be cultivated by men who cherish dharma;
even the Lord is attained through faith, and because of this, faith is pre-eminent. (11.9)

6.3.s:
anyathā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ śraddhāhīnaṃ tu bhārata .
tasmātsamāśrayedbhaktiṃ rudrasya parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 11.10 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यथा निष्फलं सर्वं श्रद्धाहीनं तु भारत .
तस्मात्समाश्रयेद्भक्तिं रुद्रस्य परमेष्ठिनः .. 11.10 ..
6.3.m:
Otherwise, everything devoid of faith is fruitless, O Bhārata;
therefore, one should resort to devotion to Rudra, the supreme deity. (11.10)

6.3.s:
teṣāṃhi saphalaṃ janma yeṣāṃ bhaktiracañcalā .
sā caiva trividhā bhaktiḥ sāttvikī rājasī tathā .. 11.11 ..
6.3.d:
तेषांहि सफलं जन्म येषां भक्तिरचञ्चला .
सा चैव त्रिविधा भक्तिः सात्त्विकी राजसी तथा .. 11.11 ..
6.3.m:
Fruitful indeed is the birth of those whose devotion is unwavering;
and that devotion is threefold: sattvic, rajasic, (11.11)

6.3.s:
tāmasī sarvalokasya trividhaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet .
te karmaphalasaṃyogādāvartante punaḥpunaḥ .. 11.12 ..
6.3.d:
तामसी सर्वलोकस्य त्रिविधं च फलं लभेत् .
ते कर्मफलसंयोगादावर्तन्ते पुनःपुनः .. 11.12 ..
6.3.m:
and tamasic for all the world, and one receives a threefold fruit;
they revolve again and again through connection with the fruits of their actions. (11.12)

6.3.s:
janmāntaraśataisteṣāṃ jñānināṃ devayājinām .
devatraye bhavedbhaktiḥ kṣayātpāpasya karmaṇaḥ .. 11.13 ..
6.3.d:
जन्मान्तरशतैस्तेषां ज्ञानिनां देवयाजिनाम् .
देवत्रये भवेद्भक्तिः क्षयात्पापस्य कर्मणः .. 11.13 ..
6.3.m:
After hundreds of other births, for those wise men who sacrifice to the gods,
devotion to the triad of deities arises through the destruction of sinful karma. (11.13)

6.3.s:
īśānāttu punarmokṣo jāyate chinnasaṃśayaḥ .
ye punarnarmadātīramāśritya dvijapuṃgavāḥ .. 11.14 ..
6.3.d:
ईशानात्तु पुनर्मोक्षो जायते छिन्नसंशयः .
ये पुनर्नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य द्विजपुंगवाः .. 11.14 ..
6.3.m:
From the Lord, then, liberation is produced without any doubt.
Moreover, those foremost brahmins who take refuge on the bank of the Narmadā, (11.14)

6.3.s:
trayīmārgamasandigdhāste yānti paramāṃ gatim .
ekāgramanaso ye tu śaṅkaraṃ śivamavyayam .. 11.15 ..
6.3.d:
त्रयीमार्गमसन्दिग्धास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् .
एकाग्रमनसो ये तु शङ्करं शिवमव्ययम् .. 11.15 ..
6.3.m:
free from doubt on the path of the three Vedas, go to the supreme state.
Those who, with single-minded consciousness, worship Śaṃkara, (11.15)

6.3.s:
arcayantīha niratāḥ kṣipraṃ sidhyanti te janāḥ .
kālena mahatā siddhirjāyate'nyatra dehinām .. 11.16 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चयन्तीह निरताः क्षिप्रं सिध्यन्ति ते जनाः .
कालेन महता सिद्धिर्जायतेऽन्यत्र देहिनाम् .. 11.16 ..
6.3.m:
ever devoted here to the imperishable Śiva, quickly attain perfection.
For embodied beings elsewhere, perfection arises only after a long time, (11.16)

6.3.s:
narmadāyāḥ punastīre kṣipraṃ siddhiravāpyate .
ṣaḍbhirvarṣaistu sidhyanti ye tu sāṃkhyavido janāḥ .. 11.17 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदायाः पुनस्तीरे क्षिप्रं सिद्धिरवाप्यते .
षड्भिर्वर्षैस्तु सिध्यन्ति ये तु सांख्यविदो जनाः .. 11.17 ..
6.3.m:
whereas on the bank of the Narmadā perfection is attained quickly.
Those who know the Sāṃkhya achieve perfection in six years; (11.17)

6.3.s:
vaiṣṇavā jñānasampannāste'pi sidhyanti cāgrataḥ .
sarvayogavido ye ca samudramiva sindhavaḥ .. 11.18 ..
6.3.d:
वैष्णवा ज्ञानसम्पन्नास्तेऽपि सिध्यन्ति चाग्रतः .
सर्वयोगविदो ये च समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः .. 11.18 ..
6.3.m:
Vaiṣṇavas endowed with knowledge also achieve perfection earlier.
And those who know all yogas, like rivers joining the ocean, (11.18)

6.3.s:
ekībhavanti kalpānte yoge māheśvare gatāḥ .
sarveṣāmeva yogānāṃ yogo māheśvaro varaḥ .. 11.19 ..
6.3.d:
एकीभवन्ति कल्पान्ते योगे माहेश्वरे गताः .
सर्वेषामेव योगानां योगो माहेश्वरो वरः .. 11.19 ..
6.3.m:
become one at the end of a cosmic cycle, having attained the yoga of the Great Lord.
Of all yogas, the yoga of the Great Lord is the foremost. (11.19)

6.3.s:
tamāsādya vimucyante ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ .
śivamarcya nadīkūle jāyante te na yoniṣu .. 11.20 ..
6.3.d:
तमासाद्य विमुच्यन्ते येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः .
शिवमर्च्य नदीकूले जायन्ते ते न योनिषु .. 11.20 ..
6.3.m:
Having attained it, even those of sinful origins are liberated.
Having worshiped Śiva on the bank of the river, they are never born into wombs again. (11.20)

6.3.s:
gatireṣā durārohā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī .
mucyante maṅkṣu saṃsārādrevāmāśritya jantavaḥ .. 11.21 ..
6.3.d:
गतिरेषा दुरारोहा सर्वपापक्षयंकरी .
मुच्यन्ते मङ्क्षु संसाराद्रेवामाश्रित्य जन्तवः .. 11.21 ..
6.3.m:
This path is difficult to ascend and destroys all sins;
having taken refuge in the Revā, creatures are swiftly liberated from worldly existence. (11.21)

6.3.s:
tasmātsnāyī bhavennityaṃ tathā bhasmavilepanaḥ .
narmadātīramāsādya kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt .. 11.22 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्स्नायी भवेन्नित्यं तथा भस्मविलेपनः .
नर्मदातीरमासाद्य क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् .. 11.22 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore, one should bathe daily and smear oneself with sacred ash;
having reached the bank of the Narmadā, one swiftly attains perfection. (11.22)

6.3.s:
trikālaṃ pūjayecchānto yo naro liṅgamādarāt .
sarvarogavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 11.23 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिकालं पूजयेच्छान्तो यो नरो लिङ्गमादरात् .
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तः स याति परमां गतिम् .. 11.23 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever calm man reverently worships the liṅga at the three junctures of the day,
freed from all illnesses, goes to the supreme state. (11.23)

6.3.s:
ṣaḍbhiḥ sidhyati masaistu yadyapi syātsa pāpakṛt .
ye punaḥ śuddhamanaso māsaiḥ śudhyanti te tribhiḥ .. 11.24 ..
6.3.d:
षड्भिः सिध्यति मसैस्तु यद्यपि स्यात्स पापकृत् .
ये पुनः शुद्धमनसो मासैः शुध्यन्ति ते त्रिभिः .. 11.24 ..
6.3.m:
He attains perfection in six months, even if he were a sinner;
those, however, of purified mind are purified in three months. (11.24)

6.3.s:
yathā dinakaraspṛṣṭaṃ himaṃ śailādviśīryante .
tadvadvilīyate pāpaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ bhasmakaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 11.25 ..
6.3.d:
यथा दिनकरस्पृष्टं हिमं शैलाद्विशीर्यन्ते .
तद्वद्विलीयते पापं स्पृष्टं भस्मकणैः शुभैः .. 11.25 ..
6.3.m: Just as snow melts away from a mountain when touched by the sun, / so sin dissolves when touched by auspicious particles of ash.

6.3.s:
vainateyabhayatrastā yathā naśyanti pannagāḥ .
tadvatpāpāni naśyanti bhasmanābhyukṣitāni ha .. 11.26 ..
6.3.d:
वैनतेयभयत्रस्ता यथा नश्यन्ति पन्नगाः .
तद्वत्पापानि नश्यन्ति भस्मनाभ्युक्षितानि ह .. 11.26 ..
6.3.m: Just as serpents perish in terror of Garuḍa, / so indeed sins perish when sprinkled with ash.

6.3.s:
narmadātoyapūtena bhasmanoddhūlayanti ye .
sadyaste pāpasaṅghācca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 11.27 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातोयपूतेन भस्मनोद्धूलयन्ति ये .
सद्यस्ते पापसङ्घाच्च मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 11.27 ..
6.3.m: Those who dust themselves with ash purified by the water of the Narmadā / are immediately freed from the mass of sins; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
vrataṃ pāśupataṃ bhaktayā yathoktaṃ pālayanti ye .
śūdrānnena vihīnāstu te yānti paramāṃ gatim .. 11.28 ..
6.3.d:
व्रतं पाशुपतं भक्तया यथोक्तं पालयन्ति ये .
शूद्रान्नेन विहीनास्तु ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् .. 11.28 ..
6.3.m: Those who observe the Pāśupata vow with devotion as prescribed, / abstaining from the food of a śūdra, attain the highest state.

6.3.s:
amṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam .
vaiśyānnamannameva syācchūdrānnaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam .. 11.29 ..
6.3.d:
अमृतं ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं क्षत्रियान्नं पयः स्मृतम् .
वैश्यान्नमन्नमेव स्याच्छूद्रान्नं रुधिरं स्मृतम् .. 11.29 ..
6.3.m: The food of a brahmin is considered nectar; the food of a kṣatriya is remembered as milk; / the food of a vaiśya is merely plain food; the food of a śūdra is considered blood.

6.3.s:
śūdrānnarasasaṃpuṣṭā ye mriyante dvijottamāḥ .
te tapojñānahīnāstu kākā gṛdhrā bhavanti te .. 11.30 ..
6.3.d:
शूद्रान्नरससंपुष्टा ये म्रियन्ते द्विजोत्तमाः .
ते तपोज्ञानहीनास्तु काका गृध्रा भवन्ति ते .. 11.30 ..
6.3.m: Those best of the twice-born who die nourished by the essence of a śūdra's food, / bereft of austerity and knowledge, become crows and vultures.

6.3.s:
duṣkṛtaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāmannamāśritya tiṣṭhati .
yo yasyānnaṃ samaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam .. 11.31 ..
6.3.d:
दुष्कृतं हि मनुष्याणामन्नमाश्रित्य तिष्ठति .
यो यस्यान्नं समश्नाति स तस्याश्नाति किल्बिषम् .. 11.31 ..
6.3.m: For the evil deeds of men reside depending upon food; / he who eats the food of anyone eats that person's sin.

6.3.s:
viśeṣādyatidharmeṇa tapolaulyaṃ samāśritāḥ .
narakaṃ yāntyasandigdhamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 11.32 ..
6.3.d:
विशेषाद्यतिधर्मेण तपोलौल्यं समाश्रिताः .
नरकं यान्त्यसन्दिग्धमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 11.32 ..
6.3.m: Especially those who, while following the duty of an ascetic, succumb to greed regarding their austerity, / go to hell without doubt; thus Śaṅkara declared.

6.3.s:
īdṛgrūpāśca ye viprāḥ pāśupatye vyavasthitāḥ .
te mahatpāpasaṃghātaṃ dahantyeva na saṃśayaḥ .. 11.33 ..
6.3.d:
ईदृग्रूपाश्च ये विप्राः पाशुपत्ये व्यवस्थिताः .
ते महत्पापसंघातं दहन्त्येव न संशयः .. 11.33 ..
6.3.m: And brahmins of such character who remain established in the Pāśupata [path] / burn up a great mass of sin; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
viḍambena ca saṃyuktā laulupyena ca pīḍitāḥ .
asaṃgrāhyā ityevaṃ śrutinodanā .. 11.34 ..
6.3.d:
विडम्बेन च संयुक्ता लौलुप्येन च पीडिताः .
असंग्राह्या इत्येवं श्रुतिनोदना .. 11.34 ..
6.3.m: Those joined with hypocrisy and afflicted by greed / are not to be received; such is the injunction of the Veda.

6.3.s:
mātāpitṛkṛtairdoṣairanye kecitsvakarmajaiḥ .
naṣṭā jñānāvalepena ahaṅkāreṇa'pare .. 11.35 ..
6.3.d:
मातापितृकृतैर्दोषैरन्ये केचित्स्वकर्मजैः .
नष्टा ज्ञानावलेपेन अहङ्कारेणऽपरे .. 11.35 ..
6.3.m: Some are ruined by the faults committed by their parents, others by those born of their own actions, / others by the pride of knowledge, and others by egoism.

6.3.s:
śāṅkare prasthitā dharme ye smṛtyarthabahiṣkṛtāḥ .
kliśyamānāstu kalena te yānti paramāṃ gatim .. 11.36 ..
6.3.d:
शाङ्करे प्रस्थिता धर्मे ये स्मृत्यर्थबहिष्कृताः .
क्लिश्यमानास्तु कलेन ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् .. 11.36 ..
6.3.m: Those who are set on the dharma of Śaṅkara, though excluded from the ordinances of the smṛti, / being afflicted by Kali [Age], attain the highest state.

6.3.s:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā mūrkhā dambhavivardhitāḥ .
na sidhyanti durātmānaḥ kudṛṣṭāntārthakīrtanāḥ .. 11.37 ..
6.3.d:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा मूर्खा दम्भविवर्धिताः .
न सिध्यन्ति दुरात्मानः कुदृष्टान्तार्थकीर्तनाः .. 11.37 ..
6.3.m: Faithless men, fools puffed up with deceit, / wicked-souled and reciting corrupt examples, do not attain perfection.

6.3.s:
mahābhāgye'pi tīrthasya śāṅkaraṃ vratamāsthitāḥ .
viyoniṃ yāntyasandigdhaṃ laulupyena samanvitāḥ .. 11.38 ..
6.3.d:
महाभाग्येऽपि तीर्थस्य शाङ्करं व्रतमास्थिताः .
वियोनिं यान्त्यसन्दिग्धं लौलुप्येन समन्विताः .. 11.38 ..
6.3.m: Even at the great glory of the sacred ford, those who undertake the vow of Śaṅkara / but are filled with greed, go to a degraded birth without doubt.

6.3.s:
na tīrthairna ca dānaiśca duṣkṛtaṃ hi vilupyate .
ajñānācca pramādācca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyati .. 11.39 ..
6.3.d:
न तीर्थैर्न च दानैश्च दुष्कृतं हि विलुप्यते .
अज्ञानाच्च प्रमादाच्च कृतं पापं विनश्यति .. 11.39 ..
6.3.m: An evil deed is not wiped out by sacred fords or by gifts; / only sin committed out of ignorance or negligence is destroyed [by them].

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā tu vidhinā vartitavyaṃ dvijātibhiḥ .
paraṃ brahma japadbhiśca vārtitavyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ .. 11.40 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु विधिना वर्तितव्यं द्विजातिभिः .
परं ब्रह्म जपद्भिश्च वार्तितव्यं मुहुर्मुहुः .. 11.40 ..
6.3.m: Having understood this, the twice-born should act according to the proper rule, / and repeating the Supreme Brahman, they should conduct themselves constantly.

6.3.s:
ūrdhvarūpaṃ virūpākṣaṃ yo'dhīte rudrameva ca .
īśānaṃ paśyate sākṣātṣaṇmāsātsaṅgavarjitaḥ .. 11.41 ..
6.3.d:
ऊर्ध्वरूपं विरूपाक्षं योऽधीते रुद्रमेव च .
ईशानं पश्यते साक्षात्षण्मासात्सङ्गवर्जितः .. 11.41 ..
6.3.m: He who recites [the hymn to] the Upward-formed, the Odd-eyed, Rudra himself, / sees Īśāna directly after six months, freed from all attachment.

6.3.s:
saṃhitāyā daśāvṛttīryaḥ karoti susaṃyataḥ .
narmadātaṭamāśritya sa mucyetsarvapātakaiḥ .. 11.42 ..
6.3.d:
संहिताया दशावृत्तीर्यः करोति सुसंयतः .
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य स मुच्येत्सर्वपातकैः .. 11.42 ..
6.3.m: He who, having restrained himself well, performs ten repetitions of the Saṃhitā / while resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ vāpi śaivīṃ vā vaiṣṇavīmapi .
yaḥ paṭhennarmadātīre śivāgre sa śivātmakaḥ .. 11.43 ..
6.3.d:
पुराणसंहितां वापि शैवीं वा वैष्णवीमपि .
यः पठेन्नर्मदातीरे शिवाग्रे स शिवात्मकः .. 11.43 ..
6.3.m: Or whatever Purāṇa-saṃhitā, whether Śaiva or Vaiṣṇava, / one recites on the bank of the Narmadā before Śiva, he becomes identical with Śiva.

6.3.s:
ā bhūtasaṃkṣayaṃ yāvatsvargaloke mahīyate .
saṃsākhyasanaṃ hātuṃ purā proktaṃ tu nandinā .. 11.44 ..
6.3.d:
आ भूतसंक्षयं यावत्स्वर्गलोके महीयते .
संसाख्यसनं हातुं पुरा प्रोक्तं तु नन्दिना .. 11.44 ..
6.3.m: He is honored in the heavenly world until the destruction of all beings. / Formerly, in order to abandon the calamity of transmigration, [this] was spoken by Nandin

6.3.s:
devarṣisiddhagandharvasamavāye śivālaye .
nandigītāmimāṃ rājañchṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ śubhām .. 11.45 ..
6.3.d:
देवर्षिसिद्धगन्धर्वसमवाये शिवालये .
नन्दिगीतामिमां राजञ्छृणुष्वैकमनाः शुभाम् .. 11.45 ..
6.3.m: in the assembly of celestial seers, siddhas, and gandharvas in the abode of Śiva. / Listen with single-minded focus, O King, to this auspicious song of Nandin,

6.3.s: svargamokṣapradāṃ puṇyāṃ saṃsārabhayanāśinīm .. 11.46 ..
6.3.d: स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदां पुण्यां संसारभयनाशिनीम् .. 11.46 ..
6.3.m: which grants heaven and liberation, is meritorious, and destroys the fear of transmigration:

6.3.s:
saṃsāragahvaraguhāṃ pravihātumetāṃ cedicchatha pratipadaṃ bhavatāpakhinnāḥ .
nānāvidhairnijakṛtairbahukarmapāśairbaddhāḥ sukhāya śṛṇutaikahitaṃ mayoktam .. 11.47 ..
6.3.d:
संसारगह्वरगुहां प्रविहातुमेतां चेदिच्छथ प्रतिपदं भवतापखिन्नाः .
नानाविधैर्निजकृतैर्बहुकर्मपाशैर्बद्धाः सुखाय शृणुतैकहितं मयोक्तम् .. 11.47 ..
6.3.m: “If you wish to abandon this cavernous cave of transmigration, distressed at every step by the torment of worldly existence, / bound by the diverse ropes of your own manifold deeds, listen for your happiness to the one beneficial thing spoken by me.

6.3.s:
śakra vakragatiṃ mā gā mā kṛthā yama yātanām .
cetaḥ pracetaḥ śamaya laulupyaṃ tyaja vittapa .. 11.48 ..
6.3.d:
शक्र वक्रगतिं मा गा मा कृथा यम यातनाम् .
चेतः प्रचेतः शमय लौलुप्यं त्यज वित्तप .. 11.48 ..
6.3.m: O Śakra, do not follow a crooked path! O Yama, do not inflict torment! / O Pracetas, calm your mind! O Kubera, abandon greed!

6.3.s:
dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyo dhanaṃ sarvaṃ parityaja .
yadi saṃsārajaladhervīcīpreṅkhollanāturaḥ .. 11.49 ..
6.3.d:
दीनानाथविशिष्टेभ्यो धनं सर्वं परित्यज .
यदि संसारजलधेर्वीचीप्रेङ्खोल्लनातुरः .. 11.49 ..
6.3.m: Surrender all your wealth to the poor, the helpless, and the distinguished, / if you are afflicted by the tossing of the waves of the ocean of transmigration.

6.3.s:
janmodvignaṃ mṛtestrastaṃ grastaṃ kāmādibhirnaram .
srastaṃ yo na yamādibhyaḥ pinākī pāti pāvanaḥ .. 11.50 ..
6.3.d:
जन्मोद्विग्नं मृतेस्त्रस्तं ग्रस्तं कामादिभिर्नरम् .
स्रस्तं यो न यमादिभ्यः पिनाकी पाति पावनः .. 11.50 ..
6.3.m: A man agitated by birth, terrified of death, seized by desire and the rest, / and fallen away from Yama and the others—the purifier holding the Pināka protects him.

6.3.s:
mā dhehi garvaṃ kīnāśa hāsyaṃ yāsyasi pīḍayan .
prāṇinaṃ sarvaśaraṇaṃ tadbhāvi śaraṇaṃ tava .. 11.51 ..
6.3.d:
मा धेहि गर्वं कीनाश हास्यं यास्यसि पीडयन् .
प्राणिनं सर्वशरणं तद्भावि शरणं तव .. 11.51 ..
6.3.m: Do not be arrogant, O Yama; you will become a laughingstock by tormenting / a living being who has taken refuge in all; he will become your refuge.

6.3.s:
kālaḥ karālako bālaḥ ko mṛtyuḥ ko yamādhamaḥ .
śivaviṣṇuparāṇāṃ hi narāṇāṃ kiṃ bhayaṃ bhavet .. 11.52 ..
6.3.d:
कालः करालको बालः को मृत्युः को यमाधमः .
शिवविष्णुपराणां हि नराणां किं भयं भवेत् .. 11.52 ..
6.3.m: What is terrible Time, a mere child? What is Death? What is vile Yama? / What fear could there be for men devoted to Śiva and Viṣṇu?

6.3.s:
bhavabhārārtajantūnāṃ revātīranivāsinām .
bhargaśca bhagavāṃścaiva bhavabhītivibhedanau .. 11.53 ..
6.3.d:
भवभारार्तजन्तूनां रेवातीरनिवासिनाम् .
भर्गश्च भगवांश्चैव भवभीतिविभेदनौ .. 11.53 ..
6.3.m: For living beings afflicted by the burden of worldly existence who reside on the bank of the Revā, / Bharga and the Lord are indeed the dispellers of the fear of worldly existence.

6.3.s:
śivaṃ bhaja śivaṃ dhyāya śivaṃ stuhi śivaṃ yaja .
śivaṃ nama varāka tvaṃ jñānaṃ mokṣaṃ yadīcchasi .. 11.54 ..
6.3.d:
शिवं भज शिवं ध्याय शिवं स्तुहि शिवं यज .
शिवं नम वराक त्वं ज्ञानं मोक्षं यदीच्छसि .. 11.54 ..
6.3.m: Worship Śiva, meditate on Śiva, praise Śiva, sacrifice to Śiva, / bow to Śiva, O wretched one, if you desire knowledge and liberation!

6.3.s:
paṭha pañcānanaṃ śāstraṃ mantraṃ pañcākṣaraṃ japa .
dhehi pañcātmakaṃ tattvaṃ yaja pañcānanaṃ param .. 11.55 ..
6.3.d:
पठ पञ्चाननं शास्त्रं मन्त्रं पञ्चाक्षरं जप .
धेहि पञ्चात्मकं तत्त्वं यज पञ्चाननं परम् .. 11.55 ..
6.3.m: Read the scripture of the Five-Faced One; recite the five-syllable mantra; / contemplate the fivefold reality; worship the supreme Five-Faced One!

6.3.s:
kiṃ taiḥ karmagaṇaiḥ śocyairnānābhāvaviśeṣitaiḥ .
yadi pañcānanaḥ śrīmān sevyate sarvathā śivaḥ .. 11.56 ..
6.3.d:
किं तैः कर्मगणैः शोच्यैर्नानाभावविशेषितैः .
यदि पञ्चाननः श्रीमान् सेव्यते सर्वथा शिवः .. 11.56 ..
6.3.m: What use are those lamentable sets of rites distinguished by various states of mind, / if the glorious, five-faced Śiva is served in every way?

6.3.s:
kiṃ saṃsāragajonmattabṛṃhitairnibhṛtairapi .
yadi pañcānano devo bhāvagandhopasevitaḥ .. 11.57 ..
6.3.d:
किं संसारगजोन्मत्तबृंहितैर्निभृतैरपि .
यदि पञ्चाननो देवो भावगन्धोपसेवितः .. 11.57 ..
6.3.m: What use are the roars of the mad elephant of transmigration, even if quieted, / if the five-faced God is attended with the fragrance of devotion?

6.3.s:
re mūḍha kiṃ viṣādena prāpya karmakadarthanām .
bhavānīvallabhaṃ bhīmaṃ japa tvaṃ bhayanāśanam .. 11.58 ..
6.3.d:
रे मूढ किं विषादेन प्राप्य कर्मकदर्थनाम् .
भवानीवल्लभं भीमं जप त्वं भयनाशनम् .. 11.58 ..
6.3.m: O fool, why despair upon meeting the torment of your actions? / Recite the name of Bhavānī's beloved, the terrible one, the destroyer of fear!

6.3.s:
narmadātīranilayaṃ duḥkhaughavilayaṃkaram .
svargamokṣapradaṃ bhargaṃ bhaja mūḍha sureśvaram .. 11.59 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातीरनिलयं दुःखौघविलयंकरम् .
स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदं भर्गं भज मूढ सुरेश्वरम् .. 11.59 ..
6.3.m: Worship Bharga, the lord of gods, who dwells on the bank of the Narmadā, / who dissolves the flood of sorrow, and who grants heaven and liberation, O fool!

6.3.s:
vihāya revāṃ surasindhusevyāṃ tattīrasaṃsthaṃ ca haraṃ hariṃ ca .
unmattavadbhāvavivarjitastvaṃ kva yāsi re mūḍha digantarāṇi .. 11.60 ..
6.3.d:
विहाय रेवां सुरसिन्धुसेव्यां तत्तीरसंस्थं च हरं हरिं च .
उन्मत्तवद्भावविवर्जितस्त्वं क्व यासि रे मूढ दिगन्तराणि .. 11.60 ..
6.3.m: Having abandoned the Revā served by the river of the gods, and Hara and Hari residing on its bank, / where are you wandering to foreign directions like a madman devoid of devotion, O fool?

6.3.s:
bhaja revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ yaja rudraṃ sanātanam .
japa pañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vraja sthānaṃ ca vāñchitam .. 11.61 ..
6.3.d:
भज रेवाजलं पुण्यं यज रुद्रं सनातनम् .
जप पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यां व्रज स्थानं च वाञ्छितम् .. 11.61 ..
6.3.m: Worship the holy water of the Revā; sacrifice to eternal Rudra; / recite the five-syllable spell, and go to the desired abode!

6.3.s:
kleśayitvā nijaṃ kāyamupāyairbahubhistu kim .
bhaja revāṃ śivaṃ prāpya sukhasādhyaṃ paraṃ padam .. 11.62 ..
6.3.d:
क्लेशयित्वा निजं कायमुपायैर्बहुभिस्तु किम् .
भज रेवां शिवं प्राप्य सुखसाध्यं परं पदम् .. 11.62 ..
6.3.m: What is the use of tormenting your own body with manifold contrivances? / Worship the Revā; having attained Śiva, [reach] the supreme state that is easily achieved!”

6.3.s:
evaṃ kailāsamāsādya nadīṃ sa śivasannidhau .
jagau yallokapālānāṃ tanmayoktaṃ tavādhunā .. 11.63 ..
6.3.d:
एवं कैलासमासाद्य नदीं स शिवसन्निधौ .
जगौ यल्लोकपालानां तन्मयोक्तं तवाधुना .. 11.63 ..
6.3.m: Having thus reached Kailāsa, what he sang concerning the river in the presence of Śiva / to the world guardians has now been told to you by me.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
snānadānaparo yastu nityaṃ dharmamanuvrataḥ .
narmadātīramāśritya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 11.64 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
स्नानदानपरो यस्तु नित्यं धर्ममनुव्रतः .
नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 11.64 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / He who is devoted to ritual ablution and gifting, always following righteousness, / resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
vidhihīno japennityaṃ vedānsarvāñchataṃ samāḥ .
mṛtyulāṅgalajāpyena samo yo'pyadhiko guṇaiḥ .. 11.65 ..
6.3.d:
विधिहीनो जपेन्नित्यं वेदान्सर्वाञ्छतं समाः .
मृत्युलाङ्गलजाप्येन समो योऽप्यधिको गुणैः .. 11.65 ..
6.3.m: If devoid of rules, even one who recites all the Vedas daily for a hundred years / or one who is superior in virtues is merely equal to the recitation of the Mṛtyulāṅgala [mantra].

6.3.s:
bījayonyaviśuddhastu yathā rudraṃ na vindati .
tathā lāṅgalamantro'pi na tiṣṭhati gatāyuṣi .. 11.66 ..
6.3.d:
बीजयोन्यविशुद्धस्तु यथा रुद्रं न विन्दति .
तथा लाङ्गलमन्त्रोऽपि न तिष्ठति गतायुषि .. 11.66 ..
6.3.m: Just as one who is impure in seed and womb does not find Rudra, / so too even the Lāṅgala mantra does not remain with one whose life is gone.

6.3.s:
gāyatrījapasaṃyuktaḥ saṃyamī hyadhiko guṇaiḥ .
agnimīḍe iṣetvo vā agna āyāhi nityadā .. 11.67 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्रीजपसंयुक्तः संयमी ह्यधिको गुणैः .
अग्निमीडे इषेत्वो वा अग्न आयाहि नित्यदा .. 11.67 ..
6.3.m: Joined with the recitation of the Gāyatrī, self-restrained, he is indeed superior in virtues, / [reciting] constantly “agnim īḍe”, “iṣe tvorje tvā”, or “agna āyāhi”.

6.3.s: śanno devīti kūlastho japenmucyeta kilbiṣaiḥ .. 11.68 ..
6.3.d: शन्नो देवीति कूलस्थो जपेन्मुच्येत किल्बिषैः .. 11.68 ..
6.3.m: Standing on the bank, one who recites 'śanno devīḥ…' is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
sāṅgopāṅgāṃstathā vedāñjapannityaṃ samāhitaḥ .
na tatphalamavāpnoti gāyatryā saṃyamī yathā .. 11.69 ..
6.3.d:
साङ्गोपाङ्गांस्तथा वेदाञ्जपन्नित्यं समाहितः .
न तत्फलमवाप्नोति गायत्र्या संयमी यथा .. 11.69 ..
6.3.m: Even by constantly reciting the Vedas along with their auxiliary and secondary branches with a concentrated mind, / one does not attain that fruit which a self-restrained man attains through the Gāyatrī.

6.3.s:
rudrādhyāyaṃ sakṛjjaptvā vipro vedasamanvitaḥ .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 11.70 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्राध्यायं सकृज्जप्त्वा विप्रो वेदसमन्वितः .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 11.70 ..
6.3.m: Having recited the Rudrādhyāya once, a brahmin endowed with the Veda / is freed from all sins and goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
anyadvai japyasaṃsthānaṃ sūktamāraṇyakaṃ tathā .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati .. 11.71 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यद्वै जप्यसंस्थानं सूक्तमारण्यकं तथा .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति .. 11.71 ..
6.3.m: Or another collection of chants, a hymn or an Āraṇyaka— / [by reciting it] he is freed from all sins and goes to the world of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
yatkiṃcitkriyate jāpyaṃ yacca dānaṃ pradīyate .
narmadājalamāśritya tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet .. 11.72 ..
6.3.d:
यत्किंचित्क्रियते जाप्यं यच्च दानं प्रदीयते .
नर्मदाजलमाश्रित्य तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत् .. 11.72 ..
6.3.m: Whatever recitation is performed and whatever gift is given / resorting to the waters of the Narmadā, all that becomes inexhaustible.

6.3.s:
evaṃvidhairvratairnityaṃ narmadāṃ ye samāśritāḥ .
te mṛtā vaiṣṇavaṃ yānti padaṃ vā śaivamavyayam .. 11.73 ..
6.3.d:
एवंविधैर्व्रतैर्नित्यं नर्मदां ये समाश्रिताः .
ते मृता वैष्णवं यान्ति पदं वा शैवमव्ययम् .. 11.73 ..
6.3.m: Those who constantly resort to the Narmadā with vows of this kind, / upon death, attain the realm of Viṣṇu or the imperishable abode of Śiva.

6.3.s:
satyalokaṃ narāḥ kecitsūryalokaṃ tathāpare .
apsarogaṇasaṃvītā yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 11.74 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यलोकं नराः केचित्सूर्यलोकं तथापरे .
अप्सरोगणसंवीता यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 11.74 ..
6.3.m: Some men go to Satyaloka, and others to the solar world, / surrounded by hosts of apsarases until the cosmic dissolution.

6.3.s:
evaṃ vai vartamāne'smiṃlloke tu nṛpapuṃgava .
ṛṣīṇāṃ daśakoṭyastu kurukṣetranivāsinām .. 11.75 ..
6.3.d:
एवं वै वर्तमानेऽस्मिंल्लोके तु नृपपुंगव .
ऋषीणां दशकोट्यस्तु कुरुक्षेत्रनिवासिनाम् .. 11.75 ..
6.3.m: While this world was thus enduring, O bull among kings, / ten crores of seers residing in Kurukṣetra,

6.3.s:
mayā saha mahābhāga narmadātaṭamāśritāḥ .
phalamūlakṛtāhārā arcayantaḥ sthitāḥ śivam .. 11.76 ..
6.3.d:
मया सह महाभाग नर्मदातटमाश्रिताः .
फलमूलकृताहारा अर्चयन्तः स्थिताः शिवम् .. 11.76 ..
6.3.m: Resorted to the banks of the Narmadā together with me, O highly fortunate one; / subsisting on fruits and roots, they remained worshiping Śiva.

6.3.s:
tacca varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ kālasaṃkhyānumānataḥ .
ṣaḍviṃśatisahasrāṇi tāni mānuṣasaṃkhyayā .. 11.77 ..
6.3.d:
तच्च वर्षशतं दिव्यं कालसंख्यानुमानतः .
षड्विंशतिसहस्राणि तानि मानुषसंख्यया .. 11.77 ..
6.3.m: And that [period was] a hundred divine years according to the calculation of time, / which is twenty-six thousand by human reckoning.

6.3.s:
tatastasyāmatītāyāṃ sandhyāyāṃ nṛpasattama .
śeṣaṃ mānuṣyamekaṃ tu kāle varṣaśataṃ sthitam .. 11.78 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तस्यामतीतायां सन्ध्यायां नृपसत्तम .
शेषं मानुष्यमेकं तु काले वर्षशतं स्थितम् .. 11.78 ..
6.3.m: Then, when that twilight period had passed, O best of kings, / one remaining human century of time was left.

6.3.s:
tato'bhavadanāvṛṣṭirlokakṣayakarī tadā .
yayā yātaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kṣayaṃ bhūyo hi dāruṇam .. 11.79 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽभवदनावृष्टिर्लोकक्षयकरी तदा .
यया यातं जगत्सर्वं क्षयं भूयो हि दारुणम् .. 11.79 ..
6.3.m: Then a drought occurred that caused the destruction of the worlds, / by which the entire universe again suffered terrible ruin.

6.3.s:
ye pūrvamiha saṃsiddhā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ .
teṣāṃ prabhāvādbhagavān vavarṣa balavṛtrahā .. 11.80 ..
6.3.d:
ये पूर्वमिह संसिद्धा ऋषयो वेदपारगाः .
तेषां प्रभावाद्भगवान् ववर्ष बलवृत्रहा .. 11.80 ..
6.3.m: By the power of those seers who had previously attained perfection here, masters of the Vedas, / the blessed slayer of Bala and Vṛtra made it rain.

6.3.s:
mahatī bhūrisalilā samantādvṛṣṭirāhitā .
tato vṛṣṭyā tu teṣāṃ vai vartanaṃ samajāyata .. 11.81 ..
6.3.d:
महती भूरिसलिला समन्ताद्वृष्टिराहिता .
ततो वृष्ट्या तु तेषां वै वर्तनं समजायत .. 11.81 ..
6.3.m: A great rain with abundant water was poured down on all sides; / then indeed, by that rain, their sustenance was ensured.

6.3.s:
punaryugānte samprāpte kiṃciccheṣe kalau yuge .
niḥśeṣamabhavatsarvaṃ śuṣkaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam .. 11.82 ..
6.3.d:
पुनर्युगान्ते सम्प्राप्ते किंचिच्छेषे कलौ युगे .
निःशेषमभवत्सर्वं शुष्कं स्थावरजङ्गमम् .. 11.82 ..
6.3.m: When the end of the yuga arrived again and a little of the Kali yuga remained, / everything, both moving and unmoving, dried up completely.

6.3.s:
nirvṛkṣauṣadhagulmaṃ ca tṛṇavīrudvivarjitam .
anāvṛṣṭihataṃ sarvaṃ bhūmaṇḍalamabhūdbhṛśam .. 11.83 ..
6.3.d:
निर्वृक्षौषधगुल्मं च तृणवीरुद्विवर्जितम् .
अनावृष्टिहतं सर्वं भूमण्डलमभूद्भृशम् .. 11.83 ..
6.3.m: Devoid of trees, medicinal herbs, and shrubs, and bereft of grass and climbing plants, / the entire globe of the earth was severely struck by drought.

6.3.s:
tataste ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṣuttṛṣārtāḥ sahasraśaḥ .
yugasvabhāvamāviṣṭā hīnasattvā abhavannṛpa .. 11.84 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्ते ऋषयः सर्वे क्षुत्तृषार्ताः सहस्रशः .
युगस्वभावमाविष्टा हीनसत्त्वा अभवन्नृप .. 11.84 ..
6.3.m: Then all those thousands of seers, afflicted with hunger and thirst, / overtaken by the nature of the yuga, lost their strength, O king.

6.3.s:
naṣṭahomasvadhākāre yugānte samupasthite .
kiṃ kāryaṃ kva nu yāsyāmaḥ ko'smākaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavet .. 11.85 ..
6.3.d:
नष्टहोमस्वधाकारे युगान्ते समुपस्थिते .
किं कार्यं क्व नु यास्यामः कोऽस्माकं शरणं भवेत् .. 11.85 ..
6.3.m: When the sacrificial offerings and svadhā-calls had perished and the end of the yuga was imminent, [they said:] / 'What is to be done? Where shall we go? Who will be our refuge?'

6.3.s:
tānahaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ mā bhaiṣṭeti punaḥpunaḥ .
īdṛgvidhā mayā dṛṣṭā bahavaḥ kālaparyayāḥ .. 11.86 ..
6.3.d:
तानहं प्रत्युवाचेदं मा भैष्टेति पुनःपुनः .
ईदृग्विधा मया दृष्टा बहवः कालपर्ययाः .. 11.86 ..
6.3.m: I said to them in reply, 'Do not fear!' again and again; / 'Many such revolutions of time have been witnessed by me.

6.3.s:
narmadātīramāśritya te sarve gamitā mayā .
eṣā hi śaraṇaṃ devī samprāpte hi yugakṣaye .. 11.87 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्य ते सर्वे गमिता मया .
एषा हि शरणं देवी सम्प्राप्ते हि युगक्षये .. 11.87 ..
6.3.m: Resorting to the banks of the Narmadā, they were all passed by me. / She indeed is our refuge, O goddess, when the destruction of the yuga arrives.

6.3.s:
nānyā gatirihāsmākaṃ vidyate dvijasattamāḥ .
janitrī sarvabhūtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa dvijottamāḥ .. 11.88 ..
6.3.d:
नान्या गतिरिहास्माकं विद्यते द्विजसत्तमाः .
जनित्री सर्वभूतानां विशेषेण द्विजोत्तमाः .. 11.88 ..
6.3.m: No other recourse exists for us here, O best of the twice-born; / she is the mother of all beings, especially of the best of the twice-born.

6.3.s:
pitāmahā ye pitaro ye cānye prapitāmahāḥ .
te samastā gatāḥ svargaṃ samāśritya mahānadīm .. 11.89 ..
6.3.d:
पितामहा ये पितरो ये चान्ये प्रपितामहाः .
ते समस्ता गताः स्वर्गं समाश्रित्य महानदीम् .. 11.89 ..
6.3.m: The grandfathers, fathers, and whatever other great-grandfathers [there were], / all of them went to heaven by resorting to the great river.

6.3.s:
bhṛgvādyāḥ sapta ye tvāsanmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ .
dhaumṛṇī ca mahābhāgā mama bhāryā śucismitā .
manasvatī ca yā matā bhārgavo'ṅgirasastathā .. 11.90 ..
6.3.d:
भृग्वाद्याः सप्त ये त्वासन्मम पूर्वपितामहाः .
धौमृणी च महाभागा मम भार्या शुचिस्मिता .
मनस्वती च या मता भार्गवोऽङ्गिरसस्तथा .. 11.90 ..
6.3.m: The seven, beginning with Bhṛgu, who were my ancestral forefathers, / and the highly fortunate Dhaumṛṇī of bright smile, my wife, / and she who was regarded as Manasvatī, as well as Bhārgava and Aṅgiras,

6.3.s:
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva vasiṣṭhātreyakāśyapāḥ .
tathānye ca mahābhāgā niyamavratacāriṇaḥ .
anye ca śatasāhasrā atra siddhiṃ samāgatāḥ .. 11.91 ..
6.3.d:
पुलस्त्यः पुलहश्चैव वसिष्ठात्रेयकाश्यपाः .
तथान्ये च महाभागा नियमव्रतचारिणः .
अन्ये च शतसाहस्रा अत्र सिद्धिं समागताः .. 11.91 ..
6.3.m: Pulastya, Pulaha, Vasiṣṭha, Atri, and Kāśyapa, / and other highly fortunate observers of restraints and vows, / and hundreds of thousands of others have attained perfection here.

6.3.s:
tasmādiyaṃ mahābhāgā na moktavyā kadācana .
nānyā kācinnadī śaktā lokatrayaphalapradā .. 11.92 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मादियं महाभागा न मोक्तव्या कदाचन .
नान्या काचिन्नदी शक्ता लोकत्रयफलप्रदा .. 11.92 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, this highly fortunate [river] must never be abandoned. / No other river is capable of granting the fruits of the three worlds.

6.3.s:
dvandvairanekairbahubhiḥ kṣuttṛṣādyairmahābhayaiḥ .
mucyante te narāḥ sadyo narmadātīravāsinaḥ .. 11.93 ..
6.3.d:
द्वन्द्वैरनेकैर्बहुभिः क्षुत्तृषाद्यैर्महाभयैः .
मुच्यन्ते ते नराः सद्यो नर्मदातीरवासिनः .. 11.93 ..
6.3.m: From numerous and various dualities, from hunger, thirst, and other great perils, / those men residing on the banks of the Narmadā are instantly freed.

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena sevitavyā saridvarā .
vāñchadbhiḥ paramaṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca .. 11.94 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 12
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन सेवितव्या सरिद्वरा .
वाञ्छद्भिः परमं श्रेय इह लोके परत्र च .. 11.94 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीनर्मदामाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम एकादशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 12
6.3.m:
Therefore, with every effort, this best of rivers must be served / by those who desire the highest good in this world and in the next.'
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Holy Narmadā,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Avantī section, in the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 12

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etacchrutvā vaco rājansaṃhṛṣṭā ṛṣayo'bhavan .
narmadāṃ stotumārabdhāḥ kṛtāñjalipuṭā dvijāḥ .. 12.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजन्संहृष्टा ऋषयोऽभवन् .
नर्मदां स्तोतुमारब्धाः कृताञ्जलिपुटा द्विजाः .. 12.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having heard these words, O king, the seers were delighted. / With folded hands, the twice-born began to praise the Narmadā:

6.3.s:
namo'stu te puṇyajale namo makaragāmini .
namaste pāpamocinyai namo devi varānane .. 12.2 ..
6.3.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते पुण्यजले नमो मकरगामिनि .
नमस्ते पापमोचिन्यै नमो देवि वरानने .. 12.2 ..
6.3.m: 'Salutations to you of sacred water; salutations to you who ride on a makara! / Salutations to you, O deliverer from sin; salutations, O goddess of beautiful face!

6.3.s:
namo'stu te puṇyajalāśraye śubhe viśuddhasattvaṃ surasiddhasevite .
namo'stu te tīrthagaṇairniṣevite namo'stu rudrāṅgasamudbhave vare .. 12.3 ..
6.3.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते पुण्यजलाश्रये शुभे विशुद्धसत्त्वं सुरसिद्धसेविते .
नमोऽस्तु ते तीर्थगणैर्निषेविते नमोऽस्तु रुद्राङ्गसमुद्भवे वरे .. 12.3 ..
6.3.m: Salutations to you, O auspicious abode of sacred waters, pure of essence, served by gods and siddhas! / Salutations to you, frequented by hosts of sacred fords; salutations to you, O excellent one born from Rudra's body!

6.3.s:
namo'stu te devi samudragāmini namo'stu te devi varaprade śive .
namo'stu lokadvayasaukhyadāyini hyanekabhūtaughasamāśrite'naghe .. 12.4 ..
6.3.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते देवि समुद्रगामिनि नमोऽस्तु ते देवि वरप्रदे शिवे .
नमोऽस्तु लोकद्वयसौख्यदायिनि ह्यनेकभूतौघसमाश्रितेऽनघे .. 12.4 ..
6.3.m: Salutations to you, O goddess who flow to the ocean; salutations to you, O auspicious goddess who grant boons! / Salutations to you who grant happiness in both worlds, who are resorted to by countless multitudes of beings, O sinless one!

6.3.s:
saridvare pāpahare vicitrite gandharvayakṣoragasevitāṅge .
sanātani prāṇigaṇānukampini mokṣaprade devi vidhehi śaṃ naḥ .. 12.5 ..
6.3.d:
सरिद्वरे पापहरे विचित्रिते गन्धर्वयक्षोरगसेविताङ्गे .
सनातनि प्राणिगणानुकम्पिनि मोक्षप्रदे देवि विधेहि शं नः .. 12.5 ..
6.3.m: O best of rivers, remover of sins, variegated one whose body is served by Gandharvas, Yakṣas, and Uragas! / O eternal one, compassionate toward all living beings, bestower of liberation! O goddess, grant us welfare!

6.3.s:
mahāgajairghamahiṣairvarāhaiḥ saṃsevite devi mahormimāle .
natāḥ sma sarve varade sukhaprade vimocayāsmānpaśupāśabandhāt .. 12.6 ..
6.3.d:
महागजैर्घमहिषैर्वराहैः संसेविते देवि महोर्मिमाले .
नताः स्म सर्वे वरदे सुखप्रदे विमोचयास्मान्पशुपाशबन्धात् .. 12.6 ..
6.3.m: O goddess served by great elephants, dark buffaloes, and boars, adorned with garlands of great waves! / We all bow to you, O giver of boons, O giver of happiness; deliver us from the bonds of paśus!

6.3.s:
pāpairanekairaśubhairvibaddhā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyāḥ .
mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhūtaṃ yāvattavāmbho hi na saṃspṛśanti .. 12.7 ..
6.3.d:
पापैरनेकैरशुभैर्विबद्धा भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु मर्त्याः .
महानिलोद्भूततरङ्गभूतं यावत्तवाम्भो हि न संस्पृशन्ति .. 12.7 ..
6.3.m: Bound by numerous inauspicious sins, mortals wander in hells / only so long as they do not touch your waters, which are stirred into waves by the mighty wind.

6.3.s:
anekaduḥkhaughabhayārditānāṃ pāpairanekairabhiveṣṭitānām .
gatistvamambhojasamānavakre dvandvairanekairapi saṃvṛtānām .. 12.8 ..
6.3.d:
अनेकदुःखौघभयार्दितानां पापैरनेकैरभिवेष्टितानाम् .
गतिस्त्वमम्भोजसमानवक्रे द्वन्द्वैरनेकैरपि संवृतानाम् .. 12.8 ..
6.3.m: To those tormented by the perils of countless afflictions, enveloped in numerous sins, / and surrounded by various dualities, you are the refuge, O one whose face resembles a lotus!

6.3.s:
nadyaśca pūtā vimalā bhavanti tvāṃ devi samprāpya na saṃśayo'tra .
duḥkhāturāṇāmabhayaṃ dadāsi śiṣṭairanekairabhipūjitāsi .. 12.9 ..
6.3.d:
नद्यश्च पूता विमला भवन्ति त्वां देवि सम्प्राप्य न संशयोऽत्र .
दुःखातुराणामभयं ददासि शिष्टैरनेकैरभिपूजितासि .. 12.9 ..
6.3.m: Even rivers become purified and spotless upon reaching you, O goddess; there is no doubt about this. / You give fearlessness to those distressed by suffering; you are worshiped by many virtuous ones.

6.3.s:
spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveśca tadaiva dadyātparamaṃ padaṃ tu .
yatropalāḥ puṇyajalāplutāste śivatvamāyānti kimatra citram .. 12.10 ..
6.3.d:
स्पृष्टं करैश्चन्द्रमसो रवेश्च तदैव दद्यात्परमं पदं तु .
यत्रोपलाः पुण्यजलाप्लुतास्ते शिवत्वमायान्ति किमत्र चित्रम् .. 12.10 ..
6.3.m: Touched by the rays of the moon and the sun, she immediately grants the highest realm; / and where the stones immersed in your sacred water attain Śiva-hood, what is there to wonder at?

6.3.s:
bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyā duḥkhāturāḥ pāpaparītadehāḥ .
mahānilodbhūtataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ yāvattavāmbho na hi saṃśrayanti .. 12.11 ..
6.3.d:
भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु मर्त्या दुःखातुराः पापपरीतदेहाः .
महानिलोद्भूततरङ्गभङ्गं यावत्तवाम्भो न हि संश्रयन्ति .. 12.11 ..
6.3.m: Mortals wander in hells, tormented by suffering and their bodies covered in sins, / only so long as they do not resort to your water with breaking waves raised by the mighty wind.

6.3.s:
mlecchāḥ pulindāstvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti ye'mbhastava devi puṇyam .
muktā bhavantīha bhayāttu ghorānniḥsaṃśayaṃ te'pi kimatra citram .. 12.12 ..
6.3.d:
म्लेच्छाः पुलिन्दास्त्वथ यातुधानाः पिबन्ति येऽम्भस्तव देवि पुण्यम् .
मुक्ता भवन्तीह भयात्तु घोरान्निःसंशयं तेऽपि किमत्र चित्रम् .. 12.12 ..
6.3.m: Even Mlecchas, Pulindas, and Yātudhānas who drink your sacred water, O goddess, / are undoubtedly freed here from terrible fear—what is there to wonder at?'

6.3.s:
sarāṃsi nadyaḥ kṣayamabhyupetā ghore yuge'smin hi kalau pradūṣite .
tvaṃ bhrājase devi jalaughapūrṇā divīva nakṣatrapathe ca gaṅgā .. 12.13 ..
6.3.d:
सरांसि नद्यः क्षयमभ्युपेता घोरे युगेऽस्मिन् हि कलौ प्रदूषिते .
त्वं भ्राजसे देवि जलौघपूर्णा दिवीव नक्षत्रपथे च गङ्गा .. 12.13 ..
6.3.m: Lakes and rivers have met with destruction in this dreadful, corrupted Kali age, / but you shine, O goddess, filled with floods of water, like the Gaṅgā in the sky on the path of the constellations.

6.3.s:
tava prasādādvarade variṣṭhe kālaṃ yathemaṃ paripālayitvā .
yāmo'tha rudraṃ tava suprasādādvayaṃ tathā tvaṃ kuru vai prasādam .. 12.14 ..
6.3.d:
तव प्रसादाद्वरदे वरिष्ठे कालं यथेमं परिपालयित्वा .
यामोऽथ रुद्रं तव सुप्रसादाद्वयं तथा त्वं कुरु वै प्रसादम् .. 12.14 ..
6.3.m: O bestower of boons, O most excellent one! By your grace, having thus endured this time, / may we then go to Rudra by your good grace; please grant that grace to us.

6.3.s:
gatistvamambeva piteva putrāṃstvaṃ pāhi no yāvadimaṃ yugāntam .
kālaṃ tvanāvṛṣṭihataṃ sughoraṃ yāvattarāmastava suprasādāt .. 12.15 ..
6.3.d:
गतिस्त्वमम्बेव पितेव पुत्रांस्त्वं पाहि नो यावदिमं युगान्तम् .
कालं त्वनावृष्टिहतं सुघोरं यावत्तरामस्तव सुप्रसादात् .. 12.15 ..
6.3.m: You are our refuge, like a mother and like a father to children; protect us until this end of the age, / so that we may cross over this most terrible time stricken by drought, by your good grace.

6.3.s:
paṭhanti ye stotramidaṃ dvijendrāḥ śṛṇvanti ye cāpi narāḥ praśāntāḥ .
te yānti rudraṃ vṛṣasaṃyutena yānena divyāmbarabhūṣitāśca .. 12.16 ..
6.3.d:
पठन्ति ये स्तोत्रमिदं द्विजेन्द्राः शृण्वन्ति ये चापि नराः प्रशान्ताः .
ते यान्ति रुद्रं वृषसंयुतेन यानेन दिव्याम्बरभूषिताश्च .. 12.16 ..
6.3.m: The best among the twice-born who recite this hymn of praise, and the tranquil men who listen to it, / adorned with divine garments, go to Rudra in a vehicle accompanied by a bull.

6.3.s:
ye stotrametatsatataṃ paṭhanti snātvā tu toye khalu narmadāyāḥ .
ante hi teṣāṃ sariduttameyaṃ gatiṃ viśuddhāmacirāddadāti .. 12.17 ..
6.3.d:
ये स्तोत्रमेतत्सततं पठन्ति स्नात्वा तु तोये खलु नर्मदायाः .
अन्ते हि तेषां सरिदुत्तमेयं गतिं विशुद्धामचिराद्ददाति .. 12.17 ..
6.3.m: Those who constantly recite this hymn after having bathed in the water of the Narmadā, / to them at the end this best of rivers soon gives a purified state.

6.3.s:
prātaḥ samutthāya tathā śayāno yaḥ kīrtayetānudinaṃ stavaṃ ca .
sa muktapāpaḥ suviśuddhadehaḥ samāśrayaṃ yāti maheśvarasya .. 12.18 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye narmadāstotrakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
प्रातः समुत्थाय तथा शयानो यः कीर्तयेतानुदिनं स्तवं च .
स मुक्तपापः सुविशुद्धदेहः समाश्रयं याति महेश्वरस्य .. 12.18 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीनर्मदामाहात्म्ये नर्मदास्तोत्रकथनं नाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Having risen in the morning, and likewise when lying down, whoever praises [her] day after day with this hymn, / freed from sin, his body completely purified, goes to the shelter of Maheśvara.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, entitled 'Recital of the Narmadā Hymn,' in the Revered Narmadā-māhātmya, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section, in the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 13
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evaṃ bhagavatī puṇyā stutā sā munipuṃgavaiḥ .
cintayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ dāsyāmi varamuttamam .. 13.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 13
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवं भगवती पुण्या स्तुता सा मुनिपुंगवैः .
चिन्तयामास सर्वेषां दास्यामि वरमुत्तमम् .. 13.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 13 / The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus praised by the foremost of sages, that holy goddess / thought: "I shall bestow an excellent boon upon all of them."

6.3.s:
tataḥ prasuptāṃstāñjñātvā rātrau devī jagāma ha .
ekaikasya ṛṣeḥ svapne darśanaṃ cāruhāsinī .. 13.2 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रसुप्तांस्ताञ्ज्ञात्वा रात्रौ देवी जगाम ह .
एकैकस्य ऋषेः स्वप्ने दर्शनं चारुहासिनी .. 13.2 ..
6.3.m: Then, knowing they had fallen fast asleep at night, the sweet-smiling goddess went / and appeared individually in the dream of each seer.

6.3.s:
tato'rdharātre samprāpta utthitā jalamadhyataḥ .
vimalāmbarasaṃvītā divyamālāvibhūṣitā .. 13.3 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽर्धरात्रे सम्प्राप्त उत्थिता जलमध्यतः .
विमलाम्बरसंवीता दिव्यमालाविभूषिता .. 13.3 ..
6.3.m: Then, when midnight arrived, she rose from the midst of the waters, / clothed in spotless garments, adorned with divine garlands,

6.3.s:
ghṛtātapatrā suśroṇī padmarāgavibhūṣitā .
jagāda mā bhairiti tānekaikaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak .. 13.4 ..
6.3.d:
घृतातपत्रा सुश्रोणी पद्मरागविभूषिता .
जगाद मा भैरिति तानेकैकं तु पृथक्पृथक् .. 13.4 ..
6.3.m: holding a parasol, of beautiful hips, adorned with rubies. / She said to each one of them separately, "Do not fear!

6.3.s: vasadhvaṃ mama pārśve tu bhayaṃ tyaktvā kṣudhādijam .. 13.5 ..
6.3.d: वसध्वं मम पार्श्वे तु भयं त्यक्त्वा क्षुधादिजम् .. 13.5 ..
6.3.m: Dwell by my side, casting aside fear arising from hunger and the like."

6.3.s:
evamuktvā tadā devī svapnānte tānmahāmunīn .
jagāmādarśanaṃ paścātpraviśya jalamātmikam .. 13.6 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी स्वप्नान्ते तान्महामुनीन् .
जगामादर्शनं पश्चात्प्रविश्य जलमात्मिकम् .. 13.6 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus to those great sages at the end of their dream, the goddess then / entered into her own waters and vanished from sight.

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhāte munayo mitha ūcurmudanvitāḥ .
tathā dṛṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭā svapne devī sudarśanā .. 13.7 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभाते मुनयो मिथ ऊचुर्मुदन्विताः .
तथा दृष्टा मया दृष्टा स्वप्ने देवी सुदर्शना .. 13.7 ..
6.3.m: Then at dawn, the sages, filled with joy, said to one another: / "The lovely goddess was seen by me in a dream just like that!"

6.3.s:
abhayaṃ dattamasmākaṃ siddhiścāpyacireṇa tu .
praśastaṃ darśanaṃ tasyā narmadāyā na saṃśayaḥ .. 13.8 ..
6.3.d:
अभयं दत्तमस्माकं सिद्धिश्चाप्यचिरेण तु .
प्रशस्तं दर्शनं तस्या नर्मदाया न संशयः .. 13.8 ..
6.3.m: "Fearlessness was given to us, and accomplishment will come without delay. / The vision of that Narmadā is auspicious; there is no doubt."

6.3.s:
athānyadivase rājanmatsyānāṃ rūpamuttamam .
paśyanti saparīvārāḥ svakīyāśramasannidhau .. 13.9 ..
6.3.d:
अथान्यदिवसे राजन्मत्स्यानां रूपमुत्तमम् .
पश्यन्ति सपरीवाराः स्वकीयाश्रमसन्निधौ .. 13.9 ..
6.3.m: Then on the next day, O king, along with their families they saw / an extraordinary appearance of fishes near their own hermitage.

6.3.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā matsyāṃstatra maharṣayaḥ .
pūjayāmāsuravyagrā havyakavyena devatāḥ .. 13.10 ..
6.3.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टा मत्स्यांस्तत्र महर्षयः .
पूजयामासुरव्यग्रा हव्यकव्येन देवताः .. 13.10 ..
6.3.m: Having seen the fishes there, the great seers were seized with amazement; / untroubled, they worshipped the gods with oblations and ancestral offerings.

6.3.s:
tānmatsyasaṅghānsamprāpya mahādevyāḥ prasādataḥ .
saputradārabhṛtyāste vartayanti pṛthakpṛthak .. 13.11 ..
6.3.d:
तान्मत्स्यसङ्घान्सम्प्राप्य महादेव्याः प्रसादतः .
सपुत्रदारभृत्यास्ते वर्तयन्ति पृथक्पृथक् .. 13.11 ..
