6.3.m: Having obtained those swarms of fish through the grace of the Great Goddess, / they, together with their sons, wives, and servants, sustained themselves separately.

6.3.s:
dine dine tathāpyevamāśrameṣu dvijātayaḥ .
matsyānāṃ sañcayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāścābhavaṃstadā .. 13.12 ..
6.3.d:
दिने दिने तथाप्येवमाश्रमेषु द्विजातयः .
मत्स्यानां सञ्चयं दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताश्चाभवंस्तदा .. 13.12 ..
6.3.m: Day after day, likewise, the brahmins in their hermitages, / seeing the accumulation of fishes, were then astonished.

6.3.s:
mṛtāṃstāṃstu supuṣṭāṅgān pāṭhīnāṃśca viśeṣataḥ .
dvāre dvāre cāśramāṇāṃ tāpasānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 13.13 ..
6.3.d:
मृतांस्तांस्तु सुपुष्टाङ्गान् पाठीनांश्च विशेषतः .
द्वारे द्वारे चाश्रमाणां तापसानां युधिष्ठिर .. 13.13 ..
6.3.m: They [saw] dead fishes with well-nourished bodies, especially pāṭhīna fish, / at every door of the hermitages of the ascetics, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstadā sarve narmadātīravāsinaḥ .
ṛṣayaste bhayaṃ sarve tatyajuḥ kṣuttṛṣodbhavam .. 13.14 ..
6.3.d:
हृष्टपुष्टास्तदा सर्वे नर्मदातीरवासिनः .
ऋषयस्ते भयं सर्वे तत्यजुः क्षुत्तृषोद्भवम् .. 13.14 ..
6.3.m: Then all those dwellers on the banks of the Narmadā, joyful and well-nourished, / all those seers cast away their fear born of hunger and thirst.

6.3.s:
te japantastapantaśca tiṣṭhanti bharatarṣabha .
arcayanti pitḥndevānnarmadātaṭamāśritāḥ .. 13.15 ..
6.3.d:
ते जपन्तस्तपन्तश्च तिष्ठन्ति भरतर्षभ .
अर्चयन्ति पित्ःन्देवान्नर्मदातटमाश्रिताः .. 13.15 ..
6.3.m: Engaged in chanting and practicing austerity, they remained, O bull among the Bharatas, / worshipping the ancestors and the gods, sheltered on the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
tairjapadbhistapadbhiśca satataṃ dvijasattamaiḥ .
bhrājate sā saricchreṣṭhā tārābhirdyaurgrahairiva .. 13.16 ..
6.3.d:
तैर्जपद्भिस्तपद्भिश्च सततं द्विजसत्तमैः .
भ्राजते सा सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा ताराभिर्द्यौर्ग्रहैरिव .. 13.16 ..
6.3.m: With those best of brahmins continually reciting prayers and practicing austerity, / that best of rivers shone as the sky shines with stars and planets.

6.3.s:
tatra tairbahulaiḥ śubhrairbrāhmaṇairvedaparāgaiḥ .
narmadā dharmadā pūrvaṃ saṃvibhaktā yathākramam .. 13.17 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तैर्बहुलैः शुभ्रैर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपरागैः .
नर्मदा धर्मदा पूर्वं संविभक्ता यथाक्रमम् .. 13.17 ..
6.3.m: There, by those numerous, pure brahmins versed in the Vedas, / the Narmadā, giver of righteousness, was formerly divided in due order.

6.3.s:
ṛṣibhirdaśakoṭibhirnarmadātīravāsibhiḥ .
vibhakteyaṃ vibhaktāṅgī narmadā śarmadā nṛṇām .. 13.18 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषिभिर्दशकोटिभिर्नर्मदातीरवासिभिः .
विभक्तेयं विभक्ताङ्गी नर्मदा शर्मदा नृणाम् .. 13.18 ..
6.3.m: By a hundred million seers dwelling on the banks of the Narmadā, / she was partitioned in her parts—the Narmadā who grants happiness to men—

6.3.s:
yajñopavītaiśca śubhairakṣasūtraiśca bhārata .
kūladvaye mahāpuṇyā narmadodadhigāminī .. 13.19 ..
6.3.d:
यज्ञोपवीतैश्च शुभैरक्षसूत्रैश्च भारत .
कूलद्वये महापुण्या नर्मदोदधिगामिनी .. 13.19 ..
6.3.m: and with pure sacred threads and rosaries, O descendant of Bharata, / on both banks, the most holy Narmadā flowing to the ocean,

6.3.s:
pṛthagāyatanaiḥ śubhrairliṅgairvālukamṛnmayaiḥ .
bhrājate yā saricchreṣṭhā nakṣatrairiva śarvarī .. 13.20 ..
6.3.d:
पृथगायतनैः शुभ्रैर्लिङ्गैर्वालुकमृन्मयैः .
भ्राजते या सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नक्षत्रैरिव शर्वरी .. 13.20 ..
6.3.m: with separate, bright sanctuaries and liṅgas of sand and clay, / that best of rivers shone like the night with its constellations.

6.3.s:
evaṃ ta ṛṣayaḥ sarve tarpayantaḥ surānpitḥn .
nyavasannarmadātīre yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 13.21 ..
6.3.d:
एवं त ऋषयः सर्वे तर्पयन्तः सुरान्पित्ःन् .
न्यवसन्नर्मदातीरे यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 13.21 ..
6.3.m: Thus all those seers, making offerings to the gods and the ancestors, / dwelt on the bank of the Narmadā until the destruction of all beings.

6.3.s:
kiṃcidgate tatastasminghore varṣaśatādhike .
ardharātre tadā kanyā jalāduttīrya bhārata .. 13.22 ..
6.3.d:
किंचिद्गते ततस्तस्मिन्घोरे वर्षशताधिके .
अर्धरात्रे तदा कन्या जलादुत्तीर्य भारत .. 13.22 ..
6.3.m: When a terrible period of more than a hundred years had somewhat passed, / at midnight the maiden, emerging from the water, O descendant of Bharata,

6.3.s:
vidyutpuṃjasamābhāsā vyālayajñopavītinī .
triśūlāgrakarā saumyā tānuvāca ṛṣīṃstadā .. 13.23 ..
6.3.d:
विद्युत्पुंजसमाभासा व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनी .
त्रिशूलाग्रकरा सौम्या तानुवाच ऋषींस्तदा .. 13.23 ..
6.3.m: radiant like a mass of lightning, having a serpent as her sacred thread, / holding the tip of a trident in her hand, gentle, said to those seers then:

6.3.s:
āgacchadhvaṃ munigaṇā viśadhvaṃ māmayonijām .
sametāḥ putradāraiśca tataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha .. 13.24 ..
6.3.d:
आगच्छध्वं मुनिगणा विशध्वं मामयोनिजाम् .
समेताः पुत्रदारैश्च ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ .. 13.24 ..
6.3.m: "Come, assemblies of sages! Enter me, who am not born of a womb, / together with your sons and wives; then you shall attain perfection.

6.3.s:
yasya yasya hi yā vāñchā tasya tāṃ tāṃ dadāmyaham .
viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇamīśānamanyaṃ vā suramuttamam .. 13.25 ..
6.3.d:
यस्य यस्य हि या वाञ्छा तस्य तां तां ददाम्यहम् .
विष्णुं ब्रह्माणमीशानमन्यं वा सुरमुत्तमम् .. 13.25 ..
6.3.m: Whatever desire anyone has, that I grant to him: / Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Īśāna, or another supreme god.

6.3.s:
tatra sarvānnayiṣyāmi prasannā varadā hyaham .
prāṇāyāmaparā bhūtvā māṃ viśadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ .. 13.26 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र सर्वान्नयिष्यामि प्रसन्ना वरदा ह्यहम् .
प्राणायामपरा भूत्वा मां विशध्वं समाहिताः .. 13.26 ..
6.3.m: I, pleased and bestowing boons, shall lead all there. / Dedicated to breath control, enter me with focused minds,

6.3.s:
saha putraiśca dāraiśca tyaktvāśramapadāni ca .
kālakṣepo na kartavyaḥ pralayo'yamupasthitaḥ .. 13.27 ..
6.3.d:
सह पुत्रैश्च दारैश्च त्यक्त्वाश्रमपदानि च .
कालक्षेपो न कर्तव्यः प्रलयोऽयमुपस्थितः .. 13.27 ..
6.3.m: along with your sons and wives, abandoning the hermitages. / No delay must be made: this cosmic dissolution has arrived,

6.3.s:
saṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ kalpadāhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ .
ekāhamabhavaṃ pūrvaṃ mahāghore janakṣaye .. 13.28 ..
6.3.d:
संहारः सर्वभूतानां कल्पदाहः सुदारुणः .
एकाहमभवं पूर्वं महाघोरे जनक्षये .. 13.28 ..
6.3.m: the destruction of all beings, the exceedingly dread conflagration of the kalpa. / Formerly, I alone remained during the great, terrifying annihilation of creatures.

6.3.s:
śeṣā nadyaḥ samudrāśca sarva eva kṣayaṃgatāḥ .
varadānānmaheśasya tenāhaṃ na kṣayaṃ gatā .. 13.29 ..
6.3.d:
शेषा नद्यः समुद्राश्च सर्व एव क्षयंगताः .
वरदानान्महेशस्य तेनाहं न क्षयं गता .. 13.29 ..
6.3.m: The remaining rivers and the oceans all went to destruction; / through the boon granted by Maheśa, because of that I did not go to destruction.

6.3.s:
amṛtaḥ śāśvato devaḥ sthāṇurīśaḥ sanātanaḥ .
sa pūjitaḥ prārthito vā kiṃ na dadyāddvijottamāḥ .. 13.30 ..
6.3.d:
अमृतः शाश्वतो देवः स्थाणुरीशः सनातनः .
स पूजितः प्रार्थितो वा किं न दद्याद्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 13.30 ..
6.3.m: The immortal, eternal God, the immovable, the ancient Lord— / when worshipped or petitioned, what would he not grant, O best of brahmins?"

6.3.s:
evamuktvā ṛṣīvrevā praviveśa jalaṃ tataḥ .
karāttaśūlā sā devī vyālayajñopavītinī .. 13.31 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ऋषीव्रेवा प्रविवेश जलं ततः .
करात्तशूला सा देवी व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनी .. 13.31 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus to the seers, the Revā then entered the water— / that goddess with a trident taken in hand, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread.

6.3.s:
tataste tadvacaḥ śrutvā vismayāpannamānasāḥ .
abhivandya ca māṃ sarve kṣāmayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ .. 13.32 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्ते तद्वचः श्रुत्वा विस्मयापन्नमानसाः .
अभिवन्द्य च मां सर्वे क्षामयन्तः पुनः पुनः .. 13.32 ..
6.3.m: Hearing her words, their minds overcome with astonishment, / they all bowed down to me and begged forgiveness again and again:

6.3.s:
kṣamyatāṃ no yaduktaṃ hi vasatāṃ tava saṃśraye .
gṛhāṃstyaktvā mahābhāgāḥ saśiṣyāḥ sahabāndhavāḥ .. 13.33 ..
6.3.d:
क्षम्यतां नो यदुक्तं हि वसतां तव संश्रये .
गृहांस्त्यक्त्वा महाभागाः सशिष्याः सहबान्धवाः .. 13.33 ..
6.3.m: "May that be forgiven us which was said while dwelling under your protection!" / Abandoning their homes, those fortunate ones, with their pupils and kinsmen,

6.3.s:
japtvā caikākṣaraṃ brahma hṛdi dhyātvā maheśvaram .
snātvā ca mantrapūtābhiratha cādbhirjitavratāḥ .. 13.34 ..
6.3.d:
जप्त्वा चैकाक्षरं ब्रह्म हृदि ध्यात्वा महेश्वरम् .
स्नात्वा च मन्त्रपूताभिरथ चाद्भिर्जितव्रताः .. 13.34 ..
6.3.m: chanting the monosyllabic Brahman and meditating on Maheśvara in their hearts, / bathing with waters purified by mantras, steadfast in their vows,

6.3.s:
viviśurnarmadātoyaṃ sapakṣā iva parvatāḥ .
dyotayanto diśaḥ sarvāḥ kuśahastāḥ sahāgrayaḥ .. 13.35 ..
6.3.d:
विविशुर्नर्मदातोयं सपक्षा इव पर्वताः .
द्योतयन्तो दिशः सर्वाः कुशहस्ताः सहाग्रयः .. 13.35 ..
6.3.m: entered the waters of the Narmadā like winged mountains, / illuminating all the quarters, holding kuśa grass in their hands, accompanied by their fires.

6.3.s:
gateṣu teṣu rājendra ahamekaḥ sthitastadā .
amareśaṃ samāsādya pūjayannarmadāṃ nadīm .. 13.36 ..
6.3.d:
गतेषु तेषु राजेन्द्र अहमेकः स्थितस्तदा .
अमरेशं समासाद्य पूजयन्नर्मदां नदीम् .. 13.36 ..
6.3.m: When they had departed, O lord of kings, I alone remained at that time, / approaching Amareśa, worshipping the river Narmadā.

6.3.s:
anubhūtāḥ saptakalpā māyūrādyā mayā nṛpa .
prasādādvedhasaḥ sarve revayā saha bhārata .. 13.37 ..
6.3.d:
अनुभूताः सप्तकल्पा मायूराद्या मया नृप .
प्रसादाद्वेधसः सर्वे रेवया सह भारत .. 13.37 ..
6.3.m: Seven kalpas, beginning with the Māyūra, were experienced by me, O king, / all together with the Revā, through the grace of the Creator, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s: janmato'dya dinaṃ yāvanna jāne'syāḥ purāsthitim .. 13.38 ..
6.3.d: जन्मतोऽद्य दिनं यावन्न जानेऽस्याः पुरास्थितिम् .. 13.38 ..
6.3.m: From my birth up to this day, I do not know her ancient origin.

6.3.s:
iyaṃ hi śāṃkarī śaktiḥ kalā śambhorilāhvayā .
narmadā duritadhvaṃsakāriṇī bhavatāriṇī .. 13.39 ..
6.3.d:
इयं हि शांकरी शक्तिः कला शम्भोरिलाह्वया .
नर्मदा दुरितध्वंसकारिणी भवतारिणी .. 13.39 ..
6.3.m: For she is Śaṃkara's power, a portion of Śambhu named Ilā, / the Narmadā, destroyer of sins, deliverer from worldly existence.

6.3.s:
yadāhamapi nābhūvaṃ purākalpeṣu pāṇḍava .
caturdaśasu kalpeṣu teṣviyaṃ sukhasaṃsthitā .. 13.40 ..
6.3.d:
यदाहमपि नाभूवं पुराकल्पेषु पाण्डव .
चतुर्दशसु कल्पेषु तेष्वियं सुखसंस्थिता .. 13.40 ..
6.3.m: When I did not exist in the ancient kalpas, O son of Pāṇḍu, / throughout those fourteen kalpas she remained happily established.

6.3.s:
caturdaśa purā kalpā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā .
tānahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi devī prāha yathā mama .. 13.41 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्दश पुरा कल्पा न मृता येषु नर्मदा .
तानहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि देवी प्राह यथा मम .. 13.41 ..
6.3.m: The fourteen ancient kalpas in which the Narmadā did not perish, / those I shall describe fully, just as the goddess told them to me.

6.3.s:
kāpilaṃ prathamaṃ viddhi prājāpatyaṃ dvitīyakam .
brāhmaṃ saumyaṃ ca sāvitraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ prabhāsakam .. 13.42 ..
6.3.d:
कापिलं प्रथमं विद्धि प्राजापत्यं द्वितीयकम् .
ब्राह्मं सौम्यं च सावित्रं बार्हस्पत्यं प्रभासकम् .. 13.42 ..
6.3.m: Know the first to be the Kāpila, the second the Prājāpatya, / the Brāhma, the Saumya, the Sāvitra, the Bārhaspatya, and the Prabhāsaka;

6.3.s:
māhendramagnikalpaṃ ca jayantaṃ mārutaṃ tathā .
vaiṣṇavaṃ bahurūpaṃ ca jyautiṣaṃ ca caturdaśam .. 13.43 ..
6.3.d:
माहेन्द्रमग्निकल्पं च जयन्तं मारुतं तथा .
वैष्णवं बहुरूपं च ज्यौतिषं च चतुर्दशम् .. 13.43 ..
6.3.m: and the Māhendra, the Agnikalpa, the Jayanta, likewise the Māruta, / the Vaiṣṇava, the Bahurūpa, and the Jyautiṣa as the fourteenth.

6.3.s:
ete kalpā mayā khyātā na mṛtā yeṣu narmadā .
māyūraṃ pañcadaśamaṃ kaurmaṃ caivātra ṣoḍaśam .. 13.44 ..
6.3.d:
एते कल्पा मया ख्याता न मृता येषु नर्मदा .
मायूरं पञ्चदशमं कौर्मं चैवात्र षोडशम् .. 13.44 ..
6.3.m: These kalpas have been related by me, during which the Narmadā did not perish. / The Māyūra is the fifteenth, and the Kaurma is the sixteenth here;

6.3.s:
bakaṃ mātsyaṃ ca pādmaṃ ca vaṭakalpaṃ ca bhārata .
ekaviṃśatimaṃ caitaṃ vārāhaṃ sāṃpratīnakam .. 13.45 ..
6.3.d:
बकं मात्स्यं च पाद्मं च वटकल्पं च भारत .
एकविंशतिमं चैतं वाराहं सांप्रतीनकम् .. 13.45 ..
6.3.m: the Baka, the Mātsya, the Pādma, and the Vaṭakalpa, O Bhārata; / and this twenty-first, the Vārāha, is the present one.

6.3.s:
ime sapta mayā sākaṃ revayā pariśīlitāḥ .
ekaviṃśatikalpāstu narmadāyāḥ śivāṅgataḥ .. 13.46 ..
6.3.d:
इमे सप्त मया साकं रेवया परिशीलिताः .
एकविंशतिकल्पास्तु नर्मदायाः शिवाङ्गतः .. 13.46 ..
6.3.m: These seven were witnessed by the Revā together with me. / Indeed, through twenty-one kalpas, the Narmadā, born from the body of Śiva,

6.3.s:
saṃjātāyā nṛpaśreṣṭha mayā dṛṣṭā hyanekaśaḥ .
kathitā nṛpatiśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathayāmi te .. 13.47 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmya ekaviṃśatikalpakathānakavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 14
6.3.d:
संजाताया नृपश्रेष्ठ मया दृष्टा ह्यनेकशः .
कथिता नृपतिश्रेष्ठ भूयः किं कथयामि ते .. 13.47 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्य एकविंशतिकल्पकथानकवर्णनं नाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 14
6.3.m:
has been seen many times by me, O best of kings. / It has been told, O best of rulers; what more shall I tell you?
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Tale of the Twenty-one Kalpas', in the Narmadāmāhātmya, in the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantīkhaṇḍa, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 14

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve mahābhāgāstapodhanāḥ .
gatāstu paramaṃ lokaṃ tataḥ kiṃ jātamadbhutam .. 14.1 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
ततस्त ऋषयः सर्वे महाभागास्तपोधनाः .
गतास्तु परमं लोकं ततः किं जातमद्भुतम् .. 14.1 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / When all those highly fortunate seers, rich in austerity, had gone to the supreme world, / what wonderful thing happened then?

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tatasteṣu prayāteṣu narmadātīravāsiṣu .
babhūva raudrasaṃhāraḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ .. 14.2 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु नर्मदातीरवासिषु .
बभूव रौद्रसंहारः सर्वभूतक्षयंकरः .. 14.2 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, when those dwellers on the bank of the Narmadā had departed, / there occurred the terrible dissolution that brings destruction to all beings.

6.3.s:
kailāsaśikharasthaṃ tu mahādevaṃ sanātanam .
brahmādyāḥ prāstuvan devamṛgyajuḥsāmabhiḥ śivam .. 14.3 ..
6.3.d:
कैलासशिखरस्थं तु महादेवं सनातनम् .
ब्रह्माद्याः प्रास्तुवन् देवमृग्यजुःसामभिः शिवम् .. 14.3 ..
6.3.m: To the eternal Mahādeva, who was on the peak of Kailāsa, / Brahmā and the others praised the god, Śiva, with the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman verses:

6.3.s:
saṃhara tvaṃ jagaddeva sadevāsuramānuṣam .
prāpto yugasahasrāntaḥ kālaḥ saṃharaṇakṣamaḥ .. 14.4 ..
6.3.d:
संहर त्वं जगद्देव सदेवासुरमानुषम् .
प्राप्तो युगसहस्रान्तः कालः संहरणक्षमः .. 14.4 ..
6.3.m: 'Dissolve the universe, O god, together with the gods, demons, and humans! / The end of a thousand ages has arrived, the time capable of dissolution.

6.3.s:
madrūpaṃ tu samāsthāya tvayā caitadvinirmitam .
vaiṣṇavīṃ mūrtimāsthāya tvayaitatparipālitam .. 14.5 ..
6.3.d:
मद्रूपं तु समास्थाय त्वया चैतद्विनिर्मितम् .
वैष्णवीं मूर्तिमास्थाय त्वयैतत्परिपालितम् .. 14.5 ..
6.3.m: Having assumed my form, this was created by you; / having assumed the form of Viṣṇu, this was protected by you.

6.3.s:
ekā mūrtistridhā jātā brāhmī śaivī ca vaiṣṇavī .
sṛṣṭisaṃhārarakṣārthaṃ bhavedevaṃ maheśvara .. 14.6 ..
6.3.d:
एका मूर्तिस्त्रिधा जाता ब्राह्मी शैवी च वैष्णवी .
सृष्टिसंहाररक्षार्थं भवेदेवं महेश्वर .. 14.6 ..
6.3.m: A single form became threefold—of Brahmā, of Śiva, and of Viṣṇu— / for the purpose of creation, dissolution, and preservation. May it be so, O Maheśvara!'

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacastathyaṃ viṣṇośca parameṣṭhinaḥ .
sagaṇaḥ saparīvāraḥ saha tābhyāṃ sahomayā .. 14.7 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तथ्यं विष्णोश्च परमेष्ठिनः .
सगणः सपरीवारः सह ताभ्यां सहोमया .. 14.7 ..
6.3.m: Having heard these true words of Viṣṇu and Brahmā, / accompanied by his attendants and retinue, together with both of them and with Umā,

6.3.s:
samalokānvibhidyemānbhagavānnīlalohitaḥ .
bhūrādyabrahmalokāntaṃ bhittvāṇḍaṃ parataḥ param .. 14.8 ..
6.3.d:
समलोकान्विभिद्येमान्भगवान्नीललोहितः .
भूराद्यब्रह्मलोकान्तं भित्त्वाण्डं परतः परम् .. 14.8 ..
6.3.m: having broken through these worlds, the blue-throated Lord, / having pierced the cosmic egg from the earth up to the world of Brahmā, beyond the beyond,

6.3.s:
śaivaṃ padamajaṃ divyamāviśatsaha tairvibhuḥ .
na tatra vāyurnākāśaṃ nāgnistatra na bhūtalam .. 14.9 ..
6.3.d:
शैवं पदमजं दिव्यमाविशत्सह तैर्विभुः .
न तत्र वायुर्नाकाशं नाग्निस्तत्र न भूतलम् .. 14.9 ..
6.3.m: the all-pervading lord entered the divine, unborn abode of Śiva together with them. / There is no wind there, no space, no fire there, and no surface of the earth,

6.3.s:
yatra saṃtiṣṭhe deva umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ .
na sūryo na grahāstatra na ṛkṣāṇi diśastathā .. 14.10 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र संतिष्ठे देव उमया सह शङ्करः .
न सूर्यो न ग्रहास्तत्र न ऋक्षाणि दिशस्तथा .. 14.10 ..
6.3.m: where the god Śaṅkara stays together with Umā; / there is no sun there, no planets, no stars, nor directions,

6.3.s: na lokapālā na sukhaṃ na ca duḥkhaṃ nṛpottama .. 14.11 ..
6.3.d: न लोकपाला न सुखं न च दुःखं नृपोत्तम .. 14.11 ..
6.3.m: no guardians of the worlds, no pleasure, and no pain, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti śaivaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti .
kṣetrajñamīśaṃ pravadanti cānye sāṃkhyāśca gāyanti kilādimokṣam .. 14.12 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मं पदं यत्कवयो वदन्ति शैवं पदं यत्कवयो वदन्ति .
क्षेत्रज्ञमीशं प्रवदन्ति चान्ये सांख्याश्च गायन्ति किलादिमोक्षम् .. 14.12 ..
6.3.m: That which poets call the state of Brahman, that which poets call the state of Śiva; / and others speak of the Lord as the knower of the field, and the Sāṃkhyas sing of it indeed as primal liberation;

6.3.s:
yadbrahma ādyaṃ pravadanti kecidyaṃ sarvamīśānamajaṃ purāṇam .
tamekarūpaṃ tamanekarūpamarūpamādyaṃ paramavyayākhyam .. 14.13 ..
6.3.d:
यद्ब्रह्म आद्यं प्रवदन्ति केचिद्यं सर्वमीशानमजं पुराणम् .
तमेकरूपं तमनेकरूपमरूपमाद्यं परमव्ययाख्यम् .. 14.13 ..
6.3.m: that which some declare to be the primal Brahman, whom [they declare to be] the Lord, all-pervading, unborn, and ancient— / him whose form is one, whose forms are manifold, formless, primal, called the supreme imperishable;

6.3.s:
avarṇamapyarthamanāmagotraṃ turyaṃ padaṃ yatkavayo vadanti .
dhyānārthavijñānamayaṃ susūkṣmamātmasthamīśānavaraṃ vareṇyam .. 14.14 ..
6.3.d:
अवर्णमप्यर्थमनामगोत्रं तुर्यं पदं यत्कवयो वदन्ति .
ध्यानार्थविज्ञानमयं सुसूक्ष्ममात्मस्थमीशानवरं वरेण्यम् .. 14.14 ..
6.3.m: the fourth state, which poets describe as colourless, the true essence, without name or lineage, / composed of meditation, purpose, and special knowledge, very subtle, abiding within the self, the best Lord, worthy of choice.

6.3.s:
tatastrayaste bhagavantamīśaṃ samprāpya saṃkṣipya bhavantyarthakam .
pṛthaksvarūpaistu punasta eva jagatsamastaṃ paripālayanti .. 14.15 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्त्रयस्ते भगवन्तमीशं सम्प्राप्य संक्षिप्य भवन्त्यर्थकम् .
पृथक्स्वरूपैस्तु पुनस्त एव जगत्समस्तं परिपालयन्ति .. 14.15 ..
6.3.m: Then those three, having reached the divine Lord, having contracted, become the essence; / then, with their distinct forms, they themselves again protect the entire universe.

6.3.s:
saṃhāraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ rudratve kurute prabhuḥ .
viṣṇutve pālayellokānbrahmatve sṛṣṭikārakaḥ .. 14.16 ..
6.3.d:
संहारं सर्वभूतानां रुद्रत्वे कुरुते प्रभुः .
विष्णुत्वे पालयेल्लोकान्ब्रह्मत्वे सृष्टिकारकः .. 14.16 ..
6.3.m: In the state of Rudra, the lord performs the dissolution of all beings; / in the state of Viṣṇu he preserves the worlds; in the state of Brahmā he is the creator of creation.

6.3.s:
prakṛtyā saha saṃyuktaḥ kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ .
viśvarūpā mahābhāgā tasya pārśve vyavasthitā .. 14.17 ..
6.3.d:
प्रकृत्या सह संयुक्तः कालो भूत्वा महेश्वरः .
विश्वरूपा महाभागा तस्य पार्श्वे व्यवस्थिता .. 14.17 ..
6.3.m: Joined with Prakṛti, Maheśvara becomes Time; / the highly fortunate [Goddess] whose form is the universe stays at his side,

6.3.s:
yāmāhuḥ prakṛtiṃ tajjñāḥ padārthānāṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ .
puruṣatve prakṛtitve ca kāraṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ .. 14.18 ..
6.3.d:
यामाहुः प्रकृतिं तज्ज्ञाः पदार्थानां विचक्षणाः .
पुरुषत्वे प्रकृतित्वे च कारणं परमेश्वरः .. 14.18 ..
6.3.m: whom the knowers thereof, discerning in realities, call Prakṛti. / The Supreme Lord is the cause both in the state of Puruṣa and in the state of Prakṛti.

6.3.s:
tasmādetajjagatsarvaṃ carācaram .
tasminneva layaṃ yāti yugānte samupasthite .. 14.19 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मादेतज्जगत्सर्वं चराचरम् .
तस्मिन्नेव लयं याति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते .. 14.19 ..
6.3.m: Therefore all this universe, both moving and unmoving, / dissolves into him alone when the end of the age has arrived.

6.3.s:
bhagaliṅgāṅkitaṃ sarvaṃ vyāptaṃ vai parameṣṭhinā .
bhagarūpo bhavedviṣṇurliṅgarūpo maheśvaraḥ .. 14.20 ..
6.3.d:
भगलिङ्गाङ्कितं सर्वं व्याप्तं वै परमेष्ठिना .
भगरूपो भवेद्विष्णुर्लिङ्गरूपो महेश्वरः .. 14.20 ..
6.3.m: Everything marked by the womb and the liṅga is indeed pervaded by the Supreme Being; / Viṣṇu is the form of the womb, and Maheśvara is the form of the liṅga.

6.3.s:
bhāti sarveṣu lokeṣu gīyate bhūrbhuvādiṣu .
praviṣṭaḥ sarvabhūteṣu tena viṣṇurbhagaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 14.21 ..
6.3.d:
भाति सर्वेषु लोकेषु गीयते भूर्भुवादिषु .
प्रविष्टः सर्वभूतेषु तेन विष्णुर्भगः स्मृतः .. 14.21 ..
6.3.m: He shines in all the worlds, he is praised in the worlds beginning with Bhūr and Bhuvas; / he has entered into all beings; therefore Viṣṇu is called bhaga.

6.3.s:
viśanādviṣṇurityuktaḥ sarvadevamayo mahān .
bhāsanādgamanāccaiva bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā .. 14.22 ..
6.3.d:
विशनाद्विष्णुरित्युक्तः सर्वदेवमयो महान् .
भासनाद्गमनाच्चैव भगसंज्ञा प्रकीर्तिता .. 14.22 ..
6.3.m: He is called Viṣṇu because of entering; he is the great one composed of all the gods. / Because of shining and moving, the name bhaga is proclaimed.

6.3.s:
brahmādistambaparyantaṃ yasminneti layaṃ jagat .
ekabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ liṅgaṃ tasmādvidurbudhāḥ .. 14.23 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं यस्मिन्नेति लयं जगत् .
एकभावं समापन्नं लिङ्गं तस्माद्विदुर्बुधाः .. 14.23 ..
6.3.m: That in which the universe, from Brahmā down to a clump of grass, attains dissolution / and merges into oneness—therefore the wise know it as the liṅga.

6.3.s:
mahādevastato devīmāha pārśve sthitāṃ tadā .
saṃharasva jagatsarvaṃ mā vilambasva śobhane .. 14.24 ..
6.3.d:
महादेवस्ततो देवीमाह पार्श्वे स्थितां तदा .
संहरस्व जगत्सर्वं मा विलम्बस्व शोभने .. 14.24 ..
6.3.m: Then Mahādeva spoke to the goddess who was standing beside him at that time: / 'Dissolve the whole universe; do not delay, O fair one!

6.3.s:
tyaja saumyamidaṃ rūpaṃ sitacandrāṃśunirmalam .
rudraṃ rūpaṃ samāsthāya saṃharasva carācaram .. 14.25 ..
6.3.d:
त्यज सौम्यमिदं रूपं सितचन्द्रांशुनिर्मलम् .
रुद्रं रूपं समास्थाय संहरस्व चराचरम् .. 14.25 ..
6.3.m: Abandon this gentle form, pure as the white moonbeams; / assuming the terrible form, dissolve the moving and unmoving.

6.3.s:
raudrairbhūtagaṇairghorairdevi tvaṃ parivāritā .
jīvalokamimaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣayasvāmbujekṣaṇe .. 14.26 ..
6.3.d:
रौद्रैर्भूतगणैर्घोरैर्देवि त्वं परिवारिता .
जीवलोकमिमं सर्वं भक्षयस्वाम्बुजेक्षणे .. 14.26 ..
6.3.m: Surrounded by dreadful, terrible hosts of beings, O goddess, / devour all this world of living beings, O lotus-eyed one!

6.3.s:
tato'haṃ mardayiṣyāmi plāvayiṣye tathā jagat .
kṛtvā caikārṇavaṃ bhūyaḥ sukhaṃ svapsye tvayā saha .. 14.27 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽहं मर्दयिष्यामि प्लावयिष्ये तथा जगत् .
कृत्वा चैकार्णवं भूयः सुखं स्वप्स्ये त्वया सह .. 14.27 ..
6.3.m: Then I will crush and likewise flood the universe; / and having made it a single ocean, I will sleep happily with you again.'

6.3.s:
śrīdevyuvāca -
nāhaṃ deva jagaccaitatsaṃharāmi mahādyute .
ambā bhūtvā viceṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayāmi bhṛśāturam .. 14.28 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच -
नाहं देव जगच्चैतत्संहरामि महाद्युते .
अम्बा भूत्वा विचेष्टं न भक्षयामि भृशातुरम् .. 14.28 ..
6.3.m: The goddess said: / 'O god, I will not dissolve this universe, O one of great splendour! / Having become the mother, I will not devour [my child] who is helpless and greatly distressed.

6.3.s:
strīsvabhāvena kāruṇyaṃ karoti hṛdayaṃ mama .
kathaṃ vai nirdahiṣyāmi jagadetajjagatpate .. 14.29 ..
6.3.d:
स्त्रीस्वभावेन कारुण्यं करोति हृदयं मम .
कथं वै निर्दहिष्यामि जगदेतज्जगत्पते .. 14.29 ..
6.3.m: By woman's nature, my heart feels compassion; / how indeed can I burn up this universe, O Lord of the universe?

6.3.s:
tasmāttvaṃ svayamevedaṃ jagatsaṃhara śaṅkara .
athaivamuktastāṃ devīṃ dhūrjaṭirnīlalohitaḥ .. 14.30 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वं स्वयमेवेदं जगत्संहर शङ्कर .
अथैवमुक्तस्तां देवीं धूर्जटिर्नीललोहितः .. 14.30 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, do you yourself dissolve this universe, O Śaṅkara!' / Then, thus addressed, the blue-throated Dhūrjaṭi,

6.3.s:
kruddho nirbhartsayāmāsa huṅkāreṇa maheśvarīm .
oṃ huṃphaṭtvaṃ sa ityāha kopāviṣṭairathekṣaṇaiḥ .. 14.31 ..
6.3.d:
क्रुद्धो निर्भर्त्सयामास हुङ्कारेण महेश्वरीम् .
ओं हुंफट्त्वं स इत्याह कोपाविष्टैरथेक्षणैः .. 14.31 ..
6.3.m: becoming angry, rebuked Maheśvarī with a roar. / 'Oṃ huṃ phaṭ you are!' he said, his eyes filled with wrath.

6.3.s:
huṃkāritā viśālākṣī pīnorujaghanasthalā .
tatkṣaṇāccābhavadraudrā kālarātrīva bhārata .. 14.32 ..
6.3.d:
हुंकारिता विशालाक्षी पीनोरुजघनस्थला .
तत्क्षणाच्चाभवद्रौद्रा कालरात्रीव भारत .. 14.32 ..
6.3.m: Rebuked with a roar, the large-eyed one, with plump thighs and hips, / instantly became terrible, like the Night of Destruction, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s:
huṃkurvatī mahānādairnādayantī diśo daśa .
vyavardhata mahāraudrā vidyutsaudāminī yathā .. 14.33 ..
6.3.d:
हुंकुर्वती महानादैर्नादयन्ती दिशो दश .
व्यवर्धत महारौद्रा विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा .. 14.33 ..
6.3.m: Roaring with great cries, causing the ten directions to resound, / she grew exceedingly terrible, like a flash of lightning.

6.3.s:
vidyutsampātaduṣprekṣyā vidyutsaṃghātacañcalā .
vidyujjvālākulā raudrā vidyudagninibhekṣaṇā .. 14.34 ..
6.3.d:
विद्युत्सम्पातदुष्प्रेक्ष्या विद्युत्संघातचञ्चला .
विद्युज्ज्वालाकुला रौद्रा विद्युदग्निनिभेक्षणा .. 14.34 ..
6.3.m: Hard to look at like a flash of lightning, flickering like a mass of lightning, / agitated by flashes of lightning, terrible, with eyes resembling lightning and fire, 14.34

6.3.s:
muktakeśī viśālākṣī kṛśagrīvā kṛśodarī .
vyāghracarmāmbaradharā vyālayajñopavītinī .. 14.35 ..
6.3.d:
मुक्तकेशी विशालाक्षी कृशग्रीवा कृशोदरी .
व्याघ्रचर्माम्बरधरा व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनी .. 14.35 ..
6.3.m: with dishevelled hair, wide eyes, a thin neck, and a slender waist, / wearing a tiger skin as a garment, having a black snake as her sacred thread, 14.35

6.3.s:
vṛścikairagnipuñjābhairgonasaiśca vibhūṣitā .
trailokyaṃ pūrayāmāsa vistāreṇocchrayeṇa ca .. 14.36 ..
6.3.d:
वृश्चिकैरग्निपुञ्जाभैर्गोनसैश्च विभूषिता .
त्रैलोक्यं पूरयामास विस्तारेणोच्छ्रयेण च .. 14.36 ..
6.3.m: adorned with scorpions resembling heaps of fire and with vipers, / she filled the three worlds with her expanse and height. 14.36

6.3.s:
bhāsurāṅgā tu saṃvṛttā kṛṣṇasarpaikakuṇḍalā .
citradaṇḍodyatakarā vyāghracarmopasevitā .. 14.37 ..
6.3.d:
भासुराङ्गा तु संवृत्ता कृष्णसर्पैककुण्डला .
चित्रदण्डोद्यतकरा व्याघ्रचर्मोपसेविता .. 14.37 ..
6.3.m: Her body became radiant, wearing a single black serpent as an earring, / her hand raised with a variegated staff, adorned with a tiger skin. 14.37

6.3.s:
vyavardhata mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇī .
sṛkkiṇī lelihānā ca krūraphūtkārakāriṇī .. 14.38 ..
6.3.d:
व्यवर्धत महारौद्रा जगत्संहारकारिणी .
सृक्किणी लेलिहाना च क्रूरफूत्कारकारिणी .. 14.38 ..
6.3.m: Terrible, she grew, causing the destruction of the world, / licking the corners of her mouth and uttering fierce hissing sounds. 14.38

6.3.s:
vyāttāsyā ghurghurārāvā jagatsaṃkṣobhakāriṇī .
kheladbhūtānugā krūrā niḥśvāsocchvāsakāriṇī .. 14.39 ..
6.3.d:
व्यात्तास्या घुर्घुरारावा जगत्संक्षोभकारिणी .
खेलद्भूतानुगा क्रूरा निःश्वासोच्छ्वासकारिणी .. 14.39 ..
6.3.m: With an open mouth, roaring with rattling sounds, agitating the world, / followed by playful spirits, cruel, she breathed in and out. 14.39

6.3.s:
jātāṭṭaahāsā durnāsā vahnikuṇḍasamekṣaṇā .
prodyatkilakilārāvā dadāha sakalaṃ jagat .. 14.40 ..
6.3.d:
जाताट्टअहासा दुर्नासा वह्निकुण्डसमेक्षणा .
प्रोद्यत्किलकिलारावा ददाह सकलं जगत् .. 14.40 ..
6.3.m: Bursting into loud laughter, with a hideous nose, her eyes like fire pits, / raising cries of rejoicing, she burned the entire world. 14.40

6.3.s:
dahyamānāḥ surāstatra patanti dharaṇītale .
patanti yakṣagandharvāḥ sakinnaramahoragāḥ .. 14.41 ..
6.3.d:
दह्यमानाः सुरास्तत्र पतन्ति धरणीतले .
पतन्ति यक्षगन्धर्वाः सकिन्नरमहोरगाः .. 14.41 ..
6.3.m: Being burned there, the gods fell to the surface of the earth; / the yakṣas and gandharvas fell, along with the kinnaras and great serpents. 14.41

6.3.s:
patanti bhūtasaṅghāśca hāhāhaihaivirāviṇaḥ .
bumbāpātaiḥ sanirghātairuditārtasvarairapi .. 14.42 ..
6.3.d:
पतन्ति भूतसङ्घाश्च हाहाहैहैविराविणः .
बुम्बापातैः सनिर्घातैरुदितार्तस्वरैरपि .. 14.42 ..
6.3.m: And the hosts of ghosts fell, shrieking 'Alas, alas!' and 'Oh, oh!' / With outcries, claps of thunder, and cries of distress, 14.42

6.3.s:
vyāptamāsīttadā viśvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .
saṃpatadbhiḥ patadbhiśca jvaladbhūtagaṇairmahī .. 14.43 ..
6.3.d:
व्याप्तमासीत्तदा विश्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .
संपतद्भिः पतद्भिश्च ज्वलद्भूतगणैर्मही .. 14.43 ..
6.3.m: the universe, the three worlds with the moving and unmoving, was then pervaded. / With colliding and falling legions of blazing spirits, the earth [shook], 14.43

6.3.s:
jātaiścaṭacaṭāśabdaiḥ patadbhirgirisānubhiḥ .
tatra raudrotsave jātā rudrānandavivardhinī .. 14.44 ..
6.3.d:
जातैश्चटचटाशब्दैः पतद्भिर्गिरिसानुभिः .
तत्र रौद्रोत्सवे जाता रुद्रानन्दविवर्धिनी .. 14.44 ..
6.3.m: with cracking sounds arisen and mountain peaks tumbling down. / In that festival of terror, she arose, heightening the joy of Rudra. 14.44

6.3.s:
vihiṃsamānā bhūtāni carvamāṇācarānapi .
tattadgandhamupādāya śivārāvavirāviṇī .. 14.45 ..
6.3.d:
विहिंसमाना भूतानि चर्वमाणाचरानपि .
तत्तद्गन्धमुपादाय शिवारावविराविणी .. 14.45 ..
6.3.m: Striking down creatures, chewing even the immobile ones, / taking in this and that smell, howling with jackal-like cries, 14.45

6.3.s:
galacchoṇitadhārābhimukhā digdhakalevarā .
caṇḍaśīlābhavaccaṇḍī jagatsaṃhārakarmaṇi .. 14.46 ..
6.3.d:
गलच्छोणितधाराभिमुखा दिग्धकलेवरा .
चण्डशीलाभवच्चण्डी जगत्संहारकर्मणि .. 14.46 ..
6.3.m: her face covered with trickling streams of blood, her body smeared, / of fierce nature, Caṇḍī engaged in the destruction of the world. 14.46

6.3.s:
ye'pi prāptā maharlokaṃ bhṛgvādyāśca maharṣayaḥ .
te'pi naśyanti śataśo brahmakṣattraviśādayaḥ .. 14.47 ..
6.3.d:
येऽपि प्राप्ता महर्लोकं भृग्वाद्याश्च महर्षयः .
तेऽपि नश्यन्ति शतशो ब्रह्मक्षत्त्रविशादयः .. 14.47 ..
6.3.m: Even the great seers like Bhṛgu and others who had reached Maharloka, / and hundreds of brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and others perished. 14.47

6.3.s:
devāsurā bhayatrastāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ .
viśanti ke'pi pātālaṃ līyante ca guhādiṣu .. 14.48 ..
6.3.d:
देवासुरा भयत्रस्ताः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः .
विशन्ति केऽपि पातालं लीयन्ते च गुहादिषु .. 14.48 ..
6.3.m: Gods and asuras, terrified with fear, along with yakṣas, serpents, and rākṣasas, / entered Pātāla, while some hid in caves and other places. 14.48

6.3.s:
sā ca devī diśaḥ sarvā vyāpya mṛtyuriva sthitā .
yugakṣayakare kāle devena viniyojitā .. 14.49 ..
6.3.d:
सा च देवी दिशः सर्वा व्याप्य मृत्युरिव स्थिता .
युगक्षयकरे काले देवेन विनियोजिता .. 14.49 ..
6.3.m: And that goddess stood like Death, having pervaded all the directions, / appointed by the God at the time that brings an end to the aeon. 14.49

6.3.s:
ekāpi navadhā jātā daśadhā daśadhā tathā .
catuḥṣaṣṭisvarūpā ca śatarūpāṭṭahāsinī .. 14.50 ..
6.3.d:
एकापि नवधा जाता दशधा दशधा तथा .
चतुःषष्टिस्वरूपा च शतरूपाट्टहासिनी .. 14.50 ..
6.3.m: Though single, she became ninefold, tenfold, and tenfold again, / assuming sixty-four forms, a hundred forms, laughing fiercely. 14.50

6.3.s:
jajñe sahasrarūpā ca lakṣakoṭitanuḥ śivā .
nānārūpāyudhākārā nānāvādanacāriṇī .. 14.51 ..
6.3.d:
जज्ञे सहस्ररूपा च लक्षकोटितनुः शिवा .
नानारूपायुधाकारा नानावादनचारिणी .. 14.51 ..
6.3.m: Śivā was born with a thousand forms, with bodies numbering a hundred thousand and ten million, / bearing various forms and weapons, moving with various musical instruments. 14.51

6.3.s:
evaṃrūpā'bhavaddevī śivasyānujñayā nṛpa .
dikṣu sarvāsu gagane vikaṭāyudhaśīlinaḥ .. 14.52 ..
6.3.d:
एवंरूपाऽभवद्देवी शिवस्यानुज्ञया नृप .
दिक्षु सर्वासु गगने विकटायुधशीलिनः .. 14.52 ..
6.3.m: Such was the goddess by Śiva's command, O king! / In all the directions and in the sky, wielding monstrous weapons, 14.52

6.3.s:
rundhanto naśyamānāṃstāngaṇā māheśvarāḥ sthitāḥ .
vicaranti tayā sārddhaṃ śūlapaṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ .. 14.53 ..
6.3.d:
रुन्धन्तो नश्यमानांस्तान्गणा माहेश्वराः स्थिताः .
विचरन्ति तया सार्द्धं शूलपट्टिशपाणयः .. 14.53 ..
6.3.m: the hosts of Māheśvara stood, cutting off those who were fleeing; / trident and spear in hand, they roamed about together with her. 14.53

6.3.s:
tato mātṛgaṇāḥ kecidvināyakagaṇaiḥ saha .
vyavardhanta mahāraudrā jagatsaṃhārakāriṇaḥ .. 14.54 ..
6.3.d:
ततो मातृगणाः केचिद्विनायकगणैः सह .
व्यवर्धन्त महारौद्रा जगत्संहारकारिणः .. 14.54 ..
6.3.m: Then certain mother-goddesses, along with the hosts of Vināyaka, / grew intensely terrible, bringing about the destruction of the universe. 14.54

6.3.s:
tatastasyā vyavardhanta daṃṣṭrāḥ kundendusannibhāḥ .
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ayutānyarbudāni ca .. 14.55 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तस्या व्यवर्धन्त दंष्ट्राः कुन्देन्दुसन्निभाः .
योजनानां सहस्राणि अयुतान्यर्बुदानि च .. 14.55 ..
6.3.m: Then her fangs, gleaming like jasmine and the moon, grew / to thousands, tens of thousands, and hundreds of millions of yojanas. 14.55

6.3.s:
daṃṣṭrāvaliḥ kararuhāḥ krūrāstīkṣṇāśca karkaśāḥ .
viyaddiśo likhantyeva saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām .. 14.56 ..
6.3.d:
दंष्ट्रावलिः कररुहाः क्रूरास्तीक्ष्णाश्च कर्कशाः .
वियद्दिशो लिखन्त्येव सप्तद्वीपां वसुंधराम् .. 14.56 ..
6.3.m: Her rows of fangs and her cruel, sharp, and rough nails / scraped the sky, the directions, and the earth with its seven continents. 14.56

6.3.s:
tasyā daṃṣṭrābhisampātaiścūrṇitā vanaparvatāḥ .
śilāsaṃcayasaṃghātā viśīryate sahasraśaḥ .. 14.57 ..
6.3.d:
तस्या दंष्ट्राभिसम्पातैश्चूर्णिता वनपर्वताः .
शिलासंचयसंघाता विशीर्यते सहस्रशः .. 14.57 ..
6.3.m: By the impacts of her fangs, forests and mountains were pulverized, / and masses of rocky heaps shattered by the thousands. 14.57

6.3.s:
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ .
mālyavāṃścaiva nīlaśca śvetaścaiva mahāgiriḥ .. 14.58 ..
6.3.d:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो गन्धमादनः .
माल्यवांश्चैव नीलश्च श्वेतश्चैव महागिरिः .. 14.58 ..
6.3.m: Himavat, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, Gandhamādana, / Mālyavat, Nīla, and the great mountain Śveta, 14.58

6.3.s:
merumadhyamilāpīṭhaṃ saptadvīpaṃ ca sārṇavam .
lokālokena sahitaṃ prākampata nṛpottama .. 14.59 ..
6.3.d:
मेरुमध्यमिलापीठं सप्तद्वीपं च सार्णवम् .
लोकालोकेन सहितं प्राकम्पत नृपोत्तम .. 14.59 ..
6.3.m: the central platform of Ilā around Meru, with its seven continents and oceans, / along with the Lokāloka mountain, trembled, O best of kings! 14.59

6.3.s:
daṃṣṭrāśanivispṛṣṭāśca viśīryante mahādrumāḥ .
utpātaiśca diśo vyāptā ghorarūpaiḥ samantataḥ .. 14.60 ..
6.3.d:
दंष्ट्राशनिविस्पृष्टाश्च विशीर्यन्ते महाद्रुमाः .
उत्पातैश्च दिशो व्याप्ता घोररूपैः समन्ततः .. 14.60 ..
6.3.m: Touched by the thunderbolts of her fangs, great trees were shattered, / and all the directions were pervaded all around with dreadful portents. 14.60

6.3.s:
tārā grahagaṇāḥ sarve ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ .
śivāsahasrairākīrṇā mahāmātṛgaṇaistathā .. 14.61 ..
6.3.d:
तारा ग्रहगणाः सर्वे ये च वैमानिका गणाः .
शिवासहस्रैराकीर्णा महामातृगणैस्तथा .. 14.61 ..
6.3.m: All the stars and hosts of planets, and the beings traveling in aerial chariots, / were overrun by thousands of jackals and the great hosts of mothers. 14.61

6.3.s:
sā cacāra jagatkṛtsnaṃ yugānte samupasthite .
bhramadbhiśca bruvadbhiśca krośadbhiśca samantataḥ .. 14.62 ..
6.3.d:
सा चचार जगत्कृत्स्नं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते .
भ्रमद्भिश्च ब्रुवद्भिश्च क्रोशद्भिश्च समन्ततः .. 14.62 ..
6.3.m: She roamed the entire world when the end of the aeon had arrived, / with [beings] wandering, crying out, and howling on all sides. 14.62

6.3.s:
pramathadbhirjvaladbhiśca raudrairvyāptā diśo daśa .
vistīrṇaṃ śailasaṅghātaṃ vighūrṇitagiridrumam .. 14.63 ..
6.3.d:
प्रमथद्भिर्ज्वलद्भिश्च रौद्रैर्व्याप्ता दिशो दश .
विस्तीर्णं शैलसङ्घातं विघूर्णितगिरिद्रुमम् .. 14.63 ..
6.3.m: The ten directions were filled with crushing, blazing, and fierce [spirits]; / vast ranges of mountains, their trees and rocks violently shaken, 14.63

6.3.s:
prabhinnagopuradvāraṃ keśaśuṣkāsthisaṃkulam .
pradagdhagrāmanagaraṃ bhasmapuṃjābhisaṃvṛtam .. 14.64 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभिन्नगोपुरद्वारं केशशुष्कास्थिसंकुलम् .
प्रदग्धग्रामनगरं भस्मपुंजाभिसंवृतम् .. 14.64 ..
6.3.m: with smashed city gates, filled with hair and dried bones, / with villages and cities burned down, covered with heaps of ashes, 14.64

6.3.s:
citādhūmākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .
hāhākārākulaṃ sarvamahahasvananisvanam .. 14.65 ..
6.3.d:
चिताधूमाकुलं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .
हाहाकाराकुलं सर्वमहहस्वननिस्वनम् .. 14.65 ..
6.3.m: the entire three worlds, moving and unmoving, was filled with the smoke of funeral pyres, / filled everywhere with lamentations, echoing with the sounds of distress. 14.65

6.3.s:
jagadetadabhūtsarvamaśaraṇyaṃ nirāśrayam .. 14.66 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kalpānukathane kālarātrikṛtajagatsaṃharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 15
6.3.d:
जगदेतदभूत्सर्वमशरण्यं निराश्रयम् .. 14.66 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये कल्पानुकथने कालरात्रिकृतजगत्संहरणवर्णनं नाम चतुर्दशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 15
6.3.m:
This entire universe became shelterless and without refuge. 14.66
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Destruction of the Universe Wrought by Kālarātri' in the recount of the cosmic cycle in the Narmadāmāhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, of the Skandapurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse compilation.
Chapter 15

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato mātṛsahasraiśca raudraiśca parivāritā .
kālarātrirjagatsarvaṃ harate dīptalocanā .. 15.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो मातृसहस्रैश्च रौद्रैश्च परिवारिता .
कालरात्रिर्जगत्सर्वं हरते दीप्तलोचना .. 15.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, surrounded by thousands of fierce mother-goddesses, / Kālarātri, with blazing eyes, destroyed the whole world. 15.1

6.3.s:
tatastā mātaro ghorā brahmaviṣṇuśivātmikāḥ .
vāyvindrānalakauberā yamatoyeśaśaktayaḥ .. 15.2 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्ता मातरो घोरा ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मिकाः .
वाय्विन्द्रानलकौबेरा यमतोयेशशक्तयः .. 15.2 ..
6.3.m: Then those dreadful Mothers, the embodiments of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / the powers of Vāyu, Indra, Agni, Kubera, Yama, and Varuṇa, 15.2

6.3.s:
skandakroḍanṛsiṃhānāṃ vicarantyo bhayānakāḥ .
cakraśūlagadākhaḍgavajraśaktyṛṣṭipaṭṭiśaiḥ .. 15.3 ..
6.3.d:
स्कन्दक्रोडनृसिंहानां विचरन्त्यो भयानकाः .
चक्रशूलगदाखड्गवज्रशक्त्यृष्टिपट्टिशैः .. 15.3 ..
6.3.m: and of Skanda, the Boar, and Narasiṃha, roamed frightfully / with discuses, tridents, maces, swords, thunderbolts, spears, javelins, and cleavers. 15.3

6.3.s:
khaṭvāṅgairulmukairdīptairvyacaranmātaraḥ kṣaye .
umāsaṃnoditā sarvāḥ pradhāvantyo diśo daśa .. 15.4 ..
6.3.d:
खट्वाङ्गैरुल्मुकैर्दीप्तैर्व्यचरन्मातरः क्षये .
उमासंनोदिता सर्वाः प्रधावन्त्यो दिशो दश .. 15.4 ..
6.3.m: With khaṭvāṅgas and blazing firebrands, the Mothers roamed at the destruction; / urged on by Umā, they all rushed through the ten directions. 15.4

6.3.s:
tāsāṃ caraṇavikṣepairhuṅkārodgāranisvanaiḥ .
trailokyametatsakalaṃ vipradagdhaṃ samantataḥ .. 15.5 ..
6.3.d:
तासां चरणविक्षेपैर्हुङ्कारोद्गारनिस्वनैः .
त्रैलोक्यमेतत्सकलं विप्रदग्धं समन्ततः .. 15.5 ..
6.3.m: By the stamping of their feet and the sounds of their roaring cries, / this entire three worlds was thoroughly burned on all sides. 15.5

6.3.s:
hāhāravākranditanisvanaiśca prabhinnarathyāgṛhagopuraiśca .
babhūva ghorā dharaṇī samantātkapālakośākulakarburāṅgī .. 15.6 ..
6.3.d:
हाहारवाक्रन्दितनिस्वनैश्च प्रभिन्नरथ्यागृहगोपुरैश्च .
बभूव घोरा धरणी समन्तात्कपालकोशाकुलकर्बुराङ्गी .. 15.6 ..
6.3.m: With wailing and shrieking sounds, and streets, houses, and gateway towers shattered, / the earth became frightful on all sides, variegated and covered with heaps of skulls. 15.6

6.3.s:
yadetacchatasāhasraṃ jambūdvīpaṃ nigadyate .
sarvameva taducchannaṃ samādhṛṣya nṛpottama .. 15.7 ..
6.3.d:
यदेतच्छतसाहस्रं जम्बूद्वीपं निगद्यते .
सर्वमेव तदुच्छन्नं समाधृष्य नृपोत्तम .. 15.7 ..
6.3.m: This Jambudvīpa, which is spoken of as one hundred thousand [yojanas], / was completely devastated, having been assaulted, O best of kings! 15.7

6.3.s:
jambuṃ śākaṃ kuśaṃ krauñcaṃ gomedaṃ śālmalistathā .
puṣkaradvīpasahitā ye ca parvatavāsinaḥ .. 15.8 ..
6.3.d:
जम्बुं शाकं कुशं क्रौञ्चं गोमेदं शाल्मलिस्तथा .
पुष्करद्वीपसहिता ये च पर्वतवासिनः .. 15.8 ..
6.3.m: Jambu, Śāka, Kuśa, Krauñca, Gomeda, and Śālmali, / together with Puṣkaradvīpa, and the mountain dwellers who were there, 15.8

6.3.s:
te grastā mṛtyunā sarve bhūtairmātṛgaṇaistathā .
mahāsurakapālaiśca māṃsamedovasotkaṭaiḥ .. 15.9 ..
6.3.d:
ते ग्रस्ता मृत्युना सर्वे भूतैर्मातृगणैस्तथा .
महासुरकपालैश्च मांसमेदोवसोत्कटैः .. 15.9 ..
6.3.m: they were all swallowed by Death, by ghosts, and by hosts of Mothers, / with skulls of great asuras, brimming with flesh, fat, and marrow. 15.9

6.3.s:
rudhirodgāraśoṇāṅgī mahāmāyā subhīṣaṇā .
pibantī rudhiraṃ tatra mahāmāṃsavasāpriyā .. 15.10 ..
6.3.d:
रुधिरोद्गारशोणाङ्गी महामाया सुभीषणा .
पिबन्ती रुधिरं तत्र महामांसवसाप्रिया .. 15.10 ..
6.3.m: Her limbs crimson from the spewing of blood, Mahāmāyā, exceedingly terrifying, / drinking blood there, delighted in human flesh and fat. 15.10

6.3.s:
kapālahastā vikaṭā bhakṣayantī surāsurān .
nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca viparītā mahāravā .. 15.11 ..
6.3.d:
कपालहस्ता विकटा भक्षयन्ती सुरासुरान् .
नृत्यन्ती च हसन्ती च विपरीता महारवा .. 15.11 ..
6.3.m: Holding a skull-bowl in her hand, monstrous, devouring gods and demons, / dancing and laughing, inverted, raising a tremendous roar,

6.3.s:
trailokyasaṃtrāsakarī vidyutsaṃsphoṭahāsinī .
saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ bhakṣayitvā ca medinīm .. 15.12 ..
6.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यसंत्रासकरी विद्युत्संस्फोटहासिनी .
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तां भक्षयित्वा च मेदिनीम् .. 15.12 ..
6.3.m: striking terror into the three worlds, laughing with the burst of lightning, / having devoured the earth as far as the oceans of the seven continents,

6.3.s:
tataḥ svasthānamagamadyatra devo maheśvaraḥ .
narmadātīramāśrityāvasanmātṛgaṇaiḥ saha .. 15.13 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स्वस्थानमगमद्यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .
नर्मदातीरमाश्रित्यावसन्मातृगणैः सह .. 15.13 ..
6.3.m: she then went to her own abode, where the god Maheśvara was. / Resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, she dwelt along with the host of Mothers.

6.3.s:
amarāṇāṃ kaṭe tuṅge nṛtyantī hasitānanā .
amarā devatāḥ proktāḥ śarīraṃ kaṭamucyate .. 15.14 ..
6.3.d:
अमराणां कटे तुङ्गे नृत्यन्ती हसितानना .
अमरा देवताः प्रोक्ताः शरीरं कटमुच्यते .. 15.14 ..
6.3.m: Dancing on the lofty hips of the immortals, her face laughing— / the gods are called immortals (amarāḥ), and the body is called hips (kaṭaḥ).

6.3.s:
taiḥ kaṭairāvṛto yasmātparvato'yaṃ nṛpottama .
chinnabhinnāsthinikarairvasāmedo'sraviplutaiḥ .. 15.15 ..
6.3.d:
तैः कटैरावृतो यस्मात्पर्वतोऽयं नृपोत्तम .
छिन्नभिन्नास्थिनिकरैर्वसामेदोऽस्रविप्लुतैः .. 15.15 ..
6.3.m: Because this mountain, O best of kings, was covered with those hips [of the dead], / with heaps of severed and shattered bones flooded with fat, marrow, and blood,

6.3.s:
amaraṃkaṭa ityevaṃ tena prokto manīṣibhiḥ .
mahāpavitro lokeṣu śambhunā sa vinirmitaḥ .. 15.16 ..
6.3.d:
अमरंकट इत्येवं तेन प्रोक्तो मनीषिभिः .
महापवित्रो लोकेषु शम्भुना स विनिर्मितः .. 15.16 ..
6.3.m: therefore it is called Amarakaṇṭaka by the wise. / Extremely holy in the worlds, it was fashioned by Śambhu.

6.3.s:
nityaṃ saṃnihitastatra śaṅkaro hyumayā saha .
tato'haṃ niyatastatra tasya pādāgrasaṃsthitaḥ .. 15.17 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं संनिहितस्तत्र शङ्करो ह्युमया सह .
ततोऽहं नियतस्तत्र तस्य पादाग्रसंस्थितः .. 15.17 ..
6.3.m: There Śaṃkara is perpetually present indeed with Umā. / Then I, restrained, standing before his feet there,

6.3.s:
prahvaḥ praṇatabhāvena staumi taṃ nīlalohitam .
tatastālakasampātairgaṇairmātṛgaṇaiḥ saha .. 15.18 ..
6.3.d:
प्रह्वः प्रणतभावेन स्तौमि तं नीललोहितम् .
ततस्तालकसम्पातैर्गणैर्मातृगणैः सह .. 15.18 ..
6.3.m: humble with a bowed disposition, praise him, the blue-and-red god. / Then, with beats of clapping, along with his attendants and the host of Mothers,

6.3.s:
saṃpranṛtyati saṃhṛṣṭo mṛtyunā saha śaṅkaraḥ .
khaṭvāṅgairulmukaiścaiva paṭṭiśaiḥ parighaistathā .. 15.19 ..
6.3.d:
संप्रनृत्यति संहृष्टो मृत्युना सह शङ्करः .
खट्वाङ्गैरुल्मुकैश्चैव पट्टिशैः परिघैस्तथा .. 15.19 ..
6.3.m: Śaṃkara, greatly rejoicing, dances along with Death. / With khaṭvāṅgas, blazing firebrands, spears, and iron bludgeons,

6.3.s:
māṃsamedovasāhastā hṛṣṭā nṛtyanti saṃghaśaḥ .
vāmanā jaṭilā muṇḍā lambagrīvoṣṭhamūrddhajāḥ .. 15.20 ..
6.3.d:
मांसमेदोवसाहस्ता हृष्टा नृत्यन्ति संघशः .
वामना जटिला मुण्डा लम्बग्रीवोष्ठमूर्द्धजाः .. 15.20 ..
6.3.m: holding meat, marrow, and fat in their hands, they dance exultantly in throngs— / dwarfs, matted-haired, bald, with long necks, lips, and hair,

6.3.s:
mahāśiśnodarabhujā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca .
vikṛtairānanairghorairarbhujolbaṇamukhādibhiḥ .. 15.21 ..
6.3.d:
महाशिश्नोदरभुजा नृत्यन्ति च हसन्ति च .
विकृतैराननैर्घोरैरर्भुजोल्बणमुखादिभिः .. 15.21 ..
6.3.m: with huge phalluses, bellies, and arms, they dance and laugh, / with disfigured, dreadful faces, terrible mouths, and the like.

6.3.s:
amaraṃ kaṇṭakaṃ cakruḥ prāpte kālaviparyaye .
teṣāṃ madhye mahāghoraṃ jagatsantrāsakāraṇam .. 15.22 ..
6.3.d:
अमरं कण्टकं चक्रुः प्राप्ते कालविपर्यये .
तेषां मध्ये महाघोरं जगत्सन्त्रासकारणम् .. 15.22 ..
6.3.m: When the reversal of time arrived, they made the immortals into thorns (amaraṃ kaṇṭakam). / In their midst, causing immense terror to the world,

6.3.s:
mṛtyuṃ paśyāmi nṛtyantaṃ taḍitpiṅgalamūrddhajam .
tasya pārśve sthitāṃ devīṃ vimalāmbarabhūṣitām .. 15.23 ..
6.3.d:
मृत्युं पश्यामि नृत्यन्तं तडित्पिङ्गलमूर्द्धजम् .
तस्य पार्श्वे स्थितां देवीं विमलाम्बरभूषिताम् .. 15.23 ..
6.3.m: I beheld Death dancing, his hair reddish-brown like lightning. / Beside him stood the goddess adorned with spotless garments,

6.3.s:
kuṇḍalodghuṣṭagaṇḍāṃ tāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm .
vicitrairupahāraiśca pūjayantīṃ maheśvaram .. 15.24 ..
6.3.d:
कुण्डलोद्घुष्टगण्डां तां नागयज्ञोपवीतिनीम् .
विचित्रैरुपहारैश्च पूजयन्तीं महेश्वरम् .. 15.24 ..
6.3.m: her cheeks resounding with earrings, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread, / worshipping Maheśvara with manifold offerings.

6.3.s:
apaśyaṃ narmadāṃ tatra mātaraṃ viśvavanditām .
nānātaraṅgāṃ sāvartāṃ suvelārṇavasaṃnibhām .. 15.25 ..
6.3.d:
अपश्यं नर्मदां तत्र मातरं विश्ववन्दिताम् .
नानातरङ्गां सावर्तां सुवेलार्णवसंनिभाम् .. 15.25 ..
6.3.m: I saw there Narmadā, the mother praised by the entire universe, / having diverse waves and whirlpools, resembling the ocean at Suvela.

6.3.s:
mahāsaraḥsaritpātairadṛśyāṃ dṛśyarūpiṇīm .
vandyamānāṃ suraiḥ siddhairmunisaṅghaiśca bhārata .. 15.26 ..
6.3.d:
महासरःसरित्पातैरदृश्यां दृश्यरूपिणीम् .
वन्द्यमानां सुरैः सिद्धैर्मुनिसङ्घैश्च भारत .. 15.26 ..
6.3.m: Invisible through the cascades of great lakes and rivers, yet possessing visible form, / being praised by gods, perfected ones, and hosts of sages, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s:
etasminnantare ghorāṃ saptasaptakasaṃjñitām .
mahāvīcyaughaphenāḍhyāṃ kurvantīṃ sajalaṃ jagat .. 15.27 ..
6.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरां सप्तसप्तकसंज्ञिताम् .
महावीच्यौघफेनाढ्यां कुर्वन्तीं सजलं जगत् .. 15.27 ..
6.3.m: In the meantime, [I saw her,] dreadful, called the forty-nine-fold, / rich in vast torrents of waves and foam, submerging the world in water;

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭavānnarmadāṃ devīṃ mṛgakṛṣṇāmbarāṃ punaḥ .
sadhūmāśaninirhrādairvahantīṃ saptadhā tadā .. 15.28 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्टवान्नर्मदां देवीं मृगकृष्णाम्बरां पुनः .
सधूमाशनिनिर्ह्रादैर्वहन्तीं सप्तधा तदा .. 15.28 ..
6.3.m: and again I saw the goddess Narmadā, clad in a black deerskin, / then flowing in seven divisions with smoky roars of thunderbolts.

6.3.s:
iti saṃhāramatulaṃ dṛṣṭavānrājasattama .
naṣṭacandrārkakiraṇamabhūdetaccarācaram .. 15.29 ..
6.3.d:
इति संहारमतुलं दृष्टवान्राजसत्तम .
नष्टचन्द्रार्ककिरणमभूदेतच्चराचरम् .. 15.29 ..
6.3.m: Having witnessed this peerless dissolution, O best of kings, / this universe of moving and unmoving beings was deprived of the rays of the moon and the sun,

6.3.s:
mahotpātasamudbhūtaṃ naṣṭanakṣatramaṇḍalam .
alātacakravattūrṇamaśeṣaṃ bhrāmayaṃstataḥ .. 15.30 ..
6.3.d:
महोत्पातसमुद्भूतं नष्टनक्षत्रमण्डलम् .
अलातचक्रवत्तूर्णमशेषं भ्रामयंस्ततः .. 15.30 ..
6.3.m: arisen from a great portent, its circle of constellations vanished, / as he quickly whirled everything entirely like a firebrand's wheel.

6.3.s:
vimānakoṭisaṃkīrṇaḥ sa kiṃnaramahoragaḥ .
mahāvātaḥ sanirghāto yenākampaccarācaram .. 15.31 ..
6.3.d:
विमानकोटिसंकीर्णः स किंनरमहोरगः .
महावातः सनिर्घातो येनाकम्पच्चराचरम् .. 15.31 ..
6.3.m: Teeming with millions of aerial chariots, along with Kinnaras and great serpents, / a mighty wind with lightning-strokes arose, by which moving and unmoving beings shook.

6.3.s:
rudravaktrātsamudbhūtaḥ saṃvarto nāma viśrutaḥ .
vāyuḥ saṃśoṣayāmāsa vitatan saptasāgarān .. 15.32 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रवक्त्रात्समुद्भूतः संवर्तो नाम विश्रुतः .
वायुः संशोषयामास विततन् सप्तसागरान् .. 15.32 ..
6.3.m: Arising from Rudra's mouth, celebrated under the name Saṃvarta, / that wind dried up the vast seven oceans.

6.3.s:
uddhūlitāṅgaḥ kapilākṣamūrddhajo jaṭākalāpairavabaddhamūrddhajaḥ .
mahāravo dīptaviśālaśūladhṛksa pātu yuṣmāṃśca dine dine haraḥ .. 15.33 ..
6.3.d:
उद्धूलिताङ्गः कपिलाक्षमूर्द्धजो जटाकलापैरवबद्धमूर्द्धजः .
महारवो दीप्तविशालशूलधृक्स पातु युष्मांश्च दिने दिने हरः .. 15.33 ..
6.3.m: His limbs smeared with ashes, his eyes and hair tawny, his hair bound in clusters of matted locks, / raising a tremendous roar, bearing a radiant, vast trident—may that Hara protect you day after day!

6.3.s:
śūlī dhanuṣmānkavacī kirīṭī śmaśānabhasmokṣitasarvagātraḥ .
kapālamālākulakaṇṭhanālo mahāhisūtrairavabaddhamauliḥ .. 15.34 ..
6.3.d:
शूली धनुष्मान्कवची किरीटी श्मशानभस्मोक्षितसर्वगात्रः .
कपालमालाकुलकण्ठनालो महाहिसूत्रैरवबद्धमौलिः .. 15.34 ..
6.3.m: Holding a trident, holding a bow, armored, crowned, with all limbs sprinkled with ashes from the cremation ground, / his throat encircled by a garland of skulls, his diadem bound with strings of great serpents,

6.3.s:
sa gonasaughaiḥ pariveṣṭitāṅgo viṣāgnicandrāmarasindhumauliḥ .
pinākakhaṇṭūvāṅgakarālapāṇiḥ sa kṛttivāsā ḍamarupraṇādaḥ .. 15.35 ..
6.3.d:
स गोनसौघैः परिवेष्टिताङ्गो विषाग्निचन्द्रामरसिन्धुमौलिः .
पिनाकखण्टूवाङ्गकरालपाणिः स कृत्तिवासा डमरुप्रणादः .. 15.35 ..
6.3.m: his body encircled by throngs of venomous serpents, his crown bearing poison, fire, the moon, and the heavenly river, / his terrifying hands holding the Pināka and the khaṭvāṅga, clad in animal skin, resounding with the ḍamaru,

6.3.s:
sa saptalokāntaraniḥsṛtātmā mahabhujāveṣṭitasarvagātraḥ .
netreṇa sūryodayasannibhena pravālakāṅkūranibhodareṇa .. 15.36 ..
6.3.d:
स सप्तलोकान्तरनिःसृतात्मा महभुजावेष्टितसर्वगात्रः .
नेत्रेण सूर्योदयसन्निभेन प्रवालकाङ्कूरनिभोदरेण .. 15.36 ..
6.3.m: whose self extends through the seven worlds, whose entire body is enveloped by mighty arms, / with an eye resembling the sunrise, whose interior resembles a sprout of coral,

6.3.s:
sandhyābhraraktotpalapadmarāgasindūravidyutprakarāruṇena .
tatena liṅgena ca locanena cikrīḍamānaḥ sa yugāntakāle .. 15.37 ..
6.3.d:
सन्ध्याभ्ररक्तोत्पलपद्मरागसिन्दूरविद्युत्प्रकरारुणेन .
ततेन लिङ्गेन च लोचनेन चिक्रीडमानः स युगान्तकाले .. 15.37 ..
6.3.m: ruddy like twilight clouds, red lotuses, rubies, vermilion, and flashes of lightning, / sporting at the end of the yuga with his extended liṅga and [third] eye,

6.3.s:
hiraṇmayenaiva samutsṛjan sa daṇḍena yadvadbhagavān sameruḥ .
pādāgravikṣepaviśīrṇaśailaḥ kurvañjagatso'pi jagāma tatra .. 15.38 ..
6.3.d:
हिरण्मयेनैव समुत्सृजन् स दण्डेन यद्वद्भगवान् समेरुः .
पादाग्रविक्षेपविशीर्णशैलः कुर्वञ्जगत्सोऽपि जगाम तत्र .. 15.38 ..
6.3.m: releasing it like a golden staff, just as the blessed Meru mountain would, / the mountains shattered by the thrusts of his toes, transforming the world, he proceeded there.

6.3.s:
saṃhartukāmastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ pramuñcamāno vikṛtāṭṭahāsam .
jahāra sarvaṃ tridivaṃ mahātmā saṃkṣobhayanvai jagadīśa ekaḥ .. 15.39 ..
6.3.d:
संहर्तुकामस्त्रिदिवं त्वशेषं प्रमुञ्चमानो विकृताट्टहासम् .
जहार सर्वं त्रिदिवं महात्मा संक्षोभयन्वै जगदीश एकः .. 15.39 ..
6.3.m: Desiring to destroy heaven completely, emitting a terrifying roar of laughter, / the great-souled sole Lord of the World destroyed the entire three heavens, convulsing them.

6.3.s:
taṃ devamīśānamajaṃ vareṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatsaṃharaṇaṃ maheśam .
sā kālarātriḥ saha mātṛbhiśca gaṇāśca sarve śivamarcayanti .. 15.40 ..
6.3.d:
तं देवमीशानमजं वरेण्यं दृष्ट्वा जगत्संहरणं महेशम् .
सा कालरात्रिः सह मातृभिश्च गणाश्च सर्वे शिवमर्चयन्ति .. 15.40 ..
6.3.m: Having seen that god, the unborn, excellent Lord Maheśa, who destroys the universe, / Kālarātri along with the Mothers, and all the attendants worship Śiva.

6.3.s:
nandī ca bhṛṅgī ca gaṇādayaśca taṃ sarvabhūtaṃ praṇamanti devam .
jāgadvaraṃ sarvajanasya kāraṇaṃ haraṃ smarārātimaharniśaṃ te .. 15.41 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye sṛṣṭisaṃharaṇasaṃrambhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 16
6.3.d:
नन्दी च भृङ्गी च गणादयश्च तं सर्वभूतं प्रणमन्ति देवम् .
जागद्वरं सर्वजनस्य कारणं हरं स्मरारातिमहर्निशं ते .. 15.41 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये सृष्टिसंहरणसंरम्भवर्णनं नाम पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 16
6.3.m:
Nandin, Bhṛṅgin, and the attendants bow to that god who is all beings, / the best in the universe, the cause of all people, Hara, the enemy of Smara, day and night.
Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Vehemence of Creation's Dissolution,' in the praise of the Narmadā, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 16

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
samātṛbhirbhūtagaṇaśca ghorairvṛtaḥ samantātsa nanarta śūlī .
gajendracarmāvaraṇe vasānaḥ saṃhartukāmaśca jagatsamastam .. 16.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
समातृभिर्भूतगणश्च घोरैर्वृतः समन्तात्स ननर्त शूली .
गजेन्द्रचर्मावरणे वसानः संहर्तुकामश्च जगत्समस्तम् .. 16.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Surrounded on all sides by the Mothers and dreadful hosts of ghosts, the trident-bearer danced, / dressed in the covering of an elephant hide, desiring to destroy the entire world.

6.3.s:
maheśvaraḥ sarvasureśvarāṇāṃ mantrairanekekhabaddhamālī .
medovasāraktavicarcitāṅgastrailokyadāhe praṇanarta śambhuḥ .. 16.2 ..
6.3.d:
महेश्वरः सर्वसुरेश्वराणां मन्त्रैरनेकेखबद्धमाली .
मेदोवसारक्तविचर्चिताङ्गस्त्रैलोक्यदाहे प्रणनर्त शम्भुः .. 16.2 ..
6.3.m: Maheśvara, having garlands strung with many syllables by the mantras of all lords of gods, / his limbs smeared with marrow, fat, and blood, Śambhu danced at the burning of the three worlds.

6.3.s:
sa kālarātryā sahito mahātmā kāle trilokīṃ sakalāṃ jahāra .
saṃvartakākhyaḥ sahabhānubhāvaḥ śambhurmahātmā jagato variṣṭhaḥ .. 16.3 ..
6.3.d:
स कालरात्र्या सहितो महात्मा काले त्रिलोकीं सकलां जहार .
संवर्तकाख्यः सहभानुभावः शम्भुर्महात्मा जगतो वरिष्ठः .. 16.3 ..
6.3.m: Accompanied by Kālarātri, the great-souled one destroyed the entire three worlds in due time. / Known as Saṃvartaka, possessing the splendor of the sun, the great-souled Śambhu is the highest in the universe.

6.3.s:
sa visphuliṅgotkaradhūmamiśraṃ maholkavajrāśanivātatulyam .
tato'ṭṭahāsaṃ pramumoca ghoraṃ vivṛtya vaktraṃ vaḍavāmukhābham .. 16.4 ..
6.3.d:
स विस्फुलिङ्गोत्करधूममिश्रं महोल्कवज्राशनिवाततुल्यम् .
ततोऽट्टहासं प्रमुमोच घोरं विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभम् .. 16.4 ..
6.3.m: Then, opening his mouth that resembled the submarine fire, he let loose a dreadful, loud laugh / mixed with a multitude of sparks and smoke, resembling a wind of great meteors and thunderbolts.

6.3.s:
sahasravajrāśanisaṃnibhena tenāṭṭahāsena harodgatena .
āpūritāstatra diśo daśaiva saṃkṣobhitāḥ sarvamahārṇavāśca .. 16.5 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रवज्राशनिसंनिभेन तेनाट्टहासेन हरोद्गतेन .
आपूरितास्तत्र दिशो दशैव संक्षोभिताः सर्वमहार्णवाश्च .. 16.5 ..
6.3.m: By that loud laugh issuing from Hara, resembling a thousand thunderbolts, / all the ten directions were filled there, and all the great oceans were agitated.

6.3.s:
sa brahmalokaṃ prajagāma śabdo brahmāṇḍabhāṇḍaṃ pracacāla sarvam .
kimetadityākulacetanāste vitrastarūpā ṛṣayo babhūvuḥ .. 16.6 ..
6.3.d:
स ब्रह्मलोकं प्रजगाम शब्दो ब्रह्माण्डभाण्डं प्रचचाल सर्वम् .
किमेतदित्याकुलचेतनास्ते वित्रस्तरूपा ऋषयो बभूवुः .. 16.6 ..
6.3.m: That sound reached the world of Brahmā; the entire vessel of the universe trembled. / 'What is this?'—their minds perturbed, the seers became terrified.

6.3.s:
praṇamya sarve sahasaiva bhītā brahmāṇamūcuḥ parameśvareśam .
bhītāśca sarve ṛṣayastataste surāsuraiścaiva mahoragaiśca .. 16.7 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य सर्वे सहसैव भीता ब्रह्माणमूचुः परमेश्वरेशम् .
भीताश्च सर्वे ऋषयस्ततस्ते सुरासुरैश्चैव महोरगैश्च .. 16.7 ..
6.3.m: Bowing at once in fear, they spoke to Brahmā, the lord of supreme gods; / and all those seers were frightened, along with gods, demons, and great serpents.

6.3.s:
vidyutprabhābhāsurabhīṣaṇāṅgaḥ ka eṣa cikrīḍati bhūtalasthaḥ .
kālānalaṃ gātramidaṃ dadhāno yasyāṭṭahāsena jagadvimūḍham .. 16.8 ..
6.3.d:
विद्युत्प्रभाभासुरभीषणाङ्गः क एष चिक्रीडति भूतलस्थः .
कालानलं गात्रमिदं दधानो यस्याट्टहासेन जगद्विमूढम् .. 16.8 ..
6.3.m: "Who is this, standing on the surface of the earth, playing, with terrifying limbs blazing with the radiance of lightning, / bearing this body [resembling] the fire of destruction, by whose loud laughter the universe is bewildered? 16.8

6.3.s:
vitrastarūpaṃ prababhau kṣaṇena saṃhartumicchetkimayaṃ trilokīm .
sārdhaṃ tvayā saptabhirarṇakaiśca janastapaḥ satyamabhiprayāti .. 16.9 ..
6.3.d:
वित्रस्तरूपं प्रबभौ क्षणेन संहर्तुमिच्छेत्किमयं त्रिलोकीम् .
सार्धं त्वया सप्तभिरर्णकैश्च जनस्तपः सत्यमभिप्रयाति .. 16.9 ..
6.3.m: In an instant, it appeared terrified in form. Does he desire to destroy the three worlds? / Together with you and the seven children, the people of the worlds—Jana, Tapas, and Satya—are approaching [ruin]. 16.9

6.3.s:
saṃhartukāmo hi ka eṣa deva etatsamastaṃ kathayāprameya .
na dṛṣṭametadviṣamaṃ kadāpi jānāsi tattvaṃ paramo mato naḥ .. 16.10 ..
6.3.d:
संहर्तुकामो हि क एष देव एतत्समस्तं कथयाप्रमेय .
न दृष्टमेतद्विषमं कदापि जानासि तत्त्वं परमो मतो नः .. 16.10 ..
6.3.m: Indeed, who is this god wishing to destroy [all]? Tell us all this, O immeasurable one! / Such a terrible thing has never been seen before. You know the truth; we consider you supreme." 16.10

6.3.s: niśamya tadvākyamathābabhāṣe brahmā samāśvāsya surādisaṅghān .. 16.11 ..
6.3.d: निशम्य तद्वाक्यमथाबभाषे ब्रह्मा समाश्वास्य सुरादिसङ्घान् .. 16.11 ..
6.3.m: Having heard their words, Brahmā then, comforting the hosts of gods and others, spoke: 16.11

6.3.s:
śrībrahmovāca -
sa eṣa kālastridivaṃ tvaśeṣaṃ saṃhartukāmo jagadakṣayātmā .
pūrṇe ca śete parivatsarāṇāṃ bhaviṣyatīśānavibhurna citram .. 16.12 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीब्रह्मोवाच -
स एष कालस्त्रिदिवं त्वशेषं संहर्तुकामो जगदक्षयात्मा .
पूर्णे च शेते परिवत्सराणां भविष्यतीशानविभुर्न चित्रम् .. 16.12 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Brahmā said: / "He is Time, desiring to destroy the entire heaven and universe, of imperishable nature. / And when the cycle of years is complete, he rests; he will become the all-pervading lord—it is no wonder. 16.12

6.3.s:
saṃvatsaro'yaṃ parivatsaraśca udvatsaro vatsara eṣa devaḥ .
dṛṣṭo'pyadṛṣṭaḥ prahutaḥ prakāśī sthūlaśca sūkṣmaḥ paramāṇureṣaḥ .. 16.13 ..
6.3.d:
संवत्सरोऽयं परिवत्सरश्च उद्वत्सरो वत्सर एष देवः .
दृष्टोऽप्यदृष्टः प्रहुतः प्रकाशी स्थूलश्च सूक्ष्मः परमाणुरेषः .. 16.13 ..
6.3.m: This god is the Saṃvatsara, the Parivatsara, the Udvatsara, and the Vatsara. / He is seen and unseen, sacrificed to, shining, gross, subtle, and an ultimate atom. 16.13

6.3.s:
nātaḥ paraṃ kiṃcidihāsti loke parāparo'yaṃ prabhurātmavādī .
tuṣyeta me kālasamānarūpa ityevamuktvā bhagavānsureśaḥ .. 16.14 ..
6.3.d:
नातः परं किंचिदिहास्ति लोके परापरोऽयं प्रभुरात्मवादी .
तुष्येत मे कालसमानरूप इत्येवमुक्त्वा भगवान्सुरेशः .. 16.14 ..
6.3.m: There is nothing higher than this in this world; he is higher than the high, the master who asserts himself. / May he who resembles Time be pleased with me!" Having spoken thus, the venerable lord of gods, 16.14

6.3.s: sanatkumārapramukhaiḥ sametaḥ saṃtoṣayāmāsa tato yatātmā .. 16.15 ..
6.3.d: सनत्कुमारप्रमुखैः समेतः संतोषयामास ततो यतात्मा .. 16.15 ..
6.3.m: accompanied by Sanatkumāra and the others, restrained in mind, then propitiated him. 16.15

6.3.s:
brahmovāca -
namo'stu sarvāya suśāntamūrtāye hyaghorarūpāya namonamaste .
sarvātmane sarva namonamaste mahātmane bhūtapate namaste .. 16.16 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच -
नमोऽस्तु सर्वाय सुशान्तमूर्ताये ह्यघोररूपाय नमोनमस्ते .
सर्वात्मने सर्व नमोनमस्ते महात्मने भूतपते नमस्ते .. 16.16 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā said: / "Homage to Sarva, whose form is exceedingly peaceful; homage, homage to you whose form is non-terrific. / Homage, homage to you, the soul of all, O Sarva! Homage to you, the great soul, O lord of creatures! 16.16

6.3.s:
oṅkāra huṅkārapariṣkṛtāya svadhāvaṣaṭkāra namonamaste .
guṇatrayeśāya maheśvarāya te trayīmayāya triguṇātmane namaḥ .. 16.17 ..
6.3.d:
ओङ्कार हुङ्कारपरिष्कृताय स्वधावषट्कार नमोनमस्ते .
गुणत्रयेशाय महेश्वराय ते त्रयीमयाय त्रिगुणात्मने नमः .. 16.17 ..
6.3.m: Homage, homage to you adorned with the sounds Oṃ and Huṃ, and with Svadhā and Vaṣaṭ! / Homage to you, the master of the three qualities, Maheśvara, composed of the three Vedas, the embodiment of the three qualities. 16.17

6.3.s:
tvaṃ śaṅkaratvaṃ hi maheśvaro'si pradhānamagryaṃ tvamasi praviṣṭaḥ .
tvaṃ viṣṇurīśaḥ prapitāmahaśca tvaṃ saptajihvastvamanantajihvaḥ .. 16.18 ..
6.3.d:
त्वं शङ्करत्वं हि महेश्वरोऽसि प्रधानमग्र्यं त्वमसि प्रविष्टः .
त्वं विष्णुरीशः प्रपितामहश्च त्वं सप्तजिह्वस्त्वमनन्तजिह्वः .. 16.18 ..
6.3.m: You are Śaṅkara, you indeed are Maheśvara; you have entered the foremost primal matter. / You are Viṣṇu, Īśa, and the great-grandfather; you are the seven-tongued, you are the endless-tongued. 16.18

6.3.s:
sraṣṭāsi sṛṣṭiśca vibho tvameva viśvasya vedyaṃ ca paraṃ nidhānam .
āhurdvijā vedavido vareṇyaṃ parātparastvaṃ parataḥ paro'si .. 16.19 ..
6.3.d:
स्रष्टासि सृष्टिश्च विभो त्वमेव विश्वस्य वेद्यं च परं निधानम् .
आहुर्द्विजा वेदविदो वरेण्यं परात्परस्त्वं परतः परोऽसि .. 16.19 ..
6.3.m: You are the creator, and you alone, O all-pervading one, are creation, the knowable, and the supreme treasure of the universe. / The twice-born knowers of the Veda declare you to be the most excellent; you are higher than the high, supreme beyond the supreme. 16.19

6.3.s: sūkṣmātisūkṣmaṃ pravadanti yacca vāco nivartanti mano yataśca .. 16.20 ..
6.3.d: सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्मं प्रवदन्ति यच्च वाचो निवर्तन्ति मनो यतश्च .. 16.20 ..
6.3.m: And you are that which they call the subtlest of the subtle, from which words turn back along with the mind." 16.20

6.3.s:
śrīmahādeva uvāca -
tvayā stuto'haṃ vividhaiśca mantraiḥ puṣṇāmi śāntiṃ tava padmayone .
īkṣasva māṃ lokamimaṃ jvalantaṃ vaktrairanekaiḥ prasabhaṃ harantam .. 16.21 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच -
त्वया स्तुतोऽहं विविधैश्च मन्त्रैः पुष्णामि शान्तिं तव पद्मयोने .
ईक्षस्व मां लोकमिमं ज्वलन्तं वक्त्रैरनेकैः प्रसभं हरन्तम् .. 16.21 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mahādeva said: / "Praised by you with various mantras, I bring peace to you, O lotus-born one. / Look upon me, blazing, forcibly seizing this world with my many mouths!" 16.21

6.3.s:
evamuktvā sa deveśo devyā saha jagatpatiḥ .
pitāmahaṃ samāśvāsya tatraivāntaradhīyata .. 16.22 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स देवेशो देव्या सह जगत्पतिः .
पितामहं समाश्वास्य तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .. 16.22 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, that lord of the gods, the master of the universe, together with the Goddess, / comforting the grandfather, vanished right there. 16.22

6.3.s:
idaṃ mahatpuṇyatamaṃ variṣṭhaṃ stotraṃ niśamyeha gatiṃ labhante .
pāpairanekaiḥ pariveṣṭitā ye prayānti rudraṃ vimalairvimānaiḥ .. 16.23 ..
6.3.d:
इदं महत्पुण्यतमं वरिष्ठं स्तोत्रं निशम्येह गतिं लभन्ते .
पापैरनेकैः परिवेष्टिता ये प्रयान्ति रुद्रं विमलैर्विमानैः .. 16.23 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this hymn, which is exceedingly auspicious and most excellent, they attain the supreme goal here. / Those who are surrounded by numerous sins go to Rudra in spotless aerial chariots. 16.23

6.3.s:
bhayaṃ ca teṣāṃ na bhavetkadācitpaṭhanti ye tāta idaṃ dvijāgryāḥ .
saṅgrāmacaurāgnivane tathābdhau teṣāṃ śivastrāti na saṃśayo'tra .. 16.24 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye brahmakṛtaśivastutivarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 17
6.3.d:
भयं च तेषां न भवेत्कदाचित्पठन्ति ये तात इदं द्विजाग्र्याः .
सङ्ग्रामचौराग्निवने तथाब्धौ तेषां शिवस्त्राति न संशयोऽत्र .. 16.24 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकृतशिवस्तुतिवर्णनं नाम षोडशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 17
6.3.m:
And no fear shall ever arise for those best of twice-born, my dear, who recite this. / In battle, from thieves, fire, in the forest, and likewise in the ocean, Śiva protects them; of this there is no doubt. 16.24
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Praise of Śiva Uttered by Brahmā', in the Narmadāmāhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantīkhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 17

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evaṃ saṃstūyamānastu brahmādyairmunipuṃgavaiḥ .
brahmalokagataistatra saṃjahāra jagatprabhuḥ .. 17.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवं संस्तूयमानस्तु ब्रह्माद्यैर्मुनिपुंगवैः .
ब्रह्मलोकगतैस्तत्र संजहार जगत्प्रभुः .. 17.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Being thus praised by the eminent sages headed by Brahmā / who were present in the Brahmaloka, the lord of the world withdrew [the universe]. 17.1

6.3.s:
sa tadbhīmaṃ mahāraudraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vaktramavyayam .
mahādaṃṣṭrotkaṭārāvaṃ pātālatalasaṃnibham .. 17.2 ..
6.3.d:
स तद्भीमं महारौद्रं दक्षिणं वक्त्रमव्ययम् .
महादंष्ट्रोत्कटारावं पातालतलसंनिभम् .. 17.2 ..
6.3.m: He [revealed] that imperishable, terrifying, exceedingly dreadful southern face, / with an intensely loud roar and huge fangs, resembling the depths of Pātāla, 17.2

6.3.s:
vidyujjvalanapiṅgākṣaṃ bhairavaṃ lomaharṣaṇam .
mahājihvaṃ mahādaṃṣṭraṃ mahāsarpaśirodharam .. 17.3 ..
6.3.d:
विद्युज्ज्वलनपिङ्गाक्षं भैरवं लोमहर्षणम् .
महाजिह्वं महादंष्ट्रं महासर्पशिरोधरम् .. 17.3 ..
6.3.m: with yellow eyes shining like lightning, fearsome, causing the hair to stand on end, / with a huge tongue, huge fangs, and carrying great serpents on its neck, 17.3

6.3.s:
mahāsuraśiromālaṃ mahāpralayakāraṇam .
grasatsamudranihitavātavārimayaṃ haviḥ .. 17.4 ..
6.3.d:
महासुरशिरोमालं महाप्रलयकारणम् .
ग्रसत्समुद्रनिहितवातवारिमयं हविः .. 17.4 ..
6.3.m: wearing a garland of heads of great asuras, the cause of the great dissolution, / devouring the oblation composed of wind and water placed in the ocean, 17.4

6.3.s:
vaḍavāmukhasaṅkāśaṃ mahādevasya tanmukham .
jihvāgreṇa jagatsarvaṃ lelihānamapaśyata .. 17.5 ..
6.3.d:
वडवामुखसङ्काशं महादेवस्य तन्मुखम् .
जिह्वाग्रेण जगत्सर्वं लेलिहानमपश्यत .. 17.5 ..
6.3.m: resembling the mouth of the submarine mare's fire—that mouth of Mahādeva, / licking all the universe with the tip of its tongue, he beheld. 17.5

6.3.s:
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi sahasrāṇāṃ śatāni ca .
diśo daśa mahāghorā māṃsamedovasotkaṭāḥ .. 17.6 ..
6.3.d:
योजनानां सहस्राणि सहस्राणां शतानि च .
दिशो दश महाघोरा मांसमेदोवसोत्कटाः .. 17.6 ..
6.3.m: Thousands of yojanas and hundreds of thousands [in extent], / the ten directions were made exceedingly terrifying, full of flesh, fat, and marrow. 17.6

6.3.s:
tasya daṃṣṭrā vyavardhata śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .
sāsurānsuragandharvān sayakṣoragarākṣasān .. 17.7 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य दंष्ट्रा व्यवर्धत शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .
सासुरान्सुरगन्धर्वान् सयक्षोरगराक्षसान् .. 17.7 ..
6.3.m: His fangs grew by hundreds and thousands, / [crushing] the asuras, suras, gandharvas, together with the yakṣas, uragas, and rākṣasas. 17.7

6.3.s:
tasya daṃṣṭrāgrasaṃlagnānsa dadarśa pitāmahaḥ .
dantayantrāntasaṃviṣṭaṃ vicūrṇitaśirodharam .. 17.8 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य दंष्ट्राग्रसंलग्नान्स ददर्श पितामहः .
दन्तयन्त्रान्तसंविष्टं विचूर्णितशिरोधरम् .. 17.8 ..
6.3.m: The grandfather saw them caught at the tips of his fangs, / situated inside the machine of his teeth, their necks crushed to powder. 17.8

6.3.s:
jagatpaśyāmi rājendra viśantaṃ vyādite mukhe .
nānātaraṅgabhaṅgāṅgā mahāphenaughasaṃkulāḥ .
yathā nadyo layaṃ yānti samudraṃ prāpya sasvanāḥ .. 17.9 ..
6.3.d:
जगत्पश्यामि राजेन्द्र विशन्तं व्यादिते मुखे .
नानातरङ्गभङ्गाङ्गा महाफेनौघसंकुलाः .
यथा नद्यो लयं यान्ति समुद्रं प्राप्य सस्वनाः .. 17.9 ..
6.3.m: "I see the world, O best of kings, entering the gaping mouth! / Just as rivers, with bodies of various breaking waves and filled with masses of heavy foam, / meet their dissolution with a roar upon reaching the ocean, 17.9

6.3.s:
tathā tataṃ viśvamidaṃ samastamanekajīvārṇavadurvigāhyam .
viveśa rudrasya mukhaṃ viśālaṃ jvalattadugraṃ ghananādaghoram .. 17.10 ..
6.3.d:
तथा ततं विश्वमिदं समस्तमनेकजीवार्णवदुर्विगाह्यम् .
विवेश रुद्रस्य मुखं विशालं ज्वलत्तदुग्रं घननादघोरम् .. 17.10 ..
6.3.m: so this entire extended universe, difficult to fathom like an ocean of countless living beings, / entered the vast, burning, fierce mouth of Rudra, terrifying with a sound like thunderclouds. 17.10

6.3.s:
jvālāstatastasya mukhātsughorāḥ savisphuliṅgā bahulāḥ sadhūmāḥ .
anekarūpā jvalanaprakāśāḥ pradīpayantīva diśo'khilāśca .. 17.11 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वालास्ततस्तस्य मुखात्सुघोराः सविस्फुलिङ्गा बहुलाः सधूमाः .
अनेकरूपा ज्वलनप्रकाशाः प्रदीपयन्तीव दिशोऽखिलाश्च .. 17.11 ..
6.3.m: Then, exceedingly dreadful, abundant flames, accompanied by sparks and smoke, / possessing various forms and the brightness of fire, [surged] from his mouth, as if setting all the directions ablaze. 17.11

6.3.s:
tato ravijvālasahasramāli babhūva vaktraṃ calajihvadaṃṣṭram .
maheśvarasyādbhutarūpiṇastadā sa dvādaśātmā prababhūva ekaḥ .. 17.12 ..
6.3.d:
ततो रविज्वालसहस्रमालि बभूव वक्त्रं चलजिह्वदंष्ट्रम् .
महेश्वरस्याद्भुतरूपिणस्तदा स द्वादशात्मा प्रबभूव एकः .. 17.12 ..
6.3.m: Then the face with moving tongue and fangs became garlanded with thousands of sun-like flames. / That one lord of wonderful form, Maheśvara, then became the twelve-fold soul. 17.12

6.3.s:
tataste dvādaśādityā rudravaktrādvinirgatāḥ .
āśritya dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ nirdahanto vasuṃdharām .. 17.13 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्ते द्वादशादित्या रुद्रवक्त्राद्विनिर्गताः .
आश्रित्य दक्षिणामाशां निर्दहन्तो वसुंधराम् .. 17.13 ..
6.3.m: Then those twelve Ādityas went forth from the mouth of Rudra, / resorting to the southern quarter, burning up the earth. 17.13

6.3.s:
bhaumaṃ yajjīvanaṃ kiṃcinnānāvṛkṣatṛṇālayam .
śuṣkaṃ pūrvamanāvṛṣṭyā sakalākulabhūtalam .. 17.14 ..
6.3.d:
भौमं यज्जीवनं किंचिन्नानावृक्षतृणालयम् .
शुष्कं पूर्वमनावृष्ट्या सकलाकुलभूतलम् .. 17.14 ..
6.3.m: Whatever living matter was on the earth, the abode of diverse trees and grass, / which was already dried up by drought, the whole earth being distressed, 17.14

6.3.s:
taddīpyamānaṃ sahasā sūryaistai rudrasambhavaiḥ .
dhūmākulamabhūtsarvaṃ praṇaṣṭagrahatārakam .. 17.15 ..
6.3.d:
तद्दीप्यमानं सहसा सूर्यैस्तै रुद्रसम्भवैः .
धूमाकुलमभूत्सर्वं प्रणष्टग्रहतारकम् .. 17.15 ..
6.3.m: all that was suddenly set ablaze by those suns born of Rudra, / became filled with smoke, with the planets and stars obliterated. 17.15

6.3.s:
jajvāla sahasā dīptaṃ bhūmaṇḍalamaśeṣataḥ .
jvālāmālākulaṃ sarvamabhūdetaccarācaram .. 17.16 ..
6.3.d:
जज्वाल सहसा दीप्तं भूमण्डलमशेषतः .
ज्वालामालाकुलं सर्वमभूदेतच्चराचरम् .. 17.16 ..
6.3.m: The globe of the earth blazed entirely in a sudden flash; / all this, moving and unmoving, became engulfed in garlands of flames. 17.16

6.3.s: saptadvīpasamudreṣu saritsu ca sarassu ca agniratti jagatsarvamājyāhutimivādhvare .. 17.17 ..
6.3.d: सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रेषु सरित्सु च सरस्सु च अग्निरत्ति जगत्सर्वमाज्याहुतिमिवाध्वरे .. 17.17 ..
6.3.m: In the oceans of the seven continents, in the rivers and in the lakes, the fire devoured the whole world like an oblation of clarified butter in a sacrifice. 17.17

6.3.s:
viśālatejasā dīptā mahājvālāsamākulāḥ .
dadahurvai jagatsarvamādityā rudrasambhavāḥ .. 17.18 ..
6.3.d:
विशालतेजसा दीप्ता महाज्वालासमाकुलाः .
ददहुर्वै जगत्सर्वमादित्या रुद्रसम्भवाः .. 17.18 ..
6.3.m: Blazing with immense splendor and filled with great flames, / the Ādityas born of Rudra truly burned the entire world. 17.18

6.3.s:
ādityānāṃ raśmayaśca saṃspṛṣṭā vai parasparam .
evaṃ dadāha bhagavāṃstrailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 17.19 ..
6.3.d:
आदित्यानां रश्मयश्च संस्पृष्टा वै परस्परम् .
एवं ददाह भगवांस्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 17.19 ..
6.3.m: The rays of the Ādityas touched one another; / thus did the Lord burn the three worlds, both moving and unmoving. 17.19

6.3.s:
saptadvīpapramāṇastu so'gnirbhūtvā maheśvaraḥ .
saptadvīpasamudrāntāṃ nirdadāha vasuṃdharām .. 17.20 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तद्वीपप्रमाणस्तु सोऽग्निर्भूत्वा महेश्वरः .
सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रान्तां निर्ददाह वसुंधराम् .. 17.20 ..
6.3.m: Maheśvara, having become that fire measuring the size of the seven continents, / burned up the earth as far as the oceans of the seven continents." 17.20

6.3.s:
sumerumandarāntāṃ ca nirdahurvasudhāṃ tadā .
bhittvā tu saptapātālaṃ nāgalokaṃ tato'dahat .. 17.21 ..
6.3.d:
सुमेरुमन्दरान्तां च निर्दहुर्वसुधां तदा .
भित्त्वा तु सप्तपातालं नागलोकं ततोऽदहत् .. 17.21 ..
6.3.m: And they burned up the earth including Sumeru and Mandara then; / having broken through the seven realms of Pātāla, it then burned the world of the Nāgas.

6.3.s:
bhūmyadhaḥ saptapātālānnirdahaṃstārakaiḥ saha .
cacārāgniḥ samantāttu nirdahanvai yudhiṣṭhira .. 17.22 ..
6.3.d:
भूम्यधः सप्तपातालान्निर्दहंस्तारकैः सह .
चचाराग्निः समन्तात्तु निर्दहन्वै युधिष्ठिर .. 17.22 ..
6.3.m: Burning beneath the earth the seven realms of Pātāla together with the demons, / the fire moved on every side, burning indeed, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
dhamyamāna ivāṅgārairloharātririva jvalan .
tathā tatprājvalatsarvaṃ saṃvartāgnipradīpitam .. 17.23 ..
6.3.d:
धम्यमान इवाङ्गारैर्लोहरात्रिरिव ज्वलन् .
तथा तत्प्राज्वलत्सर्वं संवर्ताग्निप्रदीपितम् .. 17.23 ..
6.3.m: Like [iron] being blown with coals, blazing like a night of iron, / thus all that blazed up, ignited by the fire of universal destruction.

6.3.s:
nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā bhūmirnirnirjharasaraḥ sarit .
viśīrṇaśailaśṛṅgaughā kūrmapṛṣṭhopamābhavat .. 17.24 ..
6.3.d:
निर्वृक्षा निस्तृणा भूमिर्निर्निर्झरसरः सरित् .
विशीर्णशैलशृङ्गौघा कूर्मपृष्ठोपमाभवत् .. 17.24 ..
6.3.m: Devoid of trees, devoid of grass, the earth, without springs, lakes, or rivers, / its mass of mountain peaks shattered, became like the back of a tortoise.

6.3.s:
jvālāmālākulaṃ kṛtvā jagatsarvaṃ cidāmakam .
mahārūpadharo rudro vyatiṣṭhata maheśvaraḥ .. 17.25 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वालामालाकुलं कृत्वा जगत्सर्वं चिदामकम् .
महारूपधरो रुद्रो व्यतिष्ठत महेश्वरः .. 17.25 ..
6.3.m: Having filled the entire universe with a garland of flames, the conscious essence, / Rudra, Maheśvara, having assumed an immense form, stood.

6.3.s:
samātṛgaṇabhūyiṣṭhā sayakṣoragarākṣasā .
tato devī mahādevaṃ viveśa harilocanā .. 17.26 ..
6.3.d:
समातृगणभूयिष्ठा सयक्षोरगराक्षसा .
ततो देवी महादेवं विवेश हरिलोचना .. 17.26 ..
6.3.m: Surrounded predominantly by the hosts of the mothers, accompanied by Yakṣas, serpents, and Rākṣasas, / then the Goddess with eyes like Viṣṇu entered Mahādeva,

6.3.s:
nirvāṇaṃ paramāpannā śānteva śikhinaḥ śikhā .
jagatsarvaṃ hi nirdagdhaṃ tribhirlokaiḥ sahānagha .. 17.27 ..
6.3.d:
निर्वाणं परमापन्ना शान्तेव शिखिनः शिखा .
जगत्सर्वं हि निर्दग्धं त्रिभिर्लोकैः सहानघ .. 17.27 ..
6.3.m: having attained supreme extinction, like the flame of a fire that has subsided. / For the entire universe along with the three worlds was burnt, O sinless one,

6.3.s:
rudraprasādānmuktvā māṃ narmadāṃ cāpyayonijām .
yugānāmayutaṃ devo mayā cādya bubhakṣaṇāt .. 17.28 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रप्रसादान्मुक्त्वा मां नर्मदां चाप्ययोनिजाम् .
युगानामयुतं देवो मया चाद्य बुभक्षणात् .. 17.28 ..
6.3.m: by the grace of Rudra, except for me and the Narmadā, not born of a womb. / For ten thousand yugas the god [was worshipped] by me today, because of his desire to consume.

6.3.s:
purā hyārādhitaḥ śūlī tenāhamajarāmaraḥ .
aghamarṣaṇaghoraṃ ca vāmadevaṃ ca tryambakam .. 17.29 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा ह्याराधितः शूली तेनाहमजरामरः .
अघमर्षणघोरं च वामदेवं च त्र्यम्बकम् .. 17.29 ..
6.3.m: For of old the wielder of the trident was propitiated; by that I am free from old age and death. / Having recited the Aghamarṣaṇa, the Ghora, the Vāmadeva, and the Tryambaka;

6.3.s:
ṛṣabhaṃ trisuparṇaṃ ca durgāṃ sāvitrameva ca .
bṛhadāraṇyakaṃ caiva bṛhatsāma tathottaram .. 17.30 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषभं त्रिसुपर्णं च दुर्गां सावित्रमेव च .
बृहदारण्यकं चैव बृहत्साम तथोत्तरम् .. 17.30 ..
6.3.m: the Ṛṣabha, the Trisuparṇa, the Durgā, and the Sāvitra; / the Bṛhadāraṇyaka, the Bṛhatsāma, and the Uttara;

6.3.s:
raudrīṃ paramagāyatrīṃ śivopaniṣadaṃ tathā .
yathā pratirathaṃ sūktaṃ japtvā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ tathā .. 17.31 ..
6.3.d:
रौद्रीं परमगायत्रीं शिवोपनिषदं तथा .
यथा प्रतिरथं सूक्तं जप्त्वा मृत्युंजयं तथा .. 17.31 ..
6.3.m: the supreme Raudrī Gāyatrī, and the Śivopaniṣad, / as well as the Pratiratha hymn, and the Mṛtyuṃjaya [mantra]—

6.3.s:
saritsāgaraparyantā vasudhā bhasmasātkṛtā .
varjayitvā mahābhāgāṃ narmadāmamṛtopamām .. 17.32 ..
6.3.d:
सरित्सागरपर्यन्ता वसुधा भस्मसात्कृता .
वर्जयित्वा महाभागां नर्मदाममृतोपमाम् .. 17.32 ..
6.3.m: the earth extending to the rivers and the oceans was reduced to ashes, / sparing the highly fortunate Narmadā, who is like nectar.

6.3.s:
mahendro malayaḥ sahyo hemakūṭo'tha mālyavān .
vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca saptaite kulaparvatāḥ .. 17.33 ..
6.3.d:
महेन्द्रो मलयः सह्यो हेमकूटोऽथ माल्यवान् .
विन्ध्यश्च पारियात्रश्च सप्तैते कुलपर्वताः .. 17.33 ..
6.3.m: Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Hemakūṭa, and Mālyavān, / Vindhya, and Pāriyātra: these are the seven principal mountain ranges.

6.3.s:
dvādaśādityanirdagdhāḥ śailāḥ śīrṇaśilāḥ pṛthak .
bhasmībhūtāstu dṛśyante na naṣṭā narmadā tadā .. 17.34 ..
6.3.d:
द्वादशादित्यनिर्दग्धाः शैलाः शीर्णशिलाः पृथक् .
भस्मीभूतास्तु दृश्यन्ते न नष्टा नर्मदा तदा .. 17.34 ..
6.3.m: Burned by the twelve suns, their rocks individually shattered, / the mountains were seen turned to ash; yet the Narmadā was not destroyed then.

6.3.s:
himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho gandhamādanaḥ .
mālyavāṃśca giriśreṣṭho nīlaḥ śveto'tha śṛṅgavān .. 17.35 ..
6.3.d:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधो गन्धमादनः .
माल्यवांश्च गिरिश्रेष्ठो नीलः श्वेतोऽथ शृङ्गवान् .. 17.35 ..
6.3.m: Himavān, Hemakūṭa, Niṣadha, Gandhamādana, / and Mālyavān the best of mountains, Nīla, Śveta, and Śṛṅgavān:

6.3.s:
ete parvatarā jāno devagandharvasevitāḥ .
yugāntāgnivinirdagdhāḥ sarve śīrṇamahāśilāḥ .. 17.36 ..
6.3.d:
एते पर्वतरा जानो देवगन्धर्वसेविताः .
युगान्ताग्निविनिर्दग्धाः सर्वे शीर्णमहाशिलाः .. 17.36 ..
6.3.m: these kings of mountains, resorted to by gods and Gandharvas, / all had their great rocks shattered, completely burnt by the fire of the end of the yuga.

6.3.s:
evaṃ mayā purā dṛṣṭo yugānte sarvasaṃkṣayaḥ .
varjayitvā mahāpuṇyāṃ narmadāṃ nṛpasattama .. 17.37 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīnarmadāmāhātmye dvādaśādityarūpeṇa jagatsaṃharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 18
6.3.d:
एवं मया पुरा दृष्टो युगान्ते सर्वसंक्षयः .
वर्जयित्वा महापुण्यां नर्मदां नृपसत्तम .. 17.37 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीनर्मदामाहात्म्ये द्वादशादित्यरूपेण जगत्संहरणवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 18
6.3.m:
Thus of old the complete destruction at the end of the yuga was seen by me, / sparing the greatly meritorious Narmadā, O best of kings.
