6.3.s: anyānpuṇyatamānvṛkṣānupetya svargamāpnuyāt .. 26.130 ..
6.3.d: अन्यान्पुण्यतमान्वृक्षानुपेत्य स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् .. 26.130 ..
6.3.m: by approaching these and other most sacred trees, one attains heaven.

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
caitre māse tu yā nārī kuryādvratamanuttamam .
tasya vratasya cānyāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 26.131 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
चैत्रे मासे तु या नारी कुर्याद्व्रतमनुत्तमम् .
तस्य व्रतस्य चान्यानि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .. 26.131 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / The woman who performs this unsurpassed observance in the month of Caitra— / other [observances] are not worth a sixteenth part of that observance,

6.3.s:
śrutena yena subhage durbhagatvaṃ na paśyati .
yathā himaṃ raviṃ prāpya vilayaṃ yāti bhūtale .. 26.132 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुतेन येन सुभगे दुर्भगत्वं न पश्यति .
यथा हिमं रविं प्राप्य विलयं याति भूतले .. 26.132 ..
6.3.m: by hearing which, O fortunate lady, she sees no misfortune. / Just as frost, reaching the sun, melts away upon the earth,

6.3.s:
tathā duḥkhaṃ ca daurbhāgyaṃ vratādasmādvilīyate .
madhukākhyāṃ tu lalitāmārādhayati yena vai .. 26.133 ..
6.3.d:
तथा दुःखं च दौर्भाग्यं व्रतादस्माद्विलीयते .
मधुकाख्यां तु ललितामाराधयति येन वै .. 26.133 ..
6.3.m: so sorrow and ill fortune dissolve from this observance. / Whereby one worships Lalitā, called Madhukā,

6.3.s:
vidhiṃ taṃ śṛṇu subhage kathyamānaṃ sukhāvaham .
caitre śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ susnātā śuddhamānasā .. 26.134 ..
6.3.d:
विधिं तं शृणु सुभगे कथ्यमानं सुखावहम् .
चैत्रे शुक्लतृतीयायां सुस्नाता शुद्धमानसा .. 26.134 ..
6.3.m: hear that rite, O fortunate lady, as it is told, which brings happiness: / On the bright third lunar day of Caitra, well-bathed and pure in mind,

6.3.s:
pratimāṃ madhuvṛkṣasya śāṅkarīmumayā saha .
kārayitvā dvijavaraiḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi .. 26.135 ..
6.3.d:
प्रतिमां मधुवृक्षस्य शाङ्करीमुमया सह .
कारयित्वा द्विजवरैः प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि .. 26.135 ..
6.3.m: having an image of Śaṅkara with Umā made out of madhūka wood, / and having it consecrated according to rule by excellent twice-born,

6.3.s:
sugandhikusumairdhūpaistathā karpūrakuṅkumaiḥ .
pūjayedvidhinā devaṃ mantrayuktena bhāminī .. 26.136 ..
6.3.d:
सुगन्धिकुसुमैर्धूपैस्तथा कर्पूरकुङ्कुमैः .
पूजयेद्विधिना देवं मन्त्रयुक्तेन भामिनी .. 26.136 ..
6.3.m: with fragrant flowers, incense, camphor, and saffron, / the spirited lady should worship the god according to rule, accompanied by mantras:

6.3.s:
pādau namaḥ śivāyeti meḍhre vai manmathāya ca .
kālodarāyetyudaraṃ nīlakaṃṭhāya kaṇṭhakam .. 26.137 ..
6.3.d:
पादौ नमः शिवायेति मेढ्रे वै मन्मथाय च .
कालोदरायेत्युदरं नीलकंठाय कण्ठकम् .. 26.137 ..
6.3.m: the feet with 'Obeisance to Śiva', the penis with [obeisance] to Manmatha, / the belly with [obeisance] to Kālodara, the throat to Nīlakaṇṭha,

6.3.s:
śiraḥ sarvātmane pūjya umāṃ paścātprapūjayet .
kṣāmodarāyaihyudaraṃ sukaṇṭhāyai ca kaṇṭhakam .. 26.138 ..
6.3.d:
शिरः सर्वात्मने पूज्य उमां पश्चात्प्रपूजयेत् .
क्षामोदरायैह्युदरं सुकण्ठायै च कण्ठकम् .. 26.138 ..
6.3.m: having worshipped the head for the Self of All, she should afterwards worship Umā: / the belly with [obeisance] to Kṣāmodarā, and the throat to Sukaṇṭhā,

6.3.s: śiraḥ saubhāgyadāyinyai paścādarghyaṃ pradāpayet .. 26.139 ..
6.3.d: शिरः सौभाग्यदायिन्यै पश्चादर्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् .. 26.139 ..
6.3.m: the head to Saubhāgyadāyinī; afterwards she should offer the arghya.

6.3.s:
namaste devadeveśa umāvara jagatpate .
arghyeṇānena me sarvaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ nāśaya prabho .
iti arghyamantraḥ .. 26.140 ..
6.3.d:
नमस्ते देवदेवेश उमावर जगत्पते .
अर्घ्येणानेन मे सर्वं दौर्भाग्यं नाशय प्रभो .
इति अर्घ्यमन्त्रः .. 26.140 ..
6.3.m: 'Obeisance to you, O lord of the gods, lover of Umā, lord of the world; / by this arghya, destroy all my ill fortune, O Lord.' / Thus is the mantra for the arghya.

6.3.s:
arghyaṃ dattvā tataḥ paścātkarakaṃ vāripūritam .
madhūkapātropabhṛtaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ tu śaktitaḥ .. 26.141 ..
6.3.d:
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा ततः पश्चात्करकं वारिपूरितम् .
मधूकपात्रोपभृतं सहिरण्यं तु शक्तितः .. 26.141 ..
6.3.m: Having offered the arghya, then afterwards [she should offer] a water-pot filled with water, / served with a vessel of madhūka, together with gold according to her means:

6.3.s:
karakaṃ vārisampūrṇaṃ saubhāgyena tu saṃyutam .
dattaṃ tu lalite tubhyaṃ saubhāgyādivivardhanam .
iti karakadānamantraḥ .. 26.142 ..
6.3.d:
करकं वारिसम्पूर्णं सौभाग्येन तु संयुतम् .
दत्तं तु ललिते तुभ्यं सौभाग्यादिविवर्धनम् .
इति करकदानमन्त्रः .. 26.142 ..
6.3.m: 'This water-pot filled with water, endowed with good fortune, / is given to you, O Lalitā, increasing good fortune and [prosperity].' / Thus is the mantra for giving the water-pot.

6.3.s:
mantreṇānena viprāya dadyātkarakamuttamam .
lavaṇaṃ varjayecchuklāṃ yāvadanyāṃ tṛtīyikām .. 26.143 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्राय दद्यात्करकमुत्तमम् .
लवणं वर्जयेच्छुक्लां यावदन्यां तृतीयिकाम् .. 26.143 ..
6.3.m: With this mantra she should give an excellent water-pot to a vipra. / She should avoid salt until another bright third lunar day.

6.3.s:
kṣamāpya devīṃ deveśāṃ naktamadyātsvayaṃ haviḥ .
anena vidhinā sārdhaṃ māsi māsi hyapakramet .. 26.144 ..
6.3.d:
क्षमाप्य देवीं देवेशां नक्तमद्यात्स्वयं हविः .
अनेन विधिना सार्धं मासि मासि ह्यपक्रमेत् .. 26.144 ..
6.3.m: Having asked forgiveness of the goddess, the ruler of gods, she herself should eat sacrificial food at night. / Together with this rule, she should proceed month after month.

6.3.s:
phālgunasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ tu samāpyate .
vaiśākhe lavaṇaṃ deyaṃ jyeṣṭhe cājyaṃ pradīyate .. 26.145 ..
6.3.d:
फाल्गुनस्य तृतीयायां शुक्लायां तु समाप्यते .
वैशाखे लवणं देयं ज्येष्ठे चाज्यं प्रदीयते .. 26.145 ..
6.3.m: It ends on the third day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna. / Salt should be given in Vaiśākha, and clarified butter is given in Jyeṣṭha.

6.3.s:
āṣāḍhe māsi niṣpāvāḥ payo deyaṃ tu śrāvaṇe .
mudgā deyā nabhasye tu śālimāśvayuje tathā .. 26.146 ..
6.3.d:
आषाढे मासि निष्पावाः पयो देयं तु श्रावणे .
मुद्गा देया नभस्ये तु शालिमाश्वयुजे तथा .. 26.146 ..
6.3.m: In the month of Āṣāḍha, niṣpāva beans; milk is to be given in Śrāvaṇa; / green gram is to be given in Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), and likewise winter rice in Āśvayuja.

6.3.s:
kārttike śarkarāpātraṃ karakaṃ rasasaṃbhṛtam .
mārgaśīrṣe tu kārpāsaṃ karakaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam .. 26.147 ..
6.3.d:
कार्त्तिके शर्करापात्रं करकं रससंभृतम् .
मार्गशीर्षे तु कार्पासं करकं घृतसंयुतम् .. 26.147 ..
6.3.m: In Kārttika, a vessel of sugar and a water pot filled with sugarcane juice; / in Mārgaśīrṣa, cotton and a water pot accompanied with clarified butter;

6.3.s:
pauṣe tu kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ māghe pātraṃ tilairbhṛtam .
phālgune māsi samprāpte pātraṃ modakasaṃbhṛtam .. 26.148 ..
6.3.d:
पौषे तु कुङ्कुमं देयं माघे पात्रं तिलैर्भृतम् .
फाल्गुने मासि सम्प्राप्ते पात्रं मोदकसंभृतम् .. 26.148 ..
6.3.m: in Pauṣa, saffron is to be given; in Māgha, a vessel filled with sesame seeds; / when the month of Phālguna arrives, a vessel filled with sweetmeats.

6.3.s:
paścāttṛtīyādeyaṃ yattatpūrvasyāṃ vivarjayet .
vidhānamāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ sāmānyaṃ manasaḥ priye .. 26.149 ..
6.3.d:
पश्चात्तृतीयादेयं यत्तत्पूर्वस्यां विवर्जयेत् .
विधानमासां सर्वासां सामान्यं मनसः प्रिये .. 26.149 ..
6.3.m: That which is to be given on a subsequent third day should be abstained from on the preceding one. / The procedure for all these [vows] is the same, O darling of my heart.

6.3.s:
pratimāṃ madhuvṛkṣasya tāmeva pratipūjayet .
tasmai sarvaṃ tu viprāya ācāryāya pradīyate .. 26.150 ..
6.3.d:
प्रतिमां मधुवृक्षस्य तामेव प्रतिपूजयेत् .
तस्मै सर्वं तु विप्राय आचार्याय प्रदीयते .. 26.150 ..
6.3.m: One should worship that very image of the madhūka tree. / Everything is then given to that brahmin priest.

6.3.s:
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte udyāpanavidhiṃ śṛṇu .
madhuvṛkṣaṃ tato gatvā bahusambhārasaṃvṛtaḥ .. 26.151 ..
6.3.d:
ततः संवत्सरस्यान्ते उद्यापनविधिं शृणु .
मधुवृक्षं ततो गत्वा बहुसम्भारसंवृतः .. 26.151 ..
6.3.m: Then, at the end of the year, hear the rite of concluding the vow: / Having then approached the madhūka tree, furnished with many provisions,

6.3.s:
nikhanetpratimāṃ madhye mādhūkīṃ madhukasya ca .
tatrasthaṃ pūjayetsarvamumādehārddhadhāriṇam .. 26.152 ..
6.3.d:
निखनेत्प्रतिमां मध्ये माधूकीं मधुकस्य च .
तत्रस्थं पूजयेत्सर्वमुमादेहार्द्धधारिणम् .. 26.152 ..
6.3.m: one should bury an image made of madhūka wood in the middle of the madhūka [grove]. / Stationed there, one should worship the all-[pervading one] who bears Umā as half his body,

6.3.s:
pūjopahārairvipulaiḥ kuṅkumena punaḥpunaḥ .
ślakṣṇābhiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ kausumbhaiḥ kesareṇa ca .. 26.153 ..
6.3.d:
पूजोपहारैर्विपुलैः कुङ्कुमेन पुनःपुनः .
श्लक्ष्णाभिः पुष्पमालाभिः कौसुम्भैः केसरेण च .. 26.153 ..
6.3.m: with abundant offerings of worship, again and again with saffron, / with smooth garlands of flowers, with safflower blossoms, and with saffron filaments;

6.3.s:
kausumbhe vāsasī śubhre atasīpuṣpasannibhe .
paridhāpya tāṃ pratimāṃ dampatī ravisaṃkhyayā .. 26.154 ..
6.3.d:
कौसुम्भे वाससी शुभ्रे अतसीपुष्पसन्निभे .
परिधाप्य तां प्रतिमां दम्पती रविसंख्यया .. 26.154 ..
6.3.m: having clothed that image in two bright safflower-colored garments resembling flax flowers, / [and honoring] twelve married couples,

6.3.s:
upānadyugalaiśchatraiḥ kaṇṭhasūtraiḥ sakaṇṭhikaiḥ .
kaṭakairaṅgulīyaiśca śayanīyaiḥ śubhāstṛtaiḥ .. 26.155 ..
6.3.d:
उपानद्युगलैश्छत्रैः कण्ठसूत्रैः सकण्ठिकैः .
कटकैरङ्गुलीयैश्च शयनीयैः शुभास्तृतैः .. 26.155 ..
6.3.m: with pairs of shoes, umbrellas, necklaces with pendants, / bracelets, rings, and couches spread with auspicious coverings,

6.3.s:
kuṅkumena viliptāṅgau bahupuṣpaiśca pūjitau .
bhojayedvividhai ratnairmadhūkāvāsake sthitau .. 26.156 ..
6.3.d:
कुङ्कुमेन विलिप्ताङ्गौ बहुपुष्पैश्च पूजितौ .
भोजयेद्विविधै रत्नैर्मधूकावासके स्थितौ .. 26.156 ..
6.3.m: their limbs anointed with saffron, and worshipped with many flowers, / he should feed them with various precious foods while they sit in a madhūka bower.

6.3.s:
bhuktotthitau tu viśrāmya śayyāsu ca kṣamāpayet .
gurumūlaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ gururjñeyo maheśvaraḥ .. 26.157 ..
6.3.d:
भुक्तोत्थितौ तु विश्राम्य शय्यासु च क्षमापयेत् .
गुरुमूलं यतः सर्वं गुरुर्ज्ञेयो महेश्वरः .. 26.157 ..
6.3.m: When they have finished eating and arisen, having rested them on the beds, he should ask their forgiveness. / For everything is rooted in the guru; the guru should be recognized as the Great Lord.

6.3.s:
prīte gurau tataḥ sarvaṃ jagatprītaṃ surāsuram .
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yatkiṃciddayitaṃ gṛhe .. 26.158 ..
6.3.d:
प्रीते गुरौ ततः सर्वं जगत्प्रीतं सुरासुरम् .
यद्यदिष्टतमं लोके यत्किंचिद्दयितं गृहे .. 26.158 ..
6.3.m: When the guru is pleased, then the entire world with gods and asuras is pleased. / Whatever is dearest in the world, whatever is beloved in one’s home—

6.3.s:
tatsarvaṃ gurave deyamātmanaḥ śreya icchatā .
idaṃ tu dhanibhirdeyamanyairdeyaṃ yathocyate .. 26.159 ..
6.3.d:
तत्सर्वं गुरवे देयमात्मनः श्रेय इच्छता .
इदं तु धनिभिर्देयमन्यैर्देयं यथोच्यते .. 26.159 ..
6.3.m: all that should be given to the guru by one desiring his own welfare. / This is to be given by the wealthy; as for others, what should be given is declared as follows:

6.3.s:
dāmpatyamekaṃ vidhivatpratipūjya śubhavrataiḥ .
dvitīyaṃ gurudāmpatyaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet .. 26.160 ..
6.3.d:
दाम्पत्यमेकं विधिवत्प्रतिपूज्य शुभव्रतैः .
द्वितीयं गुरुदाम्पत्यं वित्तशाठ्यं विवर्जयेत् .. 26.160 ..
6.3.m: Duly worshiping one married couple with auspicious vows, / and a second couple being the guru and his wife, one should avoid stinginess with wealth.

6.3.s:
tataḥ kṣamāpayeddevīṃ devaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ gurum .
yathā tvaṃ devi lalite na viyuktāsi śambhunā .. 26.161 ..
6.3.d:
ततः क्षमापयेद्देवीं देवं च ब्राह्मणं गुरुम् .
यथा त्वं देवि ललिते न वियुक्तासि शम्भुना .. 26.161 ..
6.3.m: Then one should beg forgiveness from the goddess, the god, and the brahmin guru, [saying]: / 'O goddess Lalitā, just as you are never separated from Śambhu,

6.3.s:
tathā me patiputrāṇāmaviyogaḥ pradīyatām .
anena vidhinā kṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ madhusaṃjñikām .. 26.162 ..
6.3.d:
तथा मे पतिपुत्राणामवियोगः प्रदीयताम् .
अनेन विधिना कृत्वा तृतीयां मधुसंज्ञिकाम् .. 26.162 ..
6.3.m: even so let non-separation from my husband and sons be granted to me.' / Having performed in this manner the third-day vow known as Madhūka,

6.3.s:
indrāṇī cendrapatnītvamavāpa sutamuttamam .
saubhāgyaṃ sarvalokeṣu sarvarddhisukhamuttamam .. 26.163 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्राणी चेन्द्रपत्नीत्वमवाप सुतमुत्तमम् .
सौभाग्यं सर्वलोकेषु सर्वर्द्धिसुखमुत्तमम् .. 26.163 ..
6.3.m: Indrāṇī attained her status as Indra’s wife, an excellent son, / good fortune among all worlds, and the highest happiness of all prosperity.

6.3.s:
anena vidhinā yā tu kumārī vratamācaret .
śobhanaṃ patimāpnoti yathendrāṇyā śatakratuḥ .. 26.164 ..
6.3.d:
अनेन विधिना या तु कुमारी व्रतमाचरेत् .
शोभनं पतिमाप्नोति यथेन्द्राण्या शतक्रतुः .. 26.164 ..
6.3.m: Whatever maiden observes this vow according to this rule / obtains a handsome husband, just as Indrāṇī obtained Śatakratu (Indra).

6.3.s:
durbhagā subhagatvaṃ ca subhagā putriṇī bhavet .
putriṇyakṣayamāpnoti na śokaṃ paśyati kvacit .. 26.165 ..
6.3.d:
दुर्भगा सुभगत्वं च सुभगा पुत्रिणी भवेत् .
पुत्रिण्यक्षयमाप्नोति न शोकं पश्यति क्वचित् .. 26.165 ..
6.3.m: An unfortunate woman becomes fortunate, and a fortunate woman becomes blessed with sons. / One blessed with sons attains imperishable [bliss] and never experiences sorrow.

6.3.s:
anekajanmajanitaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ naśyati dhruvam .
mṛtā tu tridivaṃ prāpya umayā saha modate .. 26.166 ..
6.3.d:
अनेकजन्मजनितं दौर्भाग्यं नश्यति ध्रुवम् .
मृता तु त्रिदिवं प्राप्य उमया सह मोदते .. 26.166 ..
6.3.m: Misfortune caused by many births is surely destroyed. / Upon dying, she reaches heaven and rejoices with Umā.

6.3.s:
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ bhuktvā bhogān yathepsitān .
punastu sambhave loke pārthivaṃ patimāpnuyāt .. 26.167 ..
6.3.d:
कल्पकोटिशतं साग्रं भुक्त्वा भोगान् यथेप्सितान् .
पुनस्तु सम्भवे लोके पार्थिवं पतिमाप्नुयात् .. 26.167 ..
6.3.m: Having enjoyed desired pleasures for fully a hundred billion kalpas, / upon returning to birth in the mortal world, she would obtain an earthly king as her husband.

6.3.s: subhagā rūpasampannā pārthivaṃ janayetsutam .. 26.168 ..
6.3.d: सुभगा रूपसम्पन्ना पार्थिवं जनयेत्सुतम् .. 26.168 ..
6.3.m: Fortunate and endowed with beauty, she will give birth to an earthly king as her son.

6.3.s:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam .
anyatpṛcchasva subhage vāñchitaṃ yaddhṛdi sthitam .. 26.169 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye madhūkatṛtīyāvratavidhānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 27
6.3.d:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् .
अन्यत्पृच्छस्व सुभगे वाञ्छितं यद्धृदि स्थितम् .. 26.169 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये मधूकतृतीयाव्रतविधानमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षड्विंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 27
6.3.m:
All this, the foremost vow among vows, has been told to you. / Ask something else, O fortunate lady, whatever desire dwells in your heart.
Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Procedure and Greatness of the Madhūkatṛtīyā Vow,' in the Narmadāmāhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa in the fifth book, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 27

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājñī vacanamabravīt .
prasādaṃ kuru viprendra gṛhṇa dānaṃ yathepsitam .. 27.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राज्ञी वचनमब्रवीत् .
प्रसादं कुरु विप्रेन्द्र गृह्ण दानं यथेप्सितम् .. 27.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hearing Nārada's words, the queen spoke: / 'Grant your favor, O best of brahmins! Accept a gift as you desire:

6.3.s:
suvarṇamaṇiratnāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca .
tatte dārayāmi viprendra yaccānyadapi durlabham .. 27.2 ..
6.3.d:
सुवर्णमणिरत्नानि वस्त्राणि विविधानि च .
तत्ते दारयामि विप्रेन्द्र यच्चान्यदपि दुर्लभम् .. 27.2 ..
6.3.m: Gold, jewels, gems, and various garments— / all that I shall give you, O best of brahmins, and whatever else is rare to obtain.'

6.3.s:
rājñyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado vākyamabravīt .
anyeṣāṃ dīyatāṃ bhadre ye dvijāḥ kṣīṇavṛttayaḥ .. 27.3 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .
अन्येषां दीयतां भद्रे ये द्विजाः क्षीणवृत्तयः .. 27.3 ..
6.3.m: Hearing the queen's words, Nārada replied: / 'Let it be given to others, gentle lady—to those twice-born whose means of livelihood are exhausted.

6.3.s:
vayaṃ tu sarvasampannā bhaktigrāhyāḥ sadaiva hi .
ityuktā sā tadā rājñī vedavedāṅgapāragān .. 27.4 ..
6.3.d:
वयं तु सर्वसम्पन्ना भक्तिग्राह्याः सदैव हि .
इत्युक्ता सा तदा राज्ञी वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान् .. 27.4 ..
6.3.m: We, however, are endowed with everything, and can always be won over by devotion alone.' / Thus addressed, the queen then called upon destitute brahmins / who were masters of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, and began to give

6.3.s:
āhūya brāhmaṇānniḥsvāndātuṃ samupacakrame .
yatkiṃcinnāradenoktaṃ dānasaubhāgyavardhanam .. 27.5 ..
6.3.d:
आहूय ब्राह्मणान्निःस्वान्दातुं समुपचक्रमे .
यत्किंचिन्नारदेनोक्तं दानसौभाग्यवर्धनम् .. 27.5 ..
6.3.m: whatever had been mentioned by Nārada as a gift that promotes good fortune.

6.3.s:
tena dānena me nityaṃ prīyetāṃ hariśaṅkarau .
tato rājñī ca sā prāha nāradaṃ munipuṃgavam .. 27.6 ..
6.3.d:
तेन दानेन मे नित्यं प्रीयेतां हरिशङ्करौ .
ततो राज्ञी च सा प्राह नारदं मुनिपुंगवम् .. 27.6 ..
6.3.m: 'May Hari and Śaṅkara be ever pleased with me through this gift!' / Then the queen said to Nārada, the foremost among sages:

6.3.s:
rājñyuvāca -
dānaṃ dattaṃ tvayoktaṃ yadbhartṛkarmaparaṃ hi tat .
ājanmajanma me bhartā bhavedbāṇo dvijottama .. 27.7 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्युवाच -
दानं दत्तं त्वयोक्तं यद्भर्तृकर्मपरं हि तत् .
आजन्मजन्म मे भर्ता भवेद्बाणो द्विजोत्तम .. 27.7 ..
6.3.m: The queen said: / 'The gift that you prescribed has been given, for it is dedicated to the welfare of my husband. / May Bāṇa be my husband from birth to birth, O best of the twice-born!

6.3.s:
nānyo hi daivataṃ tāta muktvā bāṇaṃ dvijottama .
tena satyena me bhartā jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 27.8 ..
6.3.d:
नान्यो हि दैवतं तात मुक्त्वा बाणं द्विजोत्तम .
तेन सत्येन मे भर्ता जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 27.8 ..
6.3.m: Indeed, there is no other deity for me, dear father, except Bāṇa, O best of the twice-born! / By that truth, may my husband live for a hundred autumns!

6.3.s:
nānyo dharmo bhavetstrīṇāṃ daivataṃ hi patiryathā .
tathāpi tava vākyena dānaṃ dattaṃ yathāvidhi .. 27.9 ..
6.3.d:
नान्यो धर्मो भवेत्स्त्रीणां दैवतं हि पतिर्यथा .
तथापि तव वाक्येन दानं दत्तं यथाविधि .. 27.9 ..
6.3.m: There is no other religious duty for women, for a husband is their deity. / Even so, according to your word, the gift was given according to rule.

6.3.s:
svakaṃ karma kariṣyāmo bhartāraṃ prati mānada .
brahmarṣe gaccha cedānīṃ tvamāśīrvādaḥ pradīyatām .. 27.10 ..
6.3.d:
स्वकं कर्म करिष्यामो भर्तारं प्रति मानद .
ब्रह्मर्षे गच्छ चेदानीं त्वमाशीर्वादः प्रदीयताम् .. 27.10 ..
6.3.m: We shall perform our own duty toward our husband, O giver of honor. / Go now, O brahmin seer; may a blessing be bestowed [by you]!'

6.3.s:
tatheti tāmanujñāpya nārado nṛpasattama .
sarvāsāṃ mānasaṃ hṛtvā anyataḥ kṛtamānasaḥ .. 27.11 ..
6.3.d:
तथेति तामनुज्ञाप्य नारदो नृपसत्तम .
सर्वासां मानसं हृत्वा अन्यतः कृतमानसः .. 27.11 ..
6.3.m: Saying 'So be it', and taking leave of her, O best of kings, / Nārada, having stolen the minds of all [those women], set his mind elsewhere.

6.3.s:
jagāmādarśanaṃ vipraḥ pūjyamānastu khecaraiḥ .
tato gatamanaskāstā bhartāraṃ prati bhārata .. 27.12 ..
6.3.d:
जगामादर्शनं विप्रः पूज्यमानस्तु खेचरैः .
ततो गतमनस्कास्ता भर्तारं प्रति भारत .. 27.12 ..
6.3.m: The brahmin vanished from sight while being worshipped by sky-farers. / Then, O descendant of Bharata, their minds having strayed from their husband,

6.3.s:
vivarṇā niṣprabhā jātā nāradena vimohitāḥ .. 27.13 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye tripurakṣobhaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
विवर्णा निष्प्रभा जाता नारदेन विमोहिताः .. 27.13 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये त्रिपुरक्षोभणवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
they became pale and lusterless, utterly bewildered by Nārada.
Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Agitation of Tripura', in the Narmadāmāhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, the fifth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etasminnantare rudro narmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ .
krīḍate hyumayā sārddhaṃ nāradastatra cāgataḥ .. 28.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रुद्रो नर्मदातटमास्थितः .
क्रीडते ह्युमया सार्द्धं नारदस्तत्र चागतः .. 28.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Meanwhile Rudra, stationed on the bank of the Narmadā, / was sporting with Umā, and Nārada arrived there.

6.3.s:
praṇamya devadeveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram .
vyajñāpayattadā devaṃ yadvṛttaṃ tripure tadā .. 28.2 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य देवदेवेशमुमया सह शङ्करम् .
व्यज्ञापयत्तदा देवं यद्वृत्तं त्रिपुरे तदा .. 28.2 ..
6.3.m: Bowing to Śaṅkara, the lord of the gods, along with Umā, / he then informed the god of what had occurred in Tripura at that time.

6.3.s:
gato'haṃ svāminirdeśādyatra tadbāṇamandiram .
dṛṣṭā bāṇaṃ yathānyāyaṃ gato hyantaḥpuraṃ mahat .. 28.3 ..
6.3.d:
गतोऽहं स्वामिनिर्देशाद्यत्र तद्बाणमन्दिरम् .
दृष्टा बाणं यथान्यायं गतो ह्यन्तःपुरं महत् .. 28.3 ..
6.3.m: "By my Lord's command I went to that palace of Bāṇa. / Having seen Bāṇa according to custom, I entered the great inner chambers.

6.3.s:
tatra bhāryāsahasrāṇi dṛṣṭvā bāṇasya dhīmataḥ .
yathāyogyaṃ yathākāmamāgataḥ kṣobhya tatpuram .. 28.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र भार्यासहस्राणि दृष्ट्वा बाणस्य धीमतः .
यथायोग्यं यथाकाममागतः क्षोभ्य तत्पुरम् .. 28.4 ..
6.3.m: Having seen there the thousands of wives of the wise Bāṇa, / properly and as I pleased, having agitated that city, I have returned."

6.3.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sādhu sādhviti pūjayan .
cintayāmāsa deveśo bhramaṇaṃ tripurasya hi .. 28.5 ..
6.3.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा साधु साध्विति पूजयन् .
चिन्तयामास देवेशो भ्रमणं त्रिपुरस्य हि .. 28.5 ..
6.3.m: Hearing Nārada's words, praising him, saying, "Well done! Well done!", / the lord of the gods reflected indeed on the wandering of Tripura:

6.3.s:
karamuktaṃ yathā cakraṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā .
mahāvegaṃ mahāyāmaṃ rakṣitaṃ tejasā mama .. 28.6 ..
6.3.d:
करमुक्तं यथा चक्रं विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना .
महावेगं महायामं रक्षितं तेजसा मम .. 28.6 ..
6.3.m: "Just as the discus was released from the hand by the mighty Viṣṇu, / of great speed and great range, protected by my splendour;

6.3.s:
sa ca me bhaktinirato bāṇo loke ca viśrutaḥ .
bhāratī ca mayā dattā brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 28.7 ..
6.3.d:
स च मे भक्तिनिरतो बाणो लोके च विश्रुतः .
भारती च मया दत्ता ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः .. 28.7 ..
6.3.m: and Bāṇa, renowned in the world, is devoted in bhakti to me; / and speech was given by me, especially to the brahmins."

6.3.s:
evaṃ sa suciraṃ kālaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
cintayitvā sunirvāṇaṃ kāryaṃ prati janeśvaraḥ .. 28.8 ..
6.3.d:
एवं स सुचिरं कालं देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
चिन्तयित्वा सुनिर्वाणं कार्यं प्रति जनेश्वरः .. 28.8 ..
6.3.m: Having thus reflected for a very long time, the god of gods, Maheśvara, / the lord of men, regarding the task of supreme cessation,

6.3.s:
tato'sau mandaraṃ dhyātvā cāpe kṛtvā guṇe mahīm .
viṣṇuṃ sanātanaṃ devaṃ bāṇe dhyātvā trilocanaḥ .. 28.9 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽसौ मन्दरं ध्यात्वा चापे कृत्वा गुणे महीम् .
विष्णुं सनातनं देवं बाणे ध्यात्वा त्रिलोचनः .. 28.9 ..
6.3.m: the three-eyed lord then visualized Mandara for his bow, made the earth his bowstring, / and visualized the eternal god Viṣṇu as the arrow,

6.3.s:
phale hutāśanaṃ devaṃ jvalantaṃ sarvatomukham .
suparṇaṃ puṅkhayormadhye jave vāyuṃ prakalpya ca .. 28.10 ..
6.3.d:
फले हुताशनं देवं ज्वलन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् .
सुपर्णं पुङ्खयोर्मध्ये जवे वायुं प्रकल्प्य च .. 28.10 ..
6.3.m: the blazing, all-facing god Agni as the arrowhead, / Suparṇa between the two feathers, and fashioned Vāyu as its speed;

6.3.s:
rathaṃ mahīmayaṃ kṛtvā dhuri tāvaśvināvubhau .
akṣe sureśvaraṃ devamagrakīlyāṃ dhanādhipam .. 28.11 ..
6.3.d:
रथं महीमयं कृत्वा धुरि तावश्विनावुभौ .
अक्षे सुरेश्वरं देवमग्रकील्यां धनाधिपम् .. 28.11 ..
6.3.m: having made a chariot consisting of the earth, he placed both the Aśvins on the yoke, / the god Indra on the axle, and Kubera on the front axle-pin;

6.3.s:
yamaṃ tu dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme kālaṃ sudāruṇam .
ādityacandrau cakre tu gandharvānārakādiṣu .. 28.12 ..
6.3.d:
यमं तु दक्षिणे पार्श्वे वामे कालं सुदारुणम् .
आदित्यचन्द्रौ चक्रे तु गन्धर्वानारकादिषु .. 28.12 ..
6.3.m: Yama on the right side, and the dread Kāla on the left, / the Sun and Moon as the two wheels, and the Gandharvas on the spokes and other parts;

6.3.s:
yantāraṃ ca surajyeṣṭhaṃ vedānkṛtvā hayottamān .
khalīnādiṣu cāṅgāni raśmīṃśchandāṃsi cākarot .. 28.13 ..
6.3.d:
यन्तारं च सुरज्येष्ठं वेदान्कृत्वा हयोत्तमान् .
खलीनादिषु चाङ्गानि रश्मींश्छन्दांसि चाकरोत् .. 28.13 ..
6.3.m: the eldest of the gods as the charioteer, having made the Vedas the excellent horses, / the Vedāṅgas on the bridle-bits and fittings, and the meters the reins;

6.3.s:
kṛtvā pratodamoṃkāraṃ mukhagrāhyaṃ maheśvaraḥ .
dhātāraṃ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā vidhātāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ .. 28.14 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा प्रतोदमोंकारं मुखग्राह्यं महेश्वरः .
धातारं चाग्रतः कृत्वा विधातारं च पृष्ठतः .. 28.14 ..
6.3.m: having made the syllable Oṃ the whip held in the hand, Maheśvara, / placing Dhātṛ in front and Vidhātṛ behind;

6.3.s:
mārutātsarvato digbhya ūrdhvayantre tathaiva ca .
mahoragapiśācāṃśca siddhavidyādharāṃstathā .. 28.15 ..
6.3.d:
मारुतात्सर्वतो दिग्भ्य ऊर्ध्वयन्त्रे तथैव च .
महोरगपिशाचांश्च सिद्धविद्याधरांस्तथा .. 28.15 ..
6.3.m: the winds from all directions, and likewise in the upper machinery / the great serpents and Piśācas, as well as the Siddhas and Vidyādharas,

6.3.s:
gaṇāṃśca bhūtasaṅghāṃśca sarve sarvāṅgasaṃdhiṣu .
yugamadhye sthito meruryugasyādho mahāgiriḥ .. 28.16 ..
6.3.d:
गणांश्च भूतसङ्घांश्च सर्वे सर्वाङ्गसंधिषु .
युगमध्ये स्थितो मेरुर्युगस्याधो महागिरिः .. 28.16 ..
6.3.m: and the gaṇas and multitudes of bhūtas, all in all the joints of its limbs; / Meru stood in the middle of the yoke, and the great mountain below the yoke;

6.3.s:
sarpā yantrasthitā ghorāḥ śamye varuṇanairṛtau .
gāyatrī caiva sāvitrī sthite te raśmibandhane .. 28.17 ..
6.3.d:
सर्पा यन्त्रस्थिता घोराः शम्ये वरुणनैरृतौ .
गायत्री चैव सावित्री स्थिते ते रश्मिबन्धने .. 28.17 ..
6.3.m: the dread serpents were placed in the mechanism, Varuṇa and Nirṛti in the yoke-pins, / and Gāyatrī and Sāvitrī were stationed in the fastening of the reins;

6.3.s:
satyaṃ rathadhvaje śaucaṃ damaṃ rakṣāṃ samantataḥ .
rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 28.18 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यं रथध्वजे शौचं दमं रक्षां समन्ततः .
रथं देवमयं कृत्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 28.18 ..
6.3.m: truth on the chariot banner, purity and restraint as the protection on all sides— / having made the chariot composed of gods, the god of gods, Maheśvara,

6.3.s:
saṃnaddhaḥ kavacī khaḍgī baddhagodhāṅgulitravān .
baddhā parikaraṃ gāḍhaṃ jaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya ca .. 28.19 ..
6.3.d:
संनद्धः कवची खड्गी बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्रवान् .
बद्धा परिकरं गाढं जटाजूटं नियम्य च .. 28.19 ..
6.3.m: fully armed, wearing armor, bearing a sword, wearing the archer’s arm-guard and finger-guards, / tightly girding his loins and binding his matted hair,

6.3.s:
sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdivyaṃ yojayitvā rathottamam .
rathamadhye sthito devaḥ śuśubhe ca yudhiṣṭhira .. 28.20 ..
6.3.d:
सज्जं कृत्वा धनुर्दिव्यं योजयित्वा रथोत्तमम् .
रथमध्ये स्थितो देवः शुशुभे च युधिष्ठिर .. 28.20 ..
6.3.m: strung the divine bow, yoked the excellent chariot, / and standing in the center of the chariot, the god shone forth, O Yudhiṣṭhira!

6.3.s:
dhanuṣaḥ śabdanādenākampayacca jagattrayam .
sthānaṃ kṛtvā tu vaiśākhaṃ nibhṛtaṃ saṃsthito haraḥ .. 28.21 ..
6.3.d:
धनुषः शब्दनादेनाकम्पयच्च जगत्त्रयम् .
स्थानं कृत्वा तु वैशाखं निभृतं संस्थितो हरः .. 28.21 ..
6.3.m: With the roaring sound of his bow he made the three worlds tremble; / assuming the vaiśākha posture, Hara stood motionless.

6.3.s:
nirīkṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ .
dhyātvā taṃ paramaṃ mantramātmānaṃ ca nirudhya saḥ .. 28.22 ..
6.3.d:
निरीक्ष्य सुचिरं कालं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः .
ध्यात्वा तं परमं मन्त्रमात्मानं च निरुध्य सः .. 28.22 ..
6.3.m: Gazing for a long time, his eyes reddened with rage, / meditating upon that supreme mantra and restraining himself,

6.3.s:
mumoca sahasā bāṇaṃ purasya vadhakāṅkṣayā .
yadā trīṇi sametāni antarikṣasthitāni tu .. 28.23 ..
6.3.d:
मुमोच सहसा बाणं पुरस्य वधकाङ्क्षया .
यदा त्रीणि समेतानि अन्तरिक्षस्थितानि तु .. 28.23 ..
6.3.m: he suddenly loosed the arrow, desiring the destruction of the city, / when the three [cities] had come together, positioned in mid-air.

6.3.s:
tataḥ kālanimeṣārdhaṃ dṛṣṭvaikyaṃ tripurasya ca .
triparvaṇā triśalyena tatastānyavasādayat .. 28.24 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कालनिमेषार्धं दृष्ट्वैक्यं त्रिपुरस्य च .
त्रिपर्वणा त्रिशल्येन ततस्तान्यवसादयत् .. 28.24 ..
6.3.m: Then, seeing the unity of Tripura for half the wink of an eye, / he destroyed them with the three-jointed, three-pointed [arrow].

6.3.s:
tato lokā bhayatrastāstripure bharatottama .
sarvāsuravināśāya kālarūpā bhayāvahāḥ .. 28.25 ..
6.3.d:
ततो लोका भयत्रस्तास्त्रिपुरे भरतोत्तम .
सर्वासुरविनाशाय कालरूपा भयावहाः .. 28.25 ..
6.3.m: Then the people in Tripura were terrified with fear, O best of Bharatas; / for the destruction of all the asuras, [portents] fearful as the form of Kāla [arose].

6.3.s:
aṭṭahāsān pramuñcanti kaṣṭarūpā narāstadā .
nimeṣonmeṣaṇaṃ caiva kurvanti lipikarmasu .. 28.26 ..
6.3.d:
अट्टहासान् प्रमुञ्चन्ति कष्टरूपा नरास्तदा .
निमेषोन्मेषणं चैव कुर्वन्ति लिपिकर्मसु .. 28.26 ..
6.3.m: Men, assuming miserable forms, then burst into bursts of loud laughter, / and they blinked constantly in their work of writing.

6.3.s:
niṣpandanayanā martyāścitreṣvālikhitā iva .
devāyatanagā devā raṭanti prahasanti ca .
svapne paśyanti cātmānaṃ raktāmbaravibhūṣitam .. 28.27 ..
6.3.d:
निष्पन्दनयना मर्त्याश्चित्रेष्वालिखिता इव .
देवायतनगा देवा रटन्ति प्रहसन्ति च .
स्वप्ने पश्यन्ति चात्मानं रक्ताम्बरविभूषितम् .. 28.27 ..
6.3.m: Mortals had motionless eyes, as if painted in pictures; / the gods residing in temples cried out and laughed out loud, / and [people] saw themselves in dreams adorned with red garments,

6.3.s:
raktamālyottamāṅgāśca patantaḥ kārdame hrade .
paśyanti nāma cātmānaṃ satailābhyaṅgamastakam .. 28.28 ..
6.3.d:
रक्तमाल्योत्तमाङ्गाश्च पतन्तः कार्दमे ह्रदे .
पश्यन्ति नाम चात्मानं सतैलाभ्यङ्गमस्तकम् .. 28.28 ..
6.3.m: having red garlands on their heads, falling into a muddy pool; / indeed, they saw themselves with their heads anointed with oil;

6.3.s:
paśyanti yānamārūḍhaṃ rāsabhaiśca nṛpottama .
saṃvartako mahāvāyuryugāntapratimo mahān .. 28.29 ..
6.3.d:
पश्यन्ति यानमारूढं रासभैश्च नृपोत्तम .
संवर्तको महावायुर्युगान्तप्रतिमो महान् .. 28.29 ..
6.3.m: they saw themselves mounted upon a vehicle drawn by donkeys, O best of kings. / A great saṃvartaka wind arose, immense like the end of an era;

6.3.s:
gṛhānunmūlayāmāsa vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ .
bhūmikampāḥ sanirghātā ulkāpātāḥ sahasraśaḥ .. 28.30 ..
6.3.d:
गृहानुन्मूलयामास वृक्षजातीननेकशः .
भूमिकम्पाः सनिर्घाता उल्कापाताः सहस्रशः .. 28.30 ..
6.3.m: it uprooted houses and trees of many species; / there were earthquakes accompanied by thunderclaps and thousands of falling meteors;

6.3.s:
rudhiraṃ varṣate devo miśritaṃ karkarairbahu .
agnikuṇḍeṣu viprāṇāṃ hutaḥ samyagghutāśanaḥ .. 28.31 ..
6.3.d:
रुधिरं वर्षते देवो मिश्रितं कर्करैर्बहु .
अग्निकुण्डेषु विप्राणां हुतः सम्यग्घुताशनः .. 28.31 ..
6.3.m: the sky rained blood mixed with many gravel stones; / the fire properly offered in the fire-altars of the brahmins

6.3.s:
jvalate dhūmasaṃyukto visphuliṅgakaṇaiḥ saha .
kuṃjarā vimadā jātāsturagāḥ sattvavarjitāḥ .. 28.32 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वलते धूमसंयुक्तो विस्फुलिङ्गकणैः सह .
कुंजरा विमदा जातास्तुरगाः सत्त्ववर्जिताः .. 28.32 ..
6.3.m: blazed enveloped in smoke, together with showers of sparks; / the elephants lost their rut, and the horses became bereft of strength;

6.3.s:
avāditāni vādyante vāditrāṇi sahasraśaḥ .
dhvajā hyakampitāḥ petuśchatrāṇi vividhāni ca .. 28.33 ..
6.3.d:
अवादितानि वाद्यन्ते वादित्राणि सहस्रशः .
ध्वजा ह्यकम्पिताः पेतुश्छत्राणि विविधानि च .. 28.33 ..
6.3.m: thousands of musical instruments were sounded without being played; / unblown banners fell, as did various umbrellas;

6.3.s:
jvalati pādapāstatra parṇāni ca sabhaṃ tataḥ .
sarvaṃ tadvyākulībhūtaṃ hāhākārasamanvitam .. 28.34 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वलति पादपास्तत्र पर्णानि च सभं ततः .
सर्वं तद्व्याकुलीभूतं हाहाकारसमन्वितम् .. 28.34 ..
6.3.m: trees blazed there, and leaves, and the assembly hall was covered; / everything became bewildered and filled with cries of woe;

6.3.s:
udyānāni vicitrāṇi prababhañja prabhañjanaḥ .
tena saṃpreritāḥ sarve jvalanti viśikhāḥ śikhāḥ .. 28.35 ..
6.3.d:
उद्यानानि विचित्राणि प्रबभञ्ज प्रभञ्जनः .
तेन संप्रेरिताः सर्वे ज्वलन्ति विशिखाः शिखाः .. 28.35 ..
6.3.m: the gale shattered the splendid gardens; / driven by it, all blazing arrow-like flames [spread];

6.3.s:
vṛkṣagulmalatāvallyo gṛhāṇi ca samantataḥ .
digvibhāgaiśca sarvaiśca pravṛtto havyavāhanaḥ .. 28.36 ..
6.3.d:
वृक्षगुल्मलतावल्ल्यो गृहाणि च समन्ततः .
दिग्विभागैश्च सर्वैश्च प्रवृत्तो हव्यवाहनः .. 28.36 ..
6.3.m: trees, bushes, creepers, vines, and houses on all sides— / the fire spread across every quarter of the sky;

6.3.s:
sarvaṃ kiṃśukaparṇābhaṃ prajvalaccaiva dṛśyate .
gṛhādgṛhaṃ tadā gantuṃ naiva dhūmena śakyate .. 28.37 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वं किंशुकपर्णाभं प्रज्वलच्चैव दृश्यते .
गृहाद्गृहं तदा गन्तुं नैव धूमेन शक्यते .. 28.37 ..
6.3.m: everything was seen blazing with the hue of kiṃśuka leaves; / it was impossible to go from house to house due to the smoke;

6.3.s:
harakopāgninirdagdhāḥ krandante tripure janāḥ .
pradīptaṃ sarvato dikṣu dahyate tripuraṃ param .. 28.38 ..
6.3.d:
हरकोपाग्निनिर्दग्धाः क्रन्दन्ते त्रिपुरे जनाः .
प्रदीप्तं सर्वतो दिक्षु दह्यते त्रिपुरं परम् .. 28.38 ..
6.3.m: burned by the fire of Hara's wrath, the people in Tripura wailed; / ablaze in all directions, supreme Tripura was consumed;

6.3.s:
patanti śikharāgrāṇi viśīrṇāni sahasraśaḥ .
pāvako dhūmasaṃpṛkto dahyamānaḥ samantataḥ .. 28.39 ..
6.3.d:
पतन्ति शिखराग्राणि विशीर्णानि सहस्रशः .
पावको धूमसंपृक्तो दह्यमानः समन्ततः .. 28.39 ..
6.3.m: thousands of shattered mountain-peaks fell; / the fire, mingled with smoke, burning on all sides,

6.3.s:
nṛtyanvai vyāptadigdeśaḥ kāntāreṣvabhidhāvati .
devāgāreṣu sarveṣu gṛheṣvaṭṭālakeṣu ca .. 28.40 ..
6.3.d:
नृत्यन्वै व्याप्तदिग्देशः कान्तारेष्वभिधावति .
देवागारेषु सर्वेषु गृहेष्वट्टालकेषु च .. 28.40 ..
6.3.m: dancing indeed, covering every quarter and region, rushed into the forests; / in all the temples, houses, and turrets,

6.3.s:
pravṛtto hutabhuktatra pure kālapracoditaḥ .
dadāha lokānsarvatra harakopaprakopitaḥ .. 28.41 ..
6.3.d:
प्रवृत्तो हुतभुक्तत्र पुरे कालप्रचोदितः .
ददाह लोकान्सर्वत्र हरकोपप्रकोपितः .. 28.41 ..
6.3.m: the fire broke out there in the city, impelled by Time; / stirred to fury by Hara's anger, it burned the people everywhere;

6.3.s:
dahate traipuraṃ lokaṃ bālavṛddhasamanvitam .
sapuraṃ sagṛhadvāraṃ savāhanavanaṃ nṛpa .. 28.42 ..
6.3.d:
दहते त्रैपुरं लोकं बालवृद्धसमन्वितम् .
सपुरं सगृहद्वारं सवाहनवनं नृप .. 28.42 ..
6.3.m: it burned the populace of Tripura, including the young and the old, / with their city, with their doorways, with their vehicles and forests, O king!

6.3.s:
kecidbhojanasaktāśca pānāsaktāstathāpare .
aparā nṛtyagīteṣu saṃsaktā vārayoṣitaḥ .. 28.43 ..
6.3.d:
केचिद्भोजनसक्ताश्च पानासक्तास्तथापरे .
अपरा नृत्यगीतेषु संसक्ता वारयोषितः .. 28.43 ..
6.3.m: Some were clinging to food, and others were clinging to drink; / other courtesans were engaged in singing and dancing;

6.3.s:
anyonyaṃ ca pariṣvajya hutāśanaśikhārditāḥ .
dahyamānā nṛpaśreṣṭha sarve gacchantyacetanāḥ .. 28.44 ..
6.3.d:
अन्योन्यं च परिष्वज्य हुताशनशिखार्दिताः .
दह्यमाना नृपश्रेष्ठ सर्वे गच्छन्त्यचेतनाः .. 28.44 ..
6.3.m: embracing one another, tormented by the flames of fire, / being burned, O best of kings, they all became unconscious and perished.

6.3.s:
athānye dānavāstatra dahyante'gnivimohitāḥ .
na śaktāścānyato gantuṃ dhūmenākulitānanāḥ .
haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇā nalinyo hemapaṅkajāḥ .. 28.45 ..
6.3.d:
अथान्ये दानवास्तत्र दह्यन्तेऽग्निविमोहिताः .
न शक्ताश्चान्यतो गन्तुं धूमेनाकुलिताननाः .
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा नलिन्यो हेमपङ्कजाः .. 28.45 ..
6.3.m: Then other Dānavas were burned there, stupefied by the fire; / unable to go anywhere else, their faces were choked with smoke; / lotus pools crowded with geese and kāraṇḍava ducks, with golden lotuses [were destroyed]—

6.3.s:
dahyante vividhāstatra vāpyaḥ kūpāśca bhārata .
dṛśyante'naladagdhāni purodyānāni dīrghikāḥ .
amlānaiḥ paṅkajaiśchannā vistīrṇāvasuyojanāḥ .. 28.46 ..
6.3.d:
दह्यन्ते विविधास्तत्र वाप्यः कूपाश्च भारत .
दृश्यन्तेऽनलदग्धानि पुरोद्यानानि दीर्घिकाः .
अम्लानैः पङ्कजैश्छन्ना विस्तीर्णावसुयोजनाः .. 28.46 ..
6.3.m: Various reservoirs and wells burned there, O descendant of Bharata; / city gardens and oblong ponds, covered with unfading lotuses / extending for eight yojanas, were seen burned by the fire.

6.3.s:
girikūṭanibhāstatra prāsādā ratnaśobhitāḥ .
dṛśyante'nalasaṃdagdhā viśīrṇā dharaṇītale .. 28.47 ..
6.3.d:
गिरिकूटनिभास्तत्र प्रासादा रत्नशोभिताः .
दृश्यन्तेऽनलसंदग्धा विशीर्णा धरणीतले .. 28.47 ..
6.3.m: Palaces there, resembling mountain peaks and adorned with jewels, / were seen scorched by the fire and shattered on the surface of the earth.

6.3.s:
narastrībālavṛddheṣu dahyamāneṣu sarvataḥ .
nirdayaṃ jvalate vahnirhāhākāro mahānabhūt .
kācicca sukhasaṃsuptāpramattānyā nṛpottama .. 28.48 ..
6.3.d:
नरस्त्रीबालवृद्धेषु दह्यमानेषु सर्वतः .
निर्दयं ज्वलते वह्निर्हाहाकारो महानभूत् .
काचिच्च सुखसंसुप्ताप्रमत्तान्या नृपोत्तम .. 28.48 ..
6.3.m: As men, women, children, and the aged were burning on every side, / the fire blazed mercilessly, and a great wailing arose. / One [woman] had been sleeping pleasantly, another was heedless, O best of kings;

6.3.s:
krīḍitvā ca suvistīrṇaśayanasthā varāṅganā .
kācitsuptā viśālākṣī hārāvalivibhūṣitā .
dhūmenākulitā dīnā nyapataddhavyavāhane .. 28.49 ..
6.3.d:
क्रीडित्वा च सुविस्तीर्णशयनस्था वराङ्गना .
काचित्सुप्ता विशालाक्षी हारावलिविभूषिता .
धूमेनाकुलिता दीना न्यपतद्धव्यवाहने .. 28.49 ..
6.3.m: an excellent woman, having sported, was lying on a very broad couch; / another, large-eyed and adorned with rows of necklaces, while asleep / was choked by smoke and, wretched, fell into the fire.

6.3.s:
kācittasminpure dīpte putrasnehānulālasā .
putramāliṅgate gāḍhaṃ dahyate tripure'gninā .. 28.50 ..
6.3.d:
काचित्तस्मिन्पुरे दीप्ते पुत्रस्नेहानुलालसा .
पुत्रमालिङ्गते गाढं दह्यते त्रिपुरेऽग्निना .. 28.50 ..
6.3.m: A woman in that blazing city, clinging fondly through love for her son, / hugged her son tightly and was burned by the fire in Tripura.

6.3.s:
kācitkanakavarṇābhā indranīlavibhūṣitā .
bhartāraṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā patitā tasya copari .. 28.51 ..
6.3.d:
काचित्कनकवर्णाभा इन्द्रनीलविभूषिता .
भर्तारं पतितं दृष्ट्वा पतिता तस्य चोपरि .. 28.51 ..
6.3.m: One of golden hue, adorned with sapphires, / seeing her husband fallen, fell upon him.

6.3.s:
kācidādityavarṇābhā prasuptā tu priyopari .
agnijvālāhatā gāḍhaṃ kaṃṭhamāliṅgate nṛpa .. 28.52 ..
6.3.d:
काचिदादित्यवर्णाभा प्रसुप्ता तु प्रियोपरि .
अग्निज्वालाहता गाढं कंठमालिङ्गते नृप .. 28.52 ..
6.3.m: Another, shining with the hue of the sun, asleep upon her beloved, / struck by the flames of fire, embraced his neck tightly, O king.

6.3.s:
medhavarṇā parā nārī calatkanakamekhalā .
śvetavastrottarīyā tu papāta dharaṇītale .. 28.53 ..
6.3.d:
मेधवर्णा परा नारी चलत्कनकमेखला .
श्वेतवस्त्रोत्तरीया तु पपात धरणीतले .. 28.53 ..
6.3.m: Another woman, cloud-complexioned, with a jangling golden girdle / and an upper garment of white cloth, fell to the surface of the earth.

6.3.s:
kācitkundenduvarṇābhā nīlaratnavibhūṣitā .
śirasā prāñjalirbhūtvā vijñāpayati pāvakam .. 28.54 ..
6.3.d:
काचित्कुन्देन्दुवर्णाभा नीलरत्नविभूषिता .
शिरसा प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा विज्ञापयति पावकम् .. 28.54 ..
6.3.m: One having the lustre of a jasmine and the moon, adorned with blue gems, / placing her joined hands upon her head, made a plea to the fire.

6.3.s:
kasyāścijjvalate vastraṃ keśāḥ kasyāśca bhārata .
jvalajjvalanasaṅkāśairhemabhāṇḍaistrasaṃhita ca .. 28.55 ..
6.3.d:
कस्याश्चिज्ज्वलते वस्त्रं केशाः कस्याश्च भारत .
ज्वलज्ज्वलनसङ्काशैर्हेमभाण्डैस्त्रसंहित च .. 28.55 ..
6.3.m: The garment of one was burning, and the hair of another, O descendant of Bharata, / along with vessels of gold resembling blazing fire.

6.3.s:
kācitprabhūtaduḥkhārtā vilalāpa varāṅganā .
bhasmībhūtaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā krandantī kurarī yathā .. 28.56 ..
6.3.d:
काचित्प्रभूतदुःखार्ता विललाप वराङ्गना .
भस्मीभूतं पतिं दृष्ट्वा क्रन्दन्ती कुररी यथा .. 28.56 ..
6.3.m: An excellent woman, stricken with immense sorrow, lamented / upon seeing her husband turned to ashes, crying like an osprey.

6.3.s:
āliṅgya gāḍhaṃ sahasā patitā tasya mūrdhani .
kācicca bahuduḥkhārtā vyalapatstrī svaveśmani .. 28.57 ..
6.3.d:
आलिङ्ग्य गाढं सहसा पतिता तस्य मूर्धनि .
काचिच्च बहुदुःखार्ता व्यलपत्स्त्री स्ववेश्मनि .. 28.57 ..
6.3.m: Embracing him tightly, she suddenly fell upon his head. / Another woman, deeply afflicted with sorrow, wailed in her own house,

6.3.s:
bhasmasācca kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā krandate kurarī yathā .
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ kāciddṛṣṭvā vigatacetanam .. 28.58 ..
6.3.d:
भस्मसाच्च कृतं दृष्ट्वा क्रन्दते कुररी यथा .
मातरं पितरं काचिद्दृष्ट्वा विगतचेतनम् .. 28.58 ..
6.3.m: crying like an osprey upon seeing [it] reduced to ashes. / Another, seeing her mother and father lifeless,

6.3.s:
vepate patitā bhūmau kheditā vaḍavā yathā .
itaścetaśca kācicca dahyamānā varāṅganā .. 28.59 ..
6.3.d:
वेपते पतिता भूमौ खेदिता वडवा यथा .
इतश्चेतश्च काचिच्च दह्यमाना वराङ्गना .. 28.59 ..
6.3.m: shook and fell to the ground, like an exhausted mare. / Here and there an excellent woman, burning,

6.3.s:
nāpaśyadbālamutsaṅge viparītamukhī sthitā .
kumbhilasya gṛhaṃ dagdhaṃ patitaṃ dharaṇītale .. 28.60 ..
6.3.d:
नापश्यद्बालमुत्सङ्गे विपरीतमुखी स्थिता .
कुम्भिलस्य गृहं दग्धं पतितं धरणीतले .. 28.60 ..
6.3.m: did not see the child in her lap, standing with her face turned away. / The house of Kumbhila burned and fell to the surface of the earth,

6.3.s:
kūṣmāṇḍasya ca dhūmrasya kuhakasya bakasya ca .
virūpanayanasyāpi virūpākṣasya caiva hi .. 28.61 ..
6.3.d:
कूष्माण्डस्य च धूम्रस्य कुहकस्य बकस्य च .
विरूपनयनस्यापि विरूपाक्षस्य चैव हि .. 28.61 ..
6.3.m: and of Kūṣmāṇḍa, Dhūmra, Kuhaka, and Baka, / and indeed of Virūpanayana and Virūpākṣa,

6.3.s:
śumbho ḍimbhaśca raudraśca prahlādaścāsurottamaḥ .
daṇḍapāṇirvipāṇiśca siṃhavaktrastathānagha .. 28.62 ..
6.3.d:
शुम्भो डिम्भश्च रौद्रश्च प्रह्लादश्चासुरोत्तमः .
दण्डपाणिर्विपाणिश्च सिंहवक्त्रस्तथानघ .. 28.62 ..
6.3.m: and Śumbha, Ḍimbha, Raudra, and Prahlāda, best of asuras, / Daṇḍapāṇi, Vipāṇi, and Siṃhavaktra, O sinless one,

6.3.s:
dundubhaścaiva saṃhrādo ḍiṇḍirmuṇḍistathaiva ca .
bāṇabhrātā ca bāṇaśca kravyādavyāghravaktrakau .. 28.63 ..
6.3.d:
दुन्दुभश्चैव संह्रादो डिण्डिर्मुण्डिस्तथैव च .
बाणभ्राता च बाणश्च क्रव्यादव्याघ्रवक्त्रकौ .. 28.63 ..
6.3.m: and Dundubha, Saṃhrāda, Ḍiṇḍi, and Muṇḍi, / and Bāṇa's brother, and Bāṇa, Kravyāda and Vyāghravaktra.

6.3.s:
evamanye'pi ye keciddānavā baladarpitāḥ .
teṣāṃ gṛhe tathā vahnirjvalate nirdayo nṛpa .
dahyamānāḥ striyastāta vilapanti gṛhe gṛhe .. 28.64 ..
6.3.d:
एवमन्येऽपि ये केचिद्दानवा बलदर्पिताः .
तेषां गृहे तथा वह्निर्ज्वलते निर्दयो नृप .
दह्यमानाः स्त्रियस्तात विलपन्ति गृहे गृहे .. 28.64 ..
6.3.m: Likewise in the house of those others—whatever Dānavas were arrogant with strength— / the fire blazed mercilessly, O king. / The women, burning, lamented in every house, O dear one.

6.3.s:
karuṇākṣaravādinyo nirādhārā gatāḥ śivam .
yadi vairaṃ surāreśca puruṣoparipāvaka .. 28.65 ..
6.3.d:
करुणाक्षरवादिन्यो निराधारा गताः शिवम् .
यदि वैरं सुरारेश्च पुरुषोपरिपावक .. 28.65 ..
6.3.m: Uttering words of pity, destitute, they went to Śiva: / "Fire! If the enmity of the enemy of the gods is against men,

6.3.s:
striyaḥ kimaparādhyanti gṛhapañjarakokilāḥ .
anirdayo nṛśaṃsastvaṃ kaste kopaḥ striyaṃ prati .. 28.66 ..
6.3.d:
स्त्रियः किमपराध्यन्ति गृहपञ्जरकोकिलाः .
अनिर्दयो नृशंसस्त्वं कस्ते कोपः स्त्रियं प्रति .. 28.66 ..
6.3.m: what offense have the women committed—cuckoos in the cage of the home? / You are unmerciful and cruel! What is your anger against a woman?

6.3.s:
kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ loke avadhyāḥ sarvathā striyaḥ .
kiṃ tu tubhyaṃ guṇo hyasti dahane pavaneritaḥ .. 28.67 ..
6.3.d:
किं त्वया न श्रुतं लोके अवध्याः सर्वथा स्त्रियः .
किं तु तुभ्यं गुणो ह्यस्ति दहने पवनेरितः .. 28.67 ..
6.3.m: Have you not heard in the world that women are by all means not to be slain? / But you have the quality of burning, driven by the wind.

6.3.s:
na kāruṇyaṃ tvayā kiṃciddākṣiṇyaṃ ca striyaṃ prati .
dayāṃ mlecchā hi kurvanti vacanaṃ vīkṣya yoṣitām .. 28.68 ..
6.3.d:
न कारुण्यं त्वया किंचिद्दाक्षिण्यं च स्त्रियं प्रति .
दयां म्लेच्छा हि कुर्वन्ति वचनं वीक्ष्य योषिताम् .. 28.68 ..
6.3.m: You have no compassion at all, nor any courtesy toward a woman. / Even barbarians show mercy upon hearing the words of women.

6.3.s:
mlecchānāmapi ca mleccho durnivāryo hyacetanaḥ .
evaṃ vilapamānānāṃ strīṇāṃ tatraiva bhārata .. 28.69 ..
6.3.d:
म्लेच्छानामपि च म्लेच्छो दुर्निवार्यो ह्यचेतनः .
एवं विलपमानानां स्त्रीणां तत्रैव भारत .. 28.69 ..
6.3.m: You are a barbarian even among barbarians, unrestrainable and mindless!" / While the women were thus lamenting right there, O descendant of Bharata,

6.3.s:
jvālākalāpabahulaḥ prajvalatyeva pāvakaḥ .
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato bāṇo dahyamāna uvāca ha .. 28.70 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वालाकलापबहुलः प्रज्वलत्येव पावकः .
एवं दृष्ट्वा ततो बाणो दह्यमान उवाच ह .. 28.70 ..
6.3.m: the fire, thick with masses of flames, blazed on. / Seeing this, Bāṇa, burning, spoke then:

6.3.s:
avajñāya vinaṣṭo'haṃ pāpātmā haramañjasā .
mayā pāpena mūrkheṇa ye lokā nāśitā dhruvam .. 28.71 ..
6.3.d:
अवज्ञाय विनष्टोऽहं पापात्मा हरमञ्जसा .
मया पापेन मूर्खेण ये लोका नाशिता ध्रुवम् .. 28.71 ..
6.3.m: "Having disregarded Hara, I, an evil soul, am utterly ruined. / By me, an evil fool, the worlds were certainly destroyed;

6.3.s:
gobrāhmaṇā hatā nityamiha loke paratra ca .
nāśitānyannapānāni maṭhārāmāśramāstathā .. 28.72 ..
6.3.d:
गोब्राह्मणा हता नित्यमिह लोके परत्र च .
नाशितान्यन्नपानानि मठारामाश्रमास्तथा .. 28.72 ..
6.3.m: cows and brahmins were constantly killed in this world and the next; / food and drink, monasteries, gardens, and hermitages were destroyed,

6.3.s:
ṛṣīṇāmāśramāścaiva devārāmā gaṇālayāḥ .
tena pāpena me dhvaṃsastapasaśca balasya ca .. 28.73 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषीणामाश्रमाश्चैव देवारामा गणालयाः .
तेन पापेन मे ध्वंसस्तपसश्च बलस्य च .. 28.73 ..
6.3.m: as well as the hermitages of seers, gardens of the gods, and dwellings of the gaṇas. / Through that sin comes the destruction of my austerity and strength.

6.3.s: kiṃ dhanena kariṣyāmi rājyeṇāntaḥpureṇa ca .. 28.74 ..
6.3.d: किं धनेन करिष्यामि राज्येणान्तःपुरेण च .. 28.74 ..
6.3.m: What shall I do with wealth, with the kingdom, or with the inner quarters?

6.3.s:
varaṃ śaṅkarapādau ca śaraṇaṃ yāmi mūḍhadhīḥ .
na mātā na pitā caiva na bandhurnāparo janaḥ .. 28.75 ..
6.3.d:
वरं शङ्करपादौ च शरणं यामि मूढधीः .
न माता न पिता चैव न बन्धुर्नापरो जनः .. 28.75 ..
6.3.m: Rather, dull-witted, I go for refuge to Śaṅkara's feet. / There is neither mother, nor father, nor kinsman, nor any other person,

6.3.s:
muktvā caiva maheśānaṃ paramārtiharaṃ param .
ātmanā ca kṛtaṃ pāpamātmanaiva tu bhujyate .. 28.76 ..
6.3.d:
मुक्त्वा चैव महेशानं परमार्तिहरं परम् .
आत्मना च कृतं पापमात्मनैव तु भुज्यते .. 28.76 ..
6.3.m: apart from Maheśāna, the supreme remover of the distress of the afflicted. / The sin committed by oneself is experienced by oneself alone.

6.3.s:
ahaṃ punaḥ samastaiśca dahyāmi saha sādhubhiḥ .
evamuktvā śivaṃ liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tanmastakopari .. 28.77 ..
6.3.d:
अहं पुनः समस्तैश्च दह्यामि सह साधुभिः .
एवमुक्त्वा शिवं लिङ्गं कृत्वा तन्मस्तकोपरि .. 28.77 ..
6.3.m: Yet I burn together with all the virtuous ones." / Having spoken thus, placing the liṅga of Śiva upon his head,

6.3.s:
nirjagāma gṛhācchīghraṃ pāvakenāvaguṇṭhitaḥ .
sa khinnaḥ svinnagātrastu praskhalaṃstu muhurmuhuḥ .. 28.78 ..
6.3.d:
निर्जगाम गृहाच्छीघ्रं पावकेनावगुण्ठितः .
स खिन्नः स्विन्नगात्रस्तु प्रस्खलंस्तु मुहुर्मुहुः .. 28.78 ..
6.3.m: he went forth quickly from the house, enveloped by fire. / Distressed, his limbs sweating, stumbling repeatedly,

6.3.s:
haraṃ gadgadayā vācā stuvanvai śaraṇaṃ yayau .
tvatkopānalanirdagdho yadi vadhyo'smi śaṅkara .. 28.79 ..
6.3.d:
हरं गद्गदया वाचा स्तुवन्वै शरणं ययौ .
त्वत्कोपानलनिर्दग्धो यदि वध्योऽस्मि शङ्कर .. 28.79 ..
6.3.m: praising Hara with a choked voice, he went for refuge: / "If, scorched by the fire of your wrath, I am to be slain, O Śaṅkara,

6.3.s:
tvatprasādānmahādeva mā me liṅgaṃ praṇaśyatu .
arcitaṃ me suraśreṣṭha dhyātaṃ bhaktyā mayā vibho .. 28.80 ..
6.3.d:
त्वत्प्रसादान्महादेव मा मे लिङ्गं प्रणश्यतु .
अर्चितं मे सुरश्रेष्ठ ध्यातं भक्त्या मया विभो .. 28.80 ..
6.3.m: by your grace, O Mahādeva, let not my liṅga perish! / It was worshipped by me, O best of gods, meditated upon with devotion, O all-pervading lord,

6.3.s:
prāṇādiṣṭatamaṃ deva tasmādrakṣitumarhasi .
yadi te'hamanugrāhyo vadhyo vā surasattama .. 28.81 ..
6.3.d:
प्राणादिष्टतमं देव तस्माद्रक्षितुमर्हसि .
यदि तेऽहमनुग्राह्यो वध्यो वा सुरसत्तम .. 28.81 ..
6.3.m: dearer than my life, O God! Therefore, you ought to protect it. / Whether I am to be favored or to be slain by you, O best of the gods,

6.3.s:
pratijanma mahādeva tvadbhaktiracalāstu me .
paśukīṭapataṅgeṣu tiryagyonigateṣu ca .
svakarmaṇā mahādeva tvadbhaktiracalāstu me .. 28.82 ..
6.3.d:
प्रतिजन्म महादेव त्वद्भक्तिरचलास्तु मे .
पशुकीटपतङ्गेषु तिर्यग्योनिगतेषु च .
स्वकर्मणा महादेव त्वद्भक्तिरचलास्तु मे .. 28.82 ..
6.3.m: let my devotion to you be unwavering in every birth, O Mahādeva! / Even among animals, insects, and birds, and among those born of animal wombs / through my own past deeds, O Mahādeva, let my devotion to you be unwavering!"

6.3.s:
evamuktvā mahābhāgo bāṇo bhaktimatāṃ varaḥ .
stotreṇa devadeveśaṃ chandayāmāsa bhārata .. 28.83 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महाभागो बाणो भक्तिमतां वरः .
स्तोत्रेण देवदेवेशं छन्दयामास भारत .. 28.83 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the illustrious Bāṇa, foremost among devotees, / propitiated the Lord of the Gods with a hymn of praise, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s:
bāṇa uvāca -
śiva śaṅkara sarvaharāya namo bhavabhītabhayārtiharāya namaḥ .
kusumāyudhadehavināśaṃkara pramadāpriyakāmaka deva namaḥ .. 28.84 ..
6.3.d:
बाण उवाच -
शिव शङ्कर सर्वहराय नमो भवभीतभयार्तिहराय नमः .
कुसुमायुधदेहविनाशंकर प्रमदाप्रियकामक देव नमः .. 28.84 ..
6.3.m: Bāṇa said: / "O Śiva, Śaṅkara, homage to the destroyer of all! Homage to the remover of the fear and distress of those afraid of worldly existence! / O causer of the destruction of the body of the flower-weaponed one, O god who fulfills the desires beloved of women, homage to you!

6.3.s:
jaya pārvatīśa paramārthasāra jaya viracitabhīmabhujaṅgahāra .
jaya nirmalabhasmaviliptagātra jaya mantramūla jagadekapātra .. 28.85 ..
6.3.d:
जय पार्वतीश परमार्थसार जय विरचितभीमभुजङ्गहार .
जय निर्मलभस्मविलिप्तगात्र जय मन्त्रमूल जगदेकपात्र .. 28.85 ..
6.3.m: Victory, O Lord of Pārvatī, essence of the supreme truth! Victory, O you who have fashioned a garland of terrible serpents! / Victory, O you whose limbs are smeared with spotless ashes! Victory, O root of mantras, sole vessel of the universe!

6.3.s:
jaya viṣadharakapilajaṭākalāpa jaya bhairavavighṛtapinākacāpa .
jaya viṣamanayanaparimuktasaṅga jaya śaṅkara dhṛtagāṅgataraṅga .. 28.86 ..
6.3.d:
जय विषधरकपिलजटाकलाप जय भैरवविघृतपिनाकचाप .
जय विषमनयनपरिमुक्तसङ्ग जय शङ्कर धृतगाङ्गतरङ्ग .. 28.86 ..
6.3.m: Victory, O you with a mass of brown matted hair containing poisonous serpents! Victory, O you who hold the bow Pināka, terrible one! / Victory, O you with uneven eyes, free from attachment! Victory, O Śaṅkara, bearer of the waves of the Gaṅgā!"

6.3.s:
jaya bhīmarūpa khaṭvāṅgahasta śaśiśekhara jaya jagatāṃ praśasta .
jaya sukhareśa suralokasāra jaya sarvasakalanirdagdhasāra .. 28.87 ..
6.3.d:
जय भीमरूप खट्वाङ्गहस्त शशिशेखर जय जगतां प्रशस्त .
जय सुखरेश सुरलोकसार जय सर्वसकलनिर्दग्धसार .. 28.87 ..
6.3.m: Victory to you of terrible form, skull-staff in hand, with the crescent moon on your crest! Victory to you, praised by the worlds! / Victory, lord of joy, essence of the realm of the gods! Victory, you who burnt entirely the essence of all!

6.3.s:
jaya kīrtanīya jagatāṃ pavitra jaya vṛṣāṅka bahuvidhacaritra .
jaya viracitanarakaṅkālamāla aghāsuradehakaṅkālakāla .. 28.88 ..
6.3.d:
जय कीर्तनीय जगतां पवित्र जय वृषाङ्क बहुविधचरित्र .
जय विरचितनरकङ्कालमाल अघासुरदेहकङ्कालकाल .. 28.88 ..
6.3.m: Victory to you who are worthy of praise, purifier of the worlds! Victory, bull-bannered one of manifold deeds! / Victory, you who fashioned a garland of human skeletons, death unto the skeleton of the demon Agha’s body!

6.3.s:
jaya nīlakaṃṭha varavṛṣabhagamana jaya sakalalokaduritānuśamana .
jaya siddhasurāsuravinatacaraṇa jaya rudra raudrabhavajaladhitaraṇa .. 28.89 ..
6.3.d:
जय नीलकंठ वरवृषभगमन जय सकललोकदुरितानुशमन .
जय सिद्धसुरासुरविनतचरण जय रुद्र रौद्रभवजलधितरण .. 28.89 ..
6.3.m: Victory, blue-throated one who rides an excellent bull! Victory, allayer of the misfortunes of all worlds! / Victory, you whose feet are bowed to by siddhas, gods, and asuras! Victory, Rudra who ferries across the terrible ocean of worldly existence!

6.3.s:
jaya giriśa sureśvaramānanīya jaya sūkṣmarūpa saṃcitanīya .
jaya dagdhatripura viśvasattva jaya sakalaśāstraparamārthatattva .. 28.90 ..
6.3.d:
जय गिरिश सुरेश्वरमाननीय जय सूक्ष्मरूप संचितनीय .
जय दग्धत्रिपुर विश्वसत्त्व जय सकलशास्त्रपरमार्थतत्त्व .. 28.90 ..
6.3.m: Victory, mountain-dweller revered by the lord of the gods! Victory, subtle-formed one worthy of contemplation! / Victory, destroyer of Tripura, inner being of the universe, ultimate reality of all scriptures!

6.3.s:
jaya duravabodha saṃsāratāra kalikaluṣamahārṇavaghoratāra .
jaya surāsuradevagaṇeśa namo hayavānarasiṃhagajendramukha .. 28.91 ..
6.3.d:
जय दुरवबोध संसारतार कलिकलुषमहार्णवघोरतार .
जय सुरासुरदेवगणेश नमो हयवानरसिंहगजेन्द्रमुख .. 28.91 ..
6.3.m: Victory, difficult to comprehend, redeemer from worldly existence, fierce savior across the great ocean of the defilements of the Kali age! / Victory, lord of the host of gods and asuras! Homage to you whose faces include the horse, monkey, lion, and lord of elephants!

6.3.s:
atihrasvasthūlasudīrghatama upalabdhirna śakyate te hyamaraiḥ .
praṇato'smi nirañjana te caraṇau jaya sāmba sulocanakāntihara .. 28.92 ..
6.3.d:
अतिह्रस्वस्थूलसुदीर्घतम उपलब्धिर्न शक्यते ते ह्यमरैः .
प्रणतोऽस्मि निरञ्जन ते चरणौ जय साम्ब सुलोचनकान्तिहर .. 28.92 ..
6.3.m: Extremely short, stout, and exceedingly tall—your perception cannot indeed be attained by the immortals. / Taintless one, I bow to your feet! Victory, you accompanied by Ambā, who steals the luster of beautiful eyes!

6.3.s:
aprāpya tvāṃ kimatyantamucchrayī na vināśayet .
atipramāthi ca tadā tapo mahatsudāruṇam .. 28.93 ..
6.3.d:
अप्राप्य त्वां किमत्यन्तमुच्छ्रयी न विनाशयेत् .
अतिप्रमाथि च तदा तपो महत्सुदारुणम् .. 28.93 ..
6.3.m: Failing to reach you, what would not an exalted person destroy? / And then great, extremely dreadful tapas is severely tormenting.

6.3.s:
na putrabāndhavā dārā na samastaḥ suhṛjjanaḥ .
saṅkaṭe'bhyupagacchanti vrajantamekagāminam .. 28.94 ..
6.3.d:
न पुत्रबान्धवा दारा न समस्तः सुहृज्जनः .
सङ्कटेऽभ्युपगच्छन्ति व्रजन्तमेकगामिनम् .. 28.94 ..
6.3.m: Neither sons, kinsmen, wives, nor all one's friends / approach to assist in distress as one goes alone on the path.

6.3.s:
yadeva karma kaivalyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena śubhāśubham .
tadeva sārthavattasya bhavatyagre tu gacchataḥ .. 28.95 ..
6.3.d:
यदेव कर्म कैवल्यं कृतं तेन शुभाशुभम् .
तदेव सार्थवत्तस्य भवत्यग्रे तु गच्छतः .. 28.95 ..
6.3.m: Whatever karma alone, good or bad, has been done by him, / that alone becomes his companion as he goes forward.

6.3.s:
nirdhanasyaiva carato na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit .
dhanībhayairna mucyeta dhanaṃ tasmāttyajāmyaham .. 28.96 ..
6.3.d:
निर्धनस्यैव चरतो न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् .
धनीभयैर्न मुच्येत धनं तस्मात्त्यजाम्यहम् .. 28.96 ..
6.3.m: For the penniless wanderer alone there is no fear anywhere; / a wealthy man is never freed from fears. Therefore I renounce wealth.

6.3.s:
lubdhāḥ pāpāni kurvanti śuddhāṃśā naiva mānavāḥ .
śrutvā dharmasya sarvasvaṃ śrutvā caivāvadhārya tat .. 28.97 ..
6.3.d:
लुब्धाः पापानि कुर्वन्ति शुद्धांशा नैव मानवाः .
श्रुत्वा धर्मस्य सर्वस्वं श्रुत्वा चैवावधार्य तत् .. 28.97 ..
6.3.m: The greedy commit sins, but men of pure disposition do not, / having heard the essence of dharma, and having heard and comprehended it.

6.3.s:
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ jagannātho brahmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ .
indrastvaṃ devadeveśa suranātha namo'stu te .. 28.98 ..
6.3.d:
त्वं विष्णुस्त्वं जगन्नाथो ब्रह्मरूपः सनातनः .
इन्द्रस्त्वं देवदेवेश सुरनाथ नमोऽस्तु ते .. 28.98 ..
6.3.m: You are Viṣṇu, you are the Lord of the Universe, the eternal form of Brahman. / You are Indra, O god of the lords of gods, lord of the celestials, homage to you!

6.3.s:
tvaṃ kṣitirvaruṇaścaiva pavanastvaṃ hutāśanaḥ .
tvaṃ dīkṣā yajamānaśca ākāśaṃ soma eva ca .. 28.99 ..
6.3.d:
त्वं क्षितिर्वरुणश्चैव पवनस्त्वं हुताशनः .
त्वं दीक्षा यजमानश्च आकाशं सोम एव च .. 28.99 ..
6.3.m: You are the earth and Varuṇa, you are the wind, and you are the fire. / You are the consecration, the sacrificer, space, and Soma.

6.3.s:
tvaṃ sūryastvaṃ tu vitteśo yamastvaṃ gurureva ca .
tvayā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhāsvatā yathā .. 28.100 ..
6.3.d:
त्वं सूर्यस्त्वं तु वित्तेशो यमस्त्वं गुरुरेव च .
त्वया व्याप्तं जगत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं भास्वता यथा .. 28.100 ..
6.3.m: You are the sun, and you are the lord of wealth, you are Yama, and you are the guru. / By you the entire universe is pervaded, as the three worlds are by the sun.

6.3.s:
etadbāṇakṛtaṃ stotraṃ śrutvā devo maheśvaraḥ .
krodhaṃ muktvā prasannātmā tadā vacanamabravīt .. 28.101 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्बाणकृतं स्तोत्रं श्रुत्वा देवो महेश्वरः .
क्रोधं मुक्त्वा प्रसन्नात्मा तदा वचनमब्रवीत् .. 28.101 ..
6.3.m: Having heard this hymn composed by Bāṇa, the divine Maheśvara, / relinquishing anger with a pleased heart, then spoke [these] words:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyamadyaprabhṛti dānava .
sauvarṇe bhavane tiṣṭha mama pārśve'thavā punaḥ .. 28.102 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
न भेतव्यं न भेतव्यमद्यप्रभृति दानव .
सौवर्णे भवने तिष्ठ मम पार्श्वेऽथवा पुनः .. 28.102 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Do not fear, do not fear from this day forward, O dānava! / Stay in the golden mansion or else by my side,

6.3.s:
putrapautraprapautraiśca bāndhavaiḥ saha bhāryayā .
adyaprabhṛti vatsa tvamavadhyaḥ sarvaśatruṣu .. 28.103 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रैश्च बान्धवैः सह भार्यया .
अद्यप्रभृति वत्स त्वमवध्यः सर्वशत्रुषु .. 28.103 ..
6.3.m: with your sons, grandsons, great-grandsons, kinsmen, and wife. / From this day forward, dear child, you are invulnerable among all enemies.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhūyastasya varo datto devadevena bhārata .
svarge martye ca pātāle pūjitaḥ sasurāsuraiḥ .. 28.104 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भूयस्तस्य वरो दत्तो देवदेवेन भारत .
स्वर्गे मर्त्ये च पाताले पूजितः ससुरासुरैः .. 28.104 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Further, a boon was granted to him by the god of gods, O descendant of Bharata, / worshipped in heaven, on earth, and in Pātāla by gods and asuras:

6.3.s:
akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva vasa tvaṃ vai yathāsukham .
tato nivārayāmāsa rudraḥ saptaśikhaṃ tadā .. 28.105 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव वस त्वं वै यथासुखम् .
ततो निवारयामास रुद्रः सप्तशिखं तदा .. 28.105 ..
6.3.m: Imperishable and unwaning, dwell as you please! / Then Rudra restrained the seven-flamed [fire].

6.3.s:
tṛtīyaṃ rakṣitaṃ tasya puraṃ devena śambhunā .
jvālāmālākulaṃ cānyatpatitaṃ dharaṇītale .. 28.106 ..
6.3.d:
तृतीयं रक्षितं तस्य पुरं देवेन शम्भुना .
ज्वालामालाकुलं चान्यत्पतितं धरणीतले .. 28.106 ..
6.3.m: His third city was protected by the divine Śambhu, / while the other, engulfed in garlands of flames, fell onto the surface of the earth.

6.3.s:
ardhena prasthitādūrdhvaṃ tasya jvālā divaṃ gatāḥ .
hāhākāro mahāṃstatra ṛṣisaṅghairudīritaḥ .. 28.107 ..
6.3.d:
अर्धेन प्रस्थितादूर्ध्वं तस्य ज्वाला दिवं गताः .
हाहाकारो महांस्तत्र ऋषिसङ्घैरुदीरितः .. 28.107 ..
6.3.m: Rising halfway upwards, its flames reached the heavens. / A great cry of woe was uttered there by the hosts of seers,

6.3.s:
daivataiśca mahābhāgaiḥ siddhavidyādharādibhiḥ .
ekaṃ tu patitaṃ tatra śrīśaile khaṇḍamuttaram .. 28.108 ..
6.3.d:
दैवतैश्च महाभागैः सिद्धविद्याधरादिभिः .
एकं तु पतितं तत्र श्रीशैले खण्डमुत्तरम् .. 28.108 ..
6.3.m: and by the exalted deities, siddhas, vidyādharas, and others. / One northern section fell there on Śrīśaila;

6.3.s:
dvitīyaṃ patitaṃ rājañchaile hyamarakaṇṭake .
prajvalatpatitaṃ tatra tena jvāleśvaraṃ smṛtam .. 28.109 ..
6.3.d:
द्वितीयं पतितं राजञ्छैले ह्यमरकण्टके .
प्रज्वलत्पतितं तत्र तेन ज्वालेश्वरं स्मृतम् .. 28.109 ..
6.3.m: the second fell, O king, on Mount Amarakaṇṭaka. / Blazing, it fell there; therefore it is remembered as Jvāleśvara.

6.3.s:
dagdhe tu tripure rājanpatite khaṇḍa uttame .
rudro devaḥ sthitastatra jvālāmālānivārakaḥ .. 28.110 ..
6.3.d:
दग्धे तु त्रिपुरे राजन्पतिते खण्ड उत्तमे .
रुद्रो देवः स्थितस्तत्र ज्वालामालानिवारकः .. 28.110 ..
6.3.m: Tripura having been burned, O king, and the upper section having fallen, / the divine Rudra remained there, turning back the garlands of flames,

6.3.s:
hāhākāraparāṇāṃ tu ṛṣīṇāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca .
svayaṃ mūrtirmaheśānumāvṛṣabhasaṃyutaḥ .. 28.111 ..
6.3.d:
हाहाकारपराणां तु ऋषीणां रक्षणाय च .
स्वयं मूर्तिर्महेशानुमावृषभसंयुतः .. 28.111 ..
6.3.m: in order to protect the seers who were crying out in woe, / Maheśāna himself in bodily form, accompanied by Umā and the bull.

6.3.s:
manasāpi smaredyastu bhaktyā hyamarakaṇṭakam .
cāndrāyaṇādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ sa labhennātra saṃśayaḥ .. 28.112 ..
6.3.d:
मनसापि स्मरेद्यस्तु भक्त्या ह्यमरकण्टकम् .
चान्द्रायणाधिकं पुण्यं स लभेन्नात्र संशयः .. 28.112 ..
6.3.m: Whoever recalls Amarakaṇṭaka with devotion even in mind / obtains merit greater than the Cāndrāyaṇa fast; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
atipuṇyo giriśreṣṭho yasmādbharatasattama .
asmānnityaṃ bhavedrājansarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ .. 28.113 ..
6.3.d:
अतिपुण्यो गिरिश्रेष्ठो यस्माद्भरतसत्तम .
अस्मान्नित्यं भवेद्राजन्सर्वपापक्षयंकरः .. 28.113 ..
6.3.m: Because this best of mountains is extremely sacred, O best of the Bharatas, / for this reason, O king, it always destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
nānādrumalatākīrṇo nānāpuṣpopaśobhitaḥ .
nānāgulmalatākīrṇo nānāvallībhirāvṛtaḥ .. 28.114 ..
6.3.d:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णो नानापुष्पोपशोभितः .
नानागुल्मलताकीर्णो नानावल्लीभिरावृतः .. 28.114 ..
6.3.m: It is filled with various trees and creepers, adorned with various flowers, / covered with various bushes and plants, and surrounded by manifold climbing vines.

6.3.s:
siṃhavyāghrasamākīrṇo mṛgayūthairalaṃkṛtaḥ .
śvāpadānāṃ ca ghoṣeṇa nityaṃ pramudito'bhavat .. 28.115 ..
6.3.d:
सिंहव्याघ्रसमाकीर्णो मृगयूथैरलंकृतः .
श्वापदानां च घोषेण नित्यं प्रमुदितोऽभवत् .. 28.115 ..
6.3.m: It is teeming with lions and tigers, adorned with herds of deer; / and with the roar of wild beasts it was constantly delightful.

6.3.s:
brahmendraviṣṇupramukhairhyamaraiśca sahasraśaḥ .
sevyate devadeveśaḥ śaṅkarastatra parvate .. 28.116 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुप्रमुखैर्ह्यमरैश्च सहस्रशः .
सेव्यते देवदेवेशः शङ्करस्तत्र पर्वते .. 28.116 ..
6.3.m: By immortals in their thousands, headed by Brahmā, Indra, and Viṣṇu, / Śaṅkara, the lord of the gods of gods, is served there on that mountain.

6.3.s:
patanaṃ kurute yo'sminparvate'marakaṇṭake .
krīḍate kramaśo rājanbhuvanāni caturdaśa .. 28.117 ..
6.3.d:
पतनं कुरुते योऽस्मिन्पर्वतेऽमरकण्टके .
क्रीडते क्रमशो राजन्भुवनानि चतुर्दश .. 28.117 ..
6.3.m: Whoever leaps down on this Mount Amarakaṇṭaka / sports, O king, through the fourteen worlds in succession:

6.3.s:
aindraṃ vāhnaṃ ca kauberaṃ vāyavyaṃ yāmyameva ca .
nairṛtyaṃ vāruṇaṃ caiva saumyaṃ sauraṃ tathaiva ca .. 28.118 ..
6.3.d:
ऐन्द्रं वाह्नं च कौबेरं वायव्यं याम्यमेव च .
नैरृत्यं वारुणं चैव सौम्यं सौरं तथैव च .. 28.118 ..
6.3.m: the realm of Indra, the realm of Agni, of Kubera, of Vāyu, and of Yama, / of Nirṛti, of Varuṇa, of Soma, and of Sūrya,

6.3.s:
brāhmaṃ ca padamakliṣṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tadanantaram .
umārudraṃ mahābhāga aiśvaraṃ tadanantaram .. 28.119 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मं च पदमक्लिष्टं वैष्णवं तदनन्तरम् .
उमारुद्रं महाभाग ऐश्वरं तदनन्तरम् .. 28.119 ..
6.3.m: and the unblemished abode of Brahmā, immediately after that the abode of Viṣṇu, / then, O illustrious one, the abode of Umā and Rudra, and next the abode of Īśvara.

6.3.s:
paraṃ sadāśivaṃ śāntaṃ sūkṣmaṃ jyotiratīndriyam .
tasminyāti layaṃ dhīro vidhinā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 28.120 ..
6.3.d:
परं सदाशिवं शान्तं सूक्ष्मं ज्योतिरतीन्द्रियम् .
तस्मिन्याति लयं धीरो विधिना नात्र संशयः .. 28.120 ..
6.3.m: Into the supreme, peaceful, subtle Sadāśiva, the light beyond the senses, / the steadfast person attains dissolution according to the rule; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
ko'pyatra vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ patane ṛṣisattama .
etanme sarvamācakṣva saṃśayo'sti mahāmune .. 28.121 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कोऽप्यत्र विधिरुद्दिष्टः पतने ऋषिसत्तम .
एतन्मे सर्वमाचक्ष्व संशयोऽस्ति महामुने .. 28.121 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What rule has been prescribed here regarding the leap, O best of seers? / Relate all of this to me, O great sage; I have a doubt.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
śṛṇuṣva kathayiṣyāmi taṃ vidhiṃ pāṇḍunandana .
yatkṛtvā prathamaṃ karma nipatettadanantaram .. 28.122 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
शृणुष्व कथयिष्यामि तं विधिं पाण्डुनन्दन .
यत्कृत्वा प्रथमं कर्म निपतेत्तदनन्तरम् .. 28.122 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Listen, son of Pāṇḍu, I will declare that rule, / having performed which initial rite one should leap down thereafter.

6.3.s:
kṛtvā kṛcchratrayaṃ pūrvaṃ japtvā lakṣaṃ daśaiva tu .
śākayāvakabhukcaiva śucistriṣavaṇo nṛpa .. 28.123 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा कृच्छ्रत्रयं पूर्वं जप्त्वा लक्षं दशैव तु .
शाकयावकभुक्चैव शुचिस्त्रिषवणो नृप .. 28.123 ..
6.3.m: Having first performed three Kṛcchra penances and recited [the mantra] one million times, / eating only herbs and barley gruel, pure and bathing at the three junctures of the day, O king,

6.3.s:
trikālamarcayedīśaṃ devadevaṃ trilocanam .
daśāṃśena tu rājendra homaṃ tatraiva kārayet .. 28.124 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिकालमर्चयेदीशं देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम् .
दशांशेन तु राजेन्द्र होमं तत्रैव कारयेत् .. 28.124 ..
6.3.m: one should worship Īśa, the three-eyed god of gods, at the three times of the day. / One should have a fire offering made right there with one tenth [of the japa count], O best of kings.

6.3.s:
lakṣavāraṃ japeddevaṃ gandhamālyaiśca pūjayet .
rātrau svapne tadā paśyedvimānasthaṃ tataḥ kṣipet .. 28.125 ..
6.3.d:
लक्षवारं जपेद्देवं गन्धमाल्यैश्च पूजयेत् .
रात्रौ स्वप्ने तदा पश्येद्विमानस्थं ततः क्षिपेत् .. 28.125 ..
6.3.m: One should recite [the name of] the god a hundred thousand times and worship with perfumes and garlands. / At night, when one sees him in a dream standing in a vimāna, one should then throw oneself down.

6.3.s:
anenaiva vidhānena ātmānaṃ yastu nikṣipet .
svargalokamanuprāpya krīḍate tridaśaiḥ saha .. 28.126 ..
6.3.d:
अनेनैव विधानेन आत्मानं यस्तु निक्षिपेत् .
स्वर्गलोकमनुप्राप्य क्रीडते त्रिदशैः सह .. 28.126 ..
6.3.m: Whoever throws oneself down according to this very procedure, / having reached the celestial world, sports together with the gods.

6.3.s:
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi triṃśatkoṭyastathaiva ca .
muktvā manoramānbhogāṃstadā gacchenmahītalam .. 28.127 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तथैव च .
मुक्त्वा मनोरमान्भोगांस्तदा गच्छेन्महीतलम् .. 28.127 ..
6.3.m: For thirty thousand years and likewise three hundred million [years], / having enjoyed delightful pleasures, he then goes down to the surface of the earth. // 28.127

6.3.s:
pṛthivīmekacchatreṇa bhunakti lokapūjitaḥ .
vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 28.128 ..
6.3.d:
पृथिवीमेकच्छत्रेण भुनक्ति लोकपूजितः .
व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 28.128 ..
6.3.m: He rules the earth under a single umbrella, worshipped by the world; / freed from illness and sorrow, he lives for a hundred autumns. // 28.128

6.3.s:
jvāleśvaraṃ tu tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .
tatra jvālā nadī pārtha prasrutā śivanirmitā .. 28.129 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वालेश्वरं तु तत्तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .
तत्र ज्वाला नदी पार्थ प्रस्रुता शिवनिर्मिता .. 28.129 ..
6.3.m: The sacred ford Jvāleśvara is renowned in the three worlds; / there the Jvālā River, created by Śiva, flowed forth, O son of Pṛthā. // 28.129

6.3.s:
nirvāpya tadbāṇapuraṃ revayā saha saṃgatā .
tatra snātvā mahārāja vidhinā mantrasaṃyutaḥ .. 28.130 ..
6.3.d:
निर्वाप्य तद्बाणपुरं रेवया सह संगता .
तत्र स्नात्वा महाराज विधिना मन्त्रसंयुतः .. 28.130 ..
6.3.m: Having extinguished that city of Bāṇa, it joined with the Revā. / Having bathed there according to rule, accompanied by mantras, O great king, // 28.130

6.3.s:
tilasaṃmiśratoyena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
piṇḍadānena ca pitṝn pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet .. 28.131 ..
6.3.d:
तिलसंमिश्रतोयेन तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
पिण्डदानेन च पितॄन् पौण्डरीकफलं लभेत् .. 28.131 ..
6.3.m: one should gratify the ancestors and the deities with water mixed with sesame seeds, / and the ancestors with the offering of rice-balls; he obtains the fruit of a Pauṇḍarīka sacrifice. // 28.131

6.3.s:
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 28.132 ..
6.3.d:
अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 28.132 ..
6.3.m: Whoever undertakes fasting unto death at that sacred ford, O ruler of men, / is freed from all sins and goes to the world of Rudra. // 28.132

6.3.s:
amarāṇāṃ śataiścaiva sevito hyamareśvaraḥ .
tathaiva ṛṣisaṅghaiśca tena puṇyatamo mahān .. 28.133 ..
6.3.d:
अमराणां शतैश्चैव सेवितो ह्यमरेश्वरः .
तथैव ऋषिसङ्घैश्च तेन पुण्यतमो महान् .. 28.133 ..
6.3.m: Amareśvara is indeed served by hundreds of immortals / and likewise by hosts of seers; therefore it is the most sacred and great. // 28.133

6.3.s:
samantādyojanaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ hyamarakaṇṭakam .
rudrakoṭisamopetaṃ tena tatpuṇyamuttamam .. 28.134 ..
6.3.d:
समन्ताद्योजनं तीर्थं पुण्यं ह्यमरकण्टकम् .
रुद्रकोटिसमोपेतं तेन तत्पुण्यमुत्तमम् .. 28.134 ..
6.3.m: The sacred ford of Amarakaṇṭaka extends for a yojana all around; / it is equal to ten million Rudras, and therefore it is supremely sacred. // 28.134

6.3.s:
tasya parvatarājasya yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam .
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 28.135 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य पर्वतराजस्य यः करोति प्रदक्षिणम् .
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन पृथिवी नात्र संशयः .. 28.135 ..
6.3.m: Whoever circumambulates that king of mountains, / by him the earth has been circumambulated; of this there is no doubt. // 28.135

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ trividhaṃ ca yat .
naśyate pātakaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 28.136 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं चैव कायिकं त्रिविधं च यत् .
नश्यते पातकं सर्वमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 28.136 ..
6.3.m: All the three kinds of sin—vocal, mental, / and bodily—are destroyed: so Śaṅkara said. // 28.136

6.3.s:
amareśvarapārśve ca tīrthaṃ śakreśvaraṃ nṛpa .
tapastaptvā purā tatra śakreṇa sthāpitaṃ kila .. 28.137 ..
6.3.d:
अमरेश्वरपार्श्वे च तीर्थं शक्रेश्वरं नृप .
तपस्तप्त्वा पुरा तत्र शक्रेण स्थापितं किल .. 28.137 ..
6.3.m: And beside Amareśvara is the sacred ford Śakreśvara, O king; / having performed austerity there in ancient times, it was established by Śakra. // 28.137

6.3.s:
kuśāvartaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ śubham .
brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathā param .. 28.138 ..
6.3.d:
कुशावर्तं नाम तीर्थं ब्रह्मणा च कृतं शुभम् .
ब्रह्मकुण्डमिति ख्यातं हंसतीर्थं तथा परम् .. 28.138 ..
6.3.m: The auspicious sacred ford named Kuśāvarta was made by Brahmā, / known as Brahmakuṇḍa, and another is Haṃsatīrtha. // 28.138

6.3.s:
ambarīṣasya tīrthaṃ ca mahākāleśvaraṃ tathā .
kāveryāḥ pūrvabhāge ca tīrthaṃ vai mātṛkeśvaram .. 28.139 ..
6.3.d:
अम्बरीषस्य तीर्थं च महाकालेश्वरं तथा .
कावेर्याः पूर्वभागे च तीर्थं वै मातृकेश्वरम् .. 28.139 ..
6.3.m: And the sacred ford of Ambarīṣa, and likewise Mahākāleśvara; / and to the east of the Kāverī is the sacred ford Mātṛkeśvara. // 28.139

6.3.s:
etāni dakṣiṇe tīre revāyā bharatarṣabha .
saṃsevanasnānadānaiḥ pāpasaṅghaharāṇi ca .. 28.140 ..
6.3.d:
एतानि दक्षिणे तीरे रेवाया भरतर्षभ .
संसेवनस्नानदानैः पापसङ्घहराणि च .. 28.140 ..
6.3.m: These are on the southern bank of the Revā, O bull of the Bharatas; / through worship, bathing, and gifts, they destroy multitudes of sins. // 28.140

6.3.s:
bhṛgutuṅge mahārāja prasiddho bhairavaḥ śivaḥ .
tasya yāmyavibhāge ca tīrthaṃ vai capaleśvaram .. 28.141 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुतुङ्गे महाराज प्रसिद्धो भैरवः शिवः .
तस्य याम्यविभागे च तीर्थं वै चपलेश्वरम् .. 28.141 ..
6.3.m: On Bhṛgutuṅga, O great king, the well-known Bhairava is Śiva; / and in its southern part is the sacred ford Capaleśvara. // 28.141

6.3.s:
etau sthitau duḥkhaharau revāyā uttare taṭe .
tāvabhyarcya tathā natvā samyagyātrāphalaṃ bhavet .
adṛṣṭapūjitau tau hi narāṇāṃ vighnakārakau .. 28.142 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tripuravidhvaṃsane jvāleśvaratīrthāmareśvatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 29
6.3.d:
एतौ स्थितौ दुःखहरौ रेवाया उत्तरे तटे .
तावभ्यर्च्य तथा नत्वा सम्यग्यात्राफलं भवेत् .
अदृष्टपूजितौ तौ हि नराणां विघ्नकारकौ .. 28.142 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे त्रिपुरविध्वंसने ज्वालेश्वरतीर्थामरेश्वतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 29
6.3.m:
These two, destroyers of sorrow, stand on the northern bank of the Revā. / Having worshipped them and bowed down to them, the full fruit of pilgrimage is attained; / for unseen and unhonoured, they cause obstacles to men. // 28.142
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Sacred Fords of Jvāleśvara and Amareśvara in the Destruction of Tripura’, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 29

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kāverīti ca vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu sattama .
māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tasyā mārkaṇḍa tattvataḥ .. 29.1 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कावेरीति च विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु सत्तम .
माहात्म्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तस्या मार्कण्ड तत्त्वतः .. 29.1 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / [There is a river] renowned in the three worlds as the Kāverī, O best of beings. / I wish to hear its māhātmya in truth, O Mārkaṇḍa.

6.3.s:
kīdṛśaṃ darśanaṃ tasyāḥ phalaṃ sparśe'thavā vibho .
snāne jāpye'thavā dāna upavāse tathā mune .. 29.2 ..
6.3.d:
कीदृशं दर्शनं तस्याः फलं स्पर्शेऽथवा विभो .
स्नाने जाप्येऽथवा दान उपवासे तथा मुने .. 29.2 ..
6.3.m: What is the fruit of beholding it, or of touching it, O Lord, / or of bathing, chanting, making gifts, and fasting, O sage?

6.3.s:
kathayasva mahābhāga kāverīsaṅgame phalam .
dharmaḥ śruto'tha dṛṣṭo vā kathito vā kṛto'pi vā .. 29.3 ..
6.3.d:
कथयस्व महाभाग कावेरीसङ्गमे फलम् .
धर्मः श्रुतोऽथ दृष्टो वा कथितो वा कृतोऽपि वा .. 29.3 ..
6.3.m: Declare, O highly fortunate one, the fruit of the confluence of the Kāverī. / Religious duty, whether heard, seen, spoken of, performed,

6.3.s:
anumodito vā viprendra punātīti śrutaṃ mayā .
yathā dharmaprasaṅge tu mune dharmo'pi jāyate .. 29.4 ..
6.3.d:
अनुमोदितो वा विप्रेन्द्र पुनातीति श्रुतं मया .
यथा धर्मप्रसङ्गे तु मुने धर्मोऽपि जायते .. 29.4 ..
6.3.m: or approved of, purifies—so have I heard, O best of brahmins. / Just as in the context of religious duty, O sage, duty itself arises,

6.3.s: svargaśca narakaścaiva ityevaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ .. 29.5 ..
6.3.d: स्वर्गश्च नरकश्चैव इत्येवं वैदिकी श्रुतिः .. 29.5 ..
6.3.m: so too [arise] heaven and hell: such is the Vedic revelation.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga yatpṛṣṭo'haṃ tvayādhunā .
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā kāverīphalamuttamam .. 29.6 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधु साधु महाभाग यत्पृष्टोऽहं त्वयाधुना .
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा कावेरीफलमुत्तमम् .. 29.6 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Excellent, excellent, O highly fortunate one, that you have asked me now! / Listen with a single mind to the supreme fruit of the Kāverī.

6.3.s:
asti yakṣo mahāsattvaḥ kuberonāma viśrutaḥ .
so'pi tīrthaprabhāvena rājanyakṣādhipo'bhavat .. 29.7 ..
6.3.d:
अस्ति यक्षो महासत्त्वः कुबेरोनाम विश्रुतः .
सोऽपि तीर्थप्रभावेन राजन्यक्षाधिपोऽभवत् .. 29.7 ..
6.3.m: There is a Yakṣa of great power renowned by the name Kubera; / he too, through the power of this sacred ford, became the ruler of Yakṣas, O king.

6.3.s:
tacchṛṇuṣva vidhānena bhaktyā paramayā nṛpa .
siddhiṃ prāpto mahābhāga kāverīsaṅgamena tu .. 29.8 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छृणुष्व विधानेन भक्त्या परमया नृप .
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो महाभाग कावेरीसङ्गमेन तु .. 29.8 ..
6.3.m: Listen to that with the proper method and with supreme devotion, O king, / how that highly fortunate one attained perfection through the confluence of the Kāverī.

6.3.s:
kāveryā narmadāyāstu saṅgame lokaviśrute .
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā kuberaḥ satyavikramaḥ .. 29.9 ..
6.3.d:
कावेर्या नर्मदायास्तु सङ्गमे लोकविश्रुते .
तत्र स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा कुबेरः सत्यविक्रमः .. 29.9 ..
6.3.m: At the confluence of the Kāverī and the Narmadā, world-renowned, / having bathed there and become pure, Kubera of true valor,

6.3.s:
vidhivanniyamaṃ kṛtvā śāstrayuktyā narottama .
ārādhayanmahādevamekacittaḥ sanātanam .. 29.10 ..
6.3.d:
विधिवन्नियमं कृत्वा शास्त्रयुक्त्या नरोत्तम .
आराधयन्महादेवमेकचित्तः सनातनम् .. 29.10 ..
6.3.m: duly undertaking observances in accordance with the scriptures, O best of men, / worshipped the eternal Mahādeva with single-minded focus.

6.3.s:
ekāhāro vasanmāsaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhāhnakālikaḥ .
pakṣopavāsī nyavasatkaṃcitkālaṃ nṛpottama .. 29.11 ..
6.3.d:
एकाहारो वसन्मासं तथा षष्ठाह्नकालिकः .
पक्षोपवासी न्यवसत्कंचित्कालं नृपोत्तम .. 29.11 ..
6.3.m: Living on a single meal a day for a month, then eating only every sixth meal-time, / and fasting for a fortnight, he dwelt there for some time, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
mūlaśākaphalaiścānyaṃ kālaṃ nayati buddhimān .
kiṃcitkālaṃ vasaṃstatra tīrthe śaivālabhojanaḥ .. 29.12 ..
6.3.d:
मूलशाकफलैश्चान्यं कालं नयति बुद्धिमान् .
किंचित्कालं वसंस्तत्र तीर्थे शैवालभोजनः .. 29.12 ..
6.3.m: The wise one spent another period of time on roots, herbs, and fruits; / dwelling there at that sacred ford for some time, he subsisted on water-moss.

6.3.s:
parākeṇānayatkālaṃ kṛcchreṇāpi ca mānada .
cāndrāyaṇena cāpyanyamanyaṃ vāyvambubhojanaḥ .. 29.13 ..
6.3.d:
पराकेणानयत्कालं कृच्छ्रेणापि च मानद .
चान्द्रायणेन चाप्यन्यमन्यं वाय्वम्बुभोजनः .. 29.13 ..
6.3.m: He passed time performing the parāka penance and also the kṛcchra penance, O giver of honor; / and another [time] through the cāndrāyaṇa penance, and another consuming only wind and water.

6.3.s:
evaṃ tatra naraśreṣṭha kāmarāgavivarjitaḥ .
sthito varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ karṣayansvaṃ tathā vapuḥ .. 29.14 ..
6.3.d:
एवं तत्र नरश्रेष्ठ कामरागविवर्जितः .
स्थितो वर्षशतं साग्रं कर्षयन्स्वं तथा वपुः .. 29.14 ..
6.3.m: Thus remaining there, O best of men, free from desire and passion, / for fully a hundred years, emaciating his body,

6.3.s:
tato varṣaśatasyānte devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
tuṣṭastu parayā bhaktyā tamuvāca hasanniva .. 29.15 ..
6.3.d:
ततो वर्षशतस्यान्ते देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
तुष्टस्तु परया भक्त्या तमुवाच हसन्निव .. 29.15 ..
6.3.m: then, at the end of the hundred years, Maheśvara, the god of gods, / pleased by his supreme devotion, said to him, as if smiling:

6.3.s:
bhobho yakṣa mahāsattva varaṃ varaya suvrata .
parituṣṭo'smi te bhaktyā tava dāsye yathepsitam .. 29.16 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो यक्ष महासत्त्व वरं वरय सुव्रत .
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते भक्त्या तव दास्ये यथेप्सितम् .. 29.16 ..
6.3.m: 'O Yakṣa of great strength, choose a boon, O you of virtuous vows! / I am well pleased with your devotion; I shall give you whatever you desire.'

6.3.s:
yakṣa uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa umayā saha śaṅkara .
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ yakṣāṇāmadhipo bhave .. 29.17 ..
6.3.d:
यक्ष उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश उमया सह शङ्कर .
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषां यक्षाणामधिपो भवे .. 29.17 ..
