6.3.m: The Yakṣa said: / 'If you are pleased, O Lord of gods, O Śaṅkara, together with Umā, / may I become from this day forward the sovereign of all Yakṣas,

6.3.s:
akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva tava bhaktipuraḥsaraḥ .
dharme matiṃ ca me nityaṃ dadasva parameśvara .. 29.18 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव तव भक्तिपुरःसरः .
धर्मे मतिं च मे नित्यं ददस्व परमेश्वर .. 29.18 ..
6.3.m: imperishable and undecaying, ever foremost in devotion to you; / and grant me, O Supreme Lord, a mind ever fixed on righteousness!'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
yattvayā prārthitaṃ sarvaṃ phalaṃ dharmasya tattathā .
ityevamuktvā taṃ tatra jagāmādarśanaṃ haraḥ .. 29.19 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
यत्त्वया प्रार्थितं सर्वं फलं धर्मस्य तत्तथा .
इत्येवमुक्त्वा तं तत्र जगामादर्शनं हरः .. 29.19 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
Everything that was requested by you, that fruit of righteousness shall be so.
Having thus spoken to him there, Hara vanished from sight.

6.3.s:
so'pi snātvā vidhānena saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .
āmantrayitvā tattīrthaṃ kṛtārthaśca gṛhaṃ yayau .. 29.20 ..
6.3.d:
सोऽपि स्नात्वा विधानेन संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः .
आमन्त्रयित्वा तत्तीर्थं कृतार्थश्च गृहं ययौ .. 29.20 ..
6.3.m:
Having bathed according to rule, satisfied the ancestors and deities,
and taken leave of that sacred ford, he went home fulfilled.

6.3.s:
pūjitastatra yakṣaistu so'bhiṣikto vidhānataḥ .
cakāra vipulaṃ tatra rājyamīpsitamuttamam .. 29.21 ..
6.3.d:
पूजितस्तत्र यक्षैस्तु सोऽभिषिक्तो विधानतः .
चकार विपुलं तत्र राज्यमीप्सितमुत्तमम् .. 29.21 ..
6.3.m:
Worshipped there by the yakṣas and consecrated according to rule,
he ruled a vast, desired, and supreme kingdom there.

6.3.s:
tatra cānye surāḥ siddhā yakṣagandharvakiṃnarāḥ .
gaṇāścāpsarasāṃ tatra ṛṣayaśca tathānagha .. 29.22 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र चान्ये सुराः सिद्धा यक्षगन्धर्वकिंनराः .
गणाश्चाप्सरसां तत्र ऋषयश्च तथानघ .. 29.22 ..
6.3.m:
Other gods, siddhas, yakṣas, gandharvas, and kiṃnaras were there,
as well as groups of apsarases and seers there, O sinless one.

6.3.s:
kāverīsaṅgamaṃ tena sarvapāpaharaṃ viduḥ .
svargāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ dvārametadyudhiṣṭhira .. 29.23 ..
6.3.d:
कावेरीसङ्गमं तेन सर्वपापहरं विदुः .
स्वर्गाणामपि सर्वेषां द्वारमेतद्युधिष्ठिर .. 29.23 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore, they know the confluence of the Kāverī to remove all sins;
this is also the gateway to all heavens, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam .
kāverīsaṅgame snātvā yairdattaṃ hi tilodakam .. 29.24 ..
6.3.d:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् .
कावेरीसङ्गमे स्नात्वा यैर्दत्तं हि तिलोदकम् .. 29.24 ..
6.3.m:
Blessed are they, great-souled are they, well-lived is their life,
by whom water with sesame seeds is offered after bathing at the confluence of the Kāverī.

6.3.s:
daśa pūrve pare tāta mātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā .
pitaraḥ pitāmahāstena uddhṛtā narakārṇavāt .. 29.25 ..
6.3.d:
दश पूर्वे परे तात मातृतः पितृतस्तथा .
पितरः पितामहास्तेन उद्धृता नरकार्णवात् .. 29.25 ..
6.3.m:
Ten [generations] before and after, dear one, on the mother's side as well as on the father's,
fathers and grandfathers are raised up by him from the ocean of hell.

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snāyīta mānavaḥ .
arcayedīśvaraṃ devaṃ yadīcchecchāśvatīṃ gatim .. 29.26 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नायीत मानवः .
अर्चयेदीश्वरं देवं यदीच्छेच्छाश्वतीं गतिम् .. 29.26 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore, with every effort, a man should bathe there
and worship Lord Īśvara if he desires an eternal state.

6.3.s:
kāverīsaṅgame rājansnānadānārcanaṃ naraiḥ .
kṛtaṃ bhaktyā naraśreṣṭha aśvamedhādhikaṃ phalam .. 29.27 ..
6.3.d:
कावेरीसङ्गमे राजन्स्नानदानार्चनं नरैः .
कृतं भक्त्या नरश्रेष्ठ अश्वमेधाधिकं फलम् .. 29.27 ..
6.3.m:
Ablution, charity, and worship performed with devotion by men at the confluence of the Kāverī,
O best of men, O king, yield a fruit greater than the horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
homena cākṣayaḥ svargo japādāyurvivardhate .
dhyānato nityamāyāti padaṃ śivakalātmakam .. 29.28 ..
6.3.d:
होमेन चाक्षयः स्वर्गो जपादायुर्विवर्धते .
ध्यानतो नित्यमायाति पदं शिवकलात्मकम् .. 29.28 ..
6.3.m:
Through oblations imperishable heaven is attained, through silent recitation life span increases,
and through meditation one always reaches the state consisting of the digits of Śiva.

6.3.s:
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe nareśvara .
agniloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 29.29 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरेश्वर .
अग्निलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 29.29 ..
6.3.m:
A person who enters fire at that sacred ford, O lord of men,
dwells in the world of Agni until the universal dissolution.

6.3.s:
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yadvai tacchṛṇuṣva narottama .. 29.30 ..
6.3.d:
अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .
तस्य पुण्यफलं यद्वै तच्छृणुष्व नरोत्तम .. 29.30 ..
6.3.m:
He who observes fasting until death at that sacred ford, O king,
listen to that meritorious fruit of his, O best of men:

6.3.s:
gandharvāpsaraḥsaṃkīrṇe vimāne sūryasannibhe .
vījyamāno varastrībhirdaivataiḥ saha modate .. 29.31 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धर्वाप्सरःसंकीर्णे विमाने सूर्यसन्निभे .
वीज्यमानो वरस्त्रीभिर्दैवतैः सह मोदते .. 29.31 ..
6.3.m:
In an aerial chariot resembling the sun, crowded with gandharvas and apsarases,
fanned by excellent women, he rejoices with the gods.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca .
krīḍate rudralokasthastadante bhuvi cāgataḥ .. 29.32 ..
6.3.d:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि षष्टिवर्षशतानि च .
क्रीडते रुद्रलोकस्थस्तदन्ते भुवि चागतः .. 29.32 ..
6.3.m:
For sixty-six thousand years
he disports dwelling in the world of Rudra, and at its end, having come to the earth,

6.3.s:
bhogavāndānaśīlaśca jāyate pṛthivīpatiḥ .
ādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 29.33 ..
6.3.d:
भोगवान्दानशीलश्च जायते पृथिवीपतिः .
आधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 29.33 ..
6.3.m:
he is born as an earthly sovereign, enjoying pleasures and given to charity;
freed from anguish and grief, he lives for a hundred autumns.

6.3.s:
evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇā kāverī sā sarinnṛpa .
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā narmadāsaṅgame sadā .. 29.34 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गुणगणाकीर्णा कावेरी सा सरिन्नृप .
त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्याता नर्मदासङ्गमे सदा .. 29.34 ..
6.3.m:
Thus endowed with an abundance of virtues, that river Kāverī, O king,
is celebrated throughout the three worlds, always at the confluence with the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
jitavākkāyacittāśca dhyeyadhyānaratāstathā .
kāverīsaṅgame tāta te'pi mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ .. 29.35 ..
6.3.d:
जितवाक्कायचित्ताश्च ध्येयध्यानरतास्तथा .
कावेरीसङ्गमे तात तेऽपि मोक्षमवाप्नुयुः .. 29.35 ..
6.3.m:
Those who have subdued speech, body, and mind, and are devoted to the meditation on the object of contemplation,
at the confluence of the Kāverī, dear one, they too attain liberation.

6.3.s:
śṛṇu te'nyatpravakṣyāmi āścaryaṃ nṛpasattama .
triṣu lokeṣu kā tvanyā dṛśyate saritā samā .. 29.36 ..
6.3.d:
शृणु तेऽन्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि आश्चर्यं नृपसत्तम .
त्रिषु लोकेषु का त्वन्या दृश्यते सरिता समा .. 29.36 ..
6.3.m:
Listen, I shall tell you another wonder, O best of kings:
what other river is seen in the three worlds equal to her?

6.3.s:
labdhaṃ yairnarmadātoyaṃ ye ca kuryuḥ pradakṣiṇam .
ye pibanti jalaṃ tatra te puṇyā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29.37 ..
6.3.d:
लब्धं यैर्नर्मदातोयं ये च कुर्युः प्रदक्षिणम् .
ये पिबन्ति जलं तत्र ते पुण्या नात्र संशयः .. 29.37 ..
6.3.m:
Those by whom the water of the Narmadā is obtained and who make circumambulation,
and those who drink the water there, they are meritorious, there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
na teṣāṃ santaticchedo daśa janmāni pañca ca .
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ vilīyeta himaṃ sūryodaye yathā .. 29.38 ..
6.3.d:
न तेषां सन्ततिच्छेदो दश जन्मानि पञ्च च .
तेषां पापं विलीयेत हिमं सूर्योदये यथा .. 29.38 ..
6.3.m:
There is no break in their lineage for fifteen births;
their sin dissolves like snow at sunrise.

6.3.s:
gaṅgāyamunasaṅge vai yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ .
tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ kāverīsnānamācaran .. 29.39 ..
6.3.d:
गङ्गायमुनसङ्गे वै यत्फलं लभते नरः .
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्यः कावेरीस्नानमाचरन् .. 29.39 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever fruit a man obtains at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā,
that fruit a mortal obtains by bathing in the Kāverī.

6.3.s:
bhaume tu bhūtajāyoge vyatīpāte ca saṃkrame .
rāhusomasamāyoge tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam .. 29.40 ..
6.3.d:
भौमे तु भूतजायोगे व्यतीपाते च संक्रमे .
राहुसोमसमायोगे तदेवाष्टगुणं स्मृतम् .. 29.40 ..
6.3.m:
On a Tuesday, at an astrological conjunction of the spirits, at Vyatīpāta, at a solstice or transit,
and at an eclipse of the moon by Rāhu, it is remembered to be eightfold.

6.3.s:
aśītiśca yavāḥ proktā gaṅgāyāmunasaṅgame .
kāverīnarmadāyoge tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam .. 29.41 ..
6.3.d:
अशीतिश्च यवाः प्रोक्ता गङ्गायामुनसङ्गमे .
कावेरीनर्मदायोगे तदेवाष्टगुणं स्मृतम् .. 29.41 ..
6.3.m:
Eighty barley grains are declared [as merit] at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Yamunā;
at the union of the Kāverī and Narmadā, it is remembered to be eightfold.

6.3.s:
gaṅgā ṣaṣṭisahasraistu kṣetrapālaiḥ prapūjyate .
tadardhairanyatīrthāni rakṣante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 29.42 ..
6.3.d:
गङ्गा षष्टिसहस्रैस्तु क्षेत्रपालैः प्रपूज्यते .
तदर्धैरन्यतीर्थानि रक्षन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 29.42 ..
6.3.m:
The Gaṅgā is worshipped by sixty thousand guardians of the field;
half that number protect other sacred fords, there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
amareśvare tu saritāṃ ye yogāḥ parikīrtitāḥ .
te tvaśītisahasraistu kṣetrapālaistu rakṣitāḥ .. 29.43 ..
6.3.d:
अमरेश्वरे तु सरितां ये योगाः परिकीर्तिताः .
ते त्वशीतिसहस्रैस्तु क्षेत्रपालैस्तु रक्षिताः .. 29.43 ..
6.3.m:
At Amareśvara, the confluences of rivers that are celebrated
are protected by eighty thousand guardians of the field.

6.3.s:
tathāmareśvare yāmye liṅgaṃ vai capaleśvaram .
dvitīyaṃ caṇḍahastākhyaṃ dve liṅge tīrtharakṣake .. 29.44 ..
6.3.d:
तथामरेश्वरे याम्ये लिङ्गं वै चपलेश्वरम् .
द्वितीयं चण्डहस्ताख्यं द्वे लिङ्गे तीर्थरक्षके .. 29.44 ..
6.3.m:
Likewise, to the south of Amareśvara is the liṅga Capaleśvara;
the second is named Caṇḍahasta: these two liṅgas are protectors of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
śivena sthāpite pūrvaṃ kāveryādyabhirakṣake .
lakṣeṇa rakṣitā devī narmadā bahukalpagā .. 29.45 ..
6.3.d:
शिवेन स्थापिते पूर्वं कावेर्याद्यभिरक्षके .
लक्षेण रक्षिता देवी नर्मदा बहुकल्पगा .. 29.45 ..
6.3.m:
Established formerly by Śiva to protect the Kāverī and others,
the goddess Narmadā, flowing through many aeons, is protected by a hundred thousand.

6.3.s:
dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭyabhiyutaiḥ puruṣairīśayojitaiḥ .
oṃ kāraśatasāhasraiḥ parvataścābhirakṣitaḥ .. 29.46 ..
6.3.d:
धनुषां षष्ट्यभियुतैः पुरुषैरीशयोजितैः .
ओं कारशतसाहस्रैः पर्वतश्चाभिरक्षितः .. 29.46 ..
6.3.m:
By men equipped with sixty bows appointed by the Lord,
and by hundreds of thousands of Oṃkāras, the mountain is protected.

6.3.s:
anyadeśakṛtaṃ pāpamasmin kṣetre vinaśyati .
asmiṃstīrthe kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepo bhaviṣyati .. 29.47 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यदेशकृतं पापमस्मिन् क्षेत्रे विनश्यति .
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे कृतं पापं वज्रलेपो भविष्यति .. 29.47 ..
6.3.m:
Sin committed in another region is destroyed in this sacred field;
but sin committed in this sacred ford will become an indelible stain.

6.3.s:
eṣā te kathitā tāta kāverī saritāṃ varā .
rudradehasamutpannā tena puṇyā saridvarā .. 29.48 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye kāverīsaṅgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 30
6.3.d:
एषा ते कथिता तात कावेरी सरितां वरा .
रुद्रदेहसमुत्पन्ना तेन पुण्या सरिद्वरा .. 29.48 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये कावेरीसङ्गममाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 30
6.3.m:
This has been told to you, dear one, the Kāverī, the best of rivers;
born from the body of Rudra, therefore she is the best, holy river.
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Confluence of the Kāverī', in the Glory of the Narmadā, in the Section on the Revā, in the fifth Section on Avantī, in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 30

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadottarakūle tu dārutīrthamanuttamam .
yatra siddho mahābhāga tapastaptvā dvijottamaḥ .. 30.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदोत्तरकूले तु दारुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महाभाग तपस्तप्त्वा द्विजोत्तमः .. 30.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the northern bank of the Narmadā is Dārutīrtha, unsurpassed,
where, having performed austerity, an excellent twice-born attained perfection, O fortunate one.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
ko'sau dvijavaraśreṣṭhaḥ siddhastatra mahāmune .
dāruketi sutaḥ kasya etanme vaktumarhasi .. 30.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कोऽसौ द्विजवरश्रेष्ठः सिद्धस्तत्र महामुने .
दारुकेति सुतः कस्य एतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि .. 30.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Who was that best of excellent twice-born that attained perfection there, O great sage?
Whose son was Dāruka? You ought to tell me this.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhārgave vipule vaṃśe dhīmato devaśārmaṇaḥ .
dārurnāma mahābhāgo vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ .. 30.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भार्गवे विपुले वंशे धीमतो देवशार्मणः .
दारुर्नाम महाभागो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः .. 30.3 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
In the vast lineage of Bhṛgu, [born] to the wise Devaśarman,
was the fortunate one named Dāru, a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

6.3.s:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho vidhikramāt .
yatidharmavidhānena cacāra vipulatapaḥ .. 30.4 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थो विधिक्रमात् .
यतिधर्मविधानेन चचार विपुलतपः .. 30.4 ..
6.3.m:
As a celibate student, householder, and forest dweller in proper order,
and according to the rule of the ascetic's way of life, he performed immense austerity.

6.3.s:
dhyāyanvai sa mahādevaṃ nirāhāro yudhiṣṭhira .
uvāsa tīrthe tasmin vai yāvatprāṇaparikṣayam .. 30.5 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यायन्वै स महादेवं निराहारो युधिष्ठिर .
उवास तीर्थे तस्मिन् वै यावत्प्राणपरिक्षयम् .. 30.5 ..
6.3.m:
Meditating on Mahādeva, fasting, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
he lived at that sacred ford until the exhaustion of his vital breaths.

6.3.s:
tasya nāmnā tu tattīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .
tatra snātvā vidhānena arcayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 30.6 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य नाम्ना तु तत्तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन अर्चयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 30.6 ..
6.3.m:
By his name that sacred ford became renowned throughout the three worlds.
Having bathed there according to rule, one should worship the ancestors and the deities.

6.3.s:
satyavādī jitakrodhaḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ .
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti rājannatraiva savarthā .. 30.7 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यवादी जितक्रोधः सर्वभूतहिते रतः .
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति राजन्नत्रैव सवर्था .. 30.7 ..
6.3.m:
Speaking the truth, having subdued anger, devoted to the welfare of all beings,
one attains all desires right here in every way, O king.

6.3.s:
yaḥ kuryādupavāsaṃ ca satyaśaucaparāyaṇaḥ .
sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ cāsya sambhavatyavicāritam .. 30.8 ..
6.3.d:
यः कुर्यादुपवासं च सत्यशौचपरायणः .
सौत्रामणिफलं चास्य सम्भवत्यविचारितम् .. 30.8 ..
6.3.m:
He who observes fasting, intent on truth and purity,
the fruit of the Sautrāmaṇī sacrifice undoubtedly accrues to him.

6.3.s:
ṛgvedajāpī ṛgvedī sāma vā sāmapāragaḥ .
yajurvedī yajurjaptvā labhate phalamuttamam .. 30.9 ..
6.3.d:
ऋग्वेदजापी ऋग्वेदी साम वा सामपारगः .
यजुर्वेदी यजुर्जप्त्वा लभते फलमुत्तमम् .. 30.9 ..
6.3.m:
One who recites the Ṛgveda, knowing the Ṛgveda, or a master of the Sāmaveda with the Sāmans,
or a knower of the Yajurveda having recited the Yajus, obtains supreme fruit.

6.3.s:
prāṇāṃstyajati yo martyastasmiṃstīrthe vidhānataḥ .
anivartikā gatistasya ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 30.10 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dārutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 31
6.3.d:
प्राणांस्त्यजति यो मर्त्यस्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे विधानतः .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य इत्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 30.10 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दारुतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 31
6.3.m:
A mortal who gives up his vital breaths at that sacred ford according to rule
attains a state from which there is no return; thus Śaṃkara has said.
Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Dārutīrtha', in the Section on the Revā, in the fifth Section on Avantī, in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 31

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchecca rājendra tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam .
brahmāvartamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 31.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेच्च राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् .
ब्रह्मावर्तमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 31.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O king of kings, to the sacred ford renowned throughout the three worlds,
known as Brahmāvarta, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra saṃnihito brahmā nityasevī yudhiṣṭhira .
ūrdhvabāhurnirālambacakāra bhramaṇaṃ sadā .. 31.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र संनिहितो ब्रह्मा नित्यसेवी युधिष्ठिर .
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्निरालम्बचकार भ्रमणं सदा .. 31.2 ..
6.3.m:
There Brahmā is present, constantly attending [upon Śiva], O Yudhiṣṭhira;
with raised arms, without support, he always circumambulated.

6.3.s:
ekāhāravaśe'tiṣṭhaddvādaśābdaṃ mahāvratī .
atra tīrthe vidhānena cintayan vai maheśvaram .. 31.3 ..
6.3.d:
एकाहारवशेऽतिष्ठद्द्वादशाब्दं महाव्रती .
अत्र तीर्थे विधानेन चिन्तयन् वै महेश्वरम् .. 31.3 ..
6.3.m:
Submitting to one meal a day, the great ascetic stayed for twelve years
at this sacred ford, according to rule, meditating indeed upon Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
tena tatpuṇyamākhyātaṃ brahmāvartamiti prabho .
tatra snātvā vidhānena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 31.4 ..
6.3.d:
तेन तत्पुण्यमाख्यातं ब्रह्मावर्तमिति प्रभो .
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 31.4 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore that holy place is renowned as Brahmāvarta, O lord.
Having bathed there according to rule, one should offer libations to the ancestors and gods.

6.3.s:
arcayeddevamīśānaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā parameśvaram .
yatphalaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ vidhivaddakṣiṇāvatām .. 31.5 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चयेद्देवमीशानं विष्णुं वा परमेश्वरम् .
यत्फलं सर्वयज्ञानां विधिवद्दक्षिणावताम् .. 31.5 ..
6.3.m:
One should worship the god Īśāna, or Viṣṇu, the supreme lord.
Whatever fruit comes from all sacrifices accompanied by fees according to rule,

6.3.s:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tattīrthasya prabhāvataḥ .
yasmiṃstīrthe tu yo devo dānavo vā dvijo'tha vā .. 31.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति तत्तीर्थस्य प्रभावतः .
यस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो देवो दानवो वा द्विजोऽथ वा .. 31.6 ..
6.3.m:
he attains that fruit through the power of that sacred ford.
At whatever sacred ford a god, a Dānava, or a twice-born

6.3.s:
siddhastenaiva tannāmnā khyātaṃ loke mahacca tat .
na jalaṃ na sthalaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ vā hyūṣarāṇi ca .. 31.7 ..
6.3.d:
सिद्धस्तेनैव तन्नाम्ना ख्यातं लोके महच्च तत् .
न जलं न स्थलं नाम क्षेत्रं वा ह्यूषराणि च .. 31.7 ..
6.3.m:
attains perfection, that great [tīrtha] is renowned by that very name in the world.
Neither water nor ground, nor a field, nor barren soils,

6.3.s:
pavitratvaṃ labhantyete pauruṣeṇa vinā nṛṇām .
sāmarthyānniścayāddhairyātsidhyanti puruṣā nṛpa .. 31.8 ..
6.3.d:
पवित्रत्वं लभन्त्येते पौरुषेण विना नृणाम् .
सामर्थ्यान्निश्चयाद्धैर्यात्सिध्यन्ति पुरुषा नृप .. 31.8 ..
6.3.m:
attain purity without human effort.
Through capacity, resolve, and fortitude, men attain perfection, O king.

6.3.s: pramādāttasya lobhena patanti narake dhruvam .. 31.9 ..
6.3.d: प्रमादात्तस्य लोभेन पतन्ति नरके ध्रुवम् .. 31.9 ..
6.3.m: Through carelessness, out of greed for it, they surely fall into hell.

6.3.s:
saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatra yatra vasenmuniḥ .
tatra tatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca .. 31.10 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe brahmāvartatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 32
6.3.d:
संनिरुध्येन्द्रियग्रामं यत्र यत्र वसेन्मुनिः .
तत्र तत्र कुरुक्षेत्रं नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च .. 31.10 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ब्रह्मावर्ततीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 32
6.3.m:
Wherever a sage might dwell having restrained the multitude of senses,
there is Kurukṣetra, Naimiṣa, and Puṣkara.
Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, named the description of the greatness of the Brahmāvarta sacred ford, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, the great Purāṇa, in a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 32

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
pattreśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśanam .
yatra siddho mahābhāgaścitrasenasuto balī .. 32.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पत्त्रेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महाभागश्चित्रसेनसुतो बली .. 32.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go to Pattreśvara, which destroys all sins,
where the illustrious and powerful son of Citrasena attained perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
ko'sau siddhastadā brahmaṃstasmiṃstīrthe mahātapāḥ .
putraḥ kasya tu ko heturetadicchāmi veditum .. 32.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कोऽसौ सिद्धस्तदा ब्रह्मंस्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महातपाः .
पुत्रः कस्य तु को हेतुरेतदिच्छामि वेदितुम् .. 32.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Who was he, of great austerity, that attained perfection then at that sacred ford, O holy one?
Whose son was he, and what was the reason? This I wish to know.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
citronāma mahātejā indrasya dayitaḥ purā .
tasya putro nṛpaśreṣṭha pattreśvara iti śrutaḥ .. 32.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
चित्रोनाम महातेजा इन्द्रस्य दयितः पुरा .
तस्य पुत्रो नृपश्रेष्ठ पत्त्रेश्वर इति श्रुतः .. 32.3 ..

6.3.s:
rūpavān subhagaścaiva sarvaśatrubhayaṃkaraḥ .
indrasya dayito'tyarthaṃ jaya ityeva cāparaḥ .. 32.4 ..
6.3.d:
रूपवान् सुभगश्चैव सर्वशत्रुभयंकरः .
इन्द्रस्य दयितोऽत्यर्थं जय इत्येव चापरः .. 32.4 ..
6.3.m:
He was handsome, fortunate, causing terror to all enemies,
exceedingly dear to Indra, and also known as Jaya.

6.3.s:
sa kadācitsabhāmadhye sarvadevasamāgame .
menakānṛtyagītena mohitaḥ suciraṃ kila .. 32.5 ..
6.3.d:
स कदाचित्सभामध्ये सर्वदेवसमागमे .
मेनकानृत्यगीतेन मोहितः सुचिरं किल .. 32.5 ..
6.3.m:
Once, in the midst of the assembly at a gathering of all the gods,
he was completely infatuated for a long time, it is said, by Menakā's dance and song.

6.3.s:
tiṣṭhate gatamaryādo gataprāṇa iva kṣaṇāt .
tāvatsurapatirdevaḥ śaśāpāthājitendriyam .. 32.6 ..
6.3.d:
तिष्ठते गतमर्यादो गतप्राण इव क्षणात् .
तावत्सुरपतिर्देवः शशापाथाजितेन्द्रियम् .. 32.6 ..
6.3.m:
Transgressing all bounds of decorum, he stood as if lifeless in an instant;
then the god, the lord of the gods, cursed the one who had not conquered his senses:

6.3.s:
yasmāttvaṃ svargasaṃstho'pi martyadharmamupeyivān .
tasmānmartye ciraṃ kālaṃ kṣapayiṣyasyasaṃśayam .. 32.7 ..
6.3.d:
यस्मात्त्वं स्वर्गसंस्थोऽपि मर्त्यधर्ममुपेयिवान् .
तस्मान्मर्त्ये चिरं कालं क्षपयिष्यस्यसंशयम् .. 32.7 ..
6.3.m:
"Since you, though residing in heaven, have succumbed to mortal conduct,
therefore you shall undoubtedly spend a long time among mortals."

6.3.s:
evamuktaḥ surendreṇa citrasenasuto yuvā .
vepamānaḥ suraśreṣṭhaḥ kṛtāñjaliruvāca ha .. 32.8 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तः सुरेन्द्रेण चित्रसेनसुतो युवा .
वेपमानः सुरश्रेष्ठः कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह .. 32.8 ..
6.3.m:
Thus addressed by the lord of gods, the young son of Citrasena,
trembling, the foremost of gods, spoke with folded hands:

6.3.s:
pattreśvara uvāca -
mayā pāpena mūḍhena ajitendriyacetasā .
prāptaṃ vai yatphalaṃ tasya prasādaṃ kartumarhasi .. 32.9 ..
6.3.d:
पत्त्रेश्वर उवाच -
मया पापेन मूढेन अजितेन्द्रियचेतसा .
प्राप्तं वै यत्फलं तस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 32.9 ..

6.3.s:
śakra uvāca -
narmadātaṭamāśritya dvādaśābdaṃ jitendriyaḥ .
ārādhaya śivaṃ śāntaṃ punaḥ prāpsyasi sadgatim .. 32.10 ..
6.3.d:
शक्र उवाच -
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य द्वादशाब्दं जितेन्द्रियः .
आराधय शिवं शान्तं पुनः प्राप्स्यसि सद्गतिम् .. 32.10 ..
6.3.m:
Śakra said:
"Taking refuge on the bank of the Narmadā for twelve years with senses controlled,
worship the peaceful Śiva; you shall attain the good path once again.

6.3.s:
satyaśaucaratānāṃ ca dharmiṣṭhānāṃ jitātmanām .
loko'yaṃ pāpināṃ naiva iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ .. 32.11 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यशौचरतानां च धर्मिष्ठानां जितात्मनाम् .
लोकोऽयं पापिनां नैव इति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः .. 32.11 ..
6.3.m:
This world is for those devoted to truth and purity, the highly righteous who have conquered themselves,
not for sinners; such is the determination of scripture."

6.3.s:
evamukte mahārāja sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā .
gandharvatanayo dhīmānpraṇamyāgāttu bhūtalam .. 32.12 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्ते महाराज सहस्राक्षेण धीमता .
गन्धर्वतनयो धीमान्प्रणम्यागात्तु भूतलम् .. 32.12 ..
6.3.m:
When thus addressed by the wise thousand-eyed [Indra], O great king,
the wise son of the Gandharva, having bowed, went to the earth's surface.

6.3.s:
revāyā vimale toye brahmāvartasamīpataḥ .
snātvā japtvā vidhānena arcayitvā ca śaṅkaram .. 32.13 ..
6.3.d:
रेवाया विमले तोये ब्रह्मावर्तसमीपतः .
स्नात्वा जप्त्वा विधानेन अर्चयित्वा च शङ्करम् .. 32.13 ..
6.3.m:
In the clear waters of the Revā, near Brahmāvarta,
having bathed, recited prayers according to rule, and worshipped Śaṅkara,

6.3.s:
vāyvambupiṇyākaphalaiśca puṣpaiḥ parṇaiśca mūlāśanayāvakena .
tatāpa pañcāgnitapobhirugraistataśca toṣaṃ samagātsa devaḥ .. 32.14 ..
6.3.d:
वाय्वम्बुपिण्याकफलैश्च पुष्पैः पर्णैश्च मूलाशनयावकेन .
तताप पञ्चाग्नितपोभिरुग्रैस्ततश्च तोषं समगात्स देवः .. 32.14 ..
6.3.m: he performed austerities with the severe discipline of the five fires, eating air, water, oil-cake, fruits, / flowers, leaves, roots, and barley gruel; then the god attained satisfaction.

6.3.s:
pinākapāṇiṃ varadaṃ triśūlinamumāpatiṃ hyandhakanāśanaṃ ca .
candrārdhamauliṃ gajakṛttivāsasaṃ dṛṣṭvā papātāgragataṃ samīkṣya .. 32.15 ..
6.3.d:
पिनाकपाणिं वरदं त्रिशूलिनमुमापतिं ह्यन्धकनाशनं च .
चन्द्रार्धमौलिं गजकृत्तिवाससं दृष्ट्वा पपाताग्रगतं समीक्ष्य .. 32.15 ..
6.3.m: Seeing him before him—bow in hand, the boon-giver with the trident, husband of Umā, destroyer of Andhaka, / crescent-moon on his crest, clad in an elephant hide—he fell down, beholding him.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te varado'haṃ tavānagha .
yamicchasi dadāmyadya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 32.16 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते वरदोऽहं तवानघ .
यमिच्छसि ददाम्यद्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 32.16 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
"Choose a boon, bless you; I am your boon-giver, O sinless one.
Whatever you desire, I give today; no hesitation should be made here."

6.3.s:
pattreśvara uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama .
atra tvaṃ satataṃ tīrthe mama nāmnā bhava prabho .. 32.17 ..
6.3.d:
पत्त्रेश्वर उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम .
अत्र त्वं सततं तीर्थे मम नाम्ना भव प्रभो .. 32.17 ..
6.3.m:
Pattreśvara said:
"If you are pleased, O lord of gods, if a boon is to be given to me,
remain perpetually at this sacred ford by my name, O lord."

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā mahādevo harṣagadgadayā girā .
tathetyuktvā yayau hṛṣṭa umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ .. 32.18 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा .
तथेत्युक्त्वा ययौ हृष्ट उमया सह शङ्करः .. 32.18 ..
6.3.m:
Having heard this, Mahādeva Śaṅkara, with a voice choked with joy,
said 'So be it,' and departed delighted along with Umā.

6.3.s:
so'pi tattīrthamāplutya gate deve divaṃ prati .
snātvā jāpyavidhānena tarpayitvā pitṝn punaḥ .. 32.19 ..
6.3.d:
सोऽपि तत्तीर्थमाप्लुत्य गते देवे दिवं प्रति .
स्नात्वा जाप्यविधानेन तर्पयित्वा पितॄन् पुनः .. 32.19 ..
6.3.m:
When the god had gone to heaven, he too, having immersed himself in that sacred ford,
having bathed according to the rule of recitation, and having again offered libations to the ancestors,

6.3.s:
sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe vidhānataḥ .
pattreśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhārata .. 32.20 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापयामास देवेशं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे विधानतः .
पत्त्रेश्वरं तु विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत .. 32.20 ..
6.3.m:
installed the lord of gods at that sacred ford according to rule—
[the liṅga] renowned in the three worlds as Pattreśvara, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s:
indralokaṃ gataḥ śāpānmuktaḥ so'pi nareśvara .
hṛṣṭaḥ pramudito ramyaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ .. 32.21 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रलोकं गतः शापान्मुक्तः सोऽपि नरेश्वर .
हृष्टः प्रमुदितो रम्यं जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः .. 32.21 ..
6.3.m:
He also, freed from the curse, went to the realm of Indra, O king of men,
delighted and rejoiced with auspicious sounds of victory and the like.

6.3.s:
eṣa te kathitaḥ praśnaḥ pṛṣṭo yo vai yudhiṣṭhira .
tatra snānena caikena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 32.22 ..
6.3.d:
एष ते कथितः प्रश्नः पृष्टो यो वै युधिष्ठिर .
तत्र स्नानेन चैकेन सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 32.22 ..
6.3.m:
This answer has been told to you regarding what you asked, O Yudhiṣṭhira;
by a single bath there, one is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
yastvarcayenmahādevaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
snātvābhyarcya pitḥn devān so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 32.23 ..
6.3.d:
यस्त्वर्चयेन्महादेवं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
स्नात्वाभ्यर्च्य पित्ःन् देवान् सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 32.23 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever should worship Mahādeva at that sacred ford, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
having bathed and worshipped the ancestors and gods, attains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice.

6.3.s:
mṛto varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ krīḍitvā ca śive pure .
rājā vā rājatulyo vā paścānmartyeṣu jāyate .. 32.24 ..
6.3.d:
मृतो वर्षशतं साग्रं क्रीडित्वा च शिवे पुरे .
राजा वा राजतुल्यो वा पश्चान्मर्त्येषु जायते .. 32.24 ..
6.3.m:
When dead, having sported for fully a hundred years in Śiva's city,
he is afterwards born among mortals as a king or equal to a king,

6.3.s:
vedavedāṅgatattvajño jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam .
vyādhiśokavinirmuktaḥ punaḥ smarati tajjalam .. 32.25 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe patreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 33
6.3.d:
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो जीवेच्च शरदः शतम् .
व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तः पुनः स्मरति तज्जलम् .. 32.25 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पत्रेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 33
6.3.m:
knowing the truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas; and he lives for a hundred autumns,
freed from disease and grief, and again remembers that water.
Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, named the description of the greatness of the Patreśvara sacred ford, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, the great Purāṇa, in a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 33

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam .
yatra saṃnihito hyagnirgataḥ kāmena mohitaḥ .. 33.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र अग्नितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र संनिहितो ह्यग्निर्गतः कामेन मोहितः .. 33.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O king of kings, to the unsurpassed Agnitīrtha,
where Agni is indeed present, having arrived deluded by desire.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ .
kathaṃ ca nityadā vāsa ekasthāneṣu jāyate .. 33.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं देवो जगद्धाता कामेन कलुषीकृतः .
कथं च नित्यदा वास एकस्थानेषु जायते .. 33.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How was the god, the maintainer of the world, sullied by desire,
and how does his eternal dwelling come to be in a single place?

6.3.s:
etattvāścaryamatulaṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttamam .
kathayasva mahābhāga paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 33.3 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्त्वाश्चर्यमतुलं सर्वलोकेष्वनुत्तमम् .
कथयस्व महाभाग परं कौतूहलं मम .. 33.3 ..
6.3.m:
This is an incomparable wonder, unsurpassed in all the worlds;
tell it, O illustrious one; my curiosity is supreme.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña pṛṣṭaḥ praśnastvayānagha .
kathayāmi yathāpūrvaṃ śrutametanmaheśvarāt .. 33.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ पृष्टः प्रश्नस्त्वयानघ .
कथयामि यथापूर्वं श्रुतमेतन्महेश्वरात् .. 33.4 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'Well said, well said, O great in wisdom, sinless one! You have asked a question. / I shall recount what was formerly heard from Maheśvara. 33.4

6.3.s:
āsītkṛtayuge rājā nāmnā duryodhano mahān .
hastyaśvarathasampūrṇo medinīparipālakaḥ .. 33.5 ..
6.3.d:
आसीत्कृतयुगे राजा नाम्ना दुर्योधनो महान् .
हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्णो मेदिनीपरिपालकः .. 33.5 ..
6.3.m: In the Kṛtayuga there was a great king named Duryodhana, / abundant in elephants, horses, and chariots, a protector of the earth. 33.5

6.3.s:
rūpayauvanasampannaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ pṛthivīpatim .
divyopabhogasampannaṃ prārthayāmāsa narmadā .. 33.6 ..
6.3.d:
रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं दृष्ट्वा तं पृथिवीपतिम् .
दिव्योपभोगसम्पन्नं प्रार्थयामास नर्मदा .. 33.6 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that lord of the earth endowed with beauty and youth, / endowed with divine enjoyments, Narmadā wooed him. 33.6

6.3.s:
sa tu tāṃ cakame kanyāṃ tyaktvā'nyaṃ pramadājanam .
mudā paramayā yukto māhiṣmatyāḥ patirnṛpa .. 33.7 ..
6.3.d:
स तु तां चकमे कन्यां त्यक्त्वाऽन्यं प्रमदाजनम् .
मुदा परमया युक्तो माहिष्मत्याः पतिर्नृप .. 33.7 ..
6.3.m: He, forsaking other women, desired that maiden, / filled with supreme joy, O king, the lord of Māhiṣmatī. 33.7

6.3.s:
ramate sa tayā sārddhaṃ kāle vai nṛpasattama .
narmadā janayāmāsa kanyāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām .. 33.8 ..
6.3.d:
रमते स तया सार्द्धं काले वै नृपसत्तम .
नर्मदा जनयामास कन्यां पद्मदलेक्षणाम् .. 33.8 ..
6.3.m: He disported with her in due time, O best of kings; / Narmadā gave birth to a daughter with eyes like lotus petals. 33.8

6.3.s:
aṅgapratyaṅgasampannā yasmāllokeṣu viśrutā .
tasyāṃ pitā ca mātā ca cakratuḥ premabandhanam .. 33.9 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गसम्पन्ना यस्माल्लोकेषु विश्रुता .
तस्यां पिता च माता च चक्रतुः प्रेमबन्धनम् .. 33.9 ..
6.3.m: Because she was renowned in the worlds for the perfection of all her limbs, / her father and mother bound her with affection. 33.9

6.3.s:
kālenātisudīrgheṇa yauvanasthā varāṅganā .
prārthyamānāpi rājanvai nātmānaṃ dātumicchati .. 33.10 ..
6.3.d:
कालेनातिसुदीर्घेण यौवनस्था वराङ्गना .
प्रार्थ्यमानापि राजन्वै नात्मानं दातुमिच्छति .. 33.10 ..
6.3.m: In the fullness of time that excellent woman came of age; / though wooed, O king, she did not wish to give herself away. 33.10

6.3.s:
tato'nyadivase vahnirdvijarūpo mahātapāḥ .
rājānaṃ prārthayāmāsa raho gatvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ .. 33.11 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽन्यदिवसे वह्निर्द्विजरूपो महातपाः .
राजानं प्रार्थयामास रहो गत्वा शनैः शनैः .. 33.11 ..
6.3.m: Then one day the Fire-god, assuming the form of a twice-born, of great austerity, / approached the king in secret and slowly wooed him: 33.11

6.3.s:
bhobho raghukulaśreṣṭha dvijo'haṃ mandasantatiḥ .
daridro hyasahāyaśca bhāryārthe varayāmi tām .. 33.12 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो रघुकुलश्रेष्ठ द्विजोऽहं मन्दसन्ततिः .
दरिद्रो ह्यसहायश्च भार्यार्थे वरयामि ताम् .. 33.12 ..
6.3.m: "O best of the Raghu lineage, I am a twice-born of modest descent, / poor and without support; I choose her as my wife. 33.12

6.3.s:
kanyā sudarśanā nāma rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi .
tāṃ dadasva mahābhāga vardhate tava mandire .. 33.13 ..
6.3.d:
कन्या सुदर्शना नाम रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि .
तां ददस्व महाभाग वर्धते तव मन्दिरे .. 33.13 ..
6.3.m: The maiden is named Sudarśanā, peerless on earth in beauty; / give her to me, O highly fortunate one, she who grows up in your palace. 33.13

6.3.s:
brahmacaryeṇa nirviṇṇa ekākī kāmapīḍitaḥ .
yācamānasya me tāta prasādaṃ kartumarhasi .. 33.14 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मचर्येण निर्विण्ण एकाकी कामपीडितः .
याचमानस्य मे तात प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि .. 33.14 ..
6.3.m: Despondent through student celibacy, alone and tormented by desire, / to me who begs you, O lord, you ought to show favour." 33.14

6.3.s:
rājovāca -
nāhaṃ dravyavihīnasya asavarṇasya karhicit .
dāsyāmi svāṃ sutāṃ śubhrāṃ gamyatāṃ dvijapuṃgava .. 33.15 ..
6.3.d:
राजोवाच -
नाहं द्रव्यविहीनस्य असवर्णस्य कर्हिचित् .
दास्यामि स्वां सुतां शुभ्रां गम्यतां द्विजपुंगव .. 33.15 ..
6.3.m: The king said: / "Never shall I give my radiant daughter to one devoid of wealth / or outside my caste; go, O eminent twice-born!" 33.15

6.3.s:
evamuktastadā vahniḥ parāṃ pīḍāmupāgataḥ .
na kiṃciduktvā rājānaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata .. 33.16 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा वह्निः परां पीडामुपागतः .
न किंचिदुक्त्वा राजानं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .. 33.16 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed, the Fire-god was overcome with intense anguish; / saying nothing to the king, he vanished right there. 33.16

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ vipre rājā mantripurohitaiḥ .
mantrayitvātha kāle tu tuṣṭo makhamukhe sthitaḥ .. 33.17 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं विप्रे राजा मन्त्रिपुरोहितैः .
मन्त्रयित्वाथ काले तु तुष्टो मखमुखे स्थितः .. 33.17 ..
6.3.m: When the brahmin had disappeared, the king, having consulted with his ministers / and family priests in due time, stood pleased at the commencement of a sacrifice. 33.17

6.3.s:
yajataśca makhe bhaktyā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha bhārata .
tataścādarśanaṃ vahniḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmagāt .. 33.18 ..
6.3.d:
यजतश्च मखे भक्त्या ब्राह्मणैः सह भारत .
ततश्चादर्शनं वह्निः सर्वेषां पश्यतामगात् .. 33.18 ..
6.3.m: And as he offered sacrifice with devotion together with the brahmins, O descendant of Bharata, / the fire vanished before the eyes of all. 33.18

6.3.s:
viprā durmanaso bhūtvā gatā rājño hi mandiram .
vahnināśaṃ vimanaso rājānamidamabruvan .. 33.19 ..
6.3.d:
विप्रा दुर्मनसो भूत्वा गता राज्ञो हि मन्दिरम् .
वह्निनाशं विमनसो राजानमिदमब्रुवन् .. 33.19 ..
6.3.m: The brahmins, dejected in spirit, went to the king's palace; / bewildered by the disappearance of the fire, they spoke thus to the king. 33.19

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .
duryodhana mahārāja śrūyatāṃ mahadadbhutam .
na śrutaṃ na ca dṛṣṭaṃ vā kautukaṃ nṛpapuṃgava .. 33.20 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .
दुर्योधन महाराज श्रूयतां महदद्भुतम् .
न श्रुतं न च दृष्टं वा कौतुकं नृपपुंगव .. 33.20 ..
6.3.m: The brahmins said: / "O Great King Duryodhana, listen to a great wonder, / a strange event neither heard nor seen before, O bull among kings! 33.20

6.3.s:
agnikāryapravṛttānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vidhivannṛpa .
kenāpi hetunā vahnirdṛśyate na jvalatyuta .. 33.21 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निकार्यप्रवृत्तानां सर्वेषां विधिवन्नृप .
केनापि हेतुना वह्निर्दृश्यते न ज्वलत्युत .. 33.21 ..
6.3.m: Though all of us engaged in the fire-rites according to rule, O king, / for some reason the fire is not seen, nor does it blaze. 33.21

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā vipriyaṃ ghoraṃ rājā vipramukhāccyutam .
āsanātpatito bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ .. 33.22 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विप्रियं घोरं राजा विप्रमुखाच्च्युतम् .
आसनात्पतितो भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः .. 33.22 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that terrible, displeasing news fall from the brahmins' mouths, / the king fell from his seat to the ground like a tree cut at its roots. 33.22

6.3.s:
āśvasya ca muhūrtena unmatta iva saṃstadā .
nirīkṣya ca diśaḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 33.23 ..
6.3.d:
आश्वस्य च मुहूर्तेन उन्मत्त इव संस्तदा .
निरीक्ष्य च दिशः सर्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 33.23 ..
6.3.m: Reviving after a moment, being like one driven mad, / he looked in all directions and spoke these words: 33.23

6.3.s:
kimetadāścaryaparamiti bhobho dvijottamāḥ .
kathyatāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyā vibhāvya ca .. 33.24 ..
6.3.d:
किमेतदाश्चर्यपरमिति भोभो द्विजोत्तमाः .
कथ्यतां कारणं सर्वं शास्त्रदृष्ट्या विभाव्य च .. 33.24 ..
6.3.m: "What is this greatest of wonders, O best of the twice-born? / Tell me the whole reason, discerning it through the eye of scripture! 33.24

6.3.s:
mama vā duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidutāho bhavatāmiha .
yena naṣṭo'gniśālāyāṃ hutabhukkena hetunā .. 33.25 ..
6.3.d:
मम वा दुष्कृतं किंचिदुताहो भवतामिह .
येन नष्टोऽग्निशालायां हुतभुक्केन हेतुना .. 33.25 ..
6.3.m: Is it some misdeed of mine, or perhaps of yours here, / on account of which the fire has perished in the sanctuary of fire—by what cause? 33.25

6.3.s:
mantracchidramathānyadvā naiva kiṃcidadakṣiṇam .
kriyāhīnaṃ kṛtaṃ vātha kena vahnirna dṛśyate .. 33.26 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रच्छिद्रमथान्यद्वा नैव किंचिददक्षिणम् .
क्रियाहीनं कृतं वाथ केन वह्निर्न दृश्यते .. 33.26 ..
6.3.m: Was there a flaw in the mantras or else something without a fee? / Was it performed lacking proper rites? Why is the fire not seen? 33.26

6.3.s:
annahīno dahedrāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ .
dātāraṃ dakṣiṇāhīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ .. 33.27 ..
6.3.d:
अन्नहीनो दहेद्राष्ट्रं मन्त्रहीनस्तु ऋत्विजः .
दातारं दक्षिणाहीनो नास्ति यज्ञसमो रिपुः .. 33.27 ..
6.3.m: Lacking food, a sacrifice burns the realm; lacking mantras, the priests; / lacking a sacrificial fee, the patron: there is no enemy like a flawed sacrifice!" 33.27

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .
na mantrahīnā hi vayaṃ na ca rājanvrataistathā .
dravyeṇa ca na hīnastvamanyatpāpaṃ vicintyatām .. 33.28 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .
न मन्त्रहीना हि वयं न च राजन्व्रतैस्तथा .
द्रव्येण च न हीनस्त्वमन्यत्पापं विचिन्त्यताम् .. 33.28 ..
6.3.m: The brahmins said: / "We are not deficient in mantras, O king, nor in our vows; / nor are you deficient in wealth; reflect upon some other sin!" 33.28

6.3.s:
rājovāca -
tathāpi yūyaṃ sahitā upāyaṃ cintayantviti .
yena śreyo bhavennityamiha loke paratra ca .. 33.29 ..
6.3.d:
राजोवाच -
तथापि यूयं सहिता उपायं चिन्तयन्त्विति .
येन श्रेयो भवेन्नित्यमिह लोके परत्र च .. 33.29 ..
6.3.m: The king said: / "Nevertheless, devise a means together, / by which welfare may always ensue in this world and in the next." 33.29

6.3.s:
evamuktāstataḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ .
nirāhārāḥ sthitāḥ śarve yatra naṣṭo hutāśanaḥ .. 33.30 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तास्ततः सर्वे ब्राह्मणाः कृतनिश्चयाः .
निराहाराः स्थिताः शर्वे यत्र नष्टो हुताशनः .. 33.30 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed, all those brahmins made a firm resolve; / fasting, all of them remained where the fire had vanished. 33.30

6.3.s:
tataḥ svapne mahātejā hutabhugbrāhmaṇāṃstadā .
uvāca śrūyatāṃ sarvairmama nāśasya kāraṇam .. 33.31 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स्वप्ने महातेजा हुतभुग्ब्राह्मणांस्तदा .
उवाच श्रूयतां सर्वैर्मम नाशस्य कारणम् .. 33.31 ..
6.3.m: Then in a dream the fire of great splendour said to the brahmins: / 'Let the cause of my disappearance be heard by all! 33.31

6.3.s:
prārthito'yaṃ mayā rājā sutāṃ dātuṃ na cecchati .
tena naṣṭo'gniśaraṇādahaṃ bho dvijasattamāḥ .. 33.32 ..
6.3.d:
प्रार्थितोऽयं मया राजा सुतां दातुं न चेच्छति .
तेन नष्टोऽग्निशरणादहं भो द्विजसत्तमाः .. 33.32 ..
6.3.m: This king was wooed by me, but he does not wish to give his daughter; / therefore have I vanished from the sanctuary of fire, O best of the twice-born! 33.32

6.3.s:
yadi me svasutāṃ rājā dadāti paramārcitām .
tadāsya jvalamāno'haṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhāmi nānyathā .. 33.33 ..
6.3.d:
यदि मे स्वसुतां राजा ददाति परमार्चिताम् .
तदास्य ज्वलमानोऽहं गृहे तिष्ठामि नान्यथा .. 33.33 ..
6.3.m: If the king gives me his highly honoured daughter, / then, blazing, I shall dwell in his house, and not otherwise.' 33.33

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ viprā vaiśvānaramukhodgatam .
vismayotphullanayanā rājānamidamabruvan .. 33.34 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं विप्रा वैश्वानरमुखोद्गतम् .
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना राजानमिदमब्रुवन् .. 33.34 ..
6.3.m: Hearing those words issue from the mouth of the Fire-god, the brahmins, / their eyes wide with astonishment, spoke thus to the king: 33.34

6.3.s:
bhavato matamājñāya sarve gatvāgnimandiram .
nirāhārāḥ sthitā rātrau paśyāmo jātavedasam .. 33.35 ..
6.3.d:
भवतो मतमाज्ञाय सर्वे गत्वाग्निमन्दिरम् .
निराहाराः स्थिता रात्रौ पश्यामो जातवेदसम् .. 33.35 ..
6.3.m: "Knowing your will, we all went to the sanctuary of fire; / fasting through the night, we beheld the All-knowing Fire. 33.35

6.3.s:
tenoktāḥ svasutāṃ cettu rājā me dātumicchati .
tato'sya bhūyo'pi gṛhe jvale'haṃ nānyathā dvijāḥ .. 33.36 ..
6.3.d:
तेनोक्ताः स्वसुतां चेत्तु राजा मे दातुमिच्छति .
ततोऽस्य भूयोऽपि गृहे ज्वलेऽहं नान्यथा द्विजाः .. 33.36 ..
6.3.m: He told us: 'If the king is willing to give me his daughter, / then I shall blaze once more in his house, not otherwise, O twice-born!' 33.36

6.3.s: evaṃ jñātvā mahārāja svasutāṃ dātumarhasi .. 33.37 ..
6.3.d: एवं ज्ञात्वा महाराज स्वसुतां दातुमर्हसि .. 33.37 ..
6.3.m: Knowing this, O Great King, you ought to give your daughter." 33.37

6.3.s:
rājovāca -
bhavatāṃ tasya vā kāryaṃ devasya vacanaṃ hṛdi .
samayaṃ kartumicchāmi kanyādāne hyanuttamam .. 33.38 ..
6.3.d:
राजोवाच -
भवतां तस्य वा कार्यं देवस्य वचनं हृदि .
समयं कर्तुमिच्छामि कन्यादाने ह्यनुत्तमम् .. 33.38 ..
6.3.m: The king said: / "Your words, or the words of that god, are to be kept in mind; / I wish to make an unsurpassed condition regarding the gift of the maiden: 33.38

6.3.s:
mama saṃnihito nityaṃ gṛhe tiṣṭhatu pāvakaḥ .
dadāmi rucirāpāṅgīṃ nānyathā karavāṇi vai .. 33.39 ..
6.3.d:
मम संनिहितो नित्यं गृहे तिष्ठतु पावकः .
ददामि रुचिरापाङ्गीं नान्यथा करवाणि वै .. 33.39 ..
6.3.m: let the Fire-god dwell perpetually present in my house; / then I shall give her of charming side-glances; otherwise I shall not do so." 33.39

6.3.s:
evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ śrutvā tathāgniṃ prāpya satvaram .
kathayitvā vivāhena yojayāmāsurāśu vai .. 33.40 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ते ब्राह्मणाः श्रुत्वा तथाग्निं प्राप्य सत्वरम् .
कथयित्वा विवाहेन योजयामासुराशु वै .. 33.40 ..
6.3.m: Having heard this, those brahmins quickly approached the Fire-god, / informed him, and straightway united them in marriage. 33.40

6.3.s:
sudarśanāyā lābhena parituṣṭo hutāśanaḥ .
jvalate sannidhau nityaṃ māhiṣmatyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 33.41 ..
6.3.d:
सुदर्शनाया लाभेन परितुष्टो हुताशनः .
ज्वलते सन्निधौ नित्यं माहिष्मत्यां युधिष्ठिर .. 33.41 ..
6.3.m: Extremely pleased by obtaining Sudarśanā, the fire / blazes perpetually in close presence in Māhiṣmatī, O Yudhiṣṭhira. 33.41

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthamagnitīrthaṃ pracakṣate .
ye tatra pakṣasandhau tu snānadānaistu bhāvitāḥ .. 33.42 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभृति तत्तीर्थमग्नितीर्थं प्रचक्षते .
ये तत्र पक्षसन्धौ तु स्नानदानैस्तु भाविताः .. 33.42 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward that sacred ford is called Agnitīrtha. / Those who, purified there by bath and gifts at the junction of fortnights, 33.42

6.3.s:
tarpayanti pitṝn devāṃste'śvamedhaphalairyutāḥ .
suvarṇaṃ ye prayacchanti tasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .. 33.43 ..
6.3.d:
तर्पयन्ति पितॄन् देवांस्तेऽश्वमेधफलैर्युताः .
सुवर्णं ये प्रयच्छन्ति तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .. 33.43 ..
6.3.m: sate the ancestors and the gods, are endowed with the fruit of a horse sacrifice. / Those who give gold at that sacred ford, O ruler of men, 33.43

6.3.s:
pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ tatra jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .. 33.44 ..
6.3.d:
पृथ्वीदानफलं तत्र जायते नात्र संशयः .
अनाशकं तु यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .. 33.44 ..
6.3.m: gain the fruit of gifting the earth there—there is no doubt about this. / And whoever undertakes a fast unto death at that sacred ford, O ruler of men, 33.44

6.3.s:
sa mṛto hyagniloke tu krīḍate surapūjitaḥ .
eṣa te hyagnitīrthasya sambhavaḥ kathito mayā .. 33.45 ..
6.3.d:
स मृतो ह्यग्निलोके तु क्रीडते सुरपूजितः .
एष ते ह्यग्नितीर्थस्य सम्भवः कथितो मया .. 33.45 ..
6.3.m: upon dying plays in the world of Fire, worshiped by the gods. / Thus the origin of the Agnitīrtha has been related to you by me, 33.45

6.3.s:
sarvapāpaharaḥ puṇyaḥ śrutamātro narottama .
dhanyaḥ pāpaharo nityamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 33.46 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe'gnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 34
6.3.d:
सर्वपापहरः पुण्यः श्रुतमात्रो नरोत्तम .
धन्यः पापहरो नित्यमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 33.46 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डेऽग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 34
6.3.m:
destroying all sins, auspicious by the mere hearing of it, O best of men; / meritorious and ever-removing sin—thus spoke Śaṅkara.' 33.46
Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Agnitīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 34

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tatraiva tu bhavedanyadādityasya mahātmanaḥ .
kīrtayāmi naraśreṣṭha yadi te śravaṇe matiḥ .. 34.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तत्रैव तु भवेदन्यदादित्यस्य महात्मनः .
कीर्तयामि नरश्रेष्ठ यदि ते श्रवणे मतिः .. 34.1 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'Right there, however, is another [sacred ford] of the great-souled Āditya. / I shall proclaim it, O best among men, if your mind is inclined to hear.' / 34.1

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
etadāścaryamatulaṃ śrutvā tava mukhodgatam .
vismayāddhṛṣṭaromāhaṃ jāto'smi munisattama .. 34.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
एतदाश्चर्यमतुलं श्रुत्वा तव मुखोद्गतम् .
विस्मयाद्धृष्टरोमाहं जातोऽस्मि मुनिसत्तम .. 34.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'Having heard this matchless wonder coming from your mouth, / my hair has stood on end with amazement, O best of sages.' / 34.2

6.3.s:
sahasrakiraṇo devo hartā kartā nirañjanaḥ .
avatāreṇa lokānāmuddhartā narmadātaṭe .. 34.3 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रकिरणो देवो हर्ता कर्ता निरञ्जनः .
अवतारेण लोकानामुद्धर्ता नर्मदातटे .. 34.3 ..
6.3.m: 'The thousand-rayed god, the destroyer, creator, and spotless one, / by his descent became the uplifter of the worlds on the bank of the Narmadā.' / 34.3

6.3.s:
puruṣākāro bhagavānutāho tapasaḥ phalāt .
kasya gotre samutpannaḥ kasya devo'bhavadvaśī .. 34.4 ..
6.3.d:
पुरुषाकारो भगवानुताहो तपसः फलात् .
कस्य गोत्रे समुत्पन्नः कस्य देवोऽभवद्वशी .. 34.4 ..
6.3.m: 'Did the Lord assume a human form, or [did this happen] by the fruit of austerity? / In whose lineage was he born, and under whose sway was the god brought?' / 34.4

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
kulikānvayasambhūto brāhmaṇo bhaktimāñchuciḥ .
īkṣyāmīti raviṃ tatra tīrthe yātrākṛtodyamaḥ .. 34.5 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
कुलिकान्वयसम्भूतो ब्राह्मणो भक्तिमाञ्छुचिः .
ईक्ष्यामीति रविं तत्र तीर्थे यात्राकृतोद्यमः .. 34.5 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'A pure brahmin endowed with devotion, born in the lineage of Kulika, / resolved to make a pilgrimage to that sacred ford, thinking, "I shall behold the sun."' / 34.5

6.3.s:
yojanānāṃ śataṃ sāgraṃ nirāhāro gatodakaḥ .
prasthito devadevena svapnānte vāritaḥ kila .. 34.6 ..
6.3.d:
योजनानां शतं साग्रं निराहारो गतोदकः .
प्रस्थितो देवदेवेन स्वप्नान्ते वारितः किल .. 34.6 ..
6.3.m: 'Having set out for over a hundred yojanas, fasting and without water, / he was indeed restrained at the end of a dream by the god of gods:' / 34.6

6.3.s:
bhobho mune mahāsattva alaṃ te vratamīdṛśam .
sarvaṃ vyāpya sthitaṃ paśya sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca mām .. 34.7 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो मुने महासत्त्व अलं ते व्रतमीदृशम् .
सर्वं व्याप्य स्थितं पश्य स्थावरं जङ्गमं च माम् .. 34.7 ..
6.3.m: '"O sage of great resolve, enough of such an observance for you! / Behold me pervading all that is unmoving and moving."' / 34.7

6.3.s:
tapāmyahaṃ tato varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca .
na mṛ(bhṛ?)taṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati .. 34.8 ..
6.3.d:
तपाम्यहं ततो वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च .
न मृ(भृ?)तं चैव मृत्युं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति .. 34.8 ..
6.3.m: '"I radiate heat; then I bring rain; I withhold and I release. / Whoever sees [me], sees neither death nor dissolution."' / 34.8

6.3.s: varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ tvamātmano yastavepsitam .. 34.9 ..
6.3.d: वरं वरय भद्रं त्वमात्मनो यस्तवेप्सितम् .. 34.9 ..
6.3.m: '"Choose a boon, auspicious one, whatever you desire for yourself."' / 34.9

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva deyo yadi varo mama .
uttare narmadākūle sadā saṃnihito bhava .. 34.10 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव देयो यदि वरो मम .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सदा संनिहितो भव .. 34.10 ..
6.3.m: The brahmin said: / 'If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be given to me, / remain ever present on the northern bank of the Narmadā.' / 34.10

6.3.s:
ye bhaktyā parayā deva yojanānāṃ śate sthitāḥ .
smariṣyanti jitātmānasteṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava .. 34.11 ..
6.3.d:
ये भक्त्या परया देव योजनानां शते स्थिताः .
स्मरिष्यन्ति जितात्मानस्तेषां त्वं वरदो भव .. 34.11 ..
6.3.m: 'Be the giver of boons to those self-controlled ones who, standing a hundred yojanas away, / remember you with supreme devotion, O god.' / 34.11

6.3.s:
kubjāndhabadhirā mūkā ye kecidvikalendriyāḥ .
tava pādau namasyanti teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava .. 34.12 ..
6.3.d:
कुब्जान्धबधिरा मूका ये केचिद्विकलेन्द्रियाः .
तव पादौ नमस्यन्ति तेषां त्वं वरदो भव .. 34.12 ..
6.3.m: 'To those who are hunchbacked, blind, deaf, mute, or have any defective faculties, / who bow before your feet, be the giver of boons.' / 34.12

6.3.s:
śīrṇaghrāṇā gatadhiyo hyasthicarmāvaśeṣitāḥ .
teṣāṃ tvaṃ karuṇāṃ deva acireṇa kuruṣva ha .. 34.13 ..
6.3.d:
शीर्णघ्राणा गतधियो ह्यस्थिचर्मावशेषिताः .
तेषां त्वं करुणां देव अचिरेण कुरुष्व ह .. 34.13 ..
6.3.m: 'To those whose noses are wasted, whose intellect is lost, and who are reduced to bone and skin— / on them, O god, quickly bestow your compassion.' / 34.13

6.3.s:
ye'pi tvāṃ narmadātoye snātvā tatra dine dine .
arcayanti jagannātha teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado bhava .. 34.14 ..
6.3.d:
येऽपि त्वां नर्मदातोये स्नात्वा तत्र दिने दिने .
अर्चयन्ति जगन्नाथ तेषां त्वं वरदो भव .. 34.14 ..
6.3.m: 'To those also who, having bathed there in the waters of the Narmadā day after day, / worship you, O Lord of the universe, be the giver of boons.' / 34.14

6.3.s:
prabhāte ye staviṣyanti stavairvaidikalaukikaiḥ .
abhipretaṃ varaṃ deva teṣāṃ tvaṃ dada bhocyuta .. 34.15 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभाते ये स्तविष्यन्ति स्तवैर्वैदिकलौकिकैः .
अभिप्रेतं वरं देव तेषां त्वं दद भोच्युत .. 34.15 ..
6.3.m: 'To those who praise you at dawn with Vedic and worldly hymns, / grant the desired boon, O god, O infallible one.' / 34.15

6.3.s:
tavāgre vapanaṃ deva kārayanti narā bhuvi .
svāmiṃsteṣāṃ varo deya eṣa me paramo varaḥ .. 34.16 ..
6.3.d:
तवाग्रे वपनं देव कारयन्ति नरा भुवि .
स्वामिंस्तेषां वरो देय एष मे परमो वरः .. 34.16 ..
6.3.m: 'To the men who perform the shaving of hair before you on earth, / O Master, a boon must be given: this is my supreme boon.' / 34.16

6.3.s:
evamastviti taṃ coktvā muniṃ karuṇayā punaḥ .
śatabhāgena rājendra sthitvā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ .. 34.17 ..
6.3.d:
एवमस्त्विति तं चोक्त्वा मुनिं करुणया पुनः .
शतभागेन राजेन्द्र स्थित्वा चादर्शनं गतः .. 34.17 ..
6.3.m: Saying to that sage with compassion, 'Let it be so,' / and having remained with a hundredth part [of himself], O king of kings, he vanished from sight. / 34.17

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā gatvā snānaṃ samācaret .
tarpayetpitṛdevāṃśca so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 34.18 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरो भक्त्या गत्वा स्नानं समाचरेत् .
तर्पयेत्पितृदेवांश्च सोऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् .. 34.18 ..
6.3.m: A man who goes with devotion to that sacred ford and performs a bath, / and makes libations to the ancestors and the gods, obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / 34.18

6.3.s:
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .
dyotayanvai diśaḥ sarvā agnilokaṃ sa gacchati .. 34.19 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .
द्योतयन्वै दिशः सर्वा अग्निलोकं स गच्छति .. 34.19 ..
6.3.m: He who enters the fire at that sacred ford, O ruler of men, / illuminating all the quarters indeed, goes to the world of Agni. / 34.19

6.3.s:
yastattīrthaṃ samāsādya tyajatīha kalevaram .
sa gato vāruṇaṃ lokamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 34.20 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तत्तीर्थं समासाद्य त्यजतीह कलेवरम् .
स गतो वारुणं लोकमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 34.20 ..
6.3.m: He who, having reached that sacred ford, abandons his body here, / goes to the world of Varuṇa; thus Śaṃkara spoke. / 34.20

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsena tanuṃ tyajet .
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate .. 34.21 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्संन्यासेन तनुं त्यजेत् .
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 34.21 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons his body at that sacred ford through renunciation, / is honored in the celestial world for sixty thousand years. / 34.21

6.3.s:
apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe divyaśabdānunādite .
uṣitvāyāti martye vai vedavedāṅgavidbhavet .. 34.22 ..
6.3.d:
अप्सरोगणसंकीर्णे दिव्यशब्दानुनादिते .
उषित्वायाति मर्त्ये वै वेदवेदाङ्गविद्भवेत् .. 34.22 ..
6.3.m: Having dwelled [there] filled with troops of apsarases and echoing with divine sounds, / he returns to the mortal world and becomes knower of the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas. / 34.22

6.3.s:
vyādhiśokavinirmukto dhanakoṭipatirbhavet .
putradārasamopeto jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam .. 34.23 ..
6.3.d:
व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो धनकोटिपतिर्भवेत् .
पुत्रदारसमोपेतो जीवेच्च शरदः शतम् .. 34.23 ..
6.3.m: Freed from disease and sorrow, he becomes the master of tens of millions in wealth; / endowed with sons and a wife, he lives for a hundred autumns. / 34.23

6.3.s:
prātarutthāya yastatra smarate bhāskaraṃ tadā .
ājanmajanitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 34.24 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 35
6.3.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय यस्तत्र स्मरते भास्करं तदा .
आजन्मजनितात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 34.24 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रवितीर्थवर्णनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 35
6.3.m:
He who, having risen in the morning, then remembers the Sun there, / is freed from sin born since birth; there is no doubt in this. / 34.24
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of Ravitīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 35

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
jalamadhye mahādevaḥ kena tiṣṭhati hetunā .
uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottama .. 35.1 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
जलमध्ये महादेवः केन तिष्ठति हेतुना .
उत्तरं दक्षिणं कूलं वर्जयित्वा द्विजोत्तम .. 35.1 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'For what reason does Mahādeva stay in the midst of the water, / leaving aside the northern and southern banks, O best of twice-born?' / 35.1

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etadākhyānamatulaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutimukhāvaham .
purāṇe yacchrutaṃ tāta tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ .. 35.2 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतदाख्यानमतुलं पुण्यं श्रुतिमुखावहम् .
पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं तात तत्ते वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः .. 35.2 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / 'This narrative is peerless, meritorious, and brings joy to the ears; / what was heard in the Purāṇa, my dear one, that I shall declare to you in its entirety.' / 35.2

6.3.s:
tretāyuge mahābhāga rāvaṇo devakaṇṭakaḥ .
trailokyavijayī raudraḥ surāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 35.3 ..
6.3.d:
त्रेतायुगे महाभाग रावणो देवकण्टकः .
त्रैलोक्यविजयी रौद्रः सुरासुरभयंकरः .. 35.3 ..
6.3.m: 'In the Tretāyuga, O highly fortunate one, Rāvaṇa was a thorn to the gods, / conqueror of the three worlds, fierce, and terrifying to gods and demons.' / 35.3

6.3.s:
devadānavagandharvairṛṣibhiśca tapodhanaiḥ .
avadhyo'tha vimānena yāvatparyaṭate mahīm .. 35.4 ..
6.3.d:
देवदानवगन्धर्वैरृषिभिश्च तपोधनैः .
अवध्योऽथ विमानेन यावत्पर्यटते महीम् .. 35.4 ..
6.3.m: 'He was invulnerable to gods, dānavas, gandharvas, and seers rich in austerity; / then, while he wandered the earth in his aerial chariot,' / 35.4

6.3.s:
tāvaddhindhyagirermadhye dānavo baladarpitaḥ .
mayo nāmeti vikhyāto guhāvāsī tapaścaran .. 35.5 ..
6.3.d:
तावद्धिन्ध्यगिरेर्मध्ये दानवो बलदर्पितः .
मयो नामेति विख्यातो गुहावासी तपश्चरन् .. 35.5 ..
6.3.m: 'at that time, in the midst of the Vindhya mountain, a dānava proud of his strength, / famed by the name of Maya, was practicing austerity, dwelling in a cave.' / 35.5

6.3.s:
tasya pārśvagato rakṣo vinayādavaniṃ gataḥ .
pūjito dānasanmānairidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 35.6 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य पार्श्वगतो रक्षो विनयादवनिं गतः .
पूजितो दानसन्मानैरिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 35.6 ..
6.3.m: 'Approaching him, the rākṣasa descended to the earth out of modesty; / honored with gifts and respect, he spoke these words:' / 35.6

6.3.s:
kasyeyaṃ padmapatrākṣī pūrṇacandranibhānanā .
kiṃnāmadheyā tapati tapa ugraṃ kathaṃ vibho .. 35.7 ..
6.3.d:
कस्येयं पद्मपत्राक्षी पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना .
किंनामधेया तपति तप उग्रं कथं विभो .. 35.7 ..
6.3.m: '"Whose is this lotus-petal-eyed maiden, whose face resembles the full moon? / What is her name, and why does she practice severe austerity, O lord?"' / 35.7

6.3.s:
maya uvāca -
dānavānāṃ patiḥ śreṣṭho mayo'haṃ nāma nāmataḥ .
bhāryā tejovatī nāma tasyāstu tanayā śubhā .. 35.8 ..
6.3.d:
मय उवाच -
दानवानां पतिः श्रेष्ठो मयोऽहं नाम नामतः .
भार्या तेजोवती नाम तस्यास्तु तनया शुभा .. 35.8 ..
6.3.m: Maya said: / 'I am the chief lord of the dānavas, Maya by name; / my wife is named Tejovatī, and she has an auspicious daughter,' / 35.8

6.3.s:
mandodarīti vikhyātā tapate bhartṛkāraṇāt .
ārādhayantī bhartāramumāyā dayitaṃ śubham .. 35.9 ..
6.3.d:
मन्दोदरीति विख्याता तपते भर्तृकारणात् .
आराधयन्ती भर्तारमुमाया दयितं शुभम् .. 35.9 ..
6.3.m: 'celebrated as Mandodarī, who performs austerity for the sake of a husband, / propitiating Umā’s auspicious beloved as her lord.' / 35.9

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya rāvaṇo madamohitaḥ .
prasṛtaḥ praṇato bhūtvā mayaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 35.10 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य रावणो मदमोहितः .
प्रसृतः प्रणतो भूत्वा मयं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 35.10 ..
6.3.m: Hearing those words of his, Rāvaṇa, infatuated with passion, / stepped forward and, bowing down, spoke these words to Maya: / 35.10

6.3.s:
paulastyānvayasaṃjāto devadānavadarpahā .
prārthayāmi mahābhāga sutāṃ tvaṃ dātumarhasi .. 35.11 ..
6.3.d:
पौलस्त्यान्वयसंजातो देवदानवदर्पहा .
प्रार्थयामि महाभाग सुतां त्वं दातुमर्हसि .. 35.11 ..
6.3.m: '"I was born in the lineage of Pulastya, the destroyer of the pride of gods and dānavas; / I make a request, O highly fortunate one: you ought to give me your daughter."' / 35.11

6.3.s:
jñātvā paitāmahaṃ vṛttaṃ mayenāpi mahātmanā .
rāvaṇāya sutā dattā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ .. 35.12 ..
6.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा पैतामहं वृत्तं मयेनापि महात्मना .
रावणाय सुता दत्ता पूजयित्वा विधानतः .. 35.12 ..
6.3.m: Knowing his paternal grandfather’s lineage, the great-souled Maya also, / having honored Rāvaṇa according to the rules, gave him his daughter. / 35.12

6.3.s:
gṛhītvā tāṃ tadā rakṣo'bhyarcyamāno niśācaraiḥ .
devodyāne vimānaiśca krīḍate sa tayā saha .. 35.13 ..
6.3.d:
गृहीत्वा तां तदा रक्षोऽभ्यर्च्यमानो निशाचरैः .
देवोद्याने विमानैश्च क्रीडते स तया सह .. 35.13 ..
6.3.m: Taking her then, that rākṣasa, being praised by the night-stalkers, / disported with her in aerial chariots in the pleasure-garden of the gods. / 35.13

6.3.s:
kenacittvatha kālena rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ .
putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭho janayāmāsa bhārata .. 35.14 ..
6.3.d:
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन रावणो लोकरावणः .
पुत्रं पुत्रवतां श्रेष्ठो जनयामास भारत .. 35.14 ..
6.3.m: After some time, Rāvaṇa, who made the worlds cry out, / the foremost among those possessing sons, fathered a son, O descendant of Bharata. / 35.14

6.3.s:
tenaiva jātamātreṇa rāvo mukto mahātmanā .
saṃvartakasya meghasya tena lokā jaḍīkṛtāḥ .. 35.15 ..
6.3.d:
तेनैव जातमात्रेण रावो मुक्तो महात्मना .
संवर्तकस्य मेघस्य तेन लोका जडीकृताः .. 35.15 ..
6.3.m: As soon as he was born, a roar was uttered by that great-souled child, / like that of a Saṃvartaka cloud, by which the worlds were stunned. / 35.15

6.3.s:
śrutvā tannarditaṃ ghoraṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
nāma cakre tadā tasya meghanādo bhaviṣyati .. 35.16 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तन्नर्दितं घोरं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
नाम चक्रे तदा तस्य मेघनादो भविष्यति .. 35.16 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that terrible roar, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / then named him: 'He shall be Meghanāda.' / 35.16

6.3.s:
evaṃnāmā kṛtaḥ so'pi paramaṃ vratamāsthitaḥ .
toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram .. 35.17 ..
6.3.d:
एवंनामा कृतः सोऽपि परमं व्रतमास्थितः .
तोषयामास देवेशमुमया सह शङ्करम् .. 35.17 ..
6.3.m: Having been given this name, he too, having undertaken a supreme vow, / pleased Śaṃkara, the lord of gods, along with Umā. / 35.17

6.3.s:
vratairniyamadānaiśca homajāpyavidhānataḥ .
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairnityaṃ kṛśaṃ kurvankalevaram .. 35.18 ..
6.3.d:
व्रतैर्नियमदानैश्च होमजाप्यविधानतः .
कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणैर्नित्यं कृशं कुर्वन्कलेवरम् .. 35.18 ..
6.3.m: Constantly emaciating his body through vows, observances, and gifts, / according to the rules of fire oblations and muttered prayers, and through kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa penances,

6.3.s:
evamanyaddine tāta kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam .
gatvā liṅgadvayaṃ gṛhya prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ .. 35.19 ..
6.3.d:
एवमन्यद्दिने तात कैलासं धरणीधरम् .
गत्वा लिङ्गद्वयं गृह्य प्रस्थितो दक्षिणामुखः .. 35.19 ..
6.3.m: in this way on another day, dear one, he went to Mount Kailāsa, / took two liṅgas, and set out facing south.

6.3.s:
narmadātaṭamāśritya snātukāmo mahābalaḥ .
nikṣipya pūjayan devaṃ kṛtajāpyo nareśvara .. 35.20 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य स्नातुकामो महाबलः .
निक्षिप्य पूजयन् देवं कृतजाप्यो नरेश्वर .. 35.20 ..
6.3.m: Reaching the bank of the Narmadā, wishing to bathe, the mighty one / put them down and worshipped the god, having performed his muttered prayer, O lord of men.

6.3.s:
tatrāyatanāvāsena snāto hutahutāśanaḥ .
kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃ mānayitvā niśācaraḥ .. 35.21 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रायतनावासेन स्नातो हुतहुताशनः .
कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानं मानयित्वा निशाचरः .. 35.21 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there by dwelling at the shrine and offered into the sacred fire, / the night-roamer [Rāvaṇa], considering himself to have achieved his purpose,

6.3.s:
gantukāmaḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ laṅkāyāṃ nṛpasattama .
ekamuddharato liṅgaṃ praṇataḥ savyapāṇinā .. 35.22 ..
6.3.d:
गन्तुकामः परं मार्गं लङ्कायां नृपसत्तम .
एकमुद्धरतो लिङ्गं प्रणतः सव्यपाणिना .. 35.22 ..
6.3.m: wished to take the further road toward Laṅkā, O best of kings. / Bowing low, as he lifted one liṅga with his left hand,

6.3.s:
dvitīyaṃ tu dvitīyena bhaktyā paulastyanandanaḥ .
tāvadeva mahāliṅgaṃ patitaṃ narmadāṃbhasi .. 35.23 ..
6.3.d:
द्वितीयं तु द्वितीयेन भक्त्या पौलस्त्यनन्दनः .
तावदेव महालिङ्गं पतितं नर्मदांभसि .. 35.23 ..
6.3.m: and the second with his second [hand] in devotion, the son of Paulastya, / just then the great liṅga fell into the waters of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
yāhi yāhīti cetyuktvā jalamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ .
namitvā rāvaṇistasya devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 35.24 ..
6.3.d:
याहि याहीति चेत्युक्त्वा जलमध्ये प्रतिष्ठितः .
नमित्वा रावणिस्तस्य देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः .. 35.24 ..
6.3.m: Saying, “Go! Go!”, it became established in the middle of the water. / The son of Rāvaṇa bowed down to that god, the supreme lord,

6.3.s:
jagāmākāśamāviśya pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ .
tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ meghanādeti viśrutam .. 35.25 ..
6.3.d:
जगामाकाशमाविश्य पूज्यमानो निशाचरैः .
तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं मेघनादेति विश्रुतम् .. 35.25 ..
6.3.m: and entered the sky, moving on, worshipped by the night-roamers. / From that time on, that sacred ford became celebrated as Meghanāda.

6.3.s:
pūrvaṃ tu garjanaṃ nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .
tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yastu snānaṃ samācaret .. 35.26 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्वं तु गर्जनं नाम सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र यस्तु स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 35.26 ..
6.3.m: Formerly its name was Garjana, destroying all sins. / Whoever performs a ritual ablution at that sacred ford, O king of kings,

6.3.s:
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .
piṇḍadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .. 35.27 ..
6.3.d:
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .
पिण्डदानं तु यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .. 35.27 ..
6.3.m: having fasted for a day and night, obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. / And whoever performs the offering of rice-balls at that sacred ford, O king,

6.3.s:
yatphalaṃ sattrayajñena tadbhavennātra saṃśayaḥ .
tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi pitaraḥ saṃpratarpitāḥ .. 35.28 ..
6.3.d:
यत्फलं सत्त्रयज्ञेन तद्भवेन्नात्र संशयः .
तेन द्वादशवर्षाणि पितरः संप्रतर्पिताः .. 35.28 ..
6.3.m: the fruit that comes from a sacrificial session will be his; there is no doubt in this. / By that, the ancestors remain fully satisfied for twelve years.

6.3.s:
yastu bhojayate vipraṃ ṣaḍrasātrena bhārata .
akṣayapuṇyamāpnoti tatra tīrthe narottama .. 35.29 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तु भोजयते विप्रं षड्रसात्रेन भारत .
अक्षयपुण्यमाप्नोति तत्र तीर्थे नरोत्तम .. 35.29 ..
6.3.m: And whoever feeds a brahmin with food of the six tastes, O Bhārata, / attains imperishable merit at that sacred ford, O best of men.

6.3.s:
prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādbhāvito bhāvitātmanā .
sa vasecchāṅkare loke yāvadā bhūtasamplavam .. 35.30 ..
6.3.d:
प्राणत्यागं तु यः कुर्याद्भावितो भावितात्मना .
स वसेच्छाङ्करे लोके यावदा भूतसम्प्लवम् .. 35.30 ..
6.3.m: And whoever casts off his life-breaths, concentrated with a purified mind, / dwells in the world of Śaṅkara until the dissolution of all beings.

6.3.s:
eṣā te naraśārdūla garjanotpattiruttamā .
kathitā snehabandhena sarvapāpakṣayakarī .. 35.31 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe meghanādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
एषा ते नरशार्दूल गर्जनोत्पत्तिरुत्तमा .
कथिता स्नेहबन्धेन सर्वपापक्षयकरी .. 35.31 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मेघनादतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
This excellent origin of Garjana, destroying all sins, / has thus been related to you out of affection, O tiger among men.
Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Meghanādatīrtha,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Avantī section in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchecca rājendra dārutīrthamanuttamam .
dāruko yatra saṃsiddha indrasya dayitaḥ purā .. 36.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेच्च राजेन्द्र दारुतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
दारुको यत्र संसिद्ध इन्द्रस्य दयितः पुरा .. 36.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the unsurpassed Dārutīrtha, / where in ancient times Dāruka, the beloved of Indra, attained perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
dārukeṇa kathaṃ tāta tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha .
vidhānaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatsakāśāddvijottama .. 36.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
दारुकेण कथं तात तपश्चीर्णं पुरानघ .
विधानं श्रोतुमिच्छामि त्वत्सकाशाद्द्विजोत्तम .. 36.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How, O sinless father, was austerity practiced formerly by Dāruka? / I wish to hear the account from you, O best of brahmins.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi vicitraṃ yatpurātanam .
vṛttaṃ svargasabhāmadhye ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām .. 36.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि विचित्रं यत्पुरातनम् .
वृत्तं स्वर्गसभामध्ये ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् .. 36.3 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Ah, I shall tell you the wondrous, ancient event / that took place in heaven's assembly among seers of purified selves.

6.3.s:
sūto vajradharasyeṣṭo mātalirnāma nāmataḥ .
sa putraṃ śaptavānpūrvaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare .. 36.4 ..
6.3.d:
सूतो वज्रधरस्येष्टो मातलिर्नाम नामतः .
स पुत्रं शप्तवान्पूर्वं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे .. 36.4 ..
6.3.m: The beloved charioteer of the wielder of the thunderbolt was named Mātali. / Formerly, on account of some reason, he cursed his son.

6.3.s:
śāpāhato vepamāna indrasya caraṇau śubhau .
prapīḍya mūrdhnā deveśaṃ vijñāpayati bhārata .. 36.5 ..
6.3.d:
शापाहतो वेपमान इन्द्रस्य चरणौ शुभौ .
प्रपीड्य मूर्ध्ना देवेशं विज्ञापयति भारत .. 36.5 ..
6.3.m: Afflicted by the curse, trembling, pressing with his head / the auspicious feet of Indra, he petitioned the lord of gods, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
tamuvācābhiśaptaṃ cāpyanāthaṃ ca sureśvaraḥ .
karmaṇā kena śāpasya ghorasyānto bhaviṣyati .. 36.6 ..
6.3.d:
तमुवाचाभिशप्तं चाप्यनाथं च सुरेश्वरः .
कर्मणा केन शापस्य घोरस्यान्तो भविष्यति .. 36.6 ..
6.3.m: The lord of gods spoke to him, who was accursed and helpless: / 'By what deed will there be an end to this dreadful curse?'

6.3.s:
narmadātaṭamāśritya toṣayanvai maheśvaram .
tiṣṭha yāvadyugasyāntaṃ punarjanma hyavāpsyasi .. 36.7 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य तोषयन्वै महेश्वरम् .
तिष्ठ यावद्युगस्यान्तं पुनर्जन्म ह्यवाप्स्यसि .. 36.7 ..
6.3.m: 'Resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, pleasing Maheśvara, / remain there until the end of the yuga, for you shall attain another birth.

6.3.s:
punarbhūtvā tu pūtastvaṃ dāruko nāma viśrutaḥ .
saṃsevya paramaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam .. 36.8 ..
6.3.d:
पुनर्भूत्वा तु पूतस्त्वं दारुको नाम विश्रुतः .
संसेव्य परमं देवं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् .. 36.8 ..
6.3.m: Being born again, purified, renowned by the name Dāruka, / having worshiped the supreme deity who holds the conch, discus, and mace,

6.3.s:
mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāpannastataḥ siddhimavāpsyasi .
evamuktastu devena sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā .. 36.9 ..
6.3.d:
मानुषं भावमापन्नस्ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि .
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन सहस्राक्षेण धीमता .. 36.9 ..
6.3.m: and attained human form, you will thereafter achieve perfection.' / Thus spoken to by the wise god of a thousand eyes,

6.3.s:
praṇamya śirasā bhūmimāgato'sau hyacetanaḥ .
narmadātaṭamāśritya karṣayannijavigraham .. 36.10 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमिमागतोऽसौ ह्यचेतनः .
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य कर्षयन्निजविग्रहम् .. 36.10 ..
6.3.m: having bowed with his head to the ground, he came, distracted in mind. / Resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, emaciating his own body,

6.3.s:
vratopavāsasaṃkhinno japahomarataḥ sadā .
mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ varadaṃ śūlapāṇinam .. 36.11 ..
6.3.d:
व्रतोपवाससंखिन्नो जपहोमरतः सदा .
महादेवं महात्मानं वरदं शूलपाणिनम् .. 36.11 ..
6.3.m: distressed by vows and fasts, ever devoted to silent recitation and oblations, / [he worshiped] the great-souled Mahādeva, the granter of boons, holding the trident in hand,

6.3.s:
bhaktyā tu parayā rājanyāvadābhūtasamplavam .
aṃśāvataraṇādviṣṇoḥ sūto bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ .. 36.12 ..
6.3.d:
भक्त्या तु परया राजन्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .
अंशावतरणाद्विष्णोः सूतो भूत्वा महामतिः .. 36.12 ..
6.3.m: with supreme devotion, O king, until the dissolution of all beings. / Becoming the charioteer of Viṣṇu of great intellect upon his descent in portion,

6.3.s: toṣayan vai jagannāthaṃ tato yāto hi sadgatim .. 36.13 ..
6.3.d: तोषयन् वै जगन्नाथं ततो यातो हि सद्गतिम् .. 36.13 ..
6.3.m: pleasing the Lord of the World, he then indeed attained the auspicious state.

6.3.s:
eṣa tatsambhavastāta dārutīrthasya suvrata .
kathito'yaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ yathā me śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 36.14 ..
6.3.d:
एष तत्सम्भवस्तात दारुतीर्थस्य सुव्रत .
कथितोऽयं मया पूर्वं यथा मे शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 36.14 ..
6.3.m: This is the origin of Dārutīrtha, O father of good vows; / this has been related by me just as Śaṅkara formerly told me.

6.3.s:
tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .
bhrātḥn vilokayāmāsa hṛṣṭaromā muhurmuhuḥ .. 36.15 ..
6.3.d:
ततो युधिष्ठिरः श्रुत्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः .
भ्रात्ःन् विलोकयामास हृष्टरोमा मुहुर्मुहुः .. 36.15 ..
6.3.m: Then Yudhiṣṭhira, having heard this, went to the highest amazement; / with hair standing on end again and again, he looked at his brothers.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhipūrvaṃ nareśvara .
upāsya saṃdhyāṃ deveśamarcayedyaśca śaṅkaram .. 36.16 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विधिपूर्वं नरेश्वर .
उपास्य संध्यां देवेशमर्चयेद्यश्च शङ्करम् .. 36.16 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having bathed at that sacred ford according to the precept, O ruler of men, / and having observed the twilight worship, whosoever worships the lord of the gods, Śaṅkara,

6.3.s:
vedābhyāsaṃ tu tatraiva yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ .
so'śvamedhaphalaṃ rājaṃllabhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 36.17 ..
6.3.d:
वेदाभ्यासं तु तत्रैव यः करोति समाहितः .
सोऽश्वमेधफलं राजंल्लभते नात्र संशयः .. 36.17 ..
6.3.m: and whoever undertakes the study of the Vedas right there, self-composed, / he obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice, O king, there is no doubt here.

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchuciḥ .
sa tu viprasahasrasya labhate phalamuttamam .. 36.18 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छुचिः .
स तु विप्रसहस्रस्य लभते फलमुत्तमम् .. 36.18 ..
6.3.m: Whosoever, pure, feeds brahmins with devotion at that sacred ford, / obtains the excellent fruit of [feeding] a thousand brahmins.

6.3.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam .
yatkṛtaṃ śuddhabhāvena tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet .. 36.19 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dārukatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 37
6.3.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् .
यत्कृतं शुद्धभावेन तत्सर्वं सफलं भवेत् .. 36.19 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दारुकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 37
6.3.m:
Ritual ablution, gifting, silent recitation, oblation, recitation of scripture, and worship of deities— / whatever is done with a pure disposition, all that becomes fruitful.
Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, named 'The Description of the Greatness of the Dāruka Sacred Ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 37

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gaccheta rājendra devatīrthamanuttamam .
yena devāstrayastriṃśatsnātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ .. 37.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
येन देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशत्स्नात्वा सिद्धिं परां गताः .. 37.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to the supreme Devatīrtha, O king of kings, / bathing in which the thirty-three gods attained supreme perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ tāta surāḥ sarve dānavairbalavattaraiḥ .
nirjitāstatra tīrthe ca snātvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ .. 37.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं तात सुराः सर्वे दानवैर्बलवत्तरैः .
निर्जितास्तत्र तीर्थे च स्नात्वा सिद्धिं परां गताः .. 37.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How, O dear one, were all the gods vanquished by the more powerful Dānavas, / and how, having bathed at that sacred ford, did they attain supreme perfection?

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
purā daityagaṇairugrairyuddhe'tibalavattaraiḥ .
indro devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svarājyāccyāvito nṛpa .. 37.3 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पुरा दैत्यगणैरुग्रैर्युद्धेऽतिबलवत्तरैः .
इन्द्रो देवगणैः सार्द्धं स्वराज्याच्च्यावितो नृप .. 37.3 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the past, O king, Indra together with the hosts of gods was driven from his kingdom / in battle by fierce troops of Daityas who were exceedingly powerful.

6.3.s:
hastyaśvarathayānaughairmardayitvā varūthinīm .
vidhvastā bhejire mārgaṃ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ .. 37.4 ..
6.3.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथयानौघैर्मर्दयित्वा वरूथिनीम् .
विध्वस्ता भेजिरे मार्गं प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृताः .. 37.4 ..
6.3.m: Having crushed his army with multitudes of elephants, horses, and chariots, / shattered and battered by blows, they took to flight.

6.3.s:
jambhaśumbhaiśca kūṣmāṇḍakuhakādibhiḥ .
vepamānārditāḥ sarve brahmāṇamupatasthire .. 37.5 ..
6.3.d:
जम्भशुम्भैश्च कूष्माण्डकुहकादिभिः .
वेपमानार्दिताः सर्वे ब्रह्माणमुपतस्थिरे .. 37.5 ..
6.3.m: Trembling and tormented by Jambha, Śumbha, Kūṣmāṇḍa, Kuhaka, and the rest, / they all approached Brahmā.

6.3.s:
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam .
tadā vijñāpayāmāsurdevā vahnipurogamāḥ .. 37.6 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् .
तदा विज्ञापयामासुर्देवा वह्निपुरोगमाः .. 37.6 ..
6.3.m: Bowing their heads to the god Brahmā, the supreme lord, / the gods, led by the fire god, then made this petition:

6.3.s:
paśya paśya mahābhāga dānavaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ .
viyojitāḥ putradāraistvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 37.7 ..
6.3.d:
पश्य पश्य महाभाग दानवैः शकलीकृताः .
वियोजिताः पुत्रदारैस्त्वामेव शरणं गताः .. 37.7 ..
6.3.m: “Look, look, O blessed one! Cut to pieces by the Dānavas, / separated from our sons and wives, we have taken refuge in you alone.

6.3.s:
paritrāyasva deveśa sarvalokapitāmaha .
nānyā gatiḥ sureśāna tvāṃ muktvā parameśvara .. 37.8 ..
6.3.d:
परित्रायस्व देवेश सर्वलोकपितामह .
नान्या गतिः सुरेशान त्वां मुक्त्वा परमेश्वर .. 37.8 ..
6.3.m: Protect us, O lord of gods, grandfather of all the worlds! / There is no other recourse, O lord of the gods, leaving you, O supreme master!”

6.3.s:
brahmovāca -
dānavānāṃ vighātārthaṃ narmadātaṭamāsthitāḥ .
tapaḥ kurudhvaṃ svasthāḥ stha tapo hi paramaṃ balam .. 37.9 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच -
दानवानां विघातार्थं नर्मदातटमास्थिताः .
तपः कुरुध्वं स्वस्थाः स्थ तपो हि परमं बलम् .. 37.9 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā said: / “For the destruction of the Dānavas, resort to the bank of the Narmadā / and perform austerity; be composed, for austerity is indeed the highest power.

6.3.s:
nānyopāyo na vai mantro vidyate na ca me kriyā .
vinā revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 37.10 ..
6.3.d:
नान्योपायो न वै मन्त्रो विद्यते न च मे क्रिया .
विना रेवाजलं पुण्यं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 37.10 ..
6.3.m: No other means nor mantra exists, nor is there any rite for me, / without the sacred water of the Revā, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
dāridryavyādhimaraṇabandhanavyasanāni ca .
etāni caiva pāpasya phalānīti matirmama .. 37.11 ..
6.3.d:
दारिद्र्यव्याधिमरणबन्धनव्यसनानि च .
एतानि चैव पापस्य फलानीति मतिर्मम .. 37.11 ..
6.3.m: Poverty, disease, death, bondage, and calamities— / these are indeed the fruits of sin; this is my conviction.

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā tataścaiva tapaḥ kuruta duṣkaram .
