उवाच च भयत्रस्तः कृताञ्जलिपुटस्तदा .
किं मयापकृतं विप्र पिप्पलाद महामुने .. 42.31 ..
6.3.m: Terrified, with folded hands, he then said: / “What wrong have I done, O brahmin, O great sage Pippalāda,

6.3.s:
caranvai gaganādyena pātito dharaṇītale .
sauriṇā hyevamuktastu pippalādo mahāmuniḥ .. 42.32 ..
6.3.d:
चरन्वै गगनाद्येन पातितो धरणीतले .
सौरिणा ह्येवमुक्तस्तु पिप्पलादो महामुनिः .. 42.32 ..
6.3.m: that moving through the sky, I have been cast down to the surface of the earth?” / Thus addressed by Sauri, the great sage Pippalāda,

6.3.s:
krodharūpo'bravīdvākyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .
pitṛmātṛvihīnasya mama bālasya durmate .
pīḍāṃ karoṣi kasmāttvaṃ saure brūhi hyaśeṣataḥ .. 42.33 ..
6.3.d:
क्रोधरूपोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .
पितृमातृविहीनस्य मम बालस्य दुर्मते .
पीडां करोषि कस्मात्त्वं सौरे ब्रूहि ह्यशेषतः .. 42.33 ..
6.3.m: assuming a wrathful form, spoke these words; hear that, O lord of men: / “To me, an infant bereft of father and mother, O evil-minded one, / why do you cause affliction, O Sauri? Tell me completely!”

6.3.s:
śanaiścara uvāca -
krūrasvabhāvaḥ sahajo mama dṛṣṭistathedṛśī .
muñcasva māṃ tathā kartā yadbravīṣi na saṃśayaḥ .. 42.34 ..
6.3.d:
शनैश्चर उवाच -
क्रूरस्वभावः सहजो मम दृष्टिस्तथेदृशी .
मुञ्चस्व मां तथा कर्ता यद्ब्रवीषि न संशयः .. 42.34 ..
6.3.m: Śanaiścara said: / “A cruel nature is inborn to me, and such is my gaze. / Release me; I will do whatever you say, without a doubt.”

6.3.s:
pippalāda uvāca -
adyaprabhṛti bālānāṃ varṣādā ṣoḍaśādgraha .
pīḍā tvayā na kartavyā eṣa te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 42.35 ..
6.3.d:
पिप्पलाद उवाच -
अद्यप्रभृति बालानां वर्षादा षोडशाद्ग्रह .
पीडा त्वया न कर्तव्या एष ते समयः कृतः .. 42.35 ..
6.3.m: Pippalāda said: / “From this day forward, until their sixteenth year, / no affliction should be caused by you to children, O planet! This is the agreement made with you.”

6.3.s:
evamastviti coktvā sa jagāma punarāgataḥ .
devamārgaṃ śanaiścārī praṇamya ṛṣisattamam .. 42.36 ..
6.3.d:
एवमस्त्विति चोक्त्वा स जगाम पुनरागतः .
देवमार्गं शनैश्चारी प्रणम्य ऋषिसत्तमम् .. 42.36 ..
6.3.m: Saying “So be it,” the slow-moving one departed whence he had come, / returning to the path of the gods after bowing down to the best of seers.

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ tatra so'pi bālo mahāgrahaḥ .
vicintayanvai pitaraṃ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ .. 42.37 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं तत्र सोऽपि बालो महाग्रहः .
विचिन्तयन्वै पितरं क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः .. 42.37 ..
6.3.m: When that great planet had disappeared from view, the boy, / reflecting on his father, was stained with anger.

6.3.s:
āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dhyātvā janayāmāsa pāvakam .
kṛtyāmantrairjuhāvāgnau kṛtyā vai saṃbhavatviti .. 42.38 ..
6.3.d:
आग्नेयीं धारणां ध्यात्वा जनयामास पावकम् .
कृत्यामन्त्रैर्जुहावाग्नौ कृत्या वै संभवत्विति .. 42.38 ..
6.3.m: Contemplating the fiery dhāraṇā, he generated a fire, / and with kṛtyā-spells he offered into the fire, saying: “May a kṛtyā come into being!”

6.3.s:
tāvajjhaṭiti sā kanyā jvālāmālāvibhūṣitā .
hutabhuksadṛśākārā kiṃ karomīti cābravīt .. 42.39 ..
6.3.d:
तावज्झटिति सा कन्या ज्वालामालाविभूषिता .
हुतभुक्सदृशाकारा किं करोमीति चाब्रवीत् .. 42.39 ..
6.3.m: Instantly, a maiden appeared, adorned with wreaths of flames, / resembling fire itself, and said: “What shall I do?”

6.3.s:
śoṣayāmi samudrān kiṃ cūrṇayāmi ca parvatān .
avaniṃ veṣṭayāmīti pātaye kiṃ nabhastalam .. 42.40 ..
6.3.d:
शोषयामि समुद्रान् किं चूर्णयामि च पर्वतान् .
अवनिं वेष्टयामीति पातये किं नभस्तलम् .. 42.40 ..
6.3.m: "Shall I dry up the oceans? Shall I crush the mountains? / Shall I envelop the earth? Shall I bring down the firmament?

6.3.s:
kasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi ghātayāmi ca kaṃ dvija .
śīghramādiśyatāṃ kāryaṃ mā me kālātyayo bhavet .. 42.41 ..
6.3.d:
कस्य मूर्ध्नि पतिष्यामि घातयामि च कं द्विज .
शीघ्रमादिश्यतां कार्यं मा मे कालात्ययो भवेत् .. 42.41 ..
6.3.m: Upon whose head shall I fall, and whom shall I strike down, O twice-born? / Command my task quickly, lest my time pass away!"

6.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā pippalādo mahātapāḥ .
krodhasaṃraktanayana idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 42.42 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पिप्पलादो महातपाः .
क्रोधसंरक्तनयन इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 42.42 ..
6.3.m: Hearing those words of hers, Pippalāda, rich in ascetic power, / his eyes reddened with rage, spoke these words:

6.3.s:
mahatā krodhavegena mayā tvaṃ cintitā śubhe .
pitā me yājñavalkyaśca tasya tvaṃ pata māciram .. 42.43 ..
6.3.d:
महता क्रोधवेगेन मया त्वं चिन्तिता शुभे .
पिता मे याज्ञवल्क्यश्च तस्य त्वं पत माचिरम् .. 42.43 ..
6.3.m: "In a great rush of fury were you conceived by me, auspicious one! / Yājñavalkya is my father; fall upon him without delay!"

6.3.s:
evamuktvāgamacchīghraṃ sphoṭayantī nabhastalam .
mithilāstho mahāprājñastapastepe mahāmanāḥ .. 42.44 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वागमच्छीघ्रं स्फोटयन्ती नभस्तलम् .
मिथिलास्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तपस्तेपे महामनाः .. 42.44 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, she went swiftly, rending the firmament. / Residing in Mithilā, the highly wise, magnanimous [sage] was practicing austerities.

6.3.s:
yāvatpaśyati digbhāgaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham .
yājñavalkyo mahātejā mahadbhūtamupasthitam .. 42.45 ..
6.3.d:
यावत्पश्यति दिग्भागं ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभम् .
याज्ञवल्क्यो महातेजा महद्भूतमुपस्थितम् .. 42.45 ..
6.3.m: Then Yājñavalkya of great splendor saw that quarter of the sky / blazing like the sun, and a great spirit arrived.

6.3.s:
taddṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntaṃ bhītabhīto mahāmuniḥ .
anuyukto'tha bhūtena janakaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau .. 42.46 ..
6.3.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा सहसायान्तं भीतभीतो महामुनिः .
अनुयुक्तोऽथ भूतेन जनकं नृपतिं ययौ .. 42.46 ..
6.3.m: Seeing it arriving suddenly, terrified, the great sage, / pursued by the spirit, went to King Janaka.

6.3.s:
śaraṇyaṃ māmanuprāptaṃ viddhi tvaṃ nṛpasattama .
mahadbhūtabhayādrakṣa yadi śaknoṣi pārthiva .. 42.47 ..
6.3.d:
शरण्यं मामनुप्राप्तं विद्धि त्वं नृपसत्तम .
महद्भूतभयाद्रक्ष यदि शक्नोषि पार्थिव .. 42.47 ..
6.3.m: "Know that I have come to you for refuge, O best of kings! / Protect me from fear of this great spirit, if you are able, O ruler of the earth!"

6.3.s:
brahmatejobhavaṃ bhūtamanivāryaṃ durāsadam .
na ca śaknomyahaṃ trātuṃ rājā vacanamabravīt .. 42.48 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मतेजोभवं भूतमनिवार्यं दुरासदम् .
न च शक्नोम्यहं त्रातुं राजा वचनमब्रवीत् .. 42.48 ..
6.3.m: "The spirit born of brahmic brilliance is irresistible and hard to approach; / I cannot protect you," said the king.

6.3.s:
tataścānyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaraṇārthī mahātapāḥ .
jagāma tena mukto'sau cendrasya sadanaṃ bhayāt .. 42.49 ..
6.3.d:
ततश्चान्यं नृपश्रेष्ठं शरणार्थी महातपाः .
जगाम तेन मुक्तोऽसौ चेन्द्रस्य सदनं भयात् .. 42.49 ..
6.3.m: Then, seeking refuge, he of great austerities went to another foremost king; / dismissed by him, he fled in terror to Indra's dwelling.

6.3.s:
devarāja namaste'stu mahābhūtabhayānnṛpa .
kampamāno'bravīdvipro rakṣasveti punaḥpunaḥ .. 42.50 ..
6.3.d:
देवराज नमस्तेऽस्तु महाभूतभयान्नृप .
कम्पमानोऽब्रवीद्विप्रो रक्षस्वेति पुनःपुनः .. 42.50 ..
6.3.m: "O king of gods, salutations to you! Out of fear of this great spirit, O king—" / trembling, the brahmin pleaded again and again, "protect me!"

6.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devarājo'bravīdidam .
na śaknomi paritrātuṃ brahmakopādahaṃ mune .. 42.51 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवराजोऽब्रवीदिदम् .
न शक्नोमि परित्रातुं ब्रह्मकोपादहं मुने .. 42.51 ..
6.3.m: Hearing his plea, the king of gods said this: / "I cannot protect you from the wrath of a brahmin, O sage."

6.3.s:
tataḥ sa brahmabhavanaṃ brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ .
jagāma viṣṇulokaṃ ca tenāpītyukta eva saḥ .. 42.52 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स ब्रह्मभवनं ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मवित्तमः .
जगाम विष्णुलोकं च तेनापीत्युक्त एव सः .. 42.52 ..
6.3.m: Then that brahmin, supreme knower of Brahman, went to Brahmā's abode, / and to the realm of Viṣṇu, and by him too he was told the very same thing.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sa munirudvigno nirāśo jīvite nṛpa .
anugamyamāno bhūtena agacchacchaṅkarālayam .. 42.53 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स मुनिरुद्विग्नो निराशो जीविते नृप .
अनुगम्यमानो भूतेन अगच्छच्छङ्करालयम् .. 42.53 ..
6.3.m: Then the sage, distressed and despairing of his life, O king, / still pursued by the spirit, went to the abode of Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
tasya yogabalopeto mahādevasya pāṇḍava .
nakhamāṃsāntare gupto yathā devo na paśyati .. 42.54 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य योगबलोपेतो महादेवस्य पाण्डव .
नखमांसान्तरे गुप्तो यथा देवो न पश्यति .. 42.54 ..
6.3.m: Endowed with the power of yoga, O descendant of Pāṇḍu, / he hid within the crevice of Mahādeva's fingernail so that the god did not see him.

6.3.s:
tadante cāgamadbhūtaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham .
muñca muñceti puruṣaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram .. 42.55 ..
6.3.d:
तदन्ते चागमद्भूतं ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभम् .
मुञ्च मुञ्चेति पुरुषं देवदेवं महेश्वरम् .. 42.55 ..
6.3.m: Directly after him arrived the spirit, shining like the blazing sun, / saying, "Release, release the man!" to Maheśvara, the god of gods.

6.3.s:
evamukto mahādevastena bhūtena bhārata .
yogīndraṃ darśayāmāsa nakhamāṃsāntare tadā .. 42.56 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तो महादेवस्तेन भूतेन भारत .
योगीन्द्रं दर्शयामास नखमांसान्तरे तदा .. 42.56 ..
6.3.m: Addressed thus by that spirit, O Bhārata, Mahādeva / then revealed the lord of yogins inside the crevice of his fingernail.

6.3.s:
saṃsthāpya bhūtaṃ bhūteśaḥ paramāpadgataṃ munim .
uvāca mā bhaistvaṃ vipra nirgacchasva mahāmune .. 42.57 ..
6.3.d:
संस्थाप्य भूतं भूतेशः परमापद्गतं मुनिम् .
उवाच मा भैस्त्वं विप्र निर्गच्छस्व महामुने .. 42.57 ..
6.3.m: Having checked the spirit, the lord of spirits said to the sage / who had fallen into extreme peril: "Do not fear, O brahmin; come out, O great sage!"

6.3.s:
tataḥ susūkṣmadehasthaṃ bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvābravīdidam .
kimasya tvaṃ mahābhūta kariṣyasi vadasva me .. 42.58 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सुसूक्ष्मदेहस्थं भूतं दृष्ट्वाब्रवीदिदम् .
किमस्य त्वं महाभूत करिष्यसि वदस्व मे .. 42.58 ..
6.3.m: Then, seeing the spirit standing with an exceedingly subtle form, he said this: / "What will you do to him, O great spirit? Tell me!"

6.3.s:
kṛtyovāca -
krodhāviṣṭena deveśa pippalādena cintitā .
asya dehaṃ haniṣyāmi hiṃsārthaṃ viddhi māṃ prabho .. 42.59 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्योवाच -
क्रोधाविष्टेन देवेश पिप्पलादेन चिन्तिता .
अस्य देहं हनिष्यामि हिंसार्थं विद्धि मां प्रभो .. 42.59 ..
6.3.m: The Kṛtyā said: / "Conceived by Pippalāda when filled with fury, O lord of gods, / I shall destroy his body; know me to be meant for violence, O Lord!"

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā mahādevo bhūtasya vadanāccyutam .
kaṭisthaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ ca mantrayāmāsa mantravit .. 42.60 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवो भूतस्य वदनाच्च्युतम् .
कटिस्थं याज्ञवल्क्यं च मन्त्रयामास मन्त्रवित् .. 42.60 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this uttered from the mouth of the spirit, / Mahādeva, the knower of mantras, consecrated Yājñavalkya seated on his hip with mantras.

6.3.s:
yogīśvareti viprasya kṛtvā nāma yudhiṣṭhira .
visarjayitvā deveśastatraivāntaradhīyata .. 42.61 ..
6.3.d:
योगीश्वरेति विप्रस्य कृत्वा नाम युधिष्ठिर .
विसर्जयित्वा देवेशस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .. 42.61 ..
6.3.m: Bestowing the name Yogīśvara upon the brahmin, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / and dismissing [the spirit], the lord of gods vanished right there.

6.3.s:
preṣayitvā tu taṃ bhūtaṃ pippalādo'pi durmanāḥ .
pitṛmātṛsamudvigno narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ .. 42.62 ..
6.3.d:
प्रेषयित्वा तु तं भूतं पिप्पलादोऽपि दुर्मनाः .
पितृमातृसमुद्विग्नो नर्मदातटमाश्रितः .. 42.62 ..
6.3.m: Having dispatched that spirit, Pippalāda too, disheartened / and anxious about his father and mother, took shelter on the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
ekāṅguṣṭho nirāhāro varṣādā ṣoḍaśānnṛpa .
toṣayāmāsa deveśamumayā saha śaṅkaram .. 42.63 ..
6.3.d:
एकाङ्गुष्ठो निराहारो वर्षादा षोडशान्नृप .
तोषयामास देवेशमुमया सह शङ्करम् .. 42.63 ..
6.3.m: Standing on one big toe and fasting for sixteen years, O king, / he propitiated Śaṅkara, the lord of gods, along with Umā.

6.3.s: tatastattapasā tuṣṭaḥ śaṅkaro vākyamabravīt .. 42.64 ..
6.3.d: ततस्तत्तपसा तुष्टः शङ्करो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 42.64 ..
6.3.m: Then, pleased by that austerity, Śaṅkara spoke these words:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
parituṣṭo'smi te vipra tapasānena suvrata .
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva te dadmi manasā cepsitaṃ śubham .. 42.65 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते विप्र तपसानेन सुव्रत .
वरं वृणीष्व ते दद्मि मनसा चेप्सितं शुभम् .. 42.65 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "I am fully pleased with you, O brahmin, by this austerity, O one of good vows! / Choose a boon; I grant you the auspicious thing desired in your mind."

6.3.s:
pippalāda uvāca -
yadi me bhagavāṃstuṣṭo yadi deyo varo mama .
atra saṃnihito deva tīrthe bhava maheśvara .. 42.66 ..
6.3.d:
पिप्पलाद उवाच -
यदि मे भगवांस्तुष्टो यदि देयो वरो मम .
अत्र संनिहितो देव तीर्थे भव महेश्वर .. 42.66 ..
6.3.m: Pippalāda said: / "If the Blessed Lord is pleased with me, if a boon is to be granted to me, / then, O god, remain present at this sacred ford, O Maheśvara!"

6.3.s:
evamuktastathetyuktvā pippalādaṃ mahāmunim .
jagāmādarśanaṃ devo bhūtasaṅghasamanvitaḥ .. 42.67 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा पिप्पलादं महामुनिम् .
जगामादर्शनं देवो भूतसङ्घसमन्वितः .. 42.67 ..
6.3.m: Addressed thus, saying "So be it!" to the great sage Pippalāda, / the god vanished from sight, accompanied by the host of spirits.

6.3.s:
pippalādo gate deve snātvā tatra mahāmbhasi .
sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāmottaraparvatam .. 42.68 ..
6.3.d:
पिप्पलादो गते देवे स्नात्वा तत्र महाम्भसि .
स्थापयित्वा महादेवं जगामोत्तरपर्वतम् .. 42.68 ..
6.3.m: When the god had departed, Pippalāda bathed there in the great water, / installed Mahādeva, and departed for the northern mountain.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā snātvā mantrayutaṃ nṛpa .
tarpayitvā pitḥn devān pūjayecca maheśvaram .. 42.69 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरो भक्त्या स्नात्वा मन्त्रयुतं नृप .
तर्पयित्वा पित्ःन् देवान् पूजयेच्च महेश्वरम् .. 42.69 ..
6.3.m: A person who bathes with devotion at that sacred ford along with mantras, O king, / offers libations to the ancestors and gods, and worships Maheśvara,

6.3.s:
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam .
mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 42.70 ..
6.3.d:
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् .
मृतो रुद्रपुरं याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 42.70 ..
6.3.m: obtains the peerless fruit of a horse sacrifice; / upon dying, he goes to the city of Rudra; there should be no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
atha yo bhojayedviprān pitḥnuddiśya bhārata .
tasya te dvādaśābdāni modante divi tarpitāḥ .. 42.71 ..
6.3.d:
अथ यो भोजयेद्विप्रान् पित्ःनुद्दिश्य भारत .
तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि मोदन्ते दिवि तर्पिताः .. 42.71 ..
6.3.m: Moreover, he who feeds brahmins on behalf of the ancestors, O Bhārata, / his ancestors, fully satisfied, rejoice in heaven for twelve years.

6.3.s:
saṃnyāsena tu yaḥ kaścittatra tīrthe tanuṃ tyajet .
anivartikā gatistasya rudralokātkadācana .. 42.72 ..
6.3.d:
संन्यासेन तु यः कश्चित्तत्र तीर्थे तनुं त्यजेत् .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकात्कदाचन .. 42.72 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons the body at that sacred ford by means of renunciation, / his state is one of never returning from the realm of Rudra at any time.

6.3.s:
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭhe hi tvayānagha .
māhātmyaṃ pippalādasya tīrthasyotpattireva ca .. 42.73 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्सर्वं समाख्यातं यत्पृष्ठे हि त्वयानघ .
माहात्म्यं पिप्पलादस्य तीर्थस्योत्पत्तिरेव च .. 42.73 ..
6.3.m: All this that was asked by you, O sinless one, has been related: / the māhātmya of Pippalāda and the very origin of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam .
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 42.74 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye pippalādatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 43
6.3.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यं दुःस्वप्ननाशनम् .
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 42.74 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये पिप्पलादतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 43
6.3.m:
This is meritorious, sin-removing, auspicious, and destroys bad dreams; / for those who read or hear it, there is the destruction of all sins.
Thus ends the forty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Pippalādatīrtha,' in the Narmadāmāhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth section, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 43

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra vimaleśvaramuttamam .
tatra devaśilā ramyā svayaṃ devairvinirmitā .. 43.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र विमलेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
तत्र देवशिला रम्या स्वयं देवैर्विनिर्मिता .. 43.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Then one should go, O king of kings, to the supreme Vimaleśvara; / there is a charming divine rock, fashioned by the gods themselves.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇānpūjayennṛpa .
svalpenāpi hi dānena tasya cānto na vidyate .. 43.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणान्पूजयेन्नृप .
स्वल्पेनापि हि दानेन तस्य चान्तो न विद्यते .. 43.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes there with devotion and honors brahmins, O king, / there is no end to [the fruit of] his gift, even if it be very small."

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kāni dānāni viprendra śastāni dharaṇītale .
yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 43.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कानि दानानि विप्रेन्द्र शस्तानि धरणीतले .
यानि दत्त्वा नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 43.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "Which gifts are commended on the surface of the earth, O foremost of brahmins, / by giving which with devotion a person is freed from all sins?"

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikameva ca .
bhūmidānaṃ ca godānaṃ mocayatpaśubhānnaram .. 43.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सुवर्णं रजतं ताम्रं मणिमौक्तिकमेव च .
भूमिदानं च गोदानं मोचयत्पशुभान्नरम् .. 43.4 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / "Gold, silver, copper, as well as gems and pearls, / the gift of land, and the gift of cows liberate a man from bestial existence.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitkurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam .
rudraloke vasettāvadyāvadā bhūtasamplavam .. 43.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् .
रुद्रलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदा भूतसम्प्लवम् .. 43.5 ..
6.3.m: Whoever causes the end of his life's breaths at that sacred ford / dwells in the realm of Rudra until the dissolution of beings.

6.3.s:
tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchetsarvapāpakṣayaṃkarīm .
tatra snātvārcayeddevaṃ tejorāśiṃ divākaram .. 43.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत्सर्वपापक्षयंकरीम् .
तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेद्देवं तेजोराशिं दिवाकरम् .. 43.6 ..
6.3.m: Then one should proceed to the Puṣkariṇī that causes the destruction of all sins; / having bathed there, one should worship the god, the sun, a mass of radiance.

6.3.s:
ṛcamekāṃ japetsāmnaḥ sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet .
yajurvedasya japanādṛgvedasya tathaiva ca .. 43.7 ..
6.3.d:
ऋचमेकां जपेत्साम्नः सामवेदफलं लभेत् .
यजुर्वेदस्य जपनादृग्वेदस्य तथैव च .. 43.7 ..
6.3.m: Reciting a single verse of the Sāman, one gains the fruit of the Sāmaveda, / and likewise from reciting a verse of the Yajurveda and the Ṛgveda."

6.3.s:
akṣaraṃ vā japenmantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram .
ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 43.8 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षरं वा जपेन्मन्त्रं ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम् .
आदित्यहृदयं जप्त्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 43.8 ..
6.3.m:
Or, meditating upon the sun, he should chant the monosyllable mantra;
reciting the Ādityahṛdaya, he is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vidhinā japeddvijān .
tasya koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 43.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा विधिना जपेद्द्विजान् .
तस्य कोटिगुणं पुण्यं जायते नात्र संशयः .. 43.9 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and duly prays for the twice-born,
his merit becomes ten millionfold; there is no doubt in this.

6.3.s:
anāśakenāgnigatyā jale vā dehapātanāt .
tasmiṃstīrthe mṛto yastu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 43.10 ..
6.3.d:
अनाशकेनाग्निगत्या जले वा देहपातनात् .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे मृतो यस्तु स याति परमां गतिम् .. 43.10 ..
6.3.m:
By fasting, by entering fire, or by casting off the body into water,
he who dies at that sacred ford attains the supreme destination.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā nṛpasattama .
vihitaṃ karma kurvāṇaḥ sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim .. 43.11 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रो वा नृपसत्तम .
विहितं कर्म कुर्वाणः स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् .. 43.11 ..
6.3.m:
A brahmin, a kṣatriya, a vaiśya, or a śūdra, O best of kings,
performing his ordained duty, shall go to the supreme destination.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
vyādhiṃ sattvakṣayaṃ mohaṃ jñātvā varṇā dvijottama .
pāpebhyo vipramucyante kena tatsādhanaṃ vada .. 43.12 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
व्याधिं सत्त्वक्षयं मोहं ज्ञात्वा वर्णा द्विजोत्तम .
पापेभ्यो विप्रमुच्यन्ते केन तत्साधनं वद .. 43.12 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Recognising illness, loss of strength, and delusion, O best of the twice-born,
by what means are the castes freed from sins? Tell [me] that.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tilodakī tilasnāyī kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ .
brāhmaṇo'naśanaiḥ prāṇāṃstyajallabhati sadgatim .. 43.13 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तिलोदकी तिलस्नायी कामक्रोधविवर्जितः .
ब्राह्मणोऽनशनैः प्राणांस्त्यजल्लभति सद्गतिम् .. 43.13 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Offering sesamum water, bathing with sesamum, free from desire and anger,
a brahmin relinquishing his life breaths through fasting attains a good destination.

6.3.s:
saṅgrāme sadgatiṃ tāta kṣatriyo nidhane labhet .
tadabhāvānmahāprājña sevamāno labhediti .. 43.14 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्ग्रामे सद्गतिं तात क्षत्रियो निधने लभेत् .
तदभावान्महाप्राज्ञ सेवमानो लभेदिति .. 43.14 ..
6.3.m:
In battle, dear child, a kṣatriya attains a good destination at his death;
in its absence, O wise one, he attains it through devoted service.

6.3.s:
vyādhigrahagṛhīto vā vṛddho vā vikalendriyaḥ .
ātmānaṃ dāhayitvāgnau vidhinā sadgatiṃ labhet .. 43.15 ..
6.3.d:
व्याधिग्रहगृहीतो वा वृद्धो वा विकलेन्द्रियः .
आत्मानं दाहयित्वाग्नौ विधिना सद्गतिं लभेत् .. 43.15 ..
6.3.m:
Or if seized by disease or evil planets, or old, or with impaired senses,
he attains a good destination by duly having himself consumed in fire.

6.3.s:
vaiśyo'pi hi tyajanprāṇānevaṃ vai śubhabhāgbhavet .
jale vā śuddhabhāvena tyaktvā prāṇāñchivo bhavet .. 43.16 ..
6.3.d:
वैश्योऽपि हि त्यजन्प्राणानेवं वै शुभभाग्भवेत् .
जले वा शुद्धभावेन त्यक्त्वा प्राणाञ्छिवो भवेत् .. 43.16 ..
6.3.m:
Even a vaiśya, relinquishing his life breaths in this manner, indeed shares in good fortune;
or giving up his life breaths in water with a pure mind, he becomes Śiva.

6.3.s:
śūdro'pi dvijaśuśrūṣustoṣayitvā maheśvaram .
vimucya nānyathā pāpaḥ patate narake dhruvam .. 43.17 ..
6.3.d:
शूद्रोऽपि द्विजशुश्रूषुस्तोषयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
विमुच्य नान्यथा पापः पतते नरके ध्रुवम् .. 43.17 ..
6.3.m:
Even a śūdra, intent on serving the twice-born, having pleased Maheśvara,
and having freed himself [from sin, attains it]; otherwise, sinful, he falls inevitably into hell.

6.3.s:
athavā praṇavāśakto dvijebhyo gurave tathā .
pañcāgnau śoṣayeddehamāpṛcchya dvijasattamān .. 43.18 ..
6.3.d:
अथवा प्रणवाशक्तो द्विजेभ्यो गुरवे तथा .
पञ्चाग्नौ शोषयेद्देहमापृच्छ्य द्विजसत्तमान् .. 43.18 ..
6.3.m:
Or, unable to recite the praṇava, having asked the best of the twice-born,
he may desiccate his body in the five fires for the twice-born and the guru.

6.3.s:
śāntadāntajitakrodhāñchāstrayuktān vicakṣaṇān .
teṣāṃ caivopadeśena karīṣāgniṃ prasādhayet .. 43.19 ..
6.3.d:
शान्तदान्तजितक्रोधाञ्छास्त्रयुक्तान् विचक्षणान् .
तेषां चैवोपदेशेन करीषाग्निं प्रसाधयेत् .. 43.19 ..
6.3.m:
[Asking] those who are calm, self-restrained, who have conquered anger, learned in scripture, and discerning,
by their instruction he should prepare a fire of dried cow-dung.

6.3.s:
evaṃ varṇā yathātvena mūḍhāhaṅkāramohitāḥ .
patanti narake ghore yathāndho girigahvare .. 43.20 ..
6.3.d:
एवं वर्णा यथात्वेन मूढाहङ्कारमोहिताः .
पतन्ति नरके घोरे यथान्धो गिरिगह्वरे .. 43.20 ..
6.3.m:
Thus the castes, foolish and deluded by egoism, failing to act properly,
fall into terrible hell, like a blind man into a mountain chasm.

6.3.s:
ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartante kāmacārataḥ .
kṛmiyoniṃ prapadyante teṣāṃ piṇḍo na ca kriyā .. 43.21 ..
6.3.d:
ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तन्ते कामचारतः .
कृमियोनिं प्रपद्यन्ते तेषां पिण्डो न च क्रिया .. 43.21 ..
6.3.m:
Those who abandon the scriptural injunction and act according to their own desire,
reach the womb of worms; for them there is neither funeral cake nor rite.

6.3.s:
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ tyaktvā yathecchācārasevinaḥ .
aṣṭāviṃśatirvai koṭyo narakāṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 43.22 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं त्यक्त्वा यथेच्छाचारसेविनः .
अष्टाविंशतिर्वै कोट्यो नरकाणां युधिष्ठिर .. 43.22 ..
6.3.m:
Abandoning the duty taught in the Śruti and Smṛti, indulging in wilful conduct—
there are twenty-eight crores of hells, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
pratyekaṃ vā patantyete magnā narakasāgare .
durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma bahudharmārjitaṃ nṛpa .. 43.23 ..
6.3.d:
प्रत्येकं वा पतन्त्येते मग्ना नरकसागरे .
दुर्लभं मानुषं जन्म बहुधर्मार्जितं नृप .. 43.23 ..
6.3.m:
One by one these [sinners] fall, submerged in the ocean of hell.
Human birth is hard to attain, acquired through much virtue, O king.

6.3.s:
tallabdhvā madamātsaryaṃ yo vai tyajati mānavaḥ .
saṃniyamya sadātmānaṃ jñānacakṣurnaro hi saḥ .. 43.24 ..
6.3.d:
तल्लब्ध्वा मदमात्सर्यं यो वै त्यजति मानवः .
संनियम्य सदात्मानं ज्ञानचक्षुर्नरो हि सः .. 43.24 ..
6.3.m:
The man who, having attained it, gives up pride and malice,
always restraining himself, is indeed a man whose eye is knowledge.

6.3.s: ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā .. 43.25 ..
6.3.d: अज्ञानतिमिरान्धस्य ज्ञानांजनशलाकया .. 43.25 ..
6.3.m: For him who is blinded by the darkness of ignorance, if with the collyrium-probe of knowledge

6.3.s:
yasya nonmīlitaṃ cakṣurjñeyo jātyandha eva saḥ .
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ nṛpasattama .. 43.26 ..
6.3.d:
यस्य नोन्मीलितं चक्षुर्ज्ञेयो जात्यन्ध एव सः .
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं यत्पृष्टं नृपसत्तम .. 43.26 ..
6.3.m:
the eye is not opened, he should be known as blind from birth.
All this has been told to you as asked, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
tathāniṣṭatarāṇāṃ hi rudrasya vacanaṃ yathā .
narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā rudradehādviniḥsṛtā .. 43.27 ..
6.3.d:
तथानिष्टतराणां हि रुद्रस्य वचनं यथा .
नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा रुद्रदेहाद्विनिःसृता .. 43.27 ..
6.3.m:
So too, for those who are most undesirable, according to Rudra's word:
the Narmadā, the best of rivers, came forth from Rudra's body.

6.3.s:
tārayetsarvabhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca .
sarvadevādhidevena īśvareṇa mahātmanā .. 43.28 ..
6.3.d:
तारयेत्सर्वभूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च .
सर्वदेवाधिदेवेन ईश्वरेण महात्मना .. 43.28 ..
6.3.m:
She carries across all beings, unmoving and moving.
By Īśvara, the great-souled supreme god of all gods,

6.3.s:
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya mahāpuṇyāvatāritā .
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ snānānnaśyati karmajam .. 43.29 ..
6.3.d:
लोकानां च हितार्थाय महापुण्यावतारिता .
मानसं वाचिकं पापं स्नानान्नश्यति कर्मजम् .. 43.29 ..
6.3.m:
for the welfare of the worlds, she was brought down, very holy;
sin born of action—mental and verbal—is destroyed by bathing [in her].

6.3.s:
rudradehādviniṣkrāntā tena puṇyatamā hi sā .
prātarutthāya yo nityaṃ bhūmimākramya bhaktitaḥ .. 43.30 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रदेहाद्विनिष्क्रान्ता तेन पुण्यतमा हि सा .
प्रातरुत्थाय यो नित्यं भूमिमाक्रम्य भक्तितः .. 43.30 ..
6.3.m:
She came forth from Rudra's body; therefore she is most holy.
Waking at dawn, whoever, stepping on the ground with devotion,

6.3.s:
etanmantraṃ japettāta snānasya labhate phalam .
namaḥ puṇyajale devi namaḥ sāgaragāmini .. 43.31 ..
6.3.d:
एतन्मन्त्रं जपेत्तात स्नानस्य लभते फलम् .
नमः पुण्यजले देवि नमः सागरगामिनि .. 43.31 ..
6.3.m:
should chant this mantra, dear child, obtains the fruit of bathing:
'Homage to you with holy water, O goddess! Homage to you who flow to the ocean!

6.3.s: namo'stu pāpanirmoce namo devi varānane .. 43.32 ..
6.3.d: नमोऽस्तु पापनिर्मोचे नमो देवि वरानने .. 43.32 ..
6.3.m: Homage be to you who release from sin! Homage to you, O fair-faced goddess!

6.3.s:
namo'stu te ṛṣivarasaṅghasevite namo'stu te trinayanadehaniḥsṛte .
namo'stu te sukṛtavatāṃ sadā vare namo'stu te satatapavitrapāvani .. 43.33 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते ऋषिवरसङ्घसेविते नमोऽस्तु ते त्रिनयनदेहनिःसृते .
नमोऽस्तु ते सुकृतवतां सदा वरे नमोऽस्तु ते सततपवित्रपावनि .. 43.33 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे विमलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Homage to you served by multitudes of excellent seers! Homage to you who issued from the body of the Three-Eyed One!
Homage to you, always the boon for the meritorious! Homage to you, who eternally purify the pure!'
Thus ends the forty-third chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford Vimaleśvara, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .
revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle nirmitaṃ śūlapāṇinā .. 44.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .
रेवाया दक्षिणे कूले निर्मितं शूलपाणिना .. 44.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hear about that sacred ford, the highest of sacred fords, O king, / created on the southern bank of the Revā by the Trident-Wielding One,

6.3.s:
mokṣārthaṃ mānavendrāṇāṃ nirmitaṃ nṛpasattama .
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
śrutā me vividhā dharmāstīrthāni vividhāni ca .
dānadharmāḥ samastāśca tvatprasādāddvijottama .. 44.2 ..
6.3.d:
मोक्षार्थं मानवेन्द्राणां निर्मितं नृपसत्तम .
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
श्रुता मे विविधा धर्मास्तीर्थानि विविधानि च .
दानधर्माः समस्ताश्च त्वत्प्रसादाद्द्विजोत्तम .. 44.2 ..
6.3.m:
fashioned for the liberation of the lords of men, O best of kings.
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Various duties and various sacred fords have been heard by me,
as well as all the duties of gift-giving, through your grace, O best of the twice-born.

6.3.s:
anyacca śrotumicchāmi saṃsāraśchidyate yathā .
punarāgamanaṃ nāsti mokṣaprāptirbhavedyathā .. 44.3 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यच्च श्रोतुमिच्छामि संसारश्छिद्यते यथा .
पुनरागमनं नास्ति मोक्षप्राप्तिर्भवेद्यथा .. 44.3 ..
6.3.m: I wish to hear another thing: how saṃsāra is cut off, / how there is no return, and how liberation is attained.

6.3.s: etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasādāddvijasattama .. 44.4 ..
6.3.d: एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वं प्रसादाद्द्विजसत्तम .. 44.4 ..
6.3.m: Tell me all this, by your grace, O best of the twice-born.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā tīrthāttīrthāntaraṃ mahat .
śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate cābdikādaghāt .. 44.5 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा तीर्थात्तीर्थान्तरं महत् .
श्रुते यस्य प्रभावे तु मुच्यते चाब्दिकादघात् .. 44.5 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Listen with a focused mind to the great, superior sacred ford, / upon hearing whose power one is freed from sins accumulated over a year.

6.3.s:
vācikairmānasairvāpi śārīraiśca viśeṣataḥ .
kīrtanāttasya tīrthasya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 44.6 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकैर्मानसैर्वापि शारीरैश्च विशेषतः .
कीर्तनात्तस्य तीर्थस्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 44.6 ..
6.3.m: Especially through mental, vocal, or bodily sins, / by praising that sacred ford one is freed from all misdeeds.

6.3.s:
pañcakrośapramāṇaṃ tu tacca tīrthaṃ mahīpate .
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ prāṇināṃ pāpakarmiṇām .. 44.7 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चक्रोशप्रमाणं तु तच्च तीर्थं महीपते .
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं प्राणिनां पापकर्मिणाम् .. 44.7 ..
6.3.m: That sacred ford measures five krośas, O lord of the earth; / divine, bestowing enjoyment and liberation upon sinful living beings.

6.3.s:
revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle parvato bhṛgusaṃjñitaḥ .
tasya mūrdhni ca tattīrthaṃ sthāpitaṃ caiva śambhunā .. 44.8 ..
6.3.d:
रेवाया दक्षिणे कूले पर्वतो भृगुसंज्ञितः .
तस्य मूर्ध्नि च तत्तीर्थं स्थापितं चैव शम्भुना .. 44.8 ..
6.3.m: On the southern bank of the Revā is a mountain called Bhṛgu; / on its summit that sacred ford was established by Śambhu.

6.3.s:
śūlabhedeti vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bhūpate .
tatra sthitāśca ye vṛkṣāstīrthāccaiva caturdiśam .. 44.9 ..
6.3.d:
शूलभेदेति विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु भूपते .
तत्र स्थिताश्च ये वृक्षास्तीर्थाच्चैव चतुर्दिशम् .. 44.9 ..
6.3.m: It is renowned in the three worlds as Śūlabheda, O king. / The trees growing there in all four directions around the sacred ford,

6.3.s:
patitā nilayaṃ yānti rudrasya nātra saṃśayaḥ .
mṛtāstatraiva ye kecijjantavo bhuvi pakṣiṇaḥ .. 44.10 ..
6.3.d:
पतिता निलयं यान्ति रुद्रस्य नात्र संशयः .
मृतास्तत्रैव ये केचिज्जन्तवो भुवि पक्षिणः .. 44.10 ..
6.3.m: when fallen, go to the abode of Rudra, without doubt. / Whatever creatures and birds on earth die right there,

6.3.s:
te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ .
pātālānniḥsṛtā gaṅgā bhogavatītisaṃjñitā .. 44.11 ..
6.3.d:
ते यान्ति परमं लोकं तत्र तीर्थे न संशयः .
पातालान्निःसृता गङ्गा भोगवतीतिसंज्ञिता .. 44.11 ..
6.3.m: they go to the supreme realm at that sacred ford, without doubt. / The Gaṅgā named Bhogavatī, having issued from Pātāla,

6.3.s:
niṣkrāntā śūlabhedācca sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī .
yā sā gīrvāṇanāmnyanyā vahetpuṇyā mahānadī .. 44.12 ..
6.3.d:
निष्क्रान्ता शूलभेदाच्च सर्वपापक्षयंकरी .
या सा गीर्वाणनाम्न्यन्या वहेत्पुण्या महानदी .. 44.12 ..
6.3.m: emerged from Śūlabheda, destroying all sins. / That other holy great river called Gīrvāṇā that flows there,

6.3.s:
patitā kuṇḍamadhye tu yatra bhinnaṃ triśūlinā .
śambhunā ca purā tāta utpādya ca sarasvatī .. 44.13 ..
6.3.d:
पतिता कुण्डमध्ये तु यत्र भिन्नं त्रिशूलिना .
शम्भुना च पुरा तात उत्पाद्य च सरस्वती .. 44.13 ..
6.3.m: fell into the midst of the basin where it was pierced by the trident-bearer, / by Śambhu in the past, my dear, having created the Sarasvatī.

6.3.s:
sā tatra patitā rājan prācīnāghavimocinī .
bhāsvatyā tritayaṃ yatra śilā gīrvāṇasaṃjñitā .. 44.14 ..
6.3.d:
सा तत्र पतिता राजन् प्राचीनाघविमोचिनी .
भास्वत्या त्रितयं यत्र शिला गीर्वाणसंज्ञिता .. 44.14 ..
6.3.m: She fell there, O king, releasing ancient sins, / where there is a triad of the radiant one, and the stone called Gīrvāṇā.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe ca tattīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati .
kedāraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gayā tathā .. 44.15 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे च तत्तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति .
केदारं च प्रयागं च कुरुक्षेत्रं गया तथा .. 44.15 ..
6.3.m: There at that sacred ford—such a sacred ford has never existed nor will ever exist. / Kedāra, Prayāga, Kurukṣetra, and Gayā,

6.3.s:
anyāni ca sutīrthāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .
pañca sthānāni tīrthāni pṛthagbhūtāni yāni ca .. 44.16 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यानि च सुतीर्थानि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .
पञ्च स्थानानि तीर्थानि पृथग्भूतानि यानि च .. 44.16 ..
6.3.m: and other fine sacred fords are not worth a sixteenth part of it. / The five sacred places that are distinct,

6.3.s:
vakṣyāmi ca samāsena ekaikaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak .
gayā nābhyāṃ yathā puṇyā cakratīrthaṃ ca tatsamam .. 44.17 ..
6.3.d:
वक्ष्यामि च समासेन एकैकं च पृथक्पृथक् .
गया नाभ्यां यथा पुण्या चक्रतीर्थं च तत्समम् .. 44.17 ..
6.3.m: I shall declare in brief, each one separately. / As Gayā is holy at the navel, Cakratīrtha is equal to that;

6.3.s:
dharmāraṇye yathā kūpaṃ śūlabhedaṃ ca tatsamam .
brahmayūpaṃ yathā puṇyaṃ devanadyāstathaiva ca .. 44.18 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मारण्ये यथा कूपं शूलभेदं च तत्समम् .
ब्रह्मयूपं यथा पुण्यं देवनद्यास्तथैव च .. 44.18 ..
6.3.m: as the well in Dharmāraṇya [is holy], Śūlabheda is equal to that; / as the sacrificial post of Brahmā is holy, and so too of the river of the gods;

6.3.s:
yathā gayāśiraḥ puṇyaṃ surāṇāṃ ca yathā śilā .
yathā ca puṣkaraṃ sthānaṃ mārkaṇḍahrada eva ca .. 44.19 ..
6.3.d:
यथा गयाशिरः पुण्यं सुराणां च यथा शिला .
यथा च पुष्करं स्थानं मार्कण्डह्रद एव च .. 44.19 ..
6.3.m: as Gayāśiras is holy, and as the stone of the gods [is holy], / and as the site of Puṣkara, so too is Mārkaṇḍahrada.

6.3.s:
dattvā piṇḍodakaṃ tatra piṇḍāṇāṃ ca tathākṣayam .
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ toyaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ .
mucyate sarvapāpaistu uragaḥ kañcukairiva .
anindyānpūjayedviprān dambhakrodhavivarjitān .. 44.20 ..
6.3.d:
दत्त्वा पिण्डोदकं तत्र पिण्डाणां च तथाक्षयम् .
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं तोयं पिबति नित्यशः .
मुच्यते सर्वपापैस्तु उरगः कञ्चुकैरिव .
अनिन्द्यान्पूजयेद्विप्रान् दम्भक्रोधविवर्जितान् .. 44.20 ..
6.3.m: Having offered funeral cakes and water there, and likewise offering of funeral cakes that brings inexhaustible [merit], / whoever performs a śrāddha there and constantly drinks the water, / is freed from all sins like a serpent from its slough. / One should honor blameless brahmins who are free from deceit and anger;

6.3.s:
trayodaśadinaṃ dānaṃ trayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet .
abhyarcitaṃ suraṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇanāthaṃ gajānanam .. 44.21 ..
6.3.d:
त्रयोदशदिनं दानं त्रयोदशगुणं भवेत् .
अभ्यर्चितं सुरं दृष्ट्वा गणनाथं गजाननम् .. 44.21 ..
6.3.m: a gift given on the thirteenth day becomes thirteen times as fruitful. / Beholding the honored god, the elephant-faced Gaṇanātha,

6.3.s: sarve vighnā vinaśyanti dṛṣṭvā kambalakṣetrapam .. 44.22 ..
6.3.d: सर्वे विघ्ना विनश्यन्ति दृष्ट्वा कम्बलक्षेत्रपम् .. 44.22 ..
6.3.m: all obstacles are destroyed upon seeing the guardian of the field, Kambala.

6.3.s: pūjayetparayā bhaktyā śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram .. 44.23 ..
6.3.d: पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या शूलपाणिं महेश्वरम् .. 44.23 ..
6.3.m: With supreme devotion one should worship Maheśvara, holding a trident in hand.

6.3.s:
devasya pūrvabhāge tu umā pūjyā prayatnataḥ .
mārkaṇḍeśaṃ tato bhaktyā pūjayedguhavāsinam .. 44.24 ..
6.3.d:
देवस्य पूर्वभागे तु उमा पूज्या प्रयत्नतः .
मार्कण्डेशं ततो भक्त्या पूजयेद्गुहवासिनम् .. 44.24 ..
6.3.m: To the east of the god, Umā is to be worshipped with effort; / then with devotion one should worship Mārkaṇḍeśa, who dwells in the cave.

6.3.s:
mucyante pātakaiḥ sarvairajñānajñānasaṃcitaiḥ .
guhāmadhye praviṣṭastu japetsūktaṃ tu tryakṣaram .. 44.25 ..
6.3.d:
मुच्यन्ते पातकैः सर्वैरज्ञानज्ञानसंचितैः .
गुहामध्ये प्रविष्टस्तु जपेत्सूक्तं तु त्र्यक्षरम् .. 44.25 ..
6.3.m: They are freed from all sins accumulated consciously or unconsciously. / Entering into the cave, one should chant the three-syllabled hymn;

6.3.s:
nīlaparvatajaṃ puṇyaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśena labheta saḥ .
trinarāstatra tiṣṭhanti sādityamarutaiḥ saha .. 44.26 ..
6.3.d:
नीलपर्वतजं पुण्यं षष्ठांशेन लभेत सः .
त्रिनरास्तत्र तिष्ठन्ति सादित्यमरुतैः सह .. 44.26 ..
6.3.m: he will obtain one-sixth of the merit born of the Blue Mountain. / Three persons abide there together with the Ādityas and the Maruts.

6.3.s:
sarvadevamayaṃ sthānaṃ koṭiliṅgamanuttamam .
yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃkṣayam .. 44.27 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वदेवमयं स्थानं कोटिलिङ्गमनुत्तमम् .
यथा नदीनदाः सर्वे सागरे यान्ति संक्षयम् .. 44.27 ..
6.3.m: The unexcelled Koṭiliṅga is a site consisting of all the gods. / Just as all rivers and streams meet their end in the ocean,

6.3.s:
tathā pāpāni naśyanti śūlabhedasya darśanāt .
pratyakṣo dṛśyate'dyāpi pratyayo hyavanīpate .. 44.28 ..
6.3.d:
तथा पापानि नश्यन्ति शूलभेदस्य दर्शनात् .
प्रत्यक्षो दृश्यतेऽद्यापि प्रत्ययो ह्यवनीपते .. 44.28 ..
6.3.m: so sins are destroyed by the darśana of Śūlabheda. / Even today an evident proof is seen, O king:

6.3.s:
visphuliṅgā liṅgamadhye spandante snānayogataḥ .
dvitīyaḥ pratyayastatra tailabindurna sarpati .. 44.29 ..
6.3.d:
विस्फुलिङ्गा लिङ्गमध्ये स्पन्दन्ते स्नानयोगतः .
द्वितीयः प्रत्ययस्तत्र तैलबिन्दुर्न सर्पति .. 44.29 ..
6.3.m: sparks vibrate in the middle of the liṅga upon performing ritual ablution; / a second proof there is that a drop of oil does not spread.

6.3.s:
evaṃ hi pratyayastatra śūlabhedaprabhāvajaḥ .
yaḥ smarecchūlabhedaṃ tu trikālaṃ nityameva ca .. 44.30 ..
6.3.d:
एवं हि प्रत्ययस्तत्र शूलभेदप्रभावजः .
यः स्मरेच्छूलभेदं तु त्रिकालं नित्यमेव च .. 44.30 ..
6.3.m: Such indeed is the proof there, born of the power of Śūlabheda. / Whoever remembers Śūlabheda at the three junctures of the day, continuously,

6.3.s:
sa pūtaśca bhavetsākṣātsabāhyābhyantaro nṛpa .
na kasyacinmayā khyātaṃ pṛṣṭo'haṃ tridaśairapi .. 44.31 ..
6.3.d:
स पूतश्च भवेत्साक्षात्सबाह्याभ्यन्तरो नृप .
न कस्यचिन्मया ख्यातं पृष्टोऽहं त्रिदशैरपि .. 44.31 ..
6.3.m: becomes manifestly purified, both outwardly and inwardly, O king. / I have not told this to anyone, even though questioned by the gods;

6.3.s:
guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ sadā gopyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadoṣaghnamuttamam .. 44.32 ..
6.3.d:
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं सदा गोप्यं कृतं मया .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदोषघ्नमुत्तमम् .. 44.32 ..
6.3.m: more secret than the secret, this sacred ford was always kept hidden by me. / Holy, destroying all sins, excellent, removing all defects,

6.3.s:
sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ śūlabhedaṃ janeśvara .
śrute yasya prabhāve tu mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 44.33 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वतीर्थमयं तीर्थं शूलभेदं जनेश्वर .
श्रुते यस्य प्रभावे तु मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 44.33 ..
6.3.m: it is a sacred ford embodying all sacred fords: Śūlabheda, O ruler of people; / upon hearing whose power one is freed from all misdeeds.

6.3.s:
śūlabhedaṃ mayā tāta saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ tava .
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 44.34 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ..
adhyāya 45
6.3.d:
शूलभेदं मया तात संक्षेपात्कथितं तव .
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 44.34 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदप्रशंसावर्णनं नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः..
अध्याय 45
6.3.m:
Śūlabheda has thus been related to you in brief, my dear; / the person who hears it with devotion is freed from all misdeeds.
Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, named the Description of the Praise of Śūlabheda, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 45

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
eṣa eva purā praśnaḥ paripṛṣṭo maheśvaram .
rājñā cottānapādena ṛṣidevasamāgame .. 45.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एष एव पुरा प्रश्नः परिपृष्टो महेश्वरम् .
राज्ञा चोत्तानपादेन ऋषिदेवसमागमे .. 45.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
This very question was asked formerly of Maheśvara
by King Uttānapāda at an assembly of seers and gods.

6.3.s:
uttānapāda uvāca -
idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ param .
guhyādguhyataraṃ sthānaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ hara .. 45.2 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तानपाद उवाच -
इदं तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वदेवमयं परम् .
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं स्थानं न दृष्टं न श्रुतं हर .. 45.2 ..

6.3.s:
śūlabhedaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ kenaivotpāditaṃ purā .
māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya vistarācchaṃsa me prabho .. 45.3 ..
6.3.d:
शूलभेदं कथं जातं केनैवोत्पादितं पुरा .
माहात्म्यं तस्य तीर्थस्य विस्तराच्छंस मे प्रभो .. 45.3 ..
6.3.m:
How did Śūlabheda come to be? By whom was it created in the past?
Proclaim to me in detail the māhātmya of that sacred ford, O Lord!

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
āsītpurā mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ .
martye na tādṛśaḥ kaścidvikrameṇa balena vā .. 45.4 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
आसीत्पुरा महावीर्यो दानवो बलदर्पितः .
मर्त्ये न तादृशः कश्चिद्विक्रमेण बलेन वा .. 45.4 ..

6.3.s:
sūnurbrahmasutasyāyamandhako nāma durmadaḥ .
nijasthāne vasan pāpaḥ kurvan rājyamakaṇṭakam .. 45.5 ..
6.3.d:
सूनुर्ब्रह्मसुतस्यायमन्धको नाम दुर्मदः .
निजस्थाने वसन् पापः कुर्वन् राज्यमकण्टकम् .. 45.5 ..
6.3.m:
He was the son of Brahmā's son, named Andhaka, haughty with pride;
dwelling in his own realm, the sinner ruled an empire without a thorn.

6.3.s:
hṛṣṭapuṣṭo vasanmartye sa surairnābhibhūyate .
bhavanaṃ tasya pāpasya vahnerupavanaṃ yathā .. 45.6 ..
6.3.d:
हृष्टपुष्टो वसन्मर्त्ये स सुरैर्नाभिभूयते .
भवनं तस्य पापस्य वह्नेरुपवनं यथा .. 45.6 ..
6.3.m:
Thriving and robust, living among mortals, he could not be overcome by the gods;
the dwelling of that sinful one was like the grove of fire.

6.3.s:
etasminnandhakaḥ kāle cintayāmāsa bhārata .
toṣayāmi mahādevaṃ yena sānugraho bhavet .. 45.7 ..
6.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्धकः काले चिन्तयामास भारत .
तोषयामि महादेवं येन सानुग्रहो भवेत् .. 45.7 ..
6.3.m:
At that time, O descendant of Bharata, Andhaka considered:
'I shall please Mahādeva, so that he may be gracious to me.

6.3.s:
prārthayāmi varaṃ divyaṃ yo me manasi vartate .
paraṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā so'ndhako nirgato gṛhāt .. 45.8 ..
6.3.d:
प्रार्थयामि वरं दिव्यं यो मे मनसि वर्तते .
परं स निश्चयं कृत्वा सोऽन्धको निर्गतो गृहात् .. 45.8 ..
6.3.m:
I shall request the divine boon that is in my mind.'
Having formed a supreme resolve, that Andhaka departed from his house.

6.3.s:
revātaṭaṃ samāsādya dānavastapasi sthitaḥ .
ugraṃ tapaścacārāsau dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam .. 45.9 ..
6.3.d:
रेवातटं समासाद्य दानवस्तपसि स्थितः .
उग्रं तपश्चचारासौ दारुणं लोमहर्षणम् .. 45.9 ..
6.3.m:
Reaching the bank of the Revā, the demon took his stand in austerity;
he performed severe austerity, harsh and hair-raising.

6.3.s:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ sa nirāhāro'bhavattataḥ .
dvitīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa nyavasadvāribhojanaḥ .. 45.10 ..
6.3.d:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं स निराहारोऽभवत्ततः .
द्वितीयं तु सहस्रं स न्यवसद्वारिभोजनः .. 45.10 ..
6.3.m:
For a thousand divine years he remained without food;
for a second thousand [years] he lived consuming only water.

6.3.s:
tṛtīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ sa dhūmapānarato'bhavat .
caturthaṃ varṣasāhasraṃ yogābhyāsena saṃsthitaḥ .. 45.11 ..
6.3.d:
तृतीयं तु सहस्रं स धूमपानरतोऽभवत् .
चतुर्थं वर्षसाहस्रं योगाभ्यासेन संस्थितः .. 45.11 ..
6.3.m:
For a third thousand [years] he was devoted to inhaling smoke;
for a fourth thousand years he remained in the practice of yoga.

6.3.s:
kopīha nedṛśa cakre tapaḥ paramadāruṇam .
asthicarmāvaśeṣo'sau yāvattiṣṭhati bhārata .. 45.12 ..
6.3.d:
कोपीह नेदृश चक्रे तपः परमदारुणम् .
अस्थिचर्मावशेषोऽसौ यावत्तिष्ठति भारत .. 45.12 ..
6.3.m:
No one here ever performed such exceedingly terrible austerity;
while he remained with only bone and skin remaining, O descendant of Bharata,

6.3.s:
tasya mūrdhni tato rājan dhūmavārttirviniḥsṛtā .
devalokamatītyāsau kailāsaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitā .. 45.13 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य मूर्ध्नि ततो राजन् धूमवार्त्तिर्विनिःसृता .
देवलोकमतीत्यासौ कैलासं व्याप्य संस्थिता .. 45.13 ..
6.3.m:
a column of smoke then issued from his crown, O king;
transcending the world of the gods, it remained pervading Kailāsa.

6.3.s:
tāvaddevasamīpasthā umā vacanamabravīt .
ko'styayaṃ mānuṣe loke tapasogreṇa saṃsthitaḥ .. 45.14 ..
6.3.d:
तावद्देवसमीपस्था उमा वचनमब्रवीत् .
कोऽस्त्ययं मानुषे लोके तपसोग्रेण संस्थितः .. 45.14 ..
6.3.m:
Then Umā, standing near the God, spoke [these] words:
“Who is this in the mortal world engaged in fierce austerity?

6.3.s:
caturvarṣasahasrāṇi vyatīyuḥ parameśvara .
na kenāpīdṛśaṃ taptaṃ tapo dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ tathā .. 45.15 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्वर्षसहस्राणि व्यतीयुः परमेश्वर .
न केनापीदृशं तप्तं तपो दृष्टं श्रुतं तथा .. 45.15 ..
6.3.m:
Four thousand years have passed, O Supreme Lord.
No one has ever been seen or heard to perform such austerity.

6.3.s:
avajñāṃ kuruṣe deva kimatra niyamānvite .
sarvasya datse śīghraṃ tvamalpena tapasā vibho .. 45.16 ..
6.3.d:
अवज्ञां कुरुषे देव किमत्र नियमान्विते .
सर्वस्य दत्से शीघ्रं त्वमल्पेन तपसा विभो .. 45.16 ..
6.3.m:
Why do you show neglect, O God, toward one observing such vows?
To everyone else you quickly grant [boons] even for little austerity, O all-pervading Lord.

6.3.s:
nākṣakrīḍāṃ kariṣye'dya tvayā saha maheśvara .
yāvannotthāpyate hyeṣa dānavo bhaktavatsala .. 45.17 ..
6.3.d:
नाक्षक्रीडां करिष्येऽद्य त्वया सह महेश्वर .
यावन्नोत्थाप्यते ह्येष दानवो भक्तवत्सल .. 45.17 ..
6.3.m:
I will not play dice with you today, O Maheśvara,
until this Dānava is raised up, O lover of your devotees.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahādevi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣite .
ahaṃ taṃ na vijānāmi kliśyantaṃ dānaveśvaram .. 45.18 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
साधु साधु महादेवि सर्वलक्षणलक्षिते .
अहं तं न विजानामि क्लिश्यन्तं दानवेश्वरम् .. 45.18 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“Well said, well said, O Great Goddess, endowed with all auspicious marks.
I did not notice that lord of Dānavas suffering.

6.3.s:
yogābhyāse sthito bhadre dhyāyaṃstatparamaṃ padam .
tatrāgaccha mayā sārddhaṃ yatra tapyatyasau tapaḥ .. 45.19 ..
6.3.d:
योगाभ्यासे स्थितो भद्रे ध्यायंस्तत्परमं पदम् .
तत्रागच्छ मया सार्द्धं यत्र तप्यत्यसौ तपः .. 45.19 ..
6.3.m:
I was absorbed in the practice of yoga, O auspicious one, meditating on that supreme abode.
Come with me to the place where he is performing austerity.”

6.3.s:
umayā sahito devo gatastatra maheśvaraḥ .
asthicarmāvaśeṣastu dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā .. 45.20 ..
6.3.d:
उमया सहितो देवो गतस्तत्र महेश्वरः .
अस्थिचर्मावशेषस्तु दृष्टो देवेन शम्भुना .. 45.20 ..
6.3.m:
Accompanied by Umā, the divine Maheśvara went there.
And he was seen by the divine Śambhu, reduced to nothing but skin and bones.

6.3.s:
pratyuvāca prasanno'sau devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
bhobhoḥ kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ bhīmaṃ dāruṇaṃ lomaharṣaṇam .. 45.21 ..
6.3.d:
प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नोऽसौ देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
भोभोः कष्टं कृतं भीमं दारुणं लोमहर्षणम् .. 45.21 ..
6.3.m:
Graciously pleased, the God of gods, Maheśvara, said:
“Ah! What terrifying, severe, hair-raising hardship has been endured!

6.3.s:
īdṛśaṃ ca tapo ghoraṃ kasmādvatsa tvayā kṛtam .
varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa yaste manasi vartate .. 45.22 ..
6.3.d:
ईदृशं च तपो घोरं कस्माद्वत्स त्वया कृतम् .
वरं दास्याम्यहं वत्स यस्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 45.22 ..
6.3.m:
Why was such dreadful austerity performed by you, my child?
I will grant a boon, my child, whatever is in your heart.”

6.3.s:
andhaka uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varado yadi śaṅkara .
surān sarvān vijeṣyāmi tvatprasādānmaheśvara .. 45.23 ..
6.3.d:
अन्धक उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव वरदो यदि शङ्कर .
सुरान् सर्वान् विजेष्यामि त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर .. 45.23 ..
6.3.m:
Andhaka said:
“If you are pleased with me, O God, if you are a granter of boons, O Śaṅkara,
may I conquer all the gods through your grace, O Maheśvara.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
svapne'pi tridaśāḥ sarve na yoddhavyāḥ kadācana .
asaṃbhāvyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ manaso yanna rocate .. 45.24 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
स्वप्नेऽपि त्रिदशाः सर्वे न योद्धव्याः कदाचन .
असंभाव्यं न वक्तव्यं मनसो यन्न रोचते .. 45.24 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“Even in a dream, one should never fight with all the gods.
One should not speak of what is impossible, nor what is not pleasing to the mind.

6.3.s:
anyaṃ kimapi yācasva yaste manasi vartate .
svarge vā yadi vā martye pātāleṣu ca saṃsthitān .. 45.25 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यं किमपि याचस्व यस्ते मनसि वर्तते .
स्वर्गे वा यदि वा मर्त्ये पातालेषु च संस्थितान् .. 45.25 ..
6.3.m:
Ask for something else, whatever is in your heart,
whether among those in heaven, on earth, or in the subterranean realms.

6.3.s:
martyeṣu vividhān bhogān bhokṣyasi tvaṃ yathepsitān .
kuru niṣkaṇṭakaṃ rājyaṃ svarge devapatiryathā .. 45.26 ..
6.3.d:
मर्त्येषु विविधान् भोगान् भोक्ष्यसि त्वं यथेप्सितान् .
कुरु निष्कण्टकं राज्यं स्वर्गे देवपतिर्यथा .. 45.26 ..
6.3.m:
You shall enjoy various pleasures on earth as you desire.
Rule a kingdom free of thorns, just as the lord of the gods [rules] in heaven.”

6.3.s:
devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā so'ndhako vimanāḥ sthitaḥ .
vṛthā kleśaśca me jāto na kiṃcitsādhitaṃ mayā .. 45.27 ..
6.3.d:
देवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा सोऽन्धको विमनाः स्थितः .
वृथा क्लेशश्च मे जातो न किंचित्साधितं मया .. 45.27 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing the God’s words, that Andhaka stood dejected:
“My trouble has become futile; nothing was achieved by me.”

6.3.s:
niśvāsaṃ paramaṃ muktvā nipapāta dharātale .
mūlacchinno yathā vṛkṣo nirucchvāsastadābhavat .. 45.28 ..
6.3.d:
निश्वासं परमं मुक्त्वा निपपात धरातले .
मूलच्छिन्नो यथा वृक्षो निरुच्छ्वासस्तदाभवत् .. 45.28 ..
6.3.m:
Releasing a deep sigh, he fell onto the surface of the earth.
Like a tree severed at its roots, he became breathless then.

6.3.s:
mūrcchāpannaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā devī vacanamabravīt .
yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayatyeṣa tamasmai dehi śaṅkara .. 45.29 ..
6.3.d:
मूर्च्छापन्नं ततो दृष्ट्वा देवी वचनमब्रवीत् .
यं कामं कामयत्येष तमस्मै देहि शङ्कर .. 45.29 ..
6.3.m:
Then, seeing him fallen unconscious, the Goddess spoke [these] words:
“Whatever desire he desires, grant that to him, O Śaṅkara.

6.3.s: bhaktānupekṣamāṇasya tavākīrtirbhaviṣyati .. 45.30 ..
6.3.d: भक्तानुपेक्षमाणस्य तवाकीर्तिर्भविष्यति .. 45.30 ..
6.3.m: Disrepute will come upon you if you overlook a devotee.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
yadi dāsye varaṃ devi icchābhūtaṃ kadācana .
tato na maṃsyate viṣṇuṃ na brahmāṇaṃ na māmapi .. 45.31 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
यदि दास्ये वरं देवि इच्छाभूतं कदाचन .
ततो न मंस्यते विष्णुं न ब्रह्माणं न मामपि .. 45.31 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“If I were ever to grant the boon he desires, O Goddess,
then he would respect neither Viṣṇu, nor Brahmā, nor even me,

6.3.s: uccatvamāpto deveśi anyānapi surāsurān .. 45.32 ..
6.3.d: उच्चत्वमाप्तो देवेशि अन्यानपि सुरासुरान् .. 45.32 ..
6.3.m: having attained supremacy, O Queen of gods, over all other gods and Asuras.”

6.3.s:
devyuvāca -
kamapyupāyamāśritya utthāpaya maheśvara .
viṣṇuvarjaṃ surānsarvāñjayasveti varaṃ vada .. 45.33 ..
6.3.d:
देव्युवाच -
कमप्युपायमाश्रित्य उत्थापय महेश्वर .
विष्णुवर्जं सुरान्सर्वाञ्जयस्वेति वरं वद .. 45.33 ..
6.3.m:
The Goddess said:
“Resorting to some means, raise him up, O Maheśvara.
State the boon: ‘Conquer all the gods, with the exception of Viṣṇu.’”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
upāyaḥ śobhano devi yo me manasi vartate .
tamevāsmai pradāsyāmi yastvayā kathito varaḥ .. 45.34 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
उपायः शोभनो देवि यो मे मनसि वर्तते .
तमेवास्मै प्रदास्यामि यस्त्वया कथितो वरः .. 45.34 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“An excellent means has occurred to my mind, O Goddess.
I shall grant him the very boon that has been spoken by you.”

6.3.s:
tato'mṛtena saṃsiktaḥ svastho'bhūttatkṣaṇādayam .
tathā punarnavo jātaḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥ .. 45.35 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽमृतेन संसिक्तः स्वस्थोऽभूत्तत्क्षणादयम् .
तथा पुनर्नवो जातः सर्वावयवशोभितः .. 45.35 ..
6.3.m:
Then, sprinkled with nectar, he instantly regained health;
likewise, he was made renewed, adorned in all his limbs.

6.3.s:
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā gṛhāṇa varamuttamam .
viṣṇuvarjaṃ pradāsyāmi yattavābhimataṃ priyam .. 45.36 ..
6.3.d:
शृणुष्वैकमना भूत्वा गृहाण वरमुत्तमम् .
विष्णुवर्जं प्रदास्यामि यत्तवाभिमतं प्रियम् .. 45.36 ..
6.3.m:
“Listen with a focused mind and accept an excellent boon:
I will grant what is dear and desired by you, with the exception of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
sarvaṃ ca saphalaṃ tubhyaṃ mā dharmaste'nyathā bhavet .
dadāmīti varaṃ tubhyaṃ manyase yadi cāsura .. 45.37 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वं च सफलं तुभ्यं मा धर्मस्तेऽन्यथा भवेत् .
ददामीति वरं तुभ्यं मन्यसे यदि चासुर .. 45.37 ..
6.3.m:
May everything be fruitful for you; may your dharma not be compromised.
I grant this boon to you, if you accept it, O Asura:

6.3.s: viṣṇuvarjaṃ surān sarvāñjeṣyasi tvaṃ ca māṃ vinā .. 45.38 ..
6.3.d: विष्णुवर्जं सुरान् सर्वाञ्जेष्यसि त्वं च मां विना .. 45.38 ..
6.3.m: You shall conquer all the gods, with the exception of Viṣṇu and without me.”

6.3.s:
andhaka uvāca -
bhavatvevamiti prāha balamāsthāya kevalam .
viṣṇuvarjaṃ vijeṣye'haṃ svabalena maheśvara .. 45.39 ..
6.3.d:
अन्धक उवाच -
भवत्वेवमिति प्राह बलमास्थाय केवलम् .
विष्णुवर्जं विजेष्येऽहं स्वबलेन महेश्वर .. 45.39 ..
6.3.m:
Andhaka said:
“Let it be so!” he said, relying solely on his own might.
“I will conquer [them] by my own strength, with the exception of Viṣṇu, O Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
kṛtārtho'haṃ hi saṃjāta ityuktvā praṇatiṃ gataḥ .
gaccha devomayāsārddhaṃ kailāsaśikharaṃ varam .. 45.40 ..
6.3.d:
कृतार्थोऽहं हि संजात इत्युक्त्वा प्रणतिं गतः .
गच्छ देवोमयासार्द्धं कैलासशिखरं वरम् .. 45.40 ..
6.3.m:
Indeed, I have attained my purpose!” Having spoken thus, he bowed down.
“Go, O God, along with Umā, to the excellent peak of Kailāsa.”

6.3.s:
vṛṣapuṃgavamāruhya devo'sāvumayā saha .
varaṃ dattvā sa tasyaivaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata .. 45.41 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe andhakavarapradānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 46
6.3.d:
वृषपुंगवमारुह्य देवोऽसावुमया सह .
वरं दत्त्वा स तस्यैवं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .. 45.41 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अन्धकवरप्रदानवर्णनं नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 46
6.3.m:
Mounting his bull, the best of bulls, the God along with Umā,
having granted his boon in this manner, disappeared right there.
Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, titled “Description of the Granting of the Boon to Andhaka,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 46

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sa dānavo varaṃ labdhvā jagāma svapuraṃ prati .
dadarśa svapuraṃ rājañchobhitaṃ citracatvaraiḥ .. 46.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
स दानवो वरं लब्ध्वा जगाम स्वपुरं प्रति .
ददर्श स्वपुरं राजञ्छोभितं चित्रचत्वरैः .. 46.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Having obtained the boon, that Dānava went toward his city.
He saw his city, O king, adorned with variegated courtyards,

6.3.s:
udyānaiścaiva vividhaiḥ kadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitaiḥ .
panasairbakulaiścaivāmrātairāmraiśca campakaiḥ .. 46.2 ..
6.3.d:
उद्यानैश्चैव विविधैः कदलीखण्डमण्डितैः .
पनसैर्बकुलैश्चैवाम्रातैराम्रैश्च चम्पकैः .. 46.2 ..
6.3.m:
with various gardens decorated with groves of plantains,
with jackfruits, bakulas, hog plums, mangoes, and campakas,

6.3.s:
aśokairnālikeraiśca mātuliṅgaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ .
nānāvṛkṣaiśca śobhāḍhyaṃ taḍāgairupaśobhitam .. 46.3 ..
6.3.d:
अशोकैर्नालिकेरैश्च मातुलिङ्गैः सदाडिमैः .
नानावृक्षैश्च शोभाढ्यं तडागैरुपशोभितम् .. 46.3 ..
6.3.m:
with aśokas, coconuts, citrons, and pomegranates,
richly adorned with various trees and beautified with ponds,

6.3.s:
devatāyatanairdivyairdhvajamālāsuśobhitaiḥ .
vedādhyayananirghoṣairmaṅgalādyairvināditam .. 46.4 ..
6.3.d:
देवतायतनैर्दिव्यैर्ध्वजमालासुशोभितैः .
वेदाध्ययननिर्घोषैर्मङ्गलाद्यैर्विनादितम् .. 46.4 ..
6.3.m:
with divine temples of deities adorned with rows of banners,
and resounded with the chanting of the Vedas and auspicious songs.

6.3.s:
prāviśadbhavane divye kāñcane rukmamālini .
apaśyatsa sutān bhāryāmamātyān dāsabhṛtyakān .. 46.5 ..
6.3.d:
प्राविशद्भवने दिव्ये काञ्चने रुक्ममालिनि .
अपश्यत्स सुतान् भार्याममात्यान् दासभृत्यकान् .. 46.5 ..
6.3.m:
He entered his divine palace, golden and garlanded with gold.
He saw his sons, his wife, ministers, servants, and attendants.

6.3.s:
tato jayapradān sarvānitaścetaśca dhāvataḥ .
hṛcchobhāṃ ca prakurvāṇān vai jayantībhiruccakaiḥ .. 46.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततो जयप्रदान् सर्वानितश्चेतश्च धावतः .
हृच्छोभां च प्रकुर्वाणान् वै जयन्तीभिरुच्चकैः .. 46.6 ..
6.3.m:
Then all, proclaiming victory, running here and there,
displayed heartfelt joy, [holding] triumph-banners high aloft.

6.3.s:
kecittoraṇamābadhya kecitpuṣpāṇyavākiran .
mātuliṅgakarāścānye dhāvanti hyandhakaṃ prati .. 46.7 ..
6.3.d:
केचित्तोरणमाबध्य केचित्पुष्पाण्यवाकिरन् .
मातुलिङ्गकराश्चान्ये धावन्ति ह्यन्धकं प्रति .. 46.7 ..
6.3.m:
Some erected archways; some scattered flowers;
and others, holding citrons in their hands, ran toward Andhaka.

6.3.s:
pure janāśca dṛśyante bhājanairannapūritaiḥ .
pūrṇahastāḥ pradṛśyante tatraiva bahavo janāḥ .. 46.8 ..
6.3.d:
पुरे जनाश्च दृश्यन्ते भाजनैरन्नपूरितैः .
पूर्णहस्ताः प्रदृश्यन्ते तत्रैव बहवो जनाः .. 46.8 ..
6.3.m:
In the city, people were seen with platters filled with food;
many people were seen right there with filled hands.

6.3.s:
sākṣatairbhājanaistatra śatasāhasrayoṣitaḥ .
mantrān paṭhanti viprāśca maṅgalānyapi yoṣitaḥ .. 46.9 ..
6.3.d:
साक्षतैर्भाजनैस्तत्र शतसाहस्रयोषितः .
मन्त्रान् पठन्ति विप्राश्च मङ्गलान्यपि योषितः .. 46.9 ..
6.3.m:
There hundreds of thousands of women [held] platters with unhusked rice grains;
brahmins recited mantras, and women [sang] auspicious songs.

6.3.s:
amātyāścaiva bhṛtyāśca gajāṃścāḍhaukayanti ca .
vardhāpayanti te sarve ye kecitpuravāsinaḥ .. 46.10 ..
6.3.d:
अमात्याश्चैव भृत्याश्च गजांश्चाढौकयन्ति च .
वर्धापयन्ति ते सर्वे ये केचित्पुरवासिनः .. 46.10 ..
6.3.m:
Ministers and servants brought elephants as gifts,
and all the citizens congratulated him.

6.3.s:
hṛṣṭastuṣṭo'vasattatra sacivaiḥ saha so'ndhakaḥ .
dadarśa sa jagatsarvaṃ turaṅgāṃśca padātikān .. 46.11 ..
6.3.d:
हृष्टस्तुष्टोऽवसत्तत्र सचिवैः सह सोऽन्धकः .
ददर्श स जगत्सर्वं तुरङ्गांश्च पदातिकान् .. 46.11 ..
6.3.m:
Glad and contented, that Andhaka lived there with his counselors.
He inspected all his domains, the horses, and the infantry,

6.3.s:
tathaiva vividhān kośāṃstatra kāñcanapūritān .
mahiṣīrgā vṛṣāṃścaivāpaśyacchatrāṇyanekadhā .. 46.12 ..
6.3.d:
तथैव विविधान् कोशांस्तत्र काञ्चनपूरितान् .
महिषीर्गा वृषांश्चैवापश्यच्छत्राण्यनेकधा .. 46.12 ..
6.3.m:
as well as various treasuries filled with gold;
he looked upon buffaloes, cows, bulls, and royal parasols of many kinds.

6.3.s:
sa evamandhakastatra kiyantaṃ kālamāvasat .
hṛṣṭastuṣṭo vasanmartye sa surairnābhyabhūyata .. 46.13 ..
6.3.d:
स एवमन्धकस्तत्र कियन्तं कालमावसत् .
हृष्टस्तुष्टो वसन्मर्त्ये स सुरैर्नाभ्यभूयत .. 46.13 ..
6.3.m:
In this way, Andhaka dwelt there for some time.
Living on earth glad and contented, he was not overcome by the gods.

6.3.s:
varaṃ labdhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā śaṅkitāḥ svargavāsinaḥ .
ekībhūtāśca te sarve vāsavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 46.14 ..
6.3.d:
वरं लब्धं तु तं ज्ञात्वा शङ्किताः स्वर्गवासिनः .
एकीभूताश्च ते सर्वे वासवं शरणं गताः .. 46.14 ..
6.3.m:
Learning of the boon that had been obtained, the dwellers of heaven were alarmed;
united together, they all went to Vāsava for refuge.

6.3.s:
śakra uvāca -
kathamāgamanaṃ vo'tra sarveṣāmapi nākinām .
kasmādvo bhayamutpannamāgatāḥ śaraṇaṃ katham .. 46.15 ..
6.3.d:
शक्र उवाच -
कथमागमनं वोऽत्र सर्वेषामपि नाकिनाम् .
कस्माद्वो भयमुत्पन्नमागताः शरणं कथम् .. 46.15 ..
6.3.m:
Śakra said:
"Why have all of you, residents of heaven, come here? / From where has your fear arisen? Why have you come for refuge?"

6.3.s: tataste hyamarāḥ sarve śakrametadvaco'bruvan .. 46.16 ..
6.3.d: ततस्ते ह्यमराः सर्वे शक्रमेतद्वचोऽब्रुवन् .. 46.16 ..
6.3.m: Then indeed all those immortals addressed these words to Śakra:

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
suranāthāndhako nāma daityaḥ śambhuvarorjitaḥ .
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ kiṃ nu kāryamataḥ param .. 46.17 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
सुरनाथान्धको नाम दैत्यः शम्भुवरोर्जितः .
अजेयः सर्वदेवानां किं नु कार्यमतः परम् .. 46.17 ..
6.3.m:
The gods said:
"O lord of gods, a daitya named Andhaka, empowered by a boon from Śambhu, / is invincible to all the gods. What indeed should be done hereafter?

6.3.s:
tattvaṃ cintaya deveśa ka upāyo vidhīyatām .
itthaṃ vadanti te devāḥ śakrāgre mantraṇodyatāḥ .. 46.18 ..
6.3.d:
तत्त्वं चिन्तय देवेश क उपायो विधीयताम् .
इत्थं वदन्ति ते देवाः शक्राग्रे मन्त्रणोद्यताः .. 46.18 ..
6.3.m:
Reflect on this truth, O lord of gods: what remedy can be devised?"
Thus the gods spoke before Śakra, preparing to take counsel.

6.3.s:
mantrayanti ca yāvadvai tāvaccāramukheritam .
jñātvā tatra sa devaughaṃ dānavo nirgato gṛhāt .. 46.19 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रयन्ति च यावद्वै तावच्चारमुखेरितम् .
ज्ञात्वा तत्र स देवौघं दानवो निर्गतो गृहात् .. 46.19 ..
6.3.m: Even as they were holding counsel, learning from the report of a spy / that the host of gods was assembled there, the Dānava set out from his dwelling.

6.3.s:
ekākī syandanārūḍha āyurdhaibahubhirvṛtaḥ .
durgamaṃ merupṛṣṭhaṃ sa līlayaiva gato nṛpa .. 46.20 ..
6.3.d:
एकाकी स्यन्दनारूढ आयुर्धैबहुभिर्वृतः .
दुर्गमं मेरुपृष्ठं स लीलयैव गतो नृप .. 46.20 ..
6.3.m: Mounted alone on a chariot, surrounded by many weapons, / he effortlessly reached the inaccessible summit of Meru, O king,

6.3.s:
svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ vividhāśramaiḥ .
durgamaṃ śatruvargasya tadā pārthivasattama .. 46.21 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्णप्राकारसंयुक्तं शोभितं विविधाश्रमैः .
दुर्गमं शत्रुवर्गस्य तदा पार्थिवसत्तम .. 46.21 ..
6.3.m: which was endowed with golden ramparts and adorned with various hermitages, / inaccessible to any host of foes, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
praviveśāsurastatra līlayā svagṛhe yathā .
vṛtrahā bhayamāpannaḥ svakīyaṃ cāsanaṃ dadau .. 46.22 ..
6.3.d:
प्रविवेशासुरस्तत्र लीलया स्वगृहे यथा .
वृत्रहा भयमापन्नः स्वकीयं चासनं ददौ .. 46.22 ..
6.3.m:
The asura entered there effortlessly, as if into his own home.
The slayer of Vṛtra was seized with fear and gave him his own seat.

6.3.s:
upaviṣṭo'ndhakastatra śakrasyaivāsane śubhe .
āsthānaṃ kalayāmāsa sarvatastridaśāvṛtam .. 46.23 ..
6.3.d:
उपविष्टोऽन्धकस्तत्र शक्रस्यैवासने शुभे .
आस्थानं कलयामास सर्वतस्त्रिदशावृतम् .. 46.23 ..
6.3.m: Andhaka sat down there upon Śakra's own auspicious seat / and held court, surrounded on all sides by the gods.

6.3.s:
śakra uvāca -
kiṃ tavāgamanaṃ cātra kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva me .
yadasmadīyaṃ vittaṃ hi tatte dāsyāmi dānava .. 46.24 ..
6.3.d:
शक्र उवाच -
किं तवागमनं चात्र किं कार्यं कथयस्व मे .
यदस्मदीयं वित्तं हि तत्ते दास्यामि दानव .. 46.24 ..
6.3.m:
Śakra said:
"What is the purpose of your coming here? Tell me what must be done.
Whatever wealth belongs to us, that I will give to you, O Dānava."

6.3.s:
andhaka uvāca -
nāhaṃ vai kāmaye kośaṃ na gajāṃśca sureśvara .
svakīyaṃ darśayasvādya svargaśṛṅgārabhūṣitam .. 46.25 ..
6.3.d:
अन्धक उवाच -
नाहं वै कामये कोशं न गजांश्च सुरेश्वर .
स्वकीयं दर्शयस्वाद्य स्वर्गशृङ्गारभूषितम् .. 46.25 ..
6.3.m:
Andhaka said:
"I desire no treasury, nor elephants, O lord of gods.
Show me today your own [domain], adorned with the ornaments of heaven:

6.3.s:
airāvataṃ mahānāgaṃ taṃ caivoccaiḥśravohayam .
urvaśyādīni ratnāni mama darśaya gopate .. 46.26 ..
6.3.d:
ऐरावतं महानागं तं चैवोच्चैःश्रवोहयम् .
उर्वश्यादीनि रत्नानि मम दर्शय गोपते .. 46.26 ..
6.3.m:
Airāvata, the great elephant, and that horse Uccaiḥśravas,
and the jewels beginning with Urvaśī—show them to me, O lord of cattle!

6.3.s:
pārijātakapuṣpāṇi vṛkṣajātīnanekaśaḥ .
vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi darśayasva śacīpate .. 46.27 ..
6.3.d:
पारिजातकपुष्पाणि वृक्षजातीननेकशः .
वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि दर्शयस्व शचीपते .. 46.27 ..
6.3.m:
The pārijāta flowers, numerous varieties of trees,
and all the musical instruments—show them to me, O husband of Śacī!"

6.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śakraścintitavānidam .
yo'muṃ nihanti pāpmānaṃ na taṃ paśyāmi karhicit .. 46.28 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शक्रश्चिन्तितवानिदम् .
योऽमुं निहन्ति पाप्मानं न तं पश्यामि कर्हिचित् .. 46.28 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing those words of his, Śakra thought to himself:
"I do not see anyone anywhere who can slay this evil one.

6.3.s:
nāsti rakṣāpradaḥ kaścitsvargalokasya duḥkhinaḥ .
bhayatrasto dadāvanyadvāditrādyapsarogaṇaiḥ .. 46.29 ..
6.3.d:
नास्ति रक्षाप्रदः कश्चित्स्वर्गलोकस्य दुःखिनः .
भयत्रस्तो ददावन्यद्वादित्राद्यप्सरोगणैः .. 46.29 ..
6.3.m:
There is no one to grant protection to this afflicted world of heaven."
Trembling with fear, he provided other [entertainments], with musical instruments and groups of apsarases.

6.3.s:
raṅgabhūmāvupāviśya kārayāmāsa tāṇḍavam .
upaviṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve yamamārutakinnarāḥ .. 46.30 ..
6.3.d:
रङ्गभूमावुपाविश्य कारयामास ताण्डवम् .
उपविष्टाः सुराः सर्वे यममारुतकिन्नराः .. 46.30 ..
6.3.m:
Seated in the assembly hall, he had a tāṇḍava dance performed.
All the gods sat down, along with Yama, the wind-god, and the kinnaras.

6.3.s:
urvaśyādyā apsaraso gītavāditrayogataḥ .
nanṛtuḥ puratastasya sarvā ekaikaśo nṛpa .. 46.31 ..
6.3.d:
उर्वश्याद्या अप्सरसो गीतवादित्रयोगतः .
ननृतुः पुरतस्तस्य सर्वा एकैकशो नृप .. 46.31 ..
6.3.m: The apsarases beginning with Urvaśī, accompanied by song and musical instruments, / danced before him, all of them one by one, O king.

6.3.s:
na vyaśrāmyata taccittaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāpsarasastadā .
śacīṃ prati manastasya sakāmamabhavannṛpa .. 46.32 ..
6.3.d:
न व्यश्राम्यत तच्चित्तं दृष्ट्वा चाप्सरसस्तदा .
शचीं प्रति मनस्तस्य सकाममभवन्नृप .. 46.32 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing the apsarases, his mind found no satisfaction then;
his heart was filled with lust for Śacī, O king.

6.3.s:
gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa prasthitaḥ svapuraṃ prati .
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhamandhakasya suraiḥ saha .. 46.33 ..
6.3.d:
गृहीत्वा शक्रभार्यां स प्रस्थितः स्वपुरं प्रति .
ततः प्रववृते युद्धमन्धकस्य सुरैः सह .. 46.33 ..
6.3.m:
Seizing the wife of Śakra, he set out towards his own city.
Then a battle broke out between Andhaka and the gods.

6.3.s:
tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhvastāḥ pārthivasattama .
saṃgrāme vividhaiḥ śastraiścakravajrādibhirghanaiḥ .. 46.34 ..
6.3.d:
तेन देवगणाः सर्वे ध्वस्ताः पार्थिवसत्तम .
संग्रामे विविधैः शस्त्रैश्चक्रवज्रादिभिर्घनैः .. 46.34 ..
6.3.m:
All the hosts of gods were crushed by him, O best of kings,
in battle with various dense weapons such as discs and thunderbolts.

6.3.s:
saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ nītā hyanekaśaḥ .
sarve'pi marutastena bhagnāḥ saṃgrāmamūrdhani .. 46.35 ..
6.3.d:
संतापिताः सुराः सर्वे क्षयं नीता ह्यनेकशः .
सर्वेऽपि मरुतस्तेन भग्नाः संग्राममूर्धनि .. 46.35 ..
6.3.m:
Tormented, all the gods were brought to ruin in many ways;
even all the Maruts were broken by him at the head of the battle.

6.3.s:
yathā siṃhogajān sarvān vicitya vicaredvanam .
tadvadekena te devā jitāḥ sarve parāṅmukhāḥ .. 46.36 ..
6.3.d:
यथा सिंहोगजान् सर्वान् विचित्य विचरेद्वनम् .
तद्वदेकेन ते देवा जिताः सर्वे पराङ्मुखाः .. 46.36 ..
6.3.m: Just as a lion would roam the forest after routing all the elephants, / so the gods were all defeated by that single one and turned their backs.

6.3.s:
bālo'dhipo yathā grāme svecchayā pīḍayejjanān .
svairamākramya gṛhṇāti kośavāsāṃsi cāsakṛt .. 46.37 ..
6.3.d:
बालोऽधिपो यथा ग्रामे स्वेच्छया पीडयेज्जनान् .
स्वैरमाक्रम्य गृह्णाति कोशवासांसि चासकृत् .. 46.37 ..
6.3.m: Just as a childish ruler in a village oppresses the people at will, / and invading at pleasure repeatedly seizes treasury and garments,

6.3.s:
gataṃ na paśyatyātmānaṃ prajāsaṃtāpanena ca .
gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa gato vai dānavottamaḥ .. 46.38 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedamāhātmye śacīharaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 47
6.3.d:
गतं न पश्यत्यात्मानं प्रजासंतापनेन च .
गृहीत्वा शक्रभार्यां स गतो वै दानवोत्तमः .. 46.38 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदमाहात्म्ये शचीहरणवर्णनं नाम षट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 47
6.3.m:
and does not see himself brought to ruin by the tormenting of subjects, / [so] that foremost Dānava, having seized Śakra's wife, departed.
Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Abduction of Śacī', in the Śūlabheda-māhātmya of the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantī section, of the Mahāpurāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 47

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
gīrvāṇāśca tataḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .
gajairgirivarākārairhayaiścaiva gajopamaiḥ .. 47.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
गीर्वाणाश्च ततः सर्वे ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः .
गजैर्गिरिवराकारैर्हयैश्चैव गजोपमैः .. 47.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
"Then all the gods went to Brahmā for refuge, / on elephants resembling great mountains and horses resembling elephants,

6.3.s:
syandanairnagarākāraiḥ siṃhaśārdūlayojitaiḥ .
kacchapairmahiṣaiścānyairmakaraiśca tathāpare .. 47.2 ..
6.3.d:
स्यन्दनैर्नगराकारैः सिंहशार्दूलयोजितैः .
कच्छपैर्महिषैश्चान्यैर्मकरैश्च तथापरे .. 47.2 ..
6.3.m: on chariots shaped like cities, yoked with lions and tigers, / and others on tortoises, buffaloes, and makaras.

6.3.s:
brahmalokamanuprāptā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ .
dṛṣṭvā padmodbhavaṃ devaṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatāḥ surāḥ .. 47.3 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मलोकमनुप्राप्ता देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः .
दृष्ट्वा पद्मोद्भवं देवं साष्टाङ्गं प्रणताः सुराः .. 47.3 ..
6.3.m: Having reached the world of Brahmā, the gods headed by Śakra / saw the lotus-born god and bowed down prostrate with all eight limbs.

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
jaya deva jagadvandya jaya saṃsṛtikāraka .
padmayone suraśreṣṭha tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 47.4 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
जय देव जगद्वन्द्य जय संसृतिकारक .
पद्मयोने सुरश्रेष्ठ त्वामेव शरणं गताः .. 47.4 ..
6.3.m:
The gods said:
'Victory, O god, who are worshipped by the universe! Victory, O maker of worldly existence! / O lotus-born one, foremost among the gods, we have come to you alone for refuge!'

6.3.s:
sodvegaṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ bhāvitātmanām .
meghagambhīrayā vācā devarājamuvāca ha .. 47.5 ..
6.3.d:
सोद्वेगं भाषितं श्रुत्वा देवानां भावितात्मनाम् .
मेघगम्भीरया वाचा देवराजमुवाच ह .. 47.5 ..
6.3.m: Hearing the agitated speech of the gods, whose minds were distressed, / he spoke to the king of the gods in a voice deep like a thundercloud:

6.3.s:
kimatrāgamanaṃ devāḥ sarveṣāṃ vai vivarṇatā .
kenāpamānitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ me kathyatāṃ svayam .. 47.6 ..
6.3.d:
किमत्रागमनं देवाः सर्वेषां वै विवर्णता .
केनापमानिताः सर्वे शीघ्रं मे कथ्यतां स्वयम् .. 47.6 ..
6.3.m: 'Why have you come here, O gods, all of you drained of colour? / By whom have you all been insulted? Tell me quickly yourself.'

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
andhakākhyo mahādaityo balavān padmasambhava .
tena devagaṇāḥ sarve dhanaratnairviyojitāḥ .. 47.7 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
अन्धकाख्यो महादैत्यो बलवान् पद्मसम्भव .
तेन देवगणाः सर्वे धनरत्नैर्वियोजिताः .. 47.7 ..
6.3.m:
The gods said:
'A mighty great daitya named Andhaka, O lotus-born one, / has stripped all the hosts of gods of their wealth and jewels.

6.3.s:
hatvā devagaṇāṃstāvadasicakraparaddviśvadhaiḥ .
gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ sa dānavo'pi gato balāt .. 47.8 ..
6.3.d:
हत्वा देवगणांस्तावदसिचक्रपरद्द्विश्वधैः .
गृहीत्वा शक्रभार्यां स दानवोऽपि गतो बलात् .. 47.8 ..
6.3.m: Having struck down the hosts of gods with swords, discs, and battle-axes, / that Dānava has also seized the wife of Śakra and departed by force.'

6.3.s:
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
cintayāmāsa rājendra vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ha .. 47.9 ..
6.3.d:
देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
चिन्तयामास राजेन्द्र वधार्थं दानवस्य ह .. 47.9 ..
6.3.m: Hearing the words of the gods, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / deliberated, O king of kings, on the means for the slaying of that Dānava:

6.3.s:
avadhyo dānavaḥ pāpaḥ sarveṣāṃ vo divaukasām .
sa trātā sarvajagatāṃ nānyo vidyeta kutracit .. 47.10 ..
6.3.d:
अवध्यो दानवः पापः सर्वेषां वो दिवौकसाम् .
स त्राता सर्वजगतां नान्यो विद्येत कुत्रचित् .. 47.10 ..
6.3.m:
'The wicked Dānava cannot be slain by any of you gods.
He [Viṣṇu] is the protector of all the worlds; no other exists anywhere.'

6.3.s:
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā tadanantaram .
brahmāṇaṃ te puraskṛtya gatā yatra sa keśavaḥ .
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmādyāścakrapāṇinam .. 47.11 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे ब्रह्मणा तदनन्तरम् .
ब्रह्माणं ते पुरस्कृत्य गता यत्र स केशवः .
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्ब्रह्माद्याश्चक्रपाणिनम् .. 47.11 ..
6.3.m:
Having been thus addressed by Brahmā, the gods immediately thereafter, / placing Brahmā at their head, went to where Keśava was.
Brahmā and the others praised the wielder of the disc with various hymns.

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
jaya tvaṃ devadeveśa lakṣmyā vakṣaḥsthalāśritaḥ .
asurakṣaya deveśa vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 47.12 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
जय त्वं देवदेवेश लक्ष्म्या वक्षःस्थलाश्रितः .
असुरक्षय देवेश वयं ते शरणं गताः .. 47.12 ..
6.3.m:
The gods said:
'Victory to you, O god of gods, who abide on Lakṣmī's breast! / O destroyer of asuras, O god of gods, we have come to you for refuge!'

6.3.s:
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvairbrahmādyaiśca janārdanaḥ .
samprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā surasaṅghamuvāca ha .. 47.13 ..
6.3.d:
स्तूयमानः सुरैः सर्वैर्ब्रह्माद्यैश्च जनार्दनः .
सम्प्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा सुरसङ्घमुवाच ह .. 47.13 ..
6.3.m: Praised by all the gods, with Brahmā at their head, Janārdana / became exceedingly joyful in heart and spoke to the company of gods.

6.3.s:
śrīvāsudeva uvāca -
svāgataṃ devaviprāṇāṃ suprabhātādya śarvarī .
kiṃ kāryaṃ procyatāṃ kṣipraṃ kasya ruṣṭā divaukasaḥ .. 47.14 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीवासुदेव उवाच -
स्वागतं देवविप्राणां सुप्रभाताद्य शर्वरी .
किं कार्यं प्रोच्यतां क्षिप्रं कस्य रुष्टा दिवौकसः .. 47.14 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Vāsudeva said:
'Welcome to the gods and brahmins! The night has dawned auspiciously today.
State quickly what is to be done. Against whom are the gods enraged?

6.3.s:
kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kaśca saṃtāpaḥ kuto vā bhayamāgatam .
kathayantu mahābhāgāḥ kāraṇaṃ yanmanogatam .. 47.15 ..
6.3.d:
किं दुःखं कश्च संतापः कुतो वा भयमागतम् .
कथयन्तु महाभागाः कारणं यन्मनोगतम् .. 47.15 ..
6.3.m:
What is the sorrow, and what is the distress? From where has fear come?
Let the illustrious ones declare the cause that is in your minds.

6.3.s:
parābhavaḥ kṛto yena so'dya yātu yamālayam .
evamuktāstu kṛṣṇena kathayāmāsurasya tat .. 47.16 ..
6.3.d:
पराभवः कृतो येन सोऽद्य यातु यमालयम् .
एवमुक्तास्तु कृष्णेन कथयामासुरस्य तत् .. 47.16 ..
6.3.m:
He by whom this humiliation was done—let him go to Yama's abode today.'
Having been spoken to in this manner by Kṛṣṇa, they described it to him,

6.3.s:
darśayantaḥ svakāndehān lajjamānā hyadhomukhāḥ .
hṛtarājyā hyandhakena kṛtā nistejasaḥ prabho .. 47.17 ..
6.3.d:
दर्शयन्तः स्वकान्देहान् लज्जमाना ह्यधोमुखाः .
हृतराज्या ह्यन्धकेन कृता निस्तेजसः प्रभो .. 47.17 ..
6.3.m:
showing their bodies, ashamed and with faces cast down:
'Our sovereignty has been taken away by Andhaka, and we have been stripped of our splendour, O Lord!'

6.3.s:
piteva putraṃ parirakṣa deva jahīndraśatruṃ saha putrapautraiḥ .
tatheti coktaḥ kamalāsanena surāsurairvanditapādapadmaḥ .. 47.18 ..
6.3.d:
पितेव पुत्रं परिरक्ष देव जहीन्द्रशत्रुं सह पुत्रपौत्रैः .
तथेति चोक्तः कमलासनेन सुरासुरैर्वन्दितपादपद्मः .. 47.18 ..
6.3.m:
"Protect [us], O god, like a father his son; slay Indra's enemy along with his sons and grandsons!"
Addressed with "So be it" by [him] whose lotus feet are praised by gods and demons, who is seated on a lotus,

6.3.s:
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ cāpaṃ saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ .
utthito bhogaparyaṅkāddevānāṃ puratastadā .. 47.19 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्खं चक्रं गदां चापं संगृह्य परमेश्वरः .
उत्थितो भोगपर्यङ्काद्देवानां पुरतस्तदा .. 47.19 ..
6.3.m:
the Supreme Lord grasped his conch, discus, mace, and bow,
and then rose up from his serpent-couch before the gods.

6.3.s:
śrīvāsudeva uvāca -
pātāle yadi vā martye nāke vā yadi tiṣṭhati .
taṃ haniṣyāmyahaṃ pāpaṃ yena saṃtāpitāḥ surāḥ .. 47.20 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीवासुदेव उवाच -
पाताले यदि वा मर्त्ये नाके वा यदि तिष्ठति .
तं हनिष्याम्यहं पापं येन संतापिताः सुराः .. 47.20 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Vāsudeva said:
"Whether he stays in Pātāla, or among mortals, or in heaven,
I will slay that wicked one by whom the gods have been tormented.

6.3.s:
svaṃ sthānaṃ yāntu gīrvāṇāḥ saṃtuṣṭā bhāvitaujasaḥ .
viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmādyāste savāsavāḥ .. 47.21 ..
6.3.d:
स्वं स्थानं यान्तु गीर्वाणाः संतुष्टा भावितौजसः .
विष्णोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्माद्यास्ते सवासवाः .. 47.21 ..
6.3.m:
Let the gods go to their own abode, satisfied, their radiance restored."
Having heard those words of Viṣṇu, those gods, Brahmā and the rest, along with Indra,

6.3.s:
svayānaistu hariṃ natvā hṛdi tuṣṭā divaṃ yayuḥ .. 47.22 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gīrvāṇasvargamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 48
6.3.d:
स्वयानैस्तु हरिं नत्वा हृदि तुष्टा दिवं ययुः .. 47.22 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गीर्वाणस्वर्गमनवर्णनं नाम सप्तचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 48
6.3.m:
bowed down to Hari and went to heaven in their own vehicles, pleased in heart.
Thus ends the forty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Gods' Departure to Heaven,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 48

6.3.s:
uttānapāda uvāca -
kasminsthāne'vasaddeva so'ndhako daityapuṃgavaḥ .
sarvāndevāṃśca nirjitya kasminsthāne samāsthitaḥ .. 48.1 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तानपाद उवाच -
कस्मिन्स्थानेऽवसद्देव सोऽन्धको दैत्यपुंगवः .
सर्वान्देवांश्च निर्जित्य कस्मिन्स्थाने समास्थितः .. 48.1 ..
6.3.m:
Uttānapāda said:
In what place did that bull among Daityas, Andhaka, reside, O god?
Having conquered all the gods, in what place did he take up his abode?

6.3.s:
śrīmaheśa uvāca -
praviṣṭo dānavo yatra kathayāmi narādhipa .
pātālalokamāśritya kanyā vidhvaṃsate tu saḥ .. 48.2 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमहेश उवाच -
प्रविष्टो दानवो यत्र कथयामि नराधिप .
पाताललोकमाश्रित्य कन्या विध्वंसते तु सः .. 48.2 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Maheśa said:
I shall tell you, O ruler of men, where the Dānava entered.
Taking refuge in the realm of Pātāla, he violated maiden girls.

6.3.s:
tatra sthitaṃ taṃ vijñāya cāpamādāya keśavaḥ .
vyasṛjadbāṇamāgneyaṃ dahyatāmiti cintayan .. 48.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थितं तं विज्ञाय चापमादाय केशवः .
व्यसृजद्बाणमाग्नेयं दह्यतामिति चिन्तयन् .. 48.3 ..
6.3.m:
Knowing him to be stationed there, Keśava took up his bow
and discharged a fiery arrow, thinking: "Let him burn!"

6.3.s:
dahyamāno'gninā so'pi vāruṇāstraṃ sa saṃdadhe .
vāruṇāstreṇa mahatā āgneyaṃ śamitaṃ tadā .. 48.4 ..
6.3.d:
दह्यमानोऽग्निना सोऽपि वारुणास्त्रं स संदधे .
वारुणास्त्रेण महता आग्नेयं शमितं तदा .. 48.4 ..
6.3.m:
