देवैः सर्वैर्महाभागा सर्वलोकहिताय वै .. 56.3 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Listen with single-minded attention to how the highly fortunate Gaṅgā was brought down / by all the gods for the welfare of all the worlds.

6.3.s:
asti vindhyo nago nāma yāmyāśāyāṃ mahīpate .
gīrvāṇāstu gatāḥ sarve tasya mūrdhni nareśvara .. 56.4 ..
6.3.d:
अस्ति विन्ध्यो नगो नाम याम्याशायां महीपते .
गीर्वाणास्तु गताः सर्वे तस्य मूर्ध्नि नरेश्वर .. 56.4 ..
6.3.m: There is a mountain named Vindhya in the southern direction, O king. / All the gods went to its summit, O ruler of men.

6.3.s:
tatra cāhvānitā gaṅgā brahmādyairakhilaiḥ suraiḥ .
abhyarcyeśaṃ jagannāthaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum .. 56.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र चाह्वानिता गङ्गा ब्रह्माद्यैरखिलैः सुरैः .
अभ्यर्च्येशं जगन्नाथं देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम् .. 56.5 ..
6.3.m: There Gaṅgā was invoked by all the gods headed by Brahmā, / after worshiping the Lord, the Lord of the universe, the god of gods, the teacher of the universe,

6.3.s:
jaṭāmadhyasthitāṃ gaṅgāṃ mocayasveti bhūtale .
bhāsvantī sā tato muktā rudreṇa śirasā bhuvi .. 56.6 ..
6.3.d:
जटामध्यस्थितां गङ्गां मोचयस्वेति भूतले .
भास्वन्ती सा ततो मुक्ता रुद्रेण शिरसा भुवि .. 56.6 ..
6.3.m: [saying,] "Release Gaṅgā, who resides within your matted hair, onto the surface of the earth." / Then that radiant one was released by Rudra from his head to the earth.

6.3.s:
tatra sthāne mahāpuṇyā devairutpāditā svayam .
tato devanadī jātā sā hitāya nṛṇāṃ bhuvi .. 56.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थाने महापुण्या देवैरुत्पादिता स्वयम् .
ततो देवनदी जाता सा हिताय नृणां भुवि .. 56.7 ..
6.3.m: At that place, the highly sacred [river] was brought forth by the gods themselves. / Then she became the river of the gods for the welfare of men on earth.

6.3.s:
vasanti ye taṭe tasyāḥ snānaṃ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ .
pibanti ca jalaṃ nityaṃ na te yānti yamālayam .. 56.8 ..
6.3.d:
वसन्ति ये तटे तस्याः स्नानं कुर्वन्ति भक्तितः .
पिबन्ति च जलं नित्यं न ते यान्ति यमालयम् .. 56.8 ..
6.3.m: Those who live on her bank, take their bath with devotion, / and constantly drink her water, do not go to the abode of Yama.

6.3.s:
yatra sā patitā kuṇḍe śūlabhede narādhipa .
devanadyāḥ pratīcyāṃ tu tatra prācī sarasvatī .. 56.9 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र सा पतिता कुण्डे शूलभेदे नराधिप .
देवनद्याः प्रतीच्यां तु तत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 56.9 ..
6.3.m: Where she fell into the pool at Śūlabheda, O king, / to the west of that divine river is the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī.

6.3.s:
yāmyāyāṃ śūlabhedasya tatra tīrthamanuttamam .
tatra devaśilā puṇyā svayaṃ devena nirmitā .. 56.10 ..
6.3.d:
याम्यायां शूलभेदस्य तत्र तीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
तत्र देवशिला पुण्या स्वयं देवेन निर्मिता .. 56.10 ..
6.3.m: To the south of Śūlabheda is an unsurpassed sacred ford. / There is the holy Devaśilā, fashioned by the god himself.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 56.11 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 56.11 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed there with devotion, offers libations to the ancestors and gods, / his ancestors are satisfied until the dissolution of all beings.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayennṛpa .
svalpānnenāpi dattena tasya cānto na vidyate .. 56.12 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेन्नृप .
स्वल्पान्नेनापि दत्तेन तस्य चान्तो न विद्यते .. 56.12 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed there with devotion, feeds brahmins, O king, / even with a little food given, there is no end to its [merit].

6.3.s:
uttānapāda uvāca -
kāni dānāni dattāni śastāni dharaṇītale .
yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 56.13 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तानपाद उवाच -
कानि दानानि दत्तानि शस्तानि धरणीतले .
यानि दत्त्वा नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 56.13 ..
6.3.m: Uttānapāda said: / What gifts given on the surface of the earth are commended, / by giving which a man is freed from all sins with devotion?

6.3.s:
devaśilāyā māhātmyaṃ snānadānādijaṃ phalam .
vratopavāsaniyamairyatprāpyaṃ tadvadasva me .. 56.14 ..
6.3.d:
देवशिलाया माहात्म्यं स्नानदानादिजं फलम् .
व्रतोपवासनियमैर्यत्प्राप्यं तद्वदस्व मे .. 56.14 ..
6.3.m: Tell me the māhātmya of Devaśilā, the fruit arising from bath, gift, and other rites, / and what is to be attained by vows, fasts, and observances.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
āsītpurā mahāvīryaścedinātho mahābalaḥ .
vīrasena iti khyāto maṇḍalādhipatirnṛpa .. 56.15 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
आसीत्पुरा महावीर्यश्चेदिनाथो महाबलः .
वीरसेन इति ख्यातो मण्डलाधिपतिर्नृप .. 56.15 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / In ancient times there was a ruler of Cedi of great valor and great strength, / known as Vīrasena, a ruler of a realm, O king.

6.3.s:
rāṣṭre tasya ripurnāsti na vyādhirna ca taskarāḥ .
na cādharmo'bhavattatra dharma eva hi sarvadā .. 56.16 ..
6.3.d:
राष्ट्रे तस्य रिपुर्नास्ति न व्याधिर्न च तस्कराः .
न चाधर्मोऽभवत्तत्र धर्म एव हि सर्वदा .. 56.16 ..
6.3.m: In his kingdom there was no enemy, no disease, and no thieves; / there was no unrighteousness there, but only righteousness at all times.

6.3.s:
sadā mudānvito rājā sabhāryo bahuputrakaḥ .
ekāsīdduhitā tasya surūpā girijā yathā .. 56.17 ..
6.3.d:
सदा मुदान्वितो राजा सभार्यो बहुपुत्रकः .
एकासीद्दुहिता तस्य सुरूपा गिरिजा यथा .. 56.17 ..
6.3.m: The king was always filled with joy, accompanied by his wife, having many sons. / He had one daughter, beautiful like Girijā.

6.3.s:
iṣṭā sā pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ bandhuvargajanasya ca .
kṛtaṃ vaivāhikaṃ karma kāle prāpte yathāvidhi .. 56.18 ..
6.3.d:
इष्टा सा पितृमातृभ्यां बन्धुवर्गजनस्य च .
कृतं वैवाहिकं कर्म काले प्राप्ते यथाविधि .. 56.18 ..
6.3.m: She was dear to her parents and to the circle of relatives; / when the proper time arrived, her marriage ceremony was performed according to rule.

6.3.s:
anantaraṃ cedipatirdvādaśābdamakhe sthitaḥ .
tatastasyāstu yo bhartā sa mṛtyuvaśamāgataḥ .. 56.19 ..
6.3.d:
अनन्तरं चेदिपतिर्द्वादशाब्दमखे स्थितः .
ततस्तस्यास्तु यो भर्ता स मृत्युवशमागतः .. 56.19 ..
6.3.m: Thereafter, the lord of Cedi engaged in a twelve-year sacrifice. / Then her husband fell into the power of death.

6.3.s:
vidhavāṃ tāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā śokasamanvitaḥ .
uvāca vacanaṃ tatra svabhāryāṃ duḥkhapīḍitām .. 56.20 ..
6.3.d:
विधवां तां सुतां दृष्ट्वा राजा शोकसमन्वितः .
उवाच वचनं तत्र स्वभार्यां दुःखपीडिताम् .. 56.20 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that daughter widowed, the king, filled with grief, / spoke these words to his wife, who was afflicted with sorrow:

6.3.s:
priye duḥkhamidaṃ jātaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ suduḥsaham .
naiṣā rakṣayituṃ śakyā rūpayauvanagarvitā .. 56.21 ..
6.3.d:
प्रिये दुःखमिदं जातं यावज्जीवं सुदुःसहम् .
नैषा रक्षयितुं शक्या रूपयौवनगर्विता .. 56.21 ..
6.3.m:
"My dear, this sorrow that has arisen will be very hard to endure for as long as we live.
Proud of her beauty and youth, she cannot be protected.

6.3.s:
dūṣayeta kulaṃ kvāpi kathaṃ rakṣyā hi bālikā .
nopāyo vidyate kvāpi bhānumatyāśca rakṣaṇe .
parasparaṃ vivadatoḥ śrutvā tatkanyakābravīt .. 56.22 ..
6.3.d:
दूषयेत कुलं क्वापि कथं रक्ष्या हि बालिका .
नोपायो विद्यते क्वापि भानुमत्याश्च रक्षणे .
परस्परं विवदतोः श्रुत्वा तत्कन्यकाब्रवीत् .. 56.22 ..
6.3.m:
She might bring disgrace upon the family somewhere; how indeed can a young girl be guarded?
There is no means anywhere to protect Bhānumatī."
As they were disputing with each other, hearing that, the maiden spoke:

6.3.s:
bhānumatyuvāca -
na lajjāmi tavāgre'haṃ jalpantī tāta karhicit .
satyaṃ notpadyate doṣo madarthe te narādhipa .. 56.23 ..
6.3.d:
भानुमत्युवाच -
न लज्जामि तवाग्रेऽहं जल्पन्ती तात कर्हिचित् .
सत्यं नोत्पद्यते दोषो मदर्थे ते नराधिप .. 56.23 ..
6.3.m:
Bhānumatī said:
"I do not feel ashamed, father, speaking before you at any time.
In truth, no fault will arise on my account for you, O ruler of men.

6.3.s:
adyaprabhṛtyahaṃ tāta dhārayiṣye na mūrdhajān .
sthūlavastrapaṭārddhaṃ tu dhārayiṣyāmi te gṛhe .. 56.24 ..
6.3.d:
अद्यप्रभृत्यहं तात धारयिष्ये न मूर्धजान् .
स्थूलवस्त्रपटार्द्धं तु धारयिष्यामि ते गृहे .. 56.24 ..
6.3.m:
From today onward, father, I will not keep hair on my head.
And in your house I will wear only half a piece of coarse cloth.

6.3.s:
kariṣyāmi vratānyāśu purāṇavihitāni ca .
ātmānaṃ śoṣayiṣyāmi toṣayiṣye janārdanam .. 56.25 ..
6.3.d:
करिष्यामि व्रतान्याशु पुराणविहितानि च .
आत्मानं शोषयिष्यामि तोषयिष्ये जनार्दनम् .. 56.25 ..
6.3.m:
I will immediately undertake religious observances prescribed in the Purāṇas.
I will emaciate myself, and I will please Janārdana.

6.3.s:
mamaiṣā vartate buddhiryadi tvaṃ tāta manyase .
bhānumatyā vacaḥ śrutvā rājā saṃharṣito'bhavat .. 56.26 ..
6.3.d:
ममैषा वर्तते बुद्धिर्यदि त्वं तात मन्यसे .
भानुमत्या वचः श्रुत्वा राजा संहर्षितोऽभवत् .. 56.26 ..
6.3.m:
This is my resolve, if you approve, O father."
Hearing Bhānumatī's words, the king became delighted.

6.3.s:
tīrthayātrāṃ samuddiśya kośaṃ dattvā supuṣkalam .
visṛjya puruṣānvṛddhān kṛtvā tasyāḥ surakṣaṇe .. 56.27 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थयात्रां समुद्दिश्य कोशं दत्त्वा सुपुष्कलम् .
विसृज्य पुरुषान्वृद्धान् कृत्वा तस्याः सुरक्षणे .. 56.27 ..
6.3.m:
Having assigned a pilgrimage to sacred fords, he gave her an abundant treasury.
Having dispatched elderly men, arranging for her good protection,

6.3.s:
puruṣān sāyudhāṃścāpi brāhmaṇānsapurohitān .
dāsīdāsānpadātīṃśca cāsyāḥ saṃrakṣaṇakṣamān .. 56.28 ..
6.3.d:
पुरुषान् सायुधांश्चापि ब्राह्मणान्सपुरोहितान् .
दासीदासान्पदातींश्च चास्याः संरक्षणक्षमान् .. 56.28 ..
6.3.m:
And men bearing weapons, brahmins along with royal priests,
Female and male servants, and foot soldiers capable of protecting her,

6.3.s:
tataḥ piturmatenaiva gaṅgātīraṃ gatā satī .
avagāhya taṭe dve tu gaṅgāyāḥ sa narādhipa .. 56.29 ..
6.3.d:
ततः पितुर्मतेनैव गङ्गातीरं गता सती .
अवगाह्य तटे द्वे तु गङ्गायाः स नराधिप .. 56.29 ..
6.3.m:
Then, by her father's consent, that virtuous woman went to the bank of the Gaṅgā.
Having bathed on both banks of the Gaṅgā, O ruler of men,

6.3.s:
nityaṃ sampūjya sadviprāngandhamālyādibhūṣaṇaiḥ .
dvādaśābdāni sā tīre gaṅgāyāḥ samavasthitā .. 56.30 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं सम्पूज्य सद्विप्रान्गन्धमाल्यादिभूषणैः .
द्वादशाब्दानि सा तीरे गङ्गायाः समवस्थिता .. 56.30 ..
6.3.m:
Always worshipping noble brahmins with perfumes, garlands, and ornaments,
She resided on the bank of the Gaṅgā for twelve years.

6.3.s:
tyaktvā gaṅgāṃ tadā rājñī gatā kāṣṭhāṃ tu dakṣiṇām .
prāptā sā sacivaiḥ sārddhaṃ yatra revā mahānadī .. 56.31 ..
6.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा गङ्गां तदा राज्ञी गता काष्ठां तु दक्षिणाम् .
प्राप्ता सा सचिवैः सार्द्धं यत्र रेवा महानदी .. 56.31 ..
6.3.m:
Then, having left the Gaṅgā, the princess went toward the southern quarter.
Together with the ministers she arrived where the great river Revā is.

6.3.s:
samāḥ pañca sthitā tatra oṅkāre'marakaṇṭake .
udagyāmyeṣu tīrtheṣu tīrthāttīrthaṃ jagāma sā .. 56.32 ..
6.3.d:
समाः पञ्च स्थिता तत्र ओङ्कारेऽमरकण्टके .
उदग्याम्येषु तीर्थेषु तीर्थात्तीर्थं जगाम सा .. 56.32 ..
6.3.m:
She stayed there for five years at Oṅkāra and Amarakaṇṭaka.
She went from sacred ford to sacred ford among the northern and southern sacred fords.

6.3.s:
snātvā snātvā pūjya viprān bhaktipūrvamatandritā .
vāruṇīṃ sā diśaṃ gatvā devanadyāśca saṅgame .. 56.33 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा स्नात्वा पूज्य विप्रान् भक्तिपूर्वमतन्द्रिता .
वारुणीं सा दिशं गत्वा देवनद्याश्च सङ्गमे .. 56.33 ..
6.3.m:
Bathing repeatedly, worshipping brahmins with devotion, never indolent,
Having gone toward the western quarter, to the confluence of the divine river,

6.3.s:
dadarśa cāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ munisaṅghaiḥ samākulam .
dṛṣṭvā munisamūhaṃ sā praṇipatyedamabravīt .. 56.34 ..
6.3.d:
ददर्श चाश्रमं पुण्यं मुनिसङ्घैः समाकुलम् .
दृष्ट्वा मुनिसमूहं सा प्रणिपत्येदमब्रवीत् .. 56.34 ..
6.3.m:
She saw a holy hermitage crowded with hosts of sages.
Seeing the multitude of sages, she bowed down and said this:

6.3.s:
māhātmyamasya tīrthasya nāma caivāsya kīdṛśam .
kathayantu mahābhāgāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama .. 56.35 ..
6.3.d:
माहात्म्यमस्य तीर्थस्य नाम चैवास्य कीदृशम् .
कथयन्तु महाभागाः प्रसादः क्रियतां मम .. 56.35 ..
6.3.m:
"What is the māhātmya of this sacred ford, and what is its name?
May your honors tell me; let favor be shown to me."

6.3.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .
cakratīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ cakraṃ dattaṃ purā hareḥ .
maheśvareṇa tuṣṭena devadevena śūlinā .. 56.36 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः .
चक्रतीर्थं तु विख्यातं चक्रं दत्तं पुरा हरेः .
महेश्वरेण तुष्टेन देवदेवेन शूलिना .. 56.36 ..
6.3.m:
The seers said:
"It is renowned as Cakratīrtha; formerly the discus was given to Hari
By Maheśvara, the god of gods who holds the trident, when he was pleased.

6.3.s:
atra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
anivartikā gatistasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 56.37 ..
6.3.d:
अत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य जायते नात्र संशयः .. 56.37 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes in this sacred ford and satisfies the ancestors and the deities,
His state becomes one from which there is no return; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
dvitīye'hni tato gacchecchūlabhede tapasvini .
pūrvoktena vidhānena snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi .. 56.38 ..
6.3.d:
द्वितीयेऽह्नि ततो गच्छेच्छूलभेदे तपस्विनि .
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन स्नानं कुर्याद्यथाविधि .. 56.38 ..
6.3.m:
On the second day, one should then go to Śūlabheda, O woman of austerities.
According to the rite mentioned before, one should perform ritual ablution as prescribed.

6.3.s:
janmatrayakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
jalena tilamātreṇa pradadyādañjalitrayam .. 56.39 ..
6.3.d:
जन्मत्रयकृतैः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .
जलेन तिलमात्रेण प्रदद्यादञ्जलित्रयम् .. 56.39 ..
6.3.m:
He is freed from the sins committed in three lifetimes; there is no doubt about this.
With water containing merely sesame seeds, one should offer three handfuls of water.

6.3.s:
tṛpyanti pitarastasya dvādaśābdānyasaṃśayam .
yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute bhaktyā śrotriyairbrāhmaṇairnṛpa .. 56.40 ..
6.3.d:
तृप्यन्ति पितरस्तस्य द्वादशाब्दान्यसंशयम् .
यः श्राद्धं कुरुते भक्त्या श्रोत्रियैर्ब्राह्मणैर्नृप .. 56.40 ..
6.3.m:
His ancestors are satisfied for twelve years, without a doubt.
Whoever performs a śrāddha with devotion by means of brahmins learned in the Vedas, O king,

6.3.s:
vārddhuṣyādyāstu varjyante pitḥṇāṃ dattamakṣayam .
apare'hṇi tato gacchetpuṇyāṃ devaśilāṃ śubhām .. 56.41 ..
6.3.d:
वार्द्धुष्याद्यास्तु वर्ज्यन्ते पित्ःणां दत्तमक्षयम् .
अपरेऽह्णि ततो गच्छेत्पुण्यां देवशिलां शुभाम् .. 56.41 ..
6.3.m:
Usurers and the like being excluded, that which is given to the ancestors becomes imperishable.
On the next day, one should then go to the holy, auspicious Devaśilā.

6.3.s:
vīkṣyate jāhnavī puṇyā devairutpāditā purā .
snātvā tatra jalaṃ dadyāttilamiśraṃ narādhipa .. 56.42 ..
6.3.d:
वीक्ष्यते जाह्नवी पुण्या देवैरुत्पादिता पुरा .
स्नात्वा तत्र जलं दद्यात्तिलमिश्रं नराधिप .. 56.42 ..
6.3.m:
There is seen the holy Jāhnavī, brought forth by the gods in ancient times.
Having bathed there, one should offer water mixed with sesame seeds, O ruler of men.

6.3.s:
sakṛtpiṇḍapradānena mucyate brahmahatyayā .
ekādaśyāmupoṣitvā pakṣayorubhayorapi .. 56.43 ..
6.3.d:
सकृत्पिण्डप्रदानेन मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .
एकादश्यामुपोषित्वा पक्षयोरुभयोरपि .. 56.43 ..
6.3.m:
By offering a funerary ball of rice just once, one is freed from the murder of a brahmin.
Fasting on the eleventh lunar day in both fortnights,

6.3.s:
kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kuryātpaṭhetpaurāṇikīṃ kathām .
viṣṇupūjāṃ prakurvīta puṣpadhūpanivedanaiḥ .. 56.44 ..
6.3.d:
क्षपाजागरणं कुर्यात्पठेत्पौराणिकीं कथाम् .
विष्णुपूजां प्रकुर्वीत पुष्पधूपनिवेदनैः .. 56.44 ..
6.3.m:
One should keep a night vigil and recite a narrative from the Purāṇas.
One should perform worship of Viṣṇu with offerings of flowers and incense.

6.3.s:
prabhāte bhojayedviprān dānaṃ dadyātsaśaktitaḥ .
caturthe'hni tato gacchedyatra prācī sarasvatī .. 56.45 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विप्रान् दानं दद्यात्सशक्तितः .
चतुर्थेऽह्नि ततो गच्छेद्यत्र प्राची सरस्वती .. 56.45 ..
6.3.m:
At dawn one should feed brahmins and give gifts according to one's ability.
On the fourth day, one should then go to where the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is,

6.3.s:
brahmadehādviniṣkrāntā pāvanārthaṃ śarīriṇām .
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 56.46 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मदेहाद्विनिष्क्रान्ता पावनार्थं शरीरिणाम् .
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 56.46 ..
6.3.m:
Which emerged from the body of Brahmā for the purification of embodied beings.
Having bathed there with devotion, a man should satisfy the ancestors and deities.

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamanindyān bhojayeddvijān .
pitarastasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdānyasaṃśayam .. 56.47 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथान्यायमनिन्द्यान् भोजयेद्द्विजान् .
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दान्यसंशयम् .. 56.47 ..
6.3.m:
Having performed a śrāddha according to rule, he should feed irreproachable brahmins.
His ancestors are satisfied for twelve years, without a doubt.

6.3.s:
sarvadevamayaṃ sthānaṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ tathā .
devakoṭisamākīrṇaṃ koṭiliṅgottamottamam .. 56.48 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वदेवमयं स्थानं सर्वतीर्थमयं तथा .
देवकोटिसमाकीर्णं कोटिलिङ्गोत्तमोत्तमम् .. 56.48 ..
6.3.m:
The place is composed of all the gods, and likewise composed of all the sacred fords;
It is crowded with ten million deities, the highest of the high with ten million liṅgas.

6.3.s:
trirātraṃ kurute yo'tra śuciḥ snātvā jitendriyaḥ .
pakṣaṃ māsaṃ ca ṣaṇmāsamabdamekaṃ kadācana .. 56.49 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिरात्रं कुरुते योऽत्र शुचिः स्नात्वा जितेन्द्रियः .
पक्षं मासं च षण्मासमब्दमेकं कदाचन .. 56.49 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever, pure, having bathed and restrained his senses, spends three nights here,
Or a fortnight, a month, six months, or at any time a year,

6.3.s:
na tasya sambhavo martye tasya vāso bhaveddivi .
niyamastho vimucyeta trijanmajanitādaghāt .. 56.50 ..
6.3.d:
न तस्य सम्भवो मर्त्ये तस्य वासो भवेद्दिवि .
नियमस्थो विमुच्येत त्रिजन्मजनितादघात् .. 56.50 ..
6.3.m:
For him there is no rebirth among mortals; his dwelling will be in heaven.
Remaining firm in religious observances, he is freed from the sin born of three lifetimes.

6.3.s:
vinā puṃsā tu yā nārī dvādaśābdaṃ śucivratā .
tiṣṭhate sākṣayaṃ kālaṃ rudraloke mahīyate .. 56.51 ..
6.3.d:
विना पुंसा तु या नारी द्वादशाब्दं शुचिव्रता .
तिष्ठते साक्षयं कालं रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 56.51 ..
6.3.m:
Moreover, whatever woman, remaining without a husband, observing pure vows,
Stays for twelve years, she is honored in the world of Rudra for an endless time."

6.3.s:
munīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā mudā paramayā yayau .
tato'vagāhya tattīrthamaharniśamatandritā .. 56.52 ..
6.3.d:
मुनीनां वचनं श्रुत्वा मुदा परमया ययौ .
ततोऽवगाह्य तत्तीर्थमहर्निशमतन्द्रिता .. 56.52 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing the words of the sages, she departed with supreme joy.
Then, having plunged into that sacred ford day and night without indolence,

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tīrthaprabhāvaṃ tu punarvacanamabravīt .
śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ me'dya brāhmaṇāḥ sapurohitāḥ .. 56.53 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तीर्थप्रभावं तु पुनर्वचनमब्रवीत् .
श्रूयतां वचनं मेऽद्य ब्राह्मणाः सपुरोहिताः .. 56.53 ..
6.3.m:
Having seen the power of the sacred ford, she again spoke these words:
"May my words be heard today, O brahmins along with the royal priests!

6.3.s:
na tyajāmīdṛśaṃ sthānaṃ yāvajjīvamaharniśam .
matpituśca tathā mātuḥ kathayadhvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 56.54 ..
6.3.d:
न त्यजामीदृशं स्थानं यावज्जीवमहर्निशम् .
मत्पितुश्च तथा मातुः कथयध्वमिदं वचः .. 56.54 ..
6.3.m:
I will not abandon such a place day and night for as long as I live.
Tell this word to my father and likewise to my mother:

6.3.s:
tvatkanyā śūlabhedasthā niyatā vratacāriṇī .
evamuktvā sthitā sā tu tatra bhānumatī nṛpaḥ .. 56.55 ..
6.3.d:
त्वत्कन्या शूलभेदस्था नियता व्रतचारिणी .
एवमुक्त्वा स्थिता सा तु तत्र भानुमती नृपः .. 56.55 ..
6.3.m:
'Your daughter resides at Śūlabheda, restrained and practicing vows.'"
Having spoken thus, Bhānumatī remained there, O king.

6.3.s:
ekāntaropavāsasthā śanairmāsopavāsitā .
devaśilāsthitā nityaṃ dadhyau sā cakrapāṇinam .. 56.56 ..
6.3.d:
एकान्तरोपवासस्था शनैर्मासोपवासिता .
देवशिलास्थिता नित्यं दध्यौ सा चक्रपाणिनम् .. 56.56 ..
6.3.m:
Practicing alternate-day fasting, and gradually fasting for a month,
Residing constantly at Devaśilā, she meditated on the wielder of the discus.

6.3.s:
aharniśaṃ daheddhūpaṃ candanaṃ ca sadīpakam .
pādaśaucaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ bhojayate dvijān .
dvādaśābdāni sā rājñī suvratā tatra saṃsthitā .. 56.57 ..
6.3.d:
अहर्निशं दहेद्धूपं चन्दनं च सदीपकम् .
पादशौचं स्वयं कृत्वा स्वयं भोजयते द्विजान् .
द्वादशाब्दानि सा राज्ञी सुव्रता तत्र संस्थिता .. 56.57 ..
6.3.m:
Day and night she burned incense and sandalwood accompanied by lamps.
Washing their feet herself, she personally fed the brahmins.
Observing good vows, that princess stayed there for twelve years.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
anyaddevaśilāyāstu māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate .
kathayāmi mahābāho setihāsaṃ purātanam .. 56.58 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
अन्यद्देवशिलायास्तु माहात्म्यं शृणु भूपते .
कथयामि महाबाहो सेतिहासं पुरातनम् .. 56.58 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
"Hear another māhātmya of Devaśilā, O lord of the earth.
I shall recount it, O mighty-armed one, along with an ancient historical account.

6.3.s:
kaścidvanecaro vyādhaḥ śabaraḥ saha bhāryayā .
durbhikṣapīḍitastatra āmiṣārthaṃ vanaṃ gataḥ .. 56.59 ..
6.3.d:
कश्चिद्वनेचरो व्याधः शबरः सह भार्यया .
दुर्भिक्षपीडितस्तत्र आमिषार्थं वनं गतः .. 56.59 ..
6.3.m:
A certain hunter living in the forest, a Śabara, along with his wife,
Afflicted there by famine, went into the forest in search of meat.

6.3.s:
nāpaśyatpakṣiṇastatra na mṛgānna phalāni ca .
sarastato dadarśātha padminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam .. 56.60 ..
6.3.d:
नापश्यत्पक्षिणस्तत्र न मृगान्न फलानि च .
सरस्ततो ददर्शाथ पद्मिनीखण्डमण्डितम् .. 56.60 ..
6.3.m:
He did not see birds there, nor beasts, nor fruits.
Then he saw a lake adorned with a grove of lotuses.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā sarovaraṃ tatra śabarī vākyamabravīt .
kumudāni gṛhāṇa tvaṃ divyānyāhārasiddhaye .. 56.61 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा सरोवरं तत्र शबरी वाक्यमब्रवीत् .
कुमुदानि गृहाण त्वं दिव्यान्याहारसिद्धये .. 56.61 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing the lake there, the Śabara woman spoke these words:
'Take the divine white lotuses for the sake of obtaining food.

6.3.s:
devasya pūjanārthaṃ tu śūlabhedasya yatnataḥ .
vikrayo bhavitā tatra dharmaśīlo jano yataḥ .. 56.62 ..
6.3.d:
देवस्य पूजनार्थं तु शूलभेदस्य यत्नतः .
विक्रयो भविता तत्र धर्मशीलो जनो यतः .. 56.62 ..
6.3.m:
For the worship of the deity of Śūlabheda with diligent care,
A sale will take place there, since the people are righteous.'

6.3.s:
bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā jagrāha kumudāni saḥ .
uttīrṇastu taṭe yāvaddṛṣṭvā śrīvṛkṣamagrataḥ .. 56.63 ..
6.3.d:
भार्याया वचनं श्रुत्वा जग्राह कुमुदानि सः .
उत्तीर्णस्तु तटे यावद्दृष्ट्वा श्रीवृक्षमग्रतः .. 56.63 ..
6.3.m: Hearing his wife's words, he took the white lotuses. / But having stepped out onto the bank, seeing a bilva tree before him,

6.3.s:
śrīphalāni gṛhītvā tu supakvāni viśeṣataḥ .
śūlabhedaṃ sa samprāpto dadarśa subahūñjanān .. 56.64 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीफलानि गृहीत्वा तु सुपक्वानि विशेषतः .
शूलभेदं स सम्प्राप्तो ददर्श सुबहूञ्जनान् .. 56.64 ..
6.3.m: taking especially well-ripened bilva fruits, / he reached Śūlabheda and saw very many people.

6.3.s:
caitramāse site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ narādhipa .
tasminnahani nāśnīyurbālā vṛddhāstathā striyaḥ .. 56.65 ..
6.3.d:
चैत्रमासे सिते पक्षे एकादश्यां नराधिप .
तस्मिन्नहनि नाश्नीयुर्बाला वृद्धास्तथा स्त्रियः .. 56.65 ..
6.3.m: In the month of Caitra, in the bright fortnight, on the eleventh day, O king! / On that day, children, the elderly, and likewise women would not eat.

6.3.s:
maṇḍapaṃ dadṛśe tatra kṛtaṃ devaśilopari .
vastraiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ divyaṃ sraṅmālyairupaśobhitam .. 56.66 ..
6.3.d:
मण्डपं ददृशे तत्र कृतं देवशिलोपरि .
वस्त्रैः संवेष्टितं दिव्यं स्रङ्माल्यैरुपशोभितम् .. 56.66 ..
6.3.m: He saw a pavilion constructed there upon the divine rock, / wrapped with garments, divine, adorned with wreaths and garlands.

6.3.s:
ṛṣayaścāgatāstatra ye cāśramanivāsinaḥ .
sopavāsāḥ saniyamāḥ sarve sāgniparigrahāḥ .. 56.67 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषयश्चागतास्तत्र ये चाश्रमनिवासिनः .
सोपवासाः सनियमाः सर्वे साग्निपरिग्रहाः .. 56.67 ..
6.3.m: And seers arrived there, those who dwelt in hermitages, / fasting, observing vows, all maintaining their sacred fires.

6.3.s:
devanadyāstaṭe ramye munisaṅghaiḥ samākule .
āgacchadbhirnṛpaśreṣṭha mārgastatra na labhyate .. 56.68 ..
6.3.d:
देवनद्यास्तटे रम्ये मुनिसङ्घैः समाकुले .
आगच्छद्भिर्नृपश्रेष्ठ मार्गस्तत्र न लभ्यते .. 56.68 ..
6.3.m: On the delightful bank of the river of the gods, crowded with hosts of sages / arriving, O best of kings, no path could be found there.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā janapadaṃ tatra tāṃ bhāryāṃ śabaro'bravīt .
gaccha pṛcchasva kimapi kimadya snānakāraṇam .. 56.69 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा जनपदं तत्र तां भार्यां शबरोऽब्रवीत् .
गच्छ पृच्छस्व किमपि किमद्य स्नानकारणम् .. 56.69 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the multitude there, the Śabara said to his wife: / 'Go, ask something: what is the reason for the ritual ablution today?

6.3.s:
parvāṇi yāni śrūyante kiṃsvitsūryendusamplavaḥ .
ayanaṃ kiṃ bhavedadya kiṃ vākṣayatṛtīyakā .. 56.70 ..
6.3.d:
पर्वाणि यानि श्रूयन्ते किंस्वित्सूर्येन्दुसम्प्लवः .
अयनं किं भवेदद्य किं वाक्षयतृतीयका .. 56.70 ..
6.3.m: Of the sacred occasions that are heard of, could it be an eclipse of the sun or moon? / Could it be a solstice today, or perhaps Akṣayatṛtīyā?'

6.3.s:
tataḥ svabharturvacanācchabarī prasthitā tadā .
papraccha nārīṃ dṛṣṭvāgre dattvāgre kamale śubhe .. 56.71 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स्वभर्तुर्वचनाच्छबरी प्रस्थिता तदा .
पप्रच्छ नारीं दृष्ट्वाग्रे दत्त्वाग्रे कमले शुभे .. 56.71 ..
6.3.m: Then, at her husband's word, the Śabarī set out at that time. / Seeing a woman ahead, having offered two auspicious lotuses in front, she asked:

6.3.s:
tithiradyaiva kā proktā kiṃ parva kathayasva me .
kimayaṃ snāti loko'yaṃ kiṃ vā snānasya kāraṇam .. 56.72 ..
6.3.d:
तिथिरद्यैव का प्रोक्ता किं पर्व कथयस्व मे .
किमयं स्नाति लोकोऽयं किं वा स्नानस्य कारणम् .. 56.72 ..
6.3.m: 'What lunar day is declared today? Tell me, what is the sacred occasion? / Why are these people bathing, or what is the reason for the ritual ablution?'

6.3.s:
nāryuvāca -
adya caikādaśī puṇyā sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī .
upoṣitā sakṛdyena nākaprāptiṃ karoti sā .. 56.73 ..
6.3.d:
नार्युवाच -
अद्य चैकादशी पुण्या सर्वपापक्षयंकरी .
उपोषिता सकृद्येन नाकप्राप्तिं करोति सा .. 56.73 ..
6.3.m: The woman said: / 'Today is the auspicious Ekādaśī, which destroys all sin; / fasted on even once, it brings attainment of heaven.'

6.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā śabarī śābarāya vai .
kathayāmāsa cāvyagrā strīvākyaṃ nṛpasattama .. 56.74 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शबरी शाबराय वै .
कथयामास चाव्यग्रा स्त्रीवाक्यं नृपसत्तम .. 56.74 ..
6.3.m: Hearing her words, the Śabarī, calm and composed, / related the woman's words to the Śabara, O best of kings:

6.3.s:
adya tvekādaśī puṇyā bālavṛddhairupoṣitā .
madanaikādaśī nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī .. 56.75 ..
6.3.d:
अद्य त्वेकादशी पुण्या बालवृद्धैरुपोषिता .
मदनैकादशी नाम सर्वपापक्षयंकरी .. 56.75 ..
6.3.m: 'Today is indeed the holy Ekādaśī, fasted on by young and old, / named Madanaikādaśī, which destroys all sin.

6.3.s:
niyatā śrūyate tatra rājaputrī suśobhanā .
vratasthā niyatāhārā nāmnā bhānumatī satī .. 56.76 ..
6.3.d:
नियता श्रूयते तत्र राजपुत्री सुशोभना .
व्रतस्था नियताहारा नाम्ना भानुमती सती .. 56.76 ..
6.3.m: Observing vows there, it is heard, is a most beautiful princess, / standing in vows, restrained in food, the virtuous woman named Bhānumatī.

6.3.s:
naitayā sadṛśī kācittriṣu lokeṣu viśrutā .
dṛśyate sā varārohā hyavatīrṇā mahītale .. 56.77 ..
6.3.d:
नैतया सदृशी काचित्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता .
दृश्यते सा वरारोहा ह्यवतीर्णा महीतले .. 56.77 ..
6.3.m: None equal to her is renowned in the three worlds; / that woman of beautiful hips is seen as if descended to the earth.'

6.3.s:
bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śabarastāṃ jagāda ha .
kamalāni yathālābhaṃ dattvā bhuṅkṣva hi satvaram .. 56.78 ..
6.3.d:
भार्याया वचनं श्रुत्वा शबरस्तां जगाद ह .
कमलानि यथालाभं दत्त्वा भुङ्क्ष्व हि सत्वरम् .. 56.78 ..
6.3.m: Hearing his wife's words, the Śabara said to her: / 'Having given the lotuses as obtained, eat quickly indeed.

6.3.s:
mamaiṣā vartate buddhirna bhoktavyaṃ mayā dhruvam .
na mayopārjitaṃ bhadre pāpabuddhyā śubhaṃ kvacit .. 56.79 ..
6.3.d:
ममैषा वर्तते बुद्धिर्न भोक्तव्यं मया ध्रुवम् .
न मयोपार्जितं भद्रे पापबुद्ध्या शुभं क्वचित् .. 56.79 ..
6.3.m: This is my resolve: I certainly must not eat. / Auspicious one, with a sinful mind, no merit was ever acquired by me.'

6.3.s:
śabaryuvāca -
na pūrvaṃ tu mayā bhuktaṃ kasmiṃścaiva tu vāsare .
bhuktaśeṣaṃ mayā bhuktaṃ yāvatkālaṃ smarāmyaham .. 56.80 ..
6.3.d:
शबर्युवाच -
न पूर्वं तु मया भुक्तं कस्मिंश्चैव तु वासरे .
भुक्तशेषं मया भुक्तं यावत्कालं स्मराम्यहम् .. 56.80 ..
6.3.m: The Śabarī said: / 'Never before have I eaten first on any day whatsoever; / I have eaten what remained of your meal, for as long as I can remember.'

6.3.s:
bhāryāyā niścayaṃ jñātvā snānaṃ kartuṃ jagāma ha .
ardhottarīyavastreṇa snānaṃ kṛtvā tu bhaktitaḥ .. 56.81 ..
6.3.d:
भार्याया निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा स्नानं कर्तुं जगाम ह .
अर्धोत्तरीयवस्त्रेण स्नानं कृत्वा तु भक्तितः .. 56.81 ..
6.3.m: Knowing his wife's resolve, he went to perform ritual ablution. / Having performed ritual ablution with half an upper garment, with devotion,

6.3.s:
sarvān devānnamaskṛtya gato devaśilāṃ prati .
tasthau sa śaṅkamāno'pi namaskṛtya janārdanam .. 56.82 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वान् देवान्नमस्कृत्य गतो देवशिलां प्रति .
तस्थौ स शङ्कमानोऽपि नमस्कृत्य जनार्दनम् .. 56.82 ..
6.3.m: bowing to all the gods, he went towards the divine rock; / he stood, though hesitating, having bowed to Janārdana.

6.3.s:
yasyāstu kumude datte tayā rājñyai niveditam .
taddṛṣṭvā padmayugalaṃ tāṃ dāsīṃ sābravīttadā .. 56.83 ..
6.3.d:
यस्यास्तु कुमुदे दत्ते तया राज्ञ्यै निवेदितम् .
तद्दृष्ट्वा पद्मयुगलं तां दासीं साब्रवीत्तदा .. 56.83 ..
6.3.m: The woman to whom the two white lotuses had been given reported it to the queen. / Seeing that pair of lotuses, she then said to that maidservant:

6.3.s:
kutra padmadvayaṃ labdhaṃ kathyatāmagrato mama .
śīghraṃ tatraiva gatvā ca padmānānaya cāparān .. 56.84 ..
6.3.d:
कुत्र पद्मद्वयं लब्धं कथ्यतामग्रतो मम .
शीघ्रं तत्रैव गत्वा च पद्मानानय चापरान् .. 56.84 ..
6.3.m: 'Tell me in front of me: where was this pair of lotuses obtained? / Having gone there quickly, bring other lotuses as well.

6.3.s:
dhānyena vasunā vāpi kamalāni samānaya .
bhānumatyā vacaḥ śrutvā gatā sā śabaraṃ prati .. 56.85 ..
6.3.d:
धान्येन वसुना वापि कमलानि समानय .
भानुमत्या वचः श्रुत्वा गता सा शबरं प्रति .. 56.85 ..
6.3.m: Bring the lotuses either with grain or with wealth.' / Hearing Bhānumatī's word, she went to the Śabara:

6.3.s: śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi bahūnyanyāni dehi me .. 56.86 ..
6.3.d: श्रीफलानि च पुष्पाणि बहून्यन्यानि देहि मे .. 56.86 ..
6.3.m: 'Give me bilva fruits and many other flowers.'

6.3.s:
śabaryuvāca -
śrīphalāni sapuṣpāṇi dāsyāmi ca viśeṣataḥ .
na lobho na spṛhā me'sti gatvā rājñīṃ nivedaya .. 56.87 ..
6.3.d:
शबर्युवाच -
श्रीफलानि सपुष्पाणि दास्यामि च विशेषतः .
न लोभो न स्पृहा मेऽस्ति गत्वा राज्ञीं निवेदय .. 56.87 ..
6.3.m: The Śabarī said: / 'I shall give the bilva fruits along with flowers in particular; / I have no greed, nor desire. Go, report to the queen.'

6.3.s:
tayā ca satvaraṃ gatvā yathāvṛttaṃ niveditam .
śabaryuktaṃ purastasyāḥ savistaraparaṃ vacaḥ .. 56.88 ..
6.3.d:
तया च सत्वरं गत्वा यथावृत्तं निवेदितम् .
शबर्युक्तं पुरस्तस्याः सविस्तरपरं वचः .. 56.88 ..
6.3.m: And going quickly, she reported the event as it happened, / the words spoken by the Śabarī, in full detail before her.

6.3.s:
tasyāstu vacanaṃ śrutvā rājñī tatra svayaṃ gatā .
uvāca śabarīṃ prītyā dehi padmāni mūlyataḥ .. 56.89 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यास्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा राज्ञी तत्र स्वयं गता .
उवाच शबरीं प्रीत्या देहि पद्मानि मूल्यतः .. 56.89 ..
6.3.m: Hearing her words, the queen went there in person. / She said to the Śabarī with affection: 'Give the lotuses for a price.'

6.3.s:
śabaryuvāca -
na mūlyaṃ kāmaye devi phalapuṣpasamudbhavam .
śrīphalāni ca puṣpāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ mama gṛhyatām .. 56.90 ..
6.3.d:
शबर्युवाच -
न मूल्यं कामये देवि फलपुष्पसमुद्भवम् .
श्रीफलानि च पुष्पाणि यथेष्टं मम गृह्यताम् .. 56.90 ..
6.3.m: The Śabarī said: / 'O queen, I desire no price arising from fruits and flowers; / take my bilva fruits and flowers as you please.

6.3.s: arcāṃ kuru yathānyāyaṃ vāsudeve jagatpatau .. 56.91 ..
6.3.d: अर्चां कुरु यथान्यायं वासुदेवे जगत्पतौ .. 56.91 ..
6.3.m: Perform worship according to rule to Vāsudeva, the Lord of the world.'

6.3.s:
rājñyuvāca -
vinā mūlyaṃ na gṛhṇāmi kamalāni tavādhunā .
dhānyasya khārikāmekāṃ dadāmi pratigṛhyatām .. 56.92 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्युवाच -
विना मूल्यं न गृह्णामि कमलानि तवाधुना .
धान्यस्य खारिकामेकां ददामि प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 56.92 ..
6.3.m: The queen said: / 'I will not take your lotuses now without a price; / I give one khārī of grain, let it be accepted!

6.3.s:
daśa viṃśatyatha triṃśaccatvāriṃśadathāpi vā .
gṛhāṇa vā khāriśataṃ durbhikṣāṃ bodhimuttara .. 56.93 ..
6.3.d:
दश विंशत्यथ त्रिंशच्चत्वारिंशदथापि वा .
गृहाण वा खारिशतं दुर्भिक्षां बोधिमुत्तर .. 56.93 ..
6.3.m: Ten, twenty, or thirty, or even forty; / or take a hundred khārīs, [as provision against] famine, O noble-minded one!

6.3.s:
vasu ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca anyatte yadabhīpsitam .
tatsarvaṃ sampradāsyāmi kamalārthe na saṃśayaḥ .. 56.94 ..
6.3.d:
वसु रत्नं सुवर्णं च अन्यत्ते यदभीप्सितम् .
तत्सर्वं सम्प्रदास्यामि कमलार्थे न संशयः .. 56.94 ..
6.3.m: Wealth, jewels, and gold, and whatever else is desired by you, / all that I will give for the sake of the lotuses, without a doubt.'

6.3.s:
śabaryuvāca -
nāhāraṃ cintayāmyadya muktvā devaṃ varānane .
devakāryaṃ vinā bhadre nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate .. 56.95 ..
6.3.d:
शबर्युवाच -
नाहारं चिन्तयाम्यद्य मुक्त्वा देवं वरानने .
देवकार्यं विना भद्रे नान्या बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते .. 56.95 ..
6.3.m: The Śabarī said: / 'O fair-faced one, I do not think of food today, apart from God. / Except for the service of God, O gentle lady, no other thought arises.'

6.3.s:
rājñyuvāca -
na tvayānnaṃ parityājyaṃ sarvamanne pratiṣṭhitam .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena mamānnaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 56.96 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्युवाच -
न त्वयान्नं परित्याज्यं सर्वमन्ने प्रतिष्ठितम् .
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ममान्नं प्रतिगृह्यताम् .. 56.96 ..
6.3.m: The queen said: / 'Food must not be abandoned by you; everything is established in food. / Therefore, by every effort, let my food be accepted!

6.3.s:
tapasvino mahābhāgā ye cāraṇyanivāsinaḥ .
gṛhasthadvāri te sarve yācante'nnamatandritāḥ .. 56.97 ..
6.3.d:
तपस्विनो महाभागा ये चारण्यनिवासिनः .
गृहस्थद्वारि ते सर्वे याचन्तेऽन्नमतन्द्रिताः .. 56.97 ..
6.3.m: The illustrious ascetics and those who dwell in the forest, / all of them unweariedly beg for food at the householder's door.'

6.3.s:
śabaryuvāca -
niṣedhaśca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam .
satyena tapate sūryaḥ satyena jvalate'nalaḥ .. 56.98 ..
6.3.d:
शबर्युवाच -
निषेधश्च कृतः पूर्वं सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम् .
सत्येन तपते सूर्यः सत्येन ज्वलतेऽनलः .. 56.98 ..
6.3.m: The Śabarī said: / 'A refusal was already made; everything is established in truth. / By truth the sun gives heat; by truth fire burns.

6.3.s:
satyena tiṣṭhatyudadhirvāyuḥ satyena vāti hi .
satyena pacyate sasyaṃ gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sravanti ca .. 56.99 ..
6.3.d:
सत्येन तिष्ठत्युदधिर्वायुः सत्येन वाति हि .
सत्येन पच्यते सस्यं गावः क्षीरं स्रवन्ति च .. 56.99 ..
6.3.m: By truth the ocean remains; the wind blows indeed by truth. / By truth crops ripen, and cows yield milk.

6.3.s:
satyādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena satyaṃ satyena pālayet .. 56.100 ..
6.3.d:
सत्याधारमिदं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् .
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन सत्यं सत्येन पालयेत् .. 56.100 ..
6.3.m: All this world, unmoving and moving, is supported by truth. / Therefore, by every effort, one should protect truth with truth.

6.3.s:
devakāryaṃ tu me muktvā nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate .
gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjāṃ gadābhṛtaḥ .. 56.101 ..
6.3.d:
देवकार्यं तु मे मुक्त्वा नान्या बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते .
गृहाण राज्ञि पुष्पाणि कुरु पूजां गदाभृतः .. 56.101 ..
6.3.m: Apart from the service of God, no other thought arises in me. / O queen, take the flowers, perform the worship of the Bearer of the Mace.

6.3.s:
śrūyate dvijavākyaistu na doṣo vidyate kvacit .
kuśāḥ śākaṃ payo matsyā gandhāḥ puṣpākṣatā dadhi .
māṃsaṃ śayyāsanaṃ dhānāḥ pratyākhyeyā na vāri ca .. 56.102 ..
6.3.d:
श्रूयते द्विजवाक्यैस्तु न दोषो विद्यते क्वचित् .
कुशाः शाकं पयो मत्स्या गन्धाः पुष्पाक्षता दधि .
मांसं शय्यासनं धानाः प्रत्याख्येया न वारि च .. 56.102 ..
6.3.m: Indeed, from the words of brahmins it is heard that there is no fault anywhere: / Kuśa grass, vegetables, milk, fish, perfumes, flowers, unbroken rice, curds, / meat, a bed, a seat, roasted grain, and water are not to be refused.'

6.3.s:
rājñyuvāca -
ārāmopahṛtaṃ puṣpamāraṇyaṃ puṣpameva ca .
krītaṃ pratigrahe labdhaṃ puṣpamevaṃ caturvidham .. 56.103 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्युवाच -
आरामोपहृतं पुष्पमारण्यं पुष्पमेव च .
क्रीतं प्रतिग्रहे लब्धं पुष्पमेवं चतुर्विधम् .. 56.103 ..
6.3.m: The queen said: / 'Flower brought from a garden, and flower from the forest, / bought, and obtained as an acceptance of gifts—thus is flower of four kinds.

6.3.s:
uttamaṃ puṣpamāraṇyaṃ gṛhītaṃ svayameva ca .
madhyamaṃ phalamārāme tvadhamaṃ krītameva ca .
pratigraheṇa yallabdhaṃ niṣphalaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ .. 56.104 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तमं पुष्पमारण्यं गृहीतं स्वयमेव च .
मध्यमं फलमारामे त्वधमं क्रीतमेव च .
प्रतिग्रहेण यल्लब्धं निष्फलं तद्विदुर्बुधाः .. 56.104 ..
6.3.m: A wild flower gathered by oneself is highest; / fruit in a garden is middling, but bought is base; / what is obtained through acceptance of gifts, the wise know that as fruitless.'

6.3.s:
purohita uvāca -
gṛhāṇa rājñi puṣpāṇi kuru pūjāṃ gadābhṛtaḥ .
upakāraḥ prakartavyo vyapadeśena karhicit .. 56.105 ..
6.3.d:
पुरोहित उवाच -
गृहाण राज्ञि पुष्पाणि कुरु पूजां गदाभृतः .
उपकारः प्रकर्तव्यो व्यपदेशेन कर्हिचित् .. 56.105 ..
6.3.m: The priest said: / “Accept the flowers, O Queen, and perform the worship of the mace-bearer [Viṣṇu]. / A favor should be done, even under a pretext, at times.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
śrīphalāni sapadmāni dattāni śabareṇa tu .
gṛhītvā tāni rājñī sā pūjāṃ cakre suśobhanām .. 56.106 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
श्रीफलानि सपद्मानि दत्तानि शबरेण तु .
गृहीत्वा तानि राज्ञी सा पूजां चक्रे सुशोभनाम् .. 56.106 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / The bilva fruits and lotuses were given by the Śabara. / Taking them, the queen performed a most splendid worship.

6.3.s:
kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ cakre śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ kathām .
śabarastu tato bhāryāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 56.107 ..
6.3.d:
क्षपाजागरणं चक्रे श्रुत्वा पौराणिकीं कथाम् .
शबरस्तु ततो भार्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 56.107 ..
6.3.m: She kept a night vigil, having listened to a Purāṇic narrative. / Then the Śabara spoke these words to his wife:

6.3.s:
dīpārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sneho yathālābhena sundari .
kṛtvā dīpaṃ tatastau tu kṛtvā pūjāṃ hareḥ śubhām .. 56.108 ..
6.3.d:
दीपार्थं गृह्यतां स्नेहो यथालाभेन सुन्दरि .
कृत्वा दीपं ततस्तौ तु कृत्वा पूजां हरेः शुभाम् .. 56.108 ..
6.3.m: “Let oil be taken for the lamp as it is obtained, O beautiful one.” / Then, having prepared the lamp and offered an auspicious worship to Hari,

6.3.s:
cakraturjāgaraṃ rātrau dhyāyanto dharaṇīdharam .
tataḥ prabhātasamaye dṛṣṭvā snānotsukaṃ janam .. 56.109 ..
6.3.d:
चक्रतुर्जागरं रात्रौ ध्यायन्तो धरणीधरम् .
ततः प्रभातसमये दृष्ट्वा स्नानोत्सुकं जनम् .. 56.109 ..
6.3.m: the two kept vigil in the night, meditating upon the bearer of the earth [Viṣṇu]. / Then, at dawn, seeing the people eager for ritual ablution:

6.3.s:
snāti vai śūlabhede tu devanadyāṃ tathāpare .
sarasvatyāṃ narāḥ kecinmārkaṇḍasya hrade'pare .. 56.110 ..
6.3.d:
स्नाति वै शूलभेदे तु देवनद्यां तथापरे .
सरस्वत्यां नराः केचिन्मार्कण्डस्य ह्रदेऽपरे .. 56.110 ..
6.3.m: some bathed indeed at Śūlabheda, others in the river of the gods, / some men in the Sarasvatī, and others in the pool of Mārkaṇḍa.

6.3.s:
cakratīrthaṃ gatāścakruḥ snānaṃ kecidvidhānataḥ .
śucayaste janāḥ sarve snātvā devāśilopari .. 56.111 ..
6.3.d:
चक्रतीर्थं गताश्चक्रुः स्नानं केचिद्विधानतः .
शुचयस्ते जनाः सर्वे स्नात्वा देवाशिलोपरि .. 56.111 ..
6.3.m: Having gone to Cakratīrtha, some performed their ritual ablution according to rule. / All those people, purified after bathing, upon the Devāśilā

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ cakruḥ prayatnena śraddhayā pūtacetasā .
tāndṛṣṭvā śabaro bilvaiḥ piṇḍāṃścakre prayatnataḥ .. 56.112 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं चक्रुः प्रयत्नेन श्रद्धया पूतचेतसा .
तान्दृष्ट्वा शबरो बिल्वैः पिण्डांश्चक्रे प्रयत्नतः .. 56.112 ..
6.3.m: diligently performed the śrāddha with faith and a purified heart. / Seeing them, the Śabara diligently made funeral cakes from bilva fruits.

6.3.s:
bhānumatyā tathā bhartuḥ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kṛtam .
anindyā bhojitā viprā dambhavārddhuṣyavarjitāḥ .. 56.113 ..
6.3.d:
भानुमत्या तथा भर्तुः पिण्डनिर्वपणं कृतम् .
अनिन्द्या भोजिता विप्रा दम्भवार्द्धुष्यवर्जिताः .. 56.113 ..
6.3.m: Likewise, the offering of funeral cakes was performed by Bhānumatī for her husband. / Irreproachable brahmins, free from deceit and usury, were fed

6.3.s:
haviṣyānnaistathā dadhnā śarkarāmadhusarpiṣā .
pāyasena tu gavyena kṛtānnena viśeṣataḥ .. 56.114 ..
6.3.d:
हविष्यान्नैस्तथा दध्ना शर्करामधुसर्पिषा .
पायसेन तु गव्येन कृतान्नेन विशेषतः .. 56.114 ..
6.3.m: with sacrificial food, curds, sugar, honey, and clarified butter, / and especially with milk-rice prepared from cow's milk and cooked dishes.

6.3.s:
bhojayitvā tathā rājñī dadau dānaṃ yathāvidhi .
pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ govṛṣameva ca .. 56.115 ..
6.3.d:
भोजयित्वा तथा राज्ञी ददौ दानं यथाविधि .
पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं शय्यां गोवृषमेव च .. 56.115 ..
6.3.m: Having thus fed them, the queen gave gifts according to the precept: / wooden sandals and shoes, an umbrella, a bed, and a bull,

6.3.s:
vividhāni ca dānāni hemaratnadhanāni ca .
cakratīrthe mahārāja kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .
pṛthvī tena bhaveddattā saśailavanakānanā .. 56.116 ..
6.3.d:
विविधानि च दानानि हेमरत्नधनानि च .
चक्रतीर्थे महाराज कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति .
पृथ्वी तेन भवेद्दत्ता सशैलवनकानना .. 56.116 ..
6.3.m: and various gifts of gold, jewels, and wealth. / O Great King, he who gives a tawny cow at Cakratīrtha / has given the entire earth along with its mountains and forests.

6.3.s:
uttānapāda uvāca -
yāni yāni ca dattāni śastāni jagatīpateḥ .
tāni sarvāṇi deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 56.117 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तानपाद उवाच -
यानि यानि च दत्तानि शस्तानि जगतीपतेः .
तानि सर्वाणि देवेश कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 56.117 ..
6.3.m: Uttānapāda said: / “Whatever gifts given to the lord of the world are commended, / tell me all those, O Lord of gods, out of your grace.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
tilapradaḥ prajāmiṣṭāṃ dīpadaścakṣuruttamam .
bhūmidaḥ svargamāpnoti dīrghamāyurhiraṇyadaḥ .. 56.118 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
तिलप्रदः प्रजामिष्टां दीपदश्चक्षुरुत्तमम् .
भूमिदः स्वर्गमाप्नोति दीर्घमायुर्हिरण्यदः .. 56.118 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “The giver of sesame seeds obtains desired offspring; the giver of a lamp, excellent vision; / the giver of land attains heaven; the giver of gold, a long life.

6.3.s:
gṛhado rogarahito rūpyado rūpavān bhavet .
vāsodaścandrasālokyamarkasāyujyamaśvadaḥ .. 56.119 ..
6.3.d:
गृहदो रोगरहितो रूप्यदो रूपवान् भवेत् .
वासोदश्चन्द्रसालोक्यमर्कसायुज्यमश्वदः .. 56.119 ..
6.3.m: The giver of a house becomes free from illness; the giver of silver becomes handsome; / the giver of clothes attains the world of the Moon; the giver of a horse, union with the Sun.

6.3.s:
vṛṣadastu śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godātā ca triviṣṭapam .
yānaśayyāprado bhāryāmaiśvaryamabhayapradaḥ .. 56.120 ..
6.3.d:
वृषदस्तु श्रियं पुष्टां गोदाता च त्रिविष्टपम् .
यानशय्याप्रदो भार्यामैश्वर्यमभयप्रदः .. 56.120 ..
6.3.m: The giver of a bull obtains abundant prosperity; the giver of a cow, the third heaven; / the giver of a conveyance and a bed, a wife; the giver of freedom from fear, sovereignty.

6.3.s:
dhānyadaḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahma śāśvatam .
vāryannapṛthivīvāsastilakāñcanasarpiṣām .. 56.121 ..
6.3.d:
धान्यदः शाश्वतं सौख्यं ब्रह्मदो ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् .
वार्यन्नपृथिवीवासस्तिलकाञ्चनसर्पिषाम् .. 56.121 ..
6.3.m: The giver of grain attains eternal happiness; the giver of the Veda, eternal Brahman. / Among gifts of water, food, earth, clothing, sesame, gold, and clarified butter,

6.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ brahmadānaṃ viśiṣyate .
yena yena hi bhāvena yadyaddānaṃ prayacchati .. 56.122 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव दानानां ब्रह्मदानं विशिष्यते .
येन येन हि भावेन यद्यद्दानं प्रयच्छति .. 56.122 ..
6.3.m: the gift of the Veda excels all gifts. / With whatever intention a person offers whatever gift,

6.3.s:
tena tena sa bhāvena prāpnoti pratipūjitam .
dṛṣṭvā dānāni sarvāṇi rājñī dattāni yāni ca .. 56.123 ..
6.3.d:
तेन तेन स भावेन प्राप्नोति प्रतिपूजितम् .
दृष्ट्वा दानानि सर्वाणि राज्ञी दत्तानि यानि च .. 56.123 ..
6.3.m: with that very intention he receives it honored in return.” / Having seen all the gifts that were given by the queen,

6.3.s:
uvāca śabaro bhāryāṃ yattacchṛṇu nareśvara .
purāṇaṃ paṭhitaṃ bhadre brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .. 56.124 ..
6.3.d:
उवाच शबरो भार्यां यत्तच्छृणु नरेश्वर .
पुराणं पठितं भद्रे ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः .. 56.124 ..
6.3.m: the Śabara spoke to his wife; hear that, O ruler of men: / “The Purāṇa was recited, O auspicious one, by brahmins who have mastered the Vedas,

6.3.s:
śrutaṃ ca tanmayā sarvaṃ dānadharmaphalaṃ śubham .
pūrvajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ snānadānavratādibhiḥ .. 56.125 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुतं च तन्मया सर्वं दानधर्मफलं शुभम् .
पूर्वजन्मार्जितं पापं स्नानदानव्रतादिभिः .. 56.125 ..
6.3.m: and all that auspicious fruit of the virtue of giving was heard by me. / Sin accumulated in past lives, through ritual ablutions, gifts, vows, and the like [is destroyed];

6.3.s:
śarīraṃ dustyajaṃ muktvā labhate gatimuttamām .
saṃsārasāgarādbhītaḥ satyaṃ bhadre vadāmi te .. 56.126 ..
6.3.d:
शरीरं दुस्त्यजं मुक्त्वा लभते गतिमुत्तमाम् .
संसारसागराद्भीतः सत्यं भद्रे वदामि ते .. 56.126 ..
6.3.m: abandoning this hard-to-relinquish body, one attains the supreme state. / Afraid of the ocean of worldly existence, I speak the truth to you, O auspicious one:

6.3.s:
anekāni ca pāpāni kṛtāni bahuśo mayā .
ghātitā jantavo bhadre nirdagdhāḥ parvatāḥ sadā .. 56.127 ..
6.3.d:
अनेकानि च पापानि कृतानि बहुशो मया .
घातिता जन्तवो भद्रे निर्दग्धाः पर्वताः सदा .. 56.127 ..
6.3.m: many sins have been committed by me repeatedly; / living creatures were killed, O blessed one, and mountains were continually burned.

6.3.s:
tena pāpena dagdho'haṃ dāridryaṃ na nivartate .
tīrthāvagāhanaṃ pūrvaṃ pāpena na kṛtaṃ mayā .. 56.128 ..
6.3.d:
तेन पापेन दग्धोऽहं दारिद्र्यं न निवर्तते .
तीर्थावगाहनं पूर्वं पापेन न कृतं मया .. 56.128 ..
6.3.m: Burned by that sin, my poverty does not cease. / Immersion in sacred fords was not performed by me previously, because of my sin.

6.3.s:
tenāhaṃ duḥkhito bhadre dāridryamanivartikam .
māturgṛhaṃ prayāhi tvaṃ tyaja snehaṃ mamopari .
nagaśṛṅgaṃ samāruhya moktumicchāmyahaṃ tanum .. 56.129 ..
6.3.d:
तेनाहं दुःखितो भद्रे दारिद्र्यमनिवर्तिकम् .
मातुर्गृहं प्रयाहि त्वं त्यज स्नेहं ममोपरि .
नगशृङ्गं समारुह्य मोक्तुमिच्छाम्यहं तनुम् .. 56.129 ..
6.3.m: Therefore am I afflicted, O auspicious one, by relentless poverty. / Go to your mother's house; give up your affection for me. / Having climbed a mountain peak, I wish to cast off my body.”

6.3.s:
śabaryuvāca -
mātrā pitrā na me kāryaṃ nāpi svajanabāndhavaiḥ .
yā gatistava jīveśa sā mamāpi bhaviṣyati .. 56.130 ..
6.3.d:
शबर्युवाच -
मात्रा पित्रा न मे कार्यं नापि स्वजनबान्धवैः .
या गतिस्तव जीवेश सा ममापि भविष्यति .. 56.130 ..
6.3.m: The Śabarī said: / “I have no use for mother, nor for father, nor for kinsmen and relatives. / Whatever is your destination, O lord of my life, that shall be mine as well.

6.3.s:
na strīṇāmīdṛśo dharmo vinā bhartrā svajīvitam .
śrūyante bahavo doṣā dharmaśāstreṣvanekadhā .. 56.131 ..
6.3.d:
न स्त्रीणामीदृशो धर्मो विना भर्त्रा स्वजीवितम् .
श्रूयन्ते बहवो दोषा धर्मशास्त्रेष्वनेकधा .. 56.131 ..
6.3.m: For women, there is no such duty as living their own life without a husband. / Many faults are heard in various ways in the treatises on dharma.

6.3.s:
pāraṇaṃ kuru bhojendra vrataṃ yena na naśyati .
yatte'bhivāñchitaṃ kiṃcidviṣṇave kartumarhasi .. 56.132 ..
6.3.d:
पारणं कुरु भोजेन्द्र व्रतं येन न नश्यति .
यत्तेऽभिवाञ्छितं किंचिद्विष्णवे कर्तुमर्हसि .. 56.132 ..
6.3.m: Break your fast, O king among Bhojas, so that your vow may not be lost. / Whatever small thing is desired by you, you ought to do it for Viṣṇu.”

6.3.s:
bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā mumude śabarastataḥ .
gṛhītvā śrīphalaṃ śīghraṃ homaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi .. 56.133 ..
6.3.d:
भार्याया वचनं श्रुत्वा मुमुदे शबरस्ततः .
गृहीत्वा श्रीफलं शीघ्रं होमं कृत्वा यथाविधि .. 56.133 ..
6.3.m: Hearing the words of his wife, the Śabara then rejoiced. / Quickly taking a bilva fruit, performing the fire sacrifice according to rule,

6.3.s:
sarvadevānnamaskṛtya bhukto'pi ca tayā saha .
caitryāṃ tu viṣuvaṃ jñātvā tasthau tatra dinatrayam .. 56.134 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe vyādhavākyopadeśakathanapūrvakadānādiphalavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 57
6.3.d:
सर्वदेवान्नमस्कृत्य भुक्तोऽपि च तया सह .
चैत्र्यां तु विषुवं ज्ञात्वा तस्थौ तत्र दिनत्रयम् .. 56.134 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे व्याधवाक्योपदेशकथनपूर्वकदानादिफलवर्णनं नाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 57
6.3.m:
and bowing down to all the gods, he also ate together with her. / Knowing the equinox to fall on the full moon of Caitra, he stayed there for three days.
Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, named 'The Description of the Fruits of Giving and Other Virtues Preceded by the Recounting of the Hunter's Speech', in the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 57

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
bhānumatī dvijānbhojya bubhuje bhuktaśeṣataḥ .
bhuktvā susukhamāsthāya tadannaṃ pariṇāmya ca .. 57.1 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
भानुमती द्विजान्भोज्य बुभुजे भुक्तशेषतः .
भुक्त्वा सुसुखमास्थाय तदन्नं परिणाम्य च .. 57.1 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Having fed the twice-born, Bhānumatī ate of the leftovers. / Having eaten, she rested in great comfort, and after digesting that food,

6.3.s:
trayodaśyāṃ tato gatvā madanākhyatithau tadā .
mārkaṇḍasya hrade snātvānarcya devaṃ guhāśayam .. 57.2 ..
6.3.d:
त्रयोदश्यां ततो गत्वा मदनाख्यतिथौ तदा .
मार्कण्डस्य ह्रदे स्नात्वानर्च्य देवं गुहाशयम् .. 57.2 ..
6.3.m: she then went on the thirteenth lunar day, named the Madana lunar day. / Having bathed in the pool of Mārkaṇḍa and having worshipped the god residing in the cave [of the heart],

6.3.s:
kṛtopavāsaniyamā snāpayitvā maheśvaram .
pañcāmṛtasugandhena dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ .. 57.3 ..
6.3.d:
कृतोपवासनियमा स्नापयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
पञ्चामृतसुगन्धेन धूपदीपनिवेदनैः .. 57.3 ..
6.3.m: she observed the vow of fasting, bathed Maheśvara / with the fragrant fivefold nectar, and with incense, lamps, and offerings,

6.3.s:
ārcayadvividhaiḥ puṣpairnaivedyaiśca suśobhanaiḥ .
kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śrutvā paurāṇikīṃ kathām .. 57.4 ..
6.3.d:
आर्चयद्विविधैः पुष्पैर्नैवेद्यैश्च सुशोभनैः .
क्षपाजागरणं कृत्वा श्रुत्वा पौराणिकीं कथाम् .. 57.4 ..
6.3.m: she worshipped him with various flowers and very splendid food offerings. / Having kept a night vigil and heard a Purāṇic recitation,

6.3.s:
nṛtyagītaistathā stotrairdadhyau devaṃ maheśvaram .
annaṃ vistāritaṃ sarvaṃ devasyāgre yathāvidhi .. 57.5 ..
6.3.d:
नृत्यगीतैस्तथा स्तोत्रैर्दध्यौ देवं महेश्वरम् .
अन्नं विस्तारितं सर्वं देवस्याग्रे यथाविधि .. 57.5 ..
6.3.m: with dances, songs, and hymns of praise she meditated upon the god Maheśvara. / All the food was laid out in front of the god according to rule.

6.3.s:
cāturvarṇyasutāḥ sarve bhojitāḥ saparicchadāḥ .
caturdaśyāṃ dinaṃ yāvatsampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam .. 57.6 ..
6.3.d:
चातुर्वर्ण्यसुताः सर्वे भोजिताः सपरिच्छदाः .
चतुर्दश्यां दिनं यावत्सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम् .. 57.6 ..
6.3.m: All members of the four classes together with their retinues were fed. / On the fourteenth day, having worshipped the one whose banner is the bull throughout the day,

6.3.s:
śaṅkhavāditrabherībhiḥ paṭahadhvanināditam .
kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhūtajanasaṃkulam .. 57.7 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्खवादित्रभेरीभिः पटहध्वनिनादितम् .
क्षपाजागरणं कृत्वा प्रभूतजनसंकुलम् .. 57.7 ..
6.3.m: resounding with the sounds of conches, musical instruments, kettle-drums, and tabors, / she kept a night vigil, crowded with numerous people.

6.3.s:
nṛtyagītaistathā stotraiḥ preritā sā niśā tadā .
prabhāte bhojitā viprāḥ pāyasairmadhusarpiṣā .. 57.8 ..
6.3.d:
नृत्यगीतैस्तथा स्तोत्रैः प्रेरिता सा निशा तदा .
प्रभाते भोजिता विप्राः पायसैर्मधुसर्पिषा .. 57.8 ..
6.3.m: That night was spent with dances, songs, and hymns of praise. / At daybreak, the brahmins were fed with milk-rice, honey, and clarified butter.

6.3.s:
dattvā dānāni viprebhyaḥ śaktyā viprānusārataḥ .
arcayitvā mahāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhairmadanena ca .. 57.9 ..
6.3.d:
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यः शक्त्या विप्रानुसारतः .
अर्चयित्वा महापुष्पैः सुगन्धैर्मदनेन च .. 57.9 ..
6.3.m: Having given gifts to the brahmins according to her capacity and following the brahmins' guidance, / having worshipped with great flowers, sweet scents, and madana plants,

6.3.s:
vicitraiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca devaḥ sampūjya veṣṭitaḥ .
sragdāmalambamānaiśca bahudīpasamujjvalaiḥ .. 57.10 ..
6.3.d:
विचित्रैः सूक्ष्मवस्त्रैश्च देवः सम्पूज्य वेष्टितः .
स्रग्दामलम्बमानैश्च बहुदीपसमुज्ज्वलैः .. 57.10 ..
6.3.m: the god, duly worshipped, was draped with wonderful, fine garments, / with hanging garlands of flowers, and with the brilliant light of many lamps.

6.3.s:
pakvānnairvividhairbhakṣyaiḥ suvṛttairmodakādibhiḥ .
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vedādhyayanatatparāḥ .. 57.11 ..
6.3.d:
पक्वान्नैर्विविधैर्भक्ष्यैः सुवृत्तैर्मोदकादिभिः .
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे वेदाध्ययनतत्पराः .. 57.11 ..
6.3.m: with various cooked foods, eatables, well-shaped round sweets and the like. / Then all those brahmins devoted to the study of the Vedas

6.3.s:
tatparva kīrtayāṃścakruḥ padmakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ .
ādityasya dinaṃ tvadya tithiḥ pañcadaśī tathā .. 57.12 ..
6.3.d:
तत्पर्व कीर्तयांश्चक्रुः पद्मकं नाम नामतः .
आदित्यस्य दिनं त्वद्य तिथिः पञ्चदशी तथा .. 57.12 ..
6.3.m: proclaimed that festival, namely by the name of Padmaka: / “Today is the day of the Sun (Sunday) and also the fifteenth lunar day;

6.3.s:
tvāṣṭrameva ca nakṣatraṃ saṃkrāntirviṣuvantathā .
vyatīpātastathā yogaḥ karaṇaviṣṭireva ca .. 57.13 ..
6.3.d:
त्वाष्ट्रमेव च नक्षत्रं संक्रान्तिर्विषुवन्तथा .
व्यतीपातस्तथा योगः करणविष्टिरेव च .. 57.13 ..
6.3.m: the asterism is Tvāṣṭra (Citra), the transit is the equinox, / the astrological yoga is Vyatīpāta, and the astrological division is Viṣṭi.

6.3.s:
padmakaṃ nāma parvaitadayanādicaturguṇam .
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam .. 57.14 ..
6.3.d:
पद्मकं नाम पर्वैतदयनादिचतुर्गुणम् .
अत्र दत्तं हुतं जप्तं सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम् .. 57.14 ..
6.3.m: This festival named Padmaka bears fourfold the fruit of a solstice and the like; / whatever is given, offered in fire, or muttered here becomes imperishable.”

6.3.s:
te dvijā bhānumatyātha śūlabhedaṃ gatāḥ saha .
dadṛśuḥ śabaraṃ kuṇḍe bhāryayā saha saṃsthitam .. 57.15 ..
6.3.d:
ते द्विजा भानुमत्याथ शूलभेदं गताः सह .
ददृशुः शबरं कुण्डे भार्यया सह संस्थितम् .. 57.15 ..
6.3.m: Those twice-born, having then gone with Bhānumatī to Śūlabheda, / saw a hunter standing at the pool with his wife.

6.3.s:
aiśānīṃ sa diśaṃ gatvā parvate bhṛgumūrdhani .
patituṃ ca samārūḍho bhāryayā saha pārthiva .. 57.16 ..
6.3.d:
ऐशानीं स दिशं गत्वा पर्वते भृगुमूर्धनि .
पतितुं च समारूढो भार्यया सह पार्थिव .. 57.16 ..
6.3.m: Having gone towards the northeast direction, on the mountain, upon the precipice, / he had ascended together with his wife to jump down, O king.

6.3.s:
bhānumatyuvāca -
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahāsattva śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ mama .
kimarthaṃ tyajasi prāṇānadyāpi ca yuvā bhavān .. 57.17 ..
6.3.d:
भानुमत्युवाच -
तिष्ठ तिष्ठ महासत्त्व शृणुष्व वचनं मम .
किमर्थं त्यजसि प्राणानद्यापि च युवा भवान् .. 57.17 ..
6.3.m: Bhānumatī said: / “Stop, stop, O great-hearted one! Listen to my words. / For what reason are you giving up your life while you are still young?

6.3.s:
kaḥ santāpaḥ ka udvegaḥ kiṃ duḥkhaṃ vyādhireva ca .
śiśuḥ saṃdṛśyase'dyāpi kāraṇaṃ kathyatāmidam .. 57.18 ..
6.3.d:
कः सन्तापः क उद्वेगः किं दुःखं व्याधिरेव च .
शिशुः संदृश्यसेऽद्यापि कारणं कथ्यतामिदम् .. 57.18 ..
6.3.m: What anguish, what distress, what suffering or sickness do you have? / You still appear to be a child. Tell me this reason!”

6.3.s:
śabara uvāca -
kāraṇaṃ nāsti me kiṃcinna duḥkhaṃ kiṃcideva tu .
saṃsārabhayabhīto'haṃ nānyā buddhiḥ pravartate .. 57.19 ..
6.3.d:
शबर उवाच -
कारणं नास्ति मे किंचिन्न दुःखं किंचिदेव तु .
संसारभयभीतोऽहं नान्या बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते .. 57.19 ..
6.3.m: The hunter said: / “I have no reason at all, nor any suffering whatever; / I am terrified of the fear of worldly existence—no other thought moves me.

6.3.s:
duḥkhena labhyate yasmānmānuṣyaṃ janma bhāgyataḥ .
mānuṣyaṃ janma cāsādya yā na dharmaṃ samācaret .. 57.20 ..
6.3.d:
दुःखेन लभ्यते यस्मान्मानुष्यं जन्म भाग्यतः .
मानुष्यं जन्म चासाद्य या न धर्मं समाचरेत् .. 57.20 ..
6.3.m: Because human birth is obtained with difficulty, only by fortune, / and having attained human birth, one who does not practice dharma

6.3.s:
sa gacchennirayaṃ ghoramātmadoṣeṇa sundari .
tasmātpatitumicchāmi tīrthe'sminpāpanāśane .. 57.21 ..
6.3.d:
स गच्छेन्निरयं घोरमात्मदोषेण सुन्दरि .
तस्मात्पतितुमिच्छामि तीर्थेऽस्मिन्पापनाशने .. 57.21 ..
6.3.m: goes to terrible hell through his own fault, O beautiful lady. / Therefore I wish to fall at this sacred ford that destroys sin.”

6.3.s:
rājñyuvāca -
adyāpi vartate kālo dharmasyopārjane tava .
kṛtāpakṛtakarmā vai vratadānairviśudhyati .. 57.22 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्युवाच -
अद्यापि वर्तते कालो धर्मस्योपार्जने तव .
कृतापकृतकर्मा वै व्रतदानैर्विशुध्यति .. 57.22 ..
6.3.m: The queen said: / “Even now there is time for you to acquire dharma; / one who has committed bad deeds is indeed purified by vows and gifts.

6.3.s:
ahaṃ dāsyāmi dhānyaṃ vā vāsāṃsi draviṇaṃ bahu .
nityamācara dharmaṃ tvaṃ dhyāyannityaṃ maheśvaram .. 57.23 ..
6.3.d:
अहं दास्यामि धान्यं वा वासांसि द्रविणं बहु .
नित्यमाचर धर्मं त्वं ध्यायन्नित्यं महेश्वरम् .. 57.23 ..
6.3.m: I will give you grain, garments, or much wealth; / constantly practice dharma, meditating always on Maheśvara.”

6.3.s:
śabara uvāca -
naivāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na dhānyaṃ vastrameva ca .
yo yasyaivānnamaśnāti sa tasyāśnāti kilbiṣam .. 57.24 ..
6.3.d:
शबर उवाच -
नैवाहं कामये वित्तं न धान्यं वस्त्रमेव च .
यो यस्यैवान्नमश्नाति स तस्याश्नाति किल्बिषम् .. 57.24 ..
6.3.m: The hunter said: / “I do not desire wealth at all, nor grain, nor clothing; / whoever eats the food of anyone, eats that person's sin.”

6.3.s:
rājñyuvāca -
kandamūlaphalāhāro bhramitvā bhaikṣyamuttamam .
avagāhya sutīrthāni sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 57.25 ..
6.3.d:
राज्ञ्युवाच -
कन्दमूलफलाहारो भ्रमित्वा भैक्ष्यमुत्तमम् .
अवगाह्य सुतीर्थानि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 57.25 ..
6.3.m: The queen said: / “Living on roots, tubers, and fruits, or wandering for excellent alms, / and bathing in auspicious sacred fords, one is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tato vimuktapāpastu yatkiṃcitkurute śuciḥ .
karmaṇā tena pūtastvaṃ sadgatiṃ prāpsyasi dhruvam .. 57.26 ..
6.3.d:
ततो विमुक्तपापस्तु यत्किंचित्कुरुते शुचिः .
कर्मणा तेन पूतस्त्वं सद्गतिं प्राप्स्यसि ध्रुवम् .. 57.26 ..
6.3.m: Then, freed from sin and pure, whatever he performs— / purified by that action, you will surely attain the good state.”

6.3.s:
śabara uvāca -
annamadya mayā tyaktaṃ prāṇebhyo'pi mahattaram .
satyaṃ na lopayeddevi niścitātra matirmama .. 57.27 ..
6.3.d:
शबर उवाच -
अन्नमद्य मया त्यक्तं प्राणेभ्योऽपि महत्तरम् .
सत्यं न लोपयेद्देवि निश्चितात्र मतिर्मम .. 57.27 ..
6.3.m: The hunter said: / “Today food, which is dearer even than life, has been abandoned by me; / O queen, truth should not be violated: my mind is resolved on this.

6.3.s:
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ devi kṣamasvādya janaiḥ saha .
ardhottarīyavastreṇa saṃyamyātmānamudyataḥ .. 57.28 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसादः क्रियतां देवि क्षमस्वाद्य जनैः सह .
अर्धोत्तरीयवस्त्रेण संयम्यात्मानमुद्यतः .. 57.28 ..
6.3.m: Show your favor, O queen; forgive me today together with your people.” / Fastening himself firmly with half of his upper garment, he prepared.

6.3.s:
bhāryayā sahito vyādho hariṃ dhyātvā papāta ha .
nagārdhātpatito yāvadgatajīvo narādhipa .. 57.29 ..
6.3.d:
भार्यया सहितो व्याधो हरिं ध्यात्वा पपात ह .
नगार्धात्पतितो यावद्गतजीवो नराधिप .. 57.29 ..
6.3.m: Together with his wife, the hunter, meditating upon Hari, jumped down; / no sooner had he fallen halfway down the mountain than life departed, O lord of men.

6.3.s:
cūrṇībhūtau hi tau dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasyopari bhūmipa .
trimuhūrte gate kāle śabaro bhāryayā saha .. 57.30 ..
6.3.d:
चूर्णीभूतौ हि तौ दृष्ट्वा कुण्डस्योपरि भूमिप .
त्रिमुहूर्ते गते काले शबरो भार्यया सह .. 57.30 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the two crushed upon the pool, O king, / when a period of three muhūrtas had passed, the hunter together with his wife,

6.3.s:
divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho gataścānuttamāṃ gatim .. 57.31 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vyādhasvargagamanavarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 58
6.3.d:
दिव्यं विमानमारूढो गतश्चानुत्तमां गतिम् .. 57.31 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे व्याधस्वर्गगमनवर्णनं नाम सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 58
6.3.m:
mounting a celestial aerial chariot, went to the highest state.
Thus ends the fifty-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Hunter's Ascent to Heaven,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 58

6.3.s:
uttānapāda uvāca -
athāto devadeveśa bhānumatyakarocca kim .
eṣa me saṃśayo deva kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 58.1 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तानपाद उवाच -
अथातो देवदेवेश भानुमत्यकरोच्च किम् .
एष मे संशयो देव कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 58.1 ..
6.3.m: Uttānapāda said: / “Now then, O Lord of the gods of gods, what did Bhānumatī do? / This is my doubt, O God; speak out of your grace.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ sā gatā kuṇḍasya sannidhau .
dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍasya māhātmyaṃ rājñī harṣeṇa pūritā .. 58.2 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं सा गता कुण्डस्य सन्निधौ .
दृष्ट्वा कुण्डस्य माहात्म्यं राज्ञी हर्षेण पूरिता .. 58.2 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “Having reflected for a muhūrta, she went near the pool; / seeing the māhātmya of the pool, the queen was filled with joy.

6.3.s:
viprān bahūn samāhūya pūjayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt .
dattvā tu vidhivaddānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nṛpātmaja .. 58.3 ..
6.3.d:
विप्रान् बहून् समाहूय पूजयामास तत्क्षणात् .
दत्त्वा तु विधिवद्दानं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नृपात्मज .. 58.3 ..
6.3.m: Having summoned many brahmins, she worshipped them at that very moment; / having given gifts in accordance with the rules to the brahmins, O prince,

6.3.s:
niścayaṃ paramaṃ kṛtvā sthitā śāntena cetasā .
tataḥ sampūjya vidhivatpitṝndevānnarādhipa .. 58.4 ..
6.3.d:
निश्चयं परमं कृत्वा स्थिता शान्तेन चेतसा .
ततः सम्पूज्य विधिवत्पितॄन्देवान्नराधिप .. 58.4 ..
6.3.m: and making a supreme resolution, she remained with a tranquil mind. / Then, having duly worshipped the ancestors and the gods, O king,

6.3.s:
kṣapayitvā pakṣamekaṃ madhumāsasya sā sthitā .
amāvāsyāṃ tato rājñī gatā parvatasannidhau .. 58.5 ..
6.3.d:
क्षपयित्वा पक्षमेकं मधुमासस्य सा स्थिता .
अमावास्यां ततो राज्ञी गता पर्वतसन्निधौ .. 58.5 ..
6.3.m: and spending one fortnight of the spring month, she remained. / Then on the new-moon day the queen went near the mountain.

6.3.s:
nagaśṛṅgaṃ samāruhya kṛtvā mukulitau karau .
vijñāpya brāhmaṇān sarvānidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 58.6 ..
6.3.d:
नगशृङ्गं समारुह्य कृत्वा मुकुलितौ करौ .
विज्ञाप्य ब्राह्मणान् सर्वानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 58.6 ..
6.3.m: Ascending the peak of the mountain, joining her hands in reverence, / she addressed all the brahmins and spoke these words:

6.3.s:
mama mātā pitā bhrātā ye cānye sakhibāndhavāḥ .
kṣamāpayitvā sarvāṃstānvacanaṃ mama kathyatām .. 58.7 ..
6.3.d:
मम माता पिता भ्राता ये चान्ये सखिबान्धवाः .
क्षमापयित्वा सर्वांस्तान्वचनं मम कथ्यताम् .. 58.7 ..
6.3.m: ‘My mother, father, brother, and whoever else are friends and kinsmen— / asking forgiveness from all of them, let my message be told:

6.3.s:
tvatputrī śūlabhede tu tapaḥ kṛtvā svaśaktitaḥ .
visṛjya caiva sātmānaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe divaṃ yayau .. 58.8 ..
6.3.d:
त्वत्पुत्री शूलभेदे तु तपः कृत्वा स्वशक्तितः .
विसृज्य चैव सात्मानं तस्मिंस्तीर्थे दिवं ययौ .. 58.8 ..
6.3.m: “Your daughter, having performed austerity at Śūlabheda according to her power, / and casting off herself, went to heaven at that sacred ford.”’

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .
saṃdeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmastvayoktaṃ śobhanavrate .
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ suśroṇi mā te'bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ .. 58.9 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .
संदेशं कथयिष्यामस्त्वयोक्तं शोभनव्रते .
मातापितृभ्यां सुश्रोणि मा तेऽभूदत्र संशयः .. 58.9 ..
6.3.m: The brahmins said: / ‘We will deliver the message spoken by you, O woman of virtuous vows, / to your mother and father, O fair-hipped lady; let there be no doubt of yours in this regard.’

6.3.s:
tato visṛjya tāṃllokān sthitā parvatamūrdhani .
ardhottarīyavastreṇa gāḍhaṃ baddhā punaḥpunaḥ .. 58.10 ..
6.3.d:
ततो विसृज्य तांल्लोकान् स्थिता पर्वतमूर्धनि .
अर्धोत्तरीयवस्त्रेण गाढं बद्धा पुनःपुनः .. 58.10 ..
6.3.m: Then, dismissing those people, she stood on top of the mountain, / tying herself tightly again and again with half of her upper garment.

6.3.s:
tataścikṣepa sātmānamekacittā narādhipa .
nagārddhe patitā yāvattāvaddṛṣṭāḥ surāṅganāḥ .. 58.11 ..
6.3.d:
ततश्चिक्षेप सात्मानमेकचित्ता नराधिप .
नगार्द्धे पतिता यावत्तावद्दृष्टाः सुराङ्गनाः .. 58.11 ..
6.3.m: Then with single-minded focus she threw herself down, O lord of men; / no sooner had she fallen halfway down the mountain than celestial women were seen:

6.3.s:
bhobho vatse mahābhāge bhānumatyatitāpasi .
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya kailāsaṃ prati gamyatām .. 58.12 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो वत्से महाभागे भानुमत्यतितापसि .
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य कैलासं प्रति गम्यताम् .. 58.12 ..
6.3.m: ‘O child, highly fortunate Bhānumatī, eminent in austerity! / Mounting a celestial aerial chariot, proceed towards Kailāsa!’

6.3.s: tataḥ sā paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ janānāṃ tridivaṃ gatā .. 58.13 ..
6.3.d: ततः सा पश्यतां तेषां जनानां त्रिदिवं गता .. 58.13 ..
6.3.m: Then, as those people watched, she went to heaven.”

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
iti te kathitaḥ sarvaḥ śūlabhedasya vistaraḥ .
yaḥ śrutaḥ śaṅkarātpūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame .. 58.14 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
इति ते कथितः सर्वः शूलभेदस्य विस्तरः .
यः श्रुतः शङ्करात्पूर्वमृषिदेवसमागमे .. 58.14 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / “Thus the entire account of Śūlabheda has been told to you, / which was heard previously from Śaṅkara at the gathering of seers and gods.

6.3.s:
ya idaṃ paṭhate bhaktyā tīrthe devakule'pi vā .
sa mucyate mahāpāpādapi janmaśatārjitāt .. 58.15 ..
6.3.d:
य इदं पठते भक्त्या तीर्थे देवकुलेऽपि वा .
स मुच्यते महापापादपि जन्मशतार्जितात् .. 58.15 ..
6.3.m: Whoever recites this with devotion at a sacred ford or in a temple / is freed from great sin, even if earned in a hundred births.

6.3.s:
brahmahā ca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ .
goghātī strīvighātī ca devabrahmasvahārakaḥ .. 58.16 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महा च सुरापी च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः .
गोघाती स्त्रीविघाती च देवब्रह्मस्वहारकः .. 58.16 ..
6.3.m: The killer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, the thief, the violator of the Guru's bed, / the cow-killer, the killer of a woman, the stealer of property belonging to the gods or brahmins,

6.3.s:
svāmidrohī mitraghātī tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ .
paranyāsāpahārī ca paranikṣepalopakaḥ .. 58.17 ..
6.3.d:
स्वामिद्रोही मित्रघाती तथा विश्वासघातकः .
परन्यासापहारी च परनिक्षेपलोपकः .. 58.17 ..
6.3.m: the betrayer of a master, the killer of a friend, and likewise the violator of trust, / the stealer of another's trust-deposit, the violator of another's bailment,

6.3.s:
rasabhedī tulābhedī tathā vārddhuṣikastu yaḥ .
yaḥ kanyāvighnakartā ca tathā vikrayakārakaḥ .. 58.18 ..
6.3.d:
रसभेदी तुलाभेदी तथा वार्द्धुषिकस्तु यः .
यः कन्याविघ्नकर्ता च तथा विक्रयकारकः .. 58.18 ..
6.3.m: the adulterator of liquids, the tamperer with scales, and the usurer, / one who causes obstacles to a maiden, and likewise one who sells [her],

6.3.s:
parabhāryā bhrātṛbhāryā gauḥ snuṣā kanyakā tathā .
abhigāmī paradveṣī tathā dharmapradūṣakaḥ .. 58.19 ..
6.3.d:
परभार्या भ्रातृभार्या गौः स्नुषा कन्यका तथा .
अभिगामी परद्वेषी तथा धर्मप्रदूषकः .. 58.19 ..
6.3.m: one who has intercourse with another's wife, a brother's wife, a cow, a daughter-in-law, or an unmarried girl, / one who hates others, and likewise one who corrupts dharma—

6.3.s: mucyante sarve evaite śūlabhedaprabhāvataḥ .. 58.20 ..
6.3.d: मुच्यन्ते सर्वे एवैते शूलभेदप्रभावतः .. 58.20 ..
6.3.m: all of these indeed are liberated through the power of Śūlabheda.

6.3.s:
ya idaṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ nṛpa .
mudaṃ prayānti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pitarastasya sarvaśaḥ .. 58.21 ..
6.3.d:
य इदं श्रावयेच्छ्राद्धे विप्राणां भुञ्जतां नृप .
मुदं प्रयान्ति संहृष्टाः पितरस्तस्य सर्वशः .. 58.21 ..
6.3.m: Whoever causes this to be heard at a śrāddha while brahmins are dining, O king, / his ancestors, exceedingly delighted, attain joy in every way.”

6.3.s:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā paṭhyamānaṃ naro vaśī .
sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhāgbhavet .. 58.22 ..
6.3.d:
यश्चेदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या पठ्यमानं नरो वशी .
स मुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः सर्वकल्याणभाग्भवेत् .. 58.22 ..
6.3.m: And whatever self-controlled man should hear this recited with devotion / is freed from all sins and becomes an heir to every blessing.

6.3.s:
idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyamidaṃ pāvanamuttamam .
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇāmāyuḥkīrtivivardhanam .. 58.23 ..
6.3.d:
इदं यशस्यमायुष्यमिदं पावनमुत्तमम् .
पठतां शृण्वतां नृणामायुःकीर्तिविवर्धनम् .. 58.23 ..
6.3.m: This brings renown and long life; this is supreme purification, / increasing the lifespan and glory of people who read and hear it.

6.3.s:
iti kathitamidaṃ te śūlabhedasya puṇyaṃ mahimana hi manuṣyaiḥ śrūyate yatsapāpaiḥ .
madanariputaṭinyā yāmyakūlasthitasya prabaladuritakandocchedakuddālakalpam .. 58.24 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūlabhedatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ..
śūlabhedamāhātmyaṃ samāptam
adhyāya 59
6.3.d:
इति कथितमिदं ते शूलभेदस्य पुण्यं महिमन हि मनुष्यैः श्रूयते यत्सपापैः .
मदनरिपुतटिन्या याम्यकूलस्थितस्य प्रबलदुरितकन्दोच्छेदकुद्दालकल्पम् .. 58.24 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलभेदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः..
शूलभेदमाहात्म्यं समाप्तम्
अध्याय 59
6.3.m:
Thus has been declared to you the merit of Śūlabheda, its greatness never heard by sinful men, / situated on the southern bank of the river of the enemy of Madana, like a spade to eradicate the root of powerful evils.
Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter, named 'The Description of the Greatness of the Śūlabheda Sacred Ford', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
The greatness of Śūlabheda is completed.
Chapter 59

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśinīm .
śrute yasyāḥ prabhāve tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 59.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः पुष्करिणीं गच्छेत्सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् .
श्रुते यस्याः प्रभावे तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 59.1 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to Puṣkariṇī, which destroys all sins, / by merely hearing whose efficacy one is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
yatrāste sarvadā devo vedamūrtirdivākaraḥ .. 59.2 ..
6.3.d:
रेवाया उत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
यत्रास्ते सर्वदा देवो वेदमूर्तिर्दिवाकरः .. 59.2 ..
6.3.m: On the northern bank of the Revā is an exceedingly splendid sacred ford, / where the sun god, the embodiment of the Vedas, dwells forever.

6.3.s:
kurukṣetraṃ yathā puṇyaṃ sārvakāmikamuttamam .
idaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 59.3 ..
6.3.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं यथा पुण्यं सार्वकामिकमुत्तमम् .
इदं तीर्थं तथा पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 59.3 ..
6.3.m: Just as Kurukṣetra is sacred, supreme, and granting all desires, / so is this sacred ford holy, granting the fruit of every wish.

6.3.s:
kurukṣetre yathā vṛddhirdānasya jagatīpate .
puṣkariṇyāṃ tathā dānaṃ vardhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 59.4 ..
6.3.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रे यथा वृद्धिर्दानस्य जगतीपते .
पुष्करिण्यां तथा दानं वर्धते नात्र संशयः .. 59.4 ..
6.3.m: Just as a gift increases at Kurukṣetra, O lord of the earth, / so does a gift multiply at Puṣkariṇī; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
yavamekaṃ tu yo dadyātsauvarṇaṃ mastake nṛpa .
puṣkariṇyāṃ tathā sthānaṃ yathā sthānaṃ nare smṛtam .. 59.5 ..
6.3.d:
यवमेकं तु यो दद्यात्सौवर्णं मस्तके नृप .
पुष्करिण्यां तथा स्थानं यथा स्थानं नरे स्मृतम् .. 59.5 ..
6.3.m: Whatever person gives a single barley-corn of gold upon his head, O king, / at Puṣkariṇī, thus is remembered a dwelling for that man.

6.3.s:
sūryagrahe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyāddānaṃ yathāvidhi .
hastyaśvaratharatnādi gṛhaṃ gāśca yugaṃdharān .. 59.6 ..
6.3.d:
सूर्यग्रहे तु यः स्नात्वा दद्याद्दानं यथाविधि .
हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नादि गृहं गाश्च युगंधरान् .. 59.6 ..
6.3.m: He who, having bathed during a solar eclipse, gives a gift according to the rules— / elephants, horses, chariots, jewels and the like, a house, cattle, and beasts of burden,

6.3.s:
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ .
trayodaśa dinaṃ yāvattrayodaśaguṇaṃ bhavet .. 59.7 ..
6.3.d:
सुवर्णं रजतं वापि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददाति यः .
त्रयोदश दिनं यावत्त्रयोदशगुणं भवेत् .. 59.7 ..
6.3.m: or who gives gold or silver to brahmins, / for thirteen days it bears thirteen-fold fruit.

6.3.s:
tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
dvādaśābde bhavetprītistatra tīrthe mahīpate .. 59.8 ..
6.3.d:
तिलमिश्रेण तोयेन तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
द्वादशाब्दे भवेत्प्रीतिस्तत्र तीर्थे महीपते .. 59.8 ..
6.3.m: One should gratify the ancestors and deities with water mixed with sesame seeds; / the satisfaction [of the ancestors] lasts for twelve years at that sacred ford, O king.

6.3.s:
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ pāyasairmadhusarpiṣā .
śrāddhado labhate svargaṃ pitḥṇāṃ dattamakṣayam .. 59.9 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं पायसैर्मधुसर्पिषा .
श्राद्धदो लभते स्वर्गं पित्ःणां दत्तमक्षयम् .. 59.9 ..
6.3.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there with milk rice, honey, and clarified butter, / the performer of the śrāddha attains heaven, and what was given to the ancestors becomes inexhaustible.

6.3.s:
akṣatairbadarairbilvairiṅgudairvā tilaiḥ saha .
akṣayaṃ phalamāpnoti tasmiṃstīrthe na saṃśayaḥ .. 59.10 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षतैर्बदरैर्बिल्वैरिङ्गुदैर्वा तिलैः सह .
अक्षयं फलमाप्नोति तस्मिंस्तीर्थे न संशयः .. 59.10 ..
6.3.m: With unhusked grains, jujube fruits, bilva fruits, or ingudas along with sesame seeds, / one obtains imperishable fruit at that sacred ford, without doubt.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā tu yo devaṃ pūjayecca divākaram .
ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā punarādityamarcayet .
sa gacchetparamaṃ lokaṃ tridaśairapi vanditam .. 59.11 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा तु यो देवं पूजयेच्च दिवाकरम् .
आदित्यहृदयं जप्त्वा पुनरादित्यमर्चयेत् .
स गच्छेत्परमं लोकं त्रिदशैरपि वन्दितम् .. 59.11 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there, whoever worships the sun god, / having recited the Ādityahṛdaya and worshipped the sun once more, / goes to the supreme world praised even by the gods.

6.3.s:
ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu yajurvā sāma eva ca .
sa samagrasya vedasya phalamāpnoti vai nṛpa .. 59.12 ..
6.3.d:
ऋचमेकां जपेद्यस्तु यजुर्वा साम एव च .
स समग्रस्य वेदस्य फलमाप्नोति वै नृप .. 59.12 ..
6.3.m: Whoever recites a single ṛc, yajus, or sāman verse, / he obtains the fruit of the entire Veda, O king.

6.3.s:
yastryakṣaraṃ japenmantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram .
ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 59.13 ..
6.3.d:
यस्त्र्यक्षरं जपेन्मन्त्रं ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम् .
आदित्यहृदयं जप्त्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 59.13 ..
6.3.m: Whoever recites the three-syllable mantra, meditating on the sun, / having recited the Ādityahṛdaya, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
yastatra vidhivatprāṇāṃstyajate nṛpasattama .
sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ .. 59.14 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe puṣkariṇyāmādityatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
यस्तत्र विधिवत्प्राणांस्त्यजते नृपसत्तम .
स गच्छेत्परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः .. 59.14 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पुष्करिण्यामादित्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whoever gives up his life-breaths there according to the rules, O best of kings, / goes to that supreme realm where the sun god dwells.
Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter, named 'The Description of the Greatness of the Āditya Sacred Ford at Puṣkariṇī', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhūyo'pyahaṃ pravakṣyāmi ādityeśvaramuttamam .
sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ pārtha sarvavighnavināśanam .. 60.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भूयोऽप्यहं प्रवक्ष्यामि आदित्येश्वरमुत्तमम् .
सर्वदुःखहरं पार्थ सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् .. 60.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Again I shall speak of the supreme Ādityeśvara, / which removes all sorrow, O son of Pṛthā, and destroys all obstacles,

6.3.s:
āyuḥśrīvarddhanaṃ nityaṃ putradaṃ svargadaṃ śivam .
yasya tīrthasya cānyāni tīrthāni kurunandana .. 60.2 ..
6.3.d:
आयुःश्रीवर्द्धनं नित्यं पुत्रदं स्वर्गदं शिवम् .
यस्य तीर्थस्य चान्यानि तीर्थानि कुरुनन्दन .. 60.2 ..
6.3.m: ever increasing lifespan and prosperity, bestowing sons, bestowing heaven, and auspicious. / Other sacred fords, O delight of the Kurus,

6.3.s:
nālabhanta śriyaṃ nāke martye pātālagocare .
kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṅgā naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā .. 60.3 ..
6.3.d:
नालभन्त श्रियं नाके मर्त्ये पातालगोचरे .
कुरुक्षेत्रं गया गङ्गा नैमिषं पुष्करं तथा .. 60.3 ..
6.3.m: could not attain its glory in heaven, in the mortal world, or in the sphere of Pātāla: / Kurukṣetra, Gayā, the Gaṅgā, Naimiṣa, and Puṣkara,

6.3.s:
vārāṇasī ca kedāraṃ prayāgaṃ rudranandanam .
mahākālaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ śuklatīrthaṃ nṛpottama .. 60.4 ..
6.3.d:
वाराणसी च केदारं प्रयागं रुद्रनन्दनम् .
महाकालं सहस्राक्षं शुक्लतीर्थं नृपोत्तम .. 60.4 ..
6.3.m: Vārāṇasī, Kedāra, Prayāga, Rudranandana, / Mahākāla, Sahasrākṣa, and Śuklatīrtha, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
ravitīrthasya sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .
ravitīrthe hi yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama .. 60.5 ..
6.3.d:
रवितीर्थस्य सर्वाणि कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .
रवितीर्थे हि यद्वृत्तं तच्छृणुष्व नृपोत्तम .. 60.5 ..
6.3.m: All of them are not worth a sixteenth part of Ravi Tīrtha. / Hear now what took place at Ravi Tīrtha, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
snehātte kathayiṣyāmi vārddhakenātipīḍitaḥ .
śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve taponiṣṭhā mahaujasaḥ .. 60.6 ..
6.3.d:
स्नेहात्ते कथयिष्यामि वार्द्धकेनातिपीडितः .
शृण्वन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे तपोनिष्ठा महौजसः .. 60.6 ..
6.3.m: Out of affection I will tell you, although very afflicted by old age. / Let all the seers hear, who are steadfast in austerity and of great splendour.

6.3.s:
śrutaṃ me rudrasāṃnidhye nandiskandagaṇaiḥ saha .
pārvatyā pṛṣṭaḥ śambhuśca ravitīrthasya yatphalam .. 60.7 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुतं मे रुद्रसांनिध्ये नन्दिस्कन्दगणैः सह .
पार्वत्या पृष्टः शम्भुश्च रवितीर्थस्य यत्फलम् .. 60.7 ..
6.3.m: It was heard by me in the presence of Rudra, together with Nandi, Skanda, and the attendants, / when Śambhu was asked by Pārvatī about the fruit of Ravi Tīrtha.

6.3.s:
śambhunā ca yadākhyātaṃ girijāyāḥ sasambhramam .
tatsarvamekacittena rudrodgītaṃ śrutaṃ mayā .. 60.8 ..
6.3.d:
शम्भुना च यदाख्यातं गिरिजायाः ससम्भ्रमम् .
तत्सर्वमेकचित्तेन रुद्रोद्गीतं श्रुतं मया .. 60.8 ..
6.3.m: And what was related by Śambhu to Girijā with great excitement, / all of that, sung aloud by Rudra, was heard by me with a single-minded heart.

6.3.s:
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇu yatnena pāṇḍava .
durbhikṣopahatā viprā narmadāṃ tu samāśritāḥ .. 60.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु यत्नेन पाण्डव .
दुर्भिक्षोपहता विप्रा नर्मदां तु समाश्रिताः .. 60.9 ..
6.3.m: I shall tell you that; listen attentively, O Pāṇḍava. / Afflicted by famine, brahmins took refuge at the Narmadā:

6.3.s:
uddālako vaśiṣṭhaśca māṇḍavyo gautamastathā .
yājñavalkyo'tha gargaśca śāṇḍilyo gālavastathā .. 60.10 ..
6.3.d:
उद्दालको वशिष्ठश्च माण्डव्यो गौतमस्तथा .
याज्ञवल्क्योऽथ गर्गश्च शाण्डिल्यो गालवस्तथा .. 60.10 ..
6.3.m: Uddālaka, Vasiṣṭha, Māṇḍavya, Gautama, / Yājñavalkya, Garga, Śāṇḍilya, Gālava,

6.3.s:
nāciketo vibhāṇḍaśca vālakhilyādayastathā .
śātātapaśca śaṅkhaśca jaiminirgobhilastathā .. 60.11 ..
6.3.d:
