नाचिकेतो विभाण्डश्च वालखिल्यादयस्तथा .
शातातपश्च शङ्खश्च जैमिनिर्गोभिलस्तथा .. 60.11 ..
6.3.m: Nāciketa, Vibhāṇḍaka, the Vālakhilyas and others, / Śātātapa, Śaṅkha, Jaimini, Gobhila,

6.3.s:
jaigīṣavyaḥ śatānīkaḥ sarva eva samāgatāḥ .
tīrthayātrā kṛtā taistu narmadāyāḥ samantataḥ .. 60.12 ..
6.3.d:
जैगीषव्यः शतानीकः सर्व एव समागताः .
तीर्थयात्रा कृता तैस्तु नर्मदायाः समन्ततः .. 60.12 ..
6.3.m: Jaigīṣavya, and Śatānīka—all of them gathered together. / They undertook a pilgrimage to the sacred fords all around the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
ādityeśvaramāyātāḥ prasaṅgādṛṣipuṃgavāḥ .
vṛkṣaiḥ saṃchāditaṃ śubhraṃ dhavatindukapāṭalaiḥ .. 60.13 ..
6.3.d:
आदित्येश्वरमायाताः प्रसङ्गादृषिपुंगवाः .
वृक्षैः संछादितं शुभ्रं धवतिन्दुकपाटलैः .. 60.13 ..
6.3.m: In the course of their journey, those eminent seers came to Ādityeśvara, / which was bright and covered with trees—dhava, tinduka, and pāṭala,

6.3.s:
jambīrairarjunaiḥ kubjaiḥ śamīkesarakiṃśukaiḥ .
tasmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye sugandhikusumākule .. 60.14 ..
6.3.d:
जम्बीरैरर्जुनैः कुब्जैः शमीकेसरकिंशुकैः .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महापुण्ये सुगन्धिकुसुमाकुले .. 60.14 ..
6.3.m: jambīra, arjuna, kubja, śamī, kesara, and kiṃśuka— / at that exceedingly holy sacred ford, crowded with fragrant flowers,

6.3.s:
punnāganālikeraiśca khadiraiḥ kalpapādapaiḥ .
anekaśvāpadākīrṇaṃ mṛgamārjārasaṃkulam .. 60.15 ..
6.3.d:
पुन्नागनालिकेरैश्च खदिरैः कल्पपादपैः .
अनेकश्वापदाकीर्णं मृगमार्जारसंकुलम् .. 60.15 ..
6.3.m: with punnāga, coconut palms, khadira, and wish-fulfilling trees, / teeming with numerous wild beasts, filled with deer and wild cats,

6.3.s:
ṛkṣahastisamākīrṇaṃ citrakaiścopaśobhitam .
praviṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve vane puṣpasamākule .. 60.16 ..
6.3.d:
ऋक्षहस्तिसमाकीर्णं चित्रकैश्चोपशोभितम् .
प्रविष्टा ऋषयः सर्वे वने पुष्पसमाकुले .. 60.16 ..
6.3.m: thronged with bears and elephants, and adorned with leopards. / All the seers entered that forest filled with flowers.

6.3.s:
vanānte ca striyo dṛṣṭvā raktā raktāmbarānvitāḥ .
raktamālyānuśobhāḍhyā raktacandanacarcitāḥ .. 60.17 ..
6.3.d:
वनान्ते च स्त्रियो दृष्ट्वा रक्ता रक्ताम्बरान्विताः .
रक्तमाल्यानुशोभाढ्या रक्तचन्दनचर्चिताः .. 60.17 ..
6.3.m: And at the edge of the forest, having seen women who were red, dressed in red garments, / richly adorned with red garlands, anointed with red sandalwood,

6.3.s:
raktābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ .
tāsāṃ samīpagā dṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇajīmūtasannibhāḥ .. 60.18 ..
6.3.d:
रक्ताभरणसंयुक्ताः पाशहस्ता भयावहाः .
तासां समीपगा दृष्टाः कृष्णजीमूतसन्निभाः .. 60.18 ..
6.3.m: bearing red ornaments, holding nooses in their hands, terrifying, / and near them were seen [beings] resembling dark clouds...

6.3.s:
mahākāyā bhīmavaktrāḥ pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ .
anāvṛṣṭyupamā dṛṣṭā āturāḥ piṅgalocanāḥ .. 60.19 ..
6.3.d:
महाकाया भीमवक्त्राः पाशहस्ता भयावहाः .
अनावृष्ट्युपमा दृष्टा आतुराः पिङ्गलोचनाः .. 60.19 ..
6.3.m: Huge of body, with terrifying faces, holding nooses in their hands, inspiring fear, / like a drought incarnate, distressed, with tawny eyes, were seen [there]. 60.19

6.3.s:
dīrghajihvā karālāsyā tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā durāsadā .
vṛddhā nārī kuruśreṣṭha dṛṣṭānyā ṛṣipuṃgavaiḥ .. 60.20 ..
6.3.d:
दीर्घजिह्वा करालास्या तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा दुरासदा .
वृद्धा नारी कुरुश्रेष्ठ दृष्टान्या ऋषिपुंगवैः .. 60.20 ..
6.3.m: Long-tongued, with dread-inspiring mouths, sharp fangs, difficult to approach, / an old woman, O best of the Kurus, was seen as well by the foremost seers. 60.20

6.3.s:
tataḥ samīpagā vṛddhā tasya vṛndasya bhārata .
svādhyāyaniratā viprā dṛṣṭāstaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ .. 60.21 ..
6.3.d:
ततः समीपगा वृद्धा तस्य वृन्दस्य भारत .
स्वाध्यायनिरता विप्रा दृष्टास्तैः पापकर्मभिः .. 60.21 ..
6.3.m: Then that old woman, having approached that company, O Bhārata— / the brahmins intent on their Vedic recitation were seen by those evil-doers. 60.21

6.3.s:
ūcuste tu samūhena brāhmaṇāṃstapasi sthitān .
asmākaṃ svāminaḥ sarve tiṣṭhante tīrthamadhyataḥ .
te prasthāpyā mahābhāgāḥ sarvathaiva tvarānvitāḥ .. 60.22 ..
6.3.d:
ऊचुस्ते तु समूहेन ब्राह्मणांस्तपसि स्थितान् .
अस्माकं स्वामिनः सर्वे तिष्ठन्ते तीर्थमध्यतः .
ते प्रस्थाप्या महाभागाः सर्वथैव त्वरान्विताः .. 60.22 ..
6.3.m: They in a group spoke to the brahmins engaged in austerity: / 'All of our masters are staying within the sacred ford. / Those highly fortunate ones must be dispatched at once with all haste.' 60.22

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ sarve caiva tvarānvitāḥ .
jagmuste narmadākakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā revāṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 60.23 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां सर्वे चैव त्वरान्विताः .
जग्मुस्ते नर्मदाकक्षं दृष्ट्वा रेवां द्विजोत्तमाः .. 60.23 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that speech of theirs, all with all haste, / the best of the twice-born went to the valley of the Narmadā, beholding the Revā. 60.23

6.3.s: tataḥ kecitstuvantyanye jaya devi namo'stu te .. 60.24 ..
6.3.d: ततः केचित्स्तुवन्त्यन्ये जय देवि नमोऽस्तु ते .. 60.24 ..
6.3.m: Then some praised [her], and others said: 'Hail, O Goddess! Homage be to you! 60.24

6.3.s:
namo'stu te siddhagaṇairniṣevite namo'stu te sarvapavitramaṅgale .
namo'stu te viprasahasrasevite namo'stu rudrāṅgasamudbhave vare .. 60.25 ..
6.3.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते सिद्धगणैर्निषेविते नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वपवित्रमङ्गले .
नमोऽस्तु ते विप्रसहस्रसेविते नमोऽस्तु रुद्राङ्गसमुद्भवे वरे .. 60.25 ..
6.3.m: Homage be to you who are served by hosts of siddhas; homage be to you who are all-holy and auspicious! / Homage be to you who are served by thousands of brahmins; homage be to you, the excellent one born from the body of Rudra! 60.25

6.3.s:
namo'stu te sarvapavitrapāvane namo'stu te devi varaprade śive .
namāmi te śītajale sukhaprade saridvare pāpahare vicitrite .. 60.26 ..
6.3.d:
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वपवित्रपावने नमोऽस्तु ते देवि वरप्रदे शिवे .
नमामि ते शीतजले सुखप्रदे सरिद्वरे पापहरे विचित्रिते .. 60.26 ..
6.3.m: Homage be to you, the purifier of all pure things; homage be to you, O Goddess, giver of boons, auspicious one! / I bow to you of cool waters, giver of happiness, foremost of rivers, remover of sins, variegated one! 60.26

6.3.s:
anekabhūtaughasusevitāṅge gandharvayakṣoragapāvitāṅge .
mahāgajaughairmahiṣairvarāhairāpīyase toyamahormimāle .. 60.27 ..
6.3.d:
अनेकभूतौघसुसेविताङ्गे गन्धर्वयक्षोरगपाविताङ्गे .
महागजौघैर्महिषैर्वराहैरापीयसे तोयमहोर्मिमाले .. 60.27 ..
6.3.m: You whose body is well attended by hosts of diverse beings, whose body is purified by gandharvas, yakṣas, and serpents! / You are drunk by multitudes of great elephants, buffaloes, and boars, O garland of great watery billows! 60.27

6.3.s: namāmi te sarvavare sukhaprade vimocayāsmānaghapāśabaddhān .. 60.28 ..
6.3.d: नमामि ते सर्ववरे सुखप्रदे विमोचयास्मानघपाशबद्धान् .. 60.28 ..
6.3.m: I bow to you, the best of all, giver of joy; release us who are bound by the noose of sin! 60.28

6.3.s:
bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyā yāvattavāmbho nahi saṃśrayanti .
spṛṣṭaṃ karaiścandramaso raveścettaddevi dadyātparamaṃ padaṃ tu .. 60.29 ..
6.3.d:
भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु मर्त्या यावत्तवाम्भो नहि संश्रयन्ति .
स्पृष्टं करैश्चन्द्रमसो रवेश्चेत्तद्देवि दद्यात्परमं पदं तु .. 60.29 ..
6.3.m: Mortals wander in hells only so long as they do not resort to your waters. / If touched by the rays of the moon and the sun, O Goddess, it grants the supreme state. 60.29

6.3.s:
anekasaṃsārabhayārditānāṃ pāpairanekairabhiveṣṭitānām .
gatistvamambhojasamānavaktre dvandvairanekairabhisaṃvṛtānām .. 60.30 ..
6.3.d:
अनेकसंसारभयार्दितानां पापैरनेकैरभिवेष्टितानाम् .
गतिस्त्वमम्भोजसमानवक्त्रे द्वन्द्वैरनेकैरभिसंवृतानाम् .. 60.30 ..
6.3.m: Of those afflicted by many fears of transmigration, wrapped around by many sins, / and surrounded by many pairs of opposites, you are the refuge, O lotus-faced one! 60.30

6.3.s:
nadyaśca pūtā vimalā bhavanti tvāṃ devi samprāpya na saṃśayo'tra .
duḥkhāturāṇāmabhayaṃ dadāsi śiṣṭairanekairabhipūjitāsi .. 60.31 ..
6.3.d:
नद्यश्च पूता विमला भवन्ति त्वां देवि सम्प्राप्य न संशयोऽत्र .
दुःखातुराणामभयं ददासि शिष्टैरनेकैरभिपूजितासि .. 60.31 ..
6.3.m: Rivers too become purified and spotless upon reaching you, O Goddess; of this there is no doubt. / You grant fearlessness to the grief-stricken; you are worshipped by many righteous persons. 60.31

6.3.s:
viṇmūtradehāśca nimagnadehā bhramanti tāvannarakeṣu martyāḥ .
mahābaladhvastataraṅgabhaṅgaṃ jalaṃ na yāvattava saṃspṛśanti .. 60.32 ..
6.3.d:
विण्मूत्रदेहाश्च निमग्नदेहा भ्रमन्ति तावन्नरकेषु मर्त्याः .
महाबलध्वस्ततरङ्गभङ्गं जलं न यावत्तव संस्पृशन्ति .. 60.32 ..
6.3.m: Mortals with bodies smeared with feces and urine, their bodies submerged, wander in hells / only so long as they do not touch your water, whose surging waves crash with great force. 60.32

6.3.s:
mlecchāḥ pulindāstvatha yātudhānāḥ pibanti ye'ṃbhastava devi puṇyam .
te'pi pramucyanti bhayācca ghorātkimatra viprā bhavapāśabhītāḥ .. 60.33 ..
6.3.d:
म्लेच्छाः पुलिन्दास्त्वथ यातुधानाः पिबन्ति येऽंभस्तव देवि पुण्यम् .
तेऽपि प्रमुच्यन्ति भयाच्च घोरात्किमत्र विप्रा भवपाशभीताः .. 60.33 ..
6.3.m: Even Mlecchas, Pulindas, and Yātudhānas who drink your holy water, O Goddess, / are freed from terrible fear; what then of brahmins afraid of the fetters of worldly existence? 60.33

6.3.s:
sarāṃsi nadyaḥ kṣayamabhyupetā ghore yuge'sminkalināvasṛṣṭe .
tvaṃ bhrājase devi jalaughapūrṇā divīva nakṣatrapathe ca gaṅgā .. 60.34 ..
6.3.d:
सरांसि नद्यः क्षयमभ्युपेता घोरे युगेऽस्मिन्कलिनावसृष्टे .
त्वं भ्राजसे देवि जलौघपूर्णा दिवीव नक्षत्रपथे च गङ्गा .. 60.34 ..
6.3.m: Lakes and rivers have met destruction in this terrible age brought forth by Kali, / but you shine, O Goddess, full of abundant waters, like the Gaṅgā in heaven along the path of constellations. 60.34

6.3.s:
tava prāsādādvarade viśiṣṭe kālaṃ yathemaṃ paripālayitvā .
yāsyāma mokṣaṃ tava suprasādādvayaṃ yathā tvaṃ kuru naḥ prasādam .. 60.35 ..
6.3.d:
तव प्रासादाद्वरदे विशिष्टे कालं यथेमं परिपालयित्वा .
यास्याम मोक्षं तव सुप्रसादाद्वयं यथा त्वं कुरु नः प्रसादम् .. 60.35 ..
6.3.m: By your grace, O distinguished granter of boons, having endured this time, / may we attain liberation through your gracious favor; do you bestow your favor upon us! 60.35

6.3.s:
tvāmāśritā ye śaraṇaṃ gatāśca gatistvamambeva piteva putrān .
tvatpālitā yāvadimaṃ sughoraṃ kālaṃ tvanāvṛṣṭihataṃ kṣipāmaḥ .. 60.36 ..
6.3.d:
त्वामाश्रिता ये शरणं गताश्च गतिस्त्वमम्बेव पितेव पुत्रान् .
त्वत्पालिता यावदिमं सुघोरं कालं त्वनावृष्टिहतं क्षिपामः .. 60.36 ..
6.3.m: For those who take refuge in you and have gone to you for shelter, you are the protector, like a mother or a father to their sons. / Protected by you, we shall endure this terrible time smitten by drought. 60.36

6.3.s:
evaṃ stutā tadā devī narmadā saritāṃ varā .
pratyakṣā sā parā mūrtirbrāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 60.37 ..
6.3.d:
एवं स्तुता तदा देवी नर्मदा सरितां वरा .
प्रत्यक्षा सा परा मूर्तिर्ब्राह्मणानां युधिष्ठिर .. 60.37 ..
6.3.m: Thus praised then was Goddess Narmadā, the foremost of rivers; / that supreme form became visible to the brahmins, O Yudhiṣṭhira. 60.37

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
paṭhanti ye stotramidaṃ narendra śṛṇvanti bhaktyā parayā praśāntāḥ .
te yānti rudraṃ vṛṣasaṃyutena yānena divyāmbarabhūṣitāṅgāḥ .. 60.38 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पठन्ति ये स्तोत्रमिदं नरेन्द्र शृण्वन्ति भक्त्या परया प्रशान्ताः .
ते यान्ति रुद्रं वृषसंयुतेन यानेन दिव्याम्बरभूषिताङ्गाः .. 60.38 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Those who recite this hymn, O lord of men, or hear it with supreme devotion, being tranquil, / go to Rudra in a vehicle accompanied by a bull, their bodies adorned with heavenly garments. 60.38

6.3.s:
ye stotrametatsatataṃ japanti snātvā ca toyena tu narmadāyāḥ .
tebhyo'ntakāle sariduttameyaṃ gatiṃ viśuddhāmacirāddadāti .. 60.39 ..
6.3.d:
ये स्तोत्रमेतत्सततं जपन्ति स्नात्वा च तोयेन तु नर्मदायाः .
तेभ्योऽन्तकाले सरिदुत्तमेयं गतिं विशुद्धामचिराद्ददाति .. 60.39 ..
6.3.m: Those who constantly chant this hymn having bathed in the water of the Narmadā— / to them at the time of death this best of rivers soon grants a pure destination. 60.39

6.3.s:
prātaḥ samutthāya tathā śayāno yaḥ kīrtayetānudinaṃ stavendram .
dehakṣayaṃ sve salile dadāti samāśrayaṃ tasya mahānubhāva .. 60.40 ..
6.3.d:
प्रातः समुत्थाय तथा शयानो यः कीर्तयेतानुदिनं स्तवेन्द्रम् .
देहक्षयं स्वे सलिले ददाति समाश्रयं तस्य महानुभाव .. 60.40 ..
6.3.m: Rising in the morning or lying down, whoever daily glorifies this king of hymns, / she grants the destruction of his body in her own waters and provides refuge to him, O noble one. 60.40

6.3.s: pāpairvimuktā divi modamānāḥ sambhoginaścaiva tu nānyathā ca .. 60.41 ..
6.3.d: पापैर्विमुक्ता दिवि मोदमानाः सम्भोगिनश्चैव तु नान्यथा च .. 60.41 ..
6.3.m: Freed from sins, rejoicing in heaven, they become enjoyers of pleasures, and not otherwise. 60.41

6.3.s:
prasannā narmadā devī stotreṇānena bhārata .
jalenāpyāyitān viprān dakṣiṇāpathavāhinī .. 60.42 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसन्ना नर्मदा देवी स्तोत्रेणानेन भारत .
जलेनाप्यायितान् विप्रान् दक्षिणापथवाहिनी .. 60.42 ..
6.3.m: Pleased by this hymn, Goddess Narmadā, O Bhārata, / who flows toward the southern region, [spoke] to the brahmins refreshed by her water: 60.42

6.3.s:
amṛtatvaṃ tu vo dadmi yogibhiryanna gamyate .
durlabhaṃ yatsuraiḥ sarvairmatprasādāllabhiṣyatha .. 60.43 ..
6.3.d:
अमृतत्वं तु वो दद्मि योगिभिर्यन्न गम्यते .
दुर्लभं यत्सुरैः सर्वैर्मत्प्रसादाल्लभिष्यथ .. 60.43 ..
6.3.m: 'I grant you immortality, which is not attained even by yogins / and is hard to attain for all the gods; you will attain it through my grace.' 60.43

6.3.s:
iti te brāhmaṇā rājaṃllabdhā varamanuttamam .
gamiṣyantaḥ prītacittā dadṛśuścitramadbhutam .. 60.44 ..
6.3.d:
इति ते ब्राह्मणा राजंल्लब्धा वरमनुत्तमम् .
गमिष्यन्तः प्रीतचित्ता ददृशुश्चित्रमद्भुतम् .. 60.44 ..
6.3.m: Having thus obtained the unexcelled boon, O king, those brahmins, / about to depart with pleased minds, beheld a wondrous marvel. 60.44

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
dṛṣṭāstaiḥ puruṣāḥ pārtha narmadātaṭasaṃsthitāḥ .
snānadevārcanāsaktāḥ pañca eva mahābalāḥ .. 60.45 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
दृष्टास्तैः पुरुषाः पार्थ नर्मदातटसंस्थिताः .
स्नानदेवार्चनासक्ताः पञ्च एव महाबलाः .. 60.45 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Men were seen by them, O son of Pṛthā, situated on the bank of the Narmadā, / intent upon bathing and deity worship—just five of them, endowed with great strength. 60.45

6.3.s:
te dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaiḥ sarvairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ .
saṃpṛṣṭāstairmahārāja yathā tadavadhāraya .. 60.46 ..
6.3.d:
ते दृष्टा ब्राह्मणैः सर्वैर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः .
संपृष्टास्तैर्महाराज यथा तदवधारय .. 60.46 ..
6.3.m: They were seen by all the brahmins who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas; / they were questioned by them, O great king. Listen to that as it happened: 60.46

6.3.s:
viprā ūcuḥ .
vanānte strīyugaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāraudraṃ bhayāvaham .
vṛddhāśca puruṣāstatra pāśahastā bhayāvahāḥ .. 60.47 ..
6.3.d:
विप्रा ऊचुः .
वनान्ते स्त्रीयुगं दृष्ट्वा महारौद्रं भयावहम् .
वृद्धाश्च पुरुषास्तत्र पाशहस्ता भयावहाः .. 60.47 ..
6.3.m: The brahmins said: / 'Having seen a pair of women at the edge of the forest, exceedingly terrible and fearful, / and old men there, holding nooses in their hands, inspiring fear, 60.47

6.3.s:
durdharṣā durnirīkṣyāśca itaścetaśca cañcalāḥ .
vyāharantaḥ śubhāṃ vācaṃ na tatra gatirasti vai .. 60.48 ..
6.3.d:
दुर्धर्षा दुर्निरीक्ष्याश्च इतश्चेतश्च चञ्चलाः .
व्याहरन्तः शुभां वाचं न तत्र गतिरस्ति वै .. 60.48 ..
6.3.m: unassailable, dreadful to look upon, wandering restlessly here and there, / uttering auspicious speech, indeed there is no passage there. 60.48

6.3.s:
aparasparayoḥ sarve nirīkṣantaḥ punaḥpunaḥ .
taistu yadvacanaṃ proktaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathyatāmiti .. 60.49 ..
6.3.d:
अपरस्परयोः सर्वे निरीक्षन्तः पुनःपुनः .
तैस्तु यद्वचनं प्रोक्तं तत्सर्वं कथ्यतामिति .. 60.49 ..
6.3.m: Looking at one another again and again, / let all that speech which was uttered by them be told: 60.49

6.3.s:
asmākaṃ puruṣāḥ pañca tiṣṭhanti tatra sattamāḥ .
te prasthāpyā mahābhāgāḥ sarvathaiva tvarānvitāḥ .. 60.50 ..
6.3.d:
अस्माकं पुरुषाः पञ्च तिष्ठन्ति तत्र सत्तमाः .
ते प्रस्थाप्या महाभागाः सर्वथैव त्वरान्विताः .. 60.50 ..
6.3.m: "Five men belonging to us are staying there, O good sirs; / those highly fortunate ones must be dispatched at once with all haste."' 60.50

6.3.s:
atha te puruṣāḥ pañca śrutvā vākyamidaṃ śubham .
parasparaṃ nirīkṣanto vadanti ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 60.51 ..
6.3.d:
अथ ते पुरुषाः पञ्च श्रुत्वा वाक्यमिदं शुभम् .
परस्परं निरीक्षन्तो वदन्ति च पुनःपुनः .. 60.51 ..
6.3.m: Then those five men, hearing this auspicious statement, / looking at one another, spoke again and again: 60.51

6.3.s: kva te kasya kuto yātāḥ kimuktaṃ tairbhayāvahaiḥ .. 60.52 ..
6.3.d: क्व ते कस्य कुतो याताः किमुक्तं तैर्भयावहैः .. 60.52 ..
6.3.m: 'Where are they? Whose are they? Whence have they come? What was spoken by those fearful beings?' 60.52

6.3.s:
puruṣā ūcuḥ .
tīrthāvagāhanaṃ sarvaiḥ pūrvadakṣiṇapaścimaiḥ .
uttaraiśca kṛtaṃ bhaktyā na pāpaṃ tairvyapohitam .. 60.53 ..
6.3.d:
पुरुषा ऊचुः .
तीर्थावगाहनं सर्वैः पूर्वदक्षिणपश्चिमैः .
उत्तरैश्च कृतं भक्त्या न पापं तैर्व्यपोहितम् .. 60.53 ..
6.3.m: The men said: / 'Immersion in sacred fords was performed with devotion by all of us in the east, south, west, / and north, yet the sin was not removed by them. 60.53

6.3.s:
niṣpāpāścātha saṃjātāstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .
śṛṇvantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve vahnikālopamā dvijāḥ .. 60.54 ..
6.3.d:
निष्पापाश्चाथ संजातास्तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .
शृण्वन्तु ऋषयः सर्वे वह्निकालोपमा द्विजाः .. 60.54 ..
6.3.m: And now we have become sinless through the power of this sacred ford. / Let all the seers hear, twice-born ones like fire and Time! 60.54

6.3.s:
pātakāni ca ghorāṇi yānyacintyāni dehinām .
pāpiṣṭhena tu caikena gurudārā niṣevitā .. 60.55 ..
6.3.d:
पातकानि च घोराणि यान्यचिन्त्यानि देहिनाम् .
पापिष्ठेन तु चैकेन गुरुदारा निषेविता .. 60.55 ..
6.3.m: Terrible sins that are unthinkable for embodied beings [were committed]: / by one most wicked person, the wife of his guru was enjoyed; 60.55

6.3.s:
hṛtaṃ cānyena mitrasvaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dhanaṃ tathā .
brahmahatyā mahāraudrā kṛtā cānyena pātakam .. 60.56 ..
6.3.d:
हृतं चान्येन मित्रस्वं सुवर्णं च धनं तथा .
ब्रह्महत्या महारौद्रा कृता चान्येन पातकम् .. 60.56 ..
6.3.m: by another, a friend's property was stolen, both gold and wealth; / by another was committed the sin of killing a brahmin, exceedingly terrible; 60.56

6.3.s:
surāpānaṃ tu cānyasya saṃjātaṃ cāpyakāmataḥ .
govadhyā cāpyakāmena kṛtā caikena pāpinā .. 60.57 ..
6.3.d:
सुरापानं तु चान्यस्य संजातं चाप्यकामतः .
गोवध्या चाप्यकामेन कृता चैकेन पापिना .. 60.57 ..
6.3.m: the drinking of liquor occurred unintentionally for another; / and the slaying of a cow was done unintentionally by one sinner.' 60.57

6.3.s:
akāmato'pi sarveṣāṃ pātakāni narādhipa .
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu te śrutvā vākyaṃ tadvismayānvitāḥ .. 60.58 ..
6.3.d:
अकामतोऽपि सर्वेषां पातकानि नराधिप .
ब्राह्मणानां तु ते श्रुत्वा वाक्यं तद्विस्मयान्विताः .. 60.58 ..
6.3.m: Even unintentional sins belonged to all of them, O king of men; / but hearing that speech of the brahmins, filled with wonder,

6.3.s:
sadya eva tadā jātāḥ pāpiṣṭhā gatakalmaṣāḥ .
tīrthasyāsya prabhāvena narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ .. 60.59 ..
6.3.d:
सद्य एव तदा जाताः पापिष्ठा गतकल्मषाः .
तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेन नर्मदायाः प्रभावतः .. 60.59 ..
6.3.m: instantly those most sinful men became free from taint, / through the power of this sacred ford, through the power of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
na kvacitpātakānāṃ tu praveśaścātra jāyate .
evaṃ saṃcitya te sarve pāpiṣṭhāśca parasparam .. 60.60 ..
6.3.d:
न क्वचित्पातकानां तु प्रवेशश्चात्र जायते .
एवं संचित्य ते सर्वे पापिष्ठाश्च परस्परम् .. 60.60 ..
6.3.m: "No entry of sins takes place here at all." / Having reflected thus among themselves, all those most sinful men,

6.3.s:
citrabhānuḥ smṛtastaistu vicintya hṛdaye harim .
snātvā revājale puṇye tarpitāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ .. 60.61 ..
6.3.d:
चित्रभानुः स्मृतस्तैस्तु विचिन्त्य हृदये हरिम् .
स्नात्वा रेवाजले पुण्ये तर्पिताः पितृदेवताः .. 60.61 ..
6.3.m: invoked the fire, meditating upon Hari in their hearts. / Having bathed in the sacred waters of the Revā, they offered libations to the ancestors and gods.

6.3.s:
natvā tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam .
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu taṃ bhaktyā jvalantaṃ jātavedasam .. 60.62 ..
6.3.d:
नत्वा तु भास्करं देवं हृदि ध्यात्वा जनार्दनम् .
प्रदक्षिणं तु तं भक्त्या ज्वलन्तं जातवेदसम् .. 60.62 ..
6.3.m: Bowing to the divine Sun, contemplating Janārdana in their hearts, / circumambulating that blazing fire with devotion,

6.3.s:
patitāḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha pāpodvignā mahīpate .
sāttvikīṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā rajastamastathā .. 60.63 ..
6.3.d:
पतिताः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ पापोद्विग्ना महीपते .
सात्त्विकीं वासनां कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा रजस्तमस्तथा .. 60.63 ..
6.3.m: they threw themselves into it, O best of Pāṇḍavas, distressed by sins, O king, / having cultivated a pure disposition and abandoned passion and darkness.

6.3.s:
hataṃ taiḥ pāvake sarvaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe .
vimānasthāstadā dṛṣṭā brāhmaṇaiste yudhiṣṭhira .. 60.64 ..
6.3.d:
हतं तैः पावके सर्वं रेवाया उत्तरे तटे .
विमानस्थास्तदा दृष्टा ब्राह्मणैस्ते युधिष्ठिर .. 60.64 ..
6.3.m: All was consumed by them in the fire on the northern bank of the Revā. / Then they were seen seated in aerial chariots by the brahmins, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
āścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭamṛṣibhirnarmadātaṭe .
tadāprabhṛti te sarve rāgadveṣavivarjitāḥ .. 60.65 ..
6.3.d:
आश्चर्यमतुलं दृष्टमृषिभिर्नर्मदातटे .
तदाप्रभृति ते सर्वे रागद्वेषविवर्जिताः .. 60.65 ..
6.3.m: An incomparable wonder was seen by the seers on the bank of the Narmadā. / From that time on, all those [brahmins], free from desire and hatred,

6.3.s:
ravitīrthaṃ dvijā hṛṣṭāḥ sevante mokṣakāṅkṣayā .
tīrthasyāsya ca yatpuṇyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 60.66 ..
6.3.d:
रवितीर्थं द्विजा हृष्टाः सेवन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षया .
तीर्थस्यास्य च यत्पुण्यं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .. 60.66 ..
6.3.m: delighted, resorted to Ravitīrtha with the desire for liberation. / Now listen to the merit of this sacred ford, O king of men.

6.3.s:
pīḍito vṛddhabhāvena bhaktyā prīto nareśvara .
uddeśaṃ kathayiṣyāmi dvikrośābhyantare sthitaḥ .. 60.67 ..
6.3.d:
पीडितो वृद्धभावेन भक्त्या प्रीतो नरेश्वर .
उद्देशं कथयिष्यामि द्विक्रोशाभ्यन्तरे स्थितः .. 60.67 ..
6.3.m: Afflicted by old age, yet pleased with devotion, O lord of men, / remaining within two krośas, I will declare its description.

6.3.s:
kurukṣetraṃ yathā puṇyaṃ ravitīrthaṃ śrutaṃ mayā .
īśvareṇa purā khyātaṃ ṣaṇmukhasya narādhipa .. 60.68 ..
6.3.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं यथा पुण्यं रवितीर्थं श्रुतं मया .
ईश्वरेण पुरा ख्यातं षण्मुखस्य नराधिप .. 60.68 ..
6.3.m: Just as Kurukṣetra is sacred, so Ravitīrtha was heard of by me; / it was declared anciently by Īśvara to the six-faced one, O king of men.

6.3.s:
śrutaṃ rudrācca taiḥ sarvairahaṃ tatra samīpagaḥ .
īśvara uvāca -
mārtaṇḍagrahaṇe prāpte ye vrajanti ṣaḍānana .
ravitīrthe kurukṣetre tulyametatphalaṃ labhet .. 60.69 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुतं रुद्राच्च तैः सर्वैरहं तत्र समीपगः .
ईश्वर उवाच -
मार्तण्डग्रहणे प्राप्ते ये व्रजन्ति षडानन .
रवितीर्थे कुरुक्षेत्रे तुल्यमेतत्फलं लभेत् .. 60.69 ..
6.3.m: It was heard from Rudra by all of them; I was near there. / Īśvara said: / When a solar eclipse occurs, those who go, O six-faced one, / to Ravitīrtha, obtain a fruit equal to that of Kurukṣetra.

6.3.s:
snāne dāne tathā japye home caiva viśeṣataḥ .
kurukṣetre samaṃ puṇyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 60.70 ..
6.3.d:
स्नाने दाने तथा जप्ये होमे चैव विशेषतः .
कुरुक्षेत्रे समं पुण्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 60.70 ..
6.3.m: In ritual ablution, in gifting, and in silent recitation and oblations especially, / the merit is equal to Kurukṣetra; no doubt should be entertained here.

6.3.s:
grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā .
ravitīrthe viśeṣeṇa revā puṇyaphalapradā .. 60.71 ..
6.3.d:
ग्रामे वा यदि वारण्ये पुण्या सर्वत्र नर्मदा .
रवितीर्थे विशेषेण रेवा पुण्यफलप्रदा .. 60.71 ..
6.3.m: Whether in a village or in a forest, the Narmadā is sacred everywhere; / at Ravitīrtha in particular, the Revā bestows sacred fruit.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ sūryadine bhaktyā vyatīpāte ca vai dhṛtau .
saṃkrāntau grahaṇe'māyāṃ ye vrajanti jitendriyāḥ .. 60.72 ..
6.3.d:
षष्ठ्यां सूर्यदिने भक्त्या व्यतीपाते च वै धृतौ .
संक्रान्तौ ग्रहणेऽमायां ये व्रजन्ति जितेन्द्रियाः .. 60.72 ..
6.3.m: On the sixth lunar day, on Sunday, on Vyatīpāta, on Dhṛti, / on a solstice, during an eclipse, or on the new-moon day, those who go, with senses conquered,

6.3.s:
kāmakrodhairvimuktāśca rāgadveṣaistathaiva ca .
upoṣya parayā bhaktyā devasyāgre narādhipa .. 60.73 ..
6.3.d:
कामक्रोधैर्विमुक्ताश्च रागद्वेषैस्तथैव च .
उपोष्य परया भक्त्या देवस्याग्रे नराधिप .. 60.73 ..
6.3.m: freed from desire and anger, and likewise from passion and hatred, / having fasted with supreme devotion before the god, O king of men,

6.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpaṃ devasya bodhayet .
kathāṃ vai vaiṣṇavīṃ pārtha vedābhyasanameva ca .. 60.74 ..
6.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा दीपं देवस्य बोधयेत् .
कथां वै वैष्णवीं पार्थ वेदाभ्यसनमेव च .. 60.74 ..
6.3.m: and kept a vigil at night, should light a lamp for the god; / [and engage in] a Vaiṣṇava narrative, O son of Pṛthā, and the study of the Veda.

6.3.s:
ṛgvedaṃ vā yajurvedaṃ sāmavedamatharvaṇam .
ṛcamekāṃ japedyastu sa vedaphalamāpnuyāt .. 60.75 ..
6.3.d:
ऋग्वेदं वा यजुर्वेदं सामवेदमथर्वणम् .
ऋचमेकां जपेद्यस्तु स वेदफलमाप्नुयात् .. 60.75 ..
6.3.m: Whether the Ṛgveda, Yajurveda, Sāmaveda, or Atharvan— / whoever recites even a single verse obtains the fruit of the Veda.

6.3.s:
gāyatryā ca caturvedaphalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .
prabhāte pūjayedviprānannadānahiraṇyataḥ .. 60.76 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्र्या च चतुर्वेदफलमाप्नोति मानवः .
प्रभाते पूजयेद्विप्रानन्नदानहिरण्यतः .. 60.76 ..
6.3.m: And through the Gāyatrī a person obtains the fruit of the four Vedas. / At dawn, one should worship brahmins with food, gifts, and gold,

6.3.s:
bhūmidānena vastreṇa annadānena śaktitaḥ .
chatropānahaśayyādigṛhadānena pāṇḍava .. 60.77 ..
6.3.d:
भूमिदानेन वस्त्रेण अन्नदानेन शक्तितः .
छत्रोपानहशय्यादिगृहदानेन पाण्डव .. 60.77 ..
6.3.m: with gifts of land, with clothing, with gifts of food according to one's capacity, / with umbrellas, shoes, beds, and gifts of houses, O Pāṇḍava,

6.3.s:
grāmadhūrvahadānena gajakanyāhayena ca .
vidyāśakaṭadānena sarveṣāmabhayaṃ bhavet .. 60.78 ..
6.3.d:
ग्रामधूर्वहदानेन गजकन्याहयेन च .
विद्याशकटदानेन सर्वेषामभयं भवेत् .. 60.78 ..
6.3.m: with gifts of villages, draft beasts, elephants, maidens, and horses; / through gifts of learning and carts, fearlessness arises for all.

6.3.s:
śatruśca mitratāṃ yāti viṣaṃ caivāmṛtaṃ bhavet .
grahā bhavanti suprītāḥ prītastasya divākaraḥ .. 60.79 ..
6.3.d:
शत्रुश्च मित्रतां याति विषं चैवामृतं भवेत् .
ग्रहा भवन्ति सुप्रीताः प्रीतस्तस्य दिवाकरः .. 60.79 ..
6.3.m: An enemy turns into a friend, and poison becomes nectar; / the planets become well pleased, and the Sun is pleased with him.

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ ravitīrthaphalaṃ nṛpa .
ye śṛṇvanti narā bhaktyā ravitīrthaphalaṃ śubham .. 60.80 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं रवितीर्थफलं नृप .
ये शृण्वन्ति नरा भक्त्या रवितीर्थफलं शुभम् .. 60.80 ..
6.3.m: All this fruit of Ravitīrtha has been declared to you, O king. / The men who listen with devotion to the auspicious fruit of Ravitīrtha,

6.3.s:
te'pi pāpavinirmuktā raviloke vasanti hi .
godānena ca yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ bhṛgudarśane .. 60.81 ..
6.3.d:
तेऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्ता रविलोके वसन्ति हि .
गोदानेन च यत्पुण्यं यत्पुण्यं भृगुदर्शने .. 60.81 ..
6.3.m: they too, released from sin, dwell in the world of the Sun. / Whatever merit comes from the gift of a cow, whatever merit from the sight of Bhṛgu,

6.3.s:
kedāra udakaṃ pītvā tatpuṇyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām .
abdamaśvatthasevāyāṃ tilapātraprado bhavet .. 60.82 ..
6.3.d:
केदार उदकं पीत्वा तत्पुण्यं जायते नृणाम् .
अब्दमश्वत्थसेवायां तिलपात्रप्रदो भवेत् .. 60.82 ..
6.3.m: that merit arises for men from drinking the water at Kedāra. / If one serves an aśvattha tree for a year and gives a vessel of sesame,

6.3.s:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ādityeśvarakīrtanāt .
śrute yasya prabhāve na jāyate yannṛpātmaja .. 60.83 ..
6.3.d:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति आदित्येश्वरकीर्तनात् .
श्रुते यस्य प्रभावे न जायते यन्नृपात्मज .. 60.83 ..
6.3.m: that fruit one obtains from celebrating Ādityeśvara. / That which does not arise when its glory is heard, O son of the king—

6.3.s:
tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhaktyā tava mahīpate .
pāpāni ca pralīyante bhinnapātre yathā jalam .. 60.84 ..
6.3.d:
तत्सर्वं कथयिष्यामि भक्त्या तव महीपते .
पापानि च प्रलीयन्ते भिन्नपात्रे यथा जलम् .. 60.84 ..
6.3.m: all that I will tell to you with devotion, O king: / sins dissolve away like water in a broken vessel.

6.3.s:
tīrthasyābhimukho nityaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ kathitaṃ tava pāṇḍava .. 60.85 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थस्याभिमुखो नित्यं जायते नात्र संशयः .
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं कथितं तव पाण्डव .. 60.85 ..
6.3.m: One constantly turns toward the sacred ford; there is no doubt here. / A sacred ford more secret than the secret has been told to you, O Pāṇḍava.

6.3.s:
pāpiṣṭhānāṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ svāmimitrāvaghātinām .
tīrthākhyānaṃ śubhaṃ teṣāṃ gopitavyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ .. 60.86 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādityeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 61
6.3.d:
पापिष्ठानां कृतघ्नानां स्वामिमित्रावघातिनाम् .
तीर्थाख्यानं शुभं तेषां गोपितव्यं सदा बुधैः .. 60.86 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे आदित्येश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 61
6.3.m:
From the most sinful, the ungrateful, and the slayers of master or friend, / this auspicious narrative of the sacred ford should always be concealed by the wise.
Thus ends the sixtieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Greatness of the Ādityeśvara Sacred Ford', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 61

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchetparaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .
śakratīrthaṃ suvikhyātamaśeṣāghavināśanam .. 61.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्परं पुण्यं नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .
शक्रतीर्थं सुविख्यातमशेषाघविनाशनम् .. 61.1 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to the exceedingly sacred Śakratīrtha on the southern bank of the Narmadā, / celebrated for destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
purā śakreṇa tatraiva tapo vai duratikramam .
prārabdhaṃ parayā bhaktyā devaṃ prati maheśvaram .. 61.2 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा शक्रेण तत्रैव तपो वै दुरतिक्रमम् .
प्रारब्धं परया भक्त्या देवं प्रति महेश्वरम् .. 61.2 ..
6.3.m: Formerly, Śakra undertook hard-to-surpass austerity right there / with supreme devotion directed toward the god Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
tataḥ saṃtoṣito deva umāpatirnarādhipa .
devendratvaṃ varaṃ rājyaṃ dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ dadau .. 61.3 ..
6.3.d:
ततः संतोषितो देव उमापतिर्नराधिप .
देवेन्द्रत्वं वरं राज्यं दानवानां वधं ददौ .. 61.3 ..
6.3.m: Then, pleased, the lord of Umā granted him, O ruler of men, / the boon of lordship of the gods, sovereignty, and the slaughter of the Dānavas.

6.3.s:
labdhaṃ śakreṇa nṛpate narmadātīrthabhāvataḥ .
tataḥ puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃjātaṃ vasudhātale .. 61.4 ..
6.3.d:
लब्धं शक्रेण नृपते नर्मदातीर्थभावतः .
ततः पुण्यतमं तीर्थं संजातं वसुधातले .. 61.4 ..
6.3.m: It was obtained by Śakra, O king, by virtue of the Narmadā sacred ford; / consequently, it became the most sacred ford upon the earth.

6.3.s:
kārttikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīm .
upoṣya vai naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 61.5 ..
6.3.d:
कार्त्तिकस्य तु मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे त्रयोदशीम् .
उपोष्य वै नरो भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 61.5 ..
6.3.m: Having fasted with devotion on the thirteenth day / of the dark half of the month of Kārttika, a man is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
duḥsvapnasambhavaiḥ pāpairdurnimittasamudbhavaiḥ .
grahaśākinisambhūtairmucyate pāṇḍunandana .. 61.6 ..
6.3.d:
दुःस्वप्नसम्भवैः पापैर्दुर्निमित्तसमुद्भवैः .
ग्रहशाकिनिसम्भूतैर्मुच्यते पाण्डुनन्दन .. 61.6 ..
6.3.m: From sins arising from bad dreams, from those originating from ill omens, / and from those caused by evil planets and Śākinīs, he is freed, O son of Pāṇḍu.

6.3.s:
śakreśvaraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha ye prapaśyanti bhaktitaḥ .
teṣāṃ janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 61.7 ..
6.3.d:
शक्रेश्वरं नृपश्रेष्ठ ये प्रपश्यन्ति भक्तितः .
तेषां जन्मकृतं पापं नश्यते नात्र संशयः .. 61.7 ..
6.3.m: Those who behold Śakreśvara with devotion, O best of kings, / their sin committed in this birth is destroyed; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
agamyāgamane caiva avāhye caiva vāhite .
svāmimitravighāte yannaśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 61.8 ..
6.3.d:
अगम्यागमने चैव अवाह्ये चैव वाहिते .
स्वामिमित्रविघाते यन्नश्यते नात्र संशयः .. 61.8 ..
6.3.m: What [sin arises] from approaching forbidden women, or from mounting what should not be mounted, / or from harming one's master or friend, is destroyed; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
gopradānaṃ prakartavyaṃ śubhaṃ brāhmaṇapuṃgave .
dhuryaṃ vā dāpayettasmin sarvāṅgaruciraṃ nṛpa .. 61.9 ..
6.3.d:
गोप्रदानं प्रकर्तव्यं शुभं ब्राह्मणपुंगवे .
धुर्यं वा दापयेत्तस्मिन् सर्वाङ्गरुचिरं नृप .. 61.9 ..
6.3.m: The auspicious gift of a cow should be made to an eminent brahmin; / or one should cause an ox, beautiful in all its limbs, to be given there, O king.

6.3.s:
dātavyaṃ parayā bhaktyā svarge vāsamabhīpsatā .
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ śakreśvaraphalaṃ nṛpa .. 61.10 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śakreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 62
6.3.d:
दातव्यं परया भक्त्या स्वर्गे वासमभीप्सता .
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं शक्रेश्वरफलं नृप .. 61.10 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शक्रेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 62
6.3.m:
It should be given with supreme devotion by one who desires residence in heaven. / All this has been told to you, O king, regarding the fruit of Śakreśvara.
Thus ends the sixty-first chapter, named 'The Description of the Greatness of the Śakreśvara Sacred Ford', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the great Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 62

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra karoḍīśvaramuttamam .
yatra vai nihatāstāta dānavāḥ sapadānugāḥ .. 62.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र करोडीश्वरमुत्तमम् .
यत्र वै निहतास्तात दानवाः सपदानुगाः .. 62.1 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Karoḍīśvara, / where the Dānavas along with their followers were slain, dear friend,

6.3.s:
indrādidevaiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaiḥ satataṃ jayabuddhibhiḥ .
teṣāṃ ye putrapautrāśca pūrvavairamanusmaram .. 62.2 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रादिदेवैः संहृष्टैः सततं जयबुद्धिभिः .
तेषां ये पुत्रपौत्राश्च पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरम् .. 62.2 ..
6.3.m: by the gods led by Indra, overjoyed and ever minded toward victory. / Remembering their ancestral enmity, the sons and grandsons of those [Dānavas]

6.3.s:
kruddhairdevasamūhaiśca dānavā nihatā raṇe .
teṣāṃ śirāṃsi saṃgṛhya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 62.3 ..
6.3.d:
क्रुद्धैर्देवसमूहैश्च दानवा निहता रणे .
तेषां शिरांसि संगृह्य सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. 62.3 ..
6.3.m: were slain in battle by the enraged hosts of gods. / Taking up their heads, all the gods along with Indra,

6.3.s:
nikṣipya narmadātoye bandhubhāvamanusmaram .
tatra snātvā surāḥ sarve sthāpayitvā umāpatim .. 62.4 ..
6.3.d:
निक्षिप्य नर्मदातोये बन्धुभावमनुस्मरम् .
तत्र स्नात्वा सुराः सर्वे स्थापयित्वा उमापतिम् .. 62.4 ..
6.3.m: cast them into the water of the Narmadā, remembering their kinship. / Having bathed there, all the gods, having established the lord of Umā,

6.3.s:
indreṇa sahitāḥ sarve'pūjayaṃllokasiddhaye .
hṛṣṭacittāḥ surāḥ sarve jagmurākāśamaṇḍalam .. 62.5 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रेण सहिताः सर्वेऽपूजयंल्लोकसिद्धये .
हृष्टचित्ताः सुराः सर्वे जग्मुराकाशमण्डलम् .. 62.5 ..
6.3.m: along with Indra, worshipped him for the welfare of the world. / With delighted minds, all the gods went to the circle of the sky.

6.3.s:
dānavānāṃ mahābhāga sūditā koṭiruttamā .
tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ karoḍīti mahītale .. 62.6 ..
6.3.d:
दानवानां महाभाग सूदिता कोटिरुत्तमा .
तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं करोडीति महीतले .. 62.6 ..
6.3.m: A full crore of Dānavas, O fortunate one, was exterminated; / from then on, that sacred ford is known on the earth as Karoḍī.

6.3.s:
vikhyātaṃ tu tadā loke pāpaghnaṃ pāṇḍunandana .
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāmubhau pakṣau ca bhaktitaḥ .
upoṣya śūlinaścāgre rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .. 62.7 ..
6.3.d:
विख्यातं तु तदा लोके पापघ्नं पाण्डुनन्दन .
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यामुभौ पक्षौ च भक्तितः .
उपोष्य शूलिनश्चाग्रे रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .. 62.7 ..
6.3.m: It became famous in the world, O son of Pāṇḍu, as destroying sin. / On the eighth and the fourteenth days of both fortnights, with devotion, / having fasted before the Trident-bearer, one should keep vigil at night, 62.7

6.3.s:
satkathāpāṭhasaṃyukto vedādhyayanasaṃyutaḥ .
prabhāte vimale prāpte pūjayettridaśeśvaram .. 62.8 ..
6.3.d:
सत्कथापाठसंयुक्तो वेदाध्ययनसंयुतः .
प्रभाते विमले प्राप्ते पूजयेत्त्रिदशेश्वरम् .. 62.8 ..
6.3.m: engaged in reciting sacred tales and reciting the Veda. / When the spotless dawn arrives, one should worship the Lord of the thirty [gods]. 62.8

6.3.s:
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya śrīkhaṇḍena ca guṇṭhayet .
śastaiḥ pallavapuṣpaiśca pūjayettu prayatnataḥ .. 62.9 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चामृतेन संस्नाप्य श्रीखण्डेन च गुण्ठयेत् .
शस्तैः पल्लवपुष्पैश्च पूजयेत्तु प्रयत्नतः .. 62.9 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed [him] with the five nectars, one should smear [him] with sandalwood paste, / and diligently worship [him] with auspicious shoots and flowers. 62.9

6.3.s:
bahurūpaṃ japanmantraṃ dakṣiṇāśāṃ vyavasthitaḥ .
yathoktena vidhānena nābhimātre jale kṣipet .. 62.10 ..
6.3.d:
बहुरूपं जपन्मन्त्रं दक्षिणाशां व्यवस्थितः .
यथोक्तेन विधानेन नाभिमात्रे जले क्षिपेत् .. 62.10 ..
6.3.m: Facing the southern direction and chanting the Bahurūpa mantra, / according to the prescribed rite, standing in navel-deep water, one should cast 62.10

6.3.s:
tilāñjaliṃ tu pretāya dakṣiṇāśāmupasthitaḥ .
śrāddhaṃ tatraiva viprāya kārayedvijitendriyaḥ .. 62.11 ..
6.3.d:
तिलाञ्जलिं तु प्रेताय दक्षिणाशामुपस्थितः .
श्राद्धं तत्रैव विप्राय कारयेद्विजितेन्द्रियः .. 62.11 ..
6.3.m: a handful of water with sesame seeds for the departed spirit, facing the southern quarter. / With subdued senses, one should perform a śrāddha right there for the brahmin, 62.11

6.3.s:
viṣamairagrajātaiśca vedābhyasanatatparaiḥ .
gohiraṇyena sampūjya tāmbūlairbhojanaistathā .. 62.12 ..
6.3.d:
विषमैरग्रजातैश्च वेदाभ्यसनतत्परैः .
गोहिरण्येन सम्पूज्य ताम्बूलैर्भोजनैस्तथा .. 62.12 ..
6.3.m: with an odd number of firstborn [brahmins] devoted to the study of the Veda. / Having honored them with cows and gold, with betel leaves and meals, 62.12

6.3.s:
bhūṣaṇaiḥ pādukābhiśca brāhmaṇānpāṇḍunandana .
bhavetkoṭiguṇaṃ tasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 62.13 ..
6.3.d:
भूषणैः पादुकाभिश्च ब्राह्मणान्पाण्डुनन्दन .
भवेत्कोटिगुणं तस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 62.13 ..
6.3.m: with ornaments and sandals, O son of Pāṇḍu—those brahmins— / for him it will be multiplied ten million times; there should be no doubt about this. 62.13

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kaścittyajeddehaṃ vidhānataḥ .
tasya bhavati yatpuṇyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 62.14 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्त्यजेद्देहं विधानतः .
तस्य भवति यत्पुण्यं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .. 62.14 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons their body at that sacred ford in accordance with the injunctions, / hear the merit that accrues to him, O lord of men: 62.14

6.3.s:
yāvadasthīni tiṣṭhanti martyasya narmadājale .
tāvadvasati dharmātmā śivaloke sudurlabhe .. 62.15 ..
6.3.d:
यावदस्थीनि तिष्ठन्ति मर्त्यस्य नर्मदाजले .
तावद्वसति धर्मात्मा शिवलोके सुदुर्लभे .. 62.15 ..
6.3.m: As long as a mortal's bones remain in the water of the Narmadā, / so long does the righteous person dwell in Śiva's world, which is so difficult to attain. 62.15

6.3.s:
tataḥ kālāccyutastasmādiha mānuṣatāṃ gataḥ .
koṭidhanapatiḥ śrīmāñjāyate rājapūjitaḥ .. 62.16 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कालाच्च्युतस्तस्मादिह मानुषतां गतः .
कोटिधनपतिः श्रीमाञ्जायते राजपूजितः .. 62.16 ..
6.3.m: Falling from there when the time comes, having attained human birth here, / he is born wealthy, master of ten million fortunes, and honored by kings. 62.16

6.3.s:
sarvadharmasamāyukto medhāvī bījaputrakaḥ .
vikhyāto vasudhāpṛṣṭhe dīrghāyurmānavo bhavet .. 62.17 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वधर्मसमायुक्तो मेधावी बीजपुत्रकः .
विख्यातो वसुधापृष्ठे दीर्घायुर्मानवो भवेत् .. 62.17 ..
6.3.m: Endowed with all virtues, wise, possessing good offspring, / renowned on the face of the earth, he becomes a long-lived man. 62.17

6.3.s:
punaḥ smarati tattīrthaṃ tatra gatvā nṛpottama .
karoḍeśvaramabhyarcya prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim .. 62.18 ..
6.3.d:
पुनः स्मरति तत्तीर्थं तत्र गत्वा नृपोत्तम .
करोडेश्वरमभ्यर्च्य प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् .. 62.18 ..
6.3.m: He remembers that sacred ford again, and going there, O best of kings, / having worshipped Karoḍeśvara, he attains the supreme state. 62.18

6.3.s:
indracandrayamairrudrairādityairvasubhistathā .
viśvedevaistathā sarvaiḥ sthāpitastridaśeśvaraḥ .. 62.19 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रचन्द्रयमैर्रुद्रैरादित्यैर्वसुभिस्तथा .
विश्वेदेवैस्तथा सर्वैः स्थापितस्त्रिदशेश्वरः .. 62.19 ..
6.3.m: By Indra, Candra, Yama, the Rudras, the Ādityas, and the Vasus, / and by all the Viśvedevas, the Lord of the thirty [gods] was established 62.19

6.3.s:
revāyā uttare kūle lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .
mānavo bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ prāsādaṃ kārayettu yaḥ .. 62.20 ..
6.3.d:
रेवाया उत्तरे कूले लोकानां हितकाम्यया .
मानवो भक्तिसंयुक्तः प्रासादं कारयेत्तु यः .. 62.20 ..
6.3.m: on the northern bank of the Revā, desiring the welfare of the worlds. / A mortal endowed with devotion who builds a temple 62.20

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe naraśreṣṭha sadgatiṃ samavāpnuyāt .
nyāyopāttadhanenaiva dārupāṣāṇakeṣṭakaiḥ .. 62.21 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरश्रेष्ठ सद्गतिं समवाप्नुयात् .
न्यायोपात्तधनेनैव दारुपाषाणकेष्टकैः .. 62.21 ..
6.3.m: at that sacred ford, O best of men, attains a good destination. / With wealth obtained by righteous means, using wood, stones, and bricks, 62.21

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhiśca śaktitaḥ .
te'pi yānti narā loke śāṃkare surapūjite .. 62.22 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैः स्त्रीभिश्च शक्तितः .
तेऽपि यान्ति नरा लोके शांकरे सुरपूजिते .. 62.22 ..
6.3.m: by a brahmin, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and women according to their ability— / those men also go to the world of Śaṅkara, worshipped by the gods. 62.22

6.3.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā bhaktyā māhātmyaṃ tīrthajaṃ nṛpa .
tasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyeta ṣaṇmāsābhyantaraṃ ca yat .. 62.23 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karoḍīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ..
adhyāya 63
6.3.d:
यः शृणोति सदा भक्त्या माहात्म्यं तीर्थजं नृप .
तस्य पापं प्रणश्येत षण्मासाभ्यन्तरं च यत् .. 62.23 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे करोडीश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः..
अध्याय 63
6.3.m:
Whoever always hears with devotion the māhātmya originating from that sacred ford, O king, / his sin that has accumulated within six months is destroyed. 62.23
Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of the Karoḍīśvara Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 63

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra kumāreśvaramuttamam .
prasiddhaṃ sarvatīrthānāmagastyeśvarasannidhau .. 63.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कुमारेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
प्रसिद्धं सर्वतीर्थानामगस्त्येश्वरसन्निधौ .. 63.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O king of kings, one should go to the excellent Kumāreśvara, / famous among all sacred fords, near Agastyeśvara. 63.1

6.3.s:
ṣaṇmukhena purā tāta sarvapātakanāśanam .
ārādhya parayā bhaktyā siddhiḥ prāptā narādhipa .. 63.2 ..
6.3.d:
षण्मुखेन पुरा तात सर्वपातकनाशनम् .
आराध्य परया भक्त्या सिद्धिः प्राप्ता नराधिप .. 63.2 ..
6.3.m: In ancient times, dear one, having propitiated with supreme devotion [the liṅga] that destroys all sins, / perfection was attained by the Six-faced One, O lord of men. 63.2

6.3.s:
devasainyādhipo jātaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ .
ugratejā mahātmāsau saṃjātastīrthasevanāt .. 63.3 ..
6.3.d:
देवसैन्याधिपो जातः सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः .
उग्रतेजा महात्मासौ संजातस्तीर्थसेवनात् .. 63.3 ..
6.3.m: He became the commander of the army of the gods, the slayer of all enemies; / endowed with fierce splendor, that great-souled one arose through serving that sacred ford. 63.3

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ saṃjātaṃnarmadātaṭe .
tatra tīrthe tu yo gatvā ekacitto jitendriyaḥ .. 63.4 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं संजातंनर्मदातटे .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो गत्वा एकचित्तो जितेन्द्रियः .. 63.4 ..
6.3.m: From that time on, that sacred ford came into being on the bank of the Narmadā. / Whoever goes to that sacred ford with a focused mind and subdued senses, 63.4

6.3.s:
kārttikasya caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .
snāpayedgirijānāthaṃ dadhidugdhena sarpiṣā .. 63.5 ..
6.3.d:
कार्त्तिकस्य चतुर्दश्यामष्टम्यां च विशेषतः .
स्नापयेद्गिरिजानाथं दधिदुग्धेन सर्पिषा .. 63.5 ..
6.3.m: especially on the fourteenth and eighth days of Kārttika, / and bathes the Lord of the Mountain's Daughter with curds, milk, and clarified butter, 63.5

6.3.s:
gītaṃ tatra prakartavyaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ yathāvidhi .
brāhmaṇaiḥ śrotriyaiḥ pārtha ṣaṭkarmanirataiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 63.6 ..
6.3.d:
गीतं तत्र प्रकर्तव्यं पिण्डदानं यथाविधि .
ब्राह्मणैः श्रोत्रियैः पार्थ षट्कर्मनिरतैः शुभैः .. 63.6 ..
6.3.m: singing should be performed there, and offering of funeral cakes according to the rules, / with auspicious brahmins who are learned in the Veda and engaged in the six duties, O son of Pṛthā. 63.6

6.3.s:
yatkiṃciddīyate tatra akṣayaṃ pāṇḍunandana .
sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrtha nirmitaṃ śikhinā nṛpa .. 63.7 ..
6.3.d:
यत्किंचिद्दीयते तत्र अक्षयं पाण्डुनन्दन .
सर्वतीर्थमयं तीर्थ निर्मितं शिखिना नृप .. 63.7 ..
6.3.m: Whatever is given there becomes imperishable, O son of Pāṇḍu; / that sacred ford, consisting of all sacred fords, was made by the peacock-rider, O king. 63.7

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kumāreśvarajaṃ phalam .
kumāradarśanātpuṇyaṃ prāpyate pāṇḍunandana .. 63.8 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कुमारेश्वरजं फलम् .
कुमारदर्शनात्पुण्यं प्राप्यते पाण्डुनन्दन .. 63.8 ..
6.3.m: All this fruit arising from Kumāreśvara has been told to you. / Merit is attained by the sight of Kumāra, O son of Pāṇḍu; 63.8

6.3.s:
mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnoti satyamīśvarabhāṣitam .. 63.9 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kumāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 64
6.3.d:
मृतः स्वर्गमवाप्नोति सत्यमीश्वरभाषितम् .. 63.9 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कुमारेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 64
6.3.m:
upon dying, one attains heaven; this is truth spoken by Īśvara. 63.9
Thus ends the sixty-third chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of the Kumāreśvara Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 64

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
narāṇāṃ pāpanāśāya agastyeśvaramuttamam .. 64.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
नराणां पापनाशाय अगस्त्येश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 64.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O king of kings, one should go to the exceedingly beautiful sacred ford, / the excellent Agastyeśvara, for the destruction of men's sins. 64.1

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā naro rājanmucyate brahmahatyayā .
kārttikasya tu māsasya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī .. 64.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .
कार्त्तिकस्य तु मासस्य कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी .. 64.2 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there, O king, a man is freed from the murder of a brahmin. / On the fourteenth day in the dark fortnight of the month of Kārttika, 64.2

6.3.s:
ghṛtena snāpayeddevaṃ samādhistho jitendriyaḥ .
ekaviṃśatikulopeto cyavedaiśvarātpadāt .. 64.3 ..
6.3.d:
घृतेन स्नापयेद्देवं समाधिस्थो जितेन्द्रियः .
एकविंशतिकुलोपेतो च्यवेदैश्वरात्पदात् .. 64.3 ..
6.3.m: absorbed in meditation and with senses restrained, one should bathe the god with clarified butter; / along with twenty-one generations of his family, he does not fall from the state of Īśvara. 64.3

6.3.s:
dhanaṃ copānahau chatraṃ dadyācca ghṛtakambalam .
bhojanaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 64.4 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe agastyeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 65
6.3.d:
धनं चोपानहौ छत्रं दद्याच्च घृतकम्बलम् .
भोजनं चैव सर्वेषां सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 64.4 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अगस्त्येश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुःषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 65
6.3.m:
And one should give wealth, two shoes, an umbrella, a blanket with clarified butter, / and food to all; everything becomes multiplied ten million times. 64.4
Thus ends the sixty-fourth chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of the Agastyeśvara Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 65

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra ānandeśvaramuttamam .
tattīrthaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 65.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र आनन्देश्वरमुत्तमम् .
तत्तीर्थं कथयिष्यामि सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 65.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O king of kings, one should go to the excellent Ānandeśvara. / I shall tell of that sacred ford, which causes the destruction of all sins. 65.1

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
ānandaścaiva saṃjāto rudrasya dvijasattama .
kathyatāṃ me ca tatsarvaṃ saṃkṣepātsaha bāndhavaiḥ .. 65.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आनन्दश्चैव संजातो रुद्रस्य द्विजसत्तम .
कथ्यतां मे च तत्सर्वं संक्षेपात्सह बान्धवैः .. 65.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / And how did the joy of Rudra arise, O best of the twice-born? / Tell me all of that in brief, along with my kinsmen. 65.2

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
kathayāmi nṛpaśreṣṭha ānandeśvaramuttamam .
dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 65.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
कथयामि नृपश्रेष्ठ आनन्देश्वरमुत्तमम् .
दानवानां वधं कृत्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 65.3 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I shall tell, O best of kings, of the excellent Ānandeśvara. / Having slain the Dānavas, the god of gods, Maheśvara, 65.3

6.3.s:
pūjito daivataiḥ sarvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣapannagaiḥ .
ānandasaṃyuto devo nanarta vṛṣavāhanaḥ .. 65.4 ..
6.3.d:
पूजितो दैवतैः सर्वैः किन्नरैर्यक्षपन्नगैः .
आनन्दसंयुतो देवो ननर्त वृषवाहनः .. 65.4 ..
6.3.m: worshipped by all deities, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, and serpents, / filled with joy, the bull-riding god danced. 65.4

6.3.s:
bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya gauryā cārddhāṅgasaṃsthitaḥ .
bhūtavetālakaṅkālairbhairavairbhairavo vṛtaḥ .. 65.5 ..
6.3.d:
भैरवं रूपमास्थाय गौर्या चार्द्धाङ्गसंस्थितः .
भूतवेतालकङ्कालैर्भैरवैर्भैरवो वृतः .. 65.5 ..
6.3.m: Assuming a terrifying form, with half of his body formed by Gaurī, / surrounded by Bhūtas, Vetālas, skeletons, and Bhairavas, the formidable one 65.5

6.3.s:
nanarta narmadātīre dakṣiṇe pāṇḍunandana .
tuṣṭairmarudgaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpitaḥ kamalāsanaḥ .. 65.6 ..
6.3.d:
ननर्त नर्मदातीरे दक्षिणे पाण्डुनन्दन .
तुष्टैर्मरुद्गणैः सर्वैः स्थापितः कमलासनः .. 65.6 ..
6.3.m: danced on the southern bank of the Narmadā, O son of Pāṇḍu. / By all the delighted hosts of the Maruts, the lotus-seated one was established. 65.6

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthamānandeśvaramucyate .
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ narādhipa .. 65.7 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थमानन्देश्वरमुच्यते .
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पौर्णमास्यां नराधिप .. 65.7 ..
6.3.m: From that time on, that sacred ford is called Ānandeśvara. / On the eighth, the fourteenth, and the full moon day, O lord of men, 65.7

6.3.s:
vidhivaccārcayeddevaṃ sugandhena vilepayet .
brāhmaṇānpūjayettatra yathāśaktyā yudhiṣṭhira .. 65.8 ..
6.3.d:
विधिवच्चार्चयेद्देवं सुगन्धेन विलेपयेत् .
ब्राह्मणान्पूजयेत्तत्र यथाशक्त्या युधिष्ठिर .. 65.8 ..
6.3.m: one should worship the god according to rule and smear him with fragrant paste; / one should worship brahmins there according to one's means, O Yudhiṣṭhira. 65.8

6.3.s:
godānaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ vastradānaṃ śubhāvaham .
vasantasya trayodaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kārayet .. 65.9 ..
6.3.d:
गोदानं तत्र कर्तव्यं वस्त्रदानं शुभावहम् .
वसन्तस्य त्रयोदश्यां श्राद्धं तत्रैव कारयेत् .. 65.9 ..
6.3.m: The gift of a cow should be made there, and the gift of garments which brings good fortune. / One should perform a śrāddha right there on the thirteenth day of the spring [month].

6.3.s:
iṅgudairbadarairbilvairakṣataiśca jalena vā .
pretānāṃ kārayecchrāddhamānandeśvara uttame .. 65.10 ..
6.3.d:
इङ्गुदैर्बदरैर्बिल्वैरक्षतैश्च जलेन वा .
प्रेतानां कारयेच्छ्राद्धमानन्देश्वर उत्तमे .. 65.10 ..
6.3.m: With inguda fruits, jujubes, bilva fruits, unhusked barley grains, or with water, / one should perform a śrāddha for the departed ancestors at the supreme Ānandeśvara.

6.3.s:
ānanditā bhaveyuste yāvadābhūtasamplavam .
santatervai na vicchedaḥ saptajanmasu jāyate .
ānando hi bhavatteṣāṃ pratijanmani bhārata .. 65.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ānandeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 66
6.3.d:
आनन्दिता भवेयुस्ते यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .
सन्ततेर्वै न विच्छेदः सप्तजन्मसु जायते .
आनन्दो हि भवत्तेषां प्रतिजन्मनि भारत .. 65.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे आनन्देश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 66
6.3.m:
They will remain delighted until the dissolution of all beings. / Indeed, no break occurs in one's lineage for seven lifetimes; / for joy shall be theirs in every birth, O descendant of Bharata.
Thus ends the sixty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Ānandeśvara Sacred Ford', in the Revā Section of the fifth Avanti Section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 66

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra mātṛtīrthamanuttamam .
saṅgamasya samīpasthaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .. 66.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र मातृतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
सङ्गमस्य समीपस्थं नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .. 66.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O king of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Mātṛtīrtha, / situated near the confluence on the southern bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
mātarastatra rājendra saṃjātā narmadātaṭe .
umārdhanārirdeveśo vyālayajñopavītadhṛk .. 66.2 ..
6.3.d:
मातरस्तत्र राजेन्द्र संजाता नर्मदातटे .
उमार्धनारिर्देवेशो व्यालयज्ञोपवीतधृक् .. 66.2 ..
6.3.m: The Mothers were born there on the bank of the Narmadā, O king of kings. / The Lord of gods, whose half-form is Umā, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread,

6.3.s:
uvāca yoginīvṛndaṃ kaṣṭaṃkaṣṭamaho hara .
ajeyāḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvatprasādānmaheśvara .. 66.3 ..
6.3.d:
उवाच योगिनीवृन्दं कष्टंकष्टमहो हर .
अजेयाः सर्वदेवानां त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर .. 66.3 ..
6.3.m: said to the assembly of yoginīs: "Alas, what distress, what distress, O Hara! / By your favor, O Maheśvara, you are invincible to all the gods.

6.3.s:
tīrthamatra vidhānena prakhyātaṃ vasudhātale .
evaṃ bhavatu yoginya ityuktvāntaradhācchivaḥ .. 66.4 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थमत्र विधानेन प्रख्यातं वसुधातले .
एवं भवतु योगिन्य इत्युक्त्वान्तरधाच्छिवः .. 66.4 ..
6.3.m: Let there be a sacred ford established here by proper rule, famous upon the earth's surface." / Saying "So be it, O yoginīs," Śiva vanished.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā navamyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ .
upoṣya parayā bhaktyā pūjayenmātṛgocaram .. 66.5 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या नवम्यां नियतः शुचिः .
उपोष्य परया भक्त्या पूजयेन्मातृगोचरम् .. 66.5 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Whoever, restrained and pure, fasts with supreme devotion on the ninth day / at that sacred ford, and worships the domain of the Mothers,

6.3.s:
tasya syurmātaraḥ prītāḥ prīto'yaṃ vṛṣavāhanaḥ .
vandhyāyā mṛtavatsāyā aputrāyā yudhiṣṭhira .. 66.6 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य स्युर्मातरः प्रीताः प्रीतोऽयं वृषवाहनः .
वन्ध्याया मृतवत्साया अपुत्राया युधिष्ठिर .. 66.6 ..
6.3.m: the Mothers become pleased with him, as does this bull-vehicled [Śiva]. / For a barren woman, a woman whose child has died, or one without a son, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

6.3.s:
snāpanaṃ cārabhettatra mantraśāstraviduttamaḥ .
sahiraṇyena kumbhena pañcaratnaphalānvitaḥ .. 66.7 ..
6.3.d:
स्नापनं चारभेत्तत्र मन्त्रशास्त्रविदुत्तमः .
सहिरण्येन कुम्भेन पञ्चरत्नफलान्वितः .. 66.7 ..
6.3.m: the foremost master of the science of mantras should then begin a ceremonial bath / with a golden pot accompanied by the five jewels and fruits.

6.3.s:
snāpayetputrakāmāyāḥ kāṃsyapātreṇa deśikaḥ .
putraṃ sā labhate nārī vīryavantaṃ guṇānvitam .. 66.8 ..
6.3.d:
स्नापयेत्पुत्रकामायाः कांस्यपात्रेण देशिकः .
पुत्रं सा लभते नारी वीर्यवन्तं गुणान्वितम् .. 66.8 ..
6.3.m: The preceptor should bathe the woman desiring a son using a bronze vessel. / That woman obtains a heroic son endowed with virtues.

6.3.s:
yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyettataḥ sa labhate nṛpa .
mātṛtīrthātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati .. 66.9 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mātṛtīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 67
6.3.d:
यो यं काममभिध्यायेत्ततः स लभते नृप .
मातृतीर्थात्परं तीर्थं न भूतं न भविष्यति .. 66.9 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मातृतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्षष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 67
6.3.m:
Whatever desire one contemplates, one obtains from that, O king. / No sacred ford higher than Mātṛtīrtha has ever been, nor ever will be.
Thus ends the sixty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Mātṛtīrtha', in the Revā Section of the fifth Avanti Section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 67

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ tāta jalamadhye vyavasthitam .
luṅkeśvaramiti khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam .. 67.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं तात जलमध्ये व्यवस्थितम् .
लुङ्केश्वरमिति ख्यातं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् .. 67.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Immediately after that, my dear, situated in the midst of the water, / is the sacred ford known as Luṅkeśvara, saluted by gods and asuras.

6.3.s:
idaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ nānāścaryaṃ mahītale .
asya tīrthasya māhātmyamutpattiṃ śṛṇu bhārata .. 67.2 ..
6.3.d:
इदं तीर्थं महापुण्यं नानाश्चर्यं महीतले .
अस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यमुत्पत्तिं शृणु भारत .. 67.2 ..
6.3.m: This sacred ford is greatly meritorious and full of various wonders on the earth. / Hear, O descendant of Bharata, the origin and the māhātmya of this sacred ford.

6.3.s:
āsītpurā mahāvīryo dānavo baladarpitaḥ .
kālapṛṣṭha iti khyātaḥ suto brahmasutasya ca .. 67.3 ..
6.3.d:
आसीत्पुरा महावीर्यो दानवो बलदर्पितः .
कालपृष्ठ इति ख्यातः सुतो ब्रह्मसुतस्य च .. 67.3 ..
6.3.m: Formerly there was an immensely heroic dānava, arrogant with strength, / known as Kālapṛṣṭha, who was the son of a son of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
gaṅgātaṭaṃ samāśritya cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .
adhomukho'pi saṃsthitvāpibaddhūmamaharniśam .. 67.4 ..
6.3.d:
गङ्गातटं समाश्रित्य चचार विपुलं तपः .
अधोमुखोऽपि संस्थित्वापिबद्धूममहर्निशम् .. 67.4 ..
6.3.m: Resorting to the bank of the Gaṅgā, he performed extensive austerity. / Remaining head downward, he inhaled smoke day and night.

6.3.s:
tataścānantaraṃ devastiṣṭhate hyumayā saha .
dṛṣṭvā taṃ pārvatī sā tu tapasyugre vyavasthitam .. 67.5 ..
6.3.d:
ततश्चानन्तरं देवस्तिष्ठते ह्युमया सह .
दृष्ट्वा तं पार्वती सा तु तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थितम् .. 67.5 ..
6.3.m: Immediately after that, the god was staying there with Umā. / Seeing him established in such severe austerity, Pārvatī said:

6.3.s:
paśya paśya mahādeva dhūmāśī tiṣṭhate naraḥ .
prasīda taṃ kuruṣvādya dehi śīghraṃ varaṃ vibho .. 67.6 ..
6.3.d:
पश्य पश्य महादेव धूमाशी तिष्ठते नरः .
प्रसीद तं कुरुष्वाद्य देहि शीघ्रं वरं विभो .. 67.6 ..
6.3.m: "Look, look, O Mahādeva, a man stands inhaling smoke! / Be pleased with him today; grant him a boon quickly, O all-pervading Lord!"

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
yaduktaṃ vacanaṃ devi na tanme rocate priye .
svakāryaṃ ca sadā cintyaṃ parakāryaṃ visarjayet .. 67.7 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
यदुक्तं वचनं देवि न तन्मे रोचते प्रिये .
स्वकार्यं च सदा चिन्त्यं परकार्यं विसर्जयेत् .. 67.7 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "O goddess, the words you have spoken do not please me, my dear. / One should always attend to one's own concern and avoid the concern of another.

6.3.s:
mūrkhastrībālaśatrūṇāṃ yaśchandenānuvartate .
vyasane patate ghore satyametadudīritam .. 67.8 ..
6.3.d:
मूर्खस्त्रीबालशत्रूणां यश्छन्देनानुवर्तते .
व्यसने पतते घोरे सत्यमेतदुदीरितम् .. 67.8 ..
6.3.m: He who follows the inclination of fools, women, children, and enemies / falls into terrible calamity. This is truly stated."

6.3.s:
devyuvāca -
bhāryayābhyarthito bhartā kāraṇaṃ bahu bhāṣate .
laghutvaṃ yāti sā nārī evaṃ śāstreṣu paṭhyate .. 67.9 ..
6.3.d:
देव्युवाच -
भार्ययाभ्यर्थितो भर्ता कारणं बहु भाषते .
लघुत्वं याति सा नारी एवं शास्त्रेषु पठ्यते .. 67.9 ..
6.3.m: The goddess said: / "When a husband is requested by his wife, he speaks many arguments. / That woman falls into low esteem; thus is it read in the scriptures.

6.3.s:
prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi yadi māṃ tvaṃ na manyase .
pārvatyā prerito devo gato'sau dānavaṃ prati .. 67.10 ..
6.3.d:
प्राणत्यागं करिष्यामि यदि मां त्वं न मन्यसे .
पार्वत्या प्रेरितो देवो गतोऽसौ दानवं प्रति .. 67.10 ..
6.3.m: I will give up my life if you do not heed me." / Urged by Pārvatī, the god went toward that dānava.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
kimarthaṃ pibase dhūmaṃ kimarthaṃ tapyase tapaḥ .
kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ nu santāpo vada kāryamabhīpsitam .. 67.11 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
किमर्थं पिबसे धूमं किमर्थं तप्यसे तपः .
किं दुःखं किं नु सन्तापो वद कार्यमभीप्सितम् .. 67.11 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "For what purpose do you inhale smoke? For what purpose do you practice austerity? / What is your distress? What is your sorrow? State your desired objective.

6.3.s:
yuvā tvaṃ dṛśyase'dyāpi varṣaviṃśatireva ca .
tadācakṣva hi me sarvaṃ tapasaḥ kāraṇaṃ mahat .. 67.12 ..
6.3.d:
युवा त्वं दृश्यसेऽद्यापि वर्षविंशतिरेव च .
तदाचक्ष्व हि मे सर्वं तपसः कारणं महत् .. 67.12 ..
6.3.m: You appear to be young, just twenty years of age even today. / Therefore declare to me in full the great reason for your austerity."

6.3.s:
dānava uvāca -
acalā dīyatāṃ bhaktirmama sthairyaṃ tavopari .
aparaṃ varṣasāhasraṃ nirvighnaṃ me gataṃ vibho .. 67.13 ..
6.3.d:
दानव उवाच -
अचला दीयतां भक्तिर्मम स्थैर्यं तवोपरि .
अपरं वर्षसाहस्रं निर्विघ्नं मे गतं विभो .. 67.13 ..
6.3.m: The dānava said: / "Let unswerving devotion be granted to me, and my steadfastness toward you. / Another thousand years have passed without obstacle for me, O all-pervading Lord.

6.3.s: divasānāṃ sahasre dve pūrṇe tvattapasā mama .. 67.14 ..
6.3.d: दिवसानां सहस्रे द्वे पूर्णे त्वत्तपसा मम .. 67.14 ..
6.3.m: Two thousand days have been completed by me in austerity toward you."

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
yācayābhīpsitaṃ kāryaṃ tuṣṭo'haṃ tava suvrata .
devasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ .. 67.15 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
याचयाभीप्सितं कार्यं तुष्टोऽहं तव सुव्रत .
देवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा चिन्तयामास दानवः .. 67.15 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "Ask for your desired objective; I am pleased with you, O man of good vows." / Hearing the god's words, the dānava thought:

6.3.s:
kiṃ nākaṃ yācayāmyadya kimadya sakalāṃ mahīm .
evaṃ saṃcintayāmāsa kāmabāṇena pīḍitaḥ .. 67.16 ..
6.3.d:
किं नाकं याचयाम्यद्य किमद्य सकलां महीम् .
एवं संचिन्तयामास कामबाणेन पीडितः .. 67.16 ..
6.3.m: "Shall I ask for heaven today, or shall I ask for the entire earth today?" / Thus he reflected, afflicted by the arrow of desire.

6.3.s:
dānava uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi me prabho .
saṅgrāmaistu na tuṣṭo'haṃ balaṃ nāstīti kiṃcana .. 67.17 ..
6.3.d:
दानव उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव वरं दास्यसि मे प्रभो .
सङ्ग्रामैस्तु न तुष्टोऽहं बलं नास्तीति किंचन .. 67.17 ..
6.3.m: The dānava said: / "If you are pleased with me, O god, and will grant me a boon, O Lord, / I am not satisfied with battles, since there is no strength whatsoever [left in them for me].

6.3.s:
yasya mūrdhanyahaṃ deva pāṇinā samupaspṛśe .
devadānavagandharvo bhasmasādyātu tatkṣaṇāt .. 67.18 ..
6.3.d:
यस्य मूर्धन्यहं देव पाणिना समुपस्पृशे .
देवदानवगन्धर्वो भस्मसाद्यातु तत्क्षणात् .. 67.18 ..
6.3.m: Upon whosever head, O god, I touch with my hand, / let him—be he god, dānava, or gandharva—turn to ashes that very moment."

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
yattvayā cintitaṃ kiṃcittatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ tava .
uttiṣṭha gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhavanaṃ prati dānava .. 67.19 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
यत्त्वया चिन्तितं किंचित्तत्सर्वं सफलं तव .
उत्तिष्ठ गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं भवनं प्रति दानव .. 67.19 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "Whatever you have imagined, let all that bear fruit for you. / Rise up, go quickly to your dwelling, O dānava."

6.3.s:
dānava uvāca -
sthīyatāṃ devadeveśa yāvajjñāsyāmi te varam .
yuṣmanmūrdhni nyase pāṇiṃ pratyayo me bhavedyathā .. 67.20 ..
6.3.d:
दानव उवाच -
स्थीयतां देवदेवेश यावज्ज्ञास्यामि ते वरम् .
युष्मन्मूर्ध्नि न्यसे पाणिं प्रत्ययो मे भवेद्यथा .. 67.20 ..
6.3.m: The dānava said: / "Wait, O Lord of the gods of gods, until I test your boon! / I shall place my hand upon your head, so that I may have confidence [in it]."

6.3.s:
tataścānantaraṃ devaścintayāno maheśvaraḥ .
na skando na harirbrahmā yaḥ kāryeṣu kṣamo'dhunā .. 67.21 ..
6.3.d:
ततश्चानन्तरं देवश्चिन्तयानो महेश्वरः .
न स्कन्दो न हरिर्ब्रह्मा यः कार्येषु क्षमोऽधुना .. 67.21 ..
6.3.m: Immediately after that, the god Maheśvara reflected: / "Neither Skanda, nor Hari, nor Brahmā is capable in this matter now."

6.3.s:
jñātvā caivāpadaṃ prāptāṃ devaḥ prārthayate vṛṣam .
anena saha pāpena yudhyasva sāmprataṃ kṣaṇam .. 67.22 ..
6.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा चैवापदं प्राप्तां देवः प्रार्थयते वृषम् .
अनेन सह पापेन युध्यस्व साम्प्रतं क्षणम् .. 67.22 ..
6.3.m: Recognizing that danger had arrived, the god beseeched the bull: / "Fight with this sinful one right now for a moment!"

6.3.s:
karaṃ prāsārayaddaityo devaṃ mūrdhni kila spṛśet .
lāṅgūlenāhato daityo viṣaṇṇaḥ patito bhuvi .. 67.23 ..
6.3.d:
करं प्रासारयद्दैत्यो देवं मूर्ध्नि किल स्पृशेत् .
लाङ्गूलेनाहतो दैत्यो विषण्णः पतितो भुवि .. 67.23 ..
6.3.m: The daitya stretched out his hand intending indeed to touch the god on the head. / Struck by the bull's tail, the daitya fell downcast to the ground.

6.3.s:
devastu dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ gataścaivomayā saha .
bhayabhīto nirīkṣeta grīvāṃ bhajya punaḥpunaḥ .. 67.24 ..
6.3.d:
देवस्तु दक्षिणामाशां गतश्चैवोमया सह .
भयभीतो निरीक्षेत ग्रीवां भज्य पुनःपुनः .. 67.24 ..
6.3.m: The god, however, went in the southern direction together with Umā. / Terrified with fear, he looked back again and again, turning his neck.

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ deve yuyudhe vṛṣabheṇa saḥ .
dvāvetau balināṃ śreṣṭhau yuyudhāte mahābalau .. 67.25 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं देवे युयुधे वृषभेण सः .
द्वावेतौ बलिनां श्रेष्ठौ युयुधाते महाबलौ .. 67.25 ..
6.3.m: When the god had gone out of sight, he fought with the bull. / Those two, the foremost among the strong, endowed with great strength, fought each other

6.3.s:
prahārairvajrasadṛśaiḥ kopena ghaṭikātrayam .
pāṇibhyāṃ na spṛśedyo vai vṛṣabhasya śirastathā .. 67.26 ..
6.3.d:
प्रहारैर्वज्रसदृशैः कोपेन घटिकात्रयम् .
पाणिभ्यां न स्पृशेद्यो वै वृषभस्य शिरस्तथा .. 67.26 ..
6.3.m: with blows like thunderbolts in anger for three ghaṭikās. / Indeed, he could not touch the bull's head with his hands.

6.3.s:
hatvā lāṅgūlapātena āgato vṛṣabhastadā .
utthitaścāpyasau daityo vrajate vṛṣapṛṣṭhataḥ .. 67.27 ..
6.3.d:
हत्वा लाङ्गूलपातेन आगतो वृषभस्तदा .
उत्थितश्चाप्यसौ दैत्यो व्रजते वृषपृष्ठतः .. 67.27 ..
6.3.m: Striking with a sweep of his tail, the bull then returned. / That daitya too got up and pursued the bull from behind.

6.3.s:
vāyuvegena samprāpto yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .
āgataṃ dānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣo vacanamabravīt .. 67.28 ..
6.3.d:
वायुवेगेन सम्प्राप्तो यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .
आगतं दानवं दृष्ट्वा वृषो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 67.28 ..
6.3.m: With the speed of wind he reached where the god Maheśvara was. / Seeing the Dānava coming, the bull spoke these words:

6.3.s:
āruhya pṛṣṭhe me deva śīghrameva hi gamyatām .
āruhya vṛṣabhaṃ devo jagāma comayā saha .. 67.29 ..
6.3.d:
आरुह्य पृष्ठे मे देव शीघ्रमेव हि गम्यताम् .
आरुह्य वृषभं देवो जगाम चोमया सह .. 67.29 ..
6.3.m: "Mounting my back, O god, you must go at once!" / Mounting the bull, the god went away together with Umā.

6.3.s:
nākaṃ prāptastato devo gataḥ śakrasya mandiram .
nātyajaddevapṛṣṭhaṃ tu dānavo baladarpitaḥ .. 67.30 ..
6.3.d:
नाकं प्राप्तस्ततो देवो गतः शक्रस्य मन्दिरम् .
नात्यजद्देवपृष्ठं तु दानवो बलदर्पितः .. 67.30 ..
6.3.m: Then the god reached heaven and went to Śakra's mansion; / yet the Dānava, arrogant with power, did not leave the god's trail.

6.3.s:
indralokaṃ parityajya brahmalokaṃ gatastadā .
yatrayatra vrajeddevo bhayātsaha divaukasaiḥ .. 67.31 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रलोकं परित्यज्य ब्रह्मलोकं गतस्तदा .
यत्रयत्र व्रजेद्देवो भयात्सह दिवौकसैः .. 67.31 ..
6.3.m: Leaving Indra's world, he then went to Brahmā's world. / Wherever the god went in fear together with the gods,

6.3.s:
apaśyattatra tatraiva pṛṣṭhe lagnaṃ tu dānavam .
sarvāṃllokān bhramitvā tu devo vismayamāgataḥ .. 67.32 ..
6.3.d:
अपश्यत्तत्र तत्रैव पृष्ठे लग्नं तु दानवम् .
सर्वांल्लोकान् भ्रमित्वा तु देवो विस्मयमागतः .. 67.32 ..
6.3.m: right there he saw the Dānava clinging to his back. / Having wandered through all the worlds, the god was filled with astonishment:

6.3.s:
na sthānaṃ vidyate kiṃcidyatra viśramyate kṣaṇam .
devadānavayostatra yuddhaṃ jñātvā sudāruṇam .. 67.33 ..
6.3.d:
न स्थानं विद्यते किंचिद्यत्र विश्रम्यते क्षणम् .
देवदानवयोस्तत्र युद्धं ज्ञात्वा सुदारुणम् .. 67.33 ..
6.3.m: "There is no place whatsoever where I may rest for a moment!" / Knowing that a dreadful conflict had arisen between the god and the Dānava,

6.3.s:
harṣitātmā munistatra ciraṃ nṛtyati nāradaḥ .
dhanyo'hamadya me janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam .. 67.34 ..
6.3.d:
हर्षितात्मा मुनिस्तत्र चिरं नृत्यति नारदः .
धन्योऽहमद्य मे जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम् .. 67.34 ..
6.3.m: the sage Nārada danced there for a long time, his heart rejoicing: / "Blessed am I today! My birth and my life have been well lived!"

6.3.s:
mahāntaṃ ca kaliṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtoṣaḥ paramo'bhavat .
devadānavayostatra yuddhaṃ tyaktvā ca nāradaḥ .. 67.35 ..
6.3.d:
महान्तं च कलिं दृष्ट्वा संतोषः परमोऽभवत् .
देवदानवयोस्तत्र युद्धं त्यक्त्वा च नारदः .. 67.35 ..
6.3.m: Beholding this great quarrel, his satisfaction was supreme. / Leaving the battle there between the god and the Dānava, Nārada

6.3.s:
ājagāma tato vipro yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .
dṛṣṭvā devo'tha taṃ vipraṃ pratipūjyābravīdidam .. 67.36 ..
6.3.d:
आजगाम ततो विप्रो यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .
दृष्ट्वा देवोऽथ तं विप्रं प्रतिपूज्याब्रवीदिदम् .. 67.36 ..
6.3.m: the brahmin then came to where the god Maheśvara was. / Seeing that brahmin, the god honored him and said this:

6.3.s:
bho nārada muniśreṣṭha jānīṣe keśavaṃ kvacit .
gatvā tatra ca śīghraṃ tvaṃ keśavāya nivedaya .. 67.37 ..
6.3.d:
भो नारद मुनिश्रेष्ठ जानीषे केशवं क्वचित् .
गत्वा तत्र च शीघ्रं त्वं केशवाय निवेदय .. 67.37 ..
6.3.m: "O Nārada, best of sages, do you know where Keśava is? / Go there quickly and report to Keśava!"

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
devadānavasiddhānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām .
sarveṣāmeva deveśo harate dhruvamāpadam .. 67.38 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
देवदानवसिद्धानां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् .
सर्वेषामेव देवेशो हरते ध्रुवमापदम् .. 67.38 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / "Of the gods, Dānavas, siddhas, Gandharvas, serpents, and rākṣasas— / of all of them, the Lord of gods surely removes distress.

6.3.s:
asaṃbhāvyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ manasāpi na cintayet .
īdṛśīṃ naiva budhyāmi āpadaṃ ca vibho tava .. 67.39 ..
6.3.d:
असंभाव्यं न वक्तव्यं मनसापि न चिन्तयेत् .
ईदृशीं नैव बुध्यामि आपदं च विभो तव .. 67.39 ..
6.3.m: This is unthinkable; it should not be spoken, nor should one even imagine it in mind. / I cannot comprehend such distress of yours, O Lord!"

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
gaccha nārada śīghraṃ tvaṃ yatra devo janārdanaḥ .
viditaṃ ca tvayā sarvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ dānavena tu .. 67.40 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
गच्छ नारद शीघ्रं त्वं यत्र देवो जनार्दनः .
विदितं च त्वया सर्वं यत्कृतं दानवेन तु .. 67.40 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "Go quickly, Nārada, to where the god Janārdana is. / All that has been done by the Dānava is known to you.

6.3.s:
avadhyo dānavo hyeṣa sendrairapi marudgaṇaiḥ .
gatvā tu keśavaṃ devaṃ nivedaya mahāmune .. 67.41 ..
6.3.d:
अवध्यो दानवो ह्येष सेन्द्रैरपि मरुद्गणैः .
गत्वा तु केशवं देवं निवेदय महामुने .. 67.41 ..
6.3.m: Indeed, this Dānava cannot be slain even by the hosts of Maruts led by Indra. / Having gone to the god Keśava, report it, O great sage!"

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
na tu gacchāmyahaṃ deva suptaḥ kṣīrodadhau sukhī .
keśavaḥ preraṇe hyeṣāmādeśo dīyatāṃ prabho .. 67.42 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
न तु गच्छाम्यहं देव सुप्तः क्षीरोदधौ सुखी .
केशवः प्रेरणे ह्येषामादेशो दीयतां प्रभो .. 67.42 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / "I will not go, O god! Sleeping happily in the Ocean of Milk, / Keśava is resting; give an order to dispatch others, O Lord!

6.3.s:
mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā rājānaṃ ca tathā prabhum .
guruṃ caivāditaḥ kṛtvā śayānaṃ na prabodhayet .. 67.43 ..
6.3.d:
मात्रा स्वस्रा दुहित्रा वा राजानं च तथा प्रभुम् .
गुरुं चैवादितः कृत्वा शयानं न प्रबोधयेत् .. 67.43 ..
6.3.m: Whether by mother, sister, or daughter, likewise a king and a master, / and beginning with a guru—one should not awaken one who is sleeping."

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
yadi kvacidagāreṣu vahnirutpadyate mahān .
nidhanaṃ yānti tatrasthā yadbudhyerannasūrayaḥ .. 67.44 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
यदि क्वचिदगारेषु वह्निरुत्पद्यते महान् .
निधनं यान्ति तत्रस्था यद्बुध्येरन्नसूरयः .. 67.44 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "If a great fire breaks out somewhere in a house, / those inside meet their end if the unwise do not wake up."

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
śīghraṃ gaccha mahādeva ātmānaṃ rakṣa suprabho .
gacchāmyahaṃ na sandeho yatra devo janārdanaḥ .. 67.45 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
शीघ्रं गच्छ महादेव आत्मानं रक्ष सुप्रभो .
गच्छाम्यहं न सन्देहो यत्र देवो जनार्दनः .. 67.45 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / "Go quickly, Mahādeva; protect yourself, O glorious lord! / I am going, there is no doubt, to where the god Janārdana is."

6.3.s:
tato nandimahākālau stambhahastau bhayānakau .
jaghnaturdānavaṃ tatra mudgarādibhirāyudhaiḥ .. 67.46 ..
6.3.d:
ततो नन्दिमहाकालौ स्तम्भहस्तौ भयानकौ .
जघ्नतुर्दानवं तत्र मुद्गरादिभिरायुधैः .. 67.46 ..
6.3.m: Then Nandin and Mahākāla, terrifying with clubs in their hands, / struck the Dānava there with weapons such as maces.

6.3.s:
trayo'pi ca mahākāyāḥ saptatālapramāṇakāḥ .
na śamo jāyate teṣāṃ yudhyatāṃ ca parasparam .. 67.47 ..
6.3.d:
त्रयोऽपि च महाकायाः सप्ततालप्रमाणकाः .
न शमो जायते तेषां युध्यतां च परस्परम् .. 67.47 ..
6.3.m: All three had huge bodies, the height of seven palm trees; / no peace arose among them as they fought one another.

6.3.s:
tataścānantaraṃ vipro'gacchattaṃ keśavaṃ prati .
suptaṃ kṣīrārṇave'paśyaccheṣaparyaṅkasaṃsthitam .. 67.48 ..
6.3.d:
ततश्चानन्तरं विप्रोऽगच्छत्तं केशवं प्रति .
सुप्तं क्षीरार्णवेऽपश्यच्छेषपर्यङ्कसंस्थितम् .. 67.48 ..
6.3.m: Immediately after that, the brahmin went to Keśava. / He saw him sleeping in the Ocean of Milk, resting on the couch of Śeṣa,

6.3.s:
lakṣmyā pādayugaṃ gṛhya ūrūpari niveśitam .
apsarogīyamānaṃ tu bhaktyānamya ca keśavam .. 67.49 ..
6.3.d:
लक्ष्म्या पादयुगं गृह्य ऊरूपरि निवेशितम् .
अप्सरोगीयमानं तु भक्त्यानम्य च केशवम् .. 67.49 ..
6.3.m: his two feet held by Lakṣmī and placed upon her thighs, / being sung to by apsarases; and having bowed down to Keśava with devotion, [he said:]

6.3.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam .
utthāpayasva deveśaṃ lakṣmi tvamaviśaṅkitā .. 67.50 ..
6.3.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं च सुजीवितम् .
उत्थापयस्व देवेशं लक्ष्मि त्वमविशङ्किता .. 67.50 ..
6.3.m: "Today my birth is fruitful, and my life is well lived! / Awaken the Lord of gods, O Lakṣmī, without hesitation!"

6.3.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā padāṅguṣṭhaṃ vyamardayat .
nāradastiṣṭhate dvāri uttiṣṭha madhusūdana .. 67.51 ..
6.3.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पदाङ्गुष्ठं व्यमर्दयत् .
नारदस्तिष्ठते द्वारि उत्तिष्ठ मधुसूदन .. 67.51 ..
6.3.m: Hearing Nārada's words, she pressed his big toe: / "Nārada is standing at the door; arise, O Madhusūdana!"

6.3.s:
devo'pi nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ harṣamupāgataḥ .
svāgataṃ tu muniśreṣṭha suprabhātādya śarvarī .. 67.52 ..
6.3.d:
देवोऽपि नारदं दृष्ट्वा परं हर्षमुपागतः .
स्वागतं तु मुनिश्रेष्ठ सुप्रभाताद्य शर्वरी .. 67.52 ..
6.3.m: Seeing Nārada, the god too attained supreme joy: / "Welcome, best of sages! The night has become a beautiful dawn today."

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
adya me saphalaṃ deva prabhātaṃ tava darśanāt .
kuśalaṃ ca na devānāṃ śīghramuttiṣṭha gamyatām .. 67.53 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
अद्य मे सफलं देव प्रभातं तव दर्शनात् .
कुशलं च न देवानां शीघ्रमुत्तिष्ठ गम्यताम् .. 67.53 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / "Today my dawn is fruitful, O god, from your darśana. / But there is no welfare for the gods; arise quickly and let us go!"

6.3.s:
śrīviṣṇuruvāca -
brahmā cendraśca rudraśca ye cānye tu marudgaṇāḥ .
āpadaḥ kāraṇaṃ yacca tatsamākhyātumarhasi .. 67.54 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीविष्णुरुवाच -
ब्रह्मा चेन्द्रश्च रुद्रश्च ये चान्ये तु मरुद्गणाः .
आपदः कारणं यच्च तत्समाख्यातुमर्हसि .. 67.54 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Viṣṇu said: / "Brahmā, Indra, Rudra, and whatever other hosts of Maruts there are— / you ought to explain the cause of their distress."

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
dānavena mahātīvraṃ tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam .
rudreṇa ca varo datto bhasmatvaṃ manasepsitam .. 67.55 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
दानवेन महातीव्रं तपस्तप्तं सुदारुणम् .
रुद्रेण च वरो दत्तो भस्मत्वं मनसेप्सितम् .. 67.55 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / "An exceedingly severe and dreadful austerity was performed by the Dānava, / and Rudra granted a boon: the turning to ashes [of anyone], as desired in his mind.

6.3.s:
varadānabalenaiva sa devaṃ hantumarhati .
īdṛśaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ jñātvā nīto devo'maraiḥ saha .. 67.56 ..
6.3.d:
वरदानबलेनैव स देवं हन्तुमर्हति .
ईदृशं चेष्टितं ज्ञात्वा नीतो देवोऽमरैः सह .. 67.56 ..
6.3.m: By the power of that boon alone he is fit to kill the god. / Learning of such an attempt, the god was led away along with the immortals."

6.3.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā jagāma samunirhariḥ .
dṛṣṭvā devastamīśānaṃ gacchantaṃ diśamuttarām .. 67.57 ..
6.3.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा जगाम समुनिर्हरिः .
दृष्ट्वा देवस्तमीशानं गच्छन्तं दिशमुत्तराम् .. 67.57 ..
6.3.m: Hearing Nārada's words, Hari went along with the sage. / The god saw Īśāna going toward the northern direction.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ ca rudro'tha pariṣvajya punaḥpunaḥ .
namaskṛtya jagannāthaṃ devaṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ .. 67.58 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा देवं च रुद्रोऽथ परिष्वज्य पुनःपुनः .
नमस्कृत्य जगन्नाथं देवं च मधुसूदनः .. 67.58 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the god, Rudra embraced him again and again; / and Madhusūdana bowed down to the god, the Lord of the universe.

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
bhayasya kāraṇaṃ deva kathyatāṃ ca maheśvara .
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ preṣayeyaṃ yamālayam .. 67.59 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
भयस्य कारणं देव कथ्यतां च महेश्वर .
देवदानवयक्षाणां प्रेषयेयं यमालयम् .. 67.59 ..
6.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / "Let the cause of fear be told, O god, O Maheśvara! / Whether of gods, Dānavas, or yakṣas, I will send them to Yama's abode.

6.3.s:
lalāṭe ca kṛto dharmo yuṣmākaṃ ca maheśvara .
chittvā śirastathāṅgāni indriyāṇi na saṃśayaḥ .. 67.60 ..
6.3.d:
ललाटे च कृतो धर्मो युष्माकं च महेश्वर .
छित्त्वा शिरस्तथाङ्गानि इन्द्रियाणि न संशयः .. 67.60 ..
6.3.m: The duty was placed upon your forehead, O Maheśvara, / after cutting off the head, the limbs, and the senses, no doubt."

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
nāsti saukhyaṃ ca mūrkheṣu nāsti saukhyaṃ ca rogiṣu .
parādhīnena saukhyaṃ tu strījite ca viśeṣataḥ .. 67.61 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
नास्ति सौख्यं च मूर्खेषु नास्ति सौख्यं च रोगिषु .
पराधीनेन सौख्यं तु स्त्रीजिते च विशेषतः .. 67.61 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "There is no happiness among fools, nor is there happiness among the sick; / there is no happiness for one subject to another, and especially for one conquered by a woman.

6.3.s:
strījitena mayā viṣṇo varo dattastu dānave .
yasya mūrdhni nyasetpāṇiṃ sa bhavedbhasmapuṃjavat .. 67.62 ..
6.3.d:
