स्त्रीजितेन मया विष्णो वरो दत्तस्तु दानवे .
यस्य मूर्ध्नि न्यसेत्पाणिं स भवेद्भस्मपुंजवत् .. 67.62 ..
6.3.m: Conquered by a woman, O Viṣṇu, a boon was granted by me to the Dānava: / 'On whose head he places his hand, that one shall become like a heap of ashes.'

6.3.s:
ajeyaścāmaraścaiva mayā hyuktaḥ sa keśava .
hantumicchati māṃ pāpa upāyastava vidyate .. 67.63 ..
6.3.d:
अजेयश्चामरश्चैव मया ह्युक्तः स केशव .
हन्तुमिच्छति मां पाप उपायस्तव विद्यते .. 67.63 ..
6.3.m: He was declared by me to be invincible and immortal, O Keśava. / That sinful one wishes to kill me; do you have a remedy?"

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
gacchantu amarāḥ sarve yuṣmābhiḥ saha śaṅkara .
upāyaṃ sarjayāmyadya vadhārthaṃ dānavasya ca .. 67.64 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
गच्छन्तु अमराः सर्वे युष्माभिः सह शङ्कर .
उपायं सर्जयाम्यद्य वधार्थं दानवस्य च .. 67.64 ..
6.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / "Let all the immortals go together with you, O Śaṅkara. / Today I shall devise a means for slaying the Dānava.

6.3.s:
revāyāśca taṭe tiṣṭha deva tvamamaraiḥ saha .
kālakṣepo na kartavyo gamyatāṃ tvaritaṃ prabho .. 67.65 ..
6.3.d:
रेवायाश्च तटे तिष्ठ देव त्वममरैः सह .
कालक्षेपो न कर्तव्यो गम्यतां त्वरितं प्रभो .. 67.65 ..
6.3.m: Stay on the bank of the Revā, O god, together with the immortals. / No delay should be made; go swiftly, O Lord!

6.3.s:
dakṣiṇā yatra gaṅgā ca revā caiva mahānadī .
yatrayatra ca dṛśyeta prācī caiva sarasvatī .. 67.66 ..
6.3.d:
दक्षिणा यत्र गङ्गा च रेवा चैव महानदी .
यत्रयत्र च दृश्येत प्राची चैव सरस्वती .. 67.66 ..
6.3.m: Where the southern Gaṅgā and the great river Revā are, / and wherever the eastward-flowing Sarasvatī is seen,

6.3.s:
tatsamaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ na martye caiva dṛśyate .
snānaṃ ye tatra kurvanti dānaṃ caiva tu bhaktitaḥ .. 67.67 ..
6.3.d:
तत्समं च महातीर्थं न मर्त्ये चैव दृश्यते .
स्नानं ये तत्र कुर्वन्ति दानं चैव तु भक्तितः .. 67.67 ..
6.3.m: no great sacred ford equal to that is seen among mortals. / Those who perform ritual ablution and donation there with devotion,

6.3.s:
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
etattīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 67.68 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं नश्यते नात्र संशयः .
एतत्तीर्थं महापुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 67.68 ..
6.3.m: their sin committed in seven lifetimes is destroyed, there is no doubt of this. / This sacred ford is of great merit, destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
gamyatāṃ tatra deveśa luṅkeśaṃ tvaṃ sahāmaraiḥ .
viṣṇostu vacanādeva praviṣṭo hradamuttamam .. 67.69 ..
6.3.d:
गम्यतां तत्र देवेश लुङ्केशं त्वं सहामरैः .
विष्णोस्तु वचनादेव प्रविष्टो ह्रदमुत्तमम् .. 67.69 ..
6.3.m: Go there, O Lord of gods, to Luṅkeśa together with the immortals." / At the very word of Viṣṇu, [the god] entered the excellent pool.

6.3.s:
ratiṃ sumahatīṃ cakre saha tatra marudgaṇaiḥ .
tataścānantaraṃ devo māyāṃ kṛtvā hyanekadhā .. 67.70 ..
6.3.d:
रतिं सुमहतीं चक्रे सह तत्र मरुद्गणैः .
ततश्चानन्तरं देवो मायां कृत्वा ह्यनेकधा .. 67.70 ..
6.3.m: He took great delight there together with the host of Maruts. / Then, right after that, the god created illusions of many kinds. 67.70

6.3.s:
vasantamāsaṃ saṃsṛjya udyānavanaśobhitam .
aśokairbakulaiścaiva brahmavṛkṣaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ .. 67.71 ..
6.3.d:
वसन्तमासं संसृज्य उद्यानवनशोभितम् .
अशोकैर्बकुलैश्चैव ब्रह्मवृक्षैः सुशोभनैः .. 67.71 ..
6.3.m: Bringing forth the spring month, beautified with pleasure gardens and forests, / with aśoka trees, bakulas, and very lovely brahmavṛkṣas, 67.71

6.3.s:
śrīvṛkṣaiśca kapitthaiśca śirīṣairrājacampakaiḥ .
śrīphalaiśca tathā tālaiḥ kadambodumbaraistathā .. 67.72 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीवृक्षैश्च कपित्थैश्च शिरीषैर्राजचम्पकैः .
श्रीफलैश्च तथा तालैः कदम्बोदुम्बरैस्तथा .. 67.72 ..
6.3.m: with śrīvṛkṣas, kapitīhas, śirīṣas, and rājacampakas, / with bilvas, and likewise palmyra palms, kadambas, and udumbaras, 67.72

6.3.s:
aśvatthādidrumaiścaiva nānāvṛkṣairanekaśaḥ .
nānāpuṣpaiḥ sugandhāḍhyairbhramaraiśca nināditam .. 67.73 ..
6.3.d:
अश्वत्थादिद्रुमैश्चैव नानावृक्षैरनेकशः .
नानापुष्पैः सुगन्धाढ्यैर्भ्रमरैश्च निनादितम् .. 67.73 ..
6.3.m: with sacred figs and various other trees in abundance, / rich in fragrant flowers of various kinds, and made resonant with bees. 67.73

6.3.s:
tasminmadhye mahāvṛkṣo nyagrodhaśca suśobhanaḥ .
bahupakṣisamāyuktaḥ kokilārāvanāditaḥ .. 67.74 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिन्मध्ये महावृक्षो न्यग्रोधश्च सुशोभनः .
बहुपक्षिसमायुक्तः कोकिलारावनादितः .. 67.74 ..
6.3.m: In the midst of that was a great, very lovely banyan tree, / filled with many birds and echoing with the cries of cuckoos. 67.74

6.3.s:
kṛṣṇena ca kṛtaṃ tasminkanyārūpaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt .
na tasyāḥ sadṛśī kanyā trailokye sacarācare .. 67.75 ..
6.3.d:
कृष्णेन च कृतं तस्मिन्कन्यारूपं च तत्क्षणात् .
न तस्याः सदृशी कन्या त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे .. 67.75 ..
6.3.m: And there Kṛṣṇa assumed in an instant the form of a maiden; / in the three worlds, with moving and unmoving beings, there was no maiden equal to her. 67.75

6.3.s:
anyāśca kanyakāḥ sapta surūpāḥ śubhalocanāḥ .
divyarūpadharāḥ sarvā divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ .. 67.76 ..
6.3.d:
अन्याश्च कन्यकाः सप्त सुरूपाः शुभलोचनाः .
दिव्यरूपधराः सर्वा दिव्याभरणभूषिताः .. 67.76 ..
6.3.m: And there were seven other maidens, shapely and fair-eyed, / all bearing celestial forms and adorned with celestial ornaments, 67.76

6.3.s:
pumāṃsamabhikāṅkṣantyo yadyekaḥ kāmayetstriyaḥ .
mauktikairratnamāṇikyairvaiḍūryaiśca suśobhanaiḥ .. 67.77 ..
6.3.d:
पुमांसमभिकाङ्क्षन्त्यो यद्येकः कामयेत्स्त्रियः .
मौक्तिकैर्रत्नमाणिक्यैर्वैडूर्यैश्च सुशोभनैः .. 67.77 ..
6.3.m: desiring a man, if one were to desire women. / With pearls, precious jewels, rubies, and very lovely beryls, 67.77

6.3.s:
kāmahāraiśca vaṃśaiśca baddho hindolakaḥ kṛtaḥ .
ārūḍhāśca mahākanyā gāyante susvaraṃ tadā .. 67.78 ..
6.3.d:
कामहारैश्च वंशैश्च बद्धो हिन्दोलकः कृतः .
आरूढाश्च महाकन्या गायन्ते सुस्वरं तदा .. 67.78 ..
6.3.m: and with lovely garlands and bamboo poles, a swing was fashioned and fastened. / Having mounted it, the stately maidens then sang melodiously. 67.78

6.3.s:
mārutaḥ śītalo vāti vanaṃ spṛṣṭvā suśobhanam .
vātena prerito gandho dānavo ghrāṇapīḍitaḥ .. 67.79 ..
6.3.d:
मारुतः शीतलो वाति वनं स्पृष्ट्वा सुशोभनम् .
वातेन प्रेरितो गन्धो दानवो घ्राणपीडितः .. 67.79 ..
6.3.m: A cool breeze blew, touching the very lovely forest. / Urged by the wind, the scent struck the dānava's nostrils. 67.79

6.3.s:
tataḥ kusumagandhena vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .
āghrāya cedṛśaṃ puṇyaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ mayā .. 67.80 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कुसुमगन्धेन विस्मयं परमं गतः .
आघ्राय चेदृशं पुण्यं न दृष्टं न श्रुतं मया .. 67.80 ..
6.3.m: Then, having smelled the fragrance of the blossoms, he was filled with supreme wonder: / 'Having smelled such holy scent, the like of which I have never seen or heard before!' 67.80

6.3.s:
vane cintayataḥ kiṃciddhvanigītaṃ suśobhanam .
gītasya ca dhvaniṃ śrutvā mohito māyayā hareḥ .. 67.81 ..
6.3.d:
वने चिन्तयतः किंचिद्ध्वनिगीतं सुशोभनम् .
गीतस्य च ध्वनिं श्रुत्वा मोहितो मायया हरेः .. 67.81 ..
6.3.m: As he was pondering something in the forest, there came a very beautiful sound of singing. / Having heard the sound of the song, he was enchanted by the illusion of Hari. 67.81

6.3.s:
vyādhasyaiva mahākūṭe patanti ca yathā mṛgāḥ .
kālaspṛṣṭastathā kṛṣṇe patitaśca narādhipa .. 67.82 ..
6.3.d:
व्याधस्यैव महाकूटे पतन्ति च यथा मृगाः .
कालस्पृष्टस्तथा कृष्णे पतितश्च नराधिप .. 67.82 ..
6.3.m: Just as deer fall into the great snare of a hunter, / so, touched by death, he fell into [the snare of] Kṛṣṇa, O king. 67.82

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ ca tāṃ daityo mūrcchayā patito bhuvi .
patitena tu dṛṣṭaikā kanyā vaṭatale sthitā .. 67.83 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा कन्यां च तां दैत्यो मूर्च्छया पतितो भुवि .
पतितेन तु दृष्टैका कन्या वटतले स्थिता .. 67.83 ..
6.3.m: Having seen that maiden, the daitya fell in a swoon to the ground. / Having fallen, he beheld that single maiden standing at the foot of the banyan tree. 67.83

6.3.s:
āsyaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu nārīṇāṃ punaḥ kāmena pīḍitaḥ .
gṛhītvā hemadaṇḍaṃ tu tāṃ pātayitumicchati .. 67.84 ..
6.3.d:
आस्यं दृष्ट्वा तु नारीणां पुनः कामेन पीडितः .
गृहीत्वा हेमदण्डं तु तां पातयितुमिच्छति .. 67.84 ..
6.3.m: Having looked upon the face of the women, he was once again afflicted with passion. / Grasping a golden rod, he wished to bring her down. 67.84

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
mā mānusparśayatvaṃ hi kumāryahaṃ kulottama .
bho muñca muñca māṃ śīghraṃ yāvadgacchāmyahaṃ gṛham .. 67.85 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
मा मानुस्पर्शयत्वं हि कुमार्यहं कुलोत्तम .
भो मुञ्च मुञ्च मां शीघ्रं यावद्गच्छाम्यहं गृहम् .. 67.85 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / 'Do not touch me! I am an unmarried girl, O best of your lineage. / Hey, let me go, let me go quickly, so that I may go home!' 67.85

6.3.s:
dānava uvāca -
ahaṃ vivāhamicchāmi tvayā saha suśobhane .
bhūpṛṣṭhe sakale rājñī bhavasyevaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 67.86 ..
6.3.d:
दानव उवाच -
अहं विवाहमिच्छामि त्वया सह सुशोभने .
भूपृष्ठे सकले राज्ञी भवस्येवं न संशयः .. 67.86 ..
6.3.m: The dānava said: / 'I desire marriage with you, O very lovely one. / You will surely become the queen over the entire face of the earth, there is no doubt.' 67.86

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
pitā rakṣati kaumārye bhartā rakṣati yauvane .
putro rakṣati vṛddhatve na strī svātantryamarhati .. 67.87 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
पिता रक्षति कौमार्ये भर्ता रक्षति यौवने .
पुत्रो रक्षति वृद्धत्वे न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति .. 67.87 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / 'A father protects in childhood, a husband protects in youth, / a son protects in old age; a woman does not deserve independence. 67.87

6.3.s:
na svātantryaṃ mamaivāsti utpannāhaṃ mahatkule .
yācyastu matpitā bhrātā mātāpi hi tathaiva ca .. 67.88 ..
6.3.d:
न स्वातन्त्र्यं ममैवास्ति उत्पन्नाहं महत्कुले .
याच्यस्तु मत्पिता भ्राता मातापि हि तथैव च .. 67.88 ..
6.3.m: I have no independence of my own; I was born in a noble family. / My father must be asked, as must my brother and my mother too.' 67.88

6.3.s:
dānava uvāca -
yadi māṃ necchase tvadya svātantryaṃ nāvalambase .
mamāpi ca tadā hatyā satyaṃ ca śubhalocane .. 67.89 ..
6.3.d:
दानव उवाच -
यदि मां नेच्छसे त्वद्य स्वातन्त्र्यं नावलम्बसे .
ममापि च तदा हत्या सत्यं च शुभलोचने .. 67.89 ..
6.3.m: The dānava said: / 'If you do not desire me today and do not assert your independence, / then I will surely kill myself, truly, O fair-eyed one.' 67.89

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
viśvāso naiva kartavyo yādṛśe tādṛśe nare .
narāḥ strīṣu vicitrāśca lampaṭāḥ kāmamohitāḥ .. 67.90 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
विश्वासो नैव कर्तव्यो यादृशे तादृशे नरे .
नराः स्त्रीषु विचित्राश्च लम्पटाः काममोहिताः .. 67.90 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / 'Trust should never be placed in just any man. / Men are treacherous towards women, dissolute and infatuated with passion. 67.90

6.3.s:
pariṇīya tu māṃ tvaṃ hi bhuṅkṣva bhogānmayā saha .
janmanāśo bhavetpaścānna tvaṃ nānyo bhavenmama .. 67.91 ..
6.3.d:
परिणीय तु मां त्वं हि भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान्मया सह .
जन्मनाशो भवेत्पश्चान्न त्वं नान्यो भवेन्मम .. 67.91 ..
6.3.m: Only after having married me may you enjoy pleasures with me. / If my life were to end afterwards, there would be neither you nor any other for me. 67.91

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇī kṣatriṇī vaiśī śūdrī yāvattathaiva ca .
dvitīyo na bhavedbhartā ekākī ceha janmani .. 67.92 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणी क्षत्रिणी वैशी शूद्री यावत्तथैव च .
द्वितीयो न भवेद्भर्ता एकाकी चेह जन्मनि .. 67.92 ..
6.3.m: Whether a brahmin woman, a kṣatriya woman, a vaiśya woman, or even a śūdra woman, / she should not have a second husband in this life, remaining faithful to one.' 67.92

6.3.s:
dānava uvāca -
yattvayā gaditaṃ vākyaṃ tanmayā dhāritaṃ hṛdi .
pratyayaṃ me kuruṣvādya yatte manasi rocate .. 67.93 ..
6.3.d:
दानव उवाच -
यत्त्वया गदितं वाक्यं तन्मया धारितं हृदि .
प्रत्ययं मे कुरुष्वाद्य यत्ते मनसि रोचते .. 67.93 ..
6.3.m: The dānava said: / 'Whatever word you have spoken, I have taken it to heart. / Give me an oath today, whatever pleases your mind.' 67.93

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
jānīṣva gopakanyāṃ māṃ krīḍāmi sakhibhiḥ saha .
asmatkuleṣu yaddivyaṃ tatkuruṣva yathāvidhi .. 67.94 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
जानीष्व गोपकन्यां मां क्रीडामि सखिभिः सह .
अस्मत्कुलेषु यद्दिव्यं तत्कुरुष्व यथाविधि .. 67.94 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / 'Know me to be a cowherd's daughter; I am playing with my friends. / Whatever is the ordeal in our families, perform that according to rule. 67.94

6.3.s:
na taddivyaṃ kule'smākaṃ viṣaṃ kośaṃ na tattulā .
gopānvayeṣu sarveṣu hastaḥ śirasi dīyate .. 67.95 ..
6.3.d:
न तद्दिव्यं कुलेऽस्माकं विषं कोशं न तत्तुला .
गोपान्वयेषु सर्वेषु हस्तः शिरसि दीयते .. 67.95 ..
6.3.m: In our family, poison is not the ordeal, nor the sacred water, nor the balance. / Among all cowherd lineages, a hand is placed upon the head.' 67.95

6.3.s:
kāmāndhenaiva rājendra nikṣipto mastake karaḥ .
tatkṣaṇādbhasmasādbhūto dagdhastṛṇacayo yathā .. 67.96 ..
6.3.d:
कामान्धेनैव राजेन्द्र निक्षिप्तो मस्तके करः .
तत्क्षणाद्भस्मसाद्भूतो दग्धस्तृणचयो यथा .. 67.96 ..
6.3.m: Blinded by desire, O best of kings, his hand was placed upon his head. / In an instant he was reduced to ashes, burned like a heap of straw. 67.96

6.3.s:
keśavopari devaistu puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ śubhā kṛtā .
hṛṣṭāḥ sarve'gamandevāḥ svasthānaṃ vigatajvarāḥ .. 67.97 ..
6.3.d:
केशवोपरि देवैस्तु पुष्पवृष्टिः शुभा कृता .
हृष्टाः सर्वेऽगमन्देवाः स्वस्थानं विगतज्वराः .. 67.97 ..
6.3.m: An auspicious shower of flowers was made upon Keśava by the gods. / Delighted, all the gods went to their own abode, freed from distress. 67.97

6.3.s:
kṣīrodaṃ keśavo gacchatkālapṛṣṭhe nipātite .
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā caritaṃ dānavasya ca .. 67.98 ..
6.3.d:
क्षीरोदं केशवो गच्छत्कालपृष्ठे निपातिते .
य इदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या चरितं दानवस्य च .. 67.98 ..
6.3.m: Keśava went to the Milk Ocean when Kālapṛṣṭha had been struck down. / Whoever hears this deed of the dānava with devotion 67.98

6.3.s:
sa jayī jāyate nityaṃ śaṅkarasya vaco yathā .
etasmātkāraṇādrājaṃlliṅgeśvaramiti śrutam .. 67.99 ..
6.3.d:
स जयी जायते नित्यं शङ्करस्य वचो यथा .
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजंल्लिङ्गेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् .. 67.99 ..
6.3.m: becomes ever victorious, according to the word of Śaṅkara. / For this reason, O king, it is renowned as Liṅgeśvara. 67.99

6.3.s:
līnaṃ ca pātakaṃ yasmātsnānamātreṇa naśyati .
tvagasthi śoṇitaṃ māṃsaṃ medaḥsnāyustathaiva ca .. 67.100 ..
6.3.d:
लीनं च पातकं यस्मात्स्नानमात्रेण नश्यति .
त्वगस्थि शोणितं मांसं मेदःस्नायुस्तथैव च .. 67.100 ..
6.3.m: And because sin dissolves [there], it is destroyed merely by bathing. / Skin, bone, blood, flesh, fat, and sinew, 67.100

6.3.s:
majjāśukragataṃ pāpaṃ naśyate janmakoṭijam .
luṅkeśvare mahārāja toyaṃ pibati bhaktitaḥ .. 67.101 ..
6.3.d:
मज्जाशुक्रगतं पापं नश्यते जन्मकोटिजम् .
लुङ्केश्वरे महाराज तोयं पिबति भक्तितः .. 67.101 ..
6.3.m: and the sin residing in the marrow and semen, born of ten million births, is destroyed / when one drinks the water with devotion at Luṅkeśvara, O great king. 67.101

6.3.s:
tribhiḥ prasṛtimātrābhiḥ pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā .
viśeṣeṇa caturdaśyāmubhau pakṣau tu cāṣṭamī .. 67.102 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिभिः प्रसृतिमात्राभिः पापं याति सहस्रधा .
विशेषेण चतुर्दश्यामुभौ पक्षौ तु चाष्टमी .. 67.102 ..
6.3.m: By merely three handfuls, sin disperses in a thousand ways, / especially on the fourteenth day and on the eighth day of both fortnights. 67.102

6.3.s:
upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā pitḥṇāṃ pāṇḍunandana .
uddhṛtāstena te sarve nārakīyāḥ pitāmahāḥ .. 67.103 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या पित्ःणां पाण्डुनन्दन .
उद्धृतास्तेन ते सर्वे नारकीयाः पितामहाः .. 67.103 ..
6.3.m: That person who, having fasted, [offers water] with devotion to the ancestors, O son of Pāṇḍu, / by him all those grandfathers who were in hell are delivered. 67.103

6.3.s:
kākiṇīṃ caiva yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage .
tena dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ kurukṣetrādikaṃ ca yat .. 67.104 ..
6.3.d:
काकिणीं चैव यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे .
तेन दानफलं सर्वं कुरुक्षेत्रादिकं च यत् .. 67.104 ..
6.3.m: And whoever gives even a single cowrie to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas, / by him is obtained the entire fruit of giving at Kurukṣetra and other places; 67.104

6.3.s:
prāptaṃ tu nānyathā rājañchaṅkaro vadate tvidam .
sparśaliṅgamidaṃ rājañchaṅkareṇa tu nirmitam .. 67.105 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्तं तु नान्यथा राजञ्छङ्करो वदते त्विदम् .
स्पर्शलिङ्गमिदं राजञ्छङ्करेण तु निर्मितम् .. 67.105 ..
6.3.m: it is obtained, not otherwise, O king; this is what Śaṅkara declares. / This touchstone liṅga was fashioned by Śaṅkara, O king. 67.105

6.3.s:
sparśamātre manuṣyāṇāṃ rudravāso'bhijāyate .
tena dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ kurukṣetrādikaṃ ca yat .. 67.106 ..
6.3.d:
स्पर्शमात्रे मनुष्याणां रुद्रवासोऽभिजायते .
तेन दानफलं सर्वं कुरुक्षेत्रादिकं च यत् .. 67.106 ..
6.3.m: By mere touch, an abode with Rudra is attained by men. / By it, the entire fruit of giving at Kurukṣetra and other places [is gained]. 67.106

6.3.s:
etasmātkāraṇādrājaṃllokapālāśca rakṣakāḥ .
durgā ca rakṣaṇe sṛṣṭā caturhastadharā śubhā .. 67.107 ..
6.3.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्राजंल्लोकपालाश्च रक्षकाः .
दुर्गा च रक्षणे सृष्टा चतुर्हस्तधरा शुभा .. 67.107 ..
6.3.m: For this reason, O king, the world-protectors are its guardians, / and the auspicious Durgā, bearing four arms, was created to protect it. 67.107

6.3.s:
dhanado lokapāleśo rakṣakaśceśvarasya ca .
rakṣati ca sadā kālaṃ grahavyāpārarūpataḥ .. 67.108 ..
6.3.d:
धनदो लोकपालेशो रक्षकश्चेश्वरस्य च .
रक्षति च सदा कालं ग्रहव्यापाररूपतः .. 67.108 ..
6.3.m: Kubera, the lord of the world-protectors, is also a guardian of Īśvara; / and he protects it at all times through the agency of the planets, 67.108

6.3.s:
putrabhrātṛsamārūpaiḥ svāmisambandharūpibhiḥ .
laṅkeśvaraṃ ca rājendra devairnādyāpi mucyate .. 67.109 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe luṅkeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 68
6.3.d:
पुत्रभ्रातृसमारूपैः स्वामिसम्बन्धरूपिभिः .
लङ्केश्वरं च राजेन्द्र देवैर्नाद्यापि मुच्यते .. 67.109 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे लुङ्केश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 68
6.3.m:
in forms resembling sons and brothers, having the nature of relations with their lord. / And Laṅkeśvara, O best of kings, is not abandoned by the gods even today. 67.109
Thus ends the sixty-seventh chapter, entitled the description of the māhātmya of Luṅkeśvara tīrtha, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Purāṇa, the collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 68

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
dhanadasya tu tattīrthaṃ tato gacchedyudhiṣṭhira .
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 68.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
धनदस्य तु तत्तीर्थं ततो गच्छेद्युधिष्ठिर .
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 68.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O Yudhiṣṭhira, to the sacred ford of Dhanada,
on the south bank of the Narmadā, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tatra prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
caitramāsatrayodaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe jitendriyaḥ .. 68.2 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वतीर्थफलं तत्र प्राप्यते नात्र संशयः .
चैत्रमासत्रयोदश्यां शुक्लपक्षे जितेन्द्रियः .. 68.2 ..
6.3.m:
The fruit of all sacred fords is obtained there, of this there is no doubt.
On the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Caitra, with senses restrained,

6.3.s:
upoṣya parayā bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .
pañcāmṛtena rājendra snāpayeddhanadaṃ budhaḥ .. 68.3 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्य परया भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .
पञ्चामृतेन राजेन्द्र स्नापयेद्धनदं बुधः .. 68.3 ..
6.3.m:
having fasted with supreme devotion, one should keep vigil at night.
O best of kings, the wise man should bathe Dhanada with the five nectars.

6.3.s:
dīpaṃ ghṛtena dātavyaṃ gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca kārayet .
prabhāte pūjayedviprānātmanaḥ śreya icchati .. 68.4 ..
6.3.d:
दीपं घृतेन दातव्यं गीतं वाद्यं च कारयेत् .
प्रभाते पूजयेद्विप्रानात्मनः श्रेय इच्छति .. 68.4 ..
6.3.m:
A lamp with ghee should be offered, and singing and instrumental music performed.
At dawn, one who desires welfare for oneself should worship brahmins,

6.3.s:
pratigrahasamarthāṃśca vidyāsiddhāntavādinaḥ .
śrautasmārtakriyāyuktān paradāraparāṅmukhān .. 68.5 ..
6.3.d:
प्रतिग्रहसमर्थांश्च विद्यासिद्धान्तवादिनः .
श्रौतस्मार्तक्रियायुक्तान् परदारपराङ्मुखान् .. 68.5 ..
6.3.m:
who are worthy of receiving gifts, who proclaim knowledge and established truths,
who are devoted to Vedic and traditional rituals, and who turn away from others' wives.

6.3.s:
pūjayedgohiraṇyena vastropānahabhojanaiḥ .
chatraśayyāpradānena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 68.6 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयेद्गोहिरण्येन वस्त्रोपानहभोजनैः .
छत्रशय्याप्रदानेन सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 68.6 ..
6.3.m:
He should worship them with cattle, gold, garments, shoes, and meals;
by the gift of an umbrella and a bed, the destruction of all sins takes place,

6.3.s:
trijanmajanitaṃ pāpaṃ varadasya prabhāvataḥ .
svargadaṃ durvinītānāṃ vinītānāṃ ca mokṣadam .. 68.7 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिजन्मजनितं पापं वरदस्य प्रभावतः .
स्वर्गदं दुर्विनीतानां विनीतानां च मोक्षदम् .. 68.7 ..
6.3.m:
even the sin produced in three births, through the power of the granter of boons.
It gives heaven to the undisciplined, and liberation to the disciplined.

6.3.s:
annadaṃ ca daridrāṇāṃ bhavejjanmanijanmani .
kulīnatvaṃ duḥkhahāniḥ svabhāvājāyate nare .. 68.8 ..
6.3.d:
अन्नदं च दरिद्राणां भवेज्जन्मनिजन्मनि .
कुलीनत्वं दुःखहानिः स्वभावाजायते नरे .. 68.8 ..
6.3.m:
It becomes a giver of food to the poor birth after birth;
noble birth and the destruction of misery naturally arise for a man.

6.3.s:
vyādhidhvaṃso bhavetteṣāṃ narmadodakasevanāt .
dhanadasya tu yastīrthe vidyādānaṃ prayacchati .. 68.9 ..
6.3.d:
व्याधिध्वंसो भवेत्तेषां नर्मदोदकसेवनात् .
धनदस्य तु यस्तीर्थे विद्यादानं प्रयच्छति .. 68.9 ..
6.3.m:
Destruction of disease occurs for them from serving the water of the Narmadā.
And whoever offers the gift of knowledge at the sacred ford of Dhanada,

6.3.s:
sa yāti bhāskare loke sarvavyādhivivarjite .
devadroṇīṃ ca tatraiva svaśaktyā pāṇḍunandana .. 68.10 ..
6.3.d:
स याति भास्करे लोके सर्वव्याधिविवर्जिते .
देवद्रोणीं च तत्रैव स्वशक्त्या पाण्डुनन्दन .. 68.10 ..
6.3.m:
he goes to the world of the sun, which is free of all disease.
And whoever, according to one's means, [organizes] a deity's procession right there, O son of Pāṇḍu,

6.3.s:
ye prakurvanti bhūyiṣṭhāṃ revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe .
te yānti śāṃkare loke sarvaduḥkhavivarjite .. 68.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhanadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 69
6.3.d:
ये प्रकुर्वन्ति भूयिष्ठां रेवाया दक्षिणे तटे .
ते यान्ति शांकरे लोके सर्वदुःखविवर्जिते .. 68.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे धनदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टषष्टितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 69
6.3.m:
and those who perform it abundantly on the south bank of the Revā,
they go to the world of Śaṅkara, which is free of all sorrow.
Thus ends the sixty-eighth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of Dhanadatīrtha," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 69

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra maṅgaleśvaramuttamam .
sthāpitaṃ bhūmiputreṇa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 69.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र मङ्गलेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
स्थापितं भूमिपुत्रेण लोकानां हितकाम्यया .. 69.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the excellent Maṅgaleśvara,
installed by the son of the earth out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.

6.3.s:
toṣitaḥ parayā bhaktyā śaṅkaraḥ śaśiśekharaḥ .
caturdaśyāṃ gururdevaḥ pratyakṣo maṅgaleśvaraḥ .. 69.2 ..
6.3.d:
तोषितः परया भक्त्या शङ्करः शशिशेखरः .
चतुर्दश्यां गुरुर्देवः प्रत्यक्षो मङ्गलेश्वरः .. 69.2 ..
6.3.m:
Śaṅkara, who bears the crescent moon on his crest, was pleased through supreme devotion.
On the fourteenth day, the guru, the lord, Maṅgaleśvara became visible [and said]:

6.3.s: brūhi putra varaṃ śubhraṃ taṃ te dāsyāmi maṅgala .. 69.3 ..
6.3.d: ब्रूहि पुत्र वरं शुभ्रं तं ते दास्यामि मङ्गल .. 69.3 ..
6.3.m: "Speak, O son, an auspicious boon; that I shall give to you, O Maṅgala."

6.3.s:
maṅgala uvāca -
prasādaṃ kuru me śambho pratijanmani śaṅkara .
tvadaṅgasvedasambhūto grahamadhye vasāmyaham .. 69.4 ..
6.3.d:
मङ्गल उवाच -
प्रसादं कुरु मे शम्भो प्रतिजन्मनि शङ्कर .
त्वदङ्गस्वेदसम्भूतो ग्रहमध्ये वसाम्यहम् .. 69.4 ..
6.3.m:
Maṅgala said:
"Be gracious to me, O Śambhu, birth after birth, O Śaṅkara!
Born of the sweat of your body, I dwell among the planets.

6.3.s:
tvatprasādena īśāna pūjyo'haṃ sarvadaivataiḥ .
kṛtārtho hyadya saṃjātastava darśanabhāṣaṇāt .. 69.5 ..
6.3.d:
त्वत्प्रसादेन ईशान पूज्योऽहं सर्वदैवतैः .
कृतार्थो ह्यद्य संजातस्तव दर्शनभाषणात् .. 69.5 ..
6.3.m:
By your grace, O Īśāna, I am worshipful to all deities.
Indeed, today I have achieved my goal from seeing and speaking with you.

6.3.s:
sthāne'smin devadeveśa mama nāmnā maheśvaraḥ .
evaṃ bhavatu te putretyuktvā cāntaradhīyata .. 69.6 ..
6.3.d:
स्थानेऽस्मिन् देवदेवेश मम नाम्ना महेश्वरः .
एवं भवतु ते पुत्रेत्युक्त्वा चान्तरधीयत .. 69.6 ..
6.3.m:
[May] Maheśvara [dwell] in this place by my name, O Lord of the gods of gods!"
Saying, "So be it for you, O son," he then disappeared.

6.3.s:
maṅgalo'pi mahātmā vai sthāpayitvā maheśvaram .
ātmayogabalenaiva śūlināpūjayattataḥ .. 69.7 ..
6.3.d:
मङ्गलोऽपि महात्मा वै स्थापयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
आत्मयोगबलेनैव शूलिनापूजयत्ततः .. 69.7 ..
6.3.m:
The noble Maṅgala, having installed Maheśvara,
then worshipped the bearer of the trident by the power of his own yoga.

6.3.s:
sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ liṅgaṃ nāmnā vai maṅgaleśvaram .
tatra tīrthe tu vai rājanbrāhmaṇānprīṇayetsudhīḥ .. 69.8 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वदुःखहरं लिङ्गं नाम्ना वै मङ्गलेश्वरम् .
तत्र तीर्थे तु वै राजन्ब्राह्मणान्प्रीणयेत्सुधीः .. 69.8 ..
6.3.m:
The liṅga, named indeed Maṅgaleśvara, removes all sorrow.
At that sacred ford, O king, the wise man should gratify brahmins

6.3.s:
sapatnīkānnṛpaśreṣṭha caturthyaṅgārake vrate .
patnībhartārasaṃyuktaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ śrotriyaṃ dvijam .. 69.9 ..
6.3.d:
सपत्नीकान्नृपश्रेष्ठ चतुर्थ्यङ्गारके व्रते .
पत्नीभर्तारसंयुक्तं विद्वांसं श्रोत्रियं द्विजम् .. 69.9 ..
6.3.m:
along with their wives, O best of kings, during the vow on a Tuesday fourth [tithi],
to a learned, Vedic scholar brahmin accompanied by his wife and husband.

6.3.s:
vratānte caiva gaurdhuryaiḥ śivamuddiśya dīyate .
prīyatāṃ me mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 69.10 ..
6.3.d:
व्रतान्ते चैव गौर्धुर्यैः शिवमुद्दिश्य दीयते .
प्रीयतां मे महादेवः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः .. 69.10 ..
6.3.m:
And at the end of the vow, a cow along with draft oxen is given dedicated to Śiva:
"May Mahādeva, whose emblem is the bull, be pleased along with his consort!"

6.3.s:
vastrayugmaṃ pradātavyaṃ lohitaṃ pāṇḍunandana .
dhūrvahau raktavarṇau ca śubhraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathaiva ca .. 69.11 ..
6.3.d:
वस्त्रयुग्मं प्रदातव्यं लोहितं पाण्डुनन्दन .
धूर्वहौ रक्तवर्णौ च शुभ्रं कृष्णं तथैव च .. 69.11 ..
6.3.m:
A pair of red garments should be given, O son of Pāṇḍu,
and two draft oxen that are red-colored, or white or black as well.

6.3.s:
chatraṃ śayyāṃ śubhāṃ caiva raktamālyānulepanam .
dātavyaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha viśuddhenāntarātmanā .. 69.12 ..
6.3.d:
छत्रं शय्यां शुभां चैव रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनम् .
दातव्यं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना .. 69.12 ..
6.3.m:
An umbrella, an auspicious bed, and red garlands and ointments
should be given, O best of Pāṇḍavas, with a purified inner soul.

6.3.s:
caturthyāṃ tu tathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ .
śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kartavyaṃ vittaśāṭhyena varjitaḥ .. 69.13 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्थ्यां तु तथाष्टम्यां पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः .
श्राद्धं तत्रैव कर्तव्यं वित्तशाठ्येन वर्जितः .. 69.13 ..
6.3.m:
On the fourth as well as on the eighth day of both fortnights, bright and dark,
a śrāddha should be performed right there, free from dishonesty regarding wealth.

6.3.s:
pretā bhavanti suprītā yugamekaṃ mahīpate .
saputro jāyate martyaḥ pratijanma nṛpottama .. 69.14 ..
6.3.d:
प्रेता भवन्ति सुप्रीता युगमेकं महीपते .
सपुत्रो जायते मर्त्यः प्रतिजन्म नृपोत्तम .. 69.14 ..
6.3.m:
The deceased spirits remain well-pleased for an entire yuga, O lord of the earth;
the mortal is born with sons in every birth, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
tasya tīrthasya bhāvena sarvāṅgaruciro nṛpa .
maṅgalaṃ bhavate vaṃśo nāśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit .. 69.15 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य तीर्थस्य भावेन सर्वाङ्गरुचिरो नृप .
मङ्गलं भवते वंशो नाशुभं विद्यते क्वचित् .. 69.15 ..
6.3.m:
Through the power of that sacred ford, O king, with all limbs handsome,
his lineage becomes auspicious, and inauspiciousness is never found anywhere.

6.3.s:
bhaktyā yaḥ kīrtayennityaṃ tasya pāpaṃ vyapohati .. 69.16 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 70
6.3.d:
भक्त्या यः कीर्तयेन्नित्यं तस्य पापं व्यपोहति .. 69.16 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 70
6.3.m:
Whoever constantly recites [this] with devotion, his sin is dispelled.
Thus ends the sixty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of Maṅgaleśvaratīrtha," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 70

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
raviṇā nirmitaṃ pārtha sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 70.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
रेवाया उत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
रविणा निर्मितं पार्थ सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 70.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the north bank of the Revā is a supremely beautiful sacred ford,
fashioned by Ravi, O son of Pṛthā, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
svāṃśena bhāskarastatra tiṣṭhate cottare taṭe .
sarvavyādhiharaḥ puṃsāṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ .. 70.2 ..
6.3.d:
स्वांशेन भास्करस्तत्र तिष्ठते चोत्तरे तटे .
सर्वव्याधिहरः पुंसां नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितः .. 70.2 ..
6.3.m:
The sun remains there on the northern bank by his own portion;
abiding at the Narmadā, he removes all disease for men.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃṣaṣṭhyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha hyaṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśīm .
snānaṃ yaḥ kārayenmartyaḥ śrāddhaṃ preteṣu bhaktitaḥ .
tasya pāpakṣayaḥ pārtha sūryaloke mahīyate .. 70.3 ..
6.3.d:
षष्ठ्यांषष्ठ्यां नृपश्रेष्ठ ह्यष्टम्यां च चतुर्दशीम् .
स्नानं यः कारयेन्मर्त्यः श्राद्धं प्रेतेषु भक्तितः .
तस्य पापक्षयः पार्थ सूर्यलोके महीयते .. 70.3 ..
6.3.m:
On every sixth, O best of kings, as well as on the eighth and the fourteenth,
whatever mortal takes a bath and performs a śrāddha for the deceased spirits with devotion,
his sin is destroyed, O son of Pṛthā, and he is honored in the world of the sun.

6.3.s:
tataḥ svargāccyutaḥ so'pi jāyate vimale kule .
dhanāḍhyo vyādhinirmukto jīvejjanmanijanmani .. 70.4 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 71
6.3.d:
ततः स्वर्गाच्च्युतः सोऽपि जायते विमले कुले .
धनाढ्यो व्याधिनिर्मुक्तो जीवेज्जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 70.4 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रवितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 71
6.3.m:
Then, having fallen from heaven, he too is born in an immaculate family;
wealthy and freed from disease, he lives birth after birth.
Thus ends the seventieth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of Ravitīrtha," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 71

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
kāmeśvaraṃ tataścānyacchṛṇu pāṇḍavasattama .
siddho yatra gaṇādhyakṣo gaurīputro mahābalaḥ .. 71.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
कामेश्वरं ततश्चान्यच्छृणु पाण्डवसत्तम .
सिद्धो यत्र गणाध्यक्षो गौरीपुत्रो महाबलः .. 71.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then hear of another [ford], Kāmeśvara, O best of Pāṇḍavas,
where the leader of the gaṇas, the mighty son of Gaurī, attained perfection.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhaktiyukto jitendriyaḥ .
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya dhūpanaivedyapūjanaiḥ .. 71.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या भक्तियुक्तो जितेन्द्रियः .
पञ्चामृतेन संस्नाप्य धूपनैवेद्यपूजनैः .. 71.2 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever, endowed with devotion, with senses restrained, at that sacred ford with devotion,
having bathed [the deity] with the five nectars, through worship with incense and food offerings,

6.3.s:
prasādya jagatāmīśaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .
aṣṭamyāṃ mārgaśīrṣasya tatra snātvā yudhiṣṭhira .. 71.3 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसाद्य जगतामीशं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .
अष्टम्यां मार्गशीर्षस्य तत्र स्नात्वा युधिष्ठिर .. 71.3 ..
6.3.m:
and having propitiated the Lord of the worlds, is released from all sins.
Having bathed there on the eighth day of Mārgaśīrṣa, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

6.3.s:
yo yena yajate tatra sa taṃ kāmamavāpnuyāt .. 71.4 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 72
6.3.d:
यो येन यजते तत्र स तं काममवाप्नुयात् .. 71.4 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कामेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 72
6.3.m:
whatever one sacrifices for there, that desire one shall obtain.
Thus ends the seventy-first chapter, entitled "The Description of the Greatness of Kāmeśvaratīrtha," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 72

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra maṇināgeśvaraṃ śubham .
uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .
sthāpitaṃ maṇināgena lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 72.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र मणिनागेश्वरं शुभम् .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .
स्थापितं मणिनागेन लोकानां हितकाम्यया .. 72.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the auspicious Maṇināgeśvara
on the north bank of the Narmadā, which destroys all sins,
installed by Maṇināga out of desire for the welfare of the worlds.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
āśīviṣeṇa sarpeṇa īśvarastoṣitaḥ katham .
kṣudrāḥ sarvasya lokasya bhayadā viṣaśālinaḥ .. 72.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आशीविषेण सर्पेण ईश्वरस्तोषितः कथम् .
क्षुद्राः सर्वस्य लोकस्य भयदा विषशालिनः .. 72.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How was Īśvara pleased by a venomous serpent?
They are vile, terrifying to the entire world, and full of poison.

6.3.s:
kathyatāṃ tāta me sarvaṃ pātakasyopaśāntidam .
mama santāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ duryodhanasamudbhavam .. 72.3 ..
6.3.d:
कथ्यतां तात मे सर्वं पातकस्योपशान्तिदम् .
मम सन्तापजं दुःखं दुर्योधनसमुद्भवम् .. 72.3 ..
6.3.m:
Tell me everything, father, which grants pacification of sin.
My suffering born of anguish, arisen from Duryodhana,

6.3.s:
karṇabhīṣmodbhavaṃ raudraṃ duḥkhaṃ pāñcālisambhavam .
tava vaktrāmbujaughena plāvitaṃ nirvṛtiṃ gataḥ .. 72.4 ..
6.3.d:
कर्णभीष्मोद्भवं रौद्रं दुःखं पाञ्चालिसम्भवम् .
तव वक्त्राम्बुजौघेन प्लावितं निर्वृतिं गतः .. 72.4 ..
6.3.m:
and the terrible suffering arisen from Karṇa and Bhīṣma, arisen on account of the princess of Pañcāla,
having been flooded by the flood from your lotus mouth, I have attained contentment.

6.3.s:
śrutvā tava mukhodgītāṃ kathāṃ vai pāpanāśinīm .
ayuktamidamasmākaṃ dvija kleśo na śāmyati .. 72.5 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तव मुखोद्गीतां कथां वै पापनाशिनीम् .
अयुक्तमिदमस्माकं द्विज क्लेशो न शाम्यति .. 72.5 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing the sin-destroying story sung from your mouth—
it is unfitting for us, O twice-born, if affliction is not pacified.

6.3.s:
athavā prāpsyate tāta vidyādānasya yatphalam .
tatphalaṃ prāpyate nityaṃ kathāśravaṇato hareḥ .. 72.6 ..
6.3.d:
अथवा प्राप्स्यते तात विद्यादानस्य यत्फलम् .
तत्फलं प्राप्यते नित्यं कथाश्रवणतो हरेः .. 72.6 ..
6.3.m:
Or rather, father, whatever fruit of imparting knowledge is obtained,
that fruit is perpetually obtained from hearing the story of Hari.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
yathāyathā tvaṃ nṛpa bhāṣase ca tathātathā me sukhameti bhāratī .
śaithilyatā vā jarayānvitasya tvatsauhṛdaṃ naśyati naiva tāta .
śṛṇuṣva tasmātsaha bāndhavaiśca kathāmimāṃ pāpaharāṃ praśastām .. 72.7 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
यथायथा त्वं नृप भाषसे च तथातथा मे सुखमेति भारती .
शैथिल्यता वा जरयान्वितस्य त्वत्सौहृदं नश्यति नैव तात .
शृणुष्व तस्मात्सह बान्धवैश्च कथामिमां पापहरां प्रशस्ताम् .. 72.7 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Just as you speak, O king, so too does my speech find joy.
Though I am beset with old age and weakness, father, my affection for you does not perish at all.
Therefore listen, along with your kinsmen, to this praised tale that removes sin.

6.3.s: kathayāmi yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam .. 72.8 ..
6.3.d: कथयामि यथावृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम् .. 72.8 ..
6.3.m: I shall recount the ancient narrative just as it happened,

6.3.s: kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛttaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata .. 72.9 ..
6.3.d: कथितं पूर्वतो वृत्तैः पारम्पर्येण भारत .. 72.9 ..
6.3.m: as recounted by earlier events through lineage, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
dve bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttame .
garutmantaṃ ca vinatāsūta kadrūrahīnatha .. 72.10 ..
6.3.d:
द्वे भार्ये कश्यपस्यास्तां सर्वलोकेष्वनुत्तमे .
गरुत्मन्तं च विनतासूत कद्रूरहीनथ .. 72.10 ..
6.3.m:
Kaśyapa had two wives, unequalled in all the worlds.
Vinatā gave birth to Garuḍa, and Kadrū then to the serpents.

6.3.s:
saṃtoṣeṇa ca te tāta tiṣṭhataḥ kāśyape gṛhe .
kadrūśca vinatā nāma hṛṣṭe ca vanite sadā .. 72.11 ..
6.3.d:
संतोषेण च ते तात तिष्ठतः काश्यपे गृहे .
कद्रूश्च विनता नाम हृष्टे च वनिते सदा .. 72.11 ..
6.3.m:
And they dwelt with contentment, father, in the house of Kaśyapa—
Kadrū and the one named Vinatā, two women ever delighted.

6.3.s:
tābhyāṃ sārddhaṃ krīḍate ca kaśyapo'pi prajāpatiḥ .
tatastvekadine prāpte āśramasthā śubhānanā .. 72.12 ..
6.3.d:
ताभ्यां सार्द्धं क्रीडते च कश्यपोऽपि प्रजापतिः .
ततस्त्वेकदिने प्राप्ते आश्रमस्था शुभानना .. 72.12 ..
6.3.m:
With them Kaśyapa, the lord of creatures, also sported.
Then on a certain day, staying in the hermitage, the fair-faced one,

6.3.s:
uccaiḥśravaṃ hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā manovegasamanvitam .
paśya paśya hi tanvaṅgī hayaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram .. 72.13 ..
6.3.d:
उच्चैःश्रवं हयं दृष्ट्वा मनोवेगसमन्वितम् .
पश्य पश्य हि तन्वङ्गी हयं सर्वत्र पाण्डुरम् .. 72.13 ..
6.3.m:
seeing the horse Uccaiḥśravas endowed with the speed of thought, [said:]
'Look, look, slender-limbed one, at the horse white all over,

6.3.s:
dhāvamānamaviśrāntaṃ javena manasopamam .
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā cāśvamīrṣyābhāvena cābravīt .. 72.14 ..
6.3.d:
धावमानमविश्रान्तं जवेन मनसोपमम् .
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा चाश्वमीर्ष्याभावेन चाब्रवीत् .. 72.14 ..
6.3.m:
running without rest, comparable in speed to thought!'
Seeing that horse suddenly, [Kadrū] spoke with feelings of envy:

6.3.s:
kadrūruvāca -
brūhi bhadre sahasrāṃśoraśvaḥ kiṃvarṇako bhavet .
ahaṃ bravīmi kṛṣṇo'yaṃ tvaṃ kiṃ vadasi tadvada .. 72.15 ..
6.3.d:
कद्रूरुवाच -
ब्रूहि भद्रे सहस्रांशोरश्वः किंवर्णको भवेत् .
अहं ब्रवीमि कृष्णोऽयं त्वं किं वदसि तद्वद .. 72.15 ..
6.3.m:
Kadrū said:
'Tell me, fair one, of what color is the horse of the thousand-rayed [sun]?
I say this one is black; what do you say? Speak to that!'

6.3.s:
vinatovāca -
paśyase nanu netraiśca kṛṣṇaṃ śvetaṃ na paśyasi .
asatyabhāṣaṇādbhadre yamalokaṃ gamiṣyasi .. 72.16 ..
6.3.d:
विनतोवाच -
पश्यसे ननु नेत्रैश्च कृष्णं श्वेतं न पश्यसि .
असत्यभाषणाद्भद्रे यमलोकं गमिष्यसि .. 72.16 ..
6.3.m:
Vinatā said:
'Do you indeed see with your eyes black, and not see white?
From speaking untruth, fair one, you will go to the realm of Yama.

6.3.s:
satyānṛte tu vacane paṇastava mamaiva tu .
sahasraṃ caiva varṣāṇāṃ dāsyahaṃ tava mandire .. 72.17 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यानृते तु वचने पणस्तव ममैव तु .
सहस्रं चैव वर्षाणां दास्यहं तव मन्दिरे .. 72.17 ..
6.3.m:
A wager between you and me upon true and false words:
for a thousand years I shall be a slave in your house,

6.3.s:
asatyā yadi me vāṇī kṛṣṇa uccaiḥśravā yadi .
tadāhaṃ tvadgṛhe dāsī bhavāmi sarpamātṛke .. 72.18 ..
6.3.d:
असत्या यदि मे वाणी कृष्ण उच्चैःश्रवा यदि .
तदाहं त्वद्गृहे दासी भवामि सर्पमातृके .. 72.18 ..
6.3.m:
if my statement is false, if Uccaiḥśravas is black;
then I shall become a slave in your house, mother of serpents.

6.3.s:
yadi uccaiḥśravāḥ śveto'haṃ dāsī ca tavaiva tu .
evaṃ parasparaṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃvādo'yaṃ vyavardhata .. 72.19 ..
6.3.d:
यदि उच्चैःश्रवाः श्वेतोऽहं दासी च तवैव तु .
एवं परस्परं द्वाभ्यां संवादोऽयं व्यवर्धत .. 72.19 ..
6.3.m:
[Kadrū said:] If Uccaiḥśravas is white, I alone shall be your slave!'
Thus between the two of them this dispute escalated.

6.3.s:
āśrameṣu gatā bālā rātrau cintāparā sthitā .
bandhuvargasya kathitaṃ samastaṃ tadviceṣṭitam .. 72.20 ..
6.3.d:
आश्रमेषु गता बाला रात्रौ चिन्तापरा स्थिता .
बन्धुवर्गस्य कथितं समस्तं तद्विचेष्टितम् .. 72.20 ..
6.3.m:
The young woman, having gone to the hermitage, remained at night absorbed in anxiety.
She told her group of kinsmen all that had taken place.

6.3.s:
putrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ pārtha paṇaṃ caiva mayā kṛtam .
hāhākāraḥ kṛtaḥ sarpaiḥ śrutvā mātrā paṇaṃ kṛtam .. 72.21 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्राणां कथितं पार्थ पणं चैव मया कृतम् .
हाहाकारः कृतः सर्पैः श्रुत्वा मात्रा पणं कृतम् .. 72.21 ..
6.3.m:
[She said,] 'I have told my sons, O son of Pṛthā, that a wager was made by me.'
An outcry of woe was made by the serpents, hearing that a wager had been made by their mother.

6.3.s:
jātā dāsī na sandehaḥ śveto bhāskaravāhanaḥ .
uccaiḥśravā hayaḥ śveto na kṛṣṇo vidyate kvacit .. 72.22 ..
6.3.d:
जाता दासी न सन्देहः श्वेतो भास्करवाहनः .
उच्चैःश्रवा हयः श्वेतो न कृष्णो विद्यते क्वचित् .. 72.22 ..
6.3.m:
[They said,] 'You have become a slave, there is no doubt! The mount of the sun is white.
The horse Uccaiḥśravas is white, nowhere is he black.'

6.3.s:
kadrūruvāca -
yathāhaṃ na bhave dāsī tatkāryaṃ ca vicintyatām .
viśadhvaṃ romakūpeṣu hyuccaiḥśravahayasya tu .. 72.23 ..
6.3.d:
कद्रूरुवाच -
यथाहं न भवे दासी तत्कार्यं च विचिन्त्यताम् .
विशध्वं रोमकूपेषु ह्युच्चैःश्रवहयस्य तु .. 72.23 ..
6.3.m:
Kadrū said:
'Devise that action so that I do not become a slave!
Enter into the hair-pores of the horse Uccaiḥśravas

6.3.s:
ekaṃ muhūrtamātraṃ tu yāvatkṛṣṇaḥ sa dṛśyate .
kṣaṇamātreṇa caikena dāsī sā bhavate mama .. 72.24 ..
6.3.d:
एकं मुहूर्तमात्रं तु यावत्कृष्णः स दृश्यते .
क्षणमात्रेण चैकेन दासी सा भवते मम .. 72.24 ..
6.3.m:
for just the span of a muhūrta, so long as he is seen as black.
And in just a single moment she will become my slave.

6.3.s:
dāsīṃ kṛtvā tu tāṃ tanvīṃ vinatāṃ satyagarvitām .
tataḥ svasthānagāḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha yathāsukham .. 72.25 ..
6.3.d:
दासीं कृत्वा तु तां तन्वीं विनतां सत्यगर्विताम् .
ततः स्वस्थानगाः सर्वे भविष्यथ यथासुखम् .. 72.25 ..
6.3.m:
Having made that slender Vinatā, proud of truth, into a slave,
then, going to your own places, all of you will dwell as you please.'

6.3.s:
sarpā ūcuḥ .
yathā tvaṃ jananī cāmba sarveṣāṃ bhuvi pūjitā .
tathā sāpi viśeṣeṇa vañcitavyā na mātaraḥ .. 72.26 ..
6.3.d:
सर्पा ऊचुः .
यथा त्वं जननी चाम्ब सर्वेषां भुवि पूजिता .
तथा सापि विशेषेण वञ्चितव्या न मातरः .. 72.26 ..
6.3.m:
The serpents said:
'Just as you are a mother, O mother, worshipped by all on earth,
so also is she especially; mothers are not to be deceived.

6.3.s:
mātā ca pitṛbhāryā ca mātṛmātā pitāmahī .
karmaṇā manasā vācā hitaṃ tāsāṃ samācaret .. 72.27 ..
6.3.d:
माता च पितृभार्या च मातृमाता पितामही .
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा हितं तासां समाचरेत् .. 72.27 ..
6.3.m:
A mother, a father's wife, a mother's mother, and a father's mother—
one should act for their welfare in deed, thought, and speech.'

6.3.s:
sā tatastena vākyena kruddhā kālānalopamā .
mama vākyamakurvāṇā ye kecidbhuvi pannagāḥ .. 72.28 ..
6.3.d:
सा ततस्तेन वाक्येन क्रुद्धा कालानलोपमा .
मम वाक्यमकुर्वाणा ये केचिद्भुवि पन्नगाः .. 72.28 ..
6.3.m:
She then, at that speech, enraged like the fire of cosmic dissolution, [said:]
'Whosoever serpents on earth do not perform my word,

6.3.s:
havyavāhamukhe sarve te yāsyantyavicāritam .
mātustadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve caiva bhujaṅgamāḥ .. 72.29 ..
6.3.d:
हव्यवाहमुखे सर्वे ते यास्यन्त्यविचारितम् .
मातुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे चैव भुजङ्गमाः .. 72.29 ..
6.3.m:
they shall all enter the mouth of the fire without hesitation!'
Hearing that speech of their mother, all the serpents—

6.3.s:
kecitpraviṣṭā romeṣu uccaiḥśravahayasya ca .
naṣṭāḥ keciddaśadiśaṃ kadrūśāpabhayāttataḥ .. 72.30 ..
6.3.d:
केचित्प्रविष्टा रोमेषु उच्चैःश्रवहयस्य च .
नष्टाः केचिद्दशदिशं कद्रूशापभयात्ततः .. 72.30 ..
6.3.m:
some entered the hairs of the horse Uccaiḥśravas,
while some fled in the ten directions out of fear of Kadrū's curse.

6.3.s:
kecidgaṅgājale naṣṭāḥ kecinnaṣṭāḥ sarasvatīm .
kecinmahodadhau līnāḥ praviṣṭā vindhyakandare .. 72.31 ..
6.3.d:
केचिद्गङ्गाजले नष्टाः केचिन्नष्टाः सरस्वतीम् .
केचिन्महोदधौ लीनाः प्रविष्टा विन्ध्यकन्दरे .. 72.31 ..
6.3.m:
Some fled into the waters of the Gaṅgā, some fled to the Sarasvatī,
some hid in the great ocean, or entered caves of the Vindhya.

6.3.s:
āśritya narmadātoye maṇināgottamo nṛpa .
tapaścacāra vipulamuttare narmadātaṭe .. 72.32 ..
6.3.d:
आश्रित्य नर्मदातोये मणिनागोत्तमो नृप .
तपश्चचार विपुलमुत्तरे नर्मदातटे .. 72.32 ..
6.3.m:
Resorting to the waters of the Narmadā, O king, Maṇināga, the best [of snakes],
performed vast austerity on the northern bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
mātṛśāpabhayātpārtha dhyāyate kāmanāśanam .
acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca vināśotpattivarjitam .. 72.33 ..
6.3.d:
मातृशापभयात्पार्थ ध्यायते कामनाशनम् .
अच्छेद्यमप्रतर्क्यं च विनाशोत्पत्तिवर्जितम् .. 72.33 ..
6.3.m:
Out of fear of his mother's curse, O son of Pṛthā, he meditated upon the destroyer of desires,
who is indivisible, inconceivable, and devoid of destruction and origination.

6.3.s:
vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ sāgraṃ tadardhaṃ ravivīkṣakaḥ .
evaṃ dhyānaratasyaiva pratyakṣastripurāntakaḥ .. 72.34 ..
6.3.d:
वायुभक्षः शतं साग्रं तदर्धं रविवीक्षकः .
एवं ध्यानरतस्यैव प्रत्यक्षस्त्रिपुरान्तकः .. 72.34 ..
6.3.m:
Eating only wind for more than a hundred [years], and for half of that gazing at the sun,
to him who was thus engaged in meditation, the destroyer of Tripura became visible to the eyes.

6.3.s:
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga sattvavāṃstu bhujaṃgama .
tvayā bhaktyā gṛhīto'haṃ prītaste hyurageśvara .
varaṃ yācaya me kṣipraṃ yaste manasi vartate .. 72.35 ..
6.3.d:
साधु साधु महाभाग सत्त्ववांस्तु भुजंगम .
त्वया भक्त्या गृहीतोऽहं प्रीतस्ते ह्युरगेश्वर .
वरं याचय मे क्षिप्रं यस्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 72.35 ..
6.3.m:
'Well done, well done, highly fortunate one, steadfast serpent!
I have been captured by you with devotion, and I am pleased with you, O lord of serpents.
Quickly ask of me the boon that is in your mind!'

6.3.s:
maṇināga uvāca -
mātṛśāpabhayānnātha kliṣṭo'haṃ narmadātaṭe .
tvatprasādena me nātha mātṛśāpo bhavedvṛthā .. 72.36 ..
6.3.d:
मणिनाग उवाच -
मातृशापभयान्नाथ क्लिष्टोऽहं नर्मदातटे .
त्वत्प्रसादेन मे नाथ मातृशापो भवेद्वृथा .. 72.36 ..
6.3.m:
Maṇināga said:
'Out of fear of my mother's curse, O Lord, I have suffered on the bank of the Narmadā.
By your grace, O Lord, may my mother's curse become vain.'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
havyavāhamukhaṃ vatsa na prāpsyasi mamājñayā .
mama loke nivāsaśca tava putra bhaviṣyati .. 72.37 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
हव्यवाहमुखं वत्स न प्राप्स्यसि ममाज्ञया .
मम लोके निवासश्च तव पुत्र भविष्यति .. 72.37 ..

6.3.s:
maṇināga uvāca -
atra sthāne mahādeva sthīyatāmaṃśabhāgataḥ .
sahasrāṃśena bhāgena sthīyatāṃ narmadājale .
upakārāya lokānāṃ mama nāmnaiva śaṅkara .. 72.38 ..
6.3.d:
मणिनाग उवाच -
अत्र स्थाने महादेव स्थीयतामंशभागतः .
सहस्रांशेन भागेन स्थीयतां नर्मदाजले .
उपकाराय लोकानां मम नाम्नैव शङ्कर .. 72.38 ..
6.3.m:
Maṇināga said:
'In this place, O Mahādeva, please remain by a portion of a part;
by a thousandth part please remain in the water of the Narmadā,
for the benefit of the worlds, under my name, O Śaṅkara!'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
sthāpayasva paraṃ liṅgamājñayā mama pannaga .
ityuktvāntarhito devo jagāma hyumayā saha .. 72.39 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
स्थापयस्व परं लिङ्गमाज्ञया मम पन्नग .
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितो देवो जगाम ह्युमया सह .. 72.39 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
'Establish the supreme liṅga by my command, O serpent.'
Having spoken thus, the god disappeared and went away with Umā.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tatra tīrthe tu ye gatvā śuciprayatamānasāḥ .
pañcamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ .. 72.40 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तत्र तीर्थे तु ये गत्वा शुचिप्रयतमानसाः .
पञ्चम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यामष्टम्यां शुक्लकृष्णयोः .. 72.40 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Those who, having gone to that sacred ford with purified and restrained minds,
on the fifth, fourteenth, or eighth day of the bright or dark fortnights,

6.3.s:
arcayanti sadā pārtha nopasarpanti te yamam .
dadhnā ca madhunā caiva ghṛtena kṣīrayogataḥ .. 72.41 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चयन्ति सदा पार्थ नोपसर्पन्ति ते यमम् .
दध्ना च मधुना चैव घृतेन क्षीरयोगतः .. 72.41 ..
6.3.m:
ever worship [it], O son of Pṛthā, do not approach Yama.
With curd, honey, ghee, and mixed with milk,

6.3.s:
snāpayanti virūpākṣamumādehārdhadhāriṇam .
kāmāṅgadahanaṃ devamaghāsuraniṣūdanam .. 72.42 ..
6.3.d:
स्नापयन्ति विरूपाक्षमुमादेहार्धधारिणम् .
कामाङ्गदहनं देवमघासुरनिषूदनम् .. 72.42 ..
6.3.m:
they bathe the uneven-eyed one who bears half of Umā's body,
the god who burned the body of Kāma, the destroyer of the demon Agha.

6.3.s:
snāpyamānaṃ ca ye bhaktvā paśyanti parameśvaram .
te yānti ca pare loke sarvapāpavivarjitaiḥ .. 72.43 ..
6.3.d:
स्नाप्यमानं च ये भक्त्वा पश्यन्ति परमेश्वरम् .
ते यान्ति च परे लोके सर्वपापविवर्जितैः .. 72.43 ..
6.3.m: And those who with devotion behold the Supreme Lord while he is being bathed, / go to the highest world, freed from all sin.

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ preteṣu ye pārtha cāṣṭamyāṃ pañcamīṣu ca .
brāhmaṇaiśca sadā yogyairvedapāṭhakacintakaiḥ .. 72.44 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं प्रेतेषु ये पार्थ चाष्टम्यां पञ्चमीषु च .
ब्राह्मणैश्च सदा योग्यैर्वेदपाठकचिन्तकैः .. 72.44 ..
6.3.m: Those who, O son of Pṛthā, perform a śrāddha for the deceased on the eighth or fifth lunar days, / with worthy brahmins who constantly study and contemplate the Vedas,

6.3.s:
svadāranirataiḥ ślakṣṇaiḥ paradāravivarjitaiḥ .
ṣaṭkarmanirataistāta śūdrapreṣaṇavarjitaiḥ .. 72.45 ..
6.3.d:
स्वदारनिरतैः श्लक्ष्णैः परदारविवर्जितैः .
षट्कर्मनिरतैस्तात शूद्रप्रेषणवर्जितैः .. 72.45 ..
6.3.m: devoted to their own wives, gentle, avoiding other men's wives, / dedicated to the six rites, dear one, and free from sending Śūdras [on their errands]—

6.3.s:
khañjāśca dardurāḥ ṣaṇḍhā vārddhuṣyāśca kṛṣīvalāḥ .
bhinnavṛttikarāḥ putra niyojyā na kadācana .. 72.46 ..
6.3.d:
खञ्जाश्च दर्दुराः षण्ढा वार्द्धुष्याश्च कृषीवलाः .
भिन्नवृत्तिकराः पुत्र नियोज्या न कदाचन .. 72.46 ..
6.3.m: the lame, the stammerers, eunuchs, usurers, farmers, / and those engaged in improper conduct, O son, must never be engaged.

6.3.s:
vṛṣalīmandire yasya mahiṣīṃ yastu pālayet .
sa vipro dūratastyājyo vrate śrāddhe narādhipa .. 72.47 ..
6.3.d:
वृषलीमन्दिरे यस्य महिषीं यस्तु पालयेत् .
स विप्रो दूरतस्त्याज्यो व्रते श्राद्धे नराधिप .. 72.47 ..
6.3.m: He in whose house lives a low-caste woman, or who keeps a buffalo-cow— / that brahmin must be avoided from afar in vows and śrāddhas, O lord of men.

6.3.s:
kāṇāṣṭuṃṭāśca maṇṭāśca vedapāṭhavivarjitāḥ .
na te pūjyā dvijāḥ pārtha maṇināgeśvare śubhe .. 72.48 ..
6.3.d:
काणाष्टुंटाश्च मण्टाश्च वेदपाठविवर्जिताः .
न ते पूज्या द्विजाः पार्थ मणिनागेश्वरे शुभे .. 72.48 ..
6.3.m: The one-eyed, those with crippled hands, the blunt-fingered, and those bereft of Vedic study— / these twice-born men should not be honored at auspicious Maṇināgeśvara, O son of Pṛthā.

6.3.s:
yadīcchedūrdhvagamanamātmanaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha .
sarvāṅgarucirāṃ dhenuṃ yo dadyādagrajanmane .. 72.49 ..
6.3.d:
यदीच्छेदूर्ध्वगमनमात्मनः पितृभिः सह .
सर्वाङ्गरुचिरां धेनुं यो दद्यादग्रजन्मने .. 72.49 ..
6.3.m: If one should desire upward ascent for oneself together with one's ancestors, / one should give a cow handsome in all limbs to a twice-born first-born.

6.3.s:
sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam .
tataḥ svargāccyutaḥ so'pi jāyate vimale kule .. 72.50 ..
6.3.d:
स याति परमं लोकं यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .
ततः स्वर्गाच्च्युतः सोऽपि जायते विमले कुले .. 72.50 ..
6.3.m: He goes to the supreme world until the dissolution of all beings; / then, falling from heaven, he is born into a pure family.

6.3.s:
ye paśyanti paraṃ bhaktyā maṇināgeśvaraṃ nṛpa .
na teṣāṃ jāyate vaṃśe pannagānāṃ bhayaṃ nṛpa .. 72.51 ..
6.3.d:
ये पश्यन्ति परं भक्त्या मणिनागेश्वरं नृप .
न तेषां जायते वंशे पन्नगानां भयं नृप .. 72.51 ..
6.3.m: Those who behold Maṇināgeśvara with supreme devotion, O king— / no fear of serpents arises in their lineage, O king.

6.3.s:
pannagaḥ śaṅkate teṣāṃ maṇināgapradarśanāt .
sauparṇarūpiṇaste vai dṛśyante nāgamaṇḍale .. 72.52 ..
6.3.d:
पन्नगः शङ्कते तेषां मणिनागप्रदर्शनात् .
सौपर्णरूपिणस्ते वै दृश्यन्ते नागमण्डले .. 72.52 ..
6.3.m: A serpent fears them from the sight of Maṇināga; / they appear in the serpent-realm with the form of Garuḍa.

6.3.s:
phalāni caiva dānānāṃ śṛṇuṣvātha nṛpottama .
annaṃ saṃskārasaṃyuktaṃ ye dadante narottamāḥ .. 72.53 ..
6.3.d:
फलानि चैव दानानां शृणुष्वाथ नृपोत्तम .
अन्नं संस्कारसंयुक्तं ये ददन्ते नरोत्तमाः .. 72.53 ..
6.3.m: Now hear the fruits of gifts, O best of kings: / those best of men who give food prepared with rituals,

6.3.s:
toyaṃ śayyāṃ tathā chatraṃ kanyāṃ dāsīṃ subhāṣiṇīm .
pātre deyaṃ yato rājan yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 72.54 ..
6.3.d:
तोयं शय्यां तथा छत्रं कन्यां दासीं सुभाषिणीम् .
पात्रे देयं यतो राजन् यदीच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः .. 72.54 ..
6.3.m: water, a bed, likewise a parasol, a maiden, and an eloquent maidservant— / it should be given to a worthy recipient, O king, if one desires one's own welfare.

6.3.s:
surabhīṇi ca puṣpāṇi gandhavastrāṇi dāpayet .
dīpaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhaṃ śubhraṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam .. 72.55 ..
6.3.d:
सुरभीणि च पुष्पाणि गन्धवस्त्राणि दापयेत् .
दीपं धान्यं गृहं शुभ्रं सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् .. 72.55 ..
6.3.m: One should cause fragrant flowers, scented garments to be given, / a lamp, grain, and a bright house equipped with all furnishings.

6.3.s:
ye dadante paraṃ bhaktyā te vrajanti triviṣṭapam .
maṇināge nṛpaśreṣṭha yacca dānaṃ pradīyate .. 72.56 ..
6.3.d:
ये ददन्ते परं भक्त्या ते व्रजन्ति त्रिविष्टपम् .
मणिनागे नृपश्रेष्ठ यच्च दानं प्रदीयते .. 72.56 ..
6.3.m: Those who give with supreme devotion go to heaven. / Whatever gift is given at Maṇināga, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
tasya dānasya bhāvena svarge vāso bhaveddhruvam .
pātakāni pralīyante āmapātre yathā jalam .. 72.57 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य दानस्य भावेन स्वर्गे वासो भवेद्ध्रुवम् .
पातकानि प्रलीयन्ते आमपात्रे यथा जलम् .. 72.57 ..
6.3.m: by the power of that gift, residence in heaven is certain to result; / sins dissolve away like water in an unbaked pot.

6.3.s:
narmadātoyasaṃsiddhaṃ bhojyaṃ vipre dadāti yaḥ .
so'pi pāpairvinirmuktaḥ krīḍate daivataiḥ saha .. 72.58 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातोयसंसिद्धं भोज्यं विप्रे ददाति यः .
सोऽपि पापैर्विनिर्मुक्तः क्रीडते दैवतैः सह .. 72.58 ..
6.3.m: He who gives food prepared with Narmadā water to a brahmin, / is also freed from sins and sports with the deities.

6.3.s:
tataḥ svargacyutānāṃ hi lakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmyaham .
dīrghāyuṣo jīvaputrā dhanavantaḥ suśobhanāḥ .. 72.59 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स्वर्गच्युतानां हि लक्षणं प्रवदाम्यहम् .
दीर्घायुषो जीवपुत्रा धनवन्तः सुशोभनाः .. 72.59 ..
6.3.m: Now I will state the characteristics of those fallen from heaven: / long-lived, with living sons, wealthy, handsome,

6.3.s:
sarvavyādhivinirmuktāḥ sutabhṛtyaiḥ samanvitāḥ .
tyāgino bhogasaṃyuktā dharmākhyānaratāḥ sadā .. 72.60 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्ताः सुतभृत्यैः समन्विताः .
त्यागिनो भोगसंयुक्ता धर्माख्यानरताः सदा .. 72.60 ..
6.3.m: freed from all diseases, accompanied by sons and servants, / generous, endowed with enjoyments, constantly devoted to sacred narratives,

6.3.s:
devadvijagurorbhaktāstīrthasevāparāyaṇāḥ .
mātāpitṛvaśā nityaṃ drohakrodhavivarjitāḥ .. 72.61 ..
6.3.d:
देवद्विजगुरोर्भक्तास्तीर्थसेवापरायणाः .
मातापितृवशा नित्यं द्रोहक्रोधविवर्जिताः .. 72.61 ..
6.3.m: devoted to gods, brahmins, and gurus, intent on serving sacred fords, / always obedient to mother and father, free from malice and wrath—

6.3.s:
ebhireva guṇairyuktā ye narāḥ pāṇḍunandana .
satyaṃ te svargādāyātāḥ svarge vāsaṃ vrajanti te .. 72.62 ..
6.3.d:
एभिरेव गुणैर्युक्ता ये नराः पाण्डुनन्दन .
सत्यं ते स्वर्गादायाताः स्वर्गे वासं व्रजन्ति ते .. 72.62 ..
6.3.m: men endowed with these very virtues, O son of Pāṇḍu, / have truly arrived from heaven, and they go to dwell in heaven.

6.3.s:
sarvatīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ maṇināgaṃ nṛpottama .
tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi .. 72.63 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वतीर्थवरं तीर्थं मणिनागं नृपोत्तम .
तीर्थाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि .. 72.63 ..
6.3.m: Maṇināga is the best sacred ford of all sacred fords, O best of kings. / Whoever recites or listens to this holy narrative of the sacred ford,

6.3.s:
so'pi pāpairvinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate .
na viṣaṃ kramate teṣāṃ vicaranti yathecchayā .. 72.64 ..
6.3.d:
सोऽपि पापैर्विनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते .
न विषं क्रमते तेषां विचरन्ति यथेच्छया .. 72.64 ..
6.3.m: freed from sins, he also is glorified in the world of Śiva. / Poison does not affect them; they wander as they please.

6.3.s:
bhādrapadyāṃ ca yatṣaṣṭhyāṃ puṇyaṃ sūryasya darśane .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ākhyānaśravaṇena tu .. 72.65 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe maṇināgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 73
6.3.d:
भाद्रपद्यां च यत्षष्ठ्यां पुण्यं सूर्यस्य दर्शने .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति आख्यानश्रवणेन तु .. 72.65 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मणिनागेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 73
6.3.m:
Whatever merit is obtained on the sixth day of Bhādrapada by the sight of the sun, / that fruit he obtains merely by listening to this narrative.
Thus ends the seventy-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Maṇināgeśvara Sacred Ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 73

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
kāśī: gaṃgātaṭe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha goprekṣeśvaramuttamam .
godehānniḥsṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūmitale nṛpa .. 73.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
काशी: गंगातटे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
सर्वपापहरं पार्थ गोप्रेक्षेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
गोदेहान्निःसृतं लिङ्गं पुण्यं भूमितले नृप .. 73.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the bank and shore of Kāśī-Gaṅgā, there is an exceedingly beautiful sacred ford, / destroying all sin, O son of Pṛthā, the supreme Goprekṣeśvara, / where a holy liṅga emerged from the body of a cow upon the earth, O king.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
godehānniḥsṛtaṃ kasmālliṅgaṃ pāpakṣayaṃkaram .
kāśī: gaṃgātaṭe kūle maṇināgasamīpataḥ .
saṃkṣepātkathyatāṃ vipra goprekṣeśvarasambhavam .. 73.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
गोदेहान्निःसृतं कस्माल्लिङ्गं पापक्षयंकरम् .
काशी: गंगातटे कूले मणिनागसमीपतः .
संक्षेपात्कथ्यतां विप्र गोप्रेक्षेश्वरसम्भवम् .. 73.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Why did the liṅga that destroys sins emerge from the cow's body, / on the bank and shore of Kāśī-Gaṅgā near Maṇināga? / Tell me in brief, O brahmin, the origin of Goprekṣeśvara.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
kāmadhenustapastatra purā pārtha cakāra ha .
dhyāyate parayā bhaktyā devadevaṃ maheśvaram .. 73.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
कामधेनुस्तपस्तत्र पुरा पार्थ चकार ह .
ध्यायते परया भक्त्या देवदेवं महेश्वरम् .. 73.3 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Long ago the wish-fulfilling cow Kāmadhenu performed austerity there, O son of Pṛthā; / she meditated with supreme devotion on the god of gods, Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
tuṣṭastasyā jagannātha kapilāya maheśvaraḥ .
niḥsṛto dehamadhyāttu acchedyaḥ parameśvaraḥ .. 73.4 ..
6.3.d:
तुष्टस्तस्या जगन्नाथ कपिलाय महेश्वरः .
निःसृतो देहमध्यात्तु अच्छेद्यः परमेश्वरः .. 73.4 ..
6.3.m: Pleased with that brown cow, Maheśvara, the Lord of the universe, / the indivisible Supreme Lord, emerged from the middle of her body.

6.3.s:
tuṣṭo devi jaganmātaḥ kapile parameśvari .
ārādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ yasmāttadvadāśu śubhānane .. 73.5 ..
6.3.d:
तुष्टो देवि जगन्मातः कपिले परमेश्वरि .
आराधनं कृतं यस्मात्तद्वदाशु शुभानने .. 73.5 ..
6.3.m: [He said:] 'I am pleased, O goddess, mother of the universe, brown cow, supreme ruler! / State quickly the reason for which worship was performed, O lovely-faced one.'

6.3.s:
surabhyuvāca -
lokānāmupakārāya sṛṣṭāhaṃ parameṣṭhinā .
lokakāryāṇi sarvāṇi sidhyanti matprasādataḥ .. 73.6 ..
6.3.d:
सुरभ्युवाच -
लोकानामुपकाराय सृष्टाहं परमेष्ठिना .
लोककार्याणि सर्वाणि सिध्यन्ति मत्प्रसादतः .. 73.6 ..
6.3.m: Surabhi said: / 'For the benefit of the worlds I was created by the Supreme Lord; / all affairs of the worlds are accomplished by my grace.

6.3.s:
lokāḥ svargaṃ prayāsyanti matprasādena śaṅkara .
tīrthe tvaṃ bhava me śambho lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 73.7 ..
6.3.d:
लोकाः स्वर्गं प्रयास्यन्ति मत्प्रसादेन शङ्कर .
तीर्थे त्वं भव मे शम्भो लोकानां हितकाम्यया .. 73.7 ..
6.3.m: Creatures will go to heaven by my grace, O Śaṅkara. / Dwell in my sacred ford, O Śambhu, out of a desire for the welfare of the worlds.'

6.3.s:
tatheti bhagavānuktvā tīrthe tatrāvasanmudā .
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ vasudhātale .
snānenaikena rājendra pāpasaṅghaṃ vyapohati .. 73.8 ..
6.3.d:
तथेति भगवानुक्त्वा तीर्थे तत्रावसन्मुदा .
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं विख्यातं वसुधातले .
स्नानेनैकेन राजेन्द्र पापसङ्घं व्यपोहति .. 73.8 ..
6.3.m: Having said, 'So be it,' the Lord resided in that sacred ford with joy. / From that time forward, that sacred ford became renowned upon the earth; / by a single bath, O king of kings, it dispels the mass of sins.

6.3.s:
goprekṣeśvaragodānaṃ yastu bhaktyā ca kārayet .
yogye dvijottame deyā yogyā dhenuḥ sakāñcanā .. 73.9 ..
6.3.d:
गोप्रेक्षेश्वरगोदानं यस्तु भक्त्या च कारयेत् .
योग्ये द्विजोत्तमे देया योग्या धेनुः सकाञ्चना .. 73.9 ..
6.3.m: Whoever performs the gift of a cow at Goprekṣeśvara with devotion— / a suitable cow, accompanied by gold, should be given to a worthy best of the twice-born,

6.3.s:
savatsā taruṇī śubhrā bahukṣīrā savastrakā .
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ vā pradāpayet .. 73.10 ..
6.3.d:
सवत्सा तरुणी शुभ्रा बहुक्षीरा सवस्त्रका .
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यामष्टम्यां वा प्रदापयेत् .. 73.10 ..
6.3.m: with a calf, young, white, with abundant milk, clothed with a garment; / one should give it on the fourteenth or the eighth day of the dark fortnight,

6.3.s:
sarveṣu caiva māseṣu kārttike ca viśeṣataḥ .
dāpayetparayā bhaktyā dvije svādhyāyatatpare .. 73.11 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषु चैव मासेषु कार्त्तिके च विशेषतः .
दापयेत्परया भक्त्या द्विजे स्वाध्यायतत्परे .. 73.11 ..
6.3.m: and in all months, especially in Kārttika; / with supreme devotion one should give it to a twice-born devoted to Vedic recitation.

6.3.s:
vidhinā ca pradadyādyo vidhinā yastu gṛhṇate .
tāvubhau puṇyakarmāṇau prekṣakaḥ puṇyabhājanam .. 73.12 ..
6.3.d:
विधिना च प्रदद्याद्यो विधिना यस्तु गृह्णते .
तावुभौ पुण्यकर्माणौ प्रेक्षकः पुण्यभाजनम् .. 73.12 ..
6.3.m: Both the one who gives according to the rule and the one who accepts according to the rule / are actors of holy deeds, and the bystander is a recipient of merit.

6.3.s:
piṇḍadānaṃ prakuryādyaḥ pretānāṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ .
piṇḍenaikena rājendra pretā yānti parāṃ gatim .. 73.13 ..
6.3.d:
पिण्डदानं प्रकुर्याद्यः प्रेतानां भक्तिसंयुतः .
पिण्डेनैकेन राजेन्द्र प्रेता यान्ति परां गतिम् .. 73.13 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, endowed with devotion, performs the offering of rice-balls for the ancestors— / by a single rice-ball, O king of kings, the spirits of the dead go to the supreme state.

6.3.s:
bhaktyā praṇāmaṃ rudrasya ye kurvanti dine dine .
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ pralīyeta bhinnapātre jalaṃ yathā .. 73.14 ..
6.3.d:
भक्त्या प्रणामं रुद्रस्य ये कुर्वन्ति दिने दिने .
तेषां पापं प्रलीयेत भिन्नपात्रे जलं यथा .. 73.14 ..
6.3.m: Those who daily make obeisance to Rudra with devotion— / their sin dissolves away like water in a cracked vessel.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanvṛṣabhaṃ ca samutsṛjet .
pitaraścoddhṛtāstena śivaloke mahīyate .. 73.15 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्वृषभं च समुत्सृजेत् .
पितरश्चोद्धृतास्तेन शिवलोके महीयते .. 73.15 ..
6.3.m: He who sets loose a bull at that sacred ford, O king— / his ancestors are rescued by him, and he is glorified in the world of Śiva.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
vṛṣotsarge kṛte tāta phalaṃ yajjāyate nṛṇām .
tatsarvaṃ kathayasvāśu prayatnena dvijottama .. 73.16 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
वृषोत्सर्गे कृते तात फलं यज्जायते नृणाम् .
तत्सर्वं कथयस्वाशु प्रयत्नेन द्विजोत्तम .. 73.16 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / When the release of a bull is performed, dear one, whatever fruit arises for men, / tell me all that quickly with diligence, O best of the twice-born.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇe vṛṣe caiva tu yatphalam .
tadahaṃ sampravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva dharmanandana .. 73.17 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णे वृषे चैव तु यत्फलम् .
तदहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्व धर्मनन्दन .. 73.17 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Whatever fruit [accrues] when a bull endowed with all auspicious marks [is set free],
that I shall fully declare; listen, O son of Dharma.

6.3.s:
kārttike caiva vaiśākhe pūrṇimāyāṃ narādhipa .
rudrasya sannidhau bhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ .. 73.18 ..
6.3.d:
कार्त्तिके चैव वैशाखे पूर्णिमायां नराधिप .
रुद्रस्य सन्निधौ भूत्वा शुचिः स्नातो जितेन्द्रियः .. 73.18 ..
6.3.m:
In Kārttika and Vaiśākha, on the full moon day, O king,
having come into the presence of Rudra, pure, bathed, and with senses subdued,

6.3.s:
vṛṣasyaiva samutsargaṃ kārayetprīyatāṃ haraḥ .
sāṃnidhye kārayetputra catasro vatsikāḥ śubhāḥ .. 73.19 ..
6.3.d:
वृषस्यैव समुत्सर्गं कारयेत्प्रीयतां हरः .
सांनिध्ये कारयेत्पुत्र चतस्रो वत्सिकाः शुभाः .. 73.19 ..
6.3.m:
one should cause the release of a bull, [saying,] 'May Hara be pleased.'
In [his] presence, O son, one should present four auspicious heifer calves.

6.3.s:
dattvā tu vipramukhyāya sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ .
prīyatāṃ ca mahādevo brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ .. 73.20 ..
6.3.d:
दत्त्वा तु विप्रमुख्याय सर्वलक्षणसंयुताः .
प्रीयतां च महादेवो ब्रह्मा विष्णुर्महेश्वरः .. 73.20 ..
6.3.m:
Having given [them], endowed with all auspicious marks, to an eminent brahmin,
[one should pray,] 'May Mahādeva, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara be pleased.'

6.3.s:
vṛṣabhe romasaṃkhyā yā sarvāṅgeṣu narādhipa .
tāvadvarṣapramāṇaṃ tu śivaloke mahīyate .. 73.21 ..
6.3.d:
वृषभे रोमसंख्या या सर्वाङ्गेषु नराधिप .
तावद्वर्षप्रमाणं तु शिवलोके महीयते .. 73.21 ..
6.3.m:
As many hairs as there are on all limbs of the bull, O king,
for that many years he is honored in the world of Śiva.

6.3.s:
śivaloke vasitvā tu yadā martyeṣu jāyate .
kule mahati sambhūtirdhanadhānyasamākule .. 73.22 ..
6.3.d:
शिवलोके वसित्वा तु यदा मर्त्येषु जायते .
कुले महति सम्भूतिर्धनधान्यसमाकुले .. 73.22 ..
6.3.m:
Having dwelt in the world of Śiva, when he is born among mortals,
his birth is in a great family, replete with wealth and grain.

6.3.s:
nīrogo rūpavāṃścaiva vidyāḍhyaḥ satyavākśuciḥ .
goprekṣeśvaramāhātmyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
godehānniḥsṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ kāśī: gaṃgā taṭe .. 73.23 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe goprekṣeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 74
6.3.d:
नीरोगो रूपवांश्चैव विद्याढ्यः सत्यवाक्शुचिः .
गोप्रेक्षेश्वरमाहात्म्यं मया ख्यातं युधिष्ठिर .
गोदेहान्निःसृतं लिङ्गं काशी: गंगा तटे .. 73.23 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गोप्रेक्षेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 74
6.3.m:
Free from disease, handsome, rich in learning, speaking the truth, and pure.
The Goprekṣeśvara-māhātmya has thus been declared by me, O Yudhiṣṭhira;
the liṅga emerged from the body of a cow on the bank of the Gaṅgā in Kāśī.
Thus ends the seventy-third chapter, titled 'Description of the Goprekṣeśvara-māhātmya', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part, the] Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 74

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
revāyā uttare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ martye nāmnā vai gautameśvaram .. 74.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
रेवाया उत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
सर्वपापहरं मर्त्ये नाम्ना वै गौतमेश्वरम् .. 74.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the northern bank of the Revā is an exceedingly beautiful sacred ford
that removes all sin in the mortal world, named indeed Gautameśvara.

6.3.s:
sthāpitaṃ gautamenaiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .
svargasopānarūpaṃ tu tīrthaṃ puṃsāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 74.2 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापितं गौतमेनैव लोकानां हितकाम्यया .
स्वर्गसोपानरूपं तु तीर्थं पुंसां युधिष्ठिर .. 74.2 ..
6.3.m:
It was established by Gautama himself, desiring the welfare of all people;
it is like a staircase to heaven for men, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
tatra gaccha paraṃ bhaktyā yatra devo jagadguruḥ .
pātakasya vināśārthaṃ svargavāsapradastathā .. 74.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र गच्छ परं भक्त्या यत्र देवो जगद्गुरुः .
पातकस्य विनाशार्थं स्वर्गवासप्रदस्तथा .. 74.3 ..
6.3.m:
Go there with supreme devotion, where the god, the teacher of the universe, resides,
for the destruction of sin, bestowing residence in heaven.

6.3.s:
saubhāgyavarddhanaṃ tīrthaṃ jayadaṃ duḥkhanāśanam .
piṇḍadānena caikena kulānāmuddharettrayam .. 74.4 ..
6.3.d:
सौभाग्यवर्द्धनं तीर्थं जयदं दुःखनाशनम् .
पिण्डदानेन चैकेन कुलानामुद्धरेत्त्रयम् .. 74.4 ..
6.3.m:
It is a sacred ford that increases fortune, grants victory, and destroys sorrow;
and by a single offering of a piṇḍa, one delivers three lineages.

6.3.s:
yatkiṃciddīyate bhaktyā svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu .
tatsarvaṃ śatasāhasramājñayā gautamasya hi .. 74.5 ..
6.3.d:
यत्किंचिद्दीयते भक्त्या स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु .
तत्सर्वं शतसाहस्रमाज्ञया गौतमस्य हि .. 74.5 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever is given with devotion, whether small or great,
all of that becomes a hundred-thousandfold, indeed by the command of Gautama.

6.3.s:
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ svayaṃ rudreṇa bhāṣitam .. 74.6 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamāvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gautameśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं स्वयं रुद्रेण भाषितम् .. 74.6 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चमावन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गौतमेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
It is the supreme sacred ford among sacred fords, spoken by Rudra himself.
Thus ends the seventy-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Gautameśvara-tīrtha-māhātmya', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part, the] Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
śaṅkhacūḍasya nāmnā vai prasiddhaṃ bhūmimaṇḍale .. 75.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
शङ्खचूडस्य नाम्ना वै प्रसिद्धं भूमिमण्डले .. 75.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the southern bank of the Narmadā is an exceedingly splendid sacred ford, / well known in the circle of the earth by the name of Śaṅkhacūḍa.

6.3.s:
śaṅkhacūḍaḥ svayaṃ tatra saṃsthitaḥ pāṇḍunandana .
vainateyabhayātpārtha sukhadanarmadātaṭe .. 75.2 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्खचूडः स्वयं तत्र संस्थितः पाण्डुनन्दन .
वैनतेयभयात्पार्थ सुखदनर्मदातटे .. 75.2 ..
6.3.m: Śaṅkhacūḍa himself stayed there, O son of Pāṇḍu, / through fear of Garuḍa, O son of Pṛthā, on the delight-giving bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ .
snāpayecchaṅkhacūḍaṃ tu kṣīrakṣaudreṇa sarpiṣā .. 75.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः .
स्नापयेच्छङ्खचूडं तु क्षीरक्षौद्रेण सर्पिषा .. 75.3 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having become pure and concentrated in mind, with devotion at that sacred ford / bathes Śaṅkhacūḍa with milk, honey, and clarified butter,

6.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāddevasyāgre narādhipa .
dadhibhaktena sampūjya brāhmaṇāñchaṃsitavratān .
gopradāne dvijendro'yaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ .. 75.4 ..
6.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्देवस्याग्रे नराधिप .
दधिभक्तेन सम्पूज्य ब्राह्मणाञ्छंसितव्रतान् .
गोप्रदाने द्विजेन्द्रोऽयं सर्वपापक्षयंकरः .. 75.4 ..
6.3.m: should keep a night vigil before the god, O ruler of men. / Having honoured with curd and boiled rice brahmins of praised vows, / this best of twice-borns, upon the gift of a cow, effects the destruction of all sins.

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ pārtha sarpadaṣṭaṃ pratarpayet .
sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ śaṅkarasya vaco yathā .. 75.5 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śaṅkhacūḍatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 76
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः पार्थ सर्पदष्टं प्रतर्पयेत् .
स याति परमं लोकं शङ्करस्य वचो यथा .. 75.5 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शङ्खचूडतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 76
6.3.m:
Whoever, O son of Pṛthā, makes water offerings at that sacred ford for one bitten by a snake, / goes to the supreme realm, according to the word of Śaṅkara.
Thus ends the seventy-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Śaṅkhacūḍa Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 76

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra pāreśvaramanuttamam .
parāśaro mahātmā vai narmadāyāstaṭe śubhe .. 76.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र पारेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .
पराशरो महात्मा वै नर्मदायास्तटे शुभे .. 76.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the unsurpassed Pāreśvara.
The great-souled Parāśara, indeed, on the auspicious bank of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ putrārthaṃ pāṇḍunandana .
himavadduhitā tena gaurī nārāyaṇī nṛpa .. 76.2 ..
6.3.d:
तपश्चचार विपुलं पुत्रार्थं पाण्डुनन्दन .
हिमवद्दुहिता तेन गौरी नारायणी नृप .. 76.2 ..
6.3.m:
performed extensive austerity for the sake of a son, O son of Pāṇḍu.
By him the daughter of Himavat, Gaurī, Nārāyaṇī, O king,

6.3.s:
toṣitā parayā bhaktyā narmadottarake taṭe .
tasya tuṣṭā mahādevī śaṅkarārdhāṅgadhāriṇī .. 76.3 ..
6.3.d:
तोषिता परया भक्त्या नर्मदोत्तरके तटे .
तस्य तुष्टा महादेवी शङ्करार्धाङ्गधारिणी .. 76.3 ..
6.3.m:
was propitiated with supreme devotion on the northern bank of the Narmadā.
The great goddess, who holds half the body of Śaṅkara, was pleased with him [and said]:

6.3.s:
bhobho ṛṣivara śreṣṭha tuṣṭāhaṃ tava bhaktitaḥ .
varaṃ yācaya me vipra parāśara mahāmate .. 76.4 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो ऋषिवर श्रेष्ठ तुष्टाहं तव भक्तितः .
वरं याचय मे विप्र पराशर महामते .. 76.4 ..
6.3.m:
'Hail, O best, most excellent of seers! I am pleased with your devotion.
Ask a boon of me, O brahmin, O noble-minded Parāśara!'

6.3.s:
parāśara uvāca -
parituṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama .
dehi putraṃ bhagavati satyaśaucaguṇānvitam .. 76.5 ..
6.3.d:
पराशर उवाच -
परितुष्टासि मे देवि यदि देयो वरो मम .
देहि पुत्रं भगवति सत्यशौचगुणान्वितम् .. 76.5 ..
6.3.m:
Parāśara said:
'If you are well pleased with me, O goddess, if a boon is to be granted to me,
give me a son, O blessed lady, endowed with the virtues of truth and purity,

6.3.s:
vedābhyasanaśīlaṃ hi sarvaśāstraviśāradam .
tīrthe cātra bhaveddevi sannidhānavareṇa tu .. 76.6 ..
6.3.d:
वेदाभ्यसनशीलं हि सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् .
तीर्थे चात्र भवेद्देवि सन्निधानवरेण तु .. 76.6 ..
6.3.m:
devoted to the study of the Vedas, and proficient in all the sacred scriptures.
And may there be, O goddess, your presence in this sacred ford by this excellent boon.

6.3.s:
lokopakārahetośca sthīyatāṃ girinandini .
parāśarābhidhānena narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .. 76.7 ..
6.3.d:
लोकोपकारहेतोश्च स्थीयतां गिरिनन्दिनि .
पराशराभिधानेन नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .. 76.7 ..
6.3.m:
For the sake of helping the world, remain here, O daughter of the mountain,
under the name of Parāśara, on the southern bank of the Narmadā.'

6.3.s:
śrīdevyuvāca -
evaṃ bhavatu te vipra tatraivāntaradhīyata .
parāśaro mahātmā vai sthāpayāmāsa pārvatīm .. 76.8 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच -
एवं भवतु ते विप्र तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .
पराशरो महात्मा वै स्थापयामास पार्वतीम् .. 76.8 ..
6.3.m:
The goddess said:
'So be it for you, O brahmin.' Right there she disappeared.
The great-souled Parāśara then established Pārvatī.

6.3.s:
śaṅkaraṃ sthāpayāmāsa surāsuranamaskṛtam .
acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca devānāṃ tu durāsadam .. 76.9 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्करं स्थापयामास सुरासुरनमस्कृतम् .
अच्छेद्यमप्रतर्क्यं च देवानां तु दुरासदम् .. 76.9 ..
6.3.m:
He established Śaṅkara, worshipped by gods and asuras,
indivisible, inconceivable, and difficult of access even to the gods.

6.3.s: parāśaro mahātmā vai kṛtārtho hyabhavannṛpa .. 76.10 ..
6.3.d: पराशरो महात्मा वै कृतार्थो ह्यभवन्नृप .. 76.10 ..
6.3.m: The great-souled Parāśara achieved his purpose, O king.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ .
stryathavā puruṣo vāpi kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ .. 76.11 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या शुचिः प्रयतमानसः .
स्त्र्यथवा पुरुषो वापि कामक्रोधविवर्जितः .. 76.11 ..
6.3.m:
At that sacred ford, whoever with devotion, pure and restrained in mind,
whether a woman or a man, free from desire and anger,

6.3.s:
māghe caitre'tha vaiśākhe śrāvaṇe nṛpanandana .
māsi mārgaśire caiva śuklapakṣe tu sarvadā .. 76.12 ..
6.3.d:
माघे चैत्रेऽथ वैशाखे श्रावणे नृपनन्दन .
मासि मार्गशिरे चैव शुक्लपक्षे तु सर्वदा .. 76.12 ..
6.3.m:
in Māgha, Caitra, or Vaiśākha, in Śrāvaṇa, O prince,
and in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, during the bright fortnight at all times,

6.3.s: tatra gatvā śubhe sthāne narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .. 76.13 ..
6.3.d: तत्र गत्वा शुभे स्थाने नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .. 76.13 ..
6.3.m: having gone to that auspicious place on the southern bank of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
upoṣya parayā bhaktyā vratametatsamācaret .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dīpadānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ .. 76.14 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्य परया भक्त्या व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् .
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा दीपदानं स्वशक्तितः .. 76.14 ..
6.3.m:
having fasted with supreme devotion, performs this observance,
keeping vigil at night and giving lamps according to one's capacity,

6.3.s:
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ tathā vādyaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ .
prabhāte vimale prāpte dvijāḥ pūjyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ .. 76.15 ..
6.3.d:
गीतं नृत्यं तथा वाद्यं कामक्रोधविवर्जितः .
प्रभाते विमले प्राप्ते द्विजाः पूज्याः स्वशक्तितः .. 76.15 ..
6.3.m:
[with] song, dance, and instrumental music, free from desire and anger;
when clear dawn arrives, the twice-born should be honored according to one's capacity.

6.3.s:
sampūjya brāhmaṇān pārtha dhanadānahiraṇyataḥ .
vastreṇa chatradānena śayyātāmbūlabhojanaiḥ .. 76.16 ..
6.3.d:
सम्पूज्य ब्राह्मणान् पार्थ धनदानहिरण्यतः .
वस्त्रेण छत्रदानेन शय्याताम्बूलभोजनैः .. 76.16 ..
6.3.m:
Having honored the brahmins, O son of Pṛthā, with gifts of wealth and gold,
with clothing, the gift of umbrellas, beds, betel, and meals,

6.3.s:
prīṇayennarmadātīre brāhmaṇāñchaṃsitavratān .
śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha āmaiḥ pakvairjalena ca .. 76.17 ..
6.3.d:
प्रीणयेन्नर्मदातीरे ब्राह्मणाञ्छंसितव्रतान् .
श्राद्धं कार्यं नृपश्रेष्ठ आमैः पक्वैर्जलेन च .. 76.17 ..
6.3.m:
one should gratify on the bank of the Narmadā the brahmins of commendable vows.
A śrāddha should be performed, O best of kings, with raw food, cooked food, and water.

6.3.s:
strīṇāṃ caiva tu śūdrāṇāmāmaśrāddhaṃ praśasyate .
āmaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .. 76.18 ..
6.3.d:
स्त्रीणां चैव तु शूद्राणामामश्राद्धं प्रशस्यते .
आमं चतुर्गुणं देयं ब्राह्मणानां युधिष्ठिर .. 76.18 ..
6.3.m:
For women and for śūdras, an āmaśrāddha is praised;
raw food should be given fourfold to the brahmins, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
vedoktena vidhānena dvijāḥ pūjyāḥ prayatnataḥ .
hastamātraiḥ kuśaiścaiva tilaiścaivākṣatairnṛpa .. 76.19 ..
6.3.d:
वेदोक्तेन विधानेन द्विजाः पूज्याः प्रयत्नतः .
हस्तमात्रैः कुशैश्चैव तिलैश्चैवाक्षतैर्नृप .. 76.19 ..
6.3.m:
According to the rite taught in the Veda, the twice-born are to be honored with care,
with kuśa grass a cubit long, with sesame seeds, and with unbroken rice, O king.

6.3.s:
viprā udaṅmukhāḥ kāryāḥ svayaṃ vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ .
darbheṣu nikṣipedannamityuccārya dvijāgrataḥ .. 76.20 ..
6.3.d:
विप्रा उदङ्मुखाः कार्याः स्वयं वै दक्षिणामुखः .
दर्भेषु निक्षिपेदन्नमित्युच्चार्य द्विजाग्रतः .. 76.20 ..
6.3.m:
The brahmins should be seated facing north, and oneself facing south.
One should place the food upon the darbha grass, uttering this before the twice-born:

6.3.s:
pretā yāntu pare loke tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .
pāpaṃ me praśamaṃ yātu etu vṛddhiṃ śubhaṃ sadā .. 76.21 ..
6.3.d:
प्रेता यान्तु परे लोके तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .
पापं मे प्रशमं यातु एतु वृद्धिं शुभं सदा .. 76.21 ..
6.3.m:
