'May the departed spirits go to the higher world by the power of this sacred ford!
May my sin be pacified; may auspiciousness always increase!

6.3.s:
vṛddhiṃ yātu sadā vaṃśo jñātivargo dvijottama .
evamuccārya viprāya dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ .. 76.22 ..
6.3.d:
वृद्धिं यातु सदा वंशो ज्ञातिवर्गो द्विजोत्तम .
एवमुच्चार्य विप्राय दानं देयं स्वशक्तितः .. 76.22 ..
6.3.m:
May my lineage and kinsmen always flourish, O best of the twice-born!'
Having uttered this, a gift should be given to the brahmin according to one's capacity.

6.3.s:
gobhūtisahiraṇyādi cānnaṃ vastraṃ svaśaktitaḥ .
dātavyaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha pāreśvaravarāśrame .. 76.23 ..
6.3.d:
गोभूतिसहिरण्यादि चान्नं वस्त्रं स्वशक्तितः .
दातव्यं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ पारेश्वरवराश्रमे .. 76.23 ..
6.3.m:
Cows, land, gold and the like, food and clothing, according to one's capacity,
should be given, O best of Pāṇḍavas, at the excellent hermitage of Pāreśvara.

6.3.s:
ye śṛṇvanti paraṃ bhaktyā mucyante sarvapātakaiḥ .. 76.24 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 77
6.3.d:
ये शृण्वन्ति परं भक्त्या मुच्यन्ते सर्वपातकैः .. 76.24 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पारेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 77
6.3.m:
Those who listen with supreme devotion are freed from all sins.
Thus ends the seventy-sixth chapter, titled 'Description of the Pāreśvara-tīrtha-māhātmya', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part, the] Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 77

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhīmeśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .
sevitaṃ ṛṣisaṅghaiśca bhīmavratadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 77.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भीमेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .
सेवितं ऋषिसङ्घैश्च भीमव्रतधरैः शुभैः .. 77.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go to Bhīmeśvara, which destroys all sin,
resorted to by hosts of seers, auspicious practitioners of fierce vows.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .
japedekākṣaraṃ mantramūrdhvabāhurdivākare .. 77.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .
जपेदेकाक्षरं मन्त्रमूर्ध्वबाहुर्दिवाकरे .. 77.2 ..
6.3.m:
At that sacred ford, having bathed, fasting and with senses subdued,
raising one's arms toward the sun, one should mutter the single-syllable mantra.

6.3.s:
tasya janmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati .
saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ gāyatryā naśyate dhruvam .. 77.3 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य जन्मार्जितं पापं तत्क्षणादेव नश्यति .
सप्तजन्मार्जितं पापं गायत्र्या नश्यते ध्रुवम् .. 77.3 ..
6.3.m: The sin accumulated in his [present] life is destroyed that very instant. / The sin accumulated in seven lives is surely destroyed by the Gāyatrī.

6.3.s:
daśabhirjanmabhirjātaṃ śatena tu purā kṛtam .
sahasreṇa trijanmotthaṃ gāyatrī hanti kilbiṣam .. 77.4 ..
6.3.d:
दशभिर्जन्मभिर्जातं शतेन तु पुरा कृतम् .
सहस्रेण त्रिजन्मोत्थं गायत्री हन्ति किल्बिषम् .. 77.4 ..
6.3.m: With ten [recitations] the sin incurred in ten lives is removed; with a hundred, that which was done long ago; / with a thousand, the Gāyatrī destroys the sin arising from three births.

6.3.s:
vaidikaṃ laukikaṃ vāpi jāpyaṃ japtaṃ nareśvara .
tatkṣaṇāddahate sarvaṃ tṛṇaṃ tu jvalano yathā .. 77.5 ..
6.3.d:
वैदिकं लौकिकं वापि जाप्यं जप्तं नरेश्वर .
तत्क्षणाद्दहते सर्वं तृणं तु ज्वलनो यथा .. 77.5 ..
6.3.m: Whatever Vedic or worldly recitation is chanted, O lord of men, / at that moment burns all [sins], just as fire [burns] straw.

6.3.s:
na devabalamāśritya kadācitpāpamācaret .
ajñānānnaśyate kṣipraṃ nottaraṃ tu kadācana .. 77.6 ..
6.3.d:
न देवबलमाश्रित्य कदाचित्पापमाचरेत् .
अज्ञानान्नश्यते क्षिप्रं नोत्तरं तु कदाचन .. 77.6 ..
6.3.m: One should never commit a sin relying upon the power of a deity. / A [sin committed] through ignorance is destroyed quickly, but never one committed subsequently [with deliberation].

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo dānaṃ śaktimāśritya cācaret .
tadakṣayyaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate pāṇḍunandana .. 77.7 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhīmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 78
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो दानं शक्तिमाश्रित्य चाचरेत् .
तदक्षय्यफलं सर्वं जायते पाण्डुनन्दन .. 77.7 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भीमेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 78
6.3.m:
And whatever gift one gives at that sacred ford according to one's capacity, / all of that yields imperishable fruit, O son of Pāṇḍu.
Thus ends the seventy-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Bhīmeśvara Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 78

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra naradeśvaramuttamam .
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu .. 78.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र नरदेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
तीर्थानां परमं तीर्थं निर्मितं नारदेन तु .. 78.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Naradeśvara, / the supreme sacred ford among sacred fords, founded by Nārada.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
nāradena muniśreṣṭha kasmāttīrthaṃ vinirmitam .
etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasanno yadi sattama .. 78.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
नारदेन मुनिश्रेष्ठ कस्मात्तीर्थं विनिर्मितम् .
एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वं प्रसन्नो यदि सत्तम .. 78.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O best of sages, why was this sacred ford founded by Nārada? / Relate all this to me, if you are pleased [with me], O most virtuous one.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
parameṣṭhisutaḥ pārtha nārado munisattamaḥ .
revāyāścottare kūle tapastena purā kṛtam .. 78.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
परमेष्ठिसुतः पार्थ नारदो मुनिसत्तमः .
रेवायाश्चोत्तरे कूले तपस्तेन पुरा कृतम् .. 78.3 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Nārada, the son of the Supreme Lord [Brahmā], is the best of sages, O son of Pṛthā; / formerly, austerity was performed by him on the northern bank of the Revā.

6.3.s:
navanāḍīnirodhena kāṣṭhāvatyāṃ gatena ca .
toṣitaḥ paśubhartā vai nāradena yudhiṣṭhira .. 78.4 ..
6.3.d:
नवनाडीनिरोधेन काष्ठावत्यां गतेन च .
तोषितः पशुभर्ता वै नारदेन युधिष्ठिर .. 78.4 ..
6.3.m: By restraining the nine channels and remaining motionlessly absorbed like wood, / the Lord of Beings was truly pleased by Nārada, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
tuṣṭo'haṃ tava viprendra yoginātha ayonija .
varaṃ prārthaya me vatsa yaste manasi vartate .. 78.5 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
तुष्टोऽहं तव विप्रेन्द्र योगिनाथ अयोनिज .
वरं प्रार्थय मे वत्स यस्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 78.5 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / I am pleased with you, O best of brahmins, lord among yogins, unborn from a womb! / Ask a boon of me, child, whatever is in your mind.

6.3.s:
nārada uvāca -
tvatprasādena me śambho yogaścaiva prasidhyatu .
acalā te bhavedbhaktiḥ sarvakālaṃ mamaiva tu .. 78.6 ..
6.3.d:
नारद उवाच -
त्वत्प्रसादेन मे शम्भो योगश्चैव प्रसिध्यतु .
अचला ते भवेद्भक्तिः सर्वकालं ममैव तु .. 78.6 ..
6.3.m: Nārada said: / By your grace, O Śambhu, may my yoga be accomplished, / and may I have unswerving devotion to you at all times.

6.3.s:
svecchācārī bhave deva vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ .
trikālajño jagannātha gītajño'haṃ sadā bhave .. 78.7 ..
6.3.d:
स्वेच्छाचारी भवे देव वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः .
त्रिकालज्ञो जगन्नाथ गीतज्ञोऽहं सदा भवे .. 78.7 ..
6.3.m: May I wander at will, O God, well-versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas; / may I know the three times, O Lord of the World, and may I always know the art of song.

6.3.s:
dine dine yathā yuddhaṃ devadānavamānuṣaiḥ .
pātāle martyaloke vā svarge vāpi maheśvara .. 78.8 ..
6.3.d:
दिने दिने यथा युद्धं देवदानवमानुषैः .
पाताले मर्त्यलोके वा स्वर्गे वापि महेश्वर .. 78.8 ..
6.3.m: Day after day, just as there is conflict among gods, Dānavas, and human beings / in Pātāla, in the mortal world, or even in heaven, O Maheśvara,

6.3.s:
paśyeyaṃ tvatprasādena bhavantaṃ pārvatīṃ tathā .
tīrthaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 78.9 ..
6.3.d:
पश्येयं त्वत्प्रसादेन भवन्तं पार्वतीं तथा .
तीर्थं लोकेषु विख्यातं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 78.9 ..
6.3.m: may I behold [it], and by your grace behold you and Pārvatī likewise; / and [grant] a sacred ford renowned throughout the worlds, destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
evaṃ nārada sarvaṃ tu bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .
cintitaṃ matprasādena sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 78.10 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
एवं नारद सर्वं तु भविष्यति न संशयः .
चिन्तितं मत्प्रसादेन सिध्यते नात्र संशयः .. 78.10 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Thus, O Nārada, all shall come to pass, there is no doubt. / Whatever you have thought will be accomplished through my grace; there is no doubt here.

6.3.s:
svecchācāro bhavervatsa svarge pātālagocare .
martye vā bhrama vai yoginna kenāpi nivāryase .. 78.11 ..
6.3.d:
स्वेच्छाचारो भवेर्वत्स स्वर्गे पातालगोचरे .
मर्त्ये वा भ्रम वै योगिन्न केनापि निवार्यसे .. 78.11 ..
6.3.m: You will wander at will, my child, in heaven and in the realm of Pātāla; / wander also in the mortal realm, O yogin, and you will not be restrained by anyone.

6.3.s:
sapta svarāstrayo grāmā mūrcchanāścaikaviṃśatiḥ .
tānā ekonapañcāśatprasādānme tava dhruvam .. 78.12 ..
6.3.d:
सप्त स्वरास्त्रयो ग्रामा मूर्च्छनाश्चैकविंशतिः .
ताना एकोनपञ्चाशत्प्रसादान्मे तव ध्रुवम् .. 78.12 ..
6.3.m: The seven musical notes, the three scales, the twenty-one modulations, / and the forty-nine melodic patterns [shall be yours] by my grace, surely.

6.3.s:
mama priyaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ nṛtyagītaṃ bhaviṣyati .
kaliṃ ca paśyase nityaṃ devadānavakinnaraiḥ .. 78.13 ..
6.3.d:
मम प्रियंकरं दिव्यं नृत्यगीतं भविष्यति .
कलिं च पश्यसे नित्यं देवदानवकिन्नरैः .. 78.13 ..
6.3.m: Divine song and dance will be pleasing to me; / and you will constantly behold strife among gods, Dānavas, and Kinnaras.

6.3.s:
tvattīrthaṃ bhūtale puṇyaṃ matprasādādbhaviṣyati .
vedavedāṅgatattvajño hyaśeṣajñānakovidaḥ .
ekastvamasi niḥsaṅgo matprasādena nārada .. 78.14 ..
6.3.d:
त्वत्तीर्थं भूतले पुण्यं मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति .
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो ह्यशेषज्ञानकोविदः .
एकस्त्वमसि निःसङ्गो मत्प्रसादेन नारद .. 78.14 ..
6.3.m: Your sacred ford on the face of the earth will be holy through my grace. / Knowing the essence of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, skilled in all knowledge, / you are solitary and unattached through my grace, O Nārada.

6.3.s:
ityuktvāntardadhe devo nāradastatra śūlinam .
sthāpayāmāsa rājendra sarvasattvopakārakam .. 78.15 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवो नारदस्तत्र शूलिनम् .
स्थापयामास राजेन्द्र सर्वसत्त्वोपकारकम् .. 78.15 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the God disappeared. Then, O best of kings, Nārada / installed the Bearer of the Trident there, who benefits all beings.

6.3.s:
pṛthivyāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu .
tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha yo gacchedvijitendriyaḥ .. 78.16 ..
6.3.d:
पृथिव्यामुत्तमं तीर्थं निर्मितं नारदेन तु .
तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ यो गच्छेद्विजितेन्द्रियः .. 78.16 ..
6.3.m: An excellent sacred ford on earth was founded by Nārada; / whichever self-controlled person goes to that sacred ford, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
māsi bhādrapade pārtha kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī .
upoṣya parayā bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .. 78.17 ..
6.3.d:
मासि भाद्रपदे पार्थ कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी .
उपोष्य परया भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .. 78.17 ..
6.3.m: on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Bhādrapada, O son of Pṛthā, / fasting with supreme devotion, should keep vigil at night.

6.3.s:
chatraṃ tatra pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe śubhalakṣaṇe .
śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ pradāpayet .
te yānti paramaṃ lokaṃ piṇḍadānaprabhāvataḥ .. 78.18 ..
6.3.d:
छत्रं तत्र प्रदातव्यं ब्राह्मणे शुभलक्षणे .
शस्त्रेण तु हता ये वै तेषां श्राद्धं प्रदापयेत् .
ते यान्ति परमं लोकं पिण्डदानप्रभावतः .. 78.18 ..
6.3.m: An umbrella should be given there to a brahmin endowed with auspicious marks. / For those who were killed by a weapon, one should offer a śrāddha; / they go to the supreme realm through the power of the gift of rice-balls.

6.3.s:
kapilā tatra dātavyā pitḥnuddiśya bhārata .
ityuccārya dvije deyā yāntu te paramāṃ gatim .. 78.19 ..
6.3.d:
कपिला तत्र दातव्या पित्ःनुद्दिश्य भारत .
इत्युच्चार्य द्विजे देया यान्तु ते परमां गतिम् .. 78.19 ..
6.3.m: A brown cow should be given there for the sake of the ancestors, O descendant of Bharata, / uttering thus, it should be given to a twice-born: 'May they attain the supreme state!'

6.3.s:
asya śrāddhasya bhāvena brāhmaṇasya prasādataḥ .
narmadātoyabhāvena nyāyārjitadhanasya ca .
teṣāṃ caiva prabhāvena pretā yāntu parāṃ gatim .. 78.20 ..
6.3.d:
अस्य श्राद्धस्य भावेन ब्राह्मणस्य प्रसादतः .
नर्मदातोयभावेन न्यायार्जितधनस्य च .
तेषां चैव प्रभावेन प्रेता यान्तु परां गतिम् .. 78.20 ..
6.3.m: 'Through the intention of this śrāddha, through the grace of the brahmin, / through the nature of the waters of the Narmadā, and through wealth earned righteously, / and through their power, may the spirits of the dead attain the supreme state!'

6.3.s:
ityuccārya dvije deyā dakṣiṇā ca svaśaktitaḥ .
haviṣyānnaṃ viśālākṣa dvijānāṃ caiva dāpayet .. 78.21 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युच्चार्य द्विजे देया दक्षिणा च स्वशक्तितः .
हविष्यान्नं विशालाक्ष द्विजानां चैव दापयेत् .. 78.21 ..
6.3.m: Having uttered thus, a sacrificial fee should be given to the twice-born according to one's capacity, / and one should feed the twice-born with sacrificial food, O large-eyed one.

6.3.s:
dīpaṃ bhaktyā pradātavyaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca kārayet .
avāptaṃ tena vai sarvaṃ yaḥ karotīśvarālaye .. 78.22 ..
6.3.d:
दीपं भक्त्या प्रदातव्यं नृत्यं गीतं च कारयेत् .
अवाप्तं तेन वै सर्वं यः करोतीश्वरालये .. 78.22 ..
6.3.m: A lamp should be offered with devotion, and dance and song should be performed; / indeed, everything is obtained by him who performs this in the abode of Īśvara.

6.3.s:
sa yāti rudrasāṃnidhyamiti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau .
vidyādānena caikena akṣayāṃ gatimāpnuyāt .. 78.23 ..
6.3.d:
स याति रुद्रसांनिध्यमिति रुद्रः स्वयं जगौ .
विद्यादानेन चैकेन अक्षयां गतिमाप्नुयात् .. 78.23 ..
6.3.m: He goes to the presence of Rudra; so Rudra himself proclaimed. / And by the singular gift of knowledge, he attains an imperishable state.

6.3.s:
dhūrvahāstatra dātavyā bhūmiḥ sasyavatī nṛpa .
citrabhānuṃ śubhairmantraiḥ prīṇayettatra bhaktitaḥ .. 78.24 ..
6.3.d:
धूर्वहास्तत्र दातव्या भूमिः सस्यवती नृप .
चित्रभानुं शुभैर्मन्त्रैः प्रीणयेत्तत्र भक्तितः .. 78.24 ..
6.3.m: Draught-oxen should be given there, [and] land bearing crops, O king. / One should please the fire [Citrabhānu] there with devotion, using auspicious mantras,

6.3.s:
ājyena suprabhūtena homadravyeṇa bhārata .
ye yajanti sadā bhaktyā trikālaṃ nṛtyameva ca .. 78.25 ..
6.3.d:
आज्येन सुप्रभूतेन होमद्रव्येण भारत .
ये यजन्ति सदा भक्त्या त्रिकालं नृत्यमेव च .. 78.25 ..
6.3.m: with abundant clarified butter and sacrificial materials, O descendant of Bharata. / Those who always worship with devotion at the three times of day and [offer] dance

6.3.s:
tīrthe nāradanāmākhye revāyāścottare taṭe .
citrabhānumukhā devāḥ sarvadevamaya ṛṣiḥ .. 78.26 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थे नारदनामाख्ये रेवायाश्चोत्तरे तटे .
चित्रभानुमुखा देवाः सर्वदेवमय ऋषिः .. 78.26 ..
6.3.m: at the sacred ford called Nārada on the northern bank of the Revā— / the gods have Citrabhānu as their mouth, and the sage is composed of all the gods.

6.3.s:
ṛṣiṇā prīṇitāḥ sarve tasmātprītyo hutāśanaḥ .
pūjite havyavāhe tu dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate .. 78.27 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषिणा प्रीणिताः सर्वे तस्मात्प्रीत्यो हुताशनः .
पूजिते हव्यवाहे तु दारिद्र्यं नैव जायते .. 78.27 ..
6.3.m: All are pleased by the sage; therefore, the consumer of oblations is pleased. / When the bearer of oblations is worshipped, poverty never arises.

6.3.s:
dhanena vipulā prītirjāyate pratijanmani .
kulīnāśca suveṣāśca sarvakālaṃ dhanena tu .. 78.28 ..
6.3.d:
धनेन विपुला प्रीतिर्जायते प्रतिजन्मनि .
कुलीनाश्च सुवेषाश्च सर्वकालं धनेन तु .. 78.28 ..
6.3.m: Great satisfaction through wealth arises in every birth; / and they are of noble family and handsomely attired at all times through wealth.

6.3.s:
plavo nadīnāṃ patiraṅganānāṃ rājā ca sadvṛttarataḥ prajānām .
dhanaṃ narāṇāmṛtavastarūṇāṃ gataṃ gataṃ yauvanamānayanti .. 78.29 ..
6.3.d:
प्लवो नदीनां पतिरङ्गनानां राजा च सद्वृत्तरतः प्रजानाम् .
धनं नराणामृतवस्तरूणां गतं गतं यौवनमानयन्ति .. 78.29 ..
6.3.m: A raft for rivers, a husband for women, a king devoted to good conduct for his subjects, / wealth for men, and seasons for trees bring back their departed youth again and again.

6.3.s:
dhanadatvaṃ dhaneśena tasmiṃstīrthe hyupārjitam .
yamena ca yamatvaṃ hi indratvaṃ caiva vajriṇā .. 78.30 ..
6.3.d:
धनदत्वं धनेशेन तस्मिंस्तीर्थे ह्युपार्जितम् .
यमेन च यमत्वं हि इन्द्रत्वं चैव वज्रिणा .. 78.30 ..
6.3.m: The status of the giver of wealth was attained by the Lord of Wealth at that very sacred ford; / and the status of Yama by Yama, and the status of Indra by the wielder of the thunderbolt.

6.3.s:
anyairapi mahīpālaiḥ pārthivatvamupārjitam .
nāradeśvaramāhātmyāddhruvo niścalatāṃ gataḥ .. 78.31 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यैरपि महीपालैः पार्थिवत्वमुपार्जितम् .
नारदेश्वरमाहात्म्याद्ध्रुवो निश्चलतां गतः .. 78.31 ..
6.3.m: Sovereignty over the earth was attained by other kings as well; / Dhruva achieved steadfastness through the māhātmya of Nāradeśvara.

6.3.s:
sarvatīrthavaraṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ nāradena tu .
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ revāyāścottare taṭe .
tadvaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 78.32 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāradeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
सर्वतीर्थवरं तीर्थं निर्मितं नारदेन तु .
पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां रेवायाश्चोत्तरे तटे .
तद्वरं सर्वतीर्थानां महापातकनाशनम् .. 78.32 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नारदेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
The sacred ford, best among all sacred fords, was founded by Nārada / on the ocean-bounded earth, on the northern bank of the Revā; / it is the best of all sacred fords, destroying the greatest sins.
Thus ends the seventy-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Nāradeśvara Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthadvayamanuttamam .
dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 79.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थद्वयमनुत्तमम् .
दधिस्कन्दं मधुस्कन्दं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 79.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the two incomparable sacred fords, / Dadhiskanda and Madhuskanda, which bring about the destruction of all sins. // 79.1

6.3.s:
dadhiskande naraḥ snātvā yastu dadyāddvije dadhi .
upatiṣṭhettatastasya saptajanmani bhārata .. 79.2 ..
6.3.d:
दधिस्कन्दे नरः स्नात्वा यस्तु दद्याद्द्विजे दधि .
उपतिष्ठेत्ततस्तस्य सप्तजन्मनि भारत .. 79.2 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes at Dadhiskanda and gives curds to a brahmin— / it shall attend him for seven births, O Bhārata. // 79.2

6.3.s:
na vyādhirna jarā tasya na śoko naiva matsaraḥ .
daśacandraśataṃ yāvajjāyate vimale kule .. 79.3 ..
6.3.d:
न व्याधिर्न जरा तस्य न शोको नैव मत्सरः .
दशचन्द्रशतं यावज्जायते विमले कुले .. 79.3 ..
6.3.m: He has neither disease nor old age, neither sorrow nor envy. / He is born in a spotless family for as long as a thousand months. // 79.3

6.3.s:
madhuskande'pi madhunā miśritānyastilāndadet .
nāsau vaivasvataṃ devaṃ paśyedvai janmasaptatim .. 79.4 ..
6.3.d:
मधुस्कन्देऽपि मधुना मिश्रितान्यस्तिलान्ददेत् .
नासौ वैवस्वतं देवं पश्येद्वै जन्मसप्ततिम् .. 79.4 ..
6.3.m: At Madhuskanda also, he who gives sesame seeds mixed with honey / does not see the god born of Vivasvat for seventy births. // 79.4

6.3.s:
madhunā saha sammiśraṃ piṇḍaṃ yastu pradāpayet .
tasya pautraprapautrebhyo dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate .. 79.5 ..
6.3.d:
मधुना सह सम्मिश्रं पिण्डं यस्तु प्रदापयेत् .
तस्य पौत्रप्रपौत्रेभ्यो दारिद्र्यं नैव जायते .. 79.5 ..
6.3.m: He who offers an ancestral ball of food mixed with honey— / poverty does not arise for his grandsons or great-grandsons. // 79.5

6.3.s:
dadhibhiḥ saha saṃmiśraṃ piṇḍaṃ yastu pradāpayet .
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhivaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ .. 79.6 ..
6.3.d:
दधिभिः सह संमिश्रं पिण्डं यस्तु प्रदापयेत् .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विधिवद्दक्षिणामुखः .. 79.6 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes in that sacred ford and, according to the rule, facing south, / offers an ancestral ball of food mixed with curds, // 79.6

6.3.s:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ .
dvādaśābdāni tuṣyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 79.7 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dadhiskandamadhuskandatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 80
6.3.d:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः .
द्वादशाब्दानि तुष्यन्ति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 79.7 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दधिस्कन्दमधुस्कन्दतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनाशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 80
6.3.m:
his father, grandfather, and likewise great-grandfather / are pleased for twelve years; about this no doubt should be entertained. // 79.7
Thus ends the seventy-ninth chapter, entitled the description of the māhātmya of the Dadhiskanda and Madhuskanda sacred fords, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 80

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra nandikeśvaramuttamam .
yatra siddho mahānandī tatte sarvaṃ vadāmyaham .. 80.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र नन्दिकेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महानन्दी तत्ते सर्वं वदाम्यहम् .. 80.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the excellent Nandikeśvara,
where the great Nandī attained perfection. I shall tell you all about it.

6.3.s:
revāyāṃ purataḥ kṛtvā purā nandī gaṇeśvaraḥ .
tapastapañjayaṃ kurvaṃstīrthāttīrthaṃ jagāma ha .. 80.2 ..
6.3.d:
रेवायां पुरतः कृत्वा पुरा नन्दी गणेश्वरः .
तपस्तपञ्जयं कुर्वंस्तीर्थात्तीर्थं जगाम ह .. 80.2 ..
6.3.m:
Formerly Nandī, the lord of the gaṇas, placing the Revā in front [of him],
went from sacred ford to sacred ford, performing tapas and repeating prayers.

6.3.s:
dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ yāvattyaktvā tu gacchati .
tāvattuṣṭo mahādevo nandināthamuvāca ha .. 80.3 ..
6.3.d:
दधिस्कन्दं मधुस्कन्दं यावत्त्यक्त्वा तु गच्छति .
तावत्तुष्टो महादेवो नन्दिनाथमुवाच ह .. 80.3 ..
6.3.m:
As he left Dadhiskanda and Madhuskanda and went on,
Mahādeva became pleased and spoke to the lord Nandī:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
bhobhoḥ prasanno nandīśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam .
tapasā tena tuṣṭo'haṃ tīrthayātrākṛtena te .. 80.4 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
भोभोः प्रसन्नो नन्दीश वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम् .
तपसा तेन तुष्टोऽहं तीर्थयात्राकृतेन ते .. 80.4 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
"Hail, hail! I am pleased, O lord of Nandī; choose a boon as you desire.
I am satisfied with that tapas performed by you during your pilgrimage to the sacred fords."

6.3.s:
nandīśvara uvāca -
na cāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na cāhaṃ kulasantatim .
muktvā na kāmaye kāmaṃ tava pādāmbujātparam .. 80.5 ..
6.3.d:
नन्दीश्वर उवाच -
न चाहं कामये वित्तं न चाहं कुलसन्ततिम् .
मुक्त्वा न कामये कामं तव पादाम्बुजात्परम् .. 80.5 ..
6.3.m:
Nandīśvara said:
"I do not desire wealth, nor do I desire offspring for my lineage.
Apart from your lotus feet, I desire no object of desire whatsoever.

6.3.s:
kṛmikīṭapataṅgeṣu tiryagyoniṃ gatasya vā .
janma janmāntare'pyastu bhaktistvayi mamācalā .. 80.6 ..
6.3.d:
कृमिकीटपतङ्गेषु तिर्यग्योनिं गतस्य वा .
जन्म जन्मान्तरेऽप्यस्तु भक्तिस्त्वयि ममाचला .. 80.6 ..
6.3.m:
Even if I enter the womb of animals, among worms, insects, or moths,
may my devotion to you remain unshakable in life after life!"

6.3.s:
tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ parayā kṛpayā nṛpa .
gṛhītvā taṃ kare siddhaṃ jagāma nilayaṃ haraḥ .. 80.7 ..
6.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवः परया कृपया नृप .
गृहीत्वा तं करे सिद्धं जगाम निलयं हरः .. 80.7 ..
6.3.m:
Saying, "So be it," out of supreme compassion, O king,
Hara took that perfected one by the hand and went to his abode.

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyā tryakṣaṃ prapūjayet .
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 80.8 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा भक्त्या त्र्यक्षं प्रपूजयेत् .
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 80.8 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and worships the Three-Eyed One with devotion,
that person obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti cet .
śivasyānucaro bhūtvā modate kalpamakṣayam .. 80.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा प्राणत्यागं करोति चेत् .
शिवस्यानुचरो भूत्वा मोदते कल्पमक्षयम् .. 80.9 ..
6.3.m:
If a person bathes at that sacred ford and gives up their life,
they become an attendant of Śiva and rejoice for an imperishable aeon.

6.3.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā jāyate vimale kule .
vedavedāṅgatattvajño jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 80.10 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कालेन महता जायते विमले कुले .
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 80.10 ..
6.3.m:
Then, after a great length of time, he is born into a pure lineage,
knowing the true meaning of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, and lives for a hundred autumns.

6.3.s:
etatte kathitaṃ tāta tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam .
durlabhaṃ martyasaṃjñasya sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 80.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandikeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 81
6.3.d:
एतत्ते कथितं तात तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .
दुर्लभं मर्त्यसंज्ञस्य सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 80.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नन्दिकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 81
6.3.m:
This excellent māhātmya of the sacred ford has been told to you, dear one;
it is difficult to attain for mortals and destroys all sins.
Thus ends the eightieth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Nandikeśvara Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 81

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahārāja varuṇeśvaramuttamam .
yatra siddho mahādevo varuṇo nṛpasattama .. 81.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महाराज वरुणेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महादेवो वरुणो नृपसत्तम .. 81.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O great king, to the excellent Varuṇeśvara,
where, O best of kings, Varuṇa attained perfection [through] Mahādeva.

6.3.s:
piṇyākaśākaparṇaiśca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ .
ārādhya girijānāthaṃ tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ .. 81.2 ..
6.3.d:
पिण्याकशाकपर्णैश्च कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः .
आराध्य गिरिजानाथं ततः सिद्धिं परां गतः .. 81.2 ..
6.3.m:
By means of oil cake, vegetables, and leaves, and by austerities such as the Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa,
he worshipped the lord of the Mountain's Daughter and then attained supreme perfection.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .
pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 81.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः .
पूजयेच्छङ्करं भक्त्या स याति परमां गतिम् .. 81.3 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes at that sacred ford, gratifies the ancestors and gods,
and worships Śaṃkara with devotion, goes to the supreme state.

6.3.s:
kuṇḍikāṃ vardhanīṃ vāpi mahadvā jalabhājanam .
annena sahitaṃ pārtha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 81.4 ..
6.3.d:
कुण्डिकां वर्धनीं वापि महद्वा जलभाजनम् .
अन्नेन सहितं पार्थ तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 81.4 ..
6.3.m:
Hear the meritorious fruit, O son of Pṛthā, of giving a small water-pot, a pitcher,
or a large water vessel together with food.

6.3.s:
yatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ satre dvādaśavārṣike .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 81.5 ..
6.3.d:
यत्फलं लभते मर्त्यः सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 81.5 ..
6.3.m:
The fruit that a mortal obtains at a twelve-year sacrificial session—
he obtains that very fruit; no doubt should be entertained here.

6.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva dānānāmannadānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam .
sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ toyamannaṃ ca nṛpasattama .. 81.6 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव दानानामन्नदानं परं स्मृतम् .
सद्यः प्रीतिकरं तोयमन्नं च नृपसत्तम .. 81.6 ..
6.3.m:
The gift of food is considered the highest of all gifts;
water and food bring immediate delight, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
tatratīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām .
varuṇasya pure vāso yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 81.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रतीर्थे मृतानां तु नराणां भावितात्मनाम् .
वरुणस्य पुरे वासो यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् .. 81.7 ..
6.3.m:
For men of purified minds who die at that sacred ford,
their dwelling is in the city of Varuṇa until the universal dissolution.

6.3.s:
paścātpūrṇe tataḥ kāle martyaloke prajāyate .
annadānaprado nityaṃ jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ .. 81.8 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe varuṇeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 82
6.3.d:
पश्चात्पूर्णे ततः काले मर्त्यलोके प्रजायते .
अन्नदानप्रदो नित्यं जीवेद्वर्षशतं नरः .. 81.8 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे वरुणेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकाशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 82
6.3.m:
Afterward, when that time is complete, he is born in the world of mortals;
always bestowing gifts of food, that man lives for a hundred years.
Thus ends the eighty-first chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Varuṇeśvara Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 82

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla vahnitīrthamanuttamam .
yatra siddho mahātejāstapaḥ kṛtvā hutāśanaḥ .. 82.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल वह्नितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महातेजास्तपः कृत्वा हुताशनः .. 82.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O ruler of the earth, to the unexcelled Vahnitīrtha,
where the Fire, endowed with great splendor, attained perfection after performing tapas.

6.3.s:
sarvabhakṣyaḥ kṛto yo'sau daṇḍake muninā purā .
narmadātaṭamāśritya pūto jāto hutāśanaḥ .. 82.2 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वभक्ष्यः कृतो योऽसौ दण्डके मुनिना पुरा .
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य पूतो जातो हुताशनः .. 82.2 ..
6.3.m:
He who was formerly cursed by a sage in Daṇḍaka to be an eater of all things
became purified by resorting to the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram .
agnipraveśaṃ kurute sa gacchedagnisāmyatām .. 82.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
अग्निप्रवेशं कुरुते स गच्छेदग्निसाम्यताम् .. 82.3 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes at that sacred ford, worships Maheśvara,
and enters the fire, attains equality with the Fire.

6.3.s:
bhaktyā snātvā tu yastatra tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 82.4 ..
6.3.d:
भक्त्या स्नात्वा तु यस्तत्र तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् .. 82.4 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes there with devotion and gratifies the ancestors and gods
obtains without doubt the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

6.3.s:
tasyaivānantaraṃ rājankauberaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
kubero yatra saṃsiddho yakṣāṇāmadhipaḥ purā .. 82.5 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यैवानन्तरं राजन्कौबेरं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
कुबेरो यत्र संसिद्धो यक्षाणामधिपः पुरा .. 82.5 ..
6.3.m:
Immediately following it, O king, is the excellent Kaubera Tīrtha,
where formerly Kubera, the lord of the yakṣas, attained complete perfection.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā samabhyarcya jagadgurum .
umayā sahitaṃ bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 82.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य जगद्गुरुम् .
उमया सहितं भक्त्या सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 82.6 ..
6.3.m:
A person who bathes at that sacred ford and worships the Teacher of the World
together with Umā with devotion, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyādviprāya kāṃcanam .
nābhimātre jale tiṣṭhansa labhetārbudaṃ phalam .. 82.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दद्याद्विप्राय कांचनम् .
नाभिमात्रे जले तिष्ठन्स लभेतार्बुदं फलम् .. 82.7 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes at that sacred ford, stands in navel-deep water,
and gives gold to a brahmin, obtains a hundred millionfold reward.

6.3.s:
dadhiskande madhuskande nandīśe varuṇālaye .
āgneye yatphalaṃ tāta snātvā tatphalamāpnuyāt .. 82.8 ..
6.3.d:
दधिस्कन्दे मधुस्कन्दे नन्दीशे वरुणालये .
आग्नेये यत्फलं तात स्नात्वा तत्फलमाप्नुयात् .. 82.8 ..
6.3.m:
The fruit that exists at Dadhiskanda, Madhuskanda, Nandīśa, the abode of Varuṇa,
and the fire-ford, dear one—one obtains all that fruit by bathing [here].

6.3.s:
te vandyā mānuṣe loke dhanyāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ .
yaistu dṛṣṭaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ narmadātīrthapañcakam .. 82.9 ..
6.3.d:
ते वन्द्या मानुषे लोके धन्याः पूर्णमनोरथाः .
यैस्तु दृष्टं महापुण्यं नर्मदातीर्थपञ्चकम् .. 82.9 ..
6.3.m:
They are praiseworthy in the world of men, blessed, and have their desires fulfilled,
by whom the group of five sacred fords of the Narmadā, endowed with great merit, has been visited.

6.3.s:
te yānti bhāskare loke parame duḥkhanāśane .
bhāskarādaiśvare loke caiśvarādanivartake .. 82.10 ..
6.3.d:
ते यान्ति भास्करे लोके परमे दुःखनाशने .
भास्करादैश्वरे लोके चैश्वरादनिवर्तके .. 82.10 ..
6.3.m:
They go to the world of the Sun, supreme and destroying suffering;
from the world of the Sun to the world of Īśvara, and from that of Īśvara to the realm of no return.

6.3.s:
nīyate sa pare loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .
tataḥ svargāccyuto martyo rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 82.11 ..
6.3.d:
नीयते स परे लोके यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश .
ततः स्वर्गाच्च्युतो मर्त्यो राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 82.11 ..
6.3.m:
He is carried to that supreme world for as long as fourteen Indras rule.
Then, fallen from heaven, that mortal becomes a righteous king.

6.3.s:
sarvarogavinirmukto bhunakti sacarācaram .
viṣṇuśca devatā yeṣāṃ narmadātīrthasevinām .. 82.12 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वरोगविनिर्मुक्तो भुनक्ति सचराचरम् .
विष्णुश्च देवता येषां नर्मदातीर्थसेविनाम् .. 82.12 ..
6.3.m:
Freed from all diseases, he rules over the moving and unmoving world.
For those who serve the sacred fords of the Narmadā and have Viṣṇu as their deity,

6.3.s:
akhaṇḍitapratāpāste jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .
gaṅgā kanakhale puṇyā kurukṣetre sarasvatī .. 82.13 ..
6.3.d:
अखण्डितप्रतापास्ते जायन्ते नात्र संशयः .
गङ्गा कनखले पुण्या कुरुक्षेत्रे सरस्वती .. 82.13 ..
6.3.m:
their power becomes unbroken; of this there is no doubt.
The Gaṅgā is sacred at Kanakhala, the Sarasvatī at Kurukṣetra,

6.3.s:
grāme vā yadi vāraṇye puṇyā sarvatra narmadā .
revātīre vasennityaṃ revātoyaṃ sadā pibet .. 82.14 ..
6.3.d:
ग्रामे वा यदि वारण्ये पुण्या सर्वत्र नर्मदा .
रेवातीरे वसेन्नित्यं रेवातोयं सदा पिबेत् .. 82.14 ..
6.3.m:
but whether in a village or in a forest, the Narmadā is sacred everywhere.
One should dwell constantly on the bank of the Revā and always drink the water of the Revā.

6.3.s:
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu somapānaṃ dine dine .
gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudrāśca sarāṃsi ca .
kalpānte saṃkṣayaṃ yānti na mṛtā tena narmadā .. 82.15 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dadhiskandādipañcatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 83
6.3.d:
स स्नातः सर्वतीर्थेषु सोमपानं दिने दिने .
गङ्गाद्याः सरितः सर्वाः समुद्राश्च सरांसि च .
कल्पान्ते संक्षयं यान्ति न मृता तेन नर्मदा .. 82.15 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दधिस्कन्दादिपञ्चतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 83
6.3.m:
He has bathed in all the sacred fords and drinks soma day after day.
All rivers beginning with the Gaṅgā, the oceans, and the lakes
perish at the end of an aeon; therefore the Narmadā is immortal.
Thus ends the eighty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Five Sacred Fords Beginning with Dadhiskanda', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 83

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
brahmahatyāharaṃ proktaṃ revātaṭasamāśrayam .
hanūmatābhidhaṃ hyatra vidyate liṅgamuttamam .. 83.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महाराज तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
ब्रह्महत्याहरं प्रोक्तं रेवातटसमाश्रयम् .
हनूमताभिधं ह्यत्र विद्यते लिङ्गमुत्तमम् .. 83.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O great king, to the extremely beautiful sacred ford,
said to remove the murder of a brahmin, situated on the bank of the Revā.
For here exists the excellent liṅga named after Hanumat.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
hanūmanteśvaraṃ nāma kathaṃ jātaṃ vadasva me .
brahmahatyāharaṃ tīrthaṃ revādakṣiṇasaṃsthitam .. 83.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
हनूमन्तेश्वरं नाम कथं जातं वदस्व मे .
ब्रह्महत्याहरं तीर्थं रेवादक्षिणसंस्थितम् .. 83.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me how Hanūmanteśvara came to be,
the sacred ford that removes the murder of a brahmin, situated on the southern bank of the Revā.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahābāho somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇa .
guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā .. 83.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधु साधु महाबाहो सोमवंशविभूषण .
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं नाख्यातं कस्यचिन्मया .. 83.3 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Excellent, excellent, O mighty-armed one, ornament of the lunar dynasty! / I have not told anyone of this sacred ford, which is more secret than the secret.

6.3.s:
tava snehātpravakṣyāmi pīḍito vārddhakena tu .
pūrvaṃ jātaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ rāmarāvaṇayorapi .. 83.4 ..
6.3.d:
तव स्नेहात्प्रवक्ष्यामि पीडितो वार्द्धकेन तु .
पूर्वं जातं महद्युद्धं रामरावणयोरपि .. 83.4 ..
6.3.m: Out of affection for you I shall declare it, though I am afflicted by old age. / Long ago, a great battle took place between Rāma and Rāvaṇa.

6.3.s:
pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ putro viśravāstasya vai sutaḥ .
rāvaṇastena saṃjāto daśāsyo brahmarākṣasaḥ .. 83.5 ..
6.3.d:
पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो विश्रवास्तस्य वै सुतः .
रावणस्तेन संजातो दशास्यो ब्रह्मराक्षसः .. 83.5 ..
6.3.m: Pulastya was the son of Brahmā, and Viśravas was indeed his son. / From him was born Rāvaṇa, the ten-faced brahmarākṣasa.

6.3.s:
trailokyavijayī bhūtaḥ prasādācchūlinaḥ sa ca .
gīrvāṇā vijitāḥ sarve rāmasya gṛhiṇī hṛtā .. 83.6 ..
6.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यविजयी भूतः प्रसादाच्छूलिनः स च .
गीर्वाणा विजिताः सर्वे रामस्य गृहिणी हृता .. 83.6 ..
6.3.m: And by the grace of the wielder of the trident, he became the conqueror of the three worlds. / All the gods were conquered, and Rāma's wife was abducted.

6.3.s:
vāritaḥ kumbhakarṇena sītāṃ mocaya mocaya .
vibhīṣaṇena vai pāpo mandodaryā punaḥpunaḥ .. 83.7 ..
6.3.d:
वारितः कुम्भकर्णेन सीतां मोचय मोचय .
विभीषणेन वै पापो मन्दोदर्या पुनःपुनः .. 83.7 ..
6.3.m: The sinner was repeatedly restrained by Kumbhakarṇa, by Vibhīṣaṇa, / and by Mandodarī: 'Release Sītā, release her!'

6.3.s:
tvaṃ jitaḥ kārtavīryeṇa raiṇukeyena so'pi ca .
sa rāmo rāmabhadreṇa tasya saṃkhye kathaṃ jayaḥ .. 83.8 ..
6.3.d:
त्वं जितः कार्तवीर्येण रैणुकेयेन सोऽपि च .
स रामो रामभद्रेण तस्य संख्ये कथं जयः .. 83.8 ..
6.3.m: 'You were defeated by Kārtavīrya, and he too by the son of Reṇukā; / that Rāma [was defeated] by Rāmabhadra; how then could there be your victory in battle?'

6.3.s:
rāvaṇa uvāca -
vānaraiśca narairṛkṣairvarāhaiśca nirāyudhaiḥ .
devāsurasamūhaiśca na jito'haṃ kadācana .. 83.9 ..
6.3.d:
रावण उवाच -
वानरैश्च नरैरृक्षैर्वराहैश्च निरायुधैः .
देवासुरसमूहैश्च न जितोऽहं कदाचन .. 83.9 ..
6.3.m: Rāvaṇa said: / 'By monkeys, men, bears, and by unarmed boars, / and by hosts of gods and asuras, I was never defeated.'

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sugrīvahanumadbhyāṃ ca kumudenāṅgadena ca .
etairanyaiḥ sahāyaiśca rāmacandreṇa vai jitaḥ .. 83.10 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सुग्रीवहनुमद्भ्यां च कुमुदेनाङ्गदेन च .
एतैरन्यैः सहायैश्च रामचन्द्रेण वै जितः .. 83.10 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Yet by Rāmacandra, with Sugrīva and Hanumān, / with Kumuda, Aṅgada, and with these and other allies, he was indeed conquered.

6.3.s:
rāmacandreṇa paulastyo hataḥ saṃkhye mahābalaḥ .
vanaṃ bhagnaṃ hatāḥ śūrāḥ prabhañjanasutena ca .. 83.11 ..
6.3.d:
रामचन्द्रेण पौलस्त्यो हतः संख्ये महाबलः .
वनं भग्नं हताः शूराः प्रभञ्जनसुतेन च .. 83.11 ..
6.3.m: By Rāmacandra, the mighty son of Pulastya was slain in battle. / The forest was broken, and heroes were slain by the son of the Wind.

6.3.s:
rāvaṇasya suto janye hataścākṣakumārakaḥ .
āyāmo rakṣasāṃ bhīmaḥ sampiṣṭo vānareṇa tu .. 83.12 ..
6.3.d:
रावणस्य सुतो जन्ये हतश्चाक्षकुमारकः .
आयामो रक्षसां भीमः सम्पिष्टो वानरेण तु .. 83.12 ..
6.3.m: Rāvaṇa's son, Prince Akṣa, was slain in combat, / and the dreadful might of the rākṣasas was crushed by the monkey.

6.3.s:
evaṃ rāmāyaṇe vṛtte sītāmokṣe kṛte sati .
ayodhyāṃ tu gate rāme hanumānsa mahākapiḥ .. 83.13 ..
6.3.d:
एवं रामायणे वृत्ते सीतामोक्षे कृते सति .
अयोध्यां तु गते रामे हनुमान्स महाकपिः .. 83.13 ..
6.3.m: When this event of the Rāmāyaṇa had thus passed and Sītā had been freed, / and Rāma had gone to Ayodhyā, that great monkey Hanumān

6.3.s:
kailāsākhyaṃ gataḥ śailaṃ praṇāmāya maheśituḥ .
tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyasau prokto nandinā vānarottamaḥ .. 83.14 ..
6.3.d:
कैलासाख्यं गतः शैलं प्रणामाय महेशितुः .
तिष्ठ तिष्ठेत्यसौ प्रोक्तो नन्दिना वानरोत्तमः .. 83.14 ..
6.3.m: went to the mountain named Kailāsa to bow before the Great Lord. / 'Wait, wait!' that best of monkeys was told by Nandin:

6.3.s:
brahmahatyāyutastvaṃ hi rākṣasānāṃ vadhena hi .
bhairavasya sabhā nūnaṃ na draṣṭavyā tvayā kape .. 83.15 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्यायुतस्त्वं हि राक्षसानां वधेन हि .
भैरवस्य सभा नूनं न द्रष्टव्या त्वया कपे .. 83.15 ..
6.3.m: 'You are tainted with the sin of killing brahmins, on account of slaying the rākṣasas. / Truly, O monkey, the assembly hall of Bhairava must not be seen by you.'

6.3.s:
hanumānuvāca -
nandinātha haraṃ pṛccha pātakasyopaśāntidam .
pāpo'haṃ plavago yasmātsaṃjātaḥ kāraṇāntarāt .. 83.16 ..
6.3.d:
हनुमानुवाच -
नन्दिनाथ हरं पृच्छ पातकस्योपशान्तिदम् .
पापोऽहं प्लवगो यस्मात्संजातः कारणान्तरात् .. 83.16 ..
6.3.m: Hanumān said: / 'O Lord Nandin, ask Hara what gives pacification of the sin. / For I am a monkey, a sinner born through another cause.'

6.3.s:
nandyuvāca -
rudradehodbhavā kiṃ te na śrutā bhūtale sthitā .
śravaṇājjanmajanitaṃ dviguṇaṃ kīrtanādvrajet .. 83.17 ..
6.3.d:
नन्द्युवाच -
रुद्रदेहोद्भवा किं ते न श्रुता भूतले स्थिता .
श्रवणाज्जन्मजनितं द्विगुणं कीर्तनाद्व्रजेत् .. 83.17 ..
6.3.m: Nandin said: / 'Have you not heard of her who is born from the body of Rudra, who rests upon the earth? / Through hearing [of her], the sin born of a lifetime is removed, and double through chanting [her name].

6.3.s:
triṃśajjanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyedrevāvagāhanāt .
tasmāttvaṃ narmadātīraṃ gatvā cara tapo mahat .. 83.18 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिंशज्जन्मार्जितं पापं नश्येद्रेवावगाहनात् .
तस्मात्त्वं नर्मदातीरं गत्वा चर तपो महत् .. 83.18 ..
6.3.m: The sin accumulated over thirty births is destroyed by plunging into the Revā. / Therefore, go to the bank of the Narmadā and perform great austerity.'

6.3.s:
gandharvāhasuto'pyevaṃ nandinoktaṃ niśamya ca .
prayāto narmadātīramaurvyādakṣiṇasaṅgamam .. 83.19 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धर्वाहसुतोऽप्येवं नन्दिनोक्तं निशम्य च .
प्रयातो नर्मदातीरमौर्व्यादक्षिणसङ्गमम् .. 83.19 ..
6.3.m: Having heard what was said by Nandin, the son of the Wind / departed for the bank of the Narmadā, to its confluence on the south of the Aurvā.

6.3.s:
dadhyau sudakṣiṇe devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ triśūlinam .
jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaṃ vyālayajñopavītinam .. 83.20 ..
6.3.d:
दध्यौ सुदक्षिणे देवं विरूपाक्षं त्रिशूलिनम् .
जटामुकुटसंयुक्तं व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिनम् .. 83.20 ..
6.3.m: Far to the south, he meditated upon the god, the three-eyed wielder of the trident, / endowed with a diadem of matted locks, wearing a serpent as a sacred thread,

6.3.s:
bhasmopacitasarvāṅgaṃ ḍamarusvaranāditam .
umārddhāṅgaharaṃ śāntaṃ gonāthāsanasaṃsthitam .. 83.21 ..
6.3.d:
भस्मोपचितसर्वाङ्गं डमरुस्वरनादितम् .
उमार्द्धाङ्गहरं शान्तं गोनाथासनसंस्थितम् .. 83.21 ..
6.3.m: all his limbs smeared with ashes, resounding with the sound of the ḍamaru, / taking Umā into half his body, peaceful, seated on the bull-lord.

6.3.s:
vatsarān subahūn yāvadupāsāṃcakra īśvaram .
tāvattuṣṭo mahādeva ājagāma sahomayā .. 83.22 ..
6.3.d:
वत्सरान् सुबहून् यावदुपासांचक्र ईश्वरम् .
तावत्तुष्टो महादेव आजगाम सहोमया .. 83.22 ..
6.3.m: For many years he worshipped Īśvara, / until Mahādeva, pleased, arrived together with Umā.

6.3.s:
uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ meghagambhīranisvanām .
sādhu sādhvityuvāceśaḥ kaṣṭaṃ vatsa tvayā kṛtam .. 83.23 ..
6.3.d:
उवाच मधुरां वाणीं मेघगम्भीरनिस्वनाम् .
साधु साध्वित्युवाचेशः कष्टं वत्स त्वया कृतम् .. 83.23 ..
6.3.m: He spoke sweet speech, resounding deep like a rain-cloud. / 'Excellent, excellent!' said the Lord, 'Child, you have endured hardship!

6.3.s:
na ca pūrvaṃ tvayā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ rāvaṇasaṃkṣaye .
svāmikāryaratastvaṃ hi siddho'si mama darśanāt .. 83.24 ..
6.3.d:
न च पूर्वं त्वया पापं कृतं रावणसंक्षये .
स्वामिकार्यरतस्त्वं हि सिद्धोऽसि मम दर्शनात् .. 83.24 ..
6.3.m: You committed no sin before in the destruction of Rāvaṇa. / Devoted to the business of your master, you are perfected by the sight of me.'

6.3.s:
hanumāṃśca haraṃ dṛṣṭvā umārddhāṅgaharaṃ sthiram .
sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato'vocajjaya śambho namo'stu te .
jayāndhakavināśāya jaya gaṅgāśirodhara .. 83.25 ..
6.3.d:
हनुमांश्च हरं दृष्ट्वा उमार्द्धाङ्गहरं स्थिरम् .
साष्टाङ्गं प्रणतोऽवोचज्जय शम्भो नमोऽस्तु ते .
जयान्धकविनाशाय जय गङ्गाशिरोधर .. 83.25 ..
6.3.m: And Hanumān, beholding Hara, steadfast, taking Umā into half his body, / bowed with eight limbs and said: 'Victory, O Śambhu! Homage be to you! / Victory to the destroyer of Andhaka! Victory, O bearer of the Gaṅgā upon your head!'

6.3.s:
evaṃ stuto mahādevo varado vākyamabravīt .
varaṃ prārthaya me vatsa prāṇasambhavasambhava .. 83.26 ..
6.3.d:
एवं स्तुतो महादेवो वरदो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .
वरं प्रार्थय मे वत्स प्राणसम्भवसम्भव .. 83.26 ..
6.3.m: Thus praised, Mahādeva, granting a boon, spoke these words: / 'Request a boon from me, my child, born of the essence of my vital breath!'

6.3.s:
śrīhanumānuvāca -
brahmarakṣovadhājjātā mama hatyā maheśvara .
na pāpo'haṃ bhavedeva yuṣmatsambhāṣaṇe kṣaṇāt .. 83.27 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीहनुमानुवाच -
ब्रह्मरक्षोवधाज्जाता मम हत्या महेश्वर .
न पापोऽहं भवेदेव युष्मत्सम्भाषणे क्षणात् .. 83.27 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Hanumān said: / 'The guilt of killing [a brahmin] arose for me from slaying the brahmarākṣasa, O Maheśvara. / May I be free from sin, O Lord, this instant, by conversing with you!'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
narmadātīrthamāhātmyāddharmayogaprabhāvataḥ .
manmūrtidarśanātputra niṣpāpo'si na saṃśayaḥ .. 83.28 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
नर्मदातीर्थमाहात्म्याद्धर्मयोगप्रभावतः .
मन्मूर्तिदर्शनात्पुत्र निष्पापोऽसि न संशयः .. 83.28 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / 'By the greatness of the sacred ford of the Narmadā, by the power of the practice of dharma, / and by the sight of my form, O son, you are sinless; there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
anyaṃ ca te prayacchāmi varaṃ vānarapuṃgava .
upakārāya lokānāṃ nāmāni tava mārute .. 83.29 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यं च ते प्रयच्छामि वरं वानरपुंगव .
उपकाराय लोकानां नामानि तव मारुते .. 83.29 ..
6.3.m: And I grant you another boon, O bull among monkeys: / your names for the benefit of the worlds, O son of the Wind:

6.3.s:
hanūmānaṃ janisuto vāyuputro mahābalaḥ .
rāmeṣṭaḥ phālguno gotraḥ piṅgākṣo'mitavikramaḥ .. 83.30 ..
6.3.d:
हनूमानं जनिसुतो वायुपुत्रो महाबलः .
रामेष्टः फाल्गुनो गोत्रः पिङ्गाक्षोऽमितविक्रमः .. 83.30 ..
6.3.m: Hanūmān, son of Añjanā, son of the Wind, exceedingly mighty, / beloved of Rāma, Phālguna's friend, yellow-eyed, of immeasurable prowess,

6.3.s:
udadhikramaṇaśreṣṭho daśagrīvasya darpahā .
lakṣmaṇaprāṇadātā ca sītāśokanivartanaḥ .. 83.31 ..
6.3.d:
उदधिक्रमणश्रेष्ठो दशग्रीवस्य दर्पहा .
लक्ष्मणप्राणदाता च सीताशोकनिवर्तनः .. 83.31 ..
6.3.m: best at leaping the ocean, crusher of the pride of the ten-necked one, / giver of life to Lakṣmaṇa, and dispeller of Sītā's sorrow.'

6.3.s:
ityuktvāntardadhe deva umayā saha śaṅkaraḥ .
hanūmānīśvaraṃ tatra sthāpayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .. 83.32 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देव उमया सह शङ्करः .
हनूमानीश्वरं तत्र स्थापयामास भक्तितः .. 83.32 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the god Śaṅkara vanished together with Umā. / Hanumān then established a liṅga there with devotion,

6.3.s:
ātmayogabalenaiva brahmacaryaprabhāvataḥ .
īśvarasya prasādena liṅgaṃ kāmapradaṃ hi tat .
acchedyamapratarkyaṃ ca vināśotpattivarjitam .. 83.33 ..
6.3.d:
आत्मयोगबलेनैव ब्रह्मचर्यप्रभावतः .
ईश्वरस्य प्रसादेन लिङ्गं कामप्रदं हि तत् .
अच्छेद्यमप्रतर्क्यं च विनाशोत्पत्तिवर्जितम् .. 83.33 ..
6.3.m: by the power of his own yoga and the strength of his celibacy. / By the grace of Īśvara, that liṅga grants desires; / it cannot be severed, it is incomprehensible, and free from destruction and arising.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
hanūmanteśvare putra pratyakṣapratyayaṃ śṛṇu .
yadvṛttaṃ dvāparasyādau tretānte pāṇḍunandana .. 83.34 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
हनूमन्तेश्वरे पुत्र प्रत्यक्षप्रत्ययं शृणु .
यद्वृत्तं द्वापरस्यादौ त्रेतान्ते पाण्डुनन्दन .. 83.34 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hear, O son, the visible proof concerning Hanūmanteśvara, / which took place at the beginning of the Dvāpara and end of the Tretā age, O joy of Pāṇḍu.

6.3.s:
suparvā nāma bhūpālo babhūva vasudhātale .
tasya rājñaḥ sadā saukhyaṃ narā dīrghāyuṣaḥ sadā .. 83.35 ..
6.3.d:
सुपर्वा नाम भूपालो बभूव वसुधातले .
तस्य राज्ञः सदा सौख्यं नरा दीर्घायुषः सदा .. 83.35 ..
6.3.m: There was a king named Suparvan upon the earth. / That king always had happiness, and people were always long-lived.

6.3.s:
sa putradhanasaṃyuktaścauropadravavarjitaḥ .
śatabāhurbabhūvāsya putro bhīmaparākramaḥ .. 83.36 ..
6.3.d:
स पुत्रधनसंयुक्तश्चौरोपद्रववर्जितः .
शतबाहुर्बभूवास्य पुत्रो भीमपराक्रमः .. 83.36 ..
6.3.m: Endowed with sons and wealth, he was free from the afflictions of thieves. / He had a son of terrible prowess named Śatabāhu.

6.3.s:
āsakto'sau sadā kālaṃ pāpadharmairnareśvara .
aṭāṭyata dharāṃ sarvāṃ parvatāṃśca vanāni ca .. 83.37 ..
6.3.d:
आसक्तोऽसौ सदा कालं पापधर्मैर्नरेश्वर .
अटाट्यत धरां सर्वां पर्वतांश्च वनानि च .. 83.37 ..
6.3.m: He was always attached to sinful ways, O lord of men. / He wandered over all the earth, the mountains, and the forests.

6.3.s:
vadhārthaṃ mṛgayūthānāmāgato vindhyaparvatam .
tarujātisamākīrṇe hastiyūthasamācite .. 83.38 ..
6.3.d:
वधार्थं मृगयूथानामागतो विन्ध्यपर्वतम् .
तरुजातिसमाकीर्णे हस्तियूथसमाचिते .. 83.38 ..
6.3.m: For the sake of hunting herds of deer, he went to the Vindhya mountain, / which was crowded with various kinds of trees and filled with herds of elephants,

6.3.s:
siṃhacitrakaśobhāḍhye mṛgavārāhasaṃkule .
krīḍitvā sa vane rājā narmadāmānataḥ kvacit .. 83.39 ..
6.3.d:
सिंहचित्रकशोभाढ्ये मृगवाराहसंकुले .
क्रीडित्वा स वने राजा नर्मदामानतः क्वचित् .. 83.39 ..
6.3.m: rich in the beauty of lions and leopards, swarming with deer and boars. / Having sported in the forest, that king bowed to the Narmadā somewhere,

6.3.s:
hanūmantavane prāptaḥ śatakrośapramāṇake .
ciñciṇīvanaśobhāḍhye kadambatarusaṃkule .. 83.40 ..
6.3.d:
हनूमन्तवने प्राप्तः शतक्रोशप्रमाणके .
चिञ्चिणीवनशोभाढ्ये कदम्बतरुसंकुले .. 83.40 ..
6.3.m: and reached the forest of Hanūmat, extending a hundred krośas, / rich in the beauty of tamarind groves and crowded with kadamba trees,

6.3.s:
nityaṃ pālāśajambīraiḥ karaṃjakhadiraistathā .
pāṭalairbadarairyuktaiḥ śamītindukaśobhitam .. 83.41 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं पालाशजम्बीरैः करंजखदिरैस्तथा .
पाटलैर्बदरैर्युक्तैः शमीतिन्दुकशोभितम् .. 83.41 ..
6.3.m: always adorned with pālāśa, jambīra, karañja, and khadira, / combined with pāṭala and badara, and embellished with śamī and tinduka,

6.3.s:
mṛgayūthaiḥ samāchannaśikhaṇḍisvaranāditam .
pārāvatakasaṅghānāṃ samantātsvaraśobhitam .. 83.42 ..
6.3.d:
मृगयूथैः समाछन्नशिखण्डिस्वरनादितम् .
पारावतकसङ्घानां समन्तात्स्वरशोभितम् .. 83.42 ..
6.3.m: covered with herds of deer, resounding with the cries of peacocks, / and beautified on all sides by the sounds of flocks of pigeons.

6.3.s:
śaratkāle'ramadrājā bahule cāśvinasya saḥ .
vanamadhyaṃ gato'drākṣīdbhramantaṃ piṅgaladvijam .. 83.43 ..
6.3.d:
शरत्कालेऽरमद्राजा बहुले चाश्विनस्य सः .
वनमध्यं गतोऽद्राक्षीद्भ्रमन्तं पिङ्गलद्विजम् .. 83.43 ..
6.3.m: In autumn, during the dark fortnight of Āśvina, the king delighted there. / Having gone into the middle of the forest, he saw a tawny brahmin wandering about,

6.3.s: pustikākarasaṃsthaṃ ca papraccha capalaṃ dvijam .. 83.44 ..
6.3.d: पुस्तिकाकरसंस्थं च पप्रच्छ चपलं द्विजम् .. 83.44 ..
6.3.m: with a manuscript resting in his hand, and he questioned that restless brahmin.

6.3.s:
śatabāhuruvāca -
ekākī tvaṃ vane kasmādbhramase pustikākaraḥ .
itastato'pi sampaśyan kathayasva dvijottama .. 83.45 ..
6.3.d:
शतबाहुरुवाच -
एकाकी त्वं वने कस्माद्भ्रमसे पुस्तिकाकरः .
इतस्ततोऽपि सम्पश्यन् कथयस्व द्विजोत्तम .. 83.45 ..
6.3.m: Śatabāhu said: / Why do you wander alone in the forest with a booklet in your hand, / looking here and there? Tell me, best of brahmins.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
kānyakubjātsamāyātaḥ preṣito rājakanyayā .
asthikṣepāya vai rājanhanūmanteśvare jale .. 83.46 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
कान्यकुब्जात्समायातः प्रेषितो राजकन्यया .
अस्थिक्षेपाय वै राजन्हनूमन्तेश्वरे जले .. 83.46 ..
6.3.m: The brahmin said: / I have come from Kānyakubja, sent by a king's daughter, / to cast bones into the waters at Hanūmanteśvara, O king.

6.3.s:
rājovāca -
asthikṣepo jale kasmāddhanūmanteśvare dvija .
kriyate kena kāryeṇa sāścaryaṃ kathyatāṃ mama .. 83.47 ..
6.3.d:
राजोवाच -
अस्थिक्षेपो जले कस्माद्धनूमन्तेश्वरे द्विज .
क्रियते केन कार्येण साश्चर्यं कथ्यतां मम .. 83.47 ..
6.3.m: The king said: / Why are bones being cast into the waters at Hanūmanteśvara, O brahmin? / For what purpose is this done? Tell me the wondrous tale.

6.3.s:
suparvaṇaḥ suto yānaṃ tyaktvā bhūmau praṇamya ca .
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā brāhmaṇāya nareśvara .
samastaṃ kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ svaṃ purātanam .. 83.48 ..
6.3.d:
सुपर्वणः सुतो यानं त्यक्त्वा भूमौ प्रणम्य च .
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा ब्राह्मणाय नरेश्वर .
समस्तं कथयामास वृत्तान्तं स्वं पुरातनम् .. 83.48 ..
6.3.m: Leaving his vehicle and bowing down upon the earth, / folding his hands in reverence to the brahmin, O king, / the son of Suparvan told his entire former account:

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
śikhaṇḍī nāma rājāsti kanyakubje pratāpavān .
aputro'sau mahīpālaḥ kanyā jātā manorathaiḥ .. 83.49 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
शिखण्डी नाम राजास्ति कन्यकुब्जे प्रतापवान् .
अपुत्रोऽसौ महीपालः कन्या जाता मनोरथैः .. 83.49 ..
6.3.m: The brahmin said: / There is a valorous king named Śikhaṇḍin in Kānyakubja; / this ruler was childless, but through desires a daughter was born to him.

6.3.s:
jātismarā sucārvaṅgī narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ .
pitrā ca saikadā kanyā vivāhāya prajalpitā .. 83.50 ..
6.3.d:
जातिस्मरा सुचार्वङ्गी नर्मदायाः प्रभावतः .
पित्रा च सैकदा कन्या विवाहाय प्रजल्पिता .. 83.50 ..
6.3.m: She remembered her past births and was very beautiful in body, through the power of the Narmadā. / Once that maiden was addressed by her father for marriage:

6.3.s:
anitye putri saṃsāre kanyādānaṃ dadāmyaham .
śvaḥkṛtyamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikam .
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ cāsya na cākṛtam .. 83.51 ..
6.3.d:
अनित्ये पुत्रि संसारे कन्यादानं ददाम्यहम् .
श्वःकृत्यमद्य कुर्वीत पूर्वाह्णे चापराह्णिकम् .
न हि प्रतीक्षते मृत्युः कृतं चास्य न चाकृतम् .. 83.51 ..
6.3.m: "In this impermanent worldly existence, daughter, I shall give [you] in marriage. / What is to be done tomorrow one should do today, and in the morning what is to be done in the afternoon; / for death does not wait to see whether one's work is done or not done."

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
iccheyaṃ yatra kāle hi tatra deyā tvayā pituḥ .
putrīvākyādasau rājā vismito vākyamabravīt .. 83.52 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
इच्छेयं यत्र काले हि तत्र देया त्वया पितुः .
पुत्रीवाक्यादसौ राजा विस्मितो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 83.52 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / "At whatever time I wish, at that time I should be given [in marriage] by you, father." / At his daughter's words, that king, astonished, spoke [these] words:

6.3.s:
śikhaṇḍyuvāca -
kathyatāṃ me mahābhāge sāścaryaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tvayā .
piturvākyena sā bālottamā hyāgatāntikam .. 83.53 ..
6.3.d:
शिखण्ड्युवाच -
कथ्यतां मे महाभागे साश्चर्यं भाषितं त्वया .
पितुर्वाक्येन सा बालोत्तमा ह्यागतान्तिकम् .. 83.53 ..
6.3.m: Śikhaṇḍin said: / "Tell me, blessed one; you have spoken wondrously." / At her father's words, that excellent girl came near,

6.3.s:
kathayāmāsa yadvṛttaṃ hanūmanteśvare nṛpa .
kalāpinī hyahaṃ tāta yutā bhartrāvasaṃ tadā .. 83.54 ..
6.3.d:
कथयामास यद्वृत्तं हनूमन्तेश्वरे नृप .
कलापिनी ह्यहं तात युता भर्त्रावसं तदा .. 83.54 ..
6.3.m: and told what had happened at Hanūmanteśvara, O king: / "Father, I was a peahen, and I lived then united with my mate.

6.3.s:
revaurvyāsaṅgamantisthā revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe .
hanūmantavane puṇye cikrīḍāhaṃ yadṛcchayā .. 83.55 ..
6.3.d:
रेवौर्व्यासङ्गमन्तिस्था रेवाया दक्षिणे तटे .
हनूमन्तवने पुण्ये चिक्रीडाहं यदृच्छया .. 83.55 ..
6.3.m: Dwelling near the confluence of the Revā and the Uru, on the southern bank of the Revā, / I disported at will in the sacred forest of Hanūmat.

6.3.s:
bhartṛyuktā ca saṃsuptā rajanyāṃ sarale nage .
āgatā lubdhakāstatra kṣudhārtā vanamuttamam .. 83.56 ..
6.3.d:
भर्तृयुक्ता च संसुप्ता रजन्यां सरले नगे .
आगता लुब्धकास्तत्र क्षुधार्ता वनमुत्तमम् .. 83.56 ..
6.3.m: Having fallen asleep with my mate at night on an upright tree, / hunters, afflicted with hunger, arrived there in that excellent forest.

6.3.s:
bhartṛyogayutā pāpairdṛṣṭāhaṃ vadhacintakaiḥ .
pāśabandhaṃ samādāya baddhāhaṃ svāminā saha .. 83.57 ..
6.3.d:
भर्तृयोगयुता पापैर्दृष्टाहं वधचिन्तकैः .
पाशबन्धं समादाय बद्धाहं स्वामिना सह .. 83.57 ..
6.3.m: United with my mate, I was seen by those wicked men intent on slaughter. / Taking a snare, I was captured together with my husband.

6.3.s:
grīvāṃ te moṭayāmāsuḥ picchāchoṭanakaṃ kṛtam .
hutāśanamukhe taistu saha kāntena lubdhakaiḥ .. 83.58 ..
6.3.d:
ग्रीवां ते मोटयामासुः पिच्छाछोटनकं कृतम् .
हुताशनमुखे तैस्तु सह कान्तेन लुब्धकैः .. 83.58 ..
6.3.m: They twisted [our] necks, plucked off our plumes; / and into the fire's mouth, together with my beloved, [we were thrown] by those hunters.

6.3.s:
paribharjyāvayormāṃsaṃ bhakṣayitvā yatheṣṭataḥ .
suptāḥ svasthendriyā rātrau sā gatā śarvarī kṣayam .. 83.59 ..
6.3.d:
परिभर्ज्यावयोर्मांसं भक्षयित्वा यथेष्टतः .
सुप्ताः स्वस्थेन्द्रिया रात्रौ सा गता शर्वरी क्षयम् .. 83.59 ..
6.3.m: Roasting the flesh of us two, eating as much as they wished, / they slept at night, their senses at ease, until that night came to an end.

6.3.s:
prabhāte māṃsaśeṣaṃ ca jambukairgṛdhraghātibhiḥ .
maccharīrodbhavaṃ cāsthi snāyumāṃsena cāvṛtam .. 83.60 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभाते मांसशेषं च जम्बुकैर्गृध्रघातिभिः .
मच्छरीरोद्भवं चास्थि स्नायुमांसेन चावृतम् .. 83.60 ..
6.3.m: In the morning, the remainder of the meat [was taken] by jackals and scavenging vultures; / and a bone produced from my body, covered with sinew and flesh,

6.3.s:
gṛhītaṃ ghātinaikena cākāśātpatitaṃ tadā .
taṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā pare pakṣiṇa āgatāḥ .. 83.61 ..
6.3.d:
गृहीतं घातिनैकेन चाकाशात्पतितं तदा .
तं मांसभक्षणं दृष्ट्वा परे पक्षिण आगताः .. 83.61 ..
6.3.m: was seized by a predatory bird, and then dropped from the sky. / Seeing him eating flesh, other birds arrived.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā pakṣisamūhaṃ tu asthikhaṇḍaṃ vyasarjayat .
vihagānāṃ samastānāṃ dhāvatāṃ caiva paśyatām .. 83.62 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पक्षिसमूहं तु अस्थिखण्डं व्यसर्जयत् .
विहगानां समस्तानां धावतां चैव पश्यताम् .. 83.62 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that flock of birds, he released the piece of bone, / while all the birds chased and watched.

6.3.s:
patitaṃ narmadātoye hanūmanteśvare nṛpa .
madīyamasthikhaṇḍaṃ ca patitaṃ narmadājale .. 83.63 ..
6.3.d:
पतितं नर्मदातोये हनूमन्तेश्वरे नृप .
मदीयमस्थिखण्डं च पतितं नर्मदाजले .. 83.63 ..
6.3.m: It fell into the waters of the Narmadā at Hanūmanteśvara, O king; / that piece of bone of mine fell into the water of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
tasya tīrthasya puṇyena jātāhaṃ putrikā tava .
bhūpakanyā tvahaṃ jātā pūrṇacandranibhānanā .. 83.64 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य तीर्थस्य पुण्येन जाताहं पुत्रिका तव .
भूपकन्या त्वहं जाता पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना .. 83.64 ..
6.3.m: By the merit of that sacred ford, I was born as your daughter; / I was born a king's daughter, with a face like the full moon.

6.3.s:
jātismarā narendrasya saṃjātā bhavataḥ kule .
tasmādvivāhaṃ necchāmi mama bhartā nṛpottama .. 83.65 ..
6.3.d:
जातिस्मरा नरेन्द्रस्य संजाता भवतः कुले .
तस्माद्विवाहं नेच्छामि मम भर्ता नृपोत्तम .. 83.65 ..
6.3.m: Remembering my past lives, I was born into your royal lineage; / therefore I do not desire marriage. My husband, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
viṣame vartate'dyāpi śakuntamṛgajātiṣu .
tasyāsthiśeṣaṃ rājendra tasmiṃstīrthe bhaviṣyati .. 83.66 ..
6.3.d:
विषमे वर्ततेऽद्यापि शकुन्तमृगजातिषु .
तस्यास्थिशेषं राजेन्द्र तस्मिंस्तीर्थे भविष्यति .. 83.66 ..
6.3.m: still remains in a wretched condition among the species of birds and beasts. / The remainder of his bones will be at that sacred ford, O king of kings.

6.3.s:
tatkṣepaṇārthaṃ vai tāta preṣayādya dvijottamam .
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kāraṇaṃ nṛpasattama .. 83.67 ..
6.3.d:
तत्क्षेपणार्थं वै तात प्रेषयाद्य द्विजोत्तमम् .
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कारणं नृपसत्तम .. 83.67 ..
6.3.m: For the sake of casting them [into the river], O father, send an excellent brahmin today. / This entire reason has been told to you, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
madbhartā viṣame sthāne śakuntamṛgajātiṣu .
yadi preṣayase tāta kaṃcittvaṃ narmadātaṭe .. 83.68 ..
6.3.d:
मद्भर्ता विषमे स्थाने शकुन्तमृगजातिषु .
यदि प्रेषयसे तात कंचित्त्वं नर्मदातटे .. 83.68 ..
6.3.m: My husband is in a wretched place among the species of birds and beasts. / If you send someone, father, to the bank of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
tasyāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi sthānaiścihnaiśca lakṣitam .
śikhaṇḍināpyahaṃ tatra hyāhūto hyavanīpate .. 83.69 ..
6.3.d:
तस्याहं कथयिष्यामि स्थानैश्चिह्नैश्च लक्षितम् .
शिखण्डिनाप्यहं तत्र ह्याहूतो ह्यवनीपते .. 83.69 ..
6.3.m: I will tell him [the place], marked by locations and signs." / And there I was summoned by Śikhaṇḍin, O lord of the earth:

6.3.s:
dāsyāmi viṃśatigrāmāngaccha tvaṃ narmadātaṭe .
preṣaṇaṃ me pratijñātamalakṣmyā pīḍitena tu .. 83.70 ..
6.3.d:
दास्यामि विंशतिग्रामान्गच्छ त्वं नर्मदातटे .
प्रेषणं मे प्रतिज्ञातमलक्ष्म्या पीडितेन तु .. 83.70 ..
6.3.m: "I will give twenty villages; go to the bank of the Narmadā." / The mission was agreed to by me, who was afflicted by poverty.

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
gaccha tvaṃ narmadāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarīm .
āgneyyāṃ somanāthasya hanūmanteśvaraḥ paraḥ .. 83.71 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
गच्छ त्वं नर्मदां पुण्यां सर्वपापक्षयंकरीम् .
आग्नेय्यां सोमनाथस्य हनूमन्तेश्वरः परः .. 83.71 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / "Go to the holy Narmadā, destroyer of all sins. / To the south-east of Somanātha is the supreme Hanūmanteśvara.

6.3.s:
ardhakrośena revāyā vistīrṇo vaṭapādapaḥ .
karaṃjaḥ kaṭahaścaiva sannidhāne vaṭasya ca .. 83.72 ..
6.3.d:
अर्धक्रोशेन रेवाया विस्तीर्णो वटपादपः .
करंजः कटहश्चैव सन्निधाने वटस्य च .. 83.72 ..
6.3.m: Half a krośa from the Revā is a sprawling banyan tree, / and a karañja and a kaṭaha near that banyan tree.

6.3.s:
nyagrodhamūlasāṃnidhye sūkṣmānyasthīni drakṣyasi .
samūhya tāni saṃgṛhya gaccha revāṃ dvijottama .. 83.73 ..
6.3.d:
न्यग्रोधमूलसांनिध्ये सूक्ष्मान्यस्थीनि द्रक्ष्यसि .
समूह्य तानि संगृह्य गच्छ रेवां द्विजोत्तम .. 83.73 ..
6.3.m: Near the root of the banyan you will see small bones; / gathering them and collecting them, go to the Revā, O best of brahmins.

6.3.s:
āśvinasyāsite pakṣe tripurāristu vai tithau .
snāpya triśūlinaṃ bhaktyā rātrau tvaṃ kuru jāgaram .. 83.74 ..
6.3.d:
आश्विनस्यासिते पक्षे त्रिपुरारिस्तु वै तिथौ .
स्नाप्य त्रिशूलिनं भक्त्या रात्रौ त्वं कुरु जागरम् .. 83.74 ..
6.3.m: In the dark fortnight of Āśvina, on the fourteenth day sacred to the foe of Tripura, / bathe the trident-bearing Lord with devotion, and keep a vigil through the night.

6.3.s:
kṣipeḥ prabhāte tāni tvaṃ nābhimātrajalasthitaḥ .
ityuccārya dvijaśreṣṭha vimuktistasya jāyatām .. 83.75 ..
6.3.d:
क्षिपेः प्रभाते तानि त्वं नाभिमात्रजलस्थितः .
इत्युच्चार्य द्विजश्रेष्ठ विमुक्तिस्तस्य जायताम् .. 83.75 ..
6.3.m: At dawn you should cast them, standing in navel-deep water, / pronouncing: 'O best of brahmins, let liberation arise for him!'

6.3.s:
kṣiptvāsthīni punaḥ snānaṃ kartavyaṃ tvaghanāśanam .
evaṃ kṛte tu rājendra gatistasya bhaviṣyati .. 83.76 ..
6.3.d:
क्षिप्त्वास्थीनि पुनः स्नानं कर्तव्यं त्वघनाशनम् .
एवं कृते तु राजेन्द्र गतिस्तस्य भविष्यति .. 83.76 ..
6.3.m: Having cast the bones, another ritual ablution must be performed that destroys sin. / When this is done, O king of kings, higher state will be his."

6.3.s:
kathitaṃ kanyayā yacca tatsarvaṃ pustikākṛtam .
āgato'haṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthe'tra duritāpahe .. 83.77 ..
6.3.d:
कथितं कन्यया यच्च तत्सर्वं पुस्तिकाकृतम् .
आगतोऽहं नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थेऽत्र दुरितापहे .. 83.77 ..
6.3.m: And whatever was told by the maiden, all that was recorded in a booklet. / I have arrived, O best of kings, at this sin-destroying sacred ford.

6.3.s:
so'bhijñānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā nītvāsthīni nareśvara .
pūrvoktena vidhānena prākṣipaṃ nārmadā masipuṣpavṛṣṭiḥ'śu sādhu sādhviti pāṇḍava .
vimānaṃ ca tato divyamāgataṃ barhiṇastadā .. 83.78 ..
6.3.d:
सोऽभिज्ञानं ततो दृष्ट्वा नीत्वास्थीनि नरेश्वर .
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन प्राक्षिपं नार्मदा मसिपुष्पवृष्टिःऽशु साधु साध्विति पाण्डव .
विमानं च ततो दिव्यमागतं बर्हिणस्तदा .. 83.78 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that mark, bringing the bones, O lord of men, / by the method previously stated I cast [them] into the waters of the Narmadā, O Pāṇḍava, [amid] a rain of flowers and cries of "Well done! Well done!"; / and then a celestial aerial chariot arrived for that peacock.

6.3.s:
divyarūpadharo bhūtvā gato nāke kalāpavān .
evaṃ tu pratyayaṃ dṛṣṭvā hanūmanteśvare nṛpa .. 83.79 ..
6.3.d:
दिव्यरूपधरो भूत्वा गतो नाके कलापवान् .
एवं तु प्रत्ययं दृष्ट्वा हनूमन्तेश्वरे नृप .. 83.79 ..
6.3.m: Taking on a celestial form, the peacock went to heaven. / Having witnessed such confirmation at Hanūmanteśvara, O king,

6.3.s:
cakārānaśanaṃ vipraḥ śatabāhuśca bhūpatiḥ .
śoṣayāmāsatustau svamīśvarārādhane ratau .. 83.80 ..
6.3.d:
चकारानशनं विप्रः शतबाहुश्च भूपतिः .
शोषयामासतुस्तौ स्वमीश्वराराधने रतौ .. 83.80 ..
6.3.m: the brahmin and King Śatabāhu undertook fasting; / devoted to the worship of Īśvara, both of them emaciated themselves.

6.3.s:
dhyāyantau tasthaturdevaṃ śatabāhudvijottamau .
māsārdhena mṛto rājā śatabāhurmahāmanāḥ .. 83.81 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यायन्तौ तस्थतुर्देवं शतबाहुद्विजोत्तमौ .
मासार्धेन मृतो राजा शतबाहुर्महामनाः .. 83.81 ..
6.3.m: Meditating on the God, the best of brahmins and Śatabāhu remained; / after half a month, the noble King Śatabāhu died.

6.3.s:
kiṅkaṇījālaśobhāḍhyaṃ vimānaṃ tatra cāgatam .
sādhu sādhu nṛpaśreṣṭha vimānārohaṇaṃ kuru .. 83.82 ..
6.3.d:
किङ्कणीजालशोभाढ्यं विमानं तत्र चागतम् .
साधु साधु नृपश्रेष्ठ विमानारोहणं कुरु .. 83.82 ..
6.3.m: And an aerial chariot arrived there, splendid with a network of tiny bells: / "Well done, well done, O best of kings! Ascend the aerial chariot!"

6.3.s:
śatabāhuruvāca -
nāyāmi svargamārgāgraṃ vipro yāvanna saṃsthitaḥ .
upadeśaprado mahyaṃ gururūpī dvijottamaḥ .. 83.83 ..
6.3.d:
शतबाहुरुवाच -
नायामि स्वर्गमार्गाग्रं विप्रो यावन्न संस्थितः .
उपदेशप्रदो मह्यं गुरुरूपी द्विजोत्तमः .. 83.83 ..
6.3.m: Śatabāhu said: / "I will not proceed on the path to heaven as long as the brahmin has not died; / the best of brahmins gave me instruction, taking the role of a guru."

6.3.s:
apsarasa ūcuḥ .
lobhāvṛto hyayaṃ vipro lobhātpāpasya saṃgrahaḥ .
hanūmanteśvare rājanye mṛtāḥ sattvamāsthitāḥ .. 83.84 ..
6.3.d:
अप्सरस ऊचुः .
लोभावृतो ह्ययं विप्रो लोभात्पापस्य संग्रहः .
हनूमन्तेश्वरे राजन्ये मृताः सत्त्वमास्थिताः .. 83.84 ..
6.3.m: The apsarases said: / "This brahmin was overcome with greed, and from greed comes the accumulation of sin; / those who die at Hanūmanteśvara, O king, established in purity, [attain heaven]."

6.3.s:
te yānti śāṃkare loke sarvapāpakṣayaṃkare .
naiva pāpakṣayaścāsya brāhmaṇasya nareśvara .. 83.85 ..
6.3.d:
ते यान्ति शांकरे लोके सर्वपापक्षयंकरे .
नैव पापक्षयश्चास्य ब्राह्मणस्य नरेश्वर .. 83.85 ..
6.3.m: They go to Śaṃkara's realm, which brings destruction to all sins; / but this brahmin’s sins are not destroyed at all, O king of men.

6.3.s:
gṛhaṃ ca gṛhiṇī citte brāhmaṇasya pravartate .
śatabāhustato vipramuvāca vinayānvitaḥ .. 83.86 ..
6.3.d:
गृहं च गृहिणी चित्ते ब्राह्मणस्य प्रवर्तते .
शतबाहुस्ततो विप्रमुवाच विनयान्वितः .. 83.86 ..
6.3.m: His home and his wife are active in the brahmin's mind.' / Then Śatabāhu, full of humility, addressed the brahmin:

6.3.s:
tyaja mūlamanarthasya lobhamenaṃ dvijottama .
ityuktvā svaryayau rājā svargakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ .. 83.87 ..
6.3.d:
त्यज मूलमनर्थस्य लोभमेनं द्विजोत्तम .
इत्युक्त्वा स्वर्ययौ राजा स्वर्गकन्यासमावृतः .. 83.87 ..
6.3.m: 'Renounce this greed, the root of ruin, O best among the twice-born.' / Having said this, the king went to heaven, surrounded by celestial maidens.

6.3.s:
dinaiḥ kaiścidgato vipraḥ svargaṃ vaitālikairvṛtaḥ .
barhī ca kāśīrājasya putrastīrthaprabhāvataḥ .. 83.88 ..
6.3.d:
दिनैः कैश्चिद्गतो विप्रः स्वर्गं वैतालिकैर्वृतः .
बर्ही च काशीराजस्य पुत्रस्तीर्थप्रभावतः .. 83.88 ..
6.3.m: After some days the brahmin went to heaven, surrounded by heralds, / as did the peacock, the son of the king of Kāśī, by the power of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
ātmānaṃ kanyayā dattaṃ pūrvajanma vyacintayan .
sā ca taṃ prauḍhamālokya piturājñāmavāpya ca .
svayaṃvare svabhartāraṃ lebhe sādhvī nṛpātmajam .. 83.89 ..
6.3.d:
आत्मानं कन्यया दत्तं पूर्वजन्म व्यचिन्तयन् .
सा च तं प्रौढमालोक्य पितुराज्ञामवाप्य च .
स्वयंवरे स्वभर्तारं लेभे साध्वी नृपात्मजम् .. 83.89 ..
6.3.m: Remembering his past birth and himself having been given by the maiden, / and she, seeing that he had grown up, and having obtained her father's permission, / that virtuous woman gained the prince as her husband at a svayaṃvara.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etadvṛttāntamabhavattasmiṃstīrthe nṛpottama .
etasmātkāraṇānmedhyaṃ tīrthametatsadā nṛpa .. 83.90 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतद्वृत्तान्तमभवत्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नृपोत्तम .
एतस्मात्कारणान्मेध्यं तीर्थमेतत्सदा नृप .. 83.90 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This incident took place at that sacred ford, O best of kings; / for this reason, O king, this sacred ford is forever pure.

6.3.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ nareśvara .
viśeṣāccāśvine māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm .. 83.91 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां सर्वकालं नरेश्वर .
विशेषाच्चाश्विने मासि कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् .. 83.91 ..
6.3.m: On the eighth or fourteenth [lunar day], at all times, O lord of men, / and especially on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Āśvina,

6.3.s:
snāpayedīśvaraṃ bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā .
dadhnā ca khaṇḍayuktena kuśatoyena vai punaḥ .. 83.92 ..
6.3.d:
स्नापयेदीश्वरं भक्त्या क्षौद्रक्षीरेण सर्पिषा .
दध्ना च खण्डयुक्तेन कुशतोयेन वै पुनः .. 83.92 ..
6.3.m: one should bathe Īśvara with devotion using honey, milk, ghee, / curd mixed with sugar, and again with kuśa-water.

6.3.s:
śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayecca maheśvaram .
tataḥ sugandhapuṣpaiśca bilvapatraiśca pūjayet .. 83.93 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीखण्डेन सुगन्धेन गुण्ठयेच्च महेश्वरम् .
ततः सुगन्धपुष्पैश्च बिल्वपत्रैश्च पूजयेत् .. 83.93 ..
6.3.m: One should smear Maheśvara with fragrant sandalwood paste; / then one should worship him with fragrant flowers and bilva leaves,

6.3.s:
mucakundena kadena jātīkāśakuśodbhavaiḥ .
unmattamunipuṣpaughaiḥ puṣpaistatkālasambhavaiḥ .. 83.94 ..
6.3.d:
मुचकुन्देन कदेन जातीकाशकुशोद्भवैः .
उन्मत्तमुनिपुष्पौघैः पुष्पैस्तत्कालसम्भवैः .. 83.94 ..
6.3.m: with mucakunda, kada, and blossoms of jātī, kāśa, and kuśa, / with clusters of unmattaka flowers and flowers of the sage, and with seasonal flowers.

6.3.s:
arcayetparayā bhaktyā hanūmanteśvaraṃ śivam .
ghṛtena dāpayeddīpaṃ tailena tadabhāvataḥ .. 83.95 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चयेत्परया भक्त्या हनूमन्तेश्वरं शिवम् .
घृतेन दापयेद्दीपं तैलेन तदभावतः .. 83.95 ..
6.3.m: With supreme devotion one should worship Śiva, Hanūmanteśvara; / one should offer a lamp with ghee, or with oil in its absence.

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ ca kārayettatra brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .
sarvalakṣaṇasampūrṇaiḥ kulīnairgṛhapālakaiḥ .. 83.96 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं च कारयेत्तत्र ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः .
सर्वलक्षणसम्पूर्णैः कुलीनैर्गृहपालकैः .. 83.96 ..
6.3.m: One should have a śrāddha performed there by brahmins who have mastered the Vedas, / endowed with all auspicious marks, of noble birth, and maintainers of households.

6.3.s:
tarpayedbrāhmaṇān bhaktyā vasanānnahiraṇyataḥ .
narakasthā divaṃ yāntu procyeti praṇameddvijān .. 83.97 ..
6.3.d:
तर्पयेद्ब्राह्मणान् भक्त्या वसनान्नहिरण्यतः .
नरकस्था दिवं यान्तु प्रोच्येति प्रणमेद्द्विजान् .. 83.97 ..
6.3.m: With devotion one should gratify the brahmins with garments, food, and gold, / and, declaring, 'May those dwelling in hell go to heaven,' bow to the twice-born.

6.3.s:
patitān varjayedviprān vṛṣalī yasya gehinī .
svavṛṣaṃ cāparityajya vṛṣairanyairvṛṣāyate .. 83.98 ..
6.3.d:
पतितान् वर्जयेद्विप्रान् वृषली यस्य गेहिनी .
स्ववृषं चापरित्यज्य वृषैरन्यैर्वृषायते .. 83.98 ..
6.3.m: One should shun fallen brahmins whose housewife is an unchaste woman, / who, abandoning her own bull, acts like a cow in heat with other bulls.

6.3.s:
vṛṣalīṃ tāṃ vidurdevā na śūdrī vṛṣalī bhavet .
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam .. 83.99 ..
6.3.d:
वृषलीं तां विदुर्देवा न शूद्री वृषली भवेत् .
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं गुरुदारनिषेवणम् .. 83.99 ..
6.3.m: The gods know such a one to be a vṛṣalī; a śūdra woman is not [thereby] a vṛṣalī. / The murder of a brahmin, the drinking of liquor, intercourse with the guru's wife,

6.3.s:
suvarṇaharaṇanyāsamitradrohodbhavaṃ tathā .
naśyate pātakaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 83.100 ..
6.3.d:
सुवर्णहरणन्यासमित्रद्रोहोद्भवं तथा .
नश्यते पातकं सर्वमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 83.100 ..
6.3.m: the theft of gold, and sins arising from betrayal of a deposit or a friend: / all such sin is destroyed—thus Śaṅkara has spoken.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
vākpralāpena bho vatsa bahunoktena kiṃ mayā .
sarvapātakasaṃyukto dadyāddānaṃ dvijanmane .. 83.101 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
वाक्प्रलापेन भो वत्स बहुनोक्तेन किं मया .
सर्वपातकसंयुक्तो दद्याद्दानं द्विजन्मने .. 83.101 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / What use is my much speaking with rambling words, my child? / Even one weighed down with every sin should make a gift to a twice-born.

6.3.s:
godānaṃ ca prakartavyamasmiṃstīrthe viśeṣataḥ .
godānaṃ hi yataḥ pārtha sarvadānādhikaṃ smṛtam .. 83.102 ..
6.3.d:
गोदानं च प्रकर्तव्यमस्मिंस्तीर्थे विशेषतः .
गोदानं हि यतः पार्थ सर्वदानाधिकं स्मृतम् .. 83.102 ..
6.3.m: A gift of a cow should especially be made at this sacred ford; / for a gift of a cow, O Pārtha, is considered superior to all gifts.

6.3.s:
sarvadevamayā gāvaḥ sarve devāstadātmakāḥ .
śṛṅgāgreṣu mahīpāla śakro vasati nityaśaḥ .. 83.103 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वदेवमया गावः सर्वे देवास्तदात्मकाः .
शृङ्गाग्रेषु महीपाल शक्रो वसति नित्यशः .. 83.103 ..
6.3.m: Cows comprise all gods; all gods have their self in them. / Upon the tips of her horns, O protector of the earth, Indra continually dwells.

6.3.s:
uraḥ skandaḥ śiro brahmā lalāṭe vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ .
candrārkau locane devau jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatī .. 83.104 ..
6.3.d:
उरः स्कन्दः शिरो ब्रह्मा ललाटे वृषभध्वजः .
चन्द्रार्कौ लोचने देवौ जिह्वायां च सरस्वती .. 83.104 ..
6.3.m: Her chest is Skanda; her head, Brahmā; on her forehead is the Bull-bannered [Śiva]; / the Moon and Sun deities are her eyes, and Sarasvatī is upon her tongue.

6.3.s:
marudgaṇāḥ sadā sādhyā yasyā dantā nareśvara .
huṅkāre caturo vedān vidyātsāṅgapadakramān .. 83.105 ..
6.3.d:
मरुद्गणाः सदा साध्या यस्या दन्ता नरेश्वर .
हुङ्कारे चतुरो वेदान् विद्यात्साङ्गपदक्रमान् .. 83.105 ..
6.3.m: The host of the Maruts and the Sādhyas are always her teeth, O king of men; / in her lowing sound one should know the four Vedas with their aṅgas, padas, and kramas.

6.3.s:
ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu hyasaṃkhyātāstapasvinaḥ .
daṇḍahasto mahākāyaḥ kṛṣṇo mahiṣavāhanaḥ .. 83.106 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषयो रोमकूपेषु ह्यसंख्यातास्तपस्विनः .
दण्डहस्तो महाकायः कृष्णो महिषवाहनः .. 83.106 ..
6.3.m: Countless ascetic seers dwell in her hair follicles. / Holding a staff in hand, of huge body, dark-complexioned, mounted on a buffalo,

6.3.s:
yamaḥ pṛṣṭhasthito nityaṃ śubhāśubhaparīkṣakaḥ .
catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ puṇyāḥ kṣīradhārāḥ staneṣu ca .. 83.107 ..
6.3.d:
यमः पृष्ठस्थितो नित्यं शुभाशुभपरीक्षकः .
चत्वारः सागराः पुण्याः क्षीरधाराः स्तनेषु च .. 83.107 ..
6.3.m: Yama continually abides on her back, assessing good and evil; / the four holy oceans and streams of milk are in her teats.

6.3.s:
viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṅgā darśanātpāpanāśanī .
prasrāve saṃsthitā yasmāttasmādvandyā sadā budhaiḥ .. 83.108 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुपादोद्भवा गङ्गा दर्शनात्पापनाशनी .
प्रस्रावे संस्थिता यस्मात्तस्माद्वन्द्या सदा बुधैः .. 83.108 ..
6.3.m: The Gaṅgā, arisen from Viṣṇu's foot and destroying sins by its very sight, / resides in her urine; therefore it is always worshipped by the wise.

6.3.s:
lakṣmīśca gomaye nityaṃ pavitrā sarvamaṅgalā .
gomayālepanaṃ tasmātkartavyaṃ pāṇḍunandana .. 83.109 ..
6.3.d:
लक्ष्मीश्च गोमये नित्यं पवित्रा सर्वमङ्गला .
गोमयालेपनं तस्मात्कर्तव्यं पाण्डुनन्दन .. 83.109 ..
6.3.m: And Lakṣmī, pure and all-auspicious, is always in cow dung; / therefore anointing with cow dung must be performed, O son of Pāṇḍu.

6.3.s:
gandharvāpsaraso nāgāḥ khurāgreṣu vyavasthitāḥ .
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ yāni tīrthāni bhārata .
tāni sarvāṇi jānīyādgaurgavyaṃ tena pāvanam .. 83.110 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो नागाः खुराग्रेषु व्यवस्थिताः .
पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां यानि तीर्थानि भारत .
तानि सर्वाणि जानीयाद्गौर्गव्यं तेन पावनम् .. 83.110 ..
6.3.m: Gandharvas, apsarases, and nāgas reside on the tips of her hooves. / Whatever sacred fords there are on the earth bounded by the oceans, O Bhārata, / one should know all of them [to be in the cow]; therefore cow products are purifying.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
sarvadevamayī dhenurgīrvāṇādyairalaṃkṛtā .
etatkathaya me tāta kasmādgoṣu samāśritāḥ .. 83.111 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
सर्वदेवमयी धेनुर्गीर्वाणाद्यैरलंकृता .
एतत्कथय मे तात कस्माद्गोषु समाश्रिताः .. 83.111 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The cow consists of all gods and is adorned by the immortals and others. / Tell me this, father: why have they taken refuge in cows?

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sarvadevamayo viṣṇurgāvo viṣṇuśarīrajāḥ .
devāstadubhayāttasmātkalpitā vividhā janaiḥ .. 83.112 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सर्वदेवमयो विष्णुर्गावो विष्णुशरीरजाः .
देवास्तदुभयात्तस्मात्कल्पिता विविधा जनैः .. 83.112 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Viṣṇu consists of all gods; cows are born from Viṣṇu's body; / therefore, from both of these, the various gods have been formed by people.

6.3.s:
śvetā vā kapilā vāpi kṣīriṇī pāṇḍunandana .
savatsā ca suśīlā ca sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitā .. 83.113 ..
6.3.d:
श्वेता वा कपिला वापि क्षीरिणी पाण्डुनन्दन .
सवत्सा च सुशीला च सितवस्त्रावगुण्ठिता .. 83.113 ..
6.3.m: Whether white or tawny, giving milk, O son of Pāṇḍu, / with her calf, of good disposition, covered with a white cloth,

6.3.s:
kāṃsyadohanikā deyā svarṇaśṛṅgī subhūṣitā .
hanūmanteśvarasyāgre bhaktyā viprāya dāpayet .. 83.114 ..
6.3.d:
कांस्यदोहनिका देया स्वर्णशृङ्गी सुभूषिता .
हनूमन्तेश्वरस्याग्रे भक्त्या विप्राय दापयेत् .. 83.114 ..
6.3.m: a bronze milking pail should be given, with gold on her horns, well-adorned; / one should offer it with devotion to a brahmin before Hanūmanteśvara.

6.3.s:
niyamasthena sā deyā svargamānantyamicchatā .
asamarthāya ye dadyurviṣṇuloke prayānti te .. 83.115 ..
6.3.d:
नियमस्थेन सा देया स्वर्गमानन्त्यमिच्छता .
असमर्थाय ये दद्युर्विष्णुलोके प्रयान्ति ते .. 83.115 ..
6.3.m: It should be given by one abiding by vows, desiring endless heaven; / those who give it to one who is destitute proceed to Viṣṇu's realm.

6.3.s:
asau loke cyuto rājanbhūtale dvijamandire .
kuśalo jāyate putro guṇavidyādhanarddhimān .. 83.116 ..
6.3.d:
असौ लोके च्युतो राजन्भूतले द्विजमन्दिरे .
कुशलो जायते पुत्रो गुणविद्याधनर्द्धिमान् .. 83.116 ..
6.3.m: When he falls from that realm, O king, to the earth into a twice-born's household, / a son is born skillful, endowed with virtues, learning, and abundance of wealth.

6.3.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ hanūmanteśvaraṃ nṛpa .
śṛṇvanvimucyate pāpādvarṇasaṃkarasaṃbhavāt .. 83.117 ..
6.3.d:
