सर्वपापहरं तीर्थं हनूमन्तेश्वरं नृप .
शृण्वन्विमुच्यते पापाद्वर्णसंकरसंभवात् .. 83.117 ..
6.3.m: Hanūmanteśvara is a sacred ford that removes all sins, O king; / hearing [of it], one is freed from the sin arising from intermixture of castes.

6.3.s:
dūrasthaścintayan paśyanmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 83.118 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe hanūmanteśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 84
6.3.d:
दूरस्थश्चिन्तयन् पश्यन्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 83.118 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे हनूमन्तेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्र्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 84
6.3.m:
Even staying far away, remembering or seeing it, one is liberated; there is no doubt in this.
Thus ends the eighty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Hanūmanteśvara Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Āvantyakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 84

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam .
kailāse pṛcchate bhaktyā ṣaṇmukhāya śivoditam .. 84.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् .
कैलासे पृच्छते भक्त्या षण्मुखाय शिवोदितम् .. 84.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In this very context they cite this ancient history, / spoken by Śiva to the six-faced [Skanda] who asked with devotion on Kailāsa.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
pūrvaṃ tretāyuge skanda hato rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ .
caturdaśa tadā koṭyo nihatā brahmarakṣasām .. 84.2 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
पूर्वं त्रेतायुगे स्कन्द हतो रामेण रावणः .
चतुर्दश तदा कोट्यो निहता ब्रह्मरक्षसाम् .. 84.2 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Formerly, in the Tretā age, O Skanda, Rāvaṇa was slain by Rāma; / fourteen crores of brahmarākṣasas were slaughtered then.

6.3.s:
hateṣu teṣu vai tatra rakṣaṇāya divaukasām .
mahānandastadā jātastriṣu lokeṣu putraka .. 84.3 ..
6.3.d:
हतेषु तेषु वै तत्र रक्षणाय दिवौकसाम् .
महानन्दस्तदा जातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु पुत्रक .. 84.3 ..
6.3.m: When they were slain there for the protection of the celestials, / great joy arose in the three worlds at that time, my dear child.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sītāṃ samāsādya samaṃ vānarapuṃgavaiḥ .
rāmo'pyayodhyāmāyāto bharatena kṛtotsavaḥ .
tasmai samarpayāmāsa sa rājyaṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ .. 84.4 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सीतां समासाद्य समं वानरपुंगवैः .
रामोऽप्ययोध्यामायातो भरतेन कृतोत्सवः .
तस्मै समर्पयामास स राज्यं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः .. 84.4 ..
6.3.m: Then, having obtained Sītā together with the eminent monkeys, / Rāma, too, came to Ayodhyā, celebrated with festivities by Bharata; / that elder brother of Lakṣmaṇa handed over the kingdom to him.

6.3.s:
tasminpraśāsati tato rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam .
kṛtakāryo'tha hanumānkailāsamagātpurā .. 84.5 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिन्प्रशासति ततो राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् .
कृतकार्योऽथ हनुमान्कैलासमगात्पुरा .. 84.5 ..
6.3.m: While he was ruling the kingdom from which thorns had been eliminated, / Hanumān, having accomplished his task, went in ancient times to Kailāsa.

6.3.s:
tato nandī pratīhāro rudrāṃśamapi taṃ kapim .
na ca saṃgamayāmāsa rudreṇāghaughahāriṇā .. 84.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततो नन्दी प्रतीहारो रुद्रांशमपि तं कपिम् .
न च संगमयामास रुद्रेणाघौघहारिणा .. 84.6 ..
6.3.m: Then Nandī, the gatekeeper, did not permit that monkey, / even though an incarnation of Rudra, to meet with Rudra, the remover of multitudes of sins.

6.3.s:
tena pṛṣṭastadā nandī kiṃ mayā pātakaṃ kṛtam .
yena rudravapuḥ puṇyaṃ na paśyāmyambikānvitam .. 84.7 ..
6.3.d:
तेन पृष्टस्तदा नन्दी किं मया पातकं कृतम् .
येन रुद्रवपुः पुण्यं न पश्याम्यम्बिकान्वितम् .. 84.7 ..
6.3.m: Asked by him then, Nandī [was questioned]: "What sin have I committed, / because of which I do not behold the holy form of Rudra accompanied by Ambikā?"

6.3.s:
nandyuvāca -
tvayāvataraṇaṃ cakre kapīndrāmarahetunā .
tathāpi hi kṛtaṃ pāpamupabhogena śāmyati .. 84.8 ..
6.3.d:
नन्द्युवाच -
त्वयावतरणं चक्रे कपीन्द्रामरहेतुना .
तथापि हि कृतं पापमुपभोगेन शाम्यति .. 84.8 ..
6.3.m: Nandī said: / "You took incarnation for the sake of the immortal gods, O lord of monkeys; / even so, the sin that was committed is extinguished only through experiencing [its fruit]."

6.3.s:
hanumānuvāca -
kiṃ mayākāri tatpāpaṃ nandindevārthakāriṇā .
rākṣasāśca hatā duṣṭā viprayajñāṅgaghātinaḥ .. 84.9 ..
6.3.d:
हनुमानुवाच -
किं मयाकारि तत्पापं नन्दिन्देवार्थकारिणा .
राक्षसाश्च हता दुष्टा विप्रयज्ञाङ्गघातिनः .. 84.9 ..
6.3.m: Hanumān said: / "What sin was committed by me, O Nandī, acting for the sake of the gods? / Wicked rākṣasas were slain, who disrupted the sacrifices and the bodies of brahmins."

6.3.s:
tatastadālāpakutūhalī haro nijāṃśabhājaṃ kapimugratejasam .
uvāca dvārāntaradattadṛṣṭiḥ puraḥsthitaṃ prekṣya kapīśvaraṃ punaḥ .. 84.10 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तदालापकुतूहली हरो निजांशभाजं कपिमुग्रतेजसम् .
उवाच द्वारान्तरदत्तदृष्टिः पुरःस्थितं प्रेक्ष्य कपीश्वरं पुनः .. 84.10 ..
6.3.m: Then, curious about that conversation, Hara, directing his gaze through the doorway, / spoke again to that monkey of fierce splendor who was a share of himself, seeing the lord of monkeys standing before him.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
gaṅgā gayā kape revā yamunā ca sarasvatī .
sarvapāpaharā nadyastāsu snānaṃ samācara .. 84.11 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
गङ्गा गया कपे रेवा यमुना च सरस्वती .
सर्वपापहरा नद्यस्तासु स्नानं समाचर .. 84.11 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "The Gaṅgā, Gayā, O monkey, the Revā, the Yamunā, and the Sarasvatī— / these rivers remove all sins; perform ritual ablution in them.

6.3.s:
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
somanāthasamīpasthaṃ tatra tvaṃ gaccha vānara .. 84.12 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
सोमनाथसमीपस्थं तत्र त्वं गच्छ वानर .. 84.12 ..
6.3.m: On the southern bank of the Narmadā is a most beautiful sacred ford / situated near Somanātha; go there, O monkey.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā mahāpāpaṃ gamiṣyati mamājñayā .
utpatya vegāddhanumāñchrīrevādakṣiṇe taṭe .. 84.13 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महापापं गमिष्यति ममाज्ञया .
उत्पत्य वेगाद्धनुमाञ्छ्रीरेवादक्षिणे तटे .. 84.13 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there, your great sin will depart by my command." / Leaping with speed to the southern bank of the glorious Revā,

6.3.s:
jagāma sumahānādastapaścakre suduṣkaram .
tasya vai tapyamānasya rakṣovadhakṛtaṃ tamaḥ .. 84.14 ..
6.3.d:
जगाम सुमहानादस्तपश्चक्रे सुदुष्करम् .
तस्य वै तप्यमानस्य रक्षोवधकृतं तमः .. 84.14 ..
6.3.m: he went, uttering a tremendous roar, and performed very arduous austerity. / As he was performing austerity, the darkness caused by the killing of the rākṣasas

6.3.s:
vilīnaṃ pārtha kālena kiyateśaprasādataḥ .
tato devaiḥ samaṃ devastattīrthamagamaddharaḥ .. 84.15 ..
6.3.d:
विलीनं पार्थ कालेन कियतेशप्रसादतः .
ततो देवैः समं देवस्तत्तीर्थमगमद्धरः .. 84.15 ..
6.3.m: dissolved in time, O son of Pṛthā, to some extent by the grace of the Lord. / Then the god Hara, along with the gods, went to that sacred ford.

6.3.s:
kapimāliṅgayāmāsa varaṃ tasmai pradattavān .
adyaprabhṛti te tīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 84.16 ..
6.3.d:
कपिमालिङ्गयामास वरं तस्मै प्रदत्तवान् .
अद्यप्रभृति ते तीर्थं भविष्यति न संशयः .. 84.16 ..
6.3.m: He embraced the monkey and granted him a boon: / "From this day forward, this sacred ford shall be yours; there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
kapitīrthaṃ tato jātaṃ tasthau tatra svayaṃ haraḥ .
hanūmanteśvaro nāmnā sarvahatyāharastadā .. 84.17 ..
6.3.d:
कपितीर्थं ततो जातं तस्थौ तत्र स्वयं हरः .
हनूमन्तेश्वरो नाम्ना सर्वहत्याहरस्तदा .. 84.17 ..
6.3.m: Thereupon Kapitīrtha came to be, and Hara himself remained there / by the name Hanūmanteśvara, removing all slaughter at that time.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyā liṅgaṃ prapūjayet .
sarvapāpāni naśyanti harasya vacanaṃ yathā .. 84.18 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा भक्त्या लिङ्गं प्रपूजयेत् .
सर्वपापानि नश्यन्ति हरस्य वचनं यथा .. 84.18 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed in that sacred ford, worships the liṅga with devotion, / all his sins are destroyed, according to the word of Hara.

6.3.s:
tatrāsthīni vilīyante piṇḍadāne'kṣayā gatiḥ .
yatkiṃciddīyate tatra taddhi koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 84.19 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रास्थीनि विलीयन्ते पिण्डदानेऽक्षया गतिः .
यत्किंचिद्दीयते तत्र तद्धि कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 84.19 ..
6.3.m: There bones dissolve, and in the offering of funeral balls there is an imperishable destination. / Whatever little is given there becomes multiplied ten-millionfold.

6.3.s:
hanumānapyayodhyāyāṃ rāmaṃ draṣṭumathāgamat .
cakāra kuśalapraśnaṃ svasvarūpaṃ nyavedayat .. 84.20 ..
6.3.d:
हनुमानप्ययोध्यायां रामं द्रष्टुमथागमत् .
चकार कुशलप्रश्नं स्वस्वरूपं न्यवेदयत् .. 84.20 ..
6.3.m: Hanumān also went to Ayodhyā to see Rāma; / he inquired after his welfare and revealed his true nature.

6.3.s:
śrīrāma uvāca -
kurvato devakāryaṃ te mama kāryaṃ ca kurvataḥ .
tato'hamapi pāpīyāṃstapastapsyāmyasaṃśayam .. 84.21 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीराम उवाच -
कुर्वतो देवकार्यं ते मम कार्यं च कुर्वतः .
ततोऽहमपि पापीयांस्तपस्तप्स्याम्यसंशयम् .. 84.21 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Rāma said: / "While you were doing the work of the gods and doing my work, / [it was on my account]; therefore I too, being sinful, will perform austerity without doubt."

6.3.s:
tatraiva dakṣiṇe kūle revāyāḥ pāpahāriṇi .
caturviṃśativarṣāṇi tapastepe'tha rāghavaḥ .. 84.22 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रैव दक्षिणे कूले रेवायाः पापहारिणि .
चतुर्विंशतिवर्षाणि तपस्तेपेऽथ राघवः .. 84.22 ..
6.3.m: Right there on the southern bank of the Revā, which removes sin, / the descendant of Raghu then performed austerity for twenty-four years,

6.3.s:
jyotiṣmatīpurīsaṃsthaḥ śrīrevāsnānamācaran .
tasya śuśrūṣaṇaṃ cakre lakṣmaṇo'pi tadājñayā .. 84.23 ..
6.3.d:
ज्योतिष्मतीपुरीसंस्थः श्रीरेवास्नानमाचरन् .
तस्य शुश्रूषणं चक्रे लक्ष्मणोऽपि तदाज्ञया .. 84.23 ..
6.3.m: residing in the city of Jyotiṣmatī and performing ritual ablution in the glorious Revā. / Lakṣmaṇa too attended upon him by his command.

6.3.s:
sthāpayāmāsaturliṅge tau tadā rāmalakṣmaṇau .
prabhāvātsatyatapaso revātīre mahāmatī .
niṣpāpatāṃ tadā vīrau jagmatū rāmalakṣmaṇau .. 84.24 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापयामासतुर्लिङ्गे तौ तदा रामलक्ष्मणौ .
प्रभावात्सत्यतपसो रेवातीरे महामती .
निष्पापतां तदा वीरौ जग्मतू रामलक्ष्मणौ .. 84.24 ..
6.3.m: Then both of them, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, installed liṅgas. / By the power of their true austerity on the bank of the Revā, those two wise heroes, / Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, then attained sinlessness.

6.3.s:
tatastadā devapurogamo haro gato hi vai puṇyamunīśvaraiḥ saha .
āgatya tīrthaṃ ca varaṃ dadau tadā nijāṃ kalāṃ tatra vimucya tīrthe .. 84.25 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तदा देवपुरोगमो हरो गतो हि वै पुण्यमुनीश्वरैः सह .
आगत्य तीर्थं च वरं ददौ तदा निजां कलां तत्र विमुच्य तीर्थे .. 84.25 ..
6.3.m: Then Hara, leading the gods, went indeed along with the holy lords of sages; / having arrived at the sacred ford, he then granted a boon, leaving his own portion there in that sacred ford.

6.3.s:
munibhiḥ sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣiptaṃ kumbhodakaṃ bhuvi .
ekasthaṃ liṅganāmātha kalākumbhastathābhavat .. 84.26 ..
6.3.d:
मुनिभिः सर्वतीर्थानां क्षिप्तं कुम्भोदकं भुवि .
एकस्थं लिङ्गनामाथ कलाकुम्भस्तथाभवत् .. 84.26 ..
6.3.m: Water from pitchers containing all the sacred fords was poured on the earth by the sages; / gathered in one place, the name of the liṅga then became Kalākumbha.

6.3.s:
kumbheśvara iti khyātastadā devagaṇārcitaḥ .
rāmo'pi pūjayāmāsa talliṅgaṃ devasevivatam .. 84.27 ..
6.3.d:
कुम्भेश्वर इति ख्यातस्तदा देवगणार्चितः .
रामोऽपि पूजयामास तल्लिङ्गं देवसेविवतम् .. 84.27 ..
6.3.m: Known as Kumbheśvara, he was worshipped at that time by the hosts of gods. / Rāma too worshipped that liṅga attended by the gods.

6.3.s:
tato varaṃ dadau devo rāmakīrtyabhivṛddhaye .
caturviṃśatime varṣe rāmo niṣpāpatāṃ gataḥ .. 84.28 ..
6.3.d:
ततो वरं ददौ देवो रामकीर्त्यभिवृद्धये .
चतुर्विंशतिमे वर्षे रामो निष्पापतां गतः .. 84.28 ..
6.3.m: Then the god granted a boon for the increase of Rāma's renown. / In the twenty-fourth year, Rāma attained sinlessness.

6.3.s:
yadā kanyāgataḥ paṅgurguruṇā sahito bhavet .
tadeva devayātreyamiti devā jagurmudā .. 84.29 ..
6.3.d:
यदा कन्यागतः पङ्गुर्गुरुणा सहितो भवेत् .
तदेव देवयात्रेयमिति देवा जगुर्मुदा .. 84.29 ..
6.3.m: When the lame planet [Saturn] enters Virgo together with Jupiter, / exactly then is this pilgrimage to the gods; thus the gods proclaimed with joy.

6.3.s:
yathā godāvarītīrthe sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet .
tathātra revāsnānena liṅgānāṃ darśanairnṛṇām .. 84.30 ..
6.3.d:
यथा गोदावरीतीर्थे सर्वतीर्थफलं भवेत् .
तथात्र रेवास्नानेन लिङ्गानां दर्शनैर्नृणाम् .. 84.30 ..
6.3.m: Just as the fruit of all sacred fords is obtained at the sacred ford of the Godāvarī, / so it is here for men through ritual ablution in the Revā and darśana of the liṅgas.

6.3.s:
kariṣyantyatra ye śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ narmadātaṭe .
kumbheśvarasamīpasthāstatphalaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha .. 84.31 ..
6.3.d:
करिष्यन्त्यत्र ये श्राद्धं पितॄणां नर्मदातटे .
कुम्भेश्वरसमीपस्थास्तत्फलं शृणु षण्मुख .. 84.31 ..
6.3.m: Those who perform a śrāddha here for the ancestors on the bank of the Narmadā, / remaining near Kumbheśvara—hear the fruit of that, O six-faced one:

6.3.s:
yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ śarīre sarvadehinām .
tāvadvarṣapramāṇena pitṝṇāmakṣayā gatiḥ .. 84.32 ..
6.3.d:
यावन्तो रोमकूपाः स्युः शरीरे सर्वदेहिनाम् .
तावद्वर्षप्रमाणेन पितॄणामक्षया गतिः .. 84.32 ..
6.3.m: As many pores of the skin as there are on the body of all embodied beings, / for a measure of years equal to that, there is an imperishable destination for the ancestors.

6.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ sarvatīrthāni yāni tu .
labhante tatphalaṃ martyā liṅgatrayavilokanāt .. 84.33 ..
6.3.d:
पृथिव्यां देवताः सर्वाः सर्वतीर्थानि यानि तु .
लभन्ते तत्फलं मर्त्या लिङ्गत्रयविलोकनात् .. 84.33 ..
6.3.m: Whatever deities and whatever sacred fords there are on the earth, / mortals obtain the fruit of them all from seeing the three liṅgas.

6.3.s:
aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano dhanamāpnuyāt .
sarogo mucyate rogānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 84.34 ..
6.3.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं निर्धनो धनमाप्नुयात् .
सरोगो मुच्यते रोगान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 84.34 ..
6.3.m: One without a son obtains a son; one without wealth obtains wealth; / a sick person is freed from disease; no doubt should be entertained here.

6.3.s:
siṃharāśiṃ gate jīve yatsyādgodāvarīphalam .
taddvādaśaguṇaṃ skanda kumbheśvarasamīpataḥ .. 84.35 ..
6.3.d:
सिंहराशिं गते जीवे यत्स्याद्गोदावरीफलम् .
तद्द्वादशगुणं स्कन्द कुम्भेश्वरसमीपतः .. 84.35 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is attained at the Godāvarī when Jupiter enters the sign of Leo, / twelve times that is attained near Kumbheśvara, O Skanda.

6.3.s:
ye jānanti na paśyanti kumbhaśambhumumāpatim .
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam .. 84.36 ..
6.3.d:
ये जानन्ति न पश्यन्ति कुम्भशम्भुमुमापतिम् .
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् .. 84.36 ..
6.3.m: Those who, knowing, do not behold Kumbha-Śambhu, the husband of Umā, / on the southern bank of the Narmadā—their birth is useless.

6.3.s:
yathā godāvarīyātrā kartavyā muniśāsanāt .
caturviṃśatime varṣe tatheyaṃ devabhāṣitam .. 84.37 ..
6.3.d:
यथा गोदावरीयात्रा कर्तव्या मुनिशासनात् .
चतुर्विंशतिमे वर्षे तथेयं देवभाषितम् .. 84.37 ..
6.3.m: Just as a pilgrimage to the Godāvarī is to be made by ordinance of the sages / in the twenty-fourth year, so is this [pilgrimage] declared by the gods.

6.3.s:
yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvadvai divi tārakaḥ .
tāvattadakṣayaṃ dānaṃ revākumbheśvarāntike .. 84.38 ..
6.3.d:
यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च यावद्वै दिवि तारकः .
तावत्तदक्षयं दानं रेवाकुम्भेश्वरान्तिके .. 84.38 ..
6.3.m: As long as the moon and the sun, and as long indeed as the stars are in the sky, / so long does a gift given near Kumbheśvara on the Revā remain imperishable.

6.3.s:
mahādānāni deyāni tatra laukairvicakṣaṇaiḥ .
godānamatra śaṃsanti sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā .. 84.39 ..
6.3.d:
महादानानि देयानि तत्र लौकैर्विचक्षणैः .
गोदानमत्र शंसन्ति सौवर्णं राजतं तथा .. 84.39 ..
6.3.m: Great gifts are to be given there by discerning people of the world; / they praise the gift of cows here, and likewise of gold and silver.

6.3.s:
yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ .
snānena kiṃ punaḥ skanda brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati .. 84.40 ..
6.3.d:
यस्याः स्मरणमात्रेण नश्यते पापसञ्चयः .
स्नानेन किं पुनः स्कन्द ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति .. 84.40 ..
6.3.m: She by whose mere remembrance a multitude of sins is destroyed— / how much more by ritual ablution, O Skanda? It removes even the murder of a brahmin.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā śrāddhaṃ kuryādyudhiṣṭhira .
ekottaraṃ kulaśatamuddharecchivaśāsanāt .. 84.41 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा श्राद्धं कुर्याद्युधिष्ठिर .
एकोत्तरं कुलशतमुद्धरेच्छिवशासनात् .. 84.41 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and performs a śrāddha, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / delivers one hundred and one generations by the command of Śiva.

6.3.s:
yāni kāni ca tīrthāni cāsamudrasarāṃsi ca .
śivaliṅgārcanasyeha kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 84.42 ..
6.3.d:
यानि कानि च तीर्थानि चासमुद्रसरांसि च .
शिवलिङ्गार्चनस्येह कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .. 84.42 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sacred fords and lakes extending to the ocean there are, / they are not worth a sixteenth part of the worship of a liṅga of Śiva here.

6.3.s:
evaṃ devā varaṃ dattvā harīśvarapurogamāḥ .
svasthānamagaman pūrvaṃ muktvā tannāma cottamam .. 84.43 ..
6.3.d:
एवं देवा वरं दत्त्वा हरीश्वरपुरोगमाः .
स्वस्थानमगमन् पूर्वं मुक्त्वा तन्नाम चोत्तमम् .. 84.43 ..
6.3.m: Thus the gods, led by the lord Hara, having granted the boon, / went previously to their own abode, having pronounced that excellent name.

6.3.s:
tīrthasyāsya varaṃ dattvā sa rāmo lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ .
ayodhyāṃ praviveśāsau niṣpāpo narmadājalāt .. 84.44 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थस्यास्य वरं दत्त्वा स रामो लक्ष्मणाग्रजः .
अयोध्यां प्रविवेशासौ निष्पापो नर्मदाजलात् .. 84.44 ..
6.3.m: Having granted a boon to this sacred ford, that Rāma, the elder brother of Lakṣmaṇa, / entered Ayodhyā, made sinless by the water of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
sauvarṇīṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā sītāṃ yajñaṃ cakāra saḥ .
anumantrya munīṃllokāndevatāśca nijaṃ kulam .. 84.45 ..
6.3.d:
सौवर्णीं च ततः कृत्वा सीतां यज्ञं चकार सः .
अनुमन्त्र्य मुनींल्लोकान्देवताश्च निजं कुलम् .. 84.45 ..
6.3.m: And then, having made a golden Sītā, he performed the sacrifice, / having consulted the sages, the people, the deities, and his own family.

6.3.s:
purā tretāyuge jātaṃ tattīrthaṃ skandanāmakam .
niyamena tato lokaiḥ kartavyaṃ liṅgadarśanam .. 84.46 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा त्रेतायुगे जातं तत्तीर्थं स्कन्दनामकम् .
नियमेन ततो लोकैः कर्तव्यं लिङ्गदर्शनम् .. 84.46 ..
6.3.m: Long ago, in the Tretā age, that sacred ford named Skanda came into being; / therefore, darśana of the liṅga should be performed with regular observance by people.

6.3.s:
tāvatpāpāni deheṣu mahāpātakajānyapi .
yāvanna prekṣate jantustattīrthaṃ devasevitam .. 84.47 ..
6.3.d:
तावत्पापानि देहेषु महापातकजान्यपि .
यावन्न प्रेक्षते जन्तुस्तत्तीर्थं देवसेवितम् .. 84.47 ..
6.3.m: So long do sins remain in bodies, even those arising from heinous offences, / as long as a living being does not behold that sacred ford frequented by the gods.

6.3.s:
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam .
jyotiṣmatīpurīsaṃsthaṃ ye drakṣyanti haraṃ param .. 84.48 ..
6.3.d:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् .
ज्योतिष्मतीपुरीसंस्थं ये द्रक्ष्यन्ति हरं परम् .. 84.48 ..
6.3.m: They are blessed, they are great souls, their birth is well-lived, / who behold the supreme Hara residing in the city of Jyotiṣmatī.

6.3.s:
tasmānmohaṃ parityajya janairgantavyamādarāt .
tīrthāśeṣaphalāvāptyai tīrthaṃ kumbheśvarāhvayam .. 84.49 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मान्मोहं परित्यज्य जनैर्गन्तव्यमादरात् .
तीर्थाशेषफलावाप्त्यै तीर्थं कुम्भेश्वराह्वयम् .. 84.49 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, abandoning delusion, people should go with reverence / to the sacred ford named Kumbheśvara, in order to attain the complete fruit of all sacred fords.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
śrutveti śambhuvacasā sa ṣaḍānano'tha natvā pituḥ padayugāmbujamādareṇa .
samprāpya dakṣiṇataṭaṃ giriśasravantyāḥ kīśāgryarāmakalaśākhyaśivān dadarśa .. 84.50 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kapitīrtharāmeśvaralakṣmaṇeśvarakumbheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 85
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
श्रुत्वेति शम्भुवचसा स षडाननोऽथ नत्वा पितुः पदयुगाम्बुजमादरेण .
सम्प्राप्य दक्षिणतटं गिरिशस्रवन्त्याः कीशाग्र्यरामकलशाख्यशिवान् ददर्श .. 84.50 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कपितीर्थरामेश्वरलक्ष्मणेश्वरकुम्भेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 85
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having heard these words of Śambhu, the six-faced one bowed with reverence to his father's pair of lotus feet; / reaching the southern bank of the river of the mountain-lord, he beheld the Śivas known as the foremost of monkeys, Rāma, and Kalaśa.
Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter, named Description of the Māhātmya of Kapitīrtha, Rāmeśvara, Lakṣmaṇeśvara, and Kumbheśvara, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 85

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra narmadāyāḥ purātanam .
brahmahatyāharaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāṇasyā samaṃ hi tat .. 85.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र नर्मदायाः पुरातनम् .
ब्रह्महत्याहरं तीर्थं वाराणस्या समं हि तत् .. 85.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O king of kings, one should go to the ancient [sacred ford] of the Narmadā, / the sacred ford that removes the sin of killing a brahmin; for it is equal to Vārāṇasī.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
āścaryaṃ kathyatāṃ brahmanyadvṛttaṃ narmadātaṭe .
vārāṇasyā samaṃ kasmādetatkathaya me prabho .. 85.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आश्चर्यं कथ्यतां ब्रह्मन्यद्वृत्तं नर्मदातटे .
वाराणस्या समं कस्मादेतत्कथय मे प्रभो .. 85.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me the wonder, O brahmin, that occurred on the bank of the Narmadā. / Why is it equal to Vārāṇasī? Tell me this, O lord.

6.3.s:
nimagno duḥkhasaṃsāre hṛtarājyo dvijottama .
yuṣmadvāṇījalasnāto nirduḥkhaḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ .. 85.3 ..
6.3.d:
निमग्नो दुःखसंसारे हृतराज्यो द्विजोत्तम .
युष्मद्वाणीजलस्नातो निर्दुःखः सह बान्धवैः .. 85.3 ..
6.3.m: Plunged into the miserable cycle of existence, robbed of my kingdom, O best of brahmins, / I am cleansed of sorrow along with my kinsmen, having bathed in the water of your words.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahābāho somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇa .
pṛṣṭo'smi durlabhaṃ tīrthaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param .. 85.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधु साधु महाबाहो सोमवंशविभूषण .
पृष्टोऽस्मि दुर्लभं तीर्थं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं परम् .. 85.4 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Well said, well said, O mighty-armed one, ornament of the lunar dynasty! / I have been asked about a rare sacred ford, the highest, more secret than the secret.

6.3.s:
ādau pitāmahastāvatsamastajagataḥ prabhuḥ .
manasā tasya saṃjātā daśaiva ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ .. 85.5 ..
6.3.d:
आदौ पितामहस्तावत्समस्तजगतः प्रभुः .
मनसा तस्य संजाता दशैव ऋषिपुंगवाः .. 85.5 ..
6.3.m: In the beginning was the Grandfather, the lord of the entire universe; / from his mind were born ten bull-like seers alone:

6.3.s:
marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum .
pracetasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhṛguṃ nāradameva ca .. 85.6 ..
6.3.d:
मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् .
प्रचेतसं वसिष्ठं च भृगुं नारदमेव च .. 85.6 ..
6.3.m: Marīci, Atri, and Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / Pracetas and Vasiṣṭha, and Bhṛgu and Nārada.

6.3.s:
jajñe prācetasaṃ dakṣaṃ mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ .
dakṣasyāpi tathā jātāḥ pañcāśadduhitāḥ kila .. 85.7 ..
6.3.d:
जज्ञे प्राचेतसं दक्षं महातेजाः प्रजापतिः .
दक्षस्यापि तथा जाताः पञ्चाशद्दुहिताः किल .. 85.7 ..
6.3.m: The prajāpati Dakṣa of great splendour was born from Pracetas; / to Dakṣa also were born fifty daughters, as is told.

6.3.s:
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa .
tathaiva sa mahābhāgaḥ saptaviṃśatimindave .. 85.8 ..
6.3.d:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश .
तथैव स महाभागः सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे .. 85.8 ..
6.3.m: He gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kaśyapa, / and likewise that fortunate one gave twenty-seven to the moon.

6.3.s:
rohiṇī nāma yā tāsāmabhīṣṭā sābhavadvidhoḥ .
śeṣāsu karuṇāṃ kṛtvā śapto dakṣeṇa candramāḥ .. 85.9 ..
6.3.d:
रोहिणी नाम या तासामभीष्टा साभवद्विधोः .
शेषासु करुणां कृत्वा शप्तो दक्षेण चन्द्रमाः .. 85.9 ..
6.3.m: She among them named Rohiṇī became the moon's beloved; / having taken pity on the others, Dakṣa cursed the moon.

6.3.s:
kṣayarogyabhavaccandro dakṣasyāyaṃ prajāpateḥ .
sa ca śāpaprabhāveṇa nistejāḥ śarvarīpatiḥ .. 85.10 ..
6.3.d:
क्षयरोग्यभवच्चन्द्रो दक्षस्यायं प्रजापतेः .
स च शापप्रभावेण निस्तेजाः शर्वरीपतिः .. 85.10 ..
6.3.m: The moon became afflicted with consumption through this prajāpati Dakṣa; / and by the power of the curse, the lord of night was stripped of his lustre.

6.3.s:
gataḥ pitāmahaṃ somo vepamāno'mṛtāṃśumān .
padmayone namastubhyaṃ vedagarbha namo'stu te .
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prasanno'smi pāhi māṃ kamalāsana .. 85.11 ..
6.3.d:
गतः पितामहं सोमो वेपमानोऽमृतांशुमान् .
पद्मयोने नमस्तुभ्यं वेदगर्भ नमोऽस्तु ते .
शरणं त्वां प्रसन्नोऽस्मि पाहि मां कमलासन .. 85.11 ..
6.3.m: Soma, the nectar-rayed one, trembling, went to the Grandfather: / “Homage to you, lotus-born one! Homage to you whose womb is the Veda! / Pleased [with me], I have taken refuge in you; protect me, O lotus-seated one!”

6.3.s:
brahmovāca -
nistejāḥ śarvarīnātha kalāhīnaśca dṛśyase .
udvignamānasastāta saṃjātaḥ kena hetunā .. 85.12 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच -
निस्तेजाः शर्वरीनाथ कलाहीनश्च दृश्यसे .
उद्विग्नमानसस्तात संजातः केन हेतुना .. 85.12 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā said: / “O lord of night, you are seen stripped of lustre and devoid of crescent digits; / your mind is agitated, my child. For what reason has this happened?”

6.3.s:
soma uvāca -
dakṣaśāpena me brahmannistejastvaṃ jagatpate .
nirhāraścāsya śāpasya kathyatāṃ me pitāmaha .. 85.13 ..
6.3.d:
सोम उवाच -
दक्षशापेन मे ब्रह्मन्निस्तेजस्त्वं जगत्पते .
निर्हारश्चास्य शापस्य कथ्यतां मे पितामह .. 85.13 ..
6.3.m: Soma said: / “By Dakṣa's curse I have lost my lustre, O Brahmā, O lord of the universe; / tell me, O Grandfather, the removal of this curse.”

6.3.s:
brahmovāca -
sarvatra sulabhā revā triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā .
oṅkāre'tha bhṛgukṣetre tathā caivaurvasaṃgame .. 85.14 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच -
सर्वत्र सुलभा रेवा त्रिषु स्थानेषु दुर्लभा .
ओङ्कारेऽथ भृगुक्षेत्रे तथा चैवौर्वसंगमे .. 85.14 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā said: / “The Revā is easy of access everywhere, [but] difficult of access in three places: / at Oṅkāra, in the Bhṛgukṣetra, and likewise at the confluence of the Aurva.

6.3.s:
tatra gaccha kṣapānātha yatra revāntaraṃ taṭam .
tvarito'sau gatastatra yatra revaurvisaṃgamaḥ .. 85.15 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र गच्छ क्षपानाथ यत्र रेवान्तरं तटम् .
त्वरितोऽसौ गतस्तत्र यत्र रेवौर्विसंगमः .. 85.15 ..
6.3.m: Go there, O lord of night, to the further bank of the Revā.” / Hastily he went to where the confluence of the Revā and the Aurvā was.

6.3.s:
kāṣṭhāvasthaḥ sthitaḥ somo dadhyau tripuravairiṇam .
yāvadvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tāvattuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 85.16 ..
6.3.d:
काष्ठावस्थः स्थितः सोमो दध्यौ त्रिपुरवैरिणम् .
यावद्वर्षशतं पूर्णं तावत्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 85.16 ..
6.3.m: Standing motionless like wood, Soma meditated on the foe of Tripura; / until a full hundred years [had passed], when Maheśvara was pleased.

6.3.s:
pratyakṣaḥ somarājasya vṛṣāsana umāpatiḥ .
sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatyoccairjaya śambho namo'stu te .. 85.17 ..
6.3.d:
प्रत्यक्षः सोमराजस्य वृषासन उमापतिः .
साष्टाङ्गं प्रणिपत्योच्चैर्जय शम्भो नमोऽस्तु ते .. 85.17 ..
6.3.m: The husband of Umā, seated on the bull, appeared before King Soma's eyes; / prostrating with eight limbs, [Soma exclaimed] loudly: “Hail, O Śambhu, homage to you!

6.3.s:
jaya śaṅkara pāpaharāya namo jaya īśvara te jagadīśa namaḥ .
jaya vāsukibhūṣaṇadhāra namo jaya śūlakapāladharāya namaḥ .. 85.18 ..
6.3.d:
जय शङ्कर पापहराय नमो जय ईश्वर ते जगदीश नमः .
जय वासुकिभूषणधार नमो जय शूलकपालधराय नमः .. 85.18 ..
6.3.m: Hail, Śaṅkara, remover of sin, homage! Hail, Īśvara, homage to you, Lord of the Universe! / Hail, wearer of the Vāsuki ornament, homage! Hail, bearer of the trident and the skull, homage!

6.3.s:
jaya andhakadehavināśa namo jaya dānavavṛndavadhāya namaḥ .
jaya niṣkalarūpa sakalāya namo jaya kāla kāmadahāya namaḥ .. 85.19 ..
6.3.d:
जय अन्धकदेहविनाश नमो जय दानववृन्दवधाय नमः .
जय निष्कलरूप सकलाय नमो जय काल कामदहाय नमः .. 85.19 ..
6.3.m: Hail, destroyer of Andhaka's body, homage! Hail, slayer of the host of Dānavas, homage! / Hail, formless one having form, homage! Hail, Death, consumer of Kāma, homage!

6.3.s:
jaya mecakakaṇṭhadharāya namo jaya sūkṣmanirañjanaśabda namaḥ .
jaya ādiranādirananta namo jaya śaṅkara kiṃkaramīśa bhaja .. 85.20 ..
6.3.d:
जय मेचककण्ठधराय नमो जय सूक्ष्मनिरञ्जनशब्द नमः .
जय आदिरनादिरनन्त नमो जय शङ्कर किंकरमीश भज .. 85.20 ..
6.3.m: Hail, bearer of the dark blue neck, homage! Hail, subtle unstained sound, homage! / Hail, beginning, beginningless, endless one, homage! Hail, Śaṅkara, O Lord, cherish your servant!”

6.3.s:
evaṃ stuto mahādevaḥ somarājena pāṇḍava .
tuṣṭastasya nṛpaśreṣṭha śivayā śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 85.21 ..
6.3.d:
एवं स्तुतो महादेवः सोमराजेन पाण्डव .
तुष्टस्तस्य नृपश्रेष्ठ शिवया शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 85.21 ..
6.3.m: Puffed with praise in this way by King Soma, O Pāṇḍava, / Mahādeva Śaṅkara, pleased with him, spoke with Śivā, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
varaṃ prārthaya me bhadra yatte manasi vartate .
sādhu sādhu mahāsattva tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasā tava .. 85.22 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
वरं प्रार्थय मे भद्र यत्ते मनसि वर्तते .
साधु साधु महासत्त्व तुष्टोऽहं तपसा तव .. 85.22 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “Ask a boon of me, good sir, whatever is in your mind. / Excellent, excellent, O one of great fortitude! I am pleased with your austerity.”

6.3.s:
soma uvāca -
dakṣaśāpena dagdho'haṃ kṣīṇasattvo maheśvara .
śāpasyopaśamaṃ deva kuru śarma mama prabho .. 85.23 ..
6.3.d:
सोम उवाच -
दक्षशापेन दग्धोऽहं क्षीणसत्त्वो महेश्वर .
शापस्योपशमं देव कुरु शर्म मम प्रभो .. 85.23 ..
6.3.m: Soma said: / “Burnt by Dakṣa's curse, I am drained of strength, O Maheśvara; / bring about an appeasement of the curse, O god; bestow peace upon me, O lord.”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
tava bhaktigṛhīto'hamumayā saha toṣitaḥ .
niṣpāpaḥ somanāthastvaṃ saṃjātastīrthasevanāt .. 85.24 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
तव भक्तिगृहीतोऽहमुमया सह तोषितः .
निष्पापः सोमनाथस्त्वं संजातस्तीर्थसेवनात् .. 85.24 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “I have been won over by your devotion, pleased along with Umā; / you, the lord of the moon, have become free from sin by resorting to this sacred ford.”

6.3.s:
ityūce devadeveśaḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvendunā tataḥ .
sthāpitaṃ paramaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmadaṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi .
sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ tattu brahmahatyāvināśanam .. 85.25 ..
6.3.d:
इत्यूचे देवदेवेशः क्षणं ध्यात्वेन्दुना ततः .
स्थापितं परमं लिङ्गं कामदं प्राणिनां भुवि .
सर्वदुःखहरं तत्तु ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् .. 85.25 ..
6.3.m: So spoke the lord of the gods of gods; then, after meditating for a moment, / a supreme liṅga granting desires to living beings on earth was installed by the moon, / removing all sorrow and destroying the sin of killing a brahmin.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
somanāthaprabhāvaṃ me saṃkṣepātkathaya prabho .
duḥkhārṇavanimagnānāṃ trātā prāpto dvijottama .. 85.26 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
सोमनाथप्रभावं मे संक्षेपात्कथय प्रभो .
दुःखार्णवनिमग्नानां त्राता प्राप्तो द्विजोत्तम .. 85.26 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me briefly, O lord, the power of Somanātha; / for those plunged into the ocean of sorrow, a saviour has arrived, O best of brahmins.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
śṛṇu tīrthaprabhāvaṃ te saṃkṣepātkathayāmyaham .
yadvṛttamuttare kūle revāyā urisaṃgame .. 85.27 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
शृणु तीर्थप्रभावं ते संक्षेपात्कथयाम्यहम् .
यद्वृत्तमुत्तरे कूले रेवाया उरिसंगमे .. 85.27 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hear the power of the sacred ford; I will tell you briefly / what happened on the northern bank of the Revā at the confluence of the Urī.

6.3.s:
śambaro nāma rājābhūttasya putrastrilocanaḥ .
trilocanasutaḥ kaṇvaḥ sa pāparddhiparo'bhavat .. 85.28 ..
6.3.d:
शम्बरो नाम राजाभूत्तस्य पुत्रस्त्रिलोचनः .
त्रिलोचनसुतः कण्वः स पापर्द्धिपरोऽभवत् .. 85.28 ..
6.3.m: There was a king named Śambara; his son was Trilocana; / Trilocana's son was Kaṇva, and he was devoted to increasing his sins.

6.3.s:
vane nityaṃ bhramanso'tha mṛgayūthaṃ dadarśa ha .
mṛgayūthaṃ hataṃ tattu trilocanasutena ca .. 85.29 ..
6.3.d:
वने नित्यं भ्रमन्सोऽथ मृगयूथं ददर्श ह .
मृगयूथं हतं तत्तु त्रिलोचनसुतेन च .. 85.29 ..
6.3.m: Wandering constantly in the forest, he saw a herd of deer; / that herd of deer was slain by Trilocana's son.

6.3.s:
mṛgarūpī dvijo madhye carate nirjane vane .
sa hatastena saṅgena kaṇvena munisattama .. 85.30 ..
6.3.d:
मृगरूपी द्विजो मध्ये चरते निर्जने वने .
स हतस्तेन सङ्गेन कण्वेन मुनिसत्तम .. 85.30 ..
6.3.m: A twice-born in the form of a deer was grazing in their midst in that solitary forest; / he was struck down alongside them by Kaṇva, O best of sages.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyānvitaḥ kaṇvo nistejā vyacaranmahīm .
vyacaraṃścaiva samprāpto narmadāmurisaṃgame .. 85.31 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्यान्वितः कण्वो निस्तेजा व्यचरन्महीम् .
व्यचरंश्चैव सम्प्राप्तो नर्मदामुरिसंगमे .. 85.31 ..
6.3.m: Possessed by the sin of killing a brahmin, Kaṇva roamed the earth stripped of his lustre; / and roaming about, he arrived at the confluence of the Narmadā and the Urī.

6.3.s:
kiṃśukāśokabahale jambīrapanasākule .
kadambapāṭalākīrṇe bilvanāraṅgaśobhite .. 85.32 ..
6.3.d:
किंशुकाशोकबहले जम्बीरपनसाकुले .
कदम्बपाटलाकीर्णे बिल्वनारङ्गशोभिते .. 85.32 ..
6.3.m: [It was] dense with kiṃśuka and aśoka trees, filled with citron and breadfruit trees, / covered with kadamba and pāṭalā, adorned with bilva and orange trees,

6.3.s:
ciñciṇīcampakopete hyagastitaruchādite .
prabhūtabhūtasaṃyuktaṃ vanaṃ sarvatra śobhitam .. 85.33 ..
6.3.d:
चिञ्चिणीचम्पकोपेते ह्यगस्तितरुछादिते .
प्रभूतभूतसंयुक्तं वनं सर्वत्र शोभितम् .. 85.33 ..
6.3.m: provided with tamarind and campaka, and shaded by agasti trees; / the forest was adorned all around, filled with abundant living beings,

6.3.s:
citrakairmṛgamārjārairhiṃsraiḥ śambaraśūkaraiḥ .
śaśairgavayasaṃyuktaiḥ śikhaṇḍikharamaṇḍitam .. 85.34 ..
6.3.d:
चित्रकैर्मृगमार्जारैर्हिंस्रैः शम्बरशूकरैः .
शशैर्गवयसंयुक्तैः शिखण्डिखरमण्डितम् .. 85.34 ..
6.3.m: with leopards, wildcats, ferocious boars, and śambara deer, / with hares along with wild oxen, and graced by peacocks and donkeys.

6.3.s:
praviṣṭastu vane kaṇvastṛṣārtaḥ śramapīḍitaḥ .
snāto revājale puṇye saṅgame pāpanāśane .. 85.35 ..
6.3.d:
प्रविष्टस्तु वने कण्वस्तृषार्तः श्रमपीडितः .
स्नातो रेवाजले पुण्ये सङ्गमे पापनाशने .. 85.35 ..
6.3.m: Having entered the forest, Kaṇva, afflicted with thirst and tormented by fatigue, / bathed in the auspicious water of the Revā at the confluence that destroys sin.

6.3.s:
arcitaḥ parayā bhaktyā somanātho yudhiṣṭhira .
papau suvimalaṃ toyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 85.36 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चितः परया भक्त्या सोमनाथो युधिष्ठिर .
पपौ सुविमलं तोयं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 85.36 ..
6.3.m: Somanātha was worshipped by him with supreme devotion, O Yudhiṣṭhira; / he drank the very pure water that brings about the destruction of all sins.

6.3.s:
phalāni ca vicitrāṇi cakhāda saha kiṃkaraiḥ .
suptaḥ pādapacchāyāyāṃ śrānto mṛgavadhena ca .. 85.37 ..
6.3.d:
फलानि च विचित्राणि चखाद सह किंकरैः .
सुप्तः पादपच्छायायां श्रान्तो मृगवधेन च .. 85.37 ..
6.3.m: And he ate various fruits along with his servants. / Exhausted from killing the deer, he fell asleep in the shade of a tree.

6.3.s:
tāvattīrthavaraṃ vipraḥ snānārthaṃ saṅgamaṃ gataḥ .
mārgago brāhmaṇo harṣodyuktastadgatamānasaḥ .. 85.38 ..
6.3.d:
तावत्तीर्थवरं विप्रः स्नानार्थं सङ्गमं गतः .
मार्गगो ब्राह्मणो हर्षोद्युक्तस्तद्गतमानसः .. 85.38 ..
6.3.m: Meanwhile, a brahmin went to that confluence, the best of sacred fords, to bathe; / walking along the path, joyful and with his mind focused upon it,

6.3.s:
abalā tamuvācedaṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha dvijottama .
trasto nirīkṣate yāvaddiśaḥ sarvā nareśvara .. 85.39 ..
6.3.d:
अबला तमुवाचेदं तिष्ठ तिष्ठ द्विजोत्तम .
त्रस्तो निरीक्षते यावद्दिशः सर्वा नरेश्वर .. 85.39 ..
6.3.m: a woman said to him, "Halt, halt, best of the twice-born!" / While he, terrified, looked in all directions, O ruler of men,

6.3.s:
tāvadvṛkṣasamārūḍhāṃ striyaṃ raktāmbarāvṛtām .
raktamālyāṃ tadā bālāṃ raktacandanacarcitām .
raktābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ pāśahastāṃ dadarśa ha .. 85.40 ..
6.3.d:
तावद्वृक्षसमारूढां स्त्रियं रक्ताम्बरावृताम् .
रक्तमाल्यां तदा बालां रक्तचन्दनचर्चिताम् .
रक्ताभरणशोभाढ्यां पाशहस्तां ददर्श ह .. 85.40 ..
6.3.m: he saw a young woman perched in a tree, clad in red garments, / wearing a red garland, smeared with red sandalwood paste, / adorned with radiant red ornaments, and holding a noose in her hand.

6.3.s:
stryuvāca -
saṃdeśaṃ śrūyatāṃ vipra yadi gacchasi saṅgame .
madbhartā tiṣṭhate tatra śīghrameva visarjaya .. 85.41 ..
6.3.d:
स्त्र्युवाच -
संदेशं श्रूयतां विप्र यदि गच्छसि सङ्गमे .
मद्भर्ता तिष्ठते तत्र शीघ्रमेव विसर्जय .. 85.41 ..
6.3.m: The woman said: / "Hear a message, O brahmin, if you are going to the confluence: / My husband is staying there; send him away [to me] immediately.

6.3.s:
ekākinī ca te bhāryā tiṣṭhate vanamadhyagā .
ityākarṇya gato vipraḥ saṅgamaṃ suradurlabhe .. 85.42 ..
6.3.d:
एकाकिनी च ते भार्या तिष्ठते वनमध्यगा .
इत्याकर्ण्य गतो विप्रः सङ्गमं सुरदुर्लभे .. 85.42 ..
6.3.m: And [tell him,] 'Your wife is staying all alone in the middle of the forest.'" / Having heard this, the brahmin went to the confluence that is hard even for gods to attain.

6.3.s:
vṛkṣacchāyānvitaḥ kaṇvo brāhmaṇenāvalokitaḥ .
uvāca taṃ prati tadā vacanaṃ brāhmaṇottamaḥ .. 85.43 ..
6.3.d:
वृक्षच्छायान्वितः कण्वो ब्राह्मणेनावलोकितः .
उवाच तं प्रति तदा वचनं ब्राह्मणोत्तमः .. 85.43 ..
6.3.m: Resting in the shade of a tree, Kaṇva was seen by the brahmin. / Then that best of brahmins spoke these words to him:

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
vanāntare mayā dṛṣṭā bālā kamalalocanā .
raktāmbaradharā tanvī raktacandanacarcitā .. 85.44 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
वनान्तरे मया दृष्टा बाला कमललोचना .
रक्ताम्बरधरा तन्वी रक्तचन्दनचर्चिता .. 85.44 ..
6.3.m: The brahmin said: / "In the middle of the forest I saw a slender, lotus-eyed maiden / wearing red garments, smeared with red sandalwood paste,

6.3.s:
raktamālyā suśobhāḍhyā pāśahastā mṛgekṣaṇā .
vṛkṣārūḍhāvadadvākyaṃ madbhartā preṣyatāmiti .. 85.45 ..
6.3.d:
रक्तमाल्या सुशोभाढ्या पाशहस्ता मृगेक्षणा .
वृक्षारूढावदद्वाक्यं मद्भर्ता प्रेष्यतामिति .. 85.45 ..
6.3.m: wearing a red garland, exceedingly beautiful, holding a noose in her hand, with deer-like eyes; / seated in a tree, she spoke the words: 'Let my husband be sent [to me]!'"

6.3.s:
kaṇva uvāca -
kasminsthāne tu viprendra vidyate mṛgalocanā .
kasya sā kena kāryeṇa sarvametadvadāśu me .. 85.46 ..
6.3.d:
कण्व उवाच -
कस्मिन्स्थाने तु विप्रेन्द्र विद्यते मृगलोचना .
कस्य सा केन कार्येण सर्वमेतद्वदाशु मे .. 85.46 ..
6.3.m: Kaṇva said: / "In what place, O lord of brahmins, is that deer-eyed maiden? / Whose [wife] is she, and for what purpose? Tell me all this at once!"

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
saṅgamādardhakrośe sā udyānānte hi vidyate .
vacanādbrahmaṇasyaiṣā na jñātā pārthivena tu .. 85.47 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
सङ्गमादर्धक्रोशे सा उद्यानान्ते हि विद्यते .
वचनाद्ब्रह्मणस्यैषा न ज्ञाता पार्थिवेन तु .. 85.47 ..
6.3.m: The brahmin said: / "She is indeed half a krośa from the confluence, at the edge of the garden." / By the words of the brahmin, the king did not recognize her.

6.3.s:
tadā sa kaṇvabhūpālaḥ svakaṃ dūtaṃ samādiśat .
kaṇva uvāca -
gaccha tvaṃ pṛcchatāṃ tāṃ kvāgatā kvaca gamiṣyasi .
preṣitastvarito dūto gato nārīsamīpataḥ .. 85.48 ..
6.3.d:
तदा स कण्वभूपालः स्वकं दूतं समादिशत् .
कण्व उवाच -
गच्छ त्वं पृच्छतां तां क्वागता क्वच गमिष्यसि .
प्रेषितस्त्वरितो दूतो गतो नारीसमीपतः .. 85.48 ..
6.3.m: Then that king Kaṇva instructed his own messenger: / Kaṇva said: / "Go, ask her: 'From where have you come, and where will you go?'" / Dispatched, the messenger hurried and went near the woman.

6.3.s:
vṛkṣasthāṃ dadṛśo bālāmuvāca nṛpasattama .
mannāthaḥ pṛcchati tvāṃ tu kāsi tvaṃ kva gamiṣyasi .. 85.49 ..
6.3.d:
वृक्षस्थां ददृशो बालामुवाच नृपसत्तम .
मन्नाथः पृच्छति त्वां तु कासि त्वं क्व गमिष्यसि .. 85.49 ..
6.3.m: He saw the maiden standing in the tree and spoke, O best of kings: / "My lord asks you: 'Who are you, and where will you go?'"

6.3.s:
kanyovāca -
gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām .
iha pracchanna pāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ .. 85.50 ..
6.3.d:
कन्योवाच -
गुरुरात्मवतां शास्ता राजा शास्ता दुरात्मनाम् .
इह प्रच्छन्न पापानां शास्ता वैवस्वतो यमः .. 85.50 ..
6.3.m: The maiden said: / "A guru is the punisher of the self-controlled; a king is the punisher of the wicked; / in this world, of secret sins, Yama, son of Vivasvat, is the punisher.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyā ca saṃjātā mṛgarūpadharadvijāt .
mayā yukto'pi te rājā muktastīrthaprabhāvataḥ .. 85.51 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्या च संजाता मृगरूपधरद्विजात् .
मया युक्तोऽपि ते राजा मुक्तस्तीर्थप्रभावतः .. 85.51 ..
6.3.m: And the murder of a brahmin arose from the twice-born who had taken the form of a deer. / Even though joined with me, your king was freed by the power of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
ardhakrośāntarānmadhye brahmahatyā na saṃviśet .
somanāthaprabhāvo'yaṃ vārāṇasyāḥ samaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 85.52 ..
6.3.d:
अर्धक्रोशान्तरान्मध्ये ब्रह्महत्या न संविशेत् .
सोमनाथप्रभावोऽयं वाराणस्याः समः स्मृतः .. 85.52 ..
6.3.m: Within half a krośa, the murder of a brahmin may not enter. / Such is the power of Somanātha, considered equal to Vārāṇasī.

6.3.s:
gaccha tvaṃ preṣyatāṃ rājā śīghramatra na saṃśayaḥ .
gato bhṛtyastataḥ śīghraṃ vepamānaḥ suvihvalaḥ .. 85.53 ..
6.3.d:
गच्छ त्वं प्रेष्यतां राजा शीघ्रमत्र न संशयः .
गतो भृत्यस्ततः शीघ्रं वेपमानः सुविह्वलः .. 85.53 ..
6.3.m: Go, let the king be sent here quickly; there is no doubt of this." / Then the servant went quickly, trembling and deeply agitated.

6.3.s:
samastaṃ kathayāmāsa yadvṛttaṃ hi purātanam .
tasya vākyādasau rājā patito dharaṇītale .. 85.54 ..
6.3.d:
समस्तं कथयामास यद्वृत्तं हि पुरातनम् .
तस्य वाक्यादसौ राजा पतितो धरणीतले .. 85.54 ..
6.3.m: He recounted everything that had taken place before. / At his words, the king fell upon the ground.

6.3.s:
bhṛtya uvāca -
kasmāttvaṃ śocase nātha pūrvopāttaṃ śubhāśubham .
ityākarṇya vacastasya rājā vacanamabravīt .. 85.55 ..
6.3.d:
भृत्य उवाच -
कस्मात्त्वं शोचसे नाथ पूर्वोपात्तं शुभाशुभम् .
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् .. 85.55 ..
6.3.m: The servant said: / "Why do you grieve, O master, over what was formerly incurred, auspicious or inauspicious?" / Having heard his words, the king said:

6.3.s:
prāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi somanāthasamīpataḥ .
śīghramānīyatāṃ vahnirindhanāni bahūni ca .. 85.56 ..
6.3.d:
प्राणत्यागं करिष्यामि सोमनाथसमीपतः .
शीघ्रमानीयतां वह्निरिन्धनानि बहूनि च .. 85.56 ..
6.3.m: "I shall surrender my life near Somanātha. / Let fire and much fuel be brought at once!"

6.3.s:
ānītaṃ tatkṣaṇātsarvaṃ bhṛtyaistadvaśavartibhiḥ .
snānaṃ kṛtvā śubhe toye saṅgame pāpanāśane .. 85.57 ..
6.3.d:
आनीतं तत्क्षणात्सर्वं भृत्यैस्तद्वशवर्तिभिः .
स्नानं कृत्वा शुभे तोये सङ्गमे पापनाशने .. 85.57 ..
6.3.m: Everything was brought that very moment by the servants who were obedient to him. / Having bathed in the auspicious waters at the sin-destroying confluence,

6.3.s:
arcitaḥ parayā bhaktyā somanātho mahībhṛtā .
triḥpradakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā jvalantaṃ jātavedasam .. 85.58 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चितः परया भक्त्या सोमनाथो महीभृता .
त्रिःप्रदक्षिणतः कृत्वा ज्वलन्तं जातवेदसम् .. 85.58 ..
6.3.m: and having worshipped Somanātha with supreme devotion, the king, / having circumambulated the blazing fire three times,

6.3.s:
praviṣṭaḥ kaṇvarājāsau hṛdi dhyātvā janārdanam .
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam .. 85.59 ..
6.3.d:
प्रविष्टः कण्वराजासौ हृदि ध्यात्वा जनार्दनम् .
पीताम्बरधरं देवं जटामुकुटधारिणम् .. 85.59 ..
6.3.m: entered [it], that king Kaṇva, meditating in his heart on Janārdana: / on the yellow-robed god wearing a crown of matted hair,

6.3.s:
śriyā yuktaṃ suparṇasthaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam .
surārisūdanaṃ dadhyau sugatirme bhavatviti .. 85.60 ..
6.3.d:
श्रिया युक्तं सुपर्णस्थं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् .
सुरारिसूदनं दध्यौ सुगतिर्मे भवत्विति .. 85.60 ..
6.3.m: endowed with Śrī, mounted on Garuḍa, bearing the conch, discus, and mace; / he meditated on the slayer of the enemies of the gods, saying, "May my destination be good!"

6.3.s:
papāta puṣpavṛṣṭistu sādhu sādhu nṛpātmaja .
āścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirīkṣya ca parasparam .. 85.61 ..
6.3.d:
पपात पुष्पवृष्टिस्तु साधु साधु नृपात्मज .
आश्चर्यमतुलं दृष्ट्वा निरीक्ष्य च परस्परम् .. 85.61 ..
6.3.m: A rain of flowers fell, [and voices cried,] "Well done! Well done, O prince!" / Seeing an incomparable wonder, they looked at one another.

6.3.s:
mṛtaṃ taiḥ pāvake bhṛtyairhṛdi dhyātvā gadādharam .
vimānasthāstataḥ sarve saṃjātāḥ pāṇḍunandana .. 85.62 ..
6.3.d:
मृतं तैः पावके भृत्यैर्हृदि ध्यात्वा गदाधरम् .
विमानस्थास्ततः सर्वे संजाताः पाण्डुनन्दन .. 85.62 ..
6.3.m: Having died in the fire, those servants, meditating on the mace-bearing god in their hearts, / all mounted aerial chariots, O son of Pāṇḍu.

6.3.s:
niṣpāpāste divaṃ yātāḥ somanāthaprabhāvataḥ .
brāhmaṇe saṅgame tatra dhyāyamāne vṛṣadhvajam .. 85.63 ..
6.3.d:
निष्पापास्ते दिवं याताः सोमनाथप्रभावतः .
ब्राह्मणे सङ्गमे तत्र ध्यायमाने वृषध्वजम् .. 85.63 ..
6.3.m: Free from sin, they went to heaven through the power of Somanātha, / while the brahmin there at the confluence was meditating on the Bull-bannered [Śiva].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
somanāthaprabhāvo'yaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vidhim .
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ raverdine .. 85.64 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सोमनाथप्रभावोऽयं शृणुष्वैकमना विधिम् .
अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां सर्वकालं रवेर्दिने .. 85.64 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Such is the power of Somanātha. Listen with an attentive mind to the rite: / On the eighth or fourteenth lunar day, or at any time on Sunday,

6.3.s:
viśeṣācchuklapakṣe cetsūryavāreṇa saptamī .
upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .. 85.65 ..
6.3.d:
विशेषाच्छुक्लपक्षे चेत्सूर्यवारेण सप्तमी .
उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .. 85.65 ..
6.3.m: especially in the bright fortnight if the seventh falls on a Sunday— / fasting, whatever man should keep a vigil at night with devotion,

6.3.s:
pañcāmṛtena gavyena snāpayetparameśvaram .
śrīkhaṇḍena tato guṇṭhya puṣpadhūpādikaṃ dadet .. 85.66 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चामृतेन गव्येन स्नापयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
श्रीखण्डेन ततो गुण्ठ्य पुष्पधूपादिकं ददेत् .. 85.66 ..
6.3.m: should bathe the Supreme Lord with the five bovine nectars. / Then, smearing him with white sandalwood paste, he should offer flowers, incense, and the like.

6.3.s:
ghṛtena bodhayeddīpaṃ nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca kārayet .
somavāre tathāṣṭamyāṃ prabhāte pūjayeddvijān .. 85.67 ..
6.3.d:
घृतेन बोधयेद्दीपं नृत्यं गीतं च कारयेत् .
सोमवारे तथाष्टम्यां प्रभाते पूजयेद्द्विजान् .. 85.67 ..
6.3.m: He should kindle a lamp with ghee and arrange dancing and singing. / On Monday, or on the eighth, in the morning he should honor brahmins

6.3.s:
jitakrodhānātmavataḥ paranindāvivarjitān .
sarvāṅgarucirāñchastān svadāraparipālakān .. 85.68 ..
6.3.d:
जितक्रोधानात्मवतः परनिन्दाविवर्जितान् .
सर्वाङ्गरुचिराञ्छस्तान् स्वदारपरिपालकान् .. 85.68 ..
6.3.m: who have mastered anger, are self-controlled, refrain from censuring others, / are handsome in all their limbs, commendable, and faithful to their own wives,

6.3.s:
gāyatrīpāṭhamātrāṃśca vikarmaviratān sadā .
punarbhūvṛṣalīśūdrī careyuryasya mandire .. 85.69 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्रीपाठमात्रांश्च विकर्मविरतान् सदा .
पुनर्भूवृषलीशूद्री चरेयुर्यस्य मन्दिरे .. 85.69 ..
6.3.m: content with merely reciting the Gāyatrī, and always abstaining from improper deeds. / A man in whose house a remarried woman, an outcaste woman, or a śūdra woman roams—

6.3.s:
dūrato'sau dvijastyājya ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā .
hīnāṅgānatiriktāṅgān yeṣāṃ pūrvāparaṃ na hi .. 85.70 ..
6.3.d:
दूरतोऽसौ द्विजस्त्याज्य आत्मनः श्रेय इच्छता .
हीनाङ्गानतिरिक्ताङ्गान् येषां पूर्वापरं न हि .. 85.70 ..
6.3.m: such a twice-born is to be avoided from afar by one who desires his own welfare; / also those of deficient limbs or superfluous limbs, and those without a pure ancestry or posterity.

6.3.s:
vrate śrāddhe tathā dāne dūratastān vivarjayet .
āyasī taruṇī tulyā dvijāḥ svādhyāyavarjitāḥ .. 85.71 ..
6.3.d:
व्रते श्राद्धे तथा दाने दूरतस्तान् विवर्जयेत् .
आयसी तरुणी तुल्या द्विजाः स्वाध्यायवर्जिताः .. 85.71 ..
6.3.m: In a vow, in a śrāddha, and in gift-giving, one should avoid them from afar. / Twice-born men devoid of Vedic study are like an iron boat;

6.3.s:
ātmānaṃ saha yājyena pātayanti na saṃśayaḥ .
śālmalīnāvatulyāḥ syuḥ ṣaṭkarmaniratā dvijāḥ .. 85.72 ..
6.3.d:
आत्मानं सह याज्येन पातयन्ति न संशयः .
शाल्मलीनावतुल्याः स्युः षट्कर्मनिरता द्विजाः .. 85.72 ..
6.3.m: they cause themselves to sink along with their sacrificer, without a doubt. / Brahmins devoted to the six duties are like a boat of silk-cotton wood;

6.3.s:
dātāraṃ ca tathātmānaṃ tārayanti taranti ca .
śrāddhaṃ someśvare pārtha yaḥ kuryādgatamatsaraḥ .. 85.73 ..
6.3.d:
दातारं च तथात्मानं तारयन्ति तरन्ति च .
श्राद्धं सोमेश्वरे पार्थ यः कुर्याद्गतमत्सरः .. 85.73 ..
6.3.m: they carry the donor across and cross over themselves. / Whoever performs a śrāddha at Someśvara, O son of Pṛthā, free from jealousy,

6.3.s:
pretāstasya hi suprītā yāvadābhūtasamplavam .
annaṃ vastraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca yo dadyādagrajanmane .. 85.74 ..
6.3.d:
प्रेतास्तस्य हि सुप्रीता यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .
अन्नं वस्त्रं हिरण्यं च यो दद्यादग्रजन्मने .. 85.74 ..
6.3.m: his ancestors will be well pleased until the dissolution of all beings. / Whoever gives food, clothing, and gold to a brahmin

6.3.s:
sa yāti śāṅkare loka iti me satyabhāṣitam .
hayaṃ yo yacchate tatra sampūrṇaṃ taruṇaṃ sitam .. 85.75 ..
6.3.d:
स याति शाङ्करे लोक इति मे सत्यभाषितम् .
हयं यो यच्छते तत्र सम्पूर्णं तरुणं सितम् .. 85.75 ..
6.3.m: goes to the realm of Śaṅkara; this is spoken truly by me. / Whoever gives a horse there—full-grown, young, white,

6.3.s:
raktaṃ vā pītavarṇaṃ vā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam .
kuṅkumena viliptāṅgāvagrajanmahayāvapi .. 85.76 ..
6.3.d:
रक्तं वा पीतवर्णं वा सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम् .
कुङ्कुमेन विलिप्ताङ्गावग्रजन्महयावपि .. 85.76 ..
6.3.m: or red, or yellow, endowed with all auspicious marks— / both the brahmin and the horse should have their limbs smeared with saffron;

6.3.s:
sragdāmabhūṣitau kāryau sitavastrāvaguṇṭhitau .
aṅghriḥ pradīyatāṃ skandhe madīye hayamāruha .. 85.77 ..
6.3.d:
स्रग्दामभूषितौ कार्यौ सितवस्त्रावगुण्ठितौ .
अङ्घ्रिः प्रदीयतां स्कन्धे मदीये हयमारुह .. 85.77 ..
6.3.m: they should be adorned with garlands of flowers and covered with white garments. / [The donor should say:] "Place your foot upon my shoulder and mount the horse!"

6.3.s:
ārūḍhe brāhmaṇe brūyādbhāskaraḥ prīyatāmiti .
sa yāti śāṃkaraṃ lokaṃ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ .. 85.78 ..
6.3.d:
आरूढे ब्राह्मणे ब्रूयाद्भास्करः प्रीयतामिति .
स याति शांकरं लोकं सर्वपापविवर्जितः .. 85.78 ..
6.3.m: When the brahmin has mounted, he should say, "May the Sun be pleased." / Rid of all sin, he goes to the world of Śaṃkara.

6.3.s:
uparāge tu somasya tīrthaṃ gatvā jitendriyaḥ .
satyalokāccyutaścāpi rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 85.79 ..
6.3.d:
उपरागे तु सोमस्य तीर्थं गत्वा जितेन्द्रियः .
सत्यलोकाच्च्युतश्चापि राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 85.79 ..
6.3.m: During an eclipse of the moon, going to the sacred ford with subdued senses, / even falling from Satyaloka, he becomes a righteous king.

6.3.s:
tasya vāsaḥ sadā rājanna naśyati kadācana .
dīrghāyurjāyate putro bhāryā ca vaśavartinī .. 85.80 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य वासः सदा राजन्न नश्यति कदाचन .
दीर्घायुर्जायते पुत्रो भार्या च वशवर्तिनी .. 85.80 ..
6.3.m: His dwelling, O king, is eternal and never perishes. / A long-lived son is born [to him], and a wife obedient to his will.

6.3.s:
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ .
sopavāso jitakrodho dhenuṃ dadyāddvijanmane .. 85.81 ..
6.3.d:
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वदुःखविवर्जितः .
सोपवासो जितक्रोधो धेनुं दद्याद्द्विजन्मने .. 85.81 ..
6.3.m: He shall live a full hundred years, free from all sorrow. / Fasting, with anger conquered, he should give a cow to a brahmin:

6.3.s:
savatsāṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktāṃ śvetavastrāvalokitām .
śabalāṃ pītavarṇāṃ ca dhūmrāṃ vā nīlakarburām .. 85.82 ..
6.3.d:
सवत्सां क्षीरसंयुक्तां श्वेतवस्त्रावलोकिताम् .
शबलां पीतवर्णां च धूम्रां वा नीलकर्बुराम् .. 85.82 ..
6.3.m: with her calf, rich in milk, covered with a white cloth, / speckled, yellow-colored, smoky, or blue-variegated,

6.3.s:
kapilāṃ vā savatsāṃ ca ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitām .
rūpyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ nareśvara .. 85.83 ..
6.3.d:
कपिलां वा सवत्सां च घण्टाभरणभूषिताम् .
रूप्यखुरां कांस्यदोहां स्वर्णशृङ्गीं नरेश्वर .. 85.83 ..
6.3.m: or a tawny cow with her calf, adorned with ornaments of bells, / with silver hooves, a bronze milking vessel, and golden horns, O lord of men.

6.3.s:
śvetayā vardhate vaṃśo raktā saubhāgyavardhinī .
śabalā pītavarṇā ca duḥkhaghnyau saṃprakīrtite .. 85.84 ..
6.3.d:
श्वेतया वर्धते वंशो रक्ता सौभाग्यवर्धिनी .
शबला पीतवर्णा च दुःखघ्न्यौ संप्रकीर्तिते .. 85.84 ..
6.3.m: By a white one his lineage flourishes; a red one increases good fortune; / a speckled one and a yellow one are declared to destroy sorrows.

6.3.s:
kapilā nāśayetpāpaṃ saptajanmasamudbhavam .
satyalokamavāpnoti gopradāyī nareśvara .. 85.85 ..
6.3.d:
कपिला नाशयेत्पापं सप्तजन्मसमुद्भवम् .
सत्यलोकमवाप्नोति गोप्रदायी नरेश्वर .. 85.85 ..
6.3.m: A tawny cow destroys the sin born of seven births. / The giver of a cow attains Satyaloka, O lord of men.

6.3.s:
pakṣānte'tha vyatīpāte vai dhṛtau ravisaṃkrame .
dinakṣaye gajacchāyāṃ grahaṇe bhāskarasya ca .. 85.86 ..
6.3.d:
पक्षान्तेऽथ व्यतीपाते वै धृतौ रविसंक्रमे .
दिनक्षये गजच्छायां ग्रहणे भास्करस्य च .. 85.86 ..
6.3.m: At the end of a fortnight, at a vyatīpāta, at a vaidhṛti, at the sun's transit, / at a dinakṣaya, during the Gajacchāyā conjunction, and during an eclipse of the sun,

6.3.s:
ye vrajanti mahātmānaḥ saṅgame suradurlabhe .
mṛdāvaguṇṭhayitvā tu cātmānaṃ saṅgame viśet .. 85.87 ..
6.3.d:
ये व्रजन्ति महात्मानः सङ्गमे सुरदुर्लभे .
मृदावगुण्ठयित्वा तु चात्मानं सङ्गमे विशेत् .. 85.87 ..
6.3.m: the great-souled ones who go to the confluence, difficult for the gods to attain— / having smeared oneself with clay, one should enter the confluence.

6.3.s:
hṛdayāntarjale jāpyā prāṇāyāmo'thavā nṛpa .
gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī caiva saurī śaivī yadṛcchayā .
te'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyanta ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 85.88 ..
6.3.d:
हृदयान्तर्जले जाप्या प्राणायामोऽथवा नृप .
गायत्री वैष्णवी चैव सौरी शैवी यदृच्छया .
तेऽपि पापैः प्रमुच्यन्त इत्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 85.88 ..
6.3.m: Deep in the water, one should chant [prayers] or perform breath control, O king; / the Vaiṣṇava Gāyatrī, or the solar, or the Śaiva one at will; / they too are freed from sins—thus indeed spoke Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
jagatīṃ somanāthasya yastu kuryātpradakṣiṇām .
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā .. 85.89 ..
6.3.d:
जगतीं सोमनाथस्य यस्तु कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणाम् .
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन सप्तद्वीपा वसुंधरा .. 85.89 ..
6.3.m: Whoever circumambulates the platform of Somanātha / has circumambulated the earth with its seven continents.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam .
bhrūṇahā svarṇahartā ca mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 85.90 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं गुरुदारनिषेवणम् .
भ्रूणहा स्वर्णहर्ता च मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 85.90 ..
6.3.m: Killing a brahmin, drinking liquor, defiling the guru's bed, / slaying an embryo, and stealing gold—they are freed [from these], there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti jitendriyaḥ .
vyādhito mucyate rogī cārogī sukhamāpnuyāt .. 85.91 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं यः शृणोति जितेन्द्रियः .
व्याधितो मुच्यते रोगी चारोगी सुखमाप्नुयात् .. 85.91 ..
6.3.m: The afflicted person with subdued senses who hears this sacred account of the sacred ford is freed from illness, / and one free from disease attains happiness.

6.3.s:
yatte saṃdahyate cetaḥ śṛṇu tanme yudhiṣṭhira .
naikāpi nṛpa loke'smin bhrūṇahatyā sudustyajā .. 85.92 ..
6.3.d:
यत्ते संदह्यते चेतः शृणु तन्मे युधिष्ठिर .
नैकापि नृप लोकेऽस्मिन् भ्रूणहत्या सुदुस्त्यजा .. 85.92 ..
6.3.m: Hear from me that by which your mind is consumed, O Yudhiṣṭhira: / In this world, O king, even a single slaying of an embryo is difficult to shed,

6.3.s:
kimu ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ pārtha prāpa yāḥ kṣaṇadākaraḥ .
so'pi tīrthamidaṃ prāpya tapastaptvā suduścaram .. 85.93 ..
6.3.d:
किमु षड्विंशतिं पार्थ प्राप याः क्षणदाकरः .
सोऽपि तीर्थमिदं प्राप्य तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुश्चरम् .. 85.93 ..
6.3.m: how much more the twenty-six that the moon incurred, O son of Pṛthā! / Even he, having reached this sacred ford and having performed austerity exceedingly hard to practice,

6.3.s:
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ śītaraśmirabhūtsukhī .
śrūyate nṛpa paurāṇī gāthā gītā maharṣibhiḥ .. 85.94 ..
6.3.d:
विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यः शीतरश्मिरभूत्सुखी .
श्रूयते नृप पौराणी गाथा गीता महर्षिभिः .. 85.94 ..
6.3.m: freed from all sins, the cool-rayed [moon] became happy. / An ancient verse sung by great seers is heard, O king:

6.3.s:
liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ hyekaṃ daśabhrūṇahanaṃ bhavet .
ato liṅgatrayaṃ somaḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhārata .. 85.95 ..
6.3.d:
लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितं ह्येकं दशभ्रूणहनं भवेत् .
अतो लिङ्गत्रयं सोमः स्थापयामास भारत .. 85.95 ..
6.3.m: "A single installed liṅga destroys [the sin of] ten embryo-killings." / Therefore, Soma installed three liṅgas, O descendant of Bharata:

6.3.s:
revaurisaṃgame hyādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhṛgukacchake .
tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya prabhāse tu tṛtīyakam .. 85.96 ..
6.3.d:
रेवौरिसंगमे ह्याद्यं द्वितीयं भृगुकच्छके .
ततः सिद्धिं परां प्राप्य प्रभासे तु तृतीयकम् .. 85.96 ..
6.3.m: the first at the confluence of the Revā and the Ūrī, the second at Bhṛgukaccha, / and then, having attained the highest perfection, the third at Prabhāsa.

6.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam .
dharmyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ saṃśuddhikṛnnṛṇām .. 85.97 ..
6.3.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .
धर्म्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं संशुद्धिकृन्नृणाम् .. 85.97 ..
6.3.m: Thus all the supreme māhātmya of the sacred ford has been told to you, / righteous, renowned, life-giving, heavenly, and bringing purification to men.

6.3.s:
putrārthī labhate putrānniṣkāmaḥ svargamāpnuyāt .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyastīrthaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ nṛpa .. 85.98 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रान्निष्कामः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यस्तीर्थं कृत्वा परं नृप .. 85.98 ..
6.3.m: One desiring a son obtains sons; one free of desire attains heaven. / One is freed from all sins after visiting this supreme sacred ford, O king.

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ somanāthasya yatphalam .
śrutvā putramavāpnoti snātvā cāṣṭau na saṃśayaḥ .. 85.99 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 86
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं सोमनाथस्य यत्फलम् .
श्रुत्वा पुत्रमवाप्नोति स्नात्वा चाष्टौ न संशयः .. 85.99 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सोमनाथतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 86
6.3.m:
All this fruit of Somanātha has been told to you. / By hearing it one obtains a son, and by bathing, eight [sons], there is no doubt.
Thus ends the eighty-fifth chapter, titled "Description of the Greatness of the Somanātha Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 86

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahārāja piṅgalāvartamuttamam .
saṅgamasya samīpasthaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe .
havyavāhena rājendra sthāpitaḥ piṅgaleśvaraḥ .. 86.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महाराज पिङ्गलावर्तमुत्तमम् .
सङ्गमस्य समीपस्थं रेवाया उत्तरे तटे .
हव्यवाहेन राजेन्द्र स्थापितः पिङ्गलेश्वरः .. 86.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O great king, to the excellent Piṅgalāvarta / situated near the confluence on the northern bank of the Revā. / O chief of kings, Piṅgaleśvara was installed by the Carrier of Oblations.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
havyavāhena bhagavannīśvaraḥ sthāpitaḥ katham .
etadākhyāhi me sarvaṃ prasādādvaktumarhasi .. 86.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
हव्यवाहेन भगवन्नीश्वरः स्थापितः कथम् .
एतदाख्याहि मे सर्वं प्रसादाद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 86.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O lord, how was Īśvara installed by the Carrier of Oblations? / Tell me all this; you ought to speak out of grace.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
śambhunā retasā rājaṃstarpito havyavāhanaḥ .
prāptasaukhyena raudreṇa gauryākrīḍanacetasā .. 86.3 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
शम्भुना रेतसा राजंस्तर्पितो हव्यवाहनः .
प्राप्तसौख्येन रौद्रेण गौर्याक्रीडनचेतसा .. 86.3 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / O king, the Carrier of Oblations was satiated by Śambhu with his semen, / when the fierce [god] had attained pleasure with a mind intent on sporting with Gaurī.

6.3.s:
havyavāhamukhe kṣiptaṃ rudreṇāmitatejasā .
rudrasya retasā dagdhastīrthayātrākṛtādaraḥ .. 86.4 ..
6.3.d:
हव्यवाहमुखे क्षिप्तं रुद्रेणामिततेजसा .
रुद्रस्य रेतसा दग्धस्तीर्थयात्राकृतादरः .. 86.4 ..
6.3.m: It was cast into the mouth of the Carrier of Oblations by Rudra of unmeasured splendor. / Burned by the semen of Rudra, having undertaken pilgrimage to sacred fords with zeal,

6.3.s:
sāgarāṃśca nadīrgatvā kramādrevāṃ samāgataḥ .
cacāra parayā bhaktyā dhyānamugraṃ hutāśanaḥ .. 86.5 ..
6.3.d:
सागरांश्च नदीर्गत्वा क्रमाद्रेवां समागतः .
चचार परया भक्त्या ध्यानमुग्रं हुताशनः .. 86.5 ..
6.3.m: having gone to oceans and rivers, he came in due course to the Revā. / With supreme devotion, the Fire-god practiced severe meditation.

6.3.s:
vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ sāgraṃ yāvattepe hutāśanaḥ .
tāvattuṣṭo mahādevo varado jātavedasaḥ .
saṃnidhau samupetyātha vacanaṃ cedamabravīt .. 86.6 ..
6.3.d:
वायुभक्षः शतं साग्रं यावत्तेपे हुताशनः .
तावत्तुष्टो महादेवो वरदो जातवेदसः .
संनिधौ समुपेत्याथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् .. 86.6 ..
6.3.m: As long as the Fire-god practiced austerity, consuming only wind for a full hundred years, / so long [afterward] Mahādeva, pleased, the giver of boons to the all-knowing [Fire], / having approached his presence, spoke this word:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva havyāśa yaste manasi vartate .. 86.7 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
वरं वृणीष्व हव्याश यस्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 86.7 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Choose a boon, O devourer of oblations, whatever is in your mind.

6.3.s:
vahniruvāca -
namaste sarvalokeśa ugramūrte namo'stu te .
retasā tava saṃdagdhaḥ kuṣṭhī jāto maheśvara .
kṛpāṃ kuru mahādeva mama rogaṃ vināśaya .. 86.8 ..
6.3.d:
वह्निरुवाच -
नमस्ते सर्वलोकेश उग्रमूर्ते नमोऽस्तु ते .
रेतसा तव संदग्धः कुष्ठी जातो महेश्वर .
कृपां कुरु महादेव मम रोगं विनाशय .. 86.8 ..
6.3.m: Agni said: / Homage to you, O Lord of all the worlds! O fierce-formed one, homage to you! / Scorched by your semen, I have become a leper, O Maheśvara. / Have mercy, O Mahādeva; destroy my disease!

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
havyavāha bhavārogo matprasādācca satvaram .
atra tīrthe kṛtasnānaḥ svarūpaṃ pratipatsyase .. 86.9 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
हव्यवाह भवारोगो मत्प्रसादाच्च सत्वरम् .
अत्र तीर्थे कृतस्नानः स्वरूपं प्रतिपत्स्यसे .. 86.9 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / O Carrier of Oblations, become free of disease quickly through my grace. / Having taken a ritual ablution at this sacred ford, you will regain your natural form.

6.3.s:
ityuktvā ca mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata .
anantaraṃ havyavāhaḥ sasnau revājale tvaran .. 86.10 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .
अनन्तरं हव्यवाहः सस्नौ रेवाजले त्वरन् .. 86.10 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva disappeared right there. / Immediately, the Carrier of Oblations swiftly bathed in the water of the Revā.

6.3.s:
tadaiva roganirmukto'bhavaddivyasvarūpavān .
sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ sa vahniḥ piṅgaleśvaram .. 86.11 ..
6.3.d:
तदैव रोगनिर्मुक्तोऽभवद्दिव्यस्वरूपवान् .
स्थापयामास देवेशं स वह्निः पिङ्गलेश्वरम् .. 86.11 ..
6.3.m: At that very moment, freed from disease, he came to possess a divine form. / That Fire installed the Lord of gods as Piṅgaleśvara.

6.3.s:
nāmnā saṃpūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva stutibhirmudā .
tato jagāma deśaṃ svaṃ devānāṃ havyavāhanaḥ .. 86.12 ..
6.3.d:
नाम्ना संपूजयामास तुष्टाव स्तुतिभिर्मुदा .
ततो जगाम देशं स्वं देवानां हव्यवाहनः .. 86.12 ..
6.3.m: By name he worshipped him and joyfully praised him with hymns of praise. / Then the Carrier of Oblations went to the realm of the gods.

6.3.s:
havyavāhena bhūpaivaṃ sthāpitaḥ piṅgaleśvaraḥ .
jitakrodho hi yastatra upavāsaṃ samācaret .. 86.13 ..
6.3.d:
हव्यवाहेन भूपैवं स्थापितः पिङ्गलेश्वरः .
जितक्रोधो हि यस्तत्र उपवासं समाचरेत् .. 86.13 ..
6.3.m: Thus, O king, Piṅgaleśvara was installed by the Carrier of Oblations. / Indeed, whoever, with anger conquered, observes a fast there,

6.3.s:
atirāntraphalaṃ tasya ante rudratvamāpnuyāt .
guṇānvitāya viprāya kapilāṃ tatra bhārata .. 86.14 ..
6.3.d:
अतिरान्त्रफलं तस्य अन्ते रुद्रत्वमाप्नुयात् .
गुणान्विताय विप्राय कपिलां तत्र भारत .. 86.14 ..
6.3.m: his fruit is [that of] an Atirātra sacrifice, and in the end he attains the state of Rudra. / There [giving] a tawny cow to a virtuous brahmin, O descendant of Bharata,

6.3.s:
alaṃkṛtya savatsāṃ ca śaktyālaṅkārabhūṣitām .
yaḥ prayacchati rājendra sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim .. 86.15 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe piṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 87
6.3.d:
अलंकृत्य सवत्सां च शक्त्यालङ्कारभूषिताम् .
यः प्रयच्छति राजेन्द्र स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् .. 86.15 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पिङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 87
6.3.m:
having adorned her along with her calf, adorned with ornaments according to one's means— / whoever gives [her], O chief of kings, goes to the supreme state.
Thus ends the eighty-sixth chapter, titled "Description of the Greatness of the Piṅgaleśvara Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 87

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
sthāpitaṃ munisaṅghairyadbrahmavaṃśasamudbhavaiḥ .. 87.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
स्थापितं मुनिसङ्घैर्यद्ब्रह्मवंशसमुद्भवैः .. 87.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to the exceedingly beautiful sacred ford / which was established by assemblies of sages born of the lineage of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
ṛṇamocanamityākhyaṃ revātaṭasamāśritam .
ṣaṇmāsaṃ manujo bhaktyā tarpayan pitṛdevatāḥ .. 87.2 ..
6.3.d:
ऋणमोचनमित्याख्यं रेवातटसमाश्रितम् .
षण्मासं मनुजो भक्त्या तर्पयन् पितृदेवताः .. 87.2 ..
6.3.m: [He should go] to the one named Ṛṇamocana, situated on the bank of the Revā. / A man who for six months, with devotion, offers oblations to the ancestors and gods,

6.3.s:
devaiḥ pitṛmanuṣyaiśca ṛṇamātmakṛtaṃ ca yat .
mucyate tatkṣaṇānmartyaḥ snāto vai narmadājale .. 87.3 ..
6.3.d:
देवैः पितृमनुष्यैश्च ऋणमात्मकृतं च यत् .
मुच्यते तत्क्षणान्मर्त्यः स्नातो वै नर्मदाजले .. 87.3 ..
6.3.m: is immediately freed, as a mortal, once bathed in the water of the Narmadā, / from debts owed to gods, ancestors, and humans, as well as from those incurred by himself.

6.3.s:
pratyakṣaṃ duritaṃ tatra dṛśyate phalarūpataḥ .
tatra tīrthe tu yo rājannekacitto jitendriyaḥ .. 87.4 ..
6.3.d:
प्रत्यक्षं दुरितं तत्र दृश्यते फलरूपतः .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्नेकचित्तो जितेन्द्रियः .. 87.4 ..
6.3.m: There sin is visibly seen through the nature of its fruit. / But whoever at that sacred ford, O king, with single-minded focus and senses restrained,

6.3.s:
snātvā dānaṃ ca vai dadyādarcayedgirijāpatim .
ṛṇatrayavinirmukto nāke dīpyati devavat .. 87.5 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ṛṇatrayamocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 88
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा दानं च वै दद्यादर्चयेद्गिरिजापतिम् .
ऋणत्रयविनिर्मुक्तो नाके दीप्यति देववत् .. 87.5 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ऋणत्रयमोचनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 88
6.3.m:
having bathed, makes gifts and worships the husband of the mountain's daughter, / is liberated from the three debts and shines in heaven like a god.
Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Ṛṇatrayamocana', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth book, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 88

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha kāpilaṃ tīrthamāśrayet .
sthāpitaṃ kapilenaiva sarvapātakanāśanam .. 88.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं पार्थ कापिलं तीर्थमाश्रयेत् .
स्थापितं कपिलेनैव सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 88.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Immediately after that, O son of Pṛthā, one should resort to the sacred ford Kāpila, / established by Kapila himself, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ nareśvara .
snāpayetparayā bhaktyā kapilākṣīrasarpiṣā .. 88.2 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टम्यां च सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां नरेश्वर .
स्नापयेत्परया भक्त्या कपिलाक्षीरसर्पिषा .. 88.2 ..
6.3.m: On the eighth and fourteenth lunar days of the bright fortnight, O lord of men, / one should bathe [the deity] with supreme devotion using milk and ghee from a brown cow.

6.3.s:
śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayeta maheśvaram .
tataḥ sugandhapuṣpaiśca śvetaiśca nṛpasattama .. 88.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीखण्डेन सुगन्धेन गुण्ठयेत महेश्वरम् .
ततः सुगन्धपुष्पैश्च श्वेतैश्च नृपसत्तम .. 88.3 ..
6.3.m: One should smear Maheśvara with fragrant sandalwood paste. / Then with fragrant and white flowers, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
ye'rcayanti jitakrodhā na te yānti yamālayam .
asipattravanaṃ ghoraṃ yamaculhī sudāruṇā .. 88.4 ..
6.3.d:
येऽर्चयन्ति जितक्रोधा न ते यान्ति यमालयम् .
असिपत्त्रवनं घोरं यमचुल्ही सुदारुणा .. 88.4 ..
6.3.m: those who worship with anger overcome do not go to the abode of Yama. / The dread forest of sword-leaves and the terrible oven of Yama

6.3.s:
dṛśyate naiva vidvadbhiḥ kapileśvarapūjanāt .
snātvā revājale puṇye bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchubhān .. 88.5 ..
6.3.d:
दृश्यते नैव विद्वद्भिः कपिलेश्वरपूजनात् .
स्नात्वा रेवाजले पुण्ये भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छुभान् .. 88.5 ..
6.3.m: are not seen at all by the wise, because of worshipping Kapileśvara. / Having bathed in the holy water of the Revā, one should feed auspicious brahmins.

6.3.s:
gopradānena vastreṇa tiladānena bhārata .
chatraśayyāpradānena rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ .. 88.6 ..
6.3.d:
गोप्रदानेन वस्त्रेण तिलदानेन भारत .
छत्रशय्याप्रदानेन राजा भवति धार्मिकः .. 88.6 ..
6.3.m: Through the gift of a cow, of cloth, and of sesame seeds, O Bhārata, / [and] through the gift of an umbrella and a bed, one becomes a righteous king,

6.3.s:
tīvratejā vighoraśca jīvatputraḥ priyaṃvadaḥ .
śatruvargo na tasya syātkadācitpāṇḍunandana .. 88.7 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kapileśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 89
6.3.d:
तीव्रतेजा विघोरश्च जीवत्पुत्रः प्रियंवदः .
शत्रुवर्गो न तस्य स्यात्कदाचित्पाण्डुनन्दन .. 88.7 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कपिलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 89
6.3.m:
endowed with intense splendour, gentle, with living sons, and soft-spoken; / he shall never have a host of enemies, O son of Pāṇḍu.
Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Kapileśvara', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth book, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 89

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra pūtikeśvaramuttamam .
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 89.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र पूतिकेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 89.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Pūtikeśvara / on the southern bank of the Narmadā, which brings about the destruction of all sins,

6.3.s:
sthāpitaṃ jāmbuvantena lokānāṃ tu hitārthinā .
rājā prasenajinnāma tasyāṃ vakṣasthalānmaṇau .. 89.2 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापितं जाम्बुवन्तेन लोकानां तु हितार्थिना .
राजा प्रसेनजिन्नाम तस्यां वक्षस्थलान्मणौ .. 89.2 ..
6.3.m: established by Jāmbavat, who desired the welfare of the worlds. / A king named Prasenajit [was struck] by him on the chest for the jewel,

6.3.s:
samutkṣipte tu tenaiva sapūtirabhavadvraṇaḥ .
tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā nirvraṇaḥ samajāyata .. 89.3 ..
6.3.d:
समुत्क्षिप्ते तु तेनैव सपूतिरभवद्व्रणः .
तत्र तीर्थे तपस्तप्त्वा निर्व्रणः समजायत .. 89.3 ..
6.3.m: and when it was seized, a putrid wound formed. / Having performed austerity at that sacred ford, he became free of the wound.

6.3.s:
tena tatsthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ pūtikeśvaramuttamam .
yastatra manujo bhaktyā snāyādbharatasattama .. 89.4 ..
6.3.d:
तेन तत्स्थापितं लिङ्गं पूतिकेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
यस्तत्र मनुजो भक्त्या स्नायाद्भरतसत्तम .. 89.4 ..
6.3.m: Therefore that excellent liṅga, Pūtikeśvara, was established by him. / The man who bathes there with devotion, O best of the Bharatas,

6.3.s:
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sampūjya parameśvaram .
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ sarvakālaṃ narādhipa .
ye'rcayanti sadā devaṃ te na yānti yamālayam .. 89.5 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pūtikeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 90
6.3.d:
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति सम्पूज्य परमेश्वरम् .
कृष्णाष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्यां सर्वकालं नराधिप .
येऽर्चयन्ति सदा देवं ते न यान्ति यमालयम् .. 89.5 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पूतिकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोननवतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 90
6.3.m:
attains all desires after worshipping the Supreme Lord. / On the eighth and fourteenth days of the dark fortnight, at all times, O ruler of men, / those who constantly worship the god do not go to the abode of Yama.
Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Pūtikeśvara', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth book, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 90

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
revāyā uttare kūle vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
jalaśāyīti vai nāma vikhyātaṃ vasudhātale .. 90.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
रेवाया उत्तरे कूले वैष्णवं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
जलशायीति वै नाम विख्यातं वसुधातले .. 90.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the northern bank of the Revā is an excellent Vaiṣṇava sacred ford / known on the earth's surface by the name Jalaśāyin.

6.3.s:
dānavānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā suptastatra janārdanaḥ .
cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ tatra devadevena cakriṇā .
sudarśanaṃ ca niṣpāpaṃ revājalasamāśrayāt .. 90.2 ..
6.3.d:
दानवानां वधं कृत्वा सुप्तस्तत्र जनार्दनः .
चक्रं प्रक्षालितं तत्र देवदेवेन चक्रिणा .
सुदर्शनं च निष्पापं रेवाजलसमाश्रयात् .. 90.2 ..
6.3.m: Having slain the Dānavas, Janārdana slept there. / The discus was washed there by the god of gods, the discus-bearer, / and Sudarśana became sinless through resorting to the water of the Revā.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
cakratīrthaṃ samācakṣva munisaṃghaiśca vanditam .
viṣṇoḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ revāyāścaiva yatphalam .. 90.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
चक्रतीर्थं समाचक्ष्व मुनिसंघैश्च वन्दितम् .
विष्णोः प्रभावमतुलं रेवायाश्चैव यत्फलम् .. 90.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell of Cakra-tīrtha, worshipped by hosts of sages, / the incomparable power of Viṣṇu, and the fruit of the Revā.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahāprājña viraktastvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
guhyādguhyataraṃ tīrthaṃ nirmitaṃ cakriṇā svayam .. 90.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञ विरक्तस्त्वं युधिष्ठिर .
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं तीर्थं निर्मितं चक्रिणा स्वयम् .. 90.4 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Well done, well done, O wise Yudhiṣṭhira, you who are dispassionate! / The sacred ford, more secret than the secret, was fashioned by the discus-bearer himself.

6.3.s:
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm .
āsītpurā mahādaityastālamegha iti śrutaḥ .. 90.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि कथां पापप्रणाशिनीम् .
आसीत्पुरा महादैत्यस्तालमेघ इति श्रुतः .. 90.5 ..
6.3.m: I shall relate to you that story which destroys sin. / Long ago there was a great Daitya famed as Tālamegha.

6.3.s:
tena devā jitāḥ sarve hṛtarājyā narādhipa .
yajñabhāgān svayaṃ bhuṅkte ahaṃ viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ .. 90.6 ..
6.3.d:
तेन देवा जिताः सर्वे हृतराज्या नराधिप .
यज्ञभागान् स्वयं भुङ्क्ते अहं विष्णुर्न संशयः .. 90.6 ..
6.3.m: By him all the gods were conquered and stripped of their kingdom, O ruler of men. / He himself consumed the sacrificial shares, [thinking,] 'I am Viṣṇu, without a doubt.'

6.3.s:
dhanadasya hṛtaṃ cittaṃ hṛtaḥ śakrasya vāraṇaḥ .
indrāṇīṃ vāñchate pāpo hayaratnaṃ raverapi .. 90.7 ..
6.3.d:
धनदस्य हृतं चित्तं हृतः शक्रस्य वारणः .
इन्द्राणीं वाञ्छते पापो हयरत्नं रवेरपि .. 90.7 ..
6.3.m: The heart of the giver of wealth was plundered; Śakra's elephant was seized. / The wicked one desired Indrāṇī and the jewel among horses belonging to the Sun.

6.3.s:
tālameghabhayātpārtha ravirudrāḥ savāsavāḥ .
yamaḥ skando jaleśo'gnirvāyurdevo dhaneśvaraḥ .. 90.8 ..
6.3.d:
तालमेघभयात्पार्थ रविरुद्राः सवासवाः .
यमः स्कन्दो जलेशोऽग्निर्वायुर्देवो धनेश्वरः .. 90.8 ..
6.3.m: Out of fear of Tālamegha, O son of Pṛthā, the sun, the Rudras along with Indra, / Yama, Skanda, the lord of waters, Agni, the wind-god, the lord of wealth,

6.3.s:
savākpatimaheśāśca naṣṭacittāḥ pitāmaham .
gatā devā brahmalokaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā pitāmaham .. 90.9 ..
6.3.d:
सवाक्पतिमहेशाश्च नष्टचित्ताः पितामहम् .
गता देवा ब्रह्मलोकं तत्र दृष्ट्वा पितामहम् .. 90.9 ..
6.3.m: along with the lord of speech and the Great Lord, distraught in mind, / went to the Brahmaloka to the Grandfather. Having seen the Grandfather there,

6.3.s:
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairvāgīśapramukhāḥ surāḥ .
guṇatrayavibhāgāya paścādbhedamupeyuṣe .. 90.10 ..
6.3.d:
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्वागीशप्रमुखाः सुराः .
गुणत्रयविभागाय पश्चाद्भेदमुपेयुषे .. 90.10 ..
6.3.m: the gods, led by the lord of speech, praised [him] with various hymns: / '[Praise be to you] who distribute the three guṇas and afterwards undergo distinction!'

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā devānnirutsāhān vivarṇānavanīpate .
prasādābhimukho devaḥ pratyuvāca divaukasaḥ .. 90.11 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा देवान्निरुत्साहान् विवर्णानवनीपते .
प्रसादाभिमुखो देवः प्रत्युवाच दिवौकसः .. 90.11 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the gods dispirited and pale, O ruler of the earth, / the god, disposed to favour, spoke in return to the dwellers of heaven.

6.3.s:
brahmovāca -
svāgataṃ surasaṅghasya kāntirnaṣṭā purātanī .
himakliṣṭaprabhāveṇa jyotīṃṣīva mukhāni vaḥ .. 90.12 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच -
स्वागतं सुरसङ्घस्य कान्तिर्नष्टा पुरातनी .
हिमक्लिष्टप्रभावेण ज्योतींषीव मुखानि वः .. 90.12 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā said: / Welcome to the host of gods! Your former lustre is lost; / your faces are like celestial bodies afflicted by snow's power.

6.3.s:
praśamādarciṣāmetadanudgīrṇaṃ surāyudham .
vṛtrasya hantuḥ kuliśaṃ kuṇṭhitaśrīva lakṣyate .. 90.13 ..
6.3.d:
प्रशमादर्चिषामेतदनुद्गीर्णं सुरायुधम् .
वृत्रस्य हन्तुः कुलिशं कुण्ठितश्रीव लक्ष्यते .. 90.13 ..
6.3.m: Through the subsiding of its flames, this weapon of the gods is unblazing; / the thunderbolt of the slayer of Vṛtra appears to have its brilliance blunted.

6.3.s:
kiṃ cāyamaridurvāraḥ pāṇau pāśaḥ pracetasaḥ .
mantreṇa hatavīryasya phaṇino dainyamāśritaḥ .. 90.14 ..
6.3.d:
किं चायमरिदुर्वारः पाणौ पाशः प्रचेतसः .
मन्त्रेण हतवीर्यस्य फणिनो दैन्यमाश्रितः .. 90.14 ..
6.3.m: And why does this noose of Pracetas, irresistible to foes, / in his hand take on the wretchedness of a serpent whose vigour is destroyed by a mantra?

6.3.s:
kuberasya manaḥśalyaṃ śaṃsatīva parābhavam .
apaviddhagato vāyurbhagnaśākha iva drumaḥ .. 90.15 ..
6.3.d:
कुबेरस्य मनःशल्यं शंसतीव पराभवम् .
अपविद्धगतो वायुर्भग्नशाख इव द्रुमः .. 90.15 ..
6.3.m: Kubera's dart in the heart seems to proclaim his defeat. / Vāyu has his motion checked, like a tree with broken branches.

6.3.s:
yamo'pi vilikhanbhūmiṃ daṇḍenāstamitatviṣā .
kurute'sminnamogho'pi nirvāṇālātalāghavam .. 90.16 ..
6.3.d:
यमोऽपि विलिखन्भूमिं दण्डेनास्तमितत्विषा .
कुरुतेऽस्मिन्नमोघोऽपि निर्वाणालातलाघवम् .. 90.16 ..
6.3.m: Even Yama, scratching the earth with his staff whose lustre is set, / though unfailing, displays the weakness of an extinguished firebrand.

6.3.s:
amī ca kathamādityāḥ pratāpakṣatiśītalāḥ .
citranyastā iva gatāḥ prakāmālokanīyatām .. 90.17 ..
6.3.d:
अमी च कथमादित्याः प्रतापक्षतिशीतलाः .
