संयुक्तः पुत्रभृत्यैश्च पौरुषे महति स्थितैः .. 97.23 ..
6.3.m: To eradicate them, he crossed the ocean and set forth, / accompanied by his sons and servants steadfast in great valor.

6.3.s:
samaraṃ taiḥ samārabdhaṃ mlecchaiśca vasunā saha .
jitā mlecchāḥ samastāste vasunā mṛgalocane .. 97.24 ..
6.3.d:
समरं तैः समारब्धं म्लेच्छैश्च वसुना सह .
जिता म्लेच्छाः समस्तास्ते वसुना मृगलोचने .. 97.24 ..
6.3.m: A battle was begun by those Mlecchas together with Vasu. / All those Mlecchas were conquered by Vasu, fawn-eyed lady.

6.3.s:
karadāste kṛtāstena saputrabalavāhanāḥ .
pradhānā tasya sā rājñī tava mātā mṛgekṣaṇe .. 97.25 ..
6.3.d:
करदास्ते कृतास्तेन सपुत्रबलवाहनाः .
प्रधाना तस्य सा राज्ञी तव माता मृगेक्षणे .. 97.25 ..
6.3.m: They were made to pay tribute by him, along with their sons, armies, and mounts. / His chief queen is your mother, O deer-eyed maiden.

6.3.s:
pravāsasthe mahīpāle saṃjātā sā rajasvalā .
nārīṇāṃ tu sadākālaṃ manmatho hyadhiko bhavet .. 97.26 ..
6.3.d:
प्रवासस्थे महीपाले संजाता सा रजस्वला .
नारीणां तु सदाकालं मन्मथो ह्यधिको भवेत् .. 97.26 ..
6.3.m: While the king was away abroad, her menses arrived. / In women, passion is ever heightened,

6.3.s:
viśeṣeṇa ṛtoḥ kāle bhidyante kāmasāyakaiḥ .
manmathena tu saṃtaptācintayatsā śubhekṣaṇā .. 97.27 ..
6.3.d:
विशेषेण ऋतोः काले भिद्यन्ते कामसायकैः .
मन्मथेन तु संतप्ताचिन्तयत्सा शुभेक्षणा .. 97.27 ..
6.3.m: and especially at the fertile time they are pierced by the arrows of love. / Tormented by desire, that fair-eyed lady thought:

6.3.s:
dūtaṃ vai preṣayāmyadya vasurājñaḥ samīpataḥ .
āhūtaḥ satvaraṃ dūta gaccha tvaṃ nṛpasannidhau .. 97.28 ..
6.3.d:
दूतं वै प्रेषयाम्यद्य वसुराज्ञः समीपतः .
आहूतः सत्वरं दूत गच्छ त्वं नृपसन्निधौ .. 97.28 ..
6.3.m: 'I shall send a messenger today to King Vasu.' / The messenger was summoned quickly: 'Go to the king’s presence.'

6.3.s:
dūta uvāca -
paratīraṃ gato devi vasurājāriśāsanaḥ .
tatra gantumaśakyeta jalayānairvinā śubhe .. 97.29 ..
6.3.d:
दूत उवाच -
परतीरं गतो देवि वसुराजारिशासनः .
तत्र गन्तुमशक्येत जलयानैर्विना शुभे .. 97.29 ..
6.3.m: The messenger said: / 'O queen, King Vasu, punisher of foes, has gone to the distant shore. / It is impossible to go there without boats, fair lady.

6.3.s:
tāni yānāni sarvāṇi gṛhītāni pare taṭe .
dūtavākyena sā rājñī viṣaṇṇā kāmapīḍitā .. 97.30 ..
6.3.d:
तानि यानानि सर्वाणि गृहीतानि परे तटे .
दूतवाक्येन सा राज्ञी विषण्णा कामपीडिता .. 97.30 ..
6.3.m: All those vessels have been seized on the opposite bank.' / At the messenger's words, the queen was dejected, afflicted by desire.

6.3.s:
tatsakhī tāmuvācātha kasmāttvaṃ paritapyase .
svalekhaḥ preṣyatāṃ devi śukahaste yathārthataḥ .. 97.31 ..
6.3.d:
तत्सखी तामुवाचाथ कस्मात्त्वं परितप्यसे .
स्वलेखः प्रेष्यतां देवि शुकहस्ते यथार्थतः .. 97.31 ..
6.3.m: Then her female friend said to her: 'Why are you grieved? / Send your own letter, O queen, into the keeping of a parrot, describing the matter faithfully.

6.3.s:
samudraṃ laṅghayitvā tu śakuntā yānti sundari .
sakhivākyena sā rājñī svasthā jātā narādhipa .. 97.32 ..
6.3.d:
समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वा तु शकुन्ता यान्ति सुन्दरि .
सखिवाक्येन सा राज्ञी स्वस्था जाता नराधिप .. 97.32 ..
6.3.m: Birds cross over the ocean, lovely lady.' / At her friend's words, that queen became composed, O lord of men.

6.3.s:
vyāhṛto lekhakastatra likha lekhaṃ mamājñayā .
tvaddhīnā satyabhāmādya vaso rājanna jīvati .. 97.33 ..
6.3.d:
व्याहृतो लेखकस्तत्र लिख लेखं ममाज्ञया .
त्वद्धीना सत्यभामाद्य वसो राजन्न जीवति .. 97.33 ..
6.3.m: A scribe was summoned there: 'Write a letter by my command: / "Without you, Satyabhāmā cannot live today, O King Vasu.

6.3.s:
ṛtukālo'dya saṃjāto likha lekhaṃ tu lekhakaṃ .
likhite bhūrjapatre tu lekhe vai lekhakena tu .. 97.34 ..
6.3.d:
ऋतुकालोऽद्य संजातो लिख लेखं तु लेखकं .
लिखिते भूर्जपत्रे तु लेखे वै लेखकेन तु .. 97.34 ..
6.3.m: My fertile period has arrived today; scribe, write the letter."' / When the letter was written on birch bark by the scribe,

6.3.s: śukaḥ pañjaramadhyastha ānītoddhaiva sannidhau .. 97.35 ..
6.3.d: शुकः पञ्जरमध्यस्थ आनीतोद्धैव सन्निधौ .. 97.35 ..
6.3.m: a parrot held inside a cage was brought upright into her presence.

6.3.s:
satyabhāmovāca -
nītvā lekhaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ vasurājñaḥ samīpataḥ .
śakuniḥ praṇato bhūtvā gṛhītvā lekhamuttamam .. 97.36 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यभामोवाच -
नीत्वा लेखं गच्छ शीघ्रं वसुराज्ञः समीपतः .
शकुनिः प्रणतो भूत्वा गृहीत्वा लेखमुत्तमम् .. 97.36 ..
6.3.m: Satyabhāmā said: / 'Take the letter and go swiftly into the presence of King Vasu.' / The bird bowed, took the excellent letter,

6.3.s:
utpatya sahasā rājañjagāmākāśamaṇḍalam .
tataḥ pakṣī gataḥ śīghraṃ vasurājasamīpataḥ .. 97.37 ..
6.3.d:
उत्पत्य सहसा राजञ्जगामाकाशमण्डलम् .
ततः पक्षी गतः शीघ्रं वसुराजसमीपतः .. 97.37 ..
6.3.m: flew up suddenly into the realm of the sky, O king, / and then that bird went swiftly to the presence of King Vasu.

6.3.s:
kṣipte lekhe śukenaiva satyabhāmāvisarjite .
vasurājñā tato lekho gṛhya haste'vadhāritaḥ .. 97.38 ..
6.3.d:
क्षिप्ते लेखे शुकेनैव सत्यभामाविसर्जिते .
वसुराज्ञा ततो लेखो गृह्य हस्तेऽवधारितः .. 97.38 ..
6.3.m: When the letter dispatched by Satyabhāmā was dropped by the parrot, / King Vasu took the letter in his hand and comprehended it.

6.3.s:
lekhārthaṃ cintayitvā tu gṛhya vīryaṃ nareśvaraḥ .
amoghaṃ puṭikāṃ kṛtvā pratilekhena miśritam .. 97.39 ..
6.3.d:
लेखार्थं चिन्तयित्वा तु गृह्य वीर्यं नरेश्वरः .
अमोघं पुटिकां कृत्वा प्रतिलेखेन मिश्रितम् .. 97.39 ..
6.3.m: Reflecting upon the message's import, the lord of men collected his semen, / infallible, made a packet, and joined it with a reply.

6.3.s:
śukasya so'payāmāsa gaccha rājñīsamīpataḥ .
praṇamya vasurājānaṃ bījaṃ gṛhyotpapāta ha .. 97.40 ..
6.3.d:
शुकस्य सोऽपयामास गच्छ राज्ञीसमीपतः .
प्रणम्य वसुराजानं बीजं गृह्योत्पपात ह .. 97.40 ..
6.3.m: He gave it to the parrot: 'Go into the presence of the queen.' / Having bowed to King Vasu and taken the seed, it flew up.

6.3.s:
samudropari samprāptaḥ śukaḥ śyenena vīkṣitaḥ .
sāmiṣaṃ taṃ śukaṃ jñātvā śyenastamabhyadhāvata .. 97.41 ..
6.3.d:
समुद्रोपरि सम्प्राप्तः शुकः श्येनेन वीक्षितः .
सामिषं तं शुकं ज्ञात्वा श्येनस्तमभ्यधावत .. 97.41 ..
6.3.m: When it reached above the ocean, the parrot was spotted by a hawk. / Believing that parrot was holding meat, the hawk rushed at it.

6.3.s:
hataścañcuprahāreṇa śukaḥ śyenena bhārata .
mūrcchayā tasya tadbījaṃ patitaṃ sāgarāmbhasi .. 97.42 ..
6.3.d:
हतश्चञ्चुप्रहारेण शुकः श्येनेन भारत .
मूर्च्छया तस्य तद्बीजं पतितं सागराम्भसि .. 97.42 ..
6.3.m: Struck by the hawk with a blow of its beak, O descendant of Bharata, / through the parrot's swoon that seed fell into the water of the ocean.

6.3.s:
matsyena gilitaṃ tacca bījaṃ vasumahīpateḥ .
kanyā matsyodare jātā tena bījena sundari .. 97.43 ..
6.3.d:
मत्स्येन गिलितं तच्च बीजं वसुमहीपतेः .
कन्या मत्स्योदरे जाता तेन बीजेन सुन्दरि .. 97.43 ..
6.3.m: And that seed of King Vasu was swallowed by a fish. / From that seed a maiden was born inside the fish's belly, beautiful lady.

6.3.s:
prāpto'sau lubdhakairmatsya ānītaḥ svagṛhaṃ tataḥ .
yāvadvidārito matsyastāvaddṛṣṭā tvamuttame .. 97.44 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्तोऽसौ लुब्धकैर्मत्स्य आनीतः स्वगृहं ततः .
यावद्विदारितो मत्स्यस्तावद्दृष्टा त्वमुत्तमे .. 97.44 ..
6.3.m: The fish was caught by fishermen and brought to their home. / When the fish was cut open, you were seen, finest lady,

6.3.s:
śaśimaṇḍalasaṅkāśā sūryatejaḥsamaprabhā .
dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ harṣitāḥ sarve kaivartā jāhnavītaṭe .. 97.45 ..
6.3.d:
शशिमण्डलसङ्काशा सूर्यतेजःसमप्रभा .
दृष्ट्वा त्वां हर्षिताः सर्वे कैवर्ता जाह्नवीतटे .. 97.45 ..
6.3.m: resembling the orb of the moon, shining with radiance like that of the sun. / Seeing you on the bank of the Jāhnavī, all the fishermen rejoiced.

6.3.s:
harṣitāste gatāḥ sarve pradhānasya ca mandiram .
strīratnaṃ kathayāmāsurgṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahāprabham .. 97.46 ..
6.3.d:
हर्षितास्ते गताः सर्वे प्रधानस्य च मन्दिरम् .
स्त्रीरत्नं कथयामासुर्गृहाण त्वं महाप्रभम् .. 97.46 ..
6.3.m: Rejoicing, they all went to the mansion of their chief. / They spoke of the jewel among women: 'Accept this child of great splendor.'

6.3.s:
gṛhītā tena tanvaṅgī hyaputreṇa mṛgekṣaṇā .
bhāryāṃ svāmāha tanvaṅgi pālayasva mṛgekṣaṇe .. 97.47 ..
6.3.d:
गृहीता तेन तन्वङ्गी ह्यपुत्रेण मृगेक्षणा .
भार्यां स्वामाह तन्वङ्गि पालयस्व मृगेक्षणे .. 97.47 ..
6.3.m: The slender, fawn-eyed girl was accepted by that childless man. / He said to his wife: 'Slender lady, protect this fawn-eyed one.'

6.3.s:
tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa parāśaravacastadā .
evamuktvā tu sā tena dattātmānaṃ nareśvara .. 97.48 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सा चिन्तयामास पराशरवचस्तदा .
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा तेन दत्तात्मानं नरेश्वर .. 97.48 ..
6.3.m: Then she reflected upon the words of Parāśara. / Having been told this by him, she gave herself [to him], O lord of men,

6.3.s:
uvāca sādhu me brahmanmatsyagandho'nu vartate .
tatastena tu sā bālā divyagandhādhivāsitā .. 97.49 ..
6.3.d:
उवाच साधु मे ब्रह्मन्मत्स्यगन्धोऽनु वर्तते .
ततस्तेन तु सा बाला दिव्यगन्धाधिवासिता .. 97.49 ..
6.3.m: and said: 'Very well, holy one, but the smell of fish clings to me.' / Thereupon the maiden was suffused by him with divine fragrance

6.3.s:
kṛtā yogabalenaiva jvālayitvā vibhāvasum .
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ vahnimūḍhā tena rasāttadā .. 97.50 ..
6.3.d:
कृता योगबलेनैव ज्वालयित्वा विभावसुम् .
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं वह्निमूढा तेन रसात्तदा .. 97.50 ..
6.3.m: by the power of yoga, and kindling a fire, / circumambulating the fire, he married her eagerly then.

6.3.s:
jalayānasya madhye tu kāmasthānānyasaṃspṛśat .
jñātvā kāmotsukaṃ vipraṃ bhītā sā dharmanandana .. 97.51 ..
6.3.d:
जलयानस्य मध्ये तु कामस्थानान्यसंस्पृशत् .
ज्ञात्वा कामोत्सुकं विप्रं भीता सा धर्मनन्दन .. 97.51 ..
6.3.m: In the middle of the boat he touched the regions of passion. / Knowing the brahmin to be eager with desire, she was afraid, O son of Dharma,

6.3.s:
hasantī tamuvācātha deva tvaṃ lokasannidhau .
na lajjase kathaṃ dhīmankurvāṇaḥ pāmarocitam .. 97.52 ..
6.3.d:
हसन्ती तमुवाचाथ देव त्वं लोकसन्निधौ .
न लज्जसे कथं धीमन्कुर्वाणः पामरोचितम् .. 97.52 ..
6.3.m: and laughing, said to him: 'My lord, in the presence of people, / are you not ashamed, wise one, acting like a vulgar man?'

6.3.s:
tatastena kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā saṃsmṛtā hṛdi tāmasī .
āgatā tāmasī māyā yayā vyāptaṃ carācaram .. 97.53 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तेन क्षणं ध्यात्वा संस्मृता हृदि तामसी .
आगता तामसी माया यया व्याप्तं चराचरम् .. 97.53 ..
6.3.m: Then, having meditated for a moment, he recalled the darkness in his heart. / Darkness arrived as an illusion by which the animate and inanimate world was covered.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sā vismitā tena karmaṇaiva tu rañjitā .
brahmacaryābhitaptena strīsaukhyaṃ krīḍitaṃ tadā .. 97.54 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सा विस्मिता तेन कर्मणैव तु रञ्जिता .
ब्रह्मचर्याभितप्तेन स्त्रीसौख्यं क्रीडितं तदा .. 97.54 ..
6.3.m: Then, astonished, she was delighted by that very deed. / He, who had been heated by celibacy, then enjoyed the pleasure of woman.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sā tatkṣaṇādeva garbhabhāreṇa pīḍitā .
prasūtā bālakaṃ tatra jaṭilaṃ daṇḍadhāriṇam .. 97.55 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सा तत्क्षणादेव गर्भभारेण पीडिता .
प्रसूता बालकं तत्र जटिलं दण्डधारिणम् .. 97.55 ..
6.3.m: Then, in that very moment, oppressed by the weight of pregnancy, / she gave birth there to a boy having matted hair and carrying a staff,

6.3.s:
kamaṇḍaludharaṃ śāntaṃ mekhalākaṭibhūṣitam .
uttarīyakṛtaskandhaṃ viṣṇumāyāvivarjitam .. 97.56 ..
6.3.d:
कमण्डलुधरं शान्तं मेखलाकटिभूषितम् .
उत्तरीयकृतस्कन्धं विष्णुमायाविवर्जितम् .. 97.56 ..
6.3.m: holding a water pot, calm, his waist adorned with a girdle, / with an upper garment placed over his shoulder, free from the illusion of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
tato'pi śaṅkitā pārtha dṛṣṭvā taṃ kalabālakam .
vepamānā tato bālā jagāma śaraṇaṃ muneḥ .. 97.57 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽपि शङ्किता पार्थ दृष्ट्वा तं कलबालकम् .
वेपमाना ततो बाला जगाम शरणं मुनेः .. 97.57 ..
6.3.m: Even then she was alarmed, O Pārtha, upon seeing that tiny child; / trembling then, the maiden sought refuge with the sage:

6.3.s:
rakṣa rakṣa muniśreṣṭha parāśara mahāmate .
jātaṃ me'tyadbhutaṃ putraṃ kaupīnavaramekhalam .
daṇḍahastaṃ jaṭāyuktamuttarīyavibhūṣitam .. 97.58 ..
6.3.d:
रक्ष रक्ष मुनिश्रेष्ठ पराशर महामते .
जातं मेऽत्यद्भुतं पुत्रं कौपीनवरमेखलम् .
दण्डहस्तं जटायुक्तमुत्तरीयविभूषितम् .. 97.58 ..
6.3.m: "Protect me, protect me, O best of sages, Parāśara of great intellect! / To me an exceedingly wondrous son has been born, with a loincloth and an excellent girdle, / with a staff in hand, endowed with matted locks, and adorned with an upper garment."

6.3.s:
parāśara uvāca -
mā bhaiṣīḥ svasute jāte kumārī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .
nāmnā yojanagandheti dvitīyaṃ satyavatyapi .. 97.59 ..
6.3.d:
पराशर उवाच -
मा भैषीः स्वसुते जाते कुमारी त्वं भविष्यसि .
नाम्ना योजनगन्धेति द्वितीयं सत्यवत्यपि .. 97.59 ..
6.3.m: Parāśara said: / "Do not fear! Though your own son is born, you will remain a virgin. / By name [you shall be called] Yojanagandhā, and your second [name shall be] Satyavatī.

6.3.s:
śaṃtanurnāma rājā yaḥ sa te bhartā bhaviṣyati .
prathamā mahiṣī tasya somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇā .. 97.60 ..
6.3.d:
शंतनुर्नाम राजा यः स ते भर्ता भविष्यति .
प्रथमा महिषी तस्य सोमवंशविभूषणा .. 97.60 ..
6.3.m: The king named Śaṃtanu, he shall be your husband. / You will be his chief queen, an ornament of the Lunar dynasty.

6.3.s:
gaccha tvaṃ svāśrayaṃ śubhre pūrvarūpeṇa saṃsthitā .
mā viṣādaṃ kuruṣvātra dṛṣṭaṃ jñānasya me balam .. 97.61 ..
6.3.d:
गच्छ त्वं स्वाश्रयं शुभ्रे पूर्वरूपेण संस्थिता .
मा विषादं कुरुष्वात्र दृष्टं ज्ञानस्य मे बलम् .. 97.61 ..
6.3.m: Go to your own home, O fair one, remaining in your former form. / Do not grieve here; you have seen the power of my wisdom."

6.3.s:
ityuktvā prayayau vipraḥ sā bālā putramāśritā .
natvoce mātaraṃ bhaktyā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ vinayānataḥ .. 97.62 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ विप्रः सा बाला पुत्रमाश्रिता .
नत्वोचे मातरं भक्त्या साष्टाङ्गं विनयानतः .. 97.62 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the brahmin departed. That girl turned to her son, / bowed down, and, bent in humility with eightfold prostration, said to him with devotion:

6.3.s:
kṣamyatāṃ mātaruktaṃ me prasādaḥ kriyatāmapi .
īśvarārādhane yatnaṃ kariṣyāmyahamambike .. 97.63 ..
6.3.d:
क्षम्यतां मातरुक्तं मे प्रसादः क्रियतामपि .
ईश्वराराधने यत्नं करिष्याम्यहमम्बिके .. 97.63 ..
6.3.m: "Pardon what I said, O mother; let your favor also be granted. / I shall make an effort in the worship of Īśvara, O mother."

6.3.s: tataḥ sā putravākyena viṣaṇṇā vākyamabravīt .. 97.64 ..
6.3.d: ततः सा पुत्रवाक्येन विषण्णा वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 97.64 ..
6.3.m: Then she, saddened by her son's words, spoke these words:

6.3.s:
yojanagandhovāca -
mā tyaktvā gaccha vatsādya mātaraṃ māmanāgasam .
tvadviyogena me putra pañcatvaṃ bhāvyasaṃśayam .. 97.65 ..
6.3.d:
योजनगन्धोवाच -
मा त्यक्त्वा गच्छ वत्साद्य मातरं मामनागसम् .
त्वद्वियोगेन मे पुत्र पञ्चत्वं भाव्यसंशयम् .. 97.65 ..
6.3.m: Yojanagandhā said: / "Do not abandon me, your innocent mother, and go away today, my child! / From separation from you, my son, my death will surely follow.

6.3.s:
nāsti putrasamaḥ sneho nāsti bhrātṛsamaṃ kulam .
nāsti satyaparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param .. 97.66 ..
6.3.d:
नास्ति पुत्रसमः स्नेहो नास्ति भ्रातृसमं कुलम् .
नास्ति सत्यपरो धर्मो नानृतात्पातकं परम् .. 97.66 ..
6.3.m: There is no love equal to that for a son; there is no lineage equal to brothers; / there is no righteousness higher than truth; there is no sin worse than falsehood.

6.3.s:
bālabhāve mayā jāta ādhāraḥ kila jāyase .
na me bhartā na me putraḥ paśya karmaviḍambanam .. 97.67 ..
6.3.d:
बालभावे मया जात आधारः किल जायसे .
न मे भर्ता न मे पुत्रः पश्य कर्मविडम्बनम् .. 97.67 ..
6.3.m: Born to me in my childhood, you were indeed to become my support. / I have no husband, nor have I a son—behold the mockery of destiny!"

6.3.s:
vyāsa uvāca -
mā viṣādaṃ kuruṣvāntaḥ satyametanmayoritam .
āpatkāle'smi te devi smartavyaḥ kāryasiddhaye .. 97.68 ..
6.3.d:
व्यास उवाच -
मा विषादं कुरुष्वान्तः सत्यमेतन्मयोरितम् .
आपत्कालेऽस्मि ते देवि स्मर्तव्यः कार्यसिद्धये .. 97.68 ..
6.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "Do not despair within your heart; this is the truth spoken by me. / In times of distress, O lady, you should remember me for the accomplishment of your purpose.

6.3.s:
āpadastārayiṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ me duruttaram .
ityuktvā prayayau vyāsaḥ kanyā sāpi gatā gṛham .. 97.69 ..
6.3.d:
आपदस्तारयिष्यामि क्षम्यतां मे दुरुत्तरम् .
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ व्यासः कन्या सापि गता गृहम् .. 97.69 ..
6.3.m: I will deliver you from calamities; forgive my difficult departure." / Having spoken thus, Vyāsa departed, and that maiden also went home.

6.3.s:
parāśarasutastatra viṣaṣṇo vanamadhyataḥ .
tretāyugāvasāne tu dvāparādau nareśvara .. 97.70 ..
6.3.d:
पराशरसुतस्तत्र विषष्णो वनमध्यतः .
त्रेतायुगावसाने तु द्वापरादौ नरेश्वर .. 97.70 ..
6.3.m: There, the son of Parāśara went into the forest, despondent, / at the end of the Tretāyuga and the beginning of the Dvāpara, O ruler of men.

6.3.s:
vyāsārthaṃ cintayāmāsurdevāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ .
ākhyāto nāradenaiva putraḥ parāśarasya saḥ .. 97.71 ..
6.3.d:
व्यासार्थं चिन्तयामासुर्देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः .
आख्यातो नारदेनैव पुत्रः पराशरस्य सः .. 97.71 ..
6.3.m: The gods, headed by Śakra, considered [the need] for a Vyāsa. / That son of Parāśara was indeed declared by Nārada,

6.3.s:
kaivartaputrikājāto jñānī jahnusutātaṭe .
tato nāradavākyena āgatāḥ surasattamāḥ .. 97.72 ..
6.3.d:
कैवर्तपुत्रिकाजातो ज्ञानी जह्नुसुतातटे .
ततो नारदवाक्येन आगताः सुरसत्तमाः .. 97.72 ..
6.3.m: as born of the fisherman's daughter, wise, on the bank of the daughter of Jahnu. / Then, at the word of Nārada, the best among the gods arrived:

6.3.s:
rāmaḥ pitāmahaḥ śakro munisaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ .
āsyādikaṃ pṛthagdattvā sādhu sādhvityudīrayan .. 97.73 ..
6.3.d:
रामः पितामहः शक्रो मुनिसङ्घैः समावृताः .
आस्यादिकं पृथग्दत्त्वा साधु साध्वित्युदीरयन् .. 97.73 ..
6.3.m: Rāma, the Grandfather [Brahmā], and Śakra, surrounded by hosts of sages. / Offering face-washing water and the rest separately, saying, "Well done! Well done!",

6.3.s:
pitāmahena vai bālo garbhādhānādisaṃskṛtaḥ .
dvīpāyano dvīpajanmā pārāśaryaḥ parāśarāt .. 97.74 ..
6.3.d:
पितामहेन वै बालो गर्भाधानादिसंस्कृतः .
द्वीपायनो द्वीपजन्मा पाराशर्यः पराशरात् .. 97.74 ..
6.3.m: the child was indeed consecrated with the rites from conception onwards by the Grandfather: / Dvaipāyana, island-born, and Pārāśarya, born of Parāśara.

6.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśātkṛṣṇanāmāyaṃ vyāso vedānvyasiṣyati .
virañcinābhiṣikto'sau munisaṅghaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 97.75 ..
6.3.d:
कृष्णांशात्कृष्णनामायं व्यासो वेदान्व्यसिष्यति .
विरञ्चिनाभिषिक्तोऽसौ मुनिसङ्घैः पुनःपुनः .. 97.75 ..
6.3.m: "Because of a portion of Kṛṣṇa, this one named Kṛṣṇa, a Vyāsa, shall divide the Vedas." / He was consecrated again and again by Virañci and the hosts of sages:

6.3.s:
vyāsastvaṃ sarvalokeṣu ityuktvā prayayuḥ surāḥ .
tīrthayātrā samārabdhā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena tu .. 97.76 ..
6.3.d:
व्यासस्त्वं सर्वलोकेषु इत्युक्त्वा प्रययुः सुराः .
तीर्थयात्रा समारब्धा कृष्णद्वैपायनेन तु .. 97.76 ..
6.3.m: "You are Vyāsa throughout all the worlds!" Having spoken thus, the gods departed. / Then a pilgrimage to sacred fords was undertaken by Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana.

6.3.s:
gaṅgāvagāhitā tena kedāraśca sapuṣkaraḥ .
gayā ca naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatī .. 97.77 ..
6.3.d:
गङ्गावगाहिता तेन केदारश्च सपुष्करः .
गया च नैमिषं तीर्थं कुरुक्षेत्रं सरस्वती .. 97.77 ..
6.3.m: He bathed in the Gaṅgā, and Kedāra along with Puṣkara, / and Gayā, and the sacred ford of Naimiṣa, Kurukṣetra, and the Sarasvatī.

6.3.s:
ujjayinyāṃ mahākālaṃ somanāthaṃ prabhāsake .
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snātvā yāto mahāmuniḥ .. 97.78 ..
6.3.d:
उज्जयिन्यां महाकालं सोमनाथं प्रभासके .
पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां स्नात्वा यातो महामुनिः .. 97.78 ..
6.3.m: At Ujjayinī [he visited] Mahākāla, and Somanātha at Prabhāsa. / Having bathed across the earth bounded by the ocean, the great sage went on,

6.3.s:
amṛtāṃ narmadāṃ prāpto rudradehodbhavāṃ śubhām .
sāhlādo narmadāṃ dṛṣṭvā cittaviśrāntimāpa ca .. 97.79 ..
6.3.d:
अमृतां नर्मदां प्राप्तो रुद्रदेहोद्भवां शुभाम् .
साह्लादो नर्मदां दृष्ट्वा चित्तविश्रान्तिमाप च .. 97.79 ..
6.3.m: and reached the immortal, auspicious Narmadā, born from the body of Rudra. / Joyful upon seeing the Narmadā, his mind attained tranquility.

6.3.s:
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ .
grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ .. 97.80 ..
6.3.d:
तपश्चचार विपुलं नर्मदातटमाश्रितः .
ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्यस्थो वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः .. 97.80 ..
6.3.m: Resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, he performed extensive austerities. / In summer he stood amid five fires; in the rainy season he lay on bare ground;

6.3.s:
sārdravāsāśca hemante tiṣṭhandadhyau maheśvaram .
svāntarhṛtkamale sthāpya dhyāyate parameśvaram .. 97.81 ..
6.3.d:
सार्द्रवासाश्च हेमन्ते तिष्ठन्दध्यौ महेश्वरम् .
स्वान्तर्हृत्कमले स्थाप्य ध्यायते परमेश्वरम् .. 97.81 ..
6.3.m: and in winter, standing in wet clothes, he meditated upon Maheśvara. / Placing the Supreme Lord within the lotus of his own heart, he meditated upon him,

6.3.s:
sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartāramachedyaṃ varadaṃ śubham .
nityaṃ siddheśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayeddhyānatatparaḥ .. 97.82 ..
6.3.d:
सृष्टिसंहारकर्तारमछेद्यं वरदं शुभम् .
नित्यं सिद्धेश्वरं लिङ्गं पूजयेद्ध्यानतत्परः .. 97.82 ..
6.3.m: the maker of creation and destruction, indivisible, bestower of boons, auspicious. / Intent on meditation, he constantly worshipped the Siddheśvara liṅga.

6.3.s:
arcanātsiddhaliṅgasya dhyānayogaprabhāvataḥ .
pratyakṣaḥ śaṅkaro jātaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya saḥ .. 97.83 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चनात्सिद्धलिङ्गस्य ध्यानयोगप्रभावतः .
प्रत्यक्षः शङ्करो जातः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य सः .. 97.83 ..
6.3.m: From the worship of the Siddha-liṅga, and by the power of the yoga of meditation, / Śaṅkara became visible to that Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
toṣito'haṃ tvayā vatsa varaṃ varaya śobhanam .. 97.84 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
तोषितोऽहं त्वया वत्स वरं वरय शोभनम् .. 97.84 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "I am pleased by you, child; choose an excellent boon."

6.3.s:
vyāsa uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama .
pratyakṣo narmadātīre svayameva bhaviṣyasi .
atītānāgatajño'haṃ tvatprasādādumāpate .. 97.85 ..
6.3.d:
व्यास उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम .
प्रत्यक्षो नर्मदातीरे स्वयमेव भविष्यसि .
अतीतानागतज्ञोऽहं त्वत्प्रसादादुमापते .. 97.85 ..
6.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "If you are pleased with me, O God, if a boon is to be given to me: / you yourself shall become manifest on the bank of the Narmadā; / and through your grace, O Lord of Umā, may I know the past and the future."

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
evaṃ bhavatu te putra matprasādādasaṃśayam .
tvayi bhaktigṛhīto'haṃ pratyakṣo narmadātaṭe .. 97.86 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
एवं भवतु ते पुत्र मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् .
त्वयि भक्तिगृहीतोऽहं प्रत्यक्षो नर्मदातटे .. 97.86 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "So shall it be, my son, without a doubt, by my grace. / Won over by devotion to you, I will become manifest on the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
sahasrāṃśārdhabhāvena pratyakṣo'haṃ tvadāśrame .
ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ kailāsaṃ nagamuttamam .. 97.87 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रांशार्धभावेन प्रत्यक्षोऽहं त्वदाश्रमे .
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवः कैलासं नगमुत्तमम् .. 97.87 ..
6.3.m: With half the nature of the thousand-rayed sun, I will be manifest in your hermitage." / Having spoken thus, the god departed for Kailāsa, the best of mountains.

6.3.s:
patnīsaṃgrahaṇaṃ jātaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya tu .
śāstroktena vidhānena patnī pālayatastathā .. 97.88 ..
6.3.d:
पत्नीसंग्रहणं जातं कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य तु .
शास्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन पत्नी पालयतस्तथा .. 97.88 ..
6.3.m: Then the acceptance of a wife took place for Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana, / and while he maintained his wife according to the rule prescribed in the scriptures,

6.3.s:
putro jāto hyaputrasya parāśarasutasya ca .
devairvardhāpitaḥ sarvairiñcendrapurogamaiḥ .. 97.89 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रो जातो ह्यपुत्रस्य पराशरसुतस्य च .
देवैर्वर्धापितः सर्वैरिञ्चेन्द्रपुरोगमैः .. 97.89 ..
6.3.m: a son was born to that son of Parāśara, who had been sonless. / He was congratulated by all the gods, headed by Indra and the Lord [Brahmā].

6.3.s:
putrajanmanyathājagmurvaśiṣṭhādyā munīśvarāḥ .
tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena parāśarapurogamāḥ .. 97.90 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रजन्मन्यथाजग्मुर्वशिष्ठाद्या मुनीश्वराः .
तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन पराशरपुरोगमाः .. 97.90 ..
6.3.m: On the birth of the son, the best of sages, headed by Vasiṣṭha, arrived / in the course of their pilgrimage to sacred fords, led by Parāśara:

6.3.s:
manvatriviṣṇuhārītayājñavalkyośano'ṅgirāḥ .
yamāpastambasaṃvartāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī .. 97.91 ..
6.3.d:
मन्वत्रिविष्णुहारीतयाज्ञवल्क्योशनोऽङ्गिराः .
यमापस्तम्बसंवर्ताः कात्यायनबृहस्पती .. 97.91 ..
6.3.m: Manu, Atri, Viṣṇu, Hārīta, Yājñavalkya, Uśanas, Aṅgiras, / Yama, Āpastamba, Saṃvarta, Kātyāyana, and Bṛhaspati;

6.3.s:
evamādisahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca .
saśiṣyāśca mahābhāgā narmadātaṭamāśritāḥ .. 97.92 ..
6.3.d:
एवमादिसहस्राणि लक्षकोटिशतानि च .
सशिष्याश्च महाभागा नर्मदातटमाश्रिताः .. 97.92 ..
6.3.m: thousands, hundreds of thousands, and hundreds of millions of such [sages], / along with their disciples, highly fortunate, resorted to the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
vyāsāśrame śubhe ramye saṃtuṣṭā āyayurnṛpa .
dṛṣṭvā tānso'pi viprendrānabhyutthānakṛtodyamaḥ .. 97.93 ..
6.3.d:
व्यासाश्रमे शुभे रम्ये संतुष्टा आययुर्नृप .
दृष्ट्वा तान्सोऽपि विप्रेन्द्रानभ्युत्थानकृतोद्यमः .. 97.93 ..
6.3.m: They came satisfied to the auspicious and lovely hermitage of Vyāsa, O king. / Seeing those chiefs among brahmins, he made an effort to rise to welcome them.

6.3.s:
pituḥ pūrvaṃ praṇamyādau sarveṣāṃ ca yathāvidhi .
āsanāni dadau bhaktyā pādyamarghaṃ nyavedayat .. 97.94 ..
6.3.d:
पितुः पूर्वं प्रणम्यादौ सर्वेषां च यथाविधि .
आसनानि ददौ भक्त्या पाद्यमर्घं न्यवेदयत् .. 97.94 ..
6.3.m: Having first bowed down to his father, and then to all in accordance with rule, / he gave them seats with devotion and offered water for the feet and the guest-offering.

6.3.s:
kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha .
uddhṛto'haṃ na sandeho yuṣmatsambhāṣaṇārcanāt .. 97.95 ..
6.3.d:
कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .
उद्धृतोऽहं न सन्देहो युष्मत्सम्भाषणार्चनात् .. 97.95 ..
6.3.m: Folding his hands in reverence, he spoke these words: / "I am uplifted, there is no doubt, from conversing with you and worshipping you.

6.3.s:
āraṇyāni ca śākāni phalānyāraṇyajāni ca .
tāni dāsyāmi yuṣmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ prītipūrvakam .. 97.96 ..
6.3.d:
आरण्यानि च शाकानि फलान्यारण्यजानि च .
तानि दास्यामि युष्माकं सर्वेषां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् .. 97.96 ..
6.3.m: Wild greens and fruits grown in the forest— / those I will give to all of you with affection."

6.3.s:
nyamantrayata tānsarvānpratyekaṃ praṇipatya ca .
tataste praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ munim .. 97.97 ..
6.3.d:
न्यमन्त्रयत तान्सर्वान्प्रत्येकं प्रणिपत्य च .
ततस्ते प्रणतं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णद्वैपायनं मुनिम् .. 97.97 ..
6.3.m: Having bowed down to each one, he invited them all. / Then they, seeing the sage Kṛṣṇa Dvaipāyana bowed down,

6.3.s:
vardhayitvā jayāśīrbhiravalokya parasparam .
parāśaraḥ samastaiśca vīkṣito munipuṃgavaiḥ .. 97.98 ..
6.3.d:
वर्धयित्वा जयाशीर्भिरवलोक्य परस्परम् .
पराशरः समस्तैश्च वीक्षितो मुनिपुंगवैः .. 97.98 ..
6.3.m: Having cheered him with blessings of victory, and looking at one another, / Parāśara was looked upon by all the foremost sages.

6.3.s:
uttaraṃ dīyatāṃ tāta kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca .
evamuktastu taiḥ sarvairbhagavānsa parāśaraḥ .
provāca svātmajaṃ vyāsamṛṣīṇāṃ yaccikīrṣitam .. 97.99 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तरं दीयतां तात कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य च .
एवमुक्तस्तु तैः सर्वैर्भगवान्स पराशरः .
प्रोवाच स्वात्मजं व्यासमृषीणां यच्चिकीर्षितम् .. 97.99 ..
6.3.m: "Father, let an answer be given to Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana." / Thus spoken to by all of them, the blessed Parāśara / declared to his son Vyāsa what the seers wished to do:

6.3.s:
śrīparāśara uvāca -
necchanti dakṣiṇe kūle vratabhaṅgabhayādatha .
bhojanaṃ bhoktukāmāste śrāddhe caiva viśeṣataḥ .. 97.100 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीपराशर उवाच -
नेच्छन्ति दक्षिणे कूले व्रतभङ्गभयादथ .
भोजनं भोक्तुकामास्ते श्राद्धे चैव विशेषतः .. 97.100 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Parāśara said: / "They do not wish [to eat] on the southern bank, out of fear of breaking their vow; / yet they desire to partake of food, especially in a śrāddha."

6.3.s:
vyāsa uvāca -
karomi bhavatāmuktamatraiva sthīyatāṃ kṣaṇam .
yāvatprasādya saritaṃ karomi vidhimuttamam .. 97.101 ..
6.3.d:
व्यास उवाच -
करोमि भवतामुक्तमत्रैव स्थीयतां क्षणम् .
यावत्प्रसाद्य सरितं करोमि विधिमुत्तमम् .. 97.101 ..
6.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "I shall do as you have spoken; stay right here for a moment, / while, having propitiated the river, I perform the highest rite."

6.3.s:
evamuktvā śucirbhūtvā narmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ .
stotraṃ jagāda sahasā tannibodha nareśvara .. 97.102 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा नर्मदातटमास्थितः .
स्तोत्रं जगाद सहसा तन्निबोध नरेश्वर .. 97.102 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus and become pure, stationed on the bank of the Narmadā, / he straightway recited a hymn of praise; listen to that, O lord of men:

6.3.s:
jaya bhagavati devi namo varade jaya pāpavināśinī bahuphalade .
jaya śumbhaniśumbhakapāladhare praṇamāmi tu devanarārtihare .. 97.103 ..
6.3.d:
जय भगवति देवि नमो वरदे जय पापविनाशिनी बहुफलदे .
जय शुम्भनिशुम्भकपालधरे प्रणमामि तु देवनरार्तिहरे .. 97.103 ..
6.3.m: "Victory, O blessed goddess, homage, O giver of boons! Victory, O destroyer of sin, bestower of abundant fruit! / Victory, O bearer of the skulls of Śumbha and Niśumbha! I bow to you who remove the distress of gods and men!

6.3.s:
jaya candradivākaranetradhare jaya pāvakabhūṣitavaktravare .
jaya bhairavadehanilīnapare jaya andhakaraktaviśoṣakare .. 97.104 ..
6.3.d:
जय चन्द्रदिवाकरनेत्रधरे जय पावकभूषितवक्त्रवरे .
जय भैरवदेहनिलीनपरे जय अन्धकरक्तविशोषकरे .. 97.104 ..
6.3.m: Victory, O you whose eyes are the moon and the sun! Victory, O you whose excellent face is adorned with fire! / Victory, O supreme one absorbed in the body of Bhairava! Victory, O dryer of the blood of Andhaka!

6.3.s:
jaya mahiṣavimardini śūlakare jaya lokasamastakapāpahare .
jaya devi pitāmaharāmanate jaya bhāskaraśakraśiro'vanate .. 97.105 ..
6.3.d:
जय महिषविमर्दिनि शूलकरे जय लोकसमस्तकपापहरे .
जय देवि पितामहरामनते जय भास्करशक्रशिरोऽवनते .. 97.105 ..
6.3.m: Victory, O crusher of Mahiṣa, bearer of the trident! Victory, O remover of the sins of the entire world! / Victory, O goddess revered by the Grandfather and Rāma! Victory, O you before whom the heads of the Sun and Śakra bow down!

6.3.s:
jaya ṣaṇmukhasāyudha īśanute jaya sāgaragāmini śambhunute .
jaya duḥkhadaridravināśakare jaya putrakalatravivṛddhikare .. 97.106 ..
6.3.d:
जय षण्मुखसायुध ईशनुते जय सागरगामिनि शम्भुनुते .
जय दुःखदरिद्रविनाशकरे जय पुत्रकलत्रविवृद्धिकरे .. 97.106 ..
6.3.m: Victory, O weapon-bearing mother of the six-faced one, praised by the Lord! Victory, O river flowing to the ocean, praised by Śambhu! / Victory, O destroyer of misery and poverty! Victory, O increaser of sons and wives!

6.3.s:
jaya devi samastaśarīradhare jaya nākavidarśini duḥkhahare .
jaya vyādhivināśini mokṣakare jaya vāñchitadāyini siddhavare .. 97.107 ..
6.3.d:
जय देवि समस्तशरीरधरे जय नाकविदर्शिनि दुःखहरे .
जय व्याधिविनाशिनि मोक्षकरे जय वाञ्छितदायिनि सिद्धवरे .. 97.107 ..
6.3.m: Victory, O goddess who wear all bodies! Victory, O revealer of heaven, remover of grief! / Victory, O destroyer of diseases, bestower of liberation! Victory, O giver of desires, supreme among the perfected!"

6.3.s:
etadvyāsakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchivasannidhau .
gṛhe vā śuddhabhāvena kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ .. 97.108 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्व्यासकृतं स्तोत्रं यः पठेच्छिवसन्निधौ .
गृहे वा शुद्धभावेन कामक्रोधविवर्जितः .. 97.108 ..
6.3.m: Whoever recites this hymn composed by Vyāsa in the presence of Śiva / or at home, with a pure disposition, free from desire and anger,

6.3.s:
tasya vyāso bhavetprītaḥ prītaśca vṛṣavāhanaḥ .
prītā syānnarmadā devī sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarī .. 97.109 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य व्यासो भवेत्प्रीतः प्रीतश्च वृषवाहनः .
प्रीता स्यान्नर्मदा देवी सर्वपापक्षयंकरी .. 97.109 ..
6.3.m: to him Vyāsa will be pleased, and pleased will be the one who rides the bull; / pleased will be goddess Narmadā, who brings about the destruction of all sins.

6.3.s:
na te yānti yamālokaṃ yaiḥ stutā bhuvi narmadā .
pitāmaho'pi muhyeta devi tvadguṇakīrtanāt .. 97.110 ..
6.3.d:
न ते यान्ति यमालोकं यैः स्तुता भुवि नर्मदा .
पितामहोऽपि मुह्येत देवि त्वद्गुणकीर्तनात् .. 97.110 ..
6.3.m: Those by whom Narmadā is praised on earth do not go to the realm of Yama. / Even the Grandfather would be bewildered in recounting your qualities, O goddess;

6.3.s:
vākpatirnaiva te vaktuṃ svarūpaṃ veda narmade .
kathaṃ guṇānahaṃ devi tvadīyāñjñātumutsahe .. 97.111 ..
6.3.d:
वाक्पतिर्नैव ते वक्तुं स्वरूपं वेद नर्मदे .
कथं गुणानहं देवि त्वदीयाञ्ज्ञातुमुत्सहे .. 97.111 ..
6.3.m: even the Lord of Speech does not know how to describe your true nature, O Narmadā. / How, O goddess, can I presume to know your qualities?

6.3.s:
iti jñātvā śuciṃ bhāvaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ .
prasannā narmadādevī tato vacanamabravīt .. 97.112 ..
6.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा शुचिं भावं वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः .
प्रसन्ना नर्मदादेवी ततो वचनमब्रवीत् .. 97.112 ..
6.3.m: Perceiving thus his pure devotion in word, mind, and bodily actions, / goddess Narmadā, pleased, then spoke these words:

6.3.s:
satyavādena tuṣṭāhaṃ bhobho vyāsa mahāmune .
yadīcchasi varaṃ kiṃcittaṃ te sarvaṃ dadāmyaham .. 97.113 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यवादेन तुष्टाहं भोभो व्यास महामुने .
यदीच्छसि वरं किंचित्तं ते सर्वं ददाम्यहम् .. 97.113 ..
6.3.m: "I am pleased by your truthful speech, O Vyāsa, O great sage! / Whatever boon you desire, I shall grant it all to you."

6.3.s:
vyāsa uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi yadi deyo varo mama .
ātithyamuttare kūle ṛṣīṇāṃ dātumarhasi .. 97.114 ..
6.3.d:
व्यास उवाच -
यदि तुष्टासि मे देवि यदि देयो वरो मम .
आतिथ्यमुत्तरे कूले ऋषीणां दातुमर्हसि .. 97.114 ..
6.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "If you are pleased with me, O goddess, if a boon is to be granted to me, / you ought to grant hospitality to the seers on the northern bank."

6.3.s:
narmadovāca -
ayuktaṃ yācitaṃ vyāsa vimārge yatpravartanam .
indracandrayamaiḥ śakyamunmārge na pravartitum .. 97.115 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदोवाच -
अयुक्तं याचितं व्यास विमार्गे यत्प्रवर्तनम् .
इन्द्रचन्द्रयमैः शक्यमुन्मार्गे न प्रवर्तितुम् .. 97.115 ..
6.3.m: Narmadā said: / "An improper thing has been asked, O Vyāsa: to proceed on a wrong course. / Even Indra, the Moon, and Yama are not able to proceed on an improper path.

6.3.s:
yācasvānyaṃ varaṃ putra yatkiṃcidbhuvi durlabham .
etacchrutvā vaco devyā vyāso mūrcchāṃ yatastadā .. 97.116 ..
6.3.d:
याचस्वान्यं वरं पुत्र यत्किंचिद्भुवि दुर्लभम् .
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो देव्या व्यासो मूर्च्छां यतस्तदा .. 97.116 ..
6.3.m: Ask for another boon, O son, whatever is difficult to obtain on earth." / Hearing these words of the goddess, Vyāsa then fell into a swoon.

6.3.s:
vṛthā kleśo'dya me jāta iti matvā papāta ha .
dharaṇī calitā sarvā saśailavanakānanā .. 97.117 ..
6.3.d:
वृथा क्लेशोऽद्य मे जात इति मत्वा पपात ह .
धरणी चलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना .. 97.117 ..
6.3.m: Thinking, "In vain has my toil been today," he collapsed. / The entire earth shook, together with its mountains and forests.

6.3.s:
mūrcchāpannaṃ tato vyāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ .
hāhākāramukhāḥ sarve tatrājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ .. 97.118 ..
6.3.d:
मूर्च्छापन्नं ततो व्यासं दृष्ट्वा देवाः सवासवाः .
हाहाकारमुखाः सर्वे तत्राजग्मुः सहस्रशः .. 97.118 ..
6.3.m: Then, seeing Vyāsa fallen into a swoon, the gods led by Vāsava, / their faces uttering cries of grief, came there by the thousands.

6.3.s:
vyāsamutthāpayāmāsurvedavyasanatatparam .
brāhmaṇārthe ca saṃkliṣṭo nātmahetoḥ saridvare .. 97.119 ..
6.3.d:
व्यासमुत्थापयामासुर्वेदव्यसनतत्परम् .
ब्राह्मणार्थे च संक्लिष्टो नात्महेतोः सरिद्वरे .. 97.119 ..
6.3.m: They revived Vyāsa, who was devoted to the toil of the Vedas. / "He is distressed for the sake of brahmins, not for his own sake, O best of rivers!

6.3.s:
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca sadyaḥ prāṇānparityajet .
evaṃ sā narmadā proktā brahmādyaiḥ surasattamaiḥ .. 97.120 ..
6.3.d:
गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे च सद्यः प्राणान्परित्यजेत् .
एवं सा नर्मदा प्रोक्ता ब्रह्माद्यैः सुरसत्तमैः .. 97.120 ..
6.3.m: For the sake of cows and for the sake of brahmins, one should immediately abandon one's life." / Thus was Narmadā addressed by Brahmā and the foremost gods.

6.3.s:
suśītalaistaṃ bahubhiśca vātairrevābhyaṣiñcatsvajalena bhītā .
sacetanaḥ satyavatīsuto'pi praṇamya devānsaritaṃ jagāda .. 97.121 ..
6.3.d:
सुशीतलैस्तं बहुभिश्च वातैर्रेवाभ्यषिञ्चत्स्वजलेन भीता .
सचेतनः सत्यवतीसुतोऽपि प्रणम्य देवान्सरितं जगाद .. 97.121 ..
6.3.m: Frightened, Revā sprinkled him with very cool breezes and her own water. / Regaining consciousness, the son of Satyavatī bowed to the gods and spoke to the river:

6.3.s:
vyāsa uvāca -
tīrthaiḥ samastaiḥ kila sevanāya phalaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ mama mandabhāgyāt .
yaddevi puṇyā viphalā mamāśā āraṇyapuṣpāṇi yathā janānām .. 97.122 ..
6.3.d:
व्यास उवाच -
तीर्थैः समस्तैः किल सेवनाय फलं प्रदिष्टं मम मन्दभाग्यात् .
यद्देवि पुण्या विफला ममाशा आरण्यपुष्पाणि यथा जनानाम् .. 97.122 ..
6.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "The fruit to be served by all sacred fords was promised to me; but through my ill fortune, / O goddess, holy one, my hopes have become futile, like forest flowers for men!"

6.3.s:
narmadovāca -
yato yato māṃ hi mahānubhāva ninīṣate cittamilātale'tra .
vindhyena sārddhaṃ tava mārgamadya yāsyāmyahaṃ daṇḍadharasya pṛṣṭhe .. 97.123 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदोवाच -
यतो यतो मां हि महानुभाव निनीषते चित्तमिलातलेऽत्र .
विन्ध्येन सार्द्धं तव मार्गमद्य यास्याम्यहं दण्डधरस्य पृष्ठे .. 97.123 ..
6.3.m: Narmadā said: / "Wherever your mind wishes to lead me on the surface of this earth, O noble one, / along with the Vindhya, I will go today on your path, behind you who carry the staff."

6.3.s:
evamukto mahātejā vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ .
dakṣiṇe cālayāmāsa svāśramasya saridvarām .. 97.124 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः .
दक्षिणे चालयामास स्वाश्रमस्य सरिद्वराम् .. 97.124 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed, the son of Satyavatī, Vyāsa of great splendour, / caused the best of rivers to move to the south of his hermitage.

6.3.s:
daṇḍahasto mahātejā huṅkāramakaronmuniḥ .
vyāsahuṅkārabhītā sā calitā rudranandinī .. 97.125 ..
6.3.d:
दण्डहस्तो महातेजा हुङ्कारमकरोन्मुनिः .
व्यासहुङ्कारभीता सा चलिता रुद्रनन्दिनी .. 97.125 ..
6.3.m: Staff in hand, the sage of great splendour uttered a roar of "huṃ". / Terrified by the roar of Vyāsa, the daughter of Rudra moved.

6.3.s:
daṇḍena darśayanmārgaṃ devī tatra pravartitā .
vyāsamārgaṃ gatā devī dṛṣṭā śakrapurogamaiḥ .. 97.126 ..
6.3.d:
दण्डेन दर्शयन्मार्गं देवी तत्र प्रवर्तिता .
व्यासमार्गं गता देवी दृष्टा शक्रपुरोगमैः .. 97.126 ..
6.3.m: Showing the path with his staff, the goddess was set in motion there. / Following the path of Vyāsa, the goddess was seen by the gods led by Śakra.

6.3.s:
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ tato devā vyamuñcan saha kiṃkaraiḥ .
kiṃ kurmo brūhi me putra karmaṇā te sma rañjitāḥ .. 97.127 ..
6.3.d:
पुष्पवृष्टिं ततो देवा व्यमुञ्चन् सह किंकरैः .
किं कुर्मो ब्रूहि मे पुत्र कर्मणा ते स्म रञ्जिताः .. 97.127 ..
6.3.m: Then the gods together with their attendants released a shower of flowers: / "Tell us what we should do, O son; we are delighted by your deed."

6.3.s:
vyāsa uvāca -
tapaśca vipulaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dattvā mahāphalam .
etadeva naraiḥ kāryaṃ sādhūnāṃ yatsukhāvaham .. 97.128 ..
6.3.d:
व्यास उवाच -
तपश्च विपुलं कृत्वा दानं दत्त्वा महाफलम् .
एतदेव नरैः कार्यं साधूनां यत्सुखावहम् .. 97.128 ..
6.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "Having performed extensive austerity and given gifts of great fruit, / this alone should be done by men: that which brings happiness to good people.

6.3.s:
yadi tuṣṭā mahābhāgā anugrāhyo hyahaṃ yadi .
tasmānmamāśrame sarvaiḥ sthīyatāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 97.129 ..
6.3.d:
यदि तुष्टा महाभागा अनुग्राह्यो ह्यहं यदि .
तस्मान्ममाश्रमे सर्वैः स्थीयतां नात्र संशयः .. 97.129 ..
6.3.m: If you noble ones are pleased, if indeed I am to be favoured, / then let everyone remain in my hermitage; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
ātithyaṃ śākaparṇena revāmṛtavimiśritam .
pratipannaṃ samastairvaḥ parāśaramukhairmama .
sthātavyaṃ svāśrame sarvairrevāyā uttare taṭe .. 97.130 ..
6.3.d:
आतिथ्यं शाकपर्णेन रेवामृतविमिश्रितम् .
प्रतिपन्नं समस्तैर्वः पराशरमुखैर्मम .
स्थातव्यं स्वाश्रमे सर्वैर्रेवाया उत्तरे तटे .. 97.130 ..
6.3.m: Hospitality consisting of vegetables and leaves mixed with the nectar of Revā / has been accepted by all of you, headed by Parāśara; / you all must remain in my hermitage on the northern bank of Revā."

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
snānatarpaṇanityāni kṛtāni dvijasattamaiḥ .
vyāsakuṇḍe tato gatvā homaḥ sarvaiḥ prakalpitaḥ .. 97.131 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
स्नानतर्पणनित्यानि कृतानि द्विजसत्तमैः .
व्यासकुण्डे ततो गत्वा होमः सर्वैः प्रकल्पितः .. 97.131 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The daily rites of ritual ablution and libation were performed by the best of the twice-born. / Then, having gone to Vyāsakuṇḍa, a fire sacrifice was prepared by all.

6.3.s:
śrīphalairbilvapatraiśca juhuvurjātavedasam .
gautamo bhṛgurmāṇḍavyo nārado lomaśastathā .. 97.132 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीफलैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च जुहुवुर्जातवेदसम् .
गौतमो भृगुर्माण्डव्यो नारदो लोमशस्तथा .. 97.132 ..
6.3.m: With bilva fruits and bilva leaves, they made offerings into the fire: / Gautama, Bhṛgu, Māṇḍavya, Nārada, and Lomaśa,

6.3.s:
parāśarastathā śaṅkhaḥ kauśikaścyavano muniḥ .
pippalādo vasiṣṭhaśca nāciketo mahātapāḥ .. 97.133 ..
6.3.d:
पराशरस्तथा शङ्खः कौशिकश्च्यवनो मुनिः .
पिप्पलादो वसिष्ठश्च नाचिकेतो महातपाः .. 97.133 ..
6.3.m: Parāśara, Śaṅkha, Kauśika, the sage Cyavana, / Pippalāda, Vasiṣṭha, and Nāciketa of great austerity,

6.3.s:
viśvāmitro'pyagastyaśca uddālakayamau tathā .
śāṇḍilyo jaiminiḥ kaṇvo yājñavalkyośano'ṅgirāḥ .. 97.134 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वामित्रोऽप्यगस्त्यश्च उद्दालकयमौ तथा .
शाण्डिल्यो जैमिनिः कण्वो याज्ञवल्क्योशनोऽङ्गिराः .. 97.134 ..
6.3.m: Viśvāmitra, Agastya, Uddālaka, and Yama, / Śāṇḍilya, Jaimini, Kaṇva, Yājñavalkya, Uśanas, Aṅgiras,

6.3.s:
śātātapo dadhīciśca kapilo gālavastathā .
jaigīṣavyastathā dakṣo bharato mudgalastathā .. 97.135 ..
6.3.d:
शातातपो दधीचिश्च कपिलो गालवस्तथा .
जैगीषव्यस्तथा दक्षो भरतो मुद्गलस्तथा .. 97.135 ..
6.3.m: Śātātapa, Dadhīci, Kapila, Gālava, / Jaigīṣavya, Dakṣa, Bharata, Mudgala,

6.3.s:
vātsyāyano mahātejāḥ saṃvartaḥ śaktireva ca .
jātūkarṇyo bharadvājo vālakhilyāruṇistathā .. 97.136 ..
6.3.d:
वात्स्यायनो महातेजाः संवर्तः शक्तिरेव च .
जातूकर्ण्यो भरद्वाजो वालखिल्यारुणिस्तथा .. 97.136 ..
6.3.m: Vātsyāyana of great splendour, Saṃvarta, Śakti, / Jātūkarṇya, Bharadvāja, the Vālakhilyas, and Āruṇi.

6.3.s:
evamādisahasrāṇi juhvate jātavedasam .
akṣamālākarotkīrṇā dhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ .. 97.137 ..
6.3.d:
एवमादिसहस्राणि जुह्वते जातवेदसम् .
अक्षमालाकरोत्कीर्णा ध्यानयोगपरायणाः .. 97.137 ..
6.3.m: Thousands of such [sages] offered oblations into the fire, / their hands busy with rosaries, devoted to meditation and yoga.

6.3.s:
ekacittā dvijāḥ sarve cakrurhomakriyāṃ tadā .
tataḥ samutthitaṃ liṅgaṃ mokṣadaṃ vyādhināśanam .. 97.138 ..
6.3.d:
एकचित्ता द्विजाः सर्वे चक्रुर्होमक्रियां तदा .
ततः समुत्थितं लिङ्गं मोक्षदं व्याधिनाशनम् .. 97.138 ..
6.3.m: With single-minded focus all the brahmins then performed the oblation ritual. / Thereupon arose a liṅga that bestows liberation and destroys diseases.

6.3.s:
acchedyaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāsastutoṣa ca .
puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ dadurdevā āśīrvādāndvijottamāḥ .. 97.139 ..
6.3.d:
अच्छेद्यं परमं देवं दृष्ट्वा व्यासस्तुतोष च .
पुष्पवृष्टिं ददुर्देवा आशीर्वादान्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 97.139 ..
6.3.m: Beholding that indivisible, supreme God, Vyāsa was delighted; / the gods showered blossoms, and the best of brahmins gave blessings.

6.3.s:
sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato vyāso devaṃ dṛṣṭvā trilocanam .
brāhmaṇānpūjayāmāsa śākamūlaphalena ca .. 97.140 ..
6.3.d:
साष्टाङ्गं प्रणतो व्यासो देवं दृष्ट्वा त्रिलोचनम् .
ब्राह्मणान्पूजयामास शाकमूलफलेन च .. 97.140 ..
6.3.m: Bowing with all eight limbs upon seeing the three-eyed God, / Vyāsa honored the brahmins with vegetables, roots, and fruits.

6.3.s:
pitṛpūrvaṃ dvijāḥ sarve bhojitāḥ pāṇḍunandana .
āśīrvādāṃstataḥ puṇyān dattvā viprā yayuḥ punaḥ .. 97.141 ..
6.3.d:
पितृपूर्वं द्विजाः सर्वे भोजिताः पाण्डुनन्दन .
आशीर्वादांस्ततः पुण्यान् दत्त्वा विप्रा ययुः पुनः .. 97.141 ..
6.3.m: Preceded by offerings to the ancestors, all the brahmins were fed, O son of Pāṇḍu; / having then bestowed sacred blessings, the brahmins departed again.

6.3.s: tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ vyāsākhyaṃ procyate budhaiḥ .. 97.142 ..
6.3.d: तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं व्यासाख्यं प्रोच्यते बुधैः .. 97.142 ..
6.3.m: From that time forth, that sacred ford is called Vyāsa by the wise.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
vyāsatīrthasya yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me .
snānadānavidhānaṃ ca yasminkāle mahāphalam .. 97.143 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
व्यासतीर्थस्य यत्पुण्यं तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे .
स्नानदानविधानं च यस्मिन्काले महाफलम् .. 97.143 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me all the merit of Vyāsatīrtha, / and the rule of ritual ablution and gift-giving, and at what time it yields great fruit.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
kathayāmi samastaṃ te bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍava .
kārttikasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ jitendriyaḥ .. 97.144 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
कथयामि समस्तं ते भ्रातृभिः सह पाण्डव .
कार्त्तिकस्य सिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां जितेन्द्रियः .. 97.144 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / I shall tell it all to you and your brothers, O Pāṇḍava. / On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, with restrained senses,

6.3.s:
upoṣya yo naro bhaktyā rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .
snāpayedīśvaraṃ bhaktyā kṣaudrakṣīreṇa sarpiṣā .. 97.145 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्य यो नरो भक्त्या रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .
स्नापयेदीश्वरं भक्त्या क्षौद्रक्षीरेण सर्पिषा .. 97.145 ..
6.3.m: the person who fasts and keeps vigil with devotion through the night, / should bathe Īśvara with devotion using honey, milk, and ghee,

6.3.s:
dadhnā ca khaṇḍayuktena kuśatoyena vai punaḥ .
śrīkhaṇḍena sugandhena guṇṭhayetparameśvaram .. 97.146 ..
6.3.d:
दध्ना च खण्डयुक्तेन कुशतोयेन वै पुनः .
श्रीखण्डेन सुगन्धेन गुण्ठयेत्परमेश्वरम् .. 97.146 ..
6.3.m: and with curds mixed with sugar, and also with kuśa-water; / then one should smear the Supreme Lord with fragrant sandalwood.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sugandhakusumairbilvapatraiśca pūjayet .
mucukundena kundena kuśajātīprasūnakaiḥ .. 97.147 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सुगन्धकुसुमैर्बिल्वपत्रैश्च पूजयेत् .
मुचुकुन्देन कुन्देन कुशजातीप्रसूनकैः .. 97.147 ..
6.3.m: Then one should worship him with fragrant flowers and bilva leaves, / with mucukunda, kunda, and blossoms of kuśa and jasmine,

6.3.s:
unmattamunipuṣpaiśca tathānyaiḥ kālasambhavaiḥ .
arcayetparayā bhaktyā dvīpeśvaramanuttamam .. 97.148 ..
6.3.d:
उन्मत्तमुनिपुष्पैश्च तथान्यैः कालसम्भवैः .
अर्चयेत्परया भक्त्या द्वीपेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .. 97.148 ..
6.3.m: and with datura and munipuṣpa flowers, as well as others that bloom in that season. / With supreme devotion, one should worship the unexcelled Dvīpeśvara.

6.3.s:
ikṣugaḍukadānena tuṣyate parameśvaraḥ .
gaḍukāṣṭakadānena pātakaṃ yātyahorjitam .. 97.149 ..
6.3.d:
इक्षुगडुकदानेन तुष्यते परमेश्वरः .
गडुकाष्टकदानेन पातकं यात्यहोर्जितम् .. 97.149 ..
6.3.m: By the offering of an earthen vessel of sugarcane juice, the Supreme Lord is pleased; / by the gift of eight vessels, sin accumulated in a single day departs.

6.3.s:
māsarjitaṃ ca naśyeta gaḍukāṣṭaśatena ca .
ṣāṇmāsikaṃ sahasreṇa dviguṇairabdikaṃ tathā .. 97.150 ..
6.3.d:
मासर्जितं च नश्येत गडुकाष्टशतेन च .
षाण्मासिकं सहस्रेण द्विगुणैरब्दिकं तथा .. 97.150 ..
6.3.m: What was accumulated in a month is destroyed by one hundred and eight vessels; / that of six months by a thousand, and likewise of a year by twice that amount.

6.3.s:
ājanmajanitaṃ pāpamayutena praṇaśyati .
dviguṇairnaśyate vyādhistriguṇaiḥ syāddhanāgamaḥ .. 97.151 ..
6.3.d:
आजन्मजनितं पापमयुतेन प्रणश्यति .
द्विगुणैर्नश्यते व्याधिस्त्रिगुणैः स्याद्धनागमः .. 97.151 ..
6.3.m: Sin incurred since birth is destroyed by ten thousand; / by twice that, disease is destroyed, and by three times that, wealth accrues.

6.3.s:
ṣaḍguṇairjāyate vāgmī siddhastaddviguṇaistathā .
rudratvaṃ daśalakṣaiśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 97.152 ..
6.3.d:
षड्गुणैर्जायते वाग्मी सिद्धस्तद्द्विगुणैस्तथा .
रुद्रत्वं दशलक्षैश्च जायते नात्र संशयः .. 97.152 ..
6.3.m: By six times that, one becomes an eloquent speaker; by twice that, an adept; / and by ten hundred thousand, Rudra-hood is attained—of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ .
mantroktena vidhānena sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 97.153 ..
6.3.d:
पौर्णमास्यां नृपश्रेष्ठ स्नानं कुर्वीत भक्तितः .
मन्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 97.153 ..
6.3.m: On the full moon day, O best of kings, one should perform ritual ablution with devotion / according to the procedure prescribed by mantras, destroying all sins,

6.3.s:
vāruṇaṃ ca tathāgneyaṃ brāhmayaṃ caivākṣayaṃkaram .
devānpitḥnmanuṣyāṃśca vidhivattarpayedbudhaḥ .. 97.154 ..
6.3.d:
वारुणं च तथाग्नेयं ब्राह्मयं चैवाक्षयंकरम् .
देवान्पित्ःन्मनुष्यांश्च विधिवत्तर्पयेद्बुधः .. 97.154 ..
6.3.m: and also the ablution sacred to Varuṇa, to Agni, and to Brahmā, which yields imperishable fruit. / The wise person should make libations to gods, ancestors, and human beings in accordance with rule.

6.3.s:
ṛcā ṛgvedajaṃ puṇyaṃ sāmnā sāmaphalaṃ labhet .
yajurvedasya yajuṣā gāyatryā sarvamāpnuyāt .. 97.155 ..
6.3.d:
ऋचा ऋग्वेदजं पुण्यं साम्ना सामफलं लभेत् .
यजुर्वेदस्य यजुषा गायत्र्या सर्वमाप्नुयात् .. 97.155 ..
6.3.m: With a Ṛg verse, one gains the merit born of the Ṛgveda; with a Sāman, the fruit of the Sāmaveda; / with a Yajus, that of the Yajurveda; and with the Gāyatrī, one attains everything.

6.3.s:
akṣaraṃ ca japenmantraṃ sauraṃ vā śivadaivatam .
athavā vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ dvādaśākṣarasaṃjñitam .. 97.156 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षरं च जपेन्मन्त्रं सौरं वा शिवदैवतम् .
अथवा वैष्णवं मन्त्रं द्वादशाक्षरसंज्ञितम् .. 97.156 ..
6.3.m: And one should recite the monosyllabic mantra, or one sacred to the Sun or to Śiva, / or the Vaiṣṇava mantra known as the twelve-syllabled one.

6.3.s:
pūjayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitān .
svadāraniratānviprāndambhalobhavivarjitān .. 97.157 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या सर्वलक्षणलक्षितान् .
स्वदारनिरतान्विप्रान्दम्भलोभविवर्जितान् .. 97.157 ..
6.3.m: With devotion one should honor brahmins endowed with all auspicious marks, / brahmins devoted to their own wives and free from deceit and greed.

6.3.s:
bhinnavṛttikarān pāpān patitāñchūdrasevanān .
śūdrīgrahaṇasaṃyuktānvṛṣalī yasya mandire .. 97.158 ..
6.3.d:
भिन्नवृत्तिकरान् पापान् पतिताञ्छूद्रसेवनान् .
शूद्रीग्रहणसंयुक्तान्वृषली यस्य मन्दिरे .. 97.158 ..
6.3.m: Those who follow a divergent way of life, sinful, fallen, in service of Śūdras, / married to a Śūdra woman, in whose house dwells a low-caste woman,

6.3.s:
parokṣavādino duṣṭāngurunindāparāyaṇān .
vedadveṣaṇaśīlāṃśca haitukān bakavṛttikān .. 97.159 ..
6.3.d:
परोक्षवादिनो दुष्टान्गुरुनिन्दापरायणान् .
वेदद्वेषणशीलांश्च हैतुकान् बकवृत्तिकान् .. 97.159 ..
6.3.m: slanderers, wicked, intent on reviling their teachers, / prone to hating the Vedas, rationalists, and hypocrites—

6.3.s:
īdṛśānvarjayecchrāddhe dāne sarvavrateṣu ca .
gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ .. 97.160 ..
6.3.d:
ईदृशान्वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धे दाने सर्वव्रतेषु च .
गायत्रीसारमात्रोऽपि वरं विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः .. 97.160 ..
6.3.m: such as these one should avoid in ancestral rites, gift-giving, and in all observances. / Even one who merely knows the essence of the Gāyatrī, if well-restrained, is preferable as a brahmin;

6.3.s:
nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī .
īdṛśānpūjayedviprānannadānahiraṇyataḥ .. 97.161 ..
6.3.d:
नायन्त्रितश्चतुर्वेदी सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी .
ईदृशान्पूजयेद्विप्रानन्नदानहिरण्यतः .. 97.161 ..
6.3.m: not an unrestrained knower of the four Vedas who eats everything and sells everything. / One should honor such [virtuous] brahmins with gifts of food and gold.

6.3.s:
upānahau ca vastrāṇi śayyāṃ chatramathāsanam .
yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe bhaktyā so'pi svarge mahīyate .. 97.162 ..
6.3.d:
उपानहौ च वस्त्राणि शय्यां छत्रमथासनम् .
यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणे भक्त्या सोऽपि स्वर्गे महीयते .. 97.162 ..
6.3.m: A pair of sandals, clothes, a bed, an umbrella, or a seat— / whoever gives these to a brahmin with devotion is honored in heaven.

6.3.s:
pratyakṣā surabhī tatra jaladhenustathāghṛtā .
tiladhenuḥ pradātavyā mahiṣyaśca tathaiva ca .. 97.163 ..
6.3.d:
प्रत्यक्षा सुरभी तत्र जलधेनुस्तथाघृता .
तिलधेनुः प्रदातव्या महिष्यश्च तथैव च .. 97.163 ..
6.3.m: A real milch cow, or one made of water, and likewise one of ghee, / or a cow made of sesame seeds should be given there, and likewise female buffaloes.

6.3.s:
kṛṣṇājinapradātā yo dātā yastilasarpiṣoḥ .
kanyāpustakayordātā so'kṣayaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 97.164 ..
6.3.d:
कृष्णाजिनप्रदाता यो दाता यस्तिलसर्पिषोः .
कन्यापुस्तकयोर्दाता सोऽक्षयं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 97.164 ..
6.3.m: One who gives a black antelope skin, who gives sesame seeds and ghee, / or who gives a maiden or a manuscript, attains an imperishable world.

6.3.s:
dhūrvāhau khurasaṃyuktau dhānyopaskarasaṃyutau .
dāpayetsvargakāmastu iti me satyabhāṣitam .. 97.165 ..
6.3.d:
धूर्वाहौ खुरसंयुक्तौ धान्योपस्करसंयुतौ .
दापयेत्स्वर्गकामस्तु इति मे सत्यभाषितम् .. 97.165 ..
6.3.m: Desiring heaven, one should have two draft oxen given, with good hooves and equipped with grain— / this is spoken truly by me.

6.3.s:
sūtreṇa veṣṭayeddvīpamathavā jagatīṃ śubham .
mandiraṃ parayā bhaktyā parameśamathāpi vā .. 97.166 ..
6.3.d:
सूत्रेण वेष्टयेद्द्वीपमथवा जगतीं शुभम् .
मन्दिरं परया भक्त्या परमेशमथापि वा .. 97.166 ..
6.3.m: One should encircle the island with a thread, or the auspicious ground, / or the temple with supreme devotion, or the Supreme Lord.

6.3.s:
pradakṣiṇāṃ vidhānena yaḥ karotyatra mānavaḥ .
jambūplākṣāhvayau dvīpau śālmaliścāparo nṛpa .. 97.167 ..
6.3.d:
प्रदक्षिणां विधानेन यः करोत्यत्र मानवः .
जम्बूप्लाक्षाह्वयौ द्वीपौ शाल्मलिश्चापरो नृप .. 97.167 ..
6.3.m: The human being who performs circumambulation here in accordance with rule / [has encircled] the two islands called Jambū and Plakṣa, and the other, Śālmali, O king,

6.3.s:
kuśaḥ krauñcastathā kāśaḥ puṣkaraścaiva saptamaḥ .
saptasāgaraparyantā veṣṭitā tena bhārata .. 97.168 ..
6.3.d:
कुशः क्रौञ्चस्तथा काशः पुष्करश्चैव सप्तमः .
सप्तसागरपर्यन्ता वेष्टिता तेन भारत .. 97.168 ..
6.3.m: Kuśa, Krauñca, Kāśa, and Puṣkara as the seventh— / extending to the seven oceans, they have been encircled by him, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
dvīpeśvare mahārāja vṛṣotsargaṃ ca kārayet .
vṛṣeṇāruṇavarṇena māheśaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 97.169 ..
6.3.d:
द्वीपेश्वरे महाराज वृषोत्सर्गं च कारयेत् .
वृषेणारुणवर्णेन माहेशं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 97.169 ..
6.3.m: At Dvīpeśvara, O great king, one should also perform the release of a bull; / by means of a red-colored bull, one attains the realm of Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
yastu vai pāṇḍuro vaktre lalāṭe pādayostathā .
lāṅgūle yastu vai śubhraḥ sa vai nākasya darśakaḥ .. 97.170 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तु वै पाण्डुरो वक्त्रे ललाटे पादयोस्तथा .
लाङ्गूले यस्तु वै शुभ्रः स वै नाकस्य दर्शकः .. 97.170 ..
6.3.m: One that is pale white on the face, forehead, and feet, / and bright white on the tail, is indeed a shower of heaven.

6.3.s:
nīlo'yamīdṛśaḥ prokto yastu dvīpeśvare tyajet .
sa samāḥ romasaṃkhyātā nāke vasati bhārata .. 97.171 ..
6.3.d:
नीलोऽयमीदृशः प्रोक्तो यस्तु द्वीपेश्वरे त्यजेत् .
स समाः रोमसंख्याता नाके वसति भारत .. 97.171 ..
6.3.m: Such a one is called a blue bull; whoever releases it at Dvīpeśvara / dwells in heaven for as many years as the count of its hairs, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
sauraṃ ca śāṃkaraṃ lokaṃ vairañcaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ kramāt .
bhunakti svecchayā rājanvyāsatīrthaprabhāvataḥ .. 97.172 ..
6.3.d:
सौरं च शांकरं लोकं वैरञ्चं वैष्णवं क्रमात् .
भुनक्ति स्वेच्छया राजन्व्यासतीर्थप्रभावतः .. 97.172 ..
6.3.m: The realm of Sūrya, of Śaṃkara, of Brahmā, and of Viṣṇu in succession / he enjoys according to his wish, O king, by the power of Vyāsatīrtha.

6.3.s:
sapatnīkaṃ tato vipraṃ pūjayettatra bhaktitaḥ .
sitaraktāni vastrāṇi yo dadyādagrajanmane .. 97.173 ..
6.3.d:
सपत्नीकं ततो विप्रं पूजयेत्तत्र भक्तितः .
सितरक्तानि वस्त्राणि यो दद्यादग्रजन्मने .. 97.173 ..
6.3.m: Then one should honor a brahmin with his wife there with devotion; / whoever gives white and red garments to a brahmin,

6.3.s:
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yugmaṃ prīyatāṃ me jagadguruḥ .
nāsti viprasamo bandhuriha loke paratra ca .. 97.174 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं युग्मं प्रीयतां मे जगद्गुरुः .
नास्ति विप्रसमो बन्धुरिह लोके परत्र च .. 97.174 ..
6.3.m: having circumambulated the couple, [praying:] ‘May the teacher of the universe be pleased with me!’— / there is no kinsman equal to a brahmin in this world or in the next,

6.3.s:
yamaloke mahāghore patantaṃ yo'bhirakṣati .
itihāsapurāṇajñaṃ viṣṇubhaktaṃ jitendriyam .. 97.175 ..
6.3.d:
यमलोके महाघोरे पतन्तं योऽभिरक्षति .
इतिहासपुराणज्ञं विष्णुभक्तं जितेन्द्रियम् .. 97.175 ..
6.3.m: one who protects a person falling into the terrible realm of Yama. / One who knows the epics and Purāṇas, devoted to Viṣṇu, with senses restrained,

6.3.s:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā sāmagaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ .
dvīpeśvaraṃ ca ye bhaktyā saṃsmaranti gṛhe sthitāḥ .. 97.176 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या सामगं वा विशेषतः .
द्वीपेश्वरं च ये भक्त्या संस्मरन्ति गृहे स्थिताः .. 97.176 ..
6.3.m: one should worship with supreme devotion, or especially a chanter of the Sāmaveda. / And those who, remaining at home, remember Dvīpeśvara with devotion—

6.3.s:
na teṣāṃ jāyate śoko na hānirna ca duṣkṛtam .
prathamaṃ pūjayettatra liṅgaṃ siddheśvaraṃ tataḥ .. 97.177 ..
6.3.d:
न तेषां जायते शोको न हानिर्न च दुष्कृतम् .
प्रथमं पूजयेत्तत्र लिङ्गं सिद्धेश्वरं ततः .. 97.177 ..
6.3.m: to them comes no grief, no loss, and no wickedness. / First one should worship the liṅga there, and then Siddheśvara,

6.3.s:
yatra siddho mahābhāgo vyāsaḥ satyavatīsutaḥ .
asyaiva pūjanātsiddho dhārāsarpo mahāmatiḥ .. 97.178 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः .
अस्यैव पूजनात्सिद्धो धारासर्पो महामतिः .. 97.178 ..
6.3.m: where the illustrious Vyāsa, son of Satyavatī, attained perfection; / by the worship of this very [liṅga], the wise Dhārāsarpa became an adept.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti ca .
sūryalokamasau bhittvā prayāti śivasannidhau .. 97.179 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्प्राणत्यागं करोति च .
सूर्यलोकमसौ भित्त्वा प्रयाति शिवसन्निधौ .. 97.179 ..
6.3.m: Moreover, O king, whoever gives up his life at that sacred ford, / having pierced the realm of the sun, goes into the presence of Śiva.

6.3.s:
samāḥ sahasrāṇi ca sapta vai jale daśaikamagnau patane ca ṣoḍaśa .
mahāhave ṣaṣṭiraśīti gograhe hyanāśake bhārata cākṣayā gatiḥ .. 97.180 ..
6.3.d:
समाः सहस्राणि च सप्त वै जले दशैकमग्नौ पतने च षोडश .
महाहवे षष्टिरशीति गोग्रहे ह्यनाशके भारत चाक्षया गतिः .. 97.180 ..
6.3.m: Seven thousand years [in heaven] for dying in water; eleven in fire; sixteen for falling from a precipice; / sixty in a great battle; eighty in a cattle-raid; but for dying of starvation, O descendant of Bharata, there is an imperishable state. // 97.180

6.3.s:
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ .
vāyubhūtaṃ nirīkṣante hyāgacchantaṃ svagotrajam .. 97.181 ..
6.3.d:
पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः .
वायुभूतं निरीक्षन्ते ह्यागच्छन्तं स्वगोत्रजम् .. 97.181 ..
6.3.m: The father, grandfather, and likewise the great-grandfather / gaze upon their descendant born of their own gotra who has become wind and is approaching, [saying]: // 97.181

6.3.s:
asmadgotre'sti kaḥ putro yo no dadyāttilodakam .
kārttikyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa veśākhyāṃ vā tathaiva ca .. 97.182 ..
6.3.d:
अस्मद्गोत्रेऽस्ति कः पुत्रो यो नो दद्यात्तिलोदकम् .
कार्त्तिक्यां च विशेषेण वेशाख्यां वा तथैव च .. 97.182 ..
6.3.m: ‘Is there any son in our gotra who will offer us water with sesame seeds, / especially on the full moon of Kārttika, or likewise on the full moon of Vaiśākha? // 97.182

6.3.s:
svargatiṃ ca prayāsyāmastatra tīrthopasevanāt .
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dvīpeśvaramanuttamam .. 97.183 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्गतिं च प्रयास्यामस्तत्र तीर्थोपसेवनात् .
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं द्वीपेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .. 97.183 ..
6.3.m: And by resorting to that sacred ford, we shall attain the heavenly realm.’ / All this has been related to you concerning the unexcelled Dvīpeśvara. // 97.183

6.3.s:
yaḥ paṭhetparayā bhaktyā śṛṇuyāttadgato nṛpa .
so'pi pāpavinirmukto modate śivamandire .. 97.184 ..
6.3.d:
यः पठेत्परया भक्त्या शृणुयात्तद्गतो नृप .
सोऽपि पापविनिर्मुक्तो मोदते शिवमन्दिरे .. 97.184 ..
6.3.m: A person who reads this with supreme devotion or listens to it with focused mind, O king, / is also freed from sin and rejoices in the abode of Śiva. // 97.184

6.3.s:
ūṣaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ nirmitaṃ munipuṃgavaiḥ .
kāmapradaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha vyāsatīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 97.185 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vyāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
ऊषरं सर्वतीर्थानां निर्मितं मुनिपुंगवैः .
कामप्रदं नृपश्रेष्ठ व्यासतीर्थं न संशयः .. 97.185 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे व्यासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तनवतितमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
The best of sages fashioned an arid ground for all sacred fords; / Vyāsatīrtha, O best of kings, fulfills all desires without a doubt. // 97.185
Thus ends the ninety-seventh chapter, titled “Description of the Māhātmya of Vyāsatīrtha,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra prabhāseśvaramuttamam .
vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu svargasopānamuttamam .. 98.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र प्रभासेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु स्वर्गसोपानमुत्तमम् .. 98.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the excellent Prabhāseśvara, / renowned in the three worlds, the supreme stairway to heaven.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
prabhāsaṃ tāta me brūhi kathaṃ jātaṃ mahāphalam .
svargasopānadaṃ dṛśyaṃ saṃkṣepātkathayasva me .. 98.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
प्रभासं तात मे ब्रूहि कथं जातं महाफलम् .
स्वर्गसोपानदं दृश्यं संक्षेपात्कथयस्व मे .. 98.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me, father, how Prabhāsa became of great fruit, / visible as bestower of a stairway to heaven; tell me in brief.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
durbhagā ravipatnī ca prabhānāmeti viśrutā .
tayā cārādhitaḥ śambhurugreṇa tapasā purā .. 98.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
दुर्भगा रविपत्नी च प्रभानामेति विश्रुता .
तया चाराधितः शम्भुरुग्रेण तपसा पुरा .. 98.3 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The unloved wife of the Sun, renowned by the name Prabhā, / formerly worshipped Śambhu with severe austerity.

6.3.s:
vāyubhakṣā sthitā varṣaṃ varṣaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇā .
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ prabhāyāḥ pāṇḍunandana .. 98.4 ..
6.3.d:
वायुभक्षा स्थिता वर्षं वर्षं ध्यानपरायणा .
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः प्रभायाः पाण्डुनन्दन .. 98.4 ..
6.3.m: She remained for a year consuming only air, and for a year devoted to meditation. / Thereupon Mahādeva was pleased with Prabhā, O son of Pāṇḍu.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
kasmātsaṃkliśyase bāle kathyatāṃ yadvivakṣitam .
ahaṃ hi bhāskaro'pyeko nānātvaṃ naiva vidyate .. 98.5 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
कस्मात्संक्लिश्यसे बाले कथ्यतां यद्विवक्षितम् .
अहं हि भास्करोऽप्येको नानात्वं नैव विद्यते .. 98.5 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Why do you torment yourself, child? Let that which you wish to say be told. / Indeed, the Sun and I are one; diversity does not exist at all.

6.3.s:
prabhovāca -
nānyo devaḥ striyaḥ śambho vinā bhartrā kvacitprabho .
saguṇo nirguṇo vāpi dhanāḍhyo vāpyakiṃcanaḥ .. 98.6 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभोवाच -
नान्यो देवः स्त्रियः शम्भो विना भर्त्रा क्वचित्प्रभो .
सगुणो निर्गुणो वापि धनाढ्यो वाप्यकिंचनः .. 98.6 ..
6.3.m: Prabhā said: / For a woman there is no other god anywhere apart from her husband, O Śambhu, O Lord, / whether he has good qualities or lacks them, whether he is rich or destitute,

6.3.s:
priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartaiva daivatam .
durbhagatvena dagdhāhaṃ sakhīmadhye sureśvara .
bharttaryallabdhasaukhyāsmi tena kliśyāmyahaṃ bhṛśam .. 98.7 ..
6.3.d:
प्रियो वा यदि वा द्वेष्यः स्त्रीणां भर्तैव दैवतम् .
दुर्भगत्वेन दग्धाहं सखीमध्ये सुरेश्वर .
भर्त्तर्यल्लब्धसौख्यास्मि तेन क्लिश्याम्यहं भृशम् .. 98.7 ..
6.3.m: whether dear or hateful; a husband alone is the deity of women. / I am burnt by being unloved among my companions, O Lord of gods; / from my husband I have obtained little happiness, therefore I suffer intensely.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
vallabhā bhāskarasyaiva matprasādādbhaviṣyasi .. 98.8 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
वल्लभा भास्करस्यैव मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यसि .. 98.8 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / By my favor you will surely become the beloved of the Sun.

6.3.s:
pārvatyuvāca -
apramāṇaṃ bhavadvākyaṃ bhāskaro'pi kariṣyati .
vṛthā kleśo bhavedasyāḥ prabhāyāḥ parameśvara .. 98.9 ..
6.3.d:
पार्वत्युवाच -
अप्रमाणं भवद्वाक्यं भास्करोऽपि करिष्यति .
वृथा क्लेशो भवेदस्याः प्रभायाः परमेश्वर .. 98.9 ..
6.3.m: Pārvatī said: / Even the Sun might treat your word as unauthoritative. / In vain would be the torment of this Prabhā, O Supreme Lord.

6.3.s:
umāvākyānmaheśānadhyātastimiranāśanaḥ .
āgato gaganādbhānurnarmadottararodhasi .. 98.10 ..
6.3.d:
उमावाक्यान्महेशानध्यातस्तिमिरनाशनः .
आगतो गगनाद्भानुर्नर्मदोत्तररोधसि .. 98.10 ..
6.3.m: Upon Umā’s word, Maheśāna meditated upon the Dispeller of Darkness. / The Sun came from the sky to the northern bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
bhānuruvāca -
āhūto'smi kathaṃ deva hyaghāsuraniṣūdana .. 98.11 ..
6.3.d:
भानुरुवाच -
आहूतोऽस्मि कथं देव ह्यघासुरनिषूदन .. 98.11 ..
6.3.m: The Sun said: / Why have I been summoned, O God, slayer of the demon Agha?

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
prabhāṃ pālaya bho bhāno saṃtoṣeṇa pareṇa hi .. 98.12 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
प्रभां पालय भो भानो संतोषेण परेण हि .. 98.12 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / O Sun, protect Prabhā with the utmost pleasure!

6.3.s:
umovāca -
prabhāyā mandire nityaṃ sthīyatāṃ himanāśana .
agrapatnī samastānāṃ bhāryāṇāṃ kriyatāṃ rave .. 98.13 ..
6.3.d:
उमोवाच -
प्रभाया मन्दिरे नित्यं स्थीयतां हिमनाशन .
अग्रपत्नी समस्तानां भार्याणां क्रियतां रवे .. 98.13 ..
6.3.m: Umā said: / Dwell constantly in the mansion of Prabhā, O Dispeller of Cold; / make her the foremost wife among all your wives, O Sun!

6.3.s:
bhānuruvāca -
evaṃ devi kariṣyāmi tava vākyaṃ varānane .
etacchrutvā prabhāhūtā pratyuvāca maheśvaram .. 98.14 ..
6.3.d:
भानुरुवाच -
एवं देवि करिष्यामि तव वाक्यं वरानने .
एतच्छ्रुत्वा प्रभाहूता प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरम् .. 98.14 ..
6.3.m: The Sun said: / So shall I do, O goddess, according to your word, O fair-faced one! / Having heard this, Prabhā was summoned and replied to Maheśvara:

6.3.s:
prabhovāca -
svāṃśena sthīyatāṃ deva manmathāre umāpate .
ekāṃśaḥ sthāpyatāmatra tīrthasyonmīlanāya ca .. 98.15 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभोवाच -
स्वांशेन स्थीयतां देव मन्मथारे उमापते .
एकांशः स्थाप्यतामत्र तीर्थस्योन्मीलनाय च .. 98.15 ..
6.3.m: Prabhā said: / Dwell here by a portion of yourself, O God, enemy of Manmatha, Lord of Umā! / Let one portion be established here for the manifestation of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sarvadevamayaṃ liṅgaṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra pāṇḍava .
prabhāseśa iti khyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu durlabham .. 98.16 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सर्वदेवमयं लिङ्गं स्थापितं तत्र पाण्डव .
प्रभासेश इति ख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु दुर्लभम् .. 98.16 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / A liṅga composed of all deities was established there, O Pāṇḍava, / famed as Prabhāseśa, difficult to attain in all the worlds.

6.3.s:
anyāni yāni tīrthāni kāle tāni phalanti vai .
prabhāseśastu rājendra sadyaḥ kāmaphalapradaḥ .. 98.17 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यानि यानि तीर्थानि काले तानि फलन्ति वै .
प्रभासेशस्तु राजेन्द्र सद्यः कामफलप्रदः .. 98.17 ..
6.3.m: Whatever other sacred fords there are bear fruit in due course of time, / but Prabhāseśa, O best of kings, immediately grants the fruit of desires.

6.3.s:
māghamāse site pakṣe saptamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .
aśvaṃ yaḥ sparśayettatra yathoktabrāhmaṇe nṛpa .. 98.18 ..
6.3.d:
माघमासे सिते पक्षे सप्तम्यां च विशेषतः .
अश्वं यः स्पर्शयेत्तत्र यथोक्तब्राह्मणे नृप .. 98.18 ..
6.3.m: Especially on the seventh day of the bright fortnight in the month of Māgha, / whoever causes a horse to touch a brahmin qualified as prescribed there, O king,

6.3.s:
indratvaṃ prāpyate tena bhāskarasyāthavā padam .
snātvā paramayā bhaktyā dānaṃ dadyāddvijātaye .. 98.19 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रत्वं प्राप्यते तेन भास्करस्याथवा पदम् .
स्नात्वा परमया भक्त्या दानं दद्याद्द्विजातये .. 98.19 ..
6.3.m: the status of Indra or the realm of the Sun is attained by him. / Having bathed with supreme devotion, he should give a gift to a twice-born.

6.3.s:
gopradātā labhetsvargaṃ satyalokaṃ vareśvara .
sarvāṅgasundarīṃ śubhrāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ taruṇīṃ śubhām .. 98.20 ..
6.3.d:
गोप्रदाता लभेत्स्वर्गं सत्यलोकं वरेश्वर .
सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरीं शुभ्रां क्षीरिणीं तरुणीं शुभाम् .. 98.20 ..
6.3.m: The giver of a cow attains heaven, the Satyaloka, O best of rulers; / [a cow] beautiful in every limb, bright, giving milk, young, auspicious,

6.3.s:
savatsāṃ ghaṇṭāsaṃyuktāṃ kāṃsyapātrāvadohinīm .
dadate ye nṛpaśreṣṭha na te yānti yamālayam .. 98.21 ..
6.3.d:
सवत्सां घण्टासंयुक्तां कांस्यपात्रावदोहिनीम् .
ददते ये नृपश्रेष्ठ न ते यान्ति यमालयम् .. 98.21 ..
6.3.m: with her calf, furnished with a bell, milked into a bronze vessel; / those who give such, O best of kings, do not go to the abode of Yama.

6.3.s:
atha yaḥ parayā bhaktyā snānaṃ devasya kārayet .
sa prāpnoti paraṃ lokaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 98.22 ..
6.3.d:
अथ यः परया भक्त्या स्नानं देवस्य कारयेत् .
स प्राप्नोति परं लोकं यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 98.22 ..
6.3.m: Furthermore, whoever causes a bath of the god to be performed with supreme devotion, / he attains the highest realm until the dissolution of all beings.

6.3.s:
daurbhāgyaṃ nāśamāyāti snānamātreṇa pāṇḍava .
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā kanyādānaṃ prayacchati .. 98.23 ..
6.3.d:
दौर्भाग्यं नाशमायाति स्नानमात्रेण पाण्डव .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या कन्यादानं प्रयच्छति .. 98.23 ..
6.3.m: Misfortune meets destruction by merely bathing, O Pāṇḍava. / Whoever with devotion gives the gift of a maiden at that sacred ford,

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇāya vivāhena dāpayetpāṇḍunandana .
samānavayase deyā kulaśīladhanaistathā .. 98.24 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणाय विवाहेन दापयेत्पाण्डुनन्दन .
समानवयसे देया कुलशीलधनैस्तथा .. 98.24 ..
6.3.m: should give her through marriage to a brahmin, O son of Pāṇḍu; / she should be given to one equal in age, as well as in lineage, character, and wealth.

6.3.s:
ye dadante mahārāja hyapi pātakasaṃyutāḥ .
teṣāṃ pāpāni līyante hyudake lavaṇaṃ yathā .. 98.25 ..
6.3.d:
ये ददन्ते महाराज ह्यपि पातकसंयुताः .
तेषां पापानि लीयन्ते ह्युदके लवणं यथा .. 98.25 ..
6.3.m: Those who give, O great king, even if accompanied by major sins, / their sins dissolve just like salt in water:

6.3.s:
svāmidrohakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nikṣepasyāpahāriṇi .
mitraghne ca kṛtaghne ca kūṭasākṣyasamudbhavam .. 98.26 ..
6.3.d:
स्वामिद्रोहकृतं पापं निक्षेपस्यापहारिणि .
मित्रघ्ने च कृतघ्ने च कूटसाक्ष्यसमुद्भवम् .. 98.26 ..
6.3.m: the sin committed by treachery to one's master, in appropriating a deposit, / in killing a friend, and in ingratitude, and that arising from false testimony.

6.3.s:
tadgrāmodyānabhedotthaṃ paradāraniṣevaṇam .
vārddhuṣikasya yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ steyasambhavam .. 98.27 ..
6.3.d:
तद्ग्रामोद्यानभेदोत्थं परदारनिषेवणम् .
वार्द्धुषिकस्य यत्पापं यत्पापं स्तेयसम्भवम् .. 98.27 ..
6.3.m: The [sin] arising from destroying a village or garden, adultery with another's wife, / the sin of a usurer, and the sin born of theft; 98.27

6.3.s:
kūpabhedodbhavaṃ yacca baiḍālavratadhāriṇaḥ .
dāmbhikaṃ vṛkṣacchedotthaṃ vivāhasya niṣedhajam .. 98.28 ..
6.3.d:
कूपभेदोद्भवं यच्च बैडालव्रतधारिणः .
दाम्भिकं वृक्षच्छेदोत्थं विवाहस्य निषेधजम् .. 98.28 ..
6.3.m: and that born of destroying a well; of one keeping the cat-vow [of hypocrisy]; / of hypocrisy; arising from cutting down a tree; born of preventing a marriage; 98.28

6.3.s:
ārāmasthatarucchedamagamyāgamanodbhavam .
svabhāryātyajane yacca parabhāryāsamīhanāt .. 98.29 ..
6.3.d:
आरामस्थतरुच्छेदमगम्यागमनोद्भवम् .
स्वभार्यात्यजने यच्च परभार्यासमीहनात् .. 98.29 ..
6.3.m: cutting down a tree standing in a grove; born of having intercourse with a woman forbidden to be approached; / and that which arises from abandoning one's own wife due to desiring another's wife; 98.29

6.3.s:
brahmasvaharaṇe yacca garade govighātini .
vidyāvikrayaṇotthaṃ ca saṃsargādyacca pātakam .. 98.30 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मस्वहरणे यच्च गरदे गोविघातिनि .
विद्याविक्रयणोत्थं च संसर्गाद्यच्च पातकम् .. 98.30 ..
6.3.m: and that arising from seizing the property of a brahmin; in a poisoner; in a cow-killer; / that arising from selling sacred knowledge; and that sin born of [evil] association; 98.30

6.3.s:
śvabiḍālavadhādghoraṃ sarpaśūdrodbhavaṃ tathā .
bhūmihartuśca yatpāpaṃ bhūmihāriṇi caiva hi .. 98.31 ..
6.3.d:
श्वबिडालवधाद्घोरं सर्पशूद्रोद्भवं तथा .
भूमिहर्तुश्च यत्पापं भूमिहारिणि चैव हि .. 98.31 ..
6.3.m: the terrible sin from killing a dog or cat, likewise that born of killing a snake or Śūdra; / and the sin of one who seizes land, and regarding a robber of land; 98.31

6.3.s:
mā dadasveti yatpāpaṃ govahnibrāhmaṇeṣu ca .
tatpāpaṃ yāti vilayaṃ kanyādānena pāṇḍava .. 98.32 ..
6.3.d:
मा ददस्वेति यत्पापं गोवह्निब्राह्मणेषु च .
तत्पापं याति विलयं कन्यादानेन पाण्डव .. 98.32 ..
6.3.m: and the sin of saying “Do not give!” with regard to cows, fire, and brahmins— / that sin dissolves away through the gift of a maiden, O Pāṇḍava. 98.32

6.3.s:
sa gatvā bhāskaraṃ lokaṃ rudraloke śubhe vrajet .
krīḍate rudralokastho yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .. 98.33 ..
6.3.d:
स गत्वा भास्करं लोकं रुद्रलोके शुभे व्रजेत् .
क्रीडते रुद्रलोकस्थो यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश .. 98.33 ..
6.3.m: Having gone to the world of the sun, he goes to the auspicious world of Rudra. / Residing in the world of Rudra, he sports as long as fourteen Indras endure. 98.33

6.3.s:
sarvapāpakṣaye jāte śive bhavati bhāvanā .
etadvrajati yastīrthaṃ prabhāsaṃ pāṇḍunandana .. 98.34 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वपापक्षये जाते शिवे भवति भावना .
एतद्व्रजति यस्तीर्थं प्रभासं पाण्डुनन्दन .. 98.34 ..
6.3.m: When all sins have been destroyed, devotion to Śiva arises. / Whoever goes to this sacred ford, Prabhāsa, O son of Pāṇḍu, 98.34

6.3.s:
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .
gopradānaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ param .
praśastaṃ sarvakālaṃ hi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 98.35 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe prabhāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 99
6.3.d:
सर्वतीर्थफलं प्राप्य सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .
गोप्रदानं महापुण्यं सर्वपापक्षयं परम् .
प्रशस्तं सर्वकालं हि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः .. 98.35 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे प्रभासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टनवतितमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 99
6.3.m:
having obtained the fruit of all sacred fords, he obtains the fruit of a horse-sacrifice. / The gift of a cow brings great religious merit, the supreme destruction of all sins, / and is indeed praised at all times, especially on the fourteenth day. 98.35
Thus ends the ninety-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Prabhāsa Ford,' in the Revā Section of the fifth section, the Āvantya Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 99

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .
sthāpitaṃ vāsukīśaṃ tu samastāghaughanāśanam .. 99.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .
स्थापितं वासुकीशं तु समस्ताघौघनाशनम् .. 99.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king, to the southern bank of the Narmadā, / to Vāsukīśa, which was consecrated [there] and destroys all hosts of sins. // 99.1

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kasmācca kāraṇāttāta revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe .
vāsukīśasthāpito vai vistarādvada me guro .. 99.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कस्माच्च कारणात्तात रेवाया दक्षिणे तटे .
वासुकीशस्थापितो वै विस्तराद्वद मे गुरो .. 99.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / And for what reason, dear sir, was Vāsukīśa consecrated / on the southern bank of the Revā? Tell me in detail, O guru. // 99.2

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etatsarvaṃ samāsthāya nṛtyaṃ śambhuścakāra vai .. 99.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतत्सर्वं समास्थाय नृत्यं शम्भुश्चकार वै .. 99.3 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Undertaking all this, Śambhu performed a dance. // 99.3

6.3.s:
śramādajāyata svedo gaṅgātoyavimiśritam .
patantamurago'śnāti haramaulivinirgatam .. 99.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रमादजायत स्वेदो गङ्गातोयविमिश्रितम् .
पतन्तमुरगोऽश्नाति हरमौलिविनिर्गतम् .. 99.4 ..
6.3.m: From fatigue, sweat arose, mixed with the waters of the Gaṅgā. / A serpent consumed it as it fell, having issued from Hara's head. // 99.4

6.3.s:
mandākinī tataḥ kruddhā vyālasyopari bhārata .
prāpnuhyajagarattvaṃ hi bhujaṅga kṣudrajantuka .. 99.5 ..
6.3.d:
मन्दाकिनी ततः क्रुद्धा व्यालस्योपरि भारत .
प्राप्नुह्यजगरत्त्वं हि भुजङ्ग क्षुद्रजन्तुक .. 99.5 ..
6.3.m: Then Mandākinī, enraged at the serpent, [said], O descendant of Bharata: / ‘Become a python, O serpent, you lowly creature!’ // 99.5

6.3.s:
vāsukiruvāca -
anugrāhyo'smi te pāpo durnayo'haṃ harādṛte .
trailokyapāvanī puṇyā sarittvaṃ śubhalakṣaṇā .. 99.6 ..
6.3.d:
वासुकिरुवाच -
अनुग्राह्योऽस्मि ते पापो दुर्नयोऽहं हरादृते .
त्रैलोक्यपावनी पुण्या सरित्त्वं शुभलक्षणा .. 99.6 ..
6.3.m: Vāsuki said: / ‘I am sinful and ill-behaved, worthy of your favor; I have no resort except Hara. / You are the river that purifies the three worlds, auspicious and endowed with good marks; // 99.6

6.3.s:
saṃsāracchedanakarī hyārtānāmārtināśanī .
svargadvāre sthitā tvaṃ hi dayāṃ kuru mayīśvari .. 99.7 ..
6.3.d:
संसारच्छेदनकरी ह्यार्तानामार्तिनाशनी .
स्वर्गद्वारे स्थिता त्वं हि दयां कुरु मयीश्वरि .. 99.7 ..
6.3.m: you cut through transmigration and remove the distress of the afflicted. / Standing at the gate of heaven, O goddess, show compassion to me!’ // 99.7

6.3.s:
gaṅgovāca -
kuruṣva vipulaṃ vindhyaṃ tapastvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ prati .
tataḥ prāpsyasi svaṃ sthānaṃ pannagatvaṃ mamājñayā .. 99.8 ..
6.3.d:
गङ्गोवाच -
कुरुष्व विपुलं विन्ध्यं तपस्त्वं शङ्करं प्रति .
ततः प्राप्स्यसि स्वं स्थानं पन्नगत्वं ममाज्ञया .. 99.8 ..
6.3.m: Gaṅgā said: / ‘Go to the vast Vindhya mountain and perform austerity directed to Śaṅkara. / Then, by my command, you shall attain your own abode and status as a serpent.’ // 99.8

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato'sau tvarito vindhyaṃ nāgo gatvā nagaṃ śubham .
tapastaptuṃ samārebhe śaṅkarārādhanodyataḥ .. 99.9 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततोऽसौ त्वरितो विन्ध्यं नागो गत्वा नगं शुभम् .
तपस्तप्तुं समारेभे शङ्कराराधनोद्यतः .. 99.9 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then that snake went swiftly to the auspicious Vindhya mountain / and, intent on propitiating Śaṅkara, began to perform austerity. // 99.9

6.3.s:
nityaṃ dadhyau mahādevaṃ tryakṣaṃ ḍamarukodyatam .
tato varṣaśate pūrṇa uparuddho jagadguruḥ .
āgatastatsamīpaṃ tu ślakṣṇāṃ vāṇīmudāharat .. 99.10 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं दध्यौ महादेवं त्र्यक्षं डमरुकोद्यतम् .
ततो वर्षशते पूर्ण उपरुद्धो जगद्गुरुः .
आगतस्तत्समीपं तु श्लक्ष्णां वाणीमुदाहरत् .. 99.10 ..
6.3.m: He constantly meditated on Mahādeva, the three-eyed one holding up a ḍamaru drum. / Then, when a hundred years had elapsed, the guru of the world, having been besought, / came into his presence and spoke smooth words: // 99.10

6.3.s: varaṃ varaya me vatsa pannaga tvaṃ kṛtādara .. 99.11 ..
6.3.d: वरं वरय मे वत्स पन्नग त्वं कृतादर .. 99.11 ..
6.3.m: ‘Choose a boon from me, my child, O serpent, you who have paid reverence.’ // 99.11

6.3.s:
vāsukiruvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dāsyasi śaṅkara .
prasādāttava deveśa bhūyānniṣpāpatā mama .
tīrthaṃ kiṃcitsamākhyāhi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 99.12 ..
6.3.d:
वासुकिरुवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव वरं दास्यसि शङ्कर .
प्रसादात्तव देवेश भूयान्निष्पापता मम .
तीर्थं किंचित्समाख्याहि सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 99.12 ..
6.3.m: Vāsuki said: / ‘If you are pleased with me, O God, and will grant me a boon, O Śaṅkara, / by your grace, O Lord of gods, may I become sinless! / Tell me of some sacred ford that completely destroys all sins.’ // 99.12

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
pannaga tvaṃ mahābāho revāṃ gaccha śubhaṃkarīm .
yāmye tasyāstaṭe puṇye snānaṃ kuru yathāvidhi .. 99.13 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
पन्नग त्वं महाबाहो रेवां गच्छ शुभंकरीम् .
याम्ये तस्यास्तटे पुण्ये स्नानं कुरु यथाविधि .. 99.13 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / ‘O serpent of mighty arms, go to the auspicious Revā. / On its sacred southern bank, perform a ritual ablution according to rule.’ // 99.13

6.3.s:
ityuktvāntardadhe devo vāsukistvarayānvitaḥ .
rūpeṇājagareṇaiva praviṣṭo narmadājalam .. 99.14 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवो वासुकिस्त्वरयान्वितः .
रूपेणाजगरेणैव प्रविष्टो नर्मदाजलम् .. 99.14 ..
