6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the god disappeared. Vāsuki, filled with haste, / entered the waters of the Narmadā in the very form of a python. // 99.14

6.3.s:
mārgeṇa tasya saṃjātaṃ jāhnavyāḥ srota uttamam .
nirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ sarpaḥ saṃjāto narmadājale .. 99.15 ..
6.3.d:
मार्गेण तस्य संजातं जाह्नव्याः स्रोत उत्तमम् .
निर्धूतकल्मषः सर्पः संजातो नर्मदाजले .. 99.15 ..
6.3.m: Along his path arose an excellent stream of the Jāhnavī. / The serpent had his impurities washed away in the water of the Narmadā. // 99.15

6.3.s:
sthāpitaḥ śaṅkarastatra narmadāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
tato nāgeśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ prasiddhaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 99.16 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापितः शङ्करस्तत्र नर्मदायां युधिष्ठिर .
ततो नागेश्वरं लिङ्गं प्रसिद्धं पापनाशनम् .. 99.16 ..
6.3.m: Śaṅkara was consecrated there at the Narmadā, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / Thence the liṅga became renowned as Nāgeśvara, destroying sin. // 99.16

6.3.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ snāpayenmadhunā śivam .
vimuktakalmaṣaḥ sadyo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 99.17 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टम्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां स्नापयेन्मधुना शिवम् .
विमुक्तकल्मषः सद्यो जायते नात्र संशयः .. 99.17 ..
6.3.m: On the eighth or fourteenth day, one should bathe Śiva with honey. / He instantly becomes freed from impurity; there is no doubt about this. // 99.17

6.3.s:
aputrā ye narāḥ pārtha snānaṃ kurvanti saṅgame .
te labhante sutāñchreṣṭhān kārttavīryopamāñchubhān .. 99.18 ..
6.3.d:
अपुत्रा ये नराः पार्थ स्नानं कुर्वन्ति सङ्गमे .
ते लभन्ते सुताञ्छ्रेष्ठान् कार्त्तवीर्योपमाञ्छुभान् .. 99.18 ..
6.3.m: Childless men who perform ritual ablution at the confluence, O son of Pṛthā, / obtain excellent and auspicious sons resembling Kārttavīrya. // 99.18

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yaḥ kuryādupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ .
kurvanpramocayetpretānnarakānnṛpanandana .. 99.19 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं तत्रैव यः कुर्यादुपवासपरायणः .
कुर्वन्प्रमोचयेत्प्रेतान्नरकान्नृपनन्दन .. 99.19 ..
6.3.m: A person devoted to fasting who performs a śrāddha right there, / performing it, releases spirits of the dead from hell, O delight of kings. // 99.19

6.3.s:
sarpāṇāṃ ca bhayaṃ vaṃśe jñātivarge na jāyate .
nirdoṣaṃ nandate tasya kulaṃ nāgaprasādataḥ .. 99.20 ..
6.3.d:
सर्पाणां च भयं वंशे ज्ञातिवर्गे न जायते .
निर्दोषं नन्दते तस्य कुलं नागप्रसादतः .. 99.20 ..
6.3.m: No fear of serpents arises in his lineage or kinship group. / His family rejoices free of blemish by the grace of the serpent. // 99.20

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tava snehānnṛpottama .. 99.21 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 100
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं तव स्नेहान्नृपोत्तम .. 99.21 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नागेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 100
6.3.m:
All this has been told to you out of affection for you, O best of kings. // 99.21
Thus ends the ninety-ninth chapter, titled “Description of the Māhātmya of Nāgeśvaratīrtha,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 100

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramarocanam .
mārkaṇḍeśamiti khyātaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .. 100.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थं परमरोचनम् .
मार्कण्डेशमिति ख्यातं नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .. 100.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king, to the extremely delightful sacred ford / known as Mārkaṇḍeśa on the southern bank of the Narmadā, // 100.1

6.3.s:
uttamaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ gīrvāṇairvanditaṃ śivam .
guhyādguhyataraṃ putra nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā .. 100.2 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तमं सर्वतीर्थानां गीर्वाणैर्वन्दितं शिवम् .
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं पुत्र नाख्यातं कस्यचिन्मया .. 100.2 ..
6.3.m: the best of all sacred fords, auspicious, praised by the gods. / It is more secret than the secret, O son; it has not been told by me to anyone. // 100.2

6.3.s:
sthāpitaṃ tu mayā pūrvaṃ svargasopānasaṃnibham .
jñānaṃ tatraiva me jātaṃ prasādācchaṅkarasya ca .. 100.3 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापितं तु मया पूर्वं स्वर्गसोपानसंनिभम् .
ज्ञानं तत्रैव मे जातं प्रसादाच्छङ्करस्य च .. 100.3 ..
6.3.m: Formerly it was established by me, resembling a staircase to heaven. / True knowledge arose in me right there through the grace of Śaṅkara. // 100.3

6.3.s:
anyastatraiva yo gatvā drupadāmantarjale japet .
sa pātakairaśeṣaśca mucyate pāṇḍunandana .. 100.4 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यस्तत्रैव यो गत्वा द्रुपदामन्तर्जले जपेत् .
स पातकैरशेषश्च मुच्यते पाण्डुनन्दन .. 100.4 ..
6.3.m: Another person who goes right there and recites the Drupadā verse while submerged in water / is completely freed from sins, O delight of Pāṇḍu: // 100.4

6.3.s:
vācikairmānasaiśca vā karmajairapi pātakaiḥ .
piṇḍikāṃ cāpyavaṣṭabhya yāmyāmāśāṃ ca saṃsthitaḥ .. 100.5 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकैर्मानसैश्च वा कर्मजैरपि पातकैः .
पिण्डिकां चाप्यवष्टभ्य याम्यामाशां च संस्थितः .. 100.5 ..
6.3.m: from sins born of speech, of mind, or of actions. / Resting upon the pedestal and facing the southern direction, // 100.5

6.3.s:
yojayecchūlinaṃ bhaktyā dvātriṃśadbahurūpiṇam .
dehapāte śivaṃ gacchediti me niścayo nṛpa .. 100.6 ..
6.3.d:
योजयेच्छूलिनं भक्त्या द्वात्रिंशद्बहुरूपिणम् .
देहपाते शिवं गच्छेदिति मे निश्चयो नृप .. 100.6 ..
6.3.m: one should direct one's devotion to the trident-bearer in his thirty-two diverse forms. / Upon the fall of the body, he shall go to Śiva; this is my firm conviction, O king. // 100.6

6.3.s:
ājyena bodhayeddīpamaṣṭamyāṃ niśi bhārata .
svargalokamavāpnoti ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 100.7 ..
6.3.d:
आज्येन बोधयेद्दीपमष्टम्यां निशि भारत .
स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नोति इत्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 100.7 ..
6.3.m: If one lights a lamp with clarified butter at night on the eighth day, O descendant of Bharata, / he attains the heavenly world; thus Śaṅkara declared. // 100.7

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo bhaktyā kurvīta nṛpanandana .
pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 100.8 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं तत्रैव यो भक्त्या कुर्वीत नृपनन्दन .
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यन्ति यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 100.8 ..
6.3.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha right there with devotion, O delight of kings, / his ancestors remain satisfied until the dissolution of all created beings. // 100.8

6.3.s:
iṅgudairbadarairbilvairakṣatena jalena vā .
tarpayettatra yo vaṃśyānāpnuyājjanmanaḥ phalam .. 100.9 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 101
6.3.d:
इङ्गुदैर्बदरैर्बिल्वैरक्षतेन जलेन वा .
तर्पयेत्तत्र यो वंश्यानाप्नुयाज्जन्मनः फलम् .. 100.9 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मार्कण्डेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम शततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 101
6.3.m:
Whoever satisfies his ancestors there with inguda fruits, badarī berries, bilva fruits, unhusked barley grains, or water, / attains the fruit of human birth. // 100.9
Thus ends the one hundredth chapter, titled “Description of the Māhātmya of Mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrtha,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 101

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
uttare narmadākūle yajñavāṭasya madhyataḥ .. 101.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले यज्ञवाटस्य मध्यतः .. 101.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the extremely beautiful sacred ford / on the northern bank of the Narmadā, in the middle of the sacrificial enclosure. // 101.1

6.3.s:
saṃkarṣaṇamiti khyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pāpanāśanam .
tapaścīrṇaṃ purā rājanbalabhadreṇa tatra vai .. 101.2 ..
6.3.d:
संकर्षणमिति ख्यातं पृथिव्यां पापनाशनम् .
तपश्चीर्णं पुरा राजन्बलभद्रेण तत्र वै .. 101.2 ..
6.3.m: [The tīrtha] known on earth as Saṃkarṣaṇa destroys sins. / Long ago, O king, Balabhadra performed austerity right there.

6.3.s:
gīrvāṇā api tatraiva saṃnidhau nṛpanandana .
umayā sahitaḥ śambhuḥ sthitastatraiva keśavaḥ .. 101.3 ..
6.3.d:
गीर्वाणा अपि तत्रैव संनिधौ नृपनन्दन .
उमया सहितः शम्भुः स्थितस्तत्रैव केशवः .. 101.3 ..
6.3.m: The gods also dwell right there in close proximity, O prince; / Śambhu accompanied by Umā and Keśava abide right there.

6.3.s:
balabhadreṇa rājendra prāṇināmupakārataḥ .
sthāpitaḥ parayā bhaktyā śaṅkaraḥ pāpanāśanaḥ .. 101.4 ..
6.3.d:
बलभद्रेण राजेन्द्र प्राणिनामुपकारतः .
स्थापितः परया भक्त्या शङ्करः पापनाशनः .. 101.4 ..
6.3.m: For the benefit of living beings, O best of kings, / Śaṅkara, destroyer of sins, was installed with supreme devotion by Balabhadra.

6.3.s:
yastatra snāti vai bhaktyā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ .
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe madhunā snāpayecchivam .. 101.5 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तत्र स्नाति वै भक्त्या जितक्रोधो जितेन्द्रियः .
एकादश्यां सिते पक्षे मधुना स्नापयेच्छिवम् .. 101.5 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes there with devotion, conquering anger and subduing the senses, / and bathes Śiva with honey on the eleventh day of the bright fortnight,

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ tatraiva yo bhaktyā pitḥṇāmatha dāpayet .
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ balabhadravaco yathā .. 101.6 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe saṃkarṣaṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 102
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं तत्रैव यो भक्त्या पित्ःणामथ दापयेत् .
स याति परमं स्थानं बलभद्रवचो यथा .. 101.6 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे संकर्षणतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 102
6.3.m:
and then offers a śrāddha to the ancestors right there with devotion, / he goes to the supreme abode, just as Balabhadra declared.
Thus ends the one hundred and first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Saṃkarṣaṇatīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, the fifth part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 102

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
manmatheśaṃ tato gacchetsarvadevanamaskṛtam .
snānamātrānnaro rājanyamalokaṃ na paśyati .. 102.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
मन्मथेशं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् .
स्नानमात्रान्नरो राजन्यमलोकं न पश्यति .. 102.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to Manmatheśa, who is bowed to by all the gods. / Merely by a ritual ablution, O king, a person does not see the world of Yama.

6.3.s:
anapatyā yā ca nārī snāyādvai pāṇḍunandana .
putraṃ sā labhate pārtha satyasaṅghaṃ dṛḍhavratam .. 102.2 ..
6.3.d:
अनपत्या या च नारी स्नायाद्वै पाण्डुनन्दन .
पुत्रं सा लभते पार्थ सत्यसङ्घं दृढव्रतम् .. 102.2 ..
6.3.m: And whatever barren woman bathes [there], O son of Pāṇḍu, / she obtains a son, O son of Pṛthā, true to his word and steadfast in vows.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā naro rājañchuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ .
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet .. 102.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजञ्छुचिः प्रयतमानसः .
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् .. 102.3 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there, O king, pure and restrained in mind, / fasting for a single night, a person obtains the fruit of a thousand cows.

6.3.s:
kāmikaṃ tīrtharājaṃ tu tādṛśaṃ na bhaviṣyati .
trirātraṃ kurute rājansa golakṣaphalaṃ labhet .. 102.4 ..
6.3.d:
कामिकं तीर्थराजं तु तादृशं न भविष्यति .
त्रिरात्रं कुरुते राजन्स गोलक्षफलं लभेत् .. 102.4 ..
6.3.m: There will never be another king of tīrthas so wish-fulfilling. / If one undertakes [a fast of] three nights, O king, he obtains the fruit of a hundred thousand cows.

6.3.s:
tatra nṛtyaṃ prakartavyaṃ tuṣyate parameśvaraḥ .
gītavāditranirghoṣai rātrau jāgaraṇena ca .. 102.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र नृत्यं प्रकर्तव्यं तुष्यते परमेश्वरः .
गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषै रात्रौ जागरणेन च .. 102.5 ..
6.3.m: Dancing should be performed there; the Supreme Lord is pleased / by the sounds of song and musical instruments and by keeping vigil at night.

6.3.s:
eraṇḍyāṃ ca mahādevo dṛṣṭo me manmatheśvaraḥ .
kiṃ samartho yamo ruṣṭo bhadro bhadrāṇi paśyati .. 102.6 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्ड्यां च महादेवो दृष्टो मे मन्मथेश्वरः .
किं समर्थो यमो रुष्टो भद्रो भद्राणि पश्यति .. 102.6 ..
6.3.m: And at the Eraṇḍī, Mahādeva, the Lord of Manmatha, was beheld by me. / How could Yama, even if angered, have power [over him]? An auspicious man beholds auspicious things.

6.3.s:
kāmena sthāpitaḥ śambhuretasmātkāmado nṛpa .
sopānaḥ svargamārgasya pṛthivyāṃ manmatheśvaraḥ .. 102.7 ..
6.3.d:
कामेन स्थापितः शम्भुरेतस्मात्कामदो नृप .
सोपानः स्वर्गमार्गस्य पृथिव्यां मन्मथेश्वरः .. 102.7 ..
6.3.m: Śambhu was installed by Kāma; therefore, O king, he fulfills desires. / Manmatheśvara is a stairway to heaven on earth.

6.3.s:
viśeṣaścātra sandhyāyāṃ śrāddhadāne ca bhārata .
annadānena rājendra kīrtitaṃ phalamuttamam .. 102.8 ..
6.3.d:
विशेषश्चात्र सन्ध्यायां श्राद्धदाने च भारत .
अन्नदानेन राजेन्द्र कीर्तितं फलमुत्तमम् .. 102.8 ..
6.3.m: And especially at twilight and in offering a śrāddha, O descendant of Bharata, / an excellent fruit is proclaimed, O best of kings, by giving food [there].

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tava bhaktyā tu bhārata .
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ prakhyāto manmatheśvaraḥ .. 102.9 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं तव भक्त्या तु भारत .
पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां प्रख्यातो मन्मथेश्वरः .. 102.9 ..
6.3.m: All this has been told to you on account of your devotion, O descendant of Bharata. / Manmatheśvara is renowned throughout the earth bounded by the oceans.

6.3.s:
godānaṃ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha trayodaśyāṃ prakārayet .
caitre māsi site pakṣe tatra gatvā jitendriyaḥ .. 102.10 ..
6.3.d:
गोदानं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठ त्रयोदश्यां प्रकारयेत् .
चैत्रे मासि सिते पक्षे तत्र गत्वा जितेन्द्रियः .. 102.10 ..
6.3.m: A gift of a cow should be made, O best of Pāṇḍavas, on the thirteenth day; / having gone there in the bright fortnight of the month of Caitra with subdued senses,

6.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā devasyāgre nṛpottama .
dīpaṃ bhaktyā ghṛtenaiva devasyāgre nivedayet .. 102.11 ..
6.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा देवस्याग्रे नृपोत्तम .
दीपं भक्त्या घृतेनैव देवस्याग्रे निवेदयेत् .. 102.11 ..
6.3.m: and having kept vigil at night before the god, O best of kings, / one should offer a lamp with ghee before the god with devotion.

6.3.s:
stryatha vā puruṣo vāpi samametatphalaṃ smṛtam .. 102.12 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe manmatheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 103
6.3.d:
स्त्र्यथ वा पुरुषो वापि सममेतत्फलं स्मृतम् .. 102.12 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मन्मथेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 103
6.3.m:
Whether a woman or a man, this fruit is declared to be equal.
Thus ends the one hundred and second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Manmatheśvaratīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, the fifth part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 103

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ param .
yacchrutaṃ vai mayā rājañchivasya vadataḥ purā .. 103.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल एरण्डीसङ्गमं परम् .
यच्छ्रुतं वै मया राजञ्छिवस्य वदतः पुरा .. 103.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to the supreme confluence of the Eraṇḍī, O ruler of the earth, / which was heard by me, O king, when Śiva spoke long ago.

6.3.s:
etadeva purā praśnaṃ gauryā pṛṣṭastu śaṅkaraḥ .
provāca nṛpaśārdūla guhyādguhyataraṃ śubham .. 103.2 ..
6.3.d:
एतदेव पुरा प्रश्नं गौर्या पृष्टस्तु शङ्करः .
प्रोवाच नृपशार्दूल गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं शुभम् .. 103.2 ..
6.3.m: When questioned long ago with this very question by Gaurī, / Śaṅkara spoke, O tiger among kings, that which is auspicious and more secret than the secret.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā .
revāyāścottare kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
bhrūṇahatyāharaṃ devi kāmadaṃ putravardhanam .. 103.3 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
शृणु देवि परं गुह्यं नाख्यातं कस्यचिन्मया .
रेवायाश्चोत्तरे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
भ्रूणहत्याहरं देवि कामदं पुत्रवर्धनम् .. 103.3 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, to the supreme secret which I have not spoken to anyone: / On the northern bank of the Revā is a most splendid tīrtha, / destroying [the sin of] abortion, O goddess, granting desires, and multiplying sons.

6.3.s:
pārvatyuvāca -
kathayasva mahādeva tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
bhrūṇahatyāharaṃ kasmātkāmadaṃ svargadarśanam .. 103.4 ..
6.3.d:
पार्वत्युवाच -
कथयस्व महादेव तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
भ्रूणहत्याहरं कस्मात्कामदं स्वर्गदर्शनम् .. 103.4 ..
6.3.m: Pārvatī said: / Tell [me], O Mahādeva, of this most splendid tīrtha: / Why does it remove [the sin of] abortion, grant desires, and grant the vision of heaven?

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
atrirnāma mahādevi mānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ .
agnihotrarato nityaṃ devatātithipūjakaḥ .. 103.5 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
अत्रिर्नाम महादेवि मानसो ब्रह्मणः सुतः .
अग्निहोत्ररतो नित्यं देवतातिथिपूजकः .. 103.5 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / There was a mind-born son of Brahmā named Atri, O great goddess, / always devoted to the Agnihotra and worshipping deities and guests.

6.3.s:
somasaṃsthāśca saptaiva kṛtā vipreṇa pārvati .
anasūyeti vikhyātā bhāryā tasya guṇānvitā .. 103.6 ..
6.3.d:
सोमसंस्थाश्च सप्तैव कृता विप्रेण पार्वति .
अनसूयेति विख्याता भार्या तस्य गुणान्विता .. 103.6 ..
6.3.m: And the seven Soma sacrifices were performed by that brahmin, O Pārvatī. / His wife, endowed with virtues, was renowned as Anasūyā,

6.3.s:
pativratā patiprāṇā patyuḥ kāryahite ratā .
evaṃ yāti tataḥ kāle na putrā na ca putrikā .. 103.7 ..
6.3.d:
पतिव्रता पतिप्राणा पत्युः कार्यहिते रता .
एवं याति ततः काले न पुत्रा न च पुत्रिका .. 103.7 ..
6.3.m: devoted to her husband, holding her husband as her life-breath, intent on the welfare and duties of her husband. / In this way time passed, but there was neither son nor daughter.

6.3.s:
aparāhṇe mahādevi sukhāsīnau tu sundari .
vadantau sukhaduḥkhāni pūrvavṛttāni yāni ca .. 103.8 ..
6.3.d:
अपराह्णे महादेवि सुखासीनौ तु सुन्दरि .
वदन्तौ सुखदुःखानि पूर्ववृत्तानि यानि च .. 103.8 ..
6.3.m: In the afternoon, O great goddess, the two sat comfortably, O beautiful one, / speaking of happiness and sorrow, and of things that had happened in the past.

6.3.s:
atriruvāca -
saumye śubhe priye kānte cārusarvāṅgasundari .
vidyāvinayasampanne padmapatranibhekṣaṇe .. 103.9 ..
6.3.d:
अत्रिरुवाच -
सौम्ये शुभे प्रिये कान्ते चारुसर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि .
विद्याविनयसम्पन्ने पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणे .. 103.9 ..
6.3.m: Atri said: / O gentle, auspicious, beloved, dear one, beautiful in all your limbs, / endowed with learning and modesty, with eyes like lotus petals,

6.3.s:
pūrṇacandranibhākāre pṛthuśroṇibharālase .
na tvayā sadṛśī nārī trailokye sacarācare .. 103.10 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाकारे पृथुश्रोणिभरालसे .
न त्वया सदृशी नारी त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे .. 103.10 ..
6.3.m: with an appearance like the full moon, languid with the weight of broad hips, / there is no woman equal to you in the three worlds, both moving and unmoving.

6.3.s:
ratiputraphalā nārī paṭhyate vedavādibhiḥ .
putrahīnasya yatsaukhyaṃ tatsaukhyaṃ mama sundari .. 103.11 ..
6.3.d:
रतिपुत्रफला नारी पठ्यते वेदवादिभिः .
पुत्रहीनस्य यत्सौख्यं तत्सौख्यं मम सुन्दरि .. 103.11 ..
6.3.m: A woman whose fruit is pleasure and sons is recited by the teachers of the Veda. / Whatever happiness a childless man has, such is my happiness, O beautiful one.

6.3.s:
yathāhaṃ na tathā putraḥ samarthaḥ sarvakarmasu .
punnāmanarakādbhadre jātamātreṇa sundari .. 103.12 ..
6.3.d:
यथाहं न तथा पुत्रः समर्थः सर्वकर्मसु .
पुन्नामनरकाद्भद्रे जातमात्रेण सुन्दरि .. 103.12 ..
6.3.m: As I am, so is a son not, who is capable in all rites; / from the hell named Put, O gentle one, as soon as he is born, O beautiful one,

6.3.s:
patantaṃ rakṣayeddevi mahāpātakinaṃ yadi .
mahāghore gatā vāpi duṣṭakarmapitāmahāḥ .. 103.13 ..
6.3.d:
पतन्तं रक्षयेद्देवि महापातकिनं यदि .
महाघोरे गता वापि दुष्टकर्मपितामहाः .. 103.13 ..
6.3.m: he saves one who is falling, O goddess, even if he is a perpetrator of great sins; / or even if the grandfathers of evil deeds have gone to the most dreadful [hell],

6.3.s:
taddharanti suputrāśca vaitaraṇyāṃ gatānapi .
putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇa paramā gatiḥ .. 103.14 ..
6.3.d:
तद्धरन्ति सुपुत्राश्च वैतरण्यां गतानपि .
पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति पौत्रेण परमा गतिः .. 103.14 ..
6.3.m: good sons deliver them, even those who have gone to the Vaitaraṇī. / By a son one conquers worlds, by a grandson comes the supreme state,

6.3.s:
atha putrasya pautreṇa pragacchedbrahma śāśvatam .
nāsti putrasamo bandhuriha loke paratra ca .. 103.15 ..
6.3.d:
अथ पुत्रस्य पौत्रेण प्रगच्छेद्ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् .
नास्ति पुत्रसमो बन्धुरिह लोके परत्र च .. 103.15 ..
6.3.m: and by the grandson of a son one goes to the eternal Brahman. / There is no friend equal to a son, both in this world and in the next.

6.3.s:
ahaśca madhyarātre ca cintayānasya sarvadā .
śuṣyanti mama gātrāṇi grīṣme nadyudakaṃ yathā .. 103.16 ..
6.3.d:
अहश्च मध्यरात्रे च चिन्तयानस्य सर्वदा .
शुष्यन्ति मम गात्राणि ग्रीष्मे नद्युदकं यथा .. 103.16 ..
6.3.m: By day and at midnight, as I worry constantly, / my limbs dry up like the water of a river in summer.

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
yattvayā śocitaṃ vipra tatsarvaṃ śocayāmyaham .
tavodvegakaraṃ yacca tanme dahati cetasi .. 103.17 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
यत्त्वया शोचितं विप्र तत्सर्वं शोचयाम्यहम् .
तवोद्वेगकरं यच्च तन्मे दहति चेतसि .. 103.17 ..
6.3.m: Anasūyā said: / That which you lament, O brahmin, all that I lament. / And that which causes you distress burns in my heart.

6.3.s:
yena putrā bhaviṣyanti āyuṣmanto guṇānvitāḥ .
tatkāryaṃ ca samīkṣasva yena tuṣyetprajāpatiḥ .. 103.18 ..
6.3.d:
येन पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति आयुष्मन्तो गुणान्विताः .
तत्कार्यं च समीक्षस्व येन तुष्येत्प्रजापतिः .. 103.18 ..
6.3.m: Consider that undertaking by which there will be sons, / long-lived and endowed with virtues, by which the Lord of Creatures would be pleased.

6.3.s:
atriruvāca -
tapastaptaṃ mayā bhadre jātamātreṇa duṣkaram .
vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ śākāhāreṇa sundari .. 103.19 ..
6.3.d:
अत्रिरुवाच -
तपस्तप्तं मया भद्रे जातमात्रेण दुष्करम् .
व्रतोपवासनियमैः शाकाहारेण सुन्दरि .. 103.19 ..
6.3.m: Atri said: / Difficult austerity was performed by me, O gentle one, as soon as I was born, / with vows, fasts, observances, and a diet of vegetables, O beautiful one.

6.3.s:
kṣīṇadehastu tiṣṭhāmi hyaśakto'haṃ mahāvrate .
tena śocāmi cātmānaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā .. 103.20 ..
6.3.d:
क्षीणदेहस्तु तिष्ठामि ह्यशक्तोऽहं महाव्रते .
तेन शोचामि चात्मानं रहस्यं कथितं मया .. 103.20 ..
6.3.m: With an emaciated body I remain, unable to undertake a great vow; / therefore I grieve for myself. The secret has been told by me.

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
bhartuḥ pativratā nārī ratiputravivardhinī .
trivargasādhanā sā ca ślāghyā ca viduṣāṃ jane .. 103.21 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
भर्तुः पतिव्रता नारी रतिपुत्रविवर्धिनी .
त्रिवर्गसाधना सा च श्लाघ्या च विदुषां जने .. 103.21 ..
6.3.m: Anasūyā said: / A woman devoted to her husband increases pleasure and sons for her husband, / achieves the three goals of life, and is praised among wise people.

6.3.s:
japastapastīrthayātrā mṛḍejyāmantrasādhanam .
devatārādhanaṃ caiva strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ .. 103.22 ..
6.3.d:
जपस्तपस्तीर्थयात्रा मृडेज्यामन्त्रसाधनम् .
देवताराधनं चैव स्त्रीशूद्रपतनानि षट् .. 103.22 ..
6.3.m: Recitation, austerity, pilgrimage to tīrthas, worship of Mṛḍa, mastery of mantras, / and worship of deities—these six cause the downfall of women and śūdras.

6.3.s:
īdṛśaṃ tu mahādoṣaṃ strīṇāṃ tu vratasādhane .
vadanti munayaḥ sarve yathoktaṃ vedabhāṣitam .. 103.23 ..
6.3.d:
ईदृशं तु महादोषं स्त्रीणां तु व्रतसाधने .
वदन्ति मुनयः सर्वे यथोक्तं वेदभाषितम् .. 103.23 ..
6.3.m: All the sages proclaim that such a great fault belongs to women / in performing rituals, according to what is declared in the Veda.

6.3.s:
anujñātā tvayā brahmaṃstapastapsyāmi duṣkaram .
putrārthitvaṃ samuddiśya toṣayāmi surottamān .. 103.24 ..
6.3.d:
अनुज्ञाता त्वया ब्रह्मंस्तपस्तप्स्यामि दुष्करम् .
पुत्रार्थित्वं समुद्दिश्य तोषयामि सुरोत्तमान् .. 103.24 ..
6.3.m: Permitted by you, O holy one, I will perform difficult austerity; / with the desire for a son in mind, I shall propitiate the foremost gods.

6.3.s:
atriruvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe mama saṃtoṣakāriṇi .
ājñātā tvaṃ mayā bhadre putrārthaṃ tapa āśraya .. 103.25 ..
6.3.d:
अत्रिरुवाच -
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञे मम संतोषकारिणि .
आज्ञाता त्वं मया भद्रे पुत्रार्थं तप आश्रय .. 103.25 ..
6.3.m: Atri said: / 'Well done, well done, O woman of great wisdom, you who bring me delight! / You are permitted by me, blessed lady; resort to austerity for the sake of a son.

6.3.s:
devatānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pitḥṇāmanṛṇo bhave .
na bhāryāsadṛśo bandhustriṣu lokeṣu vidyate .. 103.26 ..
6.3.d:
देवतानां मनुष्याणां पित्ःणामनृणो भवे .
न भार्यासदृशो बन्धुस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते .. 103.26 ..
6.3.m: May I be free of debt to the gods, to men, and to the ancestors. / In the three worlds there is no kinsman equal to a wife.

6.3.s:
tena devāḥ praśaṃsanti na bhāryāsadṛśaṃ sukham .
sanmukhe manmukhāḥ putrāḥ vilome tu parāṅmukhāḥ .. 103.27 ..
6.3.d:
तेन देवाः प्रशंसन्ति न भार्यासदृशं सुखम् .
सन्मुखे मन्मुखाः पुत्राः विलोमे तु पराङ्मुखाः .. 103.27 ..
6.3.m: Therefore the gods praise her; there is no happiness equal to a wife. / If she is favorable, sons look towards me; but if she is contrary, they turn away.

6.3.s:
tena bhāryāṃ praśaṃsanti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ .
mahāvrate mahāprājñe sattvavati śubhekṣaṇe .. 103.28 ..
6.3.d:
तेन भार्यां प्रशंसन्ति सदेवासुरमानुषाः .
महाव्रते महाप्राज्ञे सत्त्ववति शुभेक्षणे .. 103.28 ..
6.3.m: Therefore gods, demons, and mortals praise a wife. / O lady of great vows, O woman of great wisdom, noble-hearted and of auspicious gaze,

6.3.s:
tapastapasva śīghraṃ tvaṃ putrārthaṃ tu mamājñayā .
etadvākyāvasāne tu sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatābravīt .. 103.29 ..
6.3.d:
तपस्तपस्व शीघ्रं त्वं पुत्रार्थं तु ममाज्ञया .
एतद्वाक्यावसाने तु साष्टाङ्गं प्रणताब्रवीत् .. 103.29 ..
6.3.m: perform austerity quickly for the sake of a son by my command.' / At the end of these words, prostrating with eight limbs, she said:

6.3.s:
tvatprasādena viprendra sarvānkāmānavāpnuyām .
haṃsalīlāgatiḥ sā ca mṛgākṣī varavarṇinī .. 103.30 ..
6.3.d:
त्वत्प्रसादेन विप्रेन्द्र सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयाम् .
हंसलीलागतिः सा च मृगाक्षी वरवर्णिनी .. 103.30 ..
6.3.m: 'By your favor, O foremost among vipras, may I attain all desires.' / And she, walking with the playful grace of a swan, fawn-eyed and fair-complexioned,

6.3.s:
niyamasthā tato bhūtvā samprāptā narmadāṃ nadīm .
śivasvedodbhavāṃ devīṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm .. 103.31 ..
6.3.d:
नियमस्था ततो भूत्वा सम्प्राप्ता नर्मदां नदीम् .
शिवस्वेदोद्भवां देवीं सर्वपापप्रणाशनीम् .. 103.31 ..
6.3.m: abiding by observances, then reached the river Narmadā, / the goddess sprung from Śiva's sweat, destroyer of all sin,

6.3.s:
yasyā darśanamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ .
snānamātreṇa vai yasyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 103.32 ..
6.3.d:
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण नश्यते पापसञ्चयः .
स्नानमात्रेण वै यस्या अश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 103.32 ..
6.3.m: by the mere sight of whom the accumulation of sins is destroyed, / by the mere bath in whom one obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
ye pibanti mahādevi śraddadhānāḥ payaḥ śubham .
somapānena tattulyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 103.33 ..
6.3.d:
ये पिबन्ति महादेवि श्रद्दधानाः पयः शुभम् .
सोमपानेन तत्तुल्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 103.33 ..
6.3.m: Those who drink its auspicious water with faith, O great goddess, / that is equal to drinking Soma; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
ye smaranti divā rātrau yojanānāṃ śatairapi .
mucyante sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ prayānti te .. 103.34 ..
6.3.d:
ये स्मरन्ति दिवा रात्रौ योजनानां शतैरपि .
मुच्यन्ते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं प्रयान्ति ते .. 103.34 ..
6.3.m: Those who remember it day and night, even from a hundred yojanas away, / are freed from all sins and go to the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
narmadāyāḥ samīpe tu tāvubhau yojanadvaye .
na paśyanti yamaṃ tatra ye mṛtā varavarṇini .. 103.35 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदायाः समीपे तु तावुभौ योजनद्वये .
न पश्यन्ति यमं तत्र ये मृता वरवर्णिनि .. 103.35 ..
6.3.m: Within two yojanas on both sides near the Narmadā, / those who die there do not see Yama, O fair-complexioned one.

6.3.s:
tatastaduttare kūle eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame śubhe .
niyamasthā viśālākṣī śākāhāreṇa sundari .. 103.36 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तदुत्तरे कूले एरण्ड्याः सङ्गमे शुभे .
नियमस्था विशालाक्षी शाकाहारेण सुन्दरि .. 103.36 ..
6.3.m: Then on its northern bank, at the auspicious confluence with the Eraṇḍī, / keeping her vows, the large-eyed lady [lived] on a diet of vegetables, O beautiful one,

6.3.s:
toṣayantī trīṃśca devāñchubhaiḥ stotrairvrataistathā .
grīṣmeṣu ca mahādevi pañcāgniṃ sādhayettataḥ .. 103.37 ..
6.3.d:
तोषयन्ती त्रींश्च देवाञ्छुभैः स्तोत्रैर्व्रतैस्तथा .
ग्रीष्मेषु च महादेवि पञ्चाग्निं साधयेत्ततः .. 103.37 ..
6.3.m: pleasing the three gods with auspicious hymns of praise and vows. / And during the summer seasons, O great goddess, she would practice the five fires.

6.3.s:
varṣākāle cārdravāsāścareccāndrāyaṇāni ca .
hemante tu tataḥ prāpte toyamadhye vasetsadā .. 103.38 ..
6.3.d:
वर्षाकाले चार्द्रवासाश्चरेच्चान्द्रायणानि च .
हेमन्ते तु ततः प्राप्ते तोयमध्ये वसेत्सदा .. 103.38 ..
6.3.m: During the rainy season she wore wet clothes and performed the cāndrāyaṇa fasts; / when winter arrived, she would always dwell in the middle of water.

6.3.s:
prātaḥsnānaṃ tataḥ sandhyāṃ kuryāddevarṣitarpaṇam .
devānāmarcanaṃ kṛtvā homaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi .. 103.39 ..
6.3.d:
प्रातःस्नानं ततः सन्ध्यां कुर्याद्देवर्षितर्पणम् .
देवानामर्चनं कृत्वा होमं कुर्याद्यथाविधि .. 103.39 ..
6.3.m: She performed the morning ritual ablution, then the twilight prayer, and the libation to gods and seers; / having performed the worship of the gods, she performed the fire offering according to the rules.

6.3.s:
yajate vaiṣṇavāṃllokān snānajāpyahutena ca .
evaṃ varṣaśate prāpte rudraviṣṇupitāmahāḥ .. 103.40 ..
6.3.d:
यजते वैष्णवांल्लोकान् स्नानजाप्यहुतेन च .
एवं वर्षशते प्राप्ते रुद्रविष्णुपितामहाः .. 103.40 ..
6.3.m: She honored the worlds of Viṣṇu through ritual ablution, recitation, and oblations. / Thus, when a hundred years had passed, Rudra, Viṣṇu, and the Grandfather

6.3.s:
samprāptā dvijarūpaistu eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame priye .
purataḥ saṃsthitāstasyā vedamabhyuddharanti ca .. 103.41 ..
6.3.d:
सम्प्राप्ता द्विजरूपैस्तु एरण्ड्याः सङ्गमे प्रिये .
पुरतः संस्थितास्तस्या वेदमभ्युद्धरन्ति च .. 103.41 ..
6.3.m: arrived in the form of twice-born men at the confluence of the Eraṇḍī, O beloved, / and standing before her, they recited the Veda.

6.3.s:
anasūyā japaṃ tyaktvā nirīkṣya tānmuhurmuhuḥ .
utthitā sā viśālākṣī arghaṃ dattvā yathāvidhi .. 103.42 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूया जपं त्यक्त्वा निरीक्ष्य तान्मुहुर्मुहुः .
उत्थिता सा विशालाक्षी अर्घं दत्त्वा यथाविधि .. 103.42 ..
6.3.m: Anasūyā, setting aside her recitation and looking at them again and again, / arose, that large-eyed woman, and gave the water offering according to rule.

6.3.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ .
darśanena tu viprāṇāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 103.43 ..
6.3.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः .
दर्शनेन तु विप्राणां सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 103.43 ..
6.3.m: 'Today my birth has borne fruit! Today my austerity has borne fruit! / For by the sight of vipras one is freed from all sins.'

6.3.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇatābravīt .
kandamūlaphalaṃ śākaṃ nīvārānapi pāvanān .
prayacchāmyahamadyaiva munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām .. 103.44 ..
6.3.d:
प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा साष्टाङ्गं प्रणताब्रवीत् .
कन्दमूलफलं शाकं नीवारानपि पावनान् .
प्रयच्छाम्यहमद्यैव मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् .. 103.44 ..
6.3.m: Then, having circumambulated and bowed down with eight limbs, she said: / 'Roots, tubers, fruit, vegetables, and holy wild grains / I offer this very day to the sages of purified mind.'

6.3.s:
viprā ūcuḥ .
tapasā tu vicitreṇa tapaḥsatyena suvrate .
tṛptāḥ sma sarvakāmaistu suvrate tava darśanāt .. 103.45 ..
6.3.d:
विप्रा ऊचुः .
तपसा तु विचित्रेण तपःसत्येन सुव्रते .
तृप्ताः स्म सर्वकामैस्तु सुव्रते तव दर्शनात् .. 103.45 ..
6.3.m: The vipras said: / 'By your wondrous austerity and the truth of your austerity, O woman of good vows, / we are gratified in all desires, O lady of good vows, by the sight of you.

6.3.s:
asmākaṃ kautukaṃ jātaṃ tāpasena vratena yat .
svargamokṣasutasyārthe tapastapasi duṣkaram .. 103.46 ..
6.3.d:
अस्माकं कौतुकं जातं तापसेन व्रतेन यत् .
स्वर्गमोक्षसुतस्यार्थे तपस्तपसि दुष्करम् .. 103.46 ..
6.3.m: A curiosity has arisen in us regarding this ascetic vow of yours, / that for heaven, liberation, or a son you are performing such difficult austerity.'

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
tapasā sidhyate svargastapasā paramā gatiḥ .
tapasā cārthakāmau ca tapasā guṇavānsutaḥ .
tapa eva ca me viprāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 103.47 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
तपसा सिध्यते स्वर्गस्तपसा परमा गतिः .
तपसा चार्थकामौ च तपसा गुणवान्सुतः .
तप एव च मे विप्राः सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 103.47 ..
6.3.m: Anasūyā said: / 'Through austerity heaven is attained; through austerity the supreme goal [is reached]; / through austerity come wealth and desire; through austerity a virtuous son [is born]. / For me, O vipras, austerity alone grants the fruit of every desire.'

6.3.s:
viprā ūcuḥ .
tanvī śyāmā viśālākṣī snigdhāṅgī rūpasaṃyutā .
haṃsalīlāgatigamā tvaṃ ca sarvāṅgasundarī .. 103.48 ..
6.3.d:
विप्रा ऊचुः .
तन्वी श्यामा विशालाक्षी स्निग्धाङ्गी रूपसंयुता .
हंसलीलागतिगमा त्वं च सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी .. 103.48 ..
6.3.m: The vipras said: / 'Slender, youthful, large-eyed, graceful-limbed, endowed with beauty, / walking with the playful grace of a swan, and beautiful in all your limbs are you.

6.3.s: kiṃ ca te tapasā kāryamātmānaṃ śocyase katham .. 103.49 ..
6.3.d: किं च ते तपसा कार्यमात्मानं शोच्यसे कथम् .. 103.49 ..
6.3.m: What business do you have with austerity? Why do you torment yourself?'

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
yadi rudraśca viṣṇuśca svayaṃ sākṣātpitāmahaḥ .
gūḍharūpadharāḥ sarve taccihnamupalakṣaye .. 103.50 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
यदि रुद्रश्च विष्णुश्च स्वयं साक्षात्पितामहः .
गूढरूपधराः सर्वे तच्चिह्नमुपलक्षये .. 103.50 ..
6.3.m: Anasūyā said: / 'If you are Rudra, Viṣṇu, and the Grandfather himself in person / wearing disguised forms, I perceive those signs.'

6.3.s:
tasyā vākyāvasāne tu svarūpaṃ darśayanti te .
svasvarūpaiḥ sthitā devāḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhāḥ .. 103.51 ..
6.3.d:
तस्या वाक्यावसाने तु स्वरूपं दर्शयन्ति ते .
स्वस्वरूपैः स्थिता देवाः सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभाः .. 103.51 ..
6.3.m: At the conclusion of her speech, they revealed their true forms; / the gods stood in their own forms, radiant as ten million suns.

6.3.s:
caturbhujo mahādevi śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ .
atasīpuṣpavarṇastu pītavāsā janārdanaḥ .. 103.52 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्भुजो महादेवि शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः .
अतसीपुष्पवर्णस्तु पीतवासा जनार्दनः .. 103.52 ..
6.3.m: Four-armed, O great goddess, bearing the conch, discus, and mace, / with the color of an atasī flower, clad in yellow garments was Janārdana,

6.3.s:
garutmānvāhanaṃ yasya śriyā ca sahito hariḥ .
prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānsvayaṃrūpo vyavasthitaḥ .. 103.53 ..
6.3.d:
गरुत्मान्वाहनं यस्य श्रिया च सहितो हरिः .
प्रसन्नवदनः श्रीमान्स्वयंरूपो व्यवस्थितः .. 103.53 ..
6.3.m: Hari, whose mount is Garuḍa, accompanied by Śrī, / with a serene countenance, glorious, standing in his own true form.

6.3.s:
pītavāsā mahādevi caturvadanapaṅkajaḥ .
haṃsopari samārūḍho hyakṣamālākarodyataḥ .. 103.54 ..
6.3.d:
पीतवासा महादेवि चतुर्वदनपङ्कजः .
हंसोपरि समारूढो ह्यक्षमालाकरोद्यतः .. 103.54 ..
6.3.m: Clad in yellow garments, O great goddess, with four lotus-faces, / mounted upon a swan, with hands holding a rosary,

6.3.s:
āgato narmadātīre brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
yo'sau sarvajagadvyāpī svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ .. 103.55 ..
6.3.d:
आगतो नर्मदातीरे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
योऽसौ सर्वजगद्व्यापी स्वयं साक्षान्महेश्वरः .. 103.55 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, had come to the bank of the Narmadā. / And he who pervades the entire universe, Maheśvara himself in person,

6.3.s:
vṛṣabhaṃ tu samārūḍho daśabāhusamanvitaḥ .
bhasmāṅgarāgaśobhāḍhyaḥ pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ .. 103.56 ..
6.3.d:
वृषभं तु समारूढो दशबाहुसमन्वितः .
भस्माङ्गरागशोभाढ्यः पञ्चवक्त्रस्त्रिलोचनः .. 103.56 ..
6.3.m: mounted upon a bull, endowed with ten arms, / adorned with the splendor of ashes smeared on his body, five-faced and three-eyed,

6.3.s:
jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktaḥ kṛtacandrārddhaśekharaḥ .
evaṃrūpadharo devaḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ .. 103.57 ..
6.3.d:
जटामुकुटसंयुक्तः कृतचन्द्रार्द्धशेखरः .
एवंरूपधरो देवः सर्वव्यापी महेश्वरः .. 103.57 ..
6.3.m: endowed with a crown of matted hair, wearing the crescent moon on his head— / bearing such a form was the god Maheśvara, all-pervading.

6.3.s:
anasūyā nirīkṣyaitaddevānāṃ darśanaṃ param .
vepamānā tataḥ sādhvī surāndṛṣṭvā muhurmuhuḥ .. 103.58 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूया निरीक्ष्यैतद्देवानां दर्शनं परम् .
वेपमाना ततः साध्वी सुरान्दृष्ट्वा मुहुर्मुहुः .. 103.58 ..
6.3.m: Beholding this supreme vision of the gods, Anasūyā / trembled, the virtuous lady, looking at the gods again and again.

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
kiṃ vyāpārasvarūpāstu viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ .
etadvai śrotumicchāmi hyaśeṣaṃ kathayantu me .. 103.59 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
किं व्यापारस्वरूपास्तु विष्णुरुद्रपितामहाः .
एतद्वै श्रोतुमिच्छामि ह्यशेषं कथयन्तु मे .. 103.59 ..
6.3.m: Anasūyā said: / 'What is the nature of the functions of Viṣṇu, Rudra, and the Grandfather? / This indeed I wish to hear; tell it to me completely.'

6.3.s:
brahmovāca -
prāvṛṭkālo hyahaṃ brahmā āpaścaiva prakīrtitāḥ .
megharūpo hyahaṃ prokto varṣayāmi ca bhūtale .. 103.60 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच -
प्रावृट्कालो ह्यहं ब्रह्मा आपश्चैव प्रकीर्तिताः .
मेघरूपो ह्यहं प्रोक्तो वर्षयामि च भूतले .. 103.60 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā said: / 'I, Brahmā, am the rainy season, and I am celebrated as the waters; / I am said to be in the form of clouds, and I cause rain upon the surface of the earth.

6.3.s:
ahaṃ sarvāṇi bījāni prāksandhyāsūdite ravau .
etadvai kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ param .. 103.61 ..
6.3.d:
अहं सर्वाणि बीजानि प्राक्सन्ध्यासूदिते रवौ .
एतद्वै कारणं सर्वं रहस्यं कथितं परम् .. 103.61 ..
6.3.m: I am all the seeds; at the morning twilight when the sun has risen. / This is the whole cause, the supreme secret that has been told.'

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
hemantaśca bhavedviṣṇurviśvarūpaṃ carācaram .
pālanāya jagatsarvaṃ viṣṇormāhātmyamuttamam .. 103.62 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
हेमन्तश्च भवेद्विष्णुर्विश्वरूपं चराचरम् .
पालनाय जगत्सर्वं विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .. 103.62 ..
6.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / 'Viṣṇu is the winter season, the universal form, moving and unmoving; / for the protection of the whole universe is the supreme glory of Viṣṇu.'

6.3.s:
rudra uvāca -
grīṣmakālo hyahaṃ proktaḥ sarvabhūtakṣayaṃkaraḥ .
karṣayāmi jagatsarvaṃ rudrarūpastapasvini .. 103.63 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्र उवाच -
ग्रीष्मकालो ह्यहं प्रोक्तः सर्वभूतक्षयंकरः .
कर्षयामि जगत्सर्वं रुद्ररूपस्तपस्विनि .. 103.63 ..
6.3.m: Rudra said: / 'I am declared to be the summer season, the bringer of destruction to all beings; / in the form of Rudra I consume the entire universe, O ascetic lady.'

6.3.s:
evaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva mahāvrate .
trayo devāstrayaḥ sandhyāstrayaḥ kālāstrayo'gnayaḥ .. 103.64 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्चैव महाव्रते .
त्रयो देवास्त्रयः सन्ध्यास्त्रयः कालास्त्रयोऽग्नयः .. 103.64 ..
6.3.m: Thus are Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, O lady of great vows; / the three gods are the three junctures of the day, the three seasons, and the three fires.

6.3.s:
tathā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaikātmatāṃ gataḥ .
varaṃ dadyuśca te bhadre yastvayā manasīpsitam .. 103.65 ..
6.3.d:
तथा ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्चैकात्मतां गतः .
वरं दद्युश्च ते भद्रे यस्त्वया मनसीप्सितम् .. 103.65 ..
6.3.m:
Likewise, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, having attained unity of self,
shall grant you the boon, O auspicious lady, that is desired in your heart.

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
dhanyā puṇyā hyahaṃ loke ślāghyā vandyā ca sarvadā .
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca prasannavadanāḥ śubhāḥ .. 103.66 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
धन्या पुण्या ह्यहं लोके श्लाघ्या वन्द्या च सर्वदा .
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च प्रसन्नवदनाः शुभाः .. 103.66 ..

6.3.s:
yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .
asmiṃstīrthe tu sāṃnidhyādvaradāḥ santu me sadā .. 103.67 ..
6.3.d:
यदि तुष्टास्त्रयो देवा दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु सांनिध्याद्वरदाः सन्तु मे सदा .. 103.67 ..
6.3.m:
If the three gods are pleased, having shown compassion toward me,
let them ever grant boons to me by their presence at this sacred ford.

6.3.s:
rudra uvāca -
evaṃ bhavatu te vākyaṃ yattvayā prārthitaṃ śubhe .
pratyakṣā vaiṣṇavī māyā eraṇḍīnāma nāmataḥ .. 103.68 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्र उवाच -
एवं भवतु ते वाक्यं यत्त्वया प्रार्थितं शुभे .
प्रत्यक्षा वैष्णवी माया एरण्डीनाम नामतः .. 103.68 ..
6.3.m:
Rudra said:
May it be so according to your word, which you have requested, O auspicious lady!
You are the visible Vaiṣṇavī Māyā, bearing the name Eraṇḍī.

6.3.s:
yasyā darśanamātreṇa naśyate pāpasañcayaḥ .
caitramāse tu samprāpte ahorātroṣito bhavet .. 103.69 ..
6.3.d:
यस्या दर्शनमात्रेण नश्यते पापसञ्चयः .
चैत्रमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते अहोरात्रोषितो भवेत् .. 103.69 ..
6.3.m:
By the mere sight of whom the accumulation of sin is destroyed.
When the month of Caitra arrives, one should fast for a day and a night;

6.3.s:
eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātprabhāte bhojayeddvijān .. 103.70 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्ड्याः सङ्गमे स्नात्वा ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति .
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्प्रभाते भोजयेद्द्विजान् .. 103.70 ..
6.3.m:
Having bathed at the confluence of the Eraṇḍī, he dispels the sin of slaying a brahmin.
One should keep a night vigil and feed brahmins in the morning.

6.3.s:
yathoktena vidhānena piṇḍaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi .
pradakṣiṇāṃ tato dadyāddhiraṇyaṃ vastrameva ca .. 103.71 ..
6.3.d:
यथोक्तेन विधानेन पिण्डं दद्याद्यथाविधि .
प्रदक्षिणां ततो दद्याद्धिरण्यं वस्त्रमेव च .. 103.71 ..
6.3.m:
In accordance with the stated rite, he should offer a rice-ball as prescribed.
Then he should perform circumambulation and give gold and clothing,

6.3.s:
rajataṃ ca tathā gāvo bhūmidānamathāpi vā .
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktamiti svāyambhuvo'bravīt .. 103.72 ..
6.3.d:
रजतं च तथा गावो भूमिदानमथापि वा .
सर्वं कोटिगुणं प्रोक्तमिति स्वायम्भुवोऽब्रवीत् .. 103.72 ..
6.3.m:
As well as silver, cows, or the gift of land.
All is said to be multiplied ten million times; so spoke the Self-born one.

6.3.s:
ye mriyanti narā devi eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame śubhe .
yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu rudraloke vasanti te .. 103.73 ..
6.3.d:
ये म्रियन्ति नरा देवि एरण्ड्याः सङ्गमे शुभे .
यावद्युगसहस्रं तु रुद्रलोके वसन्ति ते .. 103.73 ..
6.3.m:
Those men who die, O goddess, at the auspicious confluence of the Eraṇḍī,
dwell in the world of Rudra for a thousand yugas.

6.3.s:
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā japedrudrāṃśca vaidikān .
ekādaśaikasaṃjñāṃśca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 103.74 ..
6.3.d:
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा जपेद्रुद्रांश्च वैदिकान् .
एकादशैकसंज्ञांश्च स याति परमां गतिम् .. 103.74 ..
6.3.m:
Having fasted for a day and a night, he should recite the Vedic Rudras
and the eleven called Ekā, and he goes to the supreme state.

6.3.s:
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam .
putrārthī labhate putrāṃllabhetkāmān yathepsitān .. 103.75 ..
6.3.d:
विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां धनार्थी लभते धनम् .
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रांल्लभेत्कामान् यथेप्सितान् .. 103.75 ..
6.3.m:
One seeking knowledge obtains knowledge; one seeking wealth obtains wealth;
one seeking sons obtains sons; he shall attain his desires as wished.

6.3.s:
eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgame snātvā revāyā vimale jale .
mahāpātakino vāpi te yānti paramāṃ gatim .. 103.76 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्ड्याः सङ्गमे स्नात्वा रेवाया विमले जले .
महापातकिनो वापि ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् .. 103.76 ..
6.3.m:
Having bathed at the confluence of the Eraṇḍī in the clear water of the Revā,
even great sinners go to the supreme state.

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
yadi tuṣṭāstrayo devā mama bhaktipracoditāḥ .
mama putrā bhavantveva harirudrapitāmahāḥ .. 103.77 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
यदि तुष्टास्त्रयो देवा मम भक्तिप्रचोदिताः .
मम पुत्रा भवन्त्वेव हरिरुद्रपितामहाः .. 103.77 ..
6.3.m:
Anasūyā said:
If the three gods are pleased, impelled by my devotion,
let Hari, Rudra, and Pitāmaha indeed become my sons.

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
pūjyā yatputratāṃ yānti na kadācicchrutaṃ mayā .
śubhe dadāmi putrāṃste devatulyaparākramān .
rūpavanto guṇopetānyajvinaśca bahuśrutān .. 103.78 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
पूज्या यत्पुत्रतां यान्ति न कदाचिच्छ्रुतं मया .
शुभे ददामि पुत्रांस्ते देवतुल्यपराक्रमान् .
रूपवन्तो गुणोपेतान्यज्विनश्च बहुश्रुतान् .. 103.78 ..
6.3.m:
Viṣṇu said:
That those worthy of worship become sons has never been heard by me.
O auspicious lady, I grant you sons equal to gods in prowess,
handsome, endowed with virtues, sacrificers, and highly learned.

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
īpsitaṃ tacca dātavyaṃ yanmayā prārthitaṃ hare .
nānyathā caiva kartavyā mama putraiṣaṇā tu yā .. 103.79 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
ईप्सितं तच्च दातव्यं यन्मया प्रार्थितं हरे .
नान्यथा चैव कर्तव्या मम पुत्रैषणा तु या .. 103.79 ..
6.3.m:
Anasūyā said:
That desired thing must be given which I requested, O Hari!
And my desire for sons must not be made otherwise.

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
pūrvaṃ tu bhṛgusaṃvāde garbhavāsa upārjitaḥ .
tasyāhaṃ caiva pāraṃ tu naiva paśyāmi śobhane .. 103.80 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
पूर्वं तु भृगुसंवादे गर्भवास उपार्जितः .
तस्याहं चैव पारं तु नैव पश्यामि शोभने .. 103.80 ..

6.3.s:
smaramāṇaḥ purāvṛttaṃ cintayāmi punaḥpunaḥ .
evaṃ saṃcintya te devāḥ pitāmahamaheśvarāḥ .. 103.81 ..
6.3.d:
स्मरमाणः पुरावृत्तं चिन्तयामि पुनःपुनः .
एवं संचिन्त्य ते देवाः पितामहमहेश्वराः .. 103.81 ..
6.3.m:
Remembering the past event, I think of it again and again.
Reflecting thus, those gods, Pitāmaha and Maheśvara,

6.3.s:
ayonijā bhaviṣyāmastava putrā varānane .
yonivāse mahāprājñi devā naiva vrajanti ca .. 103.82 ..
6.3.d:
अयोनिजा भविष्यामस्तव पुत्रा वरानने .
योनिवासे महाप्राज्ञि देवा नैव व्रजन्ति च .. 103.82 ..
6.3.m:
[said:] “We shall become your sons not born of a womb, O fair-faced lady!
For gods do not enter dwelling in a womb, O highly wise one.

6.3.s:
sāṃnidhyātsaṅgame devi lokānāṃ tu varapradāḥ .
eraṇḍī vaiṣṇavī māyā pratyakṣā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .. 103.83 ..
6.3.d:
सांनिध्यात्सङ्गमे देवि लोकानां तु वरप्रदाः .
एरण्डी वैष्णवी माया प्रत्यक्षा त्वं भविष्यसि .. 103.83 ..
6.3.m:
Through our presence at the confluence, O goddess, granting boons to the worlds,
you will become visibly manifest as the Eraṇḍī, the Vaiṣṇavī Māyā.”

6.3.s:
trayo devāḥ sthitāḥ pātha revāyā uttare taṭe .
varaprāptā tu sā devī gatā māhendraparvatam .. 103.84 ..
6.3.d:
त्रयो देवाः स्थिताः पाथ रेवाया उत्तरे तटे .
वरप्राप्ता तु सा देवी गता माहेन्द्रपर्वतम् .. 103.84 ..
6.3.m:
The three gods remained in the water on the northern bank of the Revā.
Having received the boon, that goddess went to Mount Mahendra.

6.3.s:
kṣīṇāṅgī śukladehā ca rūkṣakeśī sudāruṇā .
kṛtayajñopavītā sā taponiṣṭhā śubhekṣaṇā .. 103.85 ..
6.3.d:
क्षीणाङ्गी शुक्लदेहा च रूक्षकेशी सुदारुणा .
कृतयज्ञोपवीता सा तपोनिष्ठा शुभेक्षणा .. 103.85 ..
6.3.m:
Emaciated of limb, with a pale body, dry hair, exceedingly severe,
wearing the sacred thread, devoted to austerity, lovely-eyed,

6.3.s:
śilātalaniviṣṭo'sau dṛṣṭaḥ kānto mahāyaśāḥ .
hṛṣṭacitto'bhavaddevi uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha sābravīt .. 103.86 ..
6.3.d:
शिलातलनिविष्टोऽसौ दृष्टः कान्तो महायशाः .
हृष्टचित्तोऽभवद्देवि उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ साब्रवीत् .. 103.86 ..
6.3.m:
She saw her beloved husband of great renown seated on a stone slab.
His mind was delighted, O goddess; she said: “Arise! Arise!”

6.3.s:
atriruvāca -
sādhu sādhu mahāprājñe hyanasūye mahāvrate .
acintyaṃ gālavādīnāṃ varaṃ prāptāsi durlabham .. 103.87 ..
6.3.d:
अत्रिरुवाच -
साधु साधु महाप्राज्ञे ह्यनसूये महाव्रते .
अचिन्त्यं गालवादीनां वरं प्राप्तासि दुर्लभम् .. 103.87 ..
6.3.m:
Atri said:
“Well done, well done, O highly wise Anasūyā of great vows!
You have obtained a rare boon unthinkable to Gālava and others.”

6.3.s:
anasūyovāca -
tvatprasādena devarṣe varaṃ prāptāsmi durlabham .
tena devāḥ praśaṃsanti siddhāśca ṛṣayo'malāḥ .. 103.88 ..
6.3.d:
अनसूयोवाच -
त्वत्प्रसादेन देवर्षे वरं प्राप्तास्मि दुर्लभम् .
तेन देवाः प्रशंसन्ति सिद्धाश्च ऋषयोऽमलाः .. 103.88 ..
6.3.m:
Anasūyā said:
“By your grace, O divine seer, I have obtained a rare boon,
because of which the gods, the Siddhas, and the spotless seers praise [me].”

6.3.s:
evamuktā tu sā devī harṣeṇa mahatā yutā .
ālokayettataḥ kāntaṃ tenāpi śubhadarśanā .. 103.89 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी हर्षेण महता युता .
आलोकयेत्ततः कान्तं तेनापि शुभदर्शना .. 103.89 ..
6.3.m:
Having spoken thus, that goddess, filled with great joy
and of auspicious sight, then looked at her beloved, and he at her.

6.3.s:
īkṣaṇāccaiva saṃjātaṃ lalāṭe maṇḍalaṃ śubham .
navayojanasāhasraṃ maṇḍalaṃ raśmibhirvṛtam .. 103.90 ..
6.3.d:
ईक्षणाच्चैव संजातं ललाटे मण्डलं शुभम् .
नवयोजनसाहस्रं मण्डलं रश्मिभिर्वृतम् .. 103.90 ..
6.3.m:
And from that gazing, an auspicious orb arose upon the forehead,
an orb nine thousand yojanas in size, surrounded by rays,

6.3.s:
kadambagolakākāraṃ triguṇaṃ parimaṇḍalam .
tasya madhye tu deveśi puruṣo divyarūpadhṛk .. 103.91 ..
6.3.d:
कदम्बगोलकाकारं त्रिगुणं परिमण्डलम् .
तस्य मध्ये तु देवेशि पुरुषो दिव्यरूपधृक् .. 103.91 ..
6.3.m:
In the shape of a kadamba flower's spherical cluster, a threefold circle.
In the midst of it, O queen of the gods, was a person bearing a divine form,

6.3.s:
hemavarṇo'mṛtamayaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ .
ādyaḥ putro'nasūyāyāḥ svayaṃ sākṣātpitāmahaḥ .. 103.92 ..
6.3.d:
हेमवर्णोऽमृतमयः सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभः .
आद्यः पुत्रोऽनसूयायाः स्वयं साक्षात्पितामहः .. 103.92 ..
6.3.m:
Gold-hued, full of nectar, equal in radiance to ten million suns.
He was the first son of Anasūyā, manifestly Pitāmaha himself,

6.3.s:
candramā iti vikhyātaḥ somarūpo nṛpātmaja .
iṣṭāpūrte ca saṃpāti kalāṣoḍaśakena tu .. 103.93 ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रमा इति विख्यातः सोमरूपो नृपात्मज .
इष्टापूर्ते च संपाति कलाषोडशकेन तु .. 103.93 ..
6.3.m:
Renowned as Candramas, possessing the form of Soma, O prince,
falling upon sacrifice and charitable works by means of his sixteen digits.

6.3.s:
pratipacca dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca maheśvari .
caturthī pañcamī caiva avyayā ṣoḍaśī kalā .. 103.94 ..
6.3.d:
प्रतिपच्च द्वितीया च तृतीया च महेश्वरि .
चतुर्थी पञ्चमी चैव अव्यया षोडशी कला .. 103.94 ..
6.3.m:
The first lunar day, the second, and the third, O Maheśvarī,
the fourth, and the fifth, up to the imperishable sixteenth digit;

6.3.s:
caturvidhasya lokasya sūkṣmo bhūtvā varānane .
āprīṇāti jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 103.95 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्विधस्य लोकस्य सूक्ष्मो भूत्वा वरानने .
आप्रीणाति जगत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 103.95 ..
6.3.m:
Becoming subtle for the fourfold world, O fair-faced lady,
he gladdens the entire universe, the three worlds with the moving and unmoving.

6.3.s:
sarve te hyupajīvanti hutaṃ dattaṃ śaśisthitam .
vanaspatigate some dhanavāṃśca varānane .. 103.96 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वे ते ह्युपजीवन्ति हुतं दत्तं शशिस्थितम् .
वनस्पतिगते सोमे धनवांश्च वरानने .. 103.96 ..
6.3.m:
All of them subsist on the oblation and the gift that resides in the moon.
When Soma enters into the plants, O fair-faced lady, a rich man

6.3.s:
bhuñjan paragṛhe mūḍho dadedabdakṛtaṃ śubham .
vanaspatigate some yastu chindyādvanaspatīn .
tena pāpena deveśi narā yānti yamālayam .. 103.97 ..
6.3.d:
भुञ्जन् परगृहे मूढो ददेदब्दकृतं शुभम् .
वनस्पतिगते सोमे यस्तु छिन्द्याद्वनस्पतीन् .
तेन पापेन देवेशि नरा यान्ति यमालयम् .. 103.97 ..
6.3.m:
eating foolishly in another's house gives away the merit accumulated in a year.
Whoever cuts down trees when Soma has entered into the plants,
by that sin, O queen of the gods, men go to Yama's abode.

6.3.s:
vanaspatigate some maithunaṃ yo niṣevate .
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 103.98 ..
6.3.d:
वनस्पतिगते सोमे मैथुनं यो निषेवते .
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं लभते नात्र संशयः .. 103.98 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever indulges in sexual intercourse when Soma has entered into the plants,
incurs a sin equal to slaying a brahmin; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
vanaspatigate some manthānaṃ yo'dhivāhayet .
gāvastasya praṇaśyanti yāśca vai pūrvasaṃcitāḥ .. 103.99 ..
6.3.d:
वनस्पतिगते सोमे मन्थानं योऽधिवाहयेत् .
गावस्तस्य प्रणश्यन्ति याश्च वै पूर्वसंचिताः .. 103.99 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever works a churning-stick when Soma has entered into the plants,
his cattle perish, even those gathered formerly.

6.3.s:
vanaspatigate some hyadhvānaṃ yo'dhigacchati .
bhavanti pitarastasya taṃ māsaṃ reṇubhojanāḥ .. 103.100 ..
6.3.d:
वनस्पतिगते सोमे ह्यध्वानं योऽधिगच्छति .
भवन्ति पितरस्तस्य तं मासं रेणुभोजनाः .. 103.100 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever journeys on a path when Soma has entered into the plants,
his ancestors become eaters of dust for that month.

6.3.s:
amāvasyāṃ mahādevi yastu śrāddhaprado bhavet .
abdamekaṃ viśālākṣi tṛptāstatpitaro dhruvam .. 103.101 ..
6.3.d:
अमावस्यां महादेवि यस्तु श्राद्धप्रदो भवेत् .
अब्दमेकं विशालाक्षि तृप्तास्तत्पितरो ध्रुवम् .. 103.101 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever offers a śrāddha on the new-moon day, O great goddess,
his ancestors are surely satisfied for one whole year, O large-eyed lady.

6.3.s:
hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ yo dadāti dvijātiṣu .
sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ devi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 103.102 ..
6.3.d:
हिरण्यं रजतं वस्त्रं यो ददाति द्विजातिषु .
सर्वं लक्षगुणं देवि लभते नात्र संशयः .. 103.102 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever gives gold, silver, or clothing to the twice-born,
obtains it all multiplied a hundred thousand times, O goddess; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭo'sau somarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ .
saṃjātaḥ prathamaḥ putro hyanasūyāsunandanaḥ .. 103.103 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गुणविशिष्टोऽसौ सोमरूपः प्रजापतिः .
संजातः प्रथमः पुत्रो ह्यनसूयासुनन्दनः .. 103.103 ..
6.3.m:
Thus, endowed with these virtues, this Prajāpati in the form of Soma
was born as the first son, bringing joy to Anasūyā.

6.3.s:
dvitīyastu mahādevi durvāsā nāma nāmataḥ .
sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartā ca svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ .. 103.104 ..
6.3.d:
द्वितीयस्तु महादेवि दुर्वासा नाम नामतः .
सृष्टिसंहारकर्ता च स्वयं साक्षान्महेश्वरः .. 103.104 ..
6.3.m:
The second, O great goddess, was named Durvāsas,
the maker of creation and destruction, manifestly Maheśvara himself.

6.3.s:
ṛṣimadhyagato devi tapastapati duṣkaram .
so'pi rudratvamāyāti samprāpte bhūtaviplave .. 103.105 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषिमध्यगतो देवि तपस्तपति दुष्करम् .
सोऽपि रुद्रत्वमायाति सम्प्राप्ते भूतविप्लवे .. 103.105 ..
6.3.m:
Remaining in the midst of seers, O goddess, he performs difficult austerity;
and he too attains Rudrahood when the destruction of beings arrives.

6.3.s:
indro'pi śaptastenaiva durvāsasā varānane .
dvitīyasya tu putrasya sambhavaḥ kathito mayā .. 103.106 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रोऽपि शप्तस्तेनैव दुर्वाससा वरानने .
द्वितीयस्य तु पुत्रस्य सम्भवः कथितो मया .. 103.106 ..
6.3.m: Even Indra was cursed by that very Durvāsas, O fair-faced lady. / Thus the origin of the second son has been related by me.

6.3.s:
dattātreyasvarūpeṇa bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ .
jagadvyāpī jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ sākṣājjanārdanaḥ .. 103.107 ..
6.3.d:
दत्तात्रेयस्वरूपेण भगवान्मधुसूदनः .
जगद्व्यापी जगन्नाथः स्वयं साक्षाज्जनार्दनः .. 103.107 ..
6.3.m: In the form of Dattātreya was the Blessed Madhusūdana, / the all-pervading Lord of the World, Janārdana himself manifest in person.

6.3.s:
ete devāstrayaḥ putrā anasūyāyā maheśvari .
varadānena te devā hyavatīrṇā mahītale .. 103.108 ..
6.3.d:
एते देवास्त्रयः पुत्रा अनसूयाया महेश्वरि .
वरदानेन ते देवा ह्यवतीर्णा महीतले .. 103.108 ..
6.3.m: These gods are the three sons of Anasūyā, O great goddess; / by the bestowal of a boon, those gods descended to the surface of the earth.

6.3.s:
putraprāptikaraṃ tīrthaṃ revāyāścottare taṭe .
anasūyākṛtaṃ pārtha sarvapāpakṣayaṃ param .. 103.109 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रप्राप्तिकरं तीर्थं रेवायाश्चोत्तरे तटे .
अनसूयाकृतं पार्थ सर्वपापक्षयं परम् .. 103.109 ..
6.3.m: On the northern bank of the Revā is a sacred ford that grants sons, / founded by Anasūyā, O son of Pṛthā, supreme in destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
āścaryabhūtaṃ loke'sminnarmadāyāṃ purātanam .
bhrūṇahatyā gatā tatra brāhmaṇasya narādhipa .. 103.110 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेऽस्मिन्नर्मदायां पुरातनम् .
भ्रूणहत्या गता तत्र ब्राह्मणस्य नराधिप .. 103.110 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / There is an ancient wonder in this world at the Narmadā, / where the murder of an embryo was eradicated for a brahmin, O king.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
itihāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kathayasva mamānagha .
sarvapāpaharaṃ loke duḥkhārtasya ca kathyatām .. 103.111 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
इतिहासं द्विजश्रेष्ठ कथयस्व ममानघ .
सर्वपापहरं लोके दुःखार्तस्य च कथ्यताम् .. 103.111 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O best of the twice-born, sinless one, relate that history to me; / let it be told, which removes all sins in this world and aids one afflicted with grief.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
suvarṇaśilake grāme gautamānvayasambhavaḥ .
kṛṣīvalo mahādevi bhāryāputrasamanvitaḥ .. 103.112 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सुवर्णशिलके ग्रामे गौतमान्वयसम्भवः .
कृषीवलो महादेवि भार्यापुत्रसमन्वितः .. 103.112 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the village of Suvarṇaśilaka, born of the lineage of Gautama, / was a farmer, O great goddess, accompanied by his wife and son.

6.3.s:
vasate tatra govindaḥ saṃjāto vipule kule .
putradārasamopeto gṛhakṣetrarataḥ sadā .. 103.113 ..
6.3.d:
वसते तत्र गोविन्दः संजातो विपुले कुले .
पुत्रदारसमोपेतो गृहक्षेत्ररतः सदा .. 103.113 ..
6.3.m: Govinda, born into a great lineage, lived there / endowed with a son and wife, always devoted to his house and fields.

6.3.s:
śakaṭaṃ pūrayitvā tu kāṣṭhānāmagamadguham .
prakṣiptāni ca kāṣṭhāni hyekākī kṣudhayānvitaḥ .. 103.114 ..
6.3.d:
शकटं पूरयित्वा तु काष्ठानामगमद्गुहम् .
प्रक्षिप्तानि च काष्ठानि ह्येकाकी क्षुधयान्वितः .. 103.114 ..
6.3.m: Having filled a cart with firewood, he went to his house; / and being alone and afflicted with hunger, he threw down the logs of wood.

6.3.s:
riṅgamāṇastadā putraḥ pituḥ śabdātsamāgataḥ .
na dṛṣṭastena vai putraḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ saṃchādito'vaśaḥ .. 103.115 ..
6.3.d:
रिङ्गमाणस्तदा पुत्रः पितुः शब्दात्समागतः .
न दृष्टस्तेन वै पुत्रः काष्ठैः संछादितोऽवशः .. 103.115 ..
6.3.m: At that time his crawling son came toward the sound of his father; / he was not seen by him, and helpless, was covered by the firewood.

6.3.s:
āgatastvarito gehe pipāsārto narādhipa .
śakaṭaṃ mocya taddvāri savṛṣaṃ rajjusaṃyutam .. 103.116 ..
6.3.d:
आगतस्त्वरितो गेहे पिपासार्तो नराधिप .
शकटं मोच्य तद्द्वारि सवृषं रज्जुसंयुतम् .. 103.116 ..
6.3.m: Afflicted with thirst, he quickly entered the house, O king, / unyoking the cart with its bulls and ropes at the door.

6.3.s:
bhāryā tasyaiva yā dṛṣṭā cittajñā vaśavartinī .
dṛṣṭvā nipātitaṃ putraṃ kāṣṭhairnirbhinnamastakam .. 103.117 ..
6.3.d:
भार्या तस्यैव या दृष्टा चित्तज्ञा वशवर्तिनी .
दृष्ट्वा निपातितं पुत्रं काष्ठैर्निर्भिन्नमस्तकम् .. 103.117 ..
6.3.m: His wife, who was perceptive and obedient, / seeing her son knocked down with his skull split open by the logs,

6.3.s:
ajalpamānākaruṇaṃ nikṣiptaṃ jñolikāṃ śiśum .
śuśrūṣaṇe ratā sādhvī priyasya ca narādhipa .. 103.118 ..
6.3.d:
अजल्पमानाकरुणं निक्षिप्तं ज्ञोलिकां शिशुम् .
शुश्रूषणे रता साध्वी प्रियस्य च नराधिप .. 103.118 ..
6.3.m: without uttering a word in pity, placed the child in a swing-pouch; / and devoted to serving her beloved husband, O king,

6.3.s:
tataḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā bhojanācchayanaṃ śubham .
putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭhā hyutthāpayati śāsanaiḥ .. 103.119 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स्नानादिकं कृत्वा भोजनाच्छयनं शुभम् .
पुत्रं पुत्रवतां श्रेष्ठा ह्युत्थापयति शासनैः .. 103.119 ..
6.3.m: she then gave him a bath and other services, [followed by] food and a comfortable bed; / and [then] the best of mothers roused her son with gentle calls.

6.3.s:
yadā ca notthitaḥ suptaḥ putraḥ pañcatvamāgataḥ .
tadā sā dīnavadanā ruroda ca mumoha ca .. 103.120 ..
6.3.d:
यदा च नोत्थितः सुप्तः पुत्रः पञ्चत्वमागतः .
तदा सा दीनवदना रुरोद च मुमोह च .. 103.120 ..
6.3.m: When the sleeping son did not rise, having met his death, / then she, with a miserable face, wept and swooned.

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā ruditaṃ śabdaṃ govindastrastamānasaḥ .
kimetaditi coktvā tu patito dharaṇītale .. 103.121 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा रुदितं शब्दं गोविन्दस्त्रस्तमानसः .
किमेतदिति चोक्त्वा तु पतितो धरणीतले .. 103.121 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that sound of weeping, Govinda, terrified in his mind, / cried out, “What is this?” and fell down upon the ground.

6.3.s:
dvāvetau muktakeśau tu bhūmau nipatitau nṛpa .
vilepāte ca rājendra niḥśvāsocchvāsitena ca .. 103.122 ..
6.3.d:
द्वावेतौ मुक्तकेशौ तु भूमौ निपतितौ नृप .
विलेपाते च राजेन्द्र निःश्वासोच्छ्वासितेन च .. 103.122 ..
6.3.m: Both of them, with disheveled hair, fell down upon the ground, O king, / and wailed, O best of kings, heaving sighs.

6.3.s:
kaṃ paśye prāṅgaṇe putraṃ dṛṣṭvā krīḍantamāturam .
saṃdhārayiṣye hṛdayaṃ sphuṭitaṃ tava kāraṇe .. 103.123 ..
6.3.d:
कं पश्ये प्राङ्गणे पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा क्रीडन्तमातुरम् .
संधारयिष्ये हृदयं स्फुटितं तव कारणे .. 103.123 ..
6.3.m: “Whom shall I see playing anxiously in the courtyard, O son? / How shall I support my heart that has burst asunder on your account?

6.3.s:
tvajjanmāntaṃ yaśo nityamakṣayāṃ kulasantatim .
dṛṣṭvā kimanṛṇībhūto yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim .. 103.124 ..
6.3.d:
त्वज्जन्मान्तं यशो नित्यमक्षयां कुलसन्ततिम् .
दृष्ट्वा किमनृणीभूतो यास्यामि परमां गतिम् .. 103.124 ..
6.3.m: Seeing perpetual fame and unbroken family continuity throughout your life, / will I ever become free of debt and reach the supreme state?

6.3.s:
mama vṛddhasya dīnasya gatistvaṃ kila putraka .
ete manorathāḥ sarve cintitā viphalā gatāḥ .. 103.125 ..
6.3.d:
मम वृद्धस्य दीनस्य गतिस्त्वं किल पुत्रक .
एते मनोरथाः सर्वे चिन्तिता विफला गताः .. 103.125 ..
6.3.m: You were indeed the sole refuge for me, aged and wretched, O son! / All these desires envisioned by me have gone in vain.

6.3.s:
imāṃ tu vikalāṃ dīnāṃ vihīnāṃ sutabāndhavaiḥ .
rudantīṃ patitāṃ pāhi mātaraṃ dharaṇītale .. 103.126 ..
6.3.d:
इमां तु विकलां दीनां विहीनां सुतबान्धवैः .
रुदन्तीं पतितां पाहि मातरं धरणीतले .. 103.126 ..
6.3.m: Protect this mother of yours, fallen upon the surface of the earth, / distraught, wretched, bereft of her son and kin, weeping!

6.3.s:
punnāmno narakādyasmātpitaraṃ trāyate sutaḥ .
tena putra iti proktaḥ svayameva svayambhuvā .. 103.127 ..
6.3.d:
पुन्नाम्नो नरकाद्यस्मात्पितरं त्रायते सुतः .
तेन पुत्र इति प्रोक्तः स्वयमेव स्वयम्भुवा .. 103.127 ..
6.3.m: Because a son protects his father from the hell named Put, / therefore he was called ‘putra’ by the Self-manifest [Brahmā] himself.

6.3.s:
aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ diśaḥ śūnyā hyabāndhavāḥ .
mūrkhasya hṛdayaṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaśūnyaṃ daridratā .. 103.128 ..
6.3.d:
अपुत्रस्य गृहं शून्यं दिशः शून्या ह्यबान्धवाः .
मूर्खस्य हृदयं शून्यं सर्वशून्यं दरिद्रता .. 103.128 ..
6.3.m: Empty is the house of a sonless man, empty are all the quarters to one without kin, / empty is the heart of a fool, and poverty is emptiness in everything.

6.3.s:
mṛṣāyaṃ vadate lokaścandanaṃ kila śītalam .
putragātrapariṣvaṅgaścandanādapi śītalaḥ .. 103.129 ..
6.3.d:
मृषायं वदते लोकश्चन्दनं किल शीतलम् .
पुत्रगात्रपरिष्वङ्गश्चन्दनादपि शीतलः .. 103.129 ..
6.3.m: People falsely say that sandalwood is cooling; / the embrace of a son’s body is cooler even than sandalwood.

6.3.s:
śmaśrugrahaṇakrīḍantaṃ dhūlidhūsaritānanam .
puṇyahīnā na paśyanti nijotsaṅgasamāsthitam .. 103.130 ..
6.3.d:
श्मश्रुग्रहणक्रीडन्तं धूलिधूसरिताननम् .
पुण्यहीना न पश्यन्ति निजोत्सङ्गसमास्थितम् .. 103.130 ..
6.3.m: Those devoid of merit do not see [a child] seated upon their lap, / playing by grasping their beard, his face dusted with dirt.

6.3.s:
digambaraṃ gatavrīḍaṃ jaṭilaṃ dhūlidhūsaram .
puṇyahīnā na paśyanti gaṅgādharamivātmajam .. 103.131 ..
6.3.d:
दिगम्बरं गतव्रीडं जटिलं धूलिधूसरम् .
पुण्यहीना न पश्यन्ति गङ्गाधरमिवात्मजम् .. 103.131 ..
6.3.m: Those devoid of merit do not see their own son looking like Gaṅgādhara, / naked, shameless, with matted hair, and covered in dust.

6.3.s:
vīṇāvādyasvaro loke susvaraḥ śrūyate kila .
ruditaṃ bālakasyaiva tasmādāhlādakārakam .. 103.132 ..
6.3.d:
वीणावाद्यस्वरो लोके सुस्वरः श्रूयते किल .
रुदितं बालकस्यैव तस्मादाह्लादकारकम् .. 103.132 ..
6.3.m: The melodious sound of the lute is indeed heard as pleasing in this world; / yet the weeping of a child is far more delightful than that.

6.3.s:
mṛgapakṣiṣu kākeṣu paśūnāṃ svarayoniṣu .
putraṃ teṣu samasteṣu vallabhaṃ bruvate budhāḥ .. 103.133 ..
6.3.d:
मृगपक्षिषु काकेषु पशूनां स्वरयोनिषु .
पुत्रं तेषु समस्तेषु वल्लभं ब्रुवते बुधाः .. 103.133 ..
6.3.m: Among deer, birds, and crows, and among the beasts of their various kinds, / the wise declare that the offspring is dearest of all.

6.3.s:
matsyāśvaprakarāścaiva kūrmagrāhādayo'pi vā .
putrotpattau ca hṛṣyanti vipattau yānti duḥkhitām .. 103.134 ..
6.3.d:
मत्स्याश्वप्रकराश्चैव कूर्मग्राहादयोऽपि वा .
पुत्रोत्पत्तौ च हृष्यन्ति विपत्तौ यान्ति दुःखिताम् .. 103.134 ..
6.3.m: Even schools of fish and horses, or turtles and crocodiles, / rejoice at the birth of offspring and fall into sorrow at their loss.

6.3.s:
devagandharvayakṣāśca hṛṣyante putrajanmani .
pañcatve te'pi śocanti mandabhāgyo'smi putraka .. 103.135 ..
6.3.d:
देवगन्धर्वयक्षाश्च हृष्यन्ते पुत्रजन्मनि .
पञ्चत्वे तेऽपि शोचन्ति मन्दभाग्योऽस्मि पुत्रक .. 103.135 ..
6.3.m: Gods, gandharvas, and yakṣas rejoice at the birth of a son, / and they too grieve upon his death; how unfortunate I am, my child!

6.3.s:
ṛṣimelāpakaṃ cakre putrārthe rāghavo nṛpa .
indrasthāne sthitastasya prokṣate hyāsanaṃ yataḥ .. 103.136 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषिमेलापकं चक्रे पुत्रार्थे राघवो नृप .
इन्द्रस्थाने स्थितस्तस्य प्रोक्षते ह्यासनं यतः .. 103.136 ..
6.3.m: King Rāghava held an assembly of seers for the sake of a son, / for where he sat in Indra’s abode, his seat had to be sprinkled [for purification].

6.3.s:
svargavāsaṃ sutādbāhyaṃ vidyate na tu pāṇḍava .
cakre daśarathastasmātputrārthaṃ yajñamuttamam .. 103.137 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्गवासं सुताद्बाह्यं विद्यते न तु पाण्डव .
चक्रे दशरथस्तस्मात्पुत्रार्थं यज्ञमुत्तमम् .. 103.137 ..
6.3.m: No residence in heaven exists for one who lacks a son, O son of Pāṇḍu; / therefore Daśaratha performed the supreme sacrifice for the sake of a son.

6.3.s:
rāmo lakṣmaṇaśatrughnau bharatastatra sambhavāt .
kārtavīryo jito yena rāmeṇāmitatejasā .. 103.138 ..
6.3.d:
रामो लक्ष्मणशत्रुघ्नौ भरतस्तत्र सम्भवात् .
कार्तवीर्यो जितो येन रामेणामिततेजसा .. 103.138 ..
6.3.m: From that arose Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, Śatrughna, and Bharata. / By that Rāma of boundless splendor was Kārtavīrya conquered;

6.3.s:
sa rāmo rāmacandreṇa aṣṭavarṣeṇa nirjitaḥ .
ekākinā hato vālī plavagaḥ śatrudurjayaḥ .. 103.139 ..
6.3.d:
स रामो रामचन्द्रेण अष्टवर्षेण निर्जितः .
एकाकिना हतो वाली प्लवगः शत्रुदुर्जयः .. 103.139 ..
6.3.m: that Rāma was overcome by Rāmacandra at eight years of age. / Alone, he slew Vālin, the monkey invincible to his enemies.

6.3.s:
rāvaṇo brahmaputro yastrailokyaṃ yasya śaṅkate .
hataḥ sa rāmacandreṇa saputraḥ sahabāndhavaḥ .. 103.140 ..
6.3.d:
रावणो ब्रह्मपुत्रो यस्त्रैलोक्यं यस्य शङ्कते .
हतः स रामचन्द्रेण सपुत्रः सहबान्धवः .. 103.140 ..
6.3.m: Rāvaṇa, who was a son of Brahmā and of whom the three worlds were afraid, / was slain along with his sons and relatives by Rāmacandra.

6.3.s:
evaṃ putraṃ vinā saukhyaṃ martyaloke na vidyate .
vaṃśārthe maithunaṃ yasya svargārthe yasya bhāratī .. 103.141 ..
6.3.d:
एवं पुत्रं विना सौख्यं मर्त्यलोके न विद्यते .
वंशार्थे मैथुनं यस्य स्वर्गार्थे यस्य भारती .. 103.141 ..
6.3.m: Thus without a son there is no happiness in the mortal world. / Intercourse is for progeny; speech is for the sake of heaven;

6.3.s:
mṛṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇasyārthe svarge vāsaṃ tu yānti te .
brahmahatyāśvamedhābhyāṃ na paraṃ pāpapuṇyayoḥ .. 103.142 ..
6.3.d:
मृष्टान्नं ब्राह्मणस्यार्थे स्वर्गे वासं तु यान्ति ते .
ब्रह्महत्याश्वमेधाभ्यां न परं पापपुण्ययोः .. 103.142 ..
6.3.m: sweet food is for the sake of a brahmin—such people go to dwell in heaven. / There is nothing greater than the killing of a brahmin and the horse sacrifice among sin and merit respectively;

6.3.s:
putrotpattivipattibhyāṃ na paraṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ .
kiṃ bravīmīti bho vatsa na tu saukhyaṃ sutaṃ vinā .. 103.143 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रोत्पत्तिविपत्तिभ्यां न परं सुखदुःखयोः .
किं ब्रवीमीति भो वत्स न तु सौख्यं सुतं विना .. 103.143 ..
6.3.m: there is nothing greater than the birth and death of a son among happiness and sorrow. / What more can I say, O child? There is no happiness without a son.”

6.3.s:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pralapitvā punaḥpunaḥ .
janaiścāśvāsito vipro bālaṃ gṛhya bahirgataḥ .. 103.144 ..
6.3.d:
एवं बहुविधं दुःखं प्रलपित्वा पुनःपुनः .
जनैश्चाश्वासितो विप्रो बालं गृह्य बहिर्गतः .. 103.144 ..
6.3.m: Having thus lamented his manifold grief again and again, / the brahmin, consoled by the people, took the child and went outside.

6.3.s:
tataḥ saṃskṛtya taṃ bālaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā .
samavetau tu duḥkhārtāvāgatau svagṛhaṃ punaḥ .. 103.145 ..
6.3.d:
ततः संस्कृत्य तं बालं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा .
समवेतौ तु दुःखार्तावागतौ स्वगृहं पुनः .. 103.145 ..
6.3.m: Then, having cremated that child with rites prescribed by the injunctions, / the two of them, afflicted with grief, returned together to their home.

6.3.s:
evaṃ gṛhāgate vipre rātrirjātā yudhiṣṭhira .
bhūmau prasupto govindaḥ putraśokena pīḍitaḥ .. 103.146 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गृहागते विप्रे रात्रिर्जाता युधिष्ठिर .
भूमौ प्रसुप्तो गोविन्दः पुत्रशोकेन पीडितः .. 103.146 ..
6.3.m: When the brahmin had thus returned home, night fell, O Yudhiṣṭhira; / Govinda lay asleep on the ground, tormented by grief for his son.

6.3.s:
yāvannirīkṣate bhāryā bhartāraṃ duḥkhapīḍitam .
kṛmirāśigataṃ sarvaṃ govindaṃ samapaśyata .. 103.147 ..
6.3.d:
यावन्निरीक्षते भार्या भर्तारं दुःखपीडितम् .
कृमिराशिगतं सर्वं गोविन्दं समपश्यत .. 103.147 ..
6.3.m: When his wife looked upon her husband afflicted with grief, / she saw Govinda entirely covered with a heap of worms.

6.3.s:
duḥkhādduḥkhatare magnā dṛṣṭvā taṃ pātakānvitam .
evaṃ duḥkhanimagnāyāḥ śarvarī vigatā tadā .. 103.148 ..
6.3.d:
दुःखाद्दुःखतरे मग्ना दृष्ट्वा तं पातकान्वितम् .
एवं दुःखनिमग्नायाः शर्वरी विगता तदा .. 103.148 ..
6.3.m: Sunk from sorrow into deeper sorrow upon seeing him laden with sin, / as she was thus immersed in grief, the night then passed away.

6.3.s:
paśupālastu mahiṣīmuktvāraṇye'gamadgṛhāt .
araṇye mahiṣīḥ sarvā rakṣayitvā gṛhāgataḥ .. 103.149 ..
6.3.d:
पशुपालस्तु महिषीमुक्त्वारण्येऽगमद्गृहात् .
अरण्ये महिषीः सर्वा रक्षयित्वा गृहागतः .. 103.149 ..
6.3.m: The cowherd, having led out the buffaloes into the forest, went from the house; / having guarded all the buffaloes in the forest, he returned home.

6.3.s:
vijñaptaḥ paśupālena govindo brāhmaṇottamaḥ .
yāvadbhokṣyāmyahaṃ svāminmahiṣīstvaṃ ca rakṣase .. 103.150 ..
6.3.d:
विज्ञप्तः पशुपालेन गोविन्दो ब्राह्मणोत्तमः .
यावद्भोक्ष्याम्यहं स्वामिन्महिषीस्त्वं च रक्षसे .. 103.150 ..
6.3.m: Govinda, the best of brahmins, was requested by the cowherd: / “Master, while I eat, please guard the buffaloes.”

6.3.s:
tataḥ sa tvarito vipro jagāma mahiṣīḥ prati .
na tatra mahiṣīḥ paśyetpaścātkṣetrābhisammukham .. 103.151 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स त्वरितो विप्रो जगाम महिषीः प्रति .
न तत्र महिषीः पश्येत्पश्चात्क्षेत्राभिसम्मुखम् .. 103.151 ..
6.3.m: Then that brahmin went in haste toward the buffaloes; / he did not see the buffaloes there, and afterwards [went] facing toward the field.

6.3.s:
dhāvamānaśca viprastu eraṇḍīsaṅgame gataḥ .
tataḥ praviṣṭastu jale revairaṇḍyostu saṅgame .. 103.152 ..
6.3.d:
धावमानश्च विप्रस्तु एरण्डीसङ्गमे गतः .
ततः प्रविष्टस्तु जले रेवैरण्ड्योस्तु सङ्गमे .. 103.152 ..
6.3.m: Running along, the brahmin reached the confluence of the Eraṇḍī; / then he entered the water at the confluence of the Revā and Eraṇḍī.

6.3.s:
tajjalaṃ pītamātraṃ tu tvarayā cātitarṣitaḥ .
akāmātsalilaṃ pītvā prakṣālya nayane śubhe .. 103.153 ..
6.3.d:
तज्जलं पीतमात्रं तु त्वरया चातितर्षितः .
अकामात्सलिलं पीत्वा प्रक्षाल्य नयने शुभे .. 103.153 ..
6.3.m: As soon as he drank that water, being exceedingly thirsty and in haste, / having unintentionally drunk the water and washed his auspicious eyes,

6.3.s:
ājagāma tataḥ paścādbhavanaṃ divasakṣaye .
bhuktvā duḥkhānvito rātrau govindaḥ śayanaṃ yayau .. 103.154 ..
6.3.d:
आजगाम ततः पश्चाद्भवनं दिवसक्षये .
भुक्त्वा दुःखान्वितो रात्रौ गोविन्दः शयनं ययौ .. 103.154 ..
6.3.m: he came afterwards to his dwelling at the end of the day. / Having eaten, sorrowful at night, Govinda went to bed.

6.3.s:
nidrābhibhūtaḥ śokena śrameṇaiva tu kheditaḥ .
punastaccārdharātre tu tasya bhāryā yudhiṣṭhira .. 103.155 ..
6.3.d:
निद्राभिभूतः शोकेन श्रमेणैव तु खेदितः .
पुनस्तच्चार्धरात्रे तु तस्य भार्या युधिष्ठिर .. 103.155 ..
6.3.m: Overcome by sleep, distressed by grief and by weariness, / then at midnight, O Yudhiṣṭhira, his wife

6.3.s:
kṛmibhirveṣṭitaṃ gāntraṃ kvacitpaśyatyaveṣṭitam .
punaḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā tasya bhāryā guṇānvitā .
uvāca duṣkṛtaṃ tasya sādhvasāviṣṭacetasā .. 103.156 ..
6.3.d:
कृमिभिर्वेष्टितं गान्त्रं क्वचित्पश्यत्यवेष्टितम् .
पुनः सा विस्मयाविष्टा तस्य भार्या गुणान्विता .
उवाच दुष्कृतं तस्य साध्वसाविष्टचेतसा .. 103.156 ..
6.3.m: saw his body covered with worms, [and] in places uncovered. / Again struck with astonishment, his virtuous wife, / with a mind seized by fear, spoke of his misdeed:

6.3.s:
bhāryovāca -
atīte pañcame cāhni tvindhanaṃ kṣipatastu te .
gṛhapaścādgato bālo hyajñānādghātitastvayā .. 103.157 ..
6.3.d:
भार्योवाच -
अतीते पञ्चमे चाह्नि त्विन्धनं क्षिपतस्तु ते .
गृहपश्चाद्गतो बालो ह्यज्ञानाद्घातितस्त्वया .. 103.157 ..
6.3.m: The wife said: / “On the fifth day past, as you were throwing firewood, / the boy went behind the house and was killed by you through ignorance.

6.3.s:
mayā tatpātakaṃ ghoraṃ rahasyaṃ na prakāśitam .
tena pracchannapāpena dahyamānā divāniśam .. 103.158 ..
6.3.d:
मया तत्पातकं घोरं रहस्यं न प्रकाशितम् .
तेन प्रच्छन्नपापेन दह्यमाना दिवानिशम् .. 103.158 ..
6.3.m: I did not disclose that dreadful sin, [keeping it] a secret; / burning day and night because of that concealed sin,

6.3.s:
na sukhaṃ tava gātrasya paśyāmi na hi cātmanaḥ .
nidrā mama śamaṃ yātā ratiścaiva tvayā saha .. 103.159 ..
6.3.d:
न सुखं तव गात्रस्य पश्यामि न हि चात्मनः .
निद्रा मम शमं याता रतिश्चैव त्वया सह .. 103.159 ..
6.3.m: I see no comfort for your body, nor indeed for my own; / my sleep has vanished, and so too my pleasure with you.

6.3.s:
śrūyate mānave śāstre śloko gīto maharṣibhiḥ .
smṛtvā smṛtvā tu taṃ citte paritāpo na śāmyati .. 103.160 ..
6.3.d:
श्रूयते मानवे शास्त्रे श्लोको गीतो महर्षिभिः .
स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा तु तं चित्ते परितापो न शाम्यति .. 103.160 ..
6.3.m: A verse sung by great seers is heard in the Lawbook of Manu; / remembering it again and again in my mind, my anguish does not cease:

6.3.s:
kīrtanānnaśyate dharmo vardhate'sau nigūhanāt .
iha loke pare caiva pāpasyāpyevameva ca .. 103.161 ..
6.3.d:
कीर्तनान्नश्यते धर्मो वर्धतेऽसौ निगूहनात् .
इह लोके परे चैव पापस्याप्येवमेव च .. 103.161 ..
6.3.m: ‘By proclaiming it, righteousness is destroyed; it increases by concealing it, / both in this world and the next; and exactly so it is with sin.’

6.3.s:
evaṃ saṃcityamānāhaṃ sthitā rātrau bhayāturā .
kṛmirāśigataṃ tvāṃ hi kasyāhaṃ kathayāmi kim .. 103.162 ..
6.3.d:
एवं संचित्यमानाहं स्थिता रात्रौ भयातुरा .
कृमिराशिगतं त्वां हि कस्याहं कथयामि किम् .. 103.162 ..
6.3.m: Pondering thus, I remained at night tormented by fear; / seeing you covered with a swarm of worms, to whom can I say what?

6.3.s:
punastvaṃ cādya me dṛṣṭo bhrūṇahatyākṛmiśritaḥ .
kvacidbhindanti te gātraṃ kvacinnaṣṭāḥ samantataḥ .. 103.163 ..
6.3.d:
पुनस्त्वं चाद्य मे दृष्टो भ्रूणहत्याकृमिश्रितः .
क्वचिद्भिन्दन्ति ते गात्रं क्वचिन्नष्टाः समन्ततः .. 103.163 ..
6.3.m: And today you were seen by me again, covered with the worms of infanticide; / in some places they bore into your body, in some places they have disappeared all around.

6.3.s:
etatsaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya vimṛśāmi punaḥpunaḥ .
na jāne kāraṇaṃ kiṃcitpṛcchantyāḥ kathayasva me .. 103.164 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य विमृशामि पुनःपुनः .
न जाने कारणं किंचित्पृच्छन्त्याः कथयस्व मे .. 103.164 ..
6.3.m: Remembering this again and again, I reflect on it repeatedly; / I do not know any reason for it; tell me, as I ask you.

6.3.s:
taḍāgaṃ vā saridvāpi tīrthaṃ vā devatārcanam .
yaṃ gato'si prabhāvo'yaṃ tasya nānyasya me sthitam .. 103.165 ..
6.3.d:
तडागं वा सरिद्वापि तीर्थं वा देवतार्चनम् .
यं गतोऽसि प्रभावोऽयं तस्य नान्यस्य मे स्थितम् .. 103.165 ..
6.3.m: A pond, a river, a sacred ford, or the worship of a deity— / whichever you went to, it is its power; I have no doubt.”

6.3.s:
evamuktastu vipro'sau kathayāmāsa bhārata .
bhāryāyā yaddivā vṛttaṃ śaṅkamāno nṛpottama .. 103.166 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु विप्रोऽसौ कथयामास भारत .
भार्याया यद्दिवा वृत्तं शङ्कमानो नृपोत्तम .. 103.166 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed, O Bhārata, best of kings, / that brahmin related with apprehension to his wife what had happened by day:

6.3.s:
adyāhaṃ mahiṣīsārthaṃ eraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ gataḥ .
nābhimātre jale gatvā pītavānsalilaṃ bahu .. 103.167 ..
6.3.d:
अद्याहं महिषीसार्थं एरण्डीसङ्गमं गतः .
नाभिमात्रे जले गत्वा पीतवान्सलिलं बहु .. 103.167 ..
6.3.m: “Today, for the sake of the buffaloes, I went to the confluence of the Eraṇḍī; / having gone into navel-deep water, I drank much water.

6.3.s:
nānyattīrthaṃ vijānāmi saritaṃ sara eva vā .
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ kathitaṃ tava bhāmini .. 103.168 ..
6.3.d:
नान्यत्तीर्थं विजानामि सरितं सर एव वा .
सत्यं सत्यं पुनः सत्यं कथितं तव भामिनि .. 103.168 ..
6.3.m: I know of no other sacred ford, river, or lake; / truly, truly, and truly again, it has been told to you, O lovely lady.”

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā tu sā sarvamupavāsakṛtakṣaṇā .
sapatnīko gatastatra saṅgame varavarṇini .. 103.169 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु सा सर्वमुपवासकृतक्षणा .
सपत्नीको गतस्तत्र सङ्गमे वरवर्णिनि .. 103.169 ..
6.3.m: Learning all this, she resolved upon a fast; / along with his wife, he went there to the confluence, O lady of fair complexion.

6.3.s:
snātvā tatra jale ramye natvā devaṃ tu bhāskaram .
snāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ comayā saha .. 103.170 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र जले रम्ये नत्वा देवं तु भास्करम् .
स्नापयामास देवेशं शङ्करं चोमया सह .. 103.170 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there in that delightful water and bowed to the Sun deity, / he bathed Śaṅkara, the lord of deities, along with Umā,

6.3.s:
pañcagavyaghṛtakṣīrairdadhikṣaudraghṛtairjalaiḥ .
gandhamālyādidhūpaiśca naivedyaiśca suśobhanaiḥ .. 103.171 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चगव्यघृतक्षीरैर्दधिक्षौद्रघृतैर्जलैः .
गन्धमाल्यादिधूपैश्च नैवेद्यैश्च सुशोभनैः .. 103.171 ..
6.3.m: with the five products of the cow, ghee, milk, curd, honey, clarified butter, and water, / with perfumes, garlands, incenses, and very beautiful food offerings.

6.3.s:
pūjya trayīmayaṃ liṅgaṃ devīṃ kātyāyanīṃ śubhām .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā patyāsi pativratā .. 103.172 ..
6.3.d:
पूज्य त्रयीमयं लिङ्गं देवीं कात्यायनीं शुभाम् .
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा पत्यासि पतिव्रता .. 103.172 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped the liṅga consisting of the three Vedas and the auspicious goddess Kātyāyanī, / and having kept a vigil at night, the devoted wife, with her husband,

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvijānsampūjya yatnataḥ .
godānena hiraṇyena vastreṇānnena bhārata .. 103.173 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले द्विजान्सम्पूज्य यत्नतः .
गोदानेन हिरण्येन वस्त्रेणान्नेन भारत .. 103.173 ..
6.3.m: then at clear dawn, having carefully worshipped the twice-born / with gifts of cows, gold, cloth, and food, O Bhārata—

6.3.s:
govindaḥ pūjayāmāsa svaśaktyā brāhmaṇāñchubhān .
muktapāpo gṛhāyātaḥ svabhāryāsahito nṛpa .. 103.174 ..
6.3.d:
गोविन्दः पूजयामास स्वशक्त्या ब्राह्मणाञ्छुभान् .
मुक्तपापो गृहायातः स्वभार्यासहितो नृप .. 103.174 ..
6.3.m: Govinda worshipped the auspicious brahmins according to his means; / freed from sin, he returned home together with his wife, O king.

6.3.s:
evaṃ yaḥ śṛṇute bhaktyā govindākhyānamuttamam .
paṭhate parayā bhaktyā bhrūṇahatyā praṇaśyati .. 103.175 ..
6.3.d:
एवं यः शृणुते भक्त्या गोविन्दाख्यानमुत्तमम् .
पठते परया भक्त्या भ्रूणहत्या प्रणश्यति .. 103.175 ..
6.3.m: Whoever hears this excellent narrative of Govinda with devotion, / or recites it with supreme devotion, their sin of infanticide is destroyed.

6.3.s:
krīḍate śāṃkare loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam .
yaścaivāśvayuje māsi caitre vā nṛpasattama .. 103.176 ..
6.3.d:
क्रीडते शांकरे लोके यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .
यश्चैवाश्वयुजे मासि चैत्रे वा नृपसत्तम .. 103.176 ..
6.3.m: They sport in the world of Śaṅkara until the dissolution of all beings. / And whoever, in the month of Āśvayuja or Caitra, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
saptamyāṃ ca site pakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .
sāttvikīṃ vāsanāṃ kṛtvā yo vasecchivamandire .. 103.177 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तम्यां च सिते पक्षे सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .
सात्त्विकीं वासनां कृत्वा यो वसेच्छिवमन्दिरे .. 103.177 ..
