6.3.m: fasting and with senses conquered on the seventh day of the bright fortnight, / harboring a pure intention, dwells in a temple of Śiva,

6.3.s:
dhyāyamāno virūpākṣaṃ triśūlakarasaṃsthitam .
kaṃsāsuranihantāraṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam .. 103.178 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यायमानो विरूपाक्षं त्रिशूलकरसंस्थितम् .
कंसासुरनिहन्तारं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् .. 103.178 ..
6.3.m: meditating on the uneven-eyed [Rudra] holding a trident in his hand, / [and on] the slayer of the demon Kaṃsa, bearing the conch, discus, and mace,

6.3.s:
pakṣirājasamārūḍhaṃ trailokyavaradāyakam .
pitāmahaṃ tato dhyāyeddhaṃsasthaṃ caturānanam .. 103.179 ..
6.3.d:
पक्षिराजसमारूढं त्रैलोक्यवरदायकम् .
पितामहं ततो ध्यायेद्धंसस्थं चतुराननम् .. 103.179 ..
6.3.m: mounted upon the king of birds, the granter of boons to the three worlds; / and then meditates on the Grandfather, seated upon a swan, four-faced,

6.3.s:
sargapradaṃ samastasya kamalākaraśobhitam .
yo hyevaṃ vasate tatra triyame sthāna uttame .. 103.180 ..
6.3.d:
सर्गप्रदं समस्तस्य कमलाकरशोभितम् .
यो ह्येवं वसते तत्र त्रियमे स्थान उत्तमे .. 103.180 ..
6.3.m: the creator of everything, adorned with a lotus-holding hand— / whoever thus dwells there for three nights in that excellent place,

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale hyaṣṭamyāṃ ca narādhipa .
brāhmaṇān pūjayedbhaktyā sarvadoṣavivarjitān .. 103.181 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले ह्यष्टम्यां च नराधिप .
ब्राह्मणान् पूजयेद्भक्त्या सर्वदोषविवर्जितान् .. 103.181 ..
6.3.m: then at clear dawn on the eighth day, O ruler of men, / should worship with devotion brahmins free from all defects,

6.3.s:
sarvāvayavasampūrṇānsarvaśāstraviśāradān .
vedābhyāsaratānnityaṃ svadāraniratānsadā .. 103.182 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वावयवसम्पूर्णान्सर्वशास्त्रविशारदान् .
वेदाभ्यासरतान्नित्यं स्वदारनिरतान्सदा .. 103.182 ..
6.3.m: complete in all limbs, proficient in all scriptures, / ever devoted to the study of the Vedas, always faithful to their own wives,

6.3.s:
śrāddhe dāne vrate yogyān brāhmaṇān pāṇḍunandana .
pretānāṃ pūjanaṃ tatra devapūrvaṃ samārabhet .. 103.183 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धे दाने व्रते योग्यान् ब्राह्मणान् पाण्डुनन्दन .
प्रेतानां पूजनं तत्र देवपूर्वं समारभेत् .. 103.183 ..
6.3.m: brahmins worthy of ancestral rites, gifts, and vows, O son of Pāṇḍu; / there one should begin the propitiation of the departed spirits, preceded by that of the deities.

6.3.s:
pretatvānmucyate śīghrameraṇḍyāṃ piṇḍatarpaṇaiḥ .
dānāni tatra deyāni hyannamukhyāni sarvadā .. 103.184 ..
6.3.d:
प्रेतत्वान्मुच्यते शीघ्रमेरण्ड्यां पिण्डतर्पणैः .
दानानि तत्र देयानि ह्यन्नमुख्यानि सर्वदा .. 103.184 ..
6.3.m: One is quickly freed from the state of a departed ghost at the Eraṇḍī through offerings of rice balls and water libations; / gifts should always be given there, with food as the foremost,

6.3.s:
hiraṇyabhūmikanyāśca dhūrvāhau śubhalakṣaṇau .
sīreṇa sahitau pārtha dhānyaṃ droṇakasaṃkhyayā .. 103.185 ..
6.3.d:
हिरण्यभूमिकन्याश्च धूर्वाहौ शुभलक्षणौ .
सीरेण सहितौ पार्थ धान्यं द्रोणकसंख्यया .. 103.185 ..
6.3.m: gold, land, virgins, two draft-bulls of auspicious marks / together with a plow, O Pārtha, and grain measured by droṇas;

6.3.s:
alaṃkṛtāṃ savatsāṃ ca kṣīriṇīṃ taruṇīṃ sitām .
raktāṃ vā kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ vā pāṭalāṃ kapilāṃ tathā .. 103.186 ..
6.3.d:
अलंकृतां सवत्सां च क्षीरिणीं तरुणीं सिताम् .
रक्तां वा कृष्णवर्णां वा पाटलां कपिलां तथा .. 103.186 ..
6.3.m: an adorned, milk-giving young cow with her calf, white, / or red, or black-colored, or pale red, or tawny,

6.3.s:
kāṃsyadohanasaṃyuktāṃ rukmakhuravibhūṣaṇām .
svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ savatsāṃ ca brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 103.187 ..
6.3.d:
कांस्यदोहनसंयुक्तां रुक्मखुरविभूषणाम् .
स्वर्णशृङ्गीं सवत्सां च ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् .. 103.187 ..
6.3.m: equipped with a bronze milking vessel, adorned with gold on her hooves, / with horns capped in gold, together with her calf, one should present to a brahmin, [saying:]

6.3.s:
prīyatāṃ me jagannāthā harakṛṣṇapitāmahāḥ .
saṃsārarakṣaṇī devī surabhī māṃ samuddharet .. 103.188 ..
6.3.d:
प्रीयतां मे जगन्नाथा हरकृष्णपितामहाः .
संसाररक्षणी देवी सुरभी मां समुद्धरेत् .. 103.188 ..
6.3.m: “May the lords of the universe, Hara, Kṛṣṇa, and the Grandfather, be pleased with me; / may the divine cow Surabhī, the protector of the worldly existence, deliver me.”

6.3.s:
putrārthaṃ yāḥ striyaḥ pārtha hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛpa .
snāpyante rudrasūktaiśca caturvedodbhavaistathā .. 103.189 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रार्थं याः स्त्रियः पार्थ ह्येरण्डीसङ्गमे नृप .
स्नाप्यन्ते रुद्रसूक्तैश्च चतुर्वेदोद्भवैस्तथा .. 103.189 ..
6.3.m: Those women who, for the sake of obtaining a son, O Pārtha, at the confluence of the Eraṇḍī, O king, / are bathed with hymns to Rudra originating from the four Vedas,

6.3.s:
caturbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ śastaṃ dvābhyāṃ yogyaiśca kārayet .
ekena sārdrakumbhena dāmpatyamabhiṣecayet .. 103.190 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्भिर्ब्राह्मणैः शस्तं द्वाभ्यां योग्यैश्च कारयेत् .
एकेन सार्द्रकुम्भेन दाम्पत्यमभिषेचयेत् .. 103.190 ..
6.3.m: It is praised [to do this] by means of four brahmins, or one should have it done by two qualified [ones]; / with a single wet jar one should consecrate the husband and wife.

6.3.s:
daivajñenaiva caikena athavā sāmagena vā .
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ kumbhe tatraiva kārayet .. 103.191 ..
6.3.d:
दैवज्ञेनैव चैकेन अथवा सामगेन वा .
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं कुम्भे तत्रैव कारयेत् .. 103.191 ..
6.3.m: Or by an astrologer alone, or else by a singer of the Sāmaveda. / One should place in that very jar five jewels,

6.3.s:
gandhatoyasamāyuktaṃ sarvauṣadhivimiśritam .
āmrapallavasaṃyuktamaśvatthamadhukaṃ tathā .. 103.192 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धतोयसमायुक्तं सर्वौषधिविमिश्रितम् .
आम्रपल्लवसंयुक्तमश्वत्थमधुकं तथा .. 103.192 ..
6.3.m: together with scented water, mixed with all medicinal herbs, / joined with mango sprouts, and likewise aśvattha and madhuka,

6.3.s:
guṇṭhitaṃ sitavastreṇa sitacandanacarcitam .
sitapuṣpaistu saṃchannaṃ siddhārthakṛtamadhyamam .. 103.193 ..
6.3.d:
गुण्ठितं सितवस्त्रेण सितचन्दनचर्चितम् .
सितपुष्पैस्तु संछन्नं सिद्धार्थकृतमध्यमम् .. 103.193 ..
6.3.m: wrapped in white cloth, smeared with white sandalwood paste, / covered with white flowers, and having white mustard placed in its center.

6.3.s:
kāṃsyapātre tu saṃsthāpya putrārthī deśikottamaḥ .
aṅgalagnaṃ tu yadvastraṃ kaṭakābharaṇaṃ tathā .. 103.194 ..
6.3.d:
कांस्यपात्रे तु संस्थाप्य पुत्रार्थी देशिकोत्तमः .
अङ्गलग्नं तु यद्वस्त्रं कटकाभरणं तथा .. 103.194 ..
6.3.m: Placing it in a bronze vessel, the best of spiritual teachers, desiring a son [for them], / [shall instruct them that] whatever garment touches the body, and likewise bracelet-ornaments,

6.3.s:
tatsarvaṃ maṇḍale tyājyaṃ siddhyarthaṃ cātmanastadā .
praṇamya bhāskaraṃ paścādācāryaṃ rudrarūpiṇam .. 103.195 ..
6.3.d:
तत्सर्वं मण्डले त्याज्यं सिद्ध्यर्थं चात्मनस्तदा .
प्रणम्य भास्करं पश्चादाचार्यं रुद्ररूपिणम् .. 103.195 ..
6.3.m: all that must then be abandoned on the maṇḍala for one's own success. / Then, bowing to the sun and to the spiritual teacher who embodies Rudra,

6.3.s:
madhuraṃ ca tato'śnīyāddevyā bhuvana uttame .
phaladānaṃ ca viprāya chatraṃ tāmbūlameva ca .. 103.196 ..
6.3.d:
मधुरं च ततोऽश्नीयाद्देव्या भुवन उत्तमे .
फलदानं च विप्राय छत्रं ताम्बूलमेव च .. 103.196 ..
6.3.m: one should then eat sweet food in the excellent abode of the goddess. / And giving fruit to the twice-born, an umbrella, and betel leaves,

6.3.s:
upānahau ca yānaṃ ca sa bhavedduḥkhavarjitaḥ .
bhāskare krīḍate loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 103.197 ..
6.3.d:
उपानहौ च यानं च स भवेद्दुःखवर्जितः .
भास्करे क्रीडते लोके यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 103.197 ..
6.3.m: and two shoes and a conveyance, he becomes freed from sorrow. / He sports in the world of the sun until the dissolution of all beings.

6.3.s:
dānaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham .
yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃkṣayam .. 103.198 ..
6.3.d:
दानं कोटिगुणं सर्वं शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् .
यथा नदीनदाः सर्वे सागरे यान्ति संक्षयम् .. 103.198 ..
6.3.m: Every gift becomes multiplied ten-millionfold, whether auspicious or inauspicious. / Just as all rivers and streams reach their end in the ocean,

6.3.s:
evaṃ pāpāni naśyanti hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛṇām .
samantācchastrapātena hyeraṇḍīsaṅgame nṛpa .. 103.199 ..
6.3.d:
एवं पापानि नश्यन्ति ह्येरण्डीसङ्गमे नृणाम् .
समन्ताच्छस्त्रपातेन ह्येरण्डीसङ्गमे नृप .. 103.199 ..
6.3.m: even so the sins of mortals are destroyed at the Eraṇḍī confluence. / By falling on a weapon completely at the Eraṇḍī confluence, O king,

6.3.s:
bhrūṇahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate śaṅkaro'bravīt .
prāṇatyāgaṃ ca yo bhaktyā jātavedasi kārayet .. 103.200 ..
6.3.d:
भ्रूणहत्यासमं पापं नश्यते शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .
प्राणत्यागं च यो भक्त्या जातवेदसि कारयेत् .. 103.200 ..
6.3.m: sin equal to the slaying of an embryo is destroyed; so said Śaṅkara. / And he who, with devotion, abandons his life in fire,

6.3.s:
anāśakaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha jale vā tadanantaram .
pañcasāhasrikaṃ mānaṃ varṣāṇāṃ jātavedasi .. 103.201 ..
6.3.d:
अनाशकं नृपश्रेष्ठ जले वा तदनन्तरम् .
पञ्चसाहस्रिकं मानं वर्षाणां जातवेदसि .. 103.201 ..
6.3.m: or afterwards by fasting, O best of kings, or in water, / the measure [of his stay] in the case of fire is five thousand years;

6.3.s:
jale trīṇi sahasrāṇyanāśake ṣaṣṭiṃ bhuñjate .
kākā bakāḥ kapotāśca hyulūkāḥ paśavastathā .. 103.202 ..
6.3.d:
जले त्रीणि सहस्राण्यनाशके षष्टिं भुञ्जते .
काका बकाः कपोताश्च ह्युलूकाः पशवस्तथा .. 103.202 ..
6.3.m: in water, three thousand; in fasting, they enjoy sixty [thousand]. / Crows, herons, pigeons, owls, and animals,

6.3.s:
saṃgamodakasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim .
vṛkṣāśca tatpadaṃ jñātvā yāṃ gatiṃ yānti yoginaḥ .. 103.203 ..
6.3.d:
संगमोदकसंस्पृष्टास्ते यान्ति परमां गतिम् .
वृक्षाश्च तत्पदं ज्ञात्वा यां गतिं यान्ति योगिनः .. 103.203 ..
6.3.m: touched by the water of the confluence, go to the supreme state. / And trees, realizing that state, attain the destination that yogins attain.

6.3.s:
eraṇḍikā mayā devī dṛṣṭo me manmatheśvaraḥ .
kiṃ samartho yamo ruṣṭo bhadro bhadrāṇi paśyati .. 103.204 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्डिका मया देवी दृष्टो मे मन्मथेश्वरः .
किं समर्थो यमो रुष्टो भद्रो भद्राणि पश्यति .. 103.204 ..
6.3.m: "The goddess Eraṇḍikā was seen by me; Manmatheśvara was seen by me. / What can Yama do when angry? The fortunate one beholds blessings."

6.3.s:
mṛttikāṃ saṅgamodbhūtāṃ ye ca guṇṭhanti nityaśaḥ .
bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 103.205 ..
6.3.d:
मृत्तिकां सङ्गमोद्भूतां ये च गुण्ठन्ति नित्यशः .
भ्रूणहत्यादिपापानि नश्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 103.205 ..
6.3.m: And those who daily smear themselves with clay originating from the confluence, / their sins such as the slaying of an embryo are destroyed; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
eraṇḍīsaṅgame martyo luṇṭhyamāno narādhipa .
sarvapāpairvinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam .. 103.206 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्डीसङ्गमे मर्त्यो लुण्ठ्यमानो नराधिप .
सर्वपापैर्विनिर्मुक्तः पदं गच्छत्यनामयम् .. 103.206 ..
6.3.m: A mortal rolling [in the dust] at the Eraṇḍī confluence, O ruler of men, / freed from all sins, goes to the sorrowless state.

6.3.s:
eraṇḍyāḥ saṅgamaṃ martyāḥ kīrtayantyāśramasthitāḥ .
vimuktapāpā jāyante satyaṃ śaṅkarabhāṣitam .. 103.207 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्ड्याः सङ्गमं मर्त्याः कीर्तयन्त्याश्रमस्थिताः .
विमुक्तपापा जायन्ते सत्यं शङ्करभाषितम् .. 103.207 ..
6.3.m: Mortals residing in hermitages who praise the Eraṇḍī confluence / become freed from sin; this spoken by Śaṅkara is the truth.

6.3.s: eraṇḍīpādapāgraistu dṛṣṭaiḥ pāpaṃ vyapohati .. 103.208 ..
6.3.d: एरण्डीपादपाग्रैस्तु दृष्टैः पापं व्यपोहति .. 103.208 ..
6.3.m: Sin is dispelled merely by seeing the tops of the trees of Eraṇḍī.

6.3.s:
tīrthākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ ye paṭhiṣyanti mānavāḥ .
śṛṇvanti cāpare bhaktyā muktapāpā bhavanti te .. 103.209 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थाख्यानमिदं पुण्यं ये पठिष्यन्ति मानवाः .
शृण्वन्ति चापरे भक्त्या मुक्तपापा भवन्ति ते .. 103.209 ..
6.3.m: Those men who recite this holy narrative of the sacred ford, / and others who hear it with devotion, become freed from sin.

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātameraṇḍīsaṅgamaṃ nṛpa .
bhūyaścānyatpravakṣyāmi sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 103.210 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍīsaṅgamatīrthaphalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 104
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातमेरण्डीसङ्गमं नृप .
भूयश्चान्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 103.210 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे एरण्डीसङ्गमतीर्थफलमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्र्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 104
6.3.m:
All this concerning the Eraṇḍī confluence has been recounted to you, O king. / Again I shall proclaim another that causes the destruction of all sins.
Thus ends the one hundred and third chapter, named "Description of the Fruit and Māhātmya of the Eraṇḍīsaṅgama Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 104

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpālaṃ sauvarṇaśilamuttamam .
prakhyātamuttare kūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 104.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपालं सौवर्णशिलमुत्तमम् .
प्रख्यातमुत्तरे कूले सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 104.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to the excellent Sauvarṇaśila, / famous on the northern bank, causing the destruction of all sins,

6.3.s:
samantācchatapātena munisaṅghaiḥ purā kṛtam .
revāyāṃ durlabhaṃ sthānaṃ saṅgamasya samīpataḥ .. 104.2 ..
6.3.d:
समन्ताच्छतपातेन मुनिसङ्घैः पुरा कृतम् .
रेवायां दुर्लभं स्थानं सङ्गमस्य समीपतः .. 104.2 ..
6.3.m: created in former times by hosts of sages by falling [from heights] on all sides, / a place hard to attain on the Revā, near the confluence.

6.3.s:
vibhaktaṃ hastamātraṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ narādhipa .
suvarṇaśilake snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram .. 104.3 ..
6.3.d:
विभक्तं हस्तमात्रं च पुण्यक्षेत्रं नराधिप .
सुवर्णशिलके स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .. 104.3 ..
6.3.m: It is divided and measures merely a cubit, a sacred field, O ruler of men. / Having bathed at Suvarṇaśilaka and having worshipped the Great Lord,

6.3.s:
natvā tu bhāskaraṃ devaṃ hotavyaṃ ca hutāśane .
bilvenājyavimiśreṇa bilvapatrairathāpi vā .. 104.4 ..
6.3.d:
नत्वा तु भास्करं देवं होतव्यं च हुताशने .
बिल्वेनाज्यविमिश्रेण बिल्वपत्रैरथापि वा .. 104.4 ..
6.3.m: and having bowed to the sun god, an offering should be made into the fire / with bilva fruit mixed with ghee, or even with bilva leaves, [saying:]

6.3.s:
prīyatāṃ me jagannātho vyādhirnaśyatu me dhruvam .
dvijāya kāñcane datte yatphalaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me .. 104.5 ..
6.3.d:
प्रीयतां मे जगन्नाथो व्याधिर्नश्यतु मे ध्रुवम् .
द्विजाय काञ्चने दत्ते यत्फलं तच्छृणुष्व मे .. 104.5 ..
6.3.m: "May the Lord of the Universe be pleased with me; may my disease surely be destroyed." / When gold is given to a twice-born, hear from me what the fruit of that is.

6.3.s:
bahusvarṇasya yatproktaṃ yāgasya phalamuttamam .
tathāsau labhate sarvaṃ kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati .. 104.6 ..
6.3.d:
बहुस्वर्णस्य यत्प्रोक्तं यागस्य फलमुत्तमम् .
तथासौ लभते सर्वं काञ्चनं यः प्रयच्छति .. 104.6 ..
6.3.m: Whatever excellent fruit is proclaimed of the sacrifice with abundant gold, / that person who offers gold obtains all of that.

6.3.s:
tena dānena pūtātmā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt .
rudrasyānucarastāvadyāvadindrāścaturdaśa .. 104.7 ..
6.3.d:
तेन दानेन पूतात्मा मृतः स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात् .
रुद्रस्यानुचरस्तावद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश .. 104.7 ..
6.3.m: Purified in soul by that gift, upon death he would attain heaven; / he is an attendant of Rudra as long as fourteen Indras [endure].

6.3.s:
tataḥ svargāvatīrṇastu jāyate viśade kule .
dhanadhānyasamopetaḥ punaḥ smarati tajjalam .. 104.8 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe suvarṇaśilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 105
6.3.d:
ततः स्वर्गावतीर्णस्तु जायते विशदे कुले .
धनधान्यसमोपेतः पुनः स्मरति तज्जलम् .. 104.8 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सुवर्णशिलातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 105
6.3.m:
Then, having descended from heaven, he is born in a pure family; / endowed with wealth and grain, he remembers that water again.
Thus ends the one hundred and fourth chapter, named "Description of the Māhātmya of the Suvarṇaśilā Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 105

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
karañjākhyaṃ tato gacchetsopavāso jitendriyaḥ .
tatra snātvā tu rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 105.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
करञ्जाख्यं ततो गच्छेत्सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .
तत्र स्नात्वा तु राजेन्द्र सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 105.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, fasting and self-controlled, one should go to the [ford] named Karañja. / Having bathed there, O best of kings, one is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
arcayitvā mahādevaṃ dattvā dānaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ .
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇimauktikavidrumān .. 105.2 ..
6.3.d:
अर्चयित्वा महादेवं दत्त्वा दानं तु भक्तितः .
सुवर्णं रजतं वापि मणिमौक्तिकविद्रुमान् .. 105.2 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped the Great God, and having given a gift with devotion— / gold, or silver, or gems, pearls, and corals,

6.3.s:
pādukopānahau chatraṃ śayyāṃ prāvaraṇāni ca .
koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 105.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karañjatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 106
6.3.d:
पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं शय्यां प्रावरणानि च .
कोटिकोटिगुणं सर्वं जायते नात्र संशयः .. 105.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे करञ्जतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 106
6.3.m:
wooden sandals, shoes, an umbrella, a bed, and coverings— / all that becomes multiplied ten-million-ten-millionfold; of this there is no doubt.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifth chapter, named "Description of the Māhātmya of the Karañja Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 106

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
saubhāgyakaraṇaṃ divyaṃ naranārīmanoramam .. 106.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
सौभाग्यकरणं दिव्यं नरनारीमनोरमम् .. 106.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to a most beautiful sacred ford, / which brings good fortune, divine, and delightful to men and women.

6.3.s:
tatra yā durbhagā nārī naro vā nṛpasattama .
snātvārcayedumārudrau saubhāgyaṃ tasya jāyate .. 106.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र या दुर्भगा नारी नरो वा नृपसत्तम .
स्नात्वार्चयेदुमारुद्रौ सौभाग्यं तस्य जायते .. 106.2 ..
6.3.m: There, whatever unfortunate woman or man, O best of kings, / bathes and worships Umā and Rudra, good fortune arises for them.

6.3.s:
tṛtīyāyāmahorātraṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .
nimantrayeddvijaṃ bhaktyā sapatnīkaṃ surūpiṇam .. 106.3 ..
6.3.d:
तृतीयायामहोरात्रं सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .
निमन्त्रयेद्द्विजं भक्त्या सपत्नीकं सुरूपिणम् .. 106.3 ..
6.3.m: Fasting day and night on the third lunar day, with senses restrained, / one should invite with devotion a handsome twice-born together with his wife.

6.3.s:
gandhamālyairalaṃkṛtya vastradhūpādivāsitam .
bhojayetpāyasānnena kṛsareṇātha bhaktitaḥ .. 106.4 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धमाल्यैरलंकृत्य वस्त्रधूपादिवासितम् .
भोजयेत्पायसान्नेन कृसरेणाथ भक्तितः .. 106.4 ..
6.3.m: Having adorned him with perfumes and garlands, scented with garments, incense, and the like, / one should feed him with devotion on milk-rice or kṛsara.

6.3.s:
bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ pradakṣiṇamudāharet .
prīyatāṃ me mahādevaḥ sapatnīko vṛṣadhvajaḥ .. 106.5 ..
6.3.d:
भोजयित्वा यथान्यायं प्रदक्षिणमुदाहरेत् .
प्रीयतां मे महादेवः सपत्नीको वृषध्वजः .. 106.5 ..
6.3.m: Having fed him according to rule, one should make a circumambulation, saying: / "May the Great God, who has the bull on his banner, along with his consort, be pleased with me.

6.3.s:
yathā te devadeveśa na viyogaḥ kadācana .
mamāpi karuṇāṃ kṛtvā tathāstviti vicintayet .. 106.6 ..
6.3.d:
यथा ते देवदेवेश न वियोगः कदाचन .
ममापि करुणां कृत्वा तथास्त्विति विचिन्तयेत् .. 106.6 ..
6.3.m: Just as there is never separation for you, O Lord of the God of gods, / having shown compassion to me as well, may it be so," thus he should reflect.

6.3.s:
evaṃ kṛte tatastasya yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam .
tatte sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā devena bhāṣitam .. 106.7 ..
6.3.d:
एवं कृते ततस्तस्य यत्पुण्यं समुदाहृतम् .
तत्ते सर्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा देवेन भाषितम् .. 106.7 ..
6.3.m: When this is done, whatever merit is declared to be his, / all that I will tell you, just as it was spoken by the god:

6.3.s:
daurbhāgyaṃ durgatiścaiva dāridryaṃ śokabandhanam .
vandhyatvaṃ saptajanmāni jāyate na yudhiṣṭhira .. 106.8 ..
6.3.d:
दौर्भाग्यं दुर्गतिश्चैव दारिद्र्यं शोकबन्धनम् .
वन्ध्यत्वं सप्तजन्मानि जायते न युधिष्ठिर .. 106.8 ..
6.3.m: misfortune, adversity, poverty, the bondage of grief, / and barrenness do not arise for seven births, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .
tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā pañcāgniṃ sādhayettataḥ .. 106.9 ..
6.3.d:
ज्येष्ठमासे सिते पक्षे तृतीयायां विशेषतः .
तत्र गत्वा तु यो भक्त्या पञ्चाग्निं साधयेत्ततः .. 106.9 ..
6.3.m: Especially on the third lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Jyeṣṭha, / whoever goes there and with devotion performs the five-fire penance,

6.3.s:
so'pi pāpairaśeṣaistu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
guggulaṃ dahate yastu dvidhā cittavivarjitaḥ .. 106.10 ..
6.3.d:
सोऽपि पापैरशेषैस्तु मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .
गुग्गुलं दहते यस्तु द्विधा चित्तविवर्जितः .. 106.10 ..
6.3.m: he too is freed from all sins without remainder, there is no doubt of this. / And whoever burns bdellium resin, free from a wavering mind,

6.3.s:
śarīraṃ bhedayedyastu gauryāścaiva samīpataḥ .
tasminkarmapraviṣṭasya utkrāntirjāyate yadi .. 106.11 ..
6.3.d:
शरीरं भेदयेद्यस्तु गौर्याश्चैव समीपतः .
तस्मिन्कर्मप्रविष्टस्य उत्क्रान्तिर्जायते यदि .. 106.11 ..
6.3.m: or mortifies his body in the presence of Gaurī, / if his passing away occurs while engaged in that rite,

6.3.s:
dehapāte vrajetsvargamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .
sitaraktaistathā pītairvastraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 106.12 ..
6.3.d:
देहपाते व्रजेत्स्वर्गमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .
सितरक्तैस्तथा पीतैर्वस्त्रैश्च विविधैः शुभैः .. 106.12 ..
6.3.m: upon the fall of the body he goes to heaven: thus Śaṃkara said. / Having worshipped a brahmin woman and a brahmin according to the rule

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi .
puṣpairnānāvidhaiścaiva gandhadhūpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ .. 106.13 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणीं ब्राह्मणं चैव पूजयित्वा यथाविधि .
पुष्पैर्नानाविधैश्चैव गन्धधूपैः सुशोभनैः .. 106.13 ..
6.3.m: with white, red, and yellow various auspicious garments, / with various kinds of flowers, and with exceedingly splendid perfumes and incenses,

6.3.s:
kaṇṭhasūtrakasindūraiḥ kuṅkumena vilepayet .
kalpayeta striyaṃ gaurīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śivarūpiṇam .. 106.14 ..
6.3.d:
कण्ठसूत्रकसिन्दूरैः कुङ्कुमेन विलेपयेत् .
कल्पयेत स्त्रियं गौरीं ब्राह्मणं शिवरूपिणम् .. 106.14 ..
6.3.m: he should smear them with saffron, along with necklaces and vermilion; / he should visualize the woman as Gaurī and the brahmin as the form of Śiva.

6.3.s:
teṣāṃ tadrūpakaṃ kṛtvā dānamutsṛjyate tataḥ .
kaṅkaṇaṃ karṇaveṣṭaṃ ca kaṇṭhikāṃ mudrikāṃ tathā .. 106.15 ..
6.3.d:
तेषां तद्रूपकं कृत्वा दानमुत्सृज्यते ततः .
कङ्कणं कर्णवेष्टं च कण्ठिकां मुद्रिकां तथा .. 106.15 ..
6.3.m: Having fashioned their representation, a gift is then offered: / a bracelet, an ear-ornament, a necklace, and a ring,

6.3.s:
saptadhānyaṃ tathā caiva bhojanaṃ nṛpasattama .
anyānyapi ca dānāni tasmiṃstīrthe dadāti yaḥ .. 106.16 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तधान्यं तथा चैव भोजनं नृपसत्तम .
अन्यान्यपि च दानानि तस्मिंस्तीर्थे ददाति यः .. 106.16 ..
6.3.m: as well as the seven grains and food, O best of kings. / Whoever gives other gifts also at that sacred ford,

6.3.s:
sarvadānaiśca yatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ .
sahasraguṇitaṃ sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 106.17 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वदानैश्च यत्पुण्यं प्राप्नुयान्नात्र संशयः .
सहस्रगुणितं सर्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 106.17 ..
6.3.m: he obtains the merit belonging to all gifts; there is no doubt of this. / Everything is multiplied a thousandfold; no deliberation need be made on this.

6.3.s:
śaṅkareṇa samaṃ tasmādbhogaṃ bhuṅkte hyanuttamam .
saubhāgyaṃ tasya vipulaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 106.18 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्करेण समं तस्माद्भोगं भुङ्क्ते ह्यनुत्तमम् .
सौभाग्यं तस्य विपुलं जायते नात्र संशयः .. 106.18 ..
6.3.m: Therefore he enjoys unsurpassed pleasure together with Śaṃkara; / vast good fortune is born for him, there is no doubt of this.

6.3.s:
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt .
rājendra kāmadaṃ tīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam .. 106.19 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kāmadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..
adhyāya 107
6.3.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमाप्नुयात् .
राजेन्द्र कामदं तीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् .. 106.19 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कामदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..
अध्याय 107
6.3.m:
The sonless one obtains a son; the penniless one attains wealth. / O king of kings, the wish-granting sacred ford is situated on the Narmadā.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Kāmada Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 107

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gaccheta rājendra bhaṇḍārītīrthamuttamam .
daridracchedakaraṇaṃ yugānyekonaviṃśatiḥ .. 107.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र भण्डारीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
दरिद्रच्छेदकरणं युगान्येकोनविंशतिः .. 107.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Bhaṇḍārī sacred ford, / which destroys poverty for nineteen ages.

6.3.s:
dhanadena tapastaptvā prasanne padmasambhave .
tatraiva svalpadānena prāptaṃ vittasya rakṣaṇam .. 107.2 ..
6.3.d:
धनदेन तपस्तप्त्वा प्रसन्ने पद्मसम्भवे .
तत्रैव स्वल्पदानेन प्राप्तं वित्तस्य रक्षणम् .. 107.2 ..
6.3.m: When the lotus-born [Brahmā] was pleased after the giver of wealth [Kubera] performed austerity, / the safeguarding of wealth was attained right there by giving a meager gift.

6.3.s:
tatra gatvā tu yo bhaktyā snātvā vittaṃ prayacchati .
tasya vittaparicchedo na kadācidbhaviṣyati .. 107.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhaṇḍārītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 108
6.3.d:
तत्र गत्वा तु यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा वित्तं प्रयच्छति .
तस्य वित्तपरिच्छेदो न कदाचिद्भविष्यति .. 107.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भण्डारीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 108
6.3.m:
Whoever goes there and with devotion bathes and gives wealth, / for him there will never be a loss of wealth.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventh chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Bhaṇḍārī Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 108

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla rohiṇītīrthamuttamam .
vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpaharaṃ param .. 108.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल रोहिणीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वपापहरं परम् .. 108.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to the excellent Rohiṇī sacred ford, / celebrated in the three worlds, supreme, destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
rohiṇītīrthamāhātmyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .
śrotumicchāmi tattvena tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 108.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
रोहिणीतीर्थमाहात्म्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .
श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वेन तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 108.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / I desire to hear truthfully the greatness of the Rohiṇī sacred ford, / which annihilates all sins; you ought to tell it to me.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame .
udadhau ca śayānasya devadevasya cakriṇaḥ .. 108.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे .
उदधौ च शयानस्य देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः .. 108.3 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In that dreadful single ocean, when the moving and unmoving was destroyed, / as the god of gods, the wielder of the discus, was sleeping in the ocean,

6.3.s:
nābhau samutthitaṃ padmaṃ ravimaṇḍalasannibham .
karṇikākesaropetaṃ patraiśca samalaṃkṛtam .. 108.4 ..
6.3.d:
नाभौ समुत्थितं पद्मं रविमण्डलसन्निभम् .
कर्णिकाकेसरोपेतं पत्रैश्च समलंकृतम् .. 108.4 ..
6.3.m: a lotus resembling the disk of the sun arose from his navel, / endowed with a pericarp and filaments, and adorned with petals.

6.3.s:
tatra brahmā samutpannaścaturvadanapaṅkajaḥ .
kiṃ karomīti deveśa ājñā me dīyatāṃ prabho .. 108.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मा समुत्पन्नश्चतुर्वदनपङ्कजः .
किं करोमीति देवेश आज्ञा मे दीयतां प्रभो .. 108.5 ..
6.3.m: There arose Brahmā, whose lotus-like faces are four: / "What shall I do, O Lord of gods? Let your command be given to me, O master."

6.3.s:
evamuktastu deveśaḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ .
uvāca madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ tadā devaṃ pitāmaham .. 108.6 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेशः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः .
उवाच मधुरां वाणीं तदा देवं पितामहम् .. 108.6 ..
6.3.m: Addressed thus, the Lord of gods, the bearer of the conch, discus, and mace, / then spoke sweet speech to the divine grandfather:

6.3.s:
sarasvatyāṃ mahābāho lokaṃ kuru mamājñayā .
bhūtagrāmamaśeṣasya utpādanavidhikṣayam .. 108.7 ..
6.3.d:
सरस्वत्यां महाबाहो लोकं कुरु ममाज्ञया .
भूतग्राममशेषस्य उत्पादनविधिक्षयम् .. 108.7 ..
6.3.m: "O mighty-armed one, by my command fashion the world upon the Sarasvatī, / the generation, rule, and dissolution of the entire multitude of beings."

6.3.s:
etacchrutaṃ tu vacanaṃ padmanābhasya bhārata .
cintayāmāsa bhagavānsaptarṣīnhitakāmyayā .. 108.8 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुतं तु वचनं पद्मनाभस्य भारत .
चिन्तयामास भगवान्सप्तर्षीन्हितकाम्यया .. 108.8 ..
6.3.m: Having heard this speech of the lotus-navelled one, O Bhārata, / the Lord, desiring benefit, thought upon the seven seers.

6.3.s:
kramātte cintitāḥ prājñāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ .
prācetaso vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva ca .. 108.9 ..
6.3.d:
क्रमात्ते चिन्तिताः प्राज्ञाः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः .
प्राचेतसो वसिष्ठश्च भृगुर्नारद एव च .. 108.9 ..
6.3.m: In order, the wise ones were conceived in thought: Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, / the son of Pracetas [Dakṣa], Vasiṣṭha, Bhṛgu, and Nārada.

6.3.s:
yajñe prācetaso dakṣo mahātejāḥ prajāpatiḥ .
dakṣasyāpi tathā jātāḥ pañcāśadduhitaro'nagha .. 108.10 ..
6.3.d:
यज्ञे प्राचेतसो दक्षो महातेजाः प्रजापतिः .
दक्षस्यापि तथा जाताः पञ्चाशद्दुहितरोऽनघ .. 108.10 ..
6.3.m: At a sacrifice Dakṣa, the son of Pracetas, the progenitor of great splendor, [was born]; / and fifty daughters were born to Dakṣa, O sinless one.

6.3.s:
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa .
tathaiva sa mahābhāgaḥ saptaviṃśatimindave .. 108.11 ..
6.3.d:
ददौ स दश धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश .
तथैव स महाभागः सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे .. 108.11 ..
6.3.m: He gave ten to Dharma, thirteen to Kaśyapa, / and that illustrious one gave twenty-seven to the moon.

6.3.s:
rohiṇīnāma yā tāsāṃ madhye tasya narādhipa .
aniṣṭā sarvanārīṇāṃ bhartuścaiva viśeṣataḥ .. 108.12 ..
6.3.d:
रोहिणीनाम या तासां मध्ये तस्य नराधिप .
अनिष्टा सर्वनारीणां भर्तुश्चैव विशेषतः .. 108.12 ..
6.3.m: The one among them named Rohiṇī, O ruler of men, / was disliked by all the women, and especially by her husband.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sā paramaṃ kṛtvā vairāgyaṃ nṛpasattama .
āgatya narmadātīre cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 108.13 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सा परमं कृत्वा वैराग्यं नृपसत्तम .
आगत्य नर्मदातीरे चचार विपुलं तपः .. 108.13 ..
6.3.m: Then, having conceived supreme detachment, O best of kings, / she came to the bank of the Narmadā and performed vast austerity.

6.3.s:
ekarātraistrirātraiśca ṣaḍdvādaśabhireva ca .
pakṣamāsopavāsaiśca karśayanti kalevaram .. 108.14 ..
6.3.d:
एकरात्रैस्त्रिरात्रैश्च षड्द्वादशभिरेव च .
पक्षमासोपवासैश्च कर्शयन्ति कलेवरम् .. 108.14 ..
6.3.m: With fasts of one night, three nights, six, and twelve [nights], / and with fortnightly and monthly fasts, emaciating her body,

6.3.s:
ārādhayantī satataṃ mahiṣāsuranāśinīṃ .
devīṃ bhagavatīṃ tāta sarvārtivinivāraṇīm .. 108.15 ..
6.3.d:
आराधयन्ती सततं महिषासुरनाशिनीं .
देवीं भगवतीं तात सर्वार्तिविनिवारणीम् .. 108.15 ..
6.3.m: constantly worshipping the destroyer of the buffalo-demon, / the divine goddess, O dear one, the dispeller of all afflictions,

6.3.s:
snātvā snātvā jale nityaṃ narmadāyāḥ śucismitā .
tatastuṣṭā mahābhāgā devī nārāyaṇī nṛpa .. 108.16 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा स्नात्वा जले नित्यं नर्मदायाः शुचिस्मिता .
ततस्तुष्टा महाभागा देवी नारायणी नृप .. 108.16 ..
6.3.m: bathing continually in the waters of the Narmadā, she of pure smiles [practiced austerity]. / Then the illustrious goddess Nārāyaṇī was pleased, O king:

6.3.s:
prasannā te mahābhāge vratena niyamena ca .
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā .. 108.17 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसन्ना ते महाभागे व्रतेन नियमेन च .
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं रोहिणी शशिनः प्रिया .. 108.17 ..
6.3.m: "I am pleased with you, O highly fortunate one, because of your vow and observance." / Having heard this speech, Rohiṇī [said]: "O giver of honor,

6.3.s:
yathā bhavāmi na cirāttathā bhavatu mānade .
evamastviti sā coktvā bhavānī bhaktavatsalā .. 108.18 ..
6.3.d:
यथा भवामि न चिरात्तथा भवतु मानदे .
एवमस्त्विति सा चोक्त्वा भवानी भक्तवत्सला .. 108.18 ..
6.3.m: let it happen before long so that I may become dear to the moon." / Having said "So be it," Bhavānī, who is affectionate to her devotees,

6.3.s:
stūyamānā munigaṇaistatraivāntaradhīyata .
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ rohiṇī śaśinaḥ priyā .. 108.19 ..
6.3.d:
स्तूयमाना मुनिगणैस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं रोहिणी शशिनः प्रिया .. 108.19 ..
6.3.m: while being praised by the hosts of sages, disappeared right there. / From that time forth, that sacred ford [became celebrated], and Rohiṇī

6.3.s:
saṃjātā sarvakālaṃ tu vallabhā nṛpasattama .
tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī naro vā snāni bhaktitaḥ .. 108.20 ..
6.3.d:
संजाता सर्वकालं तु वल्लभा नृपसत्तम .
तत्र तीर्थे तु या नारी नरो वा स्नानि भक्तितः .. 108.20 ..
6.3.m: became beloved of the moon for all time, O best of kings. / At that sacred ford, whatever woman or man bathes with devotion,

6.3.s:
vallabhā jāyate sā tu bharturvai rohiṇī yathā .
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ karoti vai .. 108.21 ..
6.3.d:
वल्लभा जायते सा तु भर्तुर्वै रोहिणी यथा .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्प्राणत्यागं करोति वै .. 108.21 ..
6.3.m: she becomes beloved of her husband, just as Rohiṇī was. / Whosoever abandons his life at that sacred ford,

6.3.s:
saptajanmāni dāmpatyaviyogo na bhavetkvacit .. 108.22 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rohiṇīsomanāthatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 109
6.3.d:
सप्तजन्मानि दाम्पत्यवियोगो न भवेत्क्वचित् .. 108.22 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रोहिणीसोमनाथतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 109
6.3.m:
for seven births there will never be separation of the married couple.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Rohiṇī-Somanātha Sacred Ford," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 109

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla cakratīrthamanuttamam .
senāpuramitikhyātaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 109.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
सेनापुरमितिख्यातं सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 109.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
From there, O king, one should go to the unsurpassed Cakratīrtha, / renowned as Senāpura, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
saināpatyābhiṣekāya devadevena cakriṇā .
ānītaśca mahāseno devaiḥ sendrapurogamaiḥ .. 109.2 ..
6.3.d:
सैनापत्याभिषेकाय देवदेवेन चक्रिणा .
आनीतश्च महासेनो देवैः सेन्द्रपुरोगमैः .. 109.2 ..
6.3.m: For consecration to the generalship, by the discus-bearing God of gods / Mahāsena was brought along with the gods led by Indra,

6.3.s:
dānavānāṃ vadhārthāya jayāya ca divaukasām .
bhūmidānena viprendrāṃstarpayitvā yathāvidhi .. 109.3 ..
6.3.d:
दानवानां वधार्थाय जयाय च दिवौकसाम् .
भूमिदानेन विप्रेन्द्रांस्तर्पयित्वा यथाविधि .. 109.3 ..
6.3.m: for the slaughter of the Dānavas and the victory of the celestials. / Having gratified the foremost brahmins with gifts of land according to the prescribed rites,

6.3.s:
śaṅkhabherīninādaiśca paṭahānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ .
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgaiśca jhallarīsvaramaṅgalaiḥ .. 109.4 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च पटहानां च निस्वनैः .
वीणावेणुमृदङ्गैश्च झल्लरीस्वरमङ्गलैः .. 109.4 ..
6.3.m: and with the sounds of conches and kettledrums, and the beats of paṭaha-drums, / with vīṇās, flutes, mṛdaṅgas, and auspicious sounds of jhallarīs—

6.3.s:
tataḥ kṛtvā svanaṃ ghoraṃ dānavo baladarpitaḥ .
rururnāma vighātārthamabhiṣekasya cāgataḥ .. 109.5 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कृत्वा स्वनं घोरं दानवो बलदर्पितः .
रुरुर्नाम विघातार्थमभिषेकस्य चागतः .. 109.5 ..
6.3.m: then, raising a dreadful roar, a Dānava arrogant with might / named Ruru came forward in order to disrupt the consecration,

6.3.s:
hastyaśvarathapattyoghaiḥ pūrayanvai diśo daśa .
tatra tena mahadyuddhaṃ pravṛttaṃ kila bhārata .. 109.6 ..
6.3.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथपत्त्योघैः पूरयन्वै दिशो दश .
तत्र तेन महद्युद्धं प्रवृत्तं किल भारत .. 109.6 ..
6.3.m: filling indeed the ten directions with hosts of elephants, horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers. / There a great battle commenced with him, indeed, O Bhārata,

6.3.s:
śaktyṛṣṭipāśamuśalaiḥ khaḍgaistomaraṭaṅkanaiḥ .
bhallaiḥ karṇikanārācaiḥ kabandhapaṭasaṃkulaiḥ .. 109.7 ..
6.3.d:
शक्त्यृष्टिपाशमुशलैः खड्गैस्तोमरटङ्कनैः .
भल्लैः कर्णिकनाराचैः कबन्धपटसंकुलैः .. 109.7 ..
6.3.m: with javelins, spears, nooses, maces, swords, lances, chisels, / bhalla arrows, barbed arrows, iron shafts, and crowded with masses of headless trunks.

6.3.s:
tatastu tāṃ śatrubalasya senāṃ kṣaṇena cāpancyutabāṇaghātaiḥ .
vidhvastahastyaśvarathānmahātmā jagrāha cakraṃ ripusaṅghanāśanaḥ .. 109.8 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तु तां शत्रुबलस्य सेनां क्षणेन चापन्च्युतबाणघातैः .
विध्वस्तहस्त्यश्वरथान्महात्मा जग्राह चक्रं रिपुसङ्घनाशनः .. 109.8 ..
6.3.m: Then, having in a moment shattered the horses, chariots, and elephants of that enemy host with blows of arrows released from his bow, / the high-souled slayer of the throngs of enemies seized the discus.

6.3.s:
jvalacca cakraṃ niśitaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ surāsurāṇāṃ ca sudarśanaṃ raṇe .
cakarta daityasya śirastadānīṃ karātpramuktaṃ madhughātinaśca tat .. 109.9 ..
6.3.d:
ज्वलच्च चक्रं निशितं भयंकरं सुरासुराणां च सुदर्शनं रणे .
चकर्त दैत्यस्य शिरस्तदानीं करात्प्रमुक्तं मधुघातिनश्च तत् .. 109.9 ..
6.3.m: And that blazing, sharp, terrifying discus, Sudarśana, in battle, / hurled then from the hand of the slayer of Madhu, severed the Daitya's head.

6.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā vighnamabhiṣeke ṣaḍānanaḥ .
tyaktvā tu tatra saṃsthānaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 109.10 ..
6.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा विघ्नमभिषेके षडाननः .
त्यक्त्वा तु तत्र संस्थानं चचार विपुलं तपः .. 109.10 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that sudden obstacle in the consecration, the six-faced one (Skanda), / abandoning his stay there, practiced immense austerity.

6.3.s:
muktaṃ cakraṃ vināśāya hariṇā lokadhāriṇā .
dvidalaṃ dānavaṃ kṛtvā papāta vimale jale .. 109.11 ..
6.3.d:
मुक्तं चक्रं विनाशाय हरिणा लोकधारिणा .
द्विदलं दानवं कृत्वा पपात विमले जले .. 109.11 ..
6.3.m: The discus, released by Hari the upholder of the world for the destruction [of the foe], / having cleft the Dānava into two pieces, fell into the clear water.

6.3.s:
tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ cakratīrthamiti śrutam .
sarvapāpavināśāya nirmitaṃ viśvamūrtinā .. 109.12 ..
6.3.d:
तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् .
सर्वपापविनाशाय निर्मितं विश्वमूर्तिना .. 109.12 ..
6.3.m: From then on, that sacred ford has been known as Cakratīrtha, / created by the One of Universal Form for the destruction of all sins.

6.3.s:
cakratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamacyutam .
puṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 109.13 ..
6.3.d:
चक्रतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्देवमच्युतम् .
पुण्डरीकस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोति मानवः .. 109.13 ..
6.3.m: A person who bathes at Cakratīrtha and worships the imperishable Lord / obtains the fruit of the Puṇḍarīka sacrifice.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayedbrāhmaṇāñchubhān .
śāntadāntajitakrodhānsa labhetkoṭijaṃ phalam .. 109.14 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छुभान् .
शान्तदान्तजितक्रोधान्स लभेत्कोटिजं फलम् .. 109.14 ..
6.3.m: And having bathed at that sacred ford, whoever worships auspicious brahmins / who are calm, self-restrained, and conquerors of anger, obtains a ten-million-fold reward.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajate dehamātmanaḥ .
viṣṇulokaṃ mṛto yāti jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ .. 109.15 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या त्यजते देहमात्मनः .
विष्णुलोकं मृतो याति जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः .. 109.15 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons his own body with devotion at that sacred ford, / having died, goes to the world of Viṣṇu amidst auspicious shouts of victory and the like.

6.3.s:
krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ devagandharvapūjitaḥ .
ihāgatya ca bhūyo'pi jāyate vipule kule .. 109.16 ..
6.3.d:
क्रीडयित्वा यथाकामं देवगन्धर्वपूजितः .
इहागत्य च भूयोऽपि जायते विपुले कुले .. 109.16 ..
6.3.m: Sporting as he pleases, honored by gods and Gandharvas, / and having returned here again, he is born into an exalted family.

6.3.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam .
kathitaṃ te mahābhāga bhūyaścānyacchṛṇuṣva me .. 109.17 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe senāpure cakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 110
6.3.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यं दुःखप्रणाशनम् .
कथितं ते महाभाग भूयश्चान्यच्छृणुष्व मे .. 109.17 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सेनापुरे चक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 110
6.3.m:
This meritorious, sin-removing, auspicious [sacred ford] that destroys sorrow / has been related to you, O fortunate one; hear yet another from me.
End of the one hundred and ninth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Cakratīrtha at Senāpura,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 110

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchenmahāpātakanāśanam .
samīpe cakratīrthasya viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ purā .. 110.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
धौतपापं ततो गच्छेन्महापातकनाशनम् .
समीपे चक्रतीर्थस्य विष्णुना निर्मितं पुरा .. 110.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
From there, one should go to Dhautapāpa, which destroys great sins, / located near Cakratīrtha, created in ancient times by Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
nihatairdānavairghorairdevadevo janārdanaḥ .
tatpāpasya vināśārthaṃ dānavāntodbhavasya ca .. 110.2 ..
6.3.d:
निहतैर्दानवैर्घोरैर्देवदेवो जनार्दनः .
तत्पापस्य विनाशार्थं दानवान्तोद्भवस्य च .. 110.2 ..
6.3.m: When dreadful Dānavas were slain, Janārdana, the God of gods, / for the destruction of that sin arising from the death of the Dānavas,

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe jitakrodhaścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .
duścaraṃ maunamāsthāya hyaśakyaṃ devadānavaiḥ .. 110.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे जितक्रोधश्चचार विपुलं तपः .
दुश्चरं मौनमास्थाय ह्यशक्यं देवदानवैः .. 110.3 ..
6.3.m: practiced immense austerity at that sacred ford, having conquered anger, / observing silence that was difficult to endure and impossible for gods and Dānavas.

6.3.s:
snātvā dattvā dvijātibhyo dānāni vividhāni ca .
tatkṣaṇātsupāpastu gatastadvaiṣṇavaṃ padam .. 110.4 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा दत्त्वा द्विजातिभ्यो दानानि विविधानि च .
तत्क्षणात्सुपापस्तु गतस्तद्वैष्णवं पदम् .. 110.4 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed and given various gifts to the twice-born, / instantly cleansed of sin, he attained that abode of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
evaṃ yuktastu yastatra pāpaṃ kṛtvā sudāruṇam .
snātvā japtvā vidhānena mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 110.5 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 111
6.3.d:
एवं युक्तस्तु यस्तत्र पापं कृत्वा सुदारुणम् .
स्नात्वा जप्त्वा विधानेन मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 110.5 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे धौतपापतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम दशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 111
6.3.m:
Thus, whoever having committed even a terrible sin there, / bathes and recites [mantras] according to the rite, is freed from all sins.
End of the one hundred and tenth chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Dhautapāpatīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 111

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
skandena nirmitaṃ pūrvaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam .. 111.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
स्कन्देन निर्मितं पूर्वं तपः कृत्वा सुदारुणम् .. 111.1 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the southern bank of the Narmadā is an exceedingly splendid sacred ford / created formerly by Skanda after performing exceedingly severe austerity.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
skandasya caritaṃ sarvamājanma dvijasattama .
tīrthasya ca vidhiṃ puṇyaṃ kathayasva yathārthataḥ .. 111.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
स्कन्दस्य चरितं सर्वमाजन्म द्विजसत्तम .
तीर्थस्य च विधिं पुण्यं कथयस्व यथार्थतः .. 111.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me truly, O best among the twice-born, the entire life of Skanda / from his birth, and the holy rite of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
devadevena vai taptaṃ tapaḥ pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
vijñaptena suraiḥ sarvairumādevī vivāhitā .. 111.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
देवदेवेन वै तप्तं तपः पूर्वं युधिष्ठिर .
विज्ञप्तेन सुरैः सर्वैरुमादेवी विवाहिता .. 111.3 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
In ancient times, O Yudhiṣṭhira, austerity was practiced by the God of gods. / When implored by all the gods, the goddess Umā was taken in marriage.

6.3.s:
nāsti senāpatiḥ kaściddevānāṃ surasattama .
nīyante dānavairghoraiḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 111.4 ..
6.3.d:
नास्ति सेनापतिः कश्चिद्देवानां सुरसत्तम .
नीयन्ते दानवैर्घोरैः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. 111.4 ..
6.3.m: There is no commander of the army for the gods, O best among gods; / all the gods along with Indra are being led captive by the dreadful Dānavas.

6.3.s:
yathā niśā vinā candraṃ divaso bhāskaraṃ vinā .
na śobhate muhūrtaṃ vai tathā senā vināyakā .. 111.5 ..
6.3.d:
यथा निशा विना चन्द्रं दिवसो भास्करं विना .
न शोभते मुहूर्तं वै तथा सेना विनायका .. 111.5 ..
6.3.m: Just as a night without the moon, or a day without the sun / does not look splendid even for a moment, so an army without a leader does not shine.

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā mahādeva parayā dayayā vibho .
senānīrdīyatāṃ kaścittriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ .. 111.6 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा महादेव परया दयया विभो .
सेनानीर्दीयतां कश्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः .. 111.6 ..
6.3.m: Knowing this, O Mahādeva, out of supreme compassion, O omnipresent Lord, / let a commander of the army renowned in the three worlds be granted.

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ devānāṃ parameśvaraḥ .
kāmayāna umāṃ devīṃ sasmāra manasā smaram .. 111.7 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं देवानां परमेश्वरः .
कामयान उमां देवीं सस्मार मनसा स्मरम् .. 111.7 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this auspicious statement of the gods, the Supreme Lord, / desiring the goddess Umā, remembered the god of love in his mind.

6.3.s:
tena mūrchitasarvāṅgaḥ kāmarūpo jagadguruḥ .
kāmayāmāsa rudrāṇīṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ kila .. 111.8 ..
6.3.d:
तेन मूर्छितसर्वाङ्गः कामरूपो जगद्गुरुः .
कामयामास रुद्राणीं दिव्यं वर्षशतं किल .. 111.8 ..
6.3.m: All his limbs overwhelmed by him, the Preceptor of the universe, who assumes forms at will, / made love to Rudrāṇī for a full hundred divine years.

6.3.s:
devarājastato jñātvā mahāmaithunagaṃ haram .
saṃmantrya daivataiḥ sārddhaṃ praiṣayajjātavedasam .. 111.9 ..
6.3.d:
देवराजस्ततो ज्ञात्वा महामैथुनगं हरम् .
संमन्त्र्य दैवतैः सार्द्धं प्रैषयज्जातवेदसम् .. 111.9 ..
6.3.m: The king of the gods, learning that Hara was engaged in great intercourse, / consulted with the deities and dispatched Agni (Jātavedas).

6.3.s:
tena gatvā mahādevaḥ paramānandasaṃsthitaḥ .
sahasā tena dṛṣṭo'sau hāhetyuktvā samutthitaḥ .. 111.10 ..
6.3.d:
तेन गत्वा महादेवः परमानन्दसंस्थितः .
सहसा तेन दृष्टोऽसौ हाहेत्युक्त्वा समुत्थितः .. 111.10 ..
6.3.m: Having gone there, Mahādeva was situated in supreme bliss; / seen suddenly by him, he exclaimed 'Alas, alas!' and rose up.

6.3.s:
tataḥ kruddhā mahādevī śāpavācamuvāca ha .
vepamānā mahārāja śṛṇu yatte vadāmyaham .. 111.11 ..
6.3.d:
ततः क्रुद्धा महादेवी शापवाचमुवाच ह .
वेपमाना महाराज शृणु यत्ते वदाम्यहम् .. 111.11 ..
6.3.m: Then the great goddess, angered, uttered a curse; / trembling, O great king, listen to what I tell you:

6.3.s:
ahaṃ yasmātsuraiḥ sarvairyācitā putrajanmani .
kṛtā ratiśca viphalā saṃpreṣya jātavedasam .. 111.12 ..
6.3.d:
अहं यस्मात्सुरैः सर्वैर्याचिता पुत्रजन्मनि .
कृता रतिश्च विफला संप्रेष्य जातवेदसम् .. 111.12 ..
6.3.m: 'Since I was begged by all the gods for the birth of a son, / and yet our lovemaking has been rendered futile by sending Agni,

6.3.s:
tasmātsarve putrahīnā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ .
hareṇoktastato vahnirasmākaṃ bījamāvaha .. 111.13 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वे पुत्रहीना भविष्यन्ति न संशयः .
हरेणोक्तस्ततो वह्निरस्माकं बीजमावह .. 111.13 ..
6.3.m: therefore all of them shall become devoid of sons, without a doubt.' / Then the Fire-god was addressed by Hara: 'Carry our seed.

6.3.s:
yathā bhavati lokeṣu tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi .
mama tejastvayā śakyaṃ gṛhītuṃ surasattama .
devakāryārthasiddhyarthaṃ nānyaḥ śakto jagattraye .. 111.14 ..
6.3.d:
यथा भवति लोकेषु तथा त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि .
मम तेजस्त्वया शक्यं गृहीतुं सुरसत्तम .
देवकार्यार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं नान्यः शक्तो जगत्त्रये .. 111.14 ..
6.3.m: You ought to act so that it comes about in the worlds. / My fiery energy can be held by you, O best of gods; / for the sake of accomplishing the task of the gods, no other is capable in the three worlds.'

6.3.s:
agniruvāca -
tejasastava me deva kā śaktirdhāraṇe vibho .
karoti bhasmasātsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 111.15 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निरुवाच -
तेजसस्तव मे देव का शक्तिर्धारणे विभो .
करोति भस्मसात्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 111.15 ..
6.3.m:
Agni said:
O God, O all-pervading Lord, what power do I have to bear your fiery energy? / It turns the entire threefold world, with all that moves and is still, to ashes.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
udarasthena bījena yadi te jāyate rujā .
tadā kṣipasva tattejo gaṅgātoye hutāśana .. 111.16 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
उदरस्थेन बीजेन यदि ते जायते रुजा .
तदा क्षिपस्व तत्तेजो गङ्गातोये हुताशन .. 111.16 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
If pain arises for you from the seed staying in your belly, / then, O consumer of oblations, cast that fiery energy into the water of the Gaṅgā.

6.3.s:
evamuktvā mahādevo'moghaṃ bījamuttamam .
havyavāhamukhe sarvaṃ prakṣipyāntaradhīyata .. 111.17 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवोऽमोघं बीजमुत्तमम् .
हव्यवाहमुखे सर्वं प्रक्षिप्यान्तरधीयत .. 111.17 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva deposited all his excellent, unfailing seed / into the mouth of the fire-god and vanished.

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ deve dahyamāno hutāśanaḥ .
gaṅgātoye vinikṣipya jagāma svaṃniveśanam .. 111.18 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं देवे दह्यमानो हुताशनः .
गङ्गातोये विनिक्षिप्य जगाम स्वंनिवेशनम् .. 111.18 ..
6.3.m: When the god had vanished, Fire, burning with heat, / threw it into the waters of the Gaṅgā and went to his own abode.

6.3.s:
asahantī tu tattejo gaṅgāpi saritāṃ varā .
śarastambe vinikṣipya jagāmāśu yathāgatam .. 111.19 ..
6.3.d:
असहन्ती तु तत्तेजो गङ्गापि सरितां वरा .
शरस्तम्बे विनिक्षिप्य जगामाशु यथागतम् .. 111.19 ..
6.3.m: Gaṅgā too, the best of rivers, unable to bear that fiery brilliance, / threw it into a reed-bed and swiftly went back the way she came.

6.3.s:
tatra jātaṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .
kṛttikāṃ preṣayāmāsuḥ stanyaṃ pāyayituṃ tadā .. 111.20 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र जातं तु तद्दृष्ट्वा सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .
कृत्तिकां प्रेषयामासुः स्तन्यं पाययितुं तदा .. 111.20 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that [child] born there, all the gods, along with Indra, / sent the Kṛttikās to give him breast-milk then.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tā āgatāḥ sarvā gaṅgāgarbhe mahāmateḥ .
ṣaṇmukhaiḥ ṣaṇmukho bhūtvā pipāsurapibatstanam .. 111.21 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ता आगताः सर्वा गङ्गागर्भे महामतेः .
षण्मुखैः षण्मुखो भूत्वा पिपासुरपिबत्स्तनम् .. 111.21 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that they had all arrived, the noble-minded one, born of Gaṅgā's womb, / became six-faced and drank the breast-milk with six mouths, longing to drink.

6.3.s:
jātakarmādisaṃskārānvedoktānpadmasambhavaḥ .
cakāra sarvāndājendra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā .. 111.22 ..
6.3.d:
जातकर्मादिसंस्कारान्वेदोक्तान्पद्मसम्भवः .
चकार सर्वान्दाजेन्द्र विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा .. 111.22 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā, born of the lotus, performed all the rites, beginning with the birth-rite, / as prescribed by the Vedas according to the prescribed rules, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
ṣaṇmukhātṣaṇmukho nāma kārttikeyastu kṛttikāt .
kumāraśca kumāratvādgaṅgāgarbho'gnijo'paraḥ .. 111.23 ..
6.3.d:
षण्मुखात्षण्मुखो नाम कार्त्तिकेयस्तु कृत्तिकात् .
कुमारश्च कुमारत्वाद्गङ्गागर्भोऽग्निजोऽपरः .. 111.23 ..
6.3.m: From his six faces he is called Ṣaṇmukha, and Kārttikeya from the Kṛttikās; / he is Kumāra because of his boyhood, Gaṅgāgarbha, and also Agrija.

6.3.s:
evaṃ kumāraḥ sambhūto hyanadhītya sa vedavit .
śāstrāṇyanekāni veda cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 111.24 ..
6.3.d:
एवं कुमारः सम्भूतो ह्यनधीत्य स वेदवित् .
शास्त्राण्यनेकानि वेद चचार विपुलं तपः .. 111.24 ..
6.3.m: Thus Kumāra was born. Without studying, he knew the Vedas / and knew many treatises; and he performed extensive austerity.

6.3.s:
devāraṇyeṣu sarveṣu nadīṣu ca nadeṣu ca .
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni samudrādyāni bhārata .. 111.25 ..
6.3.d:
देवारण्येषु सर्वेषु नदीषु च नदेषु च .
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि समुद्राद्यानि भारत .. 111.25 ..
6.3.m: In all the divine forests, at rivers and streams, / and at whatever sacred fords exist on earth, beginning with the ocean, O descendant of Bharata,

6.3.s:
tataḥ paryāyayogena narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ .
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 111.26 ..
6.3.d:
ततः पर्याययोगेन नर्मदातटमाश्रितः .
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले चचार विपुलं तपः .. 111.26 ..
6.3.m: he then, in the course of wandering, resorted to the bank of the Narmadā, / and on the southern bank of the Narmadā he performed extensive austerity,

6.3.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmavihitaṃ japañjāpyamaharniśam .
dhyāyamāno mahādevaṃ śucirdhamanisaṃtataḥ .. 111.27 ..
6.3.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामविहितं जपञ्जाप्यमहर्निशम् .
ध्यायमानो महादेवं शुचिर्धमनिसंततः .. 111.27 ..
6.3.m: chanting day and night the prayers prescribed by the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, / meditating on Mahādeva, pure, his veins standing out [on his skin].

6.3.s:
tato varṣasahasrānte pūrṇe devo maheśvaraḥ .
umayā sahitaḥ kāle tadā vacanamabravīt .. 111.28 ..
6.3.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते पूर्णे देवो महेश्वरः .
उमया सहितः काले तदा वचनमब्रवीत् .. 111.28 ..
6.3.m: Then, at the end of a full thousand years, the god Maheśvara, / accompanied by Umā, spoke these words at that time:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
ahaṃ te varadastāta gaurī mātā pitā hyaham .
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva yacceṣṭaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham .. 111.29 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
अहं ते वरदस्तात गौरी माता पिता ह्यहम् .
वरं वृणीष्व यच्चेष्टं त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभम् .. 111.29 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“I grant you a boon, dear child. Gaurī is your mother, and I am your father. / Choose a boon, whatever you desire, even if difficult to obtain in the three worlds.”

6.3.s:
ṣaṇmukha uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva umayā saha śaṅkara .
vṛṇomi mātāpitarau nānyā gatirmatirmama .. 111.30 ..
6.3.d:
षण्मुख उवाच -
यदि तुष्टो महादेव उमया सह शङ्कर .
वृणोमि मातापितरौ नान्या गतिर्मतिर्मम .. 111.30 ..
6.3.m:
Ṣaṇmukha said:
“If you are pleased, Mahādeva, Śaṅkara, together with Umā, / I choose you both as mother and father; I have no other refuge or thought.”

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ putrasya vadanāccyutam .
tathetyuktvā tu snehena premṇā taṃ pariṣasvaje .. 111.31 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं पुत्रस्य वदनाच्च्युतम् .
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु स्नेहेन प्रेम्णा तं परिषस्वजे .. 111.31 ..
6.3.m: Hearing these auspicious words spoken from the mouth of his son, / he said, ‘So be it,’ and embraced him with affection and love.

6.3.s: tatastaṃ mūrdhnyupāghrāya hyumayovāca śaṅkaraḥ .. 111.32 ..
6.3.d: ततस्तं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय ह्युमयोवाच शङ्करः .. 111.32 ..
6.3.m: Then, smelling his head, Śaṅkara, along with Umā, said:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva senānīstvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .. 111.33 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव सेनानीस्त्वं भविष्यसि .. 111.33 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“You shall be imperishable, immutable, and the commander of the army.

6.3.s:
śikhī ca te vāhanaṃ divyarūpo datto mayā śaktidharasya saṃkhye .
surāsurādīṃśca jayeti coktvā jagāma kailāsavaraṃ mahātmā .. 111.34 ..
6.3.d:
शिखी च ते वाहनं दिव्यरूपो दत्तो मया शक्तिधरस्य संख्ये .
सुरासुरादींश्च जयेति चोक्त्वा जगाम कैलासवरं महात्मा .. 111.34 ..
6.3.m: A peacock of divine form has been given by me as a mount to you who wield the spear in battle. / Conquer the gods, asuras, and the rest!” Having said this, the Great-Souled one went to the excellent Kailāsa.

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ deve tadā sa śikhivāhanaḥ .
sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāma surasannidhau .. 111.35 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं देवे तदा स शिखिवाहनः .
स्थापयित्वा महादेवं जगाम सुरसन्निधौ .. 111.35 ..
6.3.m: When the god had vanished, he whose mount is a peacock / installed Mahādeva and then went to the presence of the gods.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ skandatīrthamiti śrutam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ martyānāṃ bhuvi durlabham .. 111.36 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं स्कन्दतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं मर्त्यानां भुवि दुर्लभम् .. 111.36 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, that sacred ford became known as Skandatīrtha, / removing all sins, holy, and difficult to attain for mortals on earth.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo rājanbhaktyā snātvārcayecchivam .
gandhamālyābhiṣekaiśca yājñikaṃ sa labhetphalam .. 111.37 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो राजन्भक्त्या स्नात्वार्चयेच्छिवम् .
गन्धमाल्याभिषेकैश्च याज्ञिकं स लभेत्फलम् .. 111.37 ..
6.3.m: O King, whoever bathes at that sacred ford with devotion and worships Śiva / with perfumes, garlands, and ceremonial bathing, obtains the fruit of a sacrificer.

6.3.s:
skandatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
tilamiśreṇa toyena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 111.38 ..
6.3.d:
स्कन्दतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्पितृदेवताः .
तिलमिश्रेण तोयेन तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 111.38 ..
6.3.m: Hear the meritorious fruit of him who bathes at Skandatīrtha / and worships the ancestors and deities with water mixed with sesame seeds:

6.3.s:
piṇḍadānena caikena vidhiyuktena bhārata .
dvādaśābdāni tuṣyanti pitaro nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 111.39 ..
6.3.d:
पिण्डदानेन चैकेन विधियुक्तेन भारत .
द्वादशाब्दानि तुष्यन्ति पितरो नात्र संशयः .. 111.39 ..
6.3.m: By a single offering of rice-balls performed according to the rules, O descendant of Bharata, / the ancestors are satisfied for twelve years; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra śubhaṃ vā yādi vāśubham .
iha loke pare caiva tatsarvaṃ jāyate'kṣayam .. 111.40 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र शुभं वा यादि वाशुभम् .
इह लोके परे चैव तत्सर्वं जायतेऽक्षयम् .. 111.40 ..
6.3.m: Whatever good or evil is done at that sacred ford, O best of kings, / all of that becomes imperishable, both in this world and in the next.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ kariṣyati .
śāstrayuktena vidhinā sa gacchecchivamandiram .. 111.41 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्प्राणत्यागं करिष्यति .
शास्त्रयुक्तेन विधिना स गच्छेच्छिवमन्दिरम् .. 111.41 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons his life at that sacred ford / according to the injunctions laid down in the scriptures, goes to the abode of Śiva.

6.3.s:
kalpamekaṃ vasitvā tu devagandharvapūjitaḥ .
atra bhāratavarṣe tu jāyate vimale kule .. 111.42 ..
6.3.d:
कल्पमेकं वसित्वा तु देवगन्धर्वपूजितः .
अत्र भारतवर्षे तु जायते विमले कुले .. 111.42 ..
6.3.m: Having lived [there] for one kalpa, honored by gods and gandharvas, / he is born here in the land of Bharata into a pure family.

6.3.s:
vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 111.43 ..
6.3.d:
वेदवेदाङ्गतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः .
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः .. 111.43 ..
6.3.m: Knowing the truth of the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas, free from all diseases, / he lives for more than a hundred years, endowed with sons and grandsons.

6.3.s:
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanskandatīrthasya sambhavam .
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam .. 111.44 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe skandatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 112
6.3.d:
इदं ते कथितं राजन्स्कन्दतीर्थस्य सम्भवम् .
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं सर्वदुःखघ्नमुत्तमम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं देवदेवेन भाषितम् .. 111.44 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे स्कन्दतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकादशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 112
6.3.m:
Thus the origin of Skandatīrtha has been related to you, O King: / auspicious, bringing fame and longevity, destroying all sorrow, excellent, / removing all sins, holy, as spoken by the God of gods.
Thus ends the one hundred and eleventh chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Skandatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 112

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthamāṅgirasasya tu .
uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpavināśanam .. 112.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थमाङ्गिरसस्य तु .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सर्वपापविनाशनम् .. 112.1 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“Then, O best of kings, one should go to the sacred ford of Aṅgiras / on the northern bank of the Narmadā, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
purāsīdaṅgirānāma brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ .
putrahetoryugasyādau cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .. 112.2 ..
6.3.d:
पुरासीदङ्गिरानाम ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः .
पुत्रहेतोर्युगस्यादौ चचार विपुलं तपः .. 112.2 ..
6.3.m: Formerly, a brahmin named Aṅgiras, who had mastered the Vedas, / performed extensive austerity at the beginning of the yuga for the sake of a son.

6.3.s:
nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī japandevaṃ sanātanam .
pūjayaṃśca mahādevaṃ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ .. 112.3 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं त्रिषवणस्नायी जपन्देवं सनातनम् .
पूजयंश्च महादेवं कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः .. 112.3 ..
6.3.m: Constantly bathing at the three junctures of the day, chanting the names of the eternal god, / and worshiping Mahādeva with observances like Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa,

6.3.s:
dvādaśābde tataḥ pūrṇe tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ .
vareṇa chandayāmāsa dvijamāṅgirasaṃ varam .. 112.4 ..
6.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दे ततः पूर्णे तुतोष परमेश्वरः .
वरेण छन्दयामास द्विजमाङ्गिरसं वरम् .. 112.4 ..
6.3.m: at the completion of twelve years, Parameśvara was pleased / and invited the excellent twice-born descendant of Aṅgiras with a boon.

6.3.s:
vavre sa tu mahādevaṃ putraṃ putravatāṃ varam .
vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ sarvaśāstraviśāradam .. 112.5 ..
6.3.d:
वव्रे स तु महादेवं पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरम् .
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नातं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् .. 112.5 ..
6.3.m: He asked Mahādeva for a son, the best among sons: / one bathed in the vows of Vedic learning, skilled in all scriptures,

6.3.s:
devānāṃ mantriṇaṃ rājan sarvalokeṣu pūjitam .
brahmalakṣmyāḥ sadāvāsamakṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ sutam .. 112.6 ..
6.3.d:
देवानां मन्त्रिणं राजन् सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम् .
ब्रह्मलक्ष्म्याः सदावासमक्षयं चाव्ययं सुतम् .. 112.6 ..
6.3.m: a counsellor of the gods, O King, honored in all the worlds, / a permanent abode of Vedic glory, an imperishable and immutable son.

6.3.s:
tathābhilaṣitaḥ putraḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ .
bhaviṣyati na sandehaścaivamuktvā yayau haraḥ .. 112.7 ..
6.3.d:
तथाभिलषितः पुत्रः सर्वविद्याविशारदः .
भविष्यति न सन्देहश्चैवमुक्त्वा ययौ हरः .. 112.7 ..
6.3.m: ‘Such a desired son, skilled in all branches of learning, / shall be born, without doubt.’ Having said this, Hara departed.

6.3.s:
varairaṅgirasaścāpi bṛhaspatirajāyata .
yathābhilaṣitaḥ putro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ .. 112.8 ..
6.3.d:
वरैरङ्गिरसश्चापि बृहस्पतिरजायत .
यथाभिलषितः पुत्रो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः .. 112.8 ..
6.3.m: And by those boons, Bṛhaspati was born to Aṅgiras— / a son just as he had desired, who had crossed to the end of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

6.3.s:
jāte putre'ṅgirāstatra sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram .
hṛṣṭatuṣṭamanā bhūtvā jagāmottaraparvatam .. 112.9 ..
6.3.d:
जाते पुत्रेऽङ्गिरास्तत्र स्थापयामास शङ्करम् .
हृष्टतुष्टमना भूत्वा जगामोत्तरपर्वतम् .. 112.9 ..
6.3.m: When the son was born, Aṅgiras installed Śaṅkara there; / and becoming joyful and satisfied in mind, he went to the Northern Mountain.

6.3.s:
tatra cāṅgirase tīrthe yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivam .
sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 112.10 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र चाङ्गिरसे तीर्थे यः स्नात्वा पूजयेच्छिवम् .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 112.10 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes at that ford of Aṅgiras and worships Śiva, / freed from all sins, goes to the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt .
icchate yaśca yaṃ kāmaṃ sa taṃ labhati mānavaḥ .. 112.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe'gnirasatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 113
6.3.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमाप्नुयात् .
इच्छते यश्च यं कामं स तं लभति मानवः .. 112.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डेऽग्निरसतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वादशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 113
6.3.m:
A sonless person obtains a son, a poor person obtains wealth, / and whatever desire a person wishes for, that he attains.”
Thus ends the one hundred and twelfth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Ford of Aṅgiras', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 113

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra koṭitīrthamanuttamam .
ṛṣikoṭirgatā tatra parāṃ siddhimupāgatā .. 113.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कोटितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
ऋषिकोटिर्गता तत्र परां सिद्धिमुपागता .. 113.1 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Koṭitīrtha, / where ten million seers went and attained supreme perfection.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchuciḥ .
ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 113.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छुचिः .
एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 113.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, purified, bathes in that sacred ford and feeds brahmins— / when a single brahmin is fed, ten million are fed.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
pūjite tu mahādeve vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .. 113.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśādhikaśātatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 114
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्पितृदेवताः .
पूजिते तु महादेवे वाजपेयफलं लभेत् .. 113.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोटितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयोदशाधिकशाततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 114
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and worships the ancestors and deities, / when Mahādeva is worshipped, obtains the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Koṭitīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 114

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
ayonijaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 114.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
अयोनिजं महापुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 114.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the supremely auspicious sacred ford, / the Ayonija, immensely meritorious, destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
ayonije naraḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
pitṛdevārcanaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 114.2 ..
6.3.d:
अयोनिजे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
पितृदेवार्चनं कृत्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 114.2 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes in the Ayonija and worships the Supreme Lord, / performing the worship of ancestors and gods, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu vidhinā prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ .
sa kadācinmahārāja yonidvāraṃ na paśyati .. 114.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayonisambhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 115
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु विधिना प्राणत्यागं करोति यः .
स कदाचिन्महाराज योनिद्वारं न पश्यति .. 114.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अयोनिसम्भवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुर्दशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 115
6.3.m:
Whoever abandons his life according to rule at that sacred ford, / he never again sees the door of a womb, O great king.
Thus ends the one hundred and fourteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Ayonisambhavatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 115

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahārāja tīrthamaṅgārakaṃ param .
rūpadaṃ sarvalokānāṃ viśrutaṃ narmadātaṭe .. 115.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महाराज तीर्थमङ्गारकं परम् .
रूपदं सर्वलोकानां विश्रुतं नर्मदातटे .. 115.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O great king, one should go to the supreme sacred ford Aṅgāraka, / which bestows beauty upon all people, renowned on the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
aṅgārakeṇa rājendra purā taptaṃ tapaḥ kila .
arbudaṃ ca nikharvaṃ ca prayutaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā .. 115.2 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गारकेण राजेन्द्र पुरा तप्तं तपः किल .
अर्बुदं च निखर्वं च प्रयुतं वर्षसंख्यया .. 115.2 ..
6.3.m: Formerly, O king of kings, austerity was indeed performed by Aṅgāraka / for one hundred million, ten billion, and one million years in number.

6.3.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ parayā kṛpayā nṛpa .
pratyakṣadarśī bhagavānuvāca kṣitinandanam .. 115.3 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः परया कृपया नृप .
प्रत्यक्षदर्शी भगवानुवाच क्षितिनन्दनम् .. 115.3 ..
6.3.m: Then Mahādeva, pleased through supreme compassion, O king, / the Lord appearing visibly, spoke to the son of the Earth:

6.3.s:
varado'smi mahābhāga durlabhaṃ tridaśairapi .
varaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ vatsa brūhi yatte vivakṣitam .. 115.4 ..
6.3.d:
वरदोऽस्मि महाभाग दुर्लभं त्रिदशैरपि .
वरं दास्याम्यहं वत्स ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम् .. 115.4 ..
6.3.m: 'I am a granter of boons, O highly fortunate one. I will grant a boon / difficult even for the thirty [gods] to attain, my child; speak what you wish to say.'

6.3.s:
aṅgāraka uvāca -
tava prasādāddeveśa sarvalokamaheśvara .
grahamadhyagato nityaṃ vicarāmi nabhastale .. 115.5 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गारक उवाच -
तव प्रसादाद्देवेश सर्वलोकमहेश्वर .
ग्रहमध्यगतो नित्यं विचरामि नभस्तले .. 115.5 ..
6.3.m: Aṅgāraka said: / 'By your favor, O Lord of gods, Great Lord of all the worlds, / positioned in the midst of the planets, may I constantly roam in the sky.

6.3.s:
yāvaddharādharo loke yāvaccandradivākarau .
nadyo nadāḥ samudrāśca varo me cākṣayo bhavet .. 115.6 ..
6.3.d:
यावद्धराधरो लोके यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ .
नद्यो नदाः समुद्राश्च वरो मे चाक्षयो भवेत् .. 115.6 ..
6.3.m: As long as the earth and mountains remain in the world, as long as the moon and sun, / the rivers, streams, and oceans endure, let my boon be inexhaustible.'

6.3.s:
evamastviti deveśo dattvā varamanuttamam .
jagāmākāśamāviśya vandyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ .. 115.7 ..
6.3.d:
एवमस्त्विति देवेशो दत्त्वा वरमनुत्तमम् .
जगामाकाशमाविश्य वन्द्यमानः सुरासुरैः .. 115.7 ..
6.3.m: 'So be it,' said the Lord of gods, and having granted the peerless boon, / he departed entering the sky, praised by gods and asuras.

6.3.s:
bhūmiputrastatastasminsthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram .
gataḥ surālaye loke grahabhāve niveśitaḥ .. 115.8 ..
6.3.d:
भूमिपुत्रस्ततस्तस्मिन्स्थापयामास शङ्करम् .
गतः सुरालये लोके ग्रहभावे निवेशितः .. 115.8 ..
6.3.m: Then the son of the Earth installed Śaṅkara in that place; / he went to the realm of the gods, established in the status of a planet.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
hutahomo jitakrodhaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 115.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
हुतहोमो जितक्रोधः सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 115.9 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and worships the Supreme Lord, / having offered oblations in fire and conquered anger, obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
caturthyaṅgārake yastu snātvā cābhyarcayedgraham .
aṅgārakaṃ vidhānena saptajanmāni bhārata .. 115.10 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्थ्यङ्गारके यस्तु स्नात्वा चाभ्यर्चयेद्ग्रहम् .
अङ्गारकं विधानेन सप्तजन्मानि भारत .. 115.10 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes on the fourth [tithi falling on a Tuesday] and worships the planet / Aṅgāraka according to rule, O Bhārata, for seven births

6.3.s:
daśayojanavistīrṇe maṇḍale rūpavān bhavet .
tatraiva tā mṛto jantuḥ kāmato'kāmato'pi vā .
rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate .. 115.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe aṅgārakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 116
6.3.d:
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णे मण्डले रूपवान् भवेत् .
तत्रैव ता मृतो जन्तुः कामतोऽकामतोऽपि वा .
रुद्रस्यानुचरो भूत्वा तेनैव सह मोदते .. 115.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अङ्गारकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 116
6.3.m:
becomes handsome within a circle ten yojanas wide. / A living being who dies right there, whether willingly or unwillingly, / becomes an attendant of Rudra and rejoices along with him.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Aṅgārakatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 116

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
pāṇḍutīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpavināśanam .
tatra snātvā naro rājanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 116.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पाण्डुतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपापविनाशनम् .
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन्मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 116.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to the Pāṇḍutīrtha, which destroys all sins. / Having bathed there, O king, a man is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dāpayetkāñcanaṃ śuciḥ .
bhrūṇahatyādipāpāni naśyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 116.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दापयेत्काञ्चनं शुचिः .
भ्रूणहत्यादिपापानि नश्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 116.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, purified, bathes in that sacred ford and has gold given, / sins such as the slaying of an embryo are destroyed; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
piṇḍodakapradānena vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .
pitaraḥ pitāmahāśca nṛtyante ca praharṣitāḥ .. 116.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe pāṇḍutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 117
6.3.d:
पिण्डोदकप्रदानेन वाजपेयफलं लभेत् .
पितरः पितामहाश्च नृत्यन्ते च प्रहर्षिताः .. 116.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पाण्डुतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षोडशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 117
6.3.m:
By the offering of rice-balls and water, one obtains the fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice. / The fathers and grandfathers dance with great joy.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Pāṇḍutīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 117

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ trilocanam .
tatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ .. 117.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र पुण्यं तीर्थं त्रिलोचनम् .
तत्र तिष्ठति देवेशः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः .. 117.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the holy Trilocana sacred ford; / there stands the Lord of gods, bowed to by all the worlds.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktyārcayati śaṅkaram .
rudrasya bhavanaṃ yāti mṛto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 117.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा भक्त्यार्चयति शङ्करम् .
रुद्रस्य भवनं याति मृतो नास्त्यत्र संशयः .. 117.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and worships Śaṅkara with devotion, / upon dying goes to the abode of Rudra; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
kalpakṣaye tataḥ pūrṇe krīḍitvā ca ihāgataḥ .
āviyogena tiṣṭheta pūjyamānaḥ śataṃ samāḥ .. 117.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe trilocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
कल्पक्षये ततः पूर्णे क्रीडित्वा च इहागतः .
आवियोगेन तिष्ठेत पूज्यमानः शतं समाः .. 117.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे त्रिलोचनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तदशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Then, having played until the end of the kalpa is fulfilled and returning here, / he would remain without separation, worshipped for a hundred years.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventeenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Trilocanatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
indratīrthetivikhyātaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe .. 118.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
इन्द्रतीर्थेतिविख्यातं नर्मदादक्षिणे तटे .. 118.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the exceedingly splendid sacred ford / renowned as Indratīrtha on the southern bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle indratīrthaṃ kathaṃ bhavet .
śrotumicchāmi viprendra hyādimadhyāntavistaraiḥ .. 118.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले इन्द्रतीर्थं कथं भवेत् .
श्रोतुमिच्छामि विप्रेन्द्र ह्यादिमध्यान्तविस्तरैः .. 118.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / 'How did Indratīrtha come to be on the southern bank of the Narmadā? / I desire to hear, O best of brahmins, in full detail from beginning, middle, to end.'

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ .
kathayāmāsa tadvattamitihāsaṃ purātanam .. 118.3 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं धर्मपुत्रस्य धीमतः .
कथयामास तद्वत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम् .. 118.3 ..
6.3.m: Having heard this speech of the wise son of Dharma, / he narrated to him that ancient history as it happened.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
viśvāsayitvā suciraṃ dharmaśatruṃ mahābalam .
vṛtraṃ jitvātha hatvā tu gacchamānaṃ śacīpatim .. 118.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
विश्वासयित्वा सुचिरं धर्मशत्रुं महाबलम् .
वृत्रं जित्वाथ हत्वा तु गच्छमानं शचीपतिम् .. 118.4 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having inspired confidence for a very long time in that mighty enemy of righteousness, / and having conquered and killed Vṛtra, Śacī's husband was departing;

6.3.s:
niṣkrāmamāṇaṃ mārgeṇa brahmahatyā durāsadā .
ahorātramaviśrāntā jagāma bhuvanatrayam .. 118.5 ..
6.3.d:
निष्क्राममाणं मार्गेण ब्रह्महत्या दुरासदा .
अहोरात्रमविश्रान्ता जगाम भुवनत्रयम् .. 118.5 ..
6.3.m: as he was proceeding along the road, the dreadful guilt of killing a brahmin (brahmahatyā), / untiring day and night, pursued [him through] the three worlds.

6.3.s:
yatoyato brahmahaṇaṃ yāti yānena śobhanam .
diśo bhāgaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ tato hatyā na muñcati .. 118.6 ..
6.3.d:
यतोयतो ब्रह्महणं याति यानेन शोभनम् .
दिशो भागं सुरैः सार्द्धं ततो हत्या न मुञ्चति .. 118.6 ..
