6.3.m: Wherever the slayer of a brahmin went by conveyance with the gods / toward any splendid quarter, the murder would not release him from that direction.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaganāgamaḥ .
pātakānāṃ gatirdṛṣṭā na tu viśvāsaghātinām .. 118.7 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वगनागमः .
पातकानां गतिर्दृष्टा न तु विश्वासघातिनाम् .. 118.7 ..
6.3.m: For killing a brahmin, drinking liquor, theft, and intercourse with a guru's wife, / an expiation for sins is found, but not for betrayers of trust.

6.3.s:
pāpakarmamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā snānadānairviśudhyati .
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi naiva viśvāsaghātinaḥ .. 118.8 ..
6.3.d:
पापकर्ममुखं दृष्ट्वा स्नानदानैर्विशुध्यति .
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि नैव विश्वासघातिनः .. 118.8 ..
6.3.m: Looking upon the visage of a sinful act, a woman or a man / is purified by bath and charity, but never the betrayers of trust.

6.3.s:
evamādīni cānyāni śrutvā vākyāni devarāṭ .
vacanaṃ tadvidhairuktaṃ viṣādamagamatparam .. 118.9 ..
6.3.d:
एवमादीनि चान्यानि श्रुत्वा वाक्यानि देवराट् .
वचनं तद्विधैरुक्तं विषादमगमत्परम् .. 118.9 ..
6.3.m: Hearing these and other words spoken by men like him, / the king of gods fell into deep dejection.

6.3.s:
tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma tapa uttamam .
putradāragṛhaṃ rājyaṃ vasūni vividhāni ca .. 118.10 ..
6.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं सुरैः सार्धं जगाम तप उत्तमम् .
पुत्रदारगृहं राज्यं वसूनि विविधानि च .. 118.10 ..
6.3.m: Abandoning his kingship along with the gods, he set out for supreme austerity. / Children, wife, house, kingdom, and various wealth—

6.3.s:
phalānyetāni dharmasya śobhayanti janeśvaram .
phalaṃ dharmasya bhuñjeti suhṛtsvajanabāndhavāḥ .. 118.11 ..
6.3.d:
फलान्येतानि धर्मस्य शोभयन्ति जनेश्वरम् .
फलं धर्मस्य भुञ्जेति सुहृत्स्वजनबान्धवाः .. 118.11 ..
6.3.m: these fruits of dharma bring glory to a lord of men. / Thinking, "Let [him] enjoy the fruit of dharma," friends, kin, and relatives [gather];

6.3.s:
paśyatāṃ sarvameteṣāṃ pāpamekena bhujyate .
paraṃ hi sukhamutsṛjya karśayanvai kalevaram .. 118.12 ..
6.3.d:
पश्यतां सर्वमेतेषां पापमेकेन भुज्यते .
परं हि सुखमुत्सृज्य कर्शयन्वै कलेवरम् .. 118.12 ..
6.3.m: while all these watch, sin is suffered alone. / Forsaking supreme pleasure and emaciating his body,

6.3.s:
devarājo jagāmāsau tīrthānyāyatanāni ca .
gaṅgātīrtheṣu sarveṣu yāmuneṣu tathaiva ca .. 118.13 ..
6.3.d:
देवराजो जगामासौ तीर्थान्यायतनानि च .
गङ्गातीर्थेषु सर्वेषु यामुनेषु तथैव च .. 118.13 ..
6.3.m: that king of gods wandered to sacred fords and temples: / to all the sacred fords of the Gaṅgā, and likewise to those of the Yamunā,

6.3.s:
sārasvateṣu sarveṣu sāmudreṣu pṛthakpṛthak .
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca .. 118.14 ..
6.3.d:
सारस्वतेषु सर्वेषु सामुद्रेषु पृथक्पृथक् .
नदीषु देवखातेषु तडागेषु सरःसु च .. 118.14 ..
6.3.m: to all those belonging to Sarasvatī, and to the oceanic ones one by one, / to rivers, divine lakes, ponds, and pools.

6.3.s:
pāpaṃ na muñcate sarve paścāddevasamāgame .
revāprabhavatīrtheṣu kūlayorubhayorapi .. 118.15 ..
6.3.d:
पापं न मुञ्चते सर्वे पश्चाद्देवसमागमे .
रेवाप्रभवतीर्थेषु कूलयोरुभयोरपि .. 118.15 ..
6.3.m: The sin did not leave him, even in the subsequent assembly of the gods. / Along both banks at the sacred fords along the course of the Revā,

6.3.s:
pūjayanvai mahādevaṃ skandatīrthaṃ samāsadat .
tava sthitvopavāsaiśca kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādibhiḥ .. 118.16 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयन्वै महादेवं स्कन्दतीर्थं समासदत् .
तव स्थित्वोपवासैश्च कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादिभिः .. 118.16 ..
6.3.m: worshiping Mahādeva, he reached Skandatīrtha. / Staying there, with fasts, the kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa penances, and the like,

6.3.s:
karśayanvai svakaṃ dehaṃ na lebhe śarma vai kvacit .
grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ .. 118.17 ..
6.3.d:
कर्शयन्वै स्वकं देहं न लेभे शर्म वै क्वचित् .
ग्रीष्मे पञ्चाग्निमध्यस्थो वर्षासु स्थण्डिलेशयः .. 118.17 ..
6.3.m: emaciating his body, he found no peace anywhere. / In the summer standing in the midst of five fires, in the rains sleeping on the bare ground,

6.3.s:
ārdravāsāstu hemante cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .
evaṃ tu tapatastasya indrasya viditātmanaḥ .. 118.18 ..
6.3.d:
आर्द्रवासास्तु हेमन्ते चचार विपुलं तपः .
एवं तु तपतस्तस्य इन्द्रस्य विदितात्मनः .. 118.18 ..
6.3.m: and in winter wearing wet clothes, he practiced vast austerity. / While Indra, whose self was known, was thus practicing austerity,

6.3.s:
vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi gatāni daśa bhārata .
tatastvekādaśe prāpte varṣe tu nṛpasattama .. 118.19 ..
6.3.d:
वत्सराणां सहस्राणि गतानि दश भारत .
ततस्त्वेकादशे प्राप्ते वर्षे तु नृपसत्तम .. 118.19 ..
6.3.m: ten thousand years passed, O Bhārata. / Then, when the eleventh year arrived, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
sahasā bhagavāndevastu tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ .
tathā brahmarṣayaḥ siddhā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ .. 118.20 ..
6.3.d:
सहसा भगवान्देवस्तु तुतोष परमेश्वरः .
तथा ब्रह्मर्षयः सिद्धा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः .. 118.20 ..
6.3.m: suddenly the blessed god, the supreme lord, was pleased, / and likewise the brahmin-seers and perfected ones, headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
tatrājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve yatra devaḥ śatakratuḥ .
dṛṣṭvā samāgatān devānṛṣīṃścaiva mahāmatiḥ .. 118.21 ..
6.3.d:
तत्राजग्मुः सुराः सर्वे यत्र देवः शतक्रतुः .
दृष्ट्वा समागतान् देवानृषींश्चैव महामतिः .. 118.21 ..
6.3.m: All the gods came there where the god Śatakratu was. / Seeing the gods and the seers assembled, the wise

6.3.s:
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā sarvadevapurohitaḥ .
viditaṃ sarvameteṣāṃ yathā vṛtravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 118.22 ..
6.3.d:
उवाच प्रणतो भूत्वा सर्वदेवपुरोहितः .
विदितं सर्वमेतेषां यथा वृत्रवधः कृतः .. 118.22 ..
6.3.m: priest of all the gods bowed down and said: / "It is known to all of them how the slaying of Vṛtra was done,

6.3.s:
yuṣmākaṃ cājñayā pūrvaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .
tathāpyevaṃ brahmahaṇaṃ matvā pāpasya kāriṇam .. 118.23 ..
6.3.d:
युष्माकं चाज्ञया पूर्वं ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .
तथाप्येवं ब्रह्महणं मत्वा पापस्य कारिणम् .. 118.23 ..
6.3.m: and formerly by your command, O Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara. / Nevertheless, considering him a slayer of a brahmin who committed a sin,

6.3.s:
bhramantaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu brahmahatyā na muñcati .
na nandati jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 118.24 ..
6.3.d:
भ्रमन्तं सर्वतीर्थेषु ब्रह्महत्या न मुञ्चति .
न नन्दति जगत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 118.24 ..
6.3.m: as he wanders among all the sacred fords, the murder of a brahmin does not leave him. / The entire world, the three worlds with all that moves and is still, does not rejoice:

6.3.s:
yathā vihīnacandrārkaṃ tathā rājyamanāyakam .
tasmātsarve suraśreṣṭhā vijñāpyaṃ mama samprati .. 118.25 ..
6.3.d:
यथा विहीनचन्द्रार्कं तथा राज्यमनायकम् .
तस्मात्सर्वे सुरश्रेष्ठा विज्ञाप्यं मम सम्प्रति .. 118.25 ..
6.3.m: just as [the sky] is bereft of the moon and sun, so is a kingdom without a ruler. / Therefore, O best of gods, listen now to my petition:

6.3.s:
kurvantu śakraṃ nirdoṣaṃ tathā sarve maharṣayaḥ .
bṛhaspatimukhodgīrṇaṃ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ śubham .. 118.26 ..
6.3.d:
कुर्वन्तु शक्रं निर्दोषं तथा सर्वे महर्षयः .
बृहस्पतिमुखोद्गीर्णं श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं शुभम् .. 118.26 ..
6.3.m: let all the great seers and [gods] make Śakra free of fault." / Hearing those auspicious words uttered from the mouth of Bṛhaspati,

6.3.s:
tataḥ provāca bhagavānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
etatpāpaṃ mahāghoraṃ brahmahatyāsamudbhavam .. 118.27 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रोवाच भगवान्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
एतत्पापं महाघोरं ब्रह्महत्यासमुद्भवम् .. 118.27 ..
6.3.m: the blessed Brahmā, grandfather of the worlds, then spoke: / "This exceedingly dreadful sin born of the murder of a brahmin,

6.3.s:
daivatebhyo'tha bhūtebhyaścaturbhāgaṃ kṣipāmyaham .
evaṃ muktvā kṣipaccaino jalopari mahāmatiḥ .. 118.28 ..
6.3.d:
दैवतेभ्योऽथ भूतेभ्यश्चतुर्भागं क्षिपाम्यहम् .
एवं मुक्त्वा क्षिपच्चैनो जलोपरि महामतिः .. 118.28 ..
6.3.m: I shall cast in four portions among deities and beings." / Having spoken thus, the wise one cast [a part of] the sin upon the water;

6.3.s:
avagāhya tataḥ peyā āpo vai nānyathā budhaiḥ .
dharāyāmakṣipadbhāgaṃ dvitīyaṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ .. 118.29 ..
6.3.d:
अवगाह्य ततः पेया आपो वै नान्यथा बुधैः .
धरायामक्षिपद्भागं द्वितीयं पद्मसंभवः .. 118.29 ..
6.3.m: hence water must be drunk by the wise [only] after plunging in, not otherwise. / The lotus-born one cast the second portion upon the earth;

6.3.s:
abhakṣyā tena saṃjātā sadākālaṃ vasuṃdharā .
tadārdhamarddhaṃ nārīṇāṃ dvitīye'hni yudhiṣṭhira .. 118.30 ..
6.3.d:
अभक्ष्या तेन संजाता सदाकालं वसुंधरा .
तदार्धमर्द्धं नारीणां द्वितीयेऽह्नि युधिष्ठिर .. 118.30 ..
6.3.m: on that account the earth has become at all times unfit for food. / Casting half of that half upon women on their second day, O Yudhiṣṭhira,

6.3.s:
nikṣipya bhagavāndevaḥ punaranyajjagāda ha .
asaṃgrāhyā tvasaṃgrāhyā tena jātā rajasvalā .. 118.31 ..
6.3.d:
निक्षिप्य भगवान्देवः पुनरन्यज्जगाद ह .
असंग्राह्या त्वसंग्राह्या तेन जाता रजस्वला .. 118.31 ..
6.3.m: the blessed god spoke further again: / "Because of this, a menstruating woman has become untouchable, truly untouchable,

6.3.s:
caturdināni sā prājñaiḥ pāpasya mahato mahāt .
caturthaṃ tu tato bhāgaṃ vibhajya parameśvaraḥ .. 118.32 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्दिनानि सा प्राज्ञैः पापस्य महतो महात् .
चतुर्थं तु ततो भागं विभज्य परमेश्वरः .. 118.32 ..
6.3.m: for four days by the wise, because of the greatness of the great sin." / Then, having divided the fourth portion, the supreme lord [cast it]

6.3.s:
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaiḥ śūdrasevākare dvije .
tato'bhinandayāmāsuḥ sarve devā maharṣayaḥ .. 118.33 ..
6.3.d:
कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यैः शूद्रसेवाकरे द्विजे .
ततोऽभिनन्दयामासुः सर्वे देवा महर्षयः .. 118.33 ..
6.3.m: upon a twice-born man engaged in agriculture, cattle-rearing, trade, and serving Śūdras. / Then all the gods and great seers congratulated

6.3.s:
devendraṃ vāgbhiriṣṭābhirnarmadājalasaṃsthitam .
vareṇa chandayāmāsa tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 118.34 ..
6.3.d:
देवेन्द्रं वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्नर्मदाजलसंस्थितम् .
वरेण छन्दयामास ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 118.34 ..
6.3.m: the lord of the gods, standing in the waters of the Narmadā, with agreeable words. / Then Maheśvara, being pleased, offered him a choice of boon:

6.3.s: varaṃ dāsyāmi deveśa varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam .. 118.35 ..
6.3.d: वरं दास्यामि देवेश वरं वृणु यथेप्सितम् .. 118.35 ..
6.3.m: "I will grant a boon, O lord of gods; choose a boon as you desire."

6.3.s:
indra uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama .
atra saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi sadā saṃnihito bhava .. 118.36 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्र उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम .
अत्र संस्थापयिष्यामि सदा संनिहितो भव .. 118.36 ..
6.3.m: Indra said: / "If you are pleased, O lord of gods, if a boon is to be given to me, / I will establish [a liṅga] here; be present here forever."

6.3.s:
evamastviti coktvā taṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .
jagmurākāśamāviśya stūyamānā maharṣibhiḥ .. 118.37 ..
6.3.d:
एवमस्त्विति चोक्त्वा तं ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .
जग्मुराकाशमाविश्य स्तूयमाना महर्षिभिः .. 118.37 ..
6.3.m: Saying to him, "So be it," Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara / went, entering the sky, praised by the great seers.

6.3.s:
gateṣu devadeveṣu devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ .
sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ jagāma tridaśālayam .. 118.38 ..
6.3.d:
गतेषु देवदेवेषु देवराजः शतक्रतुः .
स्थापयित्वा महादेवं जगाम त्रिदशालयम् .. 118.38 ..
6.3.m: When the gods of gods had departed, the king of gods, Śatakratu, / established Mahādeva and went to the abode of the thirty [gods].

6.3.s:
indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
mahāpātakayukto'pi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 118.39 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
महापातकयुक्तोऽपि मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 118.39 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes at Indratīrtha and offers libations to ancestors and gods, / even if joined with major sins, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
indratīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
so'śvamedhasya yajñasya puṣkalaṃ phalamaśnute .. 118.40 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
सोऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य पुष्कलं फलमश्नुते .. 118.40 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes at Indratīrtha and worships the supreme lord / obtains the abundant fruit of a horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam .
śrutamātreṇa yenaiva mucyante pātakairnarāḥ .. 118.41 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe indratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 119
6.3.d:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .
श्रुतमात्रेण येनैव मुच्यन्ते पातकैर्नराः .. 118.41 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे इन्द्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टादशोत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 119
6.3.m:
All this excellent māhātmya of the sacred ford has been told to you, / by merely hearing which men are freed from sins.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighteenth chapter, titled "Description of the Greatness of Indratīrtha," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 119

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra kahloḍītīrthamuttamam .
revāyāścottare kūle sarvapāpavināśanam .. 119.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कह्लोडीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
रेवायाश्चोत्तरे कूले सर्वपापविनाशनम् .. 119.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Kahloḍītīrtha / on the northern bank of the Revā, destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
hitārthaṃ sarvabhūtānāmṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaṃ purā .
tapasā tu samuddhṛtya narmadāyāṃ mahāmbhasi .. 119.2 ..
6.3.d:
हितार्थं सर्वभूतानामृषिभिः स्थापितं पुरा .
तपसा तु समुद्धृत्य नर्मदायां महाम्भसि .. 119.2 ..
6.3.m: It was established formerly by the seers for the welfare of all beings, / brought forth through austerity in the great waters of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
snātvā tu kapilātīrthe kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .
śrutvā cākhyānakaṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇāñchṛṇu yatphalam .. 119.3 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा तु कपिलातीर्थे कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति .
श्रुत्वा चाख्यानकं दिव्यं ब्राह्मणाञ्छृणु यत्फलम् .. 119.3 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed at Kapilātīrtha, donates a brown cow, / and having heard the divine narrative, [gives to] brahmins—hear the fruit thereof:

6.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ kapilādānamuttamam .
brāhmaṇānveṣitaṃ pūrvamṛṣidevasamāgame .. 119.4 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव दानानां कपिलादानमुत्तमम् .
ब्राह्मणान्वेषितं पूर्वमृषिदेवसमागमे .. 119.4 ..
6.3.m: Among all gifts, the gift of a brown cow is supreme; / it was investigated by brahmins long ago at the assembly of seers and gods.

6.3.s:
sadyaḥ prasūtāṃ kapilāṃ śobhanāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .
sopavāso jitakrodhastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 119.5 ..
6.3.d:
सद्यः प्रसूतां कपिलां शोभनां यः प्रयच्छति .
सोपवासो जितक्रोधस्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 119.5 ..
6.3.m: Whoever donates a newly calved, beautiful brown cow, / fasting and having conquered anger—hear the fruit of his merit:

6.3.s:
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā .
dattā caiva mahābāho pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 119.6 ..
6.3.d:
ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना .
दत्ता चैव महाबाहो पृथिवी नात्र संशयः .. 119.6 ..
6.3.m: By him the earth, with its oceans and caves, / with its mountains, forests, and woods, has been given, O mighty-armed one; there is no doubt of this.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam .
naśyate kapilāṃ dattvā saptajanmārjitaṃ nṛpa .. 119.7 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मणा यत्पुरा कृतम् .
नश्यते कपिलां दत्त्वा सप्तजन्मार्जितं नृप .. 119.7 ..
6.3.m: Sins of speech, mind, and deed that were committed in the past, / accumulated over seven births, are destroyed by giving a brown cow, O king.

6.3.s:
bhūmidānaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvakanakādikam .
kapilādānasyaikasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 119.8 ..
6.3.d:
भूमिदानं धनं धान्यं हस्त्यश्वकनकादिकम् .
कपिलादानस्यैकस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् .. 119.8 ..
6.3.m: The gift of land, wealth, grain, elephants, horses, gold, and the like / are not worth a sixteenth part of a single gift of a brown cow.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .
mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti gīyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 119.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा कपिलां यः प्रयच्छति .
मृतो विष्णुपुरं याति गीयमानोऽप्सरोगणैः .. 119.9 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes in that sacred ford and donates a brown cow / goes upon death to the city of Viṣṇu, sung of by hosts of apsarases.

6.3.s:
yāvanti tasyā romāṇi savatsāyāstu bhārata .
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi sa svarge krīḍate ciram .. 119.10 ..
6.3.d:
यावन्ति तस्या रोमाणि सवत्सायास्तु भारत .
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स स्वर्गे क्रीडते चिरम् .. 119.10 ..
6.3.m: As many hairs as there are on her and her calf, O Bhārata, / for that many thousands of years he sports long in heaven.

6.3.s:
tato'vakīrṇakālena tviha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ .
dhanadhānyasamopeto jāyate vipule kule .. 119.11 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽवकीर्णकालेन त्विह मानुष्यतां गतः .
धनधान्यसमोपेतो जायते विपुले कुले .. 119.11 ..
6.3.m: Then, when that time is completed, having attained human status here, / endowed with wealth and grain, he is born into an illustrious lineage,

6.3.s:
vedavidyā vratasnātaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ .
vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 119.12 ..
6.3.d:
वेदविद्या व्रतस्नातः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः .
व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 119.12 ..
6.3.m: bathed in Vedic knowledge and vows, expert in all scriptures, / completely freed from illness and grief, and he lives for a hundred autumns.

6.3.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kalhoḍītīrthamuttamam .
yatkṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 119.13 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kahloḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 120
6.3.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं कल्होडीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
यत्कृत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 119.13 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कह्लोडीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 120
6.3.m:
All this has been told to you regarding the supreme Kalhoḍī tīrtha, / performing which one is freed from all sins—of this there is no doubt.
Thus ends the one hundred and nineteenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Kahloḍī Tīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 120

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kambukeśvaramuttamam .
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo dānavo baladarpitaḥ .. 120.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि कम्बुकेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो दानवो बलदर्पितः .. 120.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hereafter I shall declare the supreme Kambukeśvara. / The Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu was a Dānava arrogant in strength,

6.3.s:
avadhyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ .
tasya putro mahātejāḥ prahlādo nāma nāmataḥ .. 120.2 ..
6.3.d:
अवध्यः सर्वलोकानां त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः .
तस्य पुत्रो महातेजाः प्रह्लादो नाम नामतः .. 120.2 ..
6.3.m: invulnerable to all beings, renowned in the three worlds. / His son of great fiery splendor was celebrated by the name Prahlāda;

6.3.s:
viṣṇuprasādādbhaktyā ca tasya rājye pratiṣṭhitaḥ .
virocanastasya sutastasyāpi balireva ca .. 120.3 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुप्रसादाद्भक्त्या च तस्य राज्ये प्रतिष्ठितः .
विरोचनस्तस्य सुतस्तस्यापि बलिरेव च .. 120.3 ..
6.3.m: by Viṣṇu's grace and through devotion, he was established in his kingdom. / Virocana was his son, and Bali was verily his son as well.

6.3.s:
baliputro'bhavadbāṇastasmādapi ca śambaraḥ .
śambarasyānvaye jātaḥ kamburnāma mahāsuraḥ .. 120.4 ..
6.3.d:
बलिपुत्रोऽभवद्बाणस्तस्मादपि च शम्बरः .
शम्बरस्यान्वये जातः कम्बुर्नाम महासुरः .. 120.4 ..
6.3.m: Bali's son was Bāṇa, and from him also Śambara; / born in Śambara's lineage was a great Asura named Kambu.

6.3.s:
jñātvā viṣṇumayaṃ ghoraṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam .
dānavānāṃ vināśāya nānyo hetuḥ kadācana .. 120.5 ..
6.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा विष्णुमयं घोरं महद्भयमुपस्थितम् .
दानवानां विनाशाय नान्यो हेतुः कदाचन .. 120.5 ..
6.3.m: Knowing that terrible, great danger filled with Viṣṇu had arisen— / for there was never any other cause for the destruction of the Dānavas—

6.3.s:
sa tyaktvā putradārāṃśca suhṛdbandhuparigrahān .
cacāra maunamāsthāya tapaḥ kamburmahāmatiḥ .. 120.6 ..
6.3.d:
स त्यक्त्वा पुत्रदारांश्च सुहृद्बन्धुपरिग्रहान् .
चचार मौनमास्थाय तपः कम्बुर्महामतिः .. 120.6 ..
6.3.m: he abandoned sons, wives, friends, relatives, and possessions; / observing silence, the magnanimous Kambu performed austerity.

6.3.s:
akṣasūtrakaro bhūtvā daṇḍī muṇḍī ca mekhalī .
śākayāvakabhakṣaśca valkalājinasaṃvṛtaḥ .. 120.7 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षसूत्रकरो भूत्वा दण्डी मुण्डी च मेखली .
शाकयावकभक्षश्च वल्कलाजिनसंवृतः .. 120.7 ..
6.3.m: Holding a rosary in his hand, bearing a staff, having a shaved head, wearing a girdle, / subsisting on greens and barley gruel, clothed in bark and black-antelope skin,

6.3.s:
snātvā nityaṃ dhṛtiparo narmadājalamāśritaḥ .
pūjayaṃstu mahādevamarbudaṃ varṣasaṃkhyayā .. 120.8 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा नित्यं धृतिपरो नर्मदाजलमाश्रितः .
पूजयंस्तु महादेवमर्बुदं वर्षसंख्यया .. 120.8 ..
6.3.m: bathing daily, devoted to steadfastness, having taken refuge in the waters of the Narmadā, / he worshipped Mahādeva for a count of one hundred million years.

6.3.s:
tatastutoṣa bhagavāndevadevo maheśvaraḥ .
uvāca dānavaṃ kāle meghagambhīrayā girā .. 120.9 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तुतोष भगवान्देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
उवाच दानवं काले मेघगम्भीरया गिरा .. 120.9 ..
6.3.m: Then the blessed lord of gods, Maheśvara, was pleased; / in due time he spoke to the Dānava in a voice deep as a thundercloud:

6.3.s:
bhobhoḥ kambo mahābhāga tuṣṭo'haṃ tava suvrata .
iṣṭaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ maunaṃ sarvārthasādhanam .. 120.10 ..
6.3.d:
भोभोः कम्बो महाभाग तुष्टोऽहं तव सुव्रत .
इष्टं व्रतानां परमं मौनं सर्वार्थसाधनम् .. 120.10 ..
6.3.m: 'O Kambu, O fortunate one of good vows, I am pleased with you! / Silence, which accomplishes all goals, is cherished as the highest of vows.

6.3.s:
caritaṃ ca tvayā loke devadānavaduścaram .
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi rocate .. 120.11 ..
6.3.d:
चरितं च त्वया लोके देवदानवदुश्चरम् .
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि रोचते .. 120.11 ..
6.3.m: And it was practiced by you—a feat difficult for gods and Dānavas to perform in the world. / Choose a boon, good fortune to you, whatever pleases your mind!'

6.3.s:
kamburuvāca -
yadi prasanno deveśa yadi deyo varo mama .
akṣayyaścāvyayaścaiva svecchayā vicarāmyaham .. 120.12 ..
6.3.d:
कम्बुरुवाच -
यदि प्रसन्नो देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम .
अक्षय्यश्चाव्ययश्चैव स्वेच्छया विचराम्यहम् .. 120.12 ..
6.3.m: Kambu said: / 'If you are pleased, O Lord of gods, if a boon is to be granted to me, / may I wander at my own will, imperishable and undecaying,

6.3.s:
daityadānavasaṅghānāṃ saṃyugeṣvapalāyitā .
bhayaṃ cānyanna vidyeta muktvā devaṃ gadādharam .. 120.13 ..
6.3.d:
दैत्यदानवसङ्घानां संयुगेष्वपलायिता .
भयं चान्यन्न विद्येत मुक्त्वा देवं गदाधरम् .. 120.13 ..
6.3.m: not fleeing in battles among the hosts of Daityas and Dānavas; / and let there be no other fear, except for the mace-bearing God.

6.3.s:
tasyāhaṃ saṃyuge sādhyo yenopāyena śaṅkara .
bhavāmi na sadā kālaṃ taṃ vadasva varaṃ mama .. 120.14 ..
6.3.d:
तस्याहं संयुगे साध्यो येनोपायेन शङ्कर .
भवामि न सदा कालं तं वदस्व वरं मम .. 120.14 ..
6.3.m: O Śaṅkara, tell me that boon by which means I / may never be conquered by him in battle at any time.'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
mama saṃnihito yatra tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi dānava .
tatra viṣṇubhayaṃ nāsti vasātra vigatajvaraḥ .. 120.15 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
मम संनिहितो यत्र त्वं भविष्यसि दानव .
तत्र विष्णुभयं नास्ति वसात्र विगतज्वरः .. 120.15 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / 'Where you, O Dānava, will be near to me, / there is no fear of Viṣṇu; dwell here free from feverish anxiety.

6.3.s:
tasya devādhidevasya vedagarbhasya saṃyuge .
śaṅkhacakradharasyeśā nāhaṃ sarve surāsurāḥ .. 120.16 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य देवाधिदेवस्य वेदगर्भस्य संयुगे .
शङ्खचक्रधरस्येशा नाहं सर्वे सुरासुराः .. 120.16 ..
6.3.m: Against that supreme god of gods, who has the Vedas in his womb, / who holds the conch and discus, neither I nor all the gods and Asuras have mastery in battle.

6.3.s:
kiṃ punaryo dviṣatyenaṃ lokālokaprabhuṃ harim .
sa sukhī vartate kālaṃ na nimeṣaṃ mataṃ mama .. 120.17 ..
6.3.d:
किं पुनर्यो द्विषत्येनं लोकालोकप्रभुं हरिम् .
स सुखी वर्तते कालं न निमेषं मतं मम .. 120.17 ..
6.3.m: How much less can one who hates Hari, the Lord of all the worlds, / live in happiness for even a wink of an eye, in my opinion?

6.3.s:
tasmāttvaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ .
vasiṣyasi ciraṃ kālamityuktvādarśanaṃ gataḥ .. 120.18 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वं परया भक्त्या सर्वभूतहिते रतः .
वसिष्यसि चिरं कालमित्युक्त्वादर्शनं गतः .. 120.18 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, devoted to the welfare of all beings with supreme devotion, / you shall dwell for a long time.' Having spoken thus, he vanished.

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ deve tatra tīrthe mahāmatiḥ .
sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śivaṃ śāntamanāmayam .. 120.19 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं देवे तत्र तीर्थे महामतिः .
स्थापयामास देवेशं शिवं शान्तमनामयम् .. 120.19 ..
6.3.m: When the god had vanished, the magnanimous one, at that sacred ford, / installed the Lord of gods, Śiva, the peaceful and disease-free.

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā divaṃ gataḥ .
tadāprabhṛti tatpārtha kambutīrthamiti śrutam .
vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam .. 120.20 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महादेवं स्थापयित्वा दिवं गतः .
तदाप्रभृति तत्पार्थ कम्बुतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् .
विख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु महापातकनाशनम् .. 120.20 ..
6.3.m: Having installed Mahādeva at that sacred ford, he went to heaven. / From that time on, O son of Pṛthā, it was celebrated as Kambu tīrtha, / renowned in all the worlds, destroying heinous sins.

6.3.s:
kambutīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhinābhyarcya bhāskaram .
ṛgyajuḥsāmamantraiśca stūyamāno nṛpottama .. 120.21 ..
6.3.d:
कम्बुतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा विधिनाभ्यर्च्य भास्करम् .
ऋग्यजुःसाममन्त्रैश्च स्तूयमानो नृपोत्तम .. 120.21 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes in Kambu tīrtha and duly worships the Sun, / being praised with the mantras of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, O best of kings—

6.3.s:
tasya puṇyaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ .
tatsarvaṃ tu śṛṇuṣvādya mamaiva gadato nṛpa .. 120.22 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य पुण्यं समुद्दिष्टं ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः .
तत्सर्वं तु शृणुष्वाद्य ममैव गदतो नृप .. 120.22 ..
6.3.m: the merit of this has been declared by brahmins who have mastered the Vedas. / Hear all of that today as I speak it, O king!

6.3.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmagīteṣu sāṅgopāṅgeṣu yatphalam .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gāyatrīmātramantravit .. 120.23 ..
6.3.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामगीतेषु साङ्गोपाङ्गेषु यत्फलम् .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति गायत्रीमात्रमन्त्रवित् .. 120.23 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is attained through the sung Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas with their limbs and sub-limbs, / that fruit does a knower of the mere Gāyatrī mantra fully obtain [there].

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 120.24 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
पूजयेद्देवमीशानं सोऽग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् .. 120.24 ..
6.3.m: One who bathes at that sacred ford and offers libations to the ancestors and gods, / and worships the god Īśāna, obtains the fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

6.3.s:
akāmo vā sakāmo vā tatra tīrthe kalevaram .
yastyajennātra sandeho rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 120.25 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kambukeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 121
6.3.d:
अकामो वा सकामो वा तत्र तीर्थे कलेवरम् .
यस्त्यजेन्नात्र सन्देहो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 120.25 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कम्बुकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 121
6.3.m:
Whether without desire or with desire, whoever casts off their bodily frame / at that sacred ford—there is no doubt—goes to the realm of Rudra.
Thus ends the one hundred and twentieth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Kambukeśvara Tīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 121

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla candrahāsamataḥ param .
yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somarājaḥ surottamaḥ .. 121.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल चन्द्रहासमतः परम् .
यत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तः सोमराजः सुरोत्तमः .. 121.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Next, O ruler of the earth, one should go to Candrahāsa, / where King Soma, the foremost of gods, attained supreme perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somanātho jagatpatiḥ .
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha .. 121.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तः सोमनाथो जगत्पतिः .
तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथयस्व ममानघ .. 121.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How did Somanātha, the lord of the world, attain supreme perfection? / I wish to hear all of that; please tell me, O sinless one!

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata .
asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi .. 121.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पुरा शप्तो मुनीन्द्रेण दक्षेण किल भारत .
असेवनाद्धि दाराणां क्षयरोगी भविष्यसि .. 121.3 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Formerly, O descendant of Bharata, he was indeed cursed by Dakṣa, the chief of sages: / 'Because of not attending to your wives, you will become afflicted with consumption!

6.3.s:
udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam .
yā niṣṭhā jāyate nṛṇāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 121.4 ..
6.3.d:
उद्वाहितानां पत्नीनां ये न कुर्वन्ति सेवनम् .
या निष्ठा जायते नृणां तां शृणुष्व नराधिप .. 121.4 ..
6.3.m: Those who do not attend to their legally wedded wives— / hear the end that befalls those men, O ruler of men!

6.3.s:
ṛtāvṛtau hi nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ .
sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca ityevaṃ śrutibhāṣitam .. 121.5 ..
6.3.d:
ऋतावृतौ हि नारीणां सेवनाज्जायते सुतः .
सुतात्स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च इत्येवं श्रुतिभाषितम् .. 121.5 ..
6.3.m: For by attending upon women in every fertile period, a son is born; / from a son come heaven and liberation; thus it is spoken in Vedic revelation.

6.3.s:
tatkālocitadharmeṇa veṣṭito raurave patet .
tasyāstadrudhiraṃ pāpaḥ pibate kālamīpsitam .. 121.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्कालोचितधर्मेण वेष्टितो रौरवे पतेत् .
तस्यास्तद्रुधिरं पापः पिबते कालमीप्सितम् .. 121.6 ..
6.3.m: Bound by the duty appropriate to that time, [the transgressor] falls into Raurava; / the sinful one drinks her menstrual blood for an intended span of time.

6.3.s:
tato'vatīrṇaḥ kālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati .
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā .. 121.7 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽवतीर्णः कालेन यां यां योनिं प्रयास्यति .
तस्यां तस्यां स दुष्टात्मा दुर्भगो जायते सदा .. 121.7 ..
6.3.m: Then, having descended in the course of time, into whatever womb he enters, / in that very womb that wicked-minded one is always born unfortunate.

6.3.s:
nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo'bhyadhikāḥ parivartate .
viśeṣeṇa ṛtau kāle pīḍyate kāmasāyakaiḥ .. 121.8 ..
6.3.d:
नारीणां तु सदा कामोऽभ्यधिकाः परिवर्तते .
विशेषेण ऋतौ काले पीड्यते कामसायकैः .. 121.8 ..
6.3.m: For women's desire always persists exceedingly; / especially in their fertile period, they are tormented by the arrows of desire.

6.3.s:
paribhūtā hitā bhartrā dhyāyante'nyaṃ patiṃ striyaḥ .
tataḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam .. 121.9 ..
6.3.d:
परिभूता हिता भर्त्रा ध्यायन्तेऽन्यं पतिं स्त्रियः .
ततः पुत्रः समुत्पन्नो ह्यटते कुलमुत्तमम् .. 121.9 ..
6.3.m: Despised by a suitable husband, women think upon another mate; / then a son born from that wanders away from the noble family.

6.3.s:
svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvajāste pitāmahāḥ .
patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭastena cocyate .. 121.10 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्गस्थास्तेन पितरः पूर्वजास्ते पितामहाः .
पतन्ति जातमात्रेण कुलटस्तेन चोच्यते .. 121.10 ..
6.3.m: The ancestors dwelling in heaven, his forefathers and grandfathers, / fall the moment he is born; because of that he is called a corrupter of the lineage.

6.3.s:
tena karmavipākena kṣayarogyabhavacchaśī .
tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ .. 121.11 ..
6.3.d:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन क्षयरोग्यभवच्छशी .
त्यक्त्वा लोकं सुरेन्द्राणां मर्त्यलोकमुपागतः .. 121.11 ..
6.3.m: Through that ripening of actions, the Moon became afflicted with consumption; / abandoning the world of the chiefs of the gods, he arrived in the mortal world.

6.3.s:
tatastīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca .
bhramanvai narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśanīm .. 121.12 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तीर्थान्यनेकानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च .
भ्रमन्वै नर्मदां प्राप्तः सर्वपापप्रणाशनीम् .. 121.12 ..
6.3.m: Then, wandering through many sacred fords and holy sanctuaries, / he reached the Narmadā, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
upavāsaṃ ca dānāni vratāni niyamāṃstathā .
cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ .. 121.13 ..
6.3.d:
उपवासं च दानानि व्रतानि नियमांस्तथा .
चचार द्वादशाब्दानि ततो मुक्तः स किल्बिषैः .. 121.13 ..
6.3.m: Fasting, gifts, vows, and observances / he performed for twelve years, and was thereupon freed from his sins.

6.3.s:
snāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .
jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ sa ca lokamanuttamam .. 121.14 ..
6.3.d:
स्नापयित्वा महादेवं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .
जगाम प्रभया पूर्णः स च लोकमनुत्तमम् .. 121.14 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed Mahādeva, the destroyer of all sins, / filled with brilliance, he went to the unsurpassed world.

6.3.s:
yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā .
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rudraloke sa pūjyate .. 121.15 ..
6.3.d:
येनैव स्थापितो देवः पूज्यते वर्षसंख्यया .
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि रुद्रलोके स पूज्यते .. 121.15 ..
6.3.m: For as many years as the deity installed by one is worshipped, / for that many thousands of years he is honoured in the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
tena devānvidhānoktānsthāpayanti narā bhuvi .
akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātkālaṃ bhuñjanti mānavāḥ .. 121.16 ..
6.3.d:
तेन देवान्विधानोक्तान्स्थापयन्ति नरा भुवि .
अक्षयं चाव्ययं यस्मात्कालं भुञ्जन्ति मानवाः .. 121.16 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, men install gods on earth according to the prescribed rites, / because [thereby] mortals enjoy imperishable and eternal time.

6.3.s:
somatīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram .
sa bhrājate naro loke somavatpriyadarśanaḥ .. 121.17 ..
6.3.d:
सोमतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्देवमीश्वरम् .
स भ्राजते नरो लोके सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनः .. 121.17 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at Somatīrtha, a man should worship the god Īśvara; / that man shines in the world, pleasant to look upon like Soma.

6.3.s:
candrahāse tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ .
snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 121.18 ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रहासे तु यो गत्वा ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः .
स्नानं समाचरेद्भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 121.18 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having gone to Candrahāsa during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / performs a ritual ablution with devotion, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāse śubhāśubham .
kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam .. 121.19 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नानं च दानं च चन्द्रहासे शुभाशुभम् .
कृतं नृपवरश्रेष्ठ सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम् .. 121.19 ..
6.3.m: There, at Candrahāsa, bathing and giving, auspicious and inauspicious [deeds] / done, O best of excellent kings, all become imperishable.

6.3.s:
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam .
candrahāse tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ .. 121.20 ..
6.3.d:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् .
चन्द्रहासे तु ये स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति ग्रहणं नराः .. 121.20 ..
6.3.m: They are fortunate, they are noble-minded, their birth has lived well— / those men who, having bathed at Candrahāsa, observe an eclipse.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam .
snānamātreṇa rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati .. 121.21 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुराकृतम् .
स्नानमात्रेण राजेन्द्र तत्र तीर्थे प्रणश्यति .. 121.21 ..
6.3.m: Sin committed in speech, in mind, or born of action that was previously done / is destroyed merely by bathing at that sacred ford, O king of kings.

6.3.s:
bahavastaṃ na jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ .
dehasthamiva sarveṣāṃ paramānandarūpiṇam .. 121.22 ..
6.3.d:
बहवस्तं न जानन्ति महामोहसमन्विताः .
देहस्थमिव सर्वेषां परमानन्दरूपिणम् .. 121.22 ..
6.3.m: Possessed of great delusion, many do not know it, / just like the form of supreme bliss dwelling in the body of all.

6.3.s:
paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam .
tatsamagramavāpnoti candrahāse na saṃśayaḥ .. 121.23 ..
6.3.d:
पश्चिमे सागरे गत्वा सोमतीर्थे तु यत्फलम् .
तत्समग्रमवाप्नोति चन्द्रहासे न संशयः .. 121.23 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit [is obtained] by going to Somatīrtha at the western ocean, / he obtains all of that at Candrahāsa without doubt.

6.3.s:
saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā .
candrahāse naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 121.24 ..
6.3.d:
संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते अयने विषुवे तथा .
चन्द्रहासे नरः स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 121.24 ..
6.3.m: At a solar transit, at a Vyatīpāta, during a solstice, and likewise at an equinox, / having bathed at Candrahāsa, a man is fully freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
te mūḍhāste durācārāsteṣāṃ janma nirarthakam .
candrahāsaṃ na jānanti ye revāyāṃ vyavasthitam .. 121.25 ..
6.3.d:
ते मूढास्ते दुराचारास्तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् .
चन्द्रहासं न जानन्ति ये रेवायां व्यवस्थितम् .. 121.25 ..
6.3.m: They are foolish, they are evil-doers, their birth is futile— / they who do not know Candrahāsa situated on the Revā.

6.3.s:
candrahāse tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsaṃ kurute dvijaḥ .
anivartikā gatistasya somalokānna saṃśayaḥ .. 121.26 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रहासे तु यः कश्चित्संन्यासं कुरुते द्विजः .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य सोमलोकान्न संशयः .. 121.26 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सोमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whatever twice-born takes renunciation at Candrahāsa, / from the world of Soma his path is one of no return, without doubt.
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-first chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Somatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 122
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla kohanasveti viśrutam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam .. 122.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 122
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल कोहनस्वेति विश्रुतम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं तीर्थं मृत्युविनाशनम् .. 122.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 122
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king, to the well-known Kohanasva, / the sacred ford that removes all sins, is holy, and destroys death.

6.3.s:
purā tatra dvijaḥ kaścidvedavedāṅgapāragaḥ .
patnīputrasuhṛdvargaiḥ svakarmanirato'vasat .. 122.2 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा तत्र द्विजः कश्चिद्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः .
पत्नीपुत्रसुहृद्वर्गैः स्वकर्मनिरतोऽवसत् .. 122.2 ..
6.3.m: Long ago, a certain twice-born who had crossed the Vedas and Vedāṅgas / lived there, intent on his own duties, with his wife, sons, and circle of friends.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
brāhmaṇasya tu yatkarma utpattiḥ kṣatriyasya tu .
vaiśyasyāpi ca śūdrasya tatsarvaṃ kathayasva me .. 122.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
ब्राह्मणस्य तु यत्कर्म उत्पत्तिः क्षत्रियस्य तु .
वैश्यस्यापि च शूद्रस्य तत्सर्वं कथयस्व मे .. 122.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The duty and the origin of the brahmin, of the kṣatriya, / of the vaiśya, and also of the śūdra—tell me all that.

6.3.s:
dharmasyārhasya kāmasya mokṣasya ca paraṃ vidhim .
nikhilaṃ jñātumicchāmi nānyo vettā matirmama .. 122.4 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मस्यार्हस्य कामस्य मोक्षस्य च परं विधिम् .
निखिलं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि नान्यो वेत्ता मतिर्मम .. 122.4 ..
6.3.m: The supreme rule of righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation— / all of it I wish to know; in my opinion, there is no other knower.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
utpattikāraṇaṃ brahmā devadevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ .
prathamaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ carācarajagadguruḥ .. 122.5 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
उत्पत्तिकारणं ब्रह्मा देवदेवः प्रकीर्तितः .
प्रथमं सर्वभूतानां चराचरजगद्गुरुः .. 122.5 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Brahmā, the god of gods, is proclaimed as the cause of origin, / the first among all beings, the teacher of the world of the moving and unmoving.

6.3.s:
dvijātayo mukhājjātāḥ kṣatriyā bāhuyantrataḥ .
ūrupradeśādvaiśyāstu śūdrāḥ pādeṣvathābhavan .. 122.6 ..
6.3.d:
द्विजातयो मुखाज्जाताः क्षत्रिया बाहुयन्त्रतः .
ऊरुप्रदेशाद्वैश्यास्तु शूद्राः पादेष्वथाभवन् .. 122.6 ..
6.3.m: The twice-born were born from his mouth, the kṣatriyas from the frame of his arms, / the vaiśyas from the region of his thighs, and the śūdras arose from his feet.

6.3.s:
tatastvanye pṛthagvarṇāḥ pṛthagdharmān samācaran .
paryāyeṇa samutpannā hyanulomavilomataḥ .. 122.7 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्त्वन्ये पृथग्वर्णाः पृथग्धर्मान् समाचरन् .
पर्यायेण समुत्पन्ना ह्यनुलोमविलोमतः .. 122.7 ..
6.3.m: Then other distinct castes, practicing distinct duties, / arose in turn through natural and inverted order.

6.3.s:
teṣāṃ dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi śrutismṛtyarthacoditam .
yena samyakkṛtenaiva sarve yānti parāṃ gatim .. 122.8 ..
6.3.d:
तेषां धर्मं प्रवक्ष्यामि श्रुतिस्मृत्यर्थचोदितम् .
येन सम्यक्कृतेनैव सर्वे यान्ति परां गतिम् .. 122.8 ..
6.3.m: I shall proclaim their duty, as enjoined by the purpose of the Vedas and Smṛtis, / through the proper execution of which all go to the supreme state.

6.3.s:
gatirdhyānaṃ vinā bhaktairbrāhmaṇaiḥ prāpyate nṛpa .
adhyāpayanyato vedānvedaṃ vāpi yathāvidhi .. 122.9 ..
6.3.d:
गतिर्ध्यानं विना भक्तैर्ब्राह्मणैः प्राप्यते नृप .
अध्यापयन्यतो वेदान्वेदं वापि यथाविधि .. 122.9 ..
6.3.m: Even without meditation, that destination is attained by devoted brahmins, O king, / from teaching the Vedas or even one Veda according to the rule.

6.3.s:
kulajāṃ rūpasampannāṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitām .
udvāhayettataḥ patnīṃ guruṇānumate tadā .. 122.10 ..
6.3.d:
कुलजां रूपसम्पन्नां सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम् .
उद्वाहयेत्ततः पत्नीं गुरुणानुमते तदा .. 122.10 ..
6.3.m: He should then marry a wife born of good family, endowed with beauty, / marked with all auspicious marks, when permitted by his teacher.

6.3.s:
tataḥ smārtaṃ vivāhāgniṃ śrautaṃ vā pūjayetkramāt .
pratigrahadhano bhūtvā dambhalobhavivarjitaḥ .. 122.11 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स्मार्तं विवाहाग्निं श्रौतं वा पूजयेत्क्रमात् .
प्रतिग्रहधनो भूत्वा दम्भलोभविवर्जितः .. 122.11 ..
6.3.m: Then he should worship in sequence the domestic marriage-fire or the Vedic fire, / having the acceptance of gifts as his wealth, free from deceit and greed.

6.3.s:
pañcayajñavidhānāni kārayedvai yathāvidhi .
vanaṃ gacchettataḥ paścāddvitīyāśramasevanāt .. 122.12 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चयज्ञविधानानि कारयेद्वै यथाविधि .
वनं गच्छेत्ततः पश्चाद्द्वितीयाश्रमसेवनात् .. 122.12 ..
6.3.m: He should carry out the rites of the five sacrifices according to the rule; / afterwards, having served the second stage of life, he should go to the forest.

6.3.s:
putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya sarvasaṅgavivarjitaḥ .
iṣṭāṃllokānavāpnoti na ceha jāyate punaḥ .. 122.13 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रेषु भार्यां निक्षिप्य सर्वसङ्गविवर्जितः .
इष्टांल्लोकानवाप्नोति न चेह जायते पुनः .. 122.13 ..
6.3.m: Leaving his wife in the care of his sons, freed from all attachment, / he attains the desired worlds and is not born here again.

6.3.s:
kṣatriyastu sthito rājye pālayitvā vasuṃdharām .
śaśvaddharmamanāścaiva prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim .. 122.14 ..
6.3.d:
क्षत्रियस्तु स्थितो राज्ये पालयित्वा वसुंधराम् .
शश्वद्धर्ममनाश्चैव प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् .. 122.14 ..
6.3.m: The kṣatriya, standing in royal power and protecting the earth, / ever devoted in mind to duty, attains the supreme destination.

6.3.s:
vaiśyadharmo na sandehaḥ kṛṣigorakṣaṇe rataḥ .
satyaśaucasamopeto gacchate svargamuttamam .. 122.15 ..
6.3.d:
वैश्यधर्मो न सन्देहः कृषिगोरक्षणे रतः .
सत्यशौचसमोपेतो गच्छते स्वर्गमुत्तमम् .. 122.15 ..
6.3.m: The duty of a vaiśya, without doubt, is intent on agriculture and cattle-tending; / endowed with truthfulness and purity, he goes to the excellent heaven.

6.3.s:
na śūdrasya pṛthagdharmo vihitaḥ parameṣṭhinā .
na mantro na ca saṃskāro na vidyāparisevanam .. 122.16 ..
6.3.d:
न शूद्रस्य पृथग्धर्मो विहितः परमेष्ठिना .
न मन्त्रो न च संस्कारो न विद्यापरिसेवनम् .. 122.16 ..
6.3.m: No separate duty was ordained for the śūdra by the Supreme Lord: / no mantra, no rite of passage, no devotion to learning,

6.3.s:
na śabdavidyāsamayo devatābhyarcanāni ca .
yathā jātena satataṃ vartitavyamaharniśam .. 122.17 ..
6.3.d:
न शब्दविद्यासमयो देवताभ्यर्चनानि च .
यथा जातेन सततं वर्तितव्यमहर्निशम् .. 122.17 ..
6.3.m: no covenant with grammar, and no rituals of deity-worship; / just as he was born, he should live constantly day and night.

6.3.s:
sa dharmaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ svayambhuvā .
mantrasaṃskārasampannāstrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ .. 122.18 ..
6.3.d:
स धर्मः सर्ववर्णानां पुरा सृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा .
मन्त्रसंस्कारसम्पन्नास्त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः .. 122.18 ..
6.3.m: That duty of all the classes was created of old by the Self-born; / the twice-born are the three classes endowed with mantras and rites of passage.

6.3.s:
teṣāṃ matamanādṛtya yadi varteta kāmataḥ .
sa mṛto jāyate śvā vai gatirūrdhvā na vidyate .. 122.19 ..
6.3.d:
तेषां मतमनादृत्य यदि वर्तेत कामतः .
स मृतो जायते श्वा वै गतिरूर्ध्वा न विद्यते .. 122.19 ..
6.3.m: Disregarding their opinion, if one should act out of desire, / he, when dead, is born indeed as a dog; no higher destination exists [for him].

6.3.s:
na teṣāṃ preṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ teṣāṃ matamanusmaran .
yaśobhāgī svadharmasthaḥ svargabhāgī sa jāyate .. 122.20 ..
6.3.d:
न तेषां प्रेषणं नित्यं तेषां मतमनुस्मरन् .
यशोभागी स्वधर्मस्थः स्वर्गभागी स जायते .. 122.20 ..
6.3.m: Not constantly serving them, yet remembering their counsel, / he shares in renown; abiding in his own duty, he shares in heaven.

6.3.s:
evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo'vasadvipraḥ sa bhārata .
hanasveti hanasveti śṛṇoti vākyamīdṛśam .. 122.21 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गुणगणाकीर्णोऽवसद्विप्रः स भारत .
हनस्वेति हनस्वेति शृणोति वाक्यमीदृशम् .. 122.21 ..
6.3.m: Thus endowed with a multitude of virtues, that brahmin lived, O Bhārata; / [then] he hears such words: “Strike! Strike!”

6.3.s:
tato nirīkṣate cordhvamadhaścaiva diśo daśa .
vepamānaḥ sa bhītaśca praskhalaṃśca pade pade .. 122.22 ..
6.3.d:
ततो निरीक्षते चोर्ध्वमधश्चैव दिशो दश .
वेपमानः स भीतश्च प्रस्खलंश्च पदे पदे .. 122.22 ..
6.3.m: Then he looks upward and downward, and in the ten directions, / trembling and terrified, stumbling at every step.

6.3.s:
śṛṅkhalāyudhahastaiśca pāśaiścaiva sudāruṇaiḥ .
veṣṭitaṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ naraṃ paśyati manmukham .. 122.23 ..
6.3.d:
शृङ्खलायुधहस्तैश्च पाशैश्चैव सुदारुणैः .
वेष्टितं महिषारूढं नरं पश्यति मन्मुखम् .. 122.23 ..
6.3.m: He sees a man facing him, mounted on a buffalo, / surrounded by those with iron chains and weapons in their hands, and most terrible nooses,

6.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃjanacayaprakhyaṃ kṛṣṇāmbaravibhūṣitam .
raktākṣamāyatabhujaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam .. 122.24 ..
6.3.d:
कृष्णांजनचयप्रख्यं कृष्णाम्बरविभूषितम् .
रक्ताक्षमायतभुजं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् .. 122.24 ..
6.3.m: resembling a mass of black collyrium, adorned with black garments, / with red eyes, long arms, and marked with all characteristic signs.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu samāyāntaṃ nirīkṣyātmānamātmanā .
japañjāpyaṃ ca paramaṃ śatarudrīyasaṃstavam .. 122.25 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तं तु समायान्तं निरीक्ष्यात्मानमात्मना .
जपञ्जाप्यं च परमं शतरुद्रीयसंस्तवम् .. 122.25 ..
6.3.m: Seeing him approaching, observing his own self with his self, / he muttered the supreme recitation: the praise of the Śatarudrīya.

6.3.s:
tataḥ provāca bhagavānyamaḥ saṃyamano mahān .
śṛṇu vākyamato brahmanyamo'haṃ sarvajantuṣu .. 122.26 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रोवाच भगवान्यमः संयमनो महान् .
शृणु वाक्यमतो ब्रह्मन्यमोऽहं सर्वजन्तुषु .. 122.26 ..
6.3.m: Then spoke the lord Yama, the great restrainer: / 'Hear my words, O brahmin! I am Yama over all creatures. // 122.26

6.3.s:
saṃharasva mahābhāga rudrajāpyaṃ sudurbhidam .
yenāhaṃ kālapāśaistvāṃ saṃyamāmi gatavyathaḥ .. 122.27 ..
6.3.d:
संहरस्व महाभाग रुद्रजाप्यं सुदुर्भिदम् .
येनाहं कालपाशैस्त्वां संयमामि गतव्यथः .. 122.27 ..
6.3.m: Desist, O fortunate one, from the recitation of the Rudra hymn, which is hard to break through, / so that, freed from obstruction, I may restrain you with the nooses of death.' // 122.27

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā niṣṭhuraṃ vākyaṃ yamasya mukhanirgatam .
mahābhayasamopeto brāhmaṇaḥ prapalāyitaḥ .. 122.28 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा निष्ठुरं वाक्यं यमस्य मुखनिर्गतम् .
महाभयसमोपेतो ब्राह्मणः प्रपलायितः .. 122.28 ..
6.3.m: Hearing those harsh words issuing from Yama's mouth, / seized by great terror, the brahmin fled. // 122.28

6.3.s:
tasya mārge gatāḥ sarve yamena saha kiṃkarāḥ .
tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti taṃ vipramūcuste so'pyadhāvata .. 122.29 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य मार्गे गताः सर्वे यमेन सह किंकराः .
तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति तं विप्रमूचुस्ते सोऽप्यधावत .. 122.29 ..
6.3.m: All the attendants along with Yama went along his path. / They said to the brahmin, 'Halt! Halt!', but he ran on. // 122.29

6.3.s:
tvaramāṇaḥ pariśrānto hā hato'haṃ durātmabhiḥ .
rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva śaraṇāgatavatsala .. 122.30 ..
6.3.d:
त्वरमाणः परिश्रान्तो हा हतोऽहं दुरात्मभिः .
रक्ष रक्ष महादेव शरणागतवत्सल .. 122.30 ..
6.3.m: Hurrying and exhausted, [he cried]: 'Alas, I am slain by evil-minded ones! / Protect me, protect me, Mahādeva, affectionate to those who seek refuge!' // 122.30

6.3.s:
evamuktvāpatadbhūmau liṅgamāliṅgya bhārata .
gatasattvaḥ sa viprendraḥ samāśritya sureśvaram .. 122.31 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वापतद्भूमौ लिङ्गमालिङ्ग्य भारत .
गतसत्त्वः स विप्रेन्द्रः समाश्रित्य सुरेश्वरम् .. 122.31 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, embracing the liṅga, he fell to the ground, O Bhārata. / His life-breath spent, that best of brahmins sought refuge in the lord of gods. // 122.31

6.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
ko haniṣyati mābhaistvaṃ huṅkāramakarottadā .. 122.32 ..
6.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
को हनिष्यति माभैस्त्वं हुङ्कारमकरोत्तदा .. 122.32 ..
6.3.m: Seeing him fallen to the ground, the god of gods, Maheśvara, / [said], 'Who shall slay [you]? Do not fear!' and then uttered a roar of 'Huṃ!'. // 122.32

6.3.s:
tena te kiṃkarāḥ sarve yamena saha bhārata .
huṅkāreṇa gatāḥ sarve meghā vātahatā yathā .. 122.33 ..
6.3.d:
तेन ते किंकराः सर्वे यमेन सह भारत .
हुङ्कारेण गताः सर्वे मेघा वातहता यथा .. 122.33 ..
6.3.m: By that roar of 'Huṃ!', all those attendants along with Yama, O Bhārata, / all fled away like clouds scattered by the wind. // 122.33

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ kohanasveti viśrutam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam .. 122.34 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं कोहनस्वेति विश्रुतम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वतीर्थेष्वनुत्तमम् .. 122.34 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, that sacred ford became renowned as Kohanasva, / destroying all sins, holy, unexcelled among all sacred fords. // 122.34

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamāpnotyanuttamam .. 122.35 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् .. 122.35 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and worships the Supreme Lord / obtains the unexcelled fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. // 122.35

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra prāṇatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ .
na paśyati yamaṃ devamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 122.36 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र प्राणत्यागं करोति यः .
न पश्यति यमं देवमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 122.36 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons his life's breath at that sacred ford, O king of kings, / does not behold the god Yama; thus Śaṅkara declared. // 122.36

6.3.s:
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryājjale vā nṛpasattama .
agniloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpaśatatrayam .. 122.37 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्याज्जले वा नृपसत्तम .
अग्निलोके वसेत्तावद्यावत्कल्पशतत्रयम् .. 122.37 ..
6.3.m: Whoever enters the fire or dies in the water, O best among kings, / dwells in the world of Agni for as long as three hundred kalpas. // 122.37

6.3.s:
evaṃ varuṇaloke'pi vasitvā kālamīpsitam .
iha lokamanuprāpto mahādhanapatirbhavet .. 122.38 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kohanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 123
6.3.d:
एवं वरुणलोकेऽपि वसित्वा कालमीप्सितम् .
इह लोकमनुप्राप्तो महाधनपतिर्भवेत् .. 122.38 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोहनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वाविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 123
6.3.m:
Likewise, having dwelt in the world of Varuṇa for his desired time, / returning to this world, he becomes a lord of immense wealth. // 122.38
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-second chapter, titled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of the Kohanatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth book, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 123

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra karmadītīrthamuttamam .
yatra tiṣṭhati vighneśo gaṇanātho mahābalaḥ .. 123.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र कर्मदीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
यत्र तिष्ठति विघ्नेशो गणनाथो महाबलः .. 123.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Karmadītīrtha, / where dwells Vighneśa, the lord of the Gaṇas, endowed with great strength.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ vā hyupoṣitaḥ .
vighnaṃ na vidyate tasya saptajanmani bhārata .. 123.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा चतुर्थ्यां वा ह्युपोषितः .
विघ्नं न विद्यते तस्य सप्तजन्मनि भारत .. 123.2 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at that sacred ford, or having fasted on the fourth [tithi], / no obstacle arises for a man throughout seven births, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe hi yatkiṃciddīyate nṛpasattama .
tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 123.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karmadeśvaratīrthamāhatmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..
adhyāya 124
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे हि यत्किंचिद्दीयते नृपसत्तम .
तदक्षयफलं सर्वं जायते नात्र संशयः .. 123.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कर्मदेश्वरतीर्थमाहत्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..
अध्याय 124
6.3.m:
Whatever is given at that sacred ford, O best of kings, / all of that bears imperishable fruit; there is no doubt about this.
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-third chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Karmadeśvaratīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 124

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla narmadeśvaramuttamam .
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 124.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल नर्मदेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 124.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O ruler of the earth, to the excellent Narmadeśvara; / having bathed at that sacred ford, a man is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
agnipraveśaśca jale'thavā mṛtyuranāśake .
anivartikā gatistasya yathā me śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 124.2 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 125
6.3.d:
अग्निप्रवेशश्च जलेऽथवा मृत्युरनाशके .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य यथा मे शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 124.2 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 125
6.3.m:
Entering fire, or [death] in water, or death by fasting— / his path is one of no return, just as Śaṅkara told me.
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Narmadeśvaratīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 125

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla ravitīrthamanuttamam .
yatra devaḥ sahasrāṃśustapastaptvā divaṃ gataḥ .. 125.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल रवितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र देवः सहस्रांशुस्तपस्तप्त्वा दिवं गतः .. 125.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O ruler of the earth, to the unsurpassed Ravitīrtha, / where the thousand-rayed god, having performed austerity, went to heaven.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ devo jagaddhātā sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .
tapastapati deveśastāpaso bhāskaro raviḥ .. 125.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं देवो जगद्धाता सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः .
तपस्तपति देवेशस्तापसो भास्करो रविः .. 125.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How does the god, the creator of the world, bowed to by all deities, / the lord of gods, the ascetic, the light-maker, Ravi, perform austerity?

6.3.s:
ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvadevaiśca pūjitaḥ .
pratyakṣo dṛśyate loke sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ .. 125.3 ..
6.3.d:
आराध्यः सर्वभूतानां सर्वदेवैश्च पूजितः .
प्रत्यक्षो दृश्यते लोके सृष्टिसंहारकारकः .. 125.3 ..
6.3.m: He is to be propitiated by all beings, worshipped by all deities, / seen visibly in the world, the cause of creation and destruction.

6.3.s:
ādityatvaṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ kathaṃ bhāskara ucyate .
sarvametatsamāsena kathayasva mamānagha .. 125.4 ..
6.3.d:
आदित्यत्वं कथं प्राप्तः कथं भास्कर उच्यते .
सर्वमेतत्समासेन कथयस्व ममानघ .. 125.4 ..
6.3.m: How did he attain status as Āditya? How is he called Bhāskara? / Tell me all this in brief, O sinless one.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
mahāpraśno mahārāja yastvayā paripṛcchitaḥ .
tatsarvaṃ sampravakṣyāmi namaskṛtya svayambhuvam .. 125.5 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
महाप्रश्नो महाराज यस्त्वया परिपृच्छितः .
तत्सर्वं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि नमस्कृत्य स्वयम्भुवम् .. 125.5 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This is a great question, O great king, which has been asked by you; / having bowed to the self-born one, I shall tell all of that.

6.3.s:
āsīdidaṃ tamobhūtamaprajñātamalakṣaṇam .
apratarkyamavijñeyaṃ prasuptamiva sarvataḥ .. 125.6 ..
6.3.d:
आसीदिदं तमोभूतमप्रज्ञातमलक्षणम् .
अप्रतर्क्यमविज्ञेयं प्रसुप्तमिव सर्वतः .. 125.6 ..
6.3.m: This [universe] was enveloped in darkness, unperceived, devoid of distinguishing marks, / inconceivable, unknowable, as if completely asleep everywhere.

6.3.s:
tatastejaśca divyaṃ ca taptapiṇḍamanuttamam .
ākāśāttu yathaivolkā sṛṣṭihetoradhomukhī .. 125.7 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तेजश्च दिव्यं च तप्तपिण्डमनुत्तमम् .
आकाशात्तु यथैवोल्का सृष्टिहेतोरधोमुखी .. 125.7 ..
6.3.m: Then [emerged] divine brilliance, an unsurpassed heated mass, / falling headlong from the sky for the sake of creation, just like a meteor.

6.3.s:
tattejaso'ntaḥ puruṣaḥ saṃjātaḥ sarvabhūṣitaḥ .
sa śivo'pāṇipādaśca yena sarvamidaṃ tatam .. 125.8 ..
6.3.d:
तत्तेजसोऽन्तः पुरुषः संजातः सर्वभूषितः .
स शिवोऽपाणिपादश्च येन सर्वमिदं ततम् .. 125.8 ..
6.3.m: Within that brilliance arose the Puruṣa, adorned with all [ornaments]; / he is auspicious, without hands and feet, by whom all this is pervaded.

6.3.s:
tasyotpannasya bhūtasya tejo rūpasya bhārata .
paścātprajāpatirbhūyaḥ kālaḥ kālāntareṇa vai .. 125.9 ..
6.3.d:
तस्योत्पन्नस्य भूतस्य तेजो रूपस्य भारत .
पश्चात्प्रजापतिर्भूयः कालः कालान्तरेण वै .. 125.9 ..
6.3.m: From that being of fiery form who had arisen, O descendant of Bharata, / afterwards Prajāpati [came forth], and then Time through the course of time.

6.3.s:
agnirjātaḥ sa bhūtānāṃ manuṣyāsurarakṣasām .
sarvadevādhidevaśca ādityastena cocyate .. 125.10 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निर्जातः स भूतानां मनुष्यासुररक्षसाम् .
सर्वदेवाधिदेवश्च आदित्यस्तेन चोच्यते .. 125.10 ..
6.3.m: He became the fire of creatures, of humans, asuras, and rākṣasas; / he is the supreme deity of all gods, and therefore he is called Āditya.

6.3.s:
ādau tasya namaskāro'nyeṣāṃ ca tadanantaram .
kriyate daivataiḥ sarvaistena sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ .. 125.11 ..
6.3.d:
आदौ तस्य नमस्कारोऽन्येषां च तदनन्तरम् .
क्रियते दैवतैः सर्वैस्तेन सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः .. 125.11 ..
6.3.m: At the beginning, salutation is made to him, and after that to the others, / by all deities and therefore by all great seers.

6.3.s:
tisraḥ sandhyāstrayo devāḥ sāṃnidhyāḥ sūryamaṇḍale .
namaskṛtena sūryeṇa sarve devā namaskṛtāḥ .. 125.12 ..
6.3.d:
तिस्रः सन्ध्यास्त्रयो देवाः सांनिध्याः सूर्यमण्डले .
नमस्कृतेन सूर्येण सर्वे देवा नमस्कृताः .. 125.12 ..
6.3.m: The three twilights and the three gods have their presence in the solar orb; / when the sun has been bowed down to, all gods have been bowed down to.

6.3.s:
na divā na bhavedrātriḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam .
ayanaṃ cottaraṃ cāpi bhāskareṇa vinā nṛpa .. 125.13 ..
6.3.d:
न दिवा न भवेद्रात्रिः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् .
अयनं चोत्तरं चापि भास्करेण विना नृप .. 125.13 ..
6.3.m: There would be no day, no night, no six months of the southern course, / nor the northern course, O king, without the light-maker.

6.3.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam .
na vartate vinā sūryaṃ tena pūjyatamo raviḥ .. 125.14 ..
6.3.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् .
न वर्तते विना सूर्यं तेन पूज्यतमो रविः .. 125.14 ..
6.3.m: Ablution, giving, recitation, oblation, Vedic study, and worship of deities / do not exist without the sun; therefore Ravi is most worthy of worship.

6.3.s:
śabdagāḥ śrutimukhyāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .
pratyakṣo bhagavāndevo dṛśyate lokapāvanaḥ .. 125.15 ..
6.3.d:
शब्दगाः श्रुतिमुख्याश्च ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .
प्रत्यक्षो भगवान्देवो दृश्यते लोकपावनः .. 125.15 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara are conveyed through words and chief in the Vedas, / [but] the visible lord, the god, the purifier of the worlds, is seen [as the sun].

6.3.s:
utpattiḥ pralayasthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam .
hetureko jagannātho nānyo vidyeta bhāskarāt .. 125.16 ..
6.3.d:
उत्पत्तिः प्रलयस्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् .
हेतुरेको जगन्नाथो नान्यो विद्येत भास्करात् .. 125.16 ..
6.3.m: The origin, the place of dissolution, the receptacle, the imperishable seed, / the sole cause, the lord of the world—none other than the light-maker is known.

6.3.s:
evamātmabhavaṃ kṛtvā jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam .
lokānāṃ tu hitārthāya sthāpayeddharmapaddhatim .. 125.17 ..
6.3.d:
एवमात्मभवं कृत्वा जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् .
लोकानां तु हितार्थाय स्थापयेद्धर्मपद्धतिम् .. 125.17 ..
6.3.m: Having thus made the world of moving and unmoving beings born from himself, / he established the path of dharma for the welfare of the worlds.

6.3.s:
narmadātaṭamāśritya sthāpayitvātmanastanum .
sahasrāṃśuṃ nidhiṃ dhāmnāṃ jagāmākāśamavyayam .. 125.18 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य स्थापयित्वात्मनस्तनुम् .
सहस्रांशुं निधिं धाम्नां जगामाकाशमव्ययम् .. 125.18 ..
6.3.m: Resorting to the bank of the Narmadā, having established his own body / as the thousand-rayed one, the storehouse of splendours, he went to imperishable space.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
sahasrakiraṇaṃ devaṃ nāmamantravidhānataḥ .. 125.19 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
सहस्रकिरणं देवं नाममन्त्रविधानतः .. 125.19 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed at that sacred ford, worships the supreme lord, / the thousand-rayed god, according to the rules of name and mantra—

6.3.s:
tena taptaṃ hutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam .
tena samyagvidhānena samprāptaṃ paramaṃ padam .. 125.20 ..
6.3.d:
तेन तप्तं हुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम् .
तेन सम्यग्विधानेन सम्प्राप्तं परमं पदम् .. 125.20 ..
6.3.m: By him has austerity been performed, by him has oblation been offered, by him has everything been accomplished; / by him, through the correct procedure, the supreme abode has been attained.

6.3.s:
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam .
snātvā ye narmadātoye devaṃ paśyanti bhāskaram .. 125.21 ..
6.3.d:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् .
स्नात्वा ये नर्मदातोये देवं पश्यन्ति भास्करम् .. 125.21 ..
6.3.m: Blessed are they, great-souled are they, well-lived is the life of those / who, having bathed in the waters of the Narmadā, behold the sun-god.

6.3.s:
tathā devasya rājendra ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam .
ananyabhaktyā satataṃ trirakṣarasamanvitāḥ .. 125.22 ..
6.3.d:
तथा देवस्य राजेन्द्र ये कुर्वन्ति प्रदक्षिणम् .
अनन्यभक्त्या सततं त्रिरक्षरसमन्विताः .. 125.22 ..
6.3.m: Likewise, O best of kings, those who circumambulate the god / constantly with undivided devotion, endowed with the three syllables,

6.3.s:
tena pūtaśarīrāste mantreṇa gatapātakāḥ .
yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavetteṣāṃ tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 125.23 ..
6.3.d:
तेन पूतशरीरास्ते मन्त्रेण गतपातकाः .
यत्पुण्यं च भवेत्तेषां तदिहैकमनाः शृणु .. 125.23 ..
6.3.m: their bodies purified by that mantra, their sins dispelled— / what merit accrues to them, hear that here with an attentive mind.

6.3.s:
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā .
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā sarvā pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 125.24 ..
6.3.d:
ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना .
प्रदक्षिणीकृता सर्वा पृथिवी नात्र संशयः .. 125.24 ..
6.3.m: By him has the entire earth, with its oceans and caves, / with its mountains, forests, and woods, been circumambulated; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
mantramūlamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .
tena mantravihīnaṃ tu kāryaṃ loke na sidhyati .. 125.25 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रमूलमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .
तेन मन्त्रविहीनं तु कार्यं लोके न सिध्यति .. 125.25 ..
6.3.m: All this threefold world, with the moving and the unmoving, is rooted in mantras. / Therefore, an action lacking a mantra is not accomplished in this world.

6.3.s:
yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ .
kāryārthaṃ naiva sidhyeta tathā karma hyamantrakam .. 125.26 ..
6.3.d:
यथा काष्ठमयो हस्ती यथा चर्ममयो मृगः .
कार्यार्थं नैव सिध्येत तथा कर्म ह्यमन्त्रकम् .. 125.26 ..
6.3.m: Just as a wooden elephant or a leather deer / cannot accomplish any practical purpose, so indeed is a rite performed without a mantra.

6.3.s:
bhasmahutaṃ pārtha yathā toyavivarjitam .
niṣphalaṃ jāyate dānaṃ tathā mantravivarjitam .. 125.27 ..
6.3.d:
भस्महुतं पार्थ यथा तोयविवर्जितम् .
निष्फलं जायते दानं तथा मन्त्रविवर्जितम् .. 125.27 ..
6.3.m: Just as an oblation poured into ashes, O Pārtha, or a gift given without water, / becomes fruitless, so too is a gift devoid of a mantra.

6.3.s:
kāṣṭhapāṣāṇaloṣṭeṣu mṛnmayeṣu viśeṣataḥ .
mantreṇa loke pūjāṃ tu kurvanti na hyamantrataḥ .. 125.28 ..
6.3.d:
काष्ठपाषाणलोष्टेषु मृन्मयेषु विशेषतः .
मन्त्रेण लोके पूजां तु कुर्वन्ति न ह्यमन्त्रतः .. 125.28 ..
6.3.m: In figures of wood, stone, clods of earth, and especially of clay, / people in this world worship with a mantra, never indeed without a mantra.

6.3.s:
dvādaśābdānnamaskārādbhaktyā yallabhate phalam .
mantrayuktanamaskārātsakṛttallabhate phalam .. 125.29 ..
6.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दान्नमस्काराद्भक्त्या यल्लभते फलम् .
मन्त्रयुक्तनमस्कारात्सकृत्तल्लभते फलम् .. 125.29 ..
6.3.m: The fruit one obtains from prostration with devotion for twelve years, / one obtains all at once from a single prostration joined with a mantra.

6.3.s:
saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte ayane viṣuve tathā .
narmadāyā jale snātvā yastu pūjayate ravim .. 125.30 ..
6.3.d:
संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते अयने विषुवे तथा .
नर्मदाया जले स्नात्वा यस्तु पूजयते रविम् .. 125.30 ..
6.3.m: At a solstice, at a vyatīpāta, at the sun's passage, or at an equinox, / he who bathes in the water of the Narmadā and worships the sun,

6.3.s:
dvādaśābdena yatpāpamajñānajñānasaṃcitam .
tatkṣaṇānnaśyate sarvaṃ vahninā tu tuṣaṃ yathā .. 125.31 ..
6.3.d:
द्वादशाब्देन यत्पापमज्ञानज्ञानसंचितम् .
तत्क्षणान्नश्यते सर्वं वह्निना तु तुषं यथा .. 125.31 ..
6.3.m: whatever sin has been accumulated through ignorance or knowledge over twelve years / is completely destroyed in an instant, like chaff by fire.

6.3.s:
candrasūryagrahe snātvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ .
tatrādityamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 125.32 ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे स्नात्वा सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः .
तत्रादित्यमुखं दृष्ट्वा मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 125.32 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, fasting and with senses controlled, / beholding the face of the sun there, he is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
māghamāse tu samprāpte saptamyāṃ nṛpasattama .
sopavāso jitakrodha uṣitvā sūryamandire .. 125.33 ..
6.3.d:
माघमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते सप्तम्यां नृपसत्तम .
सोपवासो जितक्रोध उषित्वा सूर्यमन्दिरे .. 125.33 ..
6.3.m: When the month of Māgha arrives, on the seventh day, O best of kings, / fasting, with anger conquered, having stayed in the temple of the sun,

6.3.s:
prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena dadātyarghaṃ divākare .
vidhinā mantrayuktena sa labhetpuṇyamuttamam .. 125.34 ..
6.3.d:
प्रातः स्नात्वा विधानेन ददात्यर्घं दिवाकरे .
विधिना मन्त्रयुक्तेन स लभेत्पुण्यमुत्तमम् .. 125.34 ..
6.3.m: bathing at dawn according to rule and offering an arghya to the sun / according to the rite endowed with a mantra, he attains supreme merit.

6.3.s:
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ kṛtvā hyudakatarpaṇam .
mandire devadevasya tataḥ pūjāṃ samācaret .. 125.35 ..
6.3.d:
पितृदेवमनुष्याणां कृत्वा ह्युदकतर्पणम् .
मन्दिरे देवदेवस्य ततः पूजां समाचरेत् .. 125.35 ..
6.3.m: Having performed the water-tarpaṇa for the ancestors, gods, and men, / he should then perform worship in the temple of the god of gods.

6.3.s:
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpanaivedyaśobhanaiḥ .
pūjayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato mantramudīrayet .. 125.36 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैर्दीपनैवेद्यशोभनैः .
पूजयित्वा जगन्नाथं ततो मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् .. 125.36 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped the Lord of the World with perfumes, flowers, incenses, / and splendid lamps and food-offerings, he should then utter the mantra:

6.3.s:
viṣṇuḥ śakro yamo dhātā mitro'tha varuṇastathā .
vivasvānsavitā pūṣā caṇḍāṃśurbharga eva ca .. 125.37 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुः शक्रो यमो धाता मित्रोऽथ वरुणस्तथा .
विवस्वान्सविता पूषा चण्डांशुर्भर्ग एव च .. 125.37 ..
6.3.m: “Viṣṇu, Śakra, Yama, Dhātṛ, Mitra, and Varuṇa; / Vivasvant, Savitṛ, Pūṣan, Caṇḍāṃśu, and Bharga.”

6.3.s:
iti dvādaśanāmāni japankṛtvā pradakṣiṇām .
yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 125.38 ..
6.3.d:
इति द्वादशनामानि जपन्कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणाम् .
यत्फलं लभते पार्थ तदिहैकमनाः शृणु .. 125.38 ..
6.3.m: Reciting these twelve names and performing circumambulation, / what fruit one obtains, O Pārtha, hear that here with an attentive mind.

6.3.s:
daridro vyādhito mūko badhiro jaḍa eva ca .
na bhavetsapta janmāni ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 125.39 ..
6.3.d:
दरिद्रो व्याधितो मूको बधिरो जड एव च .
न भवेत्सप्त जन्मानि इत्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 125.39 ..
6.3.m: He will not be poor, diseased, mute, deaf, or dull / for seven births; thus indeed spoke Śaṃkara.

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā vidhānena japanmantraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ .
ārādhayedraviṃ bhaktyā ya icchetpuṇyamuttamam .. 125.40 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा विधानेन जपन्मन्त्रं विचक्षणः .
आराधयेद्रविं भक्त्या य इच्छेत्पुण्यमुत्तमम् .. 125.40 ..
6.3.m: Knowing this, repeating the mantra according to the rite, the wise man / who desires supreme merit should worship the sun with devotion.

6.3.s:
mantrahīnāṃ tu yaḥ kuryādbhaktiṃ devasya bhārata .
sa viḍambati cātmānaṃ paśukīṭapataṅgavat .. 125.41 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रहीनां तु यः कुर्याद्भक्तिं देवस्य भारत .
स विडम्बति चात्मानं पशुकीटपतङ्गवत् .. 125.41 ..
6.3.m: He who offers devotion to the god devoid of mantras, O Bhārata, / merely mocks himself like a beast, a worm, or a moth.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścittyajate dehamuttamam .
sa gatastatra devaistu pūjyamāno maharṣibhiḥ .. 125.42 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्त्यजते देहमुत्तमम् .
स गतस्तत्र देवैस्तु पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः .. 125.42 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons his excellent body at that sacred ford, / having gone there, being worshipped by gods and great seers,

6.3.s: svecchayā suciraṃ kālamiha loke nṛpo bhavet .. 125.43 ..
6.3.d: स्वेच्छया सुचिरं कालमिह लोके नृपो भवेत् .. 125.43 ..
6.3.m: by his own will for a very long time, will become a king in this world.

6.3.s:
putrapautrasamāyukto hastyaśvarathasaṅkulaḥ .
dāsīdāsaśatopeto jāyate vipule kule .. 125.44 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ravitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 126
6.3.d:
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तो हस्त्यश्वरथसङ्कुलः .
दासीदासशतोपेतो जायते विपुले कुले .. 125.44 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रवितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 126
6.3.m:
Joined with sons and grandsons, crowded with elephants, horses, and chariots, / attended by hundreds of female and male servants, he is born in an exalted family.
Thus ends the one hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of Ravitīrtha, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 126

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra paraṃ tīrthamayonijam .
snātamātro narastatra na paśyedyonisaṅkaṭam .. 126.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र परं तीर्थमयोनिजम् .
स्नातमात्रो नरस्तत्र न पश्येद्योनिसङ्कटम् .. 126.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the supreme sacred ford Ayonija. / Merely upon bathing there, a person will not behold the distress of rebirth.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram .
ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara .. 126.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्देवमीश्वरम् .
अयोनिजो महादेव यथा त्वं परमेश्वर .. 126.2 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at that sacred ford, a person should worship the god Īśvara: / “Just as you, O Mahādeva, O Parameśvara, are not born from a womb,

6.3.s:
tathā mocaya māṃ deva sambhavādyonisaṅkaṭāt .
gandhapuṣpādidhūpaiśca sa mucyetsarvapātakaiḥ .. 126.3 ..
6.3.d:
तथा मोचय मां देव सम्भवाद्योनिसङ्कटात् .
गन्धपुष्पादिधूपैश्च स मुच्येत्सर्वपातकैः .. 126.3 ..
6.3.m: so deliver me, O god, from existence and the distress of rebirth!” / [Worshipping] with perfumes, flowers, incenses, and the like, he is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tasya devasya yo bhaktyā kurute liṅgapūraṇam .
sa vaseddevadevasya yāvatsikthasya saṃkhyayā .. 126.4 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य देवस्य यो भक्त्या कुरुते लिङ्गपूरणम् .
स वसेद्देवदेवस्य यावत्सिक्थस्य संख्यया .. 126.4 ..
6.3.m: Whoever with devotion fills the liṅga of that god [with grains of boiled rice], / dwells near the god of gods for as many [years] as the count of rice-grains.

6.3.s:
ayonije mahādevaṃ snāpayedgandhavāriṇā .
madhukṣīreṇa dadhnā vā sa labhedvipulāṃ śriyam .. 126.5 ..
6.3.d:
अयोनिजे महादेवं स्नापयेद्गन्धवारिणा .
मधुक्षीरेण दध्ना वा स लभेद्विपुलां श्रियम् .. 126.5 ..
6.3.m: At Ayonija, one should bathe Mahādeva with scented water, / or with honey, milk, or curd; he attains abundant fortune.

6.3.s:
aṣṭabhyāṃ ca site pakṣe asitāṃ vā caturdaśīm .
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ prīṇayedgītavādyakaiḥ .. 126.6 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टभ्यां च सिते पक्षे असितां वा चतुर्दशीम् .
पूजयित्वा महादेवं प्रीणयेद्गीतवाद्यकैः .. 126.6 ..
6.3.m: On the eighth day of the bright fortnight, or on the dark fourteenth day, / having worshipped Mahādeva, he should please him with songs and instrumental music.

6.3.s:
vasetsa ca śive loke ye kurvanti manoharam .
te vasanti śive loke yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 126.7 ..
6.3.d:
वसेत्स च शिवे लोके ये कुर्वन्ति मनोहरम् .
ते वसन्ति शिवे लोके यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 126.7 ..
6.3.m: He shall dwell in the world of Śiva. Those who make it delightful, / dwell in the world of Śiva until the universal dissolution.

6.3.s:
tasya devasya bhaktyā tu yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām .
vijñāpayaṃśca satataṃ mantreṇānena bhārata .. 126.8 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य देवस्य भक्त्या तु यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् .
विज्ञापयंश्च सततं मन्त्रेणानेन भारत .. 126.8 ..
6.3.m: Whoever circumambulates that god with devotion, / constantly addressing [him] with this mantra, O Bhārata—

6.3.s:
tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ pāramparyeṇa mānavaiḥ .
sakāśāddevadevasya tacchṛṇuṣva samādhinā .. 126.9 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं पारम्पर्येण मानवैः .
सकाशाद्देवदेवस्य तच्छृणुष्व समाधिना .. 126.9 ..
6.3.m: what fruit has been proclaimed by men through tradition / in the presence of that god of gods, hear that with concentration:

6.3.s:
ayonijo mahādeva yathā tvaṃ parameśvara .
tathā mocaya māṃ śarva sambhavādyonisaṅkaṭāt .. 126.10 ..
6.3.d:
अयोनिजो महादेव यथा त्वं परमेश्वर .
तथा मोचय मां शर्व सम्भवाद्योनिसङ्कटात् .. 126.10 ..
6.3.m: “Just as you, O Mahādeva, O Parameśvara, are not born from a womb, / so deliver me, O Śarva, from existence and the distress of rebirth!”

6.3.s:
kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ kaṃṭhaśoṣaṇatatparaiḥ .
yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti proktaṃ devasya saṃnidhau .. 126.11 ..
6.3.d:
किं तस्य बहुभिर्मन्त्रैः कंठशोषणतत्परैः .
येनौंनमः शिवायेति प्रोक्तं देवस्य संनिधौ .. 126.11 ..
6.3.m: What need has he for many mantras that merely dry the throat, / by whom “Oṃ, homage to Śiva” has been uttered in the presence of the god?

6.3.s:
tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam .
yenauṃnamaḥ śivāyeti mantrābhyāsaḥ sthirīkṛtaḥ .. 126.12 ..
6.3.d:
तेनाधीतं श्रुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम् .
येनौंनमः शिवायेति मन्त्राभ्यासः स्थिरीकृतः .. 126.12 ..
6.3.m: By him has been studied, by him has been heard, by him has everything been accomplished, / by whom the practice of the mantra “Oṃ, homage to Śiva” has been made firm.

6.3.s:
na tatphalamavāpnoti sarvadeveṣu vai dvijaḥ .
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ṣaḍakṣara udīraṇāt .. 126.13 ..
6.3.d:
न तत्फलमवाप्नोति सर्वदेवेषु वै द्विजः .
यत्फलं समवाप्नोति षडक्षर उदीरणात् .. 126.13 ..
6.3.m: A twice-born does not obtain that fruit from all the gods / which he obtains from uttering the six-syllabled [mantra].

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchivayoginam .
dvijānāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ sa labhetphalamuttamam .. 126.14 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेच्छिवयोगिनम् .
द्विजानामयुतं साग्रं स लभेत्फलमुत्तमम् .. 126.14 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed at that sacred ford, worships a Śivayogin, / obtains the excellent fruit of [feeding] fully ten thousand twice-born.

6.3.s:
athavā bhaktiyuktastu teṣāṃ dānte jitendriye .
saṃskṛtya dadate bhikṣāṃ phalaṃ tasya tato'dhikam .. 126.15 ..
6.3.d:
अथवा भक्तियुक्तस्तु तेषां दान्ते जितेन्द्रिये .
संस्कृत्य ददते भिक्षां फलं तस्य ततोऽधिकम् .. 126.15 ..
6.3.m: Or, filled with devotion, preparing alms, gives them to those who are restrained and self-controlled, / the fruit for him is greater than that.

6.3.s:
yatihaste jalaṃ dadyādbhikṣāṃ dattvā punarjalam .
sā bhikṣā meruṇā tulyā tajjalaṃ sāgaropamam .. 126.16 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ayoniprabhavatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 127
6.3.d:
यतिहस्ते जलं दद्याद्भिक्षां दत्त्वा पुनर्जलम् .
सा भिक्षा मेरुणा तुल्या तज्जलं सागरोपमम् .. 126.16 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अयोनिप्रभवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 127
6.3.m:
One should pour water into the hand of an ascetic, offer alms, and again pour water; / that alms is equal to Mount Meru, that water is like an ocean.
Thus ends the one hundred twenty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Ayoniprabhava', in the Revā Section of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 127

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra agnitīrthamanuttamam .
tatra snātvā tu pakṣādau mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 127.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र अग्नितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
तत्र स्नात्वा तु पक्षादौ मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 127.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the unsurpassed Agnitīrtha. / Having bathed there at the start of a fortnight, one is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadyātsvayamalaṃkṛtām .
tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narottama .. 127.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कन्यां दद्यात्स्वयमलंकृताम् .
तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं तच्छृणुष्व नरोत्तम .. 127.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever gives away a maiden there at that sacred ford, herself adorned, / hear the fruit declared for him, O best of men:

6.3.s:
agniṣṭomātirātrābhyāṃ śataṃ śataguṇīkṛtam .
prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā hyalaṃkṛtām .. 127.3 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां शतं शतगुणीकृतम् .
प्राप्नोति पुरुषो दत्त्वा यथाशक्त्या ह्यलंकृताम् .. 127.3 ..
6.3.m: A man obtains a hundred times a hundredfold [the fruit] of the Agniṣṭoma and Atirātra [sacrifices], / having given her away, adorned according to his ability.

6.3.s:
tasyāḥ putraprapautrāṇāṃ yā bhavedromasaṃgatiḥ .
sa yāti tena mānena śivaloke parāṃ gatim .. 127.4 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe agnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 128
6.3.d:
तस्याः पुत्रप्रपौत्राणां या भवेद्रोमसंगतिः .
स याति तेन मानेन शिवलोके परां गतिम् .. 127.4 ..
