.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अग्नितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 128
6.3.m:
As many as the hairs of her sons and grandsons may be, / by that measure he attains the supreme state in the world of Śiva.
Thus ends the one hundred twenty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Agnitīrtha', in the Revā Section of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 128

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra bhṛkuṭeśvaramuttamam .
yatra siddho mahābhāgo bhṛguḥ paramakopanaḥ .. 128.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र भृकुटेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो भृगुः परमकोपनः .. 128.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the excellent Bhṛkuṭeśvara, / where the highly fortunate Bhṛgu, exceedingly irascible, attained perfection.

6.3.s:
tena varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha .
putrārthaṃ varayāmāsa putraṃ putravatāṃ varaḥ .. 128.2 ..
6.3.d:
तेन वर्षशतं साग्रं तपश्चीर्णं पुरानघ .
पुत्रार्थं वरयामास पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः .. 128.2 ..
6.3.m: By him tapas was performed of old for a full hundred years, O sinless one; / the best among those with sons chose a boon for the sake of a son.

6.3.s:
varo datto mahābhāga devenāndhakaghātinā .
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .. 128.3 ..
6.3.d:
वरो दत्तो महाभाग देवेनान्धकघातिना .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .. 128.3 ..
6.3.m: The boon was granted, O highly fortunate one, by the god who slew Andhaka. / Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and worships the supreme lord,

6.3.s:
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ labhet .
bhṛkuṭeśaṃ tu yaḥ kaścidghṛtena madhunā saha .. 128.4 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलमष्टगुणं लभेत् .
भृकुटेशं तु यः कश्चिद्घृतेन मधुना सह .. 128.4 ..
6.3.m: obtains eightfold the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice. / Whoever bathes Bhṛkuṭeśa with ghee along with honey,

6.3.s:
putrārthī snāpayedbhaktyā sa labhetputramīpsitam .
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā dadyādviprāya kāñcanam .. 128.5 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रार्थी स्नापयेद्भक्त्या स लभेत्पुत्रमीप्सितम् .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दद्याद्विप्राय काञ्चनम् .. 128.5 ..
6.3.m: desiring a son, with devotion, attains the desired son. / Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and gives gold to a brahmin,

6.3.s: godānaṃ vā mahīṃ vāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 128.6 ..
6.3.d: गोदानं वा महीं वापि तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 128.6 ..
6.3.m: or the gift of a cow, or even land—hear the fruit of his merit:

6.3.s:
sasamudraguhā tena saśailavanakānanā .
dattā pṛthvī na sandehastena sarvā nṛpottama .. 128.7 ..
6.3.d:
ससमुद्रगुहा तेन सशैलवनकानना .
दत्ता पृथ्वी न सन्देहस्तेन सर्वा नृपोत्तम .. 128.7 ..
6.3.m: By him the entire earth has been given, along with oceans and caves, / with mountains, forests, and woods; of this there is no doubt, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
tena dānena sa svarge krīḍayitvā yathāsukham .
martye bhavati rājendro brāhmaṇo vā supūjitaḥ .. 128.8 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛkuṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 129
6.3.d:
तेन दानेन स स्वर्गे क्रीडयित्वा यथासुखम् .
मर्त्ये भवति राजेन्द्रो ब्राह्मणो वा सुपूजितः .. 128.8 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भृकुटेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाविंशत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 129
6.3.m:
Having sported in heaven at pleasure through that gift, / he becomes a king of kings in the mortal world, or a highly honored brahmin.
Thus ends the one hundred twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Bhṛkuṭeśvara', in the Revā Section of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 129

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla brahmatīrthamanuttamam .
anyeṣāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ parātparataraṃ mahat .. 129.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल ब्रह्मतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
अन्येषां चैव तीर्थानां परात्परतरं महत् .. 129.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O ruler of the earth, to the unsurpassed Brahmatīrtha, / which is greater than the greatest among the other sacred fords.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe suraśreṣṭho brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ .. 129.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे सुरश्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां नर्मदातटमाश्रितः .. 129.2 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, the best of the gods, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / has resorted to the bank of the Narmadā for [the benefit of] all four classes.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurākṛtam .
tatkṣālayati deveśo darśanādeva pātakam .. 129.3 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुराकृतम् .
तत्क्षालयति देवेशो दर्शनादेव पातकम् .. 129.3 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sin has been committed formerly, born of speech, mind, or bodily action, / the lord of the gods washes away that sin merely by being seen.

6.3.s:
śrutismṛtyuditānyeva tatra snātvā dvijarṣabhāḥ .
prāyaścittāni kurvanti teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape .. 129.4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितान्येव तत्र स्नात्वा द्विजर्षभाः .
प्रायश्चित्तानि कुर्वन्ति तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे .. 129.4 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there, the best of the twice-born perform expiations / declared in the Śruti and Smṛti; their abode is in heaven.

6.3.s:
ye punaḥ śāstramutsṛjya kāmalobhaprapīḍitāḥ .
prāyaścittaṃ vadiṣyanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ .. 129.5 ..
6.3.d:
ये पुनः शास्त्रमुत्सृज्य कामलोभप्रपीडिताः .
प्रायश्चित्तं वदिष्यन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः .. 129.5 ..
6.3.m: Those, on the other hand, who abandon the scriptures and, tormented by desire and greed, / declare an expiation, will indeed go to hell.

6.3.s:
snātvādau pātakī brahmannatvā tu kīrtayedagham .
tasya tannaśyate kṣipraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā .. 129.6 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वादौ पातकी ब्रह्मन्नत्वा तु कीर्तयेदघम् .
तस्य तन्नश्यते क्षिप्रं तमः सूर्योदये यथा .. 129.6 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed first, a sinner, O brahmin, having bowed, should declare his sin; / that [sin] of his is quickly destroyed, like darkness at sunrise.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
agniṣṭomasya yajñasya sa labhetphalamuttamam .. 129.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्पितृदेवताः .
अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य स लभेत्फलमुत्तमम् .. 129.7 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and worships the ancestors and the deities, / obtains the excellent fruit of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaddānaṃ brahmoddiśya prayacchati .
tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 129.8 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यद्दानं ब्रह्मोद्दिश्य प्रयच्छति .
तदक्षयफलं सर्वमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 129.8 ..
6.3.m: Whatever gift one gives at that sacred ford dedicated to Brahmā, / all of that has inexhaustible fruit; thus spoke Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
gāyatrīsāramātro'pi tatra yaḥ kriyate japaḥ .
ṛgyajuḥsāmasahitaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ .. 129.9 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्रीसारमात्रोऽपि तत्र यः क्रियते जपः .
ऋग्यजुःसामसहितः स भवेन्नात्र संशयः .. 129.9 ..
6.3.m: Even if only the essence of the Gāyatrī is recited there in muttered prayer, / it becomes endowed with the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā tyajeddehaṃ sudustyajam .
anivartikā gatistasya brahmalokānna saṃśayaḥ .. 129.10 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या त्यजेद्देहं सुदुस्त्यजम् .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य ब्रह्मलोकान्न संशयः .. 129.10 ..
6.3.m: Whoever abandons with devotion the body so hard to abandon at that sacred ford, / his attainment is one that does not return from the world of Brahmā; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
yāvadasthīni tiṣṭhanti brahmatīrthe ca dehinām .
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi devaloke mahīyate .. 129.11 ..
6.3.d:
यावदस्थीनि तिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्मतीर्थे च देहिनाम् .
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि देवलोके महीयते .. 129.11 ..
6.3.m: As long as the bones of embodied beings remain in Brahmatīrtha, / for that many thousands of years one is honored in the world of the gods.

6.3.s:
avatīrṇastato loke brahmajño jāyate kule .
uttamaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ devānāmiva devatā .. 129.12 ..
6.3.d:
अवतीर्णस्ततो लोके ब्रह्मज्ञो जायते कुले .
उत्तमः सर्ववर्णानां देवानामिव देवता .. 129.12 ..
6.3.m: Having descended from there into the world, he is born in a family of knowers of the Veda, / superior among all the classes, like a deity among the gods.

6.3.s:
vidyāsthānāni sarvāṇi vetti vedāṅgapāragaḥ .
jāyate pūjito loke rājabhiḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ .. 129.13 ..
6.3.d:
विद्यास्थानानि सर्वाणि वेत्ति वेदाङ्गपारगः .
जायते पूजितो लोके राजभिः स न संशयः .. 129.13 ..
6.3.m: He knows all branches of knowledge and has mastered the auxiliary disciplines of the Veda; / he is born respected in the world by kings, without a doubt.

6.3.s:
putrapautrasamopetaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ brahmatīrthaprabhāvataḥ .. 129.14 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रपौत्रसमोपेतः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः .
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं ब्रह्मतीर्थप्रभावतः .. 129.14 ..
6.3.m: Endowed with sons and grandsons, free from all diseases, / he lives for a full hundred years through the power of Brahmatīrtha.

6.3.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ jñānavatāṃ varam .
ye paśyanti mahātmāno hyamṛtatvaṃ prayānti te .. 129.15 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe brahmatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..
adhyāya 130
6.3.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं तीर्थं ज्ञानवतां वरम् .
ये पश्यन्ति महात्मानो ह्यमृतत्वं प्रयान्ति ते .. 129.15 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ब्रह्मतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः..
अध्याय 130
6.3.m:
This holy sacred ford, which removes sin, is the best for the wise; / the great-souled ones who see it attain immortality.
Thus ends the one hundred twenty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Brahmatīrtha', in the Revā Section of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 130

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle devatīrthamanuttamam .
tatra devaiḥ samāgatya toṣitaḥ parameśvaraḥ .. 130.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
तत्र देवैः समागत्य तोषितः परमेश्वरः .. 130.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the southern bank of the Narmadā is the unsurpassed Devatīrtha; / having assembled there, the supreme lord was pleased by the gods.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ .
sa labhennātra sandeho gosahasraphalaṃ dhruvam .. 130.2 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 131
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा कामक्रोधविवर्जितः .
स लभेन्नात्र सन्देहो गोसहस्रफलं ध्रुवम् .. 130.2 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे देवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 131
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes at that sacred ford, free from desire and anger, / surely obtains the fruit of a thousand cows; of this there is no doubt.
Thus ends the one hundred thirtieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford Devatīrtha', in the Revā Section of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 131

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle nāgatīrthamanuttamam .
yatra siddhā mahānāgā bhaye jāte tato nṛpa .. 131.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले नागतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महानागा भये जाते ततो नृप .. 131.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the southern bank of the Narmadā is the unsurpassed Nāgatīrtha, / where the great serpents achieved perfection, O king, when fear arose.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
mahābhayānāṃ lokasya nāgānāṃ dvijasattama .
kathaṃ jātaṃ bhayaṃ tīvraṃ yena te tapasi sthitāḥ .. 131.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
महाभयानां लोकस्य नागानां द्विजसत्तम .
कथं जातं भयं तीव्रं येन ते तपसि स्थिताः .. 131.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How did severe fear arise, O best of the twice-born, / for the serpents who are a great dread to the world, because of which they engaged in tapas?

6.3.s:
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca yatsurāsuramānave .
tāta te viditaṃ sarvaṃ tena me kautukaṃ mahat .. 131.3 ..
6.3.d:
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च यत्सुरासुरमानवे .
तात ते विदितं सर्वं तेन मे कौतुकं महत् .. 131.3 ..
6.3.m: Whatever has been, what is now, and what will be among gods, asuras, and humans, / all that is known to you, father; therefore great curiosity is mine.

6.3.s:
mama saṃtāpajaṃ duḥkhaṃ duryodhanasamudbhavam .
tava vaktrāmbujaughena plāvitaṃ nirvṛtiṃ gatam .. 131.4 ..
6.3.d:
मम संतापजं दुःखं दुर्योधनसमुद्भवम् .
तव वक्त्राम्बुजौघेन प्लावितं निर्वृतिं गतम् .. 131.4 ..
6.3.m: My distress born of anguish, arising on account of Duryodhana, / has been flooded by the flood from your lotus mouth and reached tranquility.

6.3.s:
śrutvā tava mukhodgītāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm .
bhūyo bhūyaḥ smṛtirjātā śravaṇe mama suvrata .. 131.5 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तव मुखोद्गीतां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् .
भूयो भूयः स्मृतिर्जाता श्रवणे मम सुव्रत .. 131.5 ..
6.3.m: Having heard the tale sung from your mouth, which destroys sin, / recollection upon recollection has arisen for my hearing, O one of good vows.

6.3.s:
na kleśatvaṃ dvije yuktaṃ na cānyo jānate phalam .
vidyādānasya mahataḥ śrāvitasya sutasya ca .. 131.6 ..
6.3.d:
न क्लेशत्वं द्विजे युक्तं न चान्यो जानते फलम् .
विद्यादानस्य महतः श्रावितस्य सुतस्य च .. 131.6 ..
6.3.m:
No fatigue is proper in a twice-born, nor does anyone else know the fruit
of the great gift of knowledge imparted, and of a son.

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā yathānyāyaṃ yaḥ praśnaḥ pṛcchito mayā .
kathā tu kathyatāṃ vipra dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari .. 131.7 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा यथान्यायं यः प्रश्नः पृच्छितो मया .
कथा तु कथ्यतां विप्र दयां कृत्वा ममोपरि .. 131.7 ..
6.3.m:
Knowing this properly, as to the question asked by me,
let the story be told, O brahmin, taking pity upon me.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
yathā yathā tvaṃ nṛpa bhāṣase ca tathā tathā me sukhameti bhāratī .
śaithilyabhāvājjarayānvitasya tvatsauhṛdaṃ naśyati naiva tāta .. 131.8 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
यथा यथा त्वं नृप भाषसे च तथा तथा मे सुखमेति भारती .
शैथिल्यभावाज्जरयान्वितस्य त्वत्सौहृदं नश्यति नैव तात .. 131.8 ..

6.3.s:
kathayāmi yathāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam .
kathitaṃ pūrvato vṛddhaiḥ pāramparyeṇa bhārata .. 131.9 ..
6.3.d:
कथयामि यथावृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम् .
कथितं पूर्वतो वृद्धैः पारम्पर्येण भारत .. 131.9 ..
6.3.m:
I shall tell an ancient history just as it occurred,
which was told formerly by the elders in unbroken tradition, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
dve bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ sarvalokeṣvanuttame .
garutmato vai vinatā sarpāṇāṃ kadrureva ca .. 131.10 ..
6.3.d:
द्वे भार्ये कश्यपस्यास्तां सर्वलोकेष्वनुत्तमे .
गरुत्मतो वै विनता सर्पाणां कद्रुरेव च .. 131.10 ..
6.3.m:
Kaśyapa had two wives, unsurpassed in all the worlds:
Vinatā, [mother] of Garuḍa, and Kadrū, [mother] of the serpents.

6.3.s:
aśvasaṃdarśanāttābhyāṃ kalirūpaṃ vyavasthitam .
prabhātakāle rājendra bhāskarākāravarcasam .. 131.11 ..
6.3.d:
अश्वसंदर्शनात्ताभ्यां कलिरूपं व्यवस्थितम् .
प्रभातकाले राजेन्द्र भास्कराकारवर्चसम् .. 131.11 ..
6.3.m:
From the sighting of a horse, a dispute arose between the two
at dawn, O king of kings—[a horse] whose radiance resembled the sun.

6.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vinatā rūpamaśvaṃ sarvatra pāṇḍuram .
atha tāṃ kadrūmavocatsā paśya paśya varānane .. 131.12 ..
6.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा विनता रूपमश्वं सर्वत्र पाण्डुरम् .
अथ तां कद्रूमवोचत्सा पश्य पश्य वरानने .. 131.12 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing that horse, white everywhere in form,
Vinatā then said to Kadrū: “Look, look, O fair-faced one!

6.3.s:
uccaiḥśravasaḥ sādṛśyaṃ paśya sarvatra pāṇḍuram .
dhāvamānamaviśrāntaṃ javena pavanopamam .. 131.13 ..
6.3.d:
उच्चैःश्रवसः सादृश्यं पश्य सर्वत्र पाण्डुरम् .
धावमानमविश्रान्तं जवेन पवनोपमम् .. 131.13 ..
6.3.m:
Look at its resemblance to Uccaiḥśravas, white all over,
running untiringly, swift like the wind!”

6.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā yāntamīrṣyābhāvena mohitā .
kṛṣṇaṃ matvā tathājalpattayā saha nṛpottama .. 131.14 ..
6.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा यान्तमीर्ष्याभावेन मोहिता .
कृष्णं मत्वा तथाजल्पत्तया सह नृपोत्तम .. 131.14 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing it galloping swiftly, deluded by feelings of jealousy,
thinking it black, she argued with her, O best of kings:

6.3.s:
vinate tvaṃ mṛṣā loke nṛśaṃse kulapāṃsani .
kṛṣṇaṃ cainaṃ vada śvetaṃ narakaṃ yāsyase param .. 131.15 ..
6.3.d:
विनते त्वं मृषा लोके नृशंसे कुलपांसनि .
कृष्णं चैनं वद श्वेतं नरकं यास्यसे परम् .. 131.15 ..
6.3.m:
“Vinatā, you speak falsely in this world, cruel woman, disgrace to your family!
Say it is black, though [you call it] white, or you shall go to the deepest hell!”

6.3.s:
vinatovāca -
satyānṛte tu vacane paṇo'yaṃ te mamaiva tu .
sahasraṃ vatsarāndāsī bhaveyaṃ tava veśmani .. 131.16 ..
6.3.d:
विनतोवाच -
सत्यानृते तु वचने पणोऽयं ते ममैव तु .
सहस्रं वत्सरान्दासी भवेयं तव वेश्मनि .. 131.16 ..
6.3.m:
Vinatā said:
“Whether the statement is true or false, this shall be my wager with you:
I shall become a slave-girl in your house for a thousand years.”

6.3.s:
tatheti te pratijñāya rātrau gatvā svakaṃ gṛham .
parityajya ubhe te tu krodhamūrchitamūrchite .. 131.17 ..
6.3.d:
तथेति ते प्रतिज्ञाय रात्रौ गत्वा स्वकं गृहम् .
परित्यज्य उभे ते तु क्रोधमूर्छितमूर्छिते .. 131.17 ..
6.3.m:
Having agreed with “So be it,” both went to their own house at night,
each overcome and reeling with anger.

6.3.s:
bandhugarvasya gatvā tu kathayāmāsa taṃ paṇam .
kadrūrvinatayā sārddhaṃ yadvṛttaṃ pramadālaye .. 131.18 ..
6.3.d:
बन्धुगर्वस्य गत्वा तु कथयामास तं पणम् .
कद्रूर्विनतया सार्द्धं यद्वृत्तं प्रमदालये .. 131.18 ..
6.3.m:
Going to the assembly of her relatives, Kadrū told of that wager,
what had occurred with Vinatā in the women’s quarters.

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā bāndhavāḥ sarve kadrūputrāstathaiva ca .
na manyante hitaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mātrā vigarhitam .. 131.19 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा बान्धवाः सर्वे कद्रूपुत्रास्तथैव च .
न मन्यन्ते हितं कार्यं कृतं मात्रा विगर्हितम् .. 131.19 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing that, all the relatives, the sons of Kadrū as well,
did not regard as beneficial that disgraceful deed done by their mother.

6.3.s:
akṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇatāmamba kathaṃ gaccheddhayottamaḥ .
dāsatvaṃ prāpsyase tvaṃ hi paṇenānena suvrate .. 131.20 ..
6.3.d:
अकृष्णः कृष्णतामम्ब कथं गच्छेद्धयोत्तमः .
दासत्वं प्राप्स्यसे त्वं हि पणेनानेन सुव्रते .. 131.20 ..
6.3.m:
“How could this best of horses, not black, become black, O mother?
You indeed will fall into slavery by this wager, O virtuous one!”

6.3.s:
kadrūruvāca -
bhaveyaṃ na yathādāsī tatkurudhvaṃ hi satvaram .
viśadhvaṃ romakūpeṣu tasyāśvasya matirmama .. 131.21 ..
6.3.d:
कद्रूरुवाच -
भवेयं न यथादासी तत्कुरुध्वं हि सत्वरम् .
विशध्वं रोमकूपेषु तस्याश्वस्य मतिर्मम .. 131.21 ..
6.3.m:
Kadrū said:
“Act quickly so that I may not become a slave-girl!
Enter the hair-pores of that horse; that is my intention.

6.3.s:
kṣaṇamātraṃ kṛte kārye sā dāsī ca bhavenmama .
tataḥ svasthoragāḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha yathāsukham .. 131.22 ..
6.3.d:
क्षणमात्रं कृते कार्ये सा दासी च भवेन्मम .
ततः स्वस्थोरगाः सर्वे भविष्यथ यथासुखम् .. 131.22 ..
6.3.m:
Once the task is accomplished for even a moment, she will become my slave-girl.
Then all of you serpents will be at ease and live comfortably.”

6.3.s:
sarpā ūcuḥ .
yathā tvaṃ jananī devi pannagānāṃ matā bhuvi .
tathāpi sā viśeṣeṇa vañcitavyā na karhicit .. 131.23 ..
6.3.d:
सर्पा ऊचुः .
यथा त्वं जननी देवि पन्नगानां मता भुवि .
तथापि सा विशेषेण वञ्चितव्या न कर्हिचित् .. 131.23 ..
6.3.m:
The serpents said:
“Though you are recognized as the mother of serpents on earth, O goddess,
even so, she must never be deceived by any means.”

6.3.s:
kadrūruvāca -
mama vākyamakurvāṇā ye kecidbhuvi pannagāḥ .
havyavāhamukhaṃ sarve te yāsyantyavicāritāḥ .. 131.24 ..
6.3.d:
कद्रूरुवाच -
मम वाक्यमकुर्वाणा ये केचिद्भुवि पन्नगाः .
हव्यवाहमुखं सर्वे ते यास्यन्त्यविचारिताः .. 131.24 ..
6.3.m:
Kadrū said:
“Whichever serpents on earth do not obey my command,
they all shall go into the mouth of the fire without doubt!”

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ ghoraṃ mātṛmukhodbhavam .
kecitpraviṣṭā romāṇi tathānye girisaṃsthitāḥ .. 131.25 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं घोरं मातृमुखोद्भवम् .
केचित्प्रविष्टा रोमाणि तथान्ये गिरिसंस्थिताः .. 131.25 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing this terrible curse uttered from their mother’s mouth,
some entered the hair, while others went to dwell on the mountains;

6.3.s: kecitpraviṣṭā jāhnavyāmanye ca tapasi sthitāḥ .. 131.26 ..
6.3.d: केचित्प्रविष्टा जाह्नव्यामन्ये च तपसि स्थिताः .. 131.26 ..
6.3.m: some entered the Gaṅgā, and others engaged in austerity.

6.3.s:
tato varṣasahasrānte tutoṣa parameśvaraḥ .
mahādevo jagaddhātā hyuvāca parayā girā .. 131.27 ..
6.3.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते तुतोष परमेश्वरः .
महादेवो जगद्धाता ह्युवाच परया गिरा .. 131.27 ..
6.3.m:
Then, at the end of a thousand years, the supreme Lord was pleased;
Mahādeva, the creator of the world, spoke in an exalted voice:

6.3.s:
bho bhoḥ sarpā nivartadhvaṃ tapaso'sya mahatphalam .
yamicchatha dadāmyadya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 131.28 ..
6.3.d:
भो भोः सर्पा निवर्तध्वं तपसोऽस्य महत्फलम् .
यमिच्छथ ददाम्यद्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 131.28 ..
6.3.m:
“O serpents, desist! Great is the fruit of this austerity.
Whatever you desire, I give today; there need be no hesitation here.”

6.3.s:
sarpā ūcuḥ .
kadrūśāpabhayādbhītā devadeva maheśvara .
tava pārśve vasiṣyāmo yāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 131.29 ..
6.3.d:
सर्पा ऊचुः .
कद्रूशापभयाद्भीता देवदेव महेश्वर .
तव पार्श्वे वसिष्यामो यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 131.29 ..
6.3.m:
The serpents said:
“Afraid from the fear of Kadrū’s curse, O God of gods, Maheśvara,
we wish to dwell by your side until the dissolution of all beings.”

6.3.s:
devadeva uvāca -
ekaścāyaṃ mahābāhurvāsukirbhujagottamaḥ .
mama pārśve vasennityaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhayarakṣakaḥ .. 131.30 ..
6.3.d:
देवदेव उवाच -
एकश्चायं महाबाहुर्वासुकिर्भुजगोत्तमः .
मम पार्श्वे वसेन्नित्यं सर्वेषां भयरक्षकः .. 131.30 ..
6.3.m:
The God of gods said:
“This mighty-armed Vāsuki alone, the best of serpents,
shall dwell constantly by my side, the protector of all from fear.

6.3.s:
anyeṣāṃ caiva sarpāṇāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti mamājñayā .
āplutya narmadātoye bhujagāste ca rakṣitāḥ .. 131.31 ..
6.3.d:
अन्येषां चैव सर्पाणां भयं नास्ति ममाज्ञया .
आप्लुत्य नर्मदातोये भुजगास्ते च रक्षिताः .. 131.31 ..
6.3.m:
And for the other serpents, there is no fear, by my command.
Having bathed in the waters of the Narmadā, those serpents are protected.

6.3.s:
nāsti mṛtyubhayaṃ teṣāṃ vasadhvaṃ yatra cepsitam .
kadrūśāpabhayaṃ nāsti hyeṣa me vistaraḥ paraḥ .. 131.32 ..
6.3.d:
नास्ति मृत्युभयं तेषां वसध्वं यत्र चेप्सितम् .
कद्रूशापभयं नास्ति ह्येष मे विस्तरः परः .. 131.32 ..
6.3.m:
There is no fear of death for them; dwell wherever you wish.
There is no fear of Kadrū’s curse; this indeed is my supreme assurance.”

6.3.s:
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ teṣāṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
jagāmākāśamāviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam .. 131.33 ..
6.3.d:
एवं दत्त्वा वरं तेषां देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
जगामाकाशमाविश्य कैलासं धरणीधरम् .. 131.33 ..
6.3.m:
Having thus granted them a boon, the God of gods, Maheśvara,
entering the sky, departed to the Kailāsa mountain.

6.3.s:
gate cādarśanaṃ deve vāsukipramukhā nṛpa .
sthāpayitvā tathā jagmurdevadevaṃ maheśvaram .. 131.34 ..
6.3.d:
गते चादर्शनं देवे वासुकिप्रमुखा नृप .
स्थापयित्वा तथा जग्मुर्देवदेवं महेश्वरम् .. 131.34 ..
6.3.m:
When the god had vanished, O king, [the serpents] led by Vāsuki,
having consecrated the God of gods, Maheśvara, departed likewise.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścitpañcamyāmarcayecchivam .
tasya nāgakulānyaṣṭau na hiṃsanti kadācana .. 131.35 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कश्चित्पञ्चम्यामर्चयेच्छिवम् .
तस्य नागकुलान्यष्टौ न हिंसन्ति कदाचन .. 131.35 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever worships Śiva at that sacred ford on the fifth day,
the eight families of serpents never harm him.

6.3.s:
mṛtaḥ kālena mahatā tatra tīrthe nareśvara .
śivasyānucaro bhūtvā vasate kālamīpsitam .. 131.36 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nāgeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
मृतः कालेन महता तत्र तीर्थे नरेश्वर .
शिवस्यानुचरो भूत्वा वसते कालमीप्सितम् .. 131.36 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नागेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Dying after a long time at that sacred ford, O king,
he becomes an attendant of Śiva and dwells [with him] for the desired time.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Nāgeśvara Tīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 132
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra uttare narmadātaṭe .
sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ vārāhaṃ nāma nāmataḥ .. 132.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 132
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र उत्तरे नर्मदातटे .
सर्वपापहरं तीर्थं वाराहं नाम नामतः .. 132.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 132
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the northern bank of the Narmadā, / to the sacred ford that removes all sins, named Vārāha by name.

6.3.s:
tatra devo jagaddhātā vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ .
sthito lokahitārthāya saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ .. 132.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र देवो जगद्धाता वाराहं रूपमास्थितः .
स्थितो लोकहितार्थाय संसारार्णवतारकः .. 132.2 ..
6.3.m: There the god, the creator of the world, assuming the boar form, / remained for the welfare of the world, carrying [souls] across the ocean of worldly existence.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddharaṇīdharam .
gandhamālyaviśeṣaiśca jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ .. 132.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्धरणीधरम् .
गन्धमाल्यविशेषैश्च जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः .. 132.3 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and worships the Supporter of the Earth / with specific perfumes and garlands, and auspicious cries of victory and the like,

6.3.s:
upavāsaparo bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ nṛpasattama .
vṛṣalāḥ pāpakarmāṇastathaivāndhapiśācinaḥ .. 132.4 ..
6.3.d:
उपवासपरो भूत्वा द्वादश्यां नृपसत्तम .
वृषलाः पापकर्माणस्तथैवान्धपिशाचिनः .. 132.4 ..
6.3.m: intent upon fasting on the twelfth lunar day, O best of kings— / [keeping away from] Śūdras of sinful deeds, and likewise blind Piśācas;

6.3.s:
ālāpādgātrasaṃparkānniḥśvāsātsahabhojanāt .
pāpaṃ saṃkramate yasmāttasmāttān parivarjayet .. 132.5 ..
6.3.d:
आलापाद्गात्रसंपर्कान्निःश्वासात्सहभोजनात् .
पापं संक्रमते यस्मात्तस्मात्तान् परिवर्जयेत् .. 132.5 ..
6.3.m: since sin is transmitted through conversation, bodily contact, exhalation, and dining together, / one should therefore avoid them.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇān pūjayedbhaktyā yathāśaktyā yathāvidhi .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathāyāṃ tatra bhārata .. 132.6 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणान् पूजयेद्भक्त्या यथाशक्त्या यथाविधि .
रात्रौ जागरणं कार्यं कथायां तत्र भारत .. 132.6 ..
6.3.m: One should worship brahmins with devotion according to one's ability and according to rule; / a vigil should be observed there at night during the recitation, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
prabhāte vimale snātvā tatra tīrthe jagadgurum .
ye paśyanti jitakrodhāste muktāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ .. 132.7 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभाते विमले स्नात्वा तत्र तीर्थे जगद्गुरुम् .
ये पश्यन्ति जितक्रोधास्ते मुक्ताः सर्वपातकैः .. 132.7 ..
6.3.m: Those who, having bathed at that sacred ford at clear dawn, / look upon the teacher of the universe with anger conquered, are freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
yathā tu dṛṣṭvā bhujagāḥ suparṇaṃ naśyanti muktvā viṣamugratejaḥ .
naśyanti pāpāni tathaiva śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ śūkararūpiṇastu .. 132.8 ..
6.3.d:
यथा तु दृष्ट्वा भुजगाः सुपर्णं नश्यन्ति मुक्त्वा विषमुग्रतेजः .
नश्यन्ति पापानि तथैव शीघ्रं दृष्ट्वा मुखं शूकररूपिणस्तु .. 132.8 ..
6.3.m: Just as serpents, on seeing Garuḍa, flee, abandoning their terrible burning venom, / even so sins quickly perish on seeing the face of him who has the form of a boar.

6.3.s:
nabhogataṃ naśyati cāndhakāraṃ dṛṣṭvā raviṃ devavaraṃ tathaiva .
naśyanti pāpāni sudustarāṇi dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ pārtha dharādharasya .. 132.9 ..
6.3.d:
नभोगतं नश्यति चान्धकारं दृष्ट्वा रविं देववरं तथैव .
नश्यन्ति पापानि सुदुस्तराणि दृष्ट्वा मुखं पार्थ धराधरस्य .. 132.9 ..
6.3.m: Just as darkness in the sky vanishes on seeing the sun, the foremost of gods, / even so insurmountable sins perish, O Pārtha, on seeing the face of the Supporter of the Earth.

6.3.s:
kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantrairbhaktiryasya janārdane .
namo nārāyaṇāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ .. 132.10 ..
6.3.d:
किं तस्य बहुभिर्मन्त्रैर्भक्तिर्यस्य जनार्दने .
नमो नारायणायेति मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः .. 132.10 ..
6.3.m: What need is there for many mantras for one whose devotion is directed to Janārdana? / The mantra "Obeisance to Nārāyaṇa" accomplishes all aims.

6.3.s:
eko'pi kṛṣṇasya kṛtaḥ praṇāmo daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthena tulyaḥ .
daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya .. 132.11 ..
6.3.d:
एकोऽपि कृष्णस्य कृतः प्रणामो दशाश्वमेधावभृथेन तुल्यः .
दशाश्वमेधी पुनरेति जन्म कृष्णप्रणामी न पुनर्भवाय .. 132.11 ..
6.3.m: Even a single obeisance offered to Kṛṣṇa is equal to the concluding bath of ten horse-sacrifices. / The performer of ten horse-sacrifices takes birth again, but one who bows to Kṛṣṇa is not [born] for rebirth.

6.3.s:
dhyāyamānā mahātmāno rūpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ hareḥ .
ye tyajanti svakaṃ dehaṃ tatra tīrthe jitendriyāḥ .. 132.12 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यायमाना महात्मानो रूपं नारायणं हरेः .
ये त्यजन्ति स्वकं देहं तत्र तीर्थे जितेन्द्रियाः .. 132.12 ..
6.3.m: Those great-souled ones with subdued senses who, meditating upon Hari's form as Nārāyaṇa, / cast off their own bodies at that sacred ford,

6.3.s:
te gacchantyamalaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham .
kṣarākṣaravinirmuktaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 132.13 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ādivārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
ते गच्छन्त्यमलं स्थानं यत्सुरैरपि दुर्लभम् .
क्षराक्षरविनिर्मुक्तं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् .. 132.13 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे आदिवाराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वात्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
go to the spotless abode that is difficult even for the gods to attain: / Viṣṇu's highest step, free from both the perishable and the imperishable.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-second chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Ādivārāha Sacred Ford", in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla paraṃ tīrthacatuṣṭayam .
yeṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल परं तीर्थचतुष्टयम् .
येषां दर्शनमात्रेण सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O protector of the earth, one should proceed to the excellent four sacred fords, / by the mere sight of which destruction of all sins occurs:

6.3.s:
kauberaṃ vāruṇaṃ yāmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ tu tataḥ param .
yatra siddhā mahāprājñā lokapālā mahābalāḥ .. 2 ..
6.3.d:
कौबेरं वारुणं याम्यं वायव्यं तु ततः परम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महाप्राज्ञा लोकपाला महाबलाः .. 2 ..
6.3.m: The sacred fords of Kubera, Varuṇa, Yama, and next to them that of Vāyu, / where the wise, very mighty guardians of the worlds achieved perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kimarthaṃ lokapālaiśca tapaścīrṇaṃ purānagha .
narmadātaṭamāśritya hyetanme vaktumarhasi .. 3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
किमर्थं लोकपालैश्च तपश्चीर्णं पुरानघ .
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य ह्येतन्मे वक्तुमर्हसि .. 3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For what purpose, O sinless one, was austerity performed by the guardians of the worlds in ancient times, / having resorted to the bank of the Narmadā? Truly, you should tell this to me.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
adhiṣṭhānaṃ samicchanti hyacalaṃ nirbale sati .
saṃsāre sarvabhūtānāṃ tṛṇabinduvadasthire .. 4 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
अधिष्ठानं समिच्छन्ति ह्यचलं निर्बले सति .
संसारे सर्वभूतानां तृणबिन्दुवदस्थिरे .. 4 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / They desired an unmoving, firm foundation in this weak, / unenduring saṃsāra of all beings, which is unstable like a drop of water on a blade of grass,

6.3.s:
kadalīsāraniḥsāre mṛgatṛṣṇeva cañcale .
sthāvare jaṅgame sarve bhūtagrāme caturvidhe .. 5 ..
6.3.d:
कदलीसारनिःसारे मृगतृष्णेव चञ्चले .
स्थावरे जङ्गमे सर्वे भूतग्रामे चतुर्विधे .. 5 ..
6.3.m: sapless like the core of a plantain tree, and flickering like a mirage, / among the whole fourfold collection of beings, both stationary and moving.

6.3.s:
dharmo mātā pitā dharmo dharmo bandhuḥ suhṛttathā .
ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ trailokye sacarācare .. 6 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मो माता पिता धर्मो धर्मो बन्धुः सुहृत्तथा .
आधारः सर्वभूतानां त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे .. 6 ..
6.3.m: Dharma is mother, dharma is father, dharma is kinsman, and likewise a friend; / it is the support of all living beings in the three worlds, both moving and unmoving.

6.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā tu te sarve lokapālāḥ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ .
tapaste cakruratulaṃ mārutāhāratatparāḥ .. 7 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु ते सर्वे लोकपालाः कृतक्षणाः .
तपस्ते चक्रुरतुलं मारुताहारतत्पराः .. 7 ..
6.3.m: Knowing thus, all those guardians of the worlds, having prepared themselves, / performed matchless austerity, dedicated to subsisting solely on air.

6.3.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ kṛtasyārddhe gate tadā .
anurūpeṇa rājendra yugasya parameśvaraḥ .. 8 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवः कृतस्यार्द्धे गते तदा .
अनुरूपेण राजेन्द्र युगस्य परमेश्वरः .. 8 ..
6.3.m: Then Mahādeva, the supreme lord, became pleased, O king of kings, / when half of the Kṛta age had passed, in a manner suitable to that yuga.

6.3.s:
vareṇa chandayāmāsa lokapālānmahābalān .
yo yamicchati kāmaṃ vai taṃ taṃ tasya dadāmyaham .. 9 ..
6.3.d:
वरेण छन्दयामास लोकपालान्महाबलान् .
यो यमिच्छति कामं वै तं तं तस्य ददाम्यहम् .. 9 ..
6.3.m: He invited the mighty guardians of the worlds with a boon, [saying]: / "Whatever desire each one wishes, that indeed I grant to him."

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacastasya lokapālā jagaddhitāḥ .
varadaṃ prārthayāmāsurdevaṃ varamanuttamam .. 10 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य लोकपाला जगद्धिताः .
वरदं प्रार्थयामासुर्देवं वरमनुत्तमम् .. 10 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this speech of his, the guardians of the worlds, intent on the welfare of the world, / prayed to the boon-granting god for an unexcelled boon.

6.3.s:
kubera uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama .
yakṣāṇāmīśvaraścāhaṃ bhavāmi dhanadastviti .. 11 ..
6.3.d:
कुबेर उवाच -
यदि तुष्टो महादेव यदि देयो वरो मम .
यक्षाणामीश्वरश्चाहं भवामि धनदस्त्विति .. 11 ..
6.3.m: Kubera said: / "If you are pleased, O Mahādeva, and if a boon is to be given to me, / may I become the lord of the yakṣas and the bestower of wealth!"

6.3.s:
tataḥ provāca deveśaṃ yamaḥ saṃyamane rataḥ .
tatra pradhāno bhagavān bhaveyaṃ sarvajantuṣu .. 12 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रोवाच देवेशं यमः संयमने रतः .
तत्र प्रधानो भगवान् भवेयं सर्वजन्तुषु .. 12 ..
6.3.m: Then Yama, devoted to restraint, said to the lord of the gods: / "May I become the venerable chief among all creatures there!"

6.3.s:
varuṇo'nantaraṃ prāha praṇamya tu maheśvaram .
krīḍeyaṃ vāruṇe loke yādogaṇasamanvitaḥ .. 13 ..
6.3.d:
वरुणोऽनन्तरं प्राह प्रणम्य तु महेश्वरम् .
क्रीडेयं वारुणे लोके यादोगणसमन्वितः .. 13 ..
6.3.m: Next Varuṇa spoke, having bowed down to Maheśvara: / "May I sport in the realm of Varuṇa, accompanied by the host of aquatic creatures!"

6.3.s:
jagādāśu tato vāyuḥ praṇamya tu maheśvaram .
vyāpakatvaṃ trilokeṣu prārthayāmāsa bhārata .. 14 ..
6.3.d:
जगादाशु ततो वायुः प्रणम्य तु महेश्वरम् .
व्यापकत्वं त्रिलोकेषु प्रार्थयामास भारत .. 14 ..
6.3.m: Then Vāyu quickly spoke, having bowed down to Maheśvara; / he prayed for all-pervasiveness in the three worlds, O descendant of Bharata.

6.3.s:
teṣāṃ yadīpsitaṃ kāmamumayā saha śaṅkaraḥ .
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānaḥ dattvā cādarśanaṃ gataḥ .. 15 ..
6.3.d:
तेषां यदीप्सितं काममुमया सह शङ्करः .
सर्वेषां लोकपालानः दत्त्वा चादर्शनं गतः .. 15 ..
6.3.m: Having granted to all the guardians of the worlds their desired wish, / Śaṅkara, along with Umā, disappeared from sight.

6.3.s:
gate maheśvare deve yathāsthānaṃ tu te sthitāḥ .
sthāpanā ca kṛtā sarvaiḥ svanāmnaiva pṛthakpṛthak .. 16 ..
6.3.d:
गते महेश्वरे देवे यथास्थानं तु ते स्थिताः .
स्थापना च कृता सर्वैः स्वनाम्नैव पृथक्पृथक् .. 16 ..
6.3.m: When the divine Maheśvara had departed, they remained in their respective places, / and an installation was made by all of them, separately under their own names:

6.3.s:
kuberaśca kubereśaṃ yamaścaiva yameśvaram .
varuṇo varuṇeśaṃ tu vāto vāteśvaraṃ nṛpa .. 17 ..
6.3.d:
कुबेरश्च कुबेरेशं यमश्चैव यमेश्वरम् .
वरुणो वरुणेशं तु वातो वातेश्वरं नृप .. 17 ..
6.3.m: Kubera [installed] Kubereśa, Yama [installed] Yameśvara, / Varuṇa [installed] Varuṇeśa, and Vāyu [installed] Vāteśvara, O king.

6.3.s:
tarpaṇaṃ vidadhuḥ sarve mantraiśca vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ .
sarve sarveśvaraṃ deva pūjayitvā yathāvidhi .. 18 ..
6.3.d:
तर्पणं विदधुः सर्वे मन्त्रैश्च विविधैः शुभैः .
सर्वे सर्वेश्वरं देव पूजयित्वा यथाविधि .. 18 ..
6.3.m: They all performed libations with various auspicious mantras, / after worshipping the god, the lord of all, according to the prescribed rules.

6.3.s:
āhvayāmāsustān viprānsarve sarveśvarā iva .
kṣāntadāntajitakrodhānsarvabhūtābhayapradān .. 19 ..
6.3.d:
आह्वयामासुस्तान् विप्रान्सर्वे सर्वेश्वरा इव .
क्षान्तदान्तजितक्रोधान्सर्वभूताभयप्रदान् .. 19 ..
6.3.m: Like lords of all, they summoned those brahmins / who were patient, self-controlled, who had conquered anger, and who granted fearlessness to all beings,

6.3.s:
vedavidyāvratasnātān sarvaśāstraviśāradān .
ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃyuktāṃstathātharvavibhūṣitān .. 20 ..
6.3.d:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नातान् सर्वशास्त्रविशारदान् .
ऋग्यजुःसामसंयुक्तांस्तथाथर्वविभूषितान् .. 20 ..
6.3.m: who had completed their ritual ablutions after Vedic learning and observances, who were skilled in all scriptures, / endowed with the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, and adorned with the Atharvaveda.

6.3.s:
cāturvidhyaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ dānaṃ dāsyāma gṛhṇata .
evamuktvā tu sarveṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ dānamuttamam .. 21 ..
6.3.d:
चातुर्विध्यं तु सर्वेषां दानं दास्याम गृह्णत .
एवमुक्त्वा तु सर्वेषां विप्राणां दानमुत्तमम् .. 21 ..
6.3.m: "We shall give a fourfold gift to all of you; accept it!" / Having spoken thus, [and giving] an excellent gift to all the brahmins,

6.3.s:
tatra sthāne dadusteṣāṃ bhūmidānamanuttamam .
yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhati medinī .. 22 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थाने ददुस्तेषां भूमिदानमनुत्तमम् .
यावच्चन्द्रश्च सूर्यश्च यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी .. 22 ..
6.3.m: they gave them at that place the supreme gift of land: / "As long as the moon and the sun endure, as long as the earth stands,

6.3.s:
tāvaddānaṃ tu yuṣmākaṃ paripanthī na kaścana .
rājā vā rājatulyo vā lokapālairanuttamam .. 23 ..
6.3.d:
तावद्दानं तु युष्माकं परिपन्थी न कश्चन .
राजा वा राजतुल्यो वा लोकपालैरनुत्तमम् .. 23 ..
6.3.m: so long is this gift yours; let no one oppose it, / whether a king or one equal to a king. If an unexcelled [gift]

6.3.s:
dattaṃ lopayate mūḍhaḥ śrūyatāṃ tasya yo vidhiḥ .
śoṣayeddhanado vittaṃ tasya pāpasya bhārata .. 24 ..
6.3.d:
दत्तं लोपयते मूढः श्रूयतां तस्य यो विधिः .
शोषयेद्धनदो वित्तं तस्य पापस्य भारत .. 24 ..
6.3.m: given by the guardians of the worlds is revoked by a fool, hear the fate that awaits him: / The bestower of wealth shall dry up the wealth of that sinner, O descendant of Bharata;

6.3.s:
śarīraṃ varuṇo devaḥ saṃtatīṃ śvasanastathā .
āyurnayati tasyāśu yamaḥ saṃyamano mahān .. 25 ..
6.3.d:
शरीरं वरुणो देवः संततीं श्वसनस्तथा .
आयुर्नयति तस्याशु यमः संयमनो महान् .. 25 ..
6.3.m: the divine Varuṇa [shall dry up] his body; wind [shall dry up] his progeny; / and the great Yama, the restrainer, shall swiftly carry away his lifespan.

6.3.s:
niḥśeṣaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā hutabhugyāti bhārata .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira .
bhaktiḥ kāryā nṛpaiḥ sarvairicchadbhiḥ śreya ātmanaḥ .. 26 ..
6.3.d:
निःशेषं भस्मसात्कृत्वा हुतभुग्याति भारत .
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर .
भक्तिः कार्या नृपैः सर्वैरिच्छद्भिः श्रेय आत्मनः .. 26 ..
6.3.m: The fire-consumer goes away, O descendant of Bharata, having reduced it completely to ashes. / Therefore, with every effort, devotion must be shown to the brahmins, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / by all kings who desire their own welfare.

6.3.s:
rājā vṛkṣo brāhmaṇāstasya mūlaṃ bhṛtyāḥ parṇā mantriṇastasya śākhāḥ .
tasmānmūlaṃ yatnato rakṣaṇīyaṃ mūle gupte nāsti vṛkṣasya nāśaḥ .. 27 ..
6.3.d:
राजा वृक्षो ब्राह्मणास्तस्य मूलं भृत्याः पर्णा मन्त्रिणस्तस्य शाखाः .
तस्मान्मूलं यत्नतो रक्षणीयं मूले गुप्ते नास्ति वृक्षस्य नाशः .. 27 ..
6.3.m: A king is a tree; the brahmins are its roots; servants are the leaves, and ministers are its branches. / Therefore, the root must be protected with effort; when the root is protected, there is no destruction of the tree.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati bhūmidaḥ .
ācchettā cāvamantā ca tānyeva narake vaset .. 28 ..
6.3.d:
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे तिष्ठति भूमिदः .
आच्छेत्ता चावमन्ता च तान्येव नरके वसेत् .. 28 ..
6.3.m: The giver of land dwells in heaven for sixty thousand years; / both the one who confiscates it and the one who disparages it shall dwell in hell for just as many.

6.3.s:
svadattā paradattā vā pālanīyā vasuṃdharā .
yasya yasya yadā bhūmistasya tasya tadā phalam .. 29 ..
6.3.d:
स्वदत्ता परदत्ता वा पालनीया वसुंधरा .
यस्य यस्य यदा भूमिस्तस्य तस्य तदा फलम् .. 29 ..
6.3.m: The earth, whether given by oneself or given by another, must be protected; / whosoever possesses the land at any time, his is the fruit at that time.

6.3.s:
devatājñāmanusmṛtya rājāno ye'pi tāṃ nṛpa .
pālayiṣyanti satataṃ teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape .. 30 ..
6.3.d:
देवताज्ञामनुस्मृत्य राजानो येऽपि तां नृप .
पालयिष्यन्ति सततं तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे .. 30 ..
6.3.m: Whichever kings, remembering the command of the gods, O king, / will constantly protect it, their dwelling shall be in heaven.

6.3.s:
svadattā paradattā vā yatnādrakṣyā yudhiṣṭhira .
mahī mahīkṣitā nityaṃ dānācchreyo'nupālanam .. 31 ..
6.3.d:
स्वदत्ता परदत्ता वा यत्नाद्रक्ष्या युधिष्ठिर .
मही महीक्षिता नित्यं दानाच्छ्रेयोऽनुपालनम् .. 31 ..
6.3.m: Whether given by oneself or given by another, O Yudhiṣṭhira, the earth / must always be protected with care by kings; protecting [a gift] is superior to giving.

6.3.s:
āyuryaśo balaṃ vittaṃ saṃtatiścākṣayā nṛpa .
teṣāṃ bhaviṣyate nūnaṃ ye prajāpālane ratāḥ .. 32 ..
6.3.d:
आयुर्यशो बलं वित्तं संततिश्चाक्षया नृप .
तेषां भविष्यते नूनं ये प्रजापालने रताः .. 32 ..
6.3.m: Lifespan, fame, strength, wealth, and imperishable offspring, O king, / shall surely belong to those who are devoted to protecting their subjects.

6.3.s:
evamuktvā tu tān sarvāṃllokapālān dvijottamān .
pūjayitvā vidhānena praṇipatya vyasarjayan .. 33 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु तान् सर्वांल्लोकपालान् द्विजोत्तमान् .
पूजयित्वा विधानेन प्रणिपत्य व्यसर्जयन् .. 33 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus to all those excellent brahmins, the guardians of the worlds, / having worshipped them according to the rules and bowed down, dismissed them.

6.3.s:
gateṣu vipramukhyeṣu snātvā hutahutāśanāḥ .
lokapālāḥ kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ paryaṭanbhaikṣamātmanaḥ .. 34 ..
6.3.d:
गतेषु विप्रमुख्येषु स्नात्वा हुतहुताशनाः .
लोकपालाः क्षुधाविष्टाः पर्यटन्भैक्षमात्मनः .. 34 ..
6.3.m: When the foremost brahmins had departed, the guardians of the worlds, having bathed and made offerings into the sacred fire, / afflicted with hunger, wandered about seeking alms for themselves.

6.3.s:
asthicarmāvaśeṣāṅgāḥ kapāloddhṛtapāṇayaḥ .
alabdhagrāsamarddhārdhaṃ niryayurnagarādbahiḥ .. 35 ..
6.3.d:
अस्थिचर्मावशेषाङ्गाः कपालोद्धृतपाणयः .
अलब्धग्रासमर्द्धार्धं निर्ययुर्नगराद्बहिः .. 35 ..
6.3.m: With limbs reduced to mere skin and bone, holding skull-bowls up in their hands, / not obtaining even a fraction of a morsel, they went outside the city.

6.3.s:
śāpaṃ dattvā tadā krodhādbrāhmaṇāya yudhiṣṭhira .
daridrāḥ satataṃ mūrkhā bhaveyuśca yayurgṛhān .. 36 ..
6.3.d:
शापं दत्त्वा तदा क्रोधाद्ब्राह्मणाय युधिष्ठिर .
दरिद्राः सततं मूर्खा भवेयुश्च ययुर्गृहान् .. 36 ..
6.3.m: Then, having in anger uttered a curse upon the brahmins, O Yudhiṣṭhira: / "May they always be poor and foolish!", they went to their abodes.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti te sarve brāhmaṇā dhanavarjitāḥ .
śāpadoṣeṇa kauberyāṃ saṃjātā duḥkhabhājanāḥ .. 37 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति ते सर्वे ब्राह्मणा धनवर्जिताः .
शापदोषेण कौबेर्यां संजाता दुःखभाजनाः .. 37 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, all those brahmins became devoid of wealth; / through the fault of the curse, they became vessels of sorrow in Kauberī.

6.3.s:
na dhanaṃ paitṛkaṃ putrairna pitā putrapautrikam .
bhuñjate sakalaṃ kālamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 38 ..
6.3.d:
न धनं पैतृकं पुत्रैर्न पिता पुत्रपौत्रिकम् .
भुञ्जते सकलं कालमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 38 ..
6.3.m: "The sons shall not enjoy ancestral wealth, nor the father that of sons and grandsons, / at any time": thus indeed spoke Śaṃkara. 38 ..

6.3.s:
kubereśe naraḥ snātvā yastu pūjayate śivam .
gandhadhūpanamaskāraiḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 39 ..
6.3.d:
कुबेरेशे नरः स्नात्वा यस्तु पूजयते शिवम् .
गन्धधूपनमस्कारैः सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 39 ..
6.3.m: The man who, having bathed at Kubereśa, worships Śiva / with perfumes, incense, and obeisances, obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice. 39 ..

6.3.s:
yamatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā sampaśyati yameśvaram .
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta saptajanmāntarārjitaiḥ .. 40 ..
6.3.d:
यमतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा सम्पश्यति यमेश्वरम् .
सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्येत सप्तजन्मान्तरार्जितैः .. 40 ..
6.3.m: He who, having bathed at Yamatīrtha, beholds Yameśvara, / is freed from all sins acquired over seven previous births. 40 ..

6.3.s:
pūrṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ snātvā tu pitṛtarpaṇam .
yaḥ karoti tilaiḥ snānaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 41 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्णमास्याममावास्यां स्नात्वा तु पितृतर्पणम् .
यः करोति तिलैः स्नानं तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 41 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed on a full-moon or new-moon day and offered libations to the ancestors, / whoever performs an ablution with sesame seeds—hear the fruit of his merit: 41 ..

6.3.s:
sutṛptāstena toyena pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ .
svargasthā dvādaśābdāni krīḍanti prapitāmahāḥ .. 42 ..
6.3.d:
सुतृप्तास्तेन तोयेन पितरश्च पितामहाः .
स्वर्गस्था द्वादशाब्दानि क्रीडन्ति प्रपितामहाः .. 42 ..
6.3.m: Thoroughly satisfied with that water, the fathers, grandfathers, / and great-grandfathers, dwelling in heaven, sport for twelve years. 42 ..

6.3.s:
varuṇeśe naraḥ snātvā hyarcayitvā maheśvaram .
vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam .. 43 ..
6.3.d:
वरुणेशे नरः स्नात्वा ह्यर्चयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति पुष्कलम् .. 43 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes at Varuṇeśa and worships Maheśvara / attains the abundant fruit of a Vājapeya sacrifice. 43 ..

6.3.s:
mṛtāṃ kālena mahatā loke yatra jaleśvaraḥ .
sa gacchettatra yānena gīyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 44 ..
6.3.d:
मृतां कालेन महता लोके यत्र जलेश्वरः .
स गच्छेत्तत्र यानेन गीयमानोऽप्सरोगणैः .. 44 ..
6.3.m: Dying after a long time, to the world where the Lord of the Waters dwells, / he goes there in an aerial chariot, sung to by hosts of apsarases. 44 ..

6.3.s:
vāteśvare naraḥ snātvā sampūjya ca maheśvaram .
jāyate kṛtakṛtyo'sau lokapālānavekṣayan .. 45 ..
6.3.d:
वातेश्वरे नरः स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य च महेश्वरम् .
जायते कृतकृत्योऽसौ लोकपालानवेक्षयन् .. 45 ..
6.3.m: A man who bathes at Vāteśvara and worships Maheśvara / has accomplished his purpose, beholding the world-protectors. 45 ..

6.3.s:
kiṃ tasya bahubhiryajñairdānairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ .
snātvā catuṣṭaye loke avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam .. 46 ..
6.3.d:
किं तस्य बहुभिर्यज्ञैर्दानैर्वा बहुदक्षिणैः .
स्नात्वा चतुष्टये लोके अवाप्तं जन्मनः फलम् .. 46 ..
6.3.m: What need has he of many sacrifices, or gifts with abundant sacrificial fees? / By bathing in these four [places] in the world, the fruit of his birth is attained. 46 ..

6.3.s:
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam .
nityaṃ vasanti kaurilyāṃ lokapālānnimantrya ye .. 47 ..
6.3.d:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् .
नित्यं वसन्ति कौरिल्यां लोकपालान्निमन्त्र्य ये .. 47 ..
6.3.m: Blessed are they, great-souled are they, well-lived is their birth, / who dwell constantly at Kaurilī, having invoked the world-protectors. 47 ..

6.3.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyamāyurvivardhanam .
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 48 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kuberāditīrthacatuṣṭayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 134
6.3.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं धन्यमायुर्विवर्धनम् .
पठतां शृण्वतां चैव सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 48 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कुबेरादितीर्थचतुष्टयमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 134
6.3.m:
This is meritorious, sin-destroying, auspicious, and lifespan-increasing. / For those who recite it and listen to it, destruction of all sins shall occur. 48 ..
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Four Sacred Fords Beginning with Kubera', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 134

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle rāmeśvaramanuttamam .
tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam .. 134.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले रामेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .
तीर्थं पापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखघ्नमुत्तमम् .. 134.1 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
On the south bank of the Narmadā is the unsurpassed Rāmeśvara,
a holy sacred ford that removes sins, destroying all sorrows, supreme.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu ye snātvā pūjayanti maheśvaram .
mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 134.2 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe rāmeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 135
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु ये स्नात्वा पूजयन्ति महेश्वरम् .
महादेवं महात्मानं मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 134.2 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रामेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुस्त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 135
6.3.m:
Those who, having bathed at that sacred ford, worship Maheśvara,
Mahādeva, the great-souled one, are freed from all sins.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Rāmeśvara Tīrtha,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 135

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyatsiddheśvaramanuttamam .
tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam .. 135.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं चान्यत्सिद्धेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .
तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं सर्वलोकेषु पूजितम् .. 135.1 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Directly after that is another unsurpassed [sacred ford], Siddheśvara,
a sacred ford endowed with all virtues, worshipped in all the worlds.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā hyumārudraṃ prapūjayet .
vājapeyasya yajñasya sa labhetphalamuttamam .. 135.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा ह्युमारुद्रं प्रपूजयेत् .
वाजपेयस्य यज्ञस्य स लभेत्फलमुत्तमम् .. 135.2 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever, having bathed at that sacred ford, worships Umā and Rudra,
obtains the excellent fruit of the Vājapeya sacrifice.

6.3.s:
tena puṇyena mahatā mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnuyāt .
apsarogaṇasaṃvīto jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ .. 135.3 ..
6.3.d:
तेन पुण्येन महता मृतः स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात् .
अप्सरोगणसंवीतो जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः .. 135.3 ..
6.3.m:
Dying with that great merit, he attains heaven,
surrounded by groups of apsarases with auspicious shouts of victory and the like.

6.3.s:
sahasravatsarāṃstatra krīḍayitvā yathāsukham .
dhanadhānyasamopete kule mahati jāyate .. 135.4 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रवत्सरांस्तत्र क्रीडयित्वा यथासुखम् .
धनधान्यसमोपेते कुले महति जायते .. 135.4 ..
6.3.m:
Sporting there comfortably for a thousand years,
he is born into an exalted family endowed with wealth and grain.

6.3.s:
pūjyamāno naraśreṣṭha vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ .
vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 135.5 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 136
6.3.d:
पूज्यमानो नरश्रेष्ठ वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः .
व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 135.5 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 136
6.3.m:
Honored, O best of men, a master of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,
freed from disease and sorrow, he will live for a hundred autumns.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Siddheśvara', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 136

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla cāhalyeśvaramuttamam .
yatra siddhā mahābhāgā tvahalyā tāpasī purā .. 136.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल चाहल्येश्वरमुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा त्वहल्या तापसी पुरा .. 136.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, O king, one should go to the supreme Ahalyeśvara, / where formerly the illustrious female ascetic Ahalyā attained perfection. (1)

6.3.s:
gautamo brāhmaṇastvāsītsākṣādbrahmeva cāparaḥ .
satyadharmasamāyukto vānaprasthāśrame rataḥ .. 136.2 ..
6.3.d:
गौतमो ब्राह्मणस्त्वासीत्साक्षाद्ब्रह्मेव चापरः .
सत्यधर्मसमायुक्तो वानप्रस्थाश्रमे रतः .. 136.2 ..
6.3.m: There was a brahmin named Gautama, like another Brahmā in person, / endowed with truth and virtue, devoted to the stage of life of a forest-dweller. (2)

6.3.s:
tasya patnī mahābhāgā hyahalyā nāma viśrutā .
rūpayauvanasampannā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutā .. 136.3 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य पत्नी महाभागा ह्यहल्या नाम विश्रुता .
रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुता .. 136.3 ..
6.3.m: His wife was renowned by the name of Ahalyā, highly fortunate, / endowed with beauty and youth, celebrated throughout the three worlds. (3)

6.3.s:
asyā apyatirūpeṇa devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ .
mohito lobhayāmāsa hyahalyāṃ balasūdanaḥ .. 136.4 ..
6.3.d:
अस्या अप्यतिरूपेण देवराजः शतक्रतुः .
मोहितो लोभयामास ह्यहल्यां बलसूदनः .. 136.4 ..
6.3.m: Bewitched by her surpassing beauty, the king of gods, Śatakratu, / the slayer of Bala, attempted to seduce Ahalyā: (4)

6.3.s:
māṃ bhajasva varārohe devarājamanindite .
krīḍayasva mayā sārddhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā .. 136.5 ..
6.3.d:
मां भजस्व वरारोहे देवराजमनिन्दिते .
क्रीडयस्व मया सार्द्धं त्रिषु लोकेषु पूजिता .. 136.5 ..
6.3.m: 'Take pleasure in me, O fair-hipped woman, blameless one, the king of the gods! / Sport with me, you who are revered across the three worlds! (5)

6.3.s:
kiṃ kariṣyasi vipreṇa śaucācārakṛśena tu .
tapaḥsvādhyāyaśīlena kliśyantīva sulocane .. 136.6 ..
6.3.d:
किं करिष्यसि विप्रेण शौचाचारकृशेन तु .
तपःस्वाध्यायशीलेन क्लिश्यन्तीव सुलोचने .. 136.6 ..
6.3.m: What will you do with a brahmin who is emaciated from rites of purification and good conduct, / habitually given to austerity and Vedic study, while you suffer as it were, O lovely-eyed woman?' (6)

6.3.s:
evamuktā varārohā strīsvabhāvātsucañcalā .
manasādhyāya śakraṃ sā kāmena kaluṣīkṛtā .. 136.7 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्ता वरारोहा स्त्रीस्वभावात्सुचञ्चला .
मनसाध्याय शक्रं सा कामेन कलुषीकृता .. 136.7 ..
6.3.m: Spoken to in this manner, that fair-hipped woman, very fickle by womanly nature, / turned her mind toward Śakra, defiled by lust. (7)

6.3.s:
tasyā viditvā taṃ bhāvaṃ sa devaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ .
gautamaṃ vañcayāmāsa duṣṭabhāvena bhāvitaḥ .. 136.8 ..
6.3.d:
तस्या विदित्वा तं भावं स देवः पाकशासनः .
गौतमं वञ्चयामास दुष्टभावेन भावितः .. 136.8 ..
6.3.m: Knowing that disposition of hers, that god, the chastiser of Pāka, / influenced by wicked intent, deceived Gautama. (8)

6.3.s:
viditvā cāntaraṃ tasya gṛhītvā veṣamuttamam .
ahalyāṃ ramayāmāsa viśvastāṃ mandirāntike .. 136.9 ..
6.3.d:
विदित्वा चान्तरं तस्य गृहीत्वा वेषमुत्तमम् .
अहल्यां रमयामास विश्वस्तां मन्दिरान्तिके .. 136.9 ..
6.3.m: Finding an opportunity and assuming an excellent disguise, / he sported near the dwelling with Ahalyā, who was unsuspecting. (9)

6.3.s:
kṣaṇamātrāntare tatra devarājasya bhārata .
ājagāma muniśreṣṭho mandiraṃ tvarayānvitaḥ .. 136.10 ..
6.3.d:
क्षणमात्रान्तरे तत्र देवराजस्य भारत .
आजगाम मुनिश्रेष्ठो मन्दिरं त्वरयान्वितः .. 136.10 ..
6.3.m: Within just a moment's interval of the king of gods' [presence] there, O Bhārata, / the best of sages swiftly came back to the dwelling. (10)

6.3.s:
āgataṃ gautamaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītabhītaḥ puraṃdaraḥ .
nirgataḥ sa tato dṛṣṭvā śakro'yamiti cintayan .. 136.11 ..
6.3.d:
आगतं गौतमं दृष्ट्वा भीतभीतः पुरंदरः .
निर्गतः स ततो दृष्ट्वा शक्रोऽयमिति चिन्तयन् .. 136.11 ..
6.3.m: Seeing Gautama arrive, Puraṃdara, terrified, / fled from there; and Gautama, observing him, thought, 'This is Śakra.' (11)

6.3.s:
tataḥ śaśāpa devendraṃ gautamaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ .
ajitendriyo'si yasmāttvaṃ tasmādbahubhago bhava .. 136.12 ..
6.3.d:
ततः शशाप देवेन्द्रं गौतमः क्रोधमूर्छितः .
अजितेन्द्रियोऽसि यस्मात्त्वं तस्माद्बहुभगो भव .. 136.12 ..
6.3.m: Then Gautama, faint with rage, cursed the lord of the gods: / 'Because you have not conquered your senses, therefore become covered with vulvas!' (12)

6.3.s:
evamuktastu devendrastatkṣaṇādeva bhārata .
bhagānāṃ tu sahasreṇa tatkṣaṇādeva veṣṭitaḥ .. 136.13 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन्द्रस्तत्क्षणादेव भारत .
भगानां तु सहस्रेण तत्क्षणादेव वेष्टितः .. 136.13 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed, O Bhārata, the lord of the gods at that very moment / was enveloped instantly by a thousand vulvas. (13)

6.3.s:
tyaktvā rājyaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ gataśrīko jagāma ha .
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ gautamena mahītale .. 136.14 ..
6.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं सुरैः सार्द्धं गतश्रीको जगाम ह .
तपश्चचार विपुलं गौतमेन महीतले .. 136.14 ..
6.3.m: Abandoning his kingdom along with the gods, stripped of fortune, he departed; / and he performed extensive austerity on the earth on account of Gautama. (14)

6.3.s:
ahalyāpi tataḥ śaptā yasmāttvaṃ duṣṭacāriṇī .
prekṣya māṃ ramase śakraṃ tasmādaśmamayī bhava .. 136.15 ..
6.3.d:
अहल्यापि ततः शप्ता यस्मात्त्वं दुष्टचारिणी .
प्रेक्ष्य मां रमसे शक्रं तस्मादश्ममयी भव .. 136.15 ..
6.3.m: Ahalyā too was then cursed: 'Because you are an unfaithful wife, / who, seeing me, sport with Śakra, therefore become turned to stone! (15)

6.3.s:
gate varṣasahasrānte rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaśasvinam .
tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena dhautapāpā bhaviṣyasi .. 136.16 ..
6.3.d:
गते वर्षसहस्रान्ते रामं दृष्ट्वा यशस्विनम् .
तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन धौतपापा भविष्यसि .. 136.16 ..
6.3.m: At the end of a thousand years, having seen the renowned Rāma / on the occasion of his pilgrimage, your sins will be washed away.' (16)

6.3.s:
evaṃ gate tataḥ kāle dṛṣṭā rāmeṇa dhīmatā .
viśvāmitrasahāyena tyaktvā sāśmamayīṃ tanum .. 136.17 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गते ततः काले दृष्टा रामेण धीमता .
विश्वामित्रसहायेन त्यक्त्वा साश्ममयीं तनुम् .. 136.17 ..
6.3.m: Then, when such time had passed, seen by the wise Rāma / accompanied by Viśvāmitra, she shed her stone form. (17)

6.3.s:
pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ gatapāpā vimatsarā .
āgatā narmadātīre tīrthe snātvā yathāvidhi .. 136.18 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं गतपापा विमत्सरा .
आगता नर्मदातीरे तीर्थे स्नात्वा यथाविधि .. 136.18 ..
6.3.m: Having duly worshipped him, freed from sin and devoid of malice, / she went to the bank of the Narmadā, and having bathed according to the rules at the sacred ford, (18)

6.3.s:
kṛtaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ cānyaṃ tataḥ param .
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dattvā varamanuttamam .. 136.19 ..
6.3.d:
कृतं चान्द्रायणं मासं कृच्छ्रं चान्यं ततः परम् .
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो दत्त्वा वरमनुत्तमम् .. 136.19 ..
6.3.m: she observed the cāndrāyaṇa vow for a month, and thereafter another severe penance. / Thereupon Mahādeva, pleased, granted her an incomparable boon, (19)

6.3.s:
jagāmādarśanaṃ bhūyo reme comāpatiściram .
ahalyā tu gate deve sthāpayitvā jagadgurum .. 136.20 ..
6.3.d:
जगामादर्शनं भूयो रेमे चोमापतिश्चिरम् .
अहल्या तु गते देवे स्थापयित्वा जगद्गुरुम् .. 136.20 ..
6.3.m: and vanished again; and the husband of Umā took delight for a long time. / When the god had departed, Ahalyā installed the Guru of the Universe, (20)

6.3.s:
ahalyeśvaranāmānaṃ svagṛhe cāgamatpunaḥ .
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .. 136.21 ..
6.3.d:
अहल्येश्वरनामानं स्वगृहे चागमत्पुनः .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .. 136.21 ..
6.3.m: named Ahalyeśvara, and returned to her own home. / Whoever bathes at that sacred ford and worships the Supreme Lord, (21)

6.3.s:
sa mṛtaḥ svargamāpnoti yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .
krīḍayitvā yathākāmaṃ tatra loke mahātapāḥ .. 136.22 ..
6.3.d:
स मृतः स्वर्गमाप्नोति यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .
क्रीडयित्वा यथाकामं तत्र लोके महातपाः .. 136.22 ..
6.3.m: upon death attains heaven, where the god Maheśvara resides. / Having sported as he desires in that world, the person of great austerity, (22)

6.3.s:
gate varṣasahasrānte mānuṣyaṃ labhate punaḥ .
dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .. 136.23 ..
6.3.d:
गते वर्षसहस्रान्ते मानुष्यं लभते पुनः .
धनधान्यचयोपेतः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः .. 136.23 ..
6.3.m: when a thousand years have passed, attains human birth once more, / endowed with an abundance of wealth and grain, accompanied by sons and grandsons. (23)

6.3.s:
vedavidyāśrayo dhīmāñjāyate vimale kule .
rūpasaubhāgyasampannaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgramahalyātīrthasevanāt .. 136.24 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ahalyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 137
6.3.d:
वेदविद्याश्रयो धीमाञ्जायते विमले कुले .
रूपसौभाग्यसम्पन्नः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः .
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रमहल्यातीर्थसेवनात् .. 136.24 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे अहल्यातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्त्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 137
6.3.m:
Wise and taking refuge in the Vedic sciences, he is born in a pure family, / endowed with beauty and good fortune, free from all diseases, / and lives for more than a hundred years through serving the sacred ford of Ahalyā. (24)
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Ahalyā Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 137

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
dharmaputra tato gacchetkarkaṭeśvaramuttamam .
uttare narmadākūle sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram .. 137.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
धर्मपुत्र ततो गच्छेत्कर्कटेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सर्वपापक्षयंकरम् .. 137.1 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
O Dharmaputra, one should then go to the excellent Karkaṭeśvara / on the northern bank of the Narmadā, which destroys all sins. (1)

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā vidhānena yastu pūjayate śivam .
anivartikā gatistasya rudralokādasaṃśayam .. 137.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन यस्तु पूजयते शिवम् .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकादसंशयम् .. 137.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes there according to the injunctions and worships Śiva, / his state of existence is non-returning from Rudra's world, without a doubt. (2)

6.3.s:
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ purāṇe yacchrutaṃ mayā .
na tadvarṇayituṃ śakyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa vadāmyataḥ .. 137.3 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं पुराणे यच्छ्रुतं मया .
न तद्वर्णयितुं शक्यं संक्षेपेण वदाम्यतः .. 137.3 ..
6.3.m: What I have heard in the Purāṇa regarding the māhātmya of that sacred ford / cannot be fully described; therefore I tell it in brief. (3)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kuryātkiṃcitkarma śubhāśubham .
harṣānmadānmahārāja tatsarvaṃ jāyate'kṣayam .. 137.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कुर्यात्किंचित्कर्म शुभाशुभम् .
हर्षान्मदान्महाराज तत्सर्वं जायतेऽक्षयम् .. 137.4 ..
6.3.m: Whatever deed, whether auspicious or inauspicious, one performs at that sacred ford / out of joy or intoxication, O great king, all of it becomes imperishable. (4)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā vālakhilyā marīcayaḥ .
ramante'dyāpi lokeṣu svecchayā kurunandana .. 137.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तपस्तप्त्वा वालखिल्या मरीचयः .
रमन्तेऽद्यापि लोकेषु स्वेच्छया कुरुनन्दन .. 137.5 ..
6.3.m: Having performed austerity at that sacred ford, the Vālakhilyas and the Marīcis / even today sport in the worlds at will, O delight of the Kurus! (5)

6.3.s:
tatrasthāstanna jānanti narājñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ .
śarīrasthamivātmānamakṣayaṃ jyotiravyayam .. 137.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रस्थास्तन्न जानन्ति नराज्ञानबहिष्कृताः .
शरीरस्थमिवात्मानमक्षयं ज्योतिरव्ययम् .. 137.6 ..
6.3.m: Those who dwell there do not know it, people excluded by ignorance, / like the imperishable, undecaying light, the Self situated within the body. (6)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha devī nārāyaṇī purā .
adyāpi tapate ghoraṃ tapo yāvatkilārbudam .. 137.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ देवी नारायणी पुरा .
अद्यापि तपते घोरं तपो यावत्किलार्बुदम् .. 137.7 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, O best of kings, the goddess Nārāyaṇī of old, / even today performs fierce austerity, indeed for an arbudam of years. (7)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptiṃ yānti pitāmahāḥ .. 137.8 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe karkaṭeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 138
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्तिं यान्ति पितामहाः .. 137.8 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कर्कटेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 138
6.3.m:
Whoever, having bathed at that sacred ford, offers libations to the ancestors and gods, / his forefathers attain satisfaction for twelve years. (8)
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Karkaṭeśvara Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 138

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchetpāṇḍuputra śakratīrthamanuttamam .
yatra siddho mahābhāgo devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ .. 138.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्पाण्डुपुत्र शक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धो महाभागो देवराजः शतक्रतुः .. 138.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, O son of Pāṇḍu, one should go to the supreme Śakratīrtha, / where the illustrious king of gods, Śatakratu, attained perfection. (1)

6.3.s:
gautamena purā śaptaṃ jñātvā devāḥ sureśvaram .
brahmādyā devatāḥ sarva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ .. 138.2 ..
6.3.d:
गौतमेन पुरा शप्तं ज्ञात्वा देवाः सुरेश्वरम् .
ब्रह्माद्या देवताः सर्व ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः .. 138.2 ..
6.3.m: Learning that the lord of the gods had formerly been cursed by Gautama, the gods, / all the deities beginning with Brahmā, and the seers rich in austerity, (2)

6.3.s:
gautamaṃ prārthayāmāsurvākyaiḥ sānunayaiḥ śubhaiḥ .
gatarājyaṃ gataśrīkaṃ śakraṃ prati munīśvara .. 138.3 ..
6.3.d:
गौतमं प्रार्थयामासुर्वाक्यैः सानुनयैः शुभैः .
गतराज्यं गतश्रीकं शक्रं प्रति मुनीश्वर .. 138.3 ..
6.3.m: entreated Gautama with concilatory and auspicious words / on behalf of Śakra, who had lost his kingdom and lost his fortune, O lord of sages: (3)

6.3.s:
indrena rahitaṃ rājyaṃ na kaścitkāmayeddvija .
devo vā mānavo vāpi etatte viditaṃ prabho .. 138.4 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रेन रहितं राज्यं न कश्चित्कामयेद्द्विज .
देवो वा मानवो वापि एतत्ते विदितं प्रभो .. 138.4 ..
6.3.m: 'Without Indra, no one desires the kingdom, O twice-born, / whether god or human; this is known to you, O lord. (4)

6.3.s:
tasya tvaṃ bhagayuktasya dayāṃ kuru dvijottama .
gataścādarśanaṃ śakro dūṣitaḥ svena pāpmanā .. 138.5 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य त्वं भगयुक्तस्य दयां कुरु द्विजोत्तम .
गतश्चादर्शनं शक्रो दूषितः स्वेन पाप्मना .. 138.5 ..
6.3.m: Take pity on him who is covered with vulvas, O best of the twice-born! / Śakra has vanished from sight, ruined by his own sin.' (5)

6.3.s:
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gautamo vedavittamaḥ .
tatheti kṛtvā śakrasya varaṃ dātuṃ pracakrame .. 138.6 ..
6.3.d:
देवानां वचनं श्रुत्वा गौतमो वेदवित्तमः .
तथेति कृत्वा शक्रस्य वरं दातुं प्रचक्रमे .. 138.6 ..
6.3.m: Hearing the words of the gods, Gautama, foremost among knowers of the Veda, / consented, saying, 'So be it,' and proceeded to grant a boon to Śakra. (6)

6.3.s:
etadbhagasahasraṃ tu purā jātaṃ śatakrato .
tallocanasahasraṃ tu matprasādādbhaviṣyati .. 138.7 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्भगसहस्रं तु पुरा जातं शतक्रतो .
तल्लोचनसहस्रं तु मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति .. 138.7 ..
6.3.m: "O Śatakratu, this thousand of vulvas was formerly produced [upon you]. / By my grace, it shall become a thousand eyes."

6.3.s:
evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ praṇamya munisattamam .
brāhmaṇāṃstānmahābhāgānnarmadāṃ pratyagāttataḥ .. 138.8 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तः सहस्राक्षः प्रणम्य मुनिसत्तमम् .
ब्राह्मणांस्तान्महाभागान्नर्मदां प्रत्यगात्ततः .. 138.8 ..
6.3.m: Having been spoken to thus, the thousand-eyed one bowed to the excellent sage / and to those illustrious brahmins, and then went to the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
snātvā sa vimale toye saṃsthāpya tripurāntakam .
jagāma tridaśāvāsaṃ pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 138.9 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा स विमले तोये संस्थाप्य त्रिपुरान्तकम् .
जगाम त्रिदशावासं पूज्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः .. 138.9 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed in its clear water and installed the Destroyer of Tripura, / he went to the abode of the thirty [gods], worshipped by hosts of apsarases.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
paradārābhigamanānmucyate pātakānnaraḥ .. 138.10 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 139
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
परदाराभिगमनान्मुच्यते पातकान्नरः .. 138.10 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शक्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टत्रिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 139
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and worships the Supreme Lord / is freed from the sin of approaching another's wife.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Śakratīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 139

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahārāja somatīrthamanuttamam .
yatra somastapastaptvā nakṣatrapathamāsthitaḥ .. 139.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महाराज सोमतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सोमस्तपस्तप्त्वा नक्षत्रपथमास्थितः .. 139.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O great king, to the unsurpassed Somatīrtha, / where Soma, having performed austerity, ascended to the path of constellations.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snāyādācamya vidhipūrvakam .
kṛtajāpyo raviṃ dhyāyettasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 139.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नायादाचम्य विधिपूर्वकम् .
कृतजाप्यो रविं ध्यायेत्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 139.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford, sips water according to rule, / and meditates on the sun after reciting prayers, hear the meritorious fruit of that:

6.3.s:
ṛgvedayajurvedābhyāṃ sāmavedena bhārata .
japato yatphalaṃ proktaṃ gāyatryā cātra tatphalam .. 139.3 ..
6.3.d:
ऋग्वेदयजुर्वेदाभ्यां सामवेदेन भारत .
जपतो यत्फलं प्रोक्तं गायत्र्या चात्र तत्फलम् .. 139.3 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is declared from reciting the Ṛgveda, the Yajurveda, / and the Sāmaveda, O Bhārata, that fruit is [attained] here through the Gāyatrī.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān bhojayecchuciḥ .
tena samyagvidhānena koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 139.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्छुचिः .
तेन सम्यग्विधानेन कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 139.4 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, being pure, feeds brahmins with devotion in that sacred ford, / by him, in accordance with the proper ritual, ten million have been fed.

6.3.s:
pādukopānahau chatraṃ vastrakambalavājinaḥ .
yo datte vipramukhyāya tasya tatkoṭisaṃmitam .. 139.5 ..
6.3.d:
पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं वस्त्रकम्बलवाजिनः .
यो दत्ते विप्रमुख्याय तस्य तत्कोटिसंमितम् .. 139.5 ..
6.3.m: Whoever gives wooden shoes, leather footwear, an umbrella, / garments, blankets, or horses to the foremost of brahmins, for him that is equal to ten million [such gifts].

6.3.s:
sahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇāmanṛcāṃ yastu bhojayet .
ekasya mantrayuktasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm .. 139.6 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रं तु सहस्राणामनृचां यस्तु भोजयेत् .
एकस्य मन्त्रयुक्तस्य कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् .. 139.6 ..
6.3.m: If one feeds a thousand thousands who do not know the Ṛc verses, / they do not equal a sixteenth part of one who is endowed with mantras.

6.3.s:
evaṃ tu bhojayettatra bahvṛcaṃ vedapāragam .
śākhāntargamathādhvaryuṃ chandogaṃ vā samāptigam .. 139.7 ..
6.3.d:
एवं तु भोजयेत्तत्र बह्वृचं वेदपारगम् .
शाखान्तर्गमथाध्वर्युं छन्दोगं वा समाप्तिगम् .. 139.7 ..
6.3.m: Thus one should feed there an expert in the Rigveda who has mastered the Vedas, / or an Adhvaryu versed in the branches, or a Chāndoga who has completed [his study].

6.3.s:
agnihotrasahasrasya yatphalaṃ prāpyate budhaiḥ .
samaṃ tadvedaviduṣā tīrthe somasya tatphalam .. 139.8 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निहोत्रसहस्रस्य यत्फलं प्राप्यते बुधैः .
समं तद्वेदविदुषा तीर्थे सोमस्य तत्फलम् .. 139.8 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is obtained by the wise through a thousand Agnihotras, / that same fruit is attained at Somatīrtha through a knower of the Veda.

6.3.s:
bhojayedyaḥ śataṃ teṣāṃ sahasraṃ labhate naraḥ .
ekasya yogayuktasya tatphalaṃ kavayo viduḥ .. 139.9 ..
6.3.d:
भोजयेद्यः शतं तेषां सहस्रं लभते नरः .
एकस्य योगयुक्तस्य तत्फलं कवयो विदुः .. 139.9 ..
6.3.m: A man who feeds a hundred of them obtains [the fruit of feeding] a thousand; / the wise know that fruit to belong to [feeding] a single person endowed with yoga.

6.3.s:
saṃnirudhyendriyagrāmaṃ yatrayatra vasenmuniḥ .
tatratatra kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca .. 139.10 ..
6.3.d:
संनिरुध्येन्द्रियग्रामं यत्रयत्र वसेन्मुनिः .
तत्रतत्र कुरुक्षेत्रं नैमिषं पुष्कराणि च .. 139.10 ..
6.3.m: Wherever a sage dwells, having restrained the collection of senses, / there are Kurukṣetra, Naimiṣa, and the Puṣkaras.

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ .
saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte yogī bhojyo viśeṣataḥ .. 139.11 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः .
संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते योगी भोज्यो विशेषतः .. 139.11 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, with every effort, during an eclipse of the moon or the sun, / at a solstice or an equinox, and on Vyatīpāta, a yogin especially must be fed.

6.3.s:
saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
vimānena mahābhāgāḥ sa yāti tridivaṃ naraḥ .. 139.12 ..
6.3.d:
संन्यासं कुरुते यस्तु तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
विमानेन महाभागाः स याति त्रिदिवं नरः .. 139.12 ..
6.3.m: The man who takes the renunciation vow in that sacred ford, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / goes to heaven by means of an aerial chariot, O illustrious one.

6.3.s:
somasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate .. 139.13 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe somatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 140
6.3.d:
सोमस्यानुचरो भूत्वा तेनैव सह मोदते .. 139.13 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सोमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 140
6.3.m:
Having become an attendant of Soma, he rejoices with him indeed.
Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Somatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 140

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahārāja nandāhradamanuttamam .
yatra siddhā mahābhāgā nandā devī varapradā .. 140.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महाराज नन्दाह्रदमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा नन्दा देवी वरप्रदा .. 140.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O great king, to the unsurpassed Nandāhrada, / where the illustrious goddess Nandā, bestower of boons, attained perfection,

6.3.s:
mahiṣāsure mahākāye purā devabhayaṃkare .
śūlinyā śūlabhinnāṅge kṛte dānavasattame .. 140.2 ..
6.3.d:
महिषासुरे महाकाये पुरा देवभयंकरे .
शूलिन्या शूलभिन्नाङ्गे कृते दानवसत्तमे .. 140.2 ..
6.3.m: formerly when Mahiṣāsura, of huge body, terrifying to the gods, / the foremost of Dānavas, had his limbs pierced by the spear by the Spear-bearer,

6.3.s:
yenaikādaśarudrāśca hyādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ .
vasavo vāyunā sārddhaṃ candrādityau sureśvara .. 140.3 ..
6.3.d:
येनैकादशरुद्राश्च ह्यादित्याः समरुद्गणाः .
वसवो वायुना सार्द्धं चन्द्रादित्यौ सुरेश्वर .. 140.3 ..
6.3.m: by whom the eleven Rudras, the Ādityas together with the hosts of Maruts, / the Vasus with Vāyu, and the moon and sun, O lord of the gods,

6.3.s:
balinā nirjitā yena brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .
saṅgrāme sumahāghore kṛte devabhayaṃkare .. 140.4 ..
6.3.d:
बलिना निर्जिता येन ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .
सङ्ग्रामे सुमहाघोरे कृते देवभयंकरे .. 140.4 ..
6.3.m: and by which mighty one Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara were conquered / in a very terrible battle that caused terror to the gods.

6.3.s:
kṛtvā tatkadanaṃ ghoraṃ nandā devī sureśvarī .
yasmātsnātā viśālākṣī tena nandāhradaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 140.5 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा तत्कदनं घोरं नन्दा देवी सुरेश्वरी .
यस्मात्स्नाता विशालाक्षी तेन नन्दाह्रदः स्मृतः .. 140.5 ..
6.3.m: Because, having wrought that terrible slaughter, goddess Nandā, ruler of the gods, / the large-eyed one, bathed [there], it is therefore known as Nandāhrada.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā nandāmuddiśya bhārata .
dadāti dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 140.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा नन्दामुद्दिश्य भारत .
ददाति दानं विप्रेभ्यः सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 140.6 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and, dedicating it to Nandā, O Bhārata, / gives a gift to brahmins, obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
bhairavaṃ caiva kedāraṃ tathā rudraṃ mahālayam .
nandāhradaścaturthaḥ syātpañcamaṃ bhuvi durlabham .. 140.7 ..
6.3.d:
भैरवं चैव केदारं तथा रुद्रं महालयम् .
नन्दाह्रदश्चतुर्थः स्यात्पञ्चमं भुवि दुर्लभम् .. 140.7 ..
6.3.m: Bhairava, Kedāra, Rudra, and Mahālaya: / Nandāhrada is the fourth; a fifth is difficult to obtain on earth.

6.3.s:
bahavastaṃ na jānanti kāmarāgasamanvitāḥ .
narmadāyā hradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 140.8 ..
6.3.d:
बहवस्तं न जानन्ति कामरागसमन्विताः .
नर्मदाया ह्रदं पुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 140.8 ..
6.3.m: Filled with desire and passion, many do not know that / holy pool of the Narmadā which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā nandāṃ devīṃ prapūjayet .
kiṃ tasya himavanmadhyagamanena prayojanam .. 140.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा नन्दां देवीं प्रपूजयेत् .
किं तस्य हिमवन्मध्यगमनेन प्रयोजनम् .. 140.9 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and worships goddess Nandā, / what need has he of going into the midst of the Himavat?

6.3.s:
paramārthamavijñāya paryaṭanti tamovṛtāḥ .
teṣāṃ samāgame pārtha śrama eva hi kevalam .. 140.10 ..
6.3.d:
परमार्थमविज्ञाय पर्यटन्ति तमोवृताः .
तेषां समागमे पार्थ श्रम एव हि केवलम् .. 140.10 ..
6.3.m: Not knowing the highest truth, those enveloped in darkness wander about; / in their journey, O Pārtha, there is only fatigue.

6.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāntāyāṃ snānadānena yatphalam .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti snātvā nandāhrade nṛpa .. 140.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe nandāhradatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 141
6.3.d:
पृथिव्यां सागरान्तायां स्नानदानेन यत्फलम् .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति स्नात्वा नन्दाह्रदे नृप .. 140.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नन्दाह्रदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चत्वारिंशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 141
6.3.m:
Whatever fruit is gained on earth bounded by the oceans through bathing and giving, / that fruit a man fully attains by bathing in Nandāhrada, O king.
Thus ends the one hundred and fortieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford of Nandāhrada', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 141

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla tāpeśvaramanuttamam .
yatra sā hariṇī siddhā vyādhabhītā nareśvara .. 141.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
