6.3.d:
तेऽपि दिव्यविमानेन क्रीडन्ते कल्पसंख्यया .
दीपाष्टकं तु यः कुर्यादष्टमीं च चतुर्दशीम् .. 172.42 ..
6.3.m: they too sport in an aerial chariot for countless kalpas. / He who offers eight lamps on the eighth and the fourteenth lunar days,

6.3.s:
ekādaśyāṃ tu kṛṣṇasya na paśyanti yamaṃ tu te .
phalairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhrairyaḥ kuryālliṅgapūraṇam .. 172.43 ..
6.3.d:
एकादश्यां तु कृष्णस्य न पश्यन्ति यमं तु ते .
फलैर्नानाविधैः शुभ्रैर्यः कुर्याल्लिङ्गपूरणम् .. 172.43 ..
6.3.m: and on the eleventh of the dark fortnight, will never see Yama. / And he who covers the liṅga completely with various pure fruits—

6.3.s:
te'pi yānti vimānena siddhacāraṇasevitāḥ .
ghaṇṭā caiva patākā ca vimāne puṣpamālikā .. 172.44 ..
6.3.d:
तेऽपि यान्ति विमानेन सिद्धचारणसेविताः .
घण्टा चैव पताका च विमाने पुष्पमालिका .. 172.44 ..
6.3.m: they too travel in an aerial chariot, served by siddhas and cāraṇas, / with bells, banners, and flower garlands on the aerial chariot,

6.3.s:
vāditrāṇi yathārhāṇi prānte ca gacchate śivam .
devālayaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādvaiṣṇavaṃ māṇḍaveśvaram .. 172.45 ..
6.3.d:
वादित्राणि यथार्हाणि प्रान्ते च गच्छते शिवम् .
देवालयं तु यः कुर्याद्वैष्णवं माण्डवेश्वरम् .. 172.45 ..
6.3.m: and appropriate musical instruments; and in the end, he reaches Śiva. / He who builds a temple of Viṣṇu [as] Māṇḍaveśvara,

6.3.s:
svarge vasati dharmātmā yāvadābhūtasamplavam .
māṇḍavyanārāyaṇākhye viprān bhojayate'grataḥ .. 172.46 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्गे वसति धर्मात्मा यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .
माण्डव्यनारायणाख्ये विप्रान् भोजयतेऽग्रतः .. 172.46 ..
6.3.m: that righteous person dwells in heaven until the dissolution of all beings. / In front of the one named Māṇḍavyanārāyaṇa, he who feeds brahmins—

6.3.s:
ekasmin bhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā .
āśvine māsi samprāpte śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm .. 172.47 ..
6.3.d:
एकस्मिन् भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .
आश्विने मासि सम्प्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् .. 172.47 ..
6.3.m: when one brahmin is fed, ten million are considered fed. / When the month of Āśvina arrives, on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight,

6.3.s:
kṛtopavāsaniyamo rātrau jāgaraṇena ca .
dīpamālāṃ caturdikṣu pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ .. 172.48 ..
6.3.d:
कृतोपवासनियमो रात्रौ जागरणेन च .
दीपमालां चतुर्दिक्षु पूजां कृत्वा तु शक्तितः .. 172.48 ..
6.3.m: having observed a fast and vow, keeping a night vigil, / arranging rows of lamps in the four directions, and performing worship according to one's means,

6.3.s:
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi nṛtyagītapravādanaiḥ .
prabhāte vimale sūrye snānādikavidhiṃ nṛpa .. 172.49 ..
6.3.d:
नारी वा पुरुषो वापि नृत्यगीतप्रवादनैः .
प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये स्नानादिकविधिं नृप .. 172.49 ..
6.3.m: whether woman or man, with dances, songs, and instrumental music, / at dawn, when the sun is pure, performing the rites of bathing and the rest, O king,

6.3.s:
abhinirvartya maunena paśyate devamīdṛśam .
sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate .. 172.50 ..
6.3.d:
अभिनिर्वर्त्य मौनेन पश्यते देवमीदृशम् .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 172.50 ..
6.3.m: and, after carrying it out in silence, gazes upon such a god— / freed from all sins, he is exalted in the realm of Rudra.

6.3.s:
athavā mārgaśīrṣe ca caitravaiśākhayorapi .
śrāvaṇe vā mahārāja sarvakāle'thavāpi ca .. 172.51 ..
6.3.d:
अथवा मार्गशीर्षे च चैत्रवैशाखयोरपि .
श्रावणे वा महाराज सर्वकालेऽथवापि च .. 172.51 ..
6.3.m: Or else in Mārgaśīrṣa, or in Caitra and Vaiśākha, / or in Śrāvaṇa, O great king, or at any time whatsoever,

6.3.s:
śivarātrisamaṃ puṇyamityevaṃ śivabhāṣitam .
vājapeyāśvamedhābhyāṃ phalaṃ bhavati nānyathā .. 172.52 ..
6.3.d:
शिवरात्रिसमं पुण्यमित्येवं शिवभाषितम् .
वाजपेयाश्वमेधाभ्यां फलं भवति नान्यथा .. 172.52 ..
6.3.m: the merit is equal to Śivarātri—so it was spoken by Śiva; / the fruit is that of the Vājapeya and horse sacrifice, and not otherwise.

6.3.s:
durbhagā duḥkhitā vandhyā daridrā ca mṛtaprajā .
snāti rudraghaṭairyā strī sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 172.53 ..
6.3.d:
दुर्भगा दुःखिता वन्ध्या दरिद्रा च मृतप्रजा .
स्नाति रुद्रघटैर्या स्त्री सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 172.53 ..
6.3.m: An unfortunate woman, a grieving woman, a barren woman, a poor woman, or one whose children have died, / if she bathes with Rudra-pitchers, she will obtain all her desires.

6.3.s:
kṛmikīṭapataṅgāśca tasmiṃstīrthe tu ye mṛtāḥ .
svargaṃ prayānti te sarve divyarūpadharā nṛpa .. 172.54 ..
6.3.d:
कृमिकीटपतङ्गाश्च तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु ये मृताः .
स्वर्गं प्रयान्ति ते सर्वे दिव्यरूपधरा नृप .. 172.54 ..
6.3.m: Even worms, insects, and winged creatures that die at that sacred ford— / they all go to heaven bearing divine forms, O king.

6.3.s:
anāśake jale'gnau tu ye mṛtā vyādhipīḍitāḥ .
anivartikā gatisteṣāṃ rudraloke hyasaṃśayam .. 172.55 ..
6.3.d:
अनाशके जलेऽग्नौ तु ये मृता व्याधिपीडिताः .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तेषां रुद्रलोके ह्यसंशयम् .. 172.55 ..
6.3.m: Those afflicted by disease who die by fasting, or in water, or in fire, / their destination is to never return, in the world of Rudra, without doubt.

6.3.s:
nityaṃ namati yo rāja śivanārāyaṇāvubhau .
godānaphalamāpnoti tasya tīrthaprabhāvataḥ .. 172.56 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं नमति यो राज शिवनारायणावुभौ .
गोदानफलमाप्नोति तस्य तीर्थप्रभावतः .. 172.56 ..
6.3.m: O king, he who constantly bows to both Śiva and Nārāyaṇa / obtains the fruit of giving cows by the power of that sacred ford.

6.3.s:
devālaye tu rājendra yaśca kuryātpradakṣiṇām .
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena sasāgaradharā dharā .. 172.57 ..
6.3.d:
देवालये तु राजेन्द्र यश्च कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणाम् .
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन ससागरधरा धरा .. 172.57 ..
6.3.m: And he who circumambulates the temple, O best of kings, / by him the earth with its oceans has been circumambulated.

6.3.s:
sārddhaṃ śataṃ ca tīrthāni mallikābhavanādbahiḥ .
tasya tīrthapramāṇaṃ tu vistaraṃ rājasattama .. 172.58 ..
6.3.d:
सार्द्धं शतं च तीर्थानि मल्लिकाभवनाद्बहिः .
तस्य तीर्थप्रमाणं तु विस्तरं राजसत्तम .. 172.58 ..
6.3.m: One hundred and fifty sacred fords lie outside the dwelling of Mallikā; / that is the measure and extent of that sacred ford, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
sūtreṇa veṣṭayetkṣetramathavā śivamandiram .
athavā śivaliṅgaṃ ca tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 172.59 ..
6.3.d:
सूत्रेण वेष्टयेत्क्षेत्रमथवा शिवमन्दिरम् .
अथवा शिवलिङ्गं च तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 172.59 ..
6.3.m: If one winds a thread around the sacred field, or the temple of Śiva, / or around the Śiva liṅga, listen to the fruit of that merit:

6.3.s:
jambūdvīpaśca kṛtasnaśca śālmalī kuśakrauñcakau .
śākapuṣkaragomedaiḥ saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā .. 172.60 ..
6.3.d:
जम्बूद्वीपश्च कृतस्नश्च शाल्मली कुशक्रौञ्चकौ .
शाकपुष्करगोमेदैः सप्तद्वीपा वसुंधरा .. 172.60 ..
6.3.m: all Jambudvīpa, Śālmalī, Kuśa, Krauñca, / Śāka, Puṣkara, and Gomeda—the earth of seven continents,

6.3.s:
bhūṣitā tena rājendra saśailavanakānanā .
revāyāṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge śivakṣetrātsamīpataḥ .. 172.61 ..
6.3.d:
भूषिता तेन राजेन्द्र सशैलवनकानना .
रेवायां दक्षिणे भागे शिवक्षेत्रात्समीपतः .. 172.61 ..
6.3.m: with its mountains and forests, has been adorned by him, O best of kings. / On the southern side of the Revā, near the sacred field of Śiva,

6.3.s:
devakhātaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ nirmitaṃ tridaśairapi .
tasmin yaḥ kurute snānaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 172.62 ..
6.3.d:
देवखातं महापुण्यं निर्मितं त्रिदशैरपि .
तस्मिन् यः कुरुते स्नानं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 172.62 ..
6.3.m: lies Devakhāta, highly meritorious, created by the thirty [gods]. / He who bathes in it is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
pūrṇimāyāmamāvasyāṃ vyatīpāte'rkasaṃkrame .
śrāddhaṃ ca saṃgrahe kuryātsa gacchetparamāṃ gatim .. 172.63 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्णिमायाममावस्यां व्यतीपातेऽर्कसंक्रमे .
श्राद्धं च संग्रहे कुर्यात्स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् .. 172.63 ..
6.3.m: On a full moon, a new moon, during a vyatīpāta, at a solar ingress, / and at a solar eclipse, if one performs a śrāddha, he goes to the supreme state.

6.3.s:
devakhāte trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ .
tiṣṭhanti ṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ pitṛdevagaṇaiḥ saha .. 172.64 ..
6.3.d:
देवखाते त्रयो देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेश्वराः .
तिष्ठन्ति ऋषिभिः सार्द्धं पितृदेवगणैः सह .. 172.64 ..
6.3.m: At Devakhāta dwell the three gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara, / together with the seers, and with hosts of ancestors and gods.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe'śvine māsi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .
vāyumārge sthitaḥ śakrastiṣṭhate daivataiḥ saha .. 172.65 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थेऽश्विने मासि चतुर्दश्यां विशेषतः .
वायुमार्गे स्थितः शक्रस्तिष्ठते दैवतैः सह .. 172.65 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, especially in the month of Āśvina on the fourteenth day, / Śakra stands in the path of the wind along with the deities.

6.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni saritaḥ sāgarāstathā .
viṃśati tāni sarvāṇi devakhāte dinadvayam .. 172.66 ..
6.3.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि सरितः सागरास्तथा .
विंशति तानि सर्वाणि देवखाते दिनद्वयम् .. 172.66 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sacred fords, rivers, and oceans exist on earth, / all of them enter Devakhāta for two days.

6.3.s:
gayāśire ca yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge makarakaṇṭake .
prayāge somatīrthe ca tatpuṇyaṃ māṇḍaveśvare .. 172.67 ..
6.3.d:
गयाशिरे च यत्पुण्यं प्रयागे मकरकण्टके .
प्रयागे सोमतीर्थे च तत्पुण्यं माण्डवेश्वरे .. 172.67 ..
6.3.m: The merit found at Gayāśiras, at Prayāga, at Makara-kaṇṭaka, / and at the Somatīrtha at Prayāga, that same merit is at Māṇḍaveśvara.

6.3.s:
paṭṭabandhena yatpuṇyaṃ mātrāyāṃ lakuleśvare .
āśvinyāmaśvinīyoge tatpuṇyaṃ māṇḍaveśvare .. 172.68 ..
6.3.d:
पट्टबन्धेन यत्पुण्यं मात्रायां लकुलेश्वरे .
आश्विन्यामश्विनीयोगे तत्पुण्यं माण्डवेश्वरे .. 172.68 ..
6.3.m: The merit from the crowning ceremony at Lakuleśvara in Mātrā / during the conjunction with Aśvinī in the month of Āśvina, that same merit is at Māṇḍaveśvara.

6.3.s:
ujjayinyāṃ mahākāle vārāṇasyāṃ tripuṣkare .
saṃnihatyāṃ ravigraste māṇḍavyākhye sanātanam .. 172.69 ..
6.3.d:
उज्जयिन्यां महाकाले वाराणस्यां त्रिपुष्करे .
संनिहत्यां रविग्रस्ते माण्डव्याख्ये सनातनम् .. 172.69 ..
6.3.m: The merit at Mahākāla in Ujjayinī, in Vārāṇasī, at Tripuṣkara, / and at Saṃnihiti during a solar eclipse—the eternal merit is at that [ford] named Māṇḍavya.

6.3.s:
iti jñātvā mahārāja sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam .
pitḥndevān samabhyarcya snānadānādipūjanaiḥ .. 172.70 ..
6.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा महाराज सर्वतीर्थेषु चोत्तमम् .
पित्ःन्देवान् समभ्यर्च्य स्नानदानादिपूजनैः .. 172.70 ..
6.3.m: Knowing this, O great king, [that it is] the best of all sacred fords, / having worshipped the ancestors and the gods with baths, gifts, and veneration,

6.3.s:
caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthito bhūtvā śucivrataḥ .
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā rātrau jāgaraṇe śivam .. 172.71 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्दश्यां निराहारः स्थितो भूत्वा शुचिव्रतः .
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या रात्रौ जागरणे शिवम् .. 172.71 ..
6.3.m: and remaining without food on the fourteenth day, purified and observing vows, / one should worship Śiva with supreme devotion during a night vigil.

6.3.s:
snānaiśca vividhairdevaṃ puṣpāgaruvilepanaiḥ .
prabhāte paurṇamāsyāṃ tu snānādividhitarpaṇaiḥ .. 172.72 ..
6.3.d:
स्नानैश्च विविधैर्देवं पुष्पागरुविलेपनैः .
प्रभाते पौर्णमास्यां तु स्नानादिविधितर्पणैः .. 172.72 ..
6.3.m: [worships] the god with various ritual ablutions, flowers, and agallochum ointment, / and at dawn on the full moon day with ritual libations preceded by ritual ablution, 172.72

6.3.s:
śrāddhena havyakavyena śivapūjārcanena ca .
agniṣṭomādiyajñaiśca vidhivaccāptadakṣiṇaiḥ .. 172.73 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धेन हव्यकव्येन शिवपूजार्चनेन च .
अग्निष्टोमादियज्ञैश्च विधिवच्चाप्तदक्षिणैः .. 172.73 ..
6.3.m: with a śrāddha offering food meant for gods and ancestors, with worship and veneration of Śiva, / and with Agniṣṭoma and other sacrifices performed according to rule, offering ample sacrificial fees, 172.73

6.3.s:
dhautapāpo viśuddhātmā phalate phalamuttamam .
gosahasrapradānena dattaṃ bhavati bhārata .. 172.74 ..
6.3.d:
धौतपापो विशुद्धात्मा फलते फलमुत्तमम् .
गोसहस्रप्रदानेन दत्तं भवति भारत .. 172.74 ..
6.3.m: his sins washed away and his soul purified, he attains the supreme fruit; / it becomes as if a thousand cows were given, O descendant of Bharata. 172.74

6.3.s:
snānādyairvidhivattatra taddine śivasannidhau .
hiraṇyaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dhenuṃ bhūmiṃ gomithunaṃ hayam .. 172.75 ..
6.3.d:
स्नानाद्यैर्विधिवत्तत्र तद्दिने शिवसन्निधौ .
हिरण्यं वृषभं धेनुं भूमिं गोमिथुनं हयम् .. 172.75 ..
6.3.m: By performing ritual ablutions and other rites there according to rule on that day in the presence of Śiva, / [giving] gold, a bull, a cow, land, a pair of cattle, a horse, 172.75

6.3.s:
śivamuddiśya vai vastrayugme dadyātsurūpiṇe .
pādukopānahau chatraṃ bhājanaṃ raktavāsasī .. 172.76 ..
6.3.d:
शिवमुद्दिश्य वै वस्त्रयुग्मे दद्यात्सुरूपिणे .
पादुकोपानहौ छत्रं भाजनं रक्तवाससी .. 172.76 ..
6.3.m: one should donate [them] dedicated to Śiva to a handsome [brahmin], along with a pair of garments, / sandals, shoes, an umbrella, a vessel, and two red garments. 172.76

6.3.s:
homaṃ jāpyaṃ tathā dānamakṣayaṃ sarvameva tat .
ṛcamekāṃ tu ṛgvede yajurvede yajustathā .. 172.77 ..
6.3.d:
होमं जाप्यं तथा दानमक्षयं सर्वमेव तत् .
ऋचमेकां तु ऋग्वेदे यजुर्वेदे यजुस्तथा .. 172.77 ..
6.3.m: Burnt offering, silent recitation, and charitable gift—all that becomes imperishable. / Standing before the god, one should recite one ṛc in the Ṛgveda, / likewise a yajus in the Yajurveda, 172.77

6.3.s:
sāmaikaṃ sāmavede tu japeddevāgrasaṃsthitaḥ .
samyagvedaphalaṃ tasya bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 172.78 ..
6.3.d:
सामैकं सामवेदे तु जपेद्देवाग्रसंस्थितः .
सम्यग्वेदफलं तस्य भवेद्वै नात्र संशयः .. 172.78 ..
6.3.m: and one sāman in the Sāmaveda: / the complete fruit of the Veda shall accrue to him; there is no doubt about this. 172.78

6.3.s:
gāyatrījāpyamātrastu vedatrayaphalaṃ labhet .
kulakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ labhate tu śivārcanāt .. 172.79 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्रीजाप्यमात्रस्तु वेदत्रयफलं लभेत् .
कुलकोटिशतं साग्रं लभते तु शिवार्चनात् .. 172.79 ..
6.3.m: By mere recitation of the Gāyatrī, one obtains the fruit of the three Vedas; / and from the worship of Śiva, one liberates fully one hundred crores of ancestors. 172.79

6.3.s:
snāne dāne tathā śrāddhe jāgare gītavādite .
anivartikā gatistasya śivalokātkadācana .. 172.80 ..
6.3.d:
स्नाने दाने तथा श्राद्धे जागरे गीतवादिते .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य शिवलोकात्कदाचन .. 172.80 ..
6.3.m: In ritual ablution, donation, śrāddha, keeping night vigil, and singing and instrumental music, / his return from the world of Śiva shall never occur. 172.80

6.3.s:
kālena mahatāviṣṭo martyaloke samāviśet .
rājā bhavati medhāvī sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .. 172.81 ..
6.3.d:
कालेन महताविष्टो मर्त्यलोके समाविशेत् .
राजा भवति मेधावी सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः .. 172.81 ..
6.3.m: Possessed of it for a great span of time, he then enters the mortal world; / he becomes a wise king, free from all diseases; 172.81

6.3.s:
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ putrapautradhanānvitaḥ .
tacca tīrthaṃ punaḥ smṛtvā līyamāno maheśvare .. 172.82 ..
6.3.d:
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं पुत्रपौत्रधनान्वितः .
तच्च तीर्थं पुनः स्मृत्वा लीयमानो महेश्वरे .. 172.82 ..
6.3.m: he lives for a full hundred years, endowed with sons, grandsons, and wealth; / and remembering that sacred ford again, he merges into the Great Lord. 172.82

6.3.s:
upāste yastu vai sandhyāṃ tasmiṃstīrthe ca parvaṇi .
sāṅgopāṅgaiścaturvedairlabhate phalamuttamam .. 172.83 ..
6.3.d:
उपास्ते यस्तु वै सन्ध्यां तस्मिंस्तीर्थे च पर्वणि .
साङ्गोपाङ्गैश्चतुर्वेदैर्लभते फलमुत्तमम् .. 172.83 ..
6.3.m: Whoever performs the twilight worship at that sacred ford on the festival day / attains the supreme fruit of the four Vedas together with their limbs and sub-limbs. 172.83

6.3.s:
tatra sarvaṃ śivakṣetrāccharapātaṃ samantataḥ .
na saṃcaredbhayodvignā brahmahatyā narādhipa .. 172.84 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र सर्वं शिवक्षेत्राच्छरपातं समन्ततः .
न संचरेद्भयोद्विग्ना ब्रह्महत्या नराधिप .. 172.84 ..
6.3.m: There, within an arrow's flight in all directions from the sacred field of Śiva, / brahmin-slaying cannot wander about, terrified by fear, O king. 172.84

6.3.s:
yatra tatra sthito vṛkṣān paśyate tīrthatatparaḥ .
vividhaiḥ pātakairmukto mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 172.85 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र तत्र स्थितो वृक्षान् पश्यते तीर्थतत्परः .
विविधैः पातकैर्मुक्तो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 172.85 ..
6.3.m: Standing wherever, whoever gazes upon the trees devoted to that sacred ford / is released, freed from diverse sins; there is no doubt about this. 172.85

6.3.s:
śvabhrī tatra mahārāja jalamadhye pradṛśyate .
kathānikā purāṇoktā vānarī tīrthasevanāt .. 172.86 ..
6.3.d:
श्वभ्री तत्र महाराज जलमध्ये प्रदृश्यते .
कथानिका पुराणोक्ता वानरी तीर्थसेवनात् .. 172.86 ..
6.3.m: A chasm is seen there in the middle of the water, O great king; / an ancient story is told of a female monkey, through her attendance at that sacred ford. 172.86

6.3.s:
tatra kūpo mahārāja tiṣṭhate devanirmitaḥ .
śivasya paścime bhāge śivakṣetramanuttamam .. 172.87 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र कूपो महाराज तिष्ठते देवनिर्मितः .
शिवस्य पश्चिमे भागे शिवक्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् .. 172.87 ..
6.3.m: A well built by the gods stands there, O great king; / on the western side of Śiva lies the unequalled sacred field of Śiva. 172.87

6.3.s:
vṛṣotsargaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāttasmiṃstīrthe narādhipa .
krīḍanti pitarastasya svargaloke yadṛcchayā .. 172.88 ..
6.3.d:
वृषोत्सर्गं तु यः कुर्यात्तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नराधिप .
क्रीडन्ति पितरस्तस्य स्वर्गलोके यदृच्छया .. 172.88 ..
6.3.m: Whoever releases a bull at that sacred ford, O ruler of men, / his ancestors sport at will in heaven. 172.88

6.3.s:
agamyāgamane pāpamayājyayājane kṛte .
steyācca brahmagohatyāgurughātācca pātakam .
tatsarvaṃ naśyate pāpaṃ vṛṣotsarge kṛte tu vai .. 172.89 ..
6.3.d:
अगम्यागमने पापमयाज्ययाजने कृते .
स्तेयाच्च ब्रह्मगोहत्यागुरुघाताच्च पातकम् .
तत्सर्वं नश्यते पापं वृषोत्सर्गे कृते तु वै .. 172.89 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sin is incurred by approaching forbidden women, by sacrificing for those unfit to sacrifice, / or crime born of theft, slaying a brahmin, killing a cow, or murdering a guru— / all that sin is destroyed when a bull is released. 172.89

6.3.s:
māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samādhinā .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 172.90 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 173
6.3.d:
माण्डव्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यं यः शृणोति समाधिना .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 172.90 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये माण्डव्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 173
6.3.m:
Whoever listens with concentration to the Māṇḍavyatīrthamāhātmya / is freed from all sins; no doubt should be entertained here. 172.90
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-second chapter, titled "The Description of the Greatness of Māṇḍavya Sacred Ford," in the Greatness of the Narmadā, in the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantī section, in the Skanda Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 173

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 173.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 173.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the extremely beautiful sacred ford / on the southern bank of the Narmadā, which destroys all sins, 173.1

6.3.s:
siddheśvaramiti khyātaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .
yatra śuddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
purā hatyāyutaḥ pārtha devadevastriśūladhṛk .. 173.2 ..
6.3.d:
सिद्धेश्वरमिति ख्यातं महापातकनाशनम् .
यत्र शुद्धिं परां प्राप्तो देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
पुरा हत्यायुतः पार्थ देवदेवस्त्रिशूलधृक् .. 173.2 ..
6.3.m: renowned as Siddheśvara, destroyer of great sins, / where the Great Lord, the god of gods, attained supreme purification, / when formerly, O son of Pṛthā, the god of gods, bearer of the trident, was tainted by murder. 173.2

6.3.s:
purā pañcaśirā āsīdbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
tenānṛtaṃ vacaścoktaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare .. 173.3 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा पञ्चशिरा आसीद्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
तेनानृतं वचश्चोक्तं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे .. 173.3 ..
6.3.m: Long ago, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, had five heads; / by him an untruthful word was spoken for some reason. 173.3

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā sahasā tasmai cukopa parameśvaraḥ .
chedayāmāsa bhagavānmūrdhānaṃ karajaistadā .. 173.4 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सहसा तस्मै चुकोप परमेश्वरः .
छेदयामास भगवान्मूर्धानं करजैस्तदा .. 173.4 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that, the Supreme Lord suddenly became enraged at him; / the Blessed One then severed his head with his fingernails. 173.4

6.3.s:
tasya tatkarasaṃlagnaṃ cyavate na kadācana .
tato hi devadeveśaḥ paryaṭan pṛthivīmimām .. 173.5 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य तत्करसंलग्नं च्यवते न कदाचन .
ततो हि देवदेवेशः पर्यटन् पृथिवीमिमाम् .. 173.5 ..
6.3.m: Stuck to his hand, it did not fall away at any time; / then indeed, the lord of the gods of gods wandered over this earth. 173.5

6.3.s:
tato vārāṇasīṃ prāptastasyāṃ tadapatacchiraḥ .
patite tu kapāle ca brahmahatyā na muñcati .. 173.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततो वाराणसीं प्राप्तस्तस्यां तदपतच्छिरः .
पतिते तु कपाले च ब्रह्महत्या न मुञ्चति .. 173.6 ..
6.3.m: Then he reached Vārāṇasī, and there that head fell off; / yet though the skull had fallen, brahmin-slaying did not release him. 173.6

6.3.s:
tatastu sāgare gatvā pūrve ca dakṣiṇe tathā .
paścime cottare pārtha devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 173.7 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तु सागरे गत्वा पूर्वे च दक्षिणे तथा .
पश्चिमे चोत्तरे पार्थ देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 173.7 ..
6.3.m: Then, having gone to the ocean in the east and likewise in the south, / in the west and in the north, O son of Pṛthā, the Great Lord, the god of gods, 173.7

6.3.s:
paryaṭansarvatīrtheṣu brahmahatyā na muñcati .
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle sutīrthaṃ prāptavān prabhuḥ .. 173.8 ..
6.3.d:
पर्यटन्सर्वतीर्थेषु ब्रह्महत्या न मुञ्चति .
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले सुतीर्थं प्राप्तवान् प्रभुः .. 173.8 ..
6.3.m: wandering through all the sacred fords, brahmin-slaying did not release him; / on the southern bank of the Narmadā, the Lord reached the excellent sacred ford. 173.8

6.3.s:
kulakoṭiṃ samāsādya prārthayāmāsa cātmavān .
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā babhūva gatakalmaṣaḥ .. 173.9 ..
6.3.d:
कुलकोटिं समासाद्य प्रार्थयामास चात्मवान् .
प्रायश्चित्तं ततः कृत्वा बभूव गतकल्मषः .. 173.9 ..
6.3.m: Having reached the crore of lineages, the master prayed; / then, having performed expiation, he became free of defilement. 173.9

6.3.s:
tato niṣkalmaṣo jāto devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
hatvā surebhyastatsthānaṃ tataścāntardadhe prabhuḥ .. 173.10 ..
6.3.d:
ततो निष्कल्मषो जातो देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
हत्वा सुरेभ्यस्तत्स्थानं ततश्चान्तर्दधे प्रभुः .. 173.10 ..
6.3.m: Then, having become free of sin, the Great Lord, the god of gods, / having bestowed that place upon the gods, the Lord then vanished. 173.10

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ śuddharudreti kīrtitam .
vikhyātaṃ triṣu loke brahmahatyāharaṃ param .. 173.11 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं शुद्धरुद्रेति कीर्तितम् .
विख्यातं त्रिषु लोके ब्रह्महत्याहरं परम् .. 173.11 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, that sacred ford has been celebrated as Śuddharudra, / renowned in the three worlds, the supreme remover of brahmin-slaying. 173.11

6.3.s:
māse māse site pakṣe'māvāsyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
snātvā tatra vidhānena tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 173.12 ..
6.3.d:
मासे मासे सिते पक्षेऽमावास्यायां युधिष्ठिर .
स्नात्वा तत्र विधानेन तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 173.12 ..
6.3.m: Month after month, in the bright fortnight and on the new moon day, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / bathing there according to the rule, one should offer libations to the ancestors and gods. 173.12

6.3.s:
dadyātpiṇḍaṃ pitḥṇāṃ tu bhāvitenāntarātmanā .
tasya te dvādaśābdāni sutṛptāḥ pitaro nṛpa .. 173.13 ..
6.3.d:
दद्यात्पिण्डं पित्ःणां तु भावितेनान्तरात्मना .
तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि सुतृप्ताः पितरो नृप .. 173.13 ..
6.3.m: One should offer a piṇḍa to the ancestors with a devoted inner heart; / his ancestors are well satisfied for twelve years, O king. 173.13

6.3.s:
gandhadhūpapradīpādyairabhyarcya parameśvaram .
śuddheśvarābhidhānaṃ tu śivaloke mahīyate .. 173.14 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धधूपप्रदीपाद्यैरभ्यर्च्य परमेश्वरम् .
शुद्धेश्वराभिधानं तु शिवलोके महीयते .. 173.14 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped the Supreme Lord with perfumes, incense, lamps, and other offerings, / by the name of Śuddheśvara, he is glorified in the world of Śiva. 173.14

6.3.s:
etatte kathitaṃ rājañchuddharudramanuttamam .
mayā śrutaṃ yathā devasakāśācchūlapāṇinaḥ .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 173.15 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śuddheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 174
6.3.d:
एतत्ते कथितं राजञ्छुद्धरुद्रमनुत्तमम् .
मया श्रुतं यथा देवसकाशाच्छूलपाणिनः .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 173.15 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शुद्धेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रिसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 174
6.3.m:
This has been told to you, O king: the unequalled Śuddharudra / as I heard it from the presence of the trident-bearing god; / he is released from all sins and goes to the world of Rudra. 173.15
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-third chapter, titled "The Description of the Greatness of the Śuddheśvara Sacred Ford," in the Greatness of the Narmadā, in the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantī section, in the Skanda Purāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 174

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
gopeśvaraṃ tato gaccheduttare narmadātaṭe .
yatra snānena caikena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ .. 174.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
गोपेश्वरं ततो गच्छेदुत्तरे नर्मदातटे .
यत्र स्नानेन चैकेन मुच्यन्ते पातकैर्नराः .. 174.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to Gopeśvara on the northern bank of the Narmadā, / where by a single bath men are freed from sins. 174.1

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam .
barhiyuktena yānena sa gacchecchivamandire .. 174.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् .
बर्हियुक्तेन यानेन स गच्छेच्छिवमन्दिरे .. 174.2 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed at that sacred ford, brings about the end of his life, / goes to the abode of Śiva in a vehicle yoked to peacocks. 174.2

6.3.s:
krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ śivaloke narādhipa .
iha mānuṣyatāṃ prāpya rājā bhavati vīryavān .. 174.3 ..
6.3.d:
क्रीडित्वा सुचिरं कालं शिवलोके नराधिप .
इह मानुष्यतां प्राप्य राजा भवति वीर्यवान् .. 174.3 ..
6.3.m: Having sported for a very long time in the world of Śiva, O ruler of men, / attaining human birth here, he becomes a mighty king. 174.3

6.3.s:
hastyaśvarathasampanno dāsīdāsasamanvitaḥ .
pūjyamāno narendraiśca jīvedvarṣaśataṃ naraḥ .. 174.4 ..
6.3.d:
हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पन्नो दासीदाससमन्वितः .
पूज्यमानो नरेन्द्रैश्च जीवेद्वर्षशतं नरः .. 174.4 ..
6.3.m: Endowed with elephants, horses, and chariots, attended by female and male servants, / and honored by rulers of men, that person lives for a hundred years. 174.4

6.3.s:
samprāpte kārttike māsi navamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ .
sopavāsaḥ śucirbhūtvā dīpakāṃstatra dāpayet .. 174.5 ..
6.3.d:
सम्प्राप्ते कार्त्तिके मासि नवम्यां शुक्लपक्षतः .
सोपवासः शुचिर्भूत्वा दीपकांस्तत्र दापयेत् .. 174.5 ..
6.3.m: When the month of Kārttika arrives, on the ninth day of the bright fortnight, / having fasted and become pure, one should present lamps there.

6.3.s:
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya rātrau kurvīta jāgaram .
tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 174.6 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धपुष्पैः समभ्यर्च्य रात्रौ कुर्वीत जागरम् .
तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .. 174.6 ..
6.3.m: Having worshiped with fragrant perfumes and flowers, one should keep a vigil at night. / Hear what fruit is prescribed for him, O king:

6.3.s:
yāvatpuṇyaṃ phalaṃ saṃkhyā dīpakānāṃ tathaiva ca .
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate .. 174.7 ..
6.3.d:
यावत्पुण्यं फलं संख्या दीपकानां तथैव च .
तावद्युगसहस्राणि शिवलोके महीयते .. 174.7 ..
6.3.m: As great as the meritorious fruit and as many as the number of lamps, / for so many thousands of yugas he is honored in the world of Śiva.

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra liṅgapūraṇakaṃ vidhim .
tathaiva padmakaiścaiva dadhibhaktaistathaiva ca .. 174.8 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र लिङ्गपूरणकं विधिम् .
तथैव पद्मकैश्चैव दधिभक्तैस्तथैव च .. 174.8 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, O king of kings, the rite of filling the liṅga, / and likewise with lotuses and curd-rice,

6.3.s:
yastu kuryānnaraśreṣṭha tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .
yāvanti tilasaṃkhyāni dadhibhaktaṃ tathaiva ca .. 174.9 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तु कुर्यान्नरश्रेष्ठ तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .
यावन्ति तिलसंख्यानि दधिभक्तं तथैव च .. 174.9 ..
6.3.m: whoever performs it, O best of men, hear the meritorious fruit for him. / As many as the grains of sesame and the curd-rice,

6.3.s:
padmasaṃkhyā śive loke modate kālamīpsitam .
tasmiṃstīrthe tu rājendra yatkiṃciddīyate nṛpa .. 174.10 ..
6.3.d:
पद्मसंख्या शिवे लोके मोदते कालमीप्सितम् .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र यत्किंचिद्दीयते नृप .. 174.10 ..
6.3.m: and the number of lotuses, he rejoices in the world of Śiva for his desired time. / Whatever little is given at that sacred ford, O king,

6.3.s:
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya saṃkhyātuṃ vā na śakyate .
evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatīrthamanuttamam .. 174.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gopeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 175
6.3.d:
सर्वं कोटिगुणं तस्य संख्यातुं वा न शक्यते .
एवं ते कथितं सर्वं सर्वतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 174.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गोपेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुःसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 175
6.3.m:
all of that becomes multiplied ten-millionfold; it cannot even be counted. / Thus has all this supreme [merit] of all sacred fords been told to you.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Gopeśvara Sacred Ford,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 175

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
uttare narmadākūle bhṛgukṣetrasya madhyataḥ .
kapileśvaraṃ tu vikhyātaṃ viśeṣātpāpanāśanam .. 175.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले भृगुक्षेत्रस्य मध्यतः .
कपिलेश्वरं तु विख्यातं विशेषात्पापनाशनम् .. 175.1 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / On the northern bank of the Narmadā, in the middle of Bhṛgukṣetra, / Kapileśvara is famous, especially for destroying sins.

6.3.s:
yo'sau sanātano devaḥ purāṇe paripaṭhyate .
vāsudevo jagannāthaḥ kapilatvamupāgataḥ .. 175.2 ..
6.3.d:
योऽसौ सनातनो देवः पुराणे परिपठ्यते .
वासुदेवो जगन्नाथः कपिलत्वमुपागतः .. 175.2 ..
6.3.m: That eternal god who is proclaimed in the Purāṇa, / Vāsudeva, Lord of the Universe, assumed the form of Kapila.

6.3.s:
pātālaṃ sutalaṃ nāma tasyaiva nitalaṃ hyadhaḥ .
gabhastigaṃ ca tasyādho hyandhatāmisrameva ca .. 175.3 ..
6.3.d:
पातालं सुतलं नाम तस्यैव नितलं ह्यधः .
गभस्तिगं च तस्याधो ह्यन्धतामिस्रमेव च .. 175.3 ..
6.3.m: The netherworld named Sutala, and beneath it indeed Nitala, / and beneath that Gabhastimat, and indeed Andhatāmisra,

6.3.s:
pātālaṃ saptamaṃ yacca hyadhastātsaṃsthitaṃ mahat .
vasate tatra vai devaḥ purāṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ .. 175.4 ..
6.3.d:
पातालं सप्तमं यच्च ह्यधस्तात्संस्थितं महत् .
वसते तत्र वै देवः पुराणः परमेश्वरः .. 175.4 ..
6.3.m: and the seventh Pātāla which is situated far below— / the ancient god, the supreme lord, dwells there indeed.

6.3.s:
sa brahmā sa mahādevaḥ sa devo garuḍadhvajaḥ .
pūjyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhaistiṣṭhate brahmavādibhiḥ .. 175.5 ..
6.3.d:
स ब्रह्मा स महादेवः स देवो गरुडध्वजः .
पूज्यमानः सुरैः सिद्धैस्तिष्ठते ब्रह्मवादिभिः .. 175.5 ..
6.3.m: He is Brahmā, he is Mahādeva, he is the god whose emblem is Garuḍa. / Being worshiped by gods, siddhas, and exponents of the Veda, he abides [there].

6.3.s:
vasatastasya rājendra kapilasya jagadguroḥ .
vināśaṃ cāgrataḥ prāptāḥ kṣaṇena sagarātmajāḥ .. 175.6 ..
6.3.d:
वसतस्तस्य राजेन्द्र कपिलस्य जगद्गुरोः .
विनाशं चाग्रतः प्राप्ताः क्षणेन सगरात्मजाः .. 175.6 ..
6.3.m: While he, Kapila, the teacher of the universe, was dwelling [there], O king of kings, / the sons of Sagara met destruction before him in an instant.

6.3.s:
bhasmībhūtāṃstu tāndṛṣṭvā kapilo munisattamaḥ .
jagāma paramaṃ śokaṃ cintyamāno'tha kilbiṣam .. 175.7 ..
6.3.d:
भस्मीभूतांस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा कपिलो मुनिसत्तमः .
जगाम परमं शोकं चिन्त्यमानोऽथ किल्बिषम् .. 175.7 ..
6.3.m: Seeing them turned to ashes, Kapila, the best of sages, / felt supreme grief, pondering upon the sin:

6.3.s:
sarvasaṅgaparityāge citte nirviṣayīkṛte .
ayuktaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇāṃ kartaṃ mama vināśanam .. 175.8 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वसङ्गपरित्यागे चित्ते निर्विषयीकृते .
अयुक्तं षष्टिसहस्राणां कर्तं मम विनाशनम् .. 175.8 ..
6.3.m: “When all attachment has been abandoned and the mind is freed from sensory objects, / it was unfitting for me to bring about the destruction of sixty thousand [men].

6.3.s:
kṛtasya karaṇaṃ nāsti tasmātpāpavināśanam .
gatvā tu kāpilaṃ tīrthaṃ mocayāmyaghamātmanaḥ .. 175.9 ..
6.3.d:
कृतस्य करणं नास्ति तस्मात्पापविनाशनम् .
गत्वा तु कापिलं तीर्थं मोचयाम्यघमात्मनः .. 175.9 ..
6.3.m: What is done cannot be undone; therefore, for the destruction of the sin, / having gone to the Kāpila sacred ford, I shall free myself from sin.”

6.3.s:
pātālaṃ tu tato muktvā kapilo munisattamaḥ .
tapaścacāra sumahannarmadātaṭamāsthitaḥ .. 175.10 ..
6.3.d:
पातालं तु ततो मुक्त्वा कपिलो मुनिसत्तमः .
तपश्चचार सुमहन्नर्मदातटमास्थितः .. 175.10 ..
6.3.m: Then, having left Pātāla, Kapila, the best of sages, / performed very great austerity, staying on the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
vratopavāsairvividhaiḥ snānadānajapādikaiḥ .
paraṃ nirvāṇamāpannaḥ pūjayanrudramavyayam .. 175.11 ..
6.3.d:
व्रतोपवासैर्विविधैः स्नानदानजपादिकैः .
परं निर्वाणमापन्नः पूजयन्रुद्रमव्ययम् .. 175.11 ..
6.3.m: Through various vows and fasts, ritual ablutions, gifts, and recitations, / he attained supreme liberation, worshiping the imperishable Rudra.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetparameśvaram .
gosahasraphalaṃ tasya labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 175.12 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम् .
गोसहस्रफलं तस्य लभते नात्र संशयः .. 175.12 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed at that sacred ford, worships the supreme lord, / attains the fruit of a thousand cows; there is no doubt in this.

6.3.s:
jyeṣṭhamāse tu samprāpte śuklapakṣe caturdaśī .
tatra snātvā vidhānena bhaktyā dānaṃ prayacchati .. 175.13 ..
6.3.d:
ज्येष्ठमासे तु सम्प्राप्ते शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशी .
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन भक्त्या दानं प्रयच्छति .. 175.13 ..
6.3.m: When the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight in the month of Jyeṣṭha arrives, / having bathed there according to rule, one gives a gift with devotion.

6.3.s:
pātrabhūtāya viprāya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu .
akṣayaṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ śivena parameṣṭhinā .. 175.14 ..
6.3.d:
पात्रभूताय विप्राय स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु .
अक्षयं तत्फलं प्रोक्तं शिवेन परमेष्ठिना .. 175.14 ..
6.3.m: To a deserving brahmin, whether small or great, / that fruit has been declared imperishable by Śiva, the supreme lord.

6.3.s:
aṅgārakadine prāpte caturthyāṃ navamīṣu ca .
snānaṃ karoti puruṣo bhaktyopoṣya varāṅganā .. 175.15 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गारकदिने प्राप्ते चतुर्थ्यां नवमीषु च .
स्नानं करोति पुरुषो भक्त्योपोष्य वराङ्गना .. 175.15 ..
6.3.m: When a Tuesday coincides with the fourth or ninth [tithi], / if a man performs a bath, [or] if an excellent woman fasts with devotion,

6.3.s:
rūpamaiśvaryamatulaṃ saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ parām .
labhate saptajanmāni nityaṃ nityaṃ punaḥ punaḥ .. 175.16 ..
6.3.d:
रूपमैश्वर्यमतुलं सौभाग्यं संततिं पराम् .
लभते सप्तजन्मानि नित्यं नित्यं पुनः पुनः .. 175.16 ..
6.3.m: beauty, peerless sovereignty, good fortune, and supreme progeny / they obtain for seven births, continually, again and again.

6.3.s:
paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ snātvā piṇḍaṃ prayacchati .
tasya te dvādaśābdāni tṛptā yānti surālayam .. 175.17 ..
6.3.d:
पौर्णमास्याममावास्यां स्नात्वा पिण्डं प्रयच्छति .
तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्ता यान्ति सुरालयम् .. 175.17 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed on a full moon or new moon day, whoever offers a rice-ball— / his [ancestors], satisfied, go to the abode of the gods for twelve years.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā dadyāddīpaṃ suśobhanam .
jāyate tasya rājendra mahādīptiḥ śārīrajā .. 175.18 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या दद्याद्दीपं सुशोभनम् .
जायते तस्य राजेन्द्र महादीप्तिः शारीरजा .. 175.18 ..
6.3.m: Whoever with devotion offers a very radiant lamp at that sacred ford, / for him, O king of kings, a great bodily splendor is born.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu jantūnāṃ sarvadā kila .
anivartikā bhavetteṣāṃ gatistu śivamandirāt .. 175.19 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kapileśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcasaptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāyaḥ 176
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु जन्तूनां सर्वदा किल .
अनिवर्तिका भवेत्तेषां गतिस्तु शिवमन्दिरात् .. 175.19 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कपिलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चसप्ताधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्यायः 176
6.3.m:
For living beings who die at that sacred ford at any time, / their departure from the abode of Śiva never turns back.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-fifth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Kapileśvara Sacred Ford,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 176

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla piṅgalāvartamuttamam .
tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ kāmikaṃ bhuvi durlabham .. 176.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल पिङ्गलावर्तमुत्तमम् .
तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं कामिकं भुवि दुर्लभम् .. 176.1 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king, to the excellent Piṅgalāvarta, / a sacred ford endowed with all virtues, fulfilling desires, rare on earth.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam .
piṅgaleśvaramāsādya tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet .. 176.2 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुरा कृतम् .
पिङ्गलेश्वरमासाद्य तत्सर्वं विलयं व्रजेत् .. 176.2 ..
6.3.m: Sin committed formerly by speech, mind, or action— / having approached Piṅgaleśvara, all that dissolves away.

6.3.s:
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca devakhāte kṛtaṃ nṛpa .
akṣayaṃ tadbhavetsarvamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 176.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नानं च दानं च देवखाते कृतं नृप .
अक्षयं तद्भवेत्सर्वमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 176.3 ..
6.3.m: A bath and a gift performed there in Devakhāta, O king, / all that becomes imperishable; thus indeed Śaṅkara spoke.

6.3.s:
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu samuddhṛtya śubhodakam .
muktaṃ tatra suraiḥ khātvā devakhātaṃ tato'bhavat .. 176.4 ..
6.3.d:
पृथिव्यां सर्वतीर्थेषु समुद्धृत्य शुभोदकम् .
मुक्तं तत्र सुरैः खात्वा देवखातं ततोऽभवत् .. 176.4 ..
6.3.m: Having gathered auspicious water from all the sacred fords on earth, / it was released there by the gods after digging; hence it became Devakhāta.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ tu devakhātaṃ tatsaṃjātaṃ dvijasattama .
surāḥ sarve kathaṃ tatra mumucurvāri tīrthajam .
sarvaṃ kathaya me vipra śravaṇe lampaṭaṃ manaḥ .. 176.5 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं तु देवखातं तत्संजातं द्विजसत्तम .
सुराः सर्वे कथं तत्र मुमुचुर्वारि तीर्थजम् .
सर्वं कथय मे विप्र श्रवणे लम्पटं मनः .. 176.5 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How did that Devakhāta come to be, O best of the twice-born? / Why did all the gods release water from sacred fords there? / Tell me everything, O brahmin; my mind is eager to hear.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
yadā tu śūlaśuddhyarthaṃ rudro devagaṇaiḥ saha .
babhrāma pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śubhām .. 176.6 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
यदा तु शूलशुद्ध्यर्थं रुद्रो देवगणैः सह .
बभ्राम पृथिवीं सर्वां कमण्डलुधरः शुभाम् .. 176.6 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When, for the sake of purifying his trident, Rudra, carrying a water-pot, / wandered over the entire auspicious earth together with the hosts of gods,

6.3.s:
prabhāsādyeṣu tīrtheṣu snānaṃ cakruḥ surāstadā .
sarvatīrthotthitaṃ toyaṃ pātre vai nihitaṃ tu taiḥ .. 176.7 ..
6.3.d:
प्रभासाद्येषु तीर्थेषु स्नानं चक्रुः सुरास्तदा .
सर्वतीर्थोत्थितं तोयं पात्रे वै निहितं तु तैः .. 176.7 ..
6.3.m: the gods then bathed in sacred fords beginning with Prabhāsa. / Water taken from all the sacred fords was placed into a vessel by them.

6.3.s:
śūlabhedamanuprāpya śūlaṃ śuddhaṃ tu śūlinaḥ .
tatrotthamudakaṃ gṛhya āgatā bhṛgukacchake .. 176.8 ..
6.3.d:
शूलभेदमनुप्राप्य शूलं शुद्धं तु शूलिनः .
तत्रोत्थमुदकं गृह्य आगता भृगुकच्छके .. 176.8 ..
6.3.m: Having reached Śūlabheda, the trident of the Trident-Bearer was purified. / Taking the water that arose there, they came to Bhṛgukaccha.

6.3.s:
tatrāpaśyaṃstato hyagniṃ ca piṅgalākṣaṃ ca rogiṇam .
tapasyugre vyavasitaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ maheśvaram .. 176.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रापश्यंस्ततो ह्यग्निं च पिङ्गलाक्षं च रोगिणम् .
तपस्युग्रे व्यवसितं ध्यायमानं महेश्वरम् .. 176.9 ..
6.3.m: Then they saw there the tawny-eyed Agni, afflicted with disease, / engaged in fierce austerity, meditating on Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
havirbhāgaistu viprāṇāṃ rājñāṃ caivāmayāvinām .
dṛṣṭvā tu bahurogārtamagniṃ devamukhaṃ surāḥ .
prāhuste sahitā devaṃ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram .. 176.10 ..
6.3.d:
हविर्भागैस्तु विप्राणां राज्ञां चैवामयाविनाम् .
दृष्ट्वा तु बहुरोगार्तमग्निं देवमुखं सुराः .
प्राहुस्ते सहिता देवं शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम् .. 176.10 ..
6.3.m: Seeing Agni, the mouth of the gods, suffering from many diseases / because of the oblation-shares of diseased brahmins and kings, / the gods together spoke to the god Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the world.

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ śambho piṅgalasyāmayāvinaḥ .
yathā hi nīrujaḥ kāyo haviṣāṃ grahaṇakṣamaḥ .
punarbhavati piṅgastu tathā kuru maheśvara .. 176.11 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
प्रसादः क्रियतां शम्भो पिङ्गलस्यामयाविनः .
यथा हि नीरुजः कायो हविषां ग्रहणक्षमः .
पुनर्भवति पिङ्गस्तु तथा कुरु महेश्वर .. 176.11 ..
6.3.m: The gods said: / Let grace be shown, O Śambhu, to the diseased Piṅgala, / so that Piṅga's body becomes healthy again, capable of receiving oblations; / make it so, O Maheśvara!

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
bhobhoḥ surā hi tapasā tuṣṭo'haṃ vo viśeṣataḥ .
vacanācca viśeṣeṇa dadāmyabhimataṃ varam .. 176.12 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
भोभोः सुरा हि तपसा तुष्टोऽहं वो विशेषतः .
वचनाच्च विशेषेण ददाम्यभिमतं वरम् .. 176.12 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“O gods, I am well pleased with your austerity,
and especially by your word; I grant the desired boon.”

6.3.s:
piṅgala uvāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa dīyate deva cepsitam .
candrādityau ca nayane kṛtvātra kalayā sthitaḥ .. 176.13 ..
6.3.d:
पिङ्गल उवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश दीयते देव चेप्सितम् .
चन्द्रादित्यौ च नयने कृत्वात्र कलया स्थितः .. 176.13 ..
6.3.m:
Piṅgala said:
“If you are pleased, O Lord of gods, and what is desired is granted, O God,
having made the moon and sun your eyes, stay here with a portion [of yourself],

6.3.s:
tathā punarnavaḥ kāyo bhavedvai mama śaṅkara .
tathā kuru virūpākṣa namastubhyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ .. 176.14 ..
6.3.d:
तथा पुनर्नवः कायो भवेद्वै मम शङ्कर .
तथा कुरु विरूपाक्ष नमस्तुभ्यं पुनः पुनः .. 176.14 ..
6.3.m:
so that my body may indeed become renewed, O Śaṅkara.
Bring that about, O Virūpākṣa; homage to you again and again!”

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ sa bhagavāñchambhurmūrtimādityarūpiṇīm .
kṛtvā tu tasya tadrogamapānudata śaṅkaraḥ .. 176.15 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः स भगवाञ्छम्भुर्मूर्तिमादित्यरूपिणीम् .
कृत्वा तु तस्य तद्रोगमपानुदत शङ्करः .. 176.15 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then that blessed Śambhu, having assumed
a form in the manner of the sun, removed that disease of his, O Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
tataḥ punarnavībhūtaḥ punaḥ provāca śaṅkaram .
atraiva sthīyatāṃ śambho tathaiva bhāskaraḥ svayam .. 176.16 ..
6.3.d:
ततः पुनर्नवीभूतः पुनः प्रोवाच शङ्करम् .
अत्रैव स्थीयतां शम्भो तथैव भास्करः स्वयम् .. 176.16 ..
6.3.m:
Having then become renewed, he spoke again to Śaṅkara:
“Let Śambhu remain right here, and likewise the Sun himself,

6.3.s:
prāṇināmupakārāya rogāṇāmupaśāntaye .
pāpānāṃ dhvaṃsanārthāya śreyasāṃ caiva vṛddhaye .. 176.17 ..
6.3.d:
प्राणिनामुपकाराय रोगाणामुपशान्तये .
पापानां ध्वंसनार्थाय श्रेयसां चैव वृद्धये .. 176.17 ..
6.3.m:
for the benefit of living beings, for the pacification of diseases,
for the destruction of sins, and for the increase of blessings.”

6.3.s:
evamuktastu bhagavānpiṅgalena mahātmanā .
avatāraṃ ca kṛtavān gīrvāṇānidamabravīt .. 176.18 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान्पिङ्गलेन महात्मना .
अवतारं च कृतवान् गीर्वाणानिदमब्रवीत् .. 176.18 ..
6.3.m:
Addressed thus by the great-souled Piṅgala, the Lord
made a descent and spoke these words to the gods:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
muñcadhvamudakaṃ devāstīrthebhyo yatsamāhṛtam .
mama cottarataḥ kṛtvā khātaṃ devamayaṃ śubham .. 176.19 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
मुञ्चध्वमुदकं देवास्तीर्थेभ्यो यत्समाहृतम् .
मम चोत्तरतः कृत्वा खातं देवमयं शुभम् .. 176.19 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“O gods, release the water that has been brought together from the sacred fords,
having made to the north of me an auspicious pit filled with deities.

6.3.s:
tatra nikṣipyatāṃ vāri sarvarogavināśanam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvairapi surādibhiḥ .. 176.20 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र निक्षिप्यतां वारि सर्वरोगविनाशनम् .
सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं सर्वैरपि सुरादिभिः .. 176.20 ..
6.3.m:
Let that divine water, which destroys all diseases
and removes all sins, be poured there by all the gods and others.”

6.3.s:
evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve khātaṃ kṛtvā tathottare .
vayastriṃśatkoṭigaṇairmuktaṃ tattīrthajaṃ jalam .. 176.21 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्ताः सुराः सर्वे खातं कृत्वा तथोत्तरे .
वयस्त्रिंशत्कोटिगणैर्मुक्तं तत्तीर्थजं जलम् .. 176.21 ..
6.3.m:
Addressed thus, all the gods made a pit to the north in that manner,
and the water born of those sacred fords was released by the hosts of thirty-three crores.

6.3.s:
procuste sahitāḥ sarve virūpākṣapurogamāḥ .
yaḥ kaściddevakhāte'sminmṛdālambhanapūrvakam .. 176.22 ..
6.3.d:
प्रोचुस्ते सहिताः सर्वे विरूपाक्षपुरोगमाः .
यः कश्चिद्देवखातेऽस्मिन्मृदालम्भनपूर्वकम् .. 176.22 ..
6.3.m:
All together, led by Virūpākṣa, said:
“Whoever, having first applied clay at this divine pit,

6.3.s:
snānaṃ kṛtvā ravidine saṃsnāya narmadājale .
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pitṛbhyo vai dānaṃ dattvā svaśaktitaḥ .. 176.23 ..
6.3.d:
स्नानं कृत्वा रविदिने संस्नाय नर्मदाजले .
श्राद्धं कृत्वा पितृभ्यो वै दानं दत्त्वा स्वशक्तितः .. 176.23 ..
6.3.m:
and made a ritual ablution on a Sunday, bathes thoroughly in the water of the Narmadā,
performs a śrāddha for the ancestors, gives gifts according to his capacity,

6.3.s:
pūjayiṣyati piṅgeśaṃ tasya vāsastriviṣṭape .
bhaviṣyati surairuktaṃ śṛṇoti sakalaṃ jagat .. 176.24 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयिष्यति पिङ्गेशं तस्य वासस्त्रिविष्टपे .
भविष्यति सुरैरुक्तं शृणोति सकलं जगत् .. 176.24 ..
6.3.m:
and worships Piṅgeśa, his dwelling shall be in heaven.
It has been declared by the gods; let the whole world hear it!

6.3.s:
āmayā bhuvi martyānāṃ kṣayarogavicarcikāḥ .
vyādhayo vikṛtākārāḥ kāsaśvāsajvarodbhavāḥ .. 176.25 ..
6.3.d:
आमया भुवि मर्त्यानां क्षयरोगविचर्चिकाः .
व्याधयो विकृताकाराः कासश्वासज्वरोद्भवाः .. 176.25 ..
6.3.m:
The ailments of mortals on earth—consumption and scabies,
horrible diseases arising from cough, asthma, and fever,

6.3.s:
ekadvitricaturthāhā ye jvarā bhūtasambhavāḥ .
ye cānye vikṛtā doṣā dadruśca kāmalaṃ tathā .. 176.26 ..
6.3.d:
एकद्वित्रिचतुर्थाहा ये ज्वरा भूतसम्भवाः .
ये चान्ये विकृता दोषा दद्रुश्च कामलं तथा .. 176.26 ..
6.3.m:
fevers that return every one, two, three, or four days, those arising from spirits,
and whatever other disordered humors, ringworm, and jaundice—

6.3.s:
dinaiste saptabhiryānti nāśaṃ snānairraverdine .
śatabhedaprabhinnā ye kuṣṭhā bahuvidhāstathā .. 176.27 ..
6.3.d:
दिनैस्ते सप्तभिर्यान्ति नाशं स्नानैर्रवेर्दिने .
शतभेदप्रभिन्ना ये कुष्ठा बहुविधास्तथा .. 176.27 ..
6.3.m:
they go to destruction within seven days through ritual ablutions on Sundays.
Likewise, the various kinds of leprosy differentiated into a hundred varieties—

6.3.s:
śatamādityavārāṇāṃ snāyādaṣṭottaraṃ tu yaḥ .
sampūjya śaṅkaraṃ dadyāttilapātraṃ dvijātaye .. 176.28 ..
6.3.d:
शतमादित्यवाराणां स्नायादष्टोत्तरं तु यः .
सम्पूज्य शङ्करं दद्यात्तिलपात्रं द्विजातये .. 176.28 ..
6.3.m:
he who bathes for one hundred and eight Sundays,
worships Śaṅkara, and gives a vessel of sesame to a twice-born,

6.3.s:
naśyanti tasya kuṣṭhāni garuḍeneva pannagāḥ .
evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve tridaśāstridaśālayam .. 176.29 ..
6.3.d:
नश्यन्ति तस्य कुष्ठानि गरुडेनेव पन्नगाः .
एवमुक्त्वा गताः सर्वे त्रिदशास्त्रिदशालयम् .. 176.29 ..
6.3.m:
his leprosies are destroyed like snakes by Garuḍa.”
Having spoken thus, all the thirty [gods] went to the abode of the thirty.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saritsu ca .
snānaṃ samācarennityaṃ naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 176.30 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नदीषु देवखातेषु तडागेषु सरित्सु च .
स्नानं समाचरेन्नित्यं नरः पापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 176.30 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
In rivers, divine pits, ponds, and streams
a person should always perform ritual ablution; he is freed from sins.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasreṣu ṣaṣṭitīrthaśateṣu ca .
yatphalaṃ snānadāneṣu devakhāte tato'dhikam .. 176.31 ..
6.3.d:
षष्टितीर्थसहस्रेषु षष्टितीर्थशतेषु च .
यत्फलं स्नानदानेषु देवखाते ततोऽधिकम् .. 176.31 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever fruit there is in sixty thousand sacred fords and six hundred sacred fords
in ritual ablutions and gifts, greater than that is in the divine pit.

6.3.s:
devakhāteṣu yaḥ snātvā tarpayitvā pitṝnnṛpa .
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ piṅgaleśvaramuttamam .. 176.32 ..
6.3.d:
देवखातेषु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयित्वा पितॄन्नृप .
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं पिङ्गलेश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 176.32 ..
6.3.m:
The man who, having bathed in the divine pits and offered water to the ancestors, O king,
worships the supreme Piṅgaleśvara, the God of gods,

6.3.s:
so'śvamedhasya yajñasya vājapeyasya bhārata .
dvayoḥ puṇyamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 176.33 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe piṅgaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 177
6.3.d:
सोऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य वाजपेयस्य भारत .
द्वयोः पुण्यमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 176.33 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पिङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षट्सप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 177
6.3.m:
attains the religious merit of both the horse sacrifice and the Vājapeya sacrifice,
O descendant of Bharata; there is no doubt to be entertained in this matter.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-sixth chapter, named “Description of the Māhātmya of the Piṅgaleśvara Sacred Ford,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Avantī section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 177

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhūtīśvaraṃ tato gacchetsarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam .
darśanādeva rājendra yasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyati .. 177.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भूतीश्वरं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वतीर्थेष्वनुत्तमम् .
दर्शनादेव राजेन्द्र यस्य पापं प्रणश्यति .. 177.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
One should then go to Bhūtīśvara, unmatched among all sacred fords,
by the mere darśana of which, O best of kings, sin is destroyed.

6.3.s:
tatra sthāne purā pārtha devadevena śūlinā .
uddhūlanaṃ kṛtaṃ gātre tena bhūtīśvaraṃ tu tat .. 177.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थाने पुरा पार्थ देवदेवेन शूलिना .
उद्धूलनं कृतं गात्रे तेन भूतीश्वरं तु तत् .. 177.2 ..
6.3.m:
At that place formerly, O Pārtha, smearing with ash was done
upon his body by the spear-bearing God of gods; therefore it is Bhūtīśvara.

6.3.s:
puṣye vā janmanakṣatre amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .
bhūtīśvare naraḥ snātvā kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet .. 177.3 ..
6.3.d:
पुष्ये वा जन्मनक्षत्रे अमावास्यां विशेषतः .
भूतीश्वरे नरः स्नात्वा कुलकोटिं समुद्धरेत् .. 177.3 ..
6.3.m:
On Puṣya, or under one's birth constellation, and especially on the new-moon day,
a man who bathes at Bhūtīśvara delivers a crore of ancestors in his family.

6.3.s:
tatra sthāne tu yo bhaktyā kurute hyaṅgaguṇṭhanam .
tasya yatphalamuddiṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa .. 177.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थाने तु यो भक्त्या कुरुते ह्यङ्गगुण्ठनम् .
तस्य यत्फलमुद्दिष्टं तच्छृणुष्व नराधिप .. 177.4 ..
6.3.m:
He who with devotion rubs ash upon his limbs at that place—
hear, O lord of men, what fruit is declared for him:

6.3.s:
yāvanto bhūtikaṇikā gātre lagnāḥ śivālaye .
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate .. 177.5 ..
6.3.d:
यावन्तो भूतिकणिका गात्रे लग्नाः शिवालये .
तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि शिवलोके महीयते .. 177.5 ..
6.3.m:
As many particles of ash as cling to his body in that abode of Śiva,
for so many thousands of years he is exalted in the realm of Śiva.

6.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva snānānāṃ bhasmasnānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam .
purāṇairṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ sarvaśāstreṣvanuttamam .. 177.6 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव स्नानानां भस्मस्नानं परं स्मृतम् .
पुराणैरृषिभिः प्रोक्तं सर्वशास्त्रेष्वनुत्तमम् .. 177.6 ..
6.3.m:
Of all ritual ablutions, the ablution with ash is considered supreme;
it is proclaimed by ancient seers as the highest in all scriptures.

6.3.s:
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ cāpi yaḥ sadā .
snānaṃ karoti cāgneyaṃ pāpaṃ tasya praṇaśyati .. 177.7 ..
6.3.d:
एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं चापि यः सदा .
स्नानं करोति चाग्नेयं पापं तस्य प्रणश्यति .. 177.7 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever always performs the fiery ritual ablution
once, twice, or thrice a day, his sin is destroyed.

6.3.s:
divyasnānādvaraṃ snānaṃ vāyavyaṃ bharatarṣabha .
vāyavyāduttamaṃ brāhmyaṃ varaṃ brāhmyāttu vāruṇam .. 177.8 ..
6.3.d:
दिव्यस्नानाद्वरं स्नानं वायव्यं भरतर्षभ .
वायव्यादुत्तमं ब्राह्म्यं वरं ब्राह्म्यात्तु वारुणम् .. 177.8 ..
6.3.m:
Better than the divine ritual ablution is the airy ablution, O bull among the Bharatas;
higher than the airy is the sacred ablution, and better than the sacred is the watery ablution.

6.3.s:
āgneyaṃ vāruṇācchreṣṭhaṃ yasmāduktaṃ svayambhuvā .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena hyāgneyaṃ snānamācaret .. 177.9 ..
6.3.d:
आग्नेयं वारुणाच्छ्रेष्ठं यस्मादुक्तं स्वयम्भुवा .
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ह्याग्नेयं स्नानमाचरेत् .. 177.9 ..
6.3.m:
Because the fiery ablution is declared by the self-manifest [Brahmā] to be superior to the watery,
therefore, by every effort, one should perform the fiery ritual ablution.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ divyameva ca .
kimuktaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 177.10 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आग्नेयं वारुणं ब्राह्म्यं वायव्यं दिव्यमेव च .
किमुक्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 177.10 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
The fiery, the watery, the sacred, the airy, and the divine—
what has been proclaimed? I desire to hear it, for my curiosity is great.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
āgneyaṃ bhasmanā snānamavagāhya ca vāruṇam .
āpohiṣṭheti ca brāhmyaṃ vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ smṛtam .. 177.11 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
आग्नेयं भस्मना स्नानमवगाह्य च वारुणम् .
आपोहिष्ठेति च ब्राह्म्यं वायव्यं गोरजः स्मृतम् .. 177.11 ..

6.3.s:
sūrye dṛṣṭe tu yatsnānaṃ gaṅgātoyena tatsamam .
tatsnānaṃ pañcamaṃ proktaṃ divyaṃ pāṇḍavasattama .. 177.12 ..
6.3.d:
सूर्ये दृष्टे तु यत्स्नानं गङ्गातोयेन तत्समम् .
तत्स्नानं पञ्चमं प्रोक्तं दिव्यं पाण्डवसत्तम .. 177.12 ..
6.3.m:
That ritual ablution when the sun is seen [in rain] is equal to Gaṅgā water;
that ritual ablution is declared the fifth, the divine, O best of Pāṇḍavas.

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snātvā bhūtīśvare tu yaḥ .
pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ .. 177.13 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नात्वा भूतीश्वरे तु यः .
पूजयेद्देवमीशानं स बाह्याभ्यन्तरः शुचिः .. 177.13 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore, having bathed with every effort at Bhūtīśvara, he who
worships the god Īśāna becomes pure both outwardly and inwardly.

6.3.s:
tatra sthāne tu ye nityaṃ dhyāyanti paramaṃ padam .
sūkṣmaṃ cātīndriyaṃ nityaṃ te dhanyā nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 177.14 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थाने तु ये नित्यं ध्यायन्ति परमं पदम् .
सूक्ष्मं चातीन्द्रियं नित्यं ते धन्या नात्र संशयः .. 177.14 ..
6.3.m:
Those who constantly meditate at that place on the supreme state,
subtle, beyond the senses, and eternal, they are fortunate; there is no doubt in this.

6.3.s:
muktitīrthaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam .
darśanādeva yasyaiva pāpaṃ yāti mahatkṣayam .. 177.15 ..
6.3.d:
मुक्तितीर्थं तु तत्तीर्थं सर्वतीर्थेष्वनुत्तमम् .
दर्शनादेव यस्यैव पापं याति महत्क्षयम् .. 177.15 ..
6.3.m:
That sacred ford is the sacred ford of liberation, unmatched among all sacred fords;
by the mere darśana of it, sin goes to great destruction.

6.3.s:
jāyate pūjayā rājyaṃ tatra stutvā maheśvaram .
japena pāpasaṃśuddhirdhyānenānantyamaśnute .. 177.16 ..
6.3.d:
जायते पूजया राज्यं तत्र स्तुत्वा महेश्वरम् .
जपेन पापसंशुद्धिर्ध्यानेनानन्त्यमश्नुते .. 177.16 ..
6.3.m:
By worship there, a kingdom arises; having praised Maheśvara there,
by recitation comes purification from sin, and by meditation one attains eternity.

6.3.s:
oṃ jyotiḥ svarūpamanādimadhyamanutpādyamānamanucāryamāṇākṣaram .
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ śivaṃ sarvayogeśvaraṃ sarvalokeśvaraṃ mohaśokahīnaṃ mahājñānagamyam .. 177.17 ..
6.3.d:
ओं ज्योतिः स्वरूपमनादिमध्यमनुत्पाद्यमानमनुचार्यमाणाक्षरम् .
सर्वभूतस्थितं शिवं सर्वयोगेश्वरं सर्वलोकेश्वरं मोहशोकहीनं महाज्ञानगम्यम् .. 177.17 ..
6.3.m:
Oṃ: whose nature is light; without beginning or middle; unproduced; the unuttered syllable;
dwelling in all beings; benevolent Śiva; Lord of all yoga; Lord of all worlds; free from delusion and grief; accessible by supreme knowledge.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo gatvā snānaṃ kuryānnareśvara .
aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .
evambhūtaṃ na jānanti mokṣāpekṣaṇikā narāḥ .. 177.18 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhūtīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो गत्वा स्नानं कुर्यान्नरेश्वर .
अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .
एवम्भूतं न जानन्ति मोक्षापेक्षणिका नराः .. 177.18 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भूतीश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तसप्तत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whichever man goes to that sacred ford and performs a ritual ablution, O ruler of men, / obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. / Men who seek liberation do not know of such a place.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Bhūtīśvara Sacred Ford,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra gaṅgāvāhakamuttamam .
narmadāyāṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhṛgutīrthasamīpataḥ .. 178.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र गङ्गावाहकमुत्तमम् .
नर्मदायां महापुण्यं भृगुतीर्थसमीपतः .. 178.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O lord of kings, one should go to the excellent Gaṅgāvāhaka, / of great merit, upon the Narmadā, near Bhṛgutīrtha.

6.3.s:
tatra gaṅgā mahāpuṇyā cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ .
purā varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ paramaṃ vratamāsthitā .. 178.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र गङ्गा महापुण्या चचार विपुलं तपः .
पुरा वर्षशतं साग्रं परमं व्रतमास्थिता .. 178.2 ..
6.3.m: There, the Gaṅgā of great merit performed vast austerity / of old, for a full century of years, undertaking a supreme vow.

6.3.s:
dhyātvā devaṃ jagadyoniṃ nārāyaṇamakalmaṣam .
ātmānaṃ paramaṃ dhāma saritsā jagatīpate .. 178.3 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यात्वा देवं जगद्योनिं नारायणमकल्मषम् .
आत्मानं परमं धाम सरित्सा जगतीपते .. 178.3 ..
6.3.m: Having meditated upon the taintless god Nārāyaṇa, the womb of the universe, / as her own supreme abode, that river, O lord of the earth,

6.3.s: tato janārdano deva āgatyedamuvāca ha .. 178.4 ..
6.3.d: ततो जनार्दनो देव आगत्येदमुवाच ह .. 178.4 ..
6.3.m: then the god Janārdana came and spoke this:

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
tapasā tava tuṣṭo'haṃ matpādāmbujasambhave .
mattaḥ kimicchase devi brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te .. 178.5 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
तपसा तव तुष्टोऽहं मत्पादाम्बुजसम्भवे .
मत्तः किमिच्छसे देवि ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते .. 178.5 ..
6.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / I am pleased by your austerity, O you who were born from my lotus feet! / What do you desire from me, O goddess? Speak! What shall I do for you?

6.3.s:
gaṅgovāca -
tvatpādakamalādbhraṣṭā gaṅgā sahacarā vibho .
yadṛcchayā trilokeśa vandyamānā divaukasaiḥ .. 178.6 ..
6.3.d:
गङ्गोवाच -
त्वत्पादकमलाद्भ्रष्टा गङ्गा सहचरा विभो .
यदृच्छया त्रिलोकेश वन्द्यमाना दिवौकसैः .. 178.6 ..
6.3.m: Gaṅgā said: / Fallen from your lotus feet, O pervasive one, I became Gaṅgā, your companion, / at will, O lord of the three worlds, being praised by the gods.

6.3.s:
nṛpo bhagīrathastasmāttapaḥ kṛtvā suduṣkaram .
samārādhya jagannāthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram .. 178.7 ..
6.3.d:
नृपो भगीरथस्तस्मात्तपः कृत्वा सुदुष्करम् .
समाराध्य जगन्नाथं शङ्करं लोकशङ्करम् .. 178.7 ..
6.3.m: Then King Bhagīratha, having performed exceedingly difficult austerity / and having propitiated Śaṅkara, the lord of the universe who brings welfare to the world,

6.3.s:
avatārayāmāsa hi māṃ pṛthivyāṃ dharaṇīdhara .
mayā vai yuvayorvākyādavatāraḥ kṛto bhuvi .. 178.8 ..
6.3.d:
अवतारयामास हि मां पृथिव्यां धरणीधर .
मया वै युवयोर्वाक्यादवतारः कृतो भुवि .. 178.8 ..
6.3.m: brought me down to the earth, O upholder of the earth. / Indeed, by the word of you two, my descent was made to the earth.

6.3.s:
vaiṣṇavīmiti māṃ matvā janaḥ sarvāpluto mayi .
ye vai brahmaṇo loke ye ca vai gurutalpagāḥ .. 178.9 ..
6.3.d:
वैष्णवीमिति मां मत्वा जनः सर्वाप्लुतो मयि .
ये वै ब्रह्मणो लोके ये च वै गुरुतल्पगाः .. 178.9 ..
6.3.m: Thinking me to be Vaiṣṇavī, all people plunge into me: / those in the world who are slayers of brahmins, those who violate the guru's bed,

6.3.s:
tyāginaḥ pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ ye ca svarṇaharā narāḥ .
goghnā ye manujā loke tathā ye prāṇihiṃsakāḥ .. 178.10 ..
6.3.d:
त्यागिनः पितृमातृभ्यां ये च स्वर्णहरा नराः .
गोघ्ना ये मनुजा लोके तथा ये प्राणिहिंसकाः .. 178.10 ..
6.3.m: those who abandon their father and mother, those men who steal gold, / those mortals in the world who kill cows, and likewise those who harm living beings,

6.3.s:
agamyāgāmino ye ca hyabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣakāḥ .
ye cānṛtapravaktāro ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ .. 178.11 ..
6.3.d:
अगम्यागामिनो ये च ह्यभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षकाः .
ये चानृतप्रवक्तारो ये च विश्वासघातकाः .. 178.11 ..
6.3.m: those who approach women not to be approached, and those who eat what is uneatable, / those who speak falsehoods, and those who betray trust,

6.3.s:
devabrāhmaṇavittānāṃ hartāro ye narādhamāḥ .
devabrahmagurustrīṇāṃ ye ca nindākarā narāḥ .. 178.12 ..
6.3.d:
देवब्राह्मणवित्तानां हर्तारो ये नराधमाः .
देवब्रह्मगुरुस्त्रीणां ये च निन्दाकरा नराः .. 178.12 ..
6.3.m: those lowest of men who steal the wealth of gods and brahmins, / those men who revile gods, brahmins, gurus, and women,

6.3.s:
brahmaśāpapradagdhā ye ye caivātmahano dvijāḥ .
bhraṣṭānaśanasaṃnyāsaniyatavratacāriṇaḥ .. 178.13 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मशापप्रदग्धा ये ये चैवात्महनो द्विजाः .
भ्रष्टानशनसंन्यासनियतव्रतचारिणः .. 178.13 ..
6.3.m: those twice-born scorched by a brahmin's curse, and those who kill themselves, / those fallen from fasting, renunciation, and observed vows,

6.3.s:
tathaivāpeyapeyāśca ye ca svagurunindakāḥ .
niṣedhakā ye dānānāṃ pātradānaparāṅmukhāḥ .. 178.14 ..
6.3.d:
तथैवापेयपेयाश्च ये च स्वगुरुनिन्दकाः .
निषेधका ये दानानां पात्रदानपराङ्मुखाः .. 178.14 ..
6.3.m: likewise drinkers of what must not be drunk, and those who slander their own gurus, / those who prevent gifts, and those who turn away from giving to a worthy recipient.

6.3.s:
ṛtughnā ye svapatnīnāṃ pitroḥ sehaparā na hi .
bāndhaveṣu ca dīneṣu karuṇā yasya nāsti vai .. 178.15 ..
6.3.d:
ऋतुघ्ना ये स्वपत्नीनां पित्रोः सेहपरा न हि .
बान्धवेषु च दीनेषु करुणा यस्य नास्ति वै .. 178.15 ..
6.3.m: Those who violate the fertile periods of their wives, who have no affection for their parents, / and who indeed have no compassion for kinsmen and the wretched;

6.3.s:
kṣetrasetuvibhedī ca pūrvamārgapralopakaḥ .
nāstikaḥ śāstrahīnastu vipraḥ sandhyāvivarjitaḥ .. 178.16 ..
6.3.d:
क्षेत्रसेतुविभेदी च पूर्वमार्गप्रलोपकः .
नास्तिकः शास्त्रहीनस्तु विप्रः सन्ध्याविवर्जितः .. 178.16 ..
6.3.m: and the destroyer of field embankments, the destroyer of an ancient path, / the unbeliever, the one devoid of sacred lore, and the twice-born who neglects the twilight worship;

6.3.s:
ahutāśī hyasaṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī .
kadaryā nāstikāḥ krūrāḥ kṛtaghnā ye dvijāyaḥ .. 178.17 ..
6.3.d:
अहुताशी ह्यसंतुष्टः सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी .
कदर्या नास्तिकाः क्रूराः कृतघ्ना ये द्विजायः .. 178.17 ..
6.3.m: he who eats without offering oblations, the discontented, the omnivore, the seller of everything, / the misers, the unbelievers, the cruel, and the ungrateful twice-born;

6.3.s:
paiśunyā rasavikreyāḥ sarvakālavinākṛtāḥ .
svagotrāṃ paragotrāṃ vā ye bhuñjanti dvijādhamāḥ .. 178.18 ..
6.3.d:
पैशुन्या रसविक्रेयाः सर्वकालविनाकृताः .
स्वगोत्रां परगोत्रां वा ये भुञ्जन्ति द्विजाधमाः .. 178.18 ..
6.3.m: the slanderers, the sellers of liquids, those devoid of all auspicious times, / and those lowest of twice-born who enjoy women of their own or another's clan;

6.3.s:
te māṃ prāpya vimucyante pāpasaṅghaiḥ susaṃcitaiḥ .
tatpāpakṣārataptāyā na śarma mama vidyate .. 178.19 ..
6.3.d:
ते मां प्राप्य विमुच्यन्ते पापसङ्घैः सुसंचितैः .
तत्पापक्षारतप्ताया न शर्म मम विद्यते .. 178.19 ..
6.3.m: having reached me, they are freed from their thoroughly accumulated masses of sin. / Scorched by the corrosive burn of their sins, I find no peace.

6.3.s:
tathā kuru jagannātha yathāhaṃ śarma cāpnuyām .
evamuktastu deveśastuṣṭaḥ provāca jāhnavīm .. 178.20 ..
6.3.d:
तथा कुरु जगन्नाथ यथाहं शर्म चाप्नुयाम् .
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेशस्तुष्टः प्रोवाच जाह्नवीम् .. 178.20 ..
6.3.m: Act so, Lord of the Universe, that I too may attain peace.' / Thus addressed, the Lord of gods, pleased, said to the daughter of Jahnu:

6.3.s:
viṣṇuruvāca -
ahamatra vasiṣyāmi gaṅgādharasahāyavān .
praviśasva sadā revāṃ tvamatraiva ca mūrtinā .. 178.21 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णुरुवाच -
अहमत्र वसिष्यामि गङ्गाधरसहायवान् .
प्रविशस्व सदा रेवां त्वमत्रैव च मूर्तिना .. 178.21 ..
6.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / 'I shall dwell here with the bearer of the Gaṅgā as my companion. / Enter always into the Revā here in bodily form.

6.3.s:
mama pādatalaṃ prāpya vaha tripathagāmini .
yadā bahūdakakāle narmadājalasaṃbhṛtā .. 178.22 ..
6.3.d:
मम पादतलं प्राप्य वह त्रिपथगामिनि .
यदा बहूदककाले नर्मदाजलसंभृता .. 178.22 ..
6.3.m: Having reached the sole of my foot, flow on, O goddess who moves along the three paths! / When, in the season of abundant waters, filled with the water of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
prāvṛṭkālaṃ samāsādya bhaviṣyati jalākulā .
plāvyobhayataṭaṃ devī prāpya māmuttarasthitam .. 178.23 ..
6.3.d:
प्रावृट्कालं समासाद्य भविष्यति जलाकुला .
प्लाव्योभयतटं देवी प्राप्य मामुत्तरस्थितम् .. 178.23 ..
6.3.m: and having reached the rainy season, she becomes turbulent with water, / flooding both banks, the goddess, reaching me stationed to the north,

6.3.s:
plāvayiṣyati toyena yadā śaṅkhaṃ kare sthitam .
tadā parvaśatodyuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ parvasaṃjñitam .. 178.24 ..
6.3.d:
प्लावयिष्यति तोयेन यदा शङ्खं करे स्थितम् .
तदा पर्वशतोद्युक्तं वैष्णवं पर्वसंज्ञितम् .. 178.24 ..
6.3.m: will submerge with water the conch held in my hand. / Then occurs the Vaiṣṇava festival, named a holy occasion endowed with a hundred festivals.

6.3.s:
na tena sadṛśaṃ kiṃcidvyatīpātādisaṃkramam .
ayane dve ca na tathā puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ yathā .. 178.25 ..
6.3.d:
न तेन सदृशं किंचिद्व्यतीपातादिसंक्रमम् .
अयने द्वे च न तथा पुण्यात्पुण्यतरं यथा .. 178.25 ..
6.3.m: There is nothing equal to it among astrological conjunctions such as Vyatīpāta; / nor are the two solstices so meritoriously superior to merit as this.

6.3.s:
tasminparvaṇi deveśi śaṅkhaṃ saṃspṛśya mānavaḥ .
snānamācarate toye miśre gāṅgeyanārmade .. 178.26 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिन्पर्वणि देवेशि शङ्खं संस्पृश्य मानवः .
स्नानमाचरते तोये मिश्रे गाङ्गेयनार्मदे .. 178.26 ..
6.3.m: On that holy occasion, O goddess of the gods, a person having touched the conch / performs a ritual ablution in the mingled water of Gaṅgā and Narmadā;

6.3.s:
puṇyaṃ tvaśeṣapuṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam .
viṣṇunā vidhṛto yena tasmācchāntiḥ pracakrame .. 178.27 ..
6.3.d:
पुण्यं त्वशेषपुण्यानां मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम् .
विष्णुना विधृतो येन तस्माच्छान्तिः प्रचक्रमे .. 178.27 ..
6.3.m: it is the merit of all merits and the auspiciousness of all auspicious things. / Because it was held by Viṣṇu, peace proceeded from it.

6.3.s:
tatrāntaṃ pāpasaṅghasya dhruvamāpnoti mānavaḥ .
śaṅkhoddhāre naraḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 178.28 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रान्तं पापसङ्घस्य ध्रुवमाप्नोति मानवः .
शङ्खोद्धारे नरः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 178.28 ..
6.3.m: There, a person surely attains the end of a mass of sins. / Having bathed at Śaṅkhoddhāra, a man should offer libations to the ancestors and the gods.

6.3.s:
tṛptāste dvādaśābdāni siddhiṃ ca sārvakāmikīm .
gaṅgāvahe tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ śaṅkhoddhāre pradāsyati .. 178.29 ..
6.3.d:
तृप्तास्ते द्वादशाब्दानि सिद्धिं च सार्वकामिकीम् .
गङ्गावहे तु यः श्राद्धं शङ्खोद्धारे प्रदास्यति .. 178.29 ..
6.3.m: They remain satisfied for twelve years and grant the attainment of all desires. / Whoever offers an ancestral rite at the flowing of the Gaṅgā at Śaṅkhoddhāra,

6.3.s:
tena piṇḍapradānena nṛtyanti pitarastathā .
śaṅkhoddhāre naraḥ snātvā pūjayedbalakeśavau .. 178.30 ..
6.3.d:
तेन पिण्डप्रदानेन नृत्यन्ति पितरस्तथा .
शङ्खोद्धारे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्बलकेशवौ .. 178.30 ..
6.3.m: by that offering of the rice-ball, the ancestors dance in joy. / Having bathed at Śaṅkhoddhāra, a man should worship Balarāma and Keśava.

6.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā śuddho bhavati jāhnavi .
yattvaṃ lokakṛtaṃ karma manyase bhuvi duḥsaham .. 178.31 ..
6.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा शुद्धो भवति जाह्नवि .
यत्त्वं लोककृतं कर्म मन्यसे भुवि दुःसहम् .. 178.31 ..
6.3.m: Having kept a night-vigil, O daughter of Jahnu, he becomes pure. / Whatever deed done by the world you deem unbearable on earth,

6.3.s:
tasminparvaṇi tatsarvaṃ tatra snātvā vyapohaya .
evamuktvā naraśreṣṭha viṣṇuścāntaradhīyata .. 178.32 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिन्पर्वणि तत्सर्वं तत्र स्नात्वा व्यपोहय .
एवमुक्त्वा नरश्रेष्ठ विष्णुश्चान्तरधीयत .. 178.32 ..
6.3.m: on that holy festival, wash it all away by bathing there.' / Having spoken thus, O best of men, Viṣṇu vanished.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ gaṅgāvāhakamuttamam .
brahmādyairṛṣibhistāta pāramparyakramāgataiḥ .. 178.33 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं गङ्गावाहकमुत्तमम् .
ब्रह्माद्यैरृषिभिस्तात पारम्पर्यक्रमागतैः .. 178.33 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, that sacred ford became the supreme Gaṅgāvāhaka, / [resorted to] by seers beginning with Brahmā through traditional succession, dear child.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā bhaktibhāvena bhārata .
gaṅgātīrthe tu sa snātaḥ samasteṣu na saṃśayaḥ .. 178.34 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा भक्तिभावेन भारत .
गङ्गातीर्थे तु स स्नातः समस्तेषु न संशयः .. 178.34 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford with devotion, O descendant of Bharata, / has undoubtedly bathed in all the sacred fords of the Gaṅgā.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām .
anivartikā gatisteṣāṃ viṣṇulokātkadācana .. 178.35 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gaṅgāvahakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 179
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु नराणां भावितात्मनाम् .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तेषां विष्णुलोकात्कदाचन .. 178.35 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गङ्गावहकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 179
6.3.m:
Of the self-controlled men who die at that sacred ford, / there is no return ever from the world of Viṣṇu.
Thus ends the one hundred seventy-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Gaṅgāvāhaka Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, the great Purāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 179

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra gautameśvaramuttamam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .. 179.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र गौतमेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
सर्वपापहरं तीर्थं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .. 179.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king of kings, to the supreme Gautameśvara, / a sacred ford that removes all sins and is renowned in the three worlds.

6.3.s:
gautamena tapastaptaṃ tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 179.2 ..
6.3.d:
गौतमेन तपस्तप्तं तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 179.2 ..
6.3.m: Gautama performed austerity at that sacred ford, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / for a celestial thousand years; then Maheśvara was pleased.

6.3.s:
praṇamya śirasā tatra sthāpitaḥ parameśvaraḥ .
sthāpito gautameneśo gautameśvara ucyate .. 179.3 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा तत्र स्थापितः परमेश्वरः .
स्थापितो गौतमेनेशो गौतमेश्वर उच्यते .. 179.3 ..
6.3.m: Bowing with his head, he installed Parameśvara there. / The Lord installed by Gautama is called Gautameśvara.

6.3.s:
tatra devaiśca gandharvairṛṣibhiḥ pitṛdaivataiḥ .
samprāptā hyuttamā siddhirārādhya parameśvaram .. 179.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र देवैश्च गन्धर्वैरृषिभिः पितृदैवतैः .
सम्प्राप्ता ह्युत्तमा सिद्धिराराध्य परमेश्वरम् .. 179.4 ..
6.3.m: There, having worshipped Parameśvara, supreme perfection was attained / by gods, gandharvas, seers, and ancestral deities.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
pūjayetparamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 179.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्पितृदेवताः .
पूजयेत्परमीशानं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 179.5 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at that sacred ford and worshipped the ancestral deities, / and having worshipped the supreme Īśāna, one is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
bahavastanna jānanti viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ .
tatra saṃnihitaṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram .. 179.6 ..
6.3.d:
बहवस्तन्न जानन्ति विष्णुमायाविमोहिताः .
तत्र संनिहितं देवं शूलपाणिं महेश्वरम् .. 179.6 ..
6.3.m: Deluded by the māyā of Viṣṇu, many do not know / of the trident-bearing god, Maheśvara, present there.

6.3.s:
brahmacārī tu yo bhūtvā tatra tīrthe nareśvara .
snātvārcayenmahādevaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 179.7 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मचारी तु यो भूत्वा तत्र तीर्थे नरेश्वर .
स्नात्वार्चयेन्महादेवं सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 179.7 ..
6.3.m: One who observes celibacy, O ruler of men, / bathes at that sacred ford, and worships Mahādeva, attains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
brahmacārī tu yo bhūtvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
pūjayetparamīśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 179.8 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मचारी तु यो भूत्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
पूजयेत्परमीशानं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 179.8 ..
6.3.m: One who observes celibacy, offers libations to the ancestral deities, / and worships the supreme Īśāna, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo dānaṃ bhaktyā dadyāddvijātaye .
tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 179.9 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो दानं भक्त्या दद्याद्द्विजातये .
तदक्षयफलं सर्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 179.9 ..
6.3.m: Whatever gift one gives with devotion to a twice-born at that sacred ford / brings inexhaustible fruit; no doubt should be entertained here.

6.3.s:
māse cāśvayuje rājan kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm .
snātvā tatra vidhānena dīpakānāṃ śataṃ dadet .. 179.10 ..
6.3.d:
मासे चाश्वयुजे राजन् कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् .
स्नात्वा तत्र विधानेन दीपकानां शतं ददेत् .. 179.10 ..
6.3.m: And in the month of Āśvayuja, O king, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / having bathed there according to the rule, one should offer a hundred lamps.

6.3.s:
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ gandhapuṣpādibhirnaraḥ .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet .. 179.11 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयित्वा महादेवं गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्नरः .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो मृतः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् .. 179.11 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped Mahādeva with fragrant ointments, flowers, and the like, a man / is freed from all sins, and, upon death, goes to the city of Śiva.

6.3.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ .
upoṣya prayato bhūtvā ghṛtena snāpayecchivam .. 179.12 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां कार्त्तिक्यां तु विशेषतः .
उपोष्य प्रयतो भूत्वा घृतेन स्नापयेच्छिवम् .. 179.12 ..
6.3.m: On the eighth and fourteenth days, and especially on Kārttikī, / having fasted and become self-controlled, one should bathe Śiva with clarified butter,

6.3.s:
pañcagavyena madhunā dadhnā vā śītavāriṇā .
sa ca sarvasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 179.13 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चगव्येन मधुना दध्ना वा शीतवारिणा .
स च सर्वस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 179.13 ..
6.3.m: with the five products of the cow, with honey, with curds, or with cold water; / and that man obtains the fruit of every sacrifice.

6.3.s:
bhaktyā tu pūjayetpaścātsa labhetphalamuttamam .
bilvapatrairakhaṇḍaiśca puṣpairunmattakodbhavaiḥ .. 179.14 ..
6.3.d:
भक्त्या तु पूजयेत्पश्चात्स लभेत्फलमुत्तमम् .
बिल्वपत्रैरखण्डैश्च पुष्पैरुन्मत्तकोद्भवैः .. 179.14 ..
6.3.m: If he subsequently worships with devotion, he attains an excellent reward— / with unbroken bilva leaves and flowers sprung from the unmatta plant,

6.3.s:
kuśāpāmārgasahitaiḥ kadambadroṇajairapi .
mallikākaravīraiśca raktapītaiḥ sitāsitaiḥ .. 179.15 ..
6.3.d:
कुशापामार्गसहितैः कदम्बद्रोणजैरपि .
मल्लिकाकरवीरैश्च रक्तपीतैः सितासितैः .. 179.15 ..
6.3.m: along with kuśa grass and apāmārga, with kadamba and droṇa flowers, / with mallikā and oleanders, red, yellow, white, and black,

6.3.s:
puṣpairanyairyathālābhaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayecchivam .
nairantaryeṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ yo'rcayedgautameśvaram .
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet .. 179.16 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe gautameśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekonāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 180
6.3.d:
पुष्पैरन्यैर्यथालाभं यो नरः पूजयेच्छिवम् .
नैरन्तर्येण षण्मासं योऽर्चयेद्गौतमेश्वरम् .
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति मृतः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् .. 179.16 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे गौतमेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम एकोनाशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 180
6.3.m:
and with other flowers as obtained, whichever man worships Śiva; / he who worships Gautameśvara continuously for six months / attains all desires, and, upon death, goes to the city of Śiva.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Gautameśvara Sacred Ford,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
Chapter 180

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla daśāśvamedhikaṃ param .
tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 180.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल दशाश्वमेधिकं परम् .
तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं महापातकनाशनम् .. 180.1 ..
6.3.m: Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to the supreme Daśāśvamedhika, / a sacred ford endowed with all virtues, destroying great sins.

6.3.s:
yatra gatvā mahārāja snātvā sampūjya ceśvaram .
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 180.2 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र गत्वा महाराज स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य चेश्वरम् .
दशानामश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 180.2 ..
6.3.m: Having gone there, O great king, bathed, and worshipped Īśvara, / a man obtains the fruit of ten horse sacrifices.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
aśvamedho mahāyajño bahusambhāradakṣiṇaḥ .
aśakyaḥ prākṛtaiḥ kartuṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ phalaṃ labhet .. 180.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
अश्वमेधो महायज्ञो बहुसम्भारदक्षिणः .
अशक्यः प्राकृतैः कर्तुं कथं तेषां फलं लभेत् .. 180.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The horse sacrifice is a great sacrifice requiring abundant provisions and sacrificial fees, / impossible for ordinary men to perform; how could one obtain its fruit?

6.3.s:
atyāścaryamidaṃ tattvaṃ tvayoktaṃ vadatā satā .
yathā me jāyate śraddhā dīrghāyustvaṃ tathā vada .. 180.4 ..
6.3.d:
अत्याश्चर्यमिदं तत्त्वं त्वयोक्तं वदता सता .
यथा मे जायते श्रद्धा दीर्घायुस्त्वं तथा वद .. 180.4 ..
6.3.m: This is a most wondrous truth stated by you, an eloquent good man. / Long-lived one, speak in such a way that faith may arise in me.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
idamāścaryabhūtaṃ hi gauryā pṛṣṭastriyambakaḥ .
tatte'haṃ sampravakṣyāmi pṛcchate nipuṇāya vai .. 180.5 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
इदमाश्चर्यभूतं हि गौर्या पृष्टस्त्रियम्बकः .
तत्तेऽहं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि पृच्छते निपुणाय वै .. 180.5 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This wondrous matter was indeed asked of the Three-eyed Lord by Gaurī; / that I shall declare to you, who ask with great discernment.

6.3.s:
purā vṛṣastho deveśa hyumayā saha śaṅkaraḥ .
kadācitparyaṭanpṛthivīṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ .. 180.6 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा वृषस्थो देवेश ह्युमया सह शङ्करः .
कदाचित्पर्यटन्पृथिवीं नर्मदातटमाश्रितः .. 180.6 ..
