6.3.m: Long ago, Śaṅkara, the lord of gods, mounted on his bull along with Umā, / once wandering over the earth, resorted to the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā devo maheśvaraḥ .
tīrthaṃ pratyañjaliṃ baddhvā namaścakre trilocanaḥ .. 180.7 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं दृष्ट्वा देवो महेश्वरः .
तीर्थं प्रत्यञ्जलिं बद्ध्वा नमश्चक्रे त्रिलोचनः .. 180.7 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the Daśāśvamedhika sacred ford, the god Maheśvara, / the three-eyed one, folded his hands toward the sacred ford and bowed.

6.3.s: kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā devīdamabravīt .. 180.8 ..
6.3.d: कृताञ्जलिपुटं देवं दृष्ट्वा देवीदमब्रवीत् .. 180.8 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the god with hands joined in reverent salutation, the goddess said this:

6.3.s:
devyuvāca -
kimetaddevadeveśa carācaranamaskṛta .
prahvanamrāñjaliṃ baddhvā bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ .. 180.9 ..
6.3.d:
देव्युवाच -
किमेतद्देवदेवेश चराचरनमस्कृत .
प्रह्वनम्राञ्जलिं बद्ध्वा भक्त्या परमया युतः .. 180.9 ..
6.3.m: The goddess said: / What is this, O Lord of the gods of gods, bowed to by all moving and unmoving beings, / that you stand with hands folded low in obeisance, filled with supreme devotion?

6.3.s: etadāścaryamatulaṃ sarvaṃ kathaya me prabho .. 180.10 ..
6.3.d: एतदाश्चर्यमतुलं सर्वं कथय मे प्रभो .. 180.10 ..
6.3.m: Explain all this peerless wonder to me, O Lord.

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
pratyakṣaṃ paśya tīrthasya phalaṃ mā vismitā bhava .
viyatsthā me bhuvisthasya kṣaṇaṃ devi sthirā bhava .. 180.11 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
प्रत्यक्षं पश्य तीर्थस्य फलं मा विस्मिता भव .
वियत्स्था मे भुविस्थस्य क्षणं देवि स्थिरा भव .. 180.11 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / See the fruit of the sacred ford directly; do not be amazed. / Remaining in the sky while I am on the earth, be still for a moment, O goddess.

6.3.s:
evamuktvā tu deveśo gauravarṇo dvijo'bhavat .
kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭho jaṭilaḥ śuṣko dhamanisaṃtataḥ .. 180.12 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु देवेशो गौरवर्णो द्विजोऽभवत् .
क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठो जटिलः शुष्को धमनिसंततः .. 180.12 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the lord of gods became a fair-complexioned twice-born, / his throat emaciated with hunger, with matted hair, dried up, his veins standing out.

6.3.s:
upaviśya bhuvaḥ pṛṣṭhe susvaraṃ mantramuccaran .
kramapriyo mahādevo mādhuryeṇa pramodayan .. 180.13 ..
6.3.d:
उपविश्य भुवः पृष्ठे सुस्वरं मन्त्रमुच्चरन् .
क्रमप्रियो महादेवो माधुर्येण प्रमोदयन् .. 180.13 ..
6.3.m: Sitting on the surface of the earth, uttering mantras in an exquisite tone, / Mahādeva, who loved the stepwise recitation, delighted [all] with its sweetness.

6.3.s:
śrutvā tāṃ madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ svayaṃ devena nirmitām .
saṃbhrāntā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve snātuṃ ye tatra cāgatāḥ .. 180.14 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तां मधुरां वाणीं स्वयं देवेन निर्मिताम् .
संभ्रान्ता ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे स्नातुं ये तत्र चागताः .. 180.14 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that sweet voice produced by the god himself, / all the brahmins who had come there to bathe were bewildered.

6.3.s:
nityakriyā ca sarveṣāṃ vismṛtā śrutivibhramāt .
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paṭhamānaṃ tu kṣutpipāsābhipīḍitam .. 180.15 ..
6.3.d:
नित्यक्रिया च सर्वेषां विस्मृता श्रुतिविभ्रमात् .
तं दृष्ट्वा पठमानं तु क्षुत्पिपासाभिपीडितम् .. 180.15 ..
6.3.m: And their daily ritual was forgotten due to confusion over the sacred text. / Seeing him reciting, tormented by hunger and thirst,

6.3.s:
dvijo'nyamantrayatkaścidbhaktyā taṃ bhojanāya vai .
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ brahmanbhojanāya gṛhe mama .. 180.16 ..
6.3.d:
द्विजोऽन्यमन्त्रयत्कश्चिद्भक्त्या तं भोजनाय वै .
प्रसादः क्रियतां ब्रह्मन्भोजनाय गृहे मम .. 180.16 ..
6.3.m: a certain twice-born invited him with devotion to take food: / “O brahmin, grant me the favor of taking a meal at my house.

6.3.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma hyadya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ .
sarvānkāmānpradāsyanti prītā me'dya pitāmahāḥ .. 180.17 ..
6.3.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म ह्यद्य मे सफलाः क्रियाः .
सर्वान्कामान्प्रदास्यन्ति प्रीता मेऽद्य पितामहाः .. 180.17 ..
6.3.m: Today my birth has borne fruit; today my rituals have borne fruit! / Pleased today, my forefathers will grant all desires.

6.3.s:
tvayi bhukte dvijaśreṣṭha prasīda tvaṃ dhruvaṃ mama .
evamukto mahādevo dvijarūpadharastadā .. 180.18 ..
6.3.d:
त्वयि भुक्ते द्विजश्रेष्ठ प्रसीद त्वं ध्रुवं मम .
एवमुक्तो महादेवो द्विजरूपधरस्तदा .. 180.18 ..
6.3.m: When you have eaten, O best of the twice-born, be surely gracious to me.” / Thus addressed, Mahādeva, who was then wearing the guise of a twice-born,

6.3.s:
prahasya pratyuvācedaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ślakṣṇayā girā .
mayā varṣasahasraṃ tu nirāhāraṃ tapaḥ kṛtam .. 180.19 ..
6.3.d:
प्रहस्य प्रत्युवाचेदं ब्राह्मणं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा .
मया वर्षसहस्रं तु निराहारं तपः कृतम् .. 180.19 ..
6.3.m: laughed gently and replied to the brahmin in smooth words: / “For a thousand years I have performed austerity without food.

6.3.s:
idānīṃ tu gṛhe tasya kariṣye dvijasattama .
daśabhirvājimedhaiśca yeneṣṭaṃ pāraṇaṃ tathā .. 180.20 ..
6.3.d:
इदानीं तु गृहे तस्य करिष्ये द्विजसत्तम .
दशभिर्वाजिमेधैश्च येनेष्टं पारणं तथा .. 180.20 ..
6.3.m: Now, O best of the twice-born, I shall take the breaking of my fast / in the house of him who has performed ten horse sacrifices.”

6.3.s:
ityukto devadevena brāhmaṇo vismayānvitaḥ .
uttamāṅgaṃ vidhunvanvai jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati .. 180.21 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्तो देवदेवेन ब्राह्मणो विस्मयान्वितः .
उत्तमाङ्गं विधुन्वन्वै जगाम स्वगृहं प्रति .. 180.21 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed by the god of gods, the brahmin was filled with astonishment; / shaking his head, he went back to his own house.

6.3.s:
evaṃ te bahavo viprāḥ pratyākhyāte nimantraṇe .
purāṇārthamajānanto nāstikā bahavo gatāḥ .. 180.22 ..
6.3.d:
एवं ते बहवो विप्राः प्रत्याख्याते निमन्त्रणे .
पुराणार्थमजानन्तो नास्तिका बहवो गताः .. 180.22 ..
6.3.m:
In this way, many brahmins, when their invitation was rejected,
ignorant of the meaning of the Purāṇas and lacking faith, went away in great numbers.

6.3.s:
atha kaściddvijo vidvānpurāṇārthasya tattvavit .
devaṃ nimantrayāmāsa dvijarūpadharaṃ śivam .. 180.23 ..
6.3.d:
अथ कश्चिद्द्विजो विद्वान्पुराणार्थस्य तत्त्ववित् .
देवं निमन्त्रयामास द्विजरूपधरं शिवम् .. 180.23 ..
6.3.m:
Then a certain learned brahmin, who knew the truth of the Purāṇic meaning,
invited the god Śiva, who was bearing the form of a brahmin.

6.3.s:
tathaiva so'pi devena proktaḥ sa prāha taṃ punaḥ .
manasā cintayitvā tu purāṇoktaṃ dvijottamaḥ .. 180.24 ..
6.3.d:
तथैव सोऽपि देवेन प्रोक्तः स प्राह तं पुनः .
मनसा चिन्तयित्वा तु पुराणोक्तं द्विजोत्तमः .. 180.24 ..
6.3.m:
He too was addressed in the very same way by the god. Pondering in his mind
what is stated in the Purāṇas, the best of brahmins spoke to him in turn:

6.3.s:
smṛtivedapurāṇeṣu yaduktaṃ tattathā bhavet .
iti niścitya taṃ vipramuvāca prahasanniva .. 180.25 ..
6.3.d:
स्मृतिवेदपुराणेषु यदुक्तं तत्तथा भवेत् .
इति निश्चित्य तं विप्रमुवाच प्रहसन्निव .. 180.25 ..
6.3.m:
“Whatever is stated in the Smṛtis, Vedas, and Purāṇas, that must indeed be so.”
Having thus resolved, as if smiling, he said to that brahmin:

6.3.s:
bhobho vipra pratīkṣasva yāvadāgamanaṃ punaḥ .
ityuktvā tu dvijo gatvā daśāśvamedhikaṃ param .. 180.26 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो विप्र प्रतीक्षस्व यावदागमनं पुनः .
इत्युक्त्वा तु द्विजो गत्वा दशाश्वमेधिकं परम् .. 180.26 ..
6.3.m:
“O brahmin, please wait until my return.”
Having said this, the brahmin went to the supreme Daśāśvamedhika [tīrtha].

6.3.s:
snānaṃ mahālambhanādi kṛtaṃ tena dvijanmanā .
japaṃ śrāddhaṃ tathā dānaṃ kṛtvā dharmānusārataḥ .. 180.27 ..
6.3.d:
स्नानं महालम्भनादि कृतं तेन द्विजन्मना .
जपं श्राद्धं तथा दानं कृत्वा धर्मानुसारतः .. 180.27 ..
6.3.m:
A ritual ablution, the great sacrificial rites and the rest were performed by that twice-born;
recitation, an ancestral offering, and charity he performed according to dharma.

6.3.s:
saṃkalpya kapilāṃ tatra purāṇoktavidhānataḥ .
samāyāttvaritaṃ tatra yatrāsau tiṣṭhate dvijaḥ .. 180.28 ..
6.3.d:
संकल्प्य कपिलां तत्र पुराणोक्तविधानतः .
समायात्त्वरितं तत्र यत्रासौ तिष्ठते द्विजः .. 180.28 ..
6.3.m:
Having made a resolution to donate a brown cow there according to the rule declared in the Purāṇas,
he came back quickly to the place where that brahmin was waiting.

6.3.s:
athāgatya dvijaṃ prāha vājimedhaḥ kṛto mayā .
uttiṣṭha me gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ bhojanārthaṃ hi gamyatām .. 180.29 ..
6.3.d:
अथागत्य द्विजं प्राह वाजिमेधः कृतो मया .
उत्तिष्ठ मे गृहं रम्यं भोजनार्थं हि गम्यताम् .. 180.29 ..
6.3.m:
Then, having arrived, he said to the brahmin: “A horse sacrifice has been performed by me.
Arise, let us go to my delightful house to eat.”

6.3.s:
ityuktaḥ śaṅkarastena brāhmaṇenātivismitaḥ .
uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ deva idānīṃ tvamito gataḥ .. 180.30 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्तः शङ्करस्तेन ब्राह्मणेनातिविस्मितः .
उवाच ब्राह्मणं देव इदानीं त्वमितो गतः .. 180.30 ..
6.3.m:
Thus addressed by that brahmin, Śaṃkara, greatly astonished,
said to the brahmin: “O god-like man, you have only just gone from here;

6.3.s: dvijavarya kathaṃ ceṣṭā daśa yajñā mahādhanāḥ .. 180.31 ..
6.3.d: द्विजवर्य कथं चेष्टा दश यज्ञा महाधनाः .. 180.31 ..
6.3.m: O best of brahmins, how were ten sacrifices of great expense performed?”

6.3.s:
dvija uvāca -
na vicārastvayā kāryaḥ kṛtā yajñā na saṃśayaḥ .
yadi vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ taṃ bhuvi devā dvijāstathā .. 180.32 ..
6.3.d:
द्विज उवाच -
न विचारस्त्वया कार्यः कृता यज्ञा न संशयः .
यदि वेदाः प्रमाणं तं भुवि देवा द्विजास्तथा .. 180.32 ..

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā satyaṃ dvijottama .
yadi vedapurāṇoktaṃ vākyaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ bhavet .. 180.33 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं तथा सत्यं द्विजोत्तम .
यदि वेदपुराणोक्तं वाक्यं निःसंशयं भवेत् .. 180.33 ..
6.3.m:
if the sacred ford Daśāśvamedhika is truly so, O best of brahmins,
and if the word declared in the Vedas and Purāṇas is beyond doubt;

6.3.s:
tadā prāptaṃ mayā sarvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .
evamuktastu deveśa āstikyaṃ tasya cetasaḥ .. 180.34 ..
6.3.d:
तदा प्राप्तं मया सर्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेश आस्तिक्यं तस्य चेतसः .. 180.34 ..
6.3.m:
then all has been obtained by me; there is no deliberation to be made here.”
When addressed in this way, the Lord of gods, [noticing] the faith of his mind,

6.3.s:
vimṛśya bahubhiḥ kiṃciduttaraṃ na prapadyata .
jagāma tadgṛhaṃ ramyaṃ paṭhanbrahma sanātanam .. 180.35 ..
6.3.d:
विमृश्य बहुभिः किंचिदुत्तरं न प्रपद्यत .
जगाम तद्गृहं रम्यं पठन्ब्रह्म सनातनम् .. 180.35 ..
6.3.m:
and considering it in many ways, found no retort whatsoever;
reciting the eternal Veda, he went to his delightful house.

6.3.s:
samprāptaṃ taṃ dvijaṃ bhaktyā pādyārghyeṇa tamarcayat .
ṣaḍrasaṃ bhojanaṃ tena dattaṃ paścādyathāvidhi .. 180.36 ..
6.3.d:
सम्प्राप्तं तं द्विजं भक्त्या पाद्यार्घ्येण तमर्चयत् .
षड्रसं भोजनं तेन दत्तं पश्चाद्यथाविधि .. 180.36 ..
6.3.m:
With devotion he worshipped that arriving brahmin with water for the feet and an oblation of water;
a meal of six tastes was then offered by him according to rule.

6.3.s:
tato bhukte mahādeve sarvadevamaye śive .
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papātāśu gaganāttasya mūrdhani .
tasyāstikyaṃ tu saṃlakṣya tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ .. 180.37 ..
6.3.d:
ततो भुक्ते महादेवे सर्वदेवमये शिवे .
पुष्पवृष्टिः पपाताशु गगनात्तस्य मूर्धनि .
तस्यास्तिक्यं तु संलक्ष्य तुष्टः प्रोवाच शङ्करः .. 180.37 ..
6.3.m:
Then, when the Great God, Śiva who embodies all deities, had eaten,
a shower of flowers fell swiftly from the sky upon his head.
Perceiving his faith, Śaṃkara was pleased and said:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
kiṃ te'dya kriyatāṃ brūhi varado'haṃ dvijottama .
adeyamapi dāsyāmi ekacittasya te dhruvam .. 180.38 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
किं तेऽद्य क्रियतां ब्रूहि वरदोऽहं द्विजोत्तम .
अदेयमपि दास्यामि एकचित्तस्य ते ध्रुवम् .. 180.38 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
“Tell me, what shall be done for you today? I am a giver of boons, O best of brahmins.
I will grant even what cannot be given to you who are single-minded, surely.”

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
yadi prīto'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama .
asmiṃstīrthe mahādeva sthātavyaṃ sarvadaiva hi .. 180.39 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
यदि प्रीतोऽसि मे देव यदि देयो वरो मम .
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे महादेव स्थातव्यं सर्वदैव हि .. 180.39 ..
6.3.m:
The brahmin said:
“If you are pleased with me, O god, if a boon is to be given to me,
you must always remain in this sacred ford, O Great God,

6.3.s:
upakārāya deveśa eṣa me vara uttamaḥ .
evamuktastu devena āruroha dvijottamaḥ .. 180.40 ..
6.3.d:
उपकाराय देवेश एष मे वर उत्तमः .
एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन आरुरोह द्विजोत्तमः .. 180.40 ..
6.3.m:
for the benefit [of the world], O Lord of gods; this is my supreme boon.”
Addressed thus by the god, the best of brahmins mounted

6.3.s:
gandharvāpsaraḥsambādhaṃ vimānaṃ sārvakāmikam .
pūjyamāno gatastatra yatra lokā nirāmayāḥ .. 180.41 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धर्वाप्सरःसम्बाधं विमानं सार्वकामिकम् .
पूज्यमानो गतस्तत्र यत्र लोका निरामयाः .. 180.41 ..
6.3.m:
an aerial chariot crowded with Gandharvas and apsarases, granting all desires,
and, being worshipped, he went to the world where beings are free from affliction.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etadāścaryamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī suvismitā .
vismayotphullanayanā punaḥ papraccha śaṅkaram .. 180.42 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतदाश्चर्यमतुलं दृष्ट्वा देवी सुविस्मिता .
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना पुनः पप्रच्छ शङ्करम् .. 180.42 ..

6.3.s:
pārvatyuvāca -
kathametadbhavetsatyaṃ yatredamasamañjasam .
snānaṃ kurvanti bahavo lokā hyatra maheśvara .. 180.43 ..
6.3.d:
पार्वत्युवाच -
कथमेतद्भवेत्सत्यं यत्रेदमसमञ्जसम् .
स्नानं कुर्वन्ति बहवो लोका ह्यत्र महेश्वर .. 180.43 ..

6.3.s:
teṣāṃ tu svargagamanaṃ yathaiṣa svargatiṃ gataḥ .
kathametatsamācakṣva vismayaḥ paramo mama .. 180.44 ..
6.3.d:
तेषां तु स्वर्गगमनं यथैष स्वर्गतिं गतः .
कथमेतत्समाचक्ष्व विस्मयः परमो मम .. 180.44 ..
6.3.m:
how is their departure for heaven [not seen], just as this man went to the heavenly path?
Explain this [to me]; it is my great wonder.”

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā tu deveśaḥ prahasanpratyuvāca tām .
vedavākye purāṇārthe smṛtyarthe dvijabhāṣite .. 180.45 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु देवेशः प्रहसन्प्रत्युवाच ताम् .
वेदवाक्ये पुराणार्थे स्मृत्यर्थे द्विजभाषिते .. 180.45 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing this, the Lord of gods, smiling, answered her:
“Regarding a Vedic statement, the meaning of a Purāṇa, the meaning of a Smṛti, and the words of a brahmin,

6.3.s:
vismayo hi na kartavyo hyanumānaṃ hi tattathā .
asaṃbhāvyaṃ hi lokānāṃ purāṇe yatpragīyate .. 180.46 ..
6.3.d:
विस्मयो हि न कर्तव्यो ह्यनुमानं हि तत्तथा .
असंभाव्यं हि लोकानां पुराणे यत्प्रगीयते .. 180.46 ..
6.3.m:
astonishment is not to be felt, for inference is indeed like that.
What is sung in the Purāṇas seems impossible to people;

6.3.s:
yadi pakṣaṃ puraskṛtya lokāḥ kurvanti pārvati .
tasmānna siddhireteṣāṃ bhavatyeko na vismayaḥ .. 180.47 ..
6.3.d:
यदि पक्षं पुरस्कृत्य लोकाः कुर्वन्ति पार्वति .
तस्मान्न सिद्धिरेतेषां भवत्येको न विस्मयः .. 180.47 ..
6.3.m:
if people act out of partisanship, O Pārvatī,
therefore their attainment of success does not occur; it is not a single wonder.

6.3.s:
nāstikā bhinnamaryādā ye niścayabahiṣkṛtāḥ .
teṣāṃ siddhirna vidyeta āstikyādbhavate dhruvam .. 180.48 ..
6.3.d:
नास्तिका भिन्नमर्यादा ये निश्चयबहिष्कृताः .
तेषां सिद्धिर्न विद्येत आस्तिक्याद्भवते ध्रुवम् .. 180.48 ..
6.3.m:
Those who lack faith, who transgress moral bounds, who are devoid of conviction,
success is not found for them; it certainly arises from faith.”

6.3.s:
śrutvākhyānamidaṃ devī vavande tīrthamuttamam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam .. 180.49 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुत्वाख्यानमिदं देवी ववन्दे तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् .. 180.49 ..
6.3.m:
Hearing this account, the goddess bowed to the supreme sacred ford,
which removes all sins, is meritorious, and is situated on the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
daśāśvamedhaṃ rājendra sarvatīrthottamottamam .
tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇopetaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 180.50 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
दशाश्वमेधं राजेन्द्र सर्वतीर्थोत्तमोत्तमम् .
तीर्थं सर्वगुणोपेतं महापातकनाशनम् .. 180.50 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“The Daśāśvamedha, O king of kings, is the best of the best of all sacred fords,
a sacred ford endowed with all virtues, destroying great sins.

6.3.s:
tatrāgatā mahābhāgā snātukāmā sarasvatī .
puṇyānāṃ paramā puṇyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī .. 180.51 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रागता महाभागा स्नातुकामा सरस्वती .
पुण्यानां परमा पुण्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी .. 180.51 ..
6.3.m:
The highly fortunate Sarasvatī came there, desiring to bathe—
she who is the most sacred of the sacred, the best river of rivers,

6.3.s:
nāmamātreṇa yasyāstu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .
snātāstatra divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ .. 180.52 ..
6.3.d:
नाममात्रेण यस्यास्तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .
स्नातास्तत्र दिवं यान्ति ये मृतास्तेऽपुनर्भवाः .. 180.52 ..
6.3.m:
by the mere mention of whose name one is released from all sins.
Those who have bathed there go to heaven; those who die there are free from rebirth.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhe sā rājanniyatā brahmacāriṇī .
ārādhayitvā deveśaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇamāgatīḥ .. 180.53 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधे सा राजन्नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी .
आराधयित्वा देवेशं परं निर्वाणमागतीः .. 180.53 ..
6.3.m:
She, restrained and celibate at Daśāśvamedha, O king,
having worshipped the Lord of gods, reached supreme liberation.

6.3.s:
kāluṣyaṃ brahmasambhūtā saṃvatsarasamudbhavam .
prakṣālayitumāyāti daśamyāmāśvinasya ca .. 180.54 ..
6.3.d:
कालुष्यं ब्रह्मसम्भूता संवत्सरसमुद्भवम् .
प्रक्षालयितुमायाति दशम्यामाश्विनस्य च .. 180.54 ..
6.3.m:
Born from Brahmā, she arrives on the tenth day of the month of Āśvina
to wash away the impurity that has accumulated throughout the year.

6.3.s:
upoṣya rajanīṃ tāṃ tu sampūjya tripurāntakam .
rājanniṣkalmaṣā yānti śvobhūte śāśvataṃ padam .. 180.55 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्य रजनीं तां तु सम्पूज्य त्रिपुरान्तकम् .
राजन्निष्कल्मषा यान्ति श्वोभूते शाश्वतं पदम् .. 180.55 ..
6.3.m:
Having fasted during that night and worshipped the destroyer of Tripura,
they, cleansed of blemishes, go to the eternal abode on the next morning.”

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
sarasvatī mahāpuṇyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī .
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
rājannāśvayuje māsi daśamyāṃ tadviśiṣyate .
pārthiveṣu ca tīrthe tu sarveṣveva na saṃśayaḥ .. 180.56 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
सरस्वती महापुण्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी .
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
राजन्नाश्वयुजे मासि दशम्यां तद्विशिष्यते .
पार्थिवेषु च तीर्थे तु सर्वेष्वेव न संशयः .. 180.56 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
“Sarasvatī is greatly sacred, the best river of rivers.”
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“O king, on the tenth day in the month of Āśvayuja, that is distinguished
among all earthly sacred fords, without doubt.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhike rājannityaṃ hi daśamī śubhā .
viśeṣādāśvine śuklā mahāpātakanāśinī .. 180.57 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधिके राजन्नित्यं हि दशमी शुभा .
विशेषादाश्विने शुक्ला महापातकनाशिनी .. 180.57 ..
6.3.m:
At Daśāśvamedhika, O king, the tenth day is always auspicious,
especially the bright [tenth day] of Āśvina, which destroys great sins.

6.3.s:
tasyā snātvārcayeddevānupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ .
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena paścātsampūjayecchivam .. 180.58 ..
6.3.d:
तस्या स्नात्वार्चयेद्देवानुपवासपरायणः .
श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानेन पश्चात्सम्पूजयेच्छिवम् .. 180.58 ..
6.3.m:
Having bathed on it, devoted to fasting, one should worship the gods;
having performed an ancestral rite according to rule, one should then worship Śiva.

6.3.s:
tatrasthāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ snātukāmāṃ sarasvatīm .
namo namaste deveśi brahmadehasamudbhave .. 180.59 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रस्थां पूजयेद्देवीं स्नातुकामां सरस्वतीम् .
नमो नमस्ते देवेशि ब्रह्मदेहसमुद्भवे .. 180.59 ..
6.3.m: One should worship the goddess Sarasvatī situated there, desiring to bathe: / ‘Salutations, salutations to you, O Ruler of gods, born from the body of Brahmā!

6.3.s:
kuru pāpakṣayaṃ devi saṃsārānmāṃ samuddhara .
gandhadhūpaiśca sampūjya hyarcayitvā punaḥpunaḥ .. 180.60 ..
6.3.d:
कुरु पापक्षयं देवि संसारान्मां समुद्धर .
गन्धधूपैश्च सम्पूज्य ह्यर्चयित्वा पुनःपुनः .. 180.60 ..
6.3.m:
Bring about the destruction of my sins, O goddess, and deliver me from worldly existence!’
Having worshipped her with perfumes and incense, worshipping again and again,

6.3.s:
daśa pradakṣiṇā dattvā sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet .
kapilāṃ tu tato vipre dadyādvigatamatsaraḥ .. 180.61 ..
6.3.d:
दश प्रदक्षिणा दत्त्वा सूत्रेण परिवेष्टयेत् .
कपिलां तु ततो विप्रे दद्याद्विगतमत्सरः .. 180.61 ..
6.3.m:
and circumambulating ten times, one should wind a thread around.
Then, free from jealousy, one should give a brown cow to a brahmin.

6.3.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasampannāṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām .
dattvā viprāya kapilāṃ na śocati kṛtākṛte .. 180.62 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नां सर्वोपस्करसंयुताम् .
दत्त्वा विप्राय कपिलां न शोचति कृताकृते .. 180.62 ..
6.3.m:
Endowed with all auspicious marks and accompanied by all accessories,
having given that brown cow to a brahmin, one does not grieve over what has or has not been done.

6.3.s:
paścājjāgaraṇaṃ kuryādghṛtenājvālya dīpakam .
purāṇapaṭhanenaiva nṛtyagītavivādanaiḥ .. 180.63 ..
6.3.d:
पश्चाज्जागरणं कुर्याद्घृतेनाज्वाल्य दीपकम् .
पुराणपठनेनैव नृत्यगीतविवादनैः .. 180.63 ..
6.3.m:
Afterwards, one should keep vigil, having kindled a lamp with ghee,
solely through the recitation of Purāṇas, with dances, songs, and instrumental music.”

6.3.s:
vedoktaiścaiva pūjayecchaśiśekharam .
prabhāte vimale paścātsnātvā vai narmadājale .. 180.64 ..
6.3.d:
वेदोक्तैश्चैव पूजयेच्छशिशेखरम् .
प्रभाते विमले पश्चात्स्नात्वा वै नर्मदाजले .. 180.64 ..
6.3.m: And he should worship the moon-crested [Śiva] with [mantras] declared in the Vedas. / Then, at clear dawn, having bathed in the waters of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇān bhojayedbhaktyā śivabhaktāṃśca yoginaḥ .
evaṃ kṛte tato rājan samyaktīrthaphalaṃ labhet .. 180.65 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेद्भक्त्या शिवभक्तांश्च योगिनः .
एवं कृते ततो राजन् सम्यक्तीर्थफलं लभेत् .. 180.65 ..
6.3.m: he should feed brahmins with devotion, as well as devotees of Śiva and yogins. / When this is done, O king, he then obtains the full fruit of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ naraḥ .
daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthaṃ labhate puṇyamuttamam .. 180.66 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेच्छङ्करं नरः .
दशाश्वमेधावभृथं लभते पुण्यमुत्तमम् .. 180.66 ..
6.3.m: That man who bathes in that sacred ford and worships Śaṅkara / obtains the supreme merit of the concluding bath of ten horse sacrifices.

6.3.s:
pūtātmā tena puṇyena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .
ārūḍhaḥ paramaṃ yānaṃ kāmagaṃ ca suśobhanam .. 180.67 ..
6.3.d:
पूतात्मा तेन पुण्येन रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .
आरूढः परमं यानं कामगं च सुशोभनम् .. 180.67 ..
6.3.m: Purified in soul by that merit, he goes to the world of Rudra, / mounted upon an excellent vehicle that travels at will and is most splendid.

6.3.s:
tatra divyāpsarobhistu vījyamāno'tha cāmaraiḥ .
krīḍate suciraṃ kālaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ .. 180.68 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र दिव्याप्सरोभिस्तु वीज्यमानोऽथ चामरैः .
क्रीडते सुचिरं कालं जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः .. 180.68 ..
6.3.m: Fanned there with chowries by divine apsarases, / he sports for a very long time amidst auspicious shouts of victory and the like.

6.3.s:
tato'vatīrṇaḥ kālena iha rājā bhaveddhruvam .
hastyaśvarathasampanno mahābhogī paraṃtapaḥ .. 180.69 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽवतीर्णः कालेन इह राजा भवेद्ध्रुवम् .
हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पन्नो महाभोगी परंतपः .. 180.69 ..
6.3.m: Then, having descended in time, he will surely become a king here, / endowed with elephants, horses, and chariots, enjoying great pleasures, a scorcher of enemies.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhe yaddānaṃ dīyate śivayoginām .
daśāśvamedhasadṛśaṃ bhavettannātra saṃśayaḥ .. 180.70 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधे यद्दानं दीयते शिवयोगिनाम् .
दशाश्वमेधसदृशं भवेत्तन्नात्र संशयः .. 180.70 ..
6.3.m: Whatever gift is given at Daśāśvamedha to Śaiva yogins / becomes equal to ten horse sacrifices; there is no doubt in this.

6.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva yajñānāmaśvamedho viśiṣyate .
durlabhaḥ svalpavittānāṃ bhūriśaḥ pāpakarmaṇām .. 180.71 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव यज्ञानामश्वमेधो विशिष्यते .
दुर्लभः स्वल्पवित्तानां भूरिशः पापकर्मणाम् .. 180.71 ..
6.3.m: The horse sacrifice is distinguished above all sacrifices; / it is hard to attain for those of little wealth, and abundantly so for those of sinful deeds.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra durlabho'pi surāsuraiḥ .
prāpyate snānadānena ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 180.72 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र दुर्लभोऽपि सुरासुरैः .
प्राप्यते स्नानदानेन इत्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 180.72 ..
6.3.m: Yet at that sacred ford, O best of kings, though hard to attain even for gods and asuras, / it is obtained through bathing and giving; thus spoke Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
akāmo vā sakāmo vā mṛtastatra nareśvara .
devatvaṃ prāpnuyātso'pi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 180.73 ..
6.3.d:
अकामो वा सकामो वा मृतस्तत्र नरेश्वर .
देवत्वं प्राप्नुयात्सोऽपि नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 180.73 ..
6.3.m: Whether free from desire or possessing desire, one who dies there, O lord of men, / even he would attain godhead; no deliberation need be made on this.

6.3.s:
agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra tīrthe narottama .
agniloke vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 180.74 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात्तत्र तीर्थे नरोत्तम .
अग्निलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 180.74 ..
6.3.m: Whoever enters into fire at that sacred ford, O best of men, / would dwell in the world of Agni until the dissolution of all beings.

6.3.s:
jalapraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra tīrthe narādhipa .
dhyāyamāno mahādevaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 180.75 ..
6.3.d:
जलप्रवेशं यः कुर्यात्तत्र तीर्थे नराधिप .
ध्यायमानो महादेवं वारुणं लोकमाप्नुयात् .. 180.75 ..
6.3.m: Whoever enters into water at that sacred ford, O ruler of men, / meditating upon Mahādeva, would attain the world of Varuṇa.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhe yaḥ kaścicchūravṛttyā tanuṃ tyajet .
akṣayā nu gatistasya ityevaṃ śrutinodanā .. 180.76 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधे यः कश्चिच्छूरवृत्त्या तनुं त्यजेत् .
अक्षया नु गतिस्तस्य इत्येवं श्रुतिनोदना .. 180.76 ..
6.3.m: Whoever casts off his body at Daśāśvamedha in the conduct of a hero, / his destiny is indeed imperishable; such is the prompting of the Veda.

6.3.s:
na tāṃ gatiṃ yānti bhṛguprapātino na daṇḍino naiva ca sāṃkhyayoginaḥ .
dhvajākule dundubhiśaṅkhanādite kṣaṇena yāṃ yānti mahāhave mṛtāḥ .. 180.77 ..
6.3.d:
न तां गतिं यान्ति भृगुप्रपातिनो न दण्डिनो नैव च सांख्ययोगिनः .
ध्वजाकुले दुन्दुभिशङ्खनादिते क्षणेन यां यान्ति महाहवे मृताः .. 180.77 ..
6.3.m: Not to that destiny do those go who throw themselves from cliffs, nor those who bear the staff, nor the followers of Sāṅkhya and Yoga, / to which those who die in a great battle go in an instant, crowded with banners and resounding with kettledrums and conches.

6.3.s:
yatra tatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ .
akṣayāṃllabhate lokānyadi klībaṃ na bhāṣate .. 180.78 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र तत्र हतः शूरः शत्रुभिः परिवेष्टितः .
अक्षयांल्लभते लोकान्यदि क्लीबं न भाषते .. 180.78 ..
6.3.m: Wherever a hero is slain, surrounded by enemies, / he attains imperishable worlds, provided he does not speak cowardly words.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhe saṃnyāsaṃ yaḥ karoti vidhānataḥ .
anivartikā gatistasya rudralokātkadācana .. 180.79 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधे संन्यासं यः करोति विधानतः .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य रुद्रलोकात्कदाचन .. 180.79 ..
6.3.m: Whoever duly performs saṃnyāsa at Daśāśvamedha, / his path never turns back from the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhe yatpuṇyaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa yudhiṣṭhira .
kathitaṃ parayā bhaktyā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 180.80 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe daśāśvamedhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधे यत्पुण्यं संक्षेपेण युधिष्ठिर .
कथितं परया भक्त्या सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 180.80 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दशाश्वमेधतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whatever merit there is at Daśāśvamedha has been related in brief, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / destroying all sin through supreme devotion.
Thus ends the one hundred and eightieth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Daśāśvamedhatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi bhṛgutīrthasya vistaram .
yaṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghno mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 181.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि भृगुतीर्थस्य विस्तरम् .
यं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नो मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 181.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Hereafter I shall explain the detail of Bhṛgutīrtha, / hearing which the killer of a brahmin or the killer of a cow is freed from all heinous sins. 181.1

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu vikhyātaṃ vṛṣakhātamiti śrutam .
bhṛguṇā tatra rājendra tapastaptaṃ purā kila .. 181.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु विख्यातं वृषखातमिति श्रुतम् .
भृगुणा तत्र राजेन्द्र तपस्तप्तं पुरा किल .. 181.2 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford is celebrated what is known as Vṛṣakhāta; / there indeed, O king of kings, austerity was practiced of old by Bhṛgu. 181.2

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
bhṛgukacche sa viprendro nivasan kena hetunā .
tapastaptvā suvipulaṃ parāṃ siddhimupāgataḥ .. 181.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
भृगुकच्छे स विप्रेन्द्रो निवसन् केन हेतुना .
तपस्तप्त्वा सुविपुलं परां सिद्धिमुपागतः .. 181.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For what reason did that best of brahmins, residing at Bhṛgukaccha, / having performed immense austerity, attain supreme perfection? 181.3

6.3.s:
ko vā vṛṣa iti proktastatkhātaṃ yena khānitam .
etatsarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kathayasva mamānagha .. 181.4 ..
6.3.d:
को वा वृष इति प्रोक्तस्तत्खातं येन खानितम् .
एतत्सर्वं यथान्यायं कथयस्व ममानघ .. 181.4 ..
6.3.m: Or who is called Vṛṣa, by whom that pit was dug? / Tell me all this properly, O sinless one! 181.4

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
eṣa praśno mahārāja yastvayā paripṛcchitaḥ .
tatsarvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa .. 181.5 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एष प्रश्नो महाराज यस्त्वया परिपृच्छितः .
तत्सर्वं कथयिष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना नृप .. 181.5 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / This question that was asked by you, O great king, / I shall relate all of it; listen with a one-pointed mind, O king.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭhastu brahmaṇaḥ putro mānaso bhṛgusattamaḥ .
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ śrīvṛte kṣetra uttame .. 181.6 ..
6.3.d:
षष्ठस्तु ब्रह्मणः पुत्रो मानसो भृगुसत्तमः .
तपश्चचार विपुलं श्रीवृते क्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 181.6 ..
6.3.m: The sixth mind-born son of Brahmā, the best of the Bhṛgus, / performed vast austerity in the excellent sacred field endowed with fortune.

6.3.s:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu saṃśuṣko munisattamaḥ .
nirāhāro nirānandaḥ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇavatsthitaḥ .. 181.7 ..
6.3.d:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु संशुष्को मुनिसत्तमः .
निराहारो निरानन्दः काष्ठपाषाणवत्स्थितः .. 181.7 ..
6.3.m: For a divine thousand years, desiccated, that best of sages / remained without food, devoid of joy, like a log of wood or a stone.

6.3.s:
tataḥ kadāciddeveśo vimānavaramāsthitaḥ .
umayā sahitaḥ śrīmāṃstena mārgeṇa cāgataḥ .. 181.8 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कदाचिद्देवेशो विमानवरमास्थितः .
उमया सहितः श्रीमांस्तेन मार्गेण चागतः .. 181.8 ..
6.3.m: Then once the glorious Lord of the gods, mounted on an excellent aerial chariot / together with Umā, arrived by that path.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tatra mahābhāgaṃ bhṛguṃ valmīkavatsthitam .
uvāca devī deveśaṃ kimidaṃ dṛśyate prabho .. 181.9 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तत्र महाभागं भृगुं वल्मीकवत्स्थितम् .
उवाच देवी देवेशं किमिदं दृश्यते प्रभो .. 181.9 ..
6.3.m: Having seen the illustrious Bhṛgu standing there like an anthill, / the goddess said to the Lord of the gods: “What is this that is seen, O Lord?”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
bhṛgurnāma mahādevi tapastaptvā sudāruṇam .
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu mama dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ .. 181.10 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
भृगुर्नाम महादेवि तपस्तप्त्वा सुदारुणम् .
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु मम ध्यानपरायणः .. 181.10 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “O great goddess, he is named Bhṛgu, having performed very fierce austerity / for a divine thousand years, wholly devoted to meditating on me.

6.3.s:
jalabindu kuśāgreṇa māse māse pibecca saḥ .
saṃvatsaraśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhate ca varānane .. 181.11 ..
6.3.d:
जलबिन्दु कुशाग्रेण मासे मासे पिबेच्च सः .
संवत्सरशतं साग्रं तिष्ठते च वरानने .. 181.11 ..
6.3.m: And he drinks a drop of water with the tip of a kuśa grass blade month after month, / and he has stood for fully a hundred years, O fair-faced one.”

6.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ gaurī krodhasaṃvartitekṣaṇā .
uvāca devī deveśaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ maheśvaram .. 181.12 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं गौरी क्रोधसंवर्तितेक्षणा .
उवाच देवी देवेशं शूलपाणिं महेश्वरम् .. 181.12 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that statement, Gaurī, her eyes turned with rage, / the goddess said to the Lord of the gods, the trident-bearing Maheśvara:

6.3.s:
satyamugro'si loke tvaṃ khyāpito vṛṣabhadhvaja .
niṣkāruṇyo durārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 181.13 ..
6.3.d:
सत्यमुग्रोऽसि लोके त्वं ख्यापितो वृषभध्वज .
निष्कारुण्यो दुराराध्यः सर्वभूतभयंकरः .. 181.13 ..
6.3.m: “Truly you are proclaimed fierce in the world, O bull-bannered one, / merciless, difficult to propitiate, terrifying to all beings.

6.3.s:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu dhyāyamānasya śaṅkaram .
brāhmaṇasya varaṃ kasmānna prayacchasi śaṃsa me .. 181.14 ..
6.3.d:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु ध्यायमानस्य शङ्करम् .
ब्राह्मणस्य वरं कस्मान्न प्रयच्छसि शंस मे .. 181.14 ..
6.3.m: Why do you not grant a boon to a brahmin who has been meditating upon Śaṃkara / for a divine thousand years? Tell me!”

6.3.s:
evamukto'tha deveśaḥ prahasya girinandinīm .
uvāca naraśārdūla meghagambhīrayā girā .. 181.15 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तोऽथ देवेशः प्रहस्य गिरिनन्दिनीम् .
उवाच नरशार्दूल मेघगम्भीरया गिरा .. 181.15 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed, the Lord of the gods, laughing, / said to the mountain's daughter in a voice deep as a thundercloud, O tiger among men:

6.3.s:
strī vinaśyati garveṇa tapaḥ krodhena naśyati .
gāvo dūrapracāreṇa śūdrānnena dvijottamāḥ .. 181.16 ..
6.3.d:
स्त्री विनश्यति गर्वेण तपः क्रोधेन नश्यति .
गावो दूरप्रचारेण शूद्रान्नेन द्विजोत्तमाः .. 181.16 ..
6.3.m: “A woman is ruined by pride; austerity is ruined by anger; / cows by roaming too far; and the best of the twice-born by the food of a śūdra.

6.3.s:
krodhānvito dvijo gaurī tena siddhirna vidyate .
varṣāyutaistathā lakṣairna kiṃcitkāraṇaṃ priye .. 181.17 ..
6.3.d:
क्रोधान्वितो द्विजो गौरी तेन सिद्धिर्न विद्यते .
वर्षायुतैस्तथा लक्षैर्न किंचित्कारणं प्रिये .. 181.17 ..
6.3.m: The twice-born is possessed of anger, O Gaurī; therefore perfection is not attained. / Even after tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years, [such austerity] is of no avail, my dear.

6.3.s:
evambhūtasya tasyāpi krodhasya caritaṃ mahat .
evamuktvā tataḥ śambhurvṛṣaṃ dadhyau ca tatkṣaṇe .. 181.18 ..
6.3.d:
एवम्भूतस्य तस्यापि क्रोधस्य चरितं महत् .
एवमुक्त्वा ततः शम्भुर्वृषं दध्यौ च तत्क्षणे .. 181.18 ..
6.3.m: Even being such, the conduct of his anger is great.” / Having spoken thus, Śambhu then meditated upon the bull that very instant.

6.3.s:
vṛṣo hi bhagavanbrahmā vṛṣarūpī maheśvaraḥ .
dhyānaprāptaḥ kṣaṇādeva garjayan vai muhurmuhuḥ .. 181.19 ..
6.3.d:
वृषो हि भगवन्ब्रह्मा वृषरूपी महेश्वरः .
ध्यानप्राप्तः क्षणादेव गर्जयन् वै मुहुर्मुहुः .. 181.19 ..
6.3.m: For the bull is the blessed Brahmā; the bull-formed is Maheśvara. / Reached in a moment through meditation, roaring repeatedly indeed,

6.3.s:
kiṃ karomi suraśreṣṭha dhyātaḥ kenaiva hetunā .
karomi kasya nidhanamakāle parameśvara .. 181.20 ..
6.3.d:
किं करोमि सुरश्रेष्ठ ध्यातः केनैव हेतुना .
करोमि कस्य निधनमकाले परमेश्वर .. 181.20 ..
6.3.m: [the bull said:] “What shall I do, O best of the gods? For what reason was I meditated upon? / Whose destruction shall I bring about out of season, O supreme Lord?”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
kopayasva dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ gatvā tvaṃ bhṛgusattamam .
yena me śraddadhatyeṣā gaurī lokaikasundarī .. 181.21 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
कोपयस्व द्विजश्रेष्ठं गत्वा त्वं भृगुसत्तमम् .
येन मे श्रद्दधत्येषा गौरी लोकैकसुन्दरी .. 181.21 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “Go and enrage that best of the twice-born, the foremost of the Bhṛgus, / so that this Gaurī, the sole beauty of the world, may have faith in me.”

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā vṛṣo gatvā dharṣaṇārthaṃ dvijottamam .
narmadāyāstaṭe ramye samīpe cāśrame bhṛguḥ .. 181.22 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वृषो गत्वा धर्षणार्थं द्विजोत्तमम् .
नर्मदायास्तटे रम्ये समीपे चाश्रमे भृगुः .. 181.22 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this, the bull went to attack that best of the twice-born, / to the charming bank of the Narmadā, near the hermitage where Bhṛgu was.

6.3.s:
tataḥ śṛṅgairgṛhītvā tu prakṣipto narmadājale .
tataḥ kruddho bhṛgustatra daṇḍahasto mahāmuniḥ .. 181.23 ..
6.3.d:
ततः शृङ्गैर्गृहीत्वा तु प्रक्षिप्तो नर्मदाजले .
ततः क्रुद्धो भृगुस्तत्र दण्डहस्तो महामुनिः .. 181.23 ..
6.3.m: Then, having seized him with his horns, he threw him into the water of the Narmadā. / Then the great sage Bhṛgu, enraged, staff in hand there,

6.3.s:
paśuvatte vadhiṣyāmi daṇḍaghātena mastake .
śikhāyajñopavīte ca paridhānaṃ varāsane .. 181.24 ..
6.3.d:
पशुवत्ते वधिष्यामि दण्डघातेन मस्तके .
शिखायज्ञोपवीते च परिधानं वरासने .. 181.24 ..
6.3.m: said, “Like an animal I shall kill you with a blow of my staff upon the head!” / Fastening his crest-lock and sacred thread, his garment and his seat,

6.3.s: susaṃvṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tena dhāvanvai pṛṣṭhato bravīt .. 181.25 ..
6.3.d: सुसंवृतं कृतं तेन धावन्वै पृष्ठतो ब्रवीत् .. 181.25 ..
6.3.m: firmly tucked up by him, running behind him indeed, he spoke:

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
pāpakarmandurācāra kathaṃ yāsyasi me vṛṣa .
avamānaṃ samutpādya kṛtvā gartaṃ khuraistathā .. 181.26 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
पापकर्मन्दुराचार कथं यास्यसि मे वृष .
अवमानं समुत्पाद्य कृत्वा गर्तं खुरैस्तथा .. 181.26 ..
6.3.m: Bhṛgu said: / “O evil-doer, of wicked conduct, how will you escape me, O bull, / having caused disrespect and having made a pit with your hooves?”

6.3.s:
garjayitvā mahānādaṃ tato vipramapātayat .
ātmānaṃ pātitaṃ jñātvā vṛṣeṇa parameṣṭhinā .. 181.27 ..
6.3.d:
गर्जयित्वा महानादं ततो विप्रमपातयत् .
आत्मानं पातितं ज्ञात्वा वृषेण परमेष्ठिना .. 181.27 ..
6.3.m: Having bellowed a great roar, [the bull] then knocked the brahmin down. / Realising that he had been thrown down by the bull of the Supreme Lord,

6.3.s:
bhṛguḥ krodhena jajvāla hutāhutirivānalaḥ .
kare gṛhya mahādaṇḍaṃ brahmadaṇḍamivāparam .. 181.28 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुः क्रोधेन जज्वाल हुताहुतिरिवानलः .
करे गृह्य महादण्डं ब्रह्मदण्डमिवापरम् .. 181.28 ..
6.3.m: Bhṛgu blazed with anger like a fire receiving an oblation. / Taking a great staff in his hand, like a second staff of Brahmā,

6.3.s:
hantukāmo vṛṣaṃ vipro'bhyadhāvata yudhiṣṭhira .
dhāvamānaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā sa vṛṣaḥ pūrvasāgare .. 181.29 ..
6.3.d:
हन्तुकामो वृषं विप्रोऽभ्यधावत युधिष्ठिर .
धावमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा स वृषः पूर्वसागरे .. 181.29 ..
6.3.m: desiring to kill the bull, the brahmin pursued him, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / Seeing him running, that bull then [fled] to the eastern ocean,

6.3.s:
jambūdvīpaṃ kuśāṃ krauñcaṃ śālmaliṃ śākameva ca .
gomedaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāptaḥ pūrvato dakṣiṇāpatham .. 181.30 ..
6.3.d:
जम्बूद्वीपं कुशां क्रौञ्चं शाल्मलिं शाकमेव च .
गोमेदं पुष्करं प्राप्तः पूर्वतो दक्षिणापथम् .. 181.30 ..
6.3.m: to Jambudvīpa, Kuśa, Krauñca, Śālmali, and Śāka, / Gomeda, and reached Puṣkara, from the east to the southern region,

6.3.s:
uttaraṃ paścimaṃ caiva dvīpāddvīpaṃ nareśvara .
pātālaṃ sutalaṃ paścādvitalaṃ ca talātalam .. 181.31 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तरं पश्चिमं चैव द्वीपाद्द्वीपं नरेश्वर .
पातालं सुतलं पश्चाद्वितलं च तलातलम् .. 181.31 ..
6.3.m: to the north and to the west, from island to island, O lord of men; / to Pātāla, Sutala, then Vitala, and Talātala,

6.3.s:
tāmisramandhatāmisraṃ pātālaṃ saptamaṃ yayau .
tato jagāma bhūrlokaṃ prāṇārthī sa vṛṣottamaḥ .. 181.32 ..
6.3.d:
तामिस्रमन्धतामिस्रं पातालं सप्तमं ययौ .
ततो जगाम भूर्लोकं प्राणार्थी स वृषोत्तमः .. 181.32 ..
6.3.m: Tāmisra, Andhatāmisra, and went to the seventh Pātāla. / Then that best of bulls, seeking his life, went to the earth realm,

6.3.s:
bhuvaḥ svaścaiva ca mahastapaḥ satyaṃ janastathā .
anugamyamāno vipreṇa na śarma labhate kvacit .. 181.33 ..
6.3.d:
भुवः स्वश्चैव च महस्तपः सत्यं जनस्तथा .
अनुगम्यमानो विप्रेण न शर्म लभते क्वचित् .. 181.33 ..
6.3.m: to Bhuvas, Svas, Mahas, Tapas, Satya, and Janas as well. / Followed by the brahmin, he found no peace anywhere.

6.3.s:
pāpaṃ kṛtvaiva puruṣaḥ kāmakrodhabalārditaḥ .
tato jagāma śaraṇaṃ brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumeva ca .. 181.34 ..
6.3.d:
पापं कृत्वैव पुरुषः कामक्रोधबलार्दितः .
ततो जगाम शरणं ब्रह्माणं विष्णुमेव च .. 181.34 ..
6.3.m: Having done an evil deed, a man is afflicted by the power of lust and anger. / Then he went for refuge to Brahmā and to Viṣṇu,

6.3.s:
indraṃ candraṃ tathādityairyāmyavāruṇamārutaiḥ .
yadā sarvaiḥ parityakto lokālokaiḥ sureśvaraiḥ .. 181.35 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रं चन्द्रं तथादित्यैर्याम्यवारुणमारुतैः .
यदा सर्वैः परित्यक्तो लोकालोकैः सुरेश्वरैः .. 181.35 ..
6.3.m: to Indra, Candra, and the Ādityas, to the lords of death, water, and wind. / When he was abandoned by all the lords of the gods throughout all the worlds,

6.3.s:
tadā devaṃ namaskṛtvā rakṣa rakṣasva cābravīt .
vadhyamānaṃ mahādevo bhṛguṇā parameṣṭhinā .. 181.36 ..
6.3.d:
तदा देवं नमस्कृत्वा रक्ष रक्षस्व चाब्रवीत् .
वध्यमानं महादेवो भृगुणा परमेष्ठिना .. 181.36 ..
6.3.m: then, having bowed to the Lord, he said, “Protect, protect [me]!” / While being struck by Bhṛgu, [the devotee of] the Supreme Lord,

6.3.s:
sarvalokaiḥ parityaktamanāthamiva taṃ prabho .
dṛṣṭvā śrāntaṃ vṛṣaṃ devaḥ patitaṃ caraṇāgrataḥ .. 181.37 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वलोकैः परित्यक्तमनाथमिव तं प्रभो .
दृष्ट्वा श्रान्तं वृषं देवः पतितं चरणाग्रतः .. 181.37 ..
6.3.m: abandoned by all worlds like one without a protector, O Lord, / seeing the bull exhausted, fallen before his feet,

6.3.s: tataḥ provāca bhagavān smitapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 181.38 ..
6.3.d: ततः प्रोवाच भगवान् स्मितपूर्वमिदं वचः .. 181.38 ..
6.3.m: the Blessed One then spoke this word with a smile:

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
paśya devi mahābhāge śamaṃ viprasya sundari .. 181.39 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
पश्य देवि महाभागे शमं विप्रस्य सुन्दरि .. 181.39 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “Look, O illustrious goddess, O beautiful one, at the tranquility of the brahmin!”

6.3.s:
pārvatyuvāca -
yāvadvipro na cāsmākaṃ kupyate parameśvara .
tāvadvaraṃ prayacchāśu yadi cecchasi matpriyam .. 181.40 ..
6.3.d:
पार्वत्युवाच -
यावद्विप्रो न चास्माकं कुप्यते परमेश्वर .
तावद्वरं प्रयच्छाशु यदि चेच्छसि मत्प्रियम् .. 181.40 ..
6.3.m: Pārvatī said: / “Before the brahmin becomes angry with us, O supreme Lord, / grant a boon quickly, if you desire my pleasure.”

6.3.s:
tato bhasmī jaṭī śūlī candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ .
umārddhadeho bhagavānbhūtvā vipramuvāca ha .. 181.41 ..
6.3.d:
ततो भस्मी जटी शूली चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरः .
उमार्द्धदेहो भगवान्भूत्वा विप्रमुवाच ह .. 181.41 ..
6.3.m: Then the Blessed One, covered with ash, matted-haired, trident in hand, the half-moon as his crest-ornament, / with half his body formed of Umā, having appeared, addressed the brahmin:

6.3.s:
bhobho dvijavaraśreṣṭha krodhaste na śamaṃ gataḥ .
yasmāttasmādidaṃ tāta krodhasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 181.42 ..
6.3.d:
भोभो द्विजवरश्रेष्ठ क्रोधस्ते न शमं गतः .
यस्मात्तस्मादिदं तात क्रोधस्थानं भविष्यति .. 181.42 ..
6.3.m: “Hail, O foremost among the best of the twice-born! Your anger has not subsided. / Therefore, my dear, this shall become the place of anger.”

6.3.s:
tato dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ śambhuṃ bhṛguḥ śreṣṭhaṃ trilocanam .
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā idaṃ stotramudairayat .. 181.43 ..
6.3.d:
ततो दृष्ट्वा च तं शम्भुं भृगुः श्रेष्ठं त्रिलोचनम् .
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा इदं स्तोत्रमुदैरयत् .. 181.43 ..
6.3.m: Then, having seen that Śambhu, the supreme three-eyed one, / Bhṛgu, having fallen to the earth on his knees, uttered this hymn of praise:

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
praṇipatya bhūtanāthaṃ bhavodbhavaṃ bhūtidaṃ bhayātītam .
bhavabhīto bhuvanapate vijñaptuṃ kiṃcidicchāmi .. 181.44 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
प्रणिपत्य भूतनाथं भवोद्भवं भूतिदं भयातीतम् .
भवभीतो भुवनपते विज्ञप्तुं किंचिदिच्छामि .. 181.44 ..
6.3.m: Bhṛgu said: / “Bowing down to the Lord of beings, the source of existence, the giver of prosperity, who is beyond fear, / afraid of worldly existence, O Lord of the universe, I wish to make a small petition.

6.3.s:
tvadguṇanikarānvaktuṃ kā śaktirmānuṣasyāsya .
vāsukirapi na tāvadvaktuṃ vadanasahasraṃ bhavedyasya .. 181.45 ..
6.3.d:
त्वद्गुणनिकरान्वक्तुं का शक्तिर्मानुषस्यास्य .
वासुकिरपि न तावद्वक्तुं वदनसहस्रं भवेद्यस्य .. 181.45 ..
6.3.m: What power is there in this mortal to express the multitude of your virtues? / Even Vāsuki, though he may possess a thousand mouths, could not tell of them.

6.3.s:
bhaktyā tathāpi śaṅkara śaśidhara karajāladhavalitāśeṣa .
stutimukharasya maheśvara prasīda tava caraṇaniratasya .. 181.46 ..
6.3.d:
भक्त्या तथापि शङ्कर शशिधर करजालधवलिताशेष .
स्तुतिमुखरस्य महेश्वर प्रसीद तव चरणनिरतस्य .. 181.46 ..
6.3.m: Even so, through devotion, O Śaṅkara, moon-bearer, who whitens everything with a net of rays, / be pleased with him who is vocal in your praise, O Maheśvara, and devoted to your feet.

6.3.s:
sattvaṃ rajastamastvaṃ sthityutpattivināśanaṃ deva .
bhavabhīto bhuvanapate bhuvaneśa śaraṇaniratasya .. 181.47 ..
6.3.d:
सत्त्वं रजस्तमस्त्वं स्थित्युत्पत्तिविनाशनं देव .
भवभीतो भुवनपते भुवनेश शरणनिरतस्य .. 181.47 ..
6.3.m: You are sattva, rajas, and tamas; you are the maintenance, creation, and destruction [of the worlds], O God! / Afraid of worldly existence, O Lord of the universe, O Lord of the world, [be gracious] to one intent on taking refuge [in you]!”

6.3.s:
yamaniyamayajñadānaṃ vedābhyāsaśca dhāraṇāyogaḥ .
tvadbhakteḥ sarvamidaṃ nārhanti vai kalāsahasrāṃśam .. 181.48 ..
6.3.d:
यमनियमयज्ञदानं वेदाभ्यासश्च धारणायोगः .
त्वद्भक्तेः सर्वमिदं नार्हन्ति वै कलासहस्रांशम् .. 181.48 ..
6.3.m:
Restraints, observances, sacrifice, charity, the study of the Vedas, and concentration in yoga—
all this is indeed not worth one-thousandth of a fraction of devotion to you.

6.3.s:
utkṛṣṭarasarasāyanakhaḍgāṃ janavivarapādukāsiddhiḥ .
cihnaṃ hi tava natānāṃ dṛśyata iha janmani prakaṭam .. 181.49 ..
6.3.d:
उत्कृष्टरसरसायनखड्गां जनविवरपादुकासिद्धिः .
चिह्नं हि तव नतानां दृश्यत इह जन्मनि प्रकटम् .. 181.49 ..
6.3.m:
Success in the supreme elixir of alchemy, the magical sword, the magical collyrium, the subterranean realm, and the magical sandals:
this mark is indeed visibly seen in this very birth among those who bow to you.

6.3.s:
śāṭhyena yadi praṇamati vitarasi tasyāpi bhūtimicchayā deva .
bhavati bhavacchedakarī bhaktirmokṣāya nirmitā nātha .. 181.50 ..
6.3.d:
शाठ्येन यदि प्रणमति वितरसि तस्यापि भूतिमिच्छया देव .
भवति भवच्छेदकरी भक्तिर्मोक्षाय निर्मिता नाथ .. 181.50 ..
6.3.m:
Even if one bows deceitfully, O God, you bestow prosperity upon him according to your will.
Devotion that cuts off worldly existence was ordained for liberation, O Lord.

6.3.s:
paradāraparasvarataṃ paraparibhavaduḥkhaśokasaṃtaptam .
paravadanavīkṣaṇaparaṃ parameśvara māṃ paritrāhi .. 181.51 ..
6.3.d:
परदारपरस्वरतं परपरिभवदुःखशोकसंतप्तम् .
परवदनवीक्षणपरं परमेश्वर मां परित्राहि .. 181.51 ..
6.3.m:
Devoted to another's wife and another's wealth, tormented by the sorrow and grief of humiliation by others,
intent on watching the faces of others—protect me, O Supreme Lord!

6.3.s:
adhikābhimānamuditaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅguravibhavavilasantam .
krūraṃ kupathābhimukhaṃ śaṅkara śaraṇāgataṃ paritrāhi .. 181.52 ..
6.3.d:
अधिकाभिमानमुदितं क्षणभङ्गुरविभवविलसन्तम् .
क्रूरं कुपथाभिमुखं शङ्कर शरणागतं परित्राहि .. 181.52 ..
6.3.m:
Puffed up with excessive pride, delighting in transient power,
cruel, facing the bad path—protect this one who has come for refuge, O Śaṃkara!

6.3.s:
dīnaṃ dvijaṃ varārthe bandhujane naiva pūritā hyāśā .
chinddhi maheśvara tṛṣṇāṃ kiṃ mūḍhaṃ māṃ viḍambayasi .. 181.53 ..
6.3.d:
दीनं द्विजं वरार्थे बन्धुजने नैव पूरिता ह्याशा .
छिन्द्धि महेश्वर तृष्णां किं मूढं मां विडम्बयसि .. 181.53 ..
6.3.m:
A poor brahmin seeking boons, yet his hope was never fulfilled by his kinsfolk.
Cut away my thirst, O Maheśvara! Why do you mock me, a fool?

6.3.s:
tṛṣṇāṃ harasva śīghraṃ lakṣmīṃ dada hṛdayavāsinīṃ nityam .
chinddhi madamohapāśaṃ māmuttāraya bhavācca deveśa .. 181.54 ..
6.3.d:
तृष्णां हरस्व शीघ्रं लक्ष्मीं दद हृदयवासिनीं नित्यम् .
छिन्द्धि मदमोहपाशं मामुत्तारय भवाच्च देवेश .. 181.54 ..
6.3.m:
Take away thirst quickly! Grant fortune dwelling perpetually in my heart!
Sever the snare of pride and delusion, and carry me across worldly existence, O Lord of gods!

6.3.s:
karuṇābhyudayaṃ nāma stotramidaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ divyam .
yaḥ paṭhati bhṛguṃ smarati ca śivalokamasau prayāti dehānte .. 181.55 ..
6.3.d:
करुणाभ्युदयं नाम स्तोत्रमिदं सर्वसिद्धिदं दिव्यम् .
यः पठति भृगुं स्मरति च शिवलोकमसौ प्रयाति देहान्ते .. 181.55 ..
6.3.m:
This divine hymn named 'The Dawn of Compassion' bestows all perfections.
Whoever recites it and remembers Bhṛgu goes to the world of Śiva at the end of the body.

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā mahādevaḥ stotraṃ ca bhṛgubhāṣitam .
uvāca varado'smīti devyā saha varottamam .. 181.56 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवः स्तोत्रं च भृगुभाषितम् .
उवाच वरदोऽस्मीति देव्या सह वरोत्तमम् .. 181.56 ..
6.3.m:
Having heard this hymn uttered by Bhṛgu,
Mahādeva, along with the Goddess, said: 'I am the giver of boons,' [offering] an excellent boon.

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
prasanno devadeveśa yadi deyo varo mama .
siddhikṣetramidaṃ sarvaṃ bhavitā mama nāmataḥ .. 181.57 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
प्रसन्नो देवदेवेश यदि देयो वरो मम .
सिद्धिक्षेत्रमिदं सर्वं भविता मम नामतः .. 181.57 ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu said:
'If you are pleased, O God of the chiefs of gods, and if a boon is to be given to me,
let this entire sacred field of perfections be named after me.

6.3.s:
bhavadbhiḥ sannidhānena sthātavyaṃ hi sahomayā .
devakṣetramidaṃ puṇyaṃ yena sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 181.58 ..
6.3.d:
भवद्भिः सन्निधानेन स्थातव्यं हि सहोमया .
देवक्षेत्रमिदं पुण्यं येन सर्वं भविष्यति .. 181.58 ..
6.3.m:
You must remain here in your presence together with Umā,
so that this entire sacred field of the god will become holy.

6.3.s:
atra sthāne mahāsthānaṃ karomi jagadīśvara .
tava prasādāddeveśa pūryantāṃ me manorathāḥ .. 181.59 ..
6.3.d:
अत्र स्थाने महास्थानं करोमि जगदीश्वर .
तव प्रसादाद्देवेश पूर्यन्तां मे मनोरथाः .. 181.59 ..
6.3.m:
In this place I shall establish a great seat, O Lord of the universe.
By your favor, O Lord of gods, let my desires be fulfilled!'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
śriyā kṛtamidaṃ pūrvaṃ kiṃ na jñātaṃ tvayā dvija .
anumānya śriyaṃ devīṃ yadīyaṃ manyate bhavān .. 181.60 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
श्रिया कृतमिदं पूर्वं किं न ज्ञातं त्वया द्विज .
अनुमान्य श्रियं देवीं यदीयं मन्यते भवान् .. 181.60 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
'This was previously prepared by Śrī; did you not know this, O twice-born?
Having obtained the consent of Goddess Śrī, if you consider it to be hers,

6.3.s:
kuruṣva yadabhipretaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ naḥ tadanyathā .
evamuktvā gate deve snātvā gatvā bhṛguḥ śriyam .. 181.61 ..
6.3.d:
कुरुष्व यदभिप्रेतं त्वत्कृतं नः तदन्यथा .
एवमुक्त्वा गते देवे स्नात्वा गत्वा भृगुः श्रियम् .. 181.61 ..
6.3.m:
do what is desired; what is done by you is acceptable to us, otherwise not.'
Having spoken thus, the god departed; and Bhṛgu, having bathed, went to Śrī.

6.3.s:
kṛtvā ca pāraṇaṃ tatra vasanviprastayā saha .
śriyā ca sahitaḥ kāla idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 181.62 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा च पारणं तत्र वसन्विप्रस्तया सह .
श्रिया च सहितः काल इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 181.62 ..
6.3.m:
And having broken his fast, the brahmin, dwelling there with her,
in the company of Śrī, spoke these words at that time:

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
yadi te rocate bhadre duḥkhāsīnaṃ ca te yadi .
tvayā vṛte mahākṣetre svīyaṃ sthānaṃ karomyaham .. 181.63 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
यदि ते रोचते भद्रे दुःखासीनं च ते यदि .
त्वया वृते महाक्षेत्रे स्वीयं स्थानं करोम्यहम् .. 181.63 ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu said:
'If it pleases you, blessed lady, and if you are sitting at ease,
I shall establish my own dwelling in this great sacred field chosen by you.'

6.3.s:
śrīruvāca -
mama nāmnā tu viprarṣe tava nāmnā tu śobhanam .
sthānaṃ kuruṣvābhipretamavirodhena me matiḥ .. 181.64 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीरुवाच -
मम नाम्ना तु विप्रर्षे तव नाम्ना तु शोभनम् .
स्थानं कुरुष्वाभिप्रेतमविरोधेन मे मतिः .. 181.64 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī said:
'Under my name, O brahmin-seer, and under your name,
make an auspicious, desired dwelling; in my opinion, there is no conflict.'

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
kacchapādhiṣṭhitaṃ hyetattasya pṛṣṭhigataṃ rame .
saṃmantrya sahitaṃ tena śobhanaṃ bhavatī kuru .. 181.65 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛgukacchotpattivarṇanaṃ nāmaikāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
कच्छपाधिष्ठितं ह्येतत्तस्य पृष्ठिगतं रमे .
संमन्त्र्य सहितं तेन शोभनं भवती कुरु .. 181.65 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भृगुकच्छोत्पत्तिवर्णनं नामैकाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu said:
'This [place] is presided over by a tortoise and situated upon its back, O Ramā.
Having consulted together with him, you make it auspicious.'
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-first chapter, named 'The Description of the Origin of Bhṛgukaccha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
adhyāya 182
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato bhṛguḥ śriyā caiva sametaḥ kacchapaṃ gataḥ .
abhinandya yathānyāyamuvāca vacanaṃ śubham .. 182.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 182
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो भृगुः श्रिया चैव समेतः कच्छपं गतः .
अभिनन्द्य यथान्यायमुवाच वचनं शुभम् .. 182.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 182
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then Bhṛgu, joined by Śrī, went to the tortoise.
Having greeted him properly, he spoke auspicious words:

6.3.s:
tvayā dhṛtā dharā sarvā tathā lokāścarācarāḥ .
tathaiva puṇyabhāvatvātsthitastatra mahāmate .. 182.2 ..
6.3.d:
त्वया धृता धरा सर्वा तथा लोकाश्चराचराः .
तथैव पुण्यभावत्वात्स्थितस्तत्र महामते .. 182.2 ..
6.3.m:
'By you all the earth is supported, as well as the worlds of mobile and immobile beings;
likewise, out of your virtuous nature, you abide there, O noble-minded one.

6.3.s:
cāturvidyasya saṃsthānaṃ karomi ramayā saha .
yadi tvaṃ manyase deva tadādeśaya māṃ vibho .. 182.3 ..
6.3.d:
चातुर्विद्यस्य संस्थानं करोमि रमया सह .
यदि त्वं मन्यसे देव तदादेशय मां विभो .. 182.3 ..
6.3.m:
Together with Ramā, I am establishing a foundation for those versed in the four Vedas.
If you approve, O god, then grant me the order, O all-pervading one!'

6.3.s:
kūrma uvāca -
evameva dvijaśreṣṭha mama nāmāṅkitaṃ puram .
bhaviṣyati mahatkālaṃ mamopari susaṃsthitam .. 182.4 ..
6.3.d:
कूर्म उवाच -
एवमेव द्विजश्रेष्ठ मम नामाङ्कितं पुरम् .
भविष्यति महत्कालं ममोपरि सुसंस्थितम् .. 182.4 ..
6.3.m:
The Tortoise said:
'Just so, O best of the twice-born! A city marked with my name
shall exist for a long time, well established upon me,

6.3.s:
acalaṃ susthiraṃ tāta na bhīḥ kāryā sulocane .
etacchrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ kacchapasya mukhāccyutam .. 182.5 ..
6.3.d:
अचलं सुस्थिरं तात न भीः कार्या सुलोचने .
एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं कच्छपस्य मुखाच्च्युतम् .. 182.5 ..
6.3.m:
unshakable and exceedingly firm, my dear! No fear should be felt, O fair-eyed lady!'
Having heard these auspicious words fallen from the mouth of the tortoise,

6.3.s:
hṛṣṭastuṣṭaḥ śriyā sārddhaṃ padmayonisuto bhṛguḥ .
abhīci udaye prāpte kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ .. 182.6 ..
6.3.d:
हृष्टस्तुष्टः श्रिया सार्द्धं पद्मयोनिसुतो भृगुः .
अभीचि उदये प्राप्ते कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः .. 182.6 ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu, the son of the lotus-born [Brahmā], was delighted and pleased along with Śrī.
When the auspicious rising occurred, having performed the auspicious festive rites,

6.3.s:
nandane vatsare māghe pañcamyāṃ bharatarṣabha .
śaste tu hyuttarāyoge kumbhasthe śaśimaṇḍale .. 182.7 ..
6.3.d:
नन्दने वत्सरे माघे पञ्चम्यां भरतर्षभ .
शस्ते तु ह्युत्तरायोगे कुम्भस्थे शशिमण्डले .. 182.7 ..
6.3.m:
in the year Nandana, in the month of Māgha, on the fifth day, O bull of the Bharatas,
under the auspicious conjunction of Uttarā, while the orb of the moon was in Kumbha,

6.3.s:
revāyā uttare tīre gambhīre cābhivāruṇi .
prāgudakpravaṇe deśe koṭitīrthasamanvitam .. 182.8 ..
6.3.d:
रेवाया उत्तरे तीरे गम्भीरे चाभिवारुणि .
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे कोटितीर्थसमन्वितम् .. 182.8 ..
6.3.m:
on the deep northern bank of the Revā, toward the western direction,
in a region sloping east and north, endowed with ten million sacred fords,

6.3.s:
krośapramāṇaṃ tatkṣetraṃ prāsādaśatasaṃkulam .
acireṇaiva kālena tapobalasamanvitaḥ .
vicintya viśvakarmāṇaṃ cakāra bhṛgusattamaḥ .. 182.9 ..
6.3.d:
क्रोशप्रमाणं तत्क्षेत्रं प्रासादशतसंकुलम् .
अचिरेणैव कालेन तपोबलसमन्वितः .
विचिन्त्य विश्वकर्माणं चकार भृगुसत्तमः .. 182.9 ..
6.3.m:
a sacred field one krośa in measure, crowded with hundreds of temples,
in no long time, endowed with the power of his austerity,
the best of the Bhṛgus built, having meditated upon Viśvakarman.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇā vedavidvāṃsaḥ kṣatriyā rājyapālakāḥ .
vaiśyā vṛttiratāstatra śūdrāḥ śuśrūṣakāstriṣu .. 182.10 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणा वेदविद्वांसः क्षत्रिया राज्यपालकाः .
वैश्या वृत्तिरतास्तत्र शूद्राः शुश्रूषकास्त्रिषु .. 182.10 ..
6.3.m:
Brahmins versed in the Vedas, kṣatriyas protecting the kingdom,
vaiśyas engaged in their livelihoods, and śūdras serving the three [castes were there].

6.3.s:
evaṃ śriyā vṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ paramānandananditam .
nirmitaṃ bhṛguṇā tāta sarvapātakanāśanam .
iti bhṛgukacchotpattiḥ .. 182.11 ..
6.3.d:
एवं श्रिया वृतं क्षेत्रं परमानन्दनन्दितम् .
निर्मितं भृगुणा तात सर्वपातकनाशनम् .
इति भृगुकच्छोत्पत्तिः .. 182.11 ..
6.3.m:
Thus the sacred field, chosen by Śrī, gladdened by supreme bliss,
was constructed by Bhṛgu, my dear, destroying all sins.
Thus is the origin of Bhṛgukaccha.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ kālena mahatā kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare .
devalokaṃ jagāmāśu lakṣmīrṛṣisamāgame .. 182.12 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः कालेन महता कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे .
देवलोकं जगामाशु लक्ष्मीरृषिसमागमे .. 182.12 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then after a great length of time, for some other reason,
Lakṣmī went swiftly to the heavenly world upon an assembly of seers,

6.3.s:
samarpya kuñcikāṭṭālaṃ bhṛgave brahmavādine .
pālayasva yathārthaṃ vai sthānakaṃ mama suvrata .. 182.13 ..
6.3.d:
समर्प्य कुञ्चिकाट्टालं भृगवे ब्रह्मवादिने .
पालयस्व यथार्थं वै स्थानकं मम सुव्रत .. 182.13 ..
6.3.m:
having entrusted the key to the palace to Bhṛgu, the declarer of the Veda:
'Guard my abode faithfully, O one of virtuous vows!'

6.3.s:
devakāryāṇyaśeṣāṇi kṛtvā śrīḥ punarāgatā .
ājagāma ramā devī bhṛgukacchaṃ tvarānvitā .. 182.14 ..
6.3.d:
देवकार्याण्यशेषाणि कृत्वा श्रीः पुनरागता .
आजगाम रमा देवी भृगुकच्छं त्वरान्विता .. 182.14 ..
6.3.m:
Having accomplished all the duties of the gods, Śrī returned again;
Goddess Ramā came in haste to Bhṛgukaccha.

6.3.s:
prārthitaṃ kuñcikāṭṭālaṃ svagṛhaṃ saparigraham .
bhṛguryadā tadā pārtha mithyā nāsti tadā vadata .. 182.15 ..
6.3.d:
प्रार्थितं कुञ्चिकाट्टालं स्वगृहं सपरिग्रहम् .
भृगुर्यदा तदा पार्थ मिथ्या नास्ति तदा वदत .. 182.15 ..
6.3.m:
When the key to the palace, her own house with its belongings, was requested,
then Bhṛgu [denied it], O son of Pṛthā: 'There is no falsehood,' he said then.

6.3.s:
eva vivādaḥ sumahānsaṃjātaśca nareśvara .
mameti mama caiveti parasparasamāgame .. 182.16 ..
6.3.d:
एव विवादः सुमहान्संजातश्च नरेश्वर .
ममेति मम चैवेति परस्परसमागमे .. 182.16 ..
6.3.m:
Thus a very great dispute arose, O lord of men,
[saying] 'It is mine!' and 'It is mine!' when they encountered each other.

6.3.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā bhṛguṇā paramarṣiṇā .
cāturvidyapramāṇārthaṃ cakāra mahatīṃ sthitim .. 182.17 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कालेन महता भृगुणा परमर्षिणा .
चातुर्विद्यप्रमाणार्थं चकार महतीं स्थितिम् .. 182.17 ..
6.3.m:
Then, after a great length of time, Bhṛgu, the supreme seer,
for the sake of the testimony of those versed in the four Vedas, made a great arrangement:

6.3.s:
asmadīyaṃ yathā sarvaṃ nagaraṃ mṛgalocane .
cāturvidyā dvijāḥ sarve tathā jānanti sundari .. 182.18 ..
6.3.d:
अस्मदीयं यथा सर्वं नगरं मृगलोचने .
चातुर्विद्या द्विजाः सर्वे तथा जानन्ति सुन्दरि .. 182.18 ..
6.3.m:
'Just as the entire city is ours, O deer-eyed lady,
so all the twice-born versed in the four Vedas know, O beautiful one.'

6.3.s:
śrīruvāca -
pramāṇaṃ mama viprendra cāturvaṇyā na saṃśayaḥ .
madīyaṃ vā tvadīyaṃ vā kathayantu dvijottamāḥ .. 182.19 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीरुवाच -
प्रमाणं मम विप्रेन्द्र चातुर्वण्या न संशयः .
मदीयं वा त्वदीयं वा कथयन्तु द्विजोत्तमाः .. 182.19 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī said:
'Those of the four castes are my authority, O chief of the twice-born, no doubt.
Let the best of the twice-born say whether it is mine or yours!'

6.3.s:
tataḥ samastairvibudhaiḥ sampradhārya parasparam .
dvidhā tairvāksthalaṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇā nṛpasaṃhitam .. 182.20 ..
6.3.d:
ततः समस्तैर्विबुधैः सम्प्रधार्य परस्परम् .
द्विधा तैर्वाक्स्थलं दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणा नृपसंहितम् .. 182.20 ..
6.3.m:
Then, having deliberated mutually among all the wise men,
and having seen the two sides of the spoken dispute, the brahmins, together with the king...

6.3.s:
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi nocurvai kiṃciduttaram .
aṣṭādaśasahasreṣu bhṛgukopabhayānnṛpa .
uktaṃ ca tālakaṃ haste yasya tasyedamuttaram .. 182.21 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टादशसहस्राणि नोचुर्वै किंचिदुत्तरम् .
अष्टादशसहस्रेषु भृगुकोपभयान्नृप .
उक्तं च तालकं हस्ते यस्य तस्येदमुत्तरम् .. 182.21 ..
6.3.m: Eighteen thousand gave no reply at all. / Among the eighteen thousand, out of fear of Bhṛgu's anger, O king, / it was said: "He who holds the palm-leaf document in his hand—his is this answer."

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā tu sā devī nigamaṃ naigamaiḥ kṛtam .
krodhena mahatāviṣṭā śaśāpa dvijapuṃgavān .. 182.22 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु सा देवी निगमं नैगमैः कृतम् .
क्रोधेन महताविष्टा शशाप द्विजपुंगवान् .. 182.22 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this settlement made by those who know the Vedic tradition, that goddess, / seized by great wrath, cursed the bull-like brahmins:

6.3.s:
śrīdevyuvāca -
yasmātsatyaṃ samutsṛjya lobhopahatamānasaiḥ .
madīyaṃ lopitaṃ sthānaṃ tasmācchṛṇvantu me giram .. 182.23 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच -
यस्मात्सत्यं समुत्सृज्य लोभोपहतमानसैः .
मदीयं लोपितं स्थानं तस्माच्छृण्वन्तु मे गिरम् .. 182.23 ..
6.3.m: The holy goddess said: / "Since, abandoning truth with minds corrupted by greed, / you have abolished my abode, therefore hear my word:

6.3.s:
tripauruṣā bhavedvidyā tripuruṣaṃ na bhaveddhanam .
na dvitīyastu vo vedaḥ paṭhito bhavati dvijāḥ .. 182.24 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिपौरुषा भवेद्विद्या त्रिपुरुषं न भवेद्धनम् .
न द्वितीयस्तु वो वेदः पठितो भवति द्विजाः .. 182.24 ..
6.3.m: Knowledge shall last three generations; wealth shall not last three generations. / Nor, O brahmins, shall a second Veda ever be studied by you.

6.3.s:
gṛhāṇi na dvibhaumāni na ca bhūtiḥ sthirā dvijāḥ .
pakṣapātena vo dharmo na ca niḥśreyabhāvataḥ .. 182.25 ..
6.3.d:
गृहाणि न द्विभौमानि न च भूतिः स्थिरा द्विजाः .
पक्षपातेन वो धर्मो न च निःश्रेयभावतः .. 182.25 ..
6.3.m: Your houses shall not have two storeys, nor will prosperity be enduring, O brahmins. / Your dharma shall stem from partiality, and not from the pursuit of supreme beatitude.

6.3.s:
iṣṭo gotrajanaḥ kaścillobhenāvṛtamānasaḥ .
na ca dvaidhaṃ parityajya hyekaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 182.26 ..
6.3.d:
इष्टो गोत्रजनः कश्चिल्लोभेनावृतमानसः .
न च द्वैधं परित्यज्य ह्येकं सत्यं भविष्यति .. 182.26 ..
6.3.m: Some beloved kinsman, his mind clouded by greed, / shall never abandon duality, nor will there be a single truth.

6.3.s:
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāmahaṅkāro dvijanmanām .
na pitā putravākyena na putraḥ pitṛkarmaṇi .. 182.27 ..
6.3.d:
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषामहङ्कारो द्विजन्मनाम् .
न पिता पुत्रवाक्येन न पुत्रः पितृकर्मणि .. 182.27 ..
6.3.m: From this day forward, all twice-born men shall have pride: / the father will not heed the son's word, nor the son the father's rite.

6.3.s:
ahaṅkārakṛtāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ .
iti śaptvā ramādevī tadaiva ca divaṃ yayau .. 182.28 ..
6.3.d:
अहङ्कारकृताः सर्वे भविष्यन्ति न संशयः .
इति शप्त्वा रमादेवी तदैव च दिवं ययौ .. 182.28 ..
6.3.m: All will become filled with egotism, there is no doubt." / Having cursed them thus, the goddess Ramā went to heaven that very moment.

6.3.s:
tato gatāyāṃ vai lakṣmyāṃ devā brahmarṣayo'malāḥ .
krodhalobhamidaṃ sthānaṃ te'pi coktvā divaṃ yayuḥ .. 182.29 ..
6.3.d:
ततो गतायां वै लक्ष्म्यां देवा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः .
क्रोधलोभमिदं स्थानं तेऽपि चोक्त्वा दिवं ययुः .. 182.29 ..
6.3.m: When Lakṣmī had gone, the gods and the stainless brahmin seers, / saying, "This place is filled with wrath and greed," also went to heaven.

6.3.s:
gatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tato devīmṛṣīṃścaiva tapodhanān .
bhṛguśca parameṣṭhī sa viṣādamagamatparam .
prasādayāmāsa punaḥ śaṅkaraṃ tripurāntakam .. 182.30 ..
6.3.d:
गतां दृष्ट्वा ततो देवीमृषींश्चैव तपोधनान् .
भृगुश्च परमेष्ठी स विषादमगमत्परम् .
प्रसादयामास पुनः शङ्करं त्रिपुरान्तकम् .. 182.30 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the goddess gone, and the seers rich in austerity, / Bhṛgu, that lord of creatures, fell into profound dejection. / He again propitiated Śaṃkara, the destroyer of Tripura.

6.3.s:
tapasā mahatā pārtha tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .
uvāca vacanaṃ kāle harṣayan bhṛgusattamam .. 182.31 ..
6.3.d:
तपसा महता पार्थ ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .
उवाच वचनं काले हर्षयन् भृगुसत्तमम् .. 182.31 ..
6.3.m: Through great austerity, O son of Pṛthā, Maheśvara was pleased; / at that time he spoke words that brought joy to the best of the Bhṛgus:

6.3.s:
kiṃ viṣaṇṇo'si viprendra kiṃ vā santāpakāraṇam .
mayi prasanne'pi tava hyetatkathaya me'nagha .. 182.32 ..
6.3.d:
किं विषण्णोऽसि विप्रेन्द्र किं वा सन्तापकारणम् .
मयि प्रसन्नेऽपि तव ह्येतत्कथय मेऽनघ .. 182.32 ..
6.3.m: "Why are you dejected, O lord among brahmins? What is the cause of your distress? / Even though I am pleased with you, tell me this, O sinless one."

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
śāpayitvā dvijānsarvānpurā lakṣmīrvinirgatā .
apavitramidaṃ coktvā tato devā vinirgatāḥ .. 182.33 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
शापयित्वा द्विजान्सर्वान्पुरा लक्ष्मीर्विनिर्गता .
अपवित्रमिदं चोक्त्वा ततो देवा विनिर्गताः .. 182.33 ..
6.3.m: Bhṛgu said: / "Having cursed all the brahmins, Lakṣmī departed earlier, / and declaring, 'This [place] is impure,' the gods departed from here."

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
purā mayā yathā proktaṃ tattathā na tadanyathā .
krodhasthānamasaṃdehaṃ tathānyadapi tacchṛṇu .. 182.34 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
पुरा मया यथा प्रोक्तं तत्तथा न तदन्यथा .
क्रोधस्थानमसंदेहं तथान्यदपि तच्छृणु .. 182.34 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / "As I proclaimed earlier, that is so and not otherwise: / it is certainly a place of wrath. Hear also something else:

6.3.s:
tatra sthānasamudbhūtā mahadbhayavivarjitāḥ .
brāhmaṇā matprasādena bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ .. 182.35 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्थानसमुद्भूता महद्भयविवर्जिताः .
ब्राह्मणा मत्प्रसादेन भविष्यन्ति न संशयः .. 182.35 ..
6.3.m: The brahmins born in this place, freed from great fear, / shall prosper by my grace, there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
vedavidyāvratasnātāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ .
ye'pi te śatasāhasrāstvaritā hyāgatāstviha .. 182.36 ..
6.3.d:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाताः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदाः .
येऽपि ते शतसाहस्रास्त्वरिता ह्यागतास्त्विह .. 182.36 ..
6.3.m: Even those who have taken the ceremonial bath of Vedic learning and vows, and are skilled in all scriptures, / even a hundred thousand who have swiftly gathered here—

6.3.s:
apaṭhasyāpi mūrkhasya sarvāvasthāṃ gatasya ca .
uttarāduttaraṃ śakro dātuṃ na tu bhṛgūttama .. 182.37 ..
6.3.d:
अपठस्यापि मूर्खस्य सर्वावस्थां गतस्य च .
उत्तरादुत्तरं शक्रो दातुं न तु भृगूत्तम .. 182.37 ..
6.3.m: to a fool who does not study and has sunk to every low state, / even Indra could not give a better rejoinder, O best of the Bhṛgus!

6.3.s:
koṭitīrthamidaṃ sthānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .
adyaprabhṛti viprendra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 182.38 ..
6.3.d:
कोटितीर्थमिदं स्थानं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .
अद्यप्रभृति विप्रेन्द्र भविष्यति न संशयः .. 182.38 ..
6.3.m: This place shall become Koṭitīrtha, destroying all sins, / from this day forward, O lord among brahmins, there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
matprasādāddevagaṇaiḥ sevitaṃ ca bhaviṣyati .
bhṛgukṣetre mṛtā ye tu kṛmikīṭapataṃgakāḥ .. 182.39 ..
6.3.d:
मत्प्रसादाद्देवगणैः सेवितं च भविष्यति .
भृगुक्षेत्रे मृता ये तु कृमिकीटपतंगकाः .. 182.39 ..
6.3.m: By my grace it shall be frequented by hosts of gods. / The worms, insects, and moths that die in Bhṛgukṣetra,

6.3.s:
vāsasteṣāṃ śive loke matprasādādbhaviṣyati .
vṛṣakhāte naraḥ snātvā pūjayitvā maheśvaram .. 182.40 ..
6.3.d:
वासस्तेषां शिवे लोके मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति .
वृषखाते नरः स्नात्वा पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .. 182.40 ..
6.3.m: shall abide in the auspicious realm of Śiva by my grace. / A man who bathes in Vṛṣakhāta and worships Maheśvara

6.3.s:
sarvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayam .
bhṛgutīrthe naraḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 182.41 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयम् .
भृगुतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 182.41 ..
6.3.m: doubtless attains the fruit of the Sarvamedha sacrifice. / A man who bathes in Bhṛgutīrtha and offers libations to ancestors and deities,

6.3.s:
tasya te dvādaśābdāni śāntiṃ gacchanti tarpitāḥ .
dadhikṣīreṇa toyena ghṛtena madhunā saha .. 182.42 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य ते द्वादशाब्दानि शान्तिं गच्छन्ति तर्पिताः .
दधिक्षीरेण तोयेन घृतेन मधुना सह .. 182.42 ..
6.3.m: has those [ancestors] gratified, attaining peace for twelve years. / With curd, milk, water, ghee, and honey,

6.3.s:
ye snapanti virūpākṣaṃ teṣāṃ vāsastriviṣṭape .
matprasādāddvijaśreṣṭha sarvadevānusevitam .. 182.43 ..
6.3.d:
ये स्नपन्ति विरूपाक्षं तेषां वासस्त्रिविष्टपे .
मत्प्रसादाद्द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्वदेवानुसेवितम् .. 182.43 ..
6.3.m: those who bathe Virūpākṣa abide in heaven. / By my grace, O best of the twice-born, frequented by all the gods,

6.3.s:
bhaviṣyati bhṛgukṣetraṃ kurukṣetrādibhiḥ samam .
mārtaṇḍagrahaṇe prāpte yavaṃ kṛtvā hiraṇmayam .. 182.44 ..
6.3.d:
भविष्यति भृगुक्षेत्रं कुरुक्षेत्रादिभिः समम् .
मार्तण्डग्रहणे प्राप्ते यवं कृत्वा हिरण्मयम् .. 182.44 ..
6.3.m: Bhṛgukṣetra shall be equal to Kurukṣetra and other sacred places. / When an eclipse of the sun occurs, having made a golden barley corn

6.3.s:
dattvā śirasi yaḥ snāti bhṛgukṣetre dvijottama .
avicāreṇa taṃ viddhi saṃsnātaṃ kurujāṅgale .. 182.45 ..
6.3.d:
दत्त्वा शिरसि यः स्नाति भृगुक्षेत्रे द्विजोत्तम .
अविचारेण तं विद्धि संस्नातं कुरुजाङ्गले .. 182.45 ..
6.3.m: and placed it on his head, whoever bathes in Bhṛgukṣetra, O best of brahmins, / know that without a doubt he has bathed in Kurujāṅgala.

6.3.s:
ahaṃ caiva vasiṣyāmi ambikā ca mama priyā .
sarvaduḥkhāpahā devī nāmnā saubhāgyasundarī .. 182.46 ..
6.3.d:
अहं चैव वसिष्यामि अम्बिका च मम प्रिया .
सर्वदुःखापहा देवी नाम्ना सौभाग्यसुन्दरी .. 182.46 ..
6.3.m: And I myself shall dwell there, and my beloved Ambikā, / the goddess who removes all sorrows, named Saubhāgyasundarī.

6.3.s:
vasiṣyāmi tayā devyā sahito bhṛgukacchake .
evamuktvā sthito devo bhṛgukacche'mbikā tathā .. 182.47 ..
6.3.d:
वसिष्यामि तया देव्या सहितो भृगुकच्छके .
एवमुक्त्वा स्थितो देवो भृगुकच्छेऽम्बिका तथा .. 182.47 ..
6.3.m: I shall dwell together with that goddess in Bhṛgukaccha." / Having spoken thus, the god remained in Bhṛgukaccha, and so did Ambikā.

6.3.s:
bhṛgustu svapuraṃ prāyādbrahmaghoṣanināditam .
ṛgyajuḥsāmaghoṣeṇa hyatharvaṇanināditam .. 182.48 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुस्तु स्वपुरं प्रायाद्ब्रह्मघोषनिनादितम् .
ऋग्यजुःसामघोषेण ह्यथर्वणनिनादितम् .. 182.48 ..
6.3.m: Bhṛgu, however, went to his own city, echoing with the chanting of the Veda, / resonant with the sounds of the Ṛg, Yajur, Sāma, and Atharva [Vedas].

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vṛṣamutsṛjate naraḥ .
sa yāti śivasāyujyamityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 182.49 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा वृषमुत्सृजते नरः .
स याति शिवसायुज्यमित्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 182.49 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and releases a bull / attains intimacy with Śiva; so spoke Śaṃkara.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā caitre māsi samācaret .
dadyācca lavaṇaṃ vipre pūjya saubhāgyasundarīm .. 182.50 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा चैत्रे मासि समाचरेत् .
दद्याच्च लवणं विप्रे पूज्य सौभाग्यसुन्दरीम् .. 182.50 ..
6.3.m: Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and performs rites in the month of Caitra, / and, having worshipped Saubhāgyasundarī, gives salt to a brahmin,

6.3.s:
gobhūhiraṇyaṃ viprebhyaḥ prīyetāṃ lalitāśivau .
na duḥkhaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca viyogaṃ patinā saha .. 182.51 ..
6.3.d:
गोभूहिरण्यं विप्रेभ्यः प्रीयेतां ललिताशिवौ .
न दुःखं दुर्भगत्वं च वियोगं पतिना सह .. 182.51 ..
6.3.m: and cattle, land, and gold to brahmins, pleases Lalitā and Śiva. / Neither grief, nor ill-fortune, nor separation from her husband

6.3.s:
prāpnoti nārī rājendra bhṛgutīrthāplavena ca .
yastu nityaṃ bhṛguṃ devaṃ paśyedvai pāṇḍunandana .. 182.52 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्नोति नारी राजेन्द्र भृगुतीर्थाप्लवेन च .
यस्तु नित्यं भृगुं देवं पश्येद्वै पाण्डुनन्दन .. 182.52 ..
6.3.m: does a woman suffer, O king of kings, by bathing in Bhṛgutīrtha. / And whoever constantly beholds the divine Bhṛgu, O son of Pāṇḍu,

6.3.s:
ā brahmasadanaṃ yāvattatrasthairdaivataiḥ saha .
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpottama .. 182.53 ..
6.3.d:
आ ब्रह्मसदनं यावत्तत्रस्थैर्दैवतैः सह .
यत्फलं समवाप्नोति तच्छृणुष्व नृपोत्तम .. 182.53 ..
6.3.m: all the way to the abode of Brahmā, together with the deities dwelling there— / hear the fruit that he obtains, O best of kings:

6.3.s:
suvarṇaśṛṅgīṃ kapilāṃ payasvinīṃ sādhvīṃ suśīlāṃ taruṇīṃ savatsām .
dattvā dvije sarvavratopapanne phalaṃ ca yatsyāttadihaiva nūnam .. 182.54 ..
6.3.d:
सुवर्णशृङ्गीं कपिलां पयस्विनीं साध्वीं सुशीलां तरुणीं सवत्साम् .
दत्त्वा द्विजे सर्वव्रतोपपन्ने फलं च यत्स्यात्तदिहैव नूनम् .. 182.54 ..
6.3.m: The fruit one gains by giving a tawny cow with golden horns, rich in milk, gentle, of good temper, young, and accompanied by her calf, / to a brahmin endowed with all vows—surely that is gained right here.

6.3.s:
samāḥ sahasrāṇi tu sapta vai jale mriyellabheddvādaśavahnimadhye .
tyajaṃstanuṃ śūravṛttyā narendra śakrātithyaṃ yāti vai martyadharmā .. 182.55 ..
6.3.d:
समाः सहस्राणि तु सप्त वै जले म्रियेल्लभेद्द्वादशवह्निमध्ये .
त्यजंस्तनुं शूरवृत्त्या नरेन्द्र शक्रातिथ्यं याति वै मर्त्यधर्मा .. 182.55 ..
6.3.m: If a mortal dies in water, [he attains heaven] for seven thousand years; in fire, he obtains twelve [thousand]. / Relinquishing his body by the conduct of a hero, O king, he enjoys the hospitality of Indra.

6.3.s:
ākhyānametacca sadā yaśasyaṃ svargyaṃ dhanyaṃ putryamāyuṣyakāri .
śṛṇvaṃllabhetsarvametaddhi bhaktyā parvaṇi parvaṇyājamīḍhassadaiva .. 182.56 ..
6.3.d:
आख्यानमेतच्च सदा यशस्यं स्वर्ग्यं धन्यं पुत्र्यमायुष्यकारि .
शृण्वंल्लभेत्सर्वमेतद्धि भक्त्या पर्वणि पर्वण्याजमीढस्सदैव .. 182.56 ..
6.3.m: This narrative always brings renown, heaven, prosperity, sons, and longevity. / Hearing it with devotion on every festival day, O descendant of Ajamīḍha, one obtains all this.

6.3.s:
saṃnyāsaṃ kurute yastu bhṛgutīrthe vidhānataḥ .
sa mṛtaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ gacchedvai yacca durlabham .. 182.57 ..
6.3.d:
संन्यासं कुरुते यस्तु भृगुतीर्थे विधानतः .
स मृतः परमं स्थानं गच्छेद्वै यच्च दुर्लभम् .. 182.57 ..
6.3.m: Whoever takes up renunciation according to rule at Bhṛgutīrtha, / when dead, goes to that supreme, hard-to-attain abode.

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā bhṛguśreṣṭho devadevena bhāṣitam .
prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā tatraiva saṃsthito dvijaḥ .. 182.58 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा भृगुश्रेष्ठो देवदेवेन भाषितम् .
प्रहृष्टवदनो भूत्वा तत्रैव संस्थितो द्विजः .. 182.58 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this spoken by the god of gods, the best of the Bhṛgus, / his face beaming with joy, that twice-born remained right there.

6.3.s:
tirobhāvaṃ gate deve bhṛguḥ śreṣṭho dvijottamaḥ .
svamūrti tatra muktvā tu brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha .. 182.59 ..
6.3.d:
तिरोभावं गते देवे भृगुः श्रेष्ठो द्विजोत्तमः .
स्वमूर्ति तत्र मुक्त्वा तु ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम ह .. 182.59 ..
6.3.m: When the god had vanished, Bhṛgu, the best of the twice-born, / leaving his form there, went to the world of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
bhṛgukacchasya cotpattiḥ kathitā tava pāṇḍava .
saṃkṣepeṇa mahārāja sarvapāmapraṇāśanī .. 182.60 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुकच्छस्य चोत्पत्तिः कथिता तव पाण्डव .
संक्षेपेण महाराज सर्वपामप्रणाशनी .. 182.60 ..
6.3.m: Thus the origin of Bhṛgukaccha, destroying all sins, / has been told to you in brief, O Pāṇḍava, O great king.

6.3.s:
etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ kṣetraṃ devena kīrtitam .
caturyugasahasreṇa pitāmahadinaṃ smṛtam .. 182.61 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्पुण्यं पापहरं क्षेत्रं देवेन कीर्तितम् .
चतुर्युगसहस्रेण पितामहदिनं स्मृतम् .. 182.61 ..
6.3.m:
This holy, sin-destroying sacred field was proclaimed by the god.
A thousand cycles of four yugas is traditionally remembered as a day of the Grandfather.

6.3.s:
prāpte brahmadine viprā jāyate yugasambhavaḥ .
na paśyāmi tvidaṃ kṣetramiti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau .. 182.62 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्ते ब्रह्मदिने विप्रा जायते युगसम्भवः .
न पश्यामि त्विदं क्षेत्रमिति रुद्रः स्वयं जगौ .. 182.62 ..
6.3.m:
When the day of Brahmā arrives, O brahmins, the origin of the yugas takes place.
'I do not see [another] sacred field like this,' so Rudra himself sang.

6.3.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti tvidaṃ bhaktyā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā .
sa yāti paramaṃ lokamiti rudraḥ svayaṃ jagau .. 182.63 ..
6.3.d:
यः शृणोति त्विदं भक्त्या नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा .
स याति परमं लोकमिति रुद्रः स्वयं जगौ .. 182.63 ..
6.3.m:
Whether a woman or a man who hears this with devotion,
goes to the supreme realm—so Rudra himself sang.

6.3.s:
devakhāte naraḥ snātvā piṇḍadānādisatkriyām .
yāṃ karoti nṛpaśreṣṭha tāmakṣayaphalāṃ viduḥ .. 182.64 ..
6.3.d:
देवखाते नरः स्नात्वा पिण्डदानादिसत्क्रियाम् .
यां करोति नृपश्रेष्ठ तामक्षयफलां विदुः .. 182.64 ..
6.3.m:
Having bathed in Devakhāta, whatever pious rite such as offering the rice-ball
a person performs, O best of kings, they know it to have inexhaustible fruit.

6.3.s:
ya imaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā bhṛgukacchasya vistaram .
koṭitīrthaphalaṃ tasya bhavedvai nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 182.65 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe bhṛgukacchatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
य इमं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या भृगुकच्छस्य विस्तरम् .
कोटितीर्थफलं तस्य भवेद्वै नात्र संशयः .. 182.65 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे भृगुकच्छतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whoever listens with devotion to this detailed account of Bhṛgukaccha
shall obtain the fruit of ten million sacred fords; there is no doubt about this.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of the Bhṛgukaccha sacred ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 183
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
ataḥ paraṃ mahārāja gacchetkedārasaṃjñakam .
yatra gatvā mahārāja śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā pibejjalam .
sampūjya devadeveśaṃ kedārotthaṃ phalaṃ labhet .. 183.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 183
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
अतः परं महाराज गच्छेत्केदारसंज्ञकम् .
यत्र गत्वा महाराज श्राद्धं कृत्वा पिबेज्जलम् .
सम्पूज्य देवदेवेशं केदारोत्थं फलं लभेत् .. 183.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 183
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
After this, O great king, one should go to the [place] called Kedāra.
Having gone there, O great king, having performed a śrāddha and drunk the water,
one should worship the god of the gods and obtain the fruit arising from Kedāra.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathamatra suraśreṣṭha kedārākhyaḥ sthitaḥ svayam .
uttare narmadākūle etadvistarato vada .. 183.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथमत्र सुरश्रेष्ठ केदाराख्यः स्थितः स्वयम् .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले एतद्विस्तरतो वद .. 183.2 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How did he who is called Kedāra himself remain here,
O best of gods, on the northern bank of the Narmadā? Tell this in detail.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
purā kṛtayugasyādau śaṅkarastu maheśvaraḥ .
bhṛguṇārādhitaḥ śaptaḥ śriyā ca bhṛgukacchake .. 183.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ शङ्करस्तु महेश्वरः .
भृगुणाराधितः शप्तः श्रिया च भृगुकच्छके .. 183.3 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Formerly, at the beginning of the Kṛta age, Śaṃkara, the Great Lord,
was worshipped by Bhṛgu, and [the place] was cursed by Śrī at Bhṛgukaccha.

6.3.s:
apavitramidaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvavedavivarjitam .
bhaviṣyati nṛpaśreṣṭha gatetyuktvā haripriyā .. 183.4 ..
6.3.d:
अपवित्रमिदं क्षेत्रं सर्ववेदविवर्जितम् .
भविष्यति नृपश्रेष्ठ गतेत्युक्त्वा हरिप्रिया .. 183.4 ..
6.3.m:
Having said, 'This sacred field shall become impure,
devoid of all the Vedas, O best of kings,' the beloved of Hari departed.

6.3.s:
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ bhṛgurvarṣasahasrakam .
vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraściraṃ dhamanisaṃtataḥ .. 183.5 ..
6.3.d:
तपश्चचार विपुलं भृगुर्वर्षसहस्रकम् .
वायुभक्षो निराहारश्चिरं धमनिसंततः .. 183.5 ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu performed extensive austerity for a thousand years,
subsisting on wind, taking no food, his veins standing out for a long time.

6.3.s:
tataḥ pratyakṣatāmāgālliṅgībhūto maheśvaraḥ .
prādurbhūtastu sahasā bhittvā pātālasaptakam .. 183.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रत्यक्षतामागाल्लिङ्गीभूतो महेश्वरः .
प्रादुर्भूतस्तु सहसा भित्त्वा पातालसप्तकम् .. 183.6 ..
6.3.m:
Then the Great Lord became manifest to his sight, having assumed the form of a liṅga;
