bursting through the seven subterranean realms, he suddenly appeared.

6.3.s:
dadarśātha bhṛgurdevamautpalīṃ kelikāmiva .
stutiṃ cakre sa devāya sthāṇave tryambaketi ca .. 183.7 ..
6.3.d:
ददर्शाथ भृगुर्देवमौत्पलीं केलिकामिव .
स्तुतिं चक्रे स देवाय स्थाणवे त्र्यम्बकेति च .. 183.7 ..
6.3.m:
Then Bhṛgu saw the god, like a water-lily sprout in play.
He offered praise to the god, to Sthāṇu, calling him Tryambaka.

6.3.s:
evaṃ stutaḥ sa bhagavān provāca prahasanniva .
punaḥ punarbhṛguṃ mattaḥ kiṃtu prārthayase mune .. 183.8 ..
6.3.d:
एवं स्तुतः स भगवान् प्रोवाच प्रहसन्निव .
पुनः पुनर्भृगुं मत्तः किंतु प्रार्थयसे मुने .. 183.8 ..
6.3.m:
Praised in this manner, the Blessed Lord said, as if smiling:
'Again and again, O Bhṛgu, what indeed do you request of me, O sage?'

6.3.s:
bhṛguruvāca -
pañcakrośamidaṃ kṣetraṃ padmayā śāpitaṃ vibho .
upavitramidaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvavedavivarjitam .
bhaviṣyatīti ca procya gatā devī vidaṃ prati .. 183.9 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुरुवाच -
पञ्चक्रोशमिदं क्षेत्रं पद्मया शापितं विभो .
उपवित्रमिदं क्षेत्रं सर्ववेदविवर्जितम् .
भविष्यतीति च प्रोच्य गता देवी विदं प्रति .. 183.9 ..
6.3.m:
Bhṛgu said:
'This sacred field of five krośas was cursed by Padmā, O omnipresent one.
Having proclaimed, "This sacred field shall become impure, devoid of all the Vedas,"
the goddess departed towards [her] destination.

6.3.s:
punaḥ pavitratāṃ yāti yathedaṃ kṣetramuttamam .
tathā kuru maheśāna prasanno yadi śaṅkara .. 183.10 ..
6.3.d:
पुनः पवित्रतां याति यथेदं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .
तथा कुरु महेशान प्रसन्नो यदि शङ्कर .. 183.10 ..
6.3.m:
Act in such a way, O Great Lord, that this excellent sacred field attains purity once more,
if you are pleased, O Śaṃkara.'

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
kedārākhyamidaṃ brahmaṃlliṅgamādyaṃ bhaviṣyati .
kṛtvedamādiliṅgāni bhaviṣyanti daśaiva hi .. 183.11 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
केदाराख्यमिदं ब्रह्मंल्लिङ्गमाद्यं भविष्यति .
कृत्वेदमादिलिङ्गानि भविष्यन्ति दशैव हि .. 183.11 ..
6.3.m:
The Lord said:
'This first liṅga, named Kedāra, shall arise, O holy one.
Counting this, the primeval liṅgas shall indeed be ten.

6.3.s:
ekādaśamadṛśyaṃ hi kṣetramadhye bhaviṣyati .
pāvayiṣyati tatkṣetramekādaśaḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ .. 183.12 ..
6.3.d:
एकादशमदृश्यं हि क्षेत्रमध्ये भविष्यति .
पावयिष्यति तत्क्षेत्रमेकादशः स्वयं विभुः .. 183.12 ..
6.3.m:
The eleventh shall indeed be invisible in the midst of the sacred field.
The eleventh, the omnipresent Lord himself, shall purify that sacred field.

6.3.s:
tathā vai dvādaśādityā matprasādāttu mūrtitaḥ .
vasiṣyanti bhṛgukṣetre rogaduḥkhanibarhaṇāḥ .. 183.13 ..
6.3.d:
तथा वै द्वादशादित्या मत्प्रसादात्तु मूर्तितः .
वसिष्यन्ति भृगुक्षेत्रे रोगदुःखनिबर्हणाः .. 183.13 ..
6.3.m:
Likewise, the twelve Adityas, by my grace in visible form,
shall reside in the sacred field of Bhṛgu, destroying disease and sorrow.

6.3.s:
durgāḥ hyaṣṭādaśa tathā kṣetrapālāstu ṣoḍaśa .
bhṛgukṣetre bhaviṣyanti vīrabhadrāśca mātaraḥ .. 183.14 ..
6.3.d:
दुर्गाः ह्यष्टादश तथा क्षेत्रपालास्तु षोडश .
भृगुक्षेत्रे भविष्यन्ति वीरभद्राश्च मातरः .. 183.14 ..
6.3.m:
Likewise, eighteen Durgās, sixteen guardians of the field,
Vīrabhadras, and the Mothers shall dwell in the sacred field of Bhṛgu.

6.3.s:
pavitrīkṛtametaddhi nityaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati .
nāghamāse hyuṣaḥkāle snātvā māsaṃ jitendriyaḥ .. 183.15 ..
6.3.d:
पवित्रीकृतमेतद्धि नित्यं क्षेत्रं भविष्यति .
नाघमासे ह्युषःकाले स्नात्वा मासं जितेन्द्रियः .. 183.15 ..
6.3.m:
This sacred field shall indeed remain permanently purified.
In the month of Māgha, having bathed at dawn for a month with senses restrained,

6.3.s:
yaḥ pūjayati kedāraṃ sa gacchecchivamandiram .
tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā pitḥnuddiśya bhārata .
śrāddhaṃ dadāti vidhivattasya prītāḥ pitāmahāḥ .. 183.16 ..
6.3.d:
यः पूजयति केदारं स गच्छेच्छिवमन्दिरम् .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा पित्ःनुद्दिश्य भारत .
श्राद्धं ददाति विधिवत्तस्य प्रीताः पितामहाः .. 183.16 ..
6.3.m:
whoever worships Kedāra shall go to the abode of Śiva.
Having bathed in that sacred ford and intended [it] for the ancestors, O descendant of Bharata,
if a man offers a śrāddha according to the rules, his ancestors are pleased.'

6.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ samyakkedārākhyaṃ savistaram .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhapraṇāśanam .. 183.17 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kedāreśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
इति ते कथितं सम्यक्केदाराख्यं सविस्तरम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखप्रणाशनम् .. 183.17 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे केदारेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्र्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Thus has the [shrine] named Kedāra been fully described to you in detail,
holy, sin-destroying, and removing all sorrow.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-third chapter, titled 'Description of the māhātmya of the Kedāreśvara sacred ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 184
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
dhautapāpaṃ tato gacchedbhṛgutīrthasamīpataḥ .
vṛṣeṇa tu bhṛgustatra bhūyobhūyo dhutastataḥ .. 184.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 184
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
धौतपापं ततो गच्छेद्भृगुतीर्थसमीपतः .
वृषेण तु भृगुस्तत्र भूयोभूयो धुतस्ततः .. 184.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 184
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go to Dhautapāpa, near the Bhṛgu sacred ford.
There Bhṛgu was shaken again and again by the bull.

6.3.s:
dhautapāpaṃ tu tattena nāmnā lokeṣu viśrutam .
tatra sthito mahādevastuṣṭyarthaṃ bhṛgusattame .. 184.2 ..
6.3.d:
धौतपापं तु तत्तेन नाम्ना लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .
तत्र स्थितो महादेवस्तुष्ट्यर्थं भृगुसत्तमे .. 184.2 ..
6.3.m:
Therefore, it is renowned in the worlds by the name Dhautapāpa.
The Great God remained there, O best of the Bhṛgus, to bestow satisfaction.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā śāṭhyenāpi nareśvara .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 184.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा शाठ्येनापि नरेश्वर .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 184.3 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes in that sacred ford, O lord of men, even deceitfully,
is freed from all sins; there should be no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
yastu samyagvidhānena tatra snātvārcayecchivam .
devānpitṝnsamabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 184.4 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तु सम्यग्विधानेन तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेच्छिवम् .
देवान्पितॄन्समभ्यर्च्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 184.4 ..
6.3.m:
Moreover, whoever bathes there according to proper rite and worships Śiva,
and honours the gods and the ancestors, is freed from all mortal sins.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyā gavāṃ vadhyā tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
praviśenna sadā bhītā praviṣṭāpi kṣayaṃ vrajet .. 184.5 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्या गवां वध्या तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
प्रविशेन्न सदा भीता प्रविष्टापि क्षयं व्रजेत् .. 184.5 ..
6.3.m:
The murder of a brahmin and the slaughter of cows, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
terrified, would never enter that sacred ford; and even if entered, they would perish.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
āścaryabhūtaṃ loke'sminkathayasva dvijottama .
praviśenna brahmahatyā yathā vai dhautapāpmani .. 184.6 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेऽस्मिन्कथयस्व द्विजोत्तम .
प्रविशेन्न ब्रह्महत्या यथा वै धौतपाप्मनि .. 184.6 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell of this wondrous thing in this world, O best of brahmins,
how the murder of a brahmin indeed does not enter Dhautapāpa.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā neha kiṃcana .
kathaṃ vā dhautapāpe tu praviṣṭaṃ naśyate dvija .
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ pṛcchāmi vada kautukāt .. 184.7 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं भविता नेह किंचन .
कथं वा धौतपापे तु प्रविष्टं नश्यते द्विज .
एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं पृच्छामि वद कौतुकात् .. 184.7 ..
6.3.m:
There will be no sin equal to the murder of a brahmin here [in this world].
How, then, having entered Dhautapāpa, is it destroyed, O brahmin?
I ask all this in detail out of curiosity; please tell it.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
ādisarge purā śambhurbrahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .
vikāraṃ pañcamaṃ dṛṣṭvā śiro'śvamukhasannibham .. 184.8 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
आदिसर्गे पुरा शम्भुर्ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः .
विकारं पञ्चमं दृष्ट्वा शिरोऽश्वमुखसन्निभम् .. 184.8 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Formerly, at the primordial creation, Śambhu, seeing the unnatural fifth head
of Brahmā Parameṣṭhin, which resembled a horse's face,

6.3.s:
aṅguṣṭhāṅguliyogena tacchirastena kṛntitam .
kṛttamātre tu śirasi brahmahatyā'bhavattadā .. 184.9 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गुष्ठाङ्गुलियोगेन तच्छिरस्तेन कृन्तितम् .
कृत्तमात्रे तु शिरसि ब्रह्महत्याऽभवत्तदा .. 184.9 ..
6.3.m:
severed that head with the join of his thumb and finger.
As soon as the head was severed, the murder of a brahmin arose then.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyāyutaścāsīduttare narmadātaṭe .
dhunitaṃ tu yato rājanvṛṣeṇa dharmamūrtinā .. 184.10 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्यायुतश्चासीदुत्तरे नर्मदातटे .
धुनितं तु यतो राजन्वृषेण धर्ममूर्तिना .. 184.10 ..
6.3.m:
And he was joined with the murder of a brahmin on the northern bank of the Narmadā.
Because he was shaken off by the bull who is the embodiment of dharma, O king,

6.3.s:
tatra dhauteśvarīṃ devīṃ sthāpitāṃ vṛṣabheṇa tu .
dadarśa bhagavāñchambhuḥ sarvadaivatapūjitām .. 184.11 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र धौतेश्वरीं देवीं स्थापितां वृषभेण तु .
ददर्श भगवाञ्छम्भुः सर्वदैवतपूजिताम् .. 184.11 ..
6.3.m:
the Blessed Lord Śambhu saw the goddess Dhauteśvarī installed there
by the bull, worshipped by all the deities.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā dhauteśvarīṃ durgāṃ brahmahatyāvināśinīm .
tatra viśramamāṇaśca śaṅkarastripurāntakaḥ .. 184.12 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा धौतेश्वरीं दुर्गां ब्रह्महत्याविनाशिनीम् .
तत्र विश्रममाणश्च शङ्करस्त्रिपुरान्तकः .. 184.12 ..
6.3.m:
Having seen Durgā Dhauteśvarī, the destroyer of the murder of a brahmin,
Śaṃkara, the destroyer of Tripura, rested there.

6.3.s:
sa śaṅkaro brahmahatyāvihīnaṃ mene tmānaṃ tasya tīrthasya bhāvāt .
suvismito devadevo vareṇyo dṛṣṭvā dūre brahmahatyāṃ ca tīrthāt .. 184.13 ..
6.3.d:
स शङ्करो ब्रह्महत्याविहीनं मेने त्मानं तस्य तीर्थस्य भावात् .
सुविस्मितो देवदेवो वरेण्यो दृष्ट्वा दूरे ब्रह्महत्यां च तीर्थात् .. 184.13 ..
6.3.m:
That Śaṃkara, the god of gods, the choice one, considered himself free from the murder of a brahmin
due to the power of that sacred ford, deeply amazed upon seeing the murder of a brahmin far from the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
vidhautapāpaṃ mahitaṃ dharmaśaktyā viśenna hatyā devībhayātprabhītā .
raktāmbarā raktamālyopayuktā kṛṣṇā nārī raktadāmaprasaktā .. 184.14 ..
6.3.d:
विधौतपापं महितं धर्मशक्त्या विशेन्न हत्या देवीभयात्प्रभीता .
रक्ताम्बरा रक्तमाल्योपयुक्ता कृष्णा नारी रक्तदामप्रसक्ता .. 184.14 ..
6.3.m:
Magnified by the power of dharma, the murder, frightened through fear of the goddess,
would not enter the cleansed-sin [ford]—a dark woman clad in red garments, wearing red garlands, attached to a red cord.

6.3.s:
māṃ vāñchantī skandhadeśaṃ rahasye dūre sthitā tīrthavaryaprabhāvāt .
saṃcintya devo manasā smarārirvāsāya buddhiṃ tatra tīrthe cakāra .. 184.15 ..
6.3.d:
मां वाञ्छन्ती स्कन्धदेशं रहस्ये दूरे स्थिता तीर्थवर्यप्रभावात् .
संचिन्त्य देवो मनसा स्मरारिर्वासाय बुद्धिं तत्र तीर्थे चकार .. 184.15 ..
6.3.m: "Desiring me, [yet] standing in secret afar from the region of my shoulder by the power of the foremost sacred ford—" / reflecting [thus] in his mind, the god, the enemy of Smara, resolved to dwell at that sacred ford.

6.3.s:
vimṛśya devo bahuśaḥ sthitaḥ svayaṃ vidhautapāpaḥ prathitaḥ pṛthivyām .
babhūva tatraiva nivāsakārī vidhūtapāpanikaṭapradeśe .. 184.16 ..
6.3.d:
विमृश्य देवो बहुशः स्थितः स्वयं विधौतपापः प्रथितः पृथिव्याम् .
बभूव तत्रैव निवासकारी विधूतपापनिकटप्रदेशे .. 184.16 ..
6.3.m: Having reflected repeatedly, the god himself remained, renowned on earth as [the cleanser of] washed-away sin; / he made his abode right there, in the region adjacent to [where sins are] washed away.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti rājendra brahmahatyāvināśanam .
vidhautapāpaṃ tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam .. 184.17 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् .
विधौतपापं तत्तीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् .. 184.17 ..
6.3.m: From that time forth, O king of kings, that sacred ford, which destroys the murder of a brahmin, / has been established on the Narmadā, known as Vidhautapāpa.

6.3.s:
āśvayukśuklanavamī tatra tīrthe viśiṣyate .
dinatrayaṃ tu rājendra saptamyādiviśeṣataḥ .. 184.18 ..
6.3.d:
आश्वयुक्शुक्लनवमी तत्र तीर्थे विशिष्यते .
दिनत्रयं तु राजेन्द्र सप्तम्यादिविशेषतः .. 184.18 ..
6.3.m: The ninth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina is especially distinguished at that sacred ford, / and indeed a period of three days, O king of kings, beginning with the seventh.

6.3.s:
samupoṣyāṣṭamīṃ bhaktyā sāṅgaṃ vedaṃ paṭhettu yaḥ .
ahorātreṇa caikena ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñakam .. 184.19 ..
6.3.d:
समुपोष्याष्टमीं भक्त्या साङ्गं वेदं पठेत्तु यः .
अहोरात्रेण चैकेन ऋग्यजुःसामसंज्ञकम् .. 184.19 ..
6.3.m: Having fasted with devotion on the eighth day, whoever reads the Veda together with its auxiliary limbs /—comprising the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma—in a single day and night,

6.3.s:
abhyasanbrahmahatyāyā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva yaśca gurvaṅganāgamaḥ .. 184.20 ..
6.3.d:
अभ्यसन्ब्रह्महत्याया मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .
वृषलीगमनं चैव यश्च गुर्वङ्गनागमः .. 184.20 ..
6.3.m: reciting it, is freed from the murder of a brahmin—of this there is no doubt— / and also from intercourse with an outcaste woman, and approaching the wife of an elder.

6.3.s:
snātvā brahmarasotkṛṣṭe kumbhenaiva pramucyate .
vandhyā strījananī yā tu kākavandhyā mṛtaprajā .. 184.21 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा ब्रह्मरसोत्कृष्टे कुम्भेनैव प्रमुच्यते .
वन्ध्या स्त्रीजननी या तु काकवन्ध्या मृतप्रजा .. 184.21 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed with a single pot [of water] superior with the water of Brahmā, one is completely freed. / A woman who is barren, one who gives birth only to daughters, one who bears a single child, or one whose offspring die—

6.3.s:
sāpi kumbhodakaiḥ snātā jīvatputrā prajāvatī .
apaṭhastu naropoṣya ṛgyajuḥsāmasambhavām .. 184.22 ..
6.3.d:
सापि कुम्भोदकैः स्नाता जीवत्पुत्रा प्रजावती .
अपठस्तु नरोपोष्य ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भवाम् .. 184.22 ..
6.3.m: she too, having bathed with the water from jars, becomes the mother of living sons, blessed with children. / Even a man who cannot recite, having fasted, [if] born of the Ṛg, Yajus, or Sāma,

6.3.s:
ṛcamekāṃ japanviprastathā parvaṇi yo nṛpa .
anṛcopoṣya gāyatrīṃ japedvai vedamātaram .. 184.23 ..
6.3.d:
ऋचमेकां जपन्विप्रस्तथा पर्वणि यो नृप .
अनृचोपोष्य गायत्रीं जपेद्वै वेदमातरम् .. 184.23 ..
6.3.m: a brahmin reciting a single verse of the Ṛg on the new/full moon day, O king; / or, fasting without the Ṛg verses, one should chant the Gāyatrī, the mother of the Vedas.

6.3.s:
japannavamyāṃ viprendro mucyate pāpasañcayāt .
evaṃ tu kathitaṃ tāta purāṇoktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ .. 184.24 ..
6.3.d:
जपन्नवम्यां विप्रेन्द्रो मुच्यते पापसञ्चयात् .
एवं तु कथितं तात पुराणोक्तं महर्षिभिः .. 184.24 ..
6.3.m: Chanting on the ninth day, the foremost of brahmins is freed from an accumulation of sins. / Thus has been related, dear one, what was spoken by the great seers in the Purāṇas.

6.3.s:
dhautapāpaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ mama .
prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryājjale vāgnau sthale'pi vā .. 184.25 ..
6.3.d:
धौतपापं महापुण्यं शिवेन कथितं मम .
प्राणत्यागं तु यः कुर्याज्जले वाग्नौ स्थलेऽपि वा .. 184.25 ..
6.3.m: Dhautapāpa, of great religious merit, was declared to me by Śiva. / But whoever gives up life in water, in fire, or on land,

6.3.s:
sa gacchati vimānena jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ .
haṃsabarhiprayuktena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 184.26 ..
6.3.d:
स गच्छति विमानेन ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभः .
हंसबर्हिप्रयुक्तेन सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः .. 184.26 ..
6.3.m: he goes in an aerial chariot shining like the blazing sun, / drawn by swans and peacocks, attended by hosts of apsarases,

6.3.s:
śivasya paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham .
krīḍate svecchayā tatra yāvaccandrārkatārakam .. 184.27 ..
6.3.d:
शिवस्य परमं स्थानं यत्सुरैरपि दुर्लभम् .
क्रीडते स्वेच्छया तत्र यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् .. 184.27 ..
6.3.m: to the supreme abode of Śiva, which is difficult to attain even by the gods. / There he sports at his own will as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure.

6.3.s:
dhautapāpe tu yā nārī kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam .
tatkṣaṇādeva sā pārtha puruṣatvamavāpnuyāt .. 184.28 ..
6.3.d:
धौतपापे तु या नारी कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् .
तत्क्षणादेव सा पार्थ पुरुषत्वमवाप्नुयात् .. 184.28 ..
6.3.m: Moreover, whatever woman brings about the end of her life at Dhautapāpa, / at that very moment, O Pārtha, she attains the state of being male.

6.3.s:
atha kiṃ bahunoktena śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham .
tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ dhautapāpe kṛtaṃ nṛpa .. 184.29 ..
6.3.d:
अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् .
तदक्षयफलं सर्वं धौतपापे कृतं नृप .. 184.29 ..
6.3.m: Now, what is the use of speaking much? Whether auspicious or inauspicious, / whatever is done at Dhautapāpa bears imperishable fruit, O king.

6.3.s:
saṃnyasenniyamenānnaṃ saṃnyasedviṣayādikam .
phalamūlādikaṃ caiva jalamekaṃ na saṃtyajet .. 184.30 ..
6.3.d:
संन्यसेन्नियमेनान्नं संन्यसेद्विषयादिकम् .
फलमूलादिकं चैव जलमेकं न संत्यजेत् .. 184.30 ..
6.3.m: One should regularly renounce grain, and renounce the objects of the senses and the like; / [eating] roots, fruits, and so forth, one must not abandon water alone.

6.3.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .
tatra bhuktvākhilānbhogāñjāyate bhuvi bhūpatiḥ .. 184.31 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .
तत्र भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगाञ्जायते भुवि भूपतिः .. 184.31 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे धौतपापतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whoever acts thus, O Pārtha, goes to the world of Rudra. / Having enjoyed all pleasures there, he is born as a king on earth.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford of Dhautapāpa', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 185
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla eraṇḍītīrthamuttamam .
snānamātreṇa tatraiva brahmahatyā praṇaśyati .. 185.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 185
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल एरण्डीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
स्नानमात्रेण तत्रैव ब्रह्महत्या प्रणश्यति .. 185.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 185
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to the supreme sacred ford of Eraṇḍī. / By merely bathing right there, the murder of a brahmin is destroyed.

6.3.s:
māsi cāśvayuje tatra śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm .
upoṣya prayataḥ snātastarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 185.2 ..
6.3.d:
मासि चाश्वयुजे तत्र शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दशीम् .
उपोष्य प्रयतः स्नातस्तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 185.2 ..
6.3.m: In the month of Āśvina, during the bright fortnight, having fasted on the fourteenth day, / restrained and purified by bathing, one should make water offerings to the ancestors and the deities.

6.3.s:
putrarddhirūpasampanno jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .
śivalokaṃ mṛto yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 185.3 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe eraṇḍītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रर्द्धिरूपसम्पन्नो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .
शिवलोकं मृतो याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 185.3 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे एरण्डीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Endowed with sons, prosperity, and beauty, he shall live for a hundred autumns; / when dead, he goes to the world of Śiva—there is no doubt to be entertained in this matter.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford of Eraṇḍī', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 186
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla tīrthaṃ kanakhalottamam .
garuḍena tapastaptaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram .. 186.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 186
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल तीर्थं कनखलोत्तमम् .
गरुडेन तपस्तप्तं पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .. 186.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 186
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, O protector of the earth, one should go to the excellent sacred ford of Kanakhala, / where Garuḍa performed austerity after worshiping Maheśvara.

6.3.s:
divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvajjātamātreṇa bhārata .
tapojapaiḥ kṛśībhūto dṛṣṭo devena śambhunā .. 186.2 ..
6.3.d:
दिव्यं वर्षशतं यावज्जातमात्रेण भारत .
तपोजपैः कृशीभूतो दृष्टो देवेन शम्भुना .. 186.2 ..
6.3.m: For a hundred divine years, as soon as he was born, O descendant of Bharata, / he grew emaciated through austerities and prayers, and was seen by the god Śambhu.

6.3.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo vainateyaṃ manojavam .
uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ vinatānandavardhanam .. 186.3 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो वैनतेयं मनोजवम् .
उवाच परमं वाक्यं विनतानन्दवर्धनम् .. 186.3 ..
6.3.m: Then Mahādeva, pleased, spoke supreme words to the son of Vinatā, / swift as thought, increasing the joy of Vinatā:

6.3.s:
prasannaste mahābhāga varaṃ varaya suvrata .
durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu dadāmi tava khecara .. 186.4 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसन्नस्ते महाभाग वरं वरय सुव्रत .
दुर्लभं त्रिषु लोकेषु ददामि तव खेचर .. 186.4 ..
6.3.m: "I am pleased with you, O fortunate one of good vows; choose a boon. / I grant you, O sky-wanderer, what is difficult to attain in the three worlds."

6.3.s:
garuḍa uvāca -
icchāmi vāhanaṃ viṣṇordvijendratvaṃ sureśvara .
prasanne tvayi me sarvaṃ bhavatviti matirmama .. 186.5 ..
6.3.d:
गरुड उवाच -
इच्छामि वाहनं विष्णोर्द्विजेन्द्रत्वं सुरेश्वर .
प्रसन्ने त्वयि मे सर्वं भवत्विति मतिर्मम .. 186.5 ..
6.3.m:
Garuḍa said:
"I desire to become the mount of Viṣṇu and king of the birds, O Lord of the gods! / If you are pleased with me, my wish is that all this should be mine."

6.3.s:
śrīmaheśa uvāca -
durlabhaḥ prāṇināṃ tāta yo varaḥ prārthito'nagha .
devadevasya vāhanaṃ dvijendratvaṃ sudurlabham .. 186.6 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमहेश उवाच -
दुर्लभः प्राणिनां तात यो वरः प्रार्थितोऽनघ .
देवदेवस्य वाहनं द्विजेन्द्रत्वं सुदुर्लभम् .. 186.6 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Maheśa said:
"Difficult for living beings to attain, dear child, is the boon you have requested, O sinless one: / to be the mount of the God of gods, and kingship over birds, is exceedingly hard to attain.

6.3.s:
nārāyaṇodare sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .
tvayā sa kathamūhyeta devadevo jagadguruḥ .. 186.7 ..
6.3.d:
नारायणोदरे सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .
त्वया स कथमूह्येत देवदेवो जगद्गुरुः .. 186.7 ..
6.3.m: The entire three worlds, moving and unmoving, are within the belly of Nārāyaṇa. / How could he, the God of gods and teacher of the universe, be borne by you?

6.3.s:
tenaiva sthāpitaścendrastrailokye sacarācare .
kathamanyasya cendratvaṃ bhavatīti sudurlabham .. 186.8 ..
6.3.d:
तेनैव स्थापितश्चेन्द्रस्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे .
कथमन्यस्य चेन्द्रत्वं भवतीति सुदुर्लभम् .. 186.8 ..
6.3.m: And Indra was established by him alone over the three worlds, moving and unmoving; / how then can kingship belong to another? It is exceedingly difficult to obtain.

6.3.s:
tathāpi mama vākyena vāhanaṃ tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇervahato'pi jagattrayam .. 186.9 ..
6.3.d:
तथापि मम वाक्येन वाहनं त्वं भविष्यसि .
शङ्खचक्रगदापाणेर्वहतोऽपि जगत्त्रयम् .. 186.9 ..
6.3.m: Nevertheless, by my word, you shall become the mount / of him who bears the conch, discus, and mace, even though he bears the three worlds.

6.3.s:
indrastvaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ madhye bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ .
iti dattvā varaṃ tasmā antardhānaṃ gato haraḥ .. 186.10 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रस्त्वं पक्षिणां मध्ये भविष्यसि न संशयः .
इति दत्त्वा वरं तस्मा अन्तर्धानं गतो हरः .. 186.10 ..
6.3.m: You shall become the sovereign among the birds; of this there is no doubt." / Having granted this boon to him, Hara vanished.

6.3.s:
tato gate mahādeve hyuruṇasyānujo nṛpa .
ārādhayāmāsa tadā cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamaṇḍitām .. 186.11 ..
6.3.d:
ततो गते महादेवे ह्युरुणस्यानुजो नृप .
आराधयामास तदा चामुण्डां मुण्डमण्डिताम् .. 186.11 ..
6.3.m: Then, after Mahādeva had departed, the younger brother of Aruṇa, O king, / propitiated Cāmuṇḍā, adorned with severed heads,

6.3.s:
śmaśānavāsinīṃ devīṃ bahubhūtasamanvitām .
yoginīṃ yogasaṃsiddhāṃ vasāmāṃsāsavapriyām .. 186.12 ..
6.3.d:
श्मशानवासिनीं देवीं बहुभूतसमन्विताम् .
योगिनीं योगसंसिद्धां वसामांसासवप्रियाम् .. 186.12 ..
6.3.m: the goddess dwelling in the cremation ground, accompanied by numerous spirits, / a yoginī accomplished in yoga, fond of fat, flesh, and liquor.

6.3.s:
dhyātamātrā tu tenaiva pratyakṣā hyabhavattadā .
jālaṃdhare ca yā siddhiḥ kaulīne uḍḍiśe pare .. 186.13 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यातमात्रा तु तेनैव प्रत्यक्षा ह्यभवत्तदा .
जालंधरे च या सिद्धिः कौलीने उड्डिशे परे .. 186.13 ..
6.3.m: Merely upon being meditated upon by him, she became visible right then. / Whatever spiritual perfection is found in Jālandhara, in the Kaulīna, and in the supreme Uḍḍiśa,

6.3.s:
samagrā sā bhṛgukṣetre siddhakṣetre tu saṃsthitā .
cāmuṇḍā tatra sā devī siddhakṣetre vyavasthitā .. 186.14 ..
6.3.d:
समग्रा सा भृगुक्षेत्रे सिद्धक्षेत्रे तु संस्थिता .
चामुण्डा तत्र सा देवी सिद्धक्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिता .. 186.14 ..
6.3.m: all of that resides in the sacred field of Bhṛgu, in the field of the accomplished; / Cāmuṇḍā, that goddess, resides there in the field of the accomplished,

6.3.s:
saṃstutā ṛṣibhirdevairyogakṣemārthasiddhaye .
vinatānandajananastatra tāṃ yoginīṃ nṛpa .
bhaktyā prasādayāmāsa stotrairvaidikalaukikaiḥ .. 186.15 ..
6.3.d:
संस्तुता ऋषिभिर्देवैर्योगक्षेमार्थसिद्धये .
विनतानन्दजननस्तत्र तां योगिनीं नृप .
भक्त्या प्रसादयामास स्तोत्रैर्वैदिकलौकिकैः .. 186.15 ..
6.3.m: praised by seers and gods for the accomplishment of security and prosperity. / There, O king, the son who gladdens Vinatā pleased that yoginī with devotion / through Vedic and worldly hymns.

6.3.s:
garuḍa uvāca -
oṃ yā sā kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhā navarudhiramukhā pretapadmāsanasthā bhūtānāṃ vṛndavṛndaiḥ pitṛvananilayā krīḍate śūlahastā .
śastradhvastapravīravrajarudhiragalanmuṇḍamālottarīyā devī śrīvīramātā vimalaśaśinibhā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā .. 186.16 ..
6.3.d:
गरुड उवाच -
ओं या सा क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठा नवरुधिरमुखा प्रेतपद्मासनस्था भूतानां वृन्दवृन्दैः पितृवननिलया क्रीडते शूलहस्ता .
शस्त्रध्वस्तप्रवीरव्रजरुधिरगलन्मुण्डमालोत्तरीया देवी श्रीवीरमाता विमलशशिनिभा पातु वश्चर्ममुण्डा .. 186.16 ..
6.3.m:
Garuḍa said:
"Om. May she whose throat is emaciated with hunger, whose mouth drips fresh blood, who sits upon a lotus seat of corpses, / who sports in her cremation-ground abode surrounded by hosts of spirits, holding a trident in her hand; / whose upper garment is a garland of heads dripping blood from hosts of mighty heroes struck down by weapons—the goddess Śrīvīramātā, resembling the spotless moon, Carmamuṇḍā—protect you all!"

6.3.s:
yā sā kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhā vikṛtabhayakarī trāsinī duṣkṛtānāṃ muñcajjvālākalāpairdaśanakasamasaiḥ khādati pretamāṃsam .
yā sā dordaṇḍacaṇḍairḍamaruraṇaraṇāṭopaṭaṃkāraghaṇṭaiḥ kalpāntotpātavātāhatapaṭupaṭahairvalgate bhūtamātā .
kṣutkṣāmā śuṣkakukṣiḥ khavarataranaravaraiḥ kṣodati pretamāṃsaṃ muñcantī cāṭṭahāsaṃ ghuraghuritaravā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā .. 186.17 ..
6.3.d:
या सा क्षुत्क्षामकण्ठा विकृतभयकरी त्रासिनी दुष्कृतानां मुञ्चज्ज्वालाकलापैर्दशनकसमसैः खादति प्रेतमांसम् .
या सा दोर्दण्डचण्डैर्डमरुरणरणाटोपटंकारघण्टैः कल्पान्तोत्पातवाताहतपटुपटहैर्वल्गते भूतमाता .
क्षुत्क्षामा शुष्ककुक्षिः खवरतरनरवरैः क्षोदति प्रेतमांसं मुञ्चन्ती चाट्टहासं घुरघुरितरवा पातु वश्चर्ममुण्डा .. 186.17 ..
6.3.m: May she whose throat is emaciated with hunger, who creates terrible dread, who terrifies the doers of evil, who eats corpse-flesh with ladle-like teeth amidst clusters of shooting flames; / she who, Mother of Spirits, leaps violently with arm-staffs terrifying with ḍamaru drums ringing loudly and resonant bells, and with sharp kettledrums beaten by the calamitous winds of the cosmic dissolution; / she whose throat is emaciated with hunger, whose belly is withered, who crushes corpse-flesh along with foremost men possessing exceptional weapons, uttering a loud horse-laugh with a roaring sound—may Carmamuṇḍā protect you! 186.17

6.3.s:
yā sā nimnodarābhā vikṛtabhavabhayatrāsinī śūlahastā cāmuṇḍā muṇḍaghātā raṇaraṇitaraṇajhallarīnādaramyā .
trailokyaṃ trāsayanti kakahakahakahairghorarāvairanekairnṛtyantī mātṛmadhye pitṛvananilayā pātu vaścarmamuṇḍā .. 186.18 ..
6.3.d:
या सा निम्नोदराभा विकृतभवभयत्रासिनी शूलहस्ता चामुण्डा मुण्डघाता रणरणितरणझल्लरीनादरम्या .
त्रैलोक्यं त्रासयन्ति ककहकहकहैर्घोररावैरनेकैर्नृत्यन्ती मातृमध्ये पितृवननिलया पातु वश्चर्ममुण्डा .. 186.18 ..
6.3.m: May she whose belly appears sunken, who terrifies with dread of deformed existence, spear in hand, Cāmuṇḍā, striking with skulls, delightful with the ringing sound of clashing cymbals in battle; / who terrifies the three worlds with multiple terrible cries of ‘kakahakahaka’, dancing among the Mothers, dwelling in the cremation ground—may Carmamuṇḍā protect you! 186.18

6.3.s:
yā dhatte viśvamakhilaṃ nijāṃśena mahojjvalā .
kanakaprasave līnā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.19 ..
6.3.d:
या धत्ते विश्वमखिलं निजांशेन महोज्ज्वला .
कनकप्रसवे लीना पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.19 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who sustains this entire universe by a portion of herself, immensely radiant, / resting upon a golden blossom, protect me! 186.19

6.3.s:
himādrisambhavā devī dayādarśitavigrahā .
śivapriyā śive saktā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.20 ..
6.3.d:
हिमाद्रिसम्भवा देवी दयादर्शितविग्रहा .
शिवप्रिया शिवे सक्ता पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.20 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, the goddess born of the Snow Mountain, whose bodily form was manifested out of compassion, / beloved of Śiva, attached to Śiva, protect me! 186.20

6.3.s:
anādijagadādiryā ratnagarbhā vasupriyā .
rathāṅgapāṇinā padmā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.21 ..
6.3.d:
अनादिजगदादिर्या रत्नगर्भा वसुप्रिया .
रथाङ्गपाणिना पद्मा पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.21 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who is the beginning of the beginningless universe, who holds gems within her womb, dear to the Vasus, / Padmā along with the wielder of the discus, protect me! 186.21

6.3.s:
sāvitrī yā ca gāyatrī mṛḍānī vāgathendirā .
smartḥṇāṃ yā sukhaṃ datte pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.22 ..
6.3.d:
सावित्री या च गायत्री मृडानी वागथेन्दिरा .
स्मर्त्ःणां या सुखं दत्ते पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.22 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who is Sāvitrī, Gāyatrī, Mṛḍānī, speech, and Indira, / who grants happiness to those who remember her, protect me! 186.22

6.3.s:
saumyāsaumyaiḥ sadā rūpaiḥ sṛjatyavati yā jagat .
parā śaktiḥ parā buddhiḥ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.23 ..
6.3.d:
सौम्यासौम्यैः सदा रूपैः सृजत्यवति या जगत् .
परा शक्तिः परा बुद्धिः पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.23 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who constantly creates and protects the world through gentle and ungentle forms, / the supreme energy, the supreme intellect, protect me! 186.23

6.3.s:
brahmaṇaḥ sargasamaye sṛjyaśaktiḥ parā tu yā .
jaganmāyā jagaddhātrī pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.24 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मणः सर्गसमये सृज्यशक्तिः परा तु या .
जगन्माया जगद्धात्री पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.24 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who is the supreme creative energy of Brahmā at the time of creation, / the cosmic illusion, the supporter of the world, protect me! 186.24

6.3.s:
viśvasya pālane viṣṇoryā śaktiḥ paripālikā .
madanonmādinī mukhyā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.25 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वस्य पालने विष्णोर्या शक्तिः परिपालिका .
मदनोन्मादिनी मुख्या पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.25 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who is the protective energy of Viṣṇu in the preservation of the universe, / the foremost intoxicator through passion, protect me! 186.25

6.3.s:
viśvasaṃlayane mukhyā yā rudreṇa samāśritā .
raudrī śaktiḥ śivānantā pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.26 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वसंलयने मुख्या या रुद्रेण समाश्रिता .
रौद्री शक्तिः शिवानन्ता पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.26 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, the foremost energy relied upon by Rudra in the dissolution of the universe, / the fierce power, Śivā, infinite, protect me! 186.26

6.3.s:
kailāsasānusaṃrūḍha kanakaprasaveśayā .
bhasmakābhihṛtā pūrvaṃ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.27 ..
6.3.d:
कैलाससानुसंरूढ कनकप्रसवेशया .
भस्मकाभिहृता पूर्वं पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.27 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who reposes on the golden blossom grown on the ridge of Kailāsa, / who was carried away formerly by Bhasmaka, protect me! 186.27

6.3.s:
patiprabhāvamicchantī trasyantī yā vinā patim .
abalā tvekabhāvā ca pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.28 ..
6.3.d:
पतिप्रभावमिच्छन्ती त्रस्यन्ती या विना पतिम् .
अबला त्वेकभावा च पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.28 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who desires the glory of her husband, who trembles without her husband, / being a delicate woman of one-pointed devotion, protect me! 186.28

6.3.s:
viśvasaṃrakṣaṇe saktā rakṣitā kanakena yā .
ā brahmastambajananī pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.29 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वसंरक्षणे सक्ता रक्षिता कनकेन या .
आ ब्रह्मस्तम्बजननी पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.29 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, who is devoted to the protection of the universe, who is protected by the golden one, / the mother of all from Brahmā down to a clump of grass, protect me! 186.29

6.3.s:
brahmaviṣṇvīśvarāḥ śaktyā śarīragrahaṇaṃ yayā .
prāpitāḥ prathamā śaktiḥ pātu māṃ kanakeśvarī .. 186.30 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीश्वराः शक्त्या शरीरग्रहणं यया .
प्रापिताः प्रथमा शक्तिः पातु मां कनकेश्वरी .. 186.30 ..
6.3.m: May Kanakeśvarī, the primal energy by whose power Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Īśvara / were brought to assume bodily form, protect me! 186.30

6.3.s:
śrutvā tu garuḍenoktaṃ devīvṛttacatuṣṭayam .
prasannā saṃmukhī bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 186.31 ..
6.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तु गरुडेनोक्तं देवीवृत्तचतुष्टयम् .
प्रसन्ना संमुखी भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 186.31 ..
6.3.m: Having heard the four verses of the goddess spoken by Garuḍa, / she became pleased, turned towards him, and spoke this speech: 186.31

6.3.s:
śrīcāmuṇḍovāca -
prasannā te mahāsattva varaṃ varaya vāñchitam .
dadāmi te dvijaśreṣṭha yatte manasi rocate .. 186.32 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीचामुण्डोवाच -
प्रसन्ना ते महासत्त्व वरं वरय वाञ्छितम् .
ददामि ते द्विजश्रेष्ठ यत्ते मनसि रोचते .. 186.32 ..
6.3.m: The glorious Cāmuṇḍā said: / ‘I am pleased with you, O great-spirited one! Choose a desired boon; / I grant to you, O best of the twice-born, whatever pleases your mind.’ 186.32

6.3.s:
garuḍa uvāca -
ajaraścāmaraścaiva adhṛṣyaśca surāsuraiḥ .
tava prasādāccaivānyairajeyaśca bhavāmyaham .. 186.33 ..
6.3.d:
गरुड उवाच -
अजरश्चामरश्चैव अधृष्यश्च सुरासुरैः .
तव प्रसादाच्चैवान्यैरजेयश्च भवाम्यहम् .. 186.33 ..
6.3.m: Garuḍa said: / ‘May I become free from old age, immortal, invincible to gods and asuras, / and unconquerable by any others, by your grace! 186.33

6.3.s:
tvayā cātra sadā devi sthātavyaṃ tīrthasannidhau .
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā devī devairabhiṣṭutā .. 186.34 ..
6.3.d:
त्वया चात्र सदा देवि स्थातव्यं तीर्थसन्निधौ .
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा देवी देवैरभिष्टुता .. 186.34 ..
6.3.m: And you must always remain here, O goddess, in the vicinity of the sacred ford. / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having said, "So it shall be," the goddess, praised by the gods,

6.3.s:
jagāmākāśamāviśya bhūtasaṅghasamanvitā .
yadā lakṣmyā nṛpaśreṣṭha sthāpitaṃ puramuttamam .. 186.35 ..
6.3.d:
जगामाकाशमाविश्य भूतसङ्घसमन्विता .
यदा लक्ष्म्या नृपश्रेष्ठ स्थापितं पुरमुत्तमम् .. 186.35 ..
6.3.m: entered the sky and departed accompanied by the host of spirits. / When, O best of kings, that excellent city had been established by Lakṣmī, 186.35

6.3.s:
anumānya tadā devīṃ kṛtaṃ tasyāṃ samarpitam .
lakṣmīruvāca -
rakṣaṇāya mayā devi yogakṣemārthasiddhaye .. 186.36 ..
6.3.d:
अनुमान्य तदा देवीं कृतं तस्यां समर्पितम् .
लक्ष्मीरुवाच -
रक्षणाय मया देवि योगक्षेमार्थसिद्धये .. 186.36 ..
6.3.m: assenting to the goddess, what was done was entrusted to her. / Lakṣmī said: / For protection by me, O goddess, and for the attainment of security and prosperity...

6.3.s:
mātṛvatpratipālyaṃ te sadā devi puraṃ mama .
garuḍo'pi tataḥ snātvā sampūjya kanakeśvarīm .. 186.37 ..
6.3.d:
मातृवत्प्रतिपाल्यं ते सदा देवि पुरं मम .
गरुडोऽपि ततः स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य कनकेश्वरीम् .. 186.37 ..
6.3.m: my city must always be looked after like a mother, O goddess!’ / Thereupon Garuḍa too bathed, worshipped Kanakeśvarī, 186.37

6.3.s:
tīrthaṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpya jagāmākāśamuttamam .
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 186.38 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थं तत्रैव संस्थाप्य जगामाकाशमुत्तमम् .
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 186.38 ..
6.3.m: established the sacred ford right there, and went to the highest heaven. / One who bathes at that sacred ford and worships the ancestors and deities 186.38

6.3.s:
sarvakāmasamṛddhasya yajñasya phalamaśnute .
gandhapuṣpādibhiryastu pūjayetkanakeśvaram .. 186.39 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वकामसमृद्धस्य यज्ञस्य फलमश्नुते .
गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्यस्तु पूजयेत्कनकेश्वरम् .. 186.39 ..
6.3.m: enjoys the fruit of a sacrifice endowed with all desired objects. / And whoever worships Kanakeśvara with fragrant pastes, flowers, and the like, 186.39

6.3.s:
tasya yogaiśvaryasiddhiryogapīṭheṣu jāyate .
mṛto yogeśvaraṃ lokaṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ .
sa gacchennātra sandeho yoginīgaṇasaṃyutaḥ .. 186.40 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kanakhaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तस्य योगैश्वर्यसिद्धिर्योगपीठेषु जायते .
मृतो योगेश्वरं लोकं जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः .
स गच्छेन्नात्र सन्देहो योगिनीगणसंयुतः .. 186.40 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कनखलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
his attainment of yogic power arises in the seats of yoga. / When dead, he goes, accompanied by the host of yoginīs, / to the realm of the Lord of Yoga with auspicious cries of ‘victory’ and so forth; there is no doubt of this. 186.40
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kanakhaleśvaratīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 187
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
jāleśvaraṃ tato gacchelliṅgamādyaṃ svayambhuvaḥ .
kālāgnirudraṃ vikhyātaṃ bhṛgukacche vyavasthitam .. 187.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 187
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
जालेश्वरं ततो गच्छेल्लिङ्गमाद्यं स्वयम्भुवः .
कालाग्निरुद्रं विख्यातं भृगुकच्छे व्यवस्थितम् .. 187.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 187. / The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to Jāleśvara, the primal self-manifest liṅga / renowned as Kālāgnirudra, situated at Bhṛgukaccha. 187.1

6.3.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam .
kṣetrapāpavināśāya kṛpayā ca samutthitam .. 187.2 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् .
क्षेत्रपापविनाशाय कृपया च समुत्थितम् .. 187.2 ..
6.3.m: It pacifies all sins, destroys all afflictions, / and arose out of compassion for the destruction of the sins of the sacred field. 187.2

6.3.s:
purā kalpe'suragaṇairākrānte bhuvanatraye .
vedoktakarmanāśe ca dharme ca vilayaṃ gate .. 187.3 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा कल्पेऽसुरगणैराक्रान्ते भुवनत्रये .
वेदोक्तकर्मनाशे च धर्मे च विलयं गते .. 187.3 ..
6.3.m: Formerly in a cosmic age, when the three worlds were overwhelmed by hosts of asuras, / when the rituals prescribed by the Vedas were destroyed, and when dharma went to ruin, 187.3

6.3.s:
devarṣimunisiddheṣu viśvāsaparameṣu ca .
kālāgnirudrādutpanno dhūmaḥ kālodbhavodbhavaḥ .. 187.4 ..
6.3.d:
देवर्षिमुनिसिद्धेषु विश्वासपरमेषु च .
कालाग्निरुद्रादुत्पन्नो धूमः कालोद्भवोद्भवः .. 187.4 ..
6.3.m: when divine seers, sages, and siddhas were filled with utmost faith, / smoke, born of the fire of cosmic time, arose from Kālāgnirudra. 187.4

6.3.s:
dhūmātsamutthitaṃ liṅgaṃ bhittvā pātālasaptakam .
avaṭaṃ dakṣiṇe kṛtvā liṅgaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhati .. 187.5 ..
6.3.d:
धूमात्समुत्थितं लिङ्गं भित्त्वा पातालसप्तकम् .
अवटं दक्षिणे कृत्वा लिङ्गं तत्रैव तिष्ठति .. 187.5 ..
6.3.m: From that smoke arose the liṅga, piercing the seven underworlds. / Having made a pit to the south, the liṅga stands right there. 187.5

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha kuṇḍaṃ jvālāsamudbhavam .
yatra sā patitā jvālā śivasya dahataḥ puram .. 187.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ कुण्डं ज्वालासमुद्भवम् .
यत्र सा पतिता ज्वाला शिवस्य दहतः पुरम् .. 187.6 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, O best of kings, is a pool originating from a flame, / where that flame of Śiva fell as he was burning the city [of Tripura]. 187.6

6.3.s:
tatrāvaṭaṃ samudbhūtaṃ dhūmāvartastato'bhavat .
tasminkuṇḍe tu yaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā vai narmadājale .. 187.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रावटं समुद्भूतं धूमावर्तस्ततोऽभवत् .
तस्मिन्कुण्डे तु यः स्नानं कृत्वा वै नर्मदाजले .. 187.7 ..
6.3.m: A cavity was formed there, and from that came the whirlpool of smoke. / Having performed a ritual ablution in that pool and in the waters of the Narmadā, 187.7

6.3.s:
kuryācchrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyo vai pūjayecca trilocanam .
kālāgnirudranāmāni sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim .. 187.8 ..
6.3.d:
कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं पितृभ्यो वै पूजयेच्च त्रिलोचनम् .
कालाग्निरुद्रनामानि स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् .. 187.8 ..
6.3.m: one who performs a śrāddha for the ancestors, worships the three-eyed god, / [and recites] the names of Kālāgnirudra, attains the supreme destination. 187.8

6.3.s:
yatkiṃcitkāmikaṃ karma hyābhicārikameva vā .
ripusaṃkṣayakṛdvāpi sāṃtānikamathāpi vā .
atra tīrthe kṛtaṃ sarvamacirātsidhyate nṛpa .. 187.9 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kālāgnirudratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
यत्किंचित्कामिकं कर्म ह्याभिचारिकमेव वा .
रिपुसंक्षयकृद्वापि सांतानिकमथापि वा .
अत्र तीर्थे कृतं सर्वमचिरात्सिध्यते नृप .. 187.9 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कालाग्निरुद्रतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्ताशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whatever rite is performed for desire, or sorcery, / or causing destruction to enemies, or for progeny— / everything performed at this sacred ford succeeds without delay, O king. 187.9
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter, named the Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford of Kālāgnirudra, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 188
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ paraṃ mahārāja catvāriṃśatkramāntare .
śālagrāmaṃ tato gacchetsarvadaivatapūjitam .. 188.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 188
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः परं महाराज चत्वारिंशत्क्रमान्तरे .
शालग्रामं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वदैवतपूजितम् .. 188.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 188. / The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Beyond that, O great king, at an interval of forty paces, / one should go to Śālagrāma, worshipped by all the gods, 188.1

6.3.s:
yatrādidevo bhagavānvāsudevastrivikramaḥ .
svayaṃ tiṣṭhati lokātmā sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 188.2 ..
6.3.d:
यत्रादिदेवो भगवान्वासुदेवस्त्रिविक्रमः .
स्वयं तिष्ठति लोकात्मा सर्वेषां हितकाम्यया .. 188.2 ..
6.3.m: where the primal god, the blessed Vāsudeva Trivikrama, / the Soul of the World, dwells in person, out of a desire for the welfare of all. 188.2

6.3.s:
nāradena tapastaptvā kṛtā śālā dvijanmanām .
siddhikṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ jñātvā revātaṭe svayam .. 188.3 ..
6.3.d:
नारदेन तपस्तप्त्वा कृता शाला द्विजन्मनाम् .
सिद्धिक्षेत्रं भृगुक्षेत्रं ज्ञात्वा रेवातटे स्वयम् .. 188.3 ..
6.3.m: Nārada, having performed austerity, himself made a dwelling for the twice-born / on the bank of the Revā, knowing it to be a field of perfections, Bhṛgukṣetra.

6.3.s:
śālagrāmābhidho devo viprāṇāṃ tvadhivāsitaḥ .
sādhūnāṃ copakārāya vāsudevaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 188.4 ..
6.3.d:
शालग्रामाभिधो देवो विप्राणां त्वधिवासितः .
साधूनां चोपकाराय वासुदेवः प्रतिष्ठितः .. 188.4 ..
6.3.m: The god named Śālagrāma was made to abide [there] for the brahmins, / and Vāsudeva was established for the welfare of the virtuous.

6.3.s:
yogināmupakārāya yogidhyeyo janārdanaḥ .
śālagrāmeti tenaiva narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ .. 188.5 ..
6.3.d:
योगिनामुपकाराय योगिध्येयो जनार्दनः .
शालग्रामेति तेनैव नर्मदातटमाश्रितः .. 188.5 ..
6.3.m: Janārdana, who is to be meditated upon by yogins, for the welfare of yogins / resorted to the bank of the Narmadā precisely under the name Śālagrāma.

6.3.s:
māsi mārgaśire śuklā bhavatyekādaśī yadā .
snātvā revājale puṇye taddinaṃ samupoṣayet .. 188.6 ..
6.3.d:
मासि मार्गशिरे शुक्ला भवत्येकादशी यदा .
स्नात्वा रेवाजले पुण्ये तद्दिनं समुपोषयेत् .. 188.6 ..
6.3.m: When the bright eleventh day occurs in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, / one should bathe in the holy waters of the Revā and observe a fast on that day.

6.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsampūjya ca janārdanam .
punaḥ prabhātasamaye dvādaśyāṃ narmadājale .. 188.7 ..
6.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्सम्पूज्य च जनार्दनम् .
पुनः प्रभातसमये द्वादश्यां नर्मदाजले .. 188.7 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped Janārdana, one should keep vigil at night. / Then, at dawn on the twelfth day, in the waters of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
snātvā saṃtarpya devāṃśca pitṝnmātṝṃstathaiva ca .
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścātpitṛbhyo vidhipūrvakam .. 188.8 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवांश्च पितॄन्मातॄंस्तथैव च .
श्राद्धं कृत्वा ततः पश्चात्पितृभ्यो विधिपूर्वकम् .. 188.8 ..
6.3.m: having bathed and offered libations to the gods, the fathers, and likewise the mothers, / and thereafter having performed a śrāddha for the ancestors according to rule,

6.3.s:
śaktito brāhmaṇānpūjya svarṇavastrānnadānataḥ .
kṣamāpayitvā tānviprāṃstathā devaṃ khagadhvajam .. 188.9 ..
6.3.d:
शक्तितो ब्राह्मणान्पूज्य स्वर्णवस्त्रान्नदानतः .
क्षमापयित्वा तान्विप्रांस्तथा देवं खगध्वजम् .. 188.9 ..
6.3.m: having honoured brahmins according to one's means with gifts of gold, garments, and food, / and having asked forgiveness of those brahmins and likewise of the god whose banner is a bird,

6.3.s:
evaṃ kṛte mahārāja yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhavennṝṇām .
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā tatpuṇyaṃ nṛpasattama .. 188.10 ..
6.3.d:
एवं कृते महाराज यत्पुण्यं च भवेन्नॄणाम् .
शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा तत्पुण्यं नृपसत्तम .. 188.10 ..
6.3.m: listen attentively, O best of kings, to that merit / which accrues to men when this is done, O great king:

6.3.s:
na śokaduḥkhe pratipatsyatīha jīvanmṛto yāti murārisāmyam .
mahānti pāpāni visṛjya dugdhaṃ punarna mātuḥ pibate stanodyat .. 188.11 ..
6.3.d:
न शोकदुःखे प्रतिपत्स्यतीह जीवन्मृतो याति मुरारिसाम्यम् .
महान्ति पापानि विसृज्य दुग्धं पुनर्न मातुः पिबते स्तनोद्यत् .. 188.11 ..
6.3.m: He will not encounter sorrow and grief in this world; liberated while living, he attains equality with Murāri. / Having discarded great sins, he never again drinks milk flowing from a mother's breast.

6.3.s:
śālagrāmaṃ paśyate yo hi nityaṃ snātvā jale nārmade'ghaughahāre .
sa mucyate brahmahatyādipāpairnārāyaṇānusmaraṇena tena .. 188.12 ..
6.3.d:
शालग्रामं पश्यते यो हि नित्यं स्नात्वा जले नार्मदेऽघौघहारे .
स मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यादिपापैर्नारायणानुस्मरणेन तेन .. 188.12 ..
6.3.m: Whoever, having bathed in the waters of the Narmadā that remove torrents of sin, regularly beholds Śālagrāma, / is freed from sins such as the killing of a brahmin through that remembrance of Nārāyaṇa.

6.3.s:
vasanti ye saṃnyasitvā ca tatra nigṛhya duḥkhāni vimuktasaṅghāḥ .
dhyāyanto vai sāṃkhyavṛttyā turīyaṃ padaṃ murāreste'pi tatraiva yānti .. 188.13 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śālagrāmatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
वसन्ति ये संन्यसित्वा च तत्र निगृह्य दुःखानि विमुक्तसङ्घाः .
ध्यायन्तो वै सांख्यवृत्त्या तुरीयं पदं मुरारेस्तेऽपि तत्रैव यान्ति .. 188.13 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शालग्रामतीर्थमहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Those who, having renounced, dwell there, having subdued sufferings and freed themselves from attachments, / meditating through the method of Sāṅkhya, they too go to that very fourth state, the abode of Murāri.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Śālagrāmatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [section], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 189
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
udīrṇo yatra vārāho hyabhavaddharaṇīdharaḥ .. 189.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 189
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
उदीर्णो यत्र वाराहो ह्यभवद्धरणीधरः .. 189.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 189. / Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the exceedingly splendid tīrtha / where the Boar, the upholder of the earth, arose.

6.3.s:
dhanvadaṃṣṭrāṃ karālāgrāṃ bibhracca pṛthivīmimām .
sa eva pañcamaḥ prokto vārāho muktidāyakaḥ .. 189.2 ..
6.3.d:
धन्वदंष्ट्रां करालाग्रां बिभ्रच्च पृथिवीमिमाम् .
स एव पञ्चमः प्रोक्तो वाराहो मुक्तिदायकः .. 189.2 ..
6.3.m: Bearing this earth on his terrifying, curved tusk-tip, / he is declared to be the fifth Boar, the bestower of liberation.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathamudīrṇarūpo'bhūdvārāho dharaṇīdharaḥ .
vārāhatvaṃ gataḥ kena pañcamaḥ kena saṃjñitaḥ .. 189.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथमुदीर्णरूपोऽभूद्वाराहो धरणीधरः .
वाराहत्वं गतः केन पञ्चमः केन संज्ञितः .. 189.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How did the Boar, the upholder of the earth, come to have an elevated form? / Why did he assume the state of a boar, and why is he called the fifth?

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
ādikalpe purā rājankṣīrode bhagavān hariḥ .
śete sa bhogiśayane yoganidrāvimohitaḥ .. 189.4 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
आदिकल्पे पुरा राजन्क्षीरोदे भगवान् हरिः .
शेते स भोगिशयने योगनिद्राविमोहितः .. 189.4 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Formerly, in the primeval kalpa, O king, the blessed Lord Hari / was sleeping in the Ocean of Milk upon the serpent-bed, captivated by yogic sleep.

6.3.s:
babhūva nṛpatiśreṣṭha gatvā vai devasaṃnidhau .
avocadbhārakhinnāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi rasātalam .. 189.5 ..
6.3.d:
बभूव नृपतिश्रेष्ठ गत्वा वै देवसंनिधौ .
अवोचद्भारखिन्नाहं गमिष्यामि रसातलम् .. 189.5 ..
6.3.m: She went into the presence of the god, O best of kings, / and said, 'Afflicted by burden, I will go down to the netherworld.'

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā devāḥ samudvignā gatā yatra janārdanaḥ .
tuṣṭuvurvāgbhiriṣṭābhiḥ keśavaṃ jagatpatim .. 189.6 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा देवाः समुद्विग्ना गता यत्र जनार्दनः .
तुष्टुवुर्वाग्भिरिष्टाभिः केशवं जगत्पतिम् .. 189.6 ..
6.3.m: Seeing [this], the agitated gods went where Janārdana was / and praised Keśava, the lord of the universe, with pleasing words.

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
namo namaste deveśa surārtihara sarvaga .
viśvamūrte namastubhyaṃ trāhi sarvānmahadbhayāt .. 189.7 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
नमो नमस्ते देवेश सुरार्तिहर सर्वग .
विश्वमूर्ते नमस्तुभ्यं त्राहि सर्वान्महद्भयात् .. 189.7 ..
6.3.m: The gods said: / 'Salutations, salutations to you, O lord of gods, O remover of the distress of the gods, O omnipresent one! / Salutations to you, whose form is the universe! Protect all from great danger!'

6.3.s:
ityukto daivatairdevo hyuvāca kimupasthitam .
kāryaṃ vadadhvaṃ me devā yatkṛtyaṃ mā ciraṃ kṛthāḥ .. 189.8 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्तो दैवतैर्देवो ह्युवाच किमुपस्थितम् .
कार्यं वदध्वं मे देवा यत्कृत्यं मा चिरं कृथाः .. 189.8 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed by the deities, the god said: 'What has occurred? / Tell me what task must be done, O gods; do not delay.'

6.3.s:
devā ūcuḥ .
dharā dharitrī bhūtānāṃ bhārodvignā nimajjati .
tāmuddhara hṛṣīkeśa lokānsaṃsthāpaya sthitau .. 189.9 ..
6.3.d:
देवा ऊचुः .
धरा धरित्री भूतानां भारोद्विग्ना निमज्जति .
तामुद्धर हृषीकेश लोकान्संस्थापय स्थितौ .. 189.9 ..
6.3.m: The gods said: / 'The earth, the supporter of beings, is sinking down, troubled by her burden. / Lift her up, O Hṛṣīkeśa! Establish the worlds in stability!'

6.3.s:
evamuktaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ keśavaḥ parameśvaraḥ .
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya sarvayajñamayaṃ vibhuḥ .. 189.10 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तः सुरैः सर्वैः केशवः परमेश्वरः .
वाराहं रूपमास्थाय सर्वयज्ञमयं विभुः .. 189.10 ..
6.3.m: Thus spoken to by all the gods, the all-pervading Keśava, the supreme lord, / assumed the form of a boar, consisting of all sacrifices,

6.3.s:
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ samākuñcitamūrdhajam .
kṛtvā'nantaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddharanbhuvam .. 189.11 ..
6.3.d:
दंष्ट्राकरालं पिङ्गाक्षं समाकुञ्चितमूर्धजम् .
कृत्वाऽनन्तं पादपीठं दंष्ट्राग्रेणोद्धरन्भुवम् .. 189.11 ..
6.3.m: with terrifying tusks, tawny eyes, and curled bristles, / making Ananta his footstool and lifting up the earth with the tip of his tusk.

6.3.s:
saparvatavanāmurvīṃ samudraparimekhalām .
uddhṛtya bhagavān viṣṇurudīrṇaḥ samajāyata .. 189.12 ..
6.3.d:
सपर्वतवनामुर्वीं समुद्रपरिमेखलाम् .
उद्धृत्य भगवान् विष्णुरुदीर्णः समजायत .. 189.12 ..
6.3.m: Having lifted up the earth with its mountains and forests, whose girdle is the ocean, / the blessed Lord Viṣṇu became elevated (Udīrṇa).

6.3.s:
darśayanpañcadhātmānamuttare narmadātaṭe .
tathādyaṃ koralāyāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ yodhanīpure .. 189.13 ..
6.3.d:
दर्शयन्पञ्चधात्मानमुत्तरे नर्मदातटे .
तथाद्यं कोरलायां तु द्वितीयं योधनीपुरे .. 189.13 ..
6.3.m: Displaying himself in five ways on the northern bank of the Narmadā: / thus, the first at Koralā, but the second at Yodhanīpura;

6.3.s:
jayakṣetrābhidhāne tu jayeti parikīrtitam .
asurānmohayalliṅgastṛtīyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 189.14 ..
6.3.d:
जयक्षेत्राभिधाने तु जयेति परिकीर्तितम् .
असुरान्मोहयल्लिङ्गस्तृतीयः परिकीर्तितः .. 189.14 ..
6.3.m: in the place called Jayakṣetra, he is proclaimed as Jaya; / the third is proclaimed as Liṅga, bewildering the asuras;

6.3.s:
pāvanāya jagaddhetoḥ sthito yasmācchaśiprabhaḥ .
atastu nṛpaśārdūla śveta ityābhidhīyate .. 189.15 ..
6.3.d:
पावनाय जगद्धेतोः स्थितो यस्माच्छशिप्रभः .
अतस्तु नृपशार्दूल श्वेत इत्याभिधीयते .. 189.15 ..
6.3.m: because he stood shining like the moon for the purification of the world, / therefore, O tiger among kings, he is called Śveta;

6.3.s:
uddhṛtya jagatāṃ devīmudīrṇo bhṛgukacchake .
tataḥ pañcama udīrṇo varāha iti saṃjñitaḥ .. 189.16 ..
6.3.d:
उद्धृत्य जगतां देवीमुदीर्णो भृगुकच्छके .
ततः पञ्चम उदीर्णो वराह इति संज्ञितः .. 189.16 ..
6.3.m: having lifted up the goddess of the worlds, he arose at Bhṛgukaccha; / therefore, the fifth is named the Varāha Udīrṇa.

6.3.s:
iti pañcavarāhāste kathitaḥ pāṇḍunandana .
yugapaddarśanaṃ caiṣāṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati .. 189.17 ..
6.3.d:
इति पञ्चवराहास्ते कथितः पाण्डुनन्दन .
युगपद्दर्शनं चैषां ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति .. 189.17 ..
6.3.m: Thus the five Boars have been told to you, O son of Pāṇḍu; / a simultaneous sight of them removes the sin of killing a brahmin.

6.3.s:
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .
gatvā hyādivarāhaṃ tu samprāpte daśamīdine .. 189.18 ..
6.3.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्ष एकादश्यां विशेषतः .
गत्वा ह्यादिवराहं तु सम्प्राप्ते दशमीदिने .. 189.18 ..
6.3.m: Especially on the eleventh day in the bright half of the month of Jyeṣṭha, / having gone to the First Boar when the tenth day has arrived,

6.3.s:
haviṣyamannaṃ bhuñjīyāllaghusāyaṃ gate ravau .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādvārāhe hyādisaṃjñake .. 189.19 ..
6.3.d:
हविष्यमन्नं भुञ्जीयाल्लघुसायं गते रवौ .
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्वाराहे ह्यादिसंज्ञके .. 189.19 ..
6.3.m: one should eat sacrificial food lightly at evening when the sun has set; / one should keep vigil at night at [the shrine of] the one named the First Boar.

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhāte hyuṣasi saṃsnātvā narmadājale .
saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca tilairyavavimiśritaiḥ .. 189.20 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभाते ह्युषसि संस्नात्वा नर्मदाजले .
संतर्प्य पितृदेवांश्च तिलैर्यवविमिश्रितैः .. 189.20 ..
6.3.m: Then at dawn at sunrise, having bathed in the waters of the Narmadā / and having gratified the ancestors and gods with sesamum mixed with barley,

6.3.s:
dhenuṃ dadyāddvije yogye sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām .
nirmamo nirahaṅkāro dānaṃ dadyāddvijātaye .. 189.21 ..
6.3.d:
धेनुं दद्याद्द्विजे योग्ये सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् .
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो दानं दद्याद्द्विजातये .. 189.21 ..
6.3.m: one should give a cow adorned with all ornaments to a suitable twice-born. / Free from possessiveness and egotism, one should give a gift to the twice-born.

6.3.s:
gatvā sampūjayeddevaṃ vārāhaṃ hyādisaṃjñitam .
anena vidhinā pūjya paścādgacchejjayaṃ tvaran .. 189.22 ..
6.3.d:
गत्वा सम्पूजयेद्देवं वाराहं ह्यादिसंज्ञितम् .
अनेन विधिना पूज्य पश्चाद्गच्छेज्जयं त्वरन् .. 189.22 ..
6.3.m: Going [there], one should worship the god called the First Boar. / Having worshipped according to this rite, one should then hasten to Jaya.

6.3.s:
tvaritaṃ tu jayaṃ gatvā pūrvakaṃ vidhimācaret .
aśvaṃ dadyāddvijāgryāya jayapūrvābhinirgatam .. 189.23 ..
6.3.d:
त्वरितं तु जयं गत्वा पूर्वकं विधिमाचरेत् .
अश्वं दद्याद्द्विजाग्र्याय जयपूर्वाभिनिर्गतम् .. 189.23 ..
6.3.m: Having quickly gone to Jaya, one should perform the previous rite; / one should give a horse that has set forth from the east to an excellent twice-born at Jaya.

6.3.s:
liṅge caiva tilā deyāḥ śvete hiraṇyameva ca .
udīrṇe ca bhuvaṃ dadyātpūrvakaṃ vidhimācaret .. 189.24 ..
6.3.d:
लिङ्गे चैव तिला देयाः श्वेते हिरण्यमेव च .
उदीर्णे च भुवं दद्यात्पूर्वकं विधिमाचरेत् .. 189.24 ..
6.3.m: Sesamum should be given at Liṅga, and gold at Śveta; / at Udīrṇa one should give land, and perform the previous rite.

6.3.s:
anastamita āditye varāhānpañca paśyataḥ .
yatphalaṃ labhate pārtha tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 189.25 ..
6.3.d:
अनस्तमित आदित्ये वराहान्पञ्च पश्यतः .
यत्फलं लभते पार्थ तदिहैकमनाः शृणु .. 189.25 ..
6.3.m: Listen with single-minded focus to the fruit one obtains here, O son of Pṛthā, / when one beholds the five Boars before the sun has set:

6.3.s:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ .
ebhistu saha saṃyogo viśvastānāṃ ca vañcanam .. 189.26 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः .
एभिस्तु सह संयोगो विश्वस्तानां च वञ्चनम् .. 189.26 ..
6.3.m: The killing of a brahmin, drinking liquor, theft, violation of the guru's bed, / association with these [sinners], and deception of those who trust;

6.3.s:
svasṛduhitṛbhaginīkuladāropabṛṃhaṇam .
ā janmamaraṇādyāvatpāpaṃ bharatasattama .. 189.27 ..
6.3.d:
स्वसृदुहितृभगिनीकुलदारोपबृंहणम् .
आ जन्ममरणाद्यावत्पापं भरतसत्तम .. 189.27 ..
6.3.m: carnal approach to a sister, a daughter, [or] women of one's own family— / whatever sin there is from birth to death, O best of Bharatas,

6.3.s:
tīrthapañcakapūtasya vaiṣṇavasya viśeṣataḥ .
yugapaccavinaśyeta tūlarāśirivānalāt .. 189.28 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थपञ्चकपूतस्य वैष्णवस्य विशेषतः .
युगपच्चविनश्येत तूलराशिरिवानलात् .. 189.28 ..
6.3.m: of one purified by the five tīrthas, especially of a Vaiṣṇava, / it would all perish simultaneously, like a heap of cotton from fire.

6.3.s:
nārāyaṇānusmaraṇājjapadhyānādviśeṣataḥ .
vipraṇaśyanti pāpāni girikūṭasamānyapi .. 189.29 ..
6.3.d:
नारायणानुस्मरणाज्जपध्यानाद्विशेषतः .
विप्रणश्यन्ति पापानि गिरिकूटसमान्यपि .. 189.29 ..
6.3.m: From the remembrance of Nārāyaṇa, and especially from recitation and meditation, / sins, even if equal to mountain peaks, are completely destroyed.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā pañca varāhānvai pauruṣe mahati sthitaḥ .
āplavannarmadātoye śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi .. 189.30 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पञ्च वराहान्वै पौरुषे महति स्थितः .
आप्लवन्नर्मदातोये श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथाविधि .. 189.30 ..
6.3.m: Having beheld the five boars, established in great spiritual effort, / bathing in the waters of the Narmadā, and having performed a śrāddha according to rule,

6.3.s:
udayāstamanādarvāgyaḥ paśyelloṭaṇeśvaram .
kalevaravimuktaḥ sa ityevaṃ śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 189.31 ..
6.3.d:
उदयास्तमनादर्वाग्यः पश्येल्लोटणेश्वरम् .
कलेवरविमुक्तः स इत्येवं शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 189.31 ..
6.3.m: he who beholds Loṭaṇeśvara before sunset / is freed from his body—thus spoke Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
muktiṃ prayāti sahasā duṣprāpāṃ parameśvarīm .
pauruṣe kriyamāṇe'pi na siddhirjāyate yadi .. 189.32 ..
6.3.d:
मुक्तिं प्रयाति सहसा दुष्प्रापां परमेश्वरीम् .
पौरुषे क्रियमाणेऽपि न सिद्धिर्जायते यदि .. 189.32 ..
6.3.m: He quickly attains liberation, the supreme sovereign state, difficult to reach. / Even if success is not achieved while the effort is being made,

6.3.s:
bruvanti svargagamanamapi pāpānvitasya ca .
yatra tatra gatasyaiva bhavetpañcavarāhakī .. 189.33 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रुवन्ति स्वर्गगमनमपि पापान्वितस्य च .
यत्र तत्र गतस्यैव भवेत्पञ्चवराहकी .. 189.33 ..
6.3.m: they declare that one attains heaven, even though endowed with sin. / Wherever one may go, the pilgrimage of the Five Boars would be [fruitful].

6.3.s:
jyeṣṭhasyaikādaśītithau dhruvaṃ tatra vasennaraḥ .
ādiṃ jayaṃ tathā śvetaṃ liṅgamudīrṇameva ca .. 189.34 ..
6.3.d:
ज्येष्ठस्यैकादशीतिथौ ध्रुवं तत्र वसेन्नरः .
आदिं जयं तथा श्वेतं लिङ्गमुदीर्णमेव च .. 189.34 ..
6.3.m: A man should certainly dwell there on the eleventh day of the month of Jyeṣṭha. / [The boars] Ādi, Jaya, as well as Śveta, and indeed the Udīrṇa-liṅga—

6.3.s:
āśritya tasyā draṣṭavyā varāhāstu yatastataḥ .
jyeṣṭhasyaikādaśītithau viṣṇunā prabhuviṣṇunā .. 189.35 ..
6.3.d:
आश्रित्य तस्या द्रष्टव्या वराहास्तु यतस्ततः .
ज्येष्ठस्यैकादशीतिथौ विष्णुना प्रभुविष्णुना .. 189.35 ..
6.3.m: having resorted to it, the boars are to be seen everywhere there. / On the eleventh lunar day of Jyeṣṭha, by Viṣṇu, the all-powerful Lord,

6.3.s:
vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya uddhṛtā dharaṇī vibho .
puṇyātpuṇyatamā tena hyaśeṣāghaughanāśinī .. 189.36 ..
6.3.d:
वाराहं रूपमास्थाय उद्धृता धरणी विभो .
पुण्यात्पुण्यतमा तेन ह्यशेषाघौघनाशिनी .. 189.36 ..
6.3.m: having assumed the form of a boar, the earth was lifted up, O lord. / Therefore, it is more sacred than the sacred, destroying the entire mass of sins.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā pañcavarāhānvai kroḍamudīrṇarūpiṇam .
pūjayitvā vidhānena paścājjāgaraṇaṃ caret .. 189.37 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पञ्चवराहान्वै क्रोडमुदीर्णरूपिणम् .
पूजयित्वा विधानेन पश्चाज्जागरणं चरेत् .. 189.37 ..
6.3.m: Having beheld the five boars, and the boar in the form of Udīrṇa, / having worshipped according to the rite, he should then keep a night vigil.

6.3.s:
sapañcavartikān dīpān ghṛtenojjvālya bhaktitaḥ .
purāṇaśravaṇairnṛtyairgītavādyaiḥ sumaṅgalaiḥ .. 189.38 ..
6.3.d:
सपञ्चवर्तिकान् दीपान् घृतेनोज्ज्वाल्य भक्तितः .
पुराणश्रवणैर्नृत्यैर्गीतवाद्यैः सुमङ्गलैः .. 189.38 ..
6.3.m: Having lit five-wick lamps with clarified butter with devotion, / through hearing the Purāṇas, dances, songs, and auspicious instrumental music,

6.3.s:
vedajāpyaiḥ pavitraiśca kṣapayitvā ca śarvarīm .
yatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo hyājamīḍha śṛṇuṣva tat .. 189.39 ..
6.3.d:
वेदजाप्यैः पवित्रैश्च क्षपयित्वा च शर्वरीम् .
यत्पुण्यं लभते मर्त्यो ह्याजमीढ शृणुष्व तत् .. 189.39 ..
6.3.m: and passing the night with sacred Vedic recitations— / whatever merit a mortal obtains, listen to that, O descendant of Ajamīḍha:

6.3.s:
revājalaṃ puṇyatamaṃ pṛthivyāṃ tathā ca devo jagatāṃ patirhariḥ .
ekādaśī pāpaharā narendra bahvāyāsairlabhyate mānavānām .. 189.40 ..
6.3.d:
रेवाजलं पुण्यतमं पृथिव्यां तथा च देवो जगतां पतिर्हरिः .
एकादशी पापहरा नरेन्द्र बह्वायासैर्लभ्यते मानवानाम् .. 189.40 ..
6.3.m: The water of the Revā is the most sacred on earth, and likewise Hari is the lord of the worlds; / the eleventh day removes sins, O king, and is obtained by humans through great efforts.

6.3.s:
ekaikaśo brahmahatyādikāni śaktāni hantuṃ pāpasaṅghāni rājan .
naite sarve yugapadvai sametā hantuṃ śaktāḥ kiṃ na tadbrūhi rājan .. 189.41 ..
6.3.d:
एकैकशो ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि शक्तानि हन्तुं पापसङ्घानि राजन् .
नैते सर्वे युगपद्वै समेता हन्तुं शक्ताः किं न तद्ब्रूहि राजन् .. 189.41 ..
6.3.m: Individually, these are capable of destroying hosts of sins such as the murder of a brahmin, O king. / All these having united at once—are they not capable of destroying them? Tell that, O king!

6.3.s:
yathedamuktaṃ tava dharmasūno śrutaṃ ca yacchaṅkarāccandramauleḥ .
śrutvedamicchanmucyate sarvapāpaiḥ paṭhanpadaṃ yāti hi vṛtraśatroḥ .. 189.42 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye udīrṇavarāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
यथेदमुक्तं तव धर्मसूनो श्रुतं च यच्छङ्कराच्चन्द्रमौलेः .
श्रुत्वेदमिच्छन्मुच्यते सर्वपापैः पठन्पदं याति हि वृत्रशत्रोः .. 189.42 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे नर्मदामाहात्म्ये उदीर्णवराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोननवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Thus this has been spoken to you, O son of Dharma, as was heard from Śaṅkara, the moon-crested god. / Having heard this with desire, one is freed from all sins; by reciting it, one indeed goes to the abode of the enemy of Vṛtra.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Udīrṇavarāhatīrtha', in the Glory of the Narmadā, in the Revākhaṇḍa, in the fifth Avantīkhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 190
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla somatīrthamanuttamam .
candrahāseti vikhyātaṃ sarvadaivatapūjitam .. 190.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 190
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल सोमतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
चन्द्रहासेति विख्यातं सर्वदैवतपूजितम् .. 190.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 190
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O king, to the unsurpassed Somatīrtha, / renowned as Candrahāsa, worshipped by all the gods,

6.3.s: yatra siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptaḥ somo rājā surottamaḥ .. 190.2 ..
6.3.d: यत्र सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तः सोमो राजा सुरोत्तमः .. 190.2 ..
6.3.m: where King Soma, the best of gods, attained supreme perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ siddhimanuprāptaḥ somo rājā jagatpatiḥ .
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamānagha .. 190.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तः सोमो राजा जगत्पतिः .
तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथयस्व ममानघ .. 190.3 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How did King Soma, lord of the world, obtain perfection? / I wish to hear all that; tell me, O sinless one.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
purā śapto munīndreṇa dakṣeṇa kila bhārata .
asevanāddhi dārāṇāṃ kṣayarogī bhaviṣyasi .. 190.4 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पुरा शप्तो मुनीन्द्रेण दक्षेण किल भारत .
असेवनाद्धि दाराणां क्षयरोगी भविष्यसि .. 190.4 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Formerly, he was cursed by Dakṣa, the best of sages, O Bhārata: / 'Because of not attending to your wives, you will suffer from consumption.'

6.3.s:
udvāhitānāṃ patnīnāṃ ye na kurvanti sevanam .
yā niṣṭhā jāyate teṣāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narottama .. 190.5 ..
6.3.d:
उद्वाहितानां पत्नीनां ये न कुर्वन्ति सेवनम् .
या निष्ठा जायते तेषां तां शृणुष्व नरोत्तम .. 190.5 ..
6.3.m: Those who do not attend to their wedded wives— / what their ultimate state becomes, hear that, O best of men.

6.3.s:
ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ sevanājjāyate sutaḥ .
sutātsvargaśca mokṣaśca hītyevaṃ śrutinodanā .. 190.6 ..
6.3.d:
ऋतुकाले तु नारीणां सेवनाज्जायते सुतः .
सुतात्स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च हीत्येवं श्रुतिनोदना .. 190.6 ..
6.3.m: From attending to women during their fertile season, a son is born; / from a son come heaven and liberation—such indeed is the Vedic injunction.

6.3.s:
tatkālocitadharmeṇa ye na sevanti tāṃ narāḥ .
teṣāṃ brahmaghnajaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 190.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्कालोचितधर्मेण ये न सेवन्ति तां नराः .
तेषां ब्रह्मघ्नजं पापं जायते नात्र संशयः .. 190.7 ..
6.3.m: Men who do not attend to them in accordance with the duty appropriate for that time— / the sin of killing a brahmin arises for them; of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
tena pāpena ghoreṇa veṣṭato raurave patet .
tasya tadrudhiraṃ pāpāḥ pibante kālamīpsitam .. 190.8 ..
6.3.d:
तेन पापेन घोरेण वेष्टतो रौरवे पतेत् .
तस्य तद्रुधिरं पापाः पिबन्ते कालमीप्सितम् .. 190.8 ..
6.3.m: Enveloped by that dreadful sin, one falls into Raurava. / There, sinful beings drink his blood for the intended time.

6.3.s:
tato'vatīrṇakālena yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ prayāsyati .
tasyāṃ tasyāṃ sa duṣṭātmā durbhago jāyate sadā .. 190.9 ..
6.3.d:
ततोऽवतीर्णकालेन यां यां योनिं प्रयास्यति .
तस्यां तस्यां स दुष्टात्मा दुर्भगो जायते सदा .. 190.9 ..
6.3.m: Then, when that time has expired, into whatever womb he enters, / in that very womb that evil-minded one is always born unfortunate.

6.3.s:
nārīṇāṃ tu sadā kāmo hyadhikaḥ parivartate .
viśeṣeṇa ṛtoḥ kāle bhidyate kāmasāyakaiḥ .. 190.10 ..
6.3.d:
नारीणां तु सदा कामो ह्यधिकः परिवर्तते .
विशेषेण ऋतोः काले भिद्यते कामसायकैः .. 190.10 ..
6.3.m: The desire of women is always exceedingly active; / especially at the time of the fertile period, she is pierced by the arrows of love.

6.3.s:
paribhūtā hi sā bhartrā dhyāyate'nyaṃ patiṃ tataḥ .
tasyāḥ putraḥ samutpanno hyaṭate kulamuttamam .. 190.11 ..
6.3.d:
परिभूता हि सा भर्त्रा ध्यायतेऽन्यं पतिं ततः .
तस्याः पुत्रः समुत्पन्नो ह्यटते कुलमुत्तमम् .. 190.11 ..
6.3.m: Disregarded by her husband, she then thinks of another husband; / a son born of her strays from the noble lineage.

6.3.s:
svargasthāstena pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ jātā mahīpate .
patanti jātamātreṇa kulaṭastena cocyate .. 190.12 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्गस्थास्तेन पितरः पूर्वं जाता महीपते .
पतन्ति जातमात्रेण कुलटस्तेन चोच्यते .. 190.12 ..
6.3.m: By him, the ancestors residing in heaven, who were born earlier, O king, / fall as soon as he is born; therefore he is called a corrupter of the lineage.

6.3.s:
tena karmavipākena kṣayarogī śaśī hyabhūt .
tyaktvā lokaṃ surendrāṇāṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ .. 190.13 ..
6.3.d:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन क्षयरोगी शशी ह्यभूत् .
त्यक्त्वा लोकं सुरेन्द्राणां मर्त्यलोकमुपागतः .. 190.13 ..
6.3.m: By that fruition of past actions, the moon became afflicted with consumption. / Leaving the world of the lords of the gods, he came to the world of mortals.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca .
bhramitvā narmadāṃ prāptaḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm .. 190.14 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थान्यनेकानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च .
भ्रमित्वा नर्मदां प्राप्तः सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् .. 190.14 ..
6.3.m: Having wandered there to many holy bathing places and sacred shrines, / he reached the Narmadā, the destroyer of all sins.

6.3.s:
upavāsastu dānāni vratāni niyamāśca ye .
cacāra dvādaśābdāni tato muktaḥ sa kilbiṣaiḥ .. 190.15 ..
6.3.d:
उपवासस्तु दानानि व्रतानि नियमाश्च ये .
चचार द्वादशाब्दानि ततो मुक्तः स किल्बिषैः .. 190.15 ..
6.3.m: Fasting, gifts, vows, and observances— / he performed these for twelve years; then he was freed from his sins.

6.3.s:
sthāpayitvā mahādevaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .
jagāma prabhayā pūrṇaḥ somalokamanuttamam .. 190.16 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापयित्वा महादेवं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .
जगाम प्रभया पूर्णः सोमलोकमनुत्तमम् .. 190.16 ..
6.3.m: Having installed Mahādeva, the destroyer of all sins, / filled with radiance, he went to the unsurpassed realm of Soma.

6.3.s:
yenaiva sthāpito devaḥ pūjyate varṣasaṃkhyayā .
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi tasya lokaṃ samaśnute .. 190.17 ..
6.3.d:
येनैव स्थापितो देवः पूज्यते वर्षसंख्यया .
तावद्युगसहस्राणि तस्य लोकं समश्नुते .. 190.17 ..
6.3.m: For as many years as the god installed by a person is worshipped, / for that many thousands of yugas he enjoys that deity's realm.

6.3.s:
tena devān vidhānoktān sthāpayanti narā bhuvi .
akṣayaṃ cāvyayaṃ yasmātphalaṃ bhavati nānyathā .. 190.18 ..
6.3.d:
तेन देवान् विधानोक्तान् स्थापयन्ति नरा भुवि .
अक्षयं चाव्ययं यस्मात्फलं भवति नान्यथा .. 190.18 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, men install gods on earth according to the prescribed rules, / because the fruit becomes inexhaustible and imperishable; it is not otherwise.

6.3.s:
somatīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā pūjayeddevamīśvaram .
jāyate sa naro bhūtvā somavitpriyadarśanaḥ .. 190.19 ..
6.3.d:
सोमतीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा पूजयेद्देवमीश्वरम् .
जायते स नरो भूत्वा सोमवित्प्रियदर्शनः .. 190.19 ..
6.3.m: He who bathes at Somatīrtha and worships the god Īśvara / becomes a man knowing Soma, handsome in appearance.

6.3.s:
candraprabhāse yo gatvā snānaṃ vidhivadācaret .
vyādhinā nābhibhūtaḥ syātkṣayarogeṇa vā yutaḥ .. 190.20 ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रप्रभासे यो गत्वा स्नानं विधिवदाचरेत् .
व्याधिना नाभिभूतः स्यात्क्षयरोगेण वा युतः .. 190.20 ..
6.3.m: One who goes to Candraprabhāsa and performs ritual ablution according to rule / will not be overcome by disease or afflicted with consumption.

6.3.s:
candrahāsye naraḥ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ tu nareśvara .
caturdaśyāmupoṣyaiva kṣīrasya juhuyāccarum .. 190.21 ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रहास्ये नरः स्नात्वा द्वादश्यां तु नरेश्वर .
चतुर्दश्यामुपोष्यैव क्षीरस्य जुहुयाच्चरुम् .. 190.21 ..
6.3.m: A man having bathed at Candrahāsya on the twelfth lunar day, O king of men, / and fasting on the fourteenth, should offer an oblation of milk-rice.

6.3.s:
mantraiḥ pañcabhirīśānaṃ puruṣastryambakaṃ yajet .
haviḥśeṣaṃ svayaṃ prāśya candrahāsyeśamīkṣayet .. 190.22 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रैः पञ्चभिरीशानं पुरुषस्त्र्यम्बकं यजेत् .
हविःशेषं स्वयं प्राश्य चन्द्रहास्येशमीक्षयेत् .. 190.22 ..
6.3.m: With five mantras, a person should worship Īśāna, Tryambaka. / Having consumed the remainder of the offering himself, he should look upon Candrahāsyeśa.

6.3.s:
anena vidhinā rājaṃstuṣṭo devo maheśvaraḥ .
vidhinā tīrthayogena kṣayarogādvimucyate .. 190.23 ..
6.3.d:
अनेन विधिना राजंस्तुष्टो देवो महेश्वरः .
विधिना तीर्थयोगेन क्षयरोगाद्विमुच्यते .. 190.23 ..
6.3.m: By this rite, O king, Lord Maheśvara is pleased; / by the rite, in connection with the tīrtha, one is freed from consumption.

6.3.s:
saptabhiḥ somavārairyaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret .
sa vai karṇakṛtādrogānmucyate pūjayañchivam .. 190.24 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तभिः सोमवारैर्यः स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् .
स वै कर्णकृताद्रोगान्मुच्यते पूजयञ्छिवम् .. 190.24 ..
6.3.m: He who performs ritual ablution there on seven Mondays / is indeed freed from ear disease, worshipping Śiva.

6.3.s:
akṣirogastathā rājaṃścandrahāsye vinaśyati .
candrahāsye tu yo gatvā grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ .
snānaṃ samācaredbhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 190.25 ..
6.3.d:
अक्षिरोगस्तथा राजंश्चन्द्रहास्ये विनश्यति .
चन्द्रहास्ये तु यो गत्वा ग्रहणे चन्द्रसूर्ययोः .
स्नानं समाचरेद्भक्त्या मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 190.25 ..
6.3.m: Likewise, eye disease is destroyed at Candrahāsya, O king. / He who goes to Candrahāsya during an eclipse of the moon or sun / and performs ritual ablution with devotion is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca candrahāsye śubhaśubham .
kṛtaṃ nṛpavaraśreṣṭha sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam .. 190.26 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नानं च दानं च चन्द्रहास्ये शुभशुभम् .
कृतं नृपवरश्रेष्ठ सर्वं भवति चाक्षयम् .. 190.26 ..
6.3.m: Bathing and giving gifts there at Candrahāsya, good and bad [actions] / performed [there], O best among kings, all become inexhaustible.

6.3.s:
te dhanyāste mahātmānasteṣāṃ janma sujīvitam .
candrahāsye tu ye snātvā paśyanti grahaṇaṃ narāḥ .. 190.27 ..
6.3.d:
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानस्तेषां जन्म सुजीवितम् .
चन्द्रहास्ये तु ये स्नात्वा पश्यन्ति ग्रहणं नराः .. 190.27 ..
6.3.m: They are fortunate, they are great-souled, their life is well-lived— / the men who, having bathed at Candrahāsye, behold the eclipse.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam .
snānamātrāttu rājendra tatra tīrthe praṇaśyati .. 190.28 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मजं यत्पुरा कृतम् .
स्नानमात्रात्तु राजेन्द्र तत्र तीर्थे प्रणश्यति .. 190.28 ..
6.3.m: Vocal, mental, or born of action—whatever sin was committed in the past / is destroyed at that sacred ford merely by bathing, O king of kings. 190.28

6.3.s:
bahavastanna jānanti mahāmohasamanvitāḥ .
dehastha iva sarveṣāṃ paramātmeva saṃsthitam .. 190.29 ..
6.3.d:
बहवस्तन्न जानन्ति महामोहसमन्विताः .
देहस्थ इव सर्वेषां परमात्मेव संस्थितम् .. 190.29 ..
6.3.m: Many, possessed by great delusion, do not know it, / though it stands present like the Supreme Self dwelling in the body of all beings. 190.29

6.3.s:
paścime sāgare gatvā somatīrthe tu yatphalam .
tatsamagramavāpnoti candrahāsye na saṃśayaḥ .. 190.30 ..
6.3.d:
पश्चिमे सागरे गत्वा सोमतीर्थे तु यत्फलम् .
तत्समग्रमवाप्नोति चन्द्रहास्ये न संशयः .. 190.30 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit one obtains by going to the western ocean at Somatīrtha, / one certainly obtains all of it at Candrahāsya, without doubt. 190.30

6.3.s:
saṃkrāntau ca vyatīpāte viṣuve cāyane tathā .
candrahāsye naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 190.31 ..
6.3.d:
संक्रान्तौ च व्यतीपाते विषुवे चायने तथा .
चन्द्रहास्ये नरः स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 190.31 ..
6.3.m: And on a transit, a Vyatīpāta, an equinox, and a solstice, / a man who bathes at Candrahāsya is freed from all sins. 190.31

6.3.s:
te mūḍhāste durācārāsteṣāṃ janma nirarthakam .
candrahāsyaṃ na jānanti narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam .. 190.32 ..
6.3.d:
ते मूढास्ते दुराचारास्तेषां जन्म निरर्थकम् .
चन्द्रहास्यं न जानन्ति नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् .. 190.32 ..
6.3.m: Fools they are, wicked in conduct, their birth is meaningless, / who do not know Candrahāsya situated on the Narmadā. 190.32

6.3.s:
candrahāsye tu yaḥ kaścitsaṃnyāsaṃ kurute nṛpa .
anivartikā gatistasya somalokātkadācana .. 190.33 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe candrahāsyatīrthamahātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
चन्द्रहास्ये तु यः कश्चित्संन्यासं कुरुते नृप .
अनिवर्तिका गतिस्तस्य सोमलोकात्कदाचन .. 190.33 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे चन्द्रहास्यतीर्थमहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whoever takes renunciation at Candrahāsya, O king, / his state of existence never turns back from the world of Soma. 190.33
Thus ends the one hundred and ninetieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Candrahāsyatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
adhyāya 191
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
siddheśvaraṃ tato gacchettasyaiva tu samīpataḥ .
amṛtasrāvi talliṅgamādyaṃ svāyambhuvaṃ tathā .. 191.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 191
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
सिद्धेश्वरं ततो गच्छेत्तस्यैव तु समीपतः .
अमृतस्रावि तल्लिङ्गमाद्यं स्वायम्भुवं तथा .. 191.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 191
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go to Siddheśvara, which is very close to it. / That primeval, self-manifest liṅga flows with nectar, 191.1

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭamātreṇa yeneha hyanṛṇo jāyate naraḥ .
purā varṣaśataṃ sāgramārādhya parameśvaram .. 191.2 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्टमात्रेण येनेह ह्यनृणो जायते नरः .
पुरा वर्षशतं साग्रमाराध्य परमेश्वरम् .. 191.2 ..
6.3.m: by merely seeing which a person becomes free from debt here [in this world]. / Long ago, having worshipped the Supreme Lord for over a full hundred years, 191.2

6.3.s:
prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ siddhimādityā dvādaśaiva tu .
ataḥ siddheśvaraḥ proktaḥ siddhidaḥ siddhikāṅkṣiṇām .. 191.3 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्नुयुः परमां सिद्धिमादित्या द्वादशैव तु .
अतः सिद्धेश्वरः प्रोक्तः सिद्धिदः सिद्धिकाङ्क्षिणाम् .. 191.3 ..
6.3.m: the twelve Ādityas attained supreme perfection. / Therefore it is called Siddheśvara, bestower of perfections to those who desire perfections. 191.3

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ siddheśvare prāptāḥ siddhiṃ devā dvijottama .
ādityā iti yaccoktaṃ tanme vismāpanaṃ kṛtam .. 191.4 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं सिद्धेश्वरे प्राप्ताः सिद्धिं देवा द्विजोत्तम .
आदित्या इति यच्चोक्तं तन्मे विस्मापनं कृतम् .. 191.4 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How did the gods attain perfection at Siddheśvara, O best of the twice-born? / And that it was said to be the Ādityas—that has caused me wonder! 191.4

6.3.s:
tapasyugre vyavasitā ādityāḥ kena hetunā .
samprāptāstu dvijaśreṣṭha siddhiṃ caivābhilāṣikīm .. 191.5 ..
6.3.d:
तपस्युग्रे व्यवसिता आदित्याः केन हेतुना .
सम्प्राप्तास्तु द्विजश्रेष्ठ सिद्धिं चैवाभिलाषिकीम् .. 191.5 ..
6.3.m: For what reason did the Ādityas engage in fierce austerity / and attain their desired perfection, O best of the twice-born? 191.5

6.3.s: saṃkṣipya tu mayā pṛṣṭaṃ vistarāddvija śaṃsa me .. 191.6 ..
6.3.d: संक्षिप्य तु मया पृष्टं विस्तराद्द्विज शंस मे .. 191.6 ..
6.3.m: I have asked in brief; tell me in detail, O twice-born one. 191.6

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
aditerdvādaśādityā jātāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ .
indro dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro'tha varuṇo'ryamā .. 191.7 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
अदितेर्द्वादशादित्या जाताः शक्रपुरोगमाः .
इन्द्रो धाता भगस्त्वष्टा मित्रोऽथ वरुणोऽर्यमा .. 191.7 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
The twelve Ādityas were born of Aditi, with Śakra at their head: / Indra, Dhātṛ, Bhaga, Tvaṣṭṛ, Mitra, then Varuṇa, Aryaman, 191.7

6.3.s:
vivasvānsavitā pūṣā hyaṃśumānviṣṇureva ca .
ta ime dvādaśādityā icchanto bhāskaraṃ padam .. 191.8 ..
6.3.d:
विवस्वान्सविता पूषा ह्यंशुमान्विष्णुरेव च .
त इमे द्वादशादित्या इच्छन्तो भास्करं पदम् .. 191.8 ..
6.3.m: Vivasvat, Savitṛ, Pūṣan, and Aṃśumat, and Viṣṇu. / These twelve Ādityas, desiring the solar station, 191.8

6.3.s:
narmadātaṭamāśritya tapasyugre vyavasthitāḥ .
siddheśvare mahārāja kāśyapeyairmahātmabhiḥ .. 191.9 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थिताः .
सिद्धेश्वरे महाराज काश्यपेयैर्महात्मभिः .. 191.9 ..
6.3.m: resorted to the bank of the Narmadā and engaged in fierce austerity. / At Siddheśvara, O great king, by those magnanimous sons of Kaśyapa, 191.9

6.3.s:
parā siddhiranuprāptā dvādaśādityasaṃjñitaiḥ .
sthāpitaśca jagaddhātā tasmiṃstīrthe divākaraḥ .. 191.10 ..
6.3.d:
