तदर्चित्वा परान् कामानाप्स्यसि त्वं न संशयः .. 194.28 ..
6.3.m: a thousandfold merit is attained beyond any other place. / It has been seen by you in that region and understood properly; / having worshipped it, you will obtain the highest desires, without a doubt. // 194.28

6.3.s:
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva deveśi vāñchitaṃ durlabhaṃ suraiḥ .
durgasaṃsārakāntārapatitaiḥ parameśvari .. 194.29 ..
6.3.d:
वरं वृणीष्व देवेशि वाञ्छितं दुर्लभं सुरैः .
दुर्गसंसारकान्तारपतितैः परमेश्वरि .. 194.29 ..
6.3.m: Choose a boon, O queen of gods, your desire which is difficult for gods to attain / who have fallen into the impenetrable wilderness of saṃsāra, O supreme goddess!" // 194.29

6.3.s:
śrīruvāca -
nārāyaṇa jagaddhātarnārāyaṇa jagatpate .
nārāyaṇa parabrahma nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa .. 194.30 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीरुवाच -
नारायण जगद्धातर्नारायण जगत्पते .
नारायण परब्रह्म नारायणपरायण .. 194.30 ..
6.3.m: Śrī said: / "O Nārāyaṇa, creator of the universe! O Nārāyaṇa, lord of the world! / O Nārāyaṇa, Supreme Brahman! O refuge of Nārāyaṇa! // 194.30

6.3.s:
prasīda pāhi māṃ bhaktyā samyaksarge niyojaya .
priyo hyasi priyāhaṃ te yathā syāṃ tattathā kuru .. 194.31 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसीद पाहि मां भक्त्या सम्यक्सर्गे नियोजय .
प्रियो ह्यसि प्रियाहं ते यथा स्यां तत्तथा कुरु .. 194.31 ..
6.3.m: Be gracious! Protect me through devotion, [and] engage me properly in creation. / You are dear to me, and I am dear to you; make it so that it will be thus! // 194.31

6.3.s:
gṛhaṃ dharmārthakāmānāṃ kāraṇaṃ deva saṃmatam .
tadāsthāyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ māṃ śreyasi niyojaya .. 194.32 ..
6.3.d:
गृहं धर्मार्थकामानां कारणं देव संमतम् .
तदास्थायाश्रमं पुण्यं मां श्रेयसि नियोजय .. 194.32 ..
6.3.m: The household is regarded by the wise, O god, as the cause of dharma, wealth, and pleasure. / Having established yourself in that sacred stage of life, appoint me to the highest good!" // 194.32

6.3.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca -
nārāyaṇagirā devi vijñapto'smi yatastvayā .
nārāyaṇagirirnāma tena me'tra bhaviṣyati .. 194.33 ..
6.3.d:
नारायण उवाच -
नारायणगिरा देवि विज्ञप्तोऽस्मि यतस्त्वया .
नारायणगिरिर्नाम तेन मेऽत्र भविष्यति .. 194.33 ..
6.3.m: Nārāyaṇa said: / "O goddess, since I was petitioned by you with the speech (gir) of Nārāyaṇa, / therefore my name here shall be Nārāyaṇagiri. // 194.33

6.3.s:
nārāyaṇasmṛtau yāti duritaṃ janmakoṭijam .
yasmādgirati tasmācca girirityeva śabditam .. 194.34 ..
6.3.d:
नारायणस्मृतौ याति दुरितं जन्मकोटिजम् .
यस्माद्गिरति तस्माच्च गिरिरित्येव शब्दितम् .. 194.34 ..
6.3.m: At the remembrance of Nārāyaṇa, sin born of ten million births disappears; / and because it swallows (girati) [sin], it is named giri. // 194.34

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvāśrayo devi giriḥ parvatarāṅbhavet .
surāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ yathāhamapi cāśrayaḥ .. 194.35 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वाश्रयो देवि गिरिः पर्वतराङ्भवेत् .
सुरासुरमनुष्याणां यथाहमपि चाश्रयः .. 194.35 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, O goddess, the hill (giri) shall become the king of mountains, a refuge for all, / just as I too am a refuge for gods, demons, and mortals. // 194.35

6.3.s:
ya etatpūjayiṣyanti maṇḍalasthaṃ paraṃ mama .
nārāyaṇagirirnāma devarūpaṃ śubhekṣaṇe .. 194.36 ..
6.3.d:
य एतत्पूजयिष्यन्ति मण्डलस्थं परं मम .
नारायणगिरिर्नाम देवरूपं शुभेक्षणे .. 194.36 ..
6.3.m: Those who will worship this supreme divine form of mine / standing in the maṇḍala, named Nārāyaṇagiri, O auspicious-eyed one, // 194.36

6.3.s:
te divyajñānasampannā divyadehaviceṣṭitāḥ .
divyaṃ lokamavāpsyanti divyabhogasamanvitāḥ .. 194.37 ..
6.3.d:
ते दिव्यज्ञानसम्पन्ना दिव्यदेहविचेष्टिताः .
दिव्यं लोकमवाप्स्यन्ति दिव्यभोगसमन्विताः .. 194.37 ..
6.3.m: endowed with divine knowledge, behaving with divine bodies, / will attain the divine realm, accompanied by divine pleasures." // 194.37

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tayorevaṃ saṃvadatordevā indrapurogamāḥ .
samāgatā vanoddeśaṃ sāgarānte maharṣayaḥ .. 194.38 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तयोरेवं संवदतोर्देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः .
समागता वनोद्देशं सागरान्ते महर्षयः .. 194.38 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / While the two were conversing in this manner, the gods led by Indra / and the great seers arrived at that forest region on the seashore. // 194.38

6.3.s:
tato bhṛguṃ devarājo nārāyaṇavicintitam .
vavre jñātvā tu tatkanyāṃ dharmātmā sa dadau ca tām .. 194.39 ..
6.3.d:
ततो भृगुं देवराजो नारायणविचिन्तितम् .
वव्रे ज्ञात्वा तु तत्कन्यां धर्मात्मा स ददौ च ताम् .. 194.39 ..
6.3.m: Then the king of gods, having understood what was intended by Nārāyaṇa, / chose his daughter from Bhṛgu, and that righteous-minded [sage] gave her away. // 194.39

6.3.s:
dharmo'pi vidhivadvatsa vivāhaṃ samakārayat .
devadevasya rājarṣe devatārthe samāhitaḥ .. 194.40 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मोऽपि विधिवद्वत्स विवाहं समकारयत् .
देवदेवस्य राजर्षे देवतार्थे समाहितः .. 194.40 ..
6.3.m: Dharma too, O child, duly performed the wedding / of the God of gods, O royal seer, intent upon the sake of the deities. // 194.40

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
dharmo vivāhamakarodvidhivadyattvayoditam .
ko vidhistatra kā dattā dakṣiṇā bhṛguṇāpi ca .. 194.41 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
धर्मो विवाहमकरोद्विधिवद्यत्त्वयोदितम् .
को विधिस्तत्र का दत्ता दक्षिणा भृगुणापि च .. 194.41 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Since it was spoken by you that Dharma duly performed the marriage, / what was the ritual there, and what sacrificial fee (dakṣiṇā) was given by Bhṛgu? // 194.41

6.3.s:
vivāhayajñe samabhūtsruksruvagrahaṇe ca kaḥ .
ṛtvijaḥ ke sadasyāśca tasyāsan dvijasattama .. 194.42 ..
6.3.d:
विवाहयज्ञे समभूत्स्रुक्स्रुवग्रहणे च कः .
ऋत्विजः के सदस्याश्च तस्यासन् द्विजसत्तम .. 194.42 ..
6.3.m: Who took hold of the sruc and sruva ladles at that marriage-sacrifice? / Who were the priests and who were the spectators there, O best of twice-borns? // 194.42

6.3.s:
kiṃ tasyāvabhṛthaṃ tvāsīttatsarvaṃ vada vistarāt .
tvadvākyāmṛtapānena tṛptirmama na vidyate .. 194.43 ..
6.3.d:
किं तस्यावभृथं त्वासीत्तत्सर्वं वद विस्तरात् .
त्वद्वाक्यामृतपानेन तृप्तिर्मम न विद्यते .. 194.43 ..
6.3.m: What was its concluding purificatory bath (avabhṛtha)? Tell all that in detail! / There is no satiety for me from drinking the nectar of your speech. // 194.43

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
nārāyaṇavivāhasya yajñasya ca yudhiṣṭhira .
tapasastasya devasya samyagācaraṇasya ca .. 194.44 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नारायणविवाहस्य यज्ञस्य च युधिष्ठिर .
तपसस्तस्य देवस्य सम्यगाचरणस्य च .. 194.44 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Of the marriage-sacrifice of Nārāyaṇa, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / of that god's austerity, and of his proper conduct, // 194.44

6.3.s:
vaktuṃ samartho na guṇānbrahmāpi parameśvaraḥ .
tathāpyuddeśato vacmi śṛṇu bhūtvā samāhitaḥ .. 194.45 ..
6.3.d:
वक्तुं समर्थो न गुणान्ब्रह्मापि परमेश्वरः .
तथाप्युद्देशतो वच्मि शृणु भूत्वा समाहितः .. 194.45 ..
6.3.m: even Brahmā, the supreme lord, is not capable of reciting the virtues. / Nevertheless, I shall tell it in summary; listen, becoming focused! // 194.45

6.3.s:
brahmā saptarṣayastatra sruksruvagrahaṇe ratāḥ .
agnīñjuhuvire rājanvedirdhātrī sasāgarā .. 194.46 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मा सप्तर्षयस्तत्र स्रुक्स्रुवग्रहणे रताः .
अग्नीञ्जुहुविरे राजन्वेदिर्धात्री ससागरा .. 194.46 ..
6.3.m: Brahmā and the seven seers were engaged there in taking up the sruk and sruva ladles; / they offered oblations into the fires, O king, while the earth together with the oceans served as the altar.

6.3.s:
daduḥ samudrā ratnāni brahmarṣibhyo nṛpottama .
dhanado'pi dadau vittaṃ sarvabrāhmaṇavāñchitam .. 194.47 ..
6.3.d:
ददुः समुद्रा रत्नानि ब्रह्मर्षिभ्यो नृपोत्तम .
धनदोऽपि ददौ वित्तं सर्वब्राह्मणवाञ्छितम् .. 194.47 ..
6.3.m: The oceans presented gems to the brahmin-seers, O best of kings, / and Kubera, too, gave wealth desired by all the brahmins.

6.3.s:
viśvakarmā'pi devānāṃ brahmarṣīṇāṃ paraṃtapa .
veśmāni suvicitrāṇi sarvaratnamayāni ca .. 194.48 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वकर्माऽपि देवानां ब्रह्मर्षीणां परंतप .
वेश्मानि सुविचित्राणि सर्वरत्नमयानि च .. 194.48 ..
6.3.m: Viśvakarman also, O scorcher of foes, [constructed] for the gods and brahmin-seers / wondrous mansions made entirely of jewels,

6.3.s:
kṛtvā pradarśayāmāsa devendrāya yaśasvine .
śatakratustato viprānkāpiṣṭhalapurogamān .. 194.49 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा प्रदर्शयामास देवेन्द्राय यशस्विने .
शतक्रतुस्ततो विप्रान्कापिष्ठलपुरोगमान् .. 194.49 ..
6.3.m: and having made them, displayed them to the renowned lord of the gods. / Then Indra asked the brahmins headed by Kāpiṣṭhala,

6.3.s:
śaunakādīṃśca papraccha baṣkalāñchāgalānapi .
ātreyānapi rājendra vṛṇudhvamabhivāñchitam .. 194.50 ..
6.3.d:
शौनकादींश्च पप्रच्छ बष्कलाञ्छागलानपि .
आत्रेयानपि राजेन्द्र वृणुध्वमभिवाञ्छितम् .. 194.50 ..
6.3.m: as well as Śaunaka and others, the Bāṣkalas, the Chāgalas, / and the Ātreyas, O lord of kings: “Choose what you desire!”

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā te citraratnāni prāhuḥ sarveśvareśvaram .
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca saṅgamo'yaṃ supuṇyakṛt .. 194.51 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ते चित्ररत्नानि प्राहुः सर्वेश्वरेश्वरम् .
देवानां च ऋषीणां च सङ्गमोऽयं सुपुण्यकृत् .. 194.51 ..
6.3.m: Beholding those wonderful jewels, they spoke to the lord of all lords: / “This gathering of gods and seers brings great merit.

6.3.s:
asminpuṇye sureśāna vastuṃ vāñchāmahe sadā .
śatakratuḥ prāha punarvāso vātra bhaviṣyati .
satyadharmaratā yūyaṃ yāvatkālaṃ bhaviṣyatha .. 194.52 ..
6.3.d:
अस्मिन्पुण्ये सुरेशान वस्तुं वाञ्छामहे सदा .
शतक्रतुः प्राह पुनर्वासो वात्र भविष्यति .
सत्यधर्मरता यूयं यावत्कालं भविष्यथ .. 194.52 ..
6.3.m: O lord of gods, we wish to dwell always in this sacred place.” / Indra replied again: “Your residence will be here / as long as you remain devoted to truth and righteousness.”

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
pṛṣṭaṃ yadrājaśārdūla ke makhe hotriṇo'bhavan .
tatprocyamānamadhunā śṛṇu bhūtvā samāhitaḥ .. 194.53 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पृष्टं यद्राजशार्दूल के मखे होत्रिणोऽभवन् .
तत्प्रोच्यमानमधुना शृणु भूत्वा समाहितः .. 194.53 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / As to what you asked, O tiger among kings, regarding who were the priests at the sacrifice, / listen with concentrated mind as that is now told.

6.3.s:
sanatkumārapramukhāḥ sadasyāstasya cābhavan .
audgātramatryaṅgirasau marīciśca cakāra ha .. 194.54 ..
6.3.d:
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखाः सदस्यास्तस्य चाभवन् .
औद्गात्रमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ मरीचिश्च चकार ह .. 194.54 ..
6.3.m: Sanatkumāra and others were its attendants; / Atri, Aṅgiras, and Marīci performed the role of the Udgātṛ priests;

6.3.s:
hautraṃ dharmavasiṣṭhau ca brahmatvaṃ sanako muniḥ .
ṣaṭtriṃśadgrāmasāhasraṃ prādāttebhyaḥ śatakratuḥ .. 194.55 ..
6.3.d:
हौत्रं धर्मवसिष्ठौ च ब्रह्मत्वं सनको मुनिः .
षट्त्रिंशद्ग्रामसाहस्रं प्रादात्तेभ्यः शतक्रतुः .. 194.55 ..
6.3.m: Dharma and Vasiṣṭha acted as the Hotṛs, and sage Sanaka as the Brahmā priest. / Indra gave them thirty-six thousand villages.

6.3.s:
lakṣmīrbhartrā ca saṃyuktābhavattatkṛtavānprabhuḥ .
brahmaṇo juhvato vahniṃ yāvaddeśasthitaiḥ suraiḥ .. 194.56 ..
6.3.d:
लक्ष्मीर्भर्त्रा च संयुक्ताभवत्तत्कृतवान्प्रभुः .
ब्रह्मणो जुह्वतो वह्निं यावद्देशस्थितैः सुरैः .. 194.56 ..
6.3.m: Lakṣmī was united with her husband, and the Lord brought it to completion. / While Brahmā was making oblations into the fire, from as far as the gods were standing,

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭaṃ lalāṭaṃ deśo'sau lalāṭa iti saṃjñitaḥ .
sa deśaḥ śrīpateḥ kṣetrapuṇyaṃ devarṣisevitam .. 194.57 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्टं ललाटं देशोऽसौ ललाट इति संज्ञितः .
स देशः श्रीपतेः क्षेत्रपुण्यं देवर्षिसेवितम् .. 194.57 ..
6.3.m: his forehead was seen; hence that region is known as Lalāṭa. / That region is the sacred field of the Lord of Śrī, meritorious and frequented by celestial seers,

6.3.s:
sarvāścaryamayaṃ divyaṃ divyasiddhisamanvitam .
brāhmaṇānāṃ tataḥ paṅktiṃ niveśayitumudyatā .. 194.58 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं दिव्यं दिव्यसिद्धिसमन्वितम् .
ब्राह्मणानां ततः पङ्क्तिं निवेशयितुमुद्यता .. 194.58 ..
6.3.m: filled with every wonder, celestial, and endowed with divine perfections. / Then, preparing to settle the line of brahmins,

6.3.s:
lakṣmīḥ śrīpatināmānamāha devaṃ vacastadā .
śrīruvāca -
ya ete brāhmaṇāḥ śiṣyā bhṛgvādīnāṃ yatavratāḥ .. 194.59 ..
6.3.d:
लक्ष्मीः श्रीपतिनामानमाह देवं वचस्तदा .
श्रीरुवाच -
य एते ब्राह्मणाः शिष्या भृग्वादीनां यतव्रताः .. 194.59 ..
6.3.m: Lakṣmī then spoke words to the god named Śrīpati. / Śrī said: / These brahmins who are pupils of Bhṛgu and others, strict in their vows...

6.3.s:
tānniveśayitumicchāmi tvatprasādādadhokṣaja .
marīcyādayaḥ surendreṇa sthāpitā garuḍadhvaja .. 194.60 ..
6.3.d:
तान्निवेशयितुमिच्छामि त्वत्प्रसादादधोक्षज .
मरीच्यादयः सुरेन्द्रेण स्थापिता गरुडध्वज .. 194.60 ..
6.3.m: I wish to settle them through your grace, O Adhokṣaja! / Marīci and others were established by the lord of the gods, O Garuḍa-bannered one;

6.3.s:
naiṣṭhikavratino viprā bahavo'tra yatavratāḥ .
prājāpatye vrate brāhme kecidatra vyavasthitāḥ .
tānahaṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi tvatprasādādadhokṣaja .. 194.61 ..
6.3.d:
नैष्ठिकव्रतिनो विप्रा बहवोऽत्र यतव्रताः .
प्राजापत्ये व्रते ब्राह्मे केचिदत्र व्यवस्थिताः .
तानहं स्थापयिष्यामि त्वत्प्रसादादधोक्षज .. 194.61 ..
6.3.m: here are many brahmins observing lifelong vows, firm in their vows, / and some here are established in the vow of Prajāpati pertaining to Brahmā. / I will settle them through your grace, O Adhokṣaja!”

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ kautūhaladharo bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ .
papraccha vratinaḥ sarvānvṛttibhede vyavasthitān .. 194.62 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः कौतूहलधरो भगवान्वृषभध्वजः .
पप्रच्छ व्रतिनः सर्वान्वृत्तिभेदे व्यवस्थितान् .. 194.62 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, filled with curiosity, the blessed Bull-bannered god / questioned all the vow-holders established in various modes of life.

6.3.s:
nārado'pi mahādevamupetya ca satīpatim .
prāha kṛṣṇājinadharo naiṣṭhikā brāhmaṇā hyamī .. 194.63 ..
6.3.d:
नारदोऽपि महादेवमुपेत्य च सतीपतिम् .
प्राह कृष्णाजिनधरो नैष्ठिका ब्राह्मणा ह्यमी .. 194.63 ..
6.3.m: Nārada too, clad in a black antelope skin, approached Mahādeva, the lord of Satī, / and said: “These brahmins indeed are lifelong celibates;

6.3.s:
amī kāryāḥ suvastreṇa channaguhyā dvijottamāḥ .
prājāpatyāścaturviṃśasahasrāṇi nareśvara .. 194.64 ..
6.3.d:
अमी कार्याः सुवस्त्रेण छन्नगुह्या द्विजोत्तमाः .
प्राजापत्याश्चतुर्विंशसहस्राणि नरेश्वर .. 194.64 ..
6.3.m: these best of twice-born are to be covered with fine cloth over their private parts. / The householders [observing the vow of Prajāpati] are twenty-four thousand, O lord of men,

6.3.s:
brahmacaryavratasthānāṃ vratabrahmavicāriṇām .
dvādaśaiṣāṃ sahasrāṇi santi vai vṛṣabhadhvaja .. 194.65 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतस्थानां व्रतब्रह्मविचारिणाम् .
द्वादशैषां सहस्राणि सन्ति वै वृषभध्वज .. 194.65 ..
6.3.m: and of those established in the vow of celibacy, contemplating the vow of Brahman, / there are indeed twelve thousand, O Bull-bannered god.”

6.3.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devā devarṣayo'pi ca .
sādhu sādhvityamanyanta nocuḥ kecana kiṃcana .. 194.66 ..
6.3.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवा देवर्षयोऽपि च .
साधु साध्वित्यमन्यन्त नोचुः केचन किंचन .. 194.66 ..
6.3.m: Hearing Nārada’s words, the gods and celestial seers / thought, ‘Excellent, excellent!’, and none spoke anything against it.

6.3.s:
samāhvayattato lakṣmīstān viprān bhaktisaṃyutā .
uvāca caraṇāngṛhya prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi .. 194.67 ..
6.3.d:
समाह्वयत्ततो लक्ष्मीस्तान् विप्रान् भक्तिसंयुता .
उवाच चरणान्गृह्य प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि .. 194.67 ..
6.3.m: Then Lakṣmī, filled with devotion, summoned those brahmins; / grasping their feet, she said: “Show your grace to me!

6.3.s:
ṣaṭtriṃśacca sahasrāṇi veśmanāmatra saṃsthitiḥ .
viśvakarmakṛtānāṃ tu teṣu tiṣṭhantu vo'khilāḥ .. 194.68 ..
6.3.d:
षट्त्रिंशच्च सहस्राणि वेश्मनामत्र संस्थितिः .
विश्वकर्मकृतानां तु तेषु तिष्ठन्तु वोऽखिलाः .. 194.68 ..
6.3.m: Here is the establishment of thirty-six thousand houses / built by Viśvakarman; let all of you reside in them.”

6.3.s:
te tatheti pratijñāya sthitāḥ saṃprītamānasāḥ .
dhanadhānyasamṛddhāśca vāñchitaprāptilakṣaṇāḥ .
sarvakāmasamṛddhāśca hyanārambheṣu karmaṇām .. 194.69 ..
6.3.d:
ते तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय स्थिताः संप्रीतमानसाः .
धनधान्यसमृद्धाश्च वाञ्छितप्राप्तिलक्षणाः .
सर्वकामसमृद्धाश्च ह्यनारम्भेषु कर्मणाम् .. 194.69 ..
6.3.m: Agreeing with “So be it,” they remained with delighted minds, / affluent with wealth and grain, possessing marks of obtaining all desires, / and endowed with all objects of desire even without undertaking worldly labor.

6.3.s:
iti saṃsthāpya tān viprān sā sthitā paryapālayat .
caturdhā tu sthito viṣṇuḥ śriyā devyāḥ priye rataḥ .. 194.70 ..
6.3.d:
इति संस्थाप्य तान् विप्रान् सा स्थिता पर्यपालयत् .
चतुर्धा तु स्थितो विष्णुः श्रिया देव्याः प्रिये रतः .. 194.70 ..
6.3.m: Having thus settled those brahmins, she remained and protected them. / And Viṣṇu, devoted to the pleasure of Goddess Śrī, remained in four forms.

6.3.s:
evaṃ vaivāhikamakhe nivṛtte ṛṣayastu tam .
ūcuścāvabhṛthasnānaṃ kutra kurmo janārdana .. 194.71 ..
6.3.d:
एवं वैवाहिकमखे निवृत्ते ऋषयस्तु तम् .
ऊचुश्चावभृथस्नानं कुत्र कुर्मो जनार्दन .. 194.71 ..
6.3.m: When the wedding sacrifice had ended thus, the seers / said to him: “Janārdana, where shall we take the concluding ceremonial bath?”

6.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ śrīpatiḥ pādapaṅkajāt .
mumoca jāhnavītoyaṃ revāmadhyagamaṃ śuci .. 194.72 ..
6.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं श्रीपतिः पादपङ्कजात् .
मुमोच जाह्नवीतोयं रेवामध्यगमं शुचि .. 194.72 ..
6.3.m: Hearing their words, the Lord of Śrī released from his lotus foot / the pure waters of the Gaṅgā, which flowed into the midst of the Revā.

6.3.s:
hareḥ pādodakaṃ dṛṣṭvā niḥsṛtaṃ munayastu te .
vismitāḥ samapadyanta jānantastasya gauravam .. 194.73 ..
6.3.d:
हरेः पादोदकं दृष्ट्वा निःसृतं मुनयस्तु ते .
विस्मिताः समपद्यन्त जानन्तस्तस्य गौरवम् .. 194.73 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the water from Hari’s foot flow forth, those sages / were filled with wonder, knowing its greatness.

6.3.s:
rudreṇa sahitāḥ sarve devatā ṛṣayastathā .
saṃkathā vismitāścakrurvidhunvantaḥ śirāṃsi ca .. 194.74 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रेण सहिताः सर्वे देवता ऋषयस्तथा .
संकथा विस्मिताश्चक्रुर्विधुन्वन्तः शिरांसि च .. 194.74 ..
6.3.m: Together with Rudra, all the deities and seers / conversed in amazement, shaking their heads.

6.3.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .
brūhi śambho kimatrāyaṃ akasmādvārisambhavaḥ .
viṣṇoḥ pādāmbujotthaśca sammohakaraṇaḥ paraḥ .. 194.75 ..
6.3.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः .
ब्रूहि शम्भो किमत्रायं अकस्माद्वारिसम्भवः .
विष्णोः पादाम्बुजोत्थश्च सम्मोहकरणः परः .. 194.75 ..
6.3.m: The seers said: / “Tell us, O Śambhu, why has this water suddenly appeared here, / arising from the lotus foot of Viṣṇu, causing extreme wonder?”

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
pādodakamidaṃ viṣṇorahaṃ jānāmi vai surāḥ .
daśāśvamedhāvabhṛthaiḥ snānamatrātiricyate .. 194.76 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
पादोदकमिदं विष्णोरहं जानामि वै सुराः .
दशाश्वमेधावभृथैः स्नानमत्रातिरिच्यते .. 194.76 ..
6.3.m: Īśvara said: / “I indeed know this water from the foot of Viṣṇu, O gods! / A ritual ablution here surpasses the concluding ceremonial baths of ten horse sacrifices.

6.3.s:
yuṣmābhiḥ śrīpatiḥ pūjyaḥ snānaṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ kutaḥ .
bhaviṣyatīti tenāśu idaṃ vo'rthe vinirmitam .. 194.77 ..
6.3.d:
युष्माभिः श्रीपतिः पूज्यः स्नानं चावभृथं कुतः .
भविष्यतीति तेनाशु इदं वोऽर्थे विनिर्मितम् .. 194.77 ..
6.3.m: You had to worship the Lord of Śrī, and [wondered] whence the concluding bath / would be had; therefore, this has been immediately produced for your sake.

6.3.s:
snātvātra tridaśeśānā yatphalaṃ samprapadyate .
vaktuṃ na kenacidyāti tataḥ kimuttaraṃ vacaḥ .. 194.78 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वात्र त्रिदशेशाना यत्फलं सम्प्रपद्यते .
वक्तुं न केनचिद्याति ततः किमुत्तरं वचः .. 194.78 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is attained by bathing here, O lords of the thirty gods, / cannot be described by anyone; what further words can there be?”

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evamuktvā tu te sarve snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāgatam .
jagmurdevā maheśānapurogā bharatarṣabha .. 194.79 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवमुक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे स्नानं कृत्वा यथागतम् .
जग्मुर्देवा महेशानपुरोगा भरतर्षभ .. 194.79 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having spoken thus and performed their ritual ablution, all those gods, / led by the Great Lord, departed the way they had come, O bull of the Bharatas.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇāśca tataḥ sarve svaveśmānyeva bhejire .
devatīrthe mahārāja sarvapāpapraṇāśane .. 194.80 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpativivāhavarṇanaṃ nāma caturnavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणाश्च ततः सर्वे स्ववेश्मान्येव भेजिरे .
देवतीर्थे महाराज सर्वपापप्रणाशने .. 194.80 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीपतिविवाहवर्णनं नाम चतुर्नवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
And then all the brahmins retired to their own houses / at Devatīrtha, O great king, which destroys all sins.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Marriage of Śrīpati', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 195
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
devatīrthe tu kiṃ nāma māhātmyaṃ samudāhṛtam .
phalaṃ kiṃ snānadānādikāriṇāṃ jāyate mune .. 195.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 195
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
देवतीर्थे तु किं नाम माहात्म्यं समुदाहृतम् .
फलं किं स्नानदानादिकारिणां जायते मुने .. 195.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 195 / Yudhiṣṭhira said: / What māhātmya is declared of Devatīrtha? / What fruit arises for those who perform ritual ablution, gift-giving, and other rites, O sage?

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni devairmunigaṇairapi .
sevitāni mahābāho tāni dhyātāni viṣṇunā .. 195.2 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि देवैर्मुनिगणैरपि .
सेवितानि महाबाहो तानि ध्यातानि विष्णुना .. 195.2 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Whatever sacred fords on earth have been frequented by gods / and hosts of sages, O mighty-armed one, were contemplated by Viṣṇu,

6.3.s:
samāgatānyekatāṃ vai tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
tattīrthaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ puṇyaṃ devatīrthamiti śrutam .. 195.3 ..
6.3.d:
समागतान्येकतां वै तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
तत्तीर्थं वैष्णवं पुण्यं देवतीर्थमिति श्रुतम् .. 195.3 ..
6.3.m: and they converged into oneness at that sacred ford, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / That holy sacred ford of Viṣṇu is renowned as Devatīrtha.

6.3.s:
kurukṣetraṃ bhuvi paramantarikṣe tripuṣkaram .
puruṣottamaṃ divi paraṃ devatīrthaṃ parātparam .. 195.4 ..
6.3.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं भुवि परमन्तरिक्षे त्रिपुष्करम् .
पुरुषोत्तमं दिवि परं देवतीर्थं परात्परम् .. 195.4 ..
6.3.m: Kurukṣetra is supreme on earth, Tripuṣkara in the intermediate space, / Puruṣottama in heaven, but Devatīrtha is higher than the highest.

6.3.s:
devatīrthasamaṃ nāsti tīrthamatra paratra ca .
yatprāpya manujastapyenna kadācidyudhiṣṭhira .. 195.5 ..
6.3.d:
देवतीर्थसमं नास्ति तीर्थमत्र परत्र च .
यत्प्राप्य मनुजस्तप्येन्न कदाचिद्युधिष्ठिर .. 195.5 ..
6.3.m: There is no sacred ford equal to Devatīrtha in this world or in the next, / reaching which a man never suffers [again], O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
devairuktāni tīrthāni yo'tra snānaṃ samācaret .
devatīrthe sa sarvatra snāto bhavati mānavaḥ .. 195.6 ..
6.3.d:
देवैरुक्तानि तीर्थानि योऽत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् .
देवतीर्थे स सर्वत्र स्नातो भवति मानवः .. 195.6 ..
6.3.m: Whoever performs ritual ablution here in the sacred fords spoken of by the gods, / that person has bathed in all of them at Devatīrtha.

6.3.s:
evamastviti tairuktā devā ṛṣigaṇā api .
saṃtuṣṭāḥ śrīśamabhyarcya svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ tu bhejire .. 195.7 ..
6.3.d:
एवमस्त्विति तैरुक्ता देवा ऋषिगणा अपि .
संतुष्टाः श्रीशमभ्यर्च्य स्वं स्वं स्थानं तु भेजिरे .. 195.7 ..
6.3.m: Having said to them, "May it be so," the gods and the hosts of seers as well, / highly pleased, worshiped the Lord of Śrī and went to their respective abodes.

6.3.s:
sūryagrahe'tra vai kṣetre snātvā yatphalamaśnute .
snātvā śrīśaṃ samabhyarcya samupoṣya yathāvidhi .. 195.8 ..
6.3.d:
सूर्यग्रहेऽत्र वै क्षेत्रे स्नात्वा यत्फलमश्नुते .
स्नात्वा श्रीशं समभ्यर्च्य समुपोष्य यथाविधि .. 195.8 ..
6.3.m: The fruit one enjoys by bathing in this sacred field during a solar eclipse, / having bathed and fully worshiped the Lord of Śrī, having fasted according to the rule,

6.3.s:
yaddadāti hiraṇyāni dānāni vidhivannṛpa .
tadanantaphalaṃ sarvaṃ sūryasya grahaṇe yathā .. 195.9 ..
6.3.d:
यद्ददाति हिरण्यानि दानानि विधिवन्नृप .
तदनन्तफलं सर्वं सूर्यस्य ग्रहणे यथा .. 195.9 ..
6.3.m: and whatever gifts of gold one gives according to the rule, O king, / all that yields infinite fruit, just as on a solar eclipse.

6.3.s:
bhūmidānaṃ dhenudānaṃ svarṇadānamanantakam .
vajradānamanantaṃ ca phalaṃ prāha śatakratuḥ .. 195.10 ..
6.3.d:
भूमिदानं धेनुदानं स्वर्णदानमनन्तकम् .
वज्रदानमनन्तं च फलं प्राह शतक्रतुः .. 195.10 ..
6.3.m: The gift of land, the gift of a cow, the gift of gold brings infinite [reward]; / and Śatakratu declared the gift of a diamond brings infinite fruit.

6.3.s:
somo vai vastradānena mauktikānāṃ ca bhārgavaḥ .
suvarṇasya ravirdānaṃ dharmarājo hyanantakam .. 195.11 ..
6.3.d:
सोमो वै वस्त्रदानेन मौक्तिकानां च भार्गवः .
सुवर्णस्य रविर्दानं धर्मराजो ह्यनन्तकम् .. 195.11 ..
6.3.m: Soma [proclaimed infinite fruit] from the gift of garments, and Bhārgava from [the gift of] pearls; / the Sun from the gift of gold, and Dharmarāja indeed declared it infinite.

6.3.s:
devatīrthe tu yaddānaṃ śraddhāyuktena dīyate .
tadanantaphalaṃ prāha bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ .. 195.12 ..
6.3.d:
देवतीर्थे तु यद्दानं श्रद्धायुक्तेन दीयते .
तदनन्तफलं प्राह बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः .. 195.12 ..
6.3.m: The noble-minded Bṛhaspati declared / that whatever gift is given at Devatīrtha with faith brings infinite fruit.

6.3.s:
devatīrthe bhṛgukṣetre sarvatīrthādhika nṛpa .
devatīrthe naraḥ snātvā śrīpatiṃ yo'nupaśyati .. 195.13 ..
6.3.d:
देवतीर्थे भृगुक्षेत्रे सर्वतीर्थाधिक नृप .
देवतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा श्रीपतिं योऽनुपश्यति .. 195.13 ..
6.3.m: At Devatīrtha in Bhṛgukṣetra, which is superior to all sacred fords, O king, / the man who, having bathed at Devatīrtha, beholds the Lord of Śrī,

6.3.s:
somagrahe kulaśataṃ sa samuddhṛtya nākabhāk .
dānāni dvijamukhyebhyo devatīrthe narādhipa .. 195.14 ..
6.3.d:
सोमग्रहे कुलशतं स समुद्धृत्य नाकभाक् .
दानानि द्विजमुख्येभ्यो देवतीर्थे नराधिप .. 195.14 ..
6.3.m: during a lunar eclipse, delivers a hundred families and attains heaven. / Gifts given to the foremost brahmins at Devatīrtha, O ruler of men,

6.3.s:
yairdattāni narairbhogabhāginaḥ pretya ceha te .
devatīrthe viprabhojyaṃ harimuddiśya yaścaret .. 195.15 ..
6.3.d:
यैर्दत्तानि नरैर्भोगभागिनः प्रेत्य चेह ते .
देवतीर्थे विप्रभोज्यं हरिमुद्दिश्य यश्चरेत् .. 195.15 ..
6.3.m: by whatever men they are given, they partake of enjoyments here and in the hereafter. / Whoever feeds brahmins at Devatīrtha, intending it for Hari,

6.3.s:
sa sarvāhlādamāpnoti svargaloke yudhiṣṭhira .
devatīrthe naro nārī snātvā niyatamānasau .. 195.16 ..
6.3.d:
स सर्वाह्लादमाप्नोति स्वर्गलोके युधिष्ठिर .
देवतीर्थे नरो नारी स्नात्वा नियतमानसौ .. 195.16 ..
6.3.m: he attains complete delight in the heavenly world, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / A man or a woman, having bathed at Devatīrtha with a restrained mind,

6.3.s:
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ bhaktyā pūjayedyaḥ śriyaḥ patim .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtenodbodhya dīpakam .. 195.17 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्यैकादशीं भक्त्या पूजयेद्यः श्रियः पतिम् .
रात्रौ जागरणं कृत्वा घृतेनोद्बोध्य दीपकम् .. 195.17 ..
6.3.m: having fasted on the eleventh day and worshiped the Husband of Śrī with devotion, / having kept vigil at night and kindled a lamp with clarified butter,

6.3.s:
dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya tathā vai narmadājale .
vipradāmpatyamabhyarcya vidhivatkurunandana .. 195.18 ..
6.3.d:
द्वादश्यां प्रातरुत्थाय तथा वै नर्मदाजले .
विप्रदाम्पत्यमभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्कुरुनन्दन .. 195.18 ..
6.3.m: having risen early on the twelfth day in the waters of the Narmadā, / and having worshiped a brahmin couple according to the rule, O scion of the Kurus,

6.3.s:
vastrābharaṇatāmbūlapuṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ .
akṣaye viṣṇuloke'sau modate caritavrataḥ .. 195.19 ..
6.3.d:
वस्त्राभरणताम्बूलपुष्पधूपविलेपनैः .
अक्षये विष्णुलोकेऽसौ मोदते चरितव्रतः .. 195.19 ..
6.3.m: with garments, ornaments, betel, flowers, incense, and ointments, / he, having observed the vow, rejoices in the imperishable world of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
yaḥ sadaikādaśītithau snātvopoṣyārcayeddharim .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādvedaśāstravidhānataḥ .. 195.20 ..
6.3.d:
यः सदैकादशीतिथौ स्नात्वोपोष्यार्चयेद्धरिम् .
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्याद्वेदशास्त्रविधानतः .. 195.20 ..
6.3.m: Whoever constantly fasts on the eleventh tithi after bathing, worships Hari, / and keeps vigil at night according to the ordinances of the Vedas and treatises,

6.3.s:
dharmarājakṛtāṃ pāpāṃ na sa paśyati yātanām .
pañcarātravidhānena śrīpatiṃ yo'rcayiṣyati .. 195.21 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मराजकृतां पापां न स पश्यति यातनाम् .
पञ्चरात्रविधानेन श्रीपतिं योऽर्चयिष्यति .. 195.21 ..
6.3.m: he does not see the painful torment inflicted by Dharmarāja. / Whoever shall worship the Lord of Śrī according to the Pañcarātra procedure,

6.3.s:
dīkṣāmavāpya vidhivadvaiṣṇavīṃ pāpanāśinīm .
svargamokṣapradāṃ puṇyāṃ bhogadāṃ vittadāmatha .. 195.22 ..
6.3.d:
दीक्षामवाप्य विधिवद्वैष्णवीं पापनाशिनीम् .
स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदां पुण्यां भोगदां वित्तदामथ .. 195.22 ..
6.3.m: having obtained the Vaiṣṇava initiation according to the rule, which destroys sin, / grants heaven and liberation, is meritorious, and bestows enjoyment and wealth,

6.3.s:
rājyadāṃ vā mahābhāga putradāṃ bhāgyadāmatha .
sukalatrapradāṃ vāpi viṣṇorbhaktipradāmiti .. 195.23 ..
6.3.d:
राज्यदां वा महाभाग पुत्रदां भाग्यदामथ .
सुकलत्रप्रदां वापि विष्णोर्भक्तिप्रदामिति .. 195.23 ..
6.3.m: or bestows kingdom, O highly fortunate one, bestows sons, bestows good fortune, / or bestows a good wife, and bestows devotion to Viṣṇu—

6.3.s:
tariṣyati bhavāmbhodhiṃ sa naraḥ kurunandana .
yo'rcayiṣyati tatraiva devatīrthe śriyaḥ patim .. 195.24 ..
6.3.d:
तरिष्यति भवाम्भोधिं स नरः कुरुनन्दन .
योऽर्चयिष्यति तत्रैव देवतीर्थे श्रियः पतिम् .. 195.24 ..
6.3.m: that man shall cross over the ocean of worldly existence, O scion of the Kurus, / who shall worship the Husband of Śrī right there at Devatīrtha,

6.3.s:
viśvarūpamatho samyaṅmūlaśrīpatimeva vā .
nārāyaṇagiriṃ vāpi gṛhe vaikādaśītithau .. 195.25 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वरूपमथो सम्यङ्मूलश्रीपतिमेव वा .
नारायणगिरिं वापि गृहे वैकादशीतिथौ .. 195.25 ..
6.3.m: or the Cosmic Form, or the original Lord of Śrī properly, / or at Nārāyaṇagiri, or at home on the eleventh tithi,

6.3.s:
bhaktimāñchraddhayā yuktaḥ kṣīraistīrthodakairapi .
susūkṣmairahatairvastrairmahākauśeyakairnṛpa .. 195.26 ..
6.3.d:
भक्तिमाञ्छ्रद्धया युक्तः क्षीरैस्तीर्थोदकैरपि .
सुसूक्ष्मैरहतैर्वस्त्रैर्महाकौशेयकैर्नृप .. 195.26 ..
6.3.m: devoted, endowed with faith, with milk, and with waters from sacred fords, / with very fine, unwashed clothes, and with grand silk garments, O king,

6.3.s:
vicitrairnetrajairvāpi dhūpairagurucandanaiḥ .
guggulairghṛtamiśraiśca naivedyairvividhairapi .. 195.27 ..
6.3.d:
विचित्रैर्नेत्रजैर्वापि धूपैरगुरुचन्दनैः .
गुग्गुलैर्घृतमिश्रैश्च नैवेद्यैर्विविधैरपि .. 195.27 ..
6.3.m: or with manifold woven silks, with perfumes of agarwood and sandal, / with guggulu mixed with clarified butter, and with varied food offerings,

6.3.s:
pāyasādyairmanuṣyendra payasā vā yudhiṣṭhira .
piṣṭadīpaiḥ suvimalairvardhamānairmanoharaiḥ .. 195.28 ..
6.3.d:
पायसाद्यैर्मनुष्येन्द्र पयसा वा युधिष्ठिर .
पिष्टदीपैः सुविमलैर्वर्धमानैर्मनोहरैः .. 195.28 ..
6.3.m: with milk-rice and other [dishes], O lord of men, or with milk, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / with spotless flour-lamps and charming, prosperous offerings—

6.3.s:
pūjayitvā naro yāti yathā tacchṛṇu bhārata .
śaṅkhī cakrī gadī padmī bhūtvāsau garuḍadhvajaḥ .. 195.29 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयित्वा नरो याति यथा तच्छृणु भारत .
शङ्खी चक्री गदी पद्मी भूत्वासौ गरुडध्वजः .. 195.29 ..
6.3.m: having worshiped, how a man proceeds, hear that, O Bhārata: / having become one bearing the conch, discus, mace, and lotus, with Garuḍa on his banner,

6.3.s:
devalokānatikramya viṣṇulokaṃ prapadyate .
yastu vai parayā bhaktyā śrīpateḥ pādapaṅkajam .. 195.30 ..
6.3.d:
देवलोकानतिक्रम्य विष्णुलोकं प्रपद्यते .
यस्तु वै परया भक्त्या श्रीपतेः पादपङ्कजम् .. 195.30 ..
6.3.m: surpassing the worlds of the gods, he reaches the world of Viṣṇu. / He who with supreme devotion beholds the lotus foot of the Lord of Śrī,

6.3.s:
caturdhādhiṣṭhitaṃ paśyecchriyaṃ trailokyamātaram .
nṛtyagītavinodena mucyate pātakardhruvam .. 195.31 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्धाधिष्ठितं पश्येच्छ्रियं त्रैलोक्यमातरम् .
नृत्यगीतविनोदेन मुच्यते पातकर्ध्रुवम् .. 195.31 ..
6.3.m: stationed in four forms, and Śrī, the mother of the three worlds, / with the diversion of dance and song, is surely freed from sins.

6.3.s:
nīrājane tu devasya prātarmadhye dine tathā .
sāyaṃ ca niyato nityaṃ yaḥ paśyetpūjayeddharim .. 195.32 ..
6.3.d:
नीराजने तु देवस्य प्रातर्मध्ये दिने तथा .
सायं च नियतो नित्यं यः पश्येत्पूजयेद्धरिम् .. 195.32 ..
6.3.m: During the waving of lights for the deity, in the morning, at midday, / and in the evening, who, restrained, constantly beholds and worships Hari,

6.3.s:
sa tīrtvā hyāpadaṃ durgāṃ naivārtiṃ samavāpnuyāt .
āyuḥśrīvardhanaṃ puṃsāṃ cakṣuṣāmapi pūrakam .. 195.33 ..
6.3.d:
स तीर्त्वा ह्यापदं दुर्गां नैवार्तिं समवाप्नुयात् .
आयुःश्रीवर्धनं पुंसां चक्षुषामपि पूरकम् .. 195.33 ..
6.3.m: having crossed difficult misfortune, he never meets with distress. / Increasing men's lifespan and fortune, fulfilling even their eyesight,

6.3.s:
upapāpaharaṃ caiva sadā nīrājanaṃ hareḥ .
tadā nīrājanākāle yo hareḥ paṭhati stavam .. 195.34 ..
6.3.d:
उपपापहरं चैव सदा नीराजनं हरेः .
तदा नीराजनाकाले यो हरेः पठति स्तवम् .. 195.34 ..
6.3.m: and removing minor sins is the constant waving of lights for Hari. / Whoever then, at the time of the waving of lights, recites Hari's hymn,

6.3.s:
sa dhanyo devadevasya prasannenāntarātmanā .
harernīrājanāśeṣaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati .. 195.35 ..
6.3.d:
स धन्यो देवदेवस्य प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना .
हरेर्नीराजनाशेषं पाणिभ्यां यः प्रयच्छति .. 195.35 ..
6.3.m: he is blessed, through the god of gods with a pleased inner self. / Whoever offers the remainder of the light-waving of Hari with both hands,

6.3.s:
saṃgṛhya cakṣuṣī tena yojayenmārjayanmukham .
timirādīnakṣirogānnāśayeddīptimanmukham .. 195.36 ..
6.3.d:
संगृह्य चक्षुषी तेन योजयेन्मार्जयन्मुखम् .
तिमिरादीनक्षिरोगान्नाशयेद्दीप्तिमन्मुखम् .. 195.36 ..
6.3.m: takes it, touches his two eyes with it, and wipes his face, / destroys eye diseases such as cataracts, and his radiant face

6.3.s:
bhavatyaśeṣaduṣṭānāṃ nāśāyālaṃ narottama .
dīpaprajvalanaṃ yasya nityamagre śriyaḥ pateḥ .. 195.37 ..
6.3.d:
भवत्यशेषदुष्टानां नाशायालं नरोत्तम .
दीपप्रज्वलनं यस्य नित्यमग्रे श्रियः पतेः .. 195.37 ..
6.3.m: becomes capable of destroying all evil ones, O best of men. / He before whom a lamp is constantly lit in front of the Husband of Śrī,

6.3.s:
snātvā revājale puṇye pradadyādadhikaṃ vratī .
saptadvīpavatī tena sasāgaravanāpagā .. 195.38 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा रेवाजले पुण्ये प्रदद्यादधिकं व्रती .
सप्तद्वीपवती तेन ससागरवनापगा .. 195.38 ..
6.3.m: who, having bathed in the sacred water of the Revā, gives profusely while observing the vow, / by him the earth consisting of seven continents, along with oceans, forests, and rivers,

6.3.s:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā syādvai dharaṇī śaṅkaro'bravīt .
idaṃ yaḥ paṭhyamānaṃ tu śṛṇuyātpaṭhate'pi vā .. 195.39 ..
6.3.d:
प्रदक्षिणीकृता स्याद्वै धरणी शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .
इदं यः पठ्यमानं तु शृणुयात्पठतेऽपि वा .. 195.39 ..
6.3.m: has indeed been circumambulated: so Śaṅkara declared. / Whoever hears this being recited, or himself recites it,

6.3.s:
smaraṇaṃ so'tasamaye vipāpmā prāpnuyāddhareḥ .
idaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ pitṛguṇapriyam .. 195.40 ..
6.3.d:
स्मरणं सोऽतसमये विपाप्मा प्राप्नुयाद्धरेः .
इदं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्ग्यं पितृगुणप्रियम् .. 195.40 ..
6.3.m: free from sins, he attains remembrance of Hari at the time of departure. / This māhātmya brings fame, longevity, leads to heaven, and is dear to the ancestors;

6.3.s:
māhātmyaṃ śrāvayedviprāñchrīpateḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi .
ghṛtena madhunā tena tarpitāḥ syuḥ pitāmahāḥ .. 195.41 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śrīpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
माहात्म्यं श्रावयेद्विप्राञ्छ्रीपतेः श्राद्धकर्मणि .
घृतेन मधुना तेन तर्पिताः स्युः पितामहाः .. 195.41 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे श्रीपतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
one should recite this māhātmya of the Lord of Śrī to the brahmins during the śrāddha rite. / By that, the grandfathers are gratified as if with clarified butter and honey.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, titled "Description of the Māhātmya of the Lord of Śrī," in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
adhyāya 196
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gaccheddharādhīśa haṃsatīrthamanuttamam .
yatra haṃsastapastaptvā brahmavāhanatāṃ gataḥ .. 196.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 196
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेद्धराधीश हंसतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र हंसस्तपस्तप्त्वा ब्रह्मवाहनतां गतः .. 196.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 196
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should proceed, O lord of the earth, to the unsurpassable Haṃsatīrtha, / where a swan, having performed austerities, became Brahmā's mount.

6.3.s:
haṃsatīrthe naraḥ snātvā dānaṃ dattvā ca kāñcanam .
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 196.2 ..
6.3.d:
हंसतीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा दानं दत्त्वा च काञ्चनम् .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 196.2 ..
6.3.m: A man, having bathed at Haṃsatīrtha and given a gift of gold, / completely freed from all sins, goes to the world of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
haṃsayuktena yānena taruṇādityavarcasā .
sarvakāmasamṛddhena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 196.3 ..
6.3.d:
हंसयुक्तेन यानेन तरुणादित्यवर्चसा .
सर्वकामसमृद्धेन सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः .. 196.3 ..
6.3.m: In a vehicle harnessed to swans, with the radiance of the morning sun, / endowed with all desirable things, being served by hosts of apsarases,

6.3.s:
tatra bhuktvā yathākāmaṃ sarvān bhogān yathepsitān .
jātismaro hi jāyeta punarmānuṣyamāgataḥ .. 196.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र भुक्त्वा यथाकामं सर्वान् भोगान् यथेप्सितान् .
जातिस्मरो हि जायेत पुनर्मानुष्यमागतः .. 196.4 ..
6.3.m: having enjoyed all desired pleasures there as he pleases, / when he returns again to human existence, he is born remembering his former births.

6.3.s: saṃnyāsena tyajeddehaṃ mokṣamāpnoti bhārata .. 196.5 ..
6.3.d: संन्यासेन त्यजेद्देहं मोक्षमाप्नोति भारत .. 196.5 ..
6.3.m: Through renunciation he abandons his body and attains liberation, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
etatte kathitaṃ pārtha haṃsatīrthasya yatphalam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanam .. 196.6 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
एतत्ते कथितं पार्थ हंसतीर्थस्य यत्फलम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वदुःखविनाशनम् .. 196.6 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे हंसतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षण्णवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
This fruit of Haṃsatīrtha has been told to you, O son of Pṛthā; / it removes all sins, brings merit, and destroys all sorrow.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Haṃsatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 197
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ gacchetsūryatīrthamanuttamam .
mūlasthānamiti khyātaṃ padmajasthāpitaṃ śubham .. 197.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 197
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं गच्छेत्सूर्यतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
मूलस्थानमिति ख्यातं पद्मजस्थापितं शुभम् .. 197.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 197
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Immediately after that, one should go to the unsurpassed Sūryatīrtha, / renowned as Mūlasthāna, auspicious, established by the lotus-born [Brahmā].

6.3.s:
mūlaśrīpatinā devī proktā sthāpaya bhāskaram .
śrutvā devoditaṃ devī sthāpayāmāsa bhāskaram .. 197.2 ..
6.3.d:
मूलश्रीपतिना देवी प्रोक्ता स्थापय भास्करम् .
श्रुत्वा देवोदितं देवी स्थापयामास भास्करम् .. 197.2 ..
6.3.m: The goddess was told by Mūlaśrīpati: 'Install the sun-god.' / Hearing what was spoken by the god, the goddess installed the sun-god.

6.3.s: procyate narmadātīre mūlasthānākhyabhāskaraḥ .. 197.3 ..
6.3.d: प्रोच्यते नर्मदातीरे मूलस्थानाख्यभास्करः .. 197.3 ..
6.3.m: He is called the Sun known as Mūlasthāna on the bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naro yastu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ .
saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca piṇḍena salilena ca .. 197.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरो यस्तु स्नात्वा नियतमानसः .
संतर्प्य पितृदेवांश्च पिण्डेन सलिलेन च .. 197.4 ..
6.3.m: A person who bathes at that sacred ford with restrained mind, / and satisfies the ancestors and the gods with rice-balls and water,

6.3.s:
mūlasthānaṃ tataḥ paśyetsa gacchetparamāṃ gatim .
guhyādguhyatarastatra viśeṣastu śruto mayā .. 197.5 ..
6.3.d:
मूलस्थानं ततः पश्येत्स गच्छेत्परमां गतिम् .
गुह्याद्गुह्यतरस्तत्र विशेषस्तु श्रुतो मया .. 197.5 ..
6.3.m: and then beholds Mūlasthāna, attains the supreme destination. / However, a particular [rule] there, more secret than the secret, has been heard by me,

6.3.s:
samāgame munīnāṃ tu śaṅkarācchaśiśekharāt .
sadā vai śuklasaptamyāṃ mūlamādityavāsaraḥ .. 197.6 ..
6.3.d:
समागमे मुनीनां तु शङ्कराच्छशिशेखरात् .
सदा वै शुक्लसप्तम्यां मूलमादित्यवासरः .. 197.6 ..
6.3.m: in an assembly of sages, from Śaṅkara, who bears the crescent moon on his crest: / when the Mūla asterism falls on a Sunday on the bright seventh [tithi],

6.3.s:
tadā revājalaṃ gatvā snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ .
pitḥṃśca bharataśreṣṭha dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ .. 197.7 ..
6.3.d:
तदा रेवाजलं गत्वा स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवताः .
पित्ःंश्च भरतश्रेष्ठ दत्त्वा दानं स्वशक्तितः .. 197.7 ..
6.3.m: then, having gone to the water of the Revā, having bathed, and having satisfied the deities / and ancestors, O best of Bharatas, and having given gifts according to one's capacity,

6.3.s:
karavīraistato gatvā raktacandanavāriṇā .
saṃsthāpya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā sampūjya ca yathāvidhi .. 197.8 ..
6.3.d:
करवीरैस्ततो गत्वा रक्तचन्दनवारिणा .
संस्थाप्य भास्करं भक्त्या सम्पूज्य च यथाविधि .. 197.8 ..
6.3.m: and then, having gone with oleander flowers and red sandalwood water, / having established the sun-god with devotion and worshipped him according to the injunctions,

6.3.s:
tataḥ sāgurukairdhūpaiḥ kundaraiśca viśeṣataḥ .
dhūpayeddevadeveśaṃ dīpān bodhya diśo daśa .. 197.9 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सागुरुकैर्धूपैः कुन्दरैश्च विशेषतः .
धूपयेद्देवदेवेशं दीपान् बोध्य दिशो दश .. 197.9 ..
6.3.m: and then particularly fumigating the lord of the gods of gods / with incenses containing agallochum and olibanum, lighting lamps in the ten directions,

6.3.s:
upoṣya jāgaraṃ kuryādgītavādyaṃ viśeṣataḥ .
evaṃ kṛte mahīpāla na bhavedugraduḥkhabhāk .. 197.10 ..
6.3.d:
उपोष्य जागरं कुर्याद्गीतवाद्यं विशेषतः .
एवं कृते महीपाल न भवेदुग्रदुःखभाक् .. 197.10 ..
6.3.m: and keeping a vigil while fasting, especially with song and musical instruments— / when this is done, O protector of the earth, one does not partake of terrible suffering.

6.3.s:
sūryaloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpaśatatrayam .
gandharvairapsarobhiśca sevyamāno nṛpottama .. 197.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mūlasthānatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
सूर्यलोके वसेत्तावद्यावत्कल्पशतत्रयम् .
गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सेव्यमानो नृपोत्तम .. 197.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मूलस्थानतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्तनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
He dwells in the realm of the Sun for as long as three hundred kalpas, / attended by gandharvas and apsarases, O best of kings.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Mūlasthānatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 198
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla bhadrakālītisaṅgamam .
śūlatīrthamiti khyātaṃ svayaṃ devena nirmitam .. 198.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 198
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल भद्रकालीतिसङ्गमम् .
शूलतीर्थमिति ख्यातं स्वयं देवेन निर्मितम् .. 198.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 198
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then one should go, O protector of the earth, to the confluence called Bhadrakālī, / renowned as Śūlatīrtha, fashioned by the god himself.

6.3.s:
pañcāyatanamadhye tu tiṣṭhate parameśvaraḥ .
śūlapāṇirmahādevaḥ sarvadevatapūjitaḥ .. 198.2 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चायतनमध्ये तु तिष्ठते परमेश्वरः .
शूलपाणिर्महादेवः सर्वदेवतपूजितः .. 198.2 ..
6.3.m: In the midst of the pañcāyatana stands the Supreme Lord, / the great god who bears the trident in his hand, worshipped by all the deities.

6.3.s:
sa saṅgamo nṛpaśreṣṭha nityaṃ devairniṣevitaḥ .
darśanāttasya tīrthasya snānadānādviśeṣataḥ .. 198.3 ..
6.3.d:
स सङ्गमो नृपश्रेष्ठ नित्यं देवैर्निषेवितः .
दर्शनात्तस्य तीर्थस्य स्नानदानाद्विशेषतः .. 198.3 ..
6.3.m: That confluence, O best of kings, is perpetually resorted to by the gods. / From the darśana of that sacred ford, and especially from bath and gifting,

6.3.s:
daurbhāgyaṃ durnimittaṃ ca hyabhiśāpo nṛpagrahaḥ .
yadanyadduṣkṛtaṃ karma naśyate śaṅkaro'bravīt .. 198.4 ..
6.3.d:
दौर्भाग्यं दुर्निमित्तं च ह्यभिशापो नृपग्रहः .
यदन्यद्दुष्कृतं कर्म नश्यते शङ्करोऽब्रवीत् .. 198.4 ..
6.3.m: misfortune, ill omens, curses, royal oppression, / and whatever other evil deed there is, are destroyed; so Śaṅkara declared.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kathaṃ śūleśvarī devī kathaṃ śūleśvaro haraḥ .
prathito narmadātīre etadvistarato vada .. 198.5 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
कथं शूलेश्वरी देवी कथं शूलेश्वरो हरः .
प्रथितो नर्मदातीरे एतद्विस्तरतो वद .. 198.5 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How did the goddess become Śūleśvarī? How did Hara become Śūleśvara, / renowned on the bank of the Narmadā? Tell this in detail.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
babhūva brāhmaṇaḥ kaścinmāṇḍavya iti viśrutaḥ .
vṛttimānsarvadharmajñaḥ satye tapasi ca sthitaḥ .. 198.6 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
बभूव ब्राह्मणः कश्चिन्माण्डव्य इति विश्रुतः .
वृत्तिमान्सर्वधर्मज्ञः सत्ये तपसि च स्थितः .. 198.6 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
There was a certain brahmin renowned as Māṇḍavya, / of good conduct, knowing all dharma, steadfast in truth and austerity.

6.3.s:
aśokāśramamadhyastho vṛkṣamūle mahātapāḥ .
ūrdhvabāhurmahātejāstasthau maunavratānvitaḥ .. 198.7 ..
6.3.d:
अशोकाश्रममध्यस्थो वृक्षमूले महातपाः .
ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्महातेजास्तस्थौ मौनव्रतान्वितः .. 198.7 ..
6.3.m: Dwelling in the Aśoka hermitage at the foot of a tree, practicing great austerity, / with raised arms and of great splendour, he remained observing the vow of silence.

6.3.s:
tasya kālena mahatā tīvre tapasi vartataḥ .
tamāśramamanuprāptā dasyavo loptrahāriṇaḥ .. 198.8 ..
6.3.d:
तस्य कालेन महता तीव्रे तपसि वर्ततः .
तमाश्रममनुप्राप्ता दस्यवो लोप्त्रहारिणः .. 198.8 ..
6.3.m: After a long time, while he was engaged in intense austerity, / robbers carrying stolen goods arrived at that hermitage.

6.3.s:
anusarpyamāṇā bahubhiḥ puruṣairbharatarṣabha .
te tasyāvasathe loptraṃ nyadadhuḥ kurunandana .. 198.9 ..
6.3.d:
अनुसर्प्यमाणा बहुभिः पुरुषैर्भरतर्षभ .
ते तस्यावसथे लोप्त्रं न्यदधुः कुरुनन्दन .. 198.9 ..
6.3.m: Being pursued by many men, O bull of the Bharatas, / they deposited the stolen goods in his dwelling, O joy of the Kurus.

6.3.s:
nidhāya ca tadā līnāstatraivāśramamaṇḍale .
teṣu līneṣvatho śīghraṃ tatastadrakṣiṇāṃ balam .. 198.10 ..
6.3.d:
निधाय च तदा लीनास्तत्रैवाश्रममण्डले .
तेषु लीनेष्वथो शीघ्रं ततस्तद्रक्षिणां बलम् .. 198.10 ..
6.3.m: Having hidden them, they concealed themselves right there in the precinct of the hermitage. / While they were hidden, the force of the guards quickly arrived.

6.3.s:
ājagāma tato'paśyaṃstamṛṣiṃ taskarānugāḥ .
tamapṛcchaṃstadā vṛttaṃ rakṣiṇastaṃ tapodhanam .. 198.11 ..
6.3.d:
आजगाम ततोऽपश्यंस्तमृषिं तस्करानुगाः .
तमपृच्छंस्तदा वृत्तं रक्षिणस्तं तपोधनम् .. 198.11 ..
6.3.m: Pursuing the thieves, they then saw that seer. / The guards then questioned that ascetic about what had happened:

6.3.s:
vada kena pathā yātā dasyavo dvijasattama .
tena gacchāmahe brahman yathā śīghrataraṃ vayam .. 198.12 ..
6.3.d:
वद केन पथा याता दस्यवो द्विजसत्तम .
तेन गच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् यथा शीघ्रतरं वयम् .. 198.12 ..
6.3.m: 'Tell [us], by which path did the robbers go, O best of twice-borns? / We shall proceed along that [path], O brahmin, so that we may go more swiftly.'

6.3.s:
tathā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ bruvatāṃ sa tapodhanaḥ .
na kiṃcidvacanaṃ rājannavadatsādhvasādhu vā .. 198.13 ..
6.3.d:
तथा तु वचनं तेषां ब्रुवतां स तपोधनः .
न किंचिद्वचनं राजन्नवदत्साध्वसाधु वा .. 198.13 ..
6.3.m: Although they spoke such words, that ascetic / said nothing, O king, neither good nor bad.

6.3.s:
tataste rājapuruṣā vicinvantastamāśramam .
saṃyamyainaṃ tato rājñe sarvān dasyūnnyavedayan .. 198.14 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्ते राजपुरुषा विचिन्वन्तस्तमाश्रमम् .
संयम्यैनं ततो राज्ञे सर्वान् दस्यून्न्यवेदयन् .. 198.14 ..
6.3.m: Then those royal officers, searching that hermitage, / bound him and delivered all the robbers to the king.

6.3.s:
taṃ rājā sahitaiścorairanvaśādvadhyatāmiti .
sambadhya taṃ ca tairrājañchūle proto mahātapāḥ .. 198.15 ..
6.3.d:
तं राजा सहितैश्चोरैरन्वशाद्वध्यतामिति .
सम्बध्य तं च तैर्राजञ्छूले प्रोतो महातपाः .. 198.15 ..
6.3.m: The king commanded regarding him along with the thieves: 'Let him be put to death.' / Having bound him with them, O king, the practitioner of great austerity was impaled upon a stake.

6.3.s:
tataste śūlamāropya taṃ muniṃ rakṣiṇastadā .
pratijagmurmahīpāla dhanānyādāya tānyatha .. 198.16 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्ते शूलमारोप्य तं मुनिं रक्षिणस्तदा .
प्रतिजग्मुर्महीपाल धनान्यादाय तान्यथ .. 198.16 ..
6.3.m: Then, having impaled that sage upon the stake, the guards / returned, O protector of the earth, taking all those riches.

6.3.s:
śūlasthaḥ sa tu dharmātmā kālena mahatā tadā .
dhyāyandevaṃ trilokeśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tamumāpatim .. 198.17 ..
6.3.d:
शूलस्थः स तु धर्मात्मा कालेन महता तदा .
ध्यायन्देवं त्रिलोकेशं शङ्करं तमुमापतिम् .. 198.17 ..
6.3.m: Remaining on the stake for a long time, that righteous-minded one, / meditating on the god, the lord of the three worlds, Śaṅkara, the lord of Umā,

6.3.s:
bahukālaṃ maheśānaṃ manasādhyāya saṃsthitaḥ .
nirāhāro'pi viprarṣirmaraṇaṃ nābhyapadyata .. 198.18 ..
6.3.d:
बहुकालं महेशानं मनसाध्याय संस्थितः .
निराहारोऽपि विप्रर्षिर्मरणं नाभ्यपद्यत .. 198.18 ..
6.3.m: remained meditating in his mind upon the great lord for a long time. / Even without food, the brahmin-seer did not succumb to death.

6.3.s:
dhārayāmāsa viprāṇāmṛṣabhaḥ sa hṛdā harim .
śūlāgre tapyamānena tapastena kṛtaṃ tadā .. 198.19 ..
6.3.d:
धारयामास विप्राणामृषभः स हृदा हरिम् .
शूलाग्रे तप्यमानेन तपस्तेन कृतं तदा .. 198.19 ..
6.3.m: That bull among brahmins held Hari in his heart; / tormented upon the tip of the stake, he performed austerity at that time.

6.3.s:
santāpaṃ paramaṃ jagmuḥ śrutvaitanmunayo'khilāḥ .
te rātrau śakunā bhūtvā saṃnyavartanta bhārata .. 198.20 ..
6.3.d:
सन्तापं परमं जग्मुः श्रुत्वैतन्मुनयोऽखिलाः .
ते रात्रौ शकुना भूत्वा संन्यवर्तन्त भारत .. 198.20 ..
6.3.m: Hearing this, all the sages experienced great distress; / becoming birds in the night, they assembled around him, O Bharata.

6.3.s:
darśayanto muneḥ śaktiṃ tamapṛcchan dvijottamam .
śrotumicchāma te brahman kiṃ pāpaṃ kṛtavānasi .. 198.21 ..
6.3.d:
दर्शयन्तो मुनेः शक्तिं तमपृच्छन् द्विजोत्तमम् .
श्रोतुमिच्छाम ते ब्रह्मन् किं पापं कृतवानसि .. 198.21 ..
6.3.m: Revealing their power to the sage, they questioned that best of twice-borns: / 'We wish to hear, O brahmin: what sin have you committed?'

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ sa muniśārdūlastānuvāca tapodhanān .
doṣataḥ kiṃ gamiṣyāmi na hi me'nyo parādhyati .. 198.22 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः स मुनिशार्दूलस्तानुवाच तपोधनान् .
दोषतः किं गमिष्यामि न हि मेऽन्यो पराध्यति .. 198.22 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then that tiger among sages said to those ascetics: / 'Whom shall I blame for this fault? Indeed, no other person has wronged me.'

6.3.s:
evamuktvā tataḥ sarvānācacakṣe tato muniḥ .
munayaśca tato rājñe dvitīye'hni nyavedayan .. 198.23 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सर्वानाचचक्षे ततो मुनिः .
मुनयश्च ततो राज्ञे द्वितीयेऽह्नि न्यवेदयन् .. 198.23 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the sage then recounted everything to all of them; / and on the second day, the sages reported it to the king.

6.3.s:
rājā tu tamṛṣiṃ śrutvā niṣkrāntaḥ saha bandhubhiḥ .
prasādayāmāsa tadā śūlasthamṛṣisattamam .. 198.24 ..
6.3.d:
राजा तु तमृषिं श्रुत्वा निष्क्रान्तः सह बन्धुभिः .
प्रसादयामास तदा शूलस्थमृषिसत्तमम् .. 198.24 ..
6.3.m: Hearing of that seer, the king came forth with his kinsmen; / he then propitiated that best of seers impaled upon the stake.

6.3.s:
rājovāca -
yanmayā'pakṛtaṃ tāta tavājñānavaśādbahu .
prasādaye tvāṃ tatrāhaṃ na me tvaṃ kroddhumarhasi .. 198.25 ..
6.3.d:
राजोवाच -
यन्मयाऽपकृतं तात तवाज्ञानवशाद्बहु .
प्रसादये त्वां तत्राहं न मे त्वं क्रोद्धुमर्हसि .. 198.25 ..
6.3.m:
The king said:
'Whatever great wrong I have committed against you through ignorance, father, / for that I propitiate you; you ought not to be angry with me.'

6.3.s:
evamuktastato rājñā prasādamakaronmuniḥ .
kṛtaprasādaṃ rājā taṃ tataḥ samavatārayat .. 198.26 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततो राज्ञा प्रसादमकरोन्मुनिः .
कृतप्रसादं राजा तं ततः समवतारयत् .. 198.26 ..
6.3.m: Thus addressed by the king, the sage granted his favor. / Once he had granted favor, the king brought him down.

6.3.s:
avatīryamāṇastu muniḥ śūle māṃsatvamāgate .
atisaṃpīḍito vipraḥ śaṅkaraṃ manasāgamat .. 198.27 ..
6.3.d:
अवतीर्यमाणस्तु मुनिः शूले मांसत्वमागते .
अतिसंपीडितो विप्रः शङ्करं मनसागमत् .. 198.27 ..
6.3.m: As he was being brought down, since the stake had become embedded in his flesh, / the brahmin was exceedingly tormented, and went in mind to Śaṅkara.

6.3.s:
saṃdhyātaḥ śaṅkarastena bahukālopavāsataḥ .
prādurbhūto mahādevaḥ śūlaṃ tasya tathāchinat .. 198.28 ..
6.3.d:
संध्यातः शङ्करस्तेन बहुकालोपवासतः .
प्रादुर्भूतो महादेवः शूलं तस्य तथाछिनत् .. 198.28 ..
6.3.m: Śaṅkara was contemplated by him through long-standing fasting; / the great god became manifest and severed his stake.

6.3.s:
śūlamūlasthitaḥ śambhustuṣṭaḥ prāha punaḥpunaḥ .
brūhi kiṃ kriyatāṃ vipra sattvasthānaparāyaṇa .. 198.29 ..
6.3.d:
शूलमूलस्थितः शम्भुस्तुष्टः प्राह पुनःपुनः .
ब्रूहि किं क्रियतां विप्र सत्त्वस्थानपरायण .. 198.29 ..
6.3.m:
Standing at the base of the stake, Śambhu was pleased and said repeatedly:
"Speak, what shall be done, O brahmin devoted to remaining in goodness?

6.3.s:
adeyamapi dāsyāmi tuṣṭo'smyadyomayā saha .
kiṃ tu satyavatāṃ loke siddhirna syācca bhūyasī .. 198.30 ..
6.3.d:
अदेयमपि दास्यामि तुष्टोऽस्म्यद्योमया सह .
किं तु सत्यवतां लोके सिद्धिर्न स्याच्च भूयसी .. 198.30 ..
6.3.m:
Even what cannot be given I shall bestow; today I am pleased together with Umā.
Yet, is there not greater fulfillment in the world for those who adhere to truth?

6.3.s:
svakarmaṇo'nurūpaṃ hi phalaṃ bhuñjanti jantavaḥ .
śubhena karmaṇā bhūtirduḥkhaṃ syātpātakena tu .. 198.31 ..
6.3.d:
स्वकर्मणोऽनुरूपं हि फलं भुञ्जन्ति जन्तवः .
शुभेन कर्मणा भूतिर्दुःखं स्यात्पातकेन तु .. 198.31 ..
6.3.m:
For living beings experience the fruit corresponding to their own deeds;
by a good deed comes prosperity, but from sin comes suffering.

6.3.s:
bahubhedaprabhinnaṃ tu manuṣyeṣu vipacyate .
keṣāṃ daridrabhāvena keṣāṃ dhanavipattijam .. 198.32 ..
6.3.d:
बहुभेदप्रभिन्नं तु मनुष्येषु विपच्यते .
केषां दरिद्रभावेन केषां धनविपत्तिजम् .. 198.32 ..
6.3.m:
Divided into many varieties, it ripens among human beings:
for some as poverty, and for some born from the loss of wealth;

6.3.s:
santatyabhāvajaṃ keṣāṃ keṣāṃcittadviparyayaḥ .
tathā durvṛttitasteṣāṃ phalamāvirbhavennṛṇām .. 198.33 ..
6.3.d:
सन्तत्यभावजं केषां केषांचित्तद्विपर्ययः .
तथा दुर्वृत्तितस्तेषां फलमाविर्भवेन्नृणाम् .. 198.33 ..
6.3.m:
for some born from the absence of offspring, and for some its opposite;
likewise from bad conduct the fruit manifests for men;

6.3.s:
keṣāṃcitputramaraṇe viyogātpriyamitrayoḥ .
rājacaurāgnitaḥ keṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ syāddaivanirmitam .. 198.34 ..
6.3.d:
केषांचित्पुत्रमरणे वियोगात्प्रियमित्रयोः .
राजचौराग्नितः केषां दुःखं स्याद्दैवनिर्मितम् .. 198.34 ..
6.3.m:
for some at the death of a son, or from separation from dear friends;
for some there is suffering wrought by fate through kings, thieves, or fire.

6.3.s:
taccharīre tu keṣāṃcitkarmaṇā sampradṛśyate .
jarāśca vividhāḥ keṣāṃ dṛśyante vyādhayastathā .. 198.35 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छरीरे तु केषांचित्कर्मणा सम्प्रदृश्यते .
जराश्च विविधाः केषां दृश्यन्ते व्याधयस्तथा .. 198.35 ..
6.3.m:
In the body of some it is seen through [their own] action;
for some various old-age [infirmities] are seen, and likewise diseases.

6.3.s:
dṛśyante cābhiśāpāśca pūrvakarmānusaṃcitāḥ .
kaṣṭāḥ kaṣṭatarāvasthā gatāḥ kecidanāgasaḥ .. 198.36 ..
6.3.d:
दृश्यन्ते चाभिशापाश्च पूर्वकर्मानुसंचिताः .
कष्टाः कष्टतरावस्था गताः केचिदनागसः .. 198.36 ..
6.3.m:
And curses accumulated according to past deeds are seen;
some, though innocent, have fallen into difficult and most terrible states.

6.3.s:
pūrvakarmavipākena dharmeṇa tapasi sthitāḥ .
dāntāḥ svadāraniratā bhūridāḥ paripūjakāḥ .. 198.37 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्वकर्मविपाकेन धर्मेण तपसि स्थिताः .
दान्ताः स्वदारनिरता भूरिदाः परिपूजकाः .. 198.37 ..
6.3.m:
Through the ripening of past deeds, those established in righteousness and austerity,
self-controlled, devoted to their own wives, generous givers, worshippers,

6.3.s:
hrīmanto nayasaṃyuktā anye bahuguṇairyutāḥ .
durgamāmāpadaṃ prāpya nijakarmasamudbhavām .. 198.38 ..
6.3.d:
ह्रीमन्तो नयसंयुक्ता अन्ये बहुगुणैर्युताः .
दुर्गमामापदं प्राप्य निजकर्मसमुद्भवाम् .. 198.38 ..
6.3.m:
modest, endowed with good conduct, and others possessed of many virtues,
having met with insurmountable misfortune born of their own past actions,

6.3.s:
na saṃjvaranti ye martyā dharmanindāṃ na kurvate .
idameva tapo matvā kṣipanti suvicetasaḥ .. 198.39 ..
6.3.d:
न संज्वरन्ति ये मर्त्या धर्मनिन्दां न कुर्वते .
इदमेव तपो मत्वा क्षिपन्ति सुविचेतसः .. 198.39 ..
6.3.m:
those mortals who do not feverishly lament and do not revile righteousness,
regarding this very [distress] as austerity, endure it with clear minds;

6.3.s:
hā bhrātarmātaḥ putreti kaṣṭeṣu na vadanti ye .
smaranti māṃ maheśānamathavā puṣkarekṣaṇam .. 198.40 ..
6.3.d:
हा भ्रातर्मातः पुत्रेति कष्टेषु न वदन्ति ये .
स्मरन्ति मां महेशानमथवा पुष्करेक्षणम् .. 198.40 ..
6.3.m:
those who do not cry out in hardships, 'Alas, brother! Mother! Son!',
[but] remember Me, the Great Lord, or the Lotus-Eyed [Viṣṇu]—

6.3.s: duṣkṛtaṃ pūrvajaṃ bhoktuṃ dhruvaṃ tadupaśāmyati .. 198.41 ..
6.3.d: दुष्कृतं पूर्वजं भोक्तुं ध्रुवं तदुपशाम्यति .. 198.41 ..
6.3.m: that former bad deed, having to be experienced, is surely completely pacified.

6.3.s:
dināni yāvanti vasetsa kaṣṭe yathākṛtaṃ cintayaddevamīśam .
tāvanti saumyāni kṛtāni tena bhavanti vipra śrutinodanaiṣā .. 198.42 ..
6.3.d:
दिनानि यावन्ति वसेत्स कष्टे यथाकृतं चिन्तयद्देवमीशम् .
तावन्ति सौम्यानि कृतानि तेन भवन्ति विप्र श्रुतिनोदनैषा .. 198.42 ..
6.3.m: For as many days as he may dwell in hardship, meditating upon God, the Lord, in accordance with what he has done, / so many [days] are rendered benign by Him; O brahmin, this is the command of the Veda.

6.3.s:
yasmāttvayā kaṣṭagatena nityaṃ smṛtaścāhaṃ manasā pūjitaśca .
gaurīsahāyastena ihāgato'smi brūhyadya kṛtyaṃ kriyatāṃ kiṃ nu vipra .. 198.43 ..
6.3.d:
यस्मात्त्वया कष्टगतेन नित्यं स्मृतश्चाहं मनसा पूजितश्च .
गौरीसहायस्तेन इहागतोऽस्मि ब्रूह्यद्य कृत्यं क्रियतां किं नु विप्र .. 198.43 ..
6.3.m: Because I have been constantly remembered and worshipped in mind by you while you were in distress, / therefore I, accompanied by Gaurī, have come here; tell me now what is to be done, what indeed may be done, O brahmin?"

6.3.s:
māṇḍavya uvāca -
tuṣṭo yadyumayā sārdhaṃ varado yadi śaṅkara .
tadā me śūlasaṃsthasya saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ vada .. 198.44 ..
6.3.d:
माण्डव्य उवाच -
तुष्टो यद्युमया सार्धं वरदो यदि शङ्कर .
तदा मे शूलसंस्थस्य संशयं परमं वद .. 198.44 ..
6.3.m:
Māṇḍavya said:
"If you are pleased together with Umā, if you grant boons, O Śaṅkara,
then resolve a supreme doubt of mine, situated on the stake:

6.3.s:
na rujā mama kāpi syācchūlasaṃprotite'gake .
amṛtasrāvi tacchūlaṃ prabhāvātkasya śaṃsa me .. 198.45 ..
6.3.d:
न रुजा मम कापि स्याच्छूलसंप्रोतितेऽगके .
अमृतस्रावि तच्छूलं प्रभावात्कस्य शंस मे .. 198.45 ..
6.3.m:
No pain at all has arisen in me, though my limbs are impaled on the stake;
that stake is dripping with nectar; tell me, by whose power is this?"

6.3.s:
śrīśūlapāṇiruvāca -
śūlasthena tvayā vipra manasā cintito'smi yat .
anayānāṃ nihantāhaṃ duḥkhānāṃ vinibarhaṇaḥ .. 198.46 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीशूलपाणिरुवाच -
शूलस्थेन त्वया विप्र मनसा चिन्तितोऽस्मि यत् .
अनयानां निहन्ताहं दुःखानां विनिबर्हणः .. 198.46 ..
6.3.m:
The Lord with the Trident in Hand said:
"Because, while situated on the stake, you meditated on Me in your mind, O brahmin—
I am the destroyer of misfortunes, the dispeller of sorrows.

6.3.s:
dhyātamātro hyahaṃ vipra pātāle vāpi saṃsthitaḥ .
śūlamūle tvahaṃ śambhuragre devī svayaṃ sthitā .
jaganmātāmbikā devī tvāmṛtenānvapūrayat .. 198.47 ..
6.3.d:
ध्यातमात्रो ह्यहं विप्र पाताले वापि संस्थितः .
शूलमूले त्वहं शम्भुरग्रे देवी स्वयं स्थिता .
जगन्माताम्बिका देवी त्वामृतेनान्वपूरयत् .. 198.47 ..
6.3.m: For merely upon being meditated upon, O brahmin, even if situated in Pātāla, / I, Śambhu, was at the base of the stake, and the Goddess herself stood at the tip; / Goddess Ambikā, Mother of the Universe, filled you with nectar."

6.3.s:
māṇḍavya uvāca -
pūrvameva sthito yasmācchūlaṃ vyāpyomayā saha .
prasādapravaṇo mahyamidānīṃ cānayā saha .. 198.48 ..
6.3.d:
माण्डव्य उवाच -
पूर्वमेव स्थितो यस्माच्छूलं व्याप्योमया सह .
प्रसादप्रवणो मह्यमिदानीं चानया सह .. 198.48 ..
6.3.m:
Māṇḍavya said:
"Since you were already present, pervading the stake together with Umā,
and are now disposed to show grace to me together with Her,

6.3.s:
yasyāḥ saṃsmaraṇādeva daurbhāgyaṃ pralayaṃ vrajet .
na daurbhāgyātparaṃ loke duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ kila .. 198.49 ..
6.3.d:
यस्याः संस्मरणादेव दौर्भाग्यं प्रलयं व्रजेत् .
न दौर्भाग्यात्परं लोके दुःखाद्दुःखतरं किल .. 198.49 ..
6.3.m:
from the mere remembrance of whom misfortune comes to destruction—
indeed, there is no sorrow in the world worse than misfortune;

6.3.s:
kilaivaṃ śrūyate gāthā purāṇeṣu surottama .
trailokyaṃ dahatastubhyaṃ saubhāgyamekatāṃ gatam .. 198.50 ..
6.3.d:
किलैवं श्रूयते गाथा पुराणेषु सुरोत्तम .
त्रैलोक्यं दहतस्तुभ्यं सौभाग्यमेकतां गतम् .. 198.50 ..
6.3.m:
indeed, such an account is heard in the Purāṇas, O best of gods:
when you were burning the three worlds, good fortune merged into one;

6.3.s:
viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalaṃ prāpya tatsthitaṃ ceti naḥ śrutam .
pītaṃ tadvakṣasastrastadakṣeṇa parameṣṭhinā .. 198.51 ..
6.3.d:
विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थलं प्राप्य तत्स्थितं चेति नः श्रुतम् .
पीतं तद्वक्षसस्त्रस्तदक्षेण परमेष्ठिना .. 198.51 ..
6.3.m:
reaching the chest of Viṣṇu, it remained there, so we have heard;
frightened of his chest, it was drunk by Dakṣa, the supreme lord;

6.3.s:
tasmātsatīti saṃjajña iyamindīvarekṣaṇā .
yajatastasya deveśa tava mānāvakhaṇḍanāt .. 198.52 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सतीति संजज्ञ इयमिन्दीवरेक्षणा .
यजतस्तस्य देवेश तव मानावखण्डनात् .. 198.52 ..
6.3.m:
from him she was born as Satī, this blue-lotus-eyed one;
while he was sacrificing, O Lord of Gods, because of the insult to your honor,

6.3.s:
juhāvāgnau tu sā devī hyātmānaṃ prāṇasaṃjñikam .
ātmānaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā prāleyādrestataḥ sutā .. 198.53 ..
6.3.d:
जुहावाग्नौ तु सा देवी ह्यात्मानं प्राणसंज्ञिकम् .
आत्मानं भस्मसात्कृत्वा प्रालेयाद्रेस्ततः सुता .. 198.53 ..
6.3.m:
that Goddess offered herself, called the vital breath, into the fire;
having reduced herself to ashes, she then [became] the daughter of the Snowy Mountain,

6.3.s:
menakāyāṃ prabho jātā sāmprataṃ yā hyumābhidhā .
anādinidhanā devī hyapratarkyā sureśvara .. 198.54 ..
6.3.d:
मेनकायां प्रभो जाता साम्प्रतं या ह्युमाभिधा .
अनादिनिधना देवी ह्यप्रतर्क्या सुरेश्वर .. 198.54 ..
6.3.m:
born of Menakā, O Lord, who is now named Umā;
the Goddess has neither beginning nor end, and is beyond contemplation, O Lord of Gods.

6.3.s:
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa hyumā me varadā yadi .
ubhāvapyatra vai sthāne sthitau śūlāgramūlayoḥ .. 198.55 ..
6.3.d:
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश ह्युमा मे वरदा यदि .
उभावप्यत्र वै स्थाने स्थितौ शूलाग्रमूलयोः .. 198.55 ..
6.3.m:
If you are pleased, O Lord of Gods, and if Umā grants me a boon:
both of you are indeed stationed in this place, at the tip and base of the stake;

6.3.s: avatāro yatra tatra saṃsthitiṃ vai tataḥ kuru .. 198.56 ..
6.3.d: अवतारो यत्र तत्र संस्थितिं वै ततः कुरु .. 198.56 ..
6.3.m: wherever the descent is, establish your presence permanently right there."

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tenaivamukte sahasā kṛtvā bhūmaṇḍalaṃ dvidhā .
niḥsṛtau śūlamūlāgrālliṅgārcāpratirūpiṇau .. 198.57 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तेनैवमुक्ते सहसा कृत्वा भूमण्डलं द्विधा .
निःसृतौ शूलमूलाग्राल्लिङ्गार्चाप्रतिरूपिणौ .. 198.57 ..
6.3.m:
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
When he had spoken thus, suddenly cleaving the earth in two,
two forms, an image and a liṅga, came forth from the base and the tip of the stake.

6.3.s:
pradyotayaddiśaḥ sarvā liṅgaṃ mūle pradṛśyate .
vāmataḥ pratimā devī tadā śūleśvarī sthitā .. 198.58 ..
6.3.d:
प्रद्योतयद्दिशः सर्वा लिङ्गं मूले प्रदृश्यते .
वामतः प्रतिमा देवी तदा शूलेश्वरी स्थिता .. 198.58 ..
6.3.m:
Illuminating all the directions, a liṅga was seen at the base;
on the left stood the image, the Goddess, Śūleśvarī,

6.3.s:
vilobhayantī ca jagadbhāti pūrayatī diśaḥ .
dṛṣṭvā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ stutiṃ cakre dvijottamaḥ .. 198.59 ..
6.3.d:
विलोभयन्ती च जगद्भाति पूरयती दिशः .
दृष्ट्वा कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्तुतिं चक्रे द्विजोत्तमः .. 198.59 ..
6.3.m:
enchanting the world, shining, and filling the directions;
seeing it, the best of twice-born folded his hands in reverence and offered praise.

6.3.s:
māṇḍavya uvāca -
tvamasya jagato mātā jagatsaubhāgyadevatā .
na tvayā rahitaṃ kiṃcidbrahmāṇḍe'sti varānane .. 198.60 ..
6.3.d:
माण्डव्य उवाच -
त्वमस्य जगतो माता जगत्सौभाग्यदेवता .
न त्वया रहितं किंचिद्ब्रह्माण्डेऽस्ति वरानने .. 198.60 ..

6.3.s:
prasādaṃ kuru dharmajñe mama tvājñaptumarhasi .
īdṛśenaiva rūpeṇa keṣu sthāneṣu tiṣṭhasi .
prasādapravaṇā bhūtvā vada tāni maheśvari .. 198.61 ..
6.3.d:
प्रसादं कुरु धर्मज्ञे मम त्वाज्ञप्तुमर्हसि .
ईदृशेनैव रूपेण केषु स्थानेषु तिष्ठसि .
प्रसादप्रवणा भूत्वा वद तानि महेश्वरि .. 198.61 ..
6.3.m:
Grant your grace, O knower of righteousness; you should instruct me:
in which places do you abide in this very form?
Being disposed to show grace, speak of them, O Great Goddess!"

6.3.s:
śrīdevyuvāca -
sarvagā sarvabhūteṣu draṣṭavyā sarvato bhuvi .
sarvalokeṣu yatkiṃcidvihitaṃ na mayā vinā .. 198.62 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीदेव्युवाच -
सर्वगा सर्वभूतेषु द्रष्टव्या सर्वतो भुवि .
सर्वलोकेषु यत्किंचिद्विहितं न मया विना .. 198.62 ..

6.3.s:
tathāpi yeṣu sthāneṣu draṣṭavyā siddhimīpsubhiḥ .
smartavyā bhūtikāmena tāni vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ .. 198.63 ..
6.3.d:
तथापि येषु स्थानेषु द्रष्टव्या सिद्धिमीप्सुभिः .
स्मर्तव्या भूतिकामेन तानि वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वतः .. 198.63 ..
6.3.m:
Nevertheless, in which places I am to be seen by those desiring perfection
and remembered by one desiring prosperity, those I will declare in truth.

6.3.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī naimiṣe liṅgadhāriṇī .
prayāge lalitā devī kāmukā gandhamādane .. 198.64 ..
6.3.d:
वाराणस्यां विशालाक्षी नैमिषे लिङ्गधारिणी .
प्रयागे ललिता देवी कामुका गन्धमादने .. 198.64 ..
6.3.m:
In Vārāṇasī [I am] Viśālākṣī; in Naimiṣa, Liṅgadhāriṇī;
in Prayāga, Goddess Lalitā; on Gandhamādana, Kāmukā;

6.3.s:
mānase kumudā nāma viśvakāyā tathā'pare .
gomante gomatī nāma mandare kāmacāriṇī .. 198.65 ..
6.3.d:
मानसे कुमुदा नाम विश्वकाया तथाऽपरे .
गोमन्ते गोमती नाम मन्दरे कामचारिणी .. 198.65 ..
6.3.m:
at Mānasa, Kumudā by name; Viśvakāyā likewise in another;
on Gomanta, Gomatī by name; on Mandara, Kāmacāriṇī;

6.3.s:
madotkaṭā caitrarathe hayantī hāstine pure .
kānyakubje sthitā gaurī rambhā hyamalaparvate .. 198.66 ..
6.3.d:
मदोत्कटा चैत्ररथे हयन्ती हास्तिने पुरे .
कान्यकुब्जे स्थिता गौरी रम्भा ह्यमलपर्वते .. 198.66 ..
6.3.m:
Madotkaṭā in Caitraratha; Hayantī in the city of Hāstina;
at Kānyakubja resides Gaurī; Rambhā indeed on Amala Mountain;

6.3.s:
ekāmrake kīrtimatī viśvāṃ viśveśvare viduḥ .
puṣkare puruhūtā ca kedāre mārgadāyinī .. 198.67 ..
6.3.d:
एकाम्रके कीर्तिमती विश्वां विश्वेश्वरे विदुः .
पुष्करे पुरुहूता च केदारे मार्गदायिनी .. 198.67 ..
6.3.m:
in Ekāmraka, Kīrtimatī; in Viśveśvara they know [me as] Viśvā;
at Puṣkara, Puruhūtā; and at Kedāra, Mārgadāyinī;

6.3.s:
nandā himavataḥ prasthe gokarṇe bhadrakarṇikā .
sthāneśvare bhavānī tu bilvake bilvapattrikā .. 198.68 ..
6.3.d:
नन्दा हिमवतः प्रस्थे गोकर्णे भद्रकर्णिका .
स्थानेश्वरे भवानी तु बिल्वके बिल्वपत्त्रिका .. 198.68 ..
6.3.m:
Nandā on the plateau of the Himavat; Bhadrakarṇikā at Gokarṇa;
Bhavānī at Sthāneśvara; Bilvapattrikā at Bilvaka;

6.3.s:
śrīśaile mādhavī nāma bhadre bhadreśvarīti ca .
jayā varāhaśaile tu kamalā kamalālaye .. 198.69 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीशैले माधवी नाम भद्रे भद्रेश्वरीति च .
जया वराहशैले तु कमला कमलालये .. 198.69 ..
6.3.m:
Mādhavī by name on Śrīśaila; and Bhadreśvarī at Bhadra;
Jayā on Varāha Mountain; Kamalā in Kamalālaya;

6.3.s:
rudrakoṭyāṃ tu kalyāṇī kālī kālañjare tathā .
mahāliṅge tu kapilā mākoṭe mukuṭeśvarī .. 198.70 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रकोट्यां तु कल्याणी काली कालञ्जरे तथा .
महालिङ्गे तु कपिला माकोटे मुकुटेश्वरी .. 198.70 ..
6.3.m:
Kalyāṇī at Rudrakoṭi; likewise Kālī at Kālañjara;
Kapilā at Mahāliṅga; Mukuṭeśvarī at Mākoṭa;

6.3.s:
śāligrāme mahādevī śivaliṅge jalapriyā .
māyāpuryāṃ kumārī tu saṃtāne lalitā tathā .. 198.71 ..
6.3.d:
शालिग्रामे महादेवी शिवलिङ्गे जलप्रिया .
मायापुर्यां कुमारी तु संताने ललिता तथा .. 198.71 ..
6.3.m: In Śāligrāma [she is known as] Mahādevī, in Śivaliṅga as Jalapriyā, / in Māyāpurī as Kumārī, and in Saṃtāna as Lalitā.

6.3.s:
utpalākṣī sahasrākṣe hiraṇyākṣe mahotpalā .
gayāyāṃ vimalā nāma maṅgalā puruṣottame .. 198.72 ..
6.3.d:
उत्पलाक्षी सहस्राक्षे हिरण्याक्षे महोत्पला .
गयायां विमला नाम मङ्गला पुरुषोत्तमे .. 198.72 ..
6.3.m: In Sahasrākṣa [she is] Utpalākṣī, in Hiraṇyākṣa Mahotpalā, / in Gayā named Vimalā, and in Puruṣottama Maṅgalā.

6.3.s:
vipāśāyāmamoghākṣī pāṭalā puṇḍravardhane .
nārāyaṇī supārśve tu trikūṭe bhadrasundarī .. 198.73 ..
6.3.d:
विपाशायाममोघाक्षी पाटला पुण्ड्रवर्धने .
नारायणी सुपार्श्वे तु त्रिकूटे भद्रसुन्दरी .. 198.73 ..
6.3.m: At the Vipāśā Amoghākṣī, in Puṇḍravardhana Pāṭalā, / Nārāyaṇī in Supārśva, and in Trikūṭa Bhadrasundarī.

6.3.s:
vipule vipulā nāma kalyāṇī malayācale .
koṭavī koṭitīrtheṣu sugandhā gandhamādane .. 198.74 ..
6.3.d:
विपुले विपुला नाम कल्याणी मलयाचले .
कोटवी कोटितीर्थेषु सुगन्धा गन्धमादने .. 198.74 ..
6.3.m: In Vipula named Vipulā, Kalyāṇī on Mount Malaya, / Koṭavī at the Koṭitīrthas, and Sugandhā on Mount Gandhamādana.

6.3.s:
godāśrame trisandhyā tu gaṅgādvāre ratipriyā .
śivacaṇḍe sabhānandā nandinī devikātaṭe .. 198.75 ..
6.3.d:
गोदाश्रमे त्रिसन्ध्या तु गङ्गाद्वारे रतिप्रिया .
शिवचण्डे सभानन्दा नन्दिनी देविकातटे .. 198.75 ..
6.3.m: At Godāśrama [she is] Trisandhyā, at Gaṅgādvāra Ratipriyā, / in Śivacaṇḍa Sabhānandā, and Nandinī on the bank of the Devikā.

6.3.s:
rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ tu rādhā vṛndāvane vane .
devakī mathurāyāṃ tu pātāle parameśvarī .. 198.76 ..
6.3.d:
रुक्मिणी द्वारवत्यां तु राधा वृन्दावने वने .
देवकी मथुरायां तु पाताले परमेश्वरी .. 198.76 ..
6.3.m: Rukmiṇī in Dvāravatī, Rādhā in the forest of Vṛndāvana, / Devakī in Mathurā, and Parameśvarī in Pātāla.

6.3.s:
citrakūṭe tathā sītā vindhye vindhyanivāsinī .
sahyādrāvekavīrā tu hariścandre tu caṇḍikā .. 198.77 ..
6.3.d:
चित्रकूटे तथा सीता विन्ध्ये विन्ध्यनिवासिनी .
सह्याद्रावेकवीरा तु हरिश्चन्द्रे तु चण्डिका .. 198.77 ..
6.3.m: Likewise Sītā in Citrakūṭa, Vindhyanivāsinī in the Vindhya, / Ekavīrā in the Sahyādri, and Caṇḍikā in Hariścandra.

6.3.s:
ramaṇā rāmatīrthe tu yamunāyāṃ mṛgāvatī .
karavīre mahālakṣmī rūpādevī vināyake .. 198.78 ..
6.3.d:
रमणा रामतीर्थे तु यमुनायां मृगावती .
करवीरे महालक्ष्मी रूपादेवी विनायके .. 198.78 ..
6.3.m: Ramaṇā at Rāmatīrtha, Mṛgāvatī at the Yamunā, / Mahālakṣmī in Karavīra, and Rūpādevī in Vināyaka.

6.3.s:
ārogyā vaidyanāthe tu mahākāle maheśvarī .
abhayetyuṣṇatīrthe tu mṛgī vā vindhyakandare .. 198.79 ..
6.3.d:
आरोग्या वैद्यनाथे तु महाकाले महेश्वरी .
अभयेत्युष्णतीर्थे तु मृगी वा विन्ध्यकन्दरे .. 198.79 ..
6.3.m: Ārogyā at Vaidyanātha, Maheśvarī at Mahākāla, / Abhayā at Uṣṇatīrtha, and Mṛgī in the cave of the Vindhya.

6.3.s:
māṇḍavye māṇḍukī nāma svāhā māheśvare pure .
chāgaliṅge pracaṇḍā tu caṇḍikāmarakaṇṭake .. 198.80 ..
6.3.d:
माण्डव्ये माण्डुकी नाम स्वाहा माहेश्वरे पुरे .
छागलिङ्गे प्रचण्डा तु चण्डिकामरकण्टके .. 198.80 ..
6.3.m: Named Māṇḍukī in Māṇḍavya, Svāhā in Māheśvarapura, / Pracaṇḍā in Chāgaliṅga, and Caṇḍikā at Amarakaṇṭaka.

6.3.s:
someśvare varārohā prabhāse puṣkarāvatī .
vedamātā sarasvatyāṃ pārā pārātaṭe mune .. 198.81 ..
6.3.d:
सोमेश्वरे वरारोहा प्रभासे पुष्करावती .
वेदमाता सरस्वत्यां पारा पारातटे मुने .. 198.81 ..
6.3.m: Varārohā at Someśvara, Puṣkarāvatī at Prabhāsa, / Vedamātā at the Sarasvatī, and Pārā on the bank of the Pārā, O sage.

6.3.s:
mahālaye mahābhāgā payoṣṇyāṃ piṅgaleśvarī .
siṃhikā kṛtaśauce tu kartike caiva śāṃkarī .. 198.82 ..
6.3.d:
महालये महाभागा पयोष्ण्यां पिङ्गलेश्वरी .
सिंहिका कृतशौचे तु कर्तिके चैव शांकरी .. 198.82 ..
6.3.m: Mahābhāgā at Mahālaya, Piṅgaleśvarī at the Payoṣṇī, / Siṃhikā at Kṛtaśauca, and Śāṅkarī in Kārtika.

6.3.s:
utpalāvartake lolā subhadrā śoṇasaṅgame .
matā siddhavaṭe lakṣmīstaraṃgā bhāratāśrame .. 198.83 ..
6.3.d:
उत्पलावर्तके लोला सुभद्रा शोणसङ्गमे .
मता सिद्धवटे लक्ष्मीस्तरंगा भारताश्रमे .. 198.83 ..
6.3.m: Lolā at Utpalāvartaka, Subhadrā at the confluence of the Śoṇa, / considered Lakṣmī at Siddhavaṭa, and Taraṅgā at Bhāratāśrama.

6.3.s:
jālandhare viśvamukhī tārā kiṣkindhaparvate .
devadāruvane puṣṭirmedhā kāśmīramaṇḍale .. 198.84 ..
6.3.d:
जालन्धरे विश्वमुखी तारा किष्किन्धपर्वते .
देवदारुवने पुष्टिर्मेधा काश्मीरमण्डले .. 198.84 ..
6.3.m: Viśvamukhī in Jālandhara, Tārā on Mount Kiṣkindha, / Puṣṭi in the Devadāru forest, and Medhā in the region of Kāśmīra.

6.3.s:
bhīmādevī himādrau tu puṣṭirvastreśvare tathā .
kapālamocane śuddhirmātā kāyāvarohaṇe .. 198.85 ..
6.3.d:
भीमादेवी हिमाद्रौ तु पुष्टिर्वस्त्रेश्वरे तथा .
कपालमोचने शुद्धिर्माता कायावरोहणे .. 198.85 ..
6.3.m: Bhīmādevī on the Himālaya, and Puṣṭi at Vastreśvara, / Śuddhi at Kapālamocana, and Mātā at Kāyāvarohaṇa.

6.3.s:
śaṅkhoddhāre dhvanirnāma dhṛtiḥ piṇḍārake tathā .
kālā tu candrabhāgāyāmacchode śaktidhāriṇī .. 198.86 ..
6.3.d:
शङ्खोद्धारे ध्वनिर्नाम धृतिः पिण्डारके तथा .
काला तु चन्द्रभागायामच्छोदे शक्तिधारिणी .. 198.86 ..
6.3.m: Named Dhvani at Śaṅkhoddhāra, and Dhṛti at Piṇḍāraka, / Kālā at the Candrabhāgā, and Śaktidhāriṇī at Acchoda.

6.3.s:
veṇāyāmamṛtā nāma badaryāmurvaśī tathā .
oṣadhī cottarakurau kuśadvīpe kuśodakā .. 198.87 ..
6.3.d:
वेणायाममृता नाम बदर्यामुर्वशी तथा .
ओषधी चोत्तरकुरौ कुशद्वीपे कुशोदका .. 198.87 ..
6.3.m: Named Amṛtā at the Veṇā, and Urvaśī at Badarī, / Oṣadhī in Uttarakuru, and Kuśodakā in Kuśadvīpa.

6.3.s:
manmathā hemakūṭe tu kumude satyavādinī .
aśvatthe vandinīkā tu nidhirvaiśravaṇālaye .. 198.88 ..
6.3.d:
मन्मथा हेमकूटे तु कुमुदे सत्यवादिनी .
अश्वत्थे वन्दिनीका तु निधिर्वैश्रवणालये .. 198.88 ..
6.3.m: Manmathā on Mount Hemakūṭa, Satyavādinī in Kumuda, / Vandinīkā in the Aśvattha tree, and Nidhi in the abode of Vaiśravaṇa.

6.3.s:
gāyatrī vedavadane pārvatī śivasannidhau .
devaloke tathendrāṇī brahmāsye tu sarasvatī .. 198.89 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्री वेदवदने पार्वती शिवसन्निधौ .
देवलोके तथेन्द्राणी ब्रह्मास्ये तु सरस्वती .. 198.89 ..
6.3.m: Gāyatrī in the mouth of the Veda, Pārvatī in the presence of Śiva, / Indrāṇī in the heavenly realm, and Sarasvatī in the mouth of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
sūryabimbe prabhā nāma mātṝṇāṃ vaiṣṇavī matā .
arundhatī satīnāṃ tu rāmāsu ca tilottamā .. 198.90 ..
6.3.d:
सूर्यबिम्बे प्रभा नाम मातॄणां वैष्णवी मता .
अरुन्धती सतीनां तु रामासु च तिलोत्तमा .. 198.90 ..
6.3.m: Known as Prabhā in the sun's orb, as Vaiṣṇavī among the Mothers, / Arundhatī among chaste wives, and Tilottamā among beautiful women.

6.3.s:
citre brahmakalā nāma śaktiḥ sarvaśarīriṇām .
śūleśvarī bhṛgukṣetre bhṛgau saubhāgyasundarī .. 198.91 ..
6.3.d:
चित्रे ब्रह्मकला नाम शक्तिः सर्वशरीरिणाम् .
शूलेश्वरी भृगुक्षेत्रे भृगौ सौभाग्यसुन्दरी .. 198.91 ..
6.3.m: Named Brahmakalā in the soul, the power of all embodied beings, / Śūleśvarī in Bhṛgukṣetra, and Saubhāgyasundarī in Bhṛgu.

6.3.s:
etaduddeśataḥ proktaṃ nāmāṣṭaśatamuttamam .
aṣṭottaraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ śatametadudāhṛtam .. 198.92 ..
6.3.d:
एतदुद्देशतः प्रोक्तं नामाष्टशतमुत्तमम् .
अष्टोत्तरं च तीर्थानां शतमेतदुदाहृतम् .. 198.92 ..
6.3.m: Thus the supreme one hundred and eight names have been proclaimed in brief; / and these one hundred and eight sacred fords have been enumerated.

6.3.s:
idameva paraṃ vipra sarveṣāṃ tu bhaviṣyati .
paṭhatyaṣṭottaraśataṃ nāmnāṃ yaḥ śivasannidhau .. 198.93 ..
6.3.d:
इदमेव परं विप्र सर्वेषां तु भविष्यति .
पठत्यष्टोत्तरशतं नाम्नां यः शिवसन्निधौ .. 198.93 ..
6.3.m: This indeed will be the highest [benefit] for all, O brahmin: / whoever recites the one hundred and eight names in the presence of Śiva,

6.3.s:
sa mucyate naraḥ pāpaiḥ prāpnoti striyamīpsitām .
snātvā nārī tṛtīyāyāṃ māṃ samabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ .. 198.94 ..
6.3.d:
स मुच्यते नरः पापैः प्राप्नोति स्त्रियमीप्सिताम् .
स्नात्वा नारी तृतीयायां मां समभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः .. 198.94 ..
6.3.m: that man is freed from sins and obtains the woman he desires. / Having bathed on the third lunar day and having worshipped me with devotion,

6.3.s:
na sā syādduḥkhinī jātu matprabhāvānnarottama .
nityaṃ maddarśane nārī niyatāyā bhaviṣyati .. 198.95 ..
6.3.d:
न सा स्याद्दुःखिनी जातु मत्प्रभावान्नरोत्तम .
नित्यं मद्दर्शने नारी नियताया भविष्यति .. 198.95 ..
6.3.m: she shall never experience sorrow, O best of men, through my power. / The woman who is constantly devoted to darśana of me,

6.3.s:
patiputrakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ na sā prāpsyati karhicit .
madālaye tu yā nārī tulāpuruṣasaṃjñitam .. 198.96 ..
6.3.d:
पतिपुत्रकृतं दुःखं न सा प्राप्स्यति कर्हिचित् .
मदालये तु या नारी तुलापुरुषसंज्ञितम् .. 198.96 ..
6.3.m: she shall never meet with grief caused by husband or son. / Moreover, whatever woman in my temple, having performed the [rite] called tulāpuruṣa,

6.3.s:
sampūjya maṇḍayeddevāṃllokapālāṃśca sāgnikān .
sapatnīkāndvijānpūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā .. 198.97 ..
6.3.d:
सम्पूज्य मण्डयेद्देवांल्लोकपालांश्च साग्निकान् .
सपत्नीकान्द्विजान्पूज्य वासोभिर्भूषणैस्तथा .. 198.97 ..
6.3.m: having worshipped, should adorn the gods and the world-protectors along with Agni, / and having honoured the brahmins together with their wives with garments and ornaments,

6.3.s:
bhūtebhyastu baliṃ dadyādṛtvigbhiḥ saha deśikaḥ .
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tulāmityabhimantrayet .. 198.98 ..
6.3.d:
भूतेभ्यस्तु बलिं दद्यादृत्विग्भिः सह देशिकः .
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तुलामित्यभिमन्त्रयेत् .. 198.98 ..
6.3.m: the priest, together with the officiants, should make an offering to the spirits; / then, having circumambulated [the balance], he should consecrate the balance with mantras thus:

6.3.s:
śuciraktāmbaro vā syādgṛhītvā kusumāñjalim .
namaste sarvadevānāṃ śaktistvaṃ paramā sthitā .. 198.99 ..
6.3.d:
शुचिरक्ताम्बरो वा स्याद्गृहीत्वा कुसुमाञ्जलिम् .
नमस्ते सर्वदेवानां शक्तिस्त्वं परमा स्थिता .. 198.99 ..
6.3.m: Either [the worshipper], pure and wearing red garments, holding an añjali of flowers, [shall say]: / 'Homage to you! You stand as the supreme power of all the gods,

6.3.s:
sākṣibhūtā jagaddhātrī nirmitā viśvayoninā .
tvaṃ tule sarvabhūtānāṃ pramāṇamiha kīrtitā .. 198.100 ..
6.3.d:
साक्षिभूता जगद्धात्री निर्मिता विश्वयोनिना .
त्वं तुले सर्वभूतानां प्रमाणमिह कीर्तिता .. 198.100 ..
6.3.m: serving as the witness, the sustainer of the world, fashioned by the Source of the Universe. / You, O balance, are proclaimed here as the standard of measure for all beings!'

6.3.s:
karābhyāṃ baddhamuṣṭibhyāmāste paśyannumāmukham .
tato'pare tulābhāgenyaseyurdvijapuṃgavāḥ .. 198.101 ..
6.3.d:
कराभ्यां बद्धमुष्टिभ्यामास्ते पश्यन्नुमामुखम् .
ततोऽपरे तुलाभागेन्यसेयुर्द्विजपुंगवाः .. 198.101 ..
6.3.m: With clenched fists in both hands, one sits looking upon Umā's face; / then, in the other pan of the balance, the eminent brahmins should place

6.3.s:
dravyamaṣṭavidhaṃ tatra hyātmavittānusārataḥ .
mandaśabhūte viprendra pṛthivyāṃ yadadhiṣṭhitam .. 198.102 ..
6.3.d:
द्रव्यमष्टविधं तत्र ह्यात्मवित्तानुसारतः .
मन्दशभूते विप्रेन्द्र पृथिव्यां यदधिष्ठितम् .. 198.102 ..
