6.3.m: eight kinds of substances there, according to one's own wealth, / which exist on the earth in the form of property, O chief of brahmins:

6.3.s:
suvarṇaṃ caiva niṣpāvāṃstathā rājikusumbhakam .
tṛṇarājendulavaṇaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tu tathāṣṭamam .. 198.103 ..
6.3.d:
सुवर्णं चैव निष्पावांस्तथा राजिकुसुम्भकम् .
तृणराजेन्दुलवणं कुङ्कुमं तु तथाष्टमम् .. 198.103 ..
6.3.m: gold, beans, wild mustard, safflower, / coconut, camphor, salt, and saffron as the eighth.

6.3.s:
eṣāmekatamaṃ kuryādyathā vittānusārataḥ .
sāmyādabhyadhikaṃ yāvatkāñcanādi bhaveddvija .. 198.104 ..
6.3.d:
एषामेकतमं कुर्याद्यथा वित्तानुसारतः .
साम्यादभ्यधिकं यावत्काञ्चनादि भवेद्द्विज .. 198.104 ..
6.3.m: One should use one of these according to one's wealth, / until the gold and other goods exceed the balance [of the person's weight], O brahmin.

6.3.s:
tāvattiṣṭhennaro nārī paścādidamudīrayet .
namo namaste lalite tulāpuruṣasaṃjñite .. 198.105 ..
6.3.d:
तावत्तिष्ठेन्नरो नारी पश्चादिदमुदीरयेत् .
नमो नमस्ते ललिते तुलापुरुषसंज्ञिते .. 198.105 ..
6.3.m: So long the man or woman should sit [there], and afterwards recite this: / 'Homage, homage to you, O Lalitā, designated as the balance-man!

6.3.s:
tvamume tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārakardamāt .
tato'vatīrya murave pūrvamarddhaṃ nivedayet .. 198.106 ..
6.3.d:
त्वमुमे तारयस्वास्मानस्मात्संसारकर्दमात् .
ततोऽवतीर्य मुरवे पूर्वमर्द्धं निवेदयेत् .. 198.106 ..
6.3.m: Do you, O Umā, deliver us from this mire of worldly existence!' / Then, stepping down, he should offer the first half to the guru,

6.3.s:
ṛtvigbhyo'paramarddhaṃ ca dadyādudakapūrvakam .
tebhyo labdhā tato'nujñāṃ dadyādanyeṣu cārthiṣu .. 198.107 ..
6.3.d:
ऋत्विग्भ्योऽपरमर्द्धं च दद्यादुदकपूर्वकम् .
तेभ्यो लब्धा ततोऽनुज्ञां दद्यादन्येषु चार्थिषु .. 198.107 ..
6.3.m: and the other half to the officiants, accompanied with [the pouring of] water. / Then, having obtained permission from them, he may give to other suppliants.

6.3.s:
sapatnīkaṃ guruṃ raktavāsasī paridhāpayet .
anyāṃśca ṛtvijaḥ śaktyā guruṃ keyūrakaṅkaṇaiḥ .. 198.108 ..
6.3.d:
सपत्नीकं गुरुं रक्तवाससी परिधापयेत् .
अन्यांश्च ऋत्विजः शक्त्या गुरुं केयूरकङ्कणैः .. 198.108 ..
6.3.m: He should clothe the guru and his wife in red garments, / and the other officiants according to his means, and the guru with armlets and bracelets.

6.3.s:
śuklāṃ gāṃ kṣīriṇīṃ dadyāllalitā prīyatāmiti .
anena vidhinā yā tu kuryānnārī mamālaye .. 198.109 ..
6.3.d:
शुक्लां गां क्षीरिणीं दद्याल्ललिता प्रीयतामिति .
अनेन विधिना या तु कुर्यान्नारी ममालये .. 198.109 ..
6.3.m: He should give a white milch cow, [saying], 'May Lalitā be pleased!' / Whatever woman performs [this] in my temple according to this rule,

6.3.s:
mattulyā sā bhavedrājñāṃ tejasā śrīrivāmalā .
sāvitrīva ca saundarye janmāni daśa pañca ca .. 198.110 ..
6.3.d:
मत्तुल्या सा भवेद्राज्ञां तेजसा श्रीरिवामला .
सावित्रीव च सौन्दर्ये जन्मानि दश पञ्च च .. 198.110 ..
6.3.m: she shall become like me among queens, spotless in splendour like Śrī, / and like Sāvitrī in beauty, for fifteen lifetimes.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ gauryā dvijavarottamaḥ .
namaskṛtya jagāmāśu dharmarāja niveśanam .. 198.111 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवं निशम्य वचनं गौर्या द्विजवरोत्तमः .
नमस्कृत्य जगामाशु धर्मराज निवेशनम् .. 198.111 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having thus heard the speech of Gaurī, that best of eminent brahmins / bowed down and quickly departed to the abode of Dharmarāja.

6.3.s:
tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātaṃ śūleśvarīti ca .
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 198.112 ..
6.3.d:
तदा प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं ख्यातं शूलेश्वरीति च .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 198.112 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward that sacred ford has been known as Śūleśvarī. / Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and offers libations to the ancestors and gods,

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇānannavāsobhiḥ piṇḍaiḥ pitṛpitāmahān .
bhaktopahārairdeveśamumayā saha śaṅkaraṃ .. 198.113 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणानन्नवासोभिः पिण्डैः पितृपितामहान् .
भक्तोपहारैर्देवेशमुमया सह शङ्करं .. 198.113 ..
6.3.m: [honours] brahmins with food and garments, ancestors and forefathers with rice-balls, / the Lord of the Gods, Śaṅkara, together with Umā, with dedicated offerings,

6.3.s:
dhūpagugguladānaiśca dīpadānaiḥ subodhitaiḥ .
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa gacchecchivasannidhim .. 198.114 ..
6.3.d:
धूपगुग्गुलदानैश्च दीपदानैः सुबोधितैः .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स गच्छेच्छिवसन्निधिम् .. 198.114 ..
6.3.m: and with gifts of incense, bdellium, and brightly lit lamps, / freed from all sins, shall go to the presence of Śiva.

6.3.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kaścidabhiyukto nareśvara .
ambhiśāpi tathā snātastridinaṃ mucyate naraḥ .. 198.115 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे तु यः कश्चिदभियुक्तो नरेश्वर .
अम्भिशापि तथा स्नातस्त्रिदिनं मुच्यते नरः .. 198.115 ..
6.3.m: Moreover, whatever man in that sacred ford is accused, O lord of men, / and likewise cursed, having bathed for three days, is freed [from it].

6.3.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ rātrau jāgarti yo naraḥ .
upavāsaparaḥ śuddhaḥ śivaṃ sampūjayennaraḥ .
pramucya pāpasaṃmohaṃ rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 198.116 ..
6.3.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां रात्रौ जागर्ति यो नरः .
उपवासपरः शुद्धः शिवं सम्पूजयेन्नरः .
प्रमुच्य पापसंमोहं रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 198.116 ..
6.3.m: The man who stays awake at night on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / devoted to fasting, pure, and worships Śiva— / freed from the delusion of sin, he goes to the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
trinetraśca caturbāhuḥ sākṣādrudro'paraḥ .
krīḍate devakanyābhiryāvaccandrārkatārakam .. 198.117 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śūleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
त्रिनेत्रश्च चतुर्बाहुः साक्षाद्रुद्रोऽपरः .
क्रीडते देवकन्याभिर्यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् .. 198.117 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शूलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टनवत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Three-eyed and four-armed, another Rudra incarnate, / he sports with celestial maidens as long as the moon, the sun, and the stars endure.
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-eighth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Śūleśvara Sacred Ford', in the Revā Section of the fifth Avantī Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 199
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ rājannāśvinaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
kāmikaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ prāṇināṃ siddhidāyakam .. 199.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 199
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं राजन्नाश्विनं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
कामिकं सर्वतीर्थानां प्राणिनां सिद्धिदायकम् .. 199.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 199 / The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Immediately following that, O king, is the excellent Āśvina sacred ford, / the granter of desires among all sacred fords, bestowing perfections upon living beings.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe'śvinau devau surūpau bhiṣajāṃ varau .
tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulaṃ saṃjātau yajñabhāginau .. 199.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थेऽश्विनौ देवौ सुरूपौ भिषजां वरौ .
तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलं संजातौ यज्ञभागिनौ .. 199.2 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, the two gods the Aśvins, handsome and the best of physicians, / having performed extensive austerities, became sharers in the sacrificial offering.

6.3.s:
saṃmatau sarvadevānāmādityatanayāvubhau .
nāsatyau sattvasaṃpannau sarvaduḥkhaghnasattamau .. 199.3 ..
6.3.d:
संमतौ सर्वदेवानामादित्यतनयावुभौ .
नासत्यौ सत्त्वसंपन्नौ सर्वदुःखघ्नसत्तमौ .. 199.3 ..
6.3.m: Approved by all the gods, both sons of the sun, / the Nāsatyas, endowed with purity, best of beings who destroy all suffering.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
ādityasya sutau tāta nāsatyau yena hetunā .
saṃjātau śrotumicchāmi nirṇayaṃ paramaṃ dvija .. 199.4 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आदित्यस्य सुतौ तात नासत्यौ येन हेतुना .
संजातौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि निर्णयं परमं द्विज .. 199.4 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By what cause the two Nāsatyas were born as the sons of the sun, father, / I wish to hear that ultimate conclusion, O twice-born one.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
purāṇe bhāskare tāta etadvistarato mayā .
saṃśrutaṃ devadevasya mārtaṇḍasya mahātmanaḥ .. 199.5 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पुराणे भास्करे तात एतद्विस्तरतो मया .
संश्रुतं देवदेवस्य मार्तण्डस्य महात्मनः .. 199.5 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / In the Bhāskara Purāṇa, father, this was heard by me in detail, / concerning the god of gods, the great-souled Mārtaṇḍa.

6.3.s:
tatte saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ bhaktiyuktasya bhārata .
kathayāmi na sandeho vṛddhabhāvena karśitaḥ .. 199.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्ते संक्षेपतः सर्वं भक्तियुक्तस्य भारत .
कथयामि न सन्देहो वृद्धभावेन कर्शितः .. 199.6 ..
6.3.m: All that I shall tell to you in brief, O Bhārata, since you are endowed with devotion; / there is no doubt, [though I am] emaciated by old age.

6.3.s:
atitejoraverdṛṣṭvā rājñī devī narottama .
cacāra merukāntāre vaḍavā tapa ulbaṇam .. 199.7 ..
6.3.d:
अतितेजोरवेर्दृष्ट्वा राज्ञी देवी नरोत्तम .
चचार मेरुकान्तारे वडवा तप उल्बणम् .. 199.7 ..
6.3.m: Having seen the excessive brilliance of the sun, the queen goddess, O best of men, / practiced severe austerities in the wilderness of Meru as a mare.

6.3.s:
tataḥ katipayāhasya kālasya bhagavānraviḥ .
dṛṣṭvā tu rūpamutsṛjya paramaṃ teja ujjvalam .. 199.8 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कतिपयाहस्य कालस्य भगवान्रविः .
दृष्ट्वा तु रूपमुत्सृज्य परमं तेज उज्ज्वलम् .. 199.8 ..
6.3.m: Then, after the passage of some days, the blessed sun, / seeing [her], cast off his supreme, blazing splendor.

6.3.s:
manobhavavaśībhūto hayo bhūtvā laghukramaḥ .
visphurantī yathāprāṇaṃ dhāvamānā itastataḥ .. 199.9 ..
6.3.d:
मनोभववशीभूतो हयो भूत्वा लघुक्रमः .
विस्फुरन्ती यथाप्राणं धावमाना इतस्ततः .. 199.9 ..
6.3.m: Overcome by love, having become a swift-paced horse, / [approached her who was] quivering with all her strength and running hither and thither.

6.3.s:
heṣamāṇaḥ svareṇāsau maithunāyopacakrame .
sammukhī tu tato devī nivṛttā laghuvikramā .. 199.10 ..
6.3.d:
हेषमाणः स्वरेणासौ मैथुनायोपचक्रमे .
सम्मुखी तु ततो देवी निवृत्ता लघुविक्रमा .. 199.10 ..
6.3.m: Neighing with his voice, he approached for mating. / Then the goddess, turning to face him, stopped, swift of pace.

6.3.s:
yathā tathā nāsikāyāṃ praviṣṭaṃ bījamuttamam .
tato nāsāgate bīje saṃjāto garbha uttamaḥ .. 199.11 ..
6.3.d:
यथा तथा नासिकायां प्रविष्टं बीजमुत्तमम् .
ततो नासागते बीजे संजातो गर्भ उत्तमः .. 199.11 ..
6.3.m: Somehow the excellent seed entered into her nose; / then, when the seed had entered the nose, an excellent embryo was formed.

6.3.s:
jātau yataḥ sutau pārtha nāsatyau viśrutau tataḥ .
susamau suvibhaktāṅgau bimbādbimbamivodyatau .. 199.12 ..
6.3.d:
जातौ यतः सुतौ पार्थ नासत्यौ विश्रुतौ ततः .
सुसमौ सुविभक्ताङ्गौ बिम्बाद्बिम्बमिवोद्यतौ .. 199.12 ..
6.3.m: Because the two sons were born [from the nose], O Pārtha, they are celebrated as the Nāsatyas, / well-proportioned, with symmetrical limbs, as if risen like a reflection from an image.

6.3.s:
adhikau sarvadevānāṃ rūpaiścaryasamanvitau .
narmadātaṭamāśritya bhṛgukacche gatāvubhau .
parāṃ siddhimanuprāptau tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram .. 199.13 ..
6.3.d:
अधिकौ सर्वदेवानां रूपैश्चर्यसमन्वितौ .
नर्मदातटमाश्रित्य भृगुकच्छे गतावुभौ .
परां सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तौ तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम् .. 199.13 ..
6.3.m: Surpassing all the gods, endowed with beauty and sovereignty, / both resorted to the bank of the Narmadā and went to Bhṛgukaccha; / having performed very difficult austerities, they attained supreme perfection.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .
surūpaḥ subhagaḥ pārtha jāyate yatra tatra ca .. 199.14 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe āśvinatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .
सुरूपः सुभगः पार्थ जायते यत्र तत्र च .. 199.14 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे आश्विनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whoever bathes in that sacred ford and offers libations to the ancestors and gods, / is born handsome and fortunate, O Pārtha, wherever [he is reborn].
Thus ends the one hundred and ninety-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Āśvina Sacred Ford', in the Revā Section of the fifth Avantī Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 200
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha sāvitrītīrthamuttamam .
yatra siddhā mahābhāgā sāvitrī vedamātṛkā .. 200.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 200
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं पार्थ सावित्रीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा सावित्री वेदमातृका .. 200.1 ..
6.3.m: Chapter 200 / The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Immediately following that, O Pārtha, is the excellent Sāvitrī sacred ford, / where the highly fortunate Sāvitrī, mother of the Vedas, attained perfection.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
sāvitrī kā dvijaśreṣṭha kathaṃ vārādhyate budhaiḥ .
prasannā vā varaṃ kaṃ ca dadāti kathayasva me .. 200.2 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
सावित्री का द्विजश्रेष्ठ कथं वाराध्यते बुधैः .
प्रसन्ना वा वरं कं च ददाति कथयस्व मे .. 200.2 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Who is Sāvitrī, O best of twice-borns? Or how is she propitiated by the wise? / And what boon does she grant when pleased? Tell me.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
padmā padmāsanasthenādhiṣṭhitā padmayoginī .
sāvitratejaḥsadṛśī sāvitrī tena cocyate .. 200.3 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
पद्मा पद्मासनस्थेनाधिष्ठिता पद्मयोगिनी .
सावित्रतेजःसदृशी सावित्री तेन चोच्यते .. 200.3 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / She is Padmā, seated upon a lotus posture, an ascetic woman associated with the lotus; / she resembles the splendor of the sun, and therefore she is called Sāvitrī.

6.3.s:
padmānanā padmavarṇā padmapatranibhekṣaṇā .
dhyātavyā brāhmaṇairnityaṃ kṣatravaiśyairyathāvidhi .. 200.4 ..
6.3.d:
पद्मानना पद्मवर्णा पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणा .
ध्यातव्या ब्राह्मणैर्नित्यं क्षत्रवैश्यैर्यथाविधि .. 200.4 ..
6.3.m: Lotus-faced, lotus-hued, with eyes resembling lotus petals, / she should be meditated upon constantly by brahmins, and by kṣatriyas and vaiśyas according to rule.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyābhayātsā hi na tu śūdraiḥ kadācana .
uccāraṇāddhāraṇādvā narake patati dhruvam .. 200.5 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्याभयात्सा हि न तु शूद्रैः कदाचन .
उच्चारणाद्धारणाद्वा नरके पतति ध्रुवम् .. 200.5 ..
6.3.m: Never indeed [should she be meditated upon] by śūdras, out of fear of the sin of killing a brahmin; / by chanting or holding [the mantra], he surely falls into hell.

6.3.s:
vedoccāraṇamātreṇa kṣatriyairdharmapālakaiḥ .
jihvāchedo'sya kartavyaḥ śūdrasyeti viniścayaḥ .. 200.6 ..
6.3.d:
वेदोच्चारणमात्रेण क्षत्रियैर्धर्मपालकैः .
जिह्वाछेदोऽस्य कर्तव्यः शूद्रस्येति विनिश्चयः .. 200.6 ..
6.3.m: At the mere chanting of the Veda, the cutting of his tongue / should be performed by kṣatriyas, the protectors of dharma: such is the settled rule.

6.3.s:
bālā bālendusadṛśī raktavastrānulepanā .
uṣaḥkāle tu dhyātavyā sandhyā sandhāna uttame .. 200.7 ..
6.3.d:
बाला बालेन्दुसदृशी रक्तवस्त्रानुलेपना .
उषःकाले तु ध्यातव्या सन्ध्या सन्धान उत्तमे .. 200.7 ..
6.3.m: A young girl resembling the crescent moon, wearing red garments and ointments, / should be meditated upon at dawn during the morning twilight, in the supreme union.

6.3.s:
uttuṅgapīvarakucā sumukhī śubhadarśanā .
sarvābharaṇasampannā śvetamālyānulepanā .. 200.8 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तुङ्गपीवरकुचा सुमुखी शुभदर्शना .
सर्वाभरणसम्पन्ना श्वेतमाल्यानुलेपना .. 200.8 ..
6.3.m: With lofty, full breasts, beautiful-faced, auspicious to behold, / adorned with all ornaments, wearing white garlands and ointments,

6.3.s:
śvetavastraparicchannā śvetayajñopavītinī .
madhyāhnasandhyā dhyātavyā taruṇā bhuktimuktidā .. 200.9 ..
6.3.d:
श्वेतवस्त्रपरिच्छन्ना श्वेतयज्ञोपवीतिनी .
मध्याह्नसन्ध्या ध्यातव्या तरुणा भुक्तिमुक्तिदा .. 200.9 ..
6.3.m: clothed in white garments, wearing a white sacred thread, / the midday twilight should be meditated upon as a young woman, bestowing enjoyment and liberation.

6.3.s:
pradoṣe tu punaḥ pārtha śvetā pāṇḍuramūrdhajā .
sumṛtā tu durgakāntāre mātṛvatparirakṣati .. 200.10 ..
6.3.d:
प्रदोषे तु पुनः पार्थ श्वेता पाण्डुरमूर्धजा .
सुमृता तु दुर्गकान्तारे मातृवत्परिरक्षति .. 200.10 ..
6.3.m: At dusk, again, O Pārtha, [she is] white, with pale-grey hair; / when remembered well in an impassable wilderness, she protects like a mother.

6.3.s:
viśeṣeṇa tu rājendra sāvitrītīrthamuttamam .
snātvācamya vidhānena manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ .. 200.11 ..
6.3.d:
विशेषेण तु राजेन्द्र सावित्रीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
स्नात्वाचम्य विधानेन मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः .. 200.11 ..
6.3.m: Especially, O king of kings, at the excellent Sāvitrī sacred ford, / having bathed and sipped water according to the injunction, through acts of mind, speech, and body,

6.3.s:
prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣān saptajanmārjitānbahūn .
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa prokṣayedātmanastanum .. 200.12 ..
6.3.d:
प्राणायामैर्दहेद्दोषान् सप्तजन्मार्जितान्बहून् .
आपोहिष्ठेति मन्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेदात्मनस्तनुम् .. 200.12 ..
6.3.m: one should burn away numerous faults acquired across seven lifetimes through prāṇāyāmas; / one should sprinkle one's own body with the mantra 'āpo hi ṣṭhā'.

6.3.s:
navaṣaṭca tathā tisrastatra tīrthe nṛpottama .
āpohiṣṭheti trirāvṛtya pratigrāhairna lipyate .. 200.13 ..
6.3.d:
नवषट्च तथा तिस्रस्तत्र तीर्थे नृपोत्तम .
आपोहिष्ठेति त्रिरावृत्य प्रतिग्राहैर्न लिप्यते .. 200.13 ..
6.3.m: Nine, six, and three [times] at that sacred ford, O best of kings, / repeating 'āpo hi ṣṭhā' three times, one is not tainted by [the acceptance of] gifts.

6.3.s:
aghamarṣaṇaṃ tryṛcaṃ toyaṃ yathāvedamathāpi vā .
upapāpairna lipyeta padmapatramivāmbhasā .. 200.14 ..
6.3.d:
अघमर्षणं त्र्यृचं तोयं यथावेदमथापि वा .
उपपापैर्न लिप्येत पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा .. 200.14 ..
6.3.m: Having performed the Aghamarṣaṇa with three verses over water according to the Veda, / one is not tainted by minor sins, just as a lotus leaf is not [wetted] by water.

6.3.s:
tryāpaṃ hi kurute vipra ullekhatrayamācaret .
caturthaṃ kārayedyastu brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati .. 200.15 ..
6.3.d:
त्र्यापं हि कुरुते विप्र उल्लेखत्रयमाचरेत् .
चतुर्थं कारयेद्यस्तु ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहति .. 200.15 ..
6.3.m: If a brahmin sips three handfuls of water and makes three drawings [in water], / and he who causes a fourth to be made, removes [even] the sin of killing a brahmin.

6.3.s:
drupadākhyaśca yo mantro vede vājasaneyake .
antarjale sakṛjjaptaḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaraḥ .. 200.16 ..
6.3.d:
द्रुपदाख्यश्च यो मन्त्रो वेदे वाजसनेयके .
अन्तर्जले सकृज्जप्तः सर्वपापक्षयंकरः .. 200.16 ..
6.3.m: And the mantra named Drupadā in the Vājasaneyi Veda, / when recited once while submerged in water, destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
udutyamiti mantreṇa pūjayitvā divākaram .
gāyatrīṃ ca japeddevīṃ pavitrāṃ vedamātaram .. 200.17 ..
6.3.d:
उदुत्यमिति मन्त्रेण पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् .
गायत्रीं च जपेद्देवीं पवित्रां वेदमातरम् .. 200.17 ..
6.3.m: Having worshipped the sun with the mantra 'ud u tyaṃ', / one should recite the Gāyatrī, the divine, pure mother of the Vedas.

6.3.s:
gāyatrīṃ tu japeddevīṃ yaḥ sandhyānantaraṃ dvijaḥ .
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 200.18 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्रीं तु जपेद्देवीं यः सन्ध्यानन्तरं द्विजः .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 200.18 ..
6.3.m: The twice-born one who recites the goddess Gāyatrī after the twilight worship / is freed from all sins and goes to the world of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
daśabhirjanmabhirlabdhaṃ śatena tu purākṛtam .
triyugaṃ tu sahasreṇa gāyatrī hanti kilbiṣam .. 200.19 ..
6.3.d:
दशभिर्जन्मभिर्लब्धं शतेन तु पुराकृतम् .
त्रियुगं तु सहस्रेण गायत्री हन्ति किल्बिषम् .. 200.19 ..
6.3.m: With ten [recitations] Gāyatrī destroys the sin acquired in this life, with a hundred that performed in the past, / and with a thousand, the sin of three yugas.

6.3.s:
gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ .
nāyantritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī .. 200.20 ..
6.3.d:
गायत्रीसारमात्रोऽपि वरं विप्रः सुयन्त्रितः .
नायन्त्रितश्चतुर्वेदी सर्वाशी सर्वविक्रयी .. 200.20 ..
6.3.m: Even a brahmin who possesses only the essence of the Gāyatrī, well-restrained, is superior; / not an unrestrained knower of the four Vedas who eats everything and sells everything.

6.3.s:
sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu .
yadanyatkurute kiṃcinna tasya phalabhāgbhavet .. 200.21 ..
6.3.d:
सन्ध्याहीनोऽशुचिर्नित्यमनर्हः सर्वकर्मसु .
यदन्यत्कुरुते किंचिन्न तस्य फलभाग्भवेत् .. 200.21 ..
6.3.m: One who is devoid of twilight worship is constantly impure, unfit for all ritual acts; / whatever other act he performs, he does not partake of its fruit.

6.3.s:
sandhyāṃ nopāsate yastu brāhmaṇo mandabuddhimān .
sa jīvanneva śūdraḥ syānmṛtaḥ śvā samprajāyate .. 200.22 ..
6.3.d:
सन्ध्यां नोपासते यस्तु ब्राह्मणो मन्दबुद्धिमान् .
स जीवन्नेव शूद्रः स्यान्मृतः श्वा सम्प्रजायते .. 200.22 ..
6.3.m: The dull-witted brahmin who does not perform the twilight devotions / is a śūdra while still alive, and when dead is born as a dog. // 200.22

6.3.s:
sāvitrītīrthamāsādya sāvitrīṃ yo japeddvijaḥ .
traividyaṃ tu phalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 200.23 ..
6.3.d:
सावित्रीतीर्थमासाद्य सावित्रीं यो जपेद्द्विजः .
त्रैविद्यं तु फलं तस्य जायते नात्र संशयः .. 200.23 ..
6.3.m: The twice-born who reaches Sāvitrītīrtha and chants the Sāvitrī / gains the fruit of the three Vedas; of this there is no doubt. // 200.23

6.3.s:
pitḥnuddiśya yaḥ snātvā piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ nṛpa .
kurute dvādaśābdāni tṛpyanti tatpitāmahāḥ .. 200.24 ..
6.3.d:
पित्ःनुद्दिश्य यः स्नात्वा पिण्डनिर्वपणं नृप .
कुरुते द्वादशाब्दानि तृप्यन्ति तत्पितामहाः .. 200.24 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed with the ancestors in mind, O king, he who makes an offering of rice-balls / satisfies his ancestors for twelve years. // 200.24

6.3.s:
sāvitrītīrthamāsādya yaḥ kuryātprāṇasaṃkṣayam .
brahmalokaṃ vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 200.25 ..
6.3.d:
सावित्रीतीर्थमासाद्य यः कुर्यात्प्राणसंक्षयम् .
ब्रह्मलोकं वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 200.25 ..
6.3.m: He who meets his death at Sāvitrītīrtha / dwells in the world of Brahmā until the dissolution of all beings. // 200.25

6.3.s:
pūrṇe caiva tataḥ kāla iha mānuṣyatāṃ gataḥ .
caturvedo dvijo rājañjāyate vimale kule .. 200.26 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्णे चैव ततः काल इह मानुष्यतां गतः .
चतुर्वेदो द्विजो राजञ्जायते विमले कुले .. 200.26 ..
6.3.m: And when that time is complete, having returned to human birth here, / he is born, O king, into an immaculate family as a twice-born master of the four Vedas. // 200.26

6.3.s:
dhanadhānyacayopetaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ .
vyādhiśokavinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam .. 200.27 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe sāvitrītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāya 201
6.3.d:
धनधान्यचयोपेतः पुत्रपौत्रसमन्वितः .
व्याधिशोकविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदां शतम् .. 200.27 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सावित्रीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्याय 201
6.3.m:
Endowed with stores of wealth and grain, accompanied by sons and grandsons, / freed from sickness and grief, he lives for a hundred autumns. // 200.27
Thus ends the two-hundredth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Sāvitrītīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Chapter 201

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchenmahīpāla devatīrthamanuttamam .
yatra siddhā mahābhāgā devāḥ sendrā yudhiṣṭhira .. 201.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेन्महीपाल देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महाभागा देवाः सेन्द्रा युधिष्ठिर .. 201.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O king, to the unsurpassed Devatīrtha, / where the illustrious gods together with Indra attained perfection, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam .
tatra tīrthaprabhāvena kṛtamānantyamaśnute .. 201.2 ..
6.3.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् .
तत्र तीर्थप्रभावेन कृतमानन्त्यमश्नुते .. 201.2 ..
6.3.m: Bathing, giving, recitation, oblation, personal Vedic study, and worship of deities / performed there attains endlessness through the power of the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
viśeṣādbhādrapade tu kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīm .
pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ devairadhyāsitaṃ purā .. 201.3 ..
6.3.d:
विशेषाद्भाद्रपदे तु कृष्णपक्षे त्रयोदशीम् .
प्रधानं सर्वतीर्थानां देवैरध्यासितं पुरा .. 201.3 ..
6.3.m: Especially on the thirteenth day in the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, / the foremost of all sacred fords was occupied by the gods of old.

6.3.s:
snātvā trayodaśīdine śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ .
devaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ devaṃ sampūjya vṛṣabhadhvajam .
sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokamavāpnuyāt .. 201.4 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāyaḥ 202
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा त्रयोदशीदिने श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानतः .
देवैः संस्थापितं देवं सम्पूज्य वृषभध्वजम् .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 201.4 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे देवतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्यायः 202
6.3.m:
Having bathed on the thirteenth day, having performed the śrāddha according to rule, / and having fully worshipped the bull-bannered god installed by the gods, / freed from all sins, he would attain the world of Rudra.
Thus ends the two hundred and first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Devatīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 202

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ cānyacchikhitīrthamanuttamam .
pradhānaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pañcāyatanamuttamam .. 202.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं चान्यच्छिखितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
प्रधानं सर्वतीर्थानां पञ्चायतनमुत्तमम् .. 202.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Immediately after that there is another unsurpassed sacred ford, Śikhitīrtha, / the foremost of all sacred fords, an excellent fivefold shrine.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā śikhārthaṃ havyavāhanaḥ .
śikhāṃ prāpya śikhī bhūtvā śikhākhyaṃ sthāpayañchivam .. 202.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तपस्तप्त्वा शिखार्थं हव्यवाहनः .
शिखां प्राप्य शिखी भूत्वा शिखाख्यं स्थापयञ्छिवम् .. 202.2 ..
6.3.m: Having performed austerity in that sacred ford for the sake of a flame, the carrier of oblations, / obtaining a flame and becoming the crested [fire], installed Śiva named Śikhin.

6.3.s:
pratipacchuklapakṣe yā bhavedāśvayuje nṛpa .
tadā tīrthavare gatvā snātvā vai narmadājale .. 202.3 ..
6.3.d:
प्रतिपच्छुक्लपक्षे या भवेदाश्वयुजे नृप .
तदा तीर्थवरे गत्वा स्नात्वा वै नर्मदाजले .. 202.3 ..
6.3.m: On the first lunar day in the bright fortnight that occurs in Āśvayuja, O king, / going then to the excellent sacred ford and having bathed in the waters of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
devānṛṣīn pitḥṃścānyāṃstarpayettilavāriṇā .
hiraṇyaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyātsaṃtarpya ca hutāśanam .. 202.4 ..
6.3.d:
देवानृषीन् पित्ःंश्चान्यांस्तर्पयेत्तिलवारिणा .
हिरण्यं ब्राह्मणे दद्यात्संतर्प्य च हुताशनम् .. 202.4 ..
6.3.m: he should gratify the gods, the seers, and the ancestors, as well as others, with water and sesame seeds. / He should give gold to a brahmin and satisfy the fire.

6.3.s:
gandhamālyaistathā dhūpaistataḥ sampūjayecchivam .
anena vidhinābhyarcya śikhitīrthe maheśvaram .. 202.5 ..
6.3.d:
गन्धमाल्यैस्तथा धूपैस्ततः सम्पूजयेच्छिवम् .
अनेन विधिनाभ्यर्च्य शिखितीर्थे महेश्वरम् .. 202.5 ..
6.3.m: Then he should fully worship Śiva with fragrant scents, garlands, and incenses. / Having worshipped Maheśvara at Śikhitīrtha according to this rule,

6.3.s:
vimānenārkavarṇena hyapsarogaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ .
gīyamānastu gandharvairrudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 202.6 ..
6.3.d:
विमानेनार्कवर्णेन ह्यप्सरोगणसंवृतः .
गीयमानस्तु गन्धर्वैर्रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 202.6 ..
6.3.m: in an aerial chariot possessing the color of the sun, surrounded by host of apsarases, / and being sung to by gandharvas, he goes to the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
śatrukṣayamavāpnoti tejasvī jāyate bhuvi .. 202.7 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe śikhitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
adhyāyaḥ 203
6.3.d:
शत्रुक्षयमवाप्नोति तेजस्वी जायते भुवि .. 202.7 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे शिखितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्व्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अध्यायः 203
6.3.m:
He attains the destruction of enemies and is born radiant upon earth.
Thus ends the two hundred and second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Śikhitīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.
Chapter 203

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gaccheddharādhīśa koṭitīrthamanuttamam .
yatra siddhā mahābhāgāḥ koṭisaṃkhyā maharṣayaḥ .. 203.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेद्धराधीश कोटितीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
यत्र सिद्धा महाभागाः कोटिसंख्या महर्षयः .. 203.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O ruler of the earth, to the unsurpassed Koṭitīrtha, / where illustrious great seers numbering ten million attained perfection.

6.3.s:
tapaḥ kṛtvā suvipulamṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ .
tathā koṭīśvarī devī cāmuṇḍā mahiṣārdinī .. 203.2 ..
6.3.d:
तपः कृत्वा सुविपुलमृषिभिः स्थापितः शिवः .
तथा कोटीश्वरी देवी चामुण्डा महिषार्दिनी .. 203.2 ..
6.3.m: Having performed immense austerity, Śiva was installed by the seers, / as well as the goddess Koṭīśvarī, Cāmuṇḍā the crusher of Mahiṣa.

6.3.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade nṛpa .
tīrthakoṭīḥ samāhūya munibhiḥ sthāpitaḥ śivaḥ .. 203.3 ..
6.3.d:
कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां मासि भाद्रपदे नृप .
तीर्थकोटीः समाहूय मुनिभिः स्थापितः शिवः .. 203.3 ..
6.3.m: On the fourteenth day in the dark fortnight in the month of Bhādrapada, O king, / having summoned ten million sacred fords, Śiva was installed by the sages.

6.3.s:
tasyāṃ tithau ca hastarkṣaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .
tatra tīrthe tadā gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ .. 203.4 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यां तिथौ च हस्तर्क्षं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .
तत्र तीर्थे तदा गत्वा स्नानं कृत्वा समाहितः .. 203.4 ..
6.3.m: And on that lunar day, the lunar mansion Hasta destroys all sins. / Having gone to that sacred ford at that time and performed ritual ablution with a concentrated mind, 203.4

6.3.s:
narakāduddharatyāśu puruṣānekaviṃśatim .
tilodakapradānena kimuta śrāddhado naraḥ .. 203.5 ..
6.3.d:
नरकादुद्धरत्याशु पुरुषानेकविंशतिम् .
तिलोदकप्रदानेन किमुत श्राद्धदो नरः .. 203.5 ..
6.3.m: a man quickly delivers twenty-one ancestors from hell / by offering water with sesame seeds—what then of one who offers a śrāddha? 203.5

6.3.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam .
tasya tīrthasya yogena sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 203.6 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tryuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायो देवतार्चनम् .
तस्य तीर्थस्य योगेन सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 203.6 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोटितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्र्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Ritual ablution, gifting, recitation of mantras, fire oblation, Vedic study, and worship of the deities— / by connection with that sacred ford, everything becomes multiplied ten million times. 203.6
Thus ends the two hundred and third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Koṭitīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāyaḥ 204
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhṛgutīrthaṃ tato gacchettīrtharājamanuttamam .
paitāmahaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 204.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्यायः 204
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भृगुतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थराजमनुत्तमम् .
पैतामहं महापुण्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 204.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 204
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go to Bhṛgutīrtha, unsurpassed king of sacred fords, / belonging to the Grandfather, highly meritorious, destroying all heinous sins. // 204.1

6.3.s:
brahmaṇā tatra tīrthe tu purā varṣaśatatrayam .
ārādhanaṃ kṛtaṃ śambhoḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare .. 204.2 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मणा तत्र तीर्थे तु पुरा वर्षशतत्रयम् .
आराधनं कृतं शम्भोः कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे .. 204.2 ..
6.3.m: For three hundred years in ancient times, at that sacred ford, / the worship of Śambhu was performed by Brahmā for a certain reason. // 204.2

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
kimarthaṃ muniśārdūla brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
ārādhayaddevadevaṃ mahābhaktyā maheśvaram .. 204.3 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
किमर्थं मुनिशार्दूल ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
आराधयद्देवदेवं महाभक्त्या महेश्वरम् .. 204.3 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For what reason, O tiger among sages, did Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / worship Maheśvara, the god of gods, with great devotion? // 204.3

6.3.s:
ārādhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jagadbhartā jagadguruḥ .
śrotavyaṃ śrotumicchāmi mahadāścaryamuttamam .. 204.4 ..
6.3.d:
आराध्यः सर्वभूतानां जगद्भर्ता जगद्गुरुः .
श्रोतव्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि महदाश्चर्यमुत्तमम् .. 204.4 ..
6.3.m: He who is to be worshipped by all beings, the supporter of the universe, the teacher of the universe— / I desire to hear that great and extraordinary wonder that ought to be heard. // 204.4

6.3.s:
dharmaputravacaḥ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ .
kathayāmāsa tadvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam .. 204.5 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मपुत्रवचः श्रुत्वा मार्कण्डेयो मुनीश्वरः .
कथयामास तद्वृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम् .. 204.5 ..
6.3.m: Having heard the words of the son of Dharma, Mārkaṇḍeya, the foremost of sages, / recounted that event, an ancient historical account. // 204.5

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
svaputrikāmabhigantumicchanpūrvaṃ pitāmahaḥ .
śaptastu devadevena kopāviṣṭena sattama .. 204.6 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
स्वपुत्रिकामभिगन्तुमिच्छन्पूर्वं पितामहः .
शप्तस्तु देवदेवेन कोपाविष्टेन सत्तम .. 204.6 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Desiring formerly to approach his own daughter, the Grandfather / was cursed by the god of gods overcome with anger, O best of men: // 204.6

6.3.s:
vedāstava vinaśyanti jñānaṃ ca kamalāsana .
apūjyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ .. 204.7 ..
6.3.d:
वेदास्तव विनश्यन्ति ज्ञानं च कमलासन .
अपूज्यः सर्वलोकानां भविष्यसि न संशयः .. 204.7 ..
6.3.m: "Your Vedas shall perish, and your knowledge, O lotus-seated one! / You shall become unworthy of worship by all the worlds, without a doubt." // 204.7

6.3.s:
evaṃ datte tataḥ śāpe brahmā khedāvṛtastadā .
revāyā uttare kūle snātvā varṣaśatatrayam .
toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ tuṣṭaḥ provāca śaṅkaraḥ .. 204.8 ..
6.3.d:
एवं दत्ते ततः शापे ब्रह्मा खेदावृतस्तदा .
रेवाया उत्तरे कूले स्नात्वा वर्षशतत्रयम् .
तोषयामास देवेशं तुष्टः प्रोवाच शङ्करः .. 204.8 ..
6.3.m: The curse having thus been given, Brahmā, overwhelmed by sorrow, / bathed on the northern bank of the Revā for three hundred years / and pleased the Lord of Gods. Pleased, Śaṅkara spoke: // 204.8

6.3.s:
pūjyastvaṃ bhavitā loke prāpte parvaṇi parvaṇi .
ahamatra ca vatsyāmi devaiśca pitṛbhiḥ saha .. 204.9 ..
6.3.d:
पूज्यस्त्वं भविता लोके प्राप्ते पर्वणि पर्वणि .
अहमत्र च वत्स्यामि देवैश्च पितृभिः सह .. 204.9 ..
6.3.m: "You shall become worthy of worship in the world on each full-moon or new-moon festival as it arrives. / And I shall dwell here together with the gods and the ancestors." // 204.9

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātiṃ prāptaṃ pitāmahāt .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣvanuttamam .. 204.10 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं ख्यातिं प्राप्तं पितामहात् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वतीर्थेष्वनुत्तमम् .. 204.10 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / From that time forth, that sacred ford attained renown through the Grandfather; / it removes all sins, is holy, and is unsurpassed among all sacred fords. // 204.10

6.3.s:
tatra bhādrapade māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ .
amāvāsyāṃ tu yaḥ snātvā tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ .. 204.11 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र भाद्रपदे मासि कृष्णपक्षे विशेषतः .
अमावास्यां तु यः स्नात्वा तर्पयेत्पितृदेवताः .. 204.11 ..
6.3.m: There, in the month of Bhādrapada, especially in the dark fortnight, / he who bathes on the new moon day and gratifies the ancestral deities, // 204.11

6.3.s:
piṇḍadānena caikena tilatoyena vā nṛpa .
tṛpyanti dvādaśābdāni pitaro nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 204.12 ..
6.3.d:
पिण्डदानेन चैकेन तिलतोयेन वा नृप .
तृप्यन्ति द्वादशाब्दानि पितरो नात्र संशयः .. 204.12 ..
6.3.m: with a single offering of rice-balls or with sesame-water, O king, / satisfies the ancestors for twelve years; of this there is no doubt. // 204.12

6.3.s:
kanyāgate tu yastatra nityaṃ śrāddhaprado bhavet .
avāpya tṛptiṃ tatpūrve valganti ca hasanti ca .. 204.13 ..
6.3.d:
कन्यागते तु यस्तत्र नित्यं श्राद्धप्रदो भवेत् .
अवाप्य तृप्तिं तत्पूर्वे वल्गन्ति च हसन्ति च .. 204.13 ..
6.3.m: When the sun enters Virgo, he who constantly offers śrāddha there— / having obtained satisfaction, his ancestors leap about and laugh.

6.3.s:
sarveṣu pitṛtīrtheṣu śrāddhaṃ kṛtvāsti yatphalam .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti darśe tatra na saṃśayaḥ .. 204.14 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषु पितृतीर्थेषु श्राद्धं कृत्वास्ति यत्फलम् .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति दर्शे तत्र न संशयः .. 204.14 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is attained by performing śrāddha at all the ancestor tīrthas, / he completely obtains that fruit on the new moon there, without a doubt.

6.3.s:
paitāmahe naraḥ snātvā pūjayanpārvatīpatim .
mucyate nātra sandehaḥ pātakaiścopapātakaiḥ .. 204.15 ..
6.3.d:
पैतामहे नरः स्नात्वा पूजयन्पार्वतीपतिम् .
मुच्यते नात्र सन्देहः पातकैश्चोपपातकैः .. 204.15 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at the Paitāmaha [tīrtha] and worshipping the husband of Pārvatī, / a person is liberated from major sins and minor sins, of this there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām .
anivartikā gatī rājanrudralokādasaṃśayam .. 204.16 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe paitāmahatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे मृतानां तु नराणां भावितात्मनाम् .
अनिवर्तिका गती राजन्रुद्रलोकादसंशयम् .. 204.16 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे पैतामहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
For self-controlled men who die at that sacred ford, / there is a state from which there is no return from the realm of Rudra, O king, without a doubt.
Thus ends the two hundred and fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Paitāmaha Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāyaḥ 205
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
gacchettataḥ kṣoṇinātha tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
kurkurīnāma vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 205.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्यायः 205
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
गच्छेत्ततः क्षोणिनाथ तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
कुर्कुरीनाम विख्यातं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 205.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 205
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
From there, O lord of the earth, one should go to the exceedingly splendid sacred ford / renowned by the name Kurkurī, which completely destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ paśuputradhanādikam .
taṃ taṃ dadāti deveśī kurkurī tīrthadevatā .. 205.2 ..
6.3.d:
यं यं प्रार्थयते कामं पशुपुत्रधनादिकम् .
तं तं ददाति देवेशी कुर्कुरी तीर्थदेवता .. 205.2 ..
6.3.m: Whatever desire one wishes for—cattle, sons, wealth, and the like— / that very thing the goddess, Kurkurī, the deity of the sacred ford, bestows.

6.3.s:
kṣetrapālo vasettatra ḍhauṇḍheśo nāma nāmataḥ .
tasya cārādhanaṃ kṛtvā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā .. 205.3 ..
6.3.d:
क्षेत्रपालो वसेत्तत्र ढौण्ढेशो नाम नामतः .
तस्य चाराधनं कृत्वा नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा .. 205.3 ..
6.3.m: A guardian of the field resides there, named Ḍhauṇḍheśa by name; / having performed worship to him, a woman or a man,

6.3.s:
vandanādapi rājendra daurbhāgyaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt .
aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamuttamam .. 205.4 ..
6.3.d:
वन्दनादपि राजेन्द्र दौर्भाग्यं नाशमाप्नुयात् .
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रमधनो धनमुत्तमम् .. 205.4 ..
6.3.m: even from paying homage, O king of kings, will obtain the destruction of misfortune. / The sonless one obtains a son, the impoverished one obtains excellent wealth;

6.3.s:
nārī narastathāpyevaṃ labhate kāmamuttamam .
sparśanāddarśanāttasya tīrthasya vidhipūrvakam .. 205.5 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe kurkurītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..
6.3.d:
नारी नरस्तथाप्येवं लभते काममुत्तमम् .
स्पर्शनाद्दर्शनात्तस्य तीर्थस्य विधिपूर्वकम् .. 205.5 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कुर्कुरीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः..
6.3.m:
likewise, a woman or a man obtains their highest desire / by touching and beholding that sacred ford in accordance with the prescribed rules.
Thus ends the two hundred and fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Kurkurī Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāyaḥ 206
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
gacchettataḥ kṣoṇinātha tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ daśakanyeti viśrutam .
mahādevakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam .. 206.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्यायः 206
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
गच्छेत्ततः क्षोणिनाथ तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं दशकन्येति विश्रुतम् .
महादेवकृतं पुण्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् .. 206.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 206
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
From there, O lord of the earth, one should go to the exceedingly splendid sacred ford, / sacred and taking away all sins, celebrated as Daśakanyā, / created by Mahādeva, holy, and granting the fruit of all desires.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe mahādevo daśakanyā guṇānvitāḥ .
brahmaṇo varayāmāsa hyudvāhena yuyoja ha .. 206.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे महादेवो दशकन्या गुणान्विताः .
ब्रह्मणो वरयामास ह्युद्वाहेन युयोज ह .. 206.2 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, Mahādeva chose ten endowed maidens / from Brahmā and united them indeed in marriage.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ daśakanyeti viśrutam .
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamakṣayaṃ kīrtitaṃ phalam .. 206.3 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं दशकन्येति विश्रुतम् .
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यमक्षयं कीर्तितं फलम् .. 206.3 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, that sacred ford has been celebrated as Daśakanyā; / it removes all sins, is holy, and its fruit is proclaimed imperishable.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dadāti samalaṃkṛtām .
prāpnoti puruṣo dattvā yathāśaktyā svalaṃkṛtām .. 206.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः कन्यां ददाति समलंकृताम् .
प्राप्नोति पुरुषो दत्त्वा यथाशक्त्या स्वलंकृताम् .. 206.4 ..
6.3.m: The man who gives away a well-adorned maiden at that sacred ford, / having given her well-adorned according to his ability, obtains [great reward].

6.3.s:
tena dānotthapuṇyena pūtātmāno narādhipa .
vasanti romasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi śivasannidhau .. 206.5 ..
6.3.d:
तेन दानोत्थपुण्येन पूतात्मानो नराधिप .
वसन्ति रोमसंख्यानि वर्षाणि शिवसन्निधौ .. 206.5 ..
6.3.m: Purified in self through the merit arising from that gift, O ruler of men, / they dwell in the presence of Śiva for as many years as the number of hairs [on the body].

6.3.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tviha loke nareśvara .
mānuṣyaṃ prāpya duṣprāpyaṃ dhanakoṭīpatirbhavet .. 206.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कालेन महता त्विह लोके नरेश्वर .
मानुष्यं प्राप्य दुष्प्राप्यं धनकोटीपतिर्भवेत् .. 206.6 ..
6.3.m: Then, after a great period of time, in this world, O lord of men, / having attained human birth which is difficult to attain, he becomes the master of tens of millions in wealth.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā snātvā viprāya kāñcanam .
samprayacchati śāntāya so'tyantaṃ sukhamaśnute .. 206.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यो भक्त्या स्नात्वा विप्राय काञ्चनम् .
सम्प्रयच्छति शान्ताय सोऽत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते .. 206.7 ..
6.3.m: He who, having bathed with devotion at that sacred ford, presents gold / to a tranquil brahmin, enjoys supreme happiness.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi karmajaṃ yatpurā kṛtam .
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti svarṇadānena bhārata .. 206.8 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं वापि कर्मजं यत्पुरा कृतम् .
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति स्वर्णदानेन भारत .. 206.8 ..
6.3.m: Whatever [sin] committed in the past—verbal, mental, or born of action— / all that dissolves through the gift of gold, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
naro dattvā suvarṇaṃ cāpi vālāgramātrakam .
tatra tīrthe divaṃ yāti mṛto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 206.9 ..
6.3.d:
नरो दत्त्वा सुवर्णं चापि वालाग्रमात्रकम् .
तत्र तीर्थे दिवं याति मृतो नास्त्यत्र संशयः .. 206.9 ..
6.3.m: A man, having given gold even the measure of the tip of a hair, / dying at that sacred ford, goes to heaven; there is no doubt of this.

6.3.s:
tatra vidyādharaiḥ siddhairvimānavaramāsthitaḥ .
pūjyamāno vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 206.10 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe daśakanyātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तत्र विद्याधरैः सिद्धैर्विमानवरमास्थितः .
पूज्यमानो वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 206.10 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे दशकन्यातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षडुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot, worshipped by vidyādharas and siddhas, / he resides there until the destruction of all elements.
Thus ends the two hundred and sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Daśakanyā Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāyaḥ 207
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyāgre pāvanaṃ tīrthaṃ svarṇabindviti viśrutam .
yatra snātvā divaṃ yānti mṛtāśca na punarbhavam .. 207.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्यायः 207
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्याग्रे पावनं तीर्थं स्वर्णबिन्द्विति विश्रुतम् .
यत्र स्नात्वा दिवं यान्ति मृताश्च न पुनर्भवम् .. 207.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 207
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
In front of it is the purifying sacred ford celebrated as Svarṇabindu, / where, having bathed, those who die go to heaven and not to rebirth.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā datte viprāya kāñcanam .
tena yattu phalaṃ proktaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahīpate .. 207.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यः स्नात्वा दत्ते विप्राय काञ्चनम् .
तेन यत्तु फलं प्रोक्तं तच्छृणुष्व महीपते .. 207.2 ..
6.3.m: He who, having bathed at that sacred ford, gives gold to a brahmin— / hear, O lord of the earth, the fruit that has been proclaimed for him.

6.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva ratnānāṃ kāñcanaṃ ratnamuttamam .
agnitejaḥsamudbhūtaṃ tena tatparamaṃ bhuvi .. 207.3 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव रत्नानां काञ्चनं रत्नमुत्तमम् .
अग्नितेजःसमुद्भूतं तेन तत्परमं भुवि .. 207.3 ..
6.3.m: Of all jewels indeed, gold is the supreme jewel; / it arose from the brilliance of fire, and for that reason it is supreme on earth.

6.3.s:
tenaiva dattā pṛthivī saśailavanakānanā .
sapattanapurā sarvā kāñcanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati .. 207.4 ..
6.3.d:
तेनैव दत्ता पृथिवी सशैलवनकानना .
सपत्तनपुरा सर्वा काञ्चनं यः प्रयच्छति .. 207.4 ..
6.3.m: By him indeed the earth together with its mountains, woods, and forests, / together with its cities and towns, is completely given, who presents gold.

6.3.s:
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatpurā kṛtam .
tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣipraṃ svarṇadānena bhārata .. 207.5 ..
6.3.d:
मानसं वाचिकं पापं कर्मणा यत्पुरा कृतम् .
तत्सर्वं नश्यति क्षिप्रं स्वर्णदानेन भारत .. 207.5 ..
6.3.m: The mental and verbal sin, and whatever was committed by action in the past, / all that is quickly destroyed through the gift of gold, O Bhārata.

6.3.s:
svarṇadānaṃ tu yo dattvā hyapi vālāgramātrakam .
tatra tīrthe mṛto yāti divaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 207.6 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्णदानं तु यो दत्त्वा ह्यपि वालाग्रमात्रकम् .
तत्र तीर्थे मृतो याति दिवं नास्त्यत्र संशयः .. 207.6 ..
6.3.m: He who makes a gift of gold, even the measure of the tip of a hair, / dying at that sacred ford, goes to heaven; there is no doubt of this.

6.3.s:
tatra vidyādharaiḥ siddhairvimānavaramāsthitaḥ .
pūjyamāno vasettāvadyāvadābhūtasamplavam .. 207.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र विद्याधरैः सिद्धैर्विमानवरमास्थितः .
पूज्यमानो वसेत्तावद्यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् .. 207.7 ..
6.3.m: Mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot, worshipped by vidyādharas and siddhas, / he resides there until the destruction of all elements.

6.3.s:
pūrṇe tatra tataḥ kāle prāpya mānuṣyamuttamam .
suvarṇakoṭisahite gṛhe vai jāyate dvijaḥ .. 207.8 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्णे तत्र ततः काले प्राप्य मानुष्यमुत्तमम् .
सुवर्णकोटिसहिते गृहे वै जायते द्विजः .. 207.8 ..
6.3.m: When his time is completed there, having attained an excellent human birth, / he is born as a twice-born in a household endowed with tens of millions of gold coins.

6.3.s:
sarvavyādhivinirmuktaḥ sarvalokeṣu pūjitaḥ .
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ rājasaṃ satsu viśrutaḥ .. 207.9 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe suvarṇabindutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तः सर्वलोकेषु पूजितः .
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं राजसं सत्सु विश्रुतः .. 207.9 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे सुवर्णबिन्दुतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम सप्ताधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Freed from all diseases, worshipped in all worlds, / he lives for a full hundred years, regal, renowned among the virtuous.
Thus ends the two hundred and seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Suvarṇabindu Tīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

6.3.s:
adhyāyaḥ 208
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhūmipāla tato gacchettīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam .
vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pitḥṇāmṛṇamocanam .. 208.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्यायः 208
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भूमिपाल ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं परमशोभनम् .
विख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु पित्ःणामृणमोचनम् .. 208.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 208
Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said:
O protector of the earth, from there one should go to the exceedingly splendid sacred ford / renowned in the three worlds as Pitṝṇāmṛṇamocana.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā vidhānena saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .
manuṣyaśca nṛpaśreṣṭha dānaṃ dattvānṛṇo bhavet .. 208.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः .
मनुष्यश्च नृपश्रेष्ठ दानं दत्त्वानृणो भवेत् .. 208.2 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed there according to the rules and gratified the ancestors and gods, / and having offered gifts, a man becomes free from debt, O best of kings.

6.3.s:
icchanti pitaraḥ sarve svārthahetoḥ sutaṃ yataḥ .
punnāmno narakātputro'smānayaṃ mocayiṣyati .. 208.3 ..
6.3.d:
इच्छन्ति पितरः सर्वे स्वार्थहेतोः सुतं यतः .
पुन्नाम्नो नरकात्पुत्रोऽस्मानयं मोचयिष्यति .. 208.3 ..
6.3.m: For all ancestors desire a son for their own sake: / 'He will deliver us from the hell named Put.'

6.3.s:
piṇḍadānaṃ jalaṃ tāta ṛṇamuttamamucyate .
pitḥṇāṃ taddhi vai proktamṛṇaṃ daivamataḥ param .. 208.4 ..
6.3.d:
पिण्डदानं जलं तात ऋणमुत्तममुच्यते .
पित्ःणां तद्धि वै प्रोक्तमृणं दैवमतः परम् .. 208.4 ..
6.3.m: The offering of food and water, dear one, is called the highest debt; / that indeed is proclaimed the debt to the ancestors; hear next of the divine debt.

6.3.s:
agnihotraṃ tathā yajñāḥ paśubandhāstatheṣṭayaḥ .
iti devarṇaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇu mānuṣyakaṃ tataḥ .. 208.5 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निहोत्रं तथा यज्ञाः पशुबन्धास्तथेष्टयः .
इति देवर्णं प्रोक्तं शृणु मानुष्यकं ततः .. 208.5 ..
6.3.m: The daily fire-sacrifice, sacrifices, animal sacrifices, and the regular offerings: / this is proclaimed the debt to the gods. Listen now to that which pertains to mortals.

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇeṣu ca tīrtheṣu devāyatanakarmasu .
pratiśrutya dadettattadvyavahāraḥ kṛto yathā .. 208.6 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मणेषु च तीर्थेषु देवायतनकर्मसु .
प्रतिश्रुत्य ददेत्तत्तद्व्यवहारः कृतो यथा .. 208.6 ..
6.3.m: Towards brahmins, at sacred fords, and in undertakings for divine temples, / whatever one has promised, one should give, just as an obligation is contracted.

6.3.s:
ṛṇatrayamidaṃ proktaṃ putrāṇāṃ dharmanandana .
satputrāste tu rājendra snātā ya ṛṇamocane .. 208.7 ..
6.3.d:
ऋणत्रयमिदं प्रोक्तं पुत्राणां धर्मनन्दन .
सत्पुत्रास्ते तु राजेन्द्र स्नाता य ऋणमोचने .. 208.7 ..
6.3.m: This triad of debts has been declared for sons, O joy of Dharma; / they are truly worthy sons, O king of kings, who have bathed at Ṛṇamocana.

6.3.s:
ṛṇatrayādvimucyante hyaputrāḥ putriṇastathā .
tasmāttīrthavaraṃ prāpya putreṇa niyatātmanā .
pitṛbhyastarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 208.8 ..
6.3.d:
ऋणत्रयाद्विमुच्यन्ते ह्यपुत्राः पुत्रिणस्तथा .
तस्मात्तीर्थवरं प्राप्य पुत्रेण नियतात्मना .
पितृभ्यस्तर्पणं कार्यं पिण्डदानं विशेषतः .. 208.8 ..
6.3.m:
Those without sons as well as those with sons are indeed freed from the three debts.
Therefore, having reached that best of sacred fords, a son with self-restraint
should perform libations for the ancestors, and especially the offering of piṇḍas.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe hutaṃ dattaṃ guravastoṣitā yadi .
mṛtānāṃ sapta janmāni phalamakṣayamaśnute .. 208.9 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe ṛṇamocanatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे हुतं दत्तं गुरवस्तोषिता यदि .
मृतानां सप्त जन्मानि फलमक्षयमश्नुते .. 208.9 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे ऋणमोचनतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टोत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
At that sacred ford, if offerings are poured, gifts given, and spiritual teachers pleased,
he attains imperishable fruit for seven lifetimes of the deceased.
Thus ends the two hundred and eighth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of the Ṛṇamocana Sacred Ford', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandapurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tasyaivānantaraṃ pārtha puṣkalītīrthamuttamam .
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā hyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 209.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
तस्यैवानन्तरं पार्थ पुष्कलीतीर्थमुत्तमम् .
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा ह्यश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 209.1 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Right after that, O son of Pṛthā, is the excellent Puṣkalī Sacred Ford.
Having bathed in that sacred ford, a man obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
kṣamānāthaṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam .
dānavagandharvairapsarobhiśca sevitam .. 209.2 ..
6.3.d:
क्षमानाथं ततो गच्छेत्तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् .
दानवगन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सेवितम् .. 209.2 ..
6.3.m:
Then one should go to Kṣamānātha, a sacred ford renowned in the three worlds,
frequented by dānavas, gandharvas, and apsarases.

6.3.s:
tatra tiṣṭhati deveśaḥ sākṣādrudro maheśvaraḥ .
bhāreṇa mahatā jāto bhārabhūtiriti smṛtaḥ .. 209.3 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तिष्ठति देवेशः साक्षाद्रुद्रो महेश्वरः .
भारेण महता जातो भारभूतिरिति स्मृतः .. 209.3 ..
6.3.m:
There abides the lord of gods, manifest Rudra, Maheśvara.
Born with a great burden, he is remembered as Bhārabhūti.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
bhārabhūtīti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaguṇānvitam .
śrotumicchāmi viprendra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 209.4 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
भारभूतीति विख्यातं तीर्थं सर्वगुणान्वितम् .
श्रोतुमिच्छामि विप्रेन्द्र परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 209.4 ..
6.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
I wish to hear, O best of vipras, about that sacred ford renowned as Bhārabhūti,
endowed with all virtues, for great indeed is my curiosity.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
bhārabhūtisamutpattiṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍavasattama .
vistareṇa yathā proktā purā devena śambhunā .. 209.5 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
भारभूतिसमुत्पत्तिं शृणु पाण्डवसत्तम .
विस्तरेण यथा प्रोक्ता पुरा देवेन शम्भुना .. 209.5 ..
6.3.m:
Glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Listen, O best of the Pāṇḍavas, to the origin of Bhārabhūti
in detail, as it was told of old by the god Śambhu.

6.3.s:
āsītkṛtayuge vipro vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ .
viṣṇuśarmeti vikhyātaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ .. 209.6 ..
6.3.d:
आसीत्कृतयुगे विप्रो वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः .
विष्णुशर्मेति विख्यातः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः .. 209.6 ..
6.3.m:
In the Kṛta age there was a vipra, well-versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas,
renowned as Viṣṇuśarman, who had mastered the meaning of all the śāstras.

6.3.s:
kṣamā damo dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucaṃ dhṛtistathā .
vidyā vijñānamāstikyaṃ sarvaṃ tasminpratiṣṭhitam .. 209.7 ..
6.3.d:
क्षमा दमो दया दानं सत्यं शौचं धृतिस्तथा .
विद्या विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं सर्वं तस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 209.7 ..
6.3.m:
Forbearance, self-restraint, compassion, charity, truthfulness, purity, and steadfastness,
learning, wisdom, and faith in the beyond—all were established in him.

6.3.s:
īdṛgguṇā hi ye viprā bhavanti nṛpasattama .
patitānnarake ghore tārayanti pitḥṃstu te .. 209.8 ..
6.3.d:
ईदृग्गुणा हि ये विप्रा भवन्ति नृपसत्तम .
पतितान्नरके घोरे तारयन्ति पित्ःंस्तु ते .. 209.8 ..
6.3.m:
Indeed, vipras endowed with such qualities, O best of kings,
rescue their ancestors who have fallen into dreadful hell.

6.3.s:
indriyaṃ lolupā viprā ye bhavanti nṛpottama .
patanti narake ghore raurave pāpamohitāḥ .. 209.9 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रियं लोलुपा विप्रा ये भवन्ति नृपोत्तम .
पतन्ति नरके घोरे रौरवे पापमोहिताः .. 209.9 ..
6.3.m:
Those vipras who are greedy for sensual pleasures, O best of kings,
deluded by sin, fall into the terrible Raurava hell.

6.3.s:
ye kṣāntadāntāḥ śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhānnivṛttāḥ .
pratigrahe saṃkucitāgrahastāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ .. 209.10 ..
6.3.d:
ये क्षान्तदान्ताः श्रुतिपूर्णकर्णा जितेन्द्रियाः प्राणिवधान्निवृत्ताः .
प्रतिग्रहे संकुचिताग्रहस्तास्ते ब्राह्मणास्तारयितुं समर्थाः .. 209.10 ..
6.3.m: Those who are patient, subdued, whose ears are filled with scripture, who have mastered their senses, who have abstained from slaughtering living beings, / and whose outstretched hands are restrained from accepting gifts—such brahmins are capable of delivering [their ancestors].

6.3.s:
evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇo brāhmaṇo narmadātaṭe .
vasate brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ śiloñchavṛttijīvanaḥ .. 209.11 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गुणगणाकीर्णो ब्राह्मणो नर्मदातटे .
वसते ब्राह्मणैः सार्धं शिलोञ्छवृत्तिजीवनः .. 209.11 ..
6.3.m:
A brahmin endowed with such a host of virtues, sustaining his life by the practice of gleaning grains,
dwelt on the bank of the Narmadā together with [other] brahmins.

6.3.s:
tādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jñātvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ .
dvijarūpadharo bhūtvā tasyāśramamagātsvayam .. 209.12 ..
6.3.d:
तादृशं ब्राह्मणं ज्ञात्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः .
द्विजरूपधरो भूत्वा तस्याश्रममगात्स्वयम् .. 209.12 ..
6.3.m:
Knowing such a brahmin, Maheśvara, the god of gods,
assuming the form of a twice-born, went to his hermitage himself.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhamuccarantaṃ padakramam .
abhivādayate vipraṃ svāgatena ca pūjitaḥ .. 209.13 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तं ब्राह्मणैः सार्धमुच्चरन्तं पदक्रमम् .
अभिवादयते विप्रं स्वागतेन च पूजितः .. 209.13 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing him reciting the word-by-word text and padapāṭha together with the brahmins,
he saluted the vipra and was honoured with a welcome.

6.3.s:
provāca taṃ muhūrtena brāhmaṇo vismayānvitaḥ .
kimatha tadbaṭo brūhi kiṃ karomi tavepsitam .. 209.14 ..
6.3.d:
प्रोवाच तं मुहूर्तेन ब्राह्मणो विस्मयान्वितः .
किमथ तद्बटो ब्रूहि किं करोमि तवेप्सितम् .. 209.14 ..
6.3.m:
After a moment, the brahmin, filled with wonder, spoke to him:
'For what purpose, O baṭu, speak! What desired thing of yours may I accomplish?'

6.3.s:
baṭuruvāca -
vidyārthinamanuprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ dvijasattama .
dadāsi yadi me vidyāṃ tataḥ sthāsyāmi te gṛhe .. 209.15 ..
6.3.d:
बटुरुवाच -
विद्यार्थिनमनुप्राप्तं विद्धि मां द्विजसत्तम .
ददासि यदि मे विद्यां ततः स्थास्यामि ते गृहे .. 209.15 ..
6.3.m:
The baṭu said:
'Know me as one arrived seeking learning, O best of twice-born.
If you give me knowledge, then I shall stay in your house.'

6.3.s:
brāhmaṇa uvāca -
sarveṣāmeva viprāṇāṃ baṭo tvaṃ gotra uttame .
dānānāṃ paramaṃ dānaṃ kathaṃ vidyā ca dīyate .. 209.16 ..
6.3.d:
ब्राह्मण उवाच -
सर्वेषामेव विप्राणां बटो त्वं गोत्र उत्तमे .
दानानां परमं दानं कथं विद्या च दीयते .. 209.16 ..
6.3.m:
The brahmin said:
'O baṭu, you are born in the best family of all vipras.
Learning is the highest of gifts—how can it be simply given?

6.3.s:
guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā puṣkalena dhanena vā .
athavā vidyayā vidyā bhavatīha phalapradā .. 209.17 ..
6.3.d:
गुरुशुश्रूषया विद्या पुष्कलेन धनेन वा .
अथवा विद्यया विद्या भवतीह फलप्रदा .. 209.17 ..
6.3.m:
Knowledge becomes fruitful here either through service to the guru,
or through abundant wealth, or through exchange of knowledge.'

6.3.s:
baṭuruvāca -
yathānye bālakāḥ snātāḥ śuśrūṣanti hyaharniśam .
tathāhaṃ baṭubhiḥ sārdhaṃ śuśrūṣāmi na saṃśayaḥ .. 209.18 ..
6.3.d:
बटुरुवाच -
यथान्ये बालकाः स्नाताः शुश्रूषन्ति ह्यहर्निशम् .
तथाहं बटुभिः सार्धं शुश्रूषामि न संशयः .. 209.18 ..
6.3.m:
The baṭu said:
'Just as the other boys, having bathed, render service day and night,
so shall I serve along with the students; there is no doubt.'

6.3.s:
tatheti coktvā viprendraḥ pāṭhayaṃstaṃ dine dine .
vartate saha śiṣyaiḥ sa śiloñchānupahārayan .. 209.19 ..
6.3.d:
तथेति चोक्त्वा विप्रेन्द्रः पाठयंस्तं दिने दिने .
वर्तते सह शिष्यैः स शिलोञ्छानुपहारयन् .. 209.19 ..
6.3.m:
Saying 'So be it,' the best of vipras taught him day by day,
and lived together with his pupils, bringing in gleanings of grain.

6.3.s:
tataḥ katipayāhobhiḥ prokto baṭubhirīśvaraḥ .
pacanādyaṃ baṭo karma kuru kramata āgatam .. 209.20 ..
6.3.d:
ततः कतिपयाहोभिः प्रोक्तो बटुभिरीश्वरः .
पचनाद्यं बटो कर्म कुरु क्रमत आगतम् .. 209.20 ..
6.3.m:
Then, after a few days, Īśvara was told by the students:
'O baṭu, perform the cooking and other chores that have come in turn.'

6.3.s:
tatheti cokto deveśo bhāragrāmamupāgataḥ .
dhyātvā vanaspatīḥ sarvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 209.21 ..
6.3.d:
तथेति चोक्तो देवेशो भारग्राममुपागतः .
ध्यात्वा वनस्पतीः सर्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 209.21 ..
6.3.m:
Saying 'So be it,' the lord of gods, having arrived at the village of Bhāra,
meditated on all the lords of the forest and spoke these words:

6.3.s:
yāvadāgacchate vipro baṭubhiḥ saha mandiram .
adarśanābhiḥ kartavyaṃ tāvadannaṃ susaṃskṛtam .. 209.22 ..
6.3.d:
यावदागच्छते विप्रो बटुभिः सह मन्दिरम् .
अदर्शनाभिः कर्तव्यं तावदन्नं सुसंस्कृतम् .. 209.22 ..
6.3.m:
'Until the vipra returns to the house with the students,
well-prepared food must be made by you while remaining invisible.'

6.3.s:
evamuktvā tu tāḥ sarvā viśvarūpo maheśvaraḥ .
krīḍanārthaṃ gatastatra baṭuveṣadharaḥ pṛthak .. 209.23 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु ताः सर्वा विश्वरूपो महेश्वरः .
क्रीडनार्थं गतस्तत्र बटुवेषधरः पृथक् .. 209.23 ..
6.3.m:
Having spoken thus to them all, Maheśvara, who possesses all forms,
went apart to play, assuming the guise of a baṭu.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā samāgataṃ tatra baṭuveṣadharaṃ pṛthak .
dhiktvāṃ ca paruṣaṃ vākyamūcuste girisannidhau .. 209.24 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा समागतं तत्र बटुवेषधरं पृथक् .
धिक्त्वां च परुषं वाक्यमूचुस्ते गिरिसन्निधौ .. 209.24 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing him come there apart in the guise of a baṭu,
they cursed him with harsh words near the mountain:

6.3.s:
kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhāḥ sarve ca gatvā tu kila mandiram .
tvayā siddhena cānnena tṛptiṃ yāsyāmahe vayam .. 209.25 ..
6.3.d:
क्षुत्क्षामकंठाः सर्वे च गत्वा तु किल मन्दिरम् .
त्वया सिद्धेन चान्नेन तृप्तिं यास्यामहे वयम् .. 209.25 ..
6.3.m:
'All of us, with our throats parched from hunger, having gone to the house,
were to be satisfied by the food prepared by you!

6.3.s:
tadvṛthā cintitaṃ sava tvayāgatya kṛtaṃ dvija .
mithyāpratijñena satā duranuṣṭhitamadya te .. 209.26 ..
6.3.d:
तद्वृथा चिन्तितं सव त्वयागत्य कृतं द्विज .
मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञेन सता दुरनुष्ठितमद्य ते .. 209.26 ..
6.3.m:
All that was thought in vain; having come here, O twice-born, you have made it so!
Being a breaker of promises, you have acted badly today.'

6.3.s:
baṭuruvāca -
santāpamanutāpaṃ vā bhojanārthaṃ dvijarṣabhāḥ .
mā kurudhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ siddhe'gre gṛhameṣyathā .. 209.27 ..
6.3.d:
बटुरुवाच -
सन्तापमनुतापं वा भोजनार्थं द्विजर्षभाः .
मा कुरुध्वं यथान्यायं सिद्धेऽग्रे गृहमेष्यथा .. 209.27 ..

6.3.s:
baṭuruvāca -
dinaśeṣeṇa cāsmākaṃ pañcatāṃ ca dine dine .
niṣpattiṃ yāti vā neti tadasiddhamaśeṣataḥ .. 209.28 ..
6.3.d:
बटुरुवाच -
दिनशेषेण चास्माकं पञ्चतां च दिने दिने .
निष्पत्तिं याति वा नेति तदसिद्धमशेषतः .. 209.28 ..
6.3.m:
[The students] said:
'With the remainder of the day, our death comes day by day.
Whether it has reached completion or not—all that is uncooked!

6.3.s:
asiddhaṃ siddhamasmākaṃ yattvayā samudāhṛtam .
dṛṣṭvānṛtaṃ gatāstatra tvāṃ baddhāmbhasi nikṣipe .. 209.29 ..
6.3.d:
असिद्धं सिद्धमस्माकं यत्त्वया समुदाहृतम् .
दृष्ट्वानृतं गतास्तत्र त्वां बद्धाम्भसि निक्षिपे .. 209.29 ..
6.3.m:
What you have proclaimed as cooked is raw for us.
Going there and seeing the falsehood, I shall bind you and throw you into the water!'

6.3.s:
baṭuruvāca -
bhobhoḥ śṛṇudhva sarve'tra sopādhyāyā dvijottamāḥ .
pratijñāṃ mama durdharṣāṃ yāṃ śrutvā vismayo bhavet .. 209.30 ..
6.3.d:
बटुरुवाच -
भोभोः शृणुध्व सर्वेऽत्र सोपाध्याया द्विजोत्तमाः .
प्रतिज्ञां मम दुर्धर्षां यां श्रुत्वा विस्मयो भवेत् .. 209.30 ..
6.3.m:
The baṭu said:
'Listen, all of you best among the twice-born here, together with your teacher,
to my formidable pledge, hearing which there will be astonishment:

6.3.s:
yadi siddhamidaṃ sarvamannaṃ syādāśrame guroḥ .
yūyaṃ baddhvā mayā sarve kṣeptavyā narmadāmbhasi .. 209.31 ..
6.3.d:
यदि सिद्धमिदं सर्वमन्नं स्यादाश्रमे गुरोः .
यूयं बद्ध्वा मया सर्वे क्षेप्तव्या नर्मदाम्भसि .. 209.31 ..
6.3.m:
If all this food is cooked in the guru's hermitage,
you all are to be bound by me and thrown into the waters of the Narmadā!

6.3.s:
athavānnaṃ na siddhaṃ syādbhavadbhirdṛḍhabandhanaiḥ .
gurostu paśyato baddhvā kṣeptavyo'haṃ narmadāhrade .. 209.32 ..
6.3.d:
अथवान्नं न सिद्धं स्याद्भवद्भिर्दृढबन्धनैः .
गुरोस्तु पश्यतो बद्ध्वा क्षेप्तव्योऽहं नर्मदाह्रदे .. 209.32 ..
6.3.m:
Or, if the food should not be cooked, then, bound fast by you with tight bonds
while the guru looks on, I must be thrown into the deep pool of the Narmadā!'

6.3.s:
tatheti kṛtvā te sarve samayaṃ gurusannidhau .
snātvā jāpyavidhānena bhūtagrāmaṃ tato yayuḥ .. 209.33 ..
6.3.d:
तथेति कृत्वा ते सर्वे समयं गुरुसन्निधौ .
स्नात्वा जाप्यविधानेन भूतग्रामं ततो ययुः .. 209.33 ..
6.3.m:
Having agreed 'So be it' in the presence of the guru,
they bathed according to the rules of japa and then went to the settlement.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā te vismayaṃ jagmurvistṛte bhakṣyabhojane .
ṣaḍrasena nṛpaśreṣṭha bhuktvā hutvā pṛthakpṛthak .. 209.34 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मयं जग्मुर्विस्तृते भक्ष्यभोजने .
षड्रसेन नृपश्रेष्ठ भुक्त्वा हुत्वा पृथक्पृथक् .. 209.34 ..
6.3.m:
Seeing the spread of food and delicacies of six tastes, they were struck with wonder, O best of kings,
and they ate and offered oblations individually.

6.3.s:
tataḥ provāca vacanaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭo dvijottamaḥ .
varado'smi varaṃ vatsa vṛṇu yattava rocate .. 209.35 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रोवाच वचनं हृष्टपुष्टो द्विजोत्तमः .
वरदोऽस्मि वरं वत्स वृणु यत्तव रोचते .. 209.35 ..
6.3.m:
Then, joyful and satisfied, the best of the twice-born spoke these words:
'I grant you a boon, child; choose whatever pleases you!

6.3.s:
sāṅgopāṅgāstu te vedāḥ śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca .
pratibhāsyanti te vipra madīyo'stu varastvayam .. 209.36 ..
6.3.d:
साङ्गोपाङ्गास्तु ते वेदाः शास्त्राणि विविधानि च .
प्रतिभास्यन्ति ते विप्र मदीयोऽस्तु वरस्त्वयम् .. 209.36 ..
6.3.m:
The Vedas with their limbs and secondary limbs, and the various śāstras,
shall shine forth to you, O vipra; let this boon be mine to you!'

6.3.s:
praṇamya baṭubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sa cikrīḍa yathāsukham .
dvitīye tu tataḥ prāpte divase narmadājale .. 209.37 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य बटुभिः सार्धं स चिक्रीड यथासुखम् .
द्वितीये तु ततः प्राप्ते दिवसे नर्मदाजले .. 209.37 ..
6.3.m:
Bowing, he played at ease with the students.
Then, when the second day arrived, in the waters of the Narmadā...

6.3.s:
krīḍanārthaṃ gatāḥ sarve sopādhyāyā yudhiṣṭhira .
tataḥ smṛtvā paṇaṃ sarve bhāṣayitvā vidhānataḥ .. 209.38 ..
6.3.d:
क्रीडनार्थं गताः सर्वे सोपाध्याया युधिष्ठिर .
ततः स्मृत्वा पणं सर्वे भाषयित्वा विधानतः .. 209.38 ..
6.3.m: O Yudhiṣṭhira, they all went to play together with their teacher. / Then, recalling their wager, having duly made them recite,

6.3.s:
upādhyāyamathovāca natvā devaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ .
jale prakṣepayāmyadya niṣpratijñān baṭūn prabho .. 209.39 ..
6.3.d:
उपाध्यायमथोवाच नत्वा देवः कृताञ्जलिः .
जले प्रक्षेपयाम्यद्य निष्प्रतिज्ञान् बटून् प्रभो .. 209.39 ..
6.3.m: the god, bowing with folded hands, then said to the teacher: / 'O lord, today I shall cast into the water those students who broke their vow.'

6.3.s:
taddevasya vacaḥ śrutvā naṣṭāste baṭavo nṛpa .
gurostu paśyato rājandhāvamānā diśo daśa .. 209.40 ..
6.3.d:
तद्देवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नष्टास्ते बटवो नृप .
गुरोस्तु पश्यतो राजन्धावमाना दिशो दश .. 209.40 ..
6.3.m: Hearing that word of the god, those students fled, O king, / running in the ten directions while the teacher looked on, O king.

6.3.s:
vāyuvegena devena luñjitāste samantataḥ .
bhāraṃ baddhvā tu sarveṣāṃ baṭūnāṃ ca nareśvara .. 209.41 ..
6.3.d:
वायुवेगेन देवेन लुञ्जितास्ते समन्ततः .
भारं बद्ध्वा तु सर्वेषां बटूनां च नरेश्वर .. 209.41 ..
6.3.m: They were gathered up from all sides by the god with the speed of the wind; / and tying all the students into a bundle, O lord of men,

6.3.s:
śāpānugrahako devo'kṣipattoye yathā gṛhe .
tato viṣādamagamaddṛṣṭvā tānnarmadājale .. 209.42 ..
6.3.d:
शापानुग्रहको देवोऽक्षिपत्तोये यथा गृहे .
ततो विषादमगमद्दृष्ट्वा तान्नर्मदाजले .. 209.42 ..
6.3.m: the god, bestower of curses and favors, threw them into the water as if [throwing them] into a house. / Then, seeing them in the waters of the Narmadā, he was filled with dejection;

6.3.s:
guruṇā baṭurukto'tha kimetatsāhasaṃ kṛtam .
eteṣāṃ mātṛpitaro bālakānāṃ gṛhe'ṅganāḥ .. 209.43 ..
6.3.d:
गुरुणा बटुरुक्तोऽथ किमेतत्साहसं कृतम् .
एतेषां मातृपितरो बालकानां गृहेऽङ्गनाः .. 209.43 ..
6.3.m: and the student was addressed by the teacher: 'What rash deed has been done? / These boys have mothers and fathers, and women at home;

6.3.s:
yadi pṛcchanti te bālān kva gatān kathayāmyaham .
evaṃ sthite mahābhāga yadi kaścinmariṣyati .. 209.44 ..
6.3.d:
यदि पृच्छन्ति ते बालान् क्व गतान् कथयाम्यहम् .
एवं स्थिते महाभाग यदि कश्चिन्मरिष्यति .. 209.44 ..
6.3.m: if they ask, where have the boys gone, what shall I say? / This being the case, O illustrious one, if any of them dies,

6.3.s:
tadā svakīyajīvena tvaṃ yojayitumarhasi .
mṛteṣu teṣu vipreṣu na jīve niścayo mṛtaḥ .. 209.45 ..
6.3.d:
तदा स्वकीयजीवेन त्वं योजयितुमर्हसि .
मृतेषु तेषु विप्रेषु न जीवे निश्चयो मृतः .. 209.45 ..
6.3.m: then you must restore him with your own life. / If those brahmins die, I will not live; it is certain that I will die.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyāśca te bahvyo bhaviṣyanti mṛte mayi .
dvijabandhanamātreṇa narako bhavati dhruvam .. 209.46 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्याश्च ते बह्व्यो भविष्यन्ति मृते मयि .
द्विजबन्धनमात्रेण नरको भवति ध्रुवम् .. 209.46 ..
6.3.m: And many sins of killing brahmins will accrue to you if I die. / Merely by binding a twice-born, hell is certain.

6.3.s:
maraṇādyāṃ gatiṃ yāsi na tāṃ vedmi dvijādhama .
evamuktaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 209.47 ..
6.3.d:
मरणाद्यां गतिं यासि न तां वेद्मि द्विजाधम .
एवमुक्तः स्मितं कृत्वा देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 209.47 ..
6.3.m: From [their] death, to what state of existence you will go, I do not know, O lowest of the twice-born!' / Addressed thus, the god of gods, Maheśvara, smiled;

6.3.s:
bhārabhūteśvare tīrtha ujjahāra jalāddvijān .
muktvā bhāraṃ tu devena chādayitvā tu tāndvijān .. 209.48 ..
6.3.d:
भारभूतेश्वरे तीर्थ उज्जहार जलाद्द्विजान् .
मुक्त्वा भारं तु देवेन छादयित्वा तु तान्द्विजान् .. 209.48 ..
6.3.m: and at the sacred ford Bhārabhūteśvara, he lifted the twice-born from the water. / The god released the load and covered those twice-born,

6.3.s:
liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ tatra bhārabhūteti viśrutam .
mṛtāṃstān vai dvijān dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyā nirākṛtā .. 209.49 ..
6.3.d:
लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितं तत्र भारभूतेति विश्रुतम् .
मृतांस्तान् वै द्विजान् दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्महत्या निराकृता .. 209.49 ..
6.3.m: and a liṅga was installed there, renowned as Bhārabhūta. / Seeing those twice-born dead [and then restored], the sin of killing brahmins was dispelled;

6.3.s:
gatāni pañca vai dṛṣṭvā brahmahatyāśatāni vai .
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo dṛṣṭvā tānbālakān guruḥ .. 209.50 ..
6.3.d:
गतानि पञ्च वै दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्महत्याशतानि वै .
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो दृष्ट्वा तान्बालकान् गुरुः .. 209.50 ..
6.3.m: five hundred sins of killing brahmins were indeed seen to be removed. / Then the teacher, filled with wonder at seeing those boys,

6.3.s:
nānyasya kasyacicchaktirevaṃ syādīśvaraṃ vinā .
jñātvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ praṇāmamakaroddvijaḥ .. 209.51 ..
6.3.d:
नान्यस्य कस्यचिच्छक्तिरेवं स्यादीश्वरं विना .
ज्ञात्वा तं देवदेवेशं प्रणाममकरोद्द्विजः .. 209.51 ..
6.3.m: [thought:] 'No one else could have such power, except Īśvara.' / Knowing him to be the god, the lord of gods, the twice-born bowed down [saying]:

6.3.s:
ajñānena mayā sava yaduktaṃ parameśvara .
apriyaṃ yatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣantavyaṃ tanmama prabho .. 209.52 ..
6.3.d:
अज्ञानेन मया सव यदुक्तं परमेश्वर .
अप्रियं यत्कृतं सर्वं क्षन्तव्यं तन्मम प्रभो .. 209.52 ..
6.3.m: 'Whatever I said out of ignorance, O supreme lord, / whatever displeasure I caused, all that must be forgiven by you, my lord.'

6.3.s:
deva uvāca -
bhagavangururbhavāndevo bhavānmama pitāmahaḥ .
vedagarbha namaste'stu nāsti kaścidvyatikramaḥ .. 209.53 ..
6.3.d:
देव उवाच -
भगवन्गुरुर्भवान्देवो भवान्मम पितामहः .
वेदगर्भ नमस्तेऽस्तु नास्ति कश्चिद्व्यतिक्रमः .. 209.53 ..
6.3.m: The god said: / 'Revered sir, you are my guru, you are a god, you are my grandfather. / O Vedagarbha, salutations to you! There has been no transgression at all.

6.3.s:
janitā copanetā ca yastu vidyāṃ prayacchati .
annadātā bhayatrātā pañcaite pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 209.54 ..
6.3.d:
जनिता चोपनेता च यस्तु विद्यां प्रयच्छति .
अन्नदाता भयत्राता पञ्चैते पितरः स्मृताः .. 209.54 ..
6.3.m: The progenitor, the initiator, the one who imparts learning, / the giver of food, and the protector from fear—these five are remembered as fathers.'

6.3.s:
evamuktvā jagannātho viṣṇuśarmāṇamānataḥ .
tatra tīrthe jagāmāśu kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam .. 209.55 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा जगन्नाथो विष्णुशर्माणमानतः .
तत्र तीर्थे जगामाशु कैलासं धरणीधरम् .. 209.55 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus, the Lord of the Universe, bowing to Viṣṇuśarman / at that sacred ford, went quickly to Mount Kailāsa.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ bhārabhūtīti viśrutam .
vikhyātaṃ sarvalokeṣu mahāpātakanāśanam .. 209.56 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं भारभूतीति विश्रुतम् .
विख्यातं सर्वलोकेषु महापातकनाशनम् .. 209.56 ..
6.3.m: From that time forward, that sacred ford has been renowned as Bhārabhūti, / celebrated in all the worlds, destroyer of great heinous sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe punarvṛttamitihāsaṃ bravīmi te .
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyamekāgrastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat .. 209.57 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे पुनर्वृत्तमितिहासं ब्रवीमि ते .
सर्वपापहरं दिव्यमेकाग्रस्त्वं शृणुष्व तत् .. 209.57 ..
6.3.m: I shall tell you another historical narrative that took place at that sacred ford, / divine, removing all sins; listen to it attentively.

6.3.s:
purā kṛtayugasyādau vaiśyaḥ kaścinmahāmanāḥ .
sukeśa iti vikhyātastasya putro'tidhārmikaḥ .. 209.58 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ वैश्यः कश्चिन्महामनाः .
सुकेश इति विख्यातस्तस्य पुत्रोऽतिधार्मिकः .. 209.58 ..
6.3.m: Long ago, in the beginning of the Kṛta age, there was a noble-minded merchant / known as Sukeśa; he had a very righteous son,

6.3.s:
somaśarmeti vikhyāto mṛtaḥ pṛthulalocanaḥ .
sa sakhāyaṃ vaṇikputraṃ kaṃciccakre daridriṇam .. 209.59 ..
6.3.d:
सोमशर्मेति विख्यातो मृतः पृथुललोचनः .
स सखायं वणिक्पुत्रं कंचिच्चक्रे दरिद्रिणम् .. 209.59 ..
6.3.m: renowned as Somaśarman, large-eyed. [When his father] died, / he made a friend of a certain poor merchant's son

6.3.s:
sudevamiti khyātaṃ sarvakarmasu kovidam .
ekadā tu samaṃ tena vyavahāramacintayat .. 209.60 ..
6.3.d:
सुदेवमिति ख्यातं सर्वकर्मसु कोविदम् .
एकदा तु समं तेन व्यवहारमचिन्तयत् .. 209.60 ..
6.3.m: known as Sudeva, who was skilled in all kinds of work. / Once, he contemplated business together with him:

6.3.s:
sakhe samudrayānena gacchāvottaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ .
bhāṇḍaṃ bahu samādāya madīye dravyasādhane .. 209.61 ..
6.3.d:
सखे समुद्रयानेन गच्छावोत्तरणैः शुभैः .
भाण्डं बहु समादाय मदीये द्रव्यसाधने .. 209.61 ..
6.3.m: 'O friend, let us go by sea-voyage with auspicious crossing-vessels, / taking much merchandise for our accumulation of wealth;

6.3.s:
paraṃ tīraṃ gamiṣyāva utkarṣastvāvayoḥ samaḥ .
iti tau mantrayitvā tu mantravatsamabhīpsitam .. 209.62 ..
6.3.d:
परं तीरं गमिष्याव उत्कर्षस्त्वावयोः समः .
इति तौ मन्त्रयित्वा तु मन्त्रवत्समभीप्सितम् .. 209.62 ..
6.3.m: we will go to the other shore, and our profit shall be equal.' / Having thus conferred with each other, like a secret counsel, on their desired purpose,

6.3.s:
sarvaṃ prayāṇakaṃ gṛhya hyārūḍhau lavaṇodadhim .
tau gatvā tu paraṃ bhāṇḍaṃ vikrīya puratastadā .. 209.63 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वं प्रयाणकं गृह्य ह्यारूढौ लवणोदधिम् .
तौ गत्वा तु परं भाण्डं विक्रीय पुरतस्तदा .. 209.63 ..
6.3.m: taking all their provisions, they embarked upon the salt ocean. / Having gone there and sold that merchandise in the city at that time,

6.3.s:
prāptau bahu suvarṇaṃ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca .
nāvaṃ tāṃ saṃgatāṃ kṛtvā paścāttāvārurohatuḥ .. 209.64 ..
6.3.d:
प्राप्तौ बहु सुवर्णं च रत्नानि विविधानि च .
नावं तां संगतां कृत्वा पश्चात्तावारुरोहतुः .. 209.64 ..
6.3.m: they obtained much gold and various jewels. / Having readied the boat, they then boarded it.

6.3.s:
nāvamantarjale dṛṣṭvā niśīthe svarṇasaṃbhṛtām .
dṛṣṭvā tu somaśarmāṇamutsaṅge kṛtamastakam .. 209.65 ..
6.3.d:
नावमन्तर्जले दृष्ट्वा निशीथे स्वर्णसंभृताम् .
दृष्ट्वा तु सोमशर्माणमुत्सङ्गे कृतमस्तकम् .. 209.65 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the boat laden with gold in the midst of the water at midnight, / and seeing Somaśarman with his head resting on his lap,

6.3.s:
śayānamativiśvastaṃ sahadevo vyacintayat .
eṣa nidrāvaśaṃ yāto mayi prāṇānnidhāya vai .. 209.66 ..
6.3.d:
शयानमतिविश्वस्तं सहदेवो व्यचिन्तयत् .
एष निद्रावशं यातो मयि प्राणान्निधाय वै .. 209.66 ..
6.3.m: sleeping full of trust, Sahadeva thought: / 'He has succumbed to sleep, having entrusted his very life to me;

6.3.s:
asyādhīnamidaṃ sarvaṃ dravyaratnamaśeṣataḥ .
utkarṣārddhaṃ tu me dadyāttatra gatveti vā na vā .. 209.67 ..
6.3.d:
अस्याधीनमिदं सर्वं द्रव्यरत्नमशेषतः .
उत्कर्षार्द्धं तु मे दद्यात्तत्र गत्वेति वा न वा .. 209.67 ..
6.3.m: all this wealth and jewel-store without remainder is under his control. / After going there, he may give me half the profit or he may not.'

6.3.s:
iti niścitya manasā pāpastaṃ lavaṇodadhau .
cikṣepa somaśarmāṇaṃ pāpadhyātena cetasā .. 209.68 ..
6.3.d:
इति निश्चित्य मनसा पापस्तं लवणोदधौ .
चिक्षेप सोमशर्माणं पापध्यातेन चेतसा .. 209.68 ..
6.3.m: Having thus resolved in his mind, the wicked man with evil intent / threw Somaśarman into the salt ocean.

6.3.s:
uttīrya taraṇāttasmādgatvā saṃgṛhya taddhanam .
tataḥ katipayāhobhiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kāladharmaṇā .. 209.69 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तीर्य तरणात्तस्माद्गत्वा संगृह्य तद्धनम् .
ततः कतिपयाहोभिः संयुक्तः कालधर्मणा .. 209.69 ..
6.3.m: Disembarking from that vessel, he went taking that wealth. / Then, after a few days, overtaken by the law of time [death],

6.3.s:
gato yamapuraṃ ghoraṃ gṛhīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ .
sa nītastena mārgeṇa yatra saṃtapate raviḥ .. 209.70 ..
6.3.d:
गतो यमपुरं घोरं गृहीतो यमकिंकरैः .
स नीतस्तेन मार्गेण यत्र संतपते रविः .. 209.70 ..
6.3.m: he went to the terrifying abode of Yama, seized by the servants of Yama. / He was led along that path where the sun burns intensely,

6.3.s:
kṛtvā dvādaśadhātmānaṃ samprāpte pralaye yathā .
sutīkṣṇāḥ kaṇṭakā yatra yatra śvānaḥ sudāruṇāḥ .. 209.71 ..
6.3.d:
कृत्वा द्वादशधात्मानं सम्प्राप्ते प्रलये यथा .
सुतीक्ष्णाः कण्टका यत्र यत्र श्वानः सुदारुणाः .. 209.71 ..
6.3.m: multiplying itself twelvefold as if at the arrival of universal dissolution; / where there are very sharp thorns, where there are ferocious dogs,

6.3.s:
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrā mahāvyālā vyāghrā yatra mahāvṛkāḥ .
sutaptā vālukā yatra kṣudhā tṛṣṇā tamo mahat .. 209.72 ..
6.3.d:
तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा महाव्याला व्याघ्रा यत्र महावृकाः .
सुतप्ता वालुका यत्र क्षुधा तृष्णा तमो महत् .. 209.72 ..
6.3.m: sharp-fanged great serpents, tigers, and great wolves; / where the sand is scorching hot, and there is hunger, thirst, and dense darkness;

6.3.s:
pānīyasya kathā nāsti na chāyā nāśramaḥ kvacit .
annaṃ pānīyasahitaṃ yāvattaddīyate viṣam .. 209.73 ..
6.3.d:
पानीयस्य कथा नास्ति न छाया नाश्रमः क्वचित् .
अन्नं पानीयसहितं यावत्तद्दीयते विषम् .. 209.73 ..
6.3.m: where there is no mention of water, no shade, nor any resting place anywhere; / and whatever food with drink is given turns out to be poison;

6.3.s:
chāyāṃ saṃprārthamānānāṃ bhṛśaṃ jvalati pāvakaḥ .
