“Who plays without fear with an enraged great serpent, / that he would take away my cow, looked upon by death itself?”

6.3.s:
evamuktvā mahādaṇḍaṃ brahmadaṇḍamivāparam .
gṛhītvā paramakruddho jamadagniruvāca ha .. 218.20 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादण्डं ब्रह्मदण्डमिवापरम् .
गृहीत्वा परमक्रुद्धो जमदग्निरुवाच ह .. 218.20 ..
6.3.m: Having spoken thus and seized a great staff, like another staff of Brahmā, / Jamadagni, exceedingly enraged, said:

6.3.s:
yasyāsti śaktistejo vā kṣatriyasya kulādhamaḥ .
dhenuṃ nayatu me sadyaḥ kṣīṇāyuḥ saparicchadaḥ .. 218.21 ..
6.3.d:
यस्यास्ति शक्तिस्तेजो वा क्षत्रियस्य कुलाधमः .
धेनुं नयतु मे सद्यः क्षीणायुः सपरिच्छदः .. 218.21 ..
6.3.m: “Let whichever base-born kṣatriya who has the power or fiery energy / take my cow at once, his life depleted along with his retinue!”

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacaḥ krūraṃ haihayaḥ śataśo vṛtaḥ .
dhāvamānaḥ kṣititale brahmadaṇḍahato'patat .. 218.22 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचः क्रूरं हैहयः शतशो वृतः .
धावमानः क्षितितले ब्रह्मदण्डहतोऽपतत् .. 218.22 ..
6.3.m: Hearing these fierce words, the Haihaya, surrounded by hundreds [of men], / running forward on the ground, fell down, struck by the staff of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
huṃkṛtena tato dhenvāḥ khaḍgapāśāsipāṇayaḥ .
nirgacchantaḥ pradṛśyante kalmaṣāyāḥ sahasraśaḥ .. 218.23 ..
6.3.d:
हुंकृतेन ततो धेन्वाः खड्गपाशासिपाणयः .
निर्गच्छन्तः प्रदृश्यन्ते कल्मषायाः सहस्रशः .. 218.23 ..
6.3.m: Then, from the snort of the cow, [warriors] with swords, nooses, and scimitars in hand / were seen issuing forth in thousands, dark and spotted.

6.3.s:
nāsāpuṭāgrādromāgrātkirātā māgadhā gudāt .
randhrāntareṣu cotpannāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ .. 218.24 ..
6.3.d:
नासापुटाग्राद्रोमाग्रात्किराता मागधा गुदात् .
रन्ध्रान्तरेषु चोत्पन्नाः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः .. 218.24 ..
6.3.m: From the tips of her nostrils and the tips of her hair came Kirātas; from her anus, Māgadhas; / and in the spaces of her pores arose hundreds and thousands.

6.3.s:
evamanyo'nyamāhatya haihayaṣṭaṅkaṇāndahan .
vināśaṃ saha vipreṇa gatā hyarjunatejasā .. 218.25 ..
6.3.d:
एवमन्योऽन्यमाहत्य हैहयष्टङ्कणान्दहन् .
विनाशं सह विप्रेण गता ह्यर्जुनतेजसा .. 218.25 ..
6.3.m: Thus striking one another, the Haihaya burnt the Ṭaṅkaṇas, / and they met their destruction together with the brahmin through the fiery energy of Arjuna.

6.3.s:
kārtavīryo jayaṃ labdhvā saṃkhye hatvā dvijottamam .
jagāma svāṃ purīṃ hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāntavaśamohitaḥ .. 218.26 ..
6.3.d:
कार्तवीर्यो जयं लब्ध्वा संख्ये हत्वा द्विजोत्तमम् .
जगाम स्वां पुरीं हृष्टः कृतान्तवशमोहितः .. 218.26 ..
6.3.m: Kārtavīrya, having won victory in the battle and slain the best of brahmins, / went to his city rejoicing, deluded by the power of fate.

6.3.s:
tatastvarānvitaḥ prāptaḥ paścādrāmo gate ripau .
ākrandamānāṃ jananīṃ dadarśa piturantike .. 218.27 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्त्वरान्वितः प्राप्तः पश्चाद्रामो गते रिपौ .
आक्रन्दमानां जननीं ददर्श पितुरन्तिके .. 218.27 ..
6.3.m: Then Rāma arrived in haste after the enemy had departed; / he saw his mother lamenting beside his father.

6.3.s:
rāma uvāca -
kenedamātmanāśāya hyajñānātsāhasaṃ kṛtam .
mama tātaṃ jighāṃsuryo draṣṭuṃ mṛtyumihecchati .. 218.28 ..
6.3.d:
राम उवाच -
केनेदमात्मनाशाय ह्यज्ञानात्साहसं कृतम् .
मम तातं जिघांसुर्यो द्रष्टुं मृत्युमिहेच्छति .. 218.28 ..
6.3.m:
Rāma said:
“By whom has this reckless act been committed through ignorance to his own destruction, / who, wishing to slay my father, desires to behold death in this world?”

6.3.s:
tataḥ sā rāmavākyena gatasattveva vihvalā .
udaraṃ karayugmena tāḍayantī hyuvāca tam .. 218.29 ..
6.3.d:
ततः सा रामवाक्येन गतसत्त्वेव विह्वला .
उदरं करयुग्मेन ताडयन्ती ह्युवाच तम् .. 218.29 ..
6.3.m: Then she, distraught at Rāma's words as if drained of life, / beating her belly with both hands, said to him:

6.3.s:
arjunena nṛśaṃsena kṣatriyairaparaiḥ saha .
ihāgatya pitā tena nihato bāhuśālinā .. 218.30 ..
6.3.d:
अर्जुनेन नृशंसेन क्षत्रियैरपरैः सह .
इहागत्य पिता तेन निहतो बाहुशालिना .. 218.30 ..
6.3.m: “By the cruel Arjuna, along with other kṣatriyas, / coming here, your father was slain by that strong-armed one.

6.3.s:
taṃ paśya nihataṃ tātaṃ gatāsuṃ gatacetasam .
saṃskṛtya vidhivatputra tarpayasva yathātatham .. 218.31 ..
6.3.d:
तं पश्य निहतं तातं गतासुं गतचेतसम् .
संस्कृत्य विधिवत्पुत्र तर्पयस्व यथातथम् .. 218.31 ..
6.3.m: Behold your slain father, lifeless and unconscious. / Having cremated him according to rule, O son, offer him proper oblations of water.”

6.3.s:
etacchrutvā sa vacanaṃ jananīmabhivādya tām .
pratijñāmakarodyāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva ca narādhipa .. 218.32 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा स वचनं जननीमभिवाद्य ताम् .
प्रतिज्ञामकरोद्यां तां शृणुष्व च नराधिप .. 218.32 ..
6.3.m: Hearing these words and bowing to his mother, / he made a vow; listen to it, O king:

6.3.s:
triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ niḥkṣatriyakulānvayām .
snātvā ca teṣāmasṛjā tarpayiṣyāmi te patim .. 218.33 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिःसप्तकृत्वः पृथिवीं निःक्षत्रियकुलान्वयाम् .
स्नात्वा च तेषामसृजा तर्पयिष्यामि ते पतिम् .. 218.33 ..
6.3.m: “Twenty-one times over I shall make the earth rid of all kṣatriya lineages; / and having bathed in their blood, I shall offer oblations to your husband.

6.3.s:
tasyāpi paraśunā bāhūn kārtavīryasya durmateḥ .
chittvā pāsyāmi rudhiramiti satyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me .. 218.34 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यापि परशुना बाहून् कार्तवीर्यस्य दुर्मतेः .
छित्त्वा पास्यामि रुधिरमिति सत्यं शृणुष्व मे .. 218.34 ..
6.3.m: And severing the arms of that evil-minded Kārtavīrya with an axe, / I will drink his blood; hear this truth from me!”

6.3.s:
evaṃ pratijñāṃ kṛtvāsau jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān .
krodhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ saṃskṛtya pitaraṃ tataḥ .. 218.35 ..
6.3.d:
एवं प्रतिज्ञां कृत्वासौ जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान् .
क्रोधेन महताविष्टः संस्कृत्य पितरं ततः .. 218.35 ..
6.3.m: Having thus made the vow, that powerful son of Jamadagni, / overcome with great fury, then cremated his father,

6.3.s:
māhiṣmatīṃ purīṃ rāmo jagāma krodhamūrchitaḥ .
chittvā bāhuvanaṃ tasya hatvā taṃ kṣatriyādhamam .. 218.36 ..
6.3.d:
माहिष्मतीं पुरीं रामो जगाम क्रोधमूर्छितः .
छित्त्वा बाहुवनं तस्य हत्वा तं क्षत्रियाधमम् .. 218.36 ..
6.3.m: and, bewildered with anger, Rāma went to the city of Māhiṣmatī; / cutting off the forest of his arms, he slew that vilest of kṣatriyas.

6.3.s:
jagāma kṣatriyāntāya pṛthivīmavalokayan .
saptadvīpārṇavayutāṃ saśailavanakānanām .. 218.37 ..
6.3.d:
जगाम क्षत्रियान्ताय पृथिवीमवलोकयन् .
सप्तद्वीपार्णवयुतां सशैलवनकाननाम् .. 218.37 ..
6.3.m: He set out to exterminate the kṣatriyas, surveying the earth / with its seven continents and oceans, its mountains, forests, and woods.

6.3.s:
pūrvataḥ paścimāmāśāṃ dakṣiṇottarataḥ kurūn .
samantapañcake pañca cakāra rudhirahradān .. 218.38 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्वतः पश्चिमामाशां दक्षिणोत्तरतः कुरून् .
समन्तपञ्चके पञ्च चकार रुधिरह्रदान् .. 218.38 ..
6.3.m: From the eastern to the western direction, from south to north in the Kurus, / he made five pools of blood in Samantapañcaka.

6.3.s:
sa teṣu rudhirāmbhastu hradeṣu krodhamūrchitaḥ .
pitṝn saṃtarpayāmāsa rudhireṇeti naḥ śrutam .. 218.39 ..
6.3.d:
स तेषु रुधिराम्भस्तु ह्रदेषु क्रोधमूर्छितः .
पितॄन् संतर्पयामास रुधिरेणेति नः श्रुतम् .. 218.39 ..
6.3.m: Bewildered with anger, in those pools whose water was blood, / he satiated his ancestors with blood; so it has been heard by us.

6.3.s:
atharcīkādaya upetya pitaro brāhmaṇarṣabham .
taṃ kṣamasveti jagadustataḥ sa virarāma ha .. 218.40 ..
6.3.d:
अथर्चीकादय उपेत्य पितरो ब्राह्मणर्षभम् .
तं क्षमस्वेति जगदुस्ततः स विरराम ह .. 218.40 ..
6.3.m: Then his ancestors, headed by Ṛcīka, approached that bull among brahmins / and said to him, “Forgive!” whereupon he ceased.

6.3.s:
teṣāṃ samīpe yo deśo hradānāṃ rudhirāmbhasām .
samaṃ tapaṃ cakramiti puṇyaṃ tatparikīrtitam .. 218.41 ..
6.3.d:
तेषां समीपे यो देशो ह्रदानां रुधिराम्भसाम् .
समं तपं चक्रमिति पुण्यं तत्परिकीर्तितम् .. 218.41 ..
6.3.m: The region near those pools of bloody waters / is proclaimed holy, having an even wheel of austerity.

6.3.s:
nivartya karmaṇastasmātpitḥn provāca pāṇḍava .
rāmaḥ paramadharmātmā yadidaṃ rudhiraṃ mayā .. 218.42 ..
6.3.d:
निवर्त्य कर्मणस्तस्मात्पित्ःन् प्रोवाच पाण्डव .
रामः परमधर्मात्मा यदिदं रुधिरं मया .. 218.42 ..
6.3.m: Having turned back from that deed, Rāma, supreme in righteousness, / said to the ancestors, O Pāṇḍava: “The blood that by me

6.3.s:
kṣiptaṃ pañcasu tīrtheṣu tadbhūyāttīrthamuttamam .
tathetyuktvā tu te sarve pitaro'dṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ .. 218.43 ..
6.3.d:
क्षिप्तं पञ्चसु तीर्थेषु तद्भूयात्तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे पितरोऽदृश्यतां गताः .. 218.43 ..
6.3.m: was cast into the five sacred fords—may it become an excellent sacred ford!” / Having said, “So be it,” all those ancestors vanished from sight.

6.3.s:
evaṃ rāmasya saṃsargo devamārge yudhiṣṭhira .
sarvapāpakṣayakaro darśanātsparśanānnṛṇām .. 218.44 ..
6.3.d:
एवं रामस्य संसर्गो देवमार्गे युधिष्ठिर .
सर्वपापक्षयकरो दर्शनात्स्पर्शनान्नृणाम् .. 218.44 ..
6.3.m: Such contact with Rāma on the divine path, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / destroys all sins through seeing and touching, for men.

6.3.s:
reṇukāpratyayārthāya adyāpi pitṛdevatāḥ .
dṛśyante devamārgasthāḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkarāḥ .. 218.45 ..
6.3.d:
रेणुकाप्रत्ययार्थाय अद्यापि पितृदेवताः .
दृश्यन्ते देवमार्गस्थाः सर्वपापक्षयंकराः .. 218.45 ..
6.3.m: To instill faith in Reṇukā, even today the ancestral deities / are seen situated on the divine path, destroying all sins.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu rājendra narmadodadhisaṅgame .
sthānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena mucyante pātakairnarāḥ .. 218.46 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु राजेन्द्र नर्मदोदधिसङ्गमे .
स्थानं कृत्वा विधानेन मुच्यन्ते पातकैर्नराः .. 218.46 ..
6.3.m: At that sacred ford, O king of kings, at the confluence of the Narmadā and the ocean, / having performed ablution according to the rules, men are freed from grave sins.

6.3.s:
kuśāgreṇāpi kaunteya na spṛṣṭavyo mahodadhiḥ .
anena tatra mantreṇa snātavyaṃ nṛpasattama .. 218.47 ..
6.3.d:
कुशाग्रेणापि कौन्तेय न स्पृष्टव्यो महोदधिः .
अनेन तत्र मन्त्रेण स्नातव्यं नृपसत्तम .. 218.47 ..
6.3.m: The great ocean should not be touched even with the tip of a kuśa blade [without a mantra], O son of Kuntī; / one should bathe there with this mantra, O best of kings:

6.3.s:
namaste viṣṇurūpāya namastubhyamapāṃ pate .
sānnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi .
iti sparśanamantraḥ .. 218.48 ..
6.3.d:
नमस्ते विष्णुरूपाय नमस्तुभ्यमपां पते .
सान्निध्यं कुरु देवेश सागरे लवणाम्भसि .
इति स्पर्शनमन्त्रः .. 218.48 ..
6.3.m:
“Salutations to you who are of the form of Viṣṇu! Salutations to you, O lord of waters! / Bestow your presence, O lord of gods, in the ocean of salty waters.”
— Thus is the mantra for touching [the ocean].

6.3.s:
agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca dehe reto'tha viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ .
etadbruvan pāṇḍava satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām .. 218.49 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निश्च तेजो मृडया च देहे रेतोऽथ विष्णुरमृतस्य नाभिः .
एतद्ब्रुवन् पाण्डव सत्यवाक्यं ततोऽवगाहेत पतिं नदीनाम् .. 218.49 ..
6.3.m: “Agni is energy, and with Mṛḍā in the body; seed then is Viṣṇu, the navel of nectar.” / Uttering this true statement, O Pāṇḍava, one should then plunge into the lord of rivers.

6.3.s:
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ phalapuṣpākṣatairyutam .
mantreṇānena rājendra dadyādarghaṃ mahodadheḥ .. 218.50 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चरत्नसमायुक्तं फलपुष्पाक्षतैर्युतम् .
मन्त्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र दद्यादर्घं महोदधेः .. 218.50 ..
6.3.m: Furnished with five jewels and accompanied by fruits, flowers, and unbroken grains, / one should offer water oblation to the great ocean with this mantra, O king of kings:

6.3.s:
sarvaratnanidhānastvaṃ sarvaratnākarākaraḥ .
sarvāmarapradhāneśa gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo'stu te .
ityarghamantraḥ .. 218.51 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वरत्ननिधानस्त्वं सर्वरत्नाकराकरः .
सर्वामरप्रधानेश गृहाणार्घं नमोऽस्तु ते .
इत्यर्घमन्त्रः .. 218.51 ..
6.3.m:
“You are the repository of all jewels, the source of all treasuries of jewels, / the lord supreme among all immortals; accept the water oblation, salutations to you!”
— Thus is the mantra for offering water oblation.

6.3.s:
ā janmajanitātpāpānmāmuddhara mahodadhe .
yāhyarcito ratnanidhe parvatān pārvaṇottama .
iti visarjanamantraḥ .. 218.52 ..
6.3.d:
आ जन्मजनितात्पापान्मामुद्धर महोदधे .
याह्यर्चितो रत्ननिधे पर्वतान् पार्वणोत्तम .
इति विसर्जनमन्त्रः .. 218.52 ..
6.3.m:
“Deliver me from the sin born of birth, O great ocean! / Worshipped, go to the mountains, O treasure of jewels, O best of conjunctions!”
— Thus is the dismissal mantra.

6.3.s:
ko'paraḥ sāgarāddevātsvargadvāravipāṭana .
tatra sāgaraparyantaṃ mahātīrthamanuttamam .. 218.53 ..
6.3.d:
कोऽपरः सागराद्देवात्स्वर्गद्वारविपाटन .
तत्र सागरपर्यन्तं महातीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 218.53 ..
6.3.m: Who else than the god Ocean, O breaker of the gates of heaven? / There, reaching up to the ocean, is the unexcelled great sacred ford.

6.3.s:
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa tatra devaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ .
yatra devāḥ sagandharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ .. 218.54 ..
6.3.d:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण तत्र देवः प्रतिष्ठितः .
यत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा मुनयः सिद्धचारणाः .. 218.54 ..
6.3.m: There the god was established by Rāma, son of Jamadagni, / where gods along with gandharvas, sages, and accomplished cāraṇas

6.3.s:
upāsate virūpākṣaṃ jamadagnimanuttamam .
reṇukāṃ caiva ye devīṃ paśyanti bhuvi mānavāḥ .. 218.55 ..
6.3.d:
उपासते विरूपाक्षं जमदग्निमनुत्तमम् .
रेणुकां चैव ये देवीं पश्यन्ति भुवि मानवाः .. 218.55 ..
6.3.m: worship Virūpākṣa and the incomparable Jamadagni; / and those mortals on earth who behold the goddess Reṇukā

6.3.s:
priyavāse śive loke vasanti kālamīpsitam .
tatra snātvā naro rājaṃstarpayanpitṛdevatāḥ .. 218.56 ..
6.3.d:
प्रियवासे शिवे लोके वसन्ति कालमीप्सितम् .
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजंस्तर्पयन्पितृदेवताः .. 218.56 ..
6.3.m: dwell in the beloved abode, the auspicious realm of Śiva, for their desired span of time. / Having bathed there, O king, a person offering libations to the ancestral deities

6.3.s:
tārayennarakādghorātkulānāṃ śatamuttaram .
snātvā dattvātra sahitāḥ śrutvā vai bhaktipūrvakam .. 218.57 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe jāmadagnyatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
तारयेन्नरकाद्घोरात्कुलानां शतमुत्तरम् .
स्नात्वा दत्त्वात्र सहिताः श्रुत्वा वै भक्तिपूर्वकम् .. 218.57 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे जामदग्न्यतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामाष्टादशाधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
rescues a hundred and one generations from terrifying hell. / Having bathed and given gifts there together, and having heard [this] with devotion,
Thus ends the two hundred and eighteenth chapter, titled “Description of the Greatness of the Sacred Ford of Jamadagni's Son,” in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param .
yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 219.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
नर्मदादक्षिणे कूले तीर्थं कोटीश्वरं परम् .
यत्र स्नानं च दानं च सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 219.1 ..
6.3.m:
The glorious Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“On the south bank of the Narmadā is the supreme Koṭīśvara sacred ford, / where ritual ablution and charity all become multiplied ten-millionfold.

6.3.s:
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayo ye tathāmalāḥ .
koṭitīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptā bhuvi durlabhām .. 219.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयो ये तथामलाः .
कोटितीर्थे परां सिद्धिं सम्प्राप्ता भुवि दुर्लभाम् .. 219.2 ..
6.3.m: There, the gods with the gandharvas, and the spotless seers, / attained supreme siddhi, rare on earth, at Koṭitīrtha.”

6.3.s:
sthāpitaśca mahādevastatra koṭīśvaro nṛpa .
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ siddhiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām .. 219.3 ..
6.3.d:
स्थापितश्च महादेवस्तत्र कोटीश्वरो नृप .
तं दृष्ट्वा देवदेवेशं सिद्धिं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् .. 219.3 ..
6.3.m: And there, O king, Mahādeva Koṭīśvara was installed. / Having beheld that Lord of the gods of gods, one attains unsurpassed perfection.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham .
kriyate tannṛpaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 219.4 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यत्किंचिच्छुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् .
क्रियते तन्नृपश्रेष्ठ सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 219.4 ..
6.3.m: Whatever good or even evil is done at that sacred ford, / O best of kings, all of it becomes multiplied ten-millionfold.

6.3.s:
tatra dakṣiṇamārgasthā ye kecinmunisattamāḥ .
siddhā mṛtāḥ padaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ dhruvaṃ hi te .. 219.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र दक्षिणमार्गस्था ये केचिन्मुनिसत्तमाः .
सिद्धा मृताः पदं यान्ति पितृलोकं ध्रुवं हि ते .. 219.5 ..
6.3.m: Whatever best of sages there, following the southern path, / die as perfected ones, they truly go to the permanent abode, the world of the ancestors.

6.3.s:
uttaraṃ narmadākūlaṃ ye śreṣṭhā munipuṃgavāḥ .
devalokaṃ gatāḥ pūrvamiti śāstrasya niścayaḥ .. 219.6 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
उत्तरं नर्मदाकूलं ये श्रेष्ठा मुनिपुंगवाः .
देवलोकं गताः पूर्वमिति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः .. 219.6 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोटितीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकोनविंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Those best, pre-eminent sages [who remained on] the northern bank of the Narmadā, / have previously gone to the world of the gods: such is the conclusion of scripture.
Thus ends the two hundred and nineteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Koṭitīrtha', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gaccheddharādhīśa loṭaṇeśvaramuttamam .
uttare narmadākūle sarvapātakanāśanam .. 220.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेद्धराधीश लोटणेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
उत्तरे नर्मदाकूले सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 220.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, O lord of the earth, one should go to the supreme Loṭaṇeśvara / on the northern bank of the Narmadā, which destroys all sins.

6.3.s:
tatkṣaṇādeva tatsarvaṃ saptajanmārjitaṃ tvagham .
naśyate devadevasya darśanādeva tannṛpa .. 220.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्क्षणादेव तत्सर्वं सप्तजन्मार्जितं त्वघम् .
नश्यते देवदेवस्य दर्शनादेव तन्नृप .. 220.2 ..
6.3.m: At that very moment, all that sin accumulated through seven births / is destroyed indeed, O king, merely by the darśana of the God of gods.

6.3.s:
bālyātprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ yauvane cāpi yatkṛtam .
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti devadevasya darśanāt .. 220.3 ..
6.3.d:
बाल्यात्प्रभृति यत्पापं यौवने चापि यत्कृतम् .
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति देवदेवस्य दर्शनात् .. 220.3 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sin has been committed from childhood onward, or even in youth, / all that dissolves away through the darśana of the God of gods.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
āścaryabhūtaṃ lokeṣu narmadācaritaṃ mahat .
tvayā vai kathitaṃ vipra sakalaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 220.4 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेषु नर्मदाचरितं महत् .
त्वया वै कथितं विप्र सकलं पापनाशनम् .. 220.4 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The great deeds of the Narmadā, a wonder in the worlds, / have indeed been narrated by you, O brahmin, destroying all sin.

6.3.s:
yadekaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam .
śrotumicchāmi tatsarvaṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā vadāśu me .. 220.5 ..
6.3.d:
यदेकं परमं तीर्थं सर्वतीर्थफलप्रदम् .
श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं दयां कृत्वा वदाशु मे .. 220.5 ..
6.3.m: I wish to hear entirely about that one supreme sacred ford which yields the fruit of all sacred fords; / taking compassion, tell me quickly.

6.3.s:
ye keciddurlabhāḥ praśnāstriṣu lokeṣu sattama .
tvatprasādena te sarve śrutā me saha bāndhavaiḥ .. 220.6 ..
6.3.d:
ये केचिद्दुर्लभाः प्रश्नास्त्रिषु लोकेषु सत्तम .
त्वत्प्रसादेन ते सर्वे श्रुता मे सह बान्धवैः .. 220.6 ..
6.3.m: Whatever rare questions there are in the three worlds, O best [of sages], / all of them have been heard by me along with my kinsmen, through your grace.

6.3.s:
etamekaṃ paraṃ praśnaṃ sarvapraśnavidāṃ vara .
śrutvāhaṃ tvatprasādena yatra yāmi sabāndhavaḥ .. 220.7 ..
6.3.d:
एतमेकं परं प्रश्नं सर्वप्रश्नविदां वर .
श्रुत्वाहं त्वत्प्रसादेन यत्र यामि सबान्धवः .. 220.7 ..
6.3.m: O best of those who know all questions, having heard [the answer to] this one ultimate question / by your grace, to that place shall I go together with my kinsmen.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhusādhu mahāprājña yasya te matirīdṛśī .
durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu tasya te nāsti kiṃcana .. 220.8 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधुसाधु महाप्राज्ञ यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी .
दुर्लभं त्रिषु लोकेषु तस्य ते नास्ति किंचन .. 220.8 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Excellent, excellent, O man of great wisdom, you whose mind is such! / For you whose [mind is such], nothing in the three worlds is difficult to obtain.

6.3.s:
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca bharatarṣabha .
kāle kāle ca yo vetti kartavyastena dhīmatā .. 220.9 ..
6.3.d:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं च मोक्षं च भरतर्षभ .
काले काले च यो वेत्ति कर्तव्यस्तेन धीमता .. 220.9 ..
6.3.m: Dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation, O bull of the Bharatas, / should be pursued by that wise man who knows [their proper] time from time to time.

6.3.s:
tasmātte sampravakṣyāmi praśnasyāsyottaraṃ śubham .
yacchrutvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyante bhuvi mānavāḥ .. 220.10 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रश्नस्यास्योत्तरं शुभम् .
यच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते भुवि मानवाः .. 220.10 ..
6.3.m: Therefore I shall explain to you the auspicious answer to this question, / hearing which human beings on earth are freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthamayī śubhā .
viśeṣaḥ kathitastasyā revāsāgarasaṅgame .. 220.11 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वतीर्थमयी शुभा .
विशेषः कथितस्तस्या रेवासागरसङ्गमे .. 220.11 ..
6.3.m: The Narmadā is the best of rivers, auspicious, embodying all sacred fords; / its special virtue is declared to be at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean.

6.3.s:
āgacchantīṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha dṛṣṭvā revāṃ mahodadhiḥ .
praṇamya ca punardevīṃ saṅgame revayā saha .. 220.12 ..
6.3.d:
आगच्छन्तीं नृपश्रेष्ठ दृष्ट्वा रेवां महोदधिः .
प्रणम्य च पुनर्देवीं सङ्गमे रेवया सह .. 220.12 ..
6.3.m: Seeing the Revā arriving, O best of kings, the great ocean, / having bowed down to the goddess at the confluence with the Revā,

6.3.s:
saṃcintya manasā keyamiti māṃ vai saridvarā .
jñātvā saṃcintya manasā revāṃ liṅgodbhavāṃ parām .. 220.13 ..
6.3.d:
संचिन्त्य मनसा केयमिति मां वै सरिद्वरा .
ज्ञात्वा संचिन्त्य मनसा रेवां लिङ्गोद्भवां पराम् .. 220.13 ..
6.3.m: contemplated in his mind: 'Who indeed is this best of rivers for me?' / Having understood and contemplated in mind that the Revā is the supreme [river] born from the liṅga,

6.3.s:
luṭhanvai sammukhastāta gato revāṃ mahodadhiḥ .
samudre narmadā yatra praviṣṭāsti mahānadī .. 220.14 ..
6.3.d:
लुठन्वै सम्मुखस्तात गतो रेवां महोदधिः .
समुद्रे नर्मदा यत्र प्रविष्टास्ति महानदी .. 220.14 ..
6.3.m: the great ocean, O dear one, rolling on the ground face-forward, went to the Revā, / where the great river Narmadā enters the ocean.

6.3.s:
tatra devādhidevasya samudre liṅgamutthitam .
liṅgodbhūtā mahābhāgā narmadā saritāṃ varā .. 220.15 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र देवाधिदेवस्य समुद्रे लिङ्गमुत्थितम् .
लिङ्गोद्भूता महाभागा नर्मदा सरितां वरा .. 220.15 ..
6.3.m: There a liṅga of the supreme God of gods arose in the ocean. / Born from the liṅga, the fortunate Narmadā, best of rivers,

6.3.s:
layaṃ gatā tatra liṅge tena puṇyatamā hi sā .
narmadāyāṃ vasannityaṃ narmadāmbu pibansadā .
dīkṣitaḥ sarvayajñeṣu somapānaṃ dine dine .. 220.16 ..
6.3.d:
लयं गता तत्र लिङ्गे तेन पुण्यतमा हि सा .
नर्मदायां वसन्नित्यं नर्मदाम्बु पिबन्सदा .
दीक्षितः सर्वयज्ञेषु सोमपानं दिने दिने .. 220.16 ..
6.3.m: attained dissolution there into that liṅga; therefore, she is indeed the most sacred. / Residing constantly by the Narmadā, always drinking Narmadā water, / one is consecrated in all sacrifices and drinks soma day after day.

6.3.s:
saṅgame tatra yaḥ snātvā loṭaṇeśvaramarcayet .
so'śvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 220.17 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमे तत्र यः स्नात्वा लोटणेश्वरमर्चयेत् .
सोऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 220.17 ..
6.3.m: That man who, having bathed there at the confluence, worships Loṭaṇeśvara, / attains the fruit of the horse sacrifice.

6.3.s:
vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ nṛpa .
loṭaṇeśvaramāsādya sarvaṃ vilayatāṃ vrajet .. 220.18 ..
6.3.d:
वाचिकं मानसं पापं कर्मणा यत्कृतं नृप .
लोटणेश्वरमासाद्य सर्वं विलयतां व्रजेत् .. 220.18 ..
6.3.m: The sin committed in speech, in mind, or through action, O king, / upon reaching Loṭaṇeśvara, all dissolves away.

6.3.s:
kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa kathitaṃ śaṅkareṇa tu .
tacchṛṇuṣva nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpāpanodanam .. 220.19 ..
6.3.d:
कार्त्तिक्यां तु विशेषेण कथितं शङ्करेण तु .
तच्छृणुष्व नृपश्रेष्ठ सर्वपापापनोदनम् .. 220.19 ..
6.3.m: Especially on the full moon of Kārttika, [its merit] has been proclaimed by Śaṃkara; / listen to that, O best of kings, which removes all sins.

6.3.s:
samprāptāṃ kārttikīṃ dṛṣṭvā gatvā tatra nṛpottama .
caturdaśyāmupoṣyaiva snātvā vai narmadājale .. 220.20 ..
6.3.d:
सम्प्राप्तां कार्त्तिकीं दृष्ट्वा गत्वा तत्र नृपोत्तम .
चतुर्दश्यामुपोष्यैव स्नात्वा वै नर्मदाजले .. 220.20 ..
6.3.m: Seeing that the full moon of Kārttika has arrived, having gone there, O best of kings, / and having fasted on the fourteenth day, having bathed in the water of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
saṃtarpya pitṛdevāṃśca śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi .
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsampūjya loṭaṇeśvaram .. 220.21 ..
6.3.d:
संतर्प्य पितृदेवांश्च श्राद्धं कृत्वा यथाविधि .
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्सम्पूज्य लोटणेश्वरम् .. 220.21 ..
6.3.m: having gratified the ancestors and gods, and having performed the śrāddha according to the rules, / one should keep a night vigil, having worshipped Loṭaṇeśvara.

6.3.s:
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya saphalaṃ tasya ceṣṭitam .
paṅgavaste na sandeho janma teṣāṃ nirarthakam .. 220.22 ..
6.3.d:
सफलं जीवितं तस्य सफलं तस्य चेष्टितम् .
पङ्गवस्ते न सन्देहो जन्म तेषां निरर्थकम् .. 220.22 ..
6.3.m: Fruitful is his life, fruitful is his effort. / Those [who do not do so] are lame, there is no doubt; their birth is useless,

6.3.s:
ekāgramanasā yaistu na dṛṣṭo loṭaṇeśvaraḥ .
piśācatvaṃ viyonitvaṃ na bhavettasya vai kule .. 220.23 ..
6.3.d:
एकाग्रमनसा यैस्तु न दृष्टो लोटणेश्वरः .
पिशाचत्वं वियोनित्वं न भवेत्तस्य वै कुले .. 220.23 ..
6.3.m: by whom, with single-pointed mind, Loṭaṇeśvara has not been beheld. / State of a piśāca and non-human birth will not occur in his family.

6.3.s:
saṅgame tatra yo gatvā snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi .
puṇyaiścaiva tathā kuryādgītairnṛtyaiḥ prabodhanam .. 220.24 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमे तत्र यो गत्वा स्नानं कृत्वा यथाविधि .
पुण्यैश्चैव तथा कुर्याद्गीतैर्नृत्यैः प्रबोधनम् .. 220.24 ..
6.3.m: He who, having gone to that confluence, performs the ritual ablution according to rule, / should likewise perform the awakening [of the deity] with sacred songs and dances.

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhātāṃ rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā natvā mahodadhim .
āmantrya snānavidhinā snānaṃ tatra tu kārayet .. 220.25 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभातां रजनीं दृष्ट्वा नत्वा महोदधिम् .
आमन्त्र्य स्नानविधिना स्नानं तत्र तु कारयेत् .. 220.25 ..
6.3.m: Then, seeing the night dawned and bowing to the great ocean, / having addressed it according to the rule of bathing, he should cause the ritual ablution to be performed there.

6.3.s:
oṃ namo viṣṇurūpāya tīrthanāthāya te namaḥ .
sānnidhyaṃ kuru me deva samudra lavaṇāmbhasi .
ityāmantraṇamantraḥ .. 220.26 ..
6.3.d:
ओं नमो विष्णुरूपाय तीर्थनाथाय ते नमः .
सान्निध्यं कुरु मे देव समुद्र लवणाम्भसि .
इत्यामन्त्रणमन्त्रः .. 220.26 ..
6.3.m: "Oṃ, homage to you whose form is Viṣṇu, lord of sacred fords, homage to you! / Bring your presence to me, O god Ocean, in the salt waters." / This is the invocation mantra.

6.3.s:
agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca deho reto'dhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ .
evaṃ bruvan pāṇḍava satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām .
iti snānamantraḥ .. 220.27 ..
6.3.d:
अग्निश्च तेजो मृडया च देहो रेतोऽधा विष्णुरमृतस्य नाभिः .
एवं ब्रुवन् पाण्डव सत्यवाक्यं ततोऽवगाहेत पतिं नदीनाम् .
इति स्नानमन्त्रः .. 220.27 ..
6.3.m: "Fire is fiery energy, through Mṛḍā is the body, Viṣṇu is the holder of the seed, the navel of immortality." / Speaking this true utterance, O Pāṇḍava, one should then plunge into the lord of rivers. / This is the bathing mantra.

6.3.s:
ājanmaśatasāhasraṃ yatpāpaṃ kṛtavānnaraḥ .
sakṛtsnānādvyapoheta pāpaughaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi .. 220.28 ..
6.3.d:
आजन्मशतसाहस्रं यत्पापं कृतवान्नरः .
सकृत्स्नानाद्व्यपोहेत पापौघं लवणाम्भसि .. 220.28 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sin a man has committed throughout a hundred thousand lifetimes, / by a single ritual ablution in the salt water he dispels that flood of sins.

6.3.s:
anyathā hi kuruśreṣṭha devayonirasau vibhuḥ .
kuśāgreṇāpi vibudhairna spraṣṭavyo mahārṇavaḥ .. 220.29 ..
6.3.d:
अन्यथा हि कुरुश्रेष्ठ देवयोनिरसौ विभुः .
कुशाग्रेणापि विबुधैर्न स्प्रष्टव्यो महार्णवः .. 220.29 ..
6.3.m: Otherwise, O best of the Kurus, this all-pervading [ocean] is of divine origin; / the great ocean is not to be touched by wise men even with the tip of a kuśa grass.

6.3.s:
sarvaratnapradhānastvaṃ sarvaratnākarākara .
sarvāmarapradhāneśa gṛhāṇārghaṃ namo'stu te .
iti arvamantra .. 220.30 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वरत्नप्रधानस्त्वं सर्वरत्नाकराकर .
सर्वामरप्रधानेश गृहाणार्घं नमोऽस्तु ते .
इति अर्वमन्त्र .. 220.30 ..
6.3.m: "You are pre-eminent in all jewels, a mine of mines of all gems! / O supreme lord of all immortals, accept this argha offering; homage be to you!" / This is the argha mantra.

6.3.s:
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṃśca saṃtarpya tadanantaram .
uttīrya tīre tasyaiva pañcabhirdvijapuṃgavaiḥ .. 220.31 ..
6.3.d:
पितृदेवमनुष्यांश्च संतर्प्य तदनन्तरम् .
उत्तीर्य तीरे तस्यैव पञ्चभिर्द्विजपुंगवैः .. 220.31 ..
6.3.m: Immediately thereafter, having gratified the ancestors, gods, and men, / having stepped out onto the bank of that very [ocean], with five pre-eminent brahmins

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ samācaretpaścāllokapālānurūpibhiḥ .
kṛtvāgre lokapālāṃstu pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi .. 220.32 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं समाचरेत्पश्चाल्लोकपालानुरूपिभिः .
कृत्वाग्रे लोकपालांस्तु प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविधि .. 220.32 ..
6.3.m: representing the world-guardians, he should then perform the śrāddha, / having first placed the world-guardians before him and installed them according to rule.

6.3.s:
sampūjya ca yathānyāyaṃ tāneva brāhmaṇaiḥ saha .
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ paścāttebhyaḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet .. 220.33 ..
6.3.d:
सम्पूज्य च यथान्यायं तानेव ब्राह्मणैः सह .
सुकृतं दुष्कृतं पश्चात्तेभ्यः सर्वं निवेदयेत् .. 220.33 ..
6.3.m: And having worshipped them in accordance with custom together with the brahmins, / he should afterward disclose to them all good and bad deeds:

6.3.s:
bālyātprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ kṛtaṃ vārdhakayauvane .
prakhyāpayitvā tebhyo'gre lokapālānnimantrayet .. 220.34 ..
6.3.d:
बाल्यात्प्रभृति यत्पापं कृतं वार्धकयौवने .
प्रख्यापयित्वा तेभ्योऽग्रे लोकपालान्निमन्त्रयेत् .. 220.34 ..
6.3.m: "Whatever sin has been committed from childhood onward, or in old age and youth—" / Having proclaimed it before them, he should invite the world-guardians:

6.3.s:
bālyātprabhṛti yatkiṃcitkṛtamā janmato'śubham .
viprebhyaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tatsāṃnidhyaṃ sthiteṣu me .. 220.35 ..
6.3.d:
बाल्यात्प्रभृति यत्किंचित्कृतमा जन्मतोऽशुभम् .
विप्रेभ्यः कथितं सर्वं तत्सांनिध्यं स्थितेषु मे .. 220.35 ..
6.3.m: "Whatever inauspicious deed was done from childhood onward, since birth, / all that has been spoken to the brahmins while these [guardians] stand in my presence."

6.3.s:
ityuktvā sa luṭhetpaścāttebhyo'greṇa ca sammukham .
anumānya ca tānpañca paścātsnānaṃ samācaret .. 220.36 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स लुठेत्पश्चात्तेभ्योऽग्रेण च सम्मुखम् .
अनुमान्य च तान्पञ्च पश्चात्स्नानं समाचरेत् .. 220.36 ..
6.3.m: Having said this, he should then roll facing forward before them; / and having obtained permission from those five, he should subsequently perform ritual ablution.

6.3.s:
śrāddhaṃ ca kāryaṃ vidhivatpitṛbhyo nṛpasattama .
evaṃ kṛte nṛpaśreṣṭha sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet .. 220.37 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धं च कार्यं विधिवत्पितृभ्यो नृपसत्तम .
एवं कृते नृपश्रेष्ठ सर्वपापक्षयो भवेत् .. 220.37 ..
6.3.m: And a śrāddha should be performed according to rule for the ancestors, O best of kings; / when this is done, O best of monarchs, the destruction of all sins occurs.

6.3.s:
jijñāsārthaṃ tu yaḥ kaścidātmānaṃ jñātumicchati .
śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma tasya niṣṭhāmimāṃ śṛṇu .. 220.38 ..
6.3.d:
जिज्ञासार्थं तु यः कश्चिदात्मानं ज्ञातुमिच्छति .
शुभाशुभं च यत्कर्म तस्य निष्ठामिमां शृणु .. 220.38 ..
6.3.m: Now whoever desires to know himself for the sake of enquiry, / and whatever deed is good or bad, hear this certain conclusion concerning it:

6.3.s:
snātvā tatra mahātīrthe luṭhamāno vrajennaraḥ .
pāpakarmānyato yāti dharmakarmā vrajennadīm .. 220.39 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा तत्र महातीर्थे लुठमानो व्रजेन्नरः .
पापकर्मान्यतो याति धर्मकर्मा व्रजेन्नदीम् .. 220.39 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at that great sacred ford, a person moves while rolling; / one of sinful deeds goes elsewhere, whereas one of righteous deeds goes towards the river.

6.3.s:
pāpakarmā tato jñātvā pāpaṃ me pūrvasaṃcitam .
snātvā tīrthavare tasmindānaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi .. 220.40 ..
6.3.d:
पापकर्मा ततो ज्ञात्वा पापं मे पूर्वसंचितम् .
स्नात्वा तीर्थवरे तस्मिन्दानं दद्याद्यथाविधि .. 220.40 ..
6.3.m: Then the evil-doer, knowing, 'Sin was accumulated by me previously,' / having bathed at that best of sacred fords, should give a gift according to rule.

6.3.s:
loṭaṇeśvaramabhyarcya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .
avakragamanaṃ gatvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 220.41 ..
6.3.d:
लोटणेश्वरमभ्यर्च्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .
अवक्रगमनं गत्वा मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 220.41 ..
6.3.m: Worshipping Loṭaṇeśvara, he is released from all sins; / going in an uncrooked path, he is freed from all offenses.

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena jñātvaivaṃ nṛpasattama .
snātavyaṃ mānavaistatra yatra saṃnihito haraḥ .. 220.42 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ज्ञात्वैवं नृपसत्तम .
स्नातव्यं मानवैस्तत्र यत्र संनिहितो हरः .. 220.42 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, knowing thus, with every effort, O best of kings, / ritual ablution should be performed by humans there where Hara is present.

6.3.s:
evaṃ snātvā vidhānena brāhmaṇān vedapāragān .
pūjayetpṛthivīpāla sarvapāpopaśāntaye .. 220.43 ..
6.3.d:
एवं स्नात्वा विधानेन ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान् .
पूजयेत्पृथिवीपाल सर्वपापोपशान्तये .. 220.43 ..
6.3.m: Having thus bathed according to the rite, he should worship brahmins / who have mastered the Vedas, O protector of the earth, for the pacification of all sins.

6.3.s:
evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭaṃ hi tattīrthaṃ nṛpasattama .
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikamanā nṛpa .. 220.44 ..
6.3.d:
एवं गुणविशिष्टं हि तत्तीर्थं नृपसत्तम .
तस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं शृणुष्वैकमना नृप .. 220.44 ..
6.3.m: Indeed, such is that sacred ford, endowed with virtues, O best of kings; / listen to the māhātmya of that sacred ford with an attentive mind, O king.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .
śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute tatra pitḥṇāṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ .. 220.45 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः .
श्राद्धं यः कुरुते तत्र पित्ःणां भक्तिभावितः .. 220.45 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed at that sacred ford, having gratified the ancestors and deities, / whatever person, filled with devotion, performs a śrāddha there for the ancestors,

6.3.s:
dānaṃ dadāti viprebhyo gobhūtilahiraṇyakam .
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi koṭirvarṣaśatāni ca .. 220.46 ..
6.3.d:
दानं ददाति विप्रेभ्यो गोभूतिलहिरण्यकम् .
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि कोटिर्वर्षशतानि च .. 220.46 ..
6.3.m: and gives a gift to brahmins of cows, land, sesame, and gold, / for sixty thousand years and a hundred crore years,

6.3.s:
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .
narmadāsarvatīrthebhyaḥ snāne dāne ca yatphalam .. 220.47 ..
6.3.d:
विमानवरमारूढः स्वर्गलोके महीयते .
नर्मदासर्वतीर्थेभ्यः स्नाने दाने च यत्फलम् .. 220.47 ..
6.3.m: having mounted an excellent aerial chariot, is honoured in the heavenly world. / Whatever fruit is attained from ritual ablution and gifts at all sacred fords of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti revāsāgarasaṅgame .
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇimauktikabhūṣaṇam .. 220.48 ..
6.3.d:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति रेवासागरसङ्गमे .
सुवर्णं रजतं ताम्रं मणिमौक्तिकभूषणम् .. 220.48 ..
6.3.m: that fruit one obtains at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean. / Gold, silver, copper, gems, pearl ornaments,

6.3.s:
govṛṣaṃ ca mahīṃ dhānyaṃ tatra dattvākṣayaṃ phalam .
śubhasyāpyaśubhasyāpi tatra tīrthe na saṃśayaḥ .. 220.49 ..
6.3.d:
गोवृषं च महीं धान्यं तत्र दत्त्वाक्षयं फलम् .
शुभस्याप्यशुभस्यापि तत्र तीर्थे न संशयः .. 220.49 ..
6.3.m: a cow and a bull, land, and grain given there yield imperishable fruit; / of the auspicious and even of the inauspicious at that sacred ford there is no doubt.

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe naraḥ kaścitprāṇatyāgaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
karoti bhaktyā vidhivattasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 220.50 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे नरः कश्चित्प्राणत्यागं युधिष्ठिर .
करोति भक्त्या विधिवत्तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .. 220.50 ..
6.3.m: If any person gives up his life at that sacred ford, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / doing so with devotion according to the rite, hear the meritorious fruit for him:

6.3.s:
koṭivarṣaṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ krīḍitvā śivamandire .
vedavedāṅgavidvipro jāyate vimale kule .. 220.51 ..
6.3.d:
कोटिवर्षं तु वर्षाणां क्रीडित्वा शिवमन्दिरे .
वेदवेदाङ्गविद्विप्रो जायते विमले कुले .. 220.51 ..
6.3.m: Having sported for a crore of years in the temple of Śiva, / he is born in a stainless family as a brahmin learned in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas.

6.3.s:
putrapautrasamṛddho'sau dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ .
sarvavyādhivinirmukto jīvecca śaradāṃśatam .. 220.52 ..
6.3.d:
पुत्रपौत्रसमृद्धोऽसौ धनधान्यसमन्वितः .
सर्वव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तो जीवेच्च शरदांशतम् .. 220.52 ..
6.3.m: Abounding in sons and grandsons, endowed with wealth and grain, / freed from all diseases, he will live for a hundred autumns.

6.3.s:
api dvādaśayātrāsu somanāthe yadarcite .
kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge tatpuṇyaṃ loṭaṇeśvare .. 220.53 ..
6.3.d:
अपि द्वादशयात्रासु सोमनाथे यदर्चिते .
कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे तत्पुण्यं लोटणेश्वरे .. 220.53 ..
6.3.m: Whatever merit is obtained when Somanātha is worshipped on the twelve pilgrimages / on the full moon of Kārttika under the conjunction with Kṛttikā, that [same] merit is at Loṭaṇeśvara.

6.3.s:
gayā gaṅgā kurukṣetre naimiṣe puṣkare tathā .
tatpuṇyaṃ labhate pārtha loṭaṇeśvaradarśanāt .. 220.54 ..
6.3.d:
गया गङ्गा कुरुक्षेत्रे नैमिषे पुष्करे तथा .
तत्पुण्यं लभते पार्थ लोटणेश्वरदर्शनात् .. 220.54 ..
6.3.m: At Gayā, the Gaṅgā, in Kurukṣetra, at Naimiṣa, and likewise at Puṣkara, / that merit one obtains from the darśana of Loṭaṇeśvara, O son of Pṛthā.

6.3.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā paṭhyamānamidaṃ śubham .
sarvapāpavinirmukto rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 220.55 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe loṭaṇeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या पठ्यमानमिदं शुभम् .
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 220.55 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे लोटणेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम विंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whatever man hears this auspicious [text] being recited with devotion, / completely freed from all sins, goes to the world of Rudra.
Thus ends the two hundred and twentieth chapter named 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Loṭaṇeśvara Sacred Ford' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tato gacchettu rājendra revāyā dakṣiṇe taṭe .
krośadvayāntare tīrthaṃ matṛtīrthādanuttamam .. 221.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततो गच्छेत्तु राजेन्द्र रेवाया दक्षिणे तटे .
क्रोशद्वयान्तरे तीर्थं मतृतीर्थादनुत्तमम् .. 221.1 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the southern bank of the Revā, / at an interval of two krośas from Mātṛtīrtha, to the unsurpassed sacred ford,

6.3.s:
nāmnā haṃseśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ vaimanasyavināśanam .
kaśyapasya kule jāto haṃso dākṣāyaṇīsutaḥ .. 221.2 ..
6.3.d:
नाम्ना हंसेश्वरं पुण्यं वैमनस्यविनाशनम् .
कश्यपस्य कुले जातो हंसो दाक्षायणीसुतः .. 221.2 ..
6.3.m: named Haṃseśvara, holy, destroying dejection. / Born in the family of Kaśyapa, the swan, son of Dākṣāyaṇī,

6.3.s:
brahmaṇo vāhanaṃ jātaḥ purā taptvā tapo mahat .
saikadā vidhinirdeśaṃ vinā vaiyagryamāsthitaḥ .. 221.3 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मणो वाहनं जातः पुरा तप्त्वा तपो महत् .
सैकदा विधिनिर्देशं विना वैयग्र्यमास्थितः .. 221.3 ..
6.3.m: became the mount of Brahmā in ancient times after practicing great austerity. / Once, lacking composure without the direction of the Creator,

6.3.s:
abhibhūtaḥ śivagaṇaiḥ praṇanāśa yudhiṣṭhira .
dakṣayajñapramathane kāṃdiśīko vidhiṃ vinā .. 221.4 ..
6.3.d:
अभिभूतः शिवगणैः प्रणनाश युधिष्ठिर .
दक्षयज्ञप्रमथने कांदिशीको विधिं विना .. 221.4 ..
6.3.m: overpowered by Śiva's attendants, he fled, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / in panic at the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice, without the Creator.

6.3.s:
brahmaṇā saṃsṛto'pyāśu nāyāti sa yadā khagaḥ .
tadā taṃ śaptavānbrahmā pātayāmāsa vai padāt .. 221.5 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मणा संसृतोऽप्याशु नायाति स यदा खगः .
तदा तं शप्तवान्ब्रह्मा पातयामास वै पदात् .. 221.5 ..
6.3.m: When that bird did not come quickly, even though summoned by Brahmā, / then Brahmā cursed him and cast him down from his position.

6.3.s:
tataḥ sa śaptamātmānaṃ matvā haṃsastvarānvitaḥ .
pitāmahamupāgamya praṇipatyedamabravīt .. 221.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततः स शप्तमात्मानं मत्वा हंसस्त्वरान्वितः .
पितामहमुपागम्य प्रणिपत्येदमब्रवीत् .. 221.6 ..
6.3.m: Then, realising himself to be cursed, the swan, filled with haste, / approached the Grandfather, bowed down, and spoke this:

6.3.s:
haṃsa uvāca -
tiryagyonisamutpannaṃ bhavāñchaptuṃ na cārhati .
svabhāva eva tiryakṣu vivekavikalaṃ manaḥ .. 221.7 ..
6.3.d:
हंस उवाच -
तिर्यग्योनिसमुत्पन्नं भवाञ्छप्तुं न चार्हति .
स्वभाव एव तिर्यक्षु विवेकविकलं मनः .. 221.7 ..
6.3.m: The swan said: / You ought not to curse one born from an animal womb; / indeed, the mind of animals is by nature devoid of discernment.

6.3.s:
tathāpi deva pāpo'smi yadahaṃ svāminaṃ tyaje .
kiṃ tu dhāvadbhiratyugrairgaṇaiḥ śārvaiḥ pitāmaha .
sahasāhaṃ bhayākrāntastrastastyaktvā palāyitaḥ .. 221.8 ..
6.3.d:
तथापि देव पापोऽस्मि यदहं स्वामिनं त्यजे .
किं तु धावद्भिरत्युग्रैर्गणैः शार्वैः पितामह .
सहसाहं भयाक्रान्तस्त्रस्तस्त्यक्त्वा पलायितः .. 221.8 ..
6.3.m: Even so, O Lord, I am sinful that I abandoned my master. / But, O Grandfather, by the running, extremely fierce attendants of Śarva, / I was suddenly overwhelmed with terror, frightened, and I abandoned [you] and fled.

6.3.s:
adyāpi bhayamevāhaṃ paśyannasmi vibho puraḥ .
tena smṛto'pi bhavatā nāvrajaṃ bhavadantike .. 221.9 ..
6.3.d:
अद्यापि भयमेवाहं पश्यन्नस्मि विभो पुरः .
तेन स्मृतोऽपि भवता नाव्रजं भवदन्तिके .. 221.9 ..
6.3.m: Even today, O Lord, I see only fear before me; / therefore, although remembered by you, I did not go to your presence.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
iti bruvanneva hi dhāturagre haṃsaḥ śvasatyakṣipūjyaḥ sudīnaḥ .
tiryañcaṃ māṃ pāpinaṃ mūḍhabuddhiṃ prabho puraḥ patitaṃ pāhi pāhi .. 221.10 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
इति ब्रुवन्नेव हि धातुरग्रे हंसः श्वसत्यक्षिपूज्यः सुदीनः .
तिर्यञ्चं मां पापिनं मूढबुद्धिं प्रभो पुरः पतितं पाहि पाहि .. 221.10 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Even while speaking thus before the Creator, the swan, worthy of worship with the eyes, sighed very miserably: / 'Protect, protect me, O Lord, an animal, a sinner of foolish intellect, fallen before you!

6.3.s:
eko devastvaṃ hi sargasya kartā nānāvidhaṃ sṛṣṭametattvayaiva .
ahaṃ sṛṣṭastvīdṛśo yattvayā vai so'yaṃ doṣo dhātaraddhā tavaiva .. 221.11 ..
6.3.d:
एको देवस्त्वं हि सर्गस्य कर्ता नानाविधं सृष्टमेतत्त्वयैव .
अहं सृष्टस्त्वीदृशो यत्त्वया वै सोऽयं दोषो धातरद्धा तवैव .. 221.11 ..
6.3.m: You alone are the one god, the maker of creation; this diverse world was created by you alone. / Since I was created such by you, truly this fault is yours alone, O Creator!

6.3.s:
śāpasya vānugrahasyāpi śaktastvatto nānyaḥ śaraṇaṃ kaṃ vrajāmi .
sevādharmādvicyutaṃ dāsabhūtaṃ capeṭairhantavyaṃ vai tāta māṃ trāhi bhaktam .. 221.12 ..
6.3.d:
शापस्य वानुग्रहस्यापि शक्तस्त्वत्तो नान्यः शरणं कं व्रजामि .
सेवाधर्माद्विच्युतं दासभूतं चपेटैर्हन्तव्यं वै तात मां त्राहि भक्तम् .. 221.12 ..
6.3.m: You are capable of cursing or even of bestowing grace; other than you, to what refuge shall I go? / Fallen from the duty of service, become a slave, worthy of being beaten with slaps, save me, O Father, your devotee!

6.3.s:
vidyāvidye tvatta evāvirāstāṃ dharmādharmau sadasaddyurniśe ca .
nānābhāvāñjagatastvaṃ vidhatsestaṃ tvāmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vai prapadye .. 221.13 ..
6.3.d:
विद्याविद्ये त्वत्त एवाविरास्तां धर्माधर्मौ सदसद्द्युर्निशे च .
नानाभावाञ्जगतस्त्वं विधत्सेस्तं त्वामेकं शरणं वै प्रपद्ये .. 221.13 ..
6.3.m: Knowledge and ignorance arose from you alone, virtue and vice, the real and the unreal, day and night; / you ordain the diverse states of the world. To you alone do I fly for refuge!

6.3.s:
eko'si bahurūpo'si nānācitraikakarmataḥ .
niṣkarmākhilakarmāsi tvāmataḥ śaraṇaṃ vraje .. 221.14 ..
6.3.d:
एकोऽसि बहुरूपोऽसि नानाचित्रैककर्मतः .
निष्कर्माखिलकर्मासि त्वामतः शरणं व्रजे .. 221.14 ..
6.3.m: You are one, you have many forms, through single acts of diverse wonders; / you are actionless, yet the performer of all actions. Therefore, I seek refuge in you.

6.3.s:
namonamo vareṇyāya varadāya namonamaḥ .
namo dhātre vidhātre ca śaraṇyāya namonamaḥ .. 221.15 ..
6.3.d:
नमोनमो वरेण्याय वरदाय नमोनमः .
नमो धात्रे विधात्रे च शरण्याय नमोनमः .. 221.15 ..
6.3.m: Salutations, salutations to the most excellent one, salutations, salutations to the giver of boons; / salutations to the Creator and Ordainer, salutations, salutations to the refuge!

6.3.s:
śikṣākṣaraviyukteyaṃ vāṇī me stauti kiṃ vibho .
kā śaktiḥ kiṃ parijñānamidamuktaṃ kṣamasva me .. 221.16 ..
6.3.d:
शिक्षाक्षरवियुक्तेयं वाणी मे स्तौति किं विभो .
का शक्तिः किं परिज्ञानमिदमुक्तं क्षमस्व मे .. 221.16 ..
6.3.m: How can this speech of mine, lacking the syllables of instruction, praise [you], O Lord? / What power, what thorough knowledge [do I have]? Forgive this that has been spoken by me.'

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evaṃ vadati haṃse vai brahmā prāha prasannadhīḥ .
śikṣā dattā tavaiveyaṃ mā viṣādaṃ kṛthāḥ khaga .. 221.17 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवं वदति हंसे वै ब्रह्मा प्राह प्रसन्नधीः .
शिक्षा दत्ता तवैवेयं मा विषादं कृथाः खग .. 221.17 ..
6.3.m: Śrī Mārkaṇḍeya said: / While the swan was speaking thus indeed, Brahmā, with a pleased mind, said: / 'This instruction alone was given to you; do not fall into despair, O bird.

6.3.s:
tapasā śodhayātmānaṃ yathā śāpāntamāpnuyāḥ .
revāsevāṃ kuru snātvā sthāpayitvā maheśvaram .
acireṇaiva kālena tataḥ saṃsthānamāpsyasi .. 221.18 ..
6.3.d:
तपसा शोधयात्मानं यथा शापान्तमाप्नुयाः .
रेवासेवां कुरु स्नात्वा स्थापयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
अचिरेणैव कालेन ततः संस्थानमाप्स्यसि .. 221.18 ..
6.3.m: Purify yourself with austerity so that you may reach the end of the curse. / Serve the Revā, having bathed and having established Maheśvara; / from that, in no long time, you will attain your proper station.'

6.3.s:
yacceṣṭvā bahubhiryajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ .
gosvarṇakoṭidānaiśca tatphalaṃ sthāpite śive .. 221.19 ..
6.3.d:
यच्चेष्ट्वा बहुभिर्यज्ञैः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः .
गोस्वर्णकोटिदानैश्च तत्फलं स्थापिते शिवे .. 221.19 ..
6.3.m: The fruit that is obtained by performing numerous sacrifices with ample concluding fees, / and by giving crores of cows and gold, is attained when Śiva is installed.

6.3.s:
brahmaghno vā surāpo vā svarṇahṛdgurutalpagaḥ .
revātīre śivaṃ sthāpya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 221.20 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नो वा सुरापो वा स्वर्णहृद्गुरुतल्पगः .
रेवातीरे शिवं स्थाप्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 221.20 ..
6.3.m: A slayer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief of gold, or one who violates the guru’s bed, / having installed Śiva on the bank of the Revā, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
tasmādbhargasarittīre sthāpayitvā triyambakam .
viyuktaḥ sarvadoṣaistvaṃ yāsyase padamuttamam .. 221.21 ..
6.3.d:
तस्माद्भर्गसरित्तीरे स्थापयित्वा त्रियम्बकम् .
वियुक्तः सर्वदोषैस्त्वं यास्यसे पदमुत्तमम् .. 221.21 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, having installed Tryambaka on the bank of the river of Bharga, / freed from all faults, you shall go to the supreme abode.

6.3.s:
evamuktaḥ sa vidhinā hṛṣṭatuṣṭaḥ khagottamaḥ .
tathetyuktvā jagāmāśu narmadātīramuttamam .. 221.22 ..
6.3.d:
एवमुक्तः स विधिना हृष्टतुष्टः खगोत्तमः .
तथेत्युक्त्वा जगामाशु नर्मदातीरमुत्तमम् .. 221.22 ..
6.3.m: Addressed thus by the Creator, the excellent bird, delighted and contented, / saying 'So be it,' went quickly to the excellent bank of the Narmadā.

6.3.s: tapastaptvā kiyatkālaṃ sthāpayāmāsa śaṅkaram .. 221.23 ..
6.3.d: तपस्तप्त्वा कियत्कालं स्थापयामास शङ्करम् .. 221.23 ..
6.3.m: Having performed austerity for some time, he installed Śaṅkara,

6.3.s:
svanāmnā bharataśreṣṭha haṃseśvaramanuttamam .
pūjayitvā paraṃ sthānaṃ prāptavānkhagasattamaḥ .. 221.24 ..
6.3.d:
स्वनाम्ना भरतश्रेष्ठ हंसेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .
पूजयित्वा परं स्थानं प्राप्तवान्खगसत्तमः .. 221.24 ..
6.3.m: named Haṃseśvara after himself, O best of the Bharatas, peerless. / Having worshipped him, that best of birds attained the supreme abode.

6.3.s:
tatra haṃseśvare tīrthe gatvā snātvā yudhiṣṭhira .
pūjayetparameśānaṃ sa pāpaiḥ parimucyate .. 221.25 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र हंसेश्वरे तीर्थे गत्वा स्नात्वा युधिष्ठिर .
पूजयेत्परमेशानं स पापैः परिमुच्यते .. 221.25 ..
6.3.m: Having gone to that sacred ford, Haṃseśvara, and bathed there, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / if one worships the Supreme Lord, he is freed from sins.

6.3.s:
stuvannekamanā devaṃ na dainyaṃ prāpnuyātkvacit .
śrāddhaṃ dīpapradānaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam .
dattvā śaktyā nṛpaśreṣṭha svargaloke mahīyate .. 221.26 ..
6.3.d:
स्तुवन्नेकमना देवं न दैन्यं प्राप्नुयात्क्वचित् .
श्राद्धं दीपप्रदानं च ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् .
दत्त्वा शक्त्या नृपश्रेष्ठ स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 221.26 ..
6.3.m: Praising the god with a single mind, he never suffers distress. / Having offered a śrāddha, a lamp, and food to brahmins / according to one's means, O best of kings, he is glorified in the heavenly world.

6.3.s:
trikālamekakālaṃ vā yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam .
navaprasūtāṃ dhenuṃ ca dattvā pārtha dvijottame .
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate .. 221.27 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe haṃseśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
त्रिकालमेककालं वा यो भक्त्या पूजयेच्छिवम् .
नवप्रसूतां धेनुं च दत्त्वा पार्थ द्विजोत्तमे .
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि शिवलोके महीयते .. 221.27 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे हंसेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकविंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Whoever worships Śiva with devotion three times or once a day, / and having given a freshly calved cow to an excellent twice-born, O son of Pṛthā, / is glorified in the world of Śiva for sixty thousand years.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of the Haṃseśvara Sacred Ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ krośāntare gacchettilādaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
tilaprāśanakṛdyatra jābāliḥ śuddhimāptavān .. 222.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः क्रोशान्तरे गच्छेत्तिलादं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
तिलप्राशनकृद्यत्र जाबालिः शुद्धिमाप्तवान् .. 222.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, at a distance of one krośa, one should go to the excellent sacred ford Tilāda, / where Jābāli, eating sesame seeds, attained purification.

6.3.s:
pitṛmātṛparityāgī bhrāturbhāryābhilāṣakṛt .
putravikrayakṛtpāpaśchalakṛdguruṇā saha .. 222.2 ..
6.3.d:
पितृमातृपरित्यागी भ्रातुर्भार्याभिलाषकृत् .
पुत्रविक्रयकृत्पापश्छलकृद्गुरुणा सह .. 222.2 ..
6.3.m: He had abandoned his parents, lusted after his brother's wife, / sold his own son, was a sinner, and had acted deceitfully toward his guru.

6.3.s:
evaṃ doṣasamāviṣṭo yatra yatrāpi gacchati .
tatra tatrāpi dhikkāraṃ labhate satsu bhārata .
na ko'pi saṃgatiṃ dhatte tena sārddhaṃ sabhāsvapi .. 222.3 ..
6.3.d:
एवं दोषसमाविष्टो यत्र यत्रापि गच्छति .
तत्र तत्रापि धिक्कारं लभते सत्सु भारत .
न कोऽपि संगतिं धत्ते तेन सार्द्धं सभास्वपि .. 222.3 ..
6.3.m: Overcome with such faults, wherever he went, / there he met with reproach among good people, O descendant of Bharata; / no one would even keep company with him in assemblies.

6.3.s:
iti lajjānvito vipraḥ kāle na mahatā nṛpa .
cintāmavāpa mahatīmagatijño hi pāvane .. 222.4 ..
6.3.d:
इति लज्जान्वितो विप्रः काले न महता नृप .
चिन्तामवाप महतीमगतिज्ञो हि पावने .. 222.4 ..
6.3.m: Thus covered with shame, the brahmin, before long, O king, / fell into great anxiety, knowing no way [to find] a purifying means.

6.3.s: cakāra sarvatīrthāni revāṃ cāpyavagāhayat .. 222.5 ..
6.3.d: चकार सर्वतीर्थानि रेवां चाप्यवगाहयत् .. 222.5 ..
6.3.m: He visited all sacred fords and plunged into the Revā.

6.3.s:
aṇivāpāntamāsādya dakṣiṇe narmadātaṭe .
tasthau yatra vratī pārtha jābāliḥ prāśayaṃstilān .. 222.6 ..
6.3.d:
अणिवापान्तमासाद्य दक्षिणे नर्मदातटे .
तस्थौ यत्र व्रती पार्थ जाबालिः प्राशयंस्तिलान् .. 222.6 ..
6.3.m: Having reached the vicinity of Aṇivāpa on the southern bank of the Narmadā, / Jābāli, observing vows, stayed there, O son of Pṛthā, eating sesame seeds.

6.3.s:
tilairekāśanaṃ kurvaṃstathaivaikāntarāśanam .
tryahaṣaḍdvādaśāhāśī pakṣamāsāśanastathā .. 222.7 ..
6.3.d:
तिलैरेकाशनं कुर्वंस्तथैवैकान्तराशनम् .
त्र्यहषड्द्वादशाहाशी पक्षमासाशनस्तथा .. 222.7 ..
6.3.m: Taking a single meal of sesame seeds, or eating on alternate days, / eating once every three days, six days, or twelve days, or eating once a fortnight or once a month,

6.3.s:
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādīni vratāni ca tilairapi .
tilādatvamanuprāpto hyabdadvāsaptatiṃ kramāt .. 222.8 ..
6.3.d:
कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणादीनि व्रतानि च तिलैरपि .
तिलादत्वमनुप्राप्तो ह्यब्दद्वासप्ततिं क्रमात् .. 222.8 ..
6.3.m: and performing penances like the Kṛcchra and Cāndrāyaṇa with sesame seeds alone, / he came to be known as 'Tilāda' (sesame-eater) continuously for seventy-two years.

6.3.s:
kālena gacchatā tasya prasanno'bhavadīśvaraḥ .
prādādihāmutrikīṃ tu śuddhiṃ sālokyamātmakam .. 222.9 ..
6.3.d:
कालेन गच्छता तस्य प्रसन्नोऽभवदीश्वरः .
प्रादादिहामुत्रिकीं तु शुद्धिं सालोक्यमात्मकम् .. 222.9 ..
6.3.m: As time passed, the Lord became pleased with him; / he granted him purification in this world and the next, and his own realm.

6.3.s:
tena sa sthāpito devaḥ svanāmnā bharatarṣabha .
tilādeśvarasaṃjñāṃ ca prāpa lokādapi prabhuḥ .. 222.10 ..
6.3.d:
तेन स स्थापितो देवः स्वनाम्ना भरतर्षभ .
तिलादेश्वरसंज्ञां च प्राप लोकादपि प्रभुः .. 222.10 ..
6.3.m: By him was installed that god named after himself, O bull of the Bharatas; / and the Lord received the name Tilādeśvara even from the people.

6.3.s:
tadā prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam .
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca .. 222.11 ..
6.3.d:
तदा प्रभृति विख्यातं तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् .
तत्र तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च .. 222.11 ..
6.3.m: From then on, that sacred ford became renowned as destructive of sins. / Having bathed in that sacred ford on the fourteenth and eighth days [of the fortnight],

6.3.s:
upavāsaparaḥ pārtha tathaiva harivāsare .
tilahomī tilodvartī tilasnāyī tilodakī .. 222.12 ..
6.3.d:
उपवासपरः पार्थ तथैव हरिवासरे .
तिलहोमी तिलोद्वर्ती तिलस्नायी तिलोदकी .. 222.12 ..
6.3.m: intent upon fasting, O son of Pṛthā, as well as on the day of Hari, / offering sesame into the fire, anointing himself with sesame, bathing with sesame, offering sesame water,

6.3.s:
tiladātā ca bhoktā ca nānāpāpaiḥ pramucyate .
tilairāpūrayelliṅgaṃ tilatailena dīpadaḥ .
rudralokamavāpnoti punātyā saptamaṃ kulam .. 222.13 ..
6.3.d:
तिलदाता च भोक्ता च नानापापैः प्रमुच्यते .
तिलैरापूरयेल्लिङ्गं तिलतैलेन दीपदः .
रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति पुनात्या सप्तमं कुलम् .. 222.13 ..
6.3.m: giving sesame and consuming sesame, one is freed from various sins. / If one fills the liṅga with sesame seeds and offers a lamp with sesame oil, / he attains the world of Rudra and purifies his family up to the seventh generation.

6.3.s:
tilapiṇḍapradānena śrāddhe nṛpatisattama .
vikarmasthāśca gacchanti gatimiṣṭāṃ hi pūrvajāḥ .. 222.14 ..
6.3.d:
तिलपिण्डप्रदानेन श्राद्धे नृपतिसत्तम .
विकर्मस्थाश्च गच्छन्ति गतिमिष्टां हि पूर्वजाः .. 222.14 ..
6.3.m: By the offering of rice-balls mixed with sesame in a śrāddha, O best of kings, / even ancestors who followed wrongful conduct attain the desired destination.

6.3.s:
svargalokasthitāḥ śrāddhairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ .
akṣayāṃ tṛptimāsādya modante śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 222.15 ..
6.3.d:
स्वर्गलोकस्थिताः श्राद्धैर्ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनैः .
अक्षयां तृप्तिमासाद्य मोदन्ते शाश्वतीः समाः .. 222.15 ..
6.3.m: Those who dwell in heaven, through the śrāddhas and feeding of brahmins, / attain imperishable satisfaction and rejoice for eternal years.

6.3.s:
pituḥ kulaṃ mātṛkulaṃ tathā bhāryākulaṃ nṛpa .
kulatrayaṃ samuddhṛtya svargaṃ nayati vai naraḥ .. 222.16 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tilādeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
पितुः कुलं मातृकुलं तथा भार्याकुलं नृप .
कुलत्रयं समुद्धृत्य स्वर्गं नयति वै नरः .. 222.16 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तिलादेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वाविंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
The paternal line, the maternal line, and likewise the wife's family, O king— / having uplifted these three families, a man leads them indeed to heaven.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of the Tilādeśvara Sacred Ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ krośāntare pārtha vāsavaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
vasubhiḥ sthāpitaṃ tatra sthitvā vai dvādaśābdakam .. 223.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः क्रोशान्तरे पार्थ वासवं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
वसुभिः स्थापितं तत्र स्थित्वा वै द्वादशाब्दकम् .. 223.1 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Then, at a distance of one krośa, O son of Pṛthā, is the excellent sacred ford Vāsava, / installed there by the Vasus after staying for twelve years.

6.3.s:
dharo dhruvaśca somaśca āpaścaivānilo'nalaḥ .
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭāvime purā .. 223.2 ..
6.3.d:
धरो ध्रुवश्च सोमश्च आपश्चैवानिलोऽनलः .
प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टाविमे पुरा .. 223.2 ..
6.3.m: Dhara, Dhruva, Soma, Āpa, Anila, Anala, / Pratyūṣa, and Prabhāsa—these were the eight Vasus of old.

6.3.s:
pitṛśāpaparikliṣṭā garbhavāsāya bhārata .
nārmadaṃ tīrthamāsādya tapaścakruryatendriyāḥ .. 223.3 ..
6.3.d:
पितृशापपरिक्लिष्टा गर्भवासाय भारत .
नार्मदं तीर्थमासाद्य तपश्चक्रुर्यतेन्द्रियाः .. 223.3 ..
6.3.m: Tormented by their father's curse to dwell in a womb, O descendant of Bharata, / they reached the sacred ford of the Narmadā and performed austerities with restrained senses,

6.3.s:
ārādhayantaḥ paramaṃ bhavānīpatimavyam .
dvādaśābdāni rājendra tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ .. 223.4 ..
6.3.d:
आराधयन्तः परमं भवानीपतिमव्यम् .
द्वादशाब्दानि राजेन्द्र ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः .. 223.4 ..
6.3.m: worshipping the supreme, imperishable husband of Bhavānī / for twelve years, O best of kings. Thereupon Maheśvara was pleased;

6.3.s:
pratyakṣaḥ pradadau tebhyastvabhīṣṭaṃ varamuttamam .
tataḥ svanāmnā saṃsthāpya vasavastaṃ maheśvaram .
jagmurākāśamāviśya prasanne sati śaṅkare .. 223.5 ..
6.3.d:
प्रत्यक्षः प्रददौ तेभ्यस्त्वभीष्टं वरमुत्तमम् .
ततः स्वनाम्ना संस्थाप्य वसवस्तं महेश्वरम् .
जग्मुराकाशमाविश्य प्रसन्ने सति शङ्करे .. 223.5 ..
6.3.m: manifesting before their eyes, he granted them their desired, excellent boon. / Then, having installed that Maheśvara under their own name, / the Vasus departed into the sky when Śaṅkara had become pleased.

6.3.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvāsavāhvayam .
tasmiṃstīrthe mahārāja yo bhaktyā pūjayecchivam .
yathālabdhopahāraiśca dīpaṃ dadyātprayatnataḥ .. 223.6 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रभृति विख्यातं तीर्थं तद्वासवाह्वयम् .
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे महाराज यो भक्त्या पूजयेच्छिवम् .
यथालब्धोपहारैश्च दीपं दद्यात्प्रयत्नतः .. 223.6 ..
6.3.m: From then on, that sacred ford became renowned by the name Vāsava. / At that sacred ford, O great king, whoever worships Śiva with devotion / and with offerings as available, and carefully offers a lamp

6.3.s:
śuklapakṣe tadāṣṭamyāṃ pratyahaṃ vāpi śaktitaḥ .
aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi sa vasecchivasaṃnidhau .. 223.7 ..
6.3.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तदाष्टम्यां प्रत्यहं वापि शक्तितः .
अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि स वसेच्छिवसंनिधौ .. 223.7 ..
6.3.m: on the eighth day of the bright fortnight, or daily according to one's ability, / shall dwell in the presence of Śiva for eight thousand years.

6.3.s:
tataḥ śivālayaṃ yāti garbhavāsaṃ na paśyati .
puṣpairvā pallavairvāpi phalairdhānyaistathāpi vā .. 223.8 ..
6.3.d:
ततः शिवालयं याति गर्भवासं न पश्यति .
पुष्पैर्वा पल्लवैर्वापि फलैर्धान्यैस्तथापि वा .. 223.8 ..
6.3.m: Then he goes to the abode of Śiva and does not experience dwelling in a womb. / Whether with flowers, sprouts, fruits, or grains,

6.3.s:
pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ sa dainyaṃ nāpnuyātkvacit .
sarvaśokavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate .. 223.9 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयेद्देवमीशानं स दैन्यं नाप्नुयात्क्वचित् .
सर्वशोकविनिर्मुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते .. 223.9 ..
6.3.m: if he worships the god Īśāna, he never suffers distress; / freed from all grief, he is glorified in the heavenly world.

6.3.s:
ekāhamapi kaunteya yo vasedvāsaveśvare .
pāparāśiṃ vinirdhūya bhānuvaddivi modate .. 223.10 ..
6.3.d:
एकाहमपि कौन्तेय यो वसेद्वासवेश्वरे .
पापराशिं विनिर्धूय भानुवद्दिवि मोदते .. 223.10 ..
6.3.m: Even for a single day, O son of Kuntī, whoever dwells at Vāsaveśvara, / having shaken off the mass of sins, rejoices in heaven like the sun.

6.3.s:
viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktyā dadyādvāsāṃsi dakṣiṇām .. 223.11 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vāsaveśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
विप्रांश्च भोजयेद्भक्त्या दद्याद्वासांसि दक्षिणाम् .. 223.11 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे वासवेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम त्रयोविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
One should also feed brahmins with devotion, and give garments and priestly fees.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of the Vāsaveśvara Sacred Ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ krośāntare pārtha tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param .
yatra snānaṃ ca dānaṃ ca japahomārcanādikam .
bhaktyā kṛtaṃ naraistatra sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 224.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः क्रोशान्तरे पार्थ तीर्थं कोटीश्वरं परम् .
यत्र स्नानं च दानं च जपहोमार्चनादिकम् .
भक्त्या कृतं नरैस्तत्र सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 224.1 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, at the distance of one krośa, O son of Pṛthā, is the supreme sacred ford Koṭīśvara,
where ritual ablution, donation, recitation of mantras, fire-offerings, worship, and the like,
performed there with devotion by men, all become ten-millionfold in fruit. (1)

6.3.s:
tatra devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ .
jaladhiṃ pratigacchanti narmadāṃ vīkṣituṃ kila .. 224.2 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः .
जलधिं प्रतिगच्छन्ति नर्मदां वीक्षितुं किल .. 224.2 ..
6.3.m:
There the gods along with the gandharvas, the seers, siddhas, and cāraṇas,
went towards the ocean, it is said, to see the Narmadā. (2)

6.3.s:
militāḥ koṭiśo rājanrevāsāgarasaṅgame .
vinodamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā revārṇavasamāgame .. 224.3 ..
6.3.d:
मिलिताः कोटिशो राजन्रेवासागरसङ्गमे .
विनोदमतुलं दृष्ट्वा रेवार्णवसमागमे .. 224.3 ..
6.3.m:
Assembled by the millions, O king, at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean,
having witnessed the peerless delight at the meeting of the Revā and the sea, (3)

6.3.s:
snātvā śivaṃ ca saṃsthāpya pūjayitvā maheśvaram .
koṭīśvarābhidhānaṃ tu svasvabhaktyā vidhānataḥ .. 224.4 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा शिवं च संस्थाप्य पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
कोटीश्वराभिधानं तु स्वस्वभक्त्या विधानतः .. 224.4 ..
6.3.m:
having bathed, established Śiva, and worshipped Maheśvara
named Koṭīśvara, in accordance with their respective devotion and the prescribed rite, (4)

6.3.s:
koṭītīrthe parāṃ siddhiṃ samprāptāḥ sarvatoṣaṇāt .
tena tatpuṇyamatulaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu cottamam .. 224.5 ..
6.3.d:
कोटीतीर्थे परां सिद्धिं सम्प्राप्ताः सर्वतोषणात् .
तेन तत्पुण्यमतुलं सर्वतीर्थेषु चोत्तमम् .. 224.5 ..
6.3.m:
they attained supreme perfection at Koṭītīrtha by pleasing everything.
Therefore, it is peerless in merit and the best among all sacred fords. (5)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yatkiṃcicchubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham .
kriyate nṛpaśārdūla sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet .. 224.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु यत्किंचिच्छुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् .
क्रियते नृपशार्दूल सर्वं कोटिगुणं भवेत् .. 224.6 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever good or evil is done
at that sacred ford, O tiger among kings, all becomes multiplied ten million times. (6)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu mārgasthā ye kecidṛṣisattamāḥ .
siddhāmṛtapadaṃ yānti pitṛlokaṃ tathottamam .. 224.7 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु मार्गस्था ये केचिदृषिसत्तमाः .
सिद्धामृतपदं यान्ति पितृलोकं तथोत्तमम् .. 224.7 ..
6.3.m:
Whichever best of seers, standing on the path at that sacred ford,
go to the abode of the perfected and the nectar-like realm, so too do they reach the highest world of the ancestors. (7)

6.3.s:
uttare narmadātīre dakṣiṇe cāśritāśca ye .
devalokaṃ gatāstatra iti me niścitā matiḥ .. 224.8 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तरे नर्मदातीरे दक्षिणे चाश्रिताश्च ये .
देवलोकं गतास्तत्र इति मे निश्चिता मतिः .. 224.8 ..
6.3.m:
Those who have taken refuge on the northern bank of the Narmadā and on the southern bank,
have gone from there to the realm of the gods; such is my firm conviction. (8)

6.3.s:
bilvārkapuṣpairdhattūrakuśakāśaprasūnakaiḥ .
ṛtūdbhavaistathānyaiśca pūjayitvā maheśvaram .. 224.9 ..
6.3.d:
बिल्वार्कपुष्पैर्धत्तूरकुशकाशप्रसूनकैः .
ऋतूद्भवैस्तथान्यैश्च पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .. 224.9 ..
6.3.m:
Having worshipped Maheśvara with bilva and arka flowers, dhattūra blossoms, kuśa and kāśa flowers,
and other seasonal flowers, (9)

6.3.s:
nānopacārairvidhivanmantrapūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
dhūpadīpārdhanaivedyaistoṣayitvā ca dhūrjaṭim .. 224.10 ..
6.3.d:
नानोपचारैर्विधिवन्मन्त्रपूर्वं युधिष्ठिर .
धूपदीपार्धनैवेद्यैस्तोषयित्वा च धूर्जटिम् .. 224.10 ..
6.3.m:
with various offerings according to rule, preceded by mantras, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
and having pleased Dhūrjaṭi with incense, lamps, and food offerings, (10)

6.3.s:
śivalokamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa .
pauṣakṛṣṇāṣṭamīyoge viśeṣaḥ pūjane smṛtaḥ .. 224.11 ..
6.3.d:
शिवलोकमवाप्नोति यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्दश .
पौषकृष्णाष्टमीयोगे विशेषः पूजने स्मृतः .. 224.11 ..
6.3.m:
one attains the realm of Śiva for as long as fourteen Indras reign.
A special efficacy in worship is taught on the eighth day of the dark fortnight of Pauṣa. (11)

6.3.s:
nityaṃ ca nṛpatiśreṣṭha caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca .
śivamabhyarcya viprāṃśca bhojayedbhaktito varān .. 224.12 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe koṭīśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
नित्यं च नृपतिश्रेष्ठ चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च .
शिवमभ्यर्च्य विप्रांश्च भोजयेद्भक्तितो वरान् .. 224.12 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे कोटीश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुर्विंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Constantly, O best of kings, and especially on the fourteenth and eighth lunar days,
having worshipped Śiva, one should feed excellent brahmins with devotion. (12)
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Koṭīśvara Sacred Ford,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ krośāntare gacchedalikātīrthamuttamam .
alikā nāma gāndharvī kuśīlā kuṭilāśayā .. 225.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः क्रोशान्तरे गच्छेदलिकातीर्थमुत्तमम् .
अलिका नाम गान्धर्वी कुशीला कुटिलाशया .. 225.1 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, at the distance of one krośa, one should go to the excellent Alikātīrtha.
A gandharva woman named Alikā was ill-behaved and crooked in intention. (1)

6.3.s:
citrasenasya dauhitrī vidyānandamṛṣiṃ gatā .
vavre te svīkṛtā tena daśavarṣāṇi taṃ śritā .. 225.2 ..
6.3.d:
चित्रसेनस्य दौहित्री विद्यानन्दमृषिं गता .
वव्रे ते स्वीकृता तेन दशवर्षाणि तं श्रिता .. 225.2 ..
6.3.m:
The granddaughter of Citrasena, she went to the seer Vidyānanda;
she chose him, was accepted by him, and stayed with him for ten years. (2)

6.3.s:
patiṃ jaghāna taṃ suptaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare .
gatvā nivedayāmāsa pitaraṃ ratnavallabham .. 225.3 ..
6.3.d:
पतिं जघान तं सुप्तं कस्मिंश्चित्कारणान्तरे .
गत्वा निवेदयामास पितरं रत्नवल्लभम् .. 225.3 ..
6.3.m:
For some reason, she killed that husband while he was asleep;
having gone, she reported it to her father Ratnavallabha. (3)

6.3.s:
pitrā mātrā ca saṃtyaktā bahubhirbhartsitā nṛpa .
garbhaghnī tvaṃ patighnī tvamiti darśaya mā mukham .. 225.4 ..
6.3.d:
पित्रा मात्रा च संत्यक्ता बहुभिर्भर्त्सिता नृप .
गर्भघ्नी त्वं पतिघ्नी त्वमिति दर्शय मा मुखम् .. 225.4 ..
6.3.m:
Cast out by her father and mother, and reviled by many, O king:
'You are a killer of embryos, you are a killer of your husband; do not show your face! (4)

6.3.s: brahmaghnī yāhi pāpiṣṭhe parityaktā gṛhādvraja .. 225.5 ..
6.3.d: ब्रह्मघ्नी याहि पापिष्ठे परित्यक्ता गृहाद्व्रज .. 225.5 ..
6.3.m: You slayer of a brahmin, go away, most sinful woman! Banished from our home, leave!' (5)

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
iti duḥkhānvitā mūḍhā tābhyāṃ nirbhartsitā satī .
tanuṃ tyaktuṃ manaścakre prāpya tīrthāntaraṃ kvacit .. 225.6 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
इति दुःखान्विता मूढा ताभ्यां निर्भर्त्सिता सती .
तनुं त्यक्तुं मनश्चक्रे प्राप्य तीर्थान्तरं क्वचित् .. 225.6 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Thus filled with grief and bewildered, having been rebuked by them both,
she resolved to give up her body upon reaching some sacred ford somewhere. (6)

6.3.s:
saṃpṛcchyamānā tīrthāni brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira .
śrutvā pāpaharaṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgame .. 225.7 ..
6.3.d:
संपृच्छ्यमाना तीर्थानि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिर .
श्रुत्वा पापहरं तीर्थं रेवासागरसङ्गमे .. 225.7 ..
6.3.m:
Inquiring about sacred fords from brahmins, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
and having heard of the sin-destroying sacred ford at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean, (7)

6.3.s:
tatra pārtha tapaścakre nirāhārā jitavratā .
kṛcchrātikṛcchrapārākamahāsāṃtapanādibhiḥ .. 225.8 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र पार्थ तपश्चक्रे निराहारा जितव्रता .
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रपाराकमहासांतपनादिभिः .. 225.8 ..
6.3.m:
she performed austerity there, O son of Pṛthā, abstaining from food, conqueror of her vows,
through the kṛcchra, atikṛcchra, pārāka, mahāsāṃtapana, and other penances. (8)

6.3.s:
cāndrāyaṇairbrahmakūrcaiḥ karśayāmāsa vai tanum .
evaṃ varṣaśataṃ sārddhaṃ vyatītaṃ tapasā nṛpa .. 225.9 ..
6.3.d:
चान्द्रायणैर्ब्रह्मकूर्चैः कर्शयामास वै तनुम् .
एवं वर्षशतं सार्द्धं व्यतीतं तपसा नृप .. 225.9 ..
6.3.m:
By means of cāndrāyaṇa penances and brahmakūrcas she emaciated her body.
Thus a hundred and fifty years passed in austerity, O king, (9)

6.3.s:
tasyā viśuddhimicchantyāḥ śivadhyānārcanādibhiḥ .
tataḥ katipayāhobhistasyā jñātvā haṭhaṃ param .
parituṣṭaḥ śivaḥ prāha pārvatyā paricoditaḥ .. 225.10 ..
6.3.d:
तस्या विशुद्धिमिच्छन्त्याः शिवध्यानार्चनादिभिः .
ततः कतिपयाहोभिस्तस्या ज्ञात्वा हठं परम् .
परितुष्टः शिवः प्राह पार्वत्या परिचोदितः .. 225.10 ..
6.3.m:
for her as she sought purification through meditation on Śiva, worship, and the like.
Then, after a few days, knowing her utmost persistence,
Śiva, urged by Pārvatī, was deeply pleased and said: (10)

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
putri mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīḥ śuddhadehāsi sāmpratam .
tuṣṭo'haṃ tapasā te'dya varaṃ varaya vāñchitam .. 225.11 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
पुत्रि मा साहसं कार्षीः शुद्धदेहासि साम्प्रतम् .
तुष्टोऽहं तपसा तेऽद्य वरं वरय वाञ्छितम् .. 225.11 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
'Daughter, do not act rashly; your body is now purified.
I am pleased today by your austerity; choose a desired boon.' (11)

6.3.s:
alikovāca -
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa varārhā yadyahaṃ matā .
nānāpāpāgnitaptāyā dehi śuddhiṃ parāṃ mama .. 225.12 ..
6.3.d:
अलिकोवाच -
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश वरार्हा यद्यहं मता .
नानापापाग्नितप्ताया देहि शुद्धिं परां मम .. 225.12 ..
6.3.m:
Alikā said:
'If you are pleased, O Lord of the gods, and if I am deemed worthy of a boon,
then to me, scorched by the fire of manifold sins, grant supreme purification! (12)

6.3.s:
tvaṃ me nātho hyanāthāyāstvameva jagatāṃ guruḥ .
dīnānāthasamuddhartā śaraṇyaḥ sarvadehinām .. 225.13 ..
6.3.d:
त्वं मे नाथो ह्यनाथायास्त्वमेव जगतां गुरुः .
दीनानाथसमुद्धर्ता शरण्यः सर्वदेहिनाम् .. 225.13 ..
6.3.m:
You alone are the master of me who am masterless; you alone are the teacher of the worlds,
the uplifter of the wretched and helpless, the refuge of all embodied beings.' (13)

6.3.s:
īśvara uvāca -
tvaṃ bhadre śuddhadehāsi mā kiṃcidanuśocithāḥ .
svanāmnā sthāpayitveha māṃ tataḥ svargameṣyasi .. 225.14 ..
6.3.d:
ईश्वर उवाच -
त्वं भद्रे शुद्धदेहासि मा किंचिदनुशोचिथाः .
स्वनाम्ना स्थापयित्वेह मां ततः स्वर्गमेष्यसि .. 225.14 ..
6.3.m:
Īśvara said:
'Fortunate woman, your body is purified; do not grieve at all.
Having established me here in your own name, you will then go to heaven.' (14)

6.3.s:
ityuktvā devadeveśastatraivāntaradhīyata .
alikāpi tato bhaktyā snātvā saṃsthāpya śaṅkaram .. 225.15 ..
6.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा देवदेवेशस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत .
अलिकापि ततो भक्त्या स्नात्वा संस्थाप्य शङ्करम् .. 225.15 ..
6.3.m:
Having spoken thus, the Lord of the gods vanished right there.
Then Alikā too, having bathed with devotion, established Śaṃkara, (15)

6.3.s:
dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo lokamāpa mahotkaṭam .
pitaraṃ ca samāsādya mātaraṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira .. 225.16 ..
6.3.d:
दत्त्वा दानं च विप्रेभ्यो लोकमाप महोत्कटम् .
पितरं च समासाद्य मातरं च युधिष्ठिर .. 225.16 ..
6.3.m:
and, having given gifts to brahmins, attained an exalted world.
Meeting her father and mother, O Yudhiṣṭhira, (16)

6.3.s:
taiśca saṃmānitā prītyā bandhubhiḥ sālikā tataḥ .
vimānavaramārūḍhā divyamālānvitā nṛpa .. 225.17 ..
6.3.d:
तैश्च संमानिता प्रीत्या बन्धुभिः सालिका ततः .
विमानवरमारूढा दिव्यमालान्विता नृप .. 225.17 ..
6.3.m:
and honored with affection by them and by her relatives, that Alikā then,
mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot and adorned with divine garlands, O king, (17)

6.3.s:
gaurīlokamanuprāptasakhitve'dyāpi modate .
tataḥ prabhṛti tatpārtha vikhyātamalikeśvaram .. 225.18 ..
6.3.d:
गौरीलोकमनुप्राप्तसखित्वेऽद्यापि मोदते .
ततः प्रभृति तत्पार्थ विख्यातमलिकेश्वरम् .. 225.18 ..
6.3.m:
attained the realm of Gaurī and even today rejoices in her companionship.
From that time forth, O son of Pṛthā, that [shrine] became renowned as Alikeśvara. (18)

6.3.s:
tatra tīrthe tu yā nārī puruṣo vā yudhiṣṭhira .
snātvā sampūjayedbhaktyā mahādevamumāyutam .. 225.19 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र तीर्थे तु या नारी पुरुषो वा युधिष्ठिर .
स्नात्वा सम्पूजयेद्भक्त्या महादेवमुमायुतम् .. 225.19 ..
6.3.m:
At that sacred ford, whatever woman or man, O Yudhiṣṭhira,
having bathed, worships with devotion Mahādeva united with Umā, (19)

6.3.s:
sa pāpairvividhairmukto lokamāpnoti śāṃkaram .
mānasaṃ vācikaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ yatpurā kṛtam .. 225.20 ..
6.3.d:
स पापैर्विविधैर्मुक्तो लोकमाप्नोति शांकरम् .
मानसं वाचिकं पापं कायिकं यत्पुरा कृतम् .. 225.20 ..
6.3.m:
freed from various sins, attains the world of Śaṃkara.
Mental, vocal, and physical sin committed in the past— (20)

6.3.s:
sarvaṃ tadvilayaṃ yāti bhojayitvā dvijānsadā .
dīpaṃ dattvā ca devāgre na rogaiḥ paribhūyate .. 225.21 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वं तद्विलयं याति भोजयित्वा द्विजान्सदा .
दीपं दत्त्वा च देवाग्रे न रोगैः परिभूयते .. 225.21 ..
6.3.m:
all of that disappears by constantly feeding twice-born men.
And by offering a lamp before the deity, one is not overcome by illnesses. (21)

6.3.s:
dhūpapātraṃ vimānaṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ kalaśameva ca .
dattvā devāya rājendra śākraṃ lokamavāpnuyāt .. 225.22 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revāsāgarasaṅgame'likeśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
धूपपात्रं विमानं च घण्टां कलशमेव च .
दत्त्वा देवाय राजेन्द्र शाक्रं लोकमवाप्नुयात् .. 225.22 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रेवासागरसङ्गमेऽलिकेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम पञ्चविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
By presenting an incense-burner, an aerial chariot, a bell, and a water-pot
to the deity, O lord of kings, one will attain the realm of Indra. (22)
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Alikeśvara Sacred Ford at the Confluence of the Revā and the Ocean,' in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Avantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
tataḥ krośāntare puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ tadvimaleśvaram .
yatra snānena dānena japahomārcanādibhiḥ .. 226.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
ततः क्रोशान्तरे पुण्यं तीर्थं तद्विमलेश्वरम् .
यत्र स्नानेन दानेन जपहोमार्चनादिभिः .. 226.1 ..
6.3.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Then, at the distance of one krośa, is that sacred ford Vimaleśvara,
where, by bathing, donation, recitation of mantras, fire-offerings, worship, and the like, (1)

6.3.s:
vimaleśvaramārādhya yo yadicchetsa tallabhet .
svargalābhādikaṃ vāpi pārthivaṃ vā yathepsitam .. 226.2 ..
6.3.d:
विमलेश्वरमाराध्य यो यदिच्छेत्स तल्लभेत् .
स्वर्गलाभादिकं वापि पार्थिवं वा यथेप्सितम् .. 226.2 ..
6.3.m:
having propitiated Vimaleśvara, whatever one desires, that one obtains,
whether the attainment of heaven and so forth, or earthly [rewards] as desired. (2)

6.3.s:
purā triśirasaṃ hatvā tvaṣṭuḥ putraṃ śatakratuḥ .
yasya tīrthasya māhātmyādvaimalyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 226.3 ..
6.3.d:
पुरा त्रिशिरसं हत्वा त्वष्टुः पुत्रं शतक्रतुः .
यस्य तीर्थस्य माहात्म्याद्वैमल्यं परमं गतः .. 226.3 ..
6.3.m:
Formerly, having slain Triśiras, the son of Tvaṣṭṛ, Indra of a hundred sacrifices,
by virtue of the majesty of this sacred ford, attained supreme stainlessness. (3)

6.3.s:
yatra vedanidhirvipro mahattaptvā tapaḥ purā .
nānākarmamalaiḥ kṣīṇairvimalo'bhavadarkavat .. 226.4 ..
6.3.d:
यत्र वेदनिधिर्विप्रो महत्तप्त्वा तपः पुरा .
नानाकर्ममलैः क्षीणैर्विमलोऽभवदर्कवत् .. 226.4 ..
6.3.m:
Where the brahmin Vedanidhi, having performed great austerity in ancient times,
with the impurities of various past actions destroyed, became stainless like the sun. (4)

6.3.s:
mahādevaprasādena somavatpriyadarśanaḥ .
purā bhānumatīṃ bhānuḥ sutāṃ smaraśarārditaḥ .. 226.5 ..
6.3.d:
महादेवप्रसादेन सोमवत्प्रियदर्शनः .
पुरा भानुमतीं भानुः सुतां स्मरशरार्दितः .. 226.5 ..
6.3.m:
By the grace of Mahādeva, he became pleasing to behold like the moon.
In ancient times, the sun, afflicted by the arrows of the god of love, [lusted after] his daughter Bhānumatī.

6.3.s:
cakame tena doṣeṇa kuṣṭharogārdito'bhavat .
sa cāpyatra tapastaptvā vimalatvamupāgataḥ .. 226.6 ..
6.3.d:
चकमे तेन दोषेण कुष्ठरोगार्दितोऽभवत् .
स चाप्यत्र तपस्तप्त्वा विमलत्वमुपागतः .. 226.6 ..
6.3.m:
He desired her, and because of that sin he was afflicted with leprosy.
Having performed tapas here too, he attained purity.

6.3.s:
mahādevena tuṣṭena svasthānaṃ mudito'bhajat .
tathaiva ca purā pārtha vibhāṇḍakasuto muniḥ .. 226.7 ..
6.3.d:
महादेवेन तुष्टेन स्वस्थानं मुदितोऽभजत् .
तथैव च पुरा पार्थ विभाण्डकसुतो मुनिः .. 226.7 ..
6.3.m:
Gratified by Mahādeva, he joyfully returned to his own place.
And likewise in ancient times, O son of Pṛthā, the sage, the son of Vibhāṇḍaka,

6.3.s:
yogisaṅgaṃ vane prāpya pure ca nṛpatestathā .
rājasaṃsargadoṣādvai mālinyaṃ paramātmanaḥ .. 226.8 ..
6.3.d:
योगिसङ्गं वने प्राप्य पुरे च नृपतेस्तथा .
राजसंसर्गदोषाद्वै मालिन्यं परमात्मनः .. 226.8 ..
6.3.m:
having met yogins in the forest and likewise the king in the city,
[felt] impurity of the Supreme Soul through the fault of association with royalty.

6.3.s:
vicārayannabhyupetya revāsāgarasaṅgamam .
śāntayā bhāryayā sārddhaṃ taptvā dvādaśavatsarān .. 226.9 ..
6.3.d:
विचारयन्नभ्युपेत्य रेवासागरसङ्गमम् .
शान्तया भार्यया सार्द्धं तप्त्वा द्वादशवत्सरान् .. 226.9 ..
6.3.m:
Reflecting [on this], he came to the confluence of the Revā and the ocean.
