Together with his wife Śāntā, having performed tapas for twelve years,

6.3.s:
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇairdevaṃ toṣayaṃstryambakaṃ muniḥ .
mahādevena tuṣṭena so'pi vaimalyamāptavān .. 226.10 ..
6.3.d:
कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणैर्देवं तोषयंस्त्र्यम्बकं मुनिः .
महादेवेन तुष्टेन सोऽपि वैमल्यमाप्तवान् .. 226.10 ..
6.3.m:
gratifying the three-eyed god with kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa penances, the sage,
when Mahādeva was pleased, also attained purity.

6.3.s:
śarvāṇyā preritaḥ śarvaḥ purā dāruvane nṛpa .
mohanānmunipatnīnāṃ svaṃ dīkṣya vimalaṃ kila .. 226.11 ..
6.3.d:
शर्वाण्या प्रेरितः शर्वः पुरा दारुवने नृप .
मोहनान्मुनिपत्नीनां स्वं दीक्ष्य विमलं किल .. 226.11 ..
6.3.m:
In ancient times, O king, Śarva, urged by Śarvāṇī in the pine forest,
to bewilder the wives of the sages, seeing his own [form] pure indeed,

6.3.s:
vicārya paramasthānaṃ narmadodadhisaṅgamam .
tatra sthitvā mahārāja tapastaptvā sahomayā .. 226.12 ..
6.3.d:
विचार्य परमस्थानं नर्मदोदधिसङ्गमम् .
तत्र स्थित्वा महाराज तपस्तप्त्वा सहोमया .. 226.12 ..
6.3.m:
considering the supreme place to be the confluence of the Narmadā and the ocean,
stayed there, O great king, and performed tapas together with Umā.

6.3.s:
vimalo'sau yato jātastenāsau vimaleśvaraḥ .
tena nāmnā svayaṃ tasthau lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā .. 226.13 ..
6.3.d:
विमलोऽसौ यतो जातस्तेनासौ विमलेश्वरः .
तेन नाम्ना स्वयं तस्थौ लोकानां हितकाम्यया .. 226.13 ..
6.3.m:
Since he became pure, he is therefore known as Vimaleśvara.
Under that name he established himself, desiring the welfare of the worlds.

6.3.s:
tatastilottamāṃ sṛṣṭvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .
prajānātho'pi tāṃ sṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvāgre sumanoharām .. 226.14 ..
6.3.d:
ततस्तिलोत्तमां सृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .
प्रजानाथोऽपि तां सृष्ट्वा दृष्ट्वाग्रे सुमनोहराम् .. 226.14 ..
6.3.m:
Then Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, having created Tilottamā—
even the lord of creatures, having created her and seeing her exceedingly captivating before him,

6.3.s:
bhāviyogabalākrāntaḥ sa tasyāmabhiko'bhavat .
tena vīkṣya sadoṣatvaṃ revātīradvayaṃ śritaḥ .. 226.15 ..
6.3.d:
भावियोगबलाक्रान्तः स तस्यामभिकोऽभवत् .
तेन वीक्ष्य सदोषत्वं रेवातीरद्वयं श्रितः .. 226.15 ..
6.3.m:
overcome by the power of impending fate, became lustful toward her.
Seeing his state of guilt because of that, he resorted to both banks of the Revā,

6.3.s:
tīrthānyanusaranmaunī trisnāyī saṃsmarañchivam .
revārṇavasamāyoge snātvā sampūjya śaṅkaram .
kālenālpena rājarṣe brahmāpyamalatāṃ gataḥ .. 226.16 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थान्यनुसरन्मौनी त्रिस्नायी संस्मरञ्छिवम् .
रेवार्णवसमायोगे स्नात्वा सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् .
कालेनाल्पेन राजर्षे ब्रह्माप्यमलतां गतः .. 226.16 ..
6.3.m:
silently following the sacred fords, bathing thrice daily, meditating upon Śiva.
Having bathed at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean and worshipped Śaṅkara,
in a short time, O royal seer, even Brahmā attained purity.

6.3.s:
evamanye'pi bahuśo devarṣinṛpasattamāḥ .
tyaktvā doṣamalaṃ tatra vimalā bahavo'bhavan .. 226.17 ..
6.3.d:
एवमन्येऽपि बहुशो देवर्षिनृपसत्तमाः .
त्यक्त्वा दोषमलं तत्र विमला बहवोऽभवन् .. 226.17 ..
6.3.m:
Thus many others too, the best among celestial seers and kings,
having cast away the defilement of sin there, became pure in great numbers.

6.3.s:
tathā tvamapi rājendra tatra snātvā śivārcanāt .
amalo'pi viśeṣeṇa vaimalyaṃ prāpsyase param .. 226.18 ..
6.3.d:
तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र तत्र स्नात्वा शिवार्चनात् .
अमलोऽपि विशेषेण वैमल्यं प्राप्स्यसे परम् .. 226.18 ..
6.3.m:
Likewise you too, O chief of kings, having bathed there, through the worship of Śiva,
though already pure, will especially attain supreme purity.

6.3.s:
tatra snātvā naro nārī pūjayitvā maheśvaram .
pāpadoṣavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate .. 226.19 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो नारी पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् .
पापदोषविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 226.19 ..
6.3.m:
A man or woman, having bathed there and worshipped Maheśvara,
freed from the guilt of sin, is glorified in the world of Brahmā.

6.3.s:
tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā paśyeta vimaleśvaram .
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sarvaparvasu pārthiva .. 226.20 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रोपवासं यः कृत्वा पश्येत विमलेश्वरम् .
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां सर्वपर्वसु पार्थिव .. 226.20 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever, having fasted there, beholds Vimaleśvara
on the eighth, the fourteenth, and on all full- and new-moon days, O king,

6.3.s:
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ hitvā yāti śivālayam .
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitḥṇāmanṛṇī bhavet .
brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām .. 226.21 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तजन्मकृतं पापं हित्वा याति शिवालयम् .
श्राद्धं कृत्वा विधानेन पित्ःणामनृणी भवेत् .
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्छक्त्या तेभ्यो दद्याच्च दक्षिणाम् .. 226.21 ..

6.3.s:
yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke yaccaivātmahitaṃ gṛhe .
tattadguṇavate deyaṃ tatraivākṣayamicchatā .
svarṇadhānyāni vāsāṃsi chatropānatkamaṇḍalum .. 226.22 ..
6.3.d:
यद्यदिष्टतमं लोके यच्चैवात्महितं गृहे .
तत्तद्गुणवते देयं तत्रैवाक्षयमिच्छता .
स्वर्णधान्यानि वासांसि छत्रोपानत्कमण्डलुम् .. 226.22 ..
6.3.m:
Whatever is most cherished in the world and whatever is of benefit to oneself in the home,
all that should be given there to a virtuous person by one desiring imperishable merit:
gold, grains, garments, an umbrella, shoes, and a water-pot.

6.3.s:
gṛhaṃ devasya vai śaktyā kṛtvā syādbhuvi bhūpatiḥ .
gītanṛtyakathābhiśca toṣayetparameśvaram .. 226.23 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe vimaleśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
गृहं देवस्य वै शक्त्या कृत्वा स्याद्भुवि भूपतिः .
गीतनृत्यकथाभिश्च तोषयेत्परमेश्वरम् .. 226.23 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे विमलेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम षड्विंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
etāni tava saṃkṣepātprādhānyātkathitāni ca .
na śakto vistarādvaktuṃ saṃkhyāṃ tīrtheṣu pāṇḍava .. 227.1 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एतानि तव संक्षेपात्प्राधान्यात्कथितानि च .
न शक्तो विस्तराद्वक्तुं संख्यां तीर्थेषु पाण्डव .. 227.1 ..

6.3.s:
eṣā pavitrā vimalā nadī trailokyaviśrutā .
narmadā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā mahādevasya vallabhā .. 227.2 ..
6.3.d:
एषा पवित्रा विमला नदी त्रैलोक्यविश्रुता .
नर्मदा सरितां श्रेष्ठा महादेवस्य वल्लभा .. 227.2 ..
6.3.m:
This pure, clear river is famed throughout the three worlds:
Narmadā, the best of rivers, beloved of Mahādeva.

6.3.s:
manasā saṃsmaredyastu narmadāṃ satataṃ nṛpa .
cāndrāyaṇaśatasyāśu labhate phalamuttamam .. 227.3 ..
6.3.d:
मनसा संस्मरेद्यस्तु नर्मदां सततं नृप .
चान्द्रायणशतस्याशु लभते फलमुत्तमम् .. 227.3 ..
6.3.m:
Whoever constantly meditates upon the Narmadā in his mind, O king,
speedily obtains the supreme fruit of a hundred cāndrāyaṇa penances.

6.3.s:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā nāstikāścātra ye sthitāḥ .
patanti narake ghore prāhaivaṃ parameśvaraḥ .. 227.4 ..
6.3.d:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा नास्तिकाश्चात्र ये स्थिताः .
पतन्ति नरके घोरे प्राहैवं परमेश्वरः .. 227.4 ..
6.3.m:
Men lacking faith and nihilists who reside here
fall into a dreadful hell; thus the Supreme Lord has said.

6.3.s:
narmadāṃ sevate nityaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ .
tena puṇyā nadī jñeyā brahmahatyāpahāriṇī .. 227.5 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदां सेवते नित्यं स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः .
तेन पुण्या नदी ज्ञेया ब्रह्महत्यापहारिणी .. 227.5 ..
6.3.m:
The god Maheśvara himself attends upon the Narmadā constantly;
therefore, she is to be known as a holy river that removes the sin of killing a brahmin.

6.3.s:
iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā maheśvaratanūdbhavā .
proktā dakṣiṇagaṅgeti bhāratasya yudhiṣṭhira .. 227.6 ..
6.3.d:
इयं माहेश्वरी गङ्गा महेश्वरतनूद्भवा .
प्रोक्ता दक्षिणगङ्गेति भारतस्य युधिष्ठिर .. 227.6 ..
6.3.m:
She is the Gaṅgā of Maheśvara, born from Maheśvara's body;
she is declared to be the southern Gaṅgā of the Bhārata realm, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
jāhnavī vaiṣṇavī gaṅgā brāhmī gaṅgā sarasvatī .
iyaṃ māheśvarī gaṅgā revā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ .. 227.7 ..
6.3.d:
जाह्नवी वैष्णवी गङ्गा ब्राह्मी गङ्गा सरस्वती .
इयं माहेश्वरी गङ्गा रेवा नास्त्यत्र संशयः .. 227.7 ..
6.3.m:
The Jāhnavī is the Gaṅgā of Viṣṇu; the Sarasvatī is the Gaṅgā of Brahmā;
this Revā is the Gaṅgā of Maheśvara; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
yathā hi puruṣe devastraimūrtatvamupāśritaḥ .
brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ na bhedastatra vai yathā .
tathā sarittraye pārtha bhedaṃ manasi mā kṛthāḥ .. 227.8 ..
6.3.d:
यथा हि पुरुषे देवस्त्रैमूर्तत्वमुपाश्रितः .
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाख्यं न भेदस्तत्र वै यथा .
तथा सरित्त्रये पार्थ भेदं मनसि मा कृथाः .. 227.8 ..
6.3.m:
Just as the god assumed a threefold form in the Supreme Being,
called Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśa, and just as there is indeed no difference among them,
so too, O son of Pṛthā, do not conceive any difference in mind among the triad of rivers.

6.3.s:
koṭiśo hyatra tīrthāni lakṣaśaścāpi bhārata .
tathā sahasraśo revātīradvayagatāni tu .. 227.9 ..
6.3.d:
कोटिशो ह्यत्र तीर्थानि लक्षशश्चापि भारत .
तथा सहस्रशो रेवातीरद्वयगतानि तु .. 227.9 ..
6.3.m:
Indeed, sacred fords here are in their tens of millions, hundreds of thousands, O descendant of Bharata,
and likewise in their thousands along both banks of the Revā,

6.3.s:
vṛkṣāntarikṣasaṃsthāni jalasthalagatāni ca .
kaḥ śaktastāni nirṇetuṃ vāgīśo vā maheśvaraḥ .. 227.10 ..
6.3.d:
वृक्षान्तरिक्षसंस्थानि जलस्थलगतानि च .
कः शक्तस्तानि निर्णेतुं वागीशो वा महेश्वरः .. 227.10 ..
6.3.m:
situated in trees, in the atmosphere, and in water and on dry land.
Who is able to determine them all—whether the Lord of Speech or Maheśvara?

6.3.s:
smaraṇājjanmajanitaṃ darśanācca trijanmajam .
saptajanmakṛtaṃ naśyetpāpaṃ revāvagāhanāt .. 227.11 ..
6.3.d:
स्मरणाज्जन्मजनितं दर्शनाच्च त्रिजन्मजम् .
सप्तजन्मकृतं नश्येत्पापं रेवावगाहनात् .. 227.11 ..
6.3.m:
By remembering it, the sin born of one birth is destroyed; by seeing it, of three births;
by bathing in the Revā, the sin committed across seven births is destroyed.

6.3.s:
devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tena agnayo vidhivaddhutāḥ .
vedā adhītāścatvāro yena revāvagāhitā .. 227.12 ..
6.3.d:
देवकार्यं कृतं तेन अग्नयो विधिवद्धुताः .
वेदा अधीताश्चत्वारो येन रेवावगाहिता .. 227.12 ..
6.3.m:
Rites to the gods have been performed by him, fires have been offered to according to rule,
and the four Vedas have been studied by him who has immersed himself in the Revā.

6.3.s:
prādhānyāccāpi saṃkṣepāttīrthānyuktāni te mayā .
na śakyo vistaraḥ pārtha śrotuṃ vaktuṃ ca vai mayā .. 227.13 ..
6.3.d:
प्राधान्याच्चापि संक्षेपात्तीर्थान्युक्तानि ते मया .
न शक्यो विस्तरः पार्थ श्रोतुं वक्तुं च वै मया .. 227.13 ..
6.3.m:
The sacred fords have been told to you by me by way of prominence and in brief;
a full account, O son of Pṛthā, cannot be heard or told by me.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
vidhānaṃ ca yamāṃścaiva niyamāṃśca vadasva me .
prāyaścittārthagamane ko vidhistaṃ vadasva me .. 227.14 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
विधानं च यमांश्चैव नियमांश्च वदस्व मे .
प्रायश्चित्तार्थगमने को विधिस्तं वदस्व मे .. 227.14 ..

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahārāja yacchreyaḥ pāralaukikam .
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yathājñānaṃ vadāmi te .. 227.15 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
साधु पृष्टं महाराज यच्छ्रेयः पारलौकिकम् .
शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा यथाज्ञानं वदामि ते .. 227.15 ..
6.3.m:
The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said:
Well asked, O great king, concerning what is conducive to the highest welfare in the other world.
Listen attentively; I shall tell you according to my knowledge.

6.3.s:
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa dhruvaṃ karma samācaret .
avaśyameva yāsyanti prāṇāḥ prāghūrṇikā iva .. 227.16 ..
6.3.d:
अध्रुवेण शरीरेण ध्रुवं कर्म समाचरेत् .
अवश्यमेव यास्यन्ति प्राणाः प्राघूर्णिका इव .. 227.16 ..
6.3.m:
With an impermanent body, one should perform permanent action.
For the vital breaths will inevitably depart, like guests.

6.3.s:
dānaṃ vittādṛtaṃ vācaḥ kīrtidharmau tathā khyuṣaḥ .
paropakaraṇaṃ kāyādasārātsāramuddharet .. 227.17 ..
6.3.d:
दानं वित्तादृतं वाचः कीर्तिधर्मौ तथा ख्युषः .
परोपकरणं कायादसारात्सारमुद्धरेत् .. 227.17 ..
6.3.m:
One should extract the essence from the essenceless body: gift-giving from wealth, truth of speech,
fame and righteousness from one's life, and doing good to others.

6.3.s:
asminmahāmohamaye kaṭāhe sūryāgninā rātridivendhanena .
māsartudarvīparighaṭṭanena bhūtāni kālaḥ pacatīti vārtā .. 227.18 ..
6.3.d:
अस्मिन्महामोहमये कटाहे सूर्याग्निना रात्रिदिवेन्धनेन .
मासर्तुदर्वीपरिघट्टनेन भूतानि कालः पचतीति वार्ता .. 227.18 ..
6.3.m:
In this cauldron of great delusion, with the sun as fire and night and day as fuel,
stirring with the ladle of months and seasons, Time cooks living beings: such is the news.

6.3.s:
jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi .
nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ .. 227.19 ..
6.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि .
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः .. 227.19 ..
6.3.m:
Knowing the action declared by the ordinance of the scriptures, you should perform it here.
Neither this world nor the next, nor happiness, exists for one whose mind is full of doubt.

6.3.s:
mantre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau .
yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī .. 227.20 ..
6.3.d:
मन्त्रे तीर्थे द्विजे देवे दैवज्ञे भेषजे गुरौ .
यादृशी भावना यस्य सिद्धिर्भवति तादृशी .. 227.20 ..
6.3.m:
In a mantra, a sacred ford, a twice-born, a deity, an astrologer, medicine, and a guru—
whatever disposition one holds, such is the fruition attained.

6.3.s:
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat .
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha .. 227.21 ..
6.3.d:
अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् .
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह .. 227.21 ..
6.3.m: Whatever is offered in sacrifice, given, performed as austerity, or done without faith / is said to be nonexistent, O Pārtha; it is of no account either after death or here in this world.

6.3.s:
yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ .
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim .. 227.22 ..
6.3.d:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः .
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम् .. 227.22 ..
6.3.m: He who, having discarded the ordinance of the scriptures, acts according to his own desire, / attains neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme goal.

6.3.s:
santīha vividhopāyā nṛṇāṃ dehaviśodhanāḥ .
tīrthasevāsamaṃ nāsti svaśarīrasya śodhanam .. 227.23 ..
6.3.d:
सन्तीह विविधोपाया नृणां देहविशोधनाः .
तीर्थसेवासमं नास्ति स्वशरीरस्य शोधनम् .. 227.23 ..
6.3.m: There are diverse means here for the purification of men's bodies; / [yet] there is nothing equal to resorting to a sacred ford for the purification of one's body.

6.3.s:
kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādyairvā dvitīyaṃ tīrthasevayā .
yadā tīrthaṃ samuddiśya prayāti puruṣo nṛpa .
tadā devāśca pitarastaṃ vrajantyanu khecarāḥ .. 227.24 ..
6.3.d:
कृच्छ्रचान्द्रायणाद्यैर्वा द्वितीयं तीर्थसेवया .
यदा तीर्थं समुद्दिश्य प्रयाति पुरुषो नृप .
तदा देवाश्च पितरस्तं व्रजन्त्यनु खेचराः .. 227.24 ..
6.3.m: Either by penances such as the kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa, or secondly by resorting to a sacred ford: / when a man sets out directed toward a sacred ford, O king, / then the gods and ancestors, moving in the sky, follow him.

6.3.s:
paramā modapūrṇāste prayāntyasyānuyāyinaḥ .
kṛtvābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ samāpṛcchaya tu devatām .. 227.25 ..
6.3.d:
परमा मोदपूर्णास्ते प्रयान्त्यस्यानुयायिनः .
कृत्वाभ्युदयिकं श्राद्धं समापृच्छय तु देवताम् .. 227.25 ..
6.3.m: Filled with supreme joy, they proceed following him. / Having performed an abhyudayika śrāddha and taken leave of the deity,

6.3.s:
iṣṭabandhūṃśca viṣṇuṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ sagaṇeśvaram .
vrajeddvijābhyanujñāto gṛhītvā niyamānapi .. 227.26 ..
6.3.d:
इष्टबन्धूंश्च विष्णुं च शङ्करं सगणेश्वरम् .
व्रजेद्द्विजाभ्यनुज्ञातो गृहीत्वा नियमानपि .. 227.26 ..
6.3.m: and of one's dear kinsmen, and of Viṣṇu, and of Śaṅkara together with the lord of the gaṇas, / he should depart, permitted by brahmins, having also undertaken the observances:

6.3.s:
ekāśanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ bhūśayyāṃ satyavāditām .
varjanaṃ ca parānnasya pratigrahavivarjanam .. 227.27 ..
6.3.d:
एकाशनं ब्रह्मचर्यं भूशय्यां सत्यवादिताम् .
वर्जनं च परान्नस्य प्रतिग्रहविवर्जनम् .. 227.27 ..
6.3.m: eating once a day, celibacy, sleeping on the ground, truthfulness in speech, / abstaining from another's food, and complete avoidance of accepting gifts;

6.3.s:
varjayitvā tathā drohavañcanādi nṛpottama .
sādhuveṣaṃ samāsthāya vinayena vibhūṣitaḥ .. 227.28 ..
6.3.d:
वर्जयित्वा तथा द्रोहवञ्चनादि नृपोत्तम .
साधुवेषं समास्थाय विनयेन विभूषितः .. 227.28 ..
6.3.m: likewise having renounced malice, deceit, and the like, O best of kings, / assuming the dress of a holy man, adorned with humility,

6.3.s:
dambhāhaṅkāramukto yaḥ sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .
yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam .. 227.29 ..
6.3.d:
दम्भाहङ्कारमुक्तो यः स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .
यस्य हस्तौ च पादौ च मनश्चैव सुसंयतम् .. 227.29 ..
6.3.m: free from hypocrisy and egotism—he enjoys the fruit of the sacred ford. / He whose hands, feet, and mind are well restrained,

6.3.s:
vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .
akrodhanaśca rājendra satyaśīlo dṛḍhavrataḥ .. 227.30 ..
6.3.d:
विद्या तपश्च कीर्तिश्च स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .
अक्रोधनश्च राजेन्द्र सत्यशीलो दृढव्रतः .. 227.30 ..
6.3.m: and [who possesses] learning, austerity, and fame—he enjoys the fruit of the sacred ford. / Free from anger, O king of kings, devoted to truth, steadfast in his vows,

6.3.s:
ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute .
muṇḍanaṃ copavāsaśca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ .. 227.31 ..
6.3.d:
आत्मोपमश्च भूतेषु स तीर्थफलमश्नुते .
मुण्डनं चोपवासश्च सर्वतीर्थेष्वयं विधिः .. 227.31 ..
6.3.m: and looking upon [all] beings as himself—he enjoys the fruit of the sacred ford. / Tonsure and fasting: this is the rule at all sacred fords,

6.3.s:
varjayitvā kurukṣetraṃ viśālāṃ virajāṃ gayām .
snānaṃ surārcanaṃ caiva śrāddhe vai piṇḍapātanam .. 227.32 ..
6.3.d:
वर्जयित्वा कुरुक्षेत्रं विशालां विरजां गयाम् .
स्नानं सुरार्चनं चैव श्राद्धे वै पिण्डपातनम् .. 227.32 ..
6.3.m: excepting Kurukṣetra, Viśālā, Virajā, and Gayā. / Ritual ablution, worship of the gods, and the offering of piṇḍas in a śrāddha,

6.3.s:
viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ śaktyā sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ .
prāyaścittanimittaṃ ca yo vrajedyatamānasaḥ .. 227.33 ..
6.3.d:
विप्राणां भोजनं शक्त्या सर्वतीर्थेष्वयं विधिः .
प्रायश्चित्तनिमित्तं च यो व्रजेद्यतमानसः .. 227.33 ..
6.3.m: and feeding brahmins according to one's means: this is the rule at all sacred fords. / And he who, with a restrained mind, departs for the sake of expiation—

6.3.s:
tasyāpi ca vidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu pārtha samāhitaḥ .
ekāśanaṃ brahmacaryamakṣāralavaṇāśanam .. 227.34 ..
6.3.d:
तस्यापि च विधिं वक्ष्ये शृणु पार्थ समाहितः .
एकाशनं ब्रह्मचर्यमक्षारलवणाशनम् .. 227.34 ..
6.3.m: I will tell his rule too; listen attentively, O Pārtha: / eating once a day, celibacy, eating food without salt and pungent spices,

6.3.s:
snātvā tīrthābhigamanaṃ haviṣyaikānnabhojanam .
varjayetpatitālāpaṃ bahubhāṣaṇameva ca .. 227.35 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा तीर्थाभिगमनं हविष्यैकान्नभोजनम् .
वर्जयेत्पतितालापं बहुभाषणमेव च .. 227.35 ..
6.3.m: approaching the sacred ford after bathing, eating single meals of sacrificial food (haviṣya), / he should avoid talking with fallen persons, as well as much chatter;

6.3.s:
parīvādaṃ parānnaṃ ca nīcasaṅgaṃ vivarjayet .
vrajecca nirupānatko vasāno vāsasī śuciḥ .. 227.36 ..
6.3.d:
परीवादं परान्नं च नीचसङ्गं विवर्जयेत् .
व्रजेच्च निरुपानत्को वसानो वाससी शुचिः .. 227.36 ..
6.3.m: he should avoid slander, another's food, and the company of the low-born; / and he should travel barefoot, wearing two clean garments.

6.3.s:
saṃkalpaṃ manasā kṛtvā brāhmaṇānujñayā vrajet .
tīrthe gatvā tathā snātvā kṛtvā caiva surārcanam .. 227.37 ..
6.3.d:
संकल्पं मनसा कृत्वा ब्राह्मणानुज्ञया व्रजेत् .
तीर्थे गत्वा तथा स्नात्वा कृत्वा चैव सुरार्चनम् .. 227.37 ..
6.3.m: Having formed a resolve in his mind, he should depart with the permission of brahmins. / Going to the sacred ford, bathing there, and worshipping the gods,

6.3.s:
duṣkarmato vimuktaḥ syādanutāpī bhavedyadi .
vede tīrthe ca deve ca daivajñe cauṣadhe gurau .. 227.38 ..
6.3.d:
दुष्कर्मतो विमुक्तः स्यादनुतापी भवेद्यदि .
वेदे तीर्थे च देवे च दैवज्ञे चौषधे गुरौ .. 227.38 ..
6.3.m: he would become free from evil deeds if he is truly repentant. / In the Veda, in a sacred ford, in a god, in an astrologer, in medicine, and in a guru,

6.3.s:
yādṛśī bhāvanā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī .
uktatīrthaphalānāṃ ca purāṇeṣu smṛtiṣvapi .. 227.39 ..
6.3.d:
यादृशी भावना यस्य सिद्धिर्भवति तादृशी .
उक्ततीर्थफलानां च पुराणेषु स्मृतिष्वपि .. 227.39 ..
6.3.m: whatever one's inner disposition is, such is the perfection he attains. / And concerning the fruits of the sacred fords stated in the Purāṇas and Smṛtis,

6.3.s:
arthavādabhavāṃ śaṅkāṃ vihāya bharatarṣabha .
kṛtvā vicāraṃ śāstroktaṃ parikalpya yathocitam .. 227.40 ..
6.3.d:
अर्थवादभवां शङ्कां विहाय भरतर्षभ .
कृत्वा विचारं शास्त्रोक्तं परिकल्प्य यथोचितम् .. 227.40 ..
6.3.m: abandoning doubt born of [regarding them as] mere praise, O bull of the Bharatas, / having made inquiry according to the scriptures, and having determined [the matter] properly,

6.3.s:
kāyena kṛcchracaraṇe hyaśaktānāṃ viśuddhaye .
jñātvā tīrthāviśeṣaṃ hi prāyaścittaṃ samācaret .. 227.41 ..
6.3.d:
कायेन कृच्छ्रचरणे ह्यशक्तानां विशुद्धये .
ज्ञात्वा तीर्थाविशेषं हि प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् .. 227.41 ..
6.3.m: for the purification of those physically unable to perform kṛcchra penances, / knowing the specific sacred fords, one should indeed perform the expiation.

6.3.s:
tacchṛṇuṣva mahārāja narmadāyāṃ yathocitam .
caturviṃśatisaṃkhyebhyo yojanebhyo vrajennaraḥ .. 227.42 ..
6.3.d:
तच्छृणुष्व महाराज नर्मदायां यथोचितम् .
चतुर्विंशतिसंख्येभ्यो योजनेभ्यो व्रजेन्नरः .. 227.42 ..
6.3.m: Listen to that as appropriate regarding the Narmadā, O great king: / if a man travels for twenty-four yojanas,

6.3.s:
caturviṃśatikṛcchrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śobhanam .
ata ūrdhvaṃ yojaneṣu pādakṛcchramudāhṛtaḥ .. 227.43 ..
6.3.d:
चतुर्विंशतिकृच्छ्राणां फलमाप्नोति शोभनम् .
अत ऊर्ध्वं योजनेषु पादकृच्छ्रमुदाहृतः .. 227.43 ..
6.3.m: he obtains the auspicious fruit of twenty-four kṛcchras. / Beyond that, a pādakṛcchra is prescribed for each yojana.

6.3.s:
tanmadhye ca mahārāja yo vrajecchuddhikāṅkṣayā .
yojane yojane tasya prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 227.44 ..
6.3.d:
तन्मध्ये च महाराज यो व्रजेच्छुद्धिकाङ्क्षया .
योजने योजने तस्य प्रायश्चित्तं विदुर्बुधाः .. 227.44 ..
6.3.m: And within that distance, O great king, whoever travels desiring purification— / the wise consider an expiation [accrued] for him at every yojana.

6.3.s:
praṇavākhye mahārāja tathā revorisaṃgame .
bhṛgukṣetre tathā gatvā phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ smṛtam .. 227.45 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणवाख्ये महाराज तथा रेवोरिसंगमे .
भृगुक्षेत्रे तथा गत्वा फलं तद्द्विगुणं स्मृतम् .. 227.45 ..
6.3.m: At the place called Praṇava, O great king, and likewise at the confluence of the Revā and Uri, / and going likewise to Bhṛgukṣetra, that fruit is said to be doubled.

6.3.s:
saṅgame devanadyāśca śūlabhede nṛpottama .
dviguṇaṃ pādahīnaṃ syātkarajāsaṃgame tathā .. 227.46 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमे देवनद्याश्च शूलभेदे नृपोत्तम .
द्विगुणं पादहीनं स्यात्करजासंगमे तथा .. 227.46 ..
6.3.m: And at the confluence of the river of the gods, [and] at Śūlabheda, O best of kings, / it is double less a quarter; likewise at the Karajā confluence.

6.3.s:
eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvatkapilāyāśca saṃgame .
kecittriguṇitaṃ prāhuḥ kubjārevotthasaṅgame .. 227.47 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्डीसङ्गमे तद्वत्कपिलायाश्च संगमे .
केचित्त्रिगुणितं प्राहुः कुब्जारेवोत्थसङ्गमे .. 227.47 ..
6.3.m: Similarly at the Eraṇḍī confluence, and at the confluence of the Kapilā; / some say it is tripled at the confluence of the Kubjā and Revā.

6.3.s:
oṃkāre ca mahārāja tadapi syātsamañjasam .
saṅgameṣu tathānyāsāṃ nadīnāṃ revayā saha .. 227.48 ..
6.3.d:
ओंकारे च महाराज तदपि स्यात्समञ्जसम् .
सङ्गमेषु तथान्यासां नदीनां रेवया सह .. 227.48 ..
6.3.m: And at Oṃkāra, O great king, that too would be appropriate. / Likewise at the confluences of other rivers with the Revā,

6.3.s:
prāhuste sārdhakṛcchraṃ vai phalaṃ pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira .
triguṇaṃ kṛcchramāpnoti revāsāgarasaṅgame .. 227.49 ..
6.3.d:
प्राहुस्ते सार्धकृच्छ्रं वै फलं पूर्वं युधिष्ठिर .
त्रिगुणं कृच्छ्रमाप्नोति रेवासागरसङ्गमे .. 227.49 ..
6.3.m: they say the fruit, as stated before, is one and a half kṛcchras, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / One attains a threefold kṛcchra at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean.

6.3.s:
kṛcchraṃ caturguṇaṃ proktaṃ śuklatīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
yojane yojane gatvā caturviṃśatiyojanam .
tatra tatra vasedyastu suciraṃ nṛvarottama .. 227.50 ..
6.3.d:
कृच्छ्रं चतुर्गुणं प्रोक्तं शुक्लतीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
योजने योजने गत्वा चतुर्विंशतियोजनम् .
तत्र तत्र वसेद्यस्तु सुचिरं नृवरोत्तम .. 227.50 ..
6.3.m: A fourfold kṛcchra is declared at Śuklatīrtha, O Yudhiṣṭhira. / Having gone yojana by yojana for twenty-four yojanas, / whoever resides there for a very long time at each place, O best of kings,

6.3.s:
revāsevāsamācāraḥ saṃyuktaḥ śuddhabuddhimān .
dambhāhaṅkārarahitaḥ śuddhyarthaṃ sa vimucyate .. 227.51 ..
6.3.d:
रेवासेवासमाचारः संयुक्तः शुद्धबुद्धिमान् .
दम्भाहङ्काररहितः शुद्ध्यर्थं स विमुच्यते .. 227.51 ..
6.3.m: engaged in the practice of serving the Revā, endowed with pure intellect, / free from hypocrisy and egotism, he is liberated for the sake of purification.

6.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ pārtha prāyaścittārthalakṣaṇam .
revāyātrāvidhānaṃ ca guhyametadyudhiṣṭhira .. 227.52 ..
6.3.d:
इति ते कथितं पार्थ प्रायश्चित्तार्थलक्षणम् .
रेवायात्राविधानं च गुह्यमेतद्युधिष्ठिर .. 227.52 ..
6.3.m: Thus has been told to you, O Pārtha, the definition of the purpose of expiation, / and the rule of the pilgrimage to the Revā; this is a secret, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
yojanasya pramāṇaṃ me vada tvaṃ munisattama .
yajjñātvā niścitaṃ me syānmanaḥśuddhestu kāraṇam .. 227.53 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
योजनस्य प्रमाणं मे वद त्वं मुनिसत्तम .
यज्ज्ञात्वा निश्चितं मे स्यान्मनःशुद्धेस्तु कारणम् .. 227.53 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me the measure of a yojana, O best of sages, / knowing which there would be certainty in my mind regarding the cause of mental purification.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
śṛṇu pāṇḍava vakṣyāmi pramāṇaṃ yojanasya yat .
tathā yātrāviśeṣeṇa viśeṣaṃ kṛcchrasambhavam .. 227.54 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
शृणु पाण्डव वक्ष्यामि प्रमाणं योजनस्य यत् .
तथा यात्राविशेषेण विशेषं कृच्छ्रसम्भवम् .. 227.54 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Listen, O Pāṇḍava; I will explain the measure of a yojana, / and the specific [merits] arising from kṛcchra in accordance with the specific pilgrimages.

6.3.s:
tiryagyavodarāṇyaṣṭāvūrdhvā vā vrīhayastrayaḥ .
pramāṇamaṅgulasyāhurvitastirdvādaśāṃgulā .. 227.55 ..
6.3.d:
तिर्यग्यवोदराण्यष्टावूर्ध्वा वा व्रीहयस्त्रयः .
प्रमाणमङ्गुलस्याहुर्वितस्तिर्द्वादशांगुला .. 227.55 ..
6.3.m: Eight middles of barley grains laid crosswise, or three rice grains lengthwise, / are said to be the measure of a finger-breadth (aṅgula); a span (vitasti) is twelve finger-breadths.

6.3.s:
vitastidvitayaṃ hastaścaturhastaṃ dhanuḥ smṛtam .
sa eva daṇḍo gadito viśeṣajñairyudhiṣṭhira .. 227.56 ..
6.3.d:
वितस्तिद्वितयं हस्तश्चतुर्हस्तं धनुः स्मृतम् .
स एव दण्डो गदितो विशेषज्ञैर्युधिष्ठिर .. 227.56 ..
6.3.m: Two spans are a cubit (hasta); a bow (dhanus) is recognized as four cubits. / That very [measure] is called a staff (daṇḍa) by those who know the distinctions, O Yudhiṣṭhira.

6.3.s:
dhanuḥsahasre dve krośaścatuḥkrośaṃ ca yojanam .
etadyojanamānaṃ te kathitaṃ bharatarṣabha .. 227.57 ..
6.3.d:
धनुःसहस्रे द्वे क्रोशश्चतुःक्रोशं च योजनम् .
एतद्योजनमानं ते कथितं भरतर्षभ .. 227.57 ..
6.3.m: Two thousand bows are a krośa, and four krośas are a yojana. / This measure of a yojana has been told to you, O bull of the Bharatas,

6.3.s:
yena yātrāṃ vrajan vetti phalamānaṃ nijārjitam .
uktaṃ kṛcchraphalaṃ tīrthe jalarūpe nṛpottama .. 227.58 ..
6.3.d:
येन यात्रां व्रजन् वेत्ति फलमानं निजार्जितम् .
उक्तं कृच्छ्रफलं तीर्थे जलरूपे नृपोत्तम .. 227.58 ..
6.3.m: by which one who sets out on a pilgrimage knows the measure of fruit earned by himself. / The fruit of a kṛcchra at a sacred ford consisting of water has been declared, O best of kings;

6.3.s:
yathāviśeṣaṃ te vacmi pūrvokte tatra tatra ca .
tanme śṛṇu mahīpāla śraddadhānāya kathyate .. 227.59 ..
6.3.d:
यथाविशेषं ते वच्मि पूर्वोक्ते तत्र तत्र च .
तन्मे शृणु महीपाल श्रद्दधानाय कथ्यते .. 227.59 ..
6.3.m: I shall tell you according to each distinction at each previously mentioned place. / Listen to that from me, O protector of the earth, as it is told to one who has faith.

6.3.s:
yasmiṃstīrthe hi yatproktaṃ phalaṃ kṛcchrādikaṃ nṛpa .
tatrāpyupoṣaṇātkṛcchraphalaṃ prāpnotyathādhikam .. 227.60 ..
6.3.d:
यस्मिंस्तीर्थे हि यत्प्रोक्तं फलं कृच्छ्रादिकं नृप .
तत्राप्युपोषणात्कृच्छ्रफलं प्राप्नोत्यथाधिकम् .. 227.60 ..
6.3.m: For at whatever sacred ford a fruit such as a kṛcchra has been declared, O king, / even there, by fasting, one obtains an even greater fruit of a kṛcchra.

6.3.s:
dinajāpyācca labhate phalaṃ kṛcchrasya śaktitaḥ .
tatra vikhyātadeveśaṃ snātvā dṛṣṭvābhipūjya ca .. 227.61 ..
6.3.d:
दिनजाप्याच्च लभते फलं कृच्छ्रस्य शक्तितः .
तत्र विख्यातदेवेशं स्नात्वा दृष्ट्वाभिपूज्य च .. 227.61 ..
6.3.m: And from daily recitation (jāpya) according to one's capacity, one obtains the fruit of a kṛcchra. / Having bathed there, and having seen and worshipped the renowned Lord of the gods,

6.3.s:
praṇamya labhate pārtha phalaṃ kṛcchrabhavaṃ sudhīḥ .
tīrthe mukhyaphalaṃ snānāddvitīyaṃ cāpyupoṣaṇāt .. 227.62 ..
6.3.d:
प्रणम्य लभते पार्थ फलं कृच्छ्रभवं सुधीः .
तीर्थे मुख्यफलं स्नानाद्द्वितीयं चाप्युपोषणात् .. 227.62 ..
6.3.m: and by bowing down, O Pārtha, an intelligent person obtains the fruit of an arduous penance. / The foremost fruit at a sacred ford comes from ritual ablution, and the second from fasting;

6.3.s:
tṛtīyaṃ khyātadevasya darśanābhyarcanādibhiḥ .
caturthaṃ jāpyayogena dehaśaktyā tvaharniśam .. 227.63 ..
6.3.d:
तृतीयं ख्यातदेवस्य दर्शनाभ्यर्चनादिभिः .
चतुर्थं जाप्ययोगेन देहशक्त्या त्वहर्निशम् .. 227.63 ..
6.3.m: the third from darśana, worship, and the like of the renowned deity; / and the fourth by means of reciting prayers according to one's bodily strength day and night.

6.3.s:
pañcamaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu kalpanīyaṃ hi dūrataḥ .
tīrastho yojanādarvāgdaśāṃśaṃ labhate phalam .. 227.64 ..
6.3.d:
पञ्चमं सर्वतीर्थेषु कल्पनीयं हि दूरतः .
तीरस्थो योजनादर्वाग्दशांशं लभते फलम् .. 227.64 ..
6.3.m: The fifth is indeed to be conceived from afar at all sacred fords: / one situated on the bank within a yojana obtains a tenth part of the fruit,

6.3.s: uktatīrthaphalātpārtha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 227.65 ..
6.3.d: उक्ततीर्थफलात्पार्थ नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 227.65 ..
6.3.m: from the declared fruit of that sacred ford, O Pārtha; no doubt should be entertained here.

6.3.s:
upavāsena sahitaṃ mahānadyāṃ hi majjanam .
apyarvāgyojanātpārtha dadyātkṛcchraphalaṃ nṛṇām .. 227.66 ..
6.3.d:
उपवासेन सहितं महानद्यां हि मज्जनम् .
अप्यर्वाग्योजनात्पार्थ दद्यात्कृच्छ्रफलं नृणाम् .. 227.66 ..
6.3.m: Indeed, an immersion accompanied by fasting in a great river, / even within a yojana, O Pārtha, gives people the fruit of an arduous penance.

6.3.s:
ṣaḍyojanavahā kulya nadyo'lpā dvādaśaiva ca .
caturviṃśatigā nadyo mahānadyastato'dhikāḥ .. 227.67 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthayātrādividhānaviśeṣakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
षड्योजनवहा कुल्य नद्योऽल्पा द्वादशैव च .
चतुर्विंशतिगा नद्यो महानद्यस्ततोऽधिकाः .. 227.67 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थयात्रादिविधानविशेषकथनं नाम सप्तविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
A watercourse flowing for six yojanas is a canal; minor rivers run for twelve; / rivers flow for twenty-four, and great rivers are longer than that.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-seventh chapter, named 'Account of the Specific Rules of Pilgrimage and Other Matters', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
parārthaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ gacchataḥ kasya kiṃ phalam .
kiyanmātraṃ muniśreṣṭha tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe .. 228.1 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
परार्थं तीर्थयात्रायां गच्छतः कस्य किं फलम् .
कियन्मात्रं मुनिश्रेष्ठ तन्मे ब्रूहि कृपानिधे .. 228.1 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / When someone goes on a pilgrimage on behalf of another, who obtains what fruit, / and to what extent, O best of sages? Tell me that, O ocean of compassion!

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
parārthaṃ gacchatastanme vadataḥ śṛṇu pārthiva .
yathā yāvatphalaṃ tasya yātrādivihitaṃ bhavet .. 228.2 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
परार्थं गच्छतस्तन्मे वदतः शृणु पार्थिव .
यथा यावत्फलं तस्य यात्रादिविहितं भवेत् .. 228.2 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Listen to me speak of that, O king, concerning one who goes on behalf of another, / how much fruit of the pilgrimage and other rites is ordained for him.

6.3.s:
uttameneha varṇena dravyalobhādinā nṛpa .
nādhamasya kvacitkāryaṃ tīrthayātrādisevanam .. 228.3 ..
6.3.d:
उत्तमेनेह वर्णेन द्रव्यलोभादिना नृप .
नाधमस्य क्वचित्कार्यं तीर्थयात्रादिसेवनम् .. 228.3 ..
6.3.m: A member of a higher caste, out of greed for wealth or the like, O king, / must never perform pilgrimage and similar practices on behalf of an inferior.

6.3.s:
dharmakarma mahārāja svayaṃ vidvānsamācaret .
śarīrasyāthavā śaktyā anyadvā kāryayogataḥ .. 228.4 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मकर्म महाराज स्वयं विद्वान्समाचरेत् .
शरीरस्याथवा शक्त्या अन्यद्वा कार्ययोगतः .. 228.4 ..
6.3.m: A wise man should perform religious acts himself, O great king, / or according to the capacity of his body, or through someone else if bound by necessity.

6.3.s:
dharmakarma sadā prāyaḥ savarṇenaiva kārayet .
putrapautrādikairvāpi jñātibhirgotrasambhavaiḥ .. 228.5 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मकर्म सदा प्रायः सवर्णेनैव कारयेत् .
पुत्रपौत्रादिकैर्वापि ज्ञातिभिर्गोत्रसम्भवैः .. 228.5 ..
6.3.m: One should almost always have religious acts performed by a person of one's own caste, / or by sons, grandsons, and the like, or by kinsmen born of the same lineage.

6.3.s:
śreṣṭhaṃ hi vihitaṃ prāhurdharmakarma yudhiṣṭhira .
taireva kārayettasmānnottamairnādhamairapi .. 228.6 ..
6.3.d:
श्रेष्ठं हि विहितं प्राहुर्धर्मकर्म युधिष्ठिर .
तैरेव कारयेत्तस्मान्नोत्तमैर्नाधमैरपि .. 228.6 ..
6.3.m: For religious acts performed by them are declared to be excellent, O Yudhiṣṭhira; / therefore, one should have them performed only by them, not by superiors nor by inferiors.

6.3.s:
adhamena kṛtaṃ samyaṅna bhavediti me matiḥ .
uttamaścādhamārthe vai kurvandurgatimāpnuyāt .. 228.7 ..
6.3.d:
अधमेन कृतं सम्यङ्न भवेदिति मे मतिः .
उत्तमश्चाधमार्थे वै कुर्वन्दुर्गतिमाप्नुयात् .. 228.7 ..
6.3.m: That which is performed by an inferior is not done properly—such is my opinion; / and a superior acting on behalf of an inferior will indeed fall into a degraded state.

6.3.s:
na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyānnocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam .
na cāsyopadiśeddharmaṃ na cāsya vratamādiśet .. 228.8 ..
6.3.d:
न शूद्राय मतिं दद्यान्नोच्छिष्टं न हविष्कृतम् .
न चास्योपदिशेद्धर्मं न चास्य व्रतमादिशेत् .. 228.8 ..
6.3.m: One should not give counsel to a śūdra, nor leftover food, nor sacrificial offerings; / one should not instruct him in dharma, nor prescribe a vow for him.

6.3.s:
japastapastīrthayātrā pravrajyā mantrasādhanam .
devatārādhanaṃ dīkṣā strīśūdrapatanāni ṣaṭ .. 228.9 ..
6.3.d:
जपस्तपस्तीर्थयात्रा प्रव्रज्या मन्त्रसाधनम् .
देवताराधनं दीक्षा स्त्रीशूद्रपतनानि षट् .. 228.9 ..
6.3.m: Recitation of mantras, austerity, pilgrimage, renunciation, mastering mantras, / deity worship, and initiation—these six cause the downfall of women and śūdras.

6.3.s:
pativatnī patatyeva vidhavā sarvamācaret .
sabhartṛkāśake patyau sarvaṃ kuryādanujñayā .. 228.10 ..
6.3.d:
पतिवत्नी पतत्येव विधवा सर्वमाचरेत् .
सभर्तृकाशके पत्यौ सर्वं कुर्यादनुज्ञया .. 228.10 ..
6.3.m: A woman whose husband is alive certainly falls; a widow may perform everything; / a woman with a husband should perform everything with his permission if the husband is present.

6.3.s:
gatvā parārthaṃ tīrthādau ṣoḍaśāṃśaphalaṃ labhet .
gacchataśca prasaṅgena tīrthamarddhaphalaṃ smṛtam .. 228.11 ..
6.3.d:
गत्वा परार्थं तीर्थादौ षोडशांशफलं लभेत् .
गच्छतश्च प्रसङ्गेन तीर्थमर्द्धफलं स्मृतम् .. 228.11 ..
6.3.m: Going on behalf of another to a sacred ford or the like, one obtains a sixteenth of the fruit; / but if one goes along in company, half the fruit is taught for the sacred ford.

6.3.s:
anusaṅgena tīrthasya snāne snānaphalaṃ viduḥ .
naiva yātrāphalaṃ tajjñāḥ śāstroktaṃ kalmaṣāpaham .. 228.12 ..
6.3.d:
अनुसङ्गेन तीर्थस्य स्नाने स्नानफलं विदुः .
नैव यात्राफलं तज्ज्ञाः शास्त्रोक्तं कल्मषापहम् .. 228.12 ..
6.3.m: Those who know understand that bathing merely alongside yields the fruit of ritual ablution; / it does not yield the fruit of pilgrimage declared in the scriptures, which destroys impurity.

6.3.s:
pitrarthaṃ ca pitṛvyasya māturmātāmahasya ca .
mātulasya tathā bhrātuḥ śvaśurasya sutasya ca .. 228.13 ..
6.3.d:
पित्रर्थं च पितृव्यस्य मातुर्मातामहस्य च .
मातुलस्य तथा भ्रातुः श्वशुरस्य सुतस्य च .. 228.13 ..
6.3.m: On behalf of a father, a paternal uncle, a mother, a maternal grandfather, / a maternal uncle, a brother, a father-in-law, or a son;

6.3.s:
poṣakārthādayoścāpi mātāmahyā gurostathā .
svasurmātṛṣvasuḥ paitryā ācāryādhyāpakasya ca .. 228.14 ..
6.3.d:
पोषकार्थादयोश्चापि मातामह्या गुरोस्तथा .
स्वसुर्मातृष्वसुः पैत्र्या आचार्याध्यापकस्य च .. 228.14 ..
6.3.m: or on behalf of a foster father and others, a maternal grandmother, a guru, / a sister, a maternal aunt, a paternal aunt, an ācārya, or an instructor—

6.3.s:
ityādyarthe naraḥ snātvā svayamaṣṭāṃśamāpnuyāt .
sākṣātpitroḥ prakurvāṇaścaturthāṃśamavāpnuyāt .. 228.15 ..
6.3.d:
इत्याद्यर्थे नरः स्नात्वा स्वयमष्टांशमाप्नुयात् .
साक्षात्पित्रोः प्रकुर्वाणश्चतुर्थांशमवाप्नुयात् .. 228.15 ..
6.3.m: having bathed on behalf of such persons, a man obtains an eighth part himself; / but performing it directly on behalf of parents, he obtains a fourth part.

6.3.s:
patipatnyormithaścārddhaṃ phalaṃ prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ .
bhāgineyasya śiṣyasya bhrātṛvyasya sutasya ca .
ṣaṭtripañcacaturbhāgānphalamāpnoti vai naraḥ .. 228.16 ..
6.3.d:
पतिपत्न्योर्मिथश्चार्द्धं फलं प्राहुर्मनीषिणः .
भागिनेयस्य शिष्यस्य भ्रातृव्यस्य सुतस्य च .
षट्त्रिपञ्चचतुर्भागान्फलमाप्नोति वै नरः .. 228.16 ..
6.3.m: The wise state that between husband and wife, the fruit shared is half; / for a nephew, a pupil, a brother's son, and a son, / a man indeed receives sixths, thirds, fifths, and fourths of the fruit.

6.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ pārtha pāramparyakramāgatam .
kartavyaṃ jñātivargasya parārthe dharmasādhanam .. 228.17 ..
6.3.d:
इति ते कथितं पार्थ पारम्पर्यक्रमागतम् .
कर्तव्यं ज्ञातिवर्गस्य परार्थे धर्मसाधनम् .. 228.17 ..
6.3.m: Thus has been told to you, O Pārtha, as handed down through tradition: / the means of dharma on behalf of another should be performed by the circle of kinsmen.

6.3.s:
varṣāṛtusamāyoge sarvā nadyo rajasvalāḥ .
muktvā sarasvatīṃ gaṅgāṃ narmadāṃ yamunānadīm .. 228.18 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe parārthatīrthayātrāphalakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
वर्षाऋतुसमायोगे सर्वा नद्यो रजस्वलाः .
मुक्त्वा सरस्वतीं गङ्गां नर्मदां यमुनानदीम् .. 228.18 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे परार्थतीर्थयात्राफलकथनं नामाष्टविंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
At the arrival of the rainy season, all rivers are impure, / except the Sarasvatī, the Gaṅgā, the Narmadā, and the river Yamunā.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Account of the Fruit of Pilgrimage on Behalf of Another', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth section, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājanpurāṇaṃ dharmasaṃhitam .
śivaprītyā yathā proktaṃ vāyunā devasaṃsadi .. 229.1 ..
6.3.d:
श्रीमार्कण्डेय उवाच -
एवं ते कथितं राजन्पुराणं धर्मसंहितम् .
शिवप्रीत्या यथा प्रोक्तं वायुना देवसंसदि .. 229.1 ..
6.3.m: The venerable Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Thus has this Purāṇa endowed with dharma been told to you, O king, / as it was proclaimed by Vāyu in the assembly of the gods out of love for Śiva.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭistathaiva ca .
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadāyāṃ pade pade .. 229.2 ..
6.3.d:
षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोटिस्तथैव च .
आदिमध्यावसानेषु नर्मदायां पदे पदे .. 229.2 ..
6.3.m: There are sixty thousand sacred fords, and likewise six hundred million, / at the beginning, middle, and end, at every step along the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
mayā dvādaśasāhasrī saṃhitā yā śrutā purā .
devadevasya gadataḥ sāmprataṃ kathitā tava .. 229.3 ..
6.3.d:
मया द्वादशसाहस्री संहिता या श्रुता पुरा .
देवदेवस्य गदतः साम्प्रतं कथिता तव .. 229.3 ..
6.3.m: The compendium of twelve thousand verses that was heard by me long ago / as the God of gods spoke it, has now been related to you.

6.3.s:
pṛṣṭastvayāhaṃ bhūpāla parvate'marakaṇṭake .
sthitaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarvaṃ mayā tatkathitaṃ tava .. 229.4 ..
6.3.d:
पृष्टस्त्वयाहं भूपाल पर्वतेऽमरकण्टके .
स्थितः संक्षेपतः सर्वं मया तत्कथितं तव .. 229.4 ..
6.3.m: I was questioned by you, O lord of the earth, as I stayed on Mount Amarakantaka; / all of that has been told to you in summary by me.

6.3.s:
narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu tasyāsti yatphalam .
yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiḥ syātsaṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ .. 229.5 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं शृणु तस्यास्ति यत्फलम् .
यत्फलं सर्ववेदैः स्यात्सषडङ्गपदक्रमैः .. 229.5 ..
6.3.m: Listen to the holy life-story of the Narmadā and the fruit that belongs to it: / whatever fruit would come from all the Vedas with the six auxiliary limbs, word-by-word recitations, and step-by-step recitations,

6.3.s:
paṭhitaiśca śrutairvāpi tasmādbahutaraṃ bhavet .
satrayājī phalaṃ yatra labhate dvādaśābdikam .. 229.6 ..
6.3.d:
पठितैश्च श्रुतैर्वापि तस्माद्बहुतरं भवेत् .
सत्रयाजी फलं यत्र लभते द्वादशाब्दिकम् .. 229.6 ..
6.3.m: when studied or heard, much greater than that accrues; / the fruit that a performer of a twelve-year sacrificial session attains,

6.3.s:
carite tu śrute devyā labhate tādṛśaṃ phalam .
sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ snātvā sāgaramāditaḥ .. 229.7 ..
6.3.d:
चरिते तु श्रुते देव्या लभते तादृशं फलम् .
सर्वतीर्थेषु यत्पुण्यं स्नात्वा सागरमादितः .. 229.7 ..
6.3.m: such fruit one obtains when the life-story of the goddess is heard. / Whatever merit is found at all sacred fords by bathing from the source to the ocean,

6.3.s:
sakṛtsnātvā tathā śrutvā narmadāyāṃ phalaṃ hi tat .
ādimadhyāvasānena narmadācaritaṃ śubham .. 229.8 ..
6.3.d:
सकृत्स्नात्वा तथा श्रुत्वा नर्मदायां फलं हि तत् .
आदिमध्यावसानेन नर्मदाचरितं शुभम् .. 229.8 ..
6.3.m: that fruit is obtained by bathing once in the Narmadā, or likewise by hearing [its deeds]. / The auspicious life-story of the Narmadā, through its beginning, middle, and end—

6.3.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .
sa prāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ rudrakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ .. 229.9 ..
6.3.d:
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु .
स प्राप्य शिवसंस्थानं रुद्रकन्यासमावृतः .. 229.9 ..
6.3.m: hear the holy fruit of that man who listens to it with devotion: / having attained the abode of Śiva, surrounded by the maidens of Rudra,

6.3.s:
rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā tenaiva saha modate .
etaddharmamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu sattamam .. 229.10 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रस्यानुचरो भूत्वा तेनैव सह मोदते .
एतद्धर्ममुपाख्यानं सर्वशास्त्रेषु सत्तमम् .. 229.10 ..
6.3.m: becoming an attendant of Rudra, he rejoices together with him. / This narrative of dharma is the best of all treatises;

6.3.s:
deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi vā grāme nagare'pi vā .
gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya cāturvarṇyasya bhārata .. 229.11 ..
6.3.d:
देशे वा मण्डले वापि वा ग्रामे नगरेऽपि वा .
गृहे वा तिष्ठते यस्य चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य भारत .. 229.11 ..
6.3.m: in whatever country, district, village, city, / or house of the four castes it resides, O Bhārata,

6.3.s:
sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ .
trividhaṃ kāraṇaṃ loke dharmapanthānamuttamam .. 229.12 ..
6.3.d:
स ब्रह्मा स शिवः साक्षात्स च देवो जनार्दनः .
त्रिविधं कारणं लोके धर्मपन्थानमुत्तमम् .. 229.12 ..
6.3.m: that is Brahmā, that is Śiva in person, and that is the god Janārdana. / It is the threefold cause in the world, the supreme path of dharma,

6.3.s:
devatānāṃ guruṃ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam .
śrutveśvaramukhātpārtha mayāpi tava kīrtitam .. 229.13 ..
6.3.d:
देवतानां गुरुं शास्त्रं परमं सिद्धिकारणम् .
श्रुत्वेश्वरमुखात्पार्थ मयापि तव कीर्तितम् .. 229.13 ..
6.3.m: the guru of the deities, the scripture, the supreme source of perfection. / Having heard it from the mouth of Īśvara, O Pārtha, it has also been recounted by me to you.

6.3.s:
dakṣiṇe cottare kūle yāni tīrthāni kānicit .
pradhānataḥ supuṇyāni kathitāni viśeṣataḥ .. 229.14 ..
6.3.d:
दक्षिणे चोत्तरे कूले यानि तीर्थानि कानिचित् .
प्रधानतः सुपुण्यानि कथितानि विशेषतः .. 229.14 ..
6.3.m: Whatever sacred fords there are on the southern and northern banks / have been described in particular according to their primary importance, possessing great merit.

6.3.s:
sparśanāddarśanātteṣāṃ kīrtanācchravaṇāttathā .
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .. 229.15 ..
6.3.d:
स्पर्शनाद्दर्शनात्तेषां कीर्तनाच्छ्रवणात्तथा .
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .. 229.15 ..
6.3.m: By touching them, beholding them, proclaiming them, and hearing of them, / one is liberated from all sins and goes to the world of Rudra.

6.3.s:
idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ śivabhāṣitam .
brāhmaṇo vedavidyāvān kṣatriyo vijayī bhavet .. 229.16 ..
6.3.d:
इदं यः शृणुयान्नित्यं पुराणं शिवभाषितम् .
ब्राह्मणो वेदविद्यावान् क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् .. 229.16 ..
6.3.m: Whoever listens daily to this purāṇa spoken by Śiva— / a brahmin becomes learned in Vedic knowledge, a kṣatriya becomes victorious;

6.3.s:
dhanabhāgī bhavedvaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāgbhavet .
saubhāgyaṃ santatiṃ svargaṃ nārī śrutvāpnuyāddhanam .. 229.17 ..
6.3.d:
धनभागी भवेद्वैश्यः शूद्रो वै धर्मभाग्भवेत् .
सौभाग्यं सन्ततिं स्वर्गं नारी श्रुत्वाप्नुयाद्धनम् .. 229.17 ..
6.3.m: a vaiśya gains wealth, and a śūdra attains righteousness; / by hearing it, a woman obtains good fortune, offspring, heaven, and wealth.

6.3.s:
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ .
māhātmyaṃ narmadāyāstu śrutvā pāpabahiṣkṛtāḥ .. 229.18 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः .
माहात्म्यं नर्मदायास्तु श्रुत्वा पापबहिष्कृताः .. 229.18 ..
6.3.m: Even the slayer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, the thief, and the violator of the guru's bed, / having heard the māhātmya of the Narmadā, are cast free from sin.

6.3.s:
pāpabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmiviśvāsaghātakaḥ .
goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ .. 229.19 ..
6.3.d:
पापभेदी कृतघ्नश्च स्वामिविश्वासघातकः .
गोघ्नश्च गरदश्चैव कन्याविक्रयकारकः .. 229.19 ..
6.3.m: The perpetrator of sins, the ungrateful, the betrayer of a master's trust, / the killer of cows, the poisoner, and the seller of his daughter—

6.3.s:
ete śrutvaiva pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .
ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śṛṇvanti satataṃ nṛpa .. 229.20 ..
6.3.d:
एते श्रुत्वैव पापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .
ये पुनर्भावितात्मानः शृण्वन्ति सततं नृप .. 229.20 ..
6.3.m: these, merely by hearing it, are freed from their sins; of this there is no doubt. / How much more so those purified souls who listen constantly, O king!

6.3.s:
pūjayanta idaṃ devāḥ pūjitā guravaśca taiḥ .
narmadā pūjitā tena bhagavāṃśca maheśvaraḥ .. 229.21 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयन्त इदं देवाः पूजिता गुरवश्च तैः .
नर्मदा पूजिता तेन भगवांश्च महेश्वरः .. 229.21 ..
6.3.m: By those who worship this [text], the gods are worshipped, and gurus are worshipped; / by such a one Narmadā is worshipped, and the Lord Maheśvara is worshipped.

6.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhapuṣpavibhūṣaṇaiḥ .
pūjitaṃ parayā bhaktyā śāstrametatphalapradam .. 229.22 ..
6.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन गन्धपुष्पविभूषणैः .
पूजितं परया भक्त्या शास्त्रमेतत्फलप्रदम् .. 229.22 ..
6.3.m: Therefore, by every effort, with fragrances, flowers, and ornaments, / this scripture, which bestows fruits, should be worshipped with supreme devotion.

6.3.s:
lekhāpayitvā sakalaṃ narmadācaritaṃ śubham .
uttamaṃ sarvaśāstrebhyo yo dadāti dvijanmane .. 229.23 ..
6.3.d:
लेखापयित्वा सकलं नर्मदाचरितं शुभम् .
उत्तमं सर्वशास्त्रेभ्यो यो ददाति द्विजन्मने .. 229.23 ..
6.3.m: Having caused the entire auspicious account of the Narmadā to be copied down, / whoever gives [this], the best of all treatises, to a twice-born,

6.3.s:
narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snāne dāne ca yatphalam .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 229.24 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदासर्वतीर्थेषु स्नाने दाने च यत्फलम् .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति स नरो नात्र संशयः .. 229.24 ..
6.3.m: attains the reward of ritual ablution and gifting / at all the sacred fords of the Narmadā; that man [reaches it], there is no doubt in this.

6.3.s:
etatpurāṇaṃ rudroktaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam .
svargadaṃ putradaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kīrtivardhanam .. 229.25 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्पुराणं रुद्रोक्तं महापुण्यफलप्रदम् .
स्वर्गदं पुत्रदं धन्यं यशस्यं कीर्तिवर्धनम् .. 229.25 ..
6.3.m: This purāṇa, spoken by Rudra, yields the reward of great merit; / it grants heaven, grants sons, brings blessings, confers renown, and increases fame.

6.3.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ pārtha duḥkhaduḥsvapnanāśanam .
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan sarvakāmārthasiddhidam .. 229.26 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वपापहरं पार्थ दुःखदुःस्वप्ननाशनम् .
पठतां शृण्वतां राजन् सर्वकामार्थसिद्धिदम् .. 229.26 ..
6.3.m: It removes all sins, O Pārtha, and destroys suffering and bad dreams; / for those who recite or listen to it, O king, it grants the fulfillment of all desires and aims.

6.3.s:
śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu lokāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ .
gobrāhmaṇebhyaḥ svastyastu dharmaṃ dharmātmajāśrayaḥ .. 229.27 ..
6.3.d:
शान्तिरस्तु शिवं चास्तु लोकाः सन्तु निरामयाः .
गोब्राह्मणेभ्यः स्वस्त्यस्तु धर्मं धर्मात्मजाश्रयः .. 229.27 ..
6.3.m: May there be peace, and may there be auspiciousness; may the worlds be free from disease; / may there be well-being for cows and brahmins, and may righteousness abide in the son of Dharma.

6.3.s:
narakāntakarī revā satīrthā viśvapāvanī .
narmadā dharmadā cāstu śarmadā pārtha te sadā .. 229.28 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde revākhaṇḍapaṭhanaśravaṇadānādiphalaśrutivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
नरकान्तकरी रेवा सतीर्था विश्वपावनी .
नर्मदा धर्मदा चास्तु शर्मदा पार्थ ते सदा .. 229.28 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे मार्कण्डेययुधिष्ठिरसंवादे रेवाखण्डपठनश्रवणदानादिफलश्रुतिवर्णनं नामैकोनत्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
May the Revā, which puts an end to hells, is endowed with sacred fords, and purifies the universe, / the Narmadā, grant you righteousness and grant you bliss forever, O Pārtha.
Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Fruits of Recitation, Listening, Gifting, and Other [Rites] of the Revākhaṇḍa," in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth [part], the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
sūta uvāca -
ityuktvopararāmatha pāṇḍoḥ putrāya vai muniḥ .
mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānsaptakalpasmaraḥ puraḥ .. 230.1 ..
6.3.d:
सूत उवाच -
इत्युक्त्वोपररामथ पाण्डोः पुत्राय वै मुनिः .
मृकण्डतनयो धीमान्सप्तकल्पस्मरः पुरः .. 230.1 ..
6.3.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus to the son of Pāṇḍu, the wise sage, / the son of Mṛkaṇḍu who remembers seven aeons, then paused before [him].

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍamuninā proktaṃ yathā pārthāya sattamāḥ .
tathā vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ revāmāhātmyamuttamam .. 230.2 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डमुनिना प्रोक्तं यथा पार्थाय सत्तमाः .
तथा वः कथितं सर्वं रेवामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .. 230.2 ..
6.3.m: Just as it was spoken by the sage Mārkaṇḍa to Pārtha, O best of men, / so the entire, supreme Revāmāhātmya has been related to you.

6.3.s:
iyaṃ puṇyā saricchreṣṭhā revā viśvaikapāvanī .
rudradehasamudbhūtā sarvabhūtābhayapradā .. 230.3 ..
6.3.d:
इयं पुण्या सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा रेवा विश्वैकपावनी .
रुद्रदेहसमुद्भूता सर्वभूताभयप्रदा .. 230.3 ..
6.3.m: This holy, best of rivers, the Revā, the sole purifier of the universe, / sprang from the body of Rudra and grants fearlessness to all living beings.

6.3.s:
oṅkārajaladhiṃ yāvaduvāca bhṛgunandanaḥ .
tīrthasaṅgamabhedānvai dharmaputrāya pṛcchate .. 230.4 ..
6.3.d:
ओङ्कारजलधिं यावदुवाच भृगुनन्दनः .
तीर्थसङ्गमभेदान्वै धर्मपुत्राय पृच्छते .. 230.4 ..
6.3.m: From Oṅkāra to the ocean, the son of Bhṛgu recounted / the divisions of the sacred fords and confluences to the inquiring son of Dharma.

6.3.s:
samāsenaiva munayastathāhaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ .
saptaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyastathaiva ca .. 230.5 ..
6.3.d:
समासेनैव मुनयस्तथाहं कथयामि वः .
सप्तषष्टिसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यस्तथैव च .. 230.5 ..
6.3.m: In summary, O sages, I shall likewise tell you: / sixty-seven thousand and sixty crores [of them]—

6.3.s:
kathaṃ kenātra śakyante vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi .
tathāpyatra muniśreṣṭhāḥ proktaṃ pārthāya vai yathā .. 230.6 ..
6.3.d:
कथं केनात्र शक्यन्ते वक्तुं वर्षशतैरपि .
तथाप्यत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रोक्तं पार्थाय वै यथा .. 230.6 ..
6.3.m: how could they be described here by anyone, even in hundreds of years? / Nevertheless, O best of sages, just as was spoken to Pārtha here,

6.3.s:
tīrthamoṃkāramārabhya vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ śubhām .
procyamānāṃ samāsena tāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ maharṣayaḥ .. 230.7 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थमोंकारमारभ्य वक्ष्ये तीर्थावलिं शुभाम् .
प्रोच्यमानां समासेन तां शृणुध्वं महर्षयः .. 230.7 ..
6.3.m: I shall state the auspicious series of sacred fords, beginning with the sacred ford of Oṅkāra. / Listen, O great seers, as it is related in summary.

6.3.s:
natvā somaṃ maheśānaṃ natvā brahmācyutāvubhau .
sarasvatīṃ gaṇeśānaṃ devyāsāṅghripañkajam .. 230.8 ..
6.3.d:
नत्वा सोमं महेशानं नत्वा ब्रह्माच्युतावुभौ .
सरस्वतीं गणेशानं देव्यासाङ्घ्रिपञ्कजम् .. 230.8 ..
6.3.m: Having bowed to Soma and Maheśāna, having bowed to both Brahmā and Acyuta, / to Sarasvatī, Gaṇeśāna, and the lotus-feet of the son of Diti,

6.3.s:
pūrvācāryāṃstathā sarvāndṛṣṭvādṛṣṭārthavedinaḥ .
praṇamya narmadāṃ devīṃ vakṣye tīrthāvaliṃ tvimām .. 230.9 ..
6.3.d:
पूर्वाचार्यांस्तथा सर्वान्दृष्ट्वादृष्टार्थवेदिनः .
प्रणम्य नर्मदां देवीं वक्ष्ये तीर्थावलिं त्विमाम् .. 230.9 ..
6.3.m: and to all the ancient teachers who know seen and unseen matters, / and having bowed to the goddess Narmadā, I shall declare this series of sacred fords.

6.3.s:
oṃ namo viśvarūpāya oṅkārāyākhilātmane .
yamārabhye pravakṣyāmi revātīrthāvaliṃ dvijāḥ .. 230.10 ..
6.3.d:
ओं नमो विश्वरूपाय ओङ्कारायाखिलात्मने .
यमारभ्ये प्रवक्ष्यामि रेवातीर्थावलिं द्विजाः .. 230.10 ..
6.3.m: Om, salutations to the universal form, to Oṅkāra, the Self of all, / starting from which I shall declare the series of sacred fords on the Revā, O twice-born.

6.3.s:
asminmārkaṇḍagadite revātīrthakrame śubhe .
purāṇasaṃhitādhyāyā mārkaṇḍāśramavarṇanam .. 230.11 ..
6.3.d:
अस्मिन्मार्कण्डगदिते रेवातीर्थक्रमे शुभे .
पुराणसंहिताध्याया मार्कण्डाश्रमवर्णनम् .. 230.11 ..
6.3.m: In this auspicious sequence of the sacred fords on the Revā declared by Mārkaṇḍa, / [there are] the chapters of the purāṇa compendium and the description of Mārkaṇḍa's hermitage;

6.3.s:
tataḥ praśnādhikāraśca praśaṃsā narmadodbhavā .
tathā pañcadaśānāṃ ca pravāhānāṃ prakīrtanam .. 230.12 ..
6.3.d:
ततः प्रश्नाधिकारश्च प्रशंसा नर्मदोद्भवा .
तथा पञ्चदशानां च प्रवाहानां प्रकीर्तनम् .. 230.12 ..
6.3.m: then the authority of the question, and the praise of Narmadā's origin, / as well as the proclamation of the fifteen currents;

6.3.s:
nāmanirvacanaṃ tadvattathā kalpasamudbhavāḥ .
ekaviṃśatikalpānāṃ tadvannāmānukīrtanam .. 230.13 ..
6.3.d:
नामनिर्वचनं तद्वत्तथा कल्पसमुद्भवाः .
एकविंशतिकल्पानां तद्वन्नामानुकीर्तनम् .. 230.13 ..
6.3.m: likewise the etymological explanation of names, and the origins of the aeons, / as well as the enumeration of the names of twenty-one aeons;

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeyānubhūtānāṃ saptānāṃ lakṣaṇāni ca .
māhātmyaṃ caiva revāyāḥ śivaviṣṇvostathaiva ca .. 230.14 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेयानुभूतानां सप्तानां लक्षणानि च .
माहात्म्यं चैव रेवायाः शिवविष्ण्वोस्तथैव च .. 230.14 ..
6.3.m: and the characteristics of the seven [aeons] experienced by Mārkaṇḍeya, / and the māhātmya of Revā, and of Śiva and Viṣṇu;

6.3.s:
saṃhāralakṣaṇaṃ tadvadoṅkārasya ca sambhavaḥ .
tathaivauṃkāramāhātmyamamarakaṇṭakīrtanam .. 230.15 ..
6.3.d:
संहारलक्षणं तद्वदोङ्कारस्य च सम्भवः .
तथैवौंकारमाहात्म्यममरकण्टकीर्तनम् .. 230.15 ..
6.3.m: likewise the nature of dissolution, and the origin of Oṅkāra, / as well as the māhātmya of Oṅkāra, and the celebration of Amarakaṇṭa;

6.3.s:
amareśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā dāruvanaṃ mahat .
dārukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai carukeśvaram .. 230.16 ..
6.3.d:
अमरेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा दारुवनं महत् .
दारुकेश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थं वै चरुकेश्वरम् .. 230.16 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford of Amareśvara, as well as the great Dāruvana, / the sacred ford of Dārukeśvara, and indeed the sacred ford of Carukeśvara;

6.3.s:
carukāsaṅgamastadvyadvatīpāteśvaraṃ tathā .
pātāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca koṭiyajñāhvayaṃ tathā .. 230.17 ..
6.3.d:
चरुकासङ्गमस्तद्व्यद्वतीपातेश्वरं तथा .
पातालेश्वरतीर्थं च कोटियज्ञाह्वयं तथा .. 230.17 ..
6.3.m: the confluence of the Carukā, likewise the [sacred ford] of Vyatīpāteśvara, / the sacred ford of Pātāleśvara, and likewise the one named Koṭiyajña;

6.3.s:
varuṇeśvaratīrthaṃ ca liṅgānyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam .
siddheśvaraṃ yameśaṃ ca brahmeśvaramataḥ param .. 230.18 ..
6.3.d:
वरुणेश्वरतीर्थं च लिङ्गान्यष्टोत्तरं शतम् .
सिद्धेश्वरं यमेशं च ब्रह्मेश्वरमतः परम् .. 230.18 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford of Varuṇeśvara, and the hundred and eight liṅgas, / Siddheśvara, Yameśa, and, after this, Brahmeśvara;

6.3.s:
sārasvataṃ cāṣṭarudraṃ sāvitraṃ somasaṃjñitam .
śivakhātaṃ mahātīrthaṃ rudrāvartaṃ dvijottamāḥ .. 230.19 ..
6.3.d:
सारस्वतं चाष्टरुद्रं सावित्रं सोमसंज्ञितम् .
शिवखातं महातीर्थं रुद्रावर्तं द्विजोत्तमाः .. 230.19 ..
6.3.m: and Sārasvata, Aṣṭarudra, Sāvitra, and the one named Soma, / the great sacred ford of Śivakhāta, and Rudrāvarta, O best of twice-born;

6.3.s:
brahmāvartaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sūryāvartamataḥ param .
pippalāvartatīrthaṃ ca pippalyāścaiva saṅgamaḥ .. 230.20 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मावर्तं परं तीर्थं सूर्यावर्तमतः परम् .
पिप्पलावर्ततीर्थं च पिप्पल्याश्चैव सङ्गमः .. 230.20 ..
6.3.m: the supreme sacred ford of Brahmāvarta, and after this, Sūryāvarta, / and the sacred ford of Pippalāvarta, and the confluence of the Pippalī;

6.3.s:
amarakaṇṭamāhātmyaṃ kapilāsaṅgamastathā .
viśalyāsambhavaścāpi bhṛgutuṅgādrikīrtanam .. 230.21 ..
6.3.d:
अमरकण्टमाहात्म्यं कपिलासङ्गमस्तथा .
विशल्यासम्भवश्चापि भृगुतुङ्गाद्रिकीर्तनम् .. 230.21 ..
6.3.m: the māhātmya of Amarakaṇṭa, and the confluence of the Kapilā, / and the origin of the Viśalyā, and the proclamation of Mount Bhṛgutuṅga;

6.3.s:
viśalyāsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaḥ karamardāsamāgamaḥ .
karamardeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam .. 230.22 ..
6.3.d:
विशल्यासङ्गमः पुण्यः करमर्दासमागमः .
करमर्देश्वरं तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 230.22 ..
6.3.m: the holy confluence of the Viśalyā, the meeting of the Karamardā, / the sacred ford of Karamardeśvara, and the unsurpassed Cakra sacred ford;

6.3.s:
saṅgamo nīlagaṅgāyāḥ vidhvaṃsastripurasya ca .
kīrtanaṃ tīrthadānānāṃ madhukatṛtīyāvratam .. 230.23 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमो नीलगङ्गायाः विध्वंसस्त्रिपुरस्य च .
कीर्तनं तीर्थदानानां मधुकतृतीयाव्रतम् .. 230.23 ..
6.3.m: the confluence of the Nīlagaṅgā, and the destruction of Tripura, / the mention of gifts at the sacred fords, and the observance of the Madhukatṛtīyā;

6.3.s:
apsareśvaratīrthaṃ ca dehakṣepe vidhistataḥ .
tīrthaṃ jvāleśvaraṃ nāma jvālāyāḥ saṅgamastathā .. 230.24 ..
6.3.d:
अप्सरेश्वरतीर्थं च देहक्षेपे विधिस्ततः .
तीर्थं ज्वालेश्वरं नाम ज्वालायाः सङ्गमस्तथा .. 230.24 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford of Apsareśvara, then the rite for casting off the body, / the sacred ford named Jvāleśvara, and the confluence of the Jvālā;

6.3.s:
śakratīrthaṃ kuśāvartaṃ haṃsatīrthaṃ tathaiva ca .
ambarīṣasya tīrthaṃ ca mahākāleśvaraṃ tathā .. 230.25 ..
6.3.d:
शक्रतीर्थं कुशावर्तं हंसतीर्थं तथैव च .
अम्बरीषस्य तीर्थं च महाकालेश्वरं तथा .. 230.25 ..
6.3.m: the Śakra sacred ford, Kuśāvarta, and likewise Haṃsatīrtha, / the sacred ford of Ambarīṣa, and Mahākāleśvara;

6.3.s:
mātṛkeśvaratīrthaṃ ca bhṛgutuṅgānuvarṇanam .
tatra bhairavamāhātmyaṃ capaleśvarakīrtanam .. 230.26 ..
6.3.d:
मातृकेश्वरतीर्थं च भृगुतुङ्गानुवर्णनम् .
तत्र भैरवमाहात्म्यं चपलेश्वरकीर्तनम् .. 230.26 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford of Mātṛkeśvara, and the detailed description of Bhṛgutuṅga, / therein the māhātmya of Bhairava, and the proclamation of Capaleśvara;

6.3.s:
caṇḍapāṇeśca māhātmyaṃ kāverīsaṅgamastathā .
kubereśvaratīrthaṃ ca vārāhīsaṅgamastathā .. 230.27 ..
6.3.d:
चण्डपाणेश्च माहात्म्यं कावेरीसङ्गमस्तथा .
कुबेरेश्वरतीर्थं च वाराहीसङ्गमस्तथा .. 230.27 ..
6.3.m: the māhātmya of Caṇḍapāṇi, and the confluence of the Kāverī, / the sacred ford of Kubereśvara, and the confluence of the Vārāhī;

6.3.s:
saṅgamaścaṇḍavegāyāstīrthaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ tathā .
eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇya eraṇḍeśvaramuttamam .. 230.28 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमश्चण्डवेगायास्तीर्थं चण्डेश्वरं तथा .
एरण्डीसङ्गमः पुण्य एरण्डेश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 230.28 ..
6.3.m: the confluence of the Caṇḍavegā, and the sacred ford of Caṇḍeśvara, / the holy confluence of the Eraṇḍī, and the supreme Eraṇḍeśvara.

6.3.s:
pitṛtīrthaṃ ca tatraiva oṅkārasya ca sambhavam .
māhātmyaṃ pañcaliṅgānāmoṅkārasya munīśvarāḥ .. 230.29 ..
6.3.d:
पितृतीर्थं च तत्रैव ओङ्कारस्य च सम्भवम् .
माहात्म्यं पञ्चलिङ्गानामोङ्कारस्य मुनीश्वराः .. 230.29 ..
6.3.m: And there itself is Pitṛtīrtha, and the origin of Oṅkāra, / and the māhātmya of the five liṅgas of Oṅkāra, O best of sages;

6.3.s:
koṭitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ tīrthaṃ kākahradaṃ tathā .
jambukeśvaratīrthaṃ ca sārasvatamataḥ param .. 230.30 ..
6.3.d:
कोटितीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं तीर्थं काकह्रदं तथा .
जम्बुकेश्वरतीर्थं च सारस्वतमतः परम् .. 230.30 ..
6.3.m: the māhātmya of Koṭitīrtha, and the sacred ford Kākahrada; / and the sacred ford Jambukeśvara, and after that Sārasvata;

6.3.s:
kapilāsaṅgamastadvattīrthaṃ ca kapileśvaram .
daityasūdanatīrthaṃ ca cakratīrthaṃ ca vāmanam .. 230.31 ..
6.3.d:
कपिलासङ्गमस्तद्वत्तीर्थं च कपिलेश्वरम् .
दैत्यसूदनतीर्थं च चक्रतीर्थं च वामनम् .. 230.31 ..
6.3.m: likewise the confluence of the Kapilā, and the sacred ford Kapileśvara; / and the sacred ford Daityasūdana, and Cakratīrtha, and Vāmana.

6.3.s:
tīrthalakṣaṃ viduḥ pūrve kapilāyāstu saṅgame .
svargasya narakasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ munibhāṣitam .. 230.32 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थलक्षं विदुः पूर्वे कपिलायास्तु सङ्गमे .
स्वर्गस्य नरकस्यापि लक्षणं मुनिभाषितम् .. 230.32 ..
6.3.m: The ancients knew a hundred thousand sacred fords at the confluence of the Kapilā; / and the characteristics of heaven and hell spoken by the sage;

6.3.s:
vyavasthānaṃ śarīrasya gopradānānuvarṇanam .
aśokavanikātīrthaṃ mataṅgāśramavarṇanam .. 230.33 ..
6.3.d:
व्यवस्थानं शरीरस्य गोप्रदानानुवर्णनम् .
अशोकवनिकातीर्थं मतङ्गाश्रमवर्णनम् .. 230.33 ..
6.3.m: the constitution of the body, the description of the gift of a cow; / the sacred ford Aśokavanikā, the description of Mataṅga's hermitage;

6.3.s:
aśokeśvaratīrthaṃ ca mataṅgeśvaramuttamam .
tathā mṛgavanaṃ puṇyaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ manoratham .. 230.34 ..
6.3.d:
अशोकेश्वरतीर्थं च मतङ्गेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
तथा मृगवनं पुण्यं तत्र तीर्थं मनोरथम् .. 230.34 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Aśokeśvara, and excellent Mataṅgeśvara; / likewise the holy Mṛgavana, and the sacred ford Manoratha there;

6.3.s:
saṅgamo'ṅgāragartāyā aṅgāreśvaramuttamam .
tathā meghavanaṃ tīrthaṃ devyā nāmānukīrtanam .. 230.35 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमोऽङ्गारगर्ताया अङ्गारेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
तथा मेघवनं तीर्थं देव्या नामानुकीर्तनम् .. 230.35 ..
6.3.m: the confluence of the Aṅgāragartā, excellent Aṅgāreśvara; / likewise the sacred ford Meghavana, the recitation of the names of the Goddess;

6.3.s:
saṅgamaścāpi kubjāyāstīrthaṃ kubjeśvaraṃ tathā .
bilvāmrakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ pūrṇadvīpamataḥ param .. 230.36 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमश्चापि कुब्जायास्तीर्थं कुब्जेश्वरं तथा .
बिल्वाम्रकं तथा तीर्थं पूर्णद्वीपमतः परम् .. 230.36 ..
6.3.m: and also the confluence of the Kubjā, and the sacred ford Kubjeśvara; / likewise the sacred ford Bilvāmraka, and after that Pūrṇadvīpa;

6.3.s:
tathā hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgamaḥ puṇyakīrtanaḥ .
dvīpeśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñeśvaraṃ tathā .. 230.37 ..
6.3.d:
तथा हिरण्यगर्भायाः सङ्गमः पुण्यकीर्तनः .
द्वीपेश्वरं नाम तीर्थं पुण्यं यज्ञेश्वरं तथा .. 230.37 ..
6.3.m: likewise the confluence of the Hiraṇyagarbhā, whose praise brings merit; / the sacred ford named Dvīpeśvara, and holy Yajñeśvara;

6.3.s:
māṇḍavyāśramatīrthaṃ ca viśokāsaṅgamastathā .
vāgīśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ puṇyo vai vāgusaṅgamaḥ .. 230.38 ..
6.3.d:
माण्डव्याश्रमतीर्थं च विशोकासङ्गमस्तथा .
वागीश्वरं नाम तीर्थं पुण्यो वै वागुसङ्गमः .. 230.38 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford of Māṇḍavya's hermitage, and the confluence of the Viśokā; / the sacred ford named Vāgīśvara, and the holy confluence of the Vāgu;

6.3.s:
sahasrāvartakaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ saugandhikaṃ tathā .
saṅgamaśca sarasvatyā īśānaṃ tīrthamuttamam .. 230.39 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रावर्तकं तत्र तीर्थं सौगन्धिकं तथा .
सङ्गमश्च सरस्वत्या ईशानं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 230.39 ..
6.3.m: Sahasrāvartaka there, and likewise the sacred ford Saugandhika; / and the confluence of the Sarasvatī, and the excellent sacred ford Īśāna;

6.3.s:
devatātrayatīrthaṃ ca śūlakhātaṃ tataḥ param .
brahmodaṃ śāṅkaraṃ saumyaṃ sārasvatamataḥ param .. 230.40 ..
6.3.d:
देवतात्रयतीर्थं च शूलखातं ततः परम् .
ब्रह्मोदं शाङ्करं सौम्यं सारस्वतमतः परम् .. 230.40 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Devatātraya, and after that Śūlakhāta; / Brahmoda, Śāṅkara, Saumya, and after that Sārasvata;

6.3.s:
sahasrayajñatīrthaṃ ca kapālamocanaṃ tathā .
āgneyamaditīśaṃ ca vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam .. 230.41 ..
6.3.d:
सहस्रयज्ञतीर्थं च कपालमोचनं तथा .
आग्नेयमदितीशं च वाराहं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 230.41 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Sahasrayajña, and Kapālamocana; / Āgneya, Aditīśa, and the excellent sacred ford Vārāha;

6.3.s:
tathā devapathaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñasahasrakam .
śuklatīrthaṃ dīptikeśaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ ca yodhanam .. 230.42 ..
6.3.d:
तथा देवपथं तीर्थं तीर्थं यज्ञसहस्रकम् .
शुक्लतीर्थं दीप्तिकेशं विष्णुतीर्थं च योधनम् .. 230.42 ..
6.3.m: likewise the sacred ford Devapatha, the sacred ford Yajñasahasraka; / Śuklatīrtha, Dīptikeśa, Viṣṇutīrtha, and Yodhana;

6.3.s:
narmadeśvaratīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśaṃ ca mārutam .
yogeśaṃ rohiṇītīrthaṃ dārutīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ .. 230.43 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदेश्वरतीर्थं च वरुणेशं च मारुतम् .
योगेशं रोहिणीतीर्थं दारुतीर्थं च सत्तमाः .. 230.43 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Narmadeśvara, Varuṇeśa, and Māruta; / Yogeśa, Rohiṇītīrtha, and Dārutīrtha, O best of men;

6.3.s:
brahmāvartaṃ ca pattreśaṃ vāhnaṃ sauraṃ ca kīrtyate .
meghanādaṃ dārutīrthaṃ devatīrthaṃ guhāśrayam .. 230.44 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मावर्तं च पत्त्रेशं वाह्नं सौरं च कीर्त्यते .
मेघनादं दारुतीर्थं देवतीर्थं गुहाश्रयम् .. 230.44 ..
6.3.m: Brahmāvarta, Pattreśa, Vāhna, and Saura is proclaimed; / Meghanāda, Dārutīrtha, Devatīrtha, Guhāśraya;

6.3.s:
narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tatkapilātīrthamuttamam .
karañjeśaṃ kuṇḍaleśaṃ pippalādamataḥ param .. 230.45 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदेश्वरसंज्ञं तत्कपिलातीर्थमुत्तमम् .
करञ्जेशं कुण्डलेशं पिप्पलादमतः परम् .. 230.45 ..
6.3.m: that named Narmadeśvara, excellent Kapilatīrtha; / Karañjeśa, Kuṇḍaleśa, and after that Pippalāda;

6.3.s:
vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ .
praśaṃsā śūlabhedasya tatraivāndhakavikramaḥ .. 230.46 ..
6.3.d:
विमलेश्वरतीर्थं च पुष्करिण्याश्च सङ्गमः .
प्रशंसा शूलभेदस्य तत्रैवान्धकविक्रमः .. 230.46 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Vimaleśvara, and the confluence of the Puṣkariṇī; / the praise of Śūlabheda, and there too the prowess of Andhaka;

6.3.s:
devāśvāsanadānaṃ ca tathaivāndhakanigrahaḥ .
śūlabhedasya cotpattistathā pātraparīkṣaṇam .. 230.47 ..
6.3.d:
देवाश्वासनदानं च तथैवान्धकनिग्रहः .
शूलभेदस्य चोत्पत्तिस्तथा पात्रपरीक्षणम् .. 230.47 ..
6.3.m: the granting of reassurance to the gods, and likewise the vanquishing of Andhaka; / and the origin of Śūlabheda, and the testing of the recipient;

6.3.s:
praśaṃsā dānadharmasya ṛṣiśṛṅgānubhāvanam .
svargatiṃ dīrghatapaso bhānumatyāstatheṅgitam .. 230.48 ..
6.3.d:
प्रशंसा दानधर्मस्य ऋषिशृङ्गानुभावनम् .
स्वर्गतिं दीर्घतपसो भानुमत्यास्तथेङ्गितम् .. 230.48 ..
6.3.m: the praise of the duty of giving, the manifestation of Ṛṣyaśṛṅga; / the going to heaven of Dīrghatapas, and the gesture of Bhānumatī;

6.3.s:
śabarasvargagamanaṃ māhātmyaṃ śūlabhedajam .
kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca mokṣatīrthamataḥ param .. 230.49 ..
6.3.d:
शबरस्वर्गगमनं माहात्म्यं शूलभेदजम् .
कपिलेश्वरतीर्थं च मोक्षतीर्थमतः परम् .. 230.49 ..
6.3.m: the ascent to heaven of the Śabara, the māhātmya arising from Śūlabheda; / and the sacred ford Kapileśvara, and after that Mokṣatīrtha;

6.3.s:
saṅgamo mokṣanadyāśca tīrthaṃ ca vimaleśvaram .
tathaivolūkatīrthaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāśca saṅgamaḥ .. 230.50 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमो मोक्षनद्याश्च तीर्थं च विमलेश्वरम् .
तथैवोलूकतीर्थं च पुष्करिण्याश्च सङ्गमः .. 230.50 ..
6.3.m: and the confluence of the Mokṣa river, and the sacred ford Vimaleśvara; / likewise the sacred ford Ulūka, and the confluence of the Puṣkariṇī;

6.3.s:
ādityeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram .
saṅgamo bhīmakulyāyāstīrthaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ śubham .. 230.51 ..
6.3.d:
आदित्येश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थं वै सङ्गमेश्वरम् .
सङ्गमो भीमकुल्यायास्तीर्थं भीमेश्वरं शुभम् .. 230.51 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Ādityeśvara, and the sacred ford Saṅgameśvara; / the confluence of the Bhīmakulyā, and auspicious Bhīmeśvara sacred ford;

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā vai pippaleśvaram .
karoṭīśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthamindreśvaraṃ śubham .. 230.52 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा वै पिप्पलेश्वरम् .
करोटीश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थमिन्द्रेश्वरं शुभम् .. 230.52 ..
6.3.m: and the sacred ford Mārkaṇḍeśvara, and likewise Pippaleśvara; / and the sacred ford Karoṭīśvara, and the auspicious sacred ford Indreśvara;

6.3.s:
agastyeśaṃ kumāreśaṃ vyāseśvaramanuttamam .
vaidyanāthaṃ ca kedāramānandeśvarasaṃjñitam .. 230.53 ..
6.3.d:
अगस्त्येशं कुमारेशं व्यासेश्वरमनुत्तमम् .
वैद्यनाथं च केदारमानन्देश्वरसंज्ञितम् .. 230.53 ..
6.3.m: Agastyeśa, Kumāreśa, unexcelled Vyāseśvara; / Vaidyanātha, and Kedāra, and that named Ānandeśvara;

6.3.s:
mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muṇḍeśaṃ cauraṃ kāmeśvaraṃ tathā .
saṅgamaścānuduhyā vai tīrthe bhīmārjunāhvaye .
tīrthaṃ dharmeśvaraṃ nāma luṅkeśvaramataḥ param .. 230.54 ..
6.3.d:
मातृतीर्थं च मुण्डेशं चौरं कामेश्वरं तथा .
सङ्गमश्चानुदुह्या वै तीर्थे भीमार्जुनाह्वये .
तीर्थं धर्मेश्वरं नाम लुङ्केश्वरमतः परम् .. 230.54 ..
6.3.m: and Mātṛtīrtha, Muṇḍeśa, Caura, and likewise Kāmeśvara; / and the confluence of the Anuduhyā at the sacred ford called Bhīmārjuna; / the sacred ford named Dharmeśvara, and after that Luṅkeśvara;

6.3.s:
tato dhanadatīrthaṃ ca jaṭeśaṃ maṅgaleśvaram .
kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca gopāreśvaramuttamam .. 230.55 ..
6.3.d:
ततो धनदतीर्थं च जटेशं मङ्गलेश्वरम् .
कपिलेश्वरतीर्थं च गोपारेश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 230.55 ..
6.3.m: then the sacred ford Dhanada, Jaṭeśa, Maṅgaleśvara; / and the sacred ford Kapileśvara, and excellent Gopāreśvara;

6.3.s:
maṇināgeśvaraṃ nāma maṇinadyāśca saṅgamaḥ .
tilakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca gautameśamataḥ param .. 230.56 ..
6.3.d:
मणिनागेश्वरं नाम मणिनद्याश्च सङ्गमः .
तिलकेश्वरतीर्थं च गौतमेशमतः परम् .. 230.56 ..
6.3.m: named Maṇināgeśvara, and the confluence of the Maṇi river; / and the sacred ford Tilakeśvara, and after that Gautameśa;

6.3.s:
tatraiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca muninoktaṃ munīśvarāḥ .
śaṅkhacūḍaṃ ca kedāraṃ pārāśaramataḥ param .. 230.57 ..
6.3.d:
तत्रैव मातृतीर्थं च मुनिनोक्तं मुनीश्वराः .
शङ्खचूडं च केदारं पाराशरमतः परम् .. 230.57 ..
6.3.m: there itself Mātṛtīrtha, declared by the sage, O best of sages; / Śaṅkhacūḍa, Kedāra, and after that Pārāśara;

6.3.s:
bhīmeśvaraṃ ca candreśamaśvavatyāśca saṅgamaḥ .
bahvīśvaraṃ nāradeśaṃ vaidyanāthaṃ kapīśvaram .. 230.58 ..
6.3.d:
भीमेश्वरं च चन्द्रेशमश्ववत्याश्च सङ्गमः .
बह्वीश्वरं नारदेशं वैद्यनाथं कपीश्वरम् .. 230.58 ..
6.3.m: Bhīmeśvara, Candreśa, and the confluence of the Aśvavatī; / Bahvīśvara, Nāradeśa, Vaidyanātha, Kapīśvara;

6.3.s:
kumbheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ rāmeśaṃ lakṣmaṇeśvaram .
megheśvaraṃ matsyakeśamapsarāhradasaṃjñakam .. 230.59 ..
6.3.d:
कुम्भेश्वरं च मार्कण्डं रामेशं लक्ष्मणेश्वरम् .
मेघेश्वरं मत्स्यकेशमप्सराह्रदसंज्ञकम् .. 230.59 ..
6.3.m: Kumbheśvara, Mārkaṇḍa, Rāmeśa, Lakṣmaṇeśvara; / Megheśvara, Matsyakeśa, and that named Apsarāhrada;

6.3.s:
dadhiskandaṃ madhuskandaṃ nandikeśaṃ ca vāruṇam .
pāvakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathaiva kapileśvaram .. 230.60 ..
6.3.d:
दधिस्कन्दं मधुस्कन्दं नन्दिकेशं च वारुणम् .
पावकेश्वरतीर्थं च तथैव कपिलेश्वरम् .. 230.60 ..
6.3.m: Dadhiskanda, Madhuskanda, Nandikeśa, Vāruṇa; / and the sacred ford Pāvakeśvara, and likewise Kapileśvara;

6.3.s:
nārāyaṇāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam .
caṇḍādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ caṇḍikātīrthamuttamam .. 230.61 ..
6.3.d:
नारायणाह्वयं तीर्थं चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
चण्डादित्यं परं तीर्थं चण्डिकातीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 230.61 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford called Nārāyaṇa, unexcelled Cakratīrtha; / the supreme sacred ford Caṇḍāditya, excellent Caṇḍikātīrtha;

6.3.s:
yamahāsāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ tathā gaṅgeśvaraṃ śubham .
nandikeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāhvayam .. 230.62 ..
6.3.d:
यमहासाह्वयं तीर्थं तथा गङ्गेश्वरं शुभम् .
नन्दिकेश्वरसंज्ञं च नरनारायणाह्वयम् .. 230.62 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford called Yamahāsa, likewise auspicious Gaṅgeśvara; / that named Nandikeśvara, and that called Naranārāyaṇa;

6.3.s:
naleśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ śuklatīrthamataḥ param .
vyāseśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra siddheśvaraṃ tathā .. 230.63 ..
6.3.d:
नलेश्वरं च मार्कण्डं शुक्लतीर्थमतः परम् .
व्यासेश्वरं परं तीर्थं तत्र सिद्धेश्वरं तथा .. 230.63 ..
6.3.m: Naleśvara, Mārkaṇḍa, and after that Śuklatīrtha; / the supreme sacred ford Vyāseśvara, and likewise Siddheśvara there;

6.3.s:
koṭitīrthaṃ prabhātīrthaṃ vāsukīśvaramuttamam .
saṅgamaśca karañjāyā mārkaṇḍeśvaramuttamam .. 230.64 ..
6.3.d:
कोटितीर्थं प्रभातीर्थं वासुकीश्वरमुत्तमम् .
सङ्गमश्च करञ्जाया मार्कण्डेश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 230.64 ..
6.3.m: Koṭitīrtha, Prabhātīrtha, excellent Vāsukīśvara; / and the confluence of the Karañjā, excellent Mārkaṇḍeśvara;

6.3.s:
tīrthaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ nāma tathā saṃkarṣaṇāhvayam .
kanakeśaṃ manmatheśaṃ tīrthaṃ caivānasūyakam .. 230.65 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थं कोटीश्वरं नाम तथा संकर्षणाह्वयम् .
कनकेशं मन्मथेशं तीर्थं चैवानसूयकम् .. 230.65 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Koṭīśvara, likewise that called Saṃkarṣaṇa; / Kanakeśa, Manmatheśa, and the sacred ford Anasūyaka;

6.3.s:
eraṇḍīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyo mātṛtīrthaṃ ca śobhanam .
tīrthaṃ svarṇaśalākākhyaṃ tathā caivāmbikeśvaram .. 230.66 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्डीसङ्गमः पुण्यो मातृतीर्थं च शोभनम् .
तीर्थं स्वर्णशलाकाख्यं तथा चैवाम्बिकेश्वरम् .. 230.66 ..
6.3.m: the holy confluence of the Eraṇḍī, and splendid Mātṛtīrtha; / the sacred ford called Svarṇaśalākā, and likewise Ambikeśvara;

6.3.s:
karañjeśaṃ bhārateśaṃ nāgeśaṃ mukuṭeśvaram .
saubhāgyasundarī tīrthaṃ dhanadeśvaramuttamam .. 230.67 ..
6.3.d:
करञ्जेशं भारतेशं नागेशं मुकुटेश्वरम् .
सौभाग्यसुन्दरी तीर्थं धनदेश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 230.67 ..
6.3.m: Karañjeśa, Bhārateśa, Nāgeśa, Mukuṭeśvara; / the sacred ford Saubhāgyasundarī, excellent Dhanadeśvara;

6.3.s:
rohiṇyaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca uttareśvarasaṃjñitam .
bhogeśvaraṃ ca kedāraṃ niṣkalaṅkamataḥ param .. 230.68 ..
6.3.d:
रोहिण्यं चक्रतीर्थं च उत्तरेश्वरसंज्ञितम् .
भोगेश्वरं च केदारं निष्कलङ्कमतः परम् .. 230.68 ..
6.3.m: Rohiṇya, Cakratīrtha, and that named Uttareśvara; / Bhogeśvara, Kedāra, and after that Niṣkalaṅka;

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍaṃ dhautapāpaṃ ca tīrthamāṅgiraseśvaram .
koṭavīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca tatra vai .. 230.69 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डं धौतपापं च तीर्थमाङ्गिरसेश्वरम् .
कोटवीसङ्गमः पुण्यं कोटितीर्थं च तत्र वै .. 230.69 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍa, Dhautapāpa, and the sacred ford Āṅgiraseśvara; / the confluence of the Koṭavī, and indeed Koṭitīrtha there;

6.3.s:
ayonijaṃ paraṃ tīrthamaṅgāreśvaramuttamam .
skāndaṃ ca nārmadaṃ brāhmaṃ vālmīkeśvarasaṃjñitam .. 230.70 ..
6.3.d:
अयोनिजं परं तीर्थमङ्गारेश्वरमुत्तमम् .
स्कान्दं च नार्मदं ब्राह्मं वाल्मीकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् .. 230.70 ..
6.3.m: the supreme sacred ford Ayonija, excellent Aṅgāreśvara; / Skānda, Nārmada, Brāhma, and that named Vālmīkeśvara.

6.3.s:
koṭitīrthaṃ kapāleśaṃ pāṇḍutīrthaṃ trilocanam .
kapileśaṃ kambukeśaṃ prabhāsaṃ kohaneśvaram .. 230.71 ..
6.3.d:
कोटितीर्थं कपालेशं पाण्डुतीर्थं त्रिलोचनम् .
कपिलेशं कम्बुकेशं प्रभासं कोहनेश्वरम् .. 230.71 ..
6.3.m: Koṭitīrtha, Kapāleśa, Pāṇḍutīrtha, Trilocana, / Kapileśa, Kambukeśa, Prabhāsa, Kohaneśvara,

6.3.s:
indreśaṃ vālukeśaṃ ca deveśaṃ śakrameva ca .
nāgeśvaraṃ gautameśamahalyātīrthamuttamam .. 230.72 ..
6.3.d:
इन्द्रेशं वालुकेशं च देवेशं शक्रमेव च .
नागेश्वरं गौतमेशमहल्यातीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 230.72 ..
6.3.m: Indreśa, Vālukeśa, Deveśa, and Śakra indeed, / Nāgeśvara, Gautameśa, and the supreme Ahalyātīrtha,

6.3.s:
rāmeśvaraṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ tathā kuśalaveśvarau .
narmadeśaṃ kapardīśaṃ sāgareśamataḥ param .. 230.73 ..
6.3.d:
रामेश्वरं मोक्षतीर्थं तथा कुशलवेश्वरौ .
नर्मदेशं कपर्दीशं सागरेशमतः परम् .. 230.73 ..
6.3.m: Rāmeśvara, Mokṣatīrtha, likewise Kuśeśvara and Laveśvara, / Narmadeśa, Kapardīśa, and thereafter Sāgareśa,

6.3.s:
dhaurādityaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ cāparayonijam .
piṅgaleśvaratīrtha ca bhṛgvīśvaramanuttamam .. 230.74 ..
6.3.d:
धौरादित्यं परं तीर्थं तीर्थं चापरयोनिजम् .
पिङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थ च भृग्वीश्वरमनुत्तमम् .. 230.74 ..
6.3.m: the supreme Dhaurādityatīrtha, and another sacred ford [named] Ayonija, / the Piṅgaleśvara sacred ford, and unsurpassed Bhṛgvīśvara,

6.3.s:
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ koṭitīrthaṃ ca sattamāḥ .
mārkaṇḍaṃ brahmatīrthaṃ ca ādivārāhamuttamam .. 230.75 ..
6.3.d:
दशाश्वमेधिकं तीर्थं कोटितीर्थं च सत्तमाः .
मार्कण्डं ब्रह्मतीर्थं च आदिवाराहमुत्तमम् .. 230.75 ..
6.3.m: Daśāśvamedhika sacred ford, and Koṭitīrtha, O best of beings, / Mārkaṇḍa, Brahmatīrtha, and the supreme Ādivārāha,

6.3.s:
āśāpūrābhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ kauberaṃ mārutaṃ tathā .
varuṇeśaṃ yameśaṃ ca rāmeśaṃ karkaṭeśvaram .. 230.76 ..
6.3.d:
आशापूराभिधं तीर्थं कौबेरं मारुतं तथा .
वरुणेशं यमेशं च रामेशं कर्कटेश्वरम् .. 230.76 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Āśāpūra, Kaubera, likewise Māruta, / Varuṇeśa, Yameśa, Rāmeśa, and Karkaṭeśvara,

6.3.s:
śakreśaṃ somatīrthaṃ ca nandāhradamanuttamam .
vaiṣṇavaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca rāmakeśavasaṃjñitam .. 230.77 ..
6.3.d:
शक्रेशं सोमतीर्थं च नन्दाह्रदमनुत्तमम् .
वैष्णवं चक्रतीर्थं च रामकेशवसंज्ञितम् .. 230.77 ..
6.3.m: Śakreśa, Somatīrtha, and the unsurpassed Nandāhrada, / the Vaiṣṇava Cakratīrtha, and the one known as Rāmakeśava,

6.3.s:
tathaiva rukmiṇītīrthaṃ śivatīrthamanuttamam .
jayavārāhartīrthaṃ ca tīrthamasmāhakāhvayam .. 230.78 ..
6.3.d:
तथैव रुक्मिणीतीर्थं शिवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .
जयवाराहर्तीर्थं च तीर्थमस्माहकाह्वयम् .. 230.78 ..
6.3.m: likewise Rukmiṇītīrtha, the unsurpassed Śivatīrtha, / Jayavārāhatīrtha, and the sacred ford named Asmāhaka,

6.3.s:
aṅgāreśaṃ ca siddheśaṃ tapeśvaramataḥ param .
punaḥ siddheśvaraṃ nāmatīrthaṃ ca varuṇeśvaram .. 230.79 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गारेशं च सिद्धेशं तपेश्वरमतः परम् .
पुनः सिद्धेश्वरं नामतीर्थं च वरुणेश्वरम् .. 230.79 ..
6.3.m: Aṅgāreśa, Siddheśa, and thereafter Tapeśvara, / again Siddheśvara by name, and the Varuṇeśvara sacred ford,

6.3.s:
parāśareśvaraṃ puṇyaṃ kusumeśamanuttamam .
kuṇḍaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā kalakaleśvaram .. 230.80 ..
6.3.d:
पराशरेश्वरं पुण्यं कुसुमेशमनुत्तमम् .
कुण्डलेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा कलकलेश्वरम् .. 230.80 ..
6.3.m: holy Parāśareśvara, unsurpassed Kusumeśa, / the Kuṇḍaleśvara sacred ford, and likewise Kalakaleśvara,

6.3.s:
nyaṅkuvārāhasaṃjñaṃ ca aṅkolaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
śvetavārāhatīrthaṃ ca bhārgalaṃ sauramuttamam .. 230.81 ..
6.3.d:
न्यङ्कुवाराहसंज्ञं च अङ्कोलं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
श्वेतवाराहतीर्थं च भार्गलं सौरमुत्तमम् .. 230.81 ..
6.3.m: the one named Nyaṅkuvārāha, and the supreme Aṅkola sacred ford, / Śvetavārāhatīrtha, Bhārgala, and the supreme Saura,

6.3.s:
huṅkārasvāmitīrthaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ ca śobhanam .
saṅgamo madhumatyāśca tīrthaṃ vai saṅgameśvaram .. 230.82 ..
6.3.d:
हुङ्कारस्वामितीर्थं च शुक्लतीर्थं च शोभनम् .
सङ्गमो मधुमत्याश्च तीर्थं वै सङ्गमेश्वरम् .. 230.82 ..
6.3.m: Huṅkārasvāmitīrtha, and beautiful Śuklatīrtha, / the confluence of Madhumatī, and the Saṅgameśvara sacred ford,

6.3.s:
narmadeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca nadītritayasaṅgamaḥ .
anekeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śarbheśaṃ mokṣasaṃjñitam .. 230.83 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदेश्वरसंज्ञं च नदीत्रितयसङ्गमः .
अनेकेश्वरतीर्थं च शर्भेशं मोक्षसंज्ञितम् .. 230.83 ..
6.3.m: the one named Narmadeśvara, and the confluence of three rivers, / Anekeśvaratīrtha, Śarbheśa, and that named Mokṣa,

6.3.s:
kāverīsaṅgamaḥ puṇyastīrthaṃ gopeśvarāhvayam .
mārkaṇḍeśaṃ ca nāgeśamudambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ .. 230.84 ..
6.3.d:
कावेरीसङ्गमः पुण्यस्तीर्थं गोपेश्वराह्वयम् .
मार्कण्डेशं च नागेशमुदम्बर्याश्च सङ्गमः .. 230.84 ..
