6.3.m: the holy confluence of Kāverī, the sacred ford named Gopeśvara, / Mārkaṇḍeśa, Nāgeśa, and the confluence of Udambarī,

6.3.s:
sāmbādityāhvayaṃ tīrthamudambaryāśca saṅgamaḥ .
siddheśvaraṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ tathā siddheśvarīkṛtam .. 230.85 ..
6.3.d:
साम्बादित्याह्वयं तीर्थमुदम्बर्याश्च सङ्गमः .
सिद्धेश्वरं च मार्कण्डं तथा सिद्धेश्वरीकृतम् .. 230.85 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Sāmbāditya, and the confluence of Udambarī, / Siddheśvara, Mārkaṇḍa, and the one created by Siddheśvarī,

6.3.s:
gopeśaṃ kapileśaṃ ca vaidyanāthamanuttamam .
piṅgaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca saindhavāyatanaṃ mahat .. 230.86 ..
6.3.d:
गोपेशं कपिलेशं च वैद्यनाथमनुत्तमम् .
पिङ्गलेश्वरतीर्थं च सैन्धवायतनं महत् .. 230.86 ..
6.3.m: Gopeśa, Kapileśa, and unsurpassed Vaidyanātha, / the Piṅgaleśvara sacred ford, and the great Saindhavāyatana,

6.3.s:
bhūtīśvarāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ gaṅgāvāhamataḥ param .
gautameśvaratīrthaṃ ca daśāśvamedhikaṃ tathā .. 230.87 ..
6.3.d:
भूतीश्वराह्वयं तीर्थं गङ्गावाहमतः परम् .
गौतमेश्वरतीर्थं च दशाश्वमेधिकं तथा .. 230.87 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Bhūtīśvara, and thereafter Gaṅgāvāha, / the Gautameśvara sacred ford, and likewise Daśāśvamedhika,

6.3.s:
bhṛgutīrthaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ khyātā saubhāgyasundarī .
vṛṣakhātaṃ ca tatraiva kedāraṃ dhūtapātakam .. 230.88 ..
6.3.d:
भृगुतीर्थं तथा पुण्यं ख्याता सौभाग्यसुन्दरी .
वृषखातं च तत्रैव केदारं धूतपातकम् .. 230.88 ..
6.3.m: likewise holy Bhṛgutīrtha, the famed Saubhāgyasundarī, / Vṛṣakhāta right there, and Kedāra that cleanses sins,

6.3.s:
tīrthaṃ dhūteśvarīsaṅgameraṇḍīsaṃjñakaṃ tathā .
tīrthaṃ ca kanakeśvaryā jvāleśvaraṃ tataḥ param .. 230.89 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थं धूतेश्वरीसङ्गमेरण्डीसंज्ञकं तथा .
तीर्थं च कनकेश्वर्या ज्वालेश्वरं ततः परम् .. 230.89 ..
6.3.m: the Dhūteśvarīsaṅga sacred ford, likewise that named Eraṇḍī, / the sacred ford of Kanakeśvarī, and thereafter Jvāleśvara,

6.3.s:
śālagrāmāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ somanāthamanuttamam .
tathaivodīrṇavārāhaṃ tīrthaṃ candraprabhāsakam .. 230.90 ..
6.3.d:
शालग्रामाह्वयं तीर्थं सोमनाथमनुत्तमम् .
तथैवोदीर्णवाराहं तीर्थं चन्द्रप्रभासकम् .. 230.90 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Śālagrāma, unsurpassed Somanātha, / likewise Udīrṇavārāha, and the Candraprabhāsa sacred ford,

6.3.s:
dvādaśādityatīrthaṃ ca tathā siddheśvarābhidham .
kapileśvaratīrthaṃ ca tathā traivikramaṃ śubham .. 230.91 ..
6.3.d:
द्वादशादित्यतीर्थं च तथा सिद्धेश्वराभिधम् .
कपिलेश्वरतीर्थं च तथा त्रैविक्रमं शुभम् .. 230.91 ..
6.3.m: Dvādaśādityatīrtha, and likewise that called Siddheśvara, / Kapileśvaratīrtha, and likewise auspicious Traivikrama,

6.3.s:
viśvarūpāhvayaṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇakṛtaṃ tathā .
mūlaśrīpatitīrthaṃ ca caulaśrīpatisaṃjñakam .. 230.92 ..
6.3.d:
विश्वरूपाह्वयं तीर्थं नारायणकृतं तथा .
मूलश्रीपतितीर्थं च चौलश्रीपतिसंज्ञकम् .. 230.92 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Viśvarūpa, and that fashioned by Nārāyaṇa, / Mūlaśrīpatitīrtha, and that known as Caulaśrīpati,

6.3.s:
devatīrthaṃ haṃsatīrtha prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam .
mūlasthānaṃ ca kaṇṭheśamaṭṭahāsamataḥ param .. 230.93 ..
6.3.d:
देवतीर्थं हंसतीर्थ प्रभासं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .
मूलस्थानं च कण्ठेशमट्टहासमतः परम् .. 230.93 ..
6.3.m: Devatīrtha, Haṃsatīrtha, the supreme Prabhāsatīrtha, / Mūlasthāna, Kaṇṭheśa, and thereafter Aṭṭahāsa,

6.3.s:
bhūrbhuveśvaratīrthaṃ ca khyātā śūleśvarī tathā .
sārasvataṃ dārukeśamaśvinostīrthamuttamam .. 230.94 ..
6.3.d:
भूर्भुवेश्वरतीर्थं च ख्याता शूलेश्वरी तथा .
सारस्वतं दारुकेशमश्विनोस्तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 230.94 ..
6.3.m: the Bhūrbhuveśvara sacred ford, and the renowned Śūleśvarī, / Sārasvata, Dārukeśa, and the supreme sacred ford of the Aśvins,

6.3.s:
sāvitrītīrthamatulaṃ vālakhilyeśvaraṃ tathā .
narmadeśaṃ mātṛtīrthaṃ devatīrthamanuttamam .. 230.95 ..
6.3.d:
सावित्रीतीर्थमतुलं वालखिल्येश्वरं तथा .
नर्मदेशं मातृतीर्थं देवतीर्थमनुत्तमम् .. 230.95 ..
6.3.m: incomparable Sāvitrītīrtha, and likewise Vālakhilyeśvara, / Narmadeśa, Mātṛtīrtha, and unsurpassed Devatīrtha,

6.3.s:
macchakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca śikhitīrthaṃ ca śobhanam .
koṭitīrthaṃ muniśreṣṭhāstatra koṭīśvarī mṛḍā .. 230.96 ..
6.3.d:
मच्छकेश्वरतीर्थं च शिखितीर्थं च शोभनम् .
कोटितीर्थं मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तत्र कोटीश्वरी मृडा .. 230.96 ..
6.3.m: Macchakeśvaratīrtha, and beautiful Śikhitīrtha, / Koṭitīrtha, O best of sages, and there Koṭīśvarī Mṛḍā,

6.3.s:
tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ nāma māṇḍavye śvarasaṃjñitam .
tatra nārāyaṇeśaṃ ca akrūreśamataḥ param .. 230.97 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थं पैतामहं नाम माण्डव्ये श्वरसंज्ञितम् .
तत्र नारायणेशं च अक्रूरेशमतः परम् .. 230.97 ..
6.3.m: the sacred ford named Paitāmaha, known as Māṇḍavyeśvara, / there Nārāyaṇeśa, and thereafter Akrūreśa,

6.3.s:
devakhātaṃ siddharudraṃ vaidyanāthamanuttamam .
tathaiva mātṛtīrthaṃ ca uttareśamataḥ param .. 230.98 ..
6.3.d:
देवखातं सिद्धरुद्रं वैद्यनाथमनुत्तमम् .
तथैव मातृतीर्थं च उत्तरेशमतः परम् .. 230.98 ..
6.3.m: Devakhāta, Siddharudra, unsurpassed Vaidyanātha, / likewise Mātṛtīrtha, and thereafter Uttareśa,

6.3.s:
tathaiva narmadeśāṃ ca mātṛtīrthaṃ tathā punaḥ .
tathā ca kurarītīrthaṃ ḍhauṇḍheśaṃ daśakanyakam .. 230.99 ..
6.3.d:
तथैव नर्मदेशां च मातृतीर्थं तथा पुनः .
तथा च कुररीतीर्थं ढौण्ढेशं दशकन्यकम् .. 230.99 ..
6.3.m: likewise Narmadeśa, and then again Mātṛtīrtha, / and likewise Kurarītīrtha, Ḍhauṇḍheśa, and Daśakanyaka,

6.3.s:
suvarṇabindutīrthaṃ ca ṛṇapāpapramocanam .
bhārabhūteśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā muṇḍīśvaraṃ viduḥ .. 230.100 ..
6.3.d:
सुवर्णबिन्दुतीर्थं च ऋणपापप्रमोचनम् .
भारभूतेश्वरं तीर्थं तथा मुण्डीश्वरं विदुः .. 230.100 ..
6.3.m: Suvarṇabindutīrtha, which frees from debts and sins; / they know the sacred ford of Bhārabhūteśvara, and likewise Muṇḍīśvara,

6.3.s:
ekaśālaṃ ḍiṇḍipāṇiṃ tīrthaṃ cāpsarasaṃ param .
munyālayaṃ ca mārkaṇḍaṃ gaṇitādevatāhvayam .. 230.101 ..
6.3.d:
एकशालं डिण्डिपाणिं तीर्थं चाप्सरसं परम् .
मुन्यालयं च मार्कण्डं गणितादेवताह्वयम् .. 230.101 ..
6.3.m: Ekaśāla, Ḍiṇḍipāṇi, and the supreme sacred ford of the apsarases, / Munyālaya, Mārkaṇḍa, and the one named Gaṇitādevatā,

6.3.s:
āmaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ kantheśvaraṃ tathā .
āṣāḍhītīrthamityāhuḥ śṛṅgītīrthaṃ tathaiva ca .. 230.102 ..
6.3.d:
आमलेश्वरतीर्थं च तीर्थं कन्थेश्वरं तथा .
आषाढीतीर्थमित्याहुः शृङ्गीतीर्थं तथैव च .. 230.102 ..
6.3.m: the Āmaleśvara sacred ford, and likewise the Kantheśvara sacred ford; / they speak of Āṣāḍhītīrtha, and likewise Śṛṅgītīrtha,

6.3.s:
bakeśvaratīrthaṃ ca kapāleśaṃ tathaiva ca .
mārkaṇḍaṃ kapileśaṃ ca eraṇḍīsaṅgamastathā .. 230.103 ..
6.3.d:
बकेश्वरतीर्थं च कपालेशं तथैव च .
मार्कण्डं कपिलेशं च एरण्डीसङ्गमस्तथा .. 230.103 ..
6.3.m: the Bakeśvara sacred ford, and likewise Kapāleśa, / Mārkaṇḍa, Kapileśa, and the confluence of the Eraṇḍī,

6.3.s:
eraṇḍīdevatātīrthaṃ rāmatīrthamataḥparam .
jamadagneḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ .. 230.104 ..
6.3.d:
एरण्डीदेवतातीर्थं रामतीर्थमतःपरम् .
जमदग्नेः परं तीर्थं रेवासागरसङ्गमः .. 230.104 ..
6.3.m: the Eraṇḍīdevatā sacred ford, and thereafter Rāmatīrtha, / the supreme sacred ford of Jamadagni, and the confluence of Revā and the ocean,

6.3.s:
loṭaneśvaratīrtha talluṅkeśanāmakaṃ tathā .
vṛṣarakhātaṃ tatra kuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ṛṣisattamāḥ .. 230.105 ..
6.3.d:
लोटनेश्वरतीर्थ तल्लुङ्केशनामकं तथा .
वृषरखातं तत्र कुण्डं तथैव ऋषिसत्तमाः .. 230.105 ..
6.3.m: Loṭaneśvaratīrtha, and likewise that named Talluṅkeśa, / and right there the pool [named] Vṛṣarakhāta, O best of seers,

6.3.s:
tathā haṃseśvaraṃnāma tilādaṃ vāsaveśvaram .
tathā koṭīśvaraṃ tīrthamalikātīrthamuttamam .
vimaleśvaratīrthaṃ ca revāsāgarasaṅgame .. 230.106 ..
6.3.d:
तथा हंसेश्वरंनाम तिलादं वासवेश्वरम् .
तथा कोटीश्वरं तीर्थमलिकातीर्थमुत्तमम् .
विमलेश्वरतीर्थं च रेवासागरसङ्गमे .. 230.106 ..
6.3.m: likewise Haṃseśvara by name, Tilāda, Vāsaveśvara, / likewise the sacred ford Koṭīśvara, the supreme Alikātīrtha, / and Vimaleśvaratīrtha at the confluence of Revā and the ocean.

6.3.s:
evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā mayā proktā maharṣayaḥ .
tīrthasuktāvaliḥ puṇyā grathitā taṭarajjunā .. 230.107 ..
6.3.d:
एवं तीर्थावलिः पुण्या मया प्रोक्ता महर्षयः .
तीर्थसुक्तावलिः पुण्या ग्रथिता तटरज्जुना .. 230.107 ..
6.3.m: Thus the holy garland of sacred fords has been declared by me, O great seers, / a holy pearl-string of sacred fords strung with the cord of the [river's] bank,

6.3.s:
narmadānīranirṇiktā mārkaṇḍeyavinirmitā .
maṇḍanāyeha sādhūnāṃ sarvalokahitāya ca .. 230.108 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदानीरनिर्णिक्ता मार्कण्डेयविनिर्मिता .
मण्डनायेह साधूनां सर्वलोकहिताय च .. 230.108 ..
6.3.m: washed in the waters of Narmadā, composed by Mārkaṇḍeya, / for the adornment of virtuous people here and for the benefit of all the world.

6.3.s:
daritadhvāntaśamanīdhāryā dharmārthibhiḥ sadā .
ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sakṛjjaptvāśu nāśayet .. 230.109 ..
6.3.d:
दरितध्वान्तशमनीधार्या धर्मार्थिभिः सदा .
अहोरात्रकृतं पापं सकृज्जप्त्वाशु नाशयेत् .. 230.109 ..
6.3.m: Dispelling inner darkness, it should always be held by those who seek righteousness; / reciting it once, one quickly destroys the sin committed in a day and a night.

6.3.s:
trikālaṃ japtvā māsotthaṃ śivāgre ca trimāsikam .
māsaṃ japtvātha varṣotthaṃ varṣaṃ japtvā śatābdikam .. 230.110 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिकालं जप्त्वा मासोत्थं शिवाग्रे च त्रिमासिकम् .
मासं जप्त्वाथ वर्षोत्थं वर्षं जप्त्वा शताब्दिकम् .. 230.110 ..
6.3.m: Reciting it at the three junctures of the day, [one destroys] that of a month; in front of Śiva, that of three months; / reciting it for a month, that of a year; reciting it for a year, that of a hundred years.

6.3.s:
śrāddhakāle ca viprāṇāṃ bhuñjatāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ .
paṭhaṃstīrthāvaliṃ puṇyāṃ gayāśrāddhaprado bhavet .. 230.111 ..
6.3.d:
श्राद्धकाले च विप्राणां भुञ्जतां पुरतः स्थितः .
पठंस्तीर्थावलिं पुण्यां गयाश्राद्धप्रदो भवेत् .. 230.111 ..
6.3.m: Standing before brahmins while they eat at the time of a śrāddha, / reciting this holy garland of sacred fords, one becomes an offerer of a śrāddha at Gayā.

6.3.s:
pūjākāle ca devānāṃ śraddhayā purataḥ paṭhan .
prīṇayetsarvadevāṃśca punāti sakalaṃ kulam .. 230.112 ..
6.3.d:
पूजाकाले च देवानां श्रद्धया पुरतः पठन् .
प्रीणयेत्सर्वदेवांश्च पुनाति सकलं कुलम् .. 230.112 ..
6.3.m: Reciting it with faith before the gods at the time of worship, / one pleases all the gods and purifies one's entire lineage.

6.3.s:
evaṃ tīrthāvaliḥ puṇyā revātīradvayāśritā .
mayā proktā muniśreṣṭhāstathaivaśṛṇutānaghāḥ .. 230.113 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthāvalikathanaṃ triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
एवं तीर्थावलिः पुण्या रेवातीरद्वयाश्रिता .
मया प्रोक्ता मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथैवशृणुतानघाः .. 230.113 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थावलिकथनं त्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
Thus the auspicious garland of sacred fords situated on both banks of the Revā
has been proclaimed by me, O best of sages; listen further, O sinless ones! // 230.113
Thus ends the two hundred and thirtieth chapter, entitled 'Account of the Garland of Sacred Fords', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth, the Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
adhyāya 231
śrīsūta uvāca -
tathaiva tīrthastabakān vakṣye'hamṛṣisattamāḥ .
yaistu tīrthāvalīgumphaḥ pūrvoktairekataḥ kṛtaḥ .. 231.1 ..
6.3.d:
अध्याय 231
श्रीसूत उवाच -
तथैव तीर्थस्तबकान् वक्ष्येऽहमृषिसत्तमाः .
यैस्तु तीर्थावलीगुम्फः पूर्वोक्तैरेकतः कृतः .. 231.1 ..
6.3.m:
Chapter 231
Śrī Sūta said:
In that same way I shall speak of the clusters of sacred fords, O best of seers,
by which the garland of sacred fords mentioned before was strung together as one, // 231.1

6.3.s:
vibhakto bhaktalokānāmānandaprathanaḥ śubhaḥ .
mṛkaṇḍatanayaḥ pūrvaṃ prāha pārthāya pṛcchate .. 231.2 ..
6.3.d:
विभक्तो भक्तलोकानामानन्दप्रथनः शुभः .
मृकण्डतनयः पूर्वं प्राह पार्थाय पृच्छते .. 231.2 ..
6.3.m:
divided [into groups], increasing the joy of devotees, auspicious.
Formerly, the son of Mṛkaṇḍu told it to the son of Pṛthā when he asked, // 231.2

6.3.s:
yathā tathāhaṃ vakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ stabakāniha .
śivāmbupānajā puṇyā revā kalpalatā kila .. 231.3 ..
6.3.d:
यथा तथाहं वक्ष्यामि तीर्थानां स्तबकानिह .
शिवाम्बुपानजा पुण्या रेवा कल्पलता किल .. 231.3 ..
6.3.m:
just as I shall declare the clusters of sacred fords here.
The holy Revā, arisen from the drinking of the water of Śiva, is indeed a wish-granting vine, // 231.3

6.3.s:
tīradvayodbhūtatīrthaprasūnaiḥ puṣpitā śubhā .
yatpuṇyagandhalakṣmyā vai trailokyaṃ surabhīkṛtam .. 231.4 ..
6.3.d:
तीरद्वयोद्भूततीर्थप्रसूनैः पुष्पिता शुभा .
यत्पुण्यगन्धलक्ष्म्या वै त्रैलोक्यं सुरभीकृतम् .. 231.4 ..
6.3.m:
flowering with the blossom-like sacred fords produced on both its banks, auspicious,
by the beauty of whose holy fragrance the three worlds are perfumed. // 231.4

6.3.s:
tatpuṣpamakarandasya rasāsvādaviduttamaḥ .
bhramaraḥ khalu mārkaṇḍo munirmatimatāṃ varaḥ .. 231.5 ..
6.3.d:
तत्पुष्पमकरन्दस्य रसास्वादविदुत्तमः .
भ्रमरः खलु मार्कण्डो मुनिर्मतिमतां वरः .. 231.5 ..
6.3.m:
A bee enjoying the taste of the nectar of those flowers,
the sage Mārkaṇḍa is indeed the best among the intelligent. // 231.5

6.3.s:
tatpuṣpamālāṃ hṛdaye tīrthastabakacitritām .
dadhāti satataṃ puṇyāṃ munirbhṛgukulodvahaḥ .
tasyāḥ stabakasaṃsthānaṃ vakṣye'hamṛṣisattamāḥ .. 231.6 ..
6.3.d:
तत्पुष्पमालां हृदये तीर्थस्तबकचित्रिताम् .
दधाति सततं पुण्यां मुनिर्भृगुकुलोद्वहः .
तस्याः स्तबकसंस्थानं वक्ष्येऽहमृषिसत्तमाः .. 231.6 ..
6.3.m:
The sage, the uplifter of Bhṛgu’s lineage, constantly wears on his heart
that holy garland of flowers, patterned with clusters of sacred fords.
I shall describe its arrangement of clusters, O best of seers! // 231.6

6.3.s:
oṅkāratīrthamārabhya yāvatpaścimasāgaram .
saṃgamāḥ pañcatriṃśadvai nadīnāṃ pāpanāśanāḥ .. 231.7 ..
6.3.d:
ओङ्कारतीर्थमारभ्य यावत्पश्चिमसागरम् .
संगमाः पञ्चत्रिंशद्वै नदीनां पापनाशनाः .. 231.7 ..
6.3.m:
Beginning from the Oṅkāra sacred ford as far as the western sea,
there are thirty-five confluences of rivers that destroy sins: // 231.7

6.3.s:
daśaikamuttare tīre satriviṃśati dakṣiṇe .
pañcatriṃśattamaḥ śreṣṭho revāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ .. 231.8 ..
6.3.d:
दशैकमुत्तरे तीरे सत्रिविंशति दक्षिणे .
पञ्चत्रिंशत्तमः श्रेष्ठो रेवासागरसङ्गमः .. 231.8 ..
6.3.m:
eleven on the northern bank, and twenty-three on the southern bank;
the thirty-fifth and foremost is the confluence of the Revā and the ocean. // 231.8

6.3.s:
saṅgamaḥ sahitānyevaṃ revātīradvaye'pi ca .
catuḥśatāni tīrthāni prasiddhāni dvijottamāḥ .. 231.9 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमः सहितान्येवं रेवातीरद्वयेऽपि च .
चतुःशतानि तीर्थानि प्रसिद्धानि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 231.9 ..
6.3.m:
Together with the confluences, on both banks of the Revā
there are four hundred renowned sacred fords, O best of twice-born! // 231.9

6.3.s:
triśataṃ śivatīrthāni trayīstriṃśatsamanvitam .
tatrāpi vyaktito vakṣye śṛṇudhvaṃ tāni sattamāḥ .. 231.10 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिशतं शिवतीर्थानि त्रयीस्त्रिंशत्समन्वितम् .
तत्रापि व्यक्तितो वक्ष्ये शृणुध्वं तानि सत्तमाः .. 231.10 ..
6.3.m:
Three hundred and thirty-three are sacred fords belonging to Śiva.
There also I shall describe them individually; hear them, O good ones! // 231.10

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeśvaratīrthāni daśa teṣu munīśvarāḥ .
daśādityabhavānyatra navaiva kapileśvarāḥ .. 231.11 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेश्वरतीर्थानि दश तेषु मुनीश्वराः .
दशादित्यभवान्यत्र नवैव कपिलेश्वराः .. 231.11 ..
6.3.m:
Among them, there are ten Mārkaṇḍeśvara sacred fords, O lords of sages,
ten originating from the sun, and nine Kapileśvara sacred fords; // 231.11

6.3.s:
somasaṃsthāpitānyaṣṭau tāvanto narmadeśvarāḥ .
koṭitīrthānyathāṣṭau ca sapta siddheśvarāstathā .. 231.12 ..
6.3.d:
सोमसंस्थापितान्यष्टौ तावन्तो नर्मदेश्वराः .
कोटितीर्थान्यथाष्टौ च सप्त सिद्धेश्वरास्तथा .. 231.12 ..
6.3.m:
eight established by Soma, as many Narmadeśvara sacred fords,
eight Koṭitīrthas, and likewise seven Siddheśvara sacred fords; // 231.12

6.3.s:
nāgeśvarāśca saptaiva revātīradvaye'pi tu .
saptaiva vahnivihitānyathāpyāvartasaptakam .. 231.13 ..
6.3.d:
नागेश्वराश्च सप्तैव रेवातीरद्वयेऽपि तु .
सप्तैव वह्निविहितान्यथाप्यावर्तसप्तकम् .. 231.13 ..
6.3.m:
seven Nāgeśvara sacred fords on both banks of the Revā,
seven established by Agni, and also a heptad of whirlpools; // 231.13

6.3.s:
kedāreśvaratīrthāni pañca pañcendrajāni ca .
varuṇeśāśca pañcaiva pañcaiva dhanadeśvarāḥ .. 231.14 ..
6.3.d:
केदारेश्वरतीर्थानि पञ्च पञ्चेन्द्रजानि च .
वरुणेशाश्च पञ्चैव पञ्चैव धनदेश्वराः .. 231.14 ..
6.3.m:
five Kedāreśvara sacred fords, and five born of Indra,
five Varuṇeśas, and five Dhanadeśvaras; // 231.14

6.3.s:
devatīrthāni pañcaiva catvāro vai yameśvarāḥ .
vaidyanāthāśca catvāraścatvāro vānareśvarāḥ .. 231.15 ..
6.3.d:
देवतीर्थानि पञ्चैव चत्वारो वै यमेश्वराः .
वैद्यनाथाश्च चत्वारश्चत्वारो वानरेश्वराः .. 231.15 ..
6.3.m:
five Devatīrthas, four Yameśvaras,
four Vaidyanāthas, and four Vānareśvaras; // 231.15

6.3.s:
aṅgāreśvaratīrthāni tāvantyeva munīśvarāḥ .
sārasvatāni catvāri catvāro dārukeśvarāḥ .. 231.16 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गारेश्वरतीर्थानि तावन्त्येव मुनीश्वराः .
सारस्वतानि चत्वारि चत्वारो दारुकेश्वराः .. 231.16 ..
6.3.m:
just as many Aṅgāreśvara sacred fords, O lords of sages,
four Sārasvatas, and four Dārukeśvaras; // 231.16

6.3.s:
gautameśvaratīrthāni trīṇi rāmeśvarāstrayaḥ .
kapāleśvaratīrthāni trīṇi haṃsakṛtāni ca .. 231.17 ..
6.3.d:
गौतमेश्वरतीर्थानि त्रीणि रामेश्वरास्त्रयः .
कपालेश्वरतीर्थानि त्रीणि हंसकृतानि च .. 231.17 ..
6.3.m:
three Gautameśvara sacred fords, three Rāmeśvaras,
three Kapāleśvara sacred fords, and three made by Haṃsa; // 231.17

6.3.s:
trīṇyeva mokṣatīrthāni trayo vai vimaleśvarāḥ .
sahasrayajñatīrthāni trīṇyeva munirabravīt .. 231.18 ..
6.3.d:
त्रीण्येव मोक्षतीर्थानि त्रयो वै विमलेश्वराः .
सहस्रयज्ञतीर्थानि त्रीण्येव मुनिरब्रवीत् .. 231.18 ..
6.3.m:
three Mokṣatīrthas, three Vimaleśvaras,
and three Sahasrayajña sacred fords, the sage said; // 231.18

6.3.s:
bhīmeśvarāstrayaḥ khyātāḥ svarṇatīrthāni trīṇi ca .
dhautapāpadvayaṃ proktaṃ karañjeśadvayaṃ tathā .. 231.19 ..
6.3.d:
भीमेश्वरास्त्रयः ख्याताः स्वर्णतीर्थानि त्रीणि च .
धौतपापद्वयं प्रोक्तं करञ्जेशद्वयं तथा .. 231.19 ..
6.3.m:
three are known as Bhīmeśvaras, and three Svarṇatīrthas;
two Dhautapāpa sacred fords are declared, and likewise two Karañjeśas; // 231.19

6.3.s:
ṛṇamocanatīrthe dve tathā skandeśvaradvayam .
daśāśvamedhatīrthe dve nandītīrthadvayaṃ dvijāḥ .. 231.20 ..
6.3.d:
ऋणमोचनतीर्थे द्वे तथा स्कन्देश्वरद्वयम् .
दशाश्वमेधतीर्थे द्वे नन्दीतीर्थद्वयं द्विजाः .. 231.20 ..
6.3.m:
two Ṛṇamocana sacred fords, and two Skandeśvaras;
two Daśāśvamedha sacred fords, and two Nandītīrthas, O twice-born; // 231.20

6.3.s:
manmatheśadvayaṃ caiva bhṛgutīrthadvayaṃ tathā .
parāśareśvarau dvau ca ayonīsaṃbhavadvayam .. 231.21 ..
6.3.d:
मन्मथेशद्वयं चैव भृगुतीर्थद्वयं तथा .
पराशरेश्वरौ द्वौ च अयोनीसंभवद्वयम् .. 231.21 ..
6.3.m:
two Manmatheśas, and two Bhṛgutīrthas;
two Parāśareśvaras, and two Ayonisaṃbhavas; // 231.21

6.3.s:
vyāseśvaradvayaṃ proktaṃ pitṛtīrthadvayaṃ tathā .
nandikeśvaratīrthe dve dvau ca gopeśvarau smṛtau .. 231.22 ..
6.3.d:
व्यासेश्वरद्वयं प्रोक्तं पितृतीर्थद्वयं तथा .
नन्दिकेश्वरतीर्थे द्वे द्वौ च गोपेश्वरौ स्मृतौ .. 231.22 ..
6.3.m:
two Vyāseśvaras are declared, and two Pitṛtīrthas;
two Nandikeśvara sacred fords, and two remembered as Gopeśvaras; // 231.22

6.3.s:
māruteśadvayaṃ tadvaddvau ca jvāleśvarau smṛtau .
śuklatīrthadvayaṃ puṇyamapsareśadvayaṃ tathā .. 231.23 ..
6.3.d:
मारुतेशद्वयं तद्वद्द्वौ च ज्वालेश्वरौ स्मृतौ .
शुक्लतीर्थद्वयं पुण्यमप्सरेशद्वयं तथा .. 231.23 ..
6.3.m:
likewise two Māruteśas, and two remembered as Jvāleśvaras;
two holy Śuklatīrthas, and two Apsareśas; // 231.23

6.3.s:
pippaleśvaratīrthe dve māṇḍavyeśvarasaṃjñite .
dvīpeśvaradvayaṃ caiva prāha tadvadbhṛgūdvahaḥ .
uttareśvaratīrthe dve aśokeśadvayī tathā .. 231.24 ..
6.3.d:
पिप्पलेश्वरतीर्थे द्वे माण्डव्येश्वरसंज्ञिते .
द्वीपेश्वरद्वयं चैव प्राह तद्वद्भृगूद्वहः .
उत्तरेश्वरतीर्थे द्वे अशोकेशद्वयी तथा .. 231.24 ..

6.3.s:
dve yodhanapure caiva rohiṇītīrthakadvayam .
luṅkeśvaradvayaṃ khyātamākhyānaṃ muninā tathā .. 231.25 ..
6.3.d:
द्वे योधनपुरे चैव रोहिणीतीर्थकद्वयम् .
लुङ्केश्वरद्वयं ख्यातमाख्यानं मुनिना तथा .. 231.25 ..
6.3.m:
two in Yodhanapura, and a pair of Rohiṇītīrthas;
two Luṅkeśvaras are famed, so the sage related; // 231.25

6.3.s:
saikonaviṃśatiśataṃ tīrthānyekaikaśo dvijāḥ .
stabakeṣu kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ dviśataṃ sacaturdaśam .. 231.26 ..
6.3.d:
सैकोनविंशतिशतं तीर्थान्येकैकशो द्विजाः .
स्तबकेषु कृतं तीर्थं द्विशतं सचतुर्दशम् .. 231.26 ..
6.3.m:
one hundred and nineteen sacred fords [stand] singly, O twice-born;
the sacred fords gathered in clusters amount to two hundred and fourteen. // 231.26

6.3.s:
śaivānyetāni tīrthāni vaiṣṇavāni ca sattamāḥ .
śṛṇudhvaṃ procyamānāni brāhmaśāktāni ca kramāt .. 231.27 ..
6.3.d:
शैवान्येतानि तीर्थानि वैष्णवानि च सत्तमाः .
शृणुध्वं प्रोच्यमानानि ब्राह्मशाक्तानि च क्रमात् .. 231.27 ..
6.3.m:
These are the Śaiva sacred fords; now hear the Vaiṣṇava ones being spoken of,
O good ones, and also the Brāhma and Śākta ones in sequence! // 231.27

6.3.s:
aṣṭaviṃśatitīrthāni vaiṣṇavānyabravīnmuniḥ .
teṣu vārāhatīrthāni ṣaḍeva munisattamāḥ .. 231.28 ..
6.3.d:
अष्टविंशतितीर्थानि वैष्णवान्यब्रवीन्मुनिः .
तेषु वाराहतीर्थानि षडेव मुनिसत्तमाः .. 231.28 ..
6.3.m:
The sage mentioned twenty-eight Vaiṣṇava sacred fords;
among them, six are Vārāha sacred fords, O best of sages; // 231.28

6.3.s:
catvāri cakratīrthāni śeṣāṇyaṣṭādaśaiva hi .
viṣṇunādhiṣṭhitānyeva prāha pūrvaṃ mṛkaṇḍajaḥ .. 231.29 ..
6.3.d:
चत्वारि चक्रतीर्थानि शेषाण्यष्टादशैव हि .
विष्णुनाधिष्ठितान्येव प्राह पूर्वं मृकण्डजः .. 231.29 ..
6.3.m:
four are Cakratīrthas, and the remaining eighteen are indeed
presided over by Viṣṇu, as Mṛkaṇḍu's son declared long ago. // 231.29

6.3.s:
tathaiva brahmaṇā siddhyai saptatīrthānyavīvadat .
triṣu ca brahmaṇaḥ pūjā brahmeśāścaturo'pare .
aṣṭāviṃśanmayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam .. 231.30 ..
6.3.d:
तथैव ब्रह्मणा सिद्ध्यै सप्ततीर्थान्यवीवदत् .
त्रिषु च ब्रह्मणः पूजा ब्रह्मेशाश्चतुरोऽपरे .
अष्टाविंशन्मया ख्याता यथासङ्ख्यं यथाक्रमम् .. 231.30 ..

6.3.s:
etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetatpāpaharaṃ param .
narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam .. 231.31 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्पवित्रमतुलं ह्येतत्पापहरं परम् .
नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं माहात्म्यं मुनिभाषितम् .. 231.31 ..
6.3.m:
This is incomparable purity; this destroys the greatest sins,
the sacred deeds and māhātmya of the Narmadā, spoken by the sage. // 231.31

6.3.s:
sūta uvāca -
evamuddeśataḥ prokto revātīrthakramo mayā .
yathā pārthāya saṃkṣepānmārkaṇḍo munirabravīt .. 231.32 ..
6.3.d:
सूत उवाच -
एवमुद्देशतः प्रोक्तो रेवातीर्थक्रमो मया .
यथा पार्थाय संक्षेपान्मार्कण्डो मुनिरब्रवीत् .. 231.32 ..
6.3.m:
Sūta said:
Thus has the sequence of Revā’s sacred fords been spoken by me by way of indication,
just as the sage Mārkaṇḍa told it in brief to the son of Pṛthā. // 231.32

6.3.s:
avāntarāṇi tīrthāni teṣu guptānyanekaśaḥ .
yatra yāvatpramāṇāni tānyākarṇayatānaghāḥ .. 231.33 ..
6.3.d:
अवान्तराणि तीर्थानि तेषु गुप्तान्यनेकशः .
यत्र यावत्प्रमाणानि तान्याकर्णयतानघाः .. 231.33 ..
6.3.m:
There are many hidden intermediate sacred fords within them;
hear, O sinless ones, how many there are and where: // 231.33

6.3.s:
oṅkāratīrthaparitaḥ parvatādamarakaṇṭāt .
krośadvaye sarvadikṣu sārdhakoṭītrayī matā .. 231.34 ..
6.3.d:
ओङ्कारतीर्थपरितः पर्वतादमरकण्टात् .
क्रोशद्वये सर्वदिक्षु सार्धकोटीत्रयी मता .. 231.34 ..
6.3.m:
Around Oṅkāra sacred ford from Mount Amarakaṇṭa,
within two krośas in all directions, thirty-five million are considered to be present, // 231.34

6.3.s:
tīrthānāṃ saṃkhyayā guptaprakaṭānāṃ dvijottamāḥ .
koṭirekā tu tīrthānāṃ kapilāsaṅgame pṛthak .. 231.35 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थानां संख्यया गुप्तप्रकटानां द्विजोत्तमाः .
कोटिरेका तु तीर्थानां कपिलासङ्गमे पृथक् .. 231.35 ..
6.3.m:
by count of hidden and manifest sacred fords, O best of twice-born.
One crore of sacred fords, however, is distinct at the confluence of the Kapilā; // 231.35

6.3.s:
aśokavanikāyāśca tīrthaṃ lakṣaṃ pratiṣṭhitam .
śatamaṃ gāragartāyāḥ saṅgame munisattamāḥ .. 231.36 ..
6.3.d:
अशोकवनिकायाश्च तीर्थं लक्षं प्रतिष्ठितम् .
शतमं गारगर्तायाः सङ्गमे मुनिसत्तमाः .. 231.36 ..
6.3.m:
and one hundred thousand sacred fords are established at Aśokavanikā;
one hundred at the confluence of the Gāragartā, O best of sages; // 231.36

6.3.s:
tīrthānāmayutaṃ tadvatkubjāyāḥ saṅgame sthitam .
śataṃ hiraṇyagarbhāyāḥ saṅgame samavasthitam .. 231.37 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थानामयुतं तद्वत्कुब्जायाः सङ्गमे स्थितम् .
शतं हिरण्यगर्भायाः सङ्गमे समवस्थितम् .. 231.37 ..
6.3.m:
likewise ten thousand sacred fords are situated at the confluence of the Kubjā;
one hundred are situated at the confluence of the Hiraṇyagarbhā; // 231.37

6.3.s:
tīrthānāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca viśokāsaṅgame sthitā .
tathā sahasraṃ tīrthānāṃ saṃsthitaṃ vāgusaṅgame .. 231.38 ..
6.3.d:
तीर्थानामष्टषष्टिश्च विशोकासङ्गमे स्थिता .
तथा सहस्रं तीर्थानां संस्थितं वागुसङ्गमे .. 231.38 ..
6.3.m:
sixty-eight sacred fords are situated at the confluence of the Viśokā;
likewise one thousand sacred fords reside at the confluence of the Vāgu; // 231.38

6.3.s:
śataṃ sarasvatīsaṅge śuklatīrthe śatadvayam .
sahasraṃ viṣṇutīrtheṣu mahiṣmatyāmathāyutam .. 231.39 ..
6.3.d:
शतं सरस्वतीसङ्गे शुक्लतीर्थे शतद्वयम् .
सहस्रं विष्णुतीर्थेषु महिष्मत्यामथायुतम् .. 231.39 ..
6.3.m:
one hundred at the confluence of the Sarasvatī; two hundred at Śuklatīrtha;
one thousand among the sacred fords of Viṣṇu, and ten thousand at Māhiṣmatī. // 231.39

6.3.s:
śūlabhede ca tīrthānāṃ sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ sthitaṃ dvijāḥ .
devagrāme sahasraṃ ca tīrthānāṃ munirabravīt .. 231.40 ..
6.3.d:
शूलभेदे च तीर्थानां साग्रं लक्षं स्थितं द्विजाः .
देवग्रामे सहस्रं च तीर्थानां मुनिरब्रवीत् .. 231.40 ..
6.3.m: And at Śūlabheda, O brahmins, reside more than one hundred thousand sacred fords; / and at Devagrāma reside one thousand sacred fords, so the sage declared.

6.3.s:
luṅkeśvare ca tīrthānāṃ sāgrā saptaśatī sthitā .
tīrthānyaṣṭottaraśataṃ maṇinadyāśca saṅgame .
vaidyanāthe ca tīrthānāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ viduḥ .. 231.41 ..
6.3.d:
लुङ्केश्वरे च तीर्थानां साग्रा सप्तशती स्थिता .
तीर्थान्यष्टोत्तरशतं मणिनद्याश्च सङ्गमे .
वैद्यनाथे च तीर्थानां शतमष्टाधिकं विदुः .. 231.41 ..
6.3.m: At Luṅkeśvara reside more than seven hundred sacred fords; / one hundred and eight sacred fords are at the confluence of the Maṇinadī; / and at Vaidyanātha they know of one hundred and eight sacred fords.

6.3.s:
evaṃ tāvatpramāṇāni tīrthe kumbheśvare dvijāḥ .
sāgraṃ lakṣaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitaṃ revorasaṅgame .. 231.42 ..
6.3.d:
एवं तावत्प्रमाणानि तीर्थे कुम्भेश्वरे द्विजाः .
साग्रं लक्षं च तीर्थानां स्थितं रेवोरसङ्गमे .. 231.42 ..
6.3.m: So many are the sacred fords at the Kumbheśvara ford, O brahmins; / and more than one hundred thousand sacred fords reside at the confluence of the Revā and the Uras.

6.3.s:
tataścāpyadhikāni syuriti mārkaṇḍabhāṣitam .
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi vyāsadvīpāśritāni ca .. 231.43 ..
6.3.d:
ततश्चाप्यधिकानि स्युरिति मार्कण्डभाषितम् .
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि व्यासद्वीपाश्रितानि च .. 231.43 ..
6.3.m: And they may be even more than that—thus spoke Mārkaṇḍeya. / Eighty-eight thousand are situated at Vyāsadvīpa.

6.3.s:
saṅgame ca karañjāyāḥ sthitamaṣṭottarāyutam .
eraṇḍīsaṅgame tadvattīrthānyaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam .. 231.44 ..
6.3.d:
सङ्गमे च करञ्जायाः स्थितमष्टोत्तरायुतम् .
एरण्डीसङ्गमे तद्वत्तीर्थान्यष्टाधिकं शतम् .. 231.44 ..
6.3.m: And at the confluence of the Karañjā reside ten thousand and eight; / likewise at the confluence of the Eraṇḍī there are one hundred and eight sacred fords.

6.3.s:
dhūtapāpe ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā .
skandatīrthe śataṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthānāṃ muniruktavān .. 231.45 ..
6.3.d:
धूतपापे च तीर्थानां षष्टिरष्टाधिका स्थिता .
स्कन्दतीर्थे शतं पुण्यं तीर्थानां मुनिरुक्तवान् .. 231.45 ..
6.3.m: At Dhūtapāpa reside sixty-eight sacred fords; / at the Skandatīrtha, the sage declared, there are one hundred holy sacred fords.

6.3.s:
kohaneśa ca tīrthānāṃ ṣaṣṭiraṣṭādhikā sthitā .
sārdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ sthitā vai korilāpure .. 231.46 ..
6.3.d:
कोहनेश च तीर्थानां षष्टिरष्टाधिका स्थिता .
सार्धकोटी च तीर्थानां स्थिता वै कोरिलापुरे .. 231.46 ..
6.3.m: At Kohaneśa reside sixty-eight sacred fords; / and fifteen million sacred fords reside in Korilāpura.

6.3.s:
rāmakeśavatīrthe ca sahasraṃ sāgramuktavān .
asmāhake sahasraṃ ca tīrthāni nivasanti hi .. 231.47 ..
6.3.d:
रामकेशवतीर्थे च सहस्रं साग्रमुक्तवान् .
अस्माहके सहस्रं च तीर्थानि निवसन्ति हि .. 231.47 ..
6.3.m: At the Rāmakeśavatīrtha he declared more than one thousand; / and at Asmāhaka indeed dwell one thousand sacred fords.

6.3.s:
lakṣāṣṭakaṃ sahasre dve śuklatīrthe dvijottamāḥ .
tīrthāni kathayāmāsa purā pārthāya bhārgavaḥ .. 231.48 ..
6.3.d:
लक्षाष्टकं सहस्रे द्वे शुक्लतीर्थे द्विजोत्तमाः .
तीर्थानि कथयामास पुरा पार्थाय भार्गवः .. 231.48 ..
6.3.m: Eight hundred and two thousand sacred fords at Śuklatīrtha, O best of brahmins, / the descendant of Bhṛgu proclaimed to the son of Pṛthā in ancient times.

6.3.s:
śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ prāha pratyekaṃ saṅgameṣu ca .
nadīnāmavaśiṣṭānāṃ kāverīsaṅgamaṃ vinā .. 231.49 ..
6.3.d:
शतमष्टाधिकं प्राह प्रत्येकं सङ्गमेषु च .
नदीनामवशिष्टानां कावेरीसङ्गमं विना .. 231.49 ..
6.3.m: He spoke of one hundred and eight at each of the confluences / of the remaining rivers, except for the confluence of the Kāverī.

6.3.s:
kāveryāḥ saṅgame viprāḥ sthitā pañcaśatī tathā .
tīrthānāṃ parvasu tathā viśeṣo muninoditaḥ .. 231.50 ..
6.3.d:
कावेर्याः सङ्गमे विप्राः स्थिता पञ्चशती तथा .
तीर्थानां पर्वसु तथा विशेषो मुनिनोदितः .. 231.50 ..
6.3.m: At the confluence of the Kāverī, O brahmins, five hundred are situated; / likewise, the sage spoke of the special efficacy of the sacred fords on festival days.

6.3.s:
mokṣatīrthaṃ hi satprāhuḥ purāṇapuruṣāśritam .
bhṛgoḥ kṣetre ca tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā samāśritā .. 231.51 ..
6.3.d:
मोक्षतीर्थं हि सत्प्राहुः पुराणपुरुषाश्रितम् .
भृगोः क्षेत्रे च तीर्थानां कोटिरेका समाश्रिता .. 231.51 ..
6.3.m: The virtuous declare the Mokṣatīrtha to be presided over by the primordial Puruṣa; / and in the sacred field of Bhṛgu, ten million sacred fords have gathered.

6.3.s:
sādhikānāmṛṣiśreṣṭhā vaktuṃ śakto hi ko bhavet .
sarvāmarāśrayaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthāśrayaṃ tathā .. 231.52 ..
6.3.d:
साधिकानामृषिश्रेष्ठा वक्तुं शक्तो हि को भवेत् .
सर्वामराश्रयं प्रोक्तं सर्वतीर्थाश्रयं तथा .. 231.52 ..
6.3.m: Who indeed would be capable of describing those that exceed that number, O best of seers? / It is declared to be the refuge of all immortals, and the refuge of all sacred fords,

6.3.s:
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ pūjitaṃ siddhisādhanam .
bhārabhūtyāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ sthitamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam .. 231.53 ..
6.3.d:
त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं पूजितं सिद्धिसाधनम् .
भारभूत्यां च तीर्थानां स्थितमष्टोत्तरं शतम् .. 231.53 ..
6.3.m: renowned throughout the three worlds, worshipped, accomplishing all perfections. / And at Bhārabhūti reside one hundred and eight sacred fords.

6.3.s:
akrūreśvaratīrthe ca sārdhaṃ tīrthaśataṃ sthitam .
vimaleśvaratīrthe tu revāsāgarasaṅgame .
daśāyutāni tīrthānāṃ sādhikānyabravīnmuniḥ .. 231.54 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe tīrthasaṃkhyāparigaṇanavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
6.3.d:
अक्रूरेश्वरतीर्थे च सार्धं तीर्थशतं स्थितम् .
विमलेश्वरतीर्थे तु रेवासागरसङ्गमे .
दशायुतानि तीर्थानां साधिकान्यब्रवीन्मुनिः .. 231.54 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे तीर्थसंख्यापरिगणनवर्णनं नामैकत्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
6.3.m:
At the Akrūreśvaratīrtha reside one hundred and fifty sacred fords; / but at the Vimaleśvaratīrtha, at the confluence of the Revā and the ocean, / the sage declared more than one hundred thousand sacred fords.
Thus ends the two hundred thirty-first chapter, named 'Enumeration of the Number of Sacred Fords', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth, Āvantyakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

6.3.s:
sūta uvāca -
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ viprā revāmāhātmyamuttamam .
yathopadiṣṭaṃ pārthāya mārkaṇḍeyena vai purā .. 232.1 ..
6.3.d:
सूत उवाच -
इति वः कथितं विप्रा रेवामाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .
यथोपदिष्टं पार्थाय मार्कण्डेयेन वै पुरा .. 232.1 ..
6.3.m: Sūta said: / Thus has been told to you, O brahmins, the supreme Revāmāhātmya, / just as it was taught to the son of Pṛthā by Mārkaṇḍeya in ancient times.

6.3.s:
tathā tīrthakadambāśca teṣu tīrthaviśeṣataḥ .
prādhānyena mayā khyātā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ yathākramam .. 232.2 ..
6.3.d:
तथा तीर्थकदम्बाश्च तेषु तीर्थविशेषतः .
प्राधान्येन मया ख्याता यथासङ्ख्यं यथाक्रमम् .. 232.2 ..
6.3.m: Likewise the assemblages of sacred fords, and the distinct sacred fords among them, / have been declared by me in order of importance, by number and in succession.

6.3.s:
etatpavitramatulaṃ hyetatpāpaharaṃ param .
narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ munibhāṣitam .. 232.3 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्पवित्रमतुलं ह्येतत्पापहरं परम् .
नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं माहात्म्यं मुनिभाषितम् .. 232.3 ..
6.3.m: This is incomparable and purifying, indeed this is the supreme remover of sin: / the holy exploits of the Narmadā, the māhātmya spoken by the sage.

6.3.s:
saptakalpānugo vipro narmadāyāṃ munīśvarāḥ .
mṛkaṇḍatanayo dhīmānparamārthaviduttamaḥ .. 232.4 ..
6.3.d:
सप्तकल्पानुगो विप्रो नर्मदायां मुनीश्वराः .
मृकण्डतनयो धीमान्परमार्थविदुत्तमः .. 232.4 ..
6.3.m: The wise brahmin, the son of Mṛkaṇḍu, best among knowers of the ultimate truth, / who has survived through seven cosmic ages, [dwelling] on the Narmadā, O lords of sages,

6.3.s:
saṃsevya sarvatīrthāni nadīḥ sarvāśca vai purā .
bahukalpasmarāṃ revāmālakṣya śivadehajām .. 232.5 ..
6.3.d:
संसेव्य सर्वतीर्थानि नदीः सर्वाश्च वै पुरा .
बहुकल्पस्मरां रेवामालक्ष्य शिवदेहजाम् .. 232.5 ..
6.3.m: having served all sacred fords and all rivers in ancient times, / perceiving the Revā, born from Śiva's body, which remembers many cosmic ages,

6.3.s:
me kaleti ca śarvoktāṃ śaraṇaṃ śarvajāṃ yayau .
ajarāmamarāṃ devīṃ daityadhvaṃsakarīṃ parām .. 232.6 ..
6.3.d:
मे कलेति च शर्वोक्तां शरणं शर्वजां ययौ .
अजराममरां देवीं दैत्यध्वंसकरीं पराम् .. 232.6 ..
6.3.m: took refuge with her who was born from Śarva, declared by Śarva as 'She is my portion', / the goddess unaging, immortal, the destroyer of demons, the supreme,

6.3.s:
mahāvibhavasaṃyuktāṃ bhavaghnīṃ bhavajāhnavīm .
tasyāmābadhya satprema jātaḥ so'pyajarāmaraḥ .. 232.7 ..
6.3.d:
महाविभवसंयुक्तां भवघ्नीं भवजाह्नवीम् .
तस्यामाबध्य सत्प्रेम जातः सोऽप्यजरामरः .. 232.7 ..
6.3.m: endowed with great majesty, the destroyer of worldly existence, the river Gaṅgā born from Śiva; / having formed true love for her, he too became unaging and immortal.

6.3.s:
ṣaṣṭitīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭyaśca sattamāḥ .
vyavasthitāni revāyāstīrayugme pade pade .. 232.8 ..
6.3.d:
षष्टितीर्थसहस्राणि षष्टिकोट्यश्च सत्तमाः .
व्यवस्थितानि रेवायास्तीरयुग्मे पदे पदे .. 232.8 ..
6.3.m: Sixty thousand and six hundred million sacred fords, O best of men, / are established at every step along the two banks of the Revā.

6.3.s:
sāritaḥ paritaḥ santi satīrthāstu sahasraśaḥ .
na tulāṃ yānti revāyāstāśca manye munīśvarāḥ .. 232.9 ..
6.3.d:
सारितः परितः सन्ति सतीर्थास्तु सहस्रशः .
न तुलां यान्ति रेवायास्ताश्च मन्ये मुनीश्वराः .. 232.9 ..
6.3.m: There are thousands of rivers all around possessing sacred fords; / yet none of them equals the Revā, I believe, O lords of sages.

6.3.s:
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭamakhilaṃ dvijāḥ .
yanmaheśamukhācchrutvā vāyurāha ṛṣīnprati .. 232.10 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं यत्पृष्टमखिलं द्विजाः .
यन्महेशमुखाच्छ्रुत्वा वायुराह ऋषीन्प्रति .. 232.10 ..
6.3.m: All this has been told to you, all that was asked, O brahmins, / which Vāyu, having heard from the mouth of Maheśa, spoke to the seers.

6.3.s:
tadvanmṛkaṇḍatanayo'pyanubhūyākhilāṃ nadīm .
satīrthāṃ padaśaḥ prāha pāṇḍuputrāya pāvanīm .. 232.11 ..
6.3.d:
तद्वन्मृकण्डतनयोऽप्यनुभूयाखिलां नदीम् .
सतीर्थां पदशः प्राह पाण्डुपुत्राय पावनीम् .. 232.11 ..
6.3.m: Just so the son of Mṛkaṇḍu, having experienced the entire river / along with its sacred fords step by step, proclaimed the purifier to the son of Pāṇḍu.

6.3.s:
etacca kathitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa dvijottamāḥ .
narmadācaritaṃ puṇyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham .. 232.12 ..
6.3.d:
एतच्च कथितं सर्वं संक्षेपेण द्विजोत्तमाः .
नर्मदाचरितं पुण्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्लभम् .. 232.12 ..
6.3.m: And all this has been declared in brief, O best of brahmins, / the holy exploits of the Narmadā, difficult to attain in the three worlds.

6.3.s:
kimanyaiḥ saritāṃ toyaiḥ sevitaistu sahasraśaḥ .
yadi saṃsevyate toyaṃ revāyāḥ pāpanāśanam .. 232.13 ..
6.3.d:
किमन्यैः सरितां तोयैः सेवितैस्तु सहस्रशः .
यदि संसेव्यते तोयं रेवायाः पापनाशनम् .. 232.13 ..
6.3.m: What need of the waters of other rivers, though visited in thousands, / if the sin-destroying water of the Revā is resorted to?

6.3.s: mekalājalasaṃsevī muktimāpnoti śāśvatīm .. 232.14 ..
6.3.d: मेकलाजलसंसेवी मुक्तिमाप्नोति शाश्वतीम् .. 232.14 ..
6.3.m: One who resorts to the waters of the daughter of the Mekala mountain attains everlasting liberation.

6.3.s:
yathā yathā bhajenmartyo yadyadicchati tīrthagaḥ .
tattadāpnoti niyataṃ śraddhayāśraddhayāpi ca .. 232.15 ..
6.3.d:
यथा यथा भजेन्मर्त्यो यद्यदिच्छति तीर्थगः .
तत्तदाप्नोति नियतं श्रद्धयाश्रद्धयापि च .. 232.15 ..
6.3.m: In whatever manner a mortal worships, whatever a pilgrim desires, / that indeed he unfailingly obtains, whether with faith or even without faith.

6.3.s:
idaṃ brahmā hariridamidaṃ sākṣātparo haraḥ .
idaṃ brahma nirākāraṃ kaivalyaṃ narmadājalam .. 232.16 ..
6.3.d:
इदं ब्रह्मा हरिरिदमिदं साक्षात्परो हरः .
इदं ब्रह्म निराकारं कैवल्यं नर्मदाजलम् .. 232.16 ..
6.3.m: This is Brahmā, this is Hari, this is visibly the supreme Hara; / this water of the Narmadā is the formless Brahman, absolute liberation.

6.3.s:
tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni nadyo hṛdayaphalapradāḥ .
yāvanna smaryate revā sevāhevā kalau naraiḥ .. 232.17 ..
6.3.d:
तावद्गर्जन्ति तीर्थानि नद्यो हृदयफलप्रदाः .
यावन्न स्मर्यते रेवा सेवाहेवा कलौ नरैः .. 232.17 ..
6.3.m: Sacred fords and rivers granting the heart's fruit roar [in pride] only so long / as men in the Kali age do not remember the Revā with the desire to worship her.

6.3.s:
dhruvaṃ loke hitārthāya śivena svaśarīrataḥ .
śaktiḥ kāpi saridrūpā reveyamavatāritā .. 232.18 ..
6.3.d:
ध्रुवं लोके हितार्थाय शिवेन स्वशरीरतः .
शक्तिः कापि सरिद्रूपा रेवेयमवतारिता .. 232.18 ..
6.3.m: Surely, for the welfare of the world, Śiva brought down from his own body / an extraordinary power in the form of a river, which is this Revā.

6.3.s:
tāvadgarjanti yajñāśca vanakṣetrādayo bhṛśam .
yāvanna narmadānāmakīrtanaṃ kriyate kalau .. 232.19 ..
6.3.d:
तावद्गर्जन्ति यज्ञाश्च वनक्षेत्रादयो भृशम् .
यावन्न नर्मदानामकीर्तनं क्रियते कलौ .. 232.19 ..
6.3.m: Sacrifices, sacred forests, fields, and the like roar mightily only so long / as the chanting of the name of the Narmadā is not performed in the Kali age.

6.3.s:
garimā gāṇyate tāvattapodānavratādiṣu .
narairvā prāpyate yāvadbhuvi bhargabhavā dhunī .. 232.20 ..
6.3.d:
गरिमा गाण्यते तावत्तपोदानव्रतादिषु .
नरैर्वा प्राप्यते यावद्भुवि भर्गभवा धुनी .. 232.20 ..
6.3.m: Greatness is counted among austerities, gifts, vows, and the like, / or is attained by men, only until the river born of Bharga is reached on earth.

6.3.s:
ye vasantyuttare kūle rudrasyānucarā hi te .
vasanti yāmyatīre ye lokaṃ te yānti vaiṣṇavam .. 232.21 ..
6.3.d:
ये वसन्त्युत्तरे कूले रुद्रस्यानुचरा हि ते .
वसन्ति याम्यतीरे ये लोकं ते यान्ति वैष्णवम् .. 232.21 ..
6.3.m: Those who dwell on the northern bank are indeed followers of Rudra; / those who dwell on the southern bank go to the world of Viṣṇu.

6.3.s:
dhanyāste deśavaryāste yeṣu deśeṣu narmadā .
narakāntakarī śaśvatsaṃśritā śarvanirmitā .. 232.22 ..
6.3.d:
धन्यास्ते देशवर्यास्ते येषु देशेषु नर्मदा .
नरकान्तकरी शश्वत्संश्रिता शर्वनिर्मिता .. 232.22 ..
6.3.m: Blessed are those, excellent are those regions, in which countries the Narmadā— / the constant destroyer of hell, created by Śarva—is situated.

6.3.s:
kṛtapuṇyāśca te lokāḥ śokāya na bhavanti te .
ye pibanti jalaṃ puṇyaṃ pārvatīpatisindhujam .. 232.23 ..
6.3.d:
कृतपुण्याश्च ते लोकाः शोकाय न भवन्ति ते .
ये पिबन्ति जलं पुण्यं पार्वतीपतिसिन्धुजम् .. 232.23 ..
6.3.m: And those people have accumulated merit, they do not suffer grief, / who drink the holy water sprung from the river born of Pārvatī's lord.

6.3.s:
idaṃ pavitramatulaṃ revāyāścaritaṃ dvijāḥ .
śṛṇoti yaḥ kīrtayate mucyate sarvapātakaḥ .. 232.24 ..
6.3.d:
इदं पवित्रमतुलं रेवायाश्चरितं द्विजाः .
शृणोति यः कीर्तयते मुच्यते सर्वपातकः .. 232.24 ..
6.3.m: Whoever listens to or recounts this matchless, purifying / narrative of the Revā, O brahmins, is freed from all sins.

6.3.s:
yatphalaṃ sarvavedaiśca saṣaḍaṅgapadakramaiḥ .
śrutaiśca paṭhitaistasmātphalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet .. 232.25 ..
6.3.d:
यत्फलं सर्ववेदैश्च सषडङ्गपदक्रमैः .
श्रुतैश्च पठितैस्तस्मात्फलमष्टगुणं भवेत् .. 232.25 ..
6.3.m: Whatever fruit is gained from all the Vedas with the six auxiliary limbs, the pada and krama recitations, / when heard and recited—eight times that fruit is attained from this.

6.3.s:
satrayājī phalaṃ yacca labhate dvādaśābdikam .
śrutvā sakṛcca revāyāścaritaṃ tatphalaṃ labhet .. 232.26 ..
6.3.d:
सत्रयाजी फलं यच्च लभते द्वादशाब्दिकम् .
श्रुत्वा सकृच्च रेवायाश्चरितं तत्फलं लभेत् .. 232.26 ..
6.3.m: And whatever fruit a sacrificer of a twelve-year sacrificial session attains, / having heard the narrative of the Revā just once, he shall obtain that fruit.

6.3.s:
sarvatīrthāvagāhācca yatphalaṃ sāgarādiṣu .
sakṛcchrutvā ca māhātmyaṃ revāyāstatphalaṃ labhet .. 232.27 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वतीर्थावगाहाच्च यत्फलं सागरादिषु .
सकृच्छ्रुत्वा च माहात्म्यं रेवायास्तत्फलं लभेत् .. 232.27 ..
6.3.m: And whatever fruit comes from bathing in all sacred fords, in oceans and other waters, / by hearing the māhātmya of the Revā just once, one obtains that fruit.

6.3.s:
etaddharmyamupākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstreṣvanuttamam .
deśe vā maṇḍale vāpi nagare grāmamadhyataḥ .. 232.28 ..
6.3.d:
एतद्धर्म्यमुपाख्यानं सर्वशास्त्रेष्वनुत्तमम् .
देशे वा मण्डले वापि नगरे ग्राममध्यतः .. 232.28 ..
6.3.m: This righteous narrative is supreme among all scriptures. / In a region, or in a district, or in a city, or within a village,

6.3.s:
gṛhe vā tiṣṭhate yasya likhitaṃ sārvavārṇikam .
sa brahmā sa śivaḥ sākṣātsa ca devo janārdanaḥ .. 232.29 ..
6.3.d:
गृहे वा तिष्ठते यस्य लिखितं सार्ववार्णिकम् .
स ब्रह्मा स शिवः साक्षात्स च देवो जनार्दनः .. 232.29 ..
6.3.m: or in whose house it stays written down, suitable for all castes, / he is Brahmā, he is Śiva in person, and he is the god Janārdana.

6.3.s:
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ mārge'yaṃ devasevitaḥ .
gurūṇāṃ ca guruḥ śāstraṃ paramaṃ siddhikāraṇam .. 232.30 ..
6.3.d:
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां मार्गेऽयं देवसेवितः .
गुरूणां च गुरुः शास्त्रं परमं सिद्धिकारणम् .. 232.30 ..
6.3.m: On the path of righteousness, wealth, pleasure, and liberation, this is attended by the gods; / a teacher of teachers, a scripture that is the supreme cause of accomplishment.

6.3.s:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ devabhāṣitam .
brāhmaṇo vedavānbhūyātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet .. 232.31 ..
6.3.d:
यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं पुराणं देवभाषितम् .
ब्राह्मणो वेदवान्भूयात्क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् .. 232.31 ..
6.3.m: And whoever hears daily this Purāṇa spoken by the gods, / if a brahmin, he becomes learned in the Vedas; if a kṣatriya, he becomes victorious;

6.3.s: dhanāḍhyo jāyate vaiśyaḥ śūdro vai dharmabhāgbhavet .. 232.32 ..
6.3.d: धनाढ्यो जायते वैश्यः शूद्रो वै धर्मभाग्भवेत् .. 232.32 ..
6.3.m: a vaiśya becomes wealthy; a śūdra indeed comes to share in virtue.

6.3.s:
saubhāgyasantatiṃ nārī śrutvaitatsamavāpnuyāt .
śriyaṃ saukhyaṃ svargavāsaṃ janma caivottame kule .. 232.33 ..
6.3.d:
सौभाग्यसन्ततिं नारी श्रुत्वैतत्समवाप्नुयात् .
श्रियं सौख्यं स्वर्गवासं जन्म चैवोत्तमे कुले .. 232.33 ..
6.3.m: Having heard this, a woman attains good fortune and lineage, / prosperity, happiness, dwelling in heaven, and birth in an excellent family.

6.3.s:
rasabhedī kṛtaghnaśca svāmidhruṅmitravañcakaḥ .
goghnaśca garadaścaiva kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ .. 232.34 ..
6.3.d:
रसभेदी कृतघ्नश्च स्वामिध्रुङ्मित्रवञ्चकः .
गोघ्नश्च गरदश्चैव कन्याविक्रयकारकः .. 232.34 ..
6.3.m: One who adulterates liquids, an ungrateful person, an enemy of one's master, a deceiver of friends, / a cow-killer, a poisoner, and a seller of daughters,

6.3.s:
brahmaghnaśca surāpī ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ .
narmadācaritaṃ śṛṇvaṃstāmabdaṃ yo'bhiṣevate .. 232.35 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापी च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः .
नर्मदाचरितं शृण्वंस्तामब्दं योऽभिषेवते .. 232.35 ..
6.3.m: a killer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, and a violator of the guru's bed— / one who, hearing the narrative of the Narmadā, attends upon her for a year,

6.3.s:
sarvapāpavinirmukto jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
pākabhedī vṛthāpākī devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ .. 232.36 ..
6.3.d:
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो जायते नात्र संशयः .
पाकभेदी वृथापाकी देवब्राह्मणनिन्दकः .. 232.36 ..
6.3.m: becomes liberated from all sins; there is no doubt about this. / One who cooks separate food [from others], one who cooks in vain, one who reviles gods and brahmins,

6.3.s:
parīvādī guroḥ pitroḥ sādhūnāṃ nṛpatestathā .
te'pi śrutvā ca pāpebhyo mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 232.37 ..
6.3.d:
परीवादी गुरोः पित्रोः साधूनां नृपतेस्तथा .
तेऽपि श्रुत्वा च पापेभ्यो मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 232.37 ..
6.3.m: one who slanders the guru, parents, virtuous men, or a king— / they too, having heard [it], are freed from sins; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
ye punarbhāvitātmānaḥ śastraṃ śṛṇvanti nityaśaḥ .
pūjayanti ca tacchāstraṃ nārmadaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 232.38 ..
6.3.d:
ये पुनर्भावितात्मानः शस्त्रं शृण्वन्ति नित्यशः .
पूजयन्ति च तच्छास्त्रं नार्मदं वस्त्रभूषणैः .. 232.38 ..
6.3.m: Moreover, those purified souls who daily listen to the scripture / and worship that scripture about the Narmadā with garments and ornaments,

6.3.s:
puṣpaiḥ phalaiścandanādyairbhojanairvividhairapi .
śāstre'sminpūjite devāḥ pūjitā guravastathā .. 232.39 ..
6.3.d:
पुष्पैः फलैश्चन्दनाद्यैर्भोजनैर्विविधैरपि .
शास्त्रेऽस्मिन्पूजिते देवाः पूजिता गुरवस्तथा .. 232.39 ..
6.3.m: with flowers, fruits, sandal paste and the like, and also with various foods— / when this scripture is worshipped, the gods are worshipped, and likewise the gurus,

6.3.s:
iha loke pare caiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .
tasmātsarvaprayatnena gandhavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ .. 232.40 ..
6.3.d:
इह लोके परे चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा .
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन गन्धवस्त्रादिभूषणैः .. 232.40 ..
6.3.m: in this world and in the next; no doubt need be entertained here. / Therefore, with every effort, using perfumes, garments, ornaments, and the like,

6.3.s:
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vācakaṃ śāstrameva ca .
vedapāṭhaiśca yatpuṇyamagnihotraiśca pālitaiḥ .. 232.41 ..
6.3.d:
पूजयेत्परया भक्त्या वाचकं शास्त्रमेव च .
वेदपाठैश्च यत्पुण्यमग्निहोत्रैश्च पालितैः .. 232.41 ..
6.3.m: one should worship the reciter and the scripture itself with supreme devotion. / Whatever merit [is gained] by recitations of the Veda and by maintained agnihotra rites,

6.3.s:
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti narmadācarite śubhe .
kurukṣetre ca yatpuṇyaṃ prabhāse puṣkare tathā .. 232.42 ..
6.3.d:
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति नर्मदाचरिते शुभे .
कुरुक्षेत्रे च यत्पुण्यं प्रभासे पुष्करे तथा .. 232.42 ..
6.3.m: that fruit one attains through the auspicious narrative of the Narmadā. / Whatever merit [is gained] at Kurukṣetra, and at Prabhāsa, and at Puṣkara,

6.3.s:
rudrāvarte gayāyāṃ ca vārāṇasyāṃ viśeṣataḥ .
gaṅgādvāre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame .. 232.43 ..
6.3.d:
रुद्रावर्ते गयायां च वाराणस्यां विशेषतः .
गङ्गाद्वारे प्रयागे च गङ्गासागरसङ्गमे .. 232.43 ..
6.3.m: and at Rudrāvarta, at Gayā, and especially at Vārāṇasī, / at Gaṅgādvāra, at Prayāga, and at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean—

6.3.s:
evamādiṣu tīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ jāyate nṛṇām .
narmadācaritaṃ śrutvā tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ labhet .. 232.44 ..
6.3.d:
एवमादिषु तीर्थेषु यत्पुण्यं जायते नृणाम् .
नर्मदाचरितं श्रुत्वा तत्पुण्यं सकलं लभेत् .. 232.44 ..
6.3.m: whatever merit arises for men in such sacred fords, / having heard the narrative of the Narmadā, one obtains all of that merit.

6.3.s:
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu narmadācaritaṃ śubham .
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā śṛṇudhvaṃ tatphalaṃ mahat .. 232.45 ..
6.3.d:
आदिमध्यावसानेषु नर्मदाचरितं शुभम् .
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या शृणुध्वं तत्फलं महत् .. 232.45 ..
6.3.m: The man who with devotion hears the auspicious narrative of the Narmadā / in its beginning, middle, and end—hear its great fruit:

6.3.s:
samāpya śivasaṃsthānaṃ devakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ .
rudrasyānucaro bhūtvā śivena saha modate .. 232.46 ..
6.3.d:
समाप्य शिवसंस्थानं देवकन्यासमावृतः .
रुद्रस्यानुचरो भूत्वा शिवेन सह मोदते .. 232.46 ..
6.3.m: having reached the abode of Śiva, surrounded by celestial maidens, / having become an attendant of Rudra, he rejoices with Śiva.

6.3.s:
dharmākhyānamidaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvākhyāneṣvanuttamam .
gṛhe'pi paṭhyate yasya caturvarṇasya sattamāḥ .. 232.47 ..
6.3.d:
धर्माख्यानमिदं पुण्यं सर्वाख्यानेष्वनुत्तमम् .
गृहेऽपि पठ्यते यस्य चतुर्वर्णस्य सत्तमाः .. 232.47 ..
6.3.m: This righteous, meritorious account is unsurpassed among all accounts. / In whose house it is read, O best among the four castes,

6.3.s:
dhanyaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ manye gṛhasthaṃ cāpi tatkulam .
pustakaṃ pūjayedyastu narmadācaritasya tu .. 232.48 ..
6.3.d:
धन्यं तस्य गृहं मन्ये गृहस्थं चापि तत्कुलम् .
पुस्तकं पूजयेद्यस्तु नर्मदाचरितस्य तु .. 232.48 ..
6.3.m: blessed I consider that house, the householder, and his family. / But one who worships the manuscript of the narrative of the Narmadā,

6.3.s:
narmadā pūjitā tena bhagavāṃśca maheśvaraḥ .
vācake pūjite tadvaddevāśca ṛṣayo'rcitāḥ .. 232.49 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदा पूजिता तेन भगवांश्च महेश्वरः .
वाचके पूजिते तद्वद्देवाश्च ऋषयोऽर्चिताः .. 232.49 ..
6.3.m: by him the Narmadā is worshipped, and Lord Maheśvara. / In the same way, when the reciter is worshipped, the gods and seers are worshipped.

6.3.s:
lekhayitvā ca sakalaṃ revācaritamuttamam .
bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ yo dadāti dvijanmane .. 232.50 ..
6.3.d:
लेखयित्वा च सकलं रेवाचरितमुत्तमम् .
भूषणं सर्वशास्त्राणां यो ददाति द्विजन्मने .. 232.50 ..
6.3.m: Having caused the entire excellent narrative of the Revā to be written down, / the ornament of all scriptures, whoever gives it to a twice-born,

6.3.s:
narmadāsarvatīrtheṣu snānadānena yatphalam .
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 232.51 ..
6.3.d:
नर्मदासर्वतीर्थेषु स्नानदानेन यत्फलम् .
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति स नरो नात्र संशयः .. 232.51 ..
6.3.m: whatever fruit comes from bathing and giving at all the sacred fords of the Narmadā, / that fruit that man attains; there is no doubt about this.

6.3.s:
etatpurāṇaṃ rudroktaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam .
svargadaṃ putradaṃ dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ kīrttivardhanam .. 232.52 ..
6.3.d:
एतत्पुराणं रुद्रोक्तं महापुण्यफलप्रदम् .
स्वर्गदं पुत्रदं धन्यं यशस्यं कीर्त्तिवर्धनम् .. 232.52 ..
6.3.m: This Purāṇa spoken by Rudra grants the fruit of great merit; / it gives heaven, gives sons, brings fortune, brings fame, and increases renown.

6.3.s:
dharmyamāyuṣyamatulaṃ duḥkhaduḥsvapnanāśanam .
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi sarvakāmārthasiddhidam .. 232.53 ..
6.3.d:
धर्म्यमायुष्यमतुलं दुःखदुःस्वप्ननाशनम् .
पठतां शृण्वतां चापि सर्वकामार्थसिद्धिदम् .. 232.53 ..
6.3.m: It conforms to dharma, grants peerless longevity, destroys sorrow and bad dreams; / and for those who read it and hear it, it grants the attainment of all desires and purposes.

6.3.s:
yatpradattamidaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ vācyate dvijaiḥ .
śivaloke sthitistasya purāṇākṣaravatsarī .. 232.54 ..
6.3.d:
यत्प्रदत्तमिदं पुण्यं पुराणं वाच्यते द्विजैः .
शिवलोके स्थितिस्तस्य पुराणाक्षरवत्सरी .. 232.54 ..
6.3.m: When this holy Purāṇa, having been given, is recited by brahmins, / his stay in the world of Śiva lasts for as many years as there are syllables in the Purāṇa.

6.3.s:
iti nigaditametannarmadāyāścaritraṃ pavanagaditamagryaṃ śarvavaktrādavāpya .
tribhuvanajanavandyaṃ tvetadādau munīnāṃ kulapatipuratastatsūtamukhyena sādhu .. 232.55 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍe revākhaṇḍasamāptirevākhaṇḍapustakadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
satyanārāyaṇavratakathāḥviśeṣavratapūjāḥ - budhāṣṭamīvratāṅgapūjāvidhi:
..atha-kathā..
"vyāsa-uvāca ..
6.3.d:
इति निगदितमेतन्नर्मदायाश्चरित्रं पवनगदितमग्र्यं शर्ववक्त्रादवाप्य .
त्रिभुवनजनवन्द्यं त्वेतदादौ मुनीनां कुलपतिपुरतस्तत्सूतमुख्येन साधु .. 232.55 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे रेवाखण्डे रेवाखण्डसमाप्तिरेवाखण्डपुस्तकदानादिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम द्वात्रिंशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..
सत्यनारायणव्रतकथाःविशेषव्रतपूजाः - बुधाष्टमीव्रताङ्गपूजाविधि:
..अथ-कथा..
"व्यास-उवाच ..
6.3.m:
Thus this supreme account of the Narmadā, spoken by the Wind having received it from the mouth of Śarva, / which is revered by the people of the three worlds, was well proclaimed at first in front of the head of the sages' clan by the foremost Sūta.
Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Conclusion of the Revākhaṇḍa and the Māhātmya of Donating the Manuscript of the Revākhaṇḍa', in the Revākhaṇḍa of the fifth Āvantyakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
The stories of the Satyanārāyaṇa vow, special vow rituals—procedure for the ancillary worship of the Budhāṣṭamī vow: / Now the story: / Vyāsa said:

6.3.s: "ekadā naimiṣāraṇye ṛṣaya: śaunakādaya:.. papracchurmunaya:sarve sūtaṃ paurāṇikaṃ khalu..1.. ṛṣaya ūcu:.
6.3.d: "एकदा नैमिषारण्ये ऋषय: शौनकादय:.. पप्रच्छुर्मुनय:सर्वे सूतं पौराणिकं खलु..1.. ऋषय ऊचु:.
6.3.m: Once in Naimiṣāraṇya, all the seers, Śaunaka and the others, / asked the purāṇic storyteller Sūta indeed. The seers said: 1

6.3.s:
vratena tapasā kiṃvā prāpyate vāñchitaṃ phalam .. tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāma: kathayasva mahāmune..2..
..sūta uvāca..
6.3.d:
व्रतेन तपसा किंवा प्राप्यते वाञ्छितं फलम् .. तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छाम: कथयस्व महामुने..2..
..सूत उवाच..
6.3.m:
By what vow or austerity is a desired fruit obtained? / We wish to hear all that; tell [us], O great sage! 2
Sūta said:

6.3.s: nāradenaiva sampṛṣṭo bhagavān kamalāpita:.. surarṣaye yathaivāha tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitā:..3..
6.3.d: नारदेनैव सम्पृष्टो भगवान् कमलापित:.. सुरर्षये यथैवाह तच्छृणुध्वं समाहिता:..3..
6.3.m: Just as the blessed Lord, the husband of Kamalā, when questioned by Nārada, / spoke to the celestial seer, hear that with a concentrated mind! 3

6.3.s: ekadā nārado yogī parānugrahakāṅkṣayā.. paryaṭan vividhānlokān martyalokamupāgata:..4..
6.3.d: एकदा नारदो योगी परानुग्रहकाङ्क्षया.. पर्यटन् विविधान्लोकान् मर्त्यलोकमुपागत:..4..
6.3.m: Once the ascetic Nārada, desiring to show grace to others, / wandering through various worlds, arrived in the mortal world. 4

6.3.s: tato dṛṣṭavā janānsarvānnānākleśasamanvitān.. nānāyonisamutpannānkliśyamānān svakarmabhi:.5..
6.3.d: ततो दृष्टवा जनान्सर्वान्नानाक्लेशसमन्वितान्.. नानायोनिसमुत्पन्नान्क्लिश्यमानान् स्वकर्मभि:.5..
6.3.m: Then, seeing all people afflicted with various sufferings, / born into diverse wombs, tormented by their own past deeds, 5

6.3.s: kenopāyena caiteṣāṃ duḥkhanāśo bhaveda dhruvam. iti sañcintya manasā viṣṇulokaṃ gatastadā..6..
6.3.d: केनोपायेन चैतेषां दुःखनाशो भवेद ध्रुवम्. इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा विष्णुलोकं गतस्तदा..6..
6.3.m: and reflecting in his mind, 'By what means can there be a certain end to their sorrow?', / he went at that time to the world of Viṣṇu. 6

6.3.s: tatra nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ caturbhujam. śaṅakhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam..7..

6.3.s:
"anuvāda:-śrī vyāsajī ne kahā- eka samaya naimiṣāraṇya tīrtha meṃ śaunaka ādi hajāroṃ ṛṣi-muniyoṃ ne purāṇoṃ ke mahājñānī śrī sūtajī se pūchā ki vaha vrata-tapa kauna sā hai, jisake karane se manavāṃchita phala prāpta hotā hai. hama sabhī vaha sunanā cāhate haiṃ. kṛpā kara sunāem̐. śrī sūtajī bole- aisā hī praśna nārada ne kiyā thā. jo kucha bhagavāna kamalāpati ne kahā thā, āpa saba use sunie.
paropakāra kī bhāvanā lekara yogī nārada kaī lokoṃ kī yātrā karate-karate mṛtyu loka meṃ ā gae. vahām̐ unhoṃne dekhā ki loga bhārī kaṣṭa bhoga rahe haiṃ. pichale karmoṃ ke prabhāva se aneka yoniyoṃ meṃ utpanna ho rahe haiṃ. duḥkhījanoṃ ko dekha nārada socane lage ki ina prāṇiyoṃ kā duḥkha kisa prakāra dūra kiyā jāe. mana meṃ yahī bhāvanā rakhakara nāradajī viṣṇu loka pahum̐ce. vahām̐ nāradajī ne cāra bhujādhārī satyanārāyaṇa ke darśana kie, jinhoṃne śaṃkha, cakra, gadā, padma apanī bhujāoṃ meṃ le rakhā thā aura unake gale meṃ vanamālā par̤ī thī.
nāradajī ne stuti kī aura kahā ki mana-vāṇī se pare, anaṃta śaktidhārī, āpako praṇāma hai. ādi, madhya aura aṃta se mukta sarvaātmā ke ādikāraṇa śrī hari āpako praṇāma. nāradajī kī stuti suna viṣṇu bhagavāna ne pūchā- he nārada! tumhāre mana meṃ kyā hai? vaha saba mujhe batāie. bhagavāna kī yaha vāṇī suna nāradajī ne kahā- martya loka ke sabhī prāṇī pūrva pāpoṃ ke kāraṇa vibhinna yoniyoṃ meṃ utpanna hokara aneka prakāra ke kaṣṭa bhoga rahe haiṃ.
yadi āpa mujha para kṛpālu haiṃ to ina prāṇiyoṃ ke kaṣṭa dūra karane kā koī upāya batāem̐. maiṃ vaha sunanā cāhatā hūm̐.
śrī bhagavāna bole he nārada! tuma sādhu ho. tumane jana-jana ke kalyāṇa ke lie acchā praśna kiyā hai. jisa vrata ke karane se vyakti moha se chūṭa jātā hai, vaha maiṃ tumheṃ batātā hūm̐. yaha vrata svarga aura mṛtyu loka donoṃ meṃ durlabha hai. tumhāre snehavaśa meṃ isa vrata kā vivaraṇa detā hūm̐.
6.3.d:
"अनुवाद:-श्री व्यासजी ने कहा- एक समय नैमिषारण्य तीर्थ में शौनक आदि हजारों ऋषि-मुनियों ने पुराणों के महाज्ञानी श्री सूतजी से पूछा कि वह व्रत-तप कौन सा है, जिसके करने से मनवांछित फल प्राप्त होता है. हम सभी वह सुनना चाहते हैं. कृपा कर सुनाएम्̐. श्री सूतजी बोले- ऐसा ही प्रश्न नारद ने किया था. जो कुछ भगवान कमलापति ने कहा था, आप सब उसे सुनिए.
परोपकार की भावना लेकर योगी नारद कई लोकों की यात्रा करते-करते मृत्यु लोक में आ गए. वहाम्̐ उन्होंने देखा कि लोग भारी कष्ट भोग रहे हैं. पिछले कर्मों के प्रभाव से अनेक योनियों में उत्पन्न हो रहे हैं. दुःखीजनों को देख नारद सोचने लगे कि इन प्राणियों का दुःख किस प्रकार दूर किया जाए. मन में यही भावना रखकर नारदजी विष्णु लोक पहुम्̐चे. वहाम्̐ नारदजी ने चार भुजाधारी सत्यनारायण के दर्शन किए, जिन्होंने शंख, चक्र, गदा, पद्म अपनी भुजाओं में ले रखा था और उनके गले में वनमाला पर्̤ई थी.
नारदजी ने स्तुति की और कहा कि मन-वाणी से परे, अनंत शक्तिधारी, आपको प्रणाम है. आदि, मध्य और अंत से मुक्त सर्वआत्मा के आदिकारण श्री हरि आपको प्रणाम. नारदजी की स्तुति सुन विष्णु भगवान ने पूछा- हे नारद! तुम्हारे मन में क्या है? वह सब मुझे बताइए. भगवान की यह वाणी सुन नारदजी ने कहा- मर्त्य लोक के सभी प्राणी पूर्व पापों के कारण विभिन्न योनियों में उत्पन्न होकर अनेक प्रकार के कष्ट भोग रहे हैं.
यदि आप मुझ पर कृपालु हैं तो इन प्राणियों के कष्ट दूर करने का कोई उपाय बताएम्̐. मैं वह सुनना चाहता हूम्̐.
श्री भगवान बोले हे नारद! तुम साधु हो. तुमने जन-जन के कल्याण के लिए अच्छा प्रश्न किया है. जिस व्रत के करने से व्यक्ति मोह से छूट जाता है, वह मैं तुम्हें बताता हूम्̐. यह व्रत स्वर्ग और मृत्यु लोक दोनों में दुर्लभ है. तुम्हारे स्नेहवश में इस व्रत का विवरण देता हूम्̐.
6.3.m:
"Translation:—Śrī Vyāsa said: At one time in the sacred ford of Naimiṣāraṇya, thousands of seers and sages headed by Śaunaka asked the great knower of the Purāṇas, Śrī Sūta, 'What is that observance and austerity by performing which one obtains the desired fruit? We all wish to hear that. Please recount it to us.' Śrī Sūta said: 'Nārada asked this very question. Please listen to all that the blessed Lord, the consort of Kamalā, said.'
Carrying the desire to benefit others, the yogin Nārada traveled through many worlds and came to the mortal realm. There he saw that people were enduring severe suffering. Under the influence of their past deeds, they were being born into various wombs. Seeing these distressed people, Nārada began to think how the suffering of these living beings could be removed. Keeping this thought in mind, Nārada reached the world of Viṣṇu. There Nārada had the darśana of four-armed Satyanārāyaṇa, who held a conch, discus, mace, and lotus in his arms, and a garland of forest flowers hung around his neck.
Nārada praised him and said, 'Beyond mind and speech, bearer of infinite power, salutations to you! Salutations to you, Śrī Hari, the primal cause of all souls, free from beginning, middle, and end.' Hearing Nārada's praise, Lord Viṣṇu asked, 'O Nārada! What is on your mind? Tell me all of that.' Hearing these words of the Lord, Nārada said, 'All beings of the mortal realm, having been born into various wombs due to past sins, are suffering many kinds of distress.
If you are compassionate towards me, then tell me some means of removing the suffering of these beings. I wish to hear that.'
The blessed Lord said, 'O Nārada! You are virtuous. You have asked a good question for the welfare of each and every person. I shall tell you that observance by performing which a person is freed from delusion. This observance is rare in both heaven and the mortal world. Out of affection for you, I give an account of this observance.'

6.3.s:
satyanārāyaṇa kā vrata vidhipūrvaka karane se tatkāla sukha milatā hai aura aṃtataḥ mokṣa kā adhikāra milatā hai.
śrī bhagavāna ke vacana suna nārada ne kahā ki prabhu isa vrata kā phala kyā hai? ise kaba aura kaise dhāraṇa kiyā jāe aura ise kisa-kisa ne kiyā hai. śrī bhagavāna ne kahā duḥkha-śoka dūra karane vālā, dhana bar̤hāne vālā.
saubhāgya aura saṃtāna kā dātā, sarvatra vijaya dilāne vālā śrī satyanārāyaṇa vrata manuṣya kisī bhī dina śraddhā bhakti ke sātha kara sakatā hai.
sāyaṃkāla dharmarata ho brāhmaṇa ke sahayoga se aura baṃdhu bāṃdhava sahita śrī satyanārāyaṇa kā pūjana kareṃ. bhaktipūrvaka khāne yogya uttama prasāda (savāyā) leṃ. yaha prasāda kele, ghī, dūdha, gehūm̐ ke āṭe se banā ho.
6.3.d:
सत्यनारायण का व्रत विधिपूर्वक करने से तत्काल सुख मिलता है और अंततः मोक्ष का अधिकार मिलता है.
श्री भगवान के वचन सुन नारद ने कहा कि प्रभु इस व्रत का फल क्या है? इसे कब और कैसे धारण किया जाए और इसे किस-किस ने किया है. श्री भगवान ने कहा दुःख-शोक दूर करने वाला, धन बर्̤हाने वाला.
सौभाग्य और संतान का दाता, सर्वत्र विजय दिलाने वाला श्री सत्यनारायण व्रत मनुष्य किसी भी दिन श्रद्धा भक्ति के साथ कर सकता है.
सायंकाल धर्मरत हो ब्राह्मण के सहयोग से और बंधु बांधव सहित श्री सत्यनारायण का पूजन करें. भक्तिपूर्वक खाने योग्य उत्तम प्रसाद (सवाया) लें. यह प्रसाद केले, घी, दूध, गेहूम्̐ के आटे से बना हो.
6.3.m:
'By performing the observance of Satyanārāyaṇa according to rule, one immediately obtains happiness, and ultimately obtains the entitlement to liberation.'
Hearing the words of the blessed Lord, Nārada said, 'Lord, what is the fruit of this observance? When and how should it be undertaken, and who all have performed it?' The blessed Lord said, 'Dispersing sorrow and grief, increasing wealth,
bestower of good fortune and offspring, granting victory everywhere, a person may perform the observance of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa on any day with faith and devotion.
In the evening, intent upon dharma, with the assistance of a brahmin and together with kinsmen, one should worship Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa. With devotion, one should take the finest food offering suitable for eating (amounting to one and a quarter parts). This offering should be made of bananas, ghee, milk, and wheat flour.'

6.3.s:
yadi gehūm̐ kā āṭā na ho, to cāvala kā āṭā aura śakkara ke sthāna para gur̤a milā deṃ. saba milākara savāyā banā naivedya arpita kareṃ. isake bāda kathā suneṃ, prasāda leṃ, brāhmaṇoṃ ko dakṣiṇā deṃ aura isake paścāta baṃdhu-bāṃdhavoṃ sahita brāhmaṇoṃ ko bhojana karāem̐.
prasāda pā lene ke bāda kīrtana ādi kareṃ aura phira bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa kā smaraṇa karate hue svajana apane-apane ghara jāem̐. aise vrata-pūjana karane vāle kī manokāmanā avaśya pūrī hogī. kaliyuga meṃ viśeṣa rūpa se yaha choṭā-sā upāya isa pṛthvī para sulabha hai.
iti-śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe satyanārāyaṇavratakathāyāṃ prathamo'dhyāya:..1..
6.3.d:
यदि गेहूम्̐ का आटा न हो, तो चावल का आटा और शक्कर के स्थान पर गुर्̤अ मिला दें. सब मिलाकर सवाया बना नैवेद्य अर्पित करें. इसके बाद कथा सुनें, प्रसाद लें, ब्राह्मणों को दक्षिणा दें और इसके पश्चात बंधु-बांधवों सहित ब्राह्मणों को भोजन कराएम्̐.
प्रसाद पा लेने के बाद कीर्तन आदि करें और फिर भगवान सत्यनारायण का स्मरण करते हुए स्वजन अपने-अपने घर जाएम्̐. ऐसे व्रत-पूजन करने वाले की मनोकामना अवश्य पूरी होगी. कलियुग में विशेष रूप से यह छोटा-सा उपाय इस पृथ्वी पर सुलभ है.
इति-श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे सत्यनारायणव्रतकथायां प्रथमोऽध्याय:..1..
6.3.m:
'If wheat flour is not available, then one may mix rice flour, and raw sugar in place of refined sugar. Mixing it all, one should prepare the offering of one and a quarter parts and present it as naivedya. After this, one should listen to the sacred story, receive the food offering, give sacrificial fees to brahmins, and subsequently feed the brahmins along with one's kinsmen.
After partaking of the food offering, they should perform singing and the like, and then, remembering Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, one's relatives should return to their respective homes. The heartfelt wish of one who performs such an observance and worship will certainly be fulfilled. In the Kaliyuga, especially, this simple means is easily available upon this earth.'
Thus ends the first chapter in the story of the observance of Satyanārāyaṇa in the Revākhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 1.

6.3.s:
"sūta uvāca..
athānyatsampravakṣyāmi kṛtaṃ yena purā dvija.. kaścitkāśīpure ramye hyāsīdvipro'tinirdhana:..1..
6.3.d:
"सूत उवाच..
अथान्यत्सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि कृतं येन पुरा द्विज.. कश्चित्काशीपुरे रम्ये ह्यासीद्विप्रोऽतिनिर्धन:..1..
6.3.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall relate another [matter], by whom it was performed formerly, O twice-born one. / Indeed, in the charming city of Kāśī there lived an exceedingly poor brahmin.

6.3.s: kṣutṛḍabhyāṃ vyākulo bhūtvā nityaṃ babhrāma bhūtale.. dū:khitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭavā bhagavān brāhmaṇapriya:..2..
6.3.d: क्षुतृडभ्यां व्याकुलो भूत्वा नित्यं बभ्राम भूतले.. दू:खितं ब्राह्मणं दृष्टवा भगवान् ब्राह्मणप्रिय:..2..
6.3.m: Distressed by hunger and thirst, he wandered constantly upon the earth. / Seeing the distressed brahmin, the Lord, who is fond of brahmins,

6.3.s: vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpastaṃ papraccha dvijamādarāt .. kimarthaṃ amase vipra mahīṃ nityaṃ sudu:khita:..3..
6.3.d: वृद्धब्राह्मणरूपस्तं पप्रच्छ द्विजमादरात् .. किमर्थं अमसे विप्र महीं नित्यं सुदु:खित:..3..
6.3.m: assuming the form of an old brahmin, respectfully asked that twice-born one: / "Why do you, O brahmin, exceedingly sorrowful, constantly wander the earth?

6.3.s: tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathyatāṃ dvijasattama.. "brāhmaṇa uvāca.. brāhmaṇo'tidaridro'haṃ bhikṣārthaṃ vai bhrame mahīm..4..
6.3.d: तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि कथ्यतां द्विजसत्तम.. "ब्राह्मण उवाच.. ब्राह्मणोऽतिदरिद्रोऽहं भिक्षार्थं वै भ्रमे महीम्..4..
6.3.m: I wish to hear all of that; please tell [me], O best of the twice-born." / The brahmin said: / "I am an exceedingly destitute brahmin; I wander the earth for alms.

6.3.s:
upāyaṃ yadi jānāsi kṛpayā kathaya prabho.
"vṛddhabrāhmaṇa uvāca. satyanārāyaṇo viṣṇurvāñchitārthaphalaprada:..5..
6.3.d:
उपायं यदि जानासि कृपया कथय प्रभो.
"वृद्धब्राह्मण उवाच. सत्यनारायणो विष्णुर्वाञ्छितार्थफलप्रद:..5..
6.3.m: If you know a remedy, please tell me, O lord." / The old brahmin said: / "Satyanārāyaṇa is Viṣṇu, who grants the fruit of desired aims.

6.3.s: tasya tvaṃ pūjanaṃ vipra kuruṣva vratamuttamam .. yatkṛtvā sarvaduḥkhebhyo mukto bhavati mānava:..6..
6.3.d: तस्य त्वं पूजनं विप्र कुरुष्व व्रतमुत्तमम् .. यत्कृत्वा सर्वदुःखेभ्यो मुक्तो भवति मानव:..6..
6.3.m: Do you perform his worship, O brahmin, the supreme vow, / by performing which a man becomes liberated from all sorrows."

6.3.s: vidhānaṃ ca vratasyāpi viprāyābhāṣya yatnata:.. satyanārāyaṇo vaddhastatraivāntaradhīyata ..7..
6.3.d: विधानं च व्रतस्यापि विप्रायाभाष्य यत्नत:.. सत्यनारायणो वद्धस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..7..
6.3.m: Having carefully spoken the rite of the vow to the brahmin, / the old Satyanārāyaṇa vanished right there.

6.3.s: tadavrataṃ saṅkariṣyāmi yaduktaṃ brāhmaṇena vai.. iti sañcintyavipro'sau rātraunidrāṃlabdhavān.8.
6.3.d: तदव्रतं सङ्करिष्यामि यदुक्तं ब्राह्मणेन वै.. इति सञ्चिन्त्यविप्रोऽसौ रात्रौनिद्रांलब्धवान्.8.
6.3.m: "I will certainly perform that vow which was spoken by the brahmin." / Reflecting thus, that brahmin obtained no sleep at night.

6.3.s: tata prāta: samutthāya satyanārāyaṇavratam .. kariṣya iti saṅkalpya bhikṣārthamagamad dvija:..9..
6.3.d: तत प्रात: समुत्थाय सत्यनारायणव्रतम् .. करिष्य इति सङ्कल्प्य भिक्षार्थमगमद् द्विज:..9..
6.3.m: Then, having risen in the morning, having resolved: / "I will perform the Satyanārāyaṇa vow," the twice-born one went for alms.

6.3.s: tasminneva dine vipra: pracuraṃ dravyamāptavān. tenaiva bandhubhi: sārddhaṃ satyasya vratamācarat..10..
6.3.d: तस्मिन्नेव दिने विप्र: प्रचुरं द्रव्यमाप्तवान्. तेनैव बन्धुभि: सार्द्धं सत्यस्य व्रतमाचरत्..10..
6.3.m: On that very day the brahmin obtained abundant wealth. / With that very [wealth] he performed the vow of Satya together with his kinsmen.

6.3.s: sarvadūḥkhavinirmukta: sarvasampatsamanvita:.. babhūva sa dvijaśreṣṭho vratasyāsya prabhāvata:..11..
6.3.d: सर्वदूःखविनिर्मुक्त: सर्वसम्पत्समन्वित:.. बभूव स द्विजश्रेष्ठो व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावत:..11..
6.3.m: Freed from all sorrows, endowed with all prosperities, / that best of the twice-born became [happy] through the power of this vow.

6.3.s: tata:prabhṛti kālaṃ ca māsi māsi vrataṃ kṛtam.. evaṃ nārāyaṇasyedaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā dvijottama:..12..
6.3.d: तत:प्रभृति कालं च मासि मासि व्रतं कृतम्.. एवं नारायणस्येदं व्रतं कृत्वा द्विजोत्तम:..12..
6.3.m: And from that time forth, he performed the vow month after month. / Thus having performed this vow of Nārāyaṇa, the best of the twice-born,

6.3.s: sarvapāpavinirmukto durlabhaṃ mokṣamāptavān . vratamasya yadā viprā: pṛthivyāṃ saṅkariṣyati..13..
6.3.d: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो दुर्लभं मोक्षमाप्तवान् . व्रतमस्य यदा विप्रा: पृथिव्यां सङ्करिष्यति..13..
6.3.m: freed from all sins, attained the liberation difficult to attain. / Whenever [any] person on earth shall perform this vow, O brahmins,

6.3.s: tadaiva sarvaduḥkhaṃ ca manujasya vinaśyati. evaṃ nārāyaṇenoktaṃ nāradāya mahātmane..14..
6.3.d: तदैव सर्वदुःखं च मनुजस्य विनश्यति. एवं नारायणेनोक्तं नारदाय महात्मने..14..
6.3.m: then all sorrow of that man is destroyed. / Thus it was spoken by Nārāyaṇa to the great-souled Nārada.

6.3.s:
mayā tatkathitaṃ viprā: kimanyatkathayāmi va:..
"ṛṣaya ūcu:. tasmādviprācchrutaṃ kena pṛthivyāṃ caritaṃ mune.. tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāma: śraddhāsmākaṃ prajāyate..15..
6.3.d:
मया तत्कथितं विप्रा: किमन्यत्कथयामि व:..
"ऋषय ऊचु:. तस्माद्विप्राच्छ्रुतं केन पृथिव्यां चरितं मुने.. तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छाम: श्रद्धास्माकं प्रजायते..15..
6.3.m: That has been related by me, O brahmins; what else shall I relate to you?" / The seers said: / "From that brahmin, by whom on earth was it heard [and] practiced, O sage? / We wish to hear all that; faith is born in us."

6.3.s: "sūta uvāca.. śrṛṇudhvaṃ munaya: sarve vrataṃ yena kṛtaṃ bhuvi .. ekadā sa dvijavaro yathāvibhavavistarai:..16..
6.3.d: "सूत उवाच.. श्रृणुध्वं मुनय: सर्वे व्रतं येन कृतं भुवि .. एकदा स द्विजवरो यथाविभवविस्तरै:..16..
6.3.m: Sūta said: / "Listen, all you sages, by whom the vow was performed on earth. / Once that best of the twice-born, according to his ample means,

6.3.s: bandhubhi:svajanai: sārdhaṃ vrataṃ kartuṃ samudyata:.. etasminnantare kāle kāṣṭhakretā samāgamat..17..
6.3.d: बन्धुभि:स्वजनै: सार्धं व्रतं कर्तुं समुद्यत:.. एतस्मिन्नन्तरे काले काष्ठक्रेता समागमत्..17..
6.3.m: undertook to perform the vow along with his kinsmen and relatives. / In that interval of time, a wood-seller arrived.

6.3.s: bahi:kāṣṭhaṃ ca saṃsthyāpya viprasya gṛhamāyayau.. tṛṣṇayā pīḍitātmā ca dṛṣṭvā vipraṃkṛta vratam..18..
6.3.d: बहि:काष्ठं च संस्थ्याप्य विप्रस्य गृहमाययौ.. तृष्णया पीडितात्मा च दृष्ट्वा विप्रंकृत व्रतम्..18..
6.3.m: Setting down the wood outside, he came to the brahmin's house. / With his soul afflicted by thirst, having seen the brahmin performing the vow,

6.3.s: praṇipatya dvijaṃ prāha kimidaṃ kriyate tvayā .. kṛte kiṃ phalamāpnoti vistarādvāda me prabho ..19..
6.3.d: प्रणिपत्य द्विजं प्राह किमिदं क्रियते त्वया .. कृते किं फलमाप्नोति विस्तराद्वाद मे प्रभो ..19..
6.3.m: bowing down, he said to the twice-born one: 'What is this being done by you? / When it is done, what fruit does one obtain? Tell me in detail, O lord.'

6.3.s: "vipra uvāca.. satyanārāyaṇasyedaṃ vrataṃ sarvepsitapradam.. tasya prasādānme sarvaṃ dhanadhānyādikaṃ mahat..20..
6.3.d: "विप्र उवाच.. सत्यनारायणस्येदं व्रतं सर्वेप्सितप्रदम्.. तस्य प्रसादान्मे सर्वं धनधान्यादिकं महत्..20..
6.3.m: The brahmin said: / 'This is the vow of Satyanārāyaṇa, which grants all desired things. / By his grace, all my great wealth, grain, and the like [has arisen].'

6.3.s: tasmādetad vrataṃ jñātvā kāṣṭhavikretātiharṣita:.. papau jalaṃ prasādaṃ ca bhuktvā sa nagaraṃ yayau..21..
6.3.d: तस्मादेतद् व्रतं ज्ञात्वा काष्ठविक्रेतातिहर्षित:.. पपौ जलं प्रसादं च भुक्त्वा स नगरं ययौ..21..
6.3.m: Having learned of this vow from him, the wood-seller became overjoyed. / He drank water, ate the food offering, and went to the city.

6.3.s: satyanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ manasā ityacintayat .. kāṣṭhaṃ vikrayato grāme prāpyate cādya yad‌dhanam..22..
6.3.d: सत्यनारायणं देवं मनसा इत्यचिन्तयत् .. काष्ठं विक्रयतो ग्रामे प्राप्यते चाद्य यद्‌धनम्..22..
6.3.m: He thought in his mind regarding the god Satyanārāyaṇa: / 'Whatever wealth is obtained today from selling wood in the town,

6.3.s: tenaiva satyadevasya kariṣye vratamuttamam.. itisañcintya manasā kāṣṭhaṃ dhṛtvā tu mastake..23..
6.3.d: तेनैव सत्यदेवस्य करिष्ये व्रतमुत्तमम्.. इतिसञ्चिन्त्य मनसा काष्ठं धृत्वा तु मस्तके..23..
6.3.m: with that very [wealth] I will perform the supreme vow of the true God.' / Reflecting thus in his mind, carrying the wood on his head,

6.3.s: jagāma nagare ramye dhanināṃ yatra saṃsthiti:.. taddine kāṣṭhamūlyaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ prāptavānasau..24..
6.3.d: जगाम नगरे रम्ये धनिनां यत्र संस्थिति:.. तद्दिने काष्ठमूल्यं च द्विगुणं प्राप्तवानसौ..24..
6.3.m: he went into the charming city to where wealthy men resided. / On that day he received twice the price for the wood.

6.3.s: tata: prasannahṛdaya: supakvaṃ kadalīphalam.. śarkarāghṛtadugdhaṃ ca godhūmasya ca cūrṇakam..25..
6.3.d: तत: प्रसन्नहृदय: सुपक्वं कदलीफलम्.. शर्कराघृतदुग्धं च गोधूमस्य च चूर्णकम्..25..
6.3.m: Then, with a joyful heart, well-ripened plantain fruit, / sugar, ghee, milk, and wheat flour—

6.3.s: kṛtvaikatra sapādaṃ ca gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ yayau.. tato bandhūnsamāhūya cakāra vidhinā vratam..26..
6.3.d: कृत्वैकत्र सपादं च गृहीत्वा स्वगृहं ययौ.. ततो बन्धून्समाहूय चकार विधिना व्रतम्..26..
6.3.m: taking [them] together, [each] one and a quarter [in measure], he went to his home. / Then, having summoned his relatives, he performed the vow according to the injunctions.

6.3.s: tadavratasya prabhāveṇa dhanaputrānvito'bhavat. ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuṃktvā cānte satyapuraṃ yayau..27..
6.3.d: तदव्रतस्य प्रभावेण धनपुत्रान्वितोऽभवत्. इहलोके सुखं भुंक्त्वा चान्ते सत्यपुरं ययौ..27..
6.3.m: By the power of that vow he became endowed with wealth and sons. / Having enjoyed happiness in this world, at the end he went to the realm of Satya.

6.3.s:
"anuvāda:-
sūta jī bole – he ṛṣiyoṃ! jisane pahale samaya meṃ isa vrata ko kiyā thā usakā itihāsa kahatā hūm̐, dhyāna se suno! suṃdara kāśīpurī nagarī meṃ eka atyaṃta nirdhana brāhmaṇa rahatā thā. bhūkha pyāsa se pareśāna vaha dharatī para ghūmatā rahatā thā. brāhmaṇoṃ se prema karane vāle bhagavāna ne eka dina brāhmaṇa kā veśa dhāraṇa kara usake pāsa jākara pūchā – he vipra! nitya dukhī hokara tuma pṛthvī para kyūm̐ ghūmate ho? dīna brāhmaṇa bolā – maiṃ nirdhana brāhmaṇa hūm̐. bhikṣā ke lie dharatī para ghūmatā hūm̐.
he bhagavan ! yadi āpa isakā koī upāya jānate ho to kṛpākara batāie. vṛddha brāhmaṇa kahatā hai ki satyanārāyaṇa bhagavāna manovāṃchita phala dene vāle haiṃ isalie tuma unakā pūjana karo. ise karane se manuṣya sabhī dukhoṃ se mukta ho jātā hai. vṛddha brāhmaṇa banakara āe satyanārāyaṇa bhagavāna usa nirdhana brāhmaṇa ko vrata kā sārā vidhāna batākara antardhāna ho gae. brāhmaṇa mana hī mana socane lagā ki jisa vrata ko vṛddha brāhmaṇa karane ko kaha gayā hai maiṃ use avaśya karūm̐gā. yaha niścaya karane ke bāda use rāta meṃ nīm̐da nahīṃ āī.
vaha savere uṭhakara satyanārāyaṇa bhagavāna ke vrata kā niścaya kara bhikṣā ke lie calā gayā. usa dina nirdhana brāhmaṇa ko bhikṣā meṃ bahuta dhana milā. jisase usane baṃdhu-bām̐dhavoṃ ke sātha milakara śrī satyanārāyaṇa bhagavāna kā vrata saṃpanna kiyā. bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa kā vrata saṃpanna karane ke bāda vaha nirdhana brāhmaṇa sabhī dukhoṃ se chūṭa gayā aura aneka prakāra kī saṃpattiyoṃ se yukta ho gayā. usī samaya se yaha brāhmaṇa hara māha isa vrata ko karane lagā.
6.3.d:
"अनुवाद:-
सूत जी बोले – हे ऋषियों! जिसने पहले समय में इस व्रत को किया था उसका इतिहास कहता हूम्̐, ध्यान से सुनो! सुंदर काशीपुरी नगरी में एक अत्यंत निर्धन ब्राह्मण रहता था. भूख प्यास से परेशान वह धरती पर घूमता रहता था. ब्राह्मणों से प्रेम करने वाले भगवान ने एक दिन ब्राह्मण का वेश धारण कर उसके पास जाकर पूछा – हे विप्र! नित्य दुखी होकर तुम पृथ्वी पर क्यूम्̐ घूमते हो? दीन ब्राह्मण बोला – मैं निर्धन ब्राह्मण हूम्̐. भिक्षा के लिए धरती पर घूमता हूम्̐.
हे भगवन् ! यदि आप इसका कोई उपाय जानते हो तो कृपाकर बताइए. वृद्ध ब्राह्मण कहता है कि सत्यनारायण भगवान मनोवांछित फल देने वाले हैं इसलिए तुम उनका पूजन करो. इसे करने से मनुष्य सभी दुखों से मुक्त हो जाता है. वृद्ध ब्राह्मण बनकर आए सत्यनारायण भगवान उस निर्धन ब्राह्मण को व्रत का सारा विधान बताकर अन्तर्धान हो गए. ब्राह्मण मन ही मन सोचने लगा कि जिस व्रत को वृद्ध ब्राह्मण करने को कह गया है मैं उसे अवश्य करूम्̐गा. यह निश्चय करने के बाद उसे रात में नीम्̐द नहीं आई.
वह सवेरे उठकर सत्यनारायण भगवान के व्रत का निश्चय कर भिक्षा के लिए चला गया. उस दिन निर्धन ब्राह्मण को भिक्षा में बहुत धन मिला. जिससे उसने बंधु-बाम्̐धवों के साथ मिलकर श्री सत्यनारायण भगवान का व्रत संपन्न किया. भगवान सत्यनारायण का व्रत संपन्न करने के बाद वह निर्धन ब्राह्मण सभी दुखों से छूट गया और अनेक प्रकार की संपत्तियों से युक्त हो गया. उसी समय से यह ब्राह्मण हर माह इस व्रत को करने लगा.
6.3.m: Translation:— / Sūta said: “O seers! I shall relate the history of the one who performed this observance in earlier times; listen attentively! In the beautiful city of Kāśī, there lived an exceedingly poor brahmin. Distressed by hunger and thirst, he constantly wandered about the earth. The Lord, who is fond of brahmins, assumed the disguise of a brahmin one day, approached him, and asked: ‘O vipra! Why do you wander upon the earth, constantly miserable?’ The destitute brahmin replied: ‘I am a poor brahmin. I wander the earth for alms. / O venerable one! If you know any remedy for this, please tell me.’ The old brahmin said: ‘Lord Satyanārāyaṇa grants desired fruits; therefore, you should worship him. By doing this, a man is freed from all miseries.’ Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, having come disguised as the old brahmin, explained the entire procedure of the observance to that poor brahmin and disappeared. The brahmin began to think to himself: ‘The observance that the old brahmin told me to do, I shall certainly perform.’ Having made this resolve, he could not sleep at night. / Getting up in the morning, having resolved upon the observance of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, he went out for alms. On that day, the poor brahmin received much wealth in alms. Gathering together with his kinsmen, he completed the observance of the blessed Lord Satyanārāyaṇa. After completing the observance of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, that poor brahmin was freed from all afflictions and endowed with various kinds of riches. From that time onward, this brahmin began to perform this observance every month.
