6.3.s:
"anuvāda:-
sūtajī bole- sādhu nāmaka vaiśya maṃgala smaraṇa kara brāhmaṇoṃ ko dāna dakṣiṇā de, apane ghara kī ora calā. abhī kucha dūra hī sādhu calā thā ki bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa ne sādhu vaiśya kī manovṛtti jānane ke uddeśya se, daṃḍī kā veśa dhara, vaiśya se praśna kiyā ki usakī nāva meṃ kyā hai. saṃpatti meṃ masta sādhu ne haṃsakara kahā ki daṃḍī svāmī kyā tumheṃ mudrā (rupae) cāhie. merī nāva meṃ to latā-patra hī haiṃ. aise niṭhura vacana suna śrī satyanārāyaṇa bhagavāna bole ki tumhārā kahā saca ho.
itanā kaha daṃḍī kucha dūra samudra ke hī kināre baiṭha gae. daṃḍī svāmī ke cale jāne para sādhu vaiśya ne dekhā ki nāva halkī aura uṭhī huī cala rahī hai. vaha bahuta cakita huā. usane nāva meṃ latā-patra hī dekhe to mūrcchita ho pṛthvī para gira par̤ā. hośa āne para vaha ciṃtā karane lagā. taba usake dāmāda ne kahā aise śoka kyoṃ karate ho. yaha daṃḍī svāmī kā śāpa hai. ve daṃḍī sarvasamartha haiṃ isameṃ saṃśaya nahīṃ hai. unakī śaraṇa meṃ jāne se manavāṃchita phala milegā.
dāmāda kā kahanā māna, vaiśya daṃḍī svāmī ke pāsa gayā. daṃḍī svāmī ko praṇāma kara sādara bolā. jo kucha maiṃne āpase kahā thā use kṣamā kara deṃ. aisā kaha vaha bāra-bāra namana kara mahāśoka se vyākula ho gayā. vaiśya ko rote dekha daṃḍī svāmī ne kahā mata roo. suno! tuma merī pūjā ko bhūlate ho. he kubuddhi vāle! merī ājñā se tumheṃ bārabāra duḥkha huā hai. vaiśya stuti karane lagā. sādhu bolā- prabhu āpakī māyā se brahmādi bhī mohita hue haiṃ. ve bhī āpake adbhuta rūpa guṇoṃ ko nahīṃ jānate.
6.3.d:
"अनुवाद:-
सूतजी बोले- साधु नामक वैश्य मंगल स्मरण कर ब्राह्मणों को दान दक्षिणा दे, अपने घर की ओर चला. अभी कुछ दूर ही साधु चला था कि भगवान सत्यनारायण ने साधु वैश्य की मनोवृत्ति जानने के उद्देश्य से, दंडी का वेश धर, वैश्य से प्रश्न किया कि उसकी नाव में क्या है. संपत्ति में मस्त साधु ने हंसकर कहा कि दंडी स्वामी क्या तुम्हें मुद्रा (रुपए) चाहिए. मेरी नाव में तो लता-पत्र ही हैं. ऐसे निठुर वचन सुन श्री सत्यनारायण भगवान बोले कि तुम्हारा कहा सच हो.
इतना कह दंडी कुछ दूर समुद्र के ही किनारे बैठ गए. दंडी स्वामी के चले जाने पर साधु वैश्य ने देखा कि नाव हल्की और उठी हुई चल रही है. वह बहुत चकित हुआ. उसने नाव में लता-पत्र ही देखे तो मूर्च्छित हो पृथ्वी पर गिर पर्̤आ. होश आने पर वह चिंता करने लगा. तब उसके दामाद ने कहा ऐसे शोक क्यों करते हो. यह दंडी स्वामी का शाप है. वे दंडी सर्वसमर्थ हैं इसमें संशय नहीं है. उनकी शरण में जाने से मनवांछित फल मिलेगा.
दामाद का कहना मान, वैश्य दंडी स्वामी के पास गया. दंडी स्वामी को प्रणाम कर सादर बोला. जो कुछ मैंने आपसे कहा था उसे क्षमा कर दें. ऐसा कह वह बार-बार नमन कर महाशोक से व्याकुल हो गया. वैश्य को रोते देख दंडी स्वामी ने कहा मत रोओ. सुनो! तुम मेरी पूजा को भूलते हो. हे कुबुद्धि वाले! मेरी आज्ञा से तुम्हें बारबार दुःख हुआ है. वैश्य स्तुति करने लगा. साधु बोला- प्रभु आपकी माया से ब्रह्मादि भी मोहित हुए हैं. वे भी आपके अद्भुत रूप गुणों को नहीं जानते.
6.3.m:
"Translation:—
Sūta said: The merchant named Sādhu, having remembered the auspicious [Lord] and given gifts and honoraria to the brāhmaṇas, set out towards his home. Sādhu had traveled only a short distance when Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, wishing to test the merchant Sādhu's attitude, assumed the guise of an ascetic with a staff and asked the merchant what was in his boat. Sādhu, arrogant in his wealth, laughed and said, 'O ascetic master, do you want money? In my boat there are only creepers and leaves.' Hearing such cruel words, Lord Satyanārāyaṇa said, 'May what you have said come true.'
Having said this much, the ascetic sat down at the edge of the ocean a short distance away. When the ascetic master had departed, the merchant Sādhu noticed that the boat was floating high and light. He was greatly astonished. When he looked and saw only creepers and leaves in the boat, he fainted and fell to the ground. Upon regaining consciousness, he began to worry. Then his son-in-law said, 'Why do you grieve in this manner? This is the curse of the ascetic master. That ascetic is all-powerful; of this there is no doubt. Seeking refuge in him will yield the desired reward.'
Heeding his son-in-law's advice, the merchant went to the ascetic master. Bowing down to the ascetic master, he spoke with respect: 'Please forgive whatever I said to you.' Saying this and bowing again and again, he was overcome with great grief. Seeing the merchant weeping, the ascetic master said, 'Do not weep. Listen! You repeatedly neglect my worship. O fool! By my command, suffering has befallen you again and again.' The merchant began to praise Him. Sādhu said, 'O Lord, even Brahmā and the other gods are bewildered by your divine power. Even they do not know your wondrous form and qualities.'

6.3.s:
he prabhu! mujha para prasanna hoie. maiṃ māyā se bhramita mūr̤ha āpako kaise pahacāna sakatā hūṃ. kṛpayā prasanna hoie. maiṃ apanī sāmarthya se āpakā pūjana karūṃgā. dhana jaisā pahale thā vaisā kara deṃ. maiṃ śaraṇa meṃ hūṃ. rakṣā kījie. bhaktiyukta vākyoṃ ko suna janārdana saṃtuṣṭa hue. vaiśya ko usakā manacāhā vara dekara bhagavāna aṃtardhāna hue. taba vaiśya nāva para āyā aura use dhana se bharā dekhā. satyanārāyaṇa kī kṛpā se merī manokāmanā pūrṇa huī hai, yaha kahakara sādhu vaiśya ne apane sabhī sāthiyoṃ ke sātha śrī satyanārāyaṇa kī vidhipūrvaka pūjā kī. bhagavāna satyadeva kī kṛpā prāpta kara sādhu bahuta prasanna huā. nāva calane yogya banā apane deśa kī ora cala par̤ā.
apane gṛha nagara ke nikaṭa vaiśya apane dāmāda se bolā- dekho vaha merī ratnapurī hai. dhana ke rakṣaka dūta ko nagara bhejā. dūta nagara meṃ sādhu vaiśya kī strī se hātha jor̤akara ucita vākya bolā. vaiśya dāmāda ke sātha tathā bahuta-sā dhana le saṃgī-sāthī ke sātha, nagara ke nikaṭa ā gae haiṃ. dūta ke vacana suna līlāvatī bahuta prasanna huī. bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa kī pūjā pūrṇa kara apanī beṭī se bolī. maiṃ pati ke darśana ke lie calatī hūṃ. tuma jaldī āo apanī māṃ ke vacana suna putrī ne bhī vrata samāpta mānā.
prasāda lenā chor̤a apane pati ke darśanārtha cala par̤ī. bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa isase ruṣṭa ho gae aura usake pati tathā dhana se ladī nāva ko jala meṃ ḍubā diyā . kalāvatī ne vahāṃ apane pati ko nahīṃ dekhā. use bar̤ā dukha huā aura vaha rotī huī bhūmi para gira gaī. nāva ko ḍūbatī huī dekhā. kanyā ke rudana se ḍarā huā sādhu vaiśya bolā- kyā āścarya ho gayā. nāva ke mallāha bhī ciṃtā karane lage. aba to līlāvatī bhī apanī beṭī ko dukhī dekha vyākula ho pati se bolī.
isa samaya nāva sahita dāmāda kaise adṛśya ho gae haiṃ. na jāne kisa devatā ne nāva hara lī hai. prabhu satyanārāyaṇa kī mahimā kauna jāna sakatā hai. itanā kaha vaha svajanoṃ ke sātha rone lagī. phira apanī beṭī ko goda meṃ le vilāpa karane lagī. vahāṃ beṭī kalāvatī apane pati ke nahīṃ rahane para dukhī ho rahī thī. vaiśya kanyā ne pati kī khar̤āū lekara mara jāne kā vicāra kiyā. strī sahita sādhu vaiśya ne apanī beṭī kā yaha rūpa dekhā. dharmātmā sādhu vaiśya dukha se bahuta vyākula ho ciṃtā karane lagā. usane kahā ki yaha haraṇa śrī satyadeva ne kiyā hai. satya kī māyā se mohita hūṃ.
6.3.d:
हे प्रभु! मुझ पर प्रसन्न होइए. मैं माया से भ्रमित मूर्̤ह आपको कैसे पहचान सकता हूं. कृपया प्रसन्न होइए. मैं अपनी सामर्थ्य से आपका पूजन करूंगा. धन जैसा पहले था वैसा कर दें. मैं शरण में हूं. रक्षा कीजिए. भक्तियुक्त वाक्यों को सुन जनार्दन संतुष्ट हुए. वैश्य को उसका मनचाहा वर देकर भगवान अंतर्धान हुए. तब वैश्य नाव पर आया और उसे धन से भरा देखा. सत्यनारायण की कृपा से मेरी मनोकामना पूर्ण हुई है, यह कहकर साधु वैश्य ने अपने सभी साथियों के साथ श्री सत्यनारायण की विधिपूर्वक पूजा की. भगवान सत्यदेव की कृपा प्राप्त कर साधु बहुत प्रसन्न हुआ. नाव चलने योग्य बना अपने देश की ओर चल पर्̤आ.
अपने गृह नगर के निकट वैश्य अपने दामाद से बोला- देखो वह मेरी रत्नपुरी है. धन के रक्षक दूत को नगर भेजा. दूत नगर में साधु वैश्य की स्त्री से हाथ जोर्̤अकर उचित वाक्य बोला. वैश्य दामाद के साथ तथा बहुत-सा धन ले संगी-साथी के साथ, नगर के निकट आ गए हैं. दूत के वचन सुन लीलावती बहुत प्रसन्न हुई. भगवान सत्यनारायण की पूजा पूर्ण कर अपनी बेटी से बोली. मैं पति के दर्शन के लिए चलती हूं. तुम जल्दी आओ अपनी मां के वचन सुन पुत्री ने भी व्रत समाप्त माना.
प्रसाद लेना छोर्̤अ अपने पति के दर्शनार्थ चल पर्̤ई. भगवान सत्यनारायण इससे रुष्ट हो गए और उसके पति तथा धन से लदी नाव को जल में डुबा दिया . कलावती ने वहां अपने पति को नहीं देखा. उसे बर्̤आ दुख हुआ और वह रोती हुई भूमि पर गिर गई. नाव को डूबती हुई देखा. कन्या के रुदन से डरा हुआ साधु वैश्य बोला- क्या आश्चर्य हो गया. नाव के मल्लाह भी चिंता करने लगे. अब तो लीलावती भी अपनी बेटी को दुखी देख व्याकुल हो पति से बोली.
इस समय नाव सहित दामाद कैसे अदृश्य हो गए हैं. न जाने किस देवता ने नाव हर ली है. प्रभु सत्यनारायण की महिमा कौन जान सकता है. इतना कह वह स्वजनों के साथ रोने लगी. फिर अपनी बेटी को गोद में ले विलाप करने लगी. वहां बेटी कलावती अपने पति के नहीं रहने पर दुखी हो रही थी. वैश्य कन्या ने पति की खर्̤आऊ लेकर मर जाने का विचार किया. स्त्री सहित साधु वैश्य ने अपनी बेटी का यह रूप देखा. धर्मात्मा साधु वैश्य दुख से बहुत व्याकुल हो चिंता करने लगा. उसने कहा कि यह हरण श्री सत्यदेव ने किया है. सत्य की माया से मोहित हूं.
6.3.m:
"O Lord! Be gracious unto me. Deluded by your māyā, foolish as I am, how could I recognize you? Please be gracious. I will perform your worship according to my means. Restore my wealth as it was before. I take refuge in you. Please protect me!" Hearing his words full of devotion, Janārdana became pleased. Having granted the merchant his desired boon, the Lord disappeared. Then the merchant returned to the boat and saw it filled with wealth. Saying, "By the grace of Satyanārāyaṇa my desire has been fulfilled," the merchant Sādhu properly performed the worship of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa together with all his companions. Having attained the grace of Lord Satyadeva, Sādhu became very pleased. Making the boat fit to sail, he set out towards his own land.
Near his home city, the merchant said to his son-in-law: "Look, that is my Ratnapurī." He sent an emissary, who was the guardian of the wealth, to the city. Going into the city, the messenger folded his hands and spoke fitting words to the wife of the merchant Sādhu: "The merchant, together with his son-in-law, carrying abundant wealth, and accompanied by his associates, has arrived near the city." Hearing the messenger's words, Līlāvatī was overjoyed. Completing the worship of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, she said to her daughter: "I am going to behold my husband; come quickly!" Hearing her mother's words, the daughter also regarded the vrata as completed.
Leaving behind the prasāda, she set out to behold her husband. Lord Satyanārāyaṇa became angered by this, and submerged in the water the boat loaded with her husband and the wealth. Kalāvatī did not see her husband there. Filled with immense grief, she fell weeping to the ground. She saw the boat sinking. Terrified by the maiden's weeping, the merchant Sādhu said: "What a marvel has happened!" The boat's boatmen also began to worry. Now Līlāvatī too, seeing her daughter distressed, became agitated and said to her husband:
"At this moment, how have the boat and our son-in-law disappeared? One knows not which deity has seized the boat! Who can know the glory of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa?" Having said this, she began to weep along with her relatives. Then, taking her daughter onto her lap, she began to lament. There the daughter Kalāvatī was grieving over the absence of her husband. The merchant's daughter resolved to die, taking her husband's sandals. Accompanied by his wife, the merchant Sādhu saw his daughter in this state. The righteous merchant Sādhu, deeply distressed by sorrow, began to reflect. He said, "This seizure has been done by Śrī Satyadeva. I am deluded by the māyā of Satya."

6.3.s:
sabako apane pāsa bulākara usane kahā ki maiṃ savistāra satyadeva kā pūjana karūṃgā. dina pratipālana karane vāle bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa kobāraṃbāra praṇāma karane para prasanna ho gae. bhaktavatsala ne kṛpā kara yaha vacana kahe. tumhārī beṭī prasāda chor̤a pati ko dekhane āī. isī ke kāraṇa usakā pati adṛśya ho gayā. yadi yaha ghara jākara prasāda grahaṇa kare
aura phira āe. to he sādhu! ise isakā pati milegā isameṃ saṃśaya nahīṃ hai. sādhu kī beṭī ne bhī yaha ākāśavāṇī sunī.
tatkāla vaha ghara gaī aura prasāda prāpta kiyā. phira lauṭī to apane pati ko vahāṃ dekhā. taba usane apane pitā se kahā ki aba ghara calanā cāhie dera kyoṃ kara rakhī hai. apanī beṭī ke vacana suna sādhu vaiśya prasanna huā aura bhagavāna satyanārāyaṇa kā vidhi-vidhāna se pūjana kiyā. apane baṃdhu-bāṃdhavoṃ evaṃ jāmātā ko le apane ghara gayā. pūrṇimā aura saṃkrāṃti ko satyanārāyaṇa kā pūjana karatā rahā. apane jīvanakāla meṃ sukha bhogatā rahā aura aṃta meṃ śrī satyanārāyaṇa ke vaikuṃṭha loka gayā, jo avaiṣṇavoṃ ko prāpya nahīṃ hai aura jahāṃ māyākṛta (satya, raja, tama) tīna guṇoṃ kā prabhāva nahīṃ hai.
śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe satyanārāyaṇavratakathāyāṃ caturtho'dhyāya:..4..
6.3.d:
सबको अपने पास बुलाकर उसने कहा कि मैं सविस्तार सत्यदेव का पूजन करूंगा. दिन प्रतिपालन करने वाले भगवान सत्यनारायण कोबारंबार प्रणाम करने पर प्रसन्न हो गए. भक्तवत्सल ने कृपा कर यह वचन कहे. तुम्हारी बेटी प्रसाद छोर्̤अ पति को देखने आई. इसी के कारण उसका पति अदृश्य हो गया. यदि यह घर जाकर प्रसाद ग्रहण करे
और फिर आए. तो हे साधु! इसे इसका पति मिलेगा इसमें संशय नहीं है. साधु की बेटी ने भी यह आकाशवाणी सुनी.
तत्काल वह घर गई और प्रसाद प्राप्त किया. फिर लौटी तो अपने पति को वहां देखा. तब उसने अपने पिता से कहा कि अब घर चलना चाहिए देर क्यों कर रखी है. अपनी बेटी के वचन सुन साधु वैश्य प्रसन्न हुआ और भगवान सत्यनारायण का विधि-विधान से पूजन किया. अपने बंधु-बांधवों एवं जामाता को ले अपने घर गया. पूर्णिमा और संक्रांति को सत्यनारायण का पूजन करता रहा. अपने जीवनकाल में सुख भोगता रहा और अंत में श्री सत्यनारायण के वैकुंठ लोक गया, जो अवैष्णवों को प्राप्य नहीं है और जहां मायाकृत (सत्य, रज, तम) तीन गुणों का प्रभाव नहीं है.
श्रीस्कन्दपुराणे रेवाखण्डे सत्यनारायणव्रतकथायां चतुर्थोऽध्याय:..4..
6.3.m:
Summoning everyone near him, he said: "I will worship Satyadeva in detail." Upon repeatedly bowing down to Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, the protector of the helpless, [the Lord] was pleased. Tender towards his devotees, he spoke these gracious words: "Your daughter came to see her husband having left behind the prasāda. For this very reason her husband vanished. If she goes home, accepts the prasāda,
and then returns, then, O Sādhu, she will find her husband; of this there is no doubt." The merchant's daughter also heard this incorporeal voice.
Instantly she went home and received the prasāda. Returning once again, she saw her husband there. Then she said to her father: "Now we should go home; why make any delay?" Hearing his daughter's words, the merchant Sādhu was pleased and worshipped Lord Satyanārāyaṇa according to the prescribed rites. Taking his relatives and his son-in-law, he went to his home. He continued to worship Satyanārāyaṇa on every full moon and saṃkrānti day. Throughout his life he enjoyed happiness, and in the end he went to Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa's abode of Vaikuṇṭha, which is unobtainable by non-Vaiṣṇavas, and where the effect of the three guṇas (sattva, rajas, tamas) wrought by māyā does not exist.
Thus ends the fourth chapter in the Satyanārāyaṇavratakathā in the Revākhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 4.

6.3.s:
"sūta uvāca"
athānyacca pravakṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ. āsīt tuṅgadhvajo rājā prajāpālanatatparaḥ..1..
6.3.d:
"सूत उवाच"
अथान्यच्च प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः. आसीत् तुङ्गध्वजो राजा प्रजापालनतत्परः..1..
6.3.m: Sūta said: / Now I shall relate another [story]; listen, O best of sages! / There was a king named Tuṅgadhvaja, intent on protecting his subjects. / 1

6.3.s: prasādaṃ satyadevasya tyaktvā duḥkhamavāpa saḥ. ekadā sa vanaṃ gatvā hatvā bahuvidhān paśūn.. 2..
6.3.d: प्रसादं सत्यदेवस्य त्यक्त्वा दुःखमवाप सः. एकदा स वनं गत्वा हत्वा बहुविधान् पशून्.. 2..
6.3.m: Having spurned the sacred food offering of Satyadeva, he incurred suffering. / Once he went to the forest, and having killed various animals, / 2

6.3.s: āgatya vaṭamūlaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā satyasya pūjanam. gopāḥ kurvanti saṃtuṣṭā bhaktiyuktāḥ sabāndhavāḥ..3..
6.3.d: आगत्य वटमूलं च दृष्ट्वा सत्यस्य पूजनम्. गोपाः कुर्वन्ति संतुष्टा भक्तियुक्ताः सबान्धवाः..3..
6.3.m: he came to the base of a banyan tree and saw the worship of Satya, / which contented cowherds, endowed with devotion, were performing along with their kinsmen. / 3

6.3.s: rājā dṛṣṭvā tu darpeṇa na gato na nanāma saḥ. tato gopagaṇāḥ sarve prasādaṃ nṛpasannidhau..4..
6.3.d: राजा दृष्ट्वा तु दर्पेण न गतो न ननाम सः. ततो गोपगणाः सर्वे प्रसादं नृपसन्निधौ..4..
6.3.m: Yet the king, seeing it, out of arrogance neither went [there] nor bowed down. / Then all the cowherds, having placed the sacred food offering near the king, / 4

6.3.s:
saṃsthāpya punarāgatya bhuktvā sarve yathepsitam. tataḥ prasādaṃ saṃtyajya rājā duḥkhamavāpa saḥ..5..
"anuvāda:-śrīsūta jī bole – he śreṣṭha muniyo ! aba isake bāda maiṃ eka anya kathā kahūm̐gā, āpa use suneṃ. apanī prajā kā pālana karane meṃ tatpara(taiyāra rahane vālā) tuṅgadhvaja nāma kā eka rājā thā.1.
usane satyadeva (satyanārāyaṇa) ke prasāda kā parityāga karake duḥkha prāpta kiyā. eka bāra vaha vana meṃ jākara aura vahām̐ bahuta-se paśuoṃko mārakara.2.
vaha vaṭa vṛkṣa ke nīce āyā to vahām̐ usane dekhā ki gopagaṇa (ahīra loga) bandhu-bāndhavoṃ ke sātha saṃtuṣṭa hokara bhaktipūrvaka bhagavān satyadeva kī pūjā karateṃ haiṃ.3.
6.3.d:
संस्थाप्य पुनरागत्य भुक्त्वा सर्वे यथेप्सितम्. ततः प्रसादं संत्यज्य राजा दुःखमवाप सः..5..
"अनुवाद:-श्रीसूत जी बोले – हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! अब इसके बाद मैं एक अन्य कथा कहूम्̐गा, आप उसे सुनें. अपनी प्रजा का पालन करने में तत्पर(तैयार रहने वाला) तुङ्गध्वज नाम का एक राजा था.1.
उसने सत्यदेव (सत्यनारायण) के प्रसाद का परित्याग करके दुःख प्राप्त किया. एक बार वह वन में जाकर और वहाम्̐ बहुत-से पशुओंको मारकर.2.
वह वट वृक्ष के नीचे आया तो वहाम्̐ उसने देखा कि गोपगण (अहीर लोग) बन्धु-बान्धवों के साथ संतुष्ट होकर भक्तिपूर्वक भगवान् सत्यदेव की पूजा करतें हैं.3.
6.3.m:
and having returned, ate [it] according to their wish. / Then, having spurned the sacred food offering, the king incurred suffering. / 5
Translation: Śrī Sūta said: "O excellent sages! Now after this I shall tell another story; please listen to it. There was a king named Tuṅgadhvaja, devoted to protecting his subjects. 1.
He obtained suffering by forsaking the sacred food offering of Satyadeva (Satyanārāyaṇa). Once he went into the forest and, having killed many animals there, 2.
came beneath a banyan tree; there he saw that the cowherds, contented along with their kinsmen, were worshipping Lord Satyadeva with devotion. 3.

6.3.s:
rājā yaha dekhakara bhī ahaṃkāra( darpa) vaśa na to vaha rājā vahām̐ gayā aura na usane bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa ko praṇāma hī kiyā. isake bāda (pūjana ke paścāta) sabhī gopagaṇa bhagavān satya nārāyaṇa kā prasāda rājā ke samīpa meṃ.4..
rakhakara vahām̐ se puna: lauṭa kara aura icchānusāra una sabhī ne bhagavān‌kā prasāda grahaṇa kiyā. idhara rājā ko prasādakā parityāga karane se bahuta duḥkha huā.. 5..
6.3.d:
राजा यह देखकर भी अहंकार( दर्प) वश न तो वह राजा वहाम्̐ गया और न उसने भगवान् सत्यनारायण को प्रणाम ही किया. इसके बाद (पूजन के पश्चात) सभी गोपगण भगवान् सत्य नारायण का प्रसाद राजा के समीप में.4..
रखकर वहाम्̐ से पुन: लौट कर और इच्छानुसार उन सभी ने भगवान्‌का प्रसाद ग्रहण किया. इधर राजा को प्रसादका परित्याग करने से बहुत दुःख हुआ.. 5..
6.3.m:
Even upon seeing this, out of pride, the king neither went there nor did he bow to Lord Satyanārāyaṇa. Thereafter, all the cowherds placed the sacred food offering of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa near the king, 4.
and having returned from there, they all partook of the Lord's sacred food offering according to their desire. Meanwhile, because he had abandoned the sacred food offering, great sorrow befell the king. 5.

6.3.s: tasya putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ dhanadhānyādikaṃ ca yat. satyadevena tatsarvaṃ nāśitaṃ mama niścitam ..6 ..
6.3.d: तस्य पुत्रशतं नष्टं धनधान्यादिकं च यत्. सत्यदेवेन तत्सर्वं नाशितं मम निश्चितम् ..6 ..
6.3.m: His hundred sons were destroyed, along with whatever wealth, grain, and other possessions [he had]. / "All that has surely been destroyed by Satyadeva for me; / 6

6.3.s: atastatraiva gacchāmi yatra devasya pūjanam. manasā tu viniścitya yayau gopālasannidhau..7..
6.3.d: अतस्तत्रैव गच्छामि यत्र देवस्य पूजनम्. मनसा तु विनिश्चित्य ययौ गोपालसन्निधौ..7..
6.3.m: therefore, I shall go to that very place where the worship of the deity takes place." / Having resolved thus in his mind, he went near the cowherds. / 7

6.3.s: tato'sau satyadevasya pūjāṃ gopagaṇaiḥ saha. bhaktiśraddhānvito bhūtvā cakāra vidhinā nṛpaḥ..8..
6.3.d: ततोऽसौ सत्यदेवस्य पूजां गोपगणैः सह. भक्तिश्रद्धान्वितो भूत्वा चकार विधिना नृपः..8..
6.3.m: Then, accompanied by the company of cowherds, endowed with devotion and faith, / that king performed the worship of Satyadeva according to the rule. / 8

6.3.s:
satyadevena prasādena dhanaputrānvito'bhavat . ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cānte satyapuraṃ yayau..9..
"anuvāda:-
usakā sampūrṇa dhana-dhānya evaṃ sabhī sau putra naṣṭa ho gaye. rājā ne mana meṃ yaha niścaya kiyā ki avaśya ho bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa ne hamārā nāśa kara diyā hai.6.
isaliye mujhe vahīṃ jānā cāhiye jahām̐ śrīsatyanārāyaṇa kā pūjana ho rahā thā. aisā mana meṃ niścaya karake vaha rājā gopagaṇoṃ( ahīroṃ) ke samīpa gayā.7.
aura usane gopagaṇoṃ ke sātha bhakti-śraddhā se yukta hokara vidhipūrvaka bhagavān satyadeva kī pūjā kī.8..
bhagavān satyadeva kī kṛpā se vaha punaḥ dhana aura putroṃ se sampanna ho gayā tathā isa loka meṃ sabhī sukhoṃ ko upabhogakara anta meṃ satyapura (vaikuṇṭhaloka)- ko calā gayā..9..
6.3.d:
सत्यदेवेन प्रसादेन धनपुत्रान्वितोऽभवत् . इहलोके सुखं भुक्त्वा चान्ते सत्यपुरं ययौ..9..
"अनुवाद:-
उसका सम्पूर्ण धन-धान्य एवं सभी सौ पुत्र नष्ट हो गये. राजा ने मन में यह निश्चय किया कि अवश्य हो भगवान् सत्यनारायण ने हमारा नाश कर दिया है.6.
इसलिये मुझे वहीं जाना चाहिये जहाम्̐ श्रीसत्यनारायण का पूजन हो रहा था. ऐसा मन में निश्चय करके वह राजा गोपगणों( अहीरों) के समीप गया.7.
और उसने गोपगणों के साथ भक्ति-श्रद्धा से युक्त होकर विधिपूर्वक भगवान् सत्यदेव की पूजा की.8..
भगवान् सत्यदेव की कृपा से वह पुनः धन और पुत्रों से सम्पन्न हो गया तथा इस लोक में सभी सुखों को उपभोगकर अन्त में सत्यपुर (वैकुण्ठलोक)- को चला गया..9..
6.3.m:
By the grace of Satyadeva, he became endowed with wealth and sons. / Having enjoyed happiness in this world, at the end he went to the city of Satya. / 9
Translation: All his wealth and grain and all his hundred sons were destroyed. The king resolved in his mind that surely Lord Satyanārāyaṇa had caused his ruin. 6.
"Therefore, I should go to that very place where the worship of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa was taking place." Having decided thus in his mind, the king went near the cowherds. 7.
And together with the cowherds, filled with devotion and faith, he duly worshipped Lord Satyadeva. 8.
By the grace of Lord Satyadeva, he was again endowed with wealth and sons, and having enjoyed all pleasures in this world, at the end he went to Satyapura (the world of Vaikuṇṭha). 9.

6.3.s: ya idaṃ kurute satyavrataṃ paramadurlabham. śṛṇoti ca kathāṃ puṇyāṃ bhaktiyuktaḥ phalapradām ..10..
6.3.d: य इदं कुरुते सत्यव्रतं परमदुर्लभम्. शृणोति च कथां पुण्यां भक्तियुक्तः फलप्रदाम् ..10..
6.3.m: Whoever undertakes this most rare vow of Satya, / and, endowed with devotion, listens to this sacred, fruit-granting story, / 10

6.3.s: dhanadhānyādikaṃ tasya bhavet satyaprasādataḥ. daridro labhate vittaṃ baddho mucyet bandhanāt .. 11..
6.3.d: धनधान्यादिकं तस्य भवेत् सत्यप्रसादतः. दरिद्रो लभते वित्तं बद्धो मुच्येत् बन्धनात् .. 11..
6.3.m: shall obtain wealth, grain, and the like by the grace of Satya; / a poor man obtains wealth, and a bound person is freed from bondage; / 11

6.3.s: bhīto bhayāt pramucyet satyameva na saṃśayaḥ. īpsitaṃ ca phalaṃ bhuktvā cānte satyapuraṃ vrajet .. 12 ..
6.3.d: भीतो भयात् प्रमुच्येत् सत्यमेव न संशयः. ईप्सितं च फलं भुक्त्वा चान्ते सत्यपुरं व्रजेत् .. 12 ..
6.3.m: one who is frightened is liberated from fear—this is truly so, without doubt— / and having enjoyed his desired fruit, at the end he goes to the city of Satya. / 12

6.3.s:
iti vaḥ kathitaṃ viprāḥ satyanārāyaṇavratam. yat kṛtvā sarvaduḥ khebhyo mukto bhavati mānavaḥ..13..
"anuvāda:-
sūta jī kahate haiṃ- jo vyakti isa parama durlabha śrīsatyanārāyaṇa ke vrata ko karatā aura puṇyamayī tathā phalapradāyinī kathā ko bhaktiyukta hokara sunatā hai..10.
use bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa kī kṛpā se dhana-dhānya ādi kī prāpti hotī hai. daridra ke ghara meṃ dhana ho jātā hai, bandhana meṃ par̤ā huā bandhana se chūṭa jātā hai.11..
ḍarā huā vyakti bhaya se mukta ho jātā hai-yaha satya bāta hai, isameṃ saṃśaya nahīṃ. (isa lokameṃ vaha sabhī icchita phaloṃ kā bhoga prāpta karake anta meṃ satyapura (vaikuṇṭhaloka) ko jātā hai.12.
he brāhmaṇo ! isa prakāra maiṃne āpa logoṃ se bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa ke vrata ko kahā, jise karake manuṣya sabhī duḥkhoṃ se mukta ho jātā hai ..13 ..
6.3.d:
इति वः कथितं विप्राः सत्यनारायणव्रतम्. यत् कृत्वा सर्वदुः खेभ्यो मुक्तो भवति मानवः..13..
"अनुवाद:-
सूत जी कहते हैं- जो व्यक्ति इस परम दुर्लभ श्रीसत्यनारायण के व्रत को करता और पुण्यमयी तथा फलप्रदायिनी कथा को भक्तियुक्त होकर सुनता है..10.
उसे भगवान् सत्यनारायण की कृपा से धन-धान्य आदि की प्राप्ति होती है. दरिद्र के घर में धन हो जाता है, बन्धन में पर्̤आ हुआ बन्धन से छूट जाता है.11..
डरा हुआ व्यक्ति भय से मुक्त हो जाता है-यह सत्य बात है, इसमें संशय नहीं. (इस लोकमें वह सभी इच्छित फलों का भोग प्राप्त करके अन्त में सत्यपुर (वैकुण्ठलोक) को जाता है.12.
हे ब्राह्मणो ! इस प्रकार मैंने आप लोगों से भगवान् सत्यनारायण के व्रत को कहा, जिसे करके मनुष्य सभी दुःखों से मुक्त हो जाता है ..13 ..
6.3.m:
Thus has the observance of Satyanārāyaṇa been told to you, O brahmins, / by performing which a human being is freed from all miseries. (13)
"Translation:— Sūta says: Whichever person performs this most rare observance of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa and, endowed with devotion, listens to the meritorious, fruit-bestowing tale… (10)
by the grace of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, he attains wealth, grain, and the like. Wealth comes to the house of the poor man, and he who is bound is freed from bondage. (11)
The frightened person is freed from fear—this is the truth, there is no doubt about it. Having enjoyed all desired fruits [in this world], in the end he goes to Satyaloka (Vaikuṇṭhaloka). (12)
O brahmins! Thus have I told you of the observance of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, by performing which a person becomes free from all miseries. (13)

6.3.s: viśeṣataḥ kaliyuge satyapūjā phalapradā. kecit kālaṃ vadiṣyanti satyamīśaṃ tameva ca.. 14..
6.3.d: विशेषतः कलियुगे सत्यपूजा फलप्रदा. केचित् कालं वदिष्यन्ति सत्यमीशं तमेव च.. 14..
6.3.m: Especially in the Kali age, the worship of Satya bestows fruits. / Some will speak of Time, [some of] Satya, and others indeed of Īśa; (14)

6.3.s: satyanārāyaṇaṃ kecit satyadevaṃ tathāpare. nānārūpadharo bhūtvā sarveṣāmīpsitapradam..15..
6.3.d: सत्यनारायणं केचित् सत्यदेवं तथापरे. नानारूपधरो भूत्वा सर्वेषामीप्सितप्रदम्..15..
6.3.m: some [call him] Satyanārāyaṇa, and others likewise Satyadeva. / Assuming various forms, he grants what is desired to all. (15)

6.3.s: bhaviṣyati kalau satyavratarūpī sanātanaḥ. śrīviṣṇunā dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ sarveṣāmīpsitapradam..16..
6.3.d: भविष्यति कलौ सत्यव्रतरूपी सनातनः. श्रीविष्णुना धृतं रूपं सर्वेषामीप्सितप्रदम्..16..
6.3.m: In the Kali age, the eternal Lord, having taken the form of the observance of Satya, will be present; / this form, assumed by Śrī Viṣṇu, grants what is desired to all. (16)

6.3.s: ya idaṃ paṭhet nityaṃ śṛṇoti munisattamāḥ. tasya naśyanti pāpāni satyadevaprasādataḥ..17..
6.3.d: य इदं पठेत् नित्यं शृणोति मुनिसत्तमाः. तस्य नश्यन्ति पापानि सत्यदेवप्रसादतः..17..
6.3.m: Whoever recites this daily or hears it, O best of sages, / his sins are destroyed by the grace of Satyadeva. (17)

6.3.s:
vrataṃ vaistu kṛtaṃ pūrva satyanārāyaṇasya ca. teṣāṃ tvaparajanmāni kathayāmi munīśvarāḥ..18..
"anuvāda:-kaliyuga meṃ to bhagavān satyadeva (satyanārāyaṇa) kī pūjā viśeṣa phala pradāna karane vālī hai. bhagavān viṣṇu ko hī kucha loga kāla, kucha loga satya, koī īśa.14.
aura koī satyadeva tathā dūsare loga satyanārāyaṇa nāma se kaheṃge. aneka rūpa dhāraṇa karake bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa sabhī kā manoratha siddha karate haiṃ.15.
kaliyuga meṃ sanātana bhagavān viṣṇu hī satyavrata-rūpa dhāraṇa karake sabhī kā manoratha pūrṇa karanevāle hoṃge.16.
he śreṣṭha muniyo. jo vyakti nitya bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa kī isa vrata-kathā ko par̤hatā hai, sunatā hai, bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa kī kṛpā se usake sabhī pāpa naṣṭa ho jāte haiṃ.17.
6.3.d:
व्रतं वैस्तु कृतं पूर्व सत्यनारायणस्य च. तेषां त्वपरजन्मानि कथयामि मुनीश्वराः..18..
"अनुवाद:-कलियुग में तो भगवान् सत्यदेव (सत्यनारायण) की पूजा विशेष फल प्रदान करने वाली है. भगवान् विष्णु को ही कुछ लोग काल, कुछ लोग सत्य, कोई ईश.14.
और कोई सत्यदेव तथा दूसरे लोग सत्यनारायण नाम से कहेंगे. अनेक रूप धारण करके भगवान् सत्यनारायण सभी का मनोरथ सिद्ध करते हैं.15.
कलियुग में सनातन भगवान् विष्णु ही सत्यव्रत-रूप धारण करके सभी का मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाले होंगे.16.
हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो. जो व्यक्ति नित्य भगवान् सत्यनारायण की इस व्रत-कथा को पर्̤हता है, सुनता है, भगवान् सत्यनारायण की कृपा से उसके सभी पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं.17.
6.3.m:
Those by whom the observance of Satyanārāyaṇa was previously performed— / I shall tell you of their other births, O lords of sages! (18)
"Translation:—In the Kali age, worship of Lord Satyadeva (Satyanārāyaṇa) especially grants fruits. Indeed, some people will call Lord Viṣṇu Kāla, some Satya, some Īśa, (14)
and some Satyadeva, and other people will speak of him by the name Satyanārāyaṇa. Assuming multiple forms, Lord Satyanārāyaṇa fulfills everyone's desires. (15)
In the Kali age, the eternal Lord Viṣṇu himself, having assumed the form of the Satya-observance, will fulfill the desires of all. (16)
O excellent sages! Whichever person daily reads or hears this narrative of the observance of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa, all his sins are destroyed by the grace of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa. (17)

6.3.s: he munīśvaro! pūrvakāla meṃ jina logoṃ ne bhagavān satyanārāyaṇa kā vrata kiyā thā, unake agale janma kā vṛttānta kahatā hūm̐, āpa loga use suneṃ..18..
6.3.d: हे मुनीश्वरो! पूर्वकाल में जिन लोगों ने भगवान् सत्यनारायण का व्रत किया था, उनके अगले जन्म का वृत्तान्त कहता हूम्̐, आप लोग उसे सुनें..18..
6.3.m: O lords of sages! The account of the future births of those people who performed the observance of Lord Satyanārāyaṇa in earlier times, I shall tell; listen to it. (18)

6.3.s:
__________
"śatānando mahāprājñaḥ sudāmā brāhmaṇo hyabhūt. tasmiñjanmani śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvā mokṣamavāpa ha ..19..
6.3.d:
__________
"शतानन्दो महाप्राज्ञः सुदामा ब्राह्मणो ह्यभूत्. तस्मिञ्जन्मनि श्रीकृष्णं ध्यात्वा मोक्षमवाप ह ..19..
6.3.m:
__________
"The greatly wise Śatānanda became the brahmin Sudāman; / in that birth, having meditated upon Śrī Kṛṣṇa, he attained liberation. (19)

6.3.s:
śabdārtha- śatānanda:( prathamā vibhakti eka vacana kartākāraka- . mahāprājña:= mahatī prajñā( prakṛṣṭaṃ jñāpayati yayā iti prajñā- (viveka baddhi).sudāmā brāhmaṇa: hi abhūt =sudāmā nāmaka brāhmaṇa huā.abhūt = bhū -dhātu rūpa - kartari prayoga luṅ lakāra parasmaipada prathama puruṣa ekavacana. tasmin + janmani = usa janma meṃ. śrīkṛṣṇaṃ = śrīkṛṣṇa ko . dhyātvā= dhyai- dhātu + ktvā pratyaya. dhyāna karake. mokṣaṃ = mukti ko. avāpa= prāpta kiyā. ha = niścaya hī.
"kāṣṭhabhāravaho bhillo guharājo babhūva ha. tasmiñjanmani śrīrāmaṃ sevya mokṣaṃ jagāma vai.. 20..
6.3.d:
शब्दार्थ- शतानन्द:( प्रथमा विभक्ति एक वचन कर्ताकारक- . महाप्राज्ञ:= महती प्रज्ञा( प्रकृष्टं ज्ञापयति यया इति प्रज्ञा- (विवेक बद्धि).सुदामा ब्राह्मण: हि अभूत् =सुदामा नामक ब्राह्मण हुआ.अभूत् = भू -धातु रूप - कर्तरि प्रयोग लुङ् लकार परस्मैपद प्रथम पुरुष एकवचन. तस्मिन् + जन्मनि = उस जन्म में. श्रीकृष्णं = श्रीकृष्ण को . ध्यात्वा= ध्यै- धातु + क्त्वा प्रत्यय. ध्यान करके. मोक्षं = मुक्ति को. अवाप= प्राप्त किया. ह = निश्चय ही.
"काष्ठभारवहो भिल्लो गुहराजो बभूव ह. तस्मिञ्जन्मनि श्रीरामं सेव्य मोक्षं जगाम वै.. 20..
6.3.m:
Word-meanings: śatānandaḥ = (nominative singular, agent-case). mahāprājñaḥ = one of great wisdom (prajñā = intellect endowed with discernment, by which one comprehends exceptionally). sudāmā brāhmaṇaḥ hi abhūt = indeed became the brahmin named Sudāmā. abhūt = verbal form of bhū — active voice (kartari prayoga), aorist (luṅ lakāra), parasmaipada, third person singular. tasmin + janmani = in that birth. śrīkṛṣṇaṃ = Śrī Kṛṣṇa. dhyātvā = root dhyai + ktvā suffix: having meditated upon. mokṣaṃ = liberation. avāpa = attained. ha = indeed.
"The wood-carrying Bhilla indeed became king Guha; / In that birth, having served Śrī Rāma, he surely attained liberation. 20.

6.3.s:
śabdārtha:- kāṣṭhabhāravaha: = lakar̤ahārā. bhilla: guharāja: babhūva= bhīla guharāja huā. ha= niścaya hī. tasmin + janmani = usa janma meṃ. śrīrāmaṃ sevya= śrīrāma kī sevākarake. mokṣaṃ jagāma vai= niścaya hī mokṣa ko prāpta huā. jagāma= gam- dhātu - gam- prāptau gatau ca- liṭ lakāra kartari prayoga parasmaipada ; ekavacana kartākāraka rūpa.
"ulkāmukho mahārājo nṛpo daśaratho'bhavat. śrīraṅganāthaṃ sampūjya śrīvaikuṇṭhaṃ tadāgamat ..21..
6.3.d:
शब्दार्थ:- काष्ठभारवह: = लकर्̤अहारा. भिल्ल: गुहराज: बभूव= भील गुहराज हुआ. ह= निश्चय ही. तस्मिन् + जन्मनि = उस जन्म में. श्रीरामं सेव्य= श्रीराम की सेवाकरके. मोक्षं जगाम वै= निश्चय ही मोक्ष को प्राप्त हुआ. जगाम= गम्- धातु - गम्- प्राप्तौ गतौ च- लिट् लकार कर्तरि प्रयोग परस्मैपद ; एकवचन कर्ताकारक रूप.
"उल्कामुखो महाराजो नृपो दशरथोऽभवत्. श्रीरङ्गनाथं सम्पूज्य श्रीवैकुण्ठं तदागमत् ..21..
6.3.m:
Word-meanings: kāṣṭhabhāravahaḥ = woodcutter. bhillaḥ guharājaḥ babhūva = the Bhilla became king Guha. ha = indeed. tasmin + janmani = in that birth. śrīrāmaṃ sevya = having served Śrī Rāma. mokṣaṃ jagāma vai = surely attained liberation. jagāma = root gam (in the sense of attaining and going), perfect tense (liṭ lakāra), active voice (kartari prayoga), parasmaipada, singular form of the nominative/agent.
"The great king Ulkāmukha became king Daśaratha; / Having worshipped Śrī Raṅganātha, he then went to glorious Vaikuṇṭha. 21.

6.3.s:
śabdārtha:- ulkāmukha: +mahārāja:+nṛpa:+ daśaratha:+abhavat= ulkāmukha mahārāja [dūsare janma meṃ ] rājā daśaratha hue. śrīraṅganāthaṃ sampūjya śrīvaikuṇṭhaṃ tadāgamat= śrīraṃganātha(dakṣiṇa bhārata meṃ viṣṇu kā svarūpa) kī bhalībhām̐ti pūjākara taba ve vaikuṇṭha dhāma ko cale gaye.
"dhārmikaḥ satyasandhaśca sādhurmoradhvajo'bhavat. dehārdhaṃ krakacaiśchittvā dattvā mokṣamavāpa ha..22..
6.3.d:
शब्दार्थ:- उल्कामुख: +महाराज:+नृप:+ दशरथ:+अभवत्= उल्कामुख महाराज [दूसरे जन्म में ] राजा दशरथ हुए. श्रीरङ्गनाथं सम्पूज्य श्रीवैकुण्ठं तदागमत्= श्रीरंगनाथ(दक्षिण भारत में विष्णु का स्वरूप) की भलीभाम्̐ति पूजाकर तब वे वैकुण्ठ धाम को चले गये.
"धार्मिकः सत्यसन्धश्च साधुर्मोरध्वजोऽभवत्. देहार्धं क्रकचैश्छित्त्वा दत्त्वा मोक्षमवाप ह..22..
6.3.m:
Word-meaning: Ulkāmukha, the great king, became King Daśaratha [in another birth]. Having properly worshipped Śrī Raṅganātha, he then went to Vaikuṇṭha.
“The righteous and true-to-his-promise Sādhu became [King] Moradhvaja. / Having cut his body in half with saws and given it away, he truly attained liberation. 22

6.3.s:
śabdārtha:- dhārmika:= dharmakarmakaranevālā. satyasandha= satya pratijñā karane vālā:+ sādhu = sādhu nāmaka vaiśya + mayūradhvaja:+ abhavat.= mayūra dhvaja nāmaka rājā huā. dehārdhaṃ= ādhī deha ko . krakacaiśchittvā = āre se ciravākara( kaṭavākara. dattvāmokṣaṃ+ avāpa ha.= aura usa deha ko dekara niścaya hī mokṣa ko prāpta kiyā.
"tuṅgadhvajo mahārājaḥ svāyambhuvo'bhavat kila. sarvān bhāgavatān kṛtvā śrīvaikuṇṭhaṃ tadā'gamat.. 23..
6.3.d:
शब्दार्थ:- धार्मिक:= धर्मकर्मकरनेवाला. सत्यसन्ध= सत्य प्रतिज्ञा करने वाला:+ साधु = साधु नामक वैश्य + मयूरध्वज:+ अभवत्.= मयूर ध्वज नामक राजा हुआ. देहार्धं= आधी देह को . क्रकचैश्छित्त्वा = आरे से चिरवाकर( कटवाकर. दत्त्वामोक्षं+ अवाप ह.= और उस देह को देकर निश्चय ही मोक्ष को प्राप्त किया.
"तुङ्गध्वजो महाराजः स्वायम्भुवोऽभवत् किल. सर्वान् भागवतान् कृत्वा श्रीवैकुण्ठं तदाऽगमत्.. 23..
6.3.m:
Word-meaning: dhārmikaḥ = performer of virtuous deeds; satyasandhaḥ = true to his promise; sādhuḥ = the merchant named Sādhu; moradhvajaḥ abhavat = became the king named Mayūradhvaja; dehārdham = half his body; krakacaiḥ chittvā = having sawn apart (cut) with saws; dattvā mokṣam avāpa ha = and having offered [it], he attained liberation.
“The great king Tuṅgadhvaja indeed became Svāyambhuva [Manu]. / Having made everyone devotees of the Lord, he then went to holy Vaikuṇṭha. 23

6.3.s:
śabdārtha:-tuṅgadhvajo mahārājaḥ svāyambhuvo'bhavat kila .= tuṃgadhvaja mahārāja kālāntara meṃ niścaya hī svāyambhuva hue . sarvān bhāgavatān kṛtvā = sabhī bhagavata bhaktoṃ ko . kṛtvā= karake .śrīvaikuṇṭhaṃ tadā'gamat = taba vaikuṇṭha ko gaye.
"bhūtvā gopāśca te sarve vrajamaṇḍalavāsinaḥ. nihatya rākṣasān sarvān golokaṃ tu tadā yayuḥ..24 ..
śabdārtha:-
satyanārāyaṇa kī vana meṃ kathākarane vāle ve sabhī gopagaṇa hī vrajamaṇḍala meṃ ( bhūtvā = janma lekara /hokara )
6.3.d:
शब्दार्थ:-तुङ्गध्वजो महाराजः स्वायम्भुवोऽभवत् किल .= तुंगध्वज महाराज कालान्तर में निश्चय ही स्वायम्भुव हुए . सर्वान् भागवतान् कृत्वा = सभी भगवत भक्तों को . कृत्वा= करके .श्रीवैकुण्ठं तदाऽगमत् = तब वैकुण्ठ को गये.
"भूत्वा गोपाश्च ते सर्वे व्रजमण्डलवासिनः. निहत्य राक्षसान् सर्वान् गोलोकं तु तदा ययुः..24 ..
शब्दार्थ:-
सत्यनारायण की वन में कथाकरने वाले वे सभी गोपगण ही व्रजमण्डल में ( भूत्वा = जन्म लेकर /होकर )
6.3.m:
Word-meaning: tuṅgadhvajo mahārājaḥ svāyambhuvo'bhavat kila = the great king Tuṅgadhvaja indeed became Svāyambhuva in the course of time; sarvān bhāgavatān kṛtvā = having made all devotees of the Lord; śrīvaikuṇṭhaṃ tadā'gamat = then he went to Vaikuṇṭha.
“And all those cowherds, having become dwellers in the circle of Vraja, / slew all the demons and then went to Goloka. 24”
Word-meaning:
All those cowherds who performed the recitation of Satyanārāyaṇa in the forest, [having taken birth / having become] in the circle of Vraja,

6.3.s:
gopā:= gopagaṇa. te sarve = ve saba. vrajamaṇḍalavāsinaḥ= vrajamaṇḍala ke nivāsī.
nihatya= mārakara. rākṣasān sarvān = sabhī rākṣasoṃ ko .
golokaṃ tu tadā yayuḥ= isake paścāta go-loka ko cale gaye.
mahān prajñāsampanna śatānanda nāma ke brāhmaṇa [satyanārāyaṇakā vrata karaneke prabhāvase] dūsare janma meṃ sudāmā nāmaka brāhmaṇa hue aura usa janma meṃ bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇa kā dhyāna karake unhoṃne mokṣa prāpta kiyā.19.
lakar̤a‌hārā bhilloṃ kā rājā guharāja huā aura agale janmameṃ usane bhagavān śrīrāmakī sevā karake mokṣa prāpta kiyā.20.
mahārāja ulkāmukha [dūsare janma meṃ] rājā daśaratha hue, jinhoṃne śrīraṅganātha ( viṣṇu) kī pūjā karake anta meṃ vaikuṇṭha prāpta kiyā.21.
6.3.d:

6.3.m:
Likewise, the righteous and truth-observing Sādhu [by the power of the vow of truth from his past birth] became the king named Moradhvaja in another birth. Having sawn apart half the body of his son and offered it to Lord Viṣṇu, he attained liberation. 22.
The great king Tuṅgadhvaja was Svāyambhuva Manu in his former birth, and having performed all duties dedicated to the Lord, he attained the world of Vaikuṇṭha. Those who were cowherds became cowherds dwelling in the circle of Vraja in another birth, and having slain all the demons, they too attained the eternal realm of the Lord—Goloka. 19–24.
Thus ends the fifth chapter in the story of the vow of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa, in the Revākhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 5.
In this manner, this fifth chapter of the story of the vow of Śrī Satyanārāyaṇa within the Revākhaṇḍa of the glorious Skandapurāṇa is completed. 5.

The arrival of the seers to behold the impaled Māṇḍavya; description of the seers preparing to curse the king; then the great seer Māṇḍavya describing the ripening of karma to the seers; the seers returning to their own hermitages by Māṇḍavya's command; the arrival there of the sick seer Śāṇḍilya carried on the shoulder of his wife; when Śāṇḍilya's wife inadvertently stumbled and touched the pole of the stake with her feet, the dialogue between Māṇḍavya—who was tormented by the shaking of the stake caused by that collision—and Śāṇḍilya's wife; the mutual pronouncing of curses upon each other.

devānpitṝnsamabhyarcya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 184.4 ..
6.3.d:
यस्तु सम्यग्विधानेन तत्र स्नात्वार्चयेच्छिवम् .
देवान्पितॄन्समभ्यर्च्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 184.4 ..
6.3.m: He who, having bathed there according to proper rule, worships Śiva, / and honors the gods and ancestors, is freed from all sins. 184.4

6.3.s:
brahmahatyā gavāṃ vadhyā tatra tīrthe yudhiṣṭhira .
praviśenna sadā bhītā praviṣṭāpi kṣayaṃ vrajet .. 184.5 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्या गवां वध्या तत्र तीर्थे युधिष्ठिर .
प्रविशेन्न सदा भीता प्रविष्टापि क्षयं व्रजेत् .. 184.5 ..
6.3.m: The sin of killing a brahmin and the slaughter of cows, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / would never enter that sacred ford, terrified; even if entered, it would perish. 184.5

6.3.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca -
āścaryabhūtaṃ loke'sminkathayasva dvijottama .
praviśenna brahmahatyā yathā vai dhautapāpmani .. 184.6 ..
6.3.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच -
आश्चर्यभूतं लोकेऽस्मिन्कथयस्व द्विजोत्तम .
प्रविशेन्न ब्रह्महत्या यथा वै धौतपाप्मनि .. 184.6 ..
6.3.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Speak of this wonderful thing in this world, O best of the twice-born: / how indeed the sin of killing a brahmin does not enter Dhautapāpa. 184.6

6.3.s:
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavitā neha kiṃcana .
kathaṃ vā dhautapāpe tu praviṣṭaṃ naśyate dvija .
etadvistarataḥ sarvaṃ pṛcchāmi vada kautukāt .. 184.7 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापं भविता नेह किंचन .
कथं वा धौतपापे तु प्रविष्टं नश्यते द्विज .
एतद्विस्तरतः सर्वं पृच्छामि वद कौतुकात् .. 184.7 ..
6.3.m: There is no sin here equal to the killing of a brahmin. / How then does that which has entered Dhautapāpa perish, O twice-born one? / I ask all of this in detail; speak out of curiosity.

6.3.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca -
ādisarge purā śambhurbrahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .
vikāraṃ pañcamaṃ dṛṣṭvā śiro'śvamukhasannibham .. 184.8 ..
6.3.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच -
आदिसर्गे पुरा शम्भुर्ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः .
विकारं पञ्चमं दृष्ट्वा शिरोऽश्वमुखसन्निभम् .. 184.8 ..
6.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Long ago, in the first creation, Śambhu, seeing the unnatural fifth head / Of Brahmā the Supreme Lord, resembling the head of a horse,

6.3.s:
aṅguṣṭhāṅguliyogena tacchirastena kṛntitam .
kṛttamātre tu śirasi brahmahatyā'bhavattadā .. 184.9 ..
6.3.d:
अङ्गुष्ठाङ्गुलियोगेन तच्छिरस्तेन कृन्तितम् .
कृत्तमात्रे तु शिरसि ब्रह्महत्याऽभवत्तदा .. 184.9 ..
6.3.m: Severed that head with the join of his thumb and finger. / But as soon as the head was cut off, the murder of a brahmin arose then.

6.3.s:
brahmahatyāyutaścāsīduttare narmadātaṭe .
dhunitaṃ tu yato rājanvṛṣeṇa dharmamūrtinā .. 184.10 ..
6.3.d:
ब्रह्महत्यायुतश्चासीदुत्तरे नर्मदातटे .
धुनितं तु यतो राजन्वृषेण धर्ममूर्तिना .. 184.10 ..
6.3.m: And he was accompanied by the murder of a brahmin on the northern bank of the Narmadā, / Where it was shaken off, O king, by the bull whose form is righteousness.

6.3.s:
tatra dhauteśvarīṃ devīṃ sthāpitāṃ vṛṣabheṇa tu .
dadarśa bhagavāñchambhuḥ sarvadaivatapūjitām .. 184.11 ..
6.3.d:
तत्र धौतेश्वरीं देवीं स्थापितां वृषभेण तु .
ददर्श भगवाञ्छम्भुः सर्वदैवतपूजिताम् .. 184.11 ..
6.3.m: There the blessed Śambhu beheld the goddess Dhauteśvarī, / Established by the bull and worshipped by all the gods.

6.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā dhauteśvarīṃ durgāṃ brahmahatyāvināśinīm .
tatra viśramamāṇaśca śaṅkarastripurāntakaḥ .. 184.12 ..
6.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा धौतेश्वरीं दुर्गां ब्रह्महत्याविनाशिनीम् .
तत्र विश्रममाणश्च शङ्करस्त्रिपुरान्तकः .. 184.12 ..
6.3.m: Having beheld Durgā, Dhauteśvarī, who destroys the murder of a brahmin, / Śaṅkara, the destroyer of Tripura, resting there,

6.3.s:
sa śaṅkaro brahmahatyāvihīnaṃ mene tmānaṃ tasya tīrthasya bhāvāt .
suvismito devadevo vareṇyo dṛṣṭvā dūre brahmahatyāṃ ca tīrthāt .. 184.13 ..
6.3.d:
स शङ्करो ब्रह्महत्याविहीनं मेने त्मानं तस्य तीर्थस्य भावात् .
सुविस्मितो देवदेवो वरेण्यो दृष्ट्वा दूरे ब्रह्महत्यां च तीर्थात् .. 184.13 ..
6.3.m: That Śaṅkara considered himself freed from the murder of a brahmin through the power of that sacred ford. / Amazed, the chosen god of gods, having seen the murder of a brahmin far from the sacred ford,

6.3.s:
vidhautapāpaṃ mahitaṃ dharmaśaktyā viśenna hatyā devībhayātprabhītā .
raktāmbarā raktamālyopayuktā kṛṣṇā nārī raktadāmaprasaktā .. 184.14 ..
6.3.d:
विधौतपापं महितं धर्मशक्त्या विशेन्न हत्या देवीभयात्प्रभीता .
रक्ताम्बरा रक्तमाल्योपयुक्ता कृष्णा नारी रक्तदामप्रसक्ता .. 184.14 ..
6.3.m: Where sins are cleansed, honoured by the power of righteousness, the murder would not enter, terrified through fear of the goddess— / A black woman dressed in red garments, adorned with red garlands, clinging to a red cord,

6.3.s:
māṃ vāñchantī skandhadeśaṃ rahasye dūre sthitā tīrthavaryaprabhāvāt .
saṃcintya devo manasā smarārirvāsāya buddhiṃ tatra tīrthe cakāra .. 184.15 ..
6.3.d:
मां वाञ्छन्ती स्कन्धदेशं रहस्ये दूरे स्थिता तीर्थवर्यप्रभावात् .
संचिन्त्य देवो मनसा स्मरारिर्वासाय बुद्धिं तत्र तीर्थे चकार .. 184.15 ..
6.3.m: Desiring my shoulder-region in secret, yet standing afar through the power of the excellent sacred ford. / Reflecting thus in his mind, the god, the enemy of Smara, resolved to reside at that sacred ford.

6.3.s:
vimṛśya devo bahuśaḥ sthitaḥ svayaṃ vidhautapāpaḥ prathitaḥ pṛthivyām .
babhūva tatraiva nivāsakārī vidhūtapāpanikaṭapradeśe .. 184.16 ..
6.3.d:
विमृश्य देवो बहुशः स्थितः स्वयं विधौतपापः प्रथितः पृथिव्याम् .
बभूव तत्रैव निवासकारी विधूतपापनिकटप्रदेशे .. 184.16 ..
6.3.m: Reflecting much, the god himself stayed, his sins cleansed, renowned throughout the earth; / Right there he made his abode, in the region near Vidhūtapāpa.

6.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti rājendra brahmahatyāvināśanam .
vidhautapāpaṃ tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vyavasthitam .. 184.17 ..
6.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति राजेन्द्र ब्रह्महत्याविनाशनम् .
विधौतपापं तत्तीर्थं नर्मदायां व्यवस्थितम् .. 184.17 ..
6.3.m: From that time on, O best of kings, that sacred ford Vidhautapāpa, / The destroyer of the murder of a brahmin, has been situated on the Narmadā.

6.3.s:
āśvayukśuklanavamī tatra tīrthe viśiṣyate .
dinatrayaṃ tu rājendra saptamyādiviśeṣataḥ .. 184.18 ..
6.3.d:
आश्वयुक्शुक्लनवमी तत्र तीर्थे विशिष्यते .
दिनत्रयं तु राजेन्द्र सप्तम्यादिविशेषतः .. 184.18 ..
6.3.m: The bright ninth day of Āśvina is especially celebrated at that sacred ford, / For a span of three days, O best of kings, particularly beginning with the seventh.

6.3.s:
samupoṣyāṣṭamīṃ bhaktyā sāṅgaṃ vedaṃ paṭhettu yaḥ .
ahorātreṇa caikena ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñakam .. 184.19 ..
6.3.d:
समुपोष्याष्टमीं भक्त्या साङ्गं वेदं पठेत्तु यः .
अहोरात्रेण चैकेन ऋग्यजुःसामसंज्ञकम् .. 184.19 ..
6.3.m: Having fasted with devotion on the eighth, whoever recites the Veda together with its auxiliary limbs / For one day and night, known as the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman,

6.3.s:
abhyasanbrahmahatyāyā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .
vṛṣalīgamanaṃ caiva yaśca gurvaṅganāgamaḥ .. 184.20 ..
6.3.d:
अभ्यसन्ब्रह्महत्याया मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .
वृषलीगमनं चैव यश्च गुर्वङ्गनागमः .. 184.20 ..
6.3.m: While studying it, he is freed from the murder of a brahmin; there is no doubt in this. / And also intercourse with a Śūdra woman, and approaching the wife of a guru—

6.3.s:
snātvā brahmarasotkṛṣṭe kumbhenaiva pramucyate .
vandhyā strījananī yā tu kākavandhyā mṛtaprajā .. 184.21 ..
6.3.d:
स्नात्वा ब्रह्मरसोत्कृष्टे कुम्भेनैव प्रमुच्यते .
वन्ध्या स्त्रीजननी या तु काकवन्ध्या मृतप्रजा .. 184.21 ..
6.3.m: Having bathed with a pot in that which is exalted by the essence of Brahmā, one is completely freed. / A barren woman, or one who gives birth only to daughters, or who bears a single child, or whose offspring die—

6.3.s:
sāpi kumbhodakaiḥ snātā jīvatputrā prajāvatī .
apaṭhastu naropoṣya ṛgyajuḥsāmasambhavām .. 184.22 ..
6.3.d:
सापि कुम्भोदकैः स्नाता जीवत्पुत्रा प्रजावती .
अपठस्तु नरोपोष्य ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भवाम् .. 184.22 ..
6.3.m: She too, having bathed with the waters from the pot, has living sons and abundant progeny. / A man who cannot recite, having fasted, [if] a brahmin chants a single verse

6.3.s:
ṛcamekāṃ japanviprastathā parvaṇi yo nṛpa .
anṛcopoṣya gāyatrīṃ japedvai vedamātaram .. 184.23 ..
6.3.d:
ऋचमेकां जपन्विप्रस्तथा पर्वणि यो नृप .
अनृचोपोष्य गायत्रीं जपेद्वै वेदमातरम् .. 184.23 ..
6.3.m: Originating from the Ṛg, Yajus, or Sāman on a festive occasion, O king; / Or one who cannot recite verses, having fasted, should chant the Gāyatrī, the mother of the Vedas,

6.3.s:
japannavamyāṃ viprendro mucyate pāpasañcayāt .
evaṃ tu kathitaṃ tāta purāṇoktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ .. 184.24 ..
6.3.d:
जपन्नवम्यां विप्रेन्द्रो मुच्यते पापसञ्चयात् .
एवं तु कथितं तात पुराणोक्तं महर्षिभिः .. 184.24 ..
6.3.m: Chanting on the ninth, that best of brahmins is freed from the accumulation of sins. / Thus has it been related, dear one, as told in the Purāṇas by the great seers.

6.3.s:
dhautapāpaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ mama .
prāṇatyāgaṃ tu yaḥ kuryājjale vāgnau sthale'pi vā .. 184.25 ..
6.3.d:
धौतपापं महापुण्यं शिवेन कथितं मम .
प्राणत्यागं तु यः कुर्याज्जले वाग्नौ स्थलेऽपि वा .. 184.25 ..
6.3.m: Dhautapāpa, bringing great merit, was recounted to me by Śiva. / Whoever gives up their life in water, in fire, or on dry ground,

6.3.s:
sa gacchati vimānena jvalanārkasamaprabhaḥ .
haṃsabarhiprayuktena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 184.26 ..
6.3.d:
स गच्छति विमानेन ज्वलनार्कसमप्रभः .
हंसबर्हिप्रयुक्तेन सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः .. 184.26 ..
6.3.m: He goes by aerial chariot, equal in splendour to the blazing sun, / Drawn by swans and peacocks, served by hosts of apsarases,

6.3.s:
śivasya paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatsurairapi durlabham .
krīḍate svecchayā tatra yāvaccandrārkatārakam .. 184.27 ..
6.3.d:
शिवस्य परमं स्थानं यत्सुरैरपि दुर्लभम् .
क्रीडते स्वेच्छया तत्र यावच्चन्द्रार्कतारकम् .. 184.27 ..
6.3.m: To the supreme abode of Śiva, which is difficult even for the gods to attain; / He sports there at his pleasure for as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure.

6.3.s:
dhautapāpe tu yā nārī kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam .
tatkṣaṇādeva sā pārtha puruṣatvamavāpnuyāt .. 184.28 ..
6.3.d:
धौतपापे तु या नारी कुरुते प्राणसंक्षयम् .
तत्क्षणादेव सा पार्थ पुरुषत्वमवाप्नुयात् .. 184.28 ..
6.3.m: And whatever woman gives up her life at Dhautapāpa, / From that very moment, O son of Pṛthā, she attains manhood.

6.3.s:
atha kiṃ bahunoktena śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham .
tadakṣayaphalaṃ sarvaṃ dhautapāpe kṛtaṃ nṛpa .. 184.29 ..
6.3.d:
अथ किं बहुनोक्तेन शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम् .
तदक्षयफलं सर्वं धौतपापे कृतं नृप .. 184.29 ..
6.3.m: Now, what is the use of saying more? Whether good or bad, / All that is done at Dhautapāpa yields imperishable fruit, O king.

6.3.s:
saṃnyasenniyamenānnaṃ saṃnyasedviṣayādikam .
phalamūlādikaṃ caiva jalamekaṃ na saṃtyajet .. 184.30 ..
6.3.d:
संन्यसेन्नियमेनान्नं संन्यसेद्विषयादिकम् .
फलमूलादिकं चैव जलमेकं न संत्यजेत् .. 184.30 ..
6.3.m: One should strictly renounce food, one should renounce objects of sense and the like, / As well as fruits, roots, and the like; one should not abandon water alone.

6.3.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha rudralokaṃ sa gacchati .
tatra bhuktvākhilānbhogāñjāyate bhuvi bhūpatiḥ .. 184.31 ..
.. iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe
revākhaṇḍe dhautapāpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..
asya pṛṣṭhasya sāmagrī hetu nimnalikhita srotasya pāṭhasya upayogaḥ kṛtaṃ bhavati --
Sanskrit World
6.3.d:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति .
तत्र भुक्त्वाखिलान्भोगाञ्जायते भुवि भूपतिः .. 184.31 ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां पञ्चम आवन्त्यखण्डे
रेवाखण्डे धौतपापतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम चतुरशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..
अस्य पृष्ठस्य सामग्री हेतु निम्नलिखित स्रोतस्य पाठस्य उपयोगः कृतं भवति --
सन्स्क्रित् Wओर्ल्द्
6.3.m:
Whoever acts thus, O son of Pṛthā, goes to the world of Rudra. / Having enjoyed all pleasures there, he is born as a king on earth.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Dhautapāpa Tīrtha', in the Revā Section of the Fifth Avantī Section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.
